name: prop
statement: theorem prop (x : Subtype p) : p x

name: forall'
statement: protected theorem forall' {q : ∀ x, p x → Prop} : (∀ x h, q x h) ↔ ∀ x : { a // p a }, q x x.2

name: exists'
statement: protected theorem exists' {q : ∀ x, p x → Prop} : (∃ x h, q x h) ↔ ∃ x : { a // p a }, q x x.2

name: heq_iff_coe_eq
statement:
theorem heq_iff_coe_eq (h : ∀ x, p x ↔ q x) {a1 : { x // p x }} {a2 : { x // q x }} :
    a1 ≍ a2 ↔ (a1 : α) = (a2 : α)
proof:
:=
  Eq.rec
    (motive := fun (pp : (α → Prop)) _ ↦ ∀ a2' : {x // pp x}, a1 ≍ a2' ↔ (a1 : α) = (a2' : α))
    (by grind) (funext <| fun x ↦ propext (h x)) a2

name: heq_iff_coe_heq
statement:
lemma heq_iff_coe_heq {α β : Sort _} {p : α → Prop} {q : β → Prop} {a : {x // p x}}
    {b : {y // q y}} (h : α = β) (h' : p ≍ q) : a ≍ b ↔ (a : α) ≍ (b : β)

name: coe_eta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_eta (a : { a // p a }) (h : p a) : mk (↑a) h = a

name: coe_mk
statement: theorem coe_mk (a h) : (@mk α p a h : α) = a

name: mk_eq_mk
statement: theorem mk_eq_mk {a h a' h'} : @mk α p a h = @mk α p a' h' ↔ a = a'

name: coe_eq_of_eq_mk
statement: theorem coe_eq_of_eq_mk {a : { a // p a }} {b : α} (h : ↑a = b) : a = ⟨b, h ▸ a.2⟩

name: coe_eq_iff
statement: theorem coe_eq_iff {a : { a // p a }} {b : α} : ↑a = b ↔ ∃ h, a = ⟨b, h⟩

name: coe_injective

name: val_injective

name: coe_inj
statement: theorem coe_inj {a b : Subtype p} : (a : α) = b ↔ a = b

name: val_inj
statement: theorem val_inj {a b : Subtype p} : a.val = b.val ↔ a = b

name: coe_ne_coe
statement: lemma coe_ne_coe {a b : Subtype p} : (a : α) ≠ b ↔ a ≠ b

name: _root_.exists_eq_subtype_mk_iff
statement:

name: restrict_apply
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem restrict_apply {α} {β : α → Type*} (f : ∀ x, β x) (p : α → Prop) (x : Subtype p) :
    restrict p f x = f x.1

name: restrict_def
statement:
theorem restrict_def {α β} (f : α → β) (p : α → Prop) :
    restrict p f = f ∘ (fun (a : Subtype p) ↦ a)

name: restrict_injective
statement:
theorem restrict_injective {α β} {f : α → β} (p : α → Prop) (h : Injective f) :

name: surjective_restrict
statement:
theorem surjective_restrict {α} {β : α → Type*} [ne : ∀ a, Nonempty (β a)] (p : α → Prop) :
    Surjective fun f : ∀ x, β x ↦ restrict p f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact fun f ↦ ⟨fun x ↦ if h : p x then f ⟨x, h⟩ else Nonempty.some (ne x), by grind⟩

name: coind_injective
statement:
theorem coind_injective {α β} {f : α → β} {p : β → Prop} (h : ∀ a, p (f a)) (hf : Injective f) :
    Injective (coind f h)
proof: := fun x y hxy ↦ hf <| by apply congr_arg Subtype.val hxy

name: coind_injective_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem coind_injective_iff {α β} {f : α → β} {p : β → Prop} (h : ∀ a, p (f a)) :

name: map_def
statement:
theorem map_def {p : α → Prop} {q : β → Prop} (f : α → β) (h : ∀ a, p a → q (f a)) :

map_id

name: map_eq
statement:
theorem map_eq {p : α → Prop} {q : β → Prop} {f g : α → β}
    (h₁ : ∀ a : α, p a → q (f a)) (h₂ : ∀ a : α, p a → q (g a))
    {x y : Subtype p} :
    map f h₁ x = map g h₂ y ↔ f x = g y

name: map_ne
statement:
theorem map_ne {p : α → Prop} {q : β → Prop} {f g : α → β}
    (h₁ : ∀ a : α, p a → q (f a)) (h₂ : ∀ a : α, p a → q (g a))
    {x y : Subtype p} :
    map f h₁ x ≠ map g h₂ y ↔ f x ≠ g y

name: equivalence

name: coe_prop

theorem coe_prop {S : Set α} (a : { a // a ∈ S }) : ↑a ∈ S

name: ext
statement:
theorem ext {α : Sort*} : ∀ {s t : Setoid α}, (∀ a b, s a b ↔ t a b) → s = t
  | ⟨r, _⟩, ⟨p, _⟩, Eq =>
  by have : r = p
proof:
:= funext fun a ↦ funext fun b ↦ propext <| Eq a b
     subst this
     rfl

name: lift_mk
statement:
theorem lift_mk (f : α → γ) (h : ∀ a₁ a₂, r a₁ a₂ → f a₁ = f a₂) (a : α) :

statement:

name: surjective_lift
statement:
@[simp] theorem surjective_lift {f : α → γ} (h : ∀ a₁ a₂, r a₁ a₂ → f a₁ = f a₂) :
    Function.Surjective (lift f h) ↔ Function.Surjective f
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hf => hf.comp Quot.exists_rep, fun hf y => let ⟨x, hx⟩ := hf y; ⟨Quot.mk _ x, hx⟩⟩

name: lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift₂_mk (f : α → β → γ) (hr : ∀ a b₁ b₂, s b₁ b₂ → f a b₁ = f a b₂)
    (hs : ∀ a₁ a₂ b, r a₁ a₂ → f a₁ b = f a₂ b)
    (a : α) (b : β) : Quot.lift₂ f hr hs (Quot.mk r a) (Quot.mk s b) = f a b

statement:

theorem liftOn₂_mk (a : α) (b : β) (f : α → β → γ) (hr : ∀ a b₁ b₂, s b₁ b₂ → f a b₁ = f a b₂)
    (hs : ∀ a₁ a₂ b, r a₁ a₂ → f a₁ b = f a₂ b) :
    Quot.liftOn₂ (Quot.mk r a) (Quot.mk s b) f hr hs = f a b

statement:

theorem map₂_mk (f : α → β → γ) (hr : ∀ a b₁ b₂, s b₁ b₂ → t (f a b₁) (f a b₂))
    (hs : ∀ a₁ a₂ b, r a₁ a₂ → t (f a₁ b) (f a₂ b)) (a : α) (b : β) :
    Quot.map₂ f hr hs (Quot.mk r a) (Quot.mk s b) = Quot.mk t (f a b)

name: induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected theorem induction_on₂ {δ : Quot r → Quot s → Prop} (q₁ : Quot r) (q₂ : Quot s)
    (h : ∀ a b, δ (Quot.mk r a) (Quot.mk s b)) : δ q₁ q₂
proof:
:=
  Quot.ind (β := fun a ↦ δ a q₂) (fun a₁ ↦ Quot.ind (fun a₂ ↦ h a₁ a₂) q₂) q₁

name: induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected theorem induction_on₃ {δ : Quot r → Quot s → Quot t → Prop} (q₁ : Quot r)
    (q₂ : Quot s) (q₃ : Quot t) (h : ∀ a b c, δ (Quot.mk r a) (Quot.mk s b) (Quot.mk t c)) :
    δ q₁ q₂ q₃
proof:
:=
  Quot.ind (β := fun a ↦ δ a q₂ q₃) (fun a₁ ↦ Quot.ind (β := fun b ↦ δ _ b q₃)
    (fun a₂ ↦ Quot.ind (fun a₃ ↦ h a₁ a₂ a₃) q₃) q₂) q₁

name: Quotient.forall
statement:
theorem Quotient.forall {α : Sort*} {s : Setoid α} {p : Quotient s → Prop} :
    (∀ a, p a) ↔ ∀ a : α, p ⟦a⟧
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ ↦ h _, fun h a ↦ a.ind h⟩

name: Quotient.exists
statement:
theorem Quotient.exists {α : Sort*} {s : Setoid α} {p : Quotient s → Prop} :

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨q, hq⟩ ↦ q.ind (motive := (p · → _)) .intro hq, fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ ⟨⟦a⟧, ha⟩⟩

theorem Quotient.lift₂_mk {α : Sort*} {β : Sort*} {γ : Sort*} {_ : Setoid α} {_ : Setoid β}
    (f : α → β → γ)

name: Quotient.liftOn
statement:

theorem Quotient.liftOn₂_mk {α : Sort*} {β : Sort*} {γ : Sort*} {_ : Setoid α} {_ : Setoid β}

name: Quotient.induction_on_pi
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem Quotient.induction_on_pi {ι : Type*} {α : ι → Sort*} {s : ∀ i, Setoid (α i)}

name: eq_none_iff'

  ⟨fun e => e.symm ▸ id, fun h => eq_none_iff.2 fun _ h' => h h'.fst⟩

name: some_ne_none

name: ne_none_iff
statement: theorem ne_none_iff {o : Part α} : o ≠ none ↔ ∃ x, o = some x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [Ne, eq_none_iff', not_not]
    exact fun h => ⟨o.get h, eq_some_iff.2 (get_mem h)⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    apply some_ne_none

statement: theorem mem_toOption {o : Part α} [Decidable o.Dom] {a : α} : a ∈ toOption o ↔ a ∈ o
proof:
:= by
  unfold toOption
  by_cases h : o.Dom
  · simpa [h] using ⟨fun h => ⟨_, h⟩, fun ⟨_, h⟩ => h⟩
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceDIte, Option.mem_def, reduceCtorEq, false_iff]
    exact mt Exists.fst h

@[simp]
theorem elim_toOption {α β : Type*} (a : Part α) [Decidable a.Dom] (b : β) (f : α → β) :

proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h.toOption]
    rfl
  · rw [Part.toOption_eq_none_iff.2 h]
    rfl

  | Option.none => ⟨fun h => h.fst.elim, fun h => Option.noConfusion rfl (heq_of_eq h)⟩
  | Option.some _ => ⟨fun h => congr_arg Option.some h.snd, fun h => ⟨trivial, Option.some.inj h⟩⟩

@[simp]

    · rfl

name: induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected theorem induction_on {P : Part α → Prop} (a : Part α) (hnone : P none)
    (hsome : ∀ a : α, P (some a)) : P a
proof:
:=
  (Classical.em a.Dom).elim (fun h => Part.some_get h ▸ hsome _) fun h =>
    (eq_none_iff'.2 h).symm ▸ hnone

name: le_total_of_le_of_le
statement:
theorem le_total_of_le_of_le {x y : Part α} (z : Part α) (hx : x ≤ z) (hy : y ≤ z) :
    x ≤ y ∨ y ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  rcases Part.eq_none_or_eq_some x with (h | ⟨b, h₀⟩)
  · rw [h]
    left
    apply OrderBot.bot_le _
  right; intro b' h₁
  rw [Part.eq_some_iff] at h₀
  have hx := hx _ h₀; have hy := hy _ h₁
  have hx := Part.mem_unique hx hy; subst hx
  exact h₀

statement:

name: Dom.bind
statement: protected theorem Dom.bind {o : Part α} (h : o.Dom) (f : α → Part β) : o.bind f = f (o.get h)
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  simp only [Part.mem_bind_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, fun hb => ⟨o.get h, Part.get_mem _, hb⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨a, ha, hb⟩
  rwa [Part.get_eq_of_mem ha]

  by_cases h : o.Dom
  · simp_rw [h.toOption, h.bind]

  · rw [Part.toOption_eq_none_iff.2 h]

    simp only [mem_bind_iff]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨_, ⟨_, h₁, h₂⟩, h₃⟩ => ⟨_, h₁, _, h₂, h₃⟩,

name: bind_le
statement:
theorem bind_le {α} (x : Part α) (f : α → Part β) (y : Part β) :
    x >>= f ≤ y ↔ ∀ a, a ∈ x → f a ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · intro a h' b
    have h := h b
    simp only [and_imp, bind_eq_bind, mem_bind_iff, exists_imp] at h
    apply h _ h'
  · intro b h'
    simp only [bind_eq_bind, mem_bind_iff] at h'
    rcases h' with ⟨a, h₀, h₁⟩
    apply h _ h₀ _ h₁

  · rintro ⟨h₀, h₁⟩

  rintro ⟨h₀, _, h₂⟩; exact ⟨h₀, h₂⟩

name: mul_def

name: dom_of_mem_fix
statement: theorem dom_of_mem_fix {f : α →. β ⊕ α} {a : α} {b : β} (h : b ∈ f.fix a) : (f a).Dom
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := Part.mem_assert_iff.1 h
  rw [WellFounded.fixF_eq] at h₂; exact h₂.fst.fst

name: mem_fix_iff
statement:
theorem mem_fix_iff {f : α →. β ⊕ α} {a : α} {b : β} :
    b ∈ f.fix a ↔ Sum.inl b ∈ f a ∨ ∃ a', Sum.inr a' ∈ f a ∧ b ∈ f.fix a'
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    let ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := Part.mem_assert_iff.1 h
    rw [WellFounded.fixF_eq] at h₂
    simp only [Part.mem_assert_iff] at h₂
    obtain ⟨h₂, h₃⟩ := h₂
    split at h₃
    next e => simp only [Part.mem_some_iff] at h₃; subst b; exact Or.inl ⟨h₂, e⟩
    next e => exact Or.inr ⟨_, ⟨_, e⟩, Part.mem_assert _ h₃⟩,
   fun h => by
    simp only [fix, Part.mem_assert_iff]
    rcases h with (⟨h₁, h₂⟩ | ⟨a', h, h₃⟩)
    · refine ⟨⟨_, fun y h' => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · injection Part.mem_unique ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ h'
      · rw [WellFounded.fixF_eq]
        
        apply Part.mem_assert h₁
        split
        next e =>
          injection h₂.symm.trans e with h; simp [h]
        next e =>
          injection h₂.symm.trans e
    · simp only [fix, Part.mem_assert_iff] at h₃
      obtain ⟨h₃, h₄⟩ := h₃
      refine ⟨⟨_, fun y h' => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · injection Part.mem_unique h h' with e
        exact e ▸ h₃
      · obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h
        grind [WellFounded.fixF_eq]⟩

  · intro h

name: fixInduction_spec
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixInduction
  generalize_proofs
  induction ‹Acc _ _›
  rfl

name: fixInduction'_stop
statement:
theorem fixInduction'_stop {C : α → Sort*} {f : α →. β ⊕ α} {b : β} {a : α} (h : b ∈ f.fix a)
    (fa : Sum.inl b ∈ f a) (hbase : ∀ a_final : α, Sum.inl b ∈ f a_final → C a_final)
    (hind : ∀ a₀ a₁ : α, b ∈ f.fix a₁ → Sum.inr a₁ ∈ f a₀ → C a₁ → C a₀) :
    @fixInduction' _ _ C _ _ _ h hbase hind = hbase a fa
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixInduction'
  rw [fixInduction_spec]
  
  refine Eq.rec (motive := fun x e ↦
      Sum.casesOn x ?_ ?_ (Eq.trans (Part.get_eq_of_mem fa (dom_of_mem_fix h)) e) = hbase a fa) ?_
    (Part.get_eq_of_mem fa (dom_of_mem_fix h)).symm
  simp

name: fixInduction'_fwd
statement:
theorem fixInduction'_fwd {C : α → Sort*} {f : α →. β ⊕ α} {b : β} {a a' : α} (h : b ∈ f.fix a)
    (h' : b ∈ f.fix a') (fa : Sum.inr a' ∈ f a)
    (hbase : ∀ a_final : α, Sum.inl b ∈ f a_final → C a_final)
    (hind : ∀ a₀ a₁ : α, b ∈ f.fix a₁ → Sum.inr a₁ ∈ f a₀ → C a₁ → C a₀) :
    @fixInduction' _ _ C _ _ _ h hbase hind = hind a a' h' fa (fixInduction' h' hbase hind)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fixInduction'
  rw [fixInduction_spec]
  
  refine Eq.rec (motive := fun x e =>
      Sum.casesOn (motive := fun y => (f a).get (dom_of_mem_fix h) = y → C a) x ?_ ?_
      (Eq.trans (Part.get_eq_of_mem fa (dom_of_mem_fix h)) e) = _) ?_
    (Part.get_eq_of_mem fa (dom_of_mem_fix h)).symm
  simp

statement: theorem core_def (s : Set β) : f.core s = { x | ∀ y, y ∈ f x → y ∈ s }

name: mem_core
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_core (x : α) (s : Set β) : x ∈ f.core s ↔ ∀ y, y ∈ f x → y ∈ s

name: compl_dom_subset_core
statement: theorem compl_dom_subset_core (s : Set β) : f.Domᶜ ⊆ f.core s
proof:
:= fun x hx y fxy =>
  absurd ((mem_dom f x).mpr ⟨y, fxy⟩) hx

name: core_mono
statement: theorem core_mono {s t : Set β} (h : s ⊆ t) : f.core s ⊆ f.core t

name: core_inter
statement: theorem core_inter (s t : Set β) : f.core (s ∩ t) = f.core s ∩ f.core t

name: mem_core_res
statement:
theorem mem_core_res (f : α → β) (s : Set α) (t : Set β) (x : α) :
    x ∈ (res f s).core t ↔ x ∈ s → f x ∈ t

name: core_res
statement: theorem core_res (f : α → β) (s : Set α) (t : Set β) : (res f s).core t = sᶜ ∪ f ⁻¹' t
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_core_res]
  by_cases h : x ∈ s <;> simp [h]

name: core_restrict
statement: theorem core_restrict (f : α → β) (s : Set β) : (f : α →. β).core s = s.preimage f

name: preimage_subset_core
statement: theorem preimage_subset_core (f : α →. β) (s : Set β) : f.preimage s ⊆ f.core s
proof:
:=
  fun _ ⟨y, ys, fxy⟩ y' fxy' =>
  have : y = y' := Part.mem_unique fxy fxy'
  this ▸ ys

name: preimage_eq
statement: theorem preimage_eq (f : α →. β) (s : Set β) : f.preimage s = f.core s ∩ f.Dom
proof:
:=
  Set.eq_of_subset_of_subset (Set.subset_inter (f.preimage_subset_core s) (f.preimage_subset_dom s))
    fun x ⟨xcore, xdom⟩ =>
    let y := (f x).get xdom
    have ys : y ∈ s := xcore (Part.get_mem _)
    show x ∈ f.preimage s from ⟨(f x).get xdom, ys, Part.get_mem _⟩

name: core_eq
statement: theorem core_eq (f : α →. β) (s : Set β) : f.core s = f.preimage s ∪ f.Domᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [preimage_eq, Set.inter_union_distrib_right, Set.union_comm (Dom f), Set.compl_union_self,
    Set.inter_univ, Set.union_eq_self_of_subset_right (f.compl_dom_subset_core s)]

name: preimage_asSubtype
statement:
theorem preimage_asSubtype (f : α →. β) (s : Set β) :
    f.asSubtype ⁻¹' s = Subtype.val ⁻¹' f.preimage s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, PFun.asSubtype, PFun.mem_preimage]
  show f.fn x.val _ ∈ s ↔ ∃ y ∈ s, y ∈ f x.val
  exact
    Iff.intro (fun h => ⟨_, h, Part.get_mem _⟩) fun ⟨y, ys, fxy⟩ =>
      have : f.fn x.val x.property ∈ f x.val := Part.get_mem _
      Part.mem_unique fxy this ▸ ys

name: mem_prodLift

theorem mem_prodLift {f : α →. β} {g : α →. γ} {x : α} {y : β × γ} :
    y ∈ f.prodLift g x ↔ y.1 ∈ f x ∧ y.2 ∈ g x
proof:
:= by
  trans ∃ hp hq, (f x).get hp = y.1 ∧ (g x).get hq = y.2
  · simp only [prodLift, Part.mem_mk_iff, And.exists, Prod.ext_iff]
  · simp only [exists_and_left, exists_and_right, Membership.mem, Part.Mem]

  · simp only [prodMap, Part.mem_mk_iff, And.exists, Prod.ext_iff]

name: ofFin_intCast
statement: theorem ofFin_intCast (z : ℤ) : ofFin (z : Fin (2 ^ w)) = ↑z
proof:
:= by
  cases w
  case zero =>
    simp only [eq_nil]
  case succ w =>
    apply BitVec.eq_of_toInt_eq
    rw [toInt_ofFin, Fin.val_intCast, Int.natCast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, Int.ofNat_toNat,
      toInt_intCast]
    rw [Int.max_eq_left]
    · have h : (2 ^ (w + 1) : Int) = (2 ^ (w + 1) : Nat) := by simp
      rw [h, Int.emod_bmod]
    · omega

name: toFin_nsmul

proof:
:=
  toFin_mul _ _ |>.trans <| by
    open scoped Fin.CommRing in
    simp only [natCast_eq_ofNat, toFin_ofNat, Fin.ofNat_eq_cast, nsmul_eq_mul]

    simp only [zsmul_eq_mul, toFin_intCast]

proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => simp [ih, BitVec.pow_succ]

statement:
@[simp]
theorem erase_toFinmap (a : α) (s : AList β) : erase a ⟦s⟧ = AList.toFinmap (s.erase a)

name: keys_erase_toFinset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem keys_erase_toFinset (a : α) (s : AList β) : keys ⟦s.erase a⟧ = (keys ⟦s⟧).erase a

name: keys_erase
statement:
@[simp]
theorem keys_erase (a : α) (s : Finmap β) : (erase a s).keys = s.keys.erase a
proof:
:=
  induction_on s fun s => by simp

name: mem_erase
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_erase {a a' : α} {s : Finmap β} : a' ∈ erase a s ↔ a' ≠ a ∧ a' ∈ s
proof:
:=
  induction_on s fun s => by simp

name: notMem_erase_self
statement: theorem notMem_erase_self {a : α} {s : Finmap β} : a ∉ erase a s
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_erase, not_and_or, not_not]
  left
  rfl

name: lookup_erase
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookup_erase (a) (s : Finmap β) : lookup a (erase a s) = none

name: lookup_erase_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookup_erase_ne {a a'} {s : Finmap β} (h : a ≠ a') : lookup a (erase a' s) = lookup a s

name: erase_erase
statement: theorem erase_erase {a a' : α} {s : Finmap β} : erase a (erase a' s) = erase a' (erase a s)
proof:
:=
  induction_on s fun s => ext (by simp only [AList.erase_erase, erase_toFinmap])

name: insert_toFinmap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insert_toFinmap (a : α) (b : β a) (s : AList β) :
    insert a b (AList.toFinmap s) = AList.toFinmap (s.insert a b)

name: entries_insert_of_notMem
statement:
theorem entries_insert_of_notMem {a : α} {b : β a} {s : Finmap β} :
    a ∉ s → (insert a b s).entries = ⟨a, b⟩ ::ₘ s.entries
proof:
:=
  induction_on s fun s h => by
    simp [AList.entries_insert_of_notMem (mt mem_toFinmap.1 h), -entries_insert]

name: mem_insert
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_insert {a a' : α} {b' : β a'} {s : Finmap β} : a ∈ insert a' b' s ↔ a = a' ∨ a ∈ s

name: lookup_insert
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookup_insert {a} {b : β a} (s : Finmap β) : lookup a (insert a b s) = some b
proof:
:=
  induction_on s fun s => by simp only [insert_toFinmap, lookup_toFinmap, AList.lookup_insert]

name: lookup_insert_of_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookup_insert_of_ne {a a'} {b : β a} (s : Finmap β) (h : a' ≠ a) :
    lookup a' (insert a b s) = lookup a' s
proof:
:=
  induction_on s fun s => by simp only [insert_toFinmap, lookup_toFinmap, lookup_insert_ne h]

name: insert_insert
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insert_insert {a} {b b' : β a} (s : Finmap β) :
    (s.insert a b).insert a b' = s.insert a b'
proof:
:=
  induction_on s fun s => by simp only [insert_toFinmap, AList.insert_insert]

name: insert_insert_of_ne
statement:
theorem insert_insert_of_ne {a a'} {b : β a} {b' : β a'} (s : Finmap β) (h : a ≠ a') :
    (s.insert a b).insert a' b' = (s.insert a' b').insert a b
proof:
:=
  induction_on s fun s => by
    simp only [insert_toFinmap, AList.toFinmap_eq, AList.insert_insert_of_ne _ h]

name: toFinmap_cons
statement:
theorem toFinmap_cons (a : α) (b : β a) (xs : List (Sigma β)) :
    List.toFinmap (⟨a, b⟩ :: xs) = insert a b xs.toFinmap

name: mem_list_toFinmap
statement:
theorem mem_list_toFinmap (a : α) (xs : List (Sigma β)) :
    a ∈ xs.toFinmap ↔ ∃ b : β a, Sigma.mk a b ∈ xs
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp only [toFinmap_nil, notMem_empty, not_mem_nil, exists_false]
  | cons x xs =>
    obtain ⟨fst_i, snd_i⟩ := x
    simp only [toFinmap_cons, *, exists_or, mem_cons, mem_insert, exists_and_left, Sigma.mk.inj_iff]
    refine (or_congr_left <| and_iff_left_of_imp ?_).symm
    rintro rfl
    simp only [exists_eq, heq_iff_eq]

name: insert_singleton_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insert_singleton_eq {a : α} {b b' : β a} : insert a b (singleton a b') = singleton a b

name: extract_eq_lookup_erase
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extract_eq_lookup_erase (a : α) (s : Finmap β) : extract a s = (lookup a s, erase a s)
proof:
:=
  induction_on s fun s => by simp [extract]

name: mem_union
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_union {a} {s₁ s₂ : Finmap β} : a ∈ s₁ ∪ s₂ ↔ a ∈ s₁ ∨ a ∈ s₂

name: union_toFinmap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem union_toFinmap (s₁ s₂ : AList β) : (toFinmap s₁) ∪ (toFinmap s₂) = toFinmap (s₁ ∪ s₂)

name: keys_union
statement: theorem keys_union {s₁ s₂ : Finmap β} : (s₁ ∪ s₂).keys = s₁.keys ∪ s₂.keys
proof:
:=
  induction_on₂ s₁ s₂ fun s₁ s₂ => Finset.ext <| by simp [keys]

name: lookup_union_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookup_union_left {a} {s₁ s₂ : Finmap β} : a ∈ s₁ → lookup a (s₁ ∪ s₂) = lookup a s₁

name: lookup_union_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookup_union_right {a} {s₁ s₂ : Finmap β} : a ∉ s₁ → lookup a (s₁ ∪ s₂) = lookup a s₂

name: lookup_union_left_of_not_in
statement:
theorem lookup_union_left_of_not_in {a} {s₁ s₂ : Finmap β} (h : a ∉ s₂) :
    lookup a (s₁ ∪ s₂) = lookup a s₁
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h' : a ∈ s₁
  · rw [lookup_union_left h']
  · rw [lookup_union_right h', lookup_eq_none.mpr h, lookup_eq_none.mpr h']

name: mem_lookup_union'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_lookup_union' {a} {b : β a} {s₁ s₂ : Finmap β} :
    lookup a (s₁ ∪ s₂) = some b ↔ b ∈ lookup a s₁ ∨ a ∉ s₁ ∧ b ∈ lookup a s₂

name: mem_lookup_union
statement:
theorem mem_lookup_union {a} {b : β a} {s₁ s₂ : Finmap β} :
    b ∈ lookup a (s₁ ∪ s₂) ↔ b ∈ lookup a s₁ ∨ a ∉ s₁ ∧ b ∈ lookup a s₂

name: mem_lookup_union_middle
statement:
theorem mem_lookup_union_middle {a} {b : β a} {s₁ s₂ s₃ : Finmap β} :
    b ∈ lookup a (s₁ ∪ s₃) → a ∉ s₂ → b ∈ lookup a (s₁ ∪ s₂ ∪ s₃)
proof:
:=
  induction_on₃ s₁ s₂ s₃ fun _ _ _ => AList.mem_lookup_union_middle

name: insert_union
statement: theorem insert_union {a} {b : β a} {s₁ s₂ : Finmap β} : insert a b (s₁ ∪ s₂) = insert a b s₁ ∪ s₂
proof:
:=
  induction_on₂ s₁ s₂ fun a₁ a₂ => by simp [AList.insert_union]

name: union_assoc
statement: theorem union_assoc {s₁ s₂ s₃ : Finmap β} : s₁ ∪ s₂ ∪ s₃ = s₁ ∪ (s₂ ∪ s₃)
proof:
:=
  induction_on₃ s₁ s₂ s₃ fun s₁ s₂ s₃ => by
    simp only [AList.toFinmap_eq, union_toFinmap, AList.union_assoc]

name: empty_union
statement:
@[simp]
theorem empty_union {s₁ : Finmap β} : ∅ ∪ s₁ = s₁
proof:
:=
  induction_on s₁ fun s₁ => by
    rw [← empty_toFinmap]
    simp [-empty_toFinmap, union_toFinmap]

name: union_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem union_empty {s₁ : Finmap β} : s₁ ∪ ∅ = s₁
proof:
:=
  induction_on s₁ fun s₁ => by
    rw [← empty_toFinmap]
    simp [-empty_toFinmap, union_toFinmap]

name: erase_union_singleton
statement:
theorem erase_union_singleton (a : α) (b : β a) (s : Finmap β) (h : s.lookup a = some b) :
    s.erase a ∪ singleton a b = s
proof:
:=
  ext_lookup fun x => by
    by_cases h' : x = a
    · subst a
      rw [lookup_union_right notMem_erase_self, lookup_singleton_eq, h]
    · have : x ∉ singleton a b := by rwa [mem_singleton]
      rw [lookup_union_left_of_not_in this, lookup_erase_ne h']

name: disjoint_empty
statement: theorem disjoint_empty (x : Finmap β) : Disjoint ∅ x

name: Disjoint.symm
statement:
@[symm]
theorem Disjoint.symm (x y : Finmap β) (h : Disjoint x y) : Disjoint y x
proof: := fun p hy hx => h p hx hy

name: Disjoint.symm_iff
statement: theorem Disjoint.symm_iff (x y : Finmap β) : Disjoint x y ↔ Disjoint y x

name: disjoint_union_left
statement:
theorem disjoint_union_left (x y z : Finmap β) :
    Disjoint (x ∪ y) z ↔ Disjoint x z ∧ Disjoint y z

name: disjoint_union_right
statement:
theorem disjoint_union_right (x y z : Finmap β) :
    Disjoint x (y ∪ z) ↔ Disjoint x y ∧ Disjoint x z
proof:
:= by
  rw [Disjoint.symm_iff, disjoint_union_left, Disjoint.symm_iff _ x, Disjoint.symm_iff _ x]

name: union_comm_of_disjoint
statement: theorem union_comm_of_disjoint {s₁ s₂ : Finmap β} : Disjoint s₁ s₂ → s₁ ∪ s₂ = s₂ ∪ s₁
proof:
:=
  induction_on₂ s₁ s₂ fun s₁ s₂ => by
    intro h
    simp only [AList.toFinmap_eq, union_toFinmap, AList.union_comm_of_disjoint h]

name: union_cancel
statement:
theorem union_cancel {s₁ s₂ s₃ : Finmap β} (h : Disjoint s₁ s₃) (h' : Disjoint s₂ s₃) :
    s₁ ∪ s₃ = s₂ ∪ s₃ ↔ s₁ = s₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h'' => by
    apply ext_lookup
    intro x
    have : (s₁ ∪ s₃).lookup x = (s₂ ∪ s₃).lookup x := h'' ▸ rfl
    by_cases hs₁ : x ∈ s₁
    · rwa [lookup_union_left hs₁, lookup_union_left_of_not_in (h _ hs₁)] at this
    · by_cases hs₂ : x ∈ s₂
      · rwa [lookup_union_left_of_not_in (h' _ hs₂), lookup_union_left hs₂] at this
      · rw [lookup_eq_none.mpr hs₁, lookup_eq_none.mpr hs₂], fun h => h ▸ rfl⟩

name: card_ofList
statement:
lemma card_ofList [DecidableEq α] (xs : List α) (h : ∀ x : α, x ∈ xs) :
    (FinEnum.ofList xs h).card = xs.dedup.length

name: mem_toList
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_toList [FinEnum α] (x : α) : x ∈ toList α
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toList, List.mem_map, List.mem_finRange, true_and]; exists equiv x; simp

name: nodup_toList
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nodup_toList [FinEnum α] : List.Nodup (toList α)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [toList]; apply List.Nodup.map <;> [apply Equiv.injective; apply List.nodup_finRange]

name: card_ulift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_ulift [FinEnum (ULift α)] [FinEnum α] : card (ULift α) = card α

name: equiv_up
statement: @[simp] lemma equiv_up : equiv (ULift.up a) = equiv a

name: equiv_down
statement: @[simp] lemma equiv_down : equiv a'.down = equiv a'

name: up_equiv_symm
statement: @[simp] lemma up_equiv_symm : ULift.up (equiv.symm i) = (equiv (α := ULift α)).symm i

name: down_equiv_symm
statement: @[simp] lemma down_equiv_symm : ((equiv (α := ULift α)).symm i).down = equiv.symm i

name: card_punit

name: card_fin
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_fin {n} [FinEnum (Fin n)] : card (Fin n) = n

name: Finset.mem_enum
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem Finset.mem_enum [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) (xs : List α) :
    s ∈ Finset.enum xs ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ xs
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => simp [enum, eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [enum, List.bind_eq_flatMap, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_cons,
        List.not_mem_nil, or_false, ih]
      refine ⟨by aesop, fun hs => ⟨s.erase x, ?_⟩⟩
      simp only [or_iff_not_imp_left] at hs
      simp +contextual [eq_comm (a := s), or_iff_not_imp_left, hs]

name: card_eq_fintypeCard
statement: theorem card_eq_fintypeCard {α : Type u} [FinEnum α] [Fintype α] : card α = Fintype.card α

name: card_unique
statement: theorem card_unique {α : Type u} (e₁ e₂ : FinEnum α) : e₁.card = e₂.card
proof:
:=
  calc _
  _ = _ := @card_eq_fintypeCard _ e₁ inferInstance
  _ = _ := Fintype.card_congr' rfl
  _ = _ := @card_eq_fintypeCard _ e₂ inferInstance |>.symm

name: card_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem card_eq_zero_iff {α : Type u} [FinEnum α] : card α = 0 ↔ IsEmpty α

name: card_eq_zero
statement: theorem card_eq_zero {α : Type u} [FinEnum α] [IsEmpty α] : card α = 0

name: card_pos_iff
statement: theorem card_pos_iff {α : Type u} [FinEnum α] : 0 < card α ↔ Nonempty α

name: card_pos
statement: lemma card_pos {α : Type*} [FinEnum α] [Nonempty α] : 0 < card α

name: card_ne_zero
statement: lemma card_ne_zero {α : Type*} [FinEnum α] [Nonempty α] : card α ≠ 0

name: card_eq_one
statement: theorem card_eq_one (α : Type u) [FinEnum α] [Unique α] : card α = 1

statement: @[simp, grind =] lemma card_UInt8 : card UInt8 = 2 ^ 8

name: mem_pi_toList
statement:
theorem mem_pi_toList (xs : List α)
    (f : ∀ a, a ∈ xs → β a) : f ∈ pi xs fun x => toList (β x)

name: Pi.mem_enum
statement:
theorem Pi.mem_enum (f : ∀ a, β a) :
    f ∈ Pi.enum β
proof: := by simpa [Pi.enum] using ⟨fun a _ => f a, mem_pi_toList _ _, rfl⟩

name: cast_type
statement:
theorem cast_type (is : List ℕ) (eq : ds₁ = ds₂) (h : Forall₂ (· < ·) is ds₁) :
    (cast (congr_arg HolorIndex eq) ⟨is, h⟩).val = is

name: take_take
statement:
theorem take_take : ∀ t : HolorIndex (ds₁ ++ ds₂ ++ ds₃), t.assocRight.take = t.take.take
  | ⟨is, h⟩ =>
    Subtype.ext <| by
      simp [assocRight, take, cast_type, List.take_take, Nat.le_add_right]

name: drop_take
statement:
theorem drop_take : ∀ t : HolorIndex (ds₁ ++ ds₂ ++ ds₃), t.assocRight.drop.take = t.take.drop
  | ⟨is, h⟩ => Subtype.ext (by simp [assocRight, take, drop, cast_type, List.drop_take])

name: drop_drop
statement:
theorem drop_drop : ∀ t : HolorIndex (ds₁ ++ ds₂ ++ ds₃), t.assocRight.drop.drop = t.drop
  | ⟨is, h⟩ => Subtype.ext (by simp [assocRight, drop, cast_type, List.drop_drop])

end HolorIndex

/
def Holor (α : Type u) (ds : List ℕ)

name: cast_type
statement:
theorem cast_type (eq : ds₁ = ds₂) (a : Holor α ds₁) :
    cast (congr_arg (Holor α) eq) a = fun t => a (cast (congr_arg HolorIndex eq.symm) t)

name: mul_assoc0
statement:
theorem mul_assoc0 [Semigroup α] (x : Holor α ds₁) (y : Holor α ds₂) (z : Holor α ds₃) :
    x ⊗ y ⊗ z = (x ⊗ (y ⊗ z)).assocLeft
proof:
:=
  funext fun t : HolorIndex (ds₁ ++ ds₂ ++ ds₃) => by
    rw [assocLeft]
    unfold mul
    rw [mul_assoc, ← HolorIndex.take_take, ← HolorIndex.drop_take, ← HolorIndex.drop_drop,
      cast_type]
    · rfl
    rw [append_assoc]

name: mul_assoc
statement:
theorem mul_assoc [Semigroup α] (x : Holor α ds₁) (y : Holor α ds₂) (z : Holor α ds₃) :
    mul (mul x y) z ≍ mul x (mul y z)

name: mul_left_distrib
statement:
theorem mul_left_distrib [Distrib α] (x : Holor α ds₁) (y : Holor α ds₂) (z : Holor α ds₂) :
    x ⊗ (y + z) = x ⊗ y + x ⊗ z
proof: := funext fun t => left_distrib (x t.take) (y t.drop) (z t.drop)

name: mul_right_distrib
statement:
theorem mul_right_distrib [Distrib α] (x : Holor α ds₁) (y : Holor α ds₁) (z : Holor α ds₂) :
    (x + y) ⊗ z = x ⊗ z + y ⊗ z
proof: := funext fun t => add_mul (x t.take) (y t.take) (z t.drop)

name: mul_scalar_mul
statement:
theorem mul_scalar_mul [Mul α] (x : Holor α []) (y : Holor α ds) :
    x ⊗ y = x ⟨[], Forall₂.nil⟩ • y
proof:
:= by
  simp +unfoldPartialApp [mul, SMul.smul, HolorIndex.take, HolorIndex.drop,
    HSMul.hSMul]

name: holor_index_cons_decomp
statement:
theorem holor_index_cons_decomp (p : HolorIndex (d :: ds) → Prop) :
    ∀ t : HolorIndex (d :: ds),
      (∀ i is, ∀ h : t.1 = i :: is, p ⟨i :: is, by rw [← h]; exact t.2⟩) → p t
  | ⟨[], hforall₂⟩, _ => absurd (forall₂_nil_left_iff.1 hforall₂) (cons_ne_nil d ds)
  | ⟨i :: is, _⟩, hp => hp i is rfl

/

name: slice_eq
statement: theorem slice_eq (x : Holor α (d :: ds)) (y : Holor α (d :: ds)) (h : slice x = slice y) : x = y
proof:
:=
  funext fun t : HolorIndex (d :: ds) =>
    holor_index_cons_decomp (fun t => x t = y t) t fun i is hiis =>
      have hiisdds : Forall₂ (· < ·) (i :: is) (d :: ds) := by rw [← hiis]; exact t.2
      have hid : i < d := (forall₂_cons.1 hiisdds).1
      have hisds : Forall₂ (· < ·) is ds := (forall₂_cons.1 hiisdds).2
      calc
        x ⟨i :: is, _⟩ = slice x i hid ⟨is, hisds⟩ := congr_arg x (Subtype.ext rfl)
        _ = slice y i hid ⟨is, hisds⟩ := by rw [h]
        _ = y ⟨i :: is, _⟩ := congr_arg y (Subtype.ext rfl)

name: slice_unitVec_mul
statement:
theorem slice_unitVec_mul [Semiring α] {i : ℕ} {j : ℕ} (hid : i < d) (x : Holor α ds) :
    slice (unitVec d j ⊗ x) i hid = if i = j then x else 0
proof:
:=
  funext fun t : HolorIndex ds =>
    if h : i = j then by simp [slice, mul, HolorIndex.take, unitVec, HolorIndex.drop, h]
    else by simp [slice, mul, HolorIndex.take, unitVec, HolorIndex.drop, h]; rfl

name: slice_add
statement:
theorem slice_add [Add α] (i : ℕ) (hid : i < d) (x : Holor α (d :: ds)) (y : Holor α (d :: ds)) :
    slice x i hid + slice y i hid = slice (x + y) i hid
proof:
:=
  funext fun t => by simp [slice, (· + ·), Add.add]

name: slice_zero
statement: theorem slice_zero [Zero α] (i : ℕ) (hid : i < d) : slice (0 : Holor α (d :: ds)) i hid = 0

name: slice_sum
statement:
theorem slice_sum [AddCommMonoid α] {β : Type} (i : ℕ) (hid : i < d) (s : Finset β)
    (f : β → Holor α (d :: ds)) : (∑ x ∈ s, slice (f x) i hid) = slice (∑ x ∈ s, f x) i hid
proof:
:= by
  let := Classical.decEq β
  refine Finset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
  · simp [slice_zero]
  · intro _ _ h_not_in ih
    rw [Finset.sum_insert h_not_in, ih, slice_add, Finset.sum_insert h_not_in]

name: sum_unitVec_mul_slice
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_unitVec_mul_slice [Semiring α] (x : Holor α (d :: ds)) :
    (∑ i ∈ (Finset.range d).attach,
        unitVec d i ⊗ slice x i (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.1 i.prop))) =
      x
proof:
:= by
  apply slice_eq _ _ _
  ext i hid
  rw [← slice_sum]
  simp only [slice_unitVec_mul hid]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Subtype.mk i <| Finset.mem_range.2 hid)]
  · simp
  · intro (b : { x // x ∈ Finset.range d }) (_ : b ∈ (Finset.range d).attach) (hbi : b ≠ ⟨i, _⟩)
    have hbi' : i ≠ b := by simpa only [Ne, Subtype.ext_iff, Subtype.coe_mk] using hbi.symm
    simp [hbi']
  · intro (hid' : Subtype.mk i _ ∉ Finset.attach (Finset.range d))
    exfalso
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_attach _ _) hid'

name: cprankMax_nil
statement: theorem cprankMax_nil [Mul α] [AddMonoid α] (x : Holor α nil) : CPRankMax 1 x
proof:
:= by
  have h := CPRankMax.succ 0 x 0 (CPRankMax1.nil x) CPRankMax.zero
  rwa [add_zero x, zero_add] at h

name: cprankMax_1
statement:
theorem cprankMax_1 [Mul α] [AddMonoid α] {x : Holor α ds} (h : CPRankMax1 x) :
    CPRankMax 1 x
proof:
:= by
  have h' := CPRankMax.succ 0 x 0 h CPRankMax.zero
  rwa [zero_add, add_zero] at h'

name: cprankMax_add
statement:
theorem cprankMax_add [Mul α] [AddMonoid α] :
    ∀ {m : ℕ} {n : ℕ} {x : Holor α ds} {y : Holor α ds},
      CPRankMax m x → CPRankMax n y → CPRankMax (m + n) (x + y)
  | 0, n, x, y, hx, hy => by
    match hx with
    | CPRankMax.zero => simp only [zero_add, hy]
  | m + 1, n, _, y, CPRankMax.succ _ x₁ x₂ hx₁ hx₂, hy => by
    suffices CPRankMax (m + n + 1) (x₁ + (x₂ + y)) by
      simpa only [add_comm, add_assoc, add_left_comm] using this
    apply CPRankMax.succ
    · assumption
    · exact cprankMax_add hx₂ hy

name: cprankMax_mul
statement:
theorem cprankMax_mul [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : Holor α [d]) (y : Holor α ds), CPRankMax n y → CPRankMax n (x ⊗ y)
  | 0, x, _, CPRankMax.zero => by simp [mul_zero x, CPRankMax.zero]
  | n + 1, x, _, CPRankMax.succ _ y₁ y₂ hy₁ hy₂ => by
    rw [mul_left_distrib]
    rw [Nat.add_comm]
    apply cprankMax_add
    · exact cprankMax_1 (CPRankMax1.cons _ _ hy₁)
    · exact cprankMax_mul _ x y₂ hy₂

name: cprankMax_sum
statement:
theorem cprankMax_sum [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] {β} {n : ℕ} (s : Finset β)
    (f : β → Holor α ds) : (∀ x ∈ s, CPRankMax n (f x)) → CPRankMax (s.card * n) (∑ x ∈ s, f x)
proof:
:=
  letI := Classical.decEq β
  Finset.induction_on s (by simp [CPRankMax.zero])
    (by
      intro x s (h_x_notin_s : x ∉ s) ih h_cprank
      simp only [Finset.sum_insert h_x_notin_s, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem h_x_notin_s]
      rw [Nat.right_distrib]
      simp only [Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_comm]
      have ih' : CPRankMax (Finset.card s * n) (∑ x ∈ s, f x) := by grind
      exact cprankMax_add (h_cprank x (Finset.mem_insert_self x s)) ih')

name: cprankMax_upper_bound
statement:
theorem cprankMax_upper_bound [Semiring α] : ∀ {ds}, ∀ x : Holor α ds, CPRankMax ds.prod x
  | [], x => cprankMax_nil x
  | d :: ds, x => by
    have h_summands :
      ∀ i : { x // x ∈ Finset.range d },
        CPRankMax ds.prod (unitVec d i.1 ⊗ slice x i.1 (mem_range.1 i.2))
proof:
:=
      fun i => cprankMax_mul _ _ _ (cprankMax_upper_bound (slice x i.1 (mem_range.1 i.2)))
    have h_dds_prod : (List.cons d ds).prod = Finset.card (Finset.range d) * prod ds := by
      simp [Finset.card_range]
    have :
      CPRankMax (Finset.card (Finset.attach (Finset.range d)) * prod ds)
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.attach (Finset.range d),
          unitVec d i.val ⊗ slice x i.val (mem_range.1 i.2)) :=
      cprankMax_sum (Finset.range d).attach _ fun i _ => h_summands i
    have h_cprankMax_sum :
      CPRankMax (Finset.card (Finset.range d) * prod ds)
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.attach (Finset.range d),
          unitVec d i.val ⊗ slice x i.val (mem_range.1 i.2)) := by rwa [Finset.card_attach] at this
    rw [← sum_unitVec_mul_slice x]
    rw [h_dds_prod]
    exact h_cprankMax_sum

name: cprank_upper_bound
statement: theorem cprank_upper_bound [Ring α] : ∀ {ds}, ∀ x : Holor α ds, cprank x ≤ ds.prod
proof:
:=
  fun {ds} x =>
  letI := Classical.decPred fun n : ℕ => CPRankMax n x
  Nat.find_min' ⟨ds.prod, show (fun n => CPRankMax n x) ds.prod from cprankMax_upper_bound x⟩
    (cprankMax_upper_bound x)

def insert (a : α) (v : Vector3 α n) (i : Fin2 (n + 1)) : Vector3 α (n + 1)

name: insert_fz
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insert_fz (a : α) (v : Vector3 α n) : insert a v fz = a :: v
proof:
:= by
  refine funext fun j => j.cases' ?_ ?_ <;> intros <;> rfl

name: insert_fs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insert_fs (a : α) (b : α) (v : Vector3 α n) (i : Fin2 (n + 1)) :
    insert a (b :: v) (fs i) = b :: insert a v i
proof:
:=
  funext fun j => by
    refine j.cases' (by simp [insert, insertPerm]) fun j => ?_
    simp only [insert, insertPerm, succ_eq_add_one, cons_fs]
    refine Fin2.cases' ?_ ?_ (insertPerm i j) <;> simp

name: append_insert
statement:
theorem append_insert (a : α) (t : Vector3 α m) (v : Vector3 α n) (i : Fin2 (n + 1))
    (e : (n + 1) + m = (n + m) + 1) :
    insert a (t +-+ v) (Eq.recOn e (i.add m)) = Eq.recOn e (t +-+ insert a v i)
proof:
:= by
  refine Vector3.recOn t (fun e => ?_) (@fun k b t IH _ => ?_) e
  · rfl
  have e' : (n + 1) + k = (n + k) + 1 := by lia
  change
    insert a (b :: t +-+ v)
      (Eq.recOn (congr_arg (· + 1) e' : _ + 1 = _) (fs (add i k))) =
      Eq.recOn (congr_arg (· + 1) e' : _ + 1 = _) (b :: t +-+ insert a v i)
  rw [← (Eq.recOn e' rfl :
      fs (Eq.recOn e' (i.add k) : Fin2 ((n + k) + 1)) =
        Eq.recOn (congr_arg (· + 1) e' : _ + 1 = _) (fs (i.add k)))]
  simpa [IH] using Eq.recOn e' rfl

name: vectorAll_iff_forall
statement:
theorem vectorAll_iff_forall : ∀ {n} (f : Vector3 α n → Prop), VectorAll n f ↔ ∀ v, f v
  | 0, _ => ⟨fun f0 v => v.nilElim f0, fun al => al []⟩
  | succ _, f =>
    (forall_congr' fun x => vectorAll_iff_forall fun v => f (x :: v)).trans
      ⟨fun al v => v.consElim al, fun al x v => al (x :: v)⟩

/
  i.e. `VectorAllP p [0, 1, 2] = p 0 ∧ p 1 ∧ p 2`. -/

statement:
theorem vectorAllP_iff_forall (p : α → Prop) (v : Vector3 α n) :
    VectorAllP p v ↔ ∀ i, p (v i)
proof:
:= by
  refine v.recOn ?_ ?_
  · exact ⟨fun _ => Fin2.elim0, fun _ => trivial⟩
  · simp only [vectorAllP_cons]
    refine fun {n} a v IH =>
      (and_congr_right fun _ => IH).trans
        ⟨fun ⟨pa, h⟩ i => by
          refine i.cases' ?_ ?_
          exacts [pa, h], fun h => ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩⟩
    · simpa using h fz
    · simpa using h (fs i)

name: injective_of_forall_ne_isSome

    (h : ∀ a₁ : α, a₁ ≠ a₂ → isSome (f a₁)) : Injective f
proof:
:=
  HasLeftInverse.injective
    ⟨fun b => Option.recOn b a₂ fun b' => Option.recOn (f.symm b') a₂ id, fun x => by
      cases hfx : f x
      · have : x = a₂ := not_imp_comm.1 (h x) (hfx.symm ▸ by simp)
        simp [this]
      · dsimp only
        rw [(eq_some_iff f).2 hfx]
        rfl⟩

name: injective_of_forall_isSome

proof:
:=
  (Classical.em (Nonempty α)).elim
    (fun hn => injective_of_forall_ne_isSome f (Classical.choice hn) fun a _ => h a) fun hn x =>
    (hn ⟨x⟩).elim

name: toBitVec_nsmul
statement:
protected theorem toBitVec_nsmul (n : ℕ) (a : $typeName) :
          (n • a).toBitVec = n • a.toBitVec
proof:
:= by
        rw [Lean.Grind.Semiring.nsmul_eq_natCast_mul, toBitVec_mul,
          nsmul_eq_mul, BitVec.natCast_eq_ofNat]
        rfl

      attribute [local instance] natCast intCast

      @[simp, int_toBitVec]
      protected theorem toBitVec_natCast (n : ℕ) :
          (n : $typeName).toBitVec = n := rfl

      open $typeName (toBitVec_neg) in
      @[simp, int_toBitVec]
      protected theorem toBitVec_intCast (z : ℤ) :
          (z : $typeName).toBitVec = z := by
        obtain ⟨z, rfl | rfl⟩ := z.eq_nat_or_neg
        · erw [intCast_ofNat]; rfl
        · rw [intCast_neg, toBitVec_neg]
          erw [intCast_ofNat]
          simp

      open $typeName (toBitVec_mul toBitVec_intCast) in
      @[simp, int_toBitVec]
      protected theorem toBitVec_zsmul (z : ℤ) (a : $typeName) :
          (z • a).toBitVec = z • a.toBitVec := by
        change (z * a).toBitVec = BitVec.ofInt _ z * a.toBitVec
        rw [toBitVec_mul]
        congr 1
        rw [toBitVec_intCast]
        rfl

    end $typeName
  ))

proof:

name: map_injective
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_injective [Nonempty α] [Nonempty β] {f : α → γ} {g : β → δ} :
    Injective (map f g) ↔ Injective f ∧ Injective g
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    ⟨fun a₁ a₂ ha => by
      inhabit β
      injection
        @h (a₁, default) (a₂, default) (congr_arg (fun c : γ => Prod.mk c (g default)) ha :),
      fun b₁ b₂ hb => by
      inhabit α
      injection @h (default, b₁) (default, b₂) (congr_arg (Prod.mk (f default)) hb :)⟩,
    fun h => h.1.prodMap h.2⟩

name: map_surjective
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_surjective [Nonempty γ] [Nonempty δ] {f : α → γ} {g : β → δ} :
    Surjective (map f g) ↔ Surjective f ∧ Surjective g
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    ⟨fun c => by
      inhabit δ
      obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, h⟩ := h (c, default)
      exact ⟨a, congr_arg Prod.fst h⟩,
      fun d => by
      inhabit γ
      obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, h⟩ := h (default, d)
      exact ⟨b, congr_arg Prod.snd h⟩⟩,
    fun h => h.1.prodMap h.2⟩

proof:
:= by
  have := Nonempty.map f ‹_›
  have := Nonempty.map g ‹_›
  exact (map_injective.and map_surjective).trans and_and_and_comm

name: map_leftInverse
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    ⟨fun b => by
      inhabit δ
      exact congr_arg Prod.fst (h (b, default)),
      fun d => by
      inhabit β
      exact congr_arg Prod.snd (h (default, d))⟩,
    fun h => h.1.prodMap h.2 ⟩

  rintro rfl
  exact hl.notMem hj

name: elim_mk
statement:
theorem elim_mk : ∀ (l : List ι) (f : ∀ i, α i) {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ l), (TProd.mk l f).elim hi = f i
  | i :: is, f, j, hj => by
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst hji
      simp
    · rw [TProd.elim_of_ne _ hji, snd_mk, elim_mk is]

@[ext]

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext :
    ∀ {l : List ι} (_ : l.Nodup) {v w : TProd α l}
      (_ : ∀ (i) (hi : i ∈ l), v.elim hi = w.elim hi), v = w
  | [], _, v, w, _ => PUnit.ext v w
  | i :: is, hl, v, w, hvw => by
    apply Prod.ext
    · rw [← elim_self v, hvw, elim_self]
    refine ext (nodup_cons.mp hl).2 fun j hj => ?_
    rw [← elim_of_mem hl, hvw, elim_of_mem hl]

/
  `Π i, α i`. -/
@[simp]
protected def elim' (h : ∀ i, i ∈ l) (v : TProd α l) (i : ι) : α i

name: mk_elim
statement: theorem mk_elim (hnd : l.Nodup) (h : ∀ i, i ∈ l) (v : TProd α l) : TProd.mk l (v.elim' h) = v
proof:
:=
  TProd.ext hnd fun i hi => by simp [elim_mk]

name: mk_preimage_tprod
statement:
theorem mk_preimage_tprod :
    ∀ (l : List ι) (t : ∀ i, Set (α i)), TProd.mk l ⁻¹' Set.tprod l t = { i | i ∈ l }.pi t
  | [], t => by simp [Set.tprod]
  | i :: l, t => by
    ext f
    have h : TProd.mk l f ∈ Set.tprod l t ↔ ∀ i : ι, i ∈ l → f i ∈ t i
proof:
:= by
      change f ∈ TProd.mk l ⁻¹' Set.tprod l t ↔ f ∈ { x | x ∈ l }.pi t
      rw [mk_preimage_tprod l t]
    
    rw [Set.tprod, TProd.mk, mem_preimage, mem_pi, prodMk_mem_set_prod_eq]
    simp_rw [mem_ofPred_eq, mem_cons]
    rw [forall_eq_or_imp, and_congr_right_iff]
    exact fun _ => h

name: elim_preimage_pi
statement:
theorem elim_preimage_pi [DecidableEq ι] {l : List ι} (hnd : l.Nodup) (h : ∀ i, i ∈ l)
    (t : ∀ i, Set (α i)) : TProd.elim' h ⁻¹' pi univ t = Set.tprod l t
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : { i | i ∈ l } = univ := by
    ext i
    simp [h]
  rw [← h2, ← mk_preimage_tprod, preimage_preimage]
  simp only [TProd.mk_elim hnd h]
  dsimp

correct, the tree is balanced, and the elements of the tree are organized according to the
ordering. This version of `Valid` also puts all elements in the tree in the interval `(lo, hi)`. -/

  ord : t.Bounded lo hi
  sz : t.Sized

correct, the tree is balanced, and the elements of the tree are organized according to the

theorem Valid'.node4L_lemma₁ {a b c d : ℕ} (lr₂ : 3 * (b + c + 1 + d) ≤ 16 * a + 9)

statement:
theorem Valid'.node4L_lemma₅ {a b c d : ℕ} (lr₂ : 3 * (b + c + 1 + d) ≤ 16 * a + 9)

name: Valid'.node4L
statement:
theorem Valid'.node4L {l} {x : α} {m} {y : α} {r o₁ o₂} (hl : Valid' o₁ l x) (hm : Valid' x m y)
    (hr : Valid' (↑y) r o₂) (Hm : 0 < size m)
    (H : size l = 0 ∧ size m = 1 ∧ size r ≤ 1 ∨
        0 < size l ∧
          ratio * size r ≤ size m ∧
            delta * size l ≤ size m + size r ∧
              3 * (size m + size r) ≤ 16 * size l + 9 ∧ size m ≤ delta * size r) :
    Valid' o₁ (@node4L α l x m y r) o₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain - | ⟨s, ml, z, mr⟩ := m; · cases Hm
  suffices
    BalancedSz (size l) (size ml) ∧
      BalancedSz (size mr) (size r) ∧ BalancedSz (size l + size ml + 1) (size mr + size r + 1) from
    Valid'.node' (hl.node' hm.left this.1) (hm.right.node' hr this.2.1) this.2.2
  rcases H with (⟨l0, m1, r0⟩ | ⟨l0, mr₁, lr₁, lr₂, mr₂⟩)
  · rw [hm.2.size_eq, Nat.succ_inj, add_eq_zero] at m1
    rw [l0, m1.1, m1.2]; revert r0; rcases size r with (_ | _ | _) <;>
      [decide; decide; (intro r0; unfold BalancedSz delta; lia)]
  · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (size r) with r0 | r0
    · rw [r0] at mr₂; cases not_le_of_gt Hm mr₂
    rw [hm.2.size_eq] at lr₁ lr₂ mr₁ mr₂
    by_cases mm : size ml + size mr ≤ 1
    · dsimp [delta, ratio] at lr₁ mr₁
      have r1 : r.size = 1 := by lia
      have l1 : l.size = 1 := by lia
      rw [r1, add_assoc] at lr₁
      rw [l1, r1]
      revert mm; cases size ml <;> cases size mr <;> intro mm
      · decide
      · rw [zero_add] at mm; rcases mm with (_ | ⟨⟨⟩⟩)
        decide
      · rcases mm with (_ | ⟨⟨⟩⟩); decide
      · rw [Nat.succ_add] at mm; rcases mm with (_ | ⟨⟨⟩⟩)
    rcases hm.3.1.resolve_left mm with ⟨mm₁, mm₂⟩
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (size ml) with ml0 | ml0
    · rw [ml0, mul_zero, Nat.le_zero] at mm₂
      rw [ml0, mm₂] at mm; cases mm (by decide)
    have : 2 * size l ≤ size ml + size mr + 1 := by
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left ratio lr₁
      rw [mul_left_comm, mul_add] at this
      have := le_trans this (add_le_add_right mr₁ _)
      rw [← Nat.succ_mul] at this
      exact (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (by decide)).1 this
    refine ⟨Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · refine (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (by decide)).1 (le_trans this ?_)
      rw [two_mul, Nat.succ_le_iff]
      refine add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le ?_ mm₂
      simpa using! mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (by decide : 1 < 3) ml0
    · exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Valid'.node4L_lemma₁ lr₂ mr₂ mm₁)
    · exact Valid'.node4L_lemma₂ mr₂
    · exact Valid'.node4L_lemma₃ mr₁ mm₁
    · exact Valid'.node4L_lemma₄ lr₁ mr₂ mm₁
    · exact Valid'.node4L_lemma₅ lr₂ mr₁ mm₂

statement: theorem Valid'.rotateL_lemma₁ {a b c : ℕ} (H2 : 3 * a ≤ b + c) (hb₂ : c ≤ 3 * b) : a ≤ 3 * b

name: Valid'.rotateL_lemma
statement:
theorem Valid'.rotateL_lemma₂ {a b c : ℕ} (H3 : 2 * (b + c) ≤ 9 * a + 3) (h : b < 2 * c) :
    b < 3 * a + 1

name: Valid'.rotateL_lemma
statement: theorem Valid'.rotateL_lemma₃ {a b c : ℕ} (H2 : 3 * a ≤ b + c) (h : b < 2 * c) : a + b < 3 * c

name: Valid'.rotateL_lemma
statement: theorem Valid'.rotateL_lemma₄ {a b : ℕ} (H3 : 2 * b ≤ 9 * a + 3) : 3 * b ≤ 16 * a + 9

name: Valid'.rotateL
statement:
theorem Valid'.rotateL {l} {x : α} {r o₁ o₂} (hl : Valid' o₁ l x) (hr : Valid' x r o₂)
    (H1 : ¬size l + size r ≤ 1) (H2 : delta * size l < size r)
    (H3 : 2 * size r ≤ 9 * size l + 5 ∨ size r ≤ 3) : Valid' o₁ (@rotateL α l x r) o₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain - | ⟨rs, rl, rx, rr⟩ := r; · cases H2
  rw [hr.2.size_eq, Nat.lt_succ_iff] at H2
  rw [hr.2.size_eq] at H3
  replace H3 : 2 * (size rl + size rr) ≤ 9 * size l + 3 ∨ size rl + size rr ≤ 2 :=
    H3.imp (@Nat.le_of_add_le_add_right _ 2 _) Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ
  have H3_0 (l0 : size l = 0) : size rl + size rr ≤ 2 := by lia
  have H3p : size l > 0 → 2 * (size rl + size rr) ≤ 9 * size l + 3 := fun l0 : 1 ≤ size l =>
    (or_iff_left_of_imp <| by lia).1 H3
  have ablem : ∀ {a b : ℕ}, 1 ≤ a → a + b ≤ 2 → b ≤ 1 := by lia
  have hlp : size l > 0 → ¬size rl + size rr ≤ 1 := fun l0 hb =>
    absurd (le_trans (le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ l0) H2) hb) (by decide)
  rw [Ordnode.rotateL_node]; split_ifs with h
  · have rr0 : size rr > 0 :=
      (mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ (by decide)).1 (lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) h : ratio * 0 < _)
    suffices BalancedSz (size l) (size rl) ∧ BalancedSz (size l + size rl + 1) (size rr) by
      exact hl.node3L hr.left hr.right this.1 this.2
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (size l) with l0 | l0
    · rw [l0]; replace H3 := H3_0 l0
      have := hr.3.1
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (size rl) with rl0 | rl0
      · rw [rl0] at this ⊢
        rw [le_antisymm (balancedSz_zero.1 this.symm) rr0]
        decide
      have rr1 : size rr = 1 := le_antisymm (ablem rl0 H3) rr0
      rw [add_comm] at H3
      rw [rr1, show size rl = 1 from le_antisymm (ablem rr0 H3) rl0]
      decide
    replace H3 := H3p l0
    rcases hr.3.1.resolve_left (hlp l0) with ⟨_, hb₂⟩
    refine ⟨Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact Valid'.rotateL_lemma₁ H2 hb₂
    · exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Valid'.rotateL_lemma₂ H3 h)
    · exact Valid'.rotateL_lemma₃ H2 h
    · exact
        le_trans hb₂
          (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ <| le_trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _) (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
  · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (size rl) with rl0 | rl0
    · rw [rl0, not_lt, Nat.le_zero, Nat.mul_eq_zero] at h
      replace h := h.resolve_left (by decide)
      rw [rl0, h, Nat.le_zero, Nat.mul_eq_zero] at H2
      rw [hr.2.size_eq, rl0, h, H2.resolve_left (by decide)] at H1
      cases H1 (by decide)
    refine hl.node4L hr.left hr.right rl0 ?_
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (size l) with l0 | l0
    · replace H3 := H3_0 l0
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (size rr) with rr0 | rr0
      · have := hr.3.1
        rw [rr0] at this
        exact Or.inl ⟨l0, le_antisymm (balancedSz_zero.1 this) rl0, rr0.symm ▸ zero_le_one⟩
      exact Or.inl ⟨l0, le_antisymm (ablem rr0 <| by rwa [add_comm]) rl0, ablem rl0 H3⟩
    exact
      Or.inr ⟨l0, not_lt.1 h, H2, Valid'.rotateL_lemma₄ (H3p l0), (hr.3.1.resolve_left (hlp l0)).1⟩

name: Valid'.rotateR
statement:
theorem Valid'.rotateR {l} {x : α} {r o₁ o₂} (hl : Valid' o₁ l x) (hr : Valid' x r o₂)
    (H1 : ¬size l + size r ≤ 1) (H2 : delta * size r < size l)
    (H3 : 2 * size l ≤ 9 * size r + 5 ∨ size l ≤ 3) : Valid' o₁ (@rotateR α l x r) o₂
proof:
:= by
  refine Valid'.dual_iff.2 ?_
  rw [dual_rotateR]
  refine hr.dual.rotateL hl.dual ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rwa [size_dual, size_dual, add_comm]
  · rwa [size_dual, size_dual]
  · rwa [size_dual, size_dual]

name: Valid'.balance'_aux
statement:
theorem Valid'.balance'_aux {l} {x : α} {r o₁ o₂} (hl : Valid' o₁ l x) (hr : Valid' x r o₂)
    (H₁ : 2 * @size α r ≤ 9 * size l + 5 ∨ size r ≤ 3)
    (H₂ : 2 * @size α l ≤ 9 * size r + 5 ∨ size l ≤ 3) : Valid' o₁ (@balance' α l x r) o₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [balance']; split_ifs with h h_1 h_2
  · exact hl.node' hr (Or.inl h)
  · exact hl.rotateL hr h h_1 H₁
  · exact hl.rotateR hr h h_2 H₂
  · exact hl.node' hr (Or.inr ⟨not_lt.1 h_2, not_lt.1 h_1⟩)

name: Valid'.balance'_lemma
statement:
theorem Valid'.balance'_lemma {α l l' r r'} (H1 : BalancedSz l' r')
    (H2 : Nat.dist (@size α l) l' ≤ 1 ∧ size r = r' ∨ Nat.dist (size r) r' ≤ 1 ∧ size l = l') :
    2 * @size α r ≤ 9 * size l + 5 ∨ size r ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  suffices @size α r ≤ 3 * (size l + 1) by lia
  rcases H2 with (⟨hl, rfl⟩ | ⟨hr, rfl⟩) <;> rcases H1 with (h | ⟨_, h₂⟩)
  · exact le_trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _) (le_trans h (Nat.le_add_left _ _))
  · exact
      le_trans h₂
        (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ <| le_trans (Nat.dist_tri_right _ _) (Nat.add_le_add_left hl _))
  · exact
      le_trans (Nat.dist_tri_left' _ _)
        (le_trans (add_le_add hr (le_trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _) h)) (by lia))
  · rw [Nat.mul_succ]
    exact le_trans (Nat.dist_tri_right' _ _) (add_le_add h₂ (le_trans hr (by decide)))

name: Valid'.balance'
statement:
theorem Valid'.balance' {l} {x : α} {r o₁ o₂} (hl : Valid' o₁ l x) (hr : Valid' x r o₂)
    (H : ∃ l' r', BalancedSz l' r' ∧
          (Nat.dist (size l) l' ≤ 1 ∧ size r = r' ∨ Nat.dist (size r) r' ≤ 1 ∧ size l = l')) :
    Valid' o₁ (@balance' α l x r) o₂
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, _, H1, H2⟩ := H
  Valid'.balance'_aux hl hr (Valid'.balance'_lemma H1 H2) (Valid'.balance'_lemma H1.symm H2.symm)

name: Valid'.balance
statement:
theorem Valid'.balance {l} {x : α} {r o₁ o₂} (hl : Valid' o₁ l x) (hr : Valid' x r o₂)
    (H : ∃ l' r', BalancedSz l' r' ∧
          (Nat.dist (size l) l' ≤ 1 ∧ size r = r' ∨ Nat.dist (size r) r' ≤ 1 ∧ size l = l')) :
    Valid' o₁ (@balance α l x r) o₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [balance_eq_balance' hl.3 hr.3 hl.2 hr.2]; exact hl.balance' hr H

name: Valid'.balanceL_aux
statement:
theorem Valid'.balanceL_aux {l} {x : α} {r o₁ o₂} (hl : Valid' o₁ l x) (hr : Valid' x r o₂)
    (H₁ : size l = 0 → size r ≤ 1) (H₂ : 1 ≤ size l → 1 ≤ size r → size r ≤ delta * size l)
    (H₃ : 2 * @size α l ≤ 9 * size r + 5 ∨ size l ≤ 3) : Valid' o₁ (@balanceL α l x r) o₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [balanceL_eq_balance hl.2 hr.2 H₁ H₂, balance_eq_balance' hl.3 hr.3 hl.2 hr.2]
  refine hl.balance'_aux hr (Or.inl ?_) H₃
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (size r) with r0 | r0
  · rw [r0]; exact Nat.zero_le _
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (size l) with l0 | l0
  · rw [l0]; exact le_trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (H₁ l0)) (by decide)
  replace H₂ : _ ≤ 3 * _ := H₂ l0 r0; lia

name: Valid'.balanceL
statement:
theorem Valid'.balanceL {l} {x : α} {r o₁ o₂} (hl : Valid' o₁ l x) (hr : Valid' x r o₂)
    (H : (∃ l', Raised l' (size l) ∧ BalancedSz l' (size r)) ∨
        ∃ r', Raised (size r) r' ∧ BalancedSz (size l) r') :
    Valid' o₁ (@balanceL α l x r) o₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [balanceL_eq_balance' hl.3 hr.3 hl.2 hr.2 H]
  refine hl.balance' hr ?_
  rcases H with (⟨l', e, H⟩ | ⟨r', e, H⟩)
  · exact ⟨_, _, H, Or.inl ⟨e.dist_le', rfl⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨_, _, H, Or.inr ⟨e.dist_le, rfl⟩⟩

name: Valid'.balanceR_aux
statement:
theorem Valid'.balanceR_aux {l} {x : α} {r o₁ o₂} (hl : Valid' o₁ l x) (hr : Valid' x r o₂)
    (H₁ : size r = 0 → size l ≤ 1) (H₂ : 1 ≤ size r → 1 ≤ size l → size l ≤ delta * size r)
    (H₃ : 2 * @size α r ≤ 9 * size l + 5 ∨ size r ≤ 3) : Valid' o₁ (@balanceR α l x r) o₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [Valid'.dual_iff, dual_balanceR]
  have := hr.dual.balanceL_aux hl.dual
  rw [size_dual, size_dual] at this
  exact this H₁ H₂ H₃

name: Valid'.balanceR
statement:
theorem Valid'.balanceR {l} {x : α} {r o₁ o₂} (hl : Valid' o₁ l x) (hr : Valid' x r o₂)
    (H : (∃ l', Raised (size l) l' ∧ BalancedSz l' (size r)) ∨
        ∃ r', Raised r' (size r) ∧ BalancedSz (size l) r') :
    Valid' o₁ (@balanceR α l x r) o₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [Valid'.dual_iff, dual_balanceR]; exact hr.dual.balanceL hl.dual (balance_sz_dual H)

name: Valid'.eraseMax_aux
statement:
theorem Valid'.eraseMax_aux {s l x r o₁ o₂} (H : Valid' o₁ (.node s l x r) o₂) :
    Valid' o₁ (@eraseMax α (.node' l x r)) ↑(findMax' x r) ∧
      size (.node' l x r) = size (eraseMax (.node' l x r)) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have := H.2.eq_node'; rw [this] at H; clear this
  induction r generalizing l x o₁ with
  | nil => exact ⟨H.left, rfl⟩
  | node rs rl rx rr _ IHrr =>
    have := H.2.2.2.eq_node'; rw [this] at H ⊢
    rcases IHrr H.right with ⟨h, e⟩
    refine ⟨Valid'.balanceL H.left h (Or.inr ⟨_, Or.inr e, H.3.1⟩), ?_⟩
    rw [eraseMax, size_balanceL H.3.2.1 h.3 H.2.2.1 h.2 (Or.inr ⟨_, Or.inr e, H.3.1⟩)]
    rw [size_node, e]; rfl

name: Valid'.eraseMin_aux
statement:
theorem Valid'.eraseMin_aux {s l} {x : α} {r o₁ o₂} (H : Valid' o₁ (.node s l x r) o₂) :
    Valid' ↑(findMin' l x) (@eraseMin α (.node' l x r)) o₂ ∧
      size (.node' l x r) = size (eraseMin (.node' l x r)) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have := H.dual.eraseMax_aux
  rwa [← dual_node', size_dual, ← dual_eraseMin, size_dual, ← Valid'.dual_iff, findMax'_dual]
    at this

name: eraseMin.valid
statement:
theorem eraseMin.valid : ∀ {t}, @Valid α _ t → Valid (eraseMin t)
  | nil, _ => valid_nil
  | node _ l x r, h => by rw [h.2.eq_node']; exact h.eraseMin_aux.1.valid

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in

name: eraseMax.valid
statement: theorem eraseMax.valid {t} (h : @Valid α _ t) : Valid (eraseMax t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Valid.dual_iff, dual_eraseMax]; exact eraseMin.valid h.dual

name: Valid'.glue_aux
statement:
theorem Valid'.glue_aux {l r o₁ o₂} (hl : Valid' o₁ l o₂) (hr : Valid' o₁ r o₂)
    (sep : l.All fun x => r.All fun y => x < y) (bal : BalancedSz (size l) (size r)) :
    Valid' o₁ (@glue α l r) o₂ ∧ size (glue l r) = size l + size r
proof:
:= by
  obtain - | ⟨ls, ll, lx, lr⟩ := l; · exact ⟨hr, (zero_add _).symm⟩
  obtain - | ⟨rs, rl, rx, rr⟩ := r; · exact ⟨hl, rfl⟩
  dsimp [glue]; split_ifs
  · rw [splitMax_eq]
    · obtain ⟨v, e⟩ := Valid'.eraseMax_aux hl
      suffices H : _ by
        refine ⟨Valid'.balanceR v (hr.of_gt ?_ ?_) H, ?_⟩
        · refine findMax'_all (P := fun a : α => Bounded nil (a : WithTop α) o₂)
            lx lr hl.1.2.to_nil (sep.2.2.imp ?_)
          exact fun x h => hr.1.2.to_nil.mono_left (le_of_lt h.2.1)
        · exact @findMax'_all _ (fun a => All (· > a) (.node rs rl rx rr)) lx lr sep.2.1 sep.2.2
        · rw [size_balanceR v.3 hr.3 v.2 hr.2 H, add_right_comm, ← e, hl.2.1]; rfl
      refine Or.inl ⟨_, Or.inr e, ?_⟩
      rwa [hl.2.eq_node'] at bal
  · rw [splitMin_eq]
    · obtain ⟨v, e⟩ := Valid'.eraseMin_aux hr
      suffices H : _ by
        refine ⟨Valid'.balanceL (hl.of_lt ?_ ?_) v H, ?_⟩
        · refine @findMin'_all (P := fun a : α => Bounded nil o₁ (a : WithBot α))
            _ rl rx (sep.2.1.1.imp ?_) hr.1.1.to_nil
          exact fun y h => hl.1.1.to_nil.mono_right (le_of_lt h)
        · exact
            @findMin'_all _ (fun a => All (· < a) (.node ls ll lx lr)) rl rx
              (all_iff_forall.2 fun x hx => sep.imp fun y hy => all_iff_forall.1 hy.1 _ hx)
              (sep.imp fun y hy => hy.2.1)
        · rw [size_balanceL hl.3 v.3 hl.2 v.2 H, add_assoc, ← e, hr.2.1]; rfl
      refine Or.inr ⟨_, Or.inr e, ?_⟩
      rwa [hr.2.eq_node'] at bal

name: Valid'.glue
statement:
theorem Valid'.glue {l} {x : α} {r o₁ o₂} (hl : Valid' o₁ l x) (hr : Valid' x r o₂) :
    BalancedSz (size l) (size r) →
      Valid' o₁ (@glue α l r) o₂ ∧ size (@glue α l r) = size l + size r

name: Valid'.merge_lemma
statement:
theorem Valid'.merge_lemma {a b c : ℕ} (h₁ : 3 * a < b + c + 1) (h₂ : b ≤ 3 * c) :
    2 * (a + b) ≤ 9 * c + 5

name: Valid'.merge_aux
statement:
theorem Valid'.merge_aux₁ {o₁ o₂ ls ll lx lr rs rl rx rr t}
    (hl : Valid' o₁ (@Ordnode.node α ls ll lx lr) o₂) (hr : Valid' o₁ (.node rs rl rx rr) o₂)
    (h : delta * ls < rs) (v : Valid' o₁ t rx) (e : size t = ls + size rl) :
    Valid' o₁ (.balanceL t rx rr) o₂ ∧ size (.balanceL t rx rr) = ls + rs
proof:
:= by
  rw [hl.2.1] at e
  rw [hl.2.1, hr.2.1, delta] at h
  rcases hr.3.1 with (H | ⟨hr₁, hr₂⟩); · lia
  suffices H₂ : _ by
    suffices H₁ : _ by
      refine ⟨Valid'.balanceL_aux v hr.right H₁ H₂ ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [e]; exact Or.inl (Valid'.merge_lemma h hr₁)
      · rw [balanceL_eq_balance v.2 hr.2.2.2 H₁ H₂, balance_eq_balance' v.3 hr.3.2.2 v.2 hr.2.2.2,
          size_balance' v.2 hr.2.2.2, e, hl.2.1, hr.2.1]
        abel
    · rw [e, add_right_comm]; rintro ⟨⟩
  intro _ _; rw [e]; unfold delta at hr₂ ⊢; lia

name: Valid'.merge_aux
statement:
theorem Valid'.merge_aux {l r o₁ o₂} (hl : Valid' o₁ l o₂) (hr : Valid' o₁ r o₂)
    (sep : l.All fun x => r.All fun y => x < y) :
    Valid' o₁ (@merge α l r) o₂ ∧ size (merge l r) = size l + size r
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing o₁ o₂ r with
  | nil => exact ⟨hr, (zero_add _).symm⟩
  | node ls ll lx lr _ IHlr => ?_
  induction r generalizing o₁ o₂ with
  | nil => exact ⟨hl, rfl⟩
  | node rs rl rx rr IHrl _ => ?_
  rw [merge_node]; split_ifs with h h_1
  · obtain ⟨v, e⟩ := IHrl (hl.of_lt hr.1.1.to_nil <| sep.imp fun x h => h.2.1) hr.left
      (sep.imp fun x h => h.1)
    exact Valid'.merge_aux₁ hl hr h v e
  · obtain ⟨v, e⟩ := IHlr hl.right (hr.of_gt hl.1.2.to_nil sep.2.1) sep.2.2
    have := Valid'.merge_aux₁ hr.dual hl.dual h_1 v.dual
    rw [size_dual, add_comm, size_dual, ← dual_balanceR, ← Valid'.dual_iff, size_dual,
      add_comm rs] at this
    exact this e
  · refine Valid'.glue_aux hl hr sep (Or.inr ⟨not_lt.1 h_1, not_lt.1 h⟩)

name: Valid.merge
statement:
theorem Valid.merge {l r} (hl : Valid l) (hr : Valid r)
    (sep : l.All fun x => r.All fun y => x < y) : Valid (@merge α l r)

name: insertWith.valid_aux
statement:
theorem insertWith.valid_aux [@Std.Total α (· ≤ ·)] [DecidableLE α] (f : α → α) (x : α)
    (hf : ∀ y, x ≤ y ∧ y ≤ x → x ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ x) :
    ∀ {t o₁ o₂},
      Valid' o₁ t o₂ →
        Bounded nil o₁ x →
          Bounded nil x o₂ →
            Valid' o₁ (insertWith f x t) o₂ ∧ Raised (size t) (size (insertWith f x t))
  | nil, _, _, _, bl, br => ⟨valid'_singleton bl br, Or.inr rfl⟩
  | node sz l y r, o₁, o₂, h, bl, br => by
    rw [insertWith, cmpLE]
    split_ifs with h_1 h_2 <;> dsimp only
    · rcases h with ⟨⟨lx, xr⟩, hs, hb⟩
      rcases hf _ ⟨h_1, h_2⟩ with ⟨xf, fx⟩
      refine
        ⟨⟨⟨lx.mono_right (le_trans h_2 xf), xr.mono_left (le_trans fx h_1)⟩, hs, hb⟩, Or.inl rfl⟩
    · rcases insertWith.valid_aux f x hf h.left bl (lt_of_le_not_ge h_1 h_2) with ⟨vl, e⟩
      suffices H : _ by
        refine ⟨vl.balanceL h.right H, ?_⟩
        rw [size_balanceL vl.3 h.3.2.2 vl.2 h.2.2.2 H, h.2.size_eq]
        exact (e.add_right _).add_right _
      exact Or.inl ⟨_, e, h.3.1⟩
    · have : y < x
proof:
:= lt_of_le_not_ge ((total_of (· ≤ ·) _ _).resolve_left h_1) h_1
      rcases insertWith.valid_aux f x hf h.right this br with ⟨vr, e⟩
      suffices H : _ by
        refine ⟨h.left.balanceR vr H, ?_⟩
        rw [size_balanceR h.3.2.1 vr.3 h.2.2.1 vr.2 H, h.2.size_eq]
        exact (e.add_left _).add_right _
      exact Or.inr ⟨_, e, h.3.1⟩

name: insertWith.valid
statement:
theorem insertWith.valid [@Std.Total α (· ≤ ·)] [DecidableLE α] (f : α → α) (x : α)
    (hf : ∀ y, x ≤ y ∧ y ≤ x → x ≤ f y ∧ f y ≤ x) {t} (h : Valid t) : Valid (insertWith f x t)

name: insert_eq_insertWith
statement:
theorem insert_eq_insertWith [DecidableLE α] (x : α) :
    ∀ t, Ordnode.insert x t = insertWith (fun _ => x) x t
  | nil => rfl
  | node _ l y r => by
    unfold Ordnode.insert insertWith; cases cmpLE x y <;> simp [insert_eq_insertWith]

name: insert.valid
statement:
theorem insert.valid [@Std.Total α (· ≤ ·)] [DecidableLE α] (x : α) {t} (h : Valid t) :
    Valid (Ordnode.insert x t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [insert_eq_insertWith]; exact insertWith.valid _ _ (fun _ _ => ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩) h

name: insert'_eq_insertWith
statement:
theorem insert'_eq_insertWith [DecidableLE α] (x : α) :
    ∀ t, insert' x t = insertWith id x t
  | nil => rfl

statement:

name: Valid'.map_aux
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing a₁ a₂ with
  | nil =>
    simp only [map, size_nil, and_true]; apply valid'_nil
    cases a₁; · trivial
    cases a₂; · trivial
    simp only [Option.map, Bounded]
    exact f_strict_mono h.ord
  | node _ _ _ _ t_ih_l t_ih_r =>
    have t_ih_l' := t_ih_l h.left
    have t_ih_r' := t_ih_r h.right
    clear t_ih_l t_ih_r
    obtain ⟨t_l_valid, t_l_size⟩ := t_ih_l'
    obtain ⟨t_r_valid, t_r_size⟩ := t_ih_r'
    simp only [map, size_node, and_true]
    constructor
    · exact And.intro t_l_valid.ord t_r_valid.ord
    · constructor
      · rw [t_l_size, t_r_size]; exact h.sz.1
      · constructor
        · exact t_l_valid.sz
        · exact t_r_valid.sz
    · constructor
      · rw [t_l_size, t_r_size]; exact h.bal.1
      · constructor
        · exact t_l_valid.bal
        · exact t_r_valid.bal

name: map.valid
statement:
theorem map.valid {β} [Preorder β] {f : α → β} (f_strict_mono : StrictMono f) {t} (h : Valid t) :
    Valid (map f t)

name: Valid'.erase_aux
statement:
theorem Valid'.erase_aux [DecidableLE α] (x : α) {t a₁ a₂} (h : Valid' a₁ t a₂) :
    Valid' a₁ (erase x t) a₂ ∧ Raised (erase x t).size t.size
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing a₁ a₂ with
  | nil =>
    simpa [erase, Raised]
  | node _ t_l t_x t_r t_ih_l t_ih_r =>
    simp only [erase, size_node]
    have t_ih_l' := t_ih_l h.left
    have t_ih_r' := t_ih_r h.right
    clear t_ih_l t_ih_r
    obtain ⟨t_l_valid, t_l_size⟩ := t_ih_l'
    obtain ⟨t_r_valid, t_r_size⟩ := t_ih_r'
    cases cmpLE x t_x <;> rw [h.sz.1]
    · suffices h_balanceable : _ by
        constructor
        · exact Valid'.balanceR t_l_valid h.right h_balanceable
        · rw [size_balanceR t_l_valid.bal h.right.bal t_l_valid.sz h.right.sz h_balanceable]
          repeat apply Raised.add_right
          exact t_l_size
      left; exists t_l.size; exact And.intro t_l_size h.bal.1
    · have h_glue := Valid'.glue h.left h.right h.bal.1
      obtain ⟨h_glue_valid, h_glue_sized⟩ := h_glue
      constructor
      · exact h_glue_valid
      · right; rw [h_glue_sized]
    · suffices h_balanceable : _ by
        constructor
        · exact Valid'.balanceL h.left t_r_valid h_balanceable
        · rw [size_balanceL h.left.bal t_r_valid.bal h.left.sz t_r_valid.sz h_balanceable]
          apply Raised.add_right
          apply Raised.add_left
          exact t_r_size
      right; exists t_r.size; exact And.intro t_r_size h.bal.1

name: erase.valid
statement: theorem erase.valid [DecidableLE α] (x : α) {t} (h : Valid t) : Valid (erase x t)

name: size_erase_of_mem
statement:
theorem size_erase_of_mem [DecidableLE α] {x : α} {t a₁ a₂} (h : Valid' a₁ t a₂)
    (h_mem : x ∈ t) : size (erase x t) = size t - 1
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing a₁ a₂ with
  | nil =>
    contradiction
  | node _ t_l t_x t_r t_ih_l t_ih_r =>
    have t_ih_l' := t_ih_l h.left
    have t_ih_r' := t_ih_r h.right
    clear t_ih_l t_ih_r
    dsimp only [Membership.mem, mem] at h_mem
    unfold erase
    revert h_mem; cases cmpLE x t_x <;> intro h_mem <;> dsimp only at h_mem ⊢
    · have t_ih_l := t_ih_l' h_mem
      clear t_ih_l' t_ih_r'
      have t_l_h := Valid'.erase_aux x h.left
      obtain ⟨t_l_valid, t_l_size⟩ := t_l_h
      rw [size_balanceR t_l_valid.bal h.right.bal t_l_valid.sz h.right.sz
          (Or.inl (Exists.intro t_l.size (And.intro t_l_size h.bal.1)))]
      rw [t_ih_l, h.sz.1]
      have h_pos_t_l_size := pos_size_of_mem h.left.sz h_mem
      revert h_pos_t_l_size; rcases t_l.size with - | t_l_size <;> intro h_pos_t_l_size
      · cases h_pos_t_l_size
      · simp [Nat.add_right_comm]
    · rw [(Valid'.glue h.left h.right h.bal.1).2, h.sz.1]; rfl
    · have t_ih_r := t_ih_r' h_mem
      clear t_ih_l' t_ih_r'
      have t_r_h := Valid'.erase_aux x h.right
      obtain ⟨t_r_valid, t_r_size⟩ := t_r_h
      rw [size_balanceL h.left.bal t_r_valid.bal h.left.sz t_r_valid.sz
          (Or.inr (Exists.intro t_r.size (And.intro t_r_size h.bal.1)))]
      rw [t_ih_r, h.sz.1]
      have h_pos_t_r_size := pos_size_of_mem h.right.sz h_mem
      revert h_pos_t_r_size; rcases t_r.size with - | t_r_size <;> intro h_pos_t_r_size
      · cases h_pos_t_r_size
      · simp [Nat.add_assoc]

name: empty_iff
statement: theorem empty_iff {s : Ordset α} : s = ∅ ↔ s.1.empty
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h; exact rfl,
    fun h => by cases s with | mk s_val _ => cases s_val <;> [rfl; cases h]⟩

name: pos_size_of_mem

proof:
:= by
  simp only [Membership.mem, mem, Bool.decide_eq_true] at h_mem
  apply Ordnode.pos_size_of_mem t.property.sz h_mem

name: not_le_delta
statement: theorem not_le_delta {s} (H : 1 ≤ s) : ¬s ≤ delta * 0

name: delta_lt_false
statement: theorem delta_lt_false {a b : ℕ} (h₁ : delta * a < b) (h₂ : delta * b < a) : False
proof:
:=
  not_le_of_gt (lt_trans (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h₁ <| by decide) h₂) <| by
    simpa [mul_assoc] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right a (by decide : 1 ≤ delta * delta)

name: Sized.induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem Sized.induction {t} (hl : @Sized α t) {C : Ordnode α → Prop} (H0 : C nil)
    (H1 : ∀ l x r, C l → C r → C (.node' l x r)) : C t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | nil => exact H0
  | node _ _ _ _ t_ih_l t_ih_r =>
    rw [hl.eq_node']
    exact H1 _ _ _ (t_ih_l hl.2.1) (t_ih_r hl.2.2)

  | node s l x r, ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ => by
    rw [size, h₁, size_eq_realSize h₂, size_eq_realSize h₃]; rfl

@[simp]

@[simp]

name: size_dual
statement:

theorem size_dual (t : Ordnode α) : size (dual t) = size t

name: BalancedSz.symm
statement:
@[symm]
theorem BalancedSz.symm {l r : ℕ} : BalancedSz l r → BalancedSz r l

name: balancedSz_zero
statement: theorem balancedSz_zero {l : ℕ} : BalancedSz l 0 ↔ l ≤ 1

name: balancedSz_up
statement:
theorem balancedSz_up {l r₁ r₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : r₁ ≤ r₂) (h₂ : l + r₂ ≤ 1 ∨ r₂ ≤ delta * l)
    (H : BalancedSz l r₁) : BalancedSz l r₂
proof:
:= by
  refine or_iff_not_imp_left.2 fun h => ?_
  refine ⟨?_, h₂.resolve_left h⟩
  cases H with
  | inl H =>
    cases r₂
    · cases h (le_trans (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.zero_le _) _) H)
    · exact le_trans (le_trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _) H) (Nat.le_add_left 1 _)
  | inr H =>
    exact le_trans H.1 (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ h₁)

name: balancedSz_down
statement:
theorem balancedSz_down {l r₁ r₂ : ℕ} (h₁ : r₁ ≤ r₂) (h₂ : l + r₂ ≤ 1 ∨ l ≤ delta * r₁)
    (H : BalancedSz l r₂) : BalancedSz l r₁
proof:
:=
  have : l + r₂ ≤ 1 → BalancedSz l r₁ := fun H => Or.inl (le_trans (Nat.add_le_add_left h₁ _) H)
  Or.casesOn H this fun H => Or.casesOn h₂ this fun h₂ => Or.inr ⟨h₂, le_trans h₁ H.2⟩

name: Balanced.dual
statement:
theorem Balanced.dual : ∀ {t : Ordnode α}, Balanced t → Balanced (dual t)
  | nil, _ => ⟨⟩
  | node _ l _ r, ⟨b, bl, br⟩ => ⟨by rw [size_dual, size_dual]; exact b.symm, br.dual, bl.dual⟩

/-! ### `rotate` and `balance` -/


/
def node3L (l : Ordnode α) (x : α) (m : Ordnode α) (y : α) (r : Ordnode α) : Ordnode α
proof:
:=
  node' (node' l x m) y r

name: rotateL_node
statement:
theorem rotateL_node (l : Ordnode α) (x : α) (sz : ℕ) (m : Ordnode α) (y : α) (r : Ordnode α) :
    rotateL l x (node sz m y r) =
      if size m < ratio * size r then node3L l x m y r else node4L l x m y r

name: rotateL_nil
statement: theorem rotateL_nil (l : Ordnode α) (x : α) : rotateL l x nil = node' l x nil

name: rotateR_node
statement:
theorem rotateR_node (sz : ℕ) (l : Ordnode α) (x : α) (m : Ordnode α) (y : α) (r : Ordnode α) :
    rotateR (node sz l x m) y r =
      if size m < ratio * size l then node3R l x m y r else node4R l x m y r

name: rotateR_nil
statement: theorem rotateR_nil (y : α) (r : Ordnode α) : rotateR nil y r = node' nil y r

name: dual_node'
statement:
theorem dual_node' (l : Ordnode α) (x : α) (r : Ordnode α) :
    dual (node' l x r) = node' (dual r) x (dual l)

name: dual_node3L
statement:
theorem dual_node3L (l : Ordnode α) (x : α) (m : Ordnode α) (y : α) (r : Ordnode α) :
    dual (node3L l x m y r) = node3R (dual r) y (dual m) x (dual l)

name: dual_node3R
statement:
theorem dual_node3R (l : Ordnode α) (x : α) (m : Ordnode α) (y : α) (r : Ordnode α) :
    dual (node3R l x m y r) = node3L (dual r) y (dual m) x (dual l)

name: dual_node4L
statement:
theorem dual_node4L (l : Ordnode α) (x : α) (m : Ordnode α) (y : α) (r : Ordnode α) :
    dual (node4L l x m y r) = node4R (dual r) y (dual m) x (dual l)
proof:
:= by
  cases m <;> simp [node4L, node4R, node3R, dual_node3L, add_comm]

name: dual_node4R
statement:
theorem dual_node4R (l : Ordnode α) (x : α) (m : Ordnode α) (y : α) (r : Ordnode α) :
    dual (node4R l x m y r) = node4L (dual r) y (dual m) x (dual l)
proof:
:= by
  cases m <;> simp [node4L, node4R, node3L, dual_node3R, add_comm]

name: dual_rotateL
statement:
theorem dual_rotateL (l : Ordnode α) (x : α) (r : Ordnode α) :
    dual (rotateL l x r) = rotateR (dual r) x (dual l)
proof:
:= by
  cases r <;> simp [rotateL, rotateR]; split_ifs <;>
    simp [dual_node3L, dual_node4L, node3R]

name: dual_rotateR
statement:
theorem dual_rotateR (l : Ordnode α) (x : α) (r : Ordnode α) :
    dual (rotateR l x r) = rotateL (dual r) x (dual l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dual_dual (rotateL _ _ _), dual_rotateL, dual_dual, dual_dual]

name: dual_balance'
statement:
theorem dual_balance' (l : Ordnode α) (x : α) (r : Ordnode α) :
    dual (balance' l x r) = balance' (dual r) x (dual l)
proof:
:= by
  simp [balance', add_comm]; split_ifs with h h_1 h_2 <;>
    simp [dual_rotateL, dual_rotateR, add_comm]
  cases delta_lt_false h_1 h_2

name: dual_balanceL
statement:
theorem dual_balanceL (l : Ordnode α) (x : α) (r : Ordnode α) :
    dual (balanceL l x r) = balanceR (dual r) x (dual l)
proof:
:= by
  unfold balanceL balanceR
  obtain - | ⟨rs, rl, rx, rr⟩ := r
  · obtain - | ⟨ls, ll, lx, lr⟩ := l; · rfl
    obtain - | ⟨lls, lll, llx, llr⟩ := ll <;> obtain - | ⟨lrs, lrl, lrx, lrr⟩ := lr <;>
      dsimp only [dual, id] <;> try rfl
    split_ifs with h <;> repeat simp [add_comm]
  · obtain - | ⟨ls, ll, lx, lr⟩ := l; · rfl
    dsimp only [dual, id]
    split_ifs; swap; · simp [add_comm]
    obtain - | ⟨lls, lll, llx, llr⟩ := ll <;> obtain - | ⟨lrs, lrl, lrx, lrr⟩ := lr <;> try rfl
    dsimp only [dual, id]
    split_ifs with h <;> simp [add_comm]

name: dual_balanceR
statement:
theorem dual_balanceR (l : Ordnode α) (x : α) (r : Ordnode α) :
    dual (balanceR l x r) = balanceL (dual r) x (dual l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dual_dual (balanceL _ _ _), dual_balanceL, dual_dual, dual_dual]

name: Sized.node3L
statement:
theorem Sized.node3L {l x m y r} (hl : @Sized α l) (hm : Sized m) (hr : Sized r) :
    Sized (node3L l x m y r)

name: Sized.node3R
statement:
theorem Sized.node3R {l x m y r} (hl : @Sized α l) (hm : Sized m) (hr : Sized r) :
    Sized (node3R l x m y r)

name: Sized.node4L
statement:
theorem Sized.node4L {l x m y r} (hl : @Sized α l) (hm : Sized m) (hr : Sized r) :
    Sized (node4L l x m y r)
proof:
:= by
  cases m <;> [exact (hl.node' hm).node' hr; exact (hl.node' hm.2.1).node' (hm.2.2.node' hr)]

name: node3L_size
statement: theorem node3L_size {l x m y r} : size (@node3L α l x m y r) = size l + size m + size r + 2

name: node3R_size
statement: theorem node3R_size {l x m y r} : size (@node3R α l x m y r) = size l + size m + size r + 2
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [node3R, node', size]; rw [← add_assoc, ← add_assoc]

name: node4L_size
statement:
theorem node4L_size {l x m y r} (hm : Sized m) :
    size (@node4L α l x m y r) = size l + size m + size r + 2
proof:
:= by
  cases m
  · simp [node4L, node3L, node']
    abel
  · simp [node4L, node', size, hm.1]; abel

name: Sized.dual
statement:
theorem Sized.dual : ∀ {t : Ordnode α}, Sized t → Sized (dual t)
  | nil, _ => ⟨⟩
  | node _ l _ r, ⟨rfl, sl, sr⟩ => ⟨by simp [size_dual, add_comm], Sized.dual sr, Sized.dual sl⟩

name: Sized.dual_iff
statement: theorem Sized.dual_iff {t : Ordnode α} : Sized (.dual t) ↔ Sized t
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← dual_dual t]; exact h.dual, Sized.dual⟩

name: Sized.rotateL
statement: theorem Sized.rotateL {l x r} (hl : @Sized α l) (hr : Sized r) : Sized (rotateL l x r)
proof:
:= by
  cases r; · exact hl.node' hr
  rw [Ordnode.rotateL_node]; split_ifs
  · exact hl.node3L hr.2.1 hr.2.2
  · exact hl.node4L hr.2.1 hr.2.2

name: Sized.rotateR
statement: theorem Sized.rotateR {l x r} (hl : @Sized α l) (hr : Sized r) : Sized (rotateR l x r)
proof:
:=
  Sized.dual_iff.1 <| by rw [dual_rotateR]; exact hr.dual.rotateL hl.dual

name: Sized.rotateL_size
statement:
theorem Sized.rotateL_size {l x r} (hm : Sized r) :
    size (@Ordnode.rotateL α l x r) = size l + size r + 1
proof:
:= by
  cases r <;> simp [Ordnode.rotateL]
  simp only [hm.1]
  split_ifs <;> simp [node3L_size, node4L_size hm.2.1] <;> abel

name: Sized.rotateR_size
statement:
theorem Sized.rotateR_size {l x r} (hl : Sized l) :
    size (@Ordnode.rotateR α l x r) = size l + size r + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← size_dual, dual_rotateR, hl.dual.rotateL_size, size_dual, size_dual, add_comm (size l)]

name: Sized.balance'
statement: theorem Sized.balance' {l x r} (hl : @Sized α l) (hr : Sized r) : Sized (balance' l x r)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Ordnode.balance'; split_ifs
  · exact hl.node' hr
  · exact hl.rotateL hr
  · exact hl.rotateR hr
  · exact hl.node' hr

name: size_balance'
statement:
theorem size_balance' {l x r} (hl : @Sized α l) (hr : Sized r) :
    size (@balance' α l x r) = size l + size r + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold balance'; split_ifs
  · rfl
  · exact hr.rotateL_size
  · exact hl.rotateR_size
  · rfl

name: All.imp
statement:
theorem All.imp {P Q : α → Prop} (H : ∀ a, P a → Q a) : ∀ {t}, All P t → All Q t
  | nil, _ => ⟨⟩
  | node _ _ _ _, ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ => ⟨h₁.imp H, H _ h₂, h₃.imp H⟩

name: Any.imp
statement:
theorem Any.imp {P Q : α → Prop} (H : ∀ a, P a → Q a) : ∀ {t}, Any P t → Any Q t
  | nil => id
  | node _ _ _ _ => Or.imp (Any.imp H) <| Or.imp (H _) (Any.imp H)

name: all_singleton
statement: theorem all_singleton {P : α → Prop} {x : α} : All P (singleton x) ↔ P x

name: any_singleton
statement: theorem any_singleton {P : α → Prop} {x : α} : Any P (singleton x) ↔ P x
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro (⟨⟨⟩⟩ | h | ⟨⟨⟩⟩); exact h, fun h => Or.inr (Or.inl h)⟩

name: all_dual
statement:
theorem all_dual {P : α → Prop} : ∀ {t : Ordnode α}, All P (dual t) ↔ All P t
  | nil => Iff.rfl
  | node _ _l _x _r =>
    ⟨fun ⟨hr, hx, hl⟩ => ⟨all_dual.1 hl, hx, all_dual.1 hr⟩, fun ⟨hl, hx, hr⟩ =>
      ⟨all_dual.2 hr, hx, all_dual.2 hl⟩⟩

name: all_iff_forall
statement:
theorem all_iff_forall {P : α → Prop} : ∀ {t}, All P t ↔ ∀ x, Emem x t → P x
  | nil => (iff_true_intro <| by rintro _ ⟨⟩).symm
  | node _ l x r => by simp [All, Emem, all_iff_forall, Any, or_imp, forall_and]

name: any_iff_exists
statement:
theorem any_iff_exists {P : α → Prop} : ∀ {t}, Any P t ↔ ∃ x, Emem x t ∧ P x
  | nil => ⟨by rintro ⟨⟩, by rintro ⟨_, ⟨⟩, _⟩⟩
  | node _ l x r => by simp only [Emem]; simp [Any, any_iff_exists, or_and_right, exists_or]

name: emem_iff_all
statement: theorem emem_iff_all {x : α} {t} : Emem x t ↔ ∀ P, All P t → P x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ al => all_iff_forall.1 al _ h, fun H => H _ <| all_iff_forall.2 fun _ => id⟩

name: all_node'
statement: theorem all_node' {P l x r} : @All α P (node' l x r) ↔ All P l ∧ P x ∧ All P r

name: all_node3L
statement:
theorem all_node3L {P l x m y r} :
    @All α P (node3L l x m y r) ↔ All P l ∧ P x ∧ All P m ∧ P y ∧ All P r

name: all_node3R
statement:
theorem all_node3R {P l x m y r} :
    @All α P (node3R l x m y r) ↔ All P l ∧ P x ∧ All P m ∧ P y ∧ All P r

name: all_node4L
statement:
theorem all_node4L {P l x m y r} :
    @All α P (node4L l x m y r) ↔ All P l ∧ P x ∧ All P m ∧ P y ∧ All P r
proof:
:= by
  cases m <;> simp [node4L, all_node', All, all_node3L, and_assoc]

name: all_node4R
statement:
theorem all_node4R {P l x m y r} :
    @All α P (node4R l x m y r) ↔ All P l ∧ P x ∧ All P m ∧ P y ∧ All P r
proof:
:= by
  cases m <;> simp [node4R, all_node', All, all_node3R, and_assoc]

name: all_rotateL
statement: theorem all_rotateL {P l x r} : @All α P (rotateL l x r) ↔ All P l ∧ P x ∧ All P r
proof:
:= by
  cases r <;> simp [rotateL, all_node']; split_ifs <;>
    simp [all_node3L, all_node4L, All]

name: all_rotateR
statement: theorem all_rotateR {P l x r} : @All α P (rotateR l x r) ↔ All P l ∧ P x ∧ All P r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← all_dual, dual_rotateR, all_rotateL]; simp [all_dual, and_comm, and_left_comm, and_assoc]

name: all_balance'
statement: theorem all_balance' {P l x r} : @All α P (balance' l x r) ↔ All P l ∧ P x ∧ All P r
proof:
:= by
  rw [balance']; split_ifs <;> simp [all_node', all_rotateL, all_rotateR]

name: foldr_cons_eq_toList
statement:
theorem foldr_cons_eq_toList : ∀ (t : Ordnode α) (r : List α), t.foldr List.cons r = toList t ++ r
  | nil, _ => rfl
  | node _ l x r, r' => by
    rw [foldr, foldr_cons_eq_toList l, foldr_cons_eq_toList r, ← List.cons_append,
        ← List.append_assoc, ← foldr_cons_eq_toList l]; rfl

name: length_toList'

name: length_toList
statement: theorem length_toList {t : Ordnode α} (h : Sized t) : (toList t).length = t.size

name: findMin_dual

  | node _ _ _ _ => congr_arg some <| findMin'_dual _ _

name: dual_eraseMin

  | nil => rfl
  | node _ nil _ _ => rfl
  | node _ (node sz l' y r') x r => by
    rw [eraseMin, dual_balanceR, dual_eraseMin (node sz l' y r'), dual, dual, dual, eraseMax]

name: splitMax_eq

theorem splitMax_eq :

name: merge_nil_left
