name: le_pred_iff
statement: theorem le_pred_iff {j : Fin n} {i : Fin (n + 1)} (hi : i ≠ 0) : j ≤ pred i hi ↔ succ j ≤ i

name: castSucc_pred_eq_pred_castSucc
statement:
theorem castSucc_pred_eq_pred_castSucc {a : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (a.pred ha).castSucc = (castSucc a).pred (castSucc_ne_zero_iff.mpr ha)

name: castSucc_pred_add_one_eq
statement:
theorem castSucc_pred_add_one_eq {a : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (a.pred ha).castSucc + 1 = a

name: le_pred_castSucc_iff
statement:
theorem le_pred_castSucc_iff {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : castSucc a ≠ 0) :
    b ≤ (castSucc a).pred ha ↔ b < a

name: pred_castSucc_lt_iff
statement:
theorem pred_castSucc_lt_iff {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : castSucc a ≠ 0) :
    (castSucc a).pred ha < b ↔ a ≤ b

name: pred_castSucc_lt
statement:
theorem pred_castSucc_lt {a : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : castSucc a ≠ 0) :
    (castSucc a).pred ha < a

name: le_castSucc_pred_iff
statement:
theorem le_castSucc_pred_iff {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    b ≤ castSucc (a.pred ha) ↔ b < a

name: castSucc_pred_lt_iff
statement:
theorem castSucc_pred_lt_iff {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    castSucc (a.pred ha) < b ↔ a ≤ b

name: castSucc_pred_lt
statement:
theorem castSucc_pred_lt {a : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    castSucc (a.pred ha) < a

name: castLT_eq_castPred
statement:
@[simp]
lemma castLT_eq_castPred (i : Fin (n + 1)) (h : i < last _) (h' := Fin.ext_iff.not.2 h.ne) :
    castLT i h = castPred i h'

name: coe_castPred
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_castPred (i : Fin (n + 1)) (h : i ≠ last _) : (castPred i h : ℕ) = i

name: castPred_castSucc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem castPred_castSucc {i : Fin n} (h' := Fin.ext_iff.not.2 (castSucc_lt_last i).ne) :
    castPred (castSucc i) h' = i

name: castSucc_castPred
statement:
@[simp]
theorem castSucc_castPred (i : Fin (n + 1)) (h : i ≠ last n) :
    castSucc (i.castPred h) = i
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_castSucc_eq.mpr h with ⟨y, rfl⟩
  rw [castPred_castSucc]

name: castPred_eq_iff_eq_castSucc
statement:
theorem castPred_eq_iff_eq_castSucc (i : Fin (n + 1)) (hi : i ≠ last _) (j : Fin n) :
    castPred i hi = j ↔ i = castSucc j
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← h, castSucc_castPred], fun h => by simp_rw [h, castPred_castSucc]⟩

name: castPred_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem castPred_mk (i : ℕ) (h₁ : i < n) (h₂ := h₁.trans (Nat.lt_succ_self _))
    (h₃ : ⟨i, h₂⟩ ≠ last _ := (ne_iff_vne _ _).mpr (val_last _ ▸ h₁.ne)) :
    castPred ⟨i, h₂⟩ h₃ = ⟨i, h₁⟩

name: castPred_le_castPred_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem castPred_le_castPred_iff {i j : Fin (n + 1)} {hi : i ≠ last n} {hj : j ≠ last n} :
    castPred i hi ≤ castPred j hj ↔ i ≤ j

name: castPred_le_castPred
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem castPred_le_castPred {i j : Fin (n + 1)} (h : i ≤ j) (hj : j ≠ last n) :
    castPred i (by rw [← lt_last_iff_ne_last] at hj ⊢; exact Fin.lt_of_le_of_lt h hj) ≤
      castPred j hj

name: castPred_lt_castPred_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem castPred_lt_castPred_iff {i j : Fin (n + 1)} {hi : i ≠ last n} {hj : j ≠ last n} :
    castPred i hi < castPred j hj ↔ i < j

name: castPred_lt_castPred
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem castPred_lt_castPred {i j : Fin (n + 1)} (h : i < j) (hj : j ≠ last n) :
    castPred i (ne_last_of_lt h) < castPred j hj

name: castPred_lt_iff
statement:
theorem castPred_lt_iff {j : Fin n} {i : Fin (n + 1)} (hi : i ≠ last n) :
    castPred i hi < j ↔ i < castSucc j

name: lt_castPred_iff
statement:
theorem lt_castPred_iff {j : Fin n} {i : Fin (n + 1)} (hi : i ≠ last n) :
    j < castPred i hi ↔ castSucc j < i

name: castPred_le_iff
statement:
theorem castPred_le_iff {j : Fin n} {i : Fin (n + 1)} (hi : i ≠ last n) :
    castPred i hi ≤ j ↔ i ≤ castSucc j

name: le_castPred_iff
statement:
theorem le_castPred_iff {j : Fin n} {i : Fin (n + 1)} (hi : i ≠ last n) :
    j ≤ castPred i hi ↔ castSucc j ≤ i

name: castPred_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem castPred_inj {i j : Fin (n + 1)} {hi : i ≠ last n} {hj : j ≠ last n} :
    castPred i hi = castPred j hj ↔ i = j

name: castPred_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem castPred_zero [NeZero n] :
    castPred (0 : Fin (n + 1)) (Fin.ext_iff.not.2 last_pos'.ne) = 0

name: castPred_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem castPred_eq_zero [NeZero n] {i : Fin (n + 1)} (h : i ≠ last n) :
    Fin.castPred i h = 0 ↔ i = 0

name: castPred_ne_zero
statement:
theorem castPred_ne_zero [NeZero n] {i : Fin (n + 1)} (h₁ : i ≠ last n) (h₂ : i ≠ 0) :
    castPred i h₁ ≠ 0

name: castPred_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem castPred_one [NeZero n] :
    castPred (1 : Fin (n + 2)) (Fin.ext_iff.not.2 one_lt_last.ne) = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · exact subsingleton_one.elim _ 1
  · rfl

name: succ_castPred_eq_castPred_succ
statement:
theorem succ_castPred_eq_castPred_succ {a : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ last n)
    (ha' := a.succ_ne_last_iff.mpr ha) :
    (a.castPred ha).succ = (succ a).castPred ha'

name: succ_castPred_eq_add_one
statement:
theorem succ_castPred_eq_add_one {a : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ last n) :
    (a.castPred ha).succ = a + 1
proof:
:= by
  cases a using lastCases
  · exact (ha rfl).elim
  · rw [castPred_castSucc, coeSucc_eq_succ]

name: castpred_succ_le_iff
statement:
theorem castpred_succ_le_iff {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : succ a ≠ last (n + 1)) :
    (succ a).castPred ha ≤ b ↔ a < b

name: lt_castPred_succ_iff
statement:
theorem lt_castPred_succ_iff {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : succ a ≠ last (n + 1)) :
    b < (succ a).castPred ha ↔ b ≤ a

name: lt_castPred_succ
statement:
theorem lt_castPred_succ {a : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : succ a ≠ last (n + 1)) :
    a < (succ a).castPred ha

name: succ_castPred_le_iff
statement:
theorem succ_castPred_le_iff {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ last n) :
    succ (a.castPred ha) ≤ b ↔ a < b

name: lt_succ_castPred_iff
statement:
theorem lt_succ_castPred_iff {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ last n) :
    b < succ (a.castPred ha) ↔ b ≤ a

name: lt_succ_castPred
statement:
theorem lt_succ_castPred {a : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ last n) :
    a < succ (a.castPred ha)

name: castPred_le_pred_iff
statement:
theorem castPred_le_pred_iff {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ last n) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    castPred a ha ≤ pred b hb ↔ a < b

name: pred_lt_castPred_iff
statement:
theorem pred_lt_castPred_iff {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ last n) :
    pred a ha < castPred b hb ↔ a ≤ b

name: pred_lt_castPred
statement:
theorem pred_lt_castPred {a : Fin (n + 1)} (h₁ : a ≠ 0) (h₂ : a ≠ last n) :
    pred a h₁ < castPred a h₂

name: val_sub_castLT_of_le
statement:
theorem val_sub_castLT_of_le {a b : Fin m} (ha : a.val < n) (h : b ≤ a) :
    (a.castLT ha - b.castLT (lt_of_le_of_lt h ha)).val = (a - b).val
proof:
:= by
  have : b.castLT (lt_of_le_of_lt h ha) ≤ a.castLT ha := by simpa [← val_fin_le] using h
  simp [sub_val_of_le, h, this]

name: sub_castLT_eq_castLT_sub_of_le
statement:
theorem sub_castLT_eq_castLT_sub_of_le {a b : Fin m} (ha : a.val < n) (h : b ≤ a) :
    a.castLT ha - b.castLT (lt_of_le_of_lt h ha) =
      (a - b).castLT (val_sub_lt_of_lt_of_le ha h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.ext_iff]
  exact val_sub_castLT_of_le ha h

name: val_sub_castLT_of_lt
statement:
theorem val_sub_castLT_of_lt {a b : Fin m} (hb : b < n) (h : a < b) :
    (a.castLT (lt_trans h hb) - b.castLT hb).val = (a - b).val + n - m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [val_sub, val_castLT]
  repeat rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  have h' : a.val < b.val := h
  omega

name: val_sub_castPred_of_le
statement:
theorem val_sub_castPred_of_le {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ last n)
    (h : b ≤ a) :
    (a.castPred ha - b.castPred (ne_last_of_ne_last_of_le ha h)).val = (a - b).val

name: sub_castPred_eq_castPred_sub_of_le
statement:
theorem sub_castPred_eq_castPred_sub_of_le {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ last n)
    (h : b ≤ a) :
    a.castPred ha - b.castPred (ne_last_of_ne_last_of_le ha h) =
      (a - b).castPred (sub_ne_last_of_ne_last_of_le ha h)

name: val_sub_castPred_of_ge
statement:
theorem val_sub_castPred_of_ge {a b : Fin (n + 1)} (hb : b ≠ last n)
    (h : a ≤ b) :
    (a.castPred (ne_last_of_ne_last_of_le hb h) - b.castPred hb).val = (a - b).val - 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain (rfl | h') := Fin.eq_or_lt_of_le h
  · simp [val_sub, Nat.sub_add_cancel a.is_le]
  grind [castPred, val_sub_castLT_of_lt]

name: succAbove_of_castSucc_lt
statement:
lemma succAbove_of_castSucc_lt (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) (h : castSucc i < p) :
    p.succAbove i = castSucc i

name: succAbove_of_succ_le
statement:
lemma succAbove_of_succ_le (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) (h : succ i ≤ p) :
    p.succAbove i = castSucc i

name: succAbove_of_le_castSucc
statement:
lemma succAbove_of_le_castSucc (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) (h : p ≤ castSucc i) :
    p.succAbove i = i.succ

name: succAbove_of_lt_succ
statement:
lemma succAbove_of_lt_succ (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) (h : p < succ i) :
    p.succAbove i = succ i

name: succAbove_succ_of_lt
statement: lemma succAbove_succ_of_lt (p i : Fin n) (h : p < i) : succAbove p.succ i = i.succ

name: succAbove_succ_of_le
statement: lemma succAbove_succ_of_le (p i : Fin n) (h : i ≤ p) : succAbove p.succ i = i.castSucc

name: succAbove_succ_self
statement: @[simp] lemma succAbove_succ_self (j : Fin n) : j.succ.succAbove j = j.castSucc

name: succAbove_castSucc_of_lt
statement: lemma succAbove_castSucc_of_lt (p i : Fin n) (h : i < p) : succAbove p.castSucc i = i.castSucc

name: succAbove_castSucc_of_le
statement: lemma succAbove_castSucc_of_le (p i : Fin n) (h : p ≤ i) : succAbove p.castSucc i = i.succ

name: succAbove_castSucc_self
statement: @[simp] lemma succAbove_castSucc_self (j : Fin n) : succAbove j.castSucc j = j.succ

name: succAbove_pred_of_lt
statement:
lemma succAbove_pred_of_lt (p i : Fin (n + 1)) (h : p < i) :
    succAbove p (i.pred (Fin.ne_of_gt <| Fin.lt_of_le_of_lt p.zero_le h)) = i

name: succAbove_pred_of_le
statement:
lemma succAbove_pred_of_le (p i : Fin (n + 1)) (h : i ≤ p) (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    succAbove p (i.pred hi) = (i.pred hi).castSucc

name: succAbove_pred_self
statement:
@[simp] lemma succAbove_pred_self (p : Fin (n + 1)) (h : p ≠ 0) :
    succAbove p (p.pred h) = (p.pred h).castSucc

name: succAbove_castPred_of_lt
statement:
lemma succAbove_castPred_of_lt (p i : Fin (n + 1)) (h : i < p) :
    succAbove p (i.castPred (Fin.ne_of_lt <| Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le h p.le_last)) = i

name: succAbove_castPred_of_le
statement:
lemma succAbove_castPred_of_le (p i : Fin (n + 1)) (h : p ≤ i) (hi : i ≠ last n) :
    succAbove p (i.castPred hi) = (i.castPred hi).succ

name: succAbove_castPred_self
statement:
lemma succAbove_castPred_self (p : Fin (n + 1)) (h : p ≠ last n) :
    succAbove p (p.castPred h) = (p.castPred h).succ

name: succAbove_ne
statement:
@[simp]
lemma succAbove_ne (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) : p.succAbove i ≠ p
proof:
:= by
  rcases p.castSucc_lt_or_lt_succ i with (h | h)
  · rw [succAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ h]
    exact Fin.ne_of_lt h
  · rw [succAbove_of_lt_succ _ _ h]
    exact Fin.ne_of_gt h

name: ne_succAbove
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ne_succAbove (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) : p ≠ p.succAbove i

name: succAbove_right_injective
statement: lemma succAbove_right_injective : Injective p.succAbove
proof:
:= by
  rintro i j hij
  unfold succAbove at hij
  split_ifs at hij with hi hj hj
  · exact castSucc_injective _ hij
  · rw [hij] at hi
    cases hj <| Nat.lt_trans j.castSucc_lt_succ hi
  · rw [← hij] at hj
    cases hi <| Nat.lt_trans i.castSucc_lt_succ hj
  · exact succ_injective _ hij

name: succAbove_right_inj
statement: lemma succAbove_right_inj : p.succAbove i = p.succAbove j ↔ i = j

name: succAbove_ne_zero_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma succAbove_ne_zero_zero [NeZero n] {a : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ 0) : a.succAbove 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.succAbove_of_castSucc_lt]
  · exact castSucc_zero'
  · exact Fin.pos_iff_ne_zero.2 ha

name: succAbove_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma succAbove_eq_zero_iff [NeZero n] {a : Fin (n + 1)} {b : Fin n} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    a.succAbove b = 0 ↔ b = 0

name: succAbove_ne_zero
statement:
lemma succAbove_ne_zero [NeZero n] {a : Fin (n + 1)} {b : Fin n} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    a.succAbove b ≠ 0

name: succAbove_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma succAbove_zero : succAbove (0 : Fin (n + 1)) = Fin.succ

name: succAbove_zero_apply
statement: lemma succAbove_zero_apply (i : Fin n) : succAbove 0 i = succ i

name: succAbove_ne_last_last
statement:
@[simp] lemma succAbove_ne_last_last {a : Fin (n + 2)} (h : a ≠ last (n + 1)) :
    a.succAbove (last n) = last (n + 1)

name: succAbove_eq_last_iff
statement:
lemma succAbove_eq_last_iff {a : Fin (n + 2)} {b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ last _) :
    a.succAbove b = last _ ↔ b = last _

name: succAbove_ne_last
statement:
lemma succAbove_ne_last {a : Fin (n + 2)} {b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ last _) (hb : b ≠ last _) :
    a.succAbove b ≠ last _

name: succAbove_last
statement: @[simp] lemma succAbove_last : succAbove (last n) = castSucc

name: succAbove_last_apply
statement: lemma succAbove_last_apply (i : Fin n) : succAbove (last n) i = castSucc i

name: succAbove_lt_iff_castSucc_lt
statement:
lemma succAbove_lt_iff_castSucc_lt (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    p.succAbove i < p ↔ castSucc i < p
proof:
:= by
  rcases castSucc_lt_or_lt_succ p i with H | H
  · rwa [iff_true_right H, succAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ H]
  · rw [castSucc_lt_iff_succ_le, iff_false_right (Fin.not_le.2 H), succAbove_of_lt_succ _ _ H]
    exact Fin.not_lt.2 <| Fin.le_of_lt H

name: succAbove_lt_iff_succ_le
statement:
lemma succAbove_lt_iff_succ_le (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    p.succAbove i < p ↔ succ i ≤ p

name: lt_succAbove_iff_le_castSucc
statement:
lemma lt_succAbove_iff_le_castSucc (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    p < p.succAbove i ↔ p ≤ castSucc i
proof:
:= by
  rcases castSucc_lt_or_lt_succ p i with H | H
  · rw [iff_false_right (Fin.not_le.2 H), succAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ H]
    exact Fin.not_lt.2 <| Fin.le_of_lt H
  · rwa [succAbove_of_lt_succ _ _ H, iff_true_left H, le_castSucc_iff]

name: lt_succAbove_iff_lt_castSucc
statement:
lemma lt_succAbove_iff_lt_castSucc (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    p < p.succAbove i ↔ p < succ i

name: succAbove_pos
statement: lemma succAbove_pos [NeZero n] (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) (h : 0 < i) : 0 < p.succAbove i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : castSucc i < p
  · simpa [succAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ H] using castSucc_pos' h
  · simp [succAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ (Fin.not_lt.1 H)]

name: castPred_succAbove
statement:
lemma castPred_succAbove (x : Fin n) (y : Fin (n + 1)) (h : castSucc x < y)
    (h' := Fin.ne_last_of_lt <| (succAbove_lt_iff_castSucc_lt ..).2 h) :
    (y.succAbove x).castPred h' = x

name: pred_succAbove
statement:
lemma pred_succAbove (x : Fin n) (y : Fin (n + 1)) (h : y ≤ castSucc x)
    (h' := Fin.ne_zero_of_lt <| (lt_succAbove_iff_le_castSucc ..).2 h) :
    (y.succAbove x).pred h' = x

name: exists_succAbove_eq
statement: lemma exists_succAbove_eq {x y : Fin (n + 1)} (h : x ≠ y) : ∃ z, y.succAbove z = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain hxy | hyx := Fin.lt_or_lt_of_ne h
  exacts [⟨_, succAbove_castPred_of_lt _ _ hxy⟩, ⟨_, succAbove_pred_of_lt _ _ hyx⟩]

name: exists_succAbove_eq_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma exists_succAbove_eq_iff {x y : Fin (n + 1)} : (∃ z, x.succAbove z = y) ↔ y ≠ x

name: range_succAbove
statement: @[simp] lemma range_succAbove (p : Fin (n + 1)) : Set.range p.succAbove = {p}ᶜ

name: range_succ
statement: @[simp] lemma range_succ (n : ℕ) : Set.range (Fin.succ : Fin n → Fin (n + 1)) = {0}ᶜ

name: succAbove_left_injective
statement: lemma succAbove_left_injective : Injective (@succAbove n)
proof:
:= fun _ _ h => by
  simpa [range_succAbove] using congr_arg (fun f : Fin n → Fin (n + 1) => (Set.range f)ᶜ) h

name: succAbove_left_inj
statement: @[simp] lemma succAbove_left_inj {x y : Fin (n + 1)} : x.succAbove = y.succAbove ↔ x = y

name: zero_succAbove
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_succAbove {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : (0 : Fin (n + 1)).succAbove i = i.succ

name: succ_succAbove_zero
statement: lemma succ_succAbove_zero {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (i : Fin n) : succAbove i.succ 0 = 0

name: succ_succAbove_succ
statement:
@[simp] lemma succ_succAbove_succ {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin n) :
    i.succ.succAbove j.succ = (i.succAbove j).succ
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := i.lt_or_ge (succ j)
  · rw [succAbove_of_lt_succ _ _ h, succAbove_succ_of_lt _ _ h]
  · rwa [succAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ h, succAbove_succ_of_le, succ_castSucc]

name: castSucc_succAbove_castSucc
statement:
@[simp]
lemma castSucc_succAbove_castSucc {n : ℕ} {i : Fin (n + 1)} {j : Fin n} :
    i.castSucc.succAbove j.castSucc = (i.succAbove j).castSucc
proof:
:= by
  rcases i.le_or_gt (castSucc j) with (h | h)
  · rw [succAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ h, succAbove_castSucc_of_le _ _ h, succ_castSucc]
  · rw [succAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ h, succAbove_castSucc_of_lt _ _ h]

name: pred_succAbove_pred
statement:
lemma pred_succAbove_pred {a : Fin (n + 2)} {b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hk := succAbove_ne_zero ha hb) :
    (a.pred ha).succAbove (b.pred hb) = (a.succAbove b).pred hk
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← succ_inj (b := pred (succAbove a b) hk), ← succ_succAbove_succ, succ_pred]

name: castPred_succAbove_castPred
statement:
lemma castPred_succAbove_castPred {a : Fin (n + 2)} {b : Fin (n + 1)} (ha : a ≠ last (n + 1))
    (hb : b ≠ last n) (hk := succAbove_ne_last ha hb) :
    (a.castPred ha).succAbove (b.castPred hb) = (a.succAbove b).castPred hk
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← castSucc_inj (b := (a.succAbove b).castPred hk), ← castSucc_succAbove_castSucc,
    castSucc_castPred]

name: one_succAbove_zero
statement: lemma one_succAbove_zero {n : ℕ} : (1 : Fin (n + 2)).succAbove 0 = 0

name: succ_succAbove_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma succ_succAbove_one {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    i.succ.succAbove 1 = (i.succAbove 0).succ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← succ_zero_eq_one']
  exact succ_succAbove_succ i 0

name: one_succAbove_succ
statement:
@[simp] lemma one_succAbove_succ {n : ℕ} (j : Fin n) :
    (1 : Fin (n + 2)).succAbove j.succ = j.succ.succ
proof:
:= by
  have := succ_succAbove_succ 0 j; rwa [succ_zero_eq_one, zero_succAbove] at this

name: one_succAbove_one
statement: @[simp] lemma one_succAbove_one {n : ℕ} : (1 : Fin (n + 3)).succAbove 1 = 2

name: succAbove_le_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma succAbove_le_iff {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    p.succAbove i ≤ p ↔ i.castSucc < p

name: succAbove_lt_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma succAbove_lt_iff {n : ℕ} (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    p.succAbove i < p ↔ i.castSucc < p

name: predAbove_of_le_castSucc
statement:
lemma predAbove_of_le_castSucc (p : Fin n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (h : i ≤ castSucc p) :
    p.predAbove i = i.castPred (Fin.ne_of_lt <| Fin.lt_of_le_of_lt h <| castSucc_lt_last _)

name: predAbove_of_lt_succ
statement:
lemma predAbove_of_lt_succ (p : Fin n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (h : i < succ p) :
    p.predAbove i = i.castPred (Fin.ne_last_of_lt h)

name: predAbove_of_castSucc_lt
statement:
lemma predAbove_of_castSucc_lt (p : Fin n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (h : castSucc p < i) :
    p.predAbove i = i.pred (Fin.ne_zero_of_lt h)

name: predAbove_of_succ_le
statement:
lemma predAbove_of_succ_le (p : Fin n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (h : succ p ≤ i) :
    p.predAbove i = i.pred (Fin.ne_of_gt <| Fin.lt_of_lt_of_le (succ_pos _) h)

name: predAbove_succ_of_lt
statement:
lemma predAbove_succ_of_lt (p i : Fin n) (h : i < p) :
    p.predAbove (succ i) = (i.succ).castPred (succ_ne_last_of_lt h)

name: predAbove_succ_of_le
statement: lemma predAbove_succ_of_le (p i : Fin n) (h : p ≤ i) : p.predAbove (succ i) = i

name: predAbove_succ_self
statement: @[simp] lemma predAbove_succ_self (p : Fin n) : p.predAbove (succ p) = p

name: predAbove_castSucc_of_lt
statement:
lemma predAbove_castSucc_of_lt (p i : Fin n) (h : p < i) :
    p.predAbove (castSucc i) = i.castSucc.pred (castSucc_ne_zero_of_lt h)

name: predAbove_castSucc_of_le
statement: lemma predAbove_castSucc_of_le (p i : Fin n) (h : i ≤ p) : p.predAbove (castSucc i) = i

name: predAbove_castSucc_self
statement: @[simp] lemma predAbove_castSucc_self (p : Fin n) : p.predAbove (castSucc p) = p

name: predAbove_pred_of_lt
statement:
lemma predAbove_pred_of_lt (p i : Fin (n + 1)) (h : i < p) :
    (pred p (Fin.ne_zero_of_lt h)).predAbove i = castPred i (Fin.ne_last_of_lt h)

name: predAbove_pred_of_le
statement:
lemma predAbove_pred_of_le (p i : Fin (n + 1)) (h : p ≤ i) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    (pred p hp).predAbove i =
      pred i (Fin.ne_of_gt <| Fin.lt_of_lt_of_le (Fin.pos_iff_ne_zero.2 hp) h)

name: predAbove_pred_self
statement: lemma predAbove_pred_self (p : Fin (n + 1)) (hp : p ≠ 0) : (pred p hp).predAbove p = pred p hp

name: predAbove_castPred_of_lt
statement:
lemma predAbove_castPred_of_lt (p i : Fin (n + 1)) (h : p < i) :
    (castPred p (Fin.ne_last_of_lt h)).predAbove i = pred i (Fin.ne_zero_of_lt h)

name: predAbove_castPred_of_le
statement:
lemma predAbove_castPred_of_le (p i : Fin (n + 1)) (h : i ≤ p) (hp : p ≠ last n) :
    (castPred p hp).predAbove i =
      castPred i (Fin.ne_of_lt <| Fin.lt_of_le_of_lt h <| Fin.lt_last_iff_ne_last.2 hp)

name: predAbove_castPred_self
statement:
lemma predAbove_castPred_self (p : Fin (n + 1)) (hp : p ≠ last n) :
    (castPred p hp).predAbove p = castPred p hp

name: predAbove_right_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma predAbove_right_zero [NeZero n] {i : Fin n} : predAbove (i : Fin n) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · exact i.elim0
  · rw [predAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ (zero_le _), castPred_zero]

name: predAbove_zero_succ
statement: lemma predAbove_zero_succ [NeZero n] {i : Fin n} : predAbove 0 i.succ = i

name: predAbove_zero_of_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma predAbove_zero_of_ne_zero [NeZero n] {i : Fin (n + 1)} (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    predAbove 0 i = i.pred hi
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := exists_succ_eq.2 hi
  exact predAbove_zero_succ

name: succ_predAbove_zero
statement: lemma succ_predAbove_zero [NeZero n] {j : Fin (n + 1)} (h : j ≠ 0) : succ (predAbove 0 j) = j

name: predAbove_zero
statement:
lemma predAbove_zero [NeZero n] {i : Fin (n + 1)} :
    predAbove (0 : Fin n) i = if hi : i = 0 then 0 else i.pred hi
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hi
  · rw [hi, predAbove_right_zero]
  · rw [predAbove_zero_of_ne_zero hi]

name: predAbove_right_last
statement: @[simp] lemma predAbove_right_last {i : Fin (n + 1)} : predAbove i (last (n + 1)) = last n

name: predAbove_last_castSucc
statement: lemma predAbove_last_castSucc {i : Fin (n + 1)} : predAbove (last n) (i.castSucc) = i

name: predAbove_last_of_ne_last
statement:
@[simp] lemma predAbove_last_of_ne_last {i : Fin (n + 2)} (hi : i ≠ last (n + 1)) :
    predAbove (last n) i = castPred i hi
proof:
:= by
  rw [← exists_castSucc_eq] at hi
  rcases hi with ⟨y, rfl⟩
  exact predAbove_last_castSucc

name: predAbove_last_apply
statement:
lemma predAbove_last_apply {i : Fin (n + 2)} :
    predAbove (last n) i = if hi : i = last _ then last _ else i.castPred hi
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hi
  · rw [hi, predAbove_right_last]
  · rw [predAbove_last_of_ne_last hi]

name: predAbove_surjective
statement:
lemma predAbove_surjective {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n) :
    Function.Surjective p.predAbove
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i ≤ p
  · exact ⟨i.castSucc, predAbove_castSucc_of_le p i hi⟩
  · rw [Fin.not_le] at hi
    exact ⟨i.succ, predAbove_succ_of_le p i (Fin.le_of_lt hi)⟩

name: succAbove_predAbove
statement:
@[simp]
lemma succAbove_predAbove {p : Fin n} {i : Fin (n + 1)} (h : i ≠ castSucc p) :
    p.castSucc.succAbove (p.predAbove i) = i
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := Fin.lt_or_lt_of_ne h
  · rw [predAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ (Fin.le_of_lt h), succAbove_castPred_of_lt _ _ h]
  · rw [predAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ h, succAbove_pred_of_lt _ _ h]

name: succ_succAbove_predAbove
statement:
@[simp]
lemma succ_succAbove_predAbove {n : ℕ} {p : Fin n} {i : Fin (n + 1)} (h : i ≠ p.succ) :
    p.succ.succAbove (p.predAbove i) = i
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := Fin.lt_or_lt_of_ne h
  · rw [predAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ (le_castSucc_iff.2 h),
      succAbove_castPred_of_lt _ _ h]
  · rw [predAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ (Fin.lt_of_le_of_lt (p.castSucc_le_succ) h),
      succAbove_pred_of_lt _ _ h]

name: predAbove_succAbove
statement:
@[simp]
lemma predAbove_succAbove (p : Fin n) (i : Fin n) : p.predAbove ((castSucc p).succAbove i) = i
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := p.le_or_gt i
  · rw [succAbove_castSucc_of_le _ _ h, predAbove_succ_of_le _ _ h]
  · rw [succAbove_castSucc_of_lt _ _ h, predAbove_castSucc_of_le _ _ <| Fin.le_of_lt h]

name: succ_predAbove_succ
statement:
@[simp] lemma succ_predAbove_succ (a : Fin n) (b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    a.succ.predAbove b.succ = (a.predAbove b).succ
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := Fin.le_or_gt (succ a) b
  · rw [predAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ h, predAbove_succ_of_le _ _ h, succ_pred]
  · rw [predAbove_of_lt_succ _ _ h, predAbove_succ_of_lt _ _ h, succ_castPred_eq_castPred_succ]

name: castSucc_predAbove_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] lemma castSucc_predAbove_castSucc {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n) (b : Fin (n + 1)) :
    a.castSucc.predAbove b.castSucc = (a.predAbove b).castSucc
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := a.castSucc.lt_or_ge b
  · rw [predAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ h, predAbove_castSucc_of_lt _ _ h,
      castSucc_pred_eq_pred_castSucc]
  · rw [predAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ h, predAbove_castSucc_of_le _ _ h, castSucc_castPred]

name: predAbove_predAbove_succAbove
statement:
theorem predAbove_predAbove_succAbove {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin n) :
    (j.predAbove i).predAbove (i.succAbove j) = j
proof:
:= by
  cases j.castSucc.lt_or_le i with
  | inl h =>
    rw [predAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ h, succAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ h, predAbove_of_le_castSucc,
      castPred_castSucc]
    rwa [le_castSucc_iff, succ_pred]
  | inr h =>
    rw [predAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ h, succAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ h, predAbove_of_castSucc_lt,
      pred_succ]
    rwa [castSucc_castPred, ← le_castSucc_iff]

name: succAbove_succAbove_predAbove
statement:
theorem succAbove_succAbove_predAbove {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin n) :
    (i.succAbove j).succAbove (j.predAbove i) = i
proof:
:= by
  cases Fin.lt_or_le j.castSucc i with
  | inl h => rw [succAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ h, succAbove_predAbove (Fin.ne_of_gt h)]
  | inr h =>
    rw [succAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ h,
      succ_succAbove_predAbove (Fin.ne_of_lt <| le_castSucc_iff.mp h)]

name: succAbove_succAbove_succAbove_predAbove
proof:
:= by
  /- While it is possible to give a "morally correct" proof
  by saying that both functions are strictly monotone and have the same range `{i, i.succAbove j}ᶜ`,
  we give a direct proof by case analysis to avoid extra dependencies. -/
  ext
  simp only [succAbove, predAbove, lt_def, val_castSucc, apply_dite Fin.val, val_pred, coe_castPred,
    dite_eq_ite, apply_ite Fin.val, val_succ]
  split_ifs <;> lia

name: vecAppend_eq_ite
statement:
theorem vecAppend_eq_ite {α : Type*} {o : ℕ} (ho : o = m + n) (u : Fin m → α) (v : Fin n → α) :
    vecAppend ho u v = fun i : Fin o =>
      if h : (i : ℕ) < m then u ⟨i, h⟩ else v ⟨(i : ℕ) - m, by lia⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  rw [vecAppend, Fin.append, Function.comp_apply, Fin.addCases]
  congr with hi
  simp only [eq_rec_constant]
  rfl

name: vecAppend_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vecAppend_apply_zero {α : Type*} {o : ℕ} (ho : o + 1 = m + 1 + n) (u : Fin (m + 1) → α)
    (v : Fin n → α) : vecAppend ho u v 0 = u 0

statement:

theorem empty_vecAppend (v : Fin n → α) : vecAppend n.zero_add.symm ![] v = v

name: vecAppend_empty
statement:

theorem vecAppend_empty (v : Fin n → α) : vecAppend rfl v ![] = v

name: cons_vecAppend
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cons_vecAppend (ho : o + 1 = m + 1 + n) (x : α) (u : Fin m → α) (v : Fin n → α) :
    vecAppend ho (vecCons x u) v = vecCons x (vecAppend (by lia) u v)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp_rw [vecAppend_eq_ite]
  split_ifs with h
  · rcases i with ⟨⟨⟩ | i, hi⟩
    · simp
    · simp only [Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right] at h
      simp [h]
  · rcases i with ⟨⟨⟩ | i, hi⟩
    · simp at h
    · rw [not_lt, Fin.val_mk, Nat.add_le_add_iff_right] at h
      simp [not_lt.2 h]

name: vecAlt0_vecAppend
statement:
theorem vecAlt0_vecAppend (v : Fin n → α) :
    vecAlt0 rfl (vecAppend rfl v v) = v ∘ (fun n ↦ n + n)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp_rw [Function.comp, vecAlt0, vecAppend_eq_ite]
  split_ifs with h <;> congr
  · rw [Fin.val_mk] at h
    exact (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h).symm
  · rw [Fin.val_mk, not_lt] at h
    simp only [Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod h]
    refine (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ?_).symm
    lia

name: vecAlt1_vecAppend
statement:
theorem vecAlt1_vecAppend (v : Fin (n + 1) → α) :
    vecAlt1 rfl (vecAppend rfl v v) = v ∘ (fun n ↦ (n + n) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp_rw [Function.comp, vecAlt1, vecAppend_eq_ite]
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
    simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.lt_one_iff] at hi; subst i; rfl
  | succ n =>
    split_ifs with h <;> congr
    · simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, h]
    · rw [Fin.val_mk, not_lt] at h
      simp only [Nat.mod_add_mod,
        Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod h, show 1 % (n + 2) = 1 from Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by lia)]
      refine (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ?_).symm
      lia

statement:

theorem cons_vecAlt0 (h : m + 1 + 1 = n + 1 + (n + 1)) (x y : α) (u : Fin m → α) :

name: cons_cons_comp_swap_zero_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cons_cons_comp_swap_zero_one (a b : α) (x : Fin n → α) :
    vecCons a (vecCons b x) ∘ (Equiv.swap 0 1) = vecCons b (vecCons a x)
proof:
:= by
  ext j : 1
  match j with
  | 0 => simp
  | 1 => simp
  | ⟨i + 2, h⟩ =>
    have h' : (⟨i + 2, h⟩ : Fin n.succ.succ) = Fin.succ (Fin.succ ⟨i, by lia⟩) := by grind
    simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, h', Function.comp_apply,
      Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero _) (Fin.succ_succ_ne_one _), cons_val_succ]

name: cons_swap
statement:
lemma cons_swap (a : α) (x : Fin n → α) (i j : Fin n) :
    vecCons a (x ∘ (Equiv.swap i j)) = vecCons a x ∘ (Equiv.swap i.succ j.succ)
proof:
:= by
  ext k : 1
  rcases eq_or_ne k 0 with rfl | hk₀
  · simp [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero i).symm (Fin.succ_ne_zero j).symm]
  rcases eq_or_ne k i.succ with rfl | hki
  · simp
  rcases eq_or_ne k j.succ with rfl | hkj
  · simp
  have hk : k = Fin.succ ⟨k - 1, by lia⟩ := by grind
  rw [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hki hkj, hk, cons_val_succ,
    Function.comp_apply, cons_val_succ, Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (by grind) (by grind)]

name: IsMaxChain.range_fin_of_covBy
statement:
theorem IsMaxChain.range_fin_of_covBy (h0 : f 0 = ⊥) (hlast : f (.last n) = ⊤)
    (hcovBy : ∀ k : Fin n, f k.castSucc ⩿ f k.succ) :
    IsMaxChain (· ≤ ·) (range f)
proof:
:= by
  have hmono : Monotone f := Fin.monotone_iff_le_succ.2 fun k ↦ (hcovBy k).1
  refine ⟨hmono.isChain_range, fun t htc hbt ↦ hbt.antisymm fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [mem_range]; by_contra! h
  suffices ∀ k, f k < x by simpa [hlast] using this (.last _)
  intro k
  induction k using Fin.induction with
  | zero => simpa [h0, bot_lt_iff_ne_bot] using (h 0).symm
  | succ k ihk =>
    rw [range_subset_iff] at hbt
    exact (htc.lt_of_le (hbt k.succ) hx (h _)).resolve_right ((hcovBy k).2 ihk)

statement:
theorem coe_int_sub_eq_ite {n : Nat} (u v : Fin n) :
    ((u - v : Fin n) : Int) = if v ≤ u then (u - v : Int) else (u - v : Int) + n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sub_def]
  split
  · rw [natCast_emod, Int.emod_eq_sub_self_emod, Int.emod_eq_of_lt] <;> omega
  · rw [natCast_emod, Int.emod_eq_of_lt] <;> omega

  · rw [Int.emod_eq_of_lt] <;> omega

proof:

  rw [Fin.add_def]
  split
  · rw [natCast_emod, Int.emod_eq_of_lt] <;> lia
  · rw [natCast_emod, Int.emod_eq_sub_self_emod, Int.emod_eq_of_lt] <;> lia

proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero n := ⟨by lia⟩
  rcases i with ⟨i, hi⟩
  rcases j with ⟨j, hj⟩
  simp_rw [← Fin.val_ne_iff]
  by_cases h0 : 0 ≠ i ∧ 0 ≠ j
  · exact ⟨0, h0⟩
  · by_cases h1 : 1 ≠ i ∧ 1 ≠ j
    · exact ⟨⟨1, by lia⟩, h1⟩
    · refine ⟨⟨2, by lia⟩, ?_⟩
      dsimp only
      lia

proof:
:= neZero_iff.mpr (by lia)
    (j - i).castLT (sub_val_lt_sub (Fin.le_of_lt hij)) ≠ 0 := by
  refine Ne.symm (ne_of_val_ne ?_)
  simp [coe_sub_iff_le.mpr (Fin.le_of_lt hij)]

name: one_le_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma one_le_of_ne_zero {n : ℕ} {k : Fin n} :
    haveI
proof:
:= k.neZero
    (hk : k ≠ 0) → 1 ≤ k := by
  have : NeZero n := k.neZero
  intro hk
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
  cases n with
  | zero => simp only [Fin.isValue, Fin.zero_le]
  | succ n => rwa [Fin.le_iff_val_le_val, Fin.val_one, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero, val_ne_zero_iff]

name: val_sub_one_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma val_sub_one_of_ne_zero {i : Fin n} :
    haveI
proof:
:= i.neZero
    (hi : i ≠ 0) → (i - 1).val = i - 1 := by
  have := i.neZero
  intro hi
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
  rw [Fin.sub_val_of_le (one_le_of_ne_zero hi), Fin.val_one', Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
    (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (nontrivial_iff_two_le.mp <| nontrivial_of_ne i 0 hi))]

statement:

lemma castLE_natCast {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] (h : m ≤ n) (a : ℕ) :

proof:
:= ⟨Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mp (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le m.pos_of_neZero h)⟩
    Fin.castLE h (a.cast : Fin m) = (a % m : ℕ) := by
  ext
  simp only [val_castLE, val_natCast]
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (a := a % m) (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.mod_lt _ m.pos_of_neZero) h)]

name: modNat_rev
statement: theorem modNat_rev (i : Fin (m * n)) : i.rev.modNat = i.modNat.rev
proof:
:= by
  ext
  have H₁ : i % n + 1 ≤ n := i.modNat.is_lt
  have H₂ : i / n < m := i.divNat.is_lt
  simp only [val_rev]
  calc
    (m * n - (i + 1)) % n = (m * n - ((i / n) * n + i % n + 1)) % n := by rw [Nat.div_add_mod']
    _ = ((m - i / n - 1) * n + (n - (i % n + 1))) % n := by
      rw [Nat.mul_sub_right_distrib, Nat.one_mul, Nat.sub_add_sub_cancel _ H₁,
        Nat.mul_sub_right_distrib, Nat.sub_sub, Nat.add_assoc]
      exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ <| Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' H₂
    _ = n - (i % n + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]; exact i.modNat.rev.is_lt

name: strong_induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma strong_induction_on {n : ℕ} {motive : Fin n → Prop}
    (h : ∀ (j : Fin n) (_ : ∀ (k : Fin n), k < j → motive k), motive j) (i : Fin n) :
    motive i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
  induction i using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h j hj => exact h _ (fun ⟨k, hk₁⟩ hk₂ ↦ hj _ hk₂ hk₁)

name: liftFun_iff_succ
statement:
theorem liftFun_iff_succ {α : Type*} (r : α → α → Prop) [IsTrans α r] {f : Fin (n + 1) → α} :
    ((· < ·) ⇒ r) f f ↔ ∀ i : Fin n, r (f (castSucc i)) (f i.succ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H i
    exact H i.castSucc_lt_succ
  · refine fun H i => Fin.induction (fun h ↦ ?_) ?_
    · simp at h
    · intro j ihj hij
      rw [← le_castSucc_iff] at hij
      obtain hij | hij := Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le <| le_def.1 hij
      · obtain rfl := Fin.ext hij
        exact H _
      · exact _root_.trans (ihj hij) (H j)

  refine ⟨⟨k, Nat.lt_trans hkb b.is_lt⟩, hkb, by fin_omega, ?_⟩

statement:
theorem lt_of_injective_of_notMem (f : Fin m → Fin n) (hf : f.Injective) {b : Fin n}
    (hb : b ∉ Set.range f) : m < n

name: nonempty_embedding_iff
statement: lemma nonempty_embedding_iff : Nonempty (Fin n ↪ Fin m) ↔ n ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨castLEEmb h⟩⟩
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => exact m.zero_le
  | succ n ihn =>
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
    rcases exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (pos_iff_nonempty.2 (Nonempty.map e inferInstance)).ne'
      with ⟨m, rfl⟩
    refine Nat.succ_le_succ <| ihn ⟨?_⟩
    refine ⟨fun i ↦ (e.setValue 0 0 i.succ).pred (mt e.setValue_eq_iff.1 i.succ_ne_zero),
      fun i j h ↦ ?_⟩
    simpa only [pred_inj, EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq, succ_inj] using h

proof:

name: succAbove_rev_left
statement:
lemma succAbove_rev_left (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) :
    p.rev.succAbove i = (p.succAbove i.rev).rev
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := (rev p).succ_le_or_le_castSucc i
  · rw [succAbove_of_succ_le _ _ h,
      succAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ (rev_succ _ ▸ (le_rev_iff.mpr h)), rev_succ, rev_rev]
  · rw [succAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ h,
      succAbove_of_succ_le _ _ (rev_castSucc _ ▸ (rev_le_iff.mpr h)), rev_castSucc, rev_rev]

name: predAbove_rev_left

  · rw [predAbove_of_succ_le _ _ h, rev_pred,
      predAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ (rev_succ _ ▸ (le_rev_iff.mpr h)), castPred_inj, rev_rev]
  · rw [predAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ h, rev_castPred,
      predAbove_of_succ_le _ _ (rev_castSucc _ ▸ (rev_le_iff.mpr h)), pred_inj, rev_rev]

name: even_succAbove_add_predAbove
statement:
theorem even_succAbove_add_predAbove (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin n) :
    Even (i.succAbove j + j.predAbove i : ℕ) ↔ Odd (i + j : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_ge j.castSucc i with hji | hij
  · have : 1 ≤ (i : ℕ) := (Nat.zero_le j).trans_lt hji
    simp [succAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ hji, predAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ hji, this, iff_comm,
      parity_simps]
  · simp [succAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ hij, predAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ hij,
      ← Nat.not_even_iff_odd, not_iff, not_iff_comm, parity_simps]

name: neg_one_pow_succAbove_add_predAbove
statement:
lemma neg_one_pow_succAbove_add_predAbove {R : Type*} [Monoid R] [HasDistribNeg R]
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin n) :
    (-1 : R) ^ (i.succAbove j + j.predAbove i : ℕ) = -(-1) ^ (i + j : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_one_mul (_ ^ _), ← pow_succ', neg_one_pow_congr]
  rw [even_succAbove_add_predAbove, Nat.even_add_one, Nat.not_even_iff_odd]

name: even_of_val
statement: lemma even_of_val (h : Even k.val) : Even k
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero n := ⟨k.pos.ne'⟩
  rw [← Fin.cast_val_eq_self k]
  exact h.natCast

name: odd_of_val
statement: lemma odd_of_val [NeZero n] (h : Odd k.val) : Odd k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fin.cast_val_eq_self k]
  exact h.natCast

name: even_of_odd
statement: lemma even_of_odd (hn : Odd n) (k : Fin n) : Even k
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero n := ⟨k.pos.ne'⟩
  rcases k.val.even_or_odd with hk | hk
  · exact even_of_val hk
  · simpa using (hk.add_odd hn).natCast (α := Fin n)

name: odd_of_odd
statement: lemma odd_of_odd [NeZero n] (hn : Odd n) (k : Fin n) : Odd k
proof:
:= by
  rcases k.val.even_or_odd with hk | hk
  · simpa using (Even.add_odd hk hn).natCast (R := Fin n)
  · exact odd_of_val hk

name: even_iff_of_even
statement: lemma even_iff_of_even (hn : Even n) : Even k ↔ Even k.val
proof:
:= by
  rcases hn with ⟨n, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨?_, even_of_val⟩
  rintro ⟨l, rfl⟩
  rw [val_add_eq_ite]
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [Nat.even_sub, *]

name: odd_iff_of_even
statement: lemma odd_iff_of_even [NeZero n] (hn : Even n) : Odd k ↔ Odd k.val
proof:
:= by
  rcases hn with ⟨n, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨?_, odd_of_val⟩
  rintro ⟨l, rfl⟩
  rw [val_add, val_mul, coe_ofNat_eq_mod, coe_ofNat_eq_mod]
  simp only [Nat.mod_mul_mod, Nat.add_mod_mod, Nat.mod_add_mod, Nat.odd_iff]
  rw [Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ ⟨n, (two_mul n).symm⟩, ← Nat.odd_iff, Nat.odd_add_one,
    Nat.not_odd_iff_even]
  simp

name: even_iff
statement: lemma even_iff : Even k ↔ (Odd n ∨ Even k.val)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hk ↦ ?_, or_imp.mpr ⟨(even_of_odd · k), even_of_val⟩⟩
  rw [← Nat.not_even_iff_odd, ← imp_iff_not_or]
  exact fun hn ↦ (even_iff_of_even hn).mp hk

name: even_iff_imp
statement: lemma even_iff_imp : Even k ↔ (Even n → Even k.val)

name: odd_iff
statement: lemma odd_iff [NeZero n] : Odd k ↔ Odd n ∨ Odd k.val
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hk ↦ ?_, or_imp.mpr ⟨(odd_of_odd · k), odd_of_val⟩⟩
  rw [← Nat.not_even_iff_odd, ← imp_iff_not_or]
  exact fun hn ↦ (odd_iff_of_even hn).mp hk

name: odd_iff_imp
statement: lemma odd_iff_imp [NeZero n] : Odd k ↔ (Even n → Odd k.val)

:= by

name: not_even_iff_odd_of_even

name: odd_add_one_iff_even

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨k, hk⟩ ↦ add_right_cancel hk ▸ even_two_mul k, Even.add_one⟩

name: even_add_one_iff_odd

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨k, hk⟩ ↦ eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mpr hk ▸ (Even.add_self k).sub_odd odd_one, Odd.add_one⟩

name: optionElim_apply_eq_elim
statement:

lemma optionElim_apply_eq_elim (y : M) (f : α →₀ M) (a : Option α) :
    f.optionElim y a = a.elim y f
proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | none => exact optionElim_apply_none y f
  | some x => simp only [optionElim_apply_some, Option.elim_some]

name: optionElim_eq_elim'

name: optionElim_some

proof:

name: optionElim_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem optionElim_zero (y : M) : (0 : α →₀ M).optionElim y = single none y
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  cases a
  · simp
  · simp

name: optionElim_ne_zero_of_left
statement: theorem optionElim_ne_zero_of_left (y : M) (f : α →₀ M) (h : y ≠ 0) : f.optionElim y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose h with c
  have : f.optionElim y none = (0 : Option α →₀ M) none := by
    rw [c]
  simp only [optionElim_apply_eq_elim, Option.elim_none, coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at this
  exact this

name: optionElim_ne_zero_of_right
statement: theorem optionElim_ne_zero_of_right (y : M) (f : α →₀ M) (h : f ≠ 0) : f.optionElim y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose h with c
  ext a
  have : f.optionElim y (Option.some a) = (0 : Option α →₀ M) (Option.some a) := by
    rw [c]
  simp only [optionElim_apply_eq_elim, Option.elim_some, coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at this
  exact this

name: optionElim_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem optionElim_ne_zero_iff (y : M) (f : α →₀ M) :
    f.optionElim y ≠ 0 ↔ f ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    contrapose! h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [optionElim_zero, single_zero]
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | inl h => exact optionElim_ne_zero_of_right y f h
    | inr h => exact optionElim_ne_zero_of_left y f h

name: eq_option_embedding_update_none_iff
statement:
theorem eq_option_embedding_update_none_iff {n : Option α →₀ M} {m : α →₀ M} {i : M} :

name: prod_option_index
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_option_index [AddZeroClass M] [CommMonoid N] (f : Option α →₀ M)
    (b : Option α → M → N) (h_zero : ∀ o, b o 0 = 1)
    (h_add : ∀ o m₁ m₂, b o (m₁ + m₂) = b o m₁ * b o m₂) :
    f.prod b = b none (f none) * f.some.prod fun a => b (Option.some a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
    induction f using induction_linear with
    | zero => simp [some_zero, h_zero]
    | add f₁ f₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      rw [Finsupp.prod_add_index, h₁, h₂, some_add, Finsupp.prod_add_index]
      · simp only [h_add, Pi.add_apply, Finsupp.coe_add]
        rw [mul_mul_mul_comm]
      all_goals simp [h_zero, h_add]
    | single a m => cases a <;> simp [h_zero]

name: sum_option_index_smul
statement:
theorem sum_option_index_smul [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] (f : Option α →₀ R)
    (b : Option α → M) :
    (f.sum fun o r => r • b o) = f none • b none + f.some.sum fun a r => r • b (Option.some a)

name: optionElim_add

lemma optionElim_add [AddZeroClass M] (a b : α →₀ M) (i j : M) :

proof:
:= by
  ext x; cases x <;> simp

name: indicator_apply

name: indicator_injective

proof:

name: indicator_indicator
statement:
theorem indicator_indicator [DecidableEq ι] :

name: eq_indicator_iff
statement:
theorem eq_indicator_iff {g : ι → α} :
    g = indicator s f ↔ g.support ⊆ s ∧ ∀ ⦃i⦄ (hi : i ∈ s), f i hi = g i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices g.support ⊆ s ∧ (∀ i (hi : i ∈ s), f i hi = g i) ↔
      (∀ i, if hi : i ∈ s then f i hi = g i else g i = 0) by
    simp only [this, funext_iff, indicator_apply]
    grind
  rw [Set.subset_def, and_comm]
  have : (∀ (i : ι), if hi : i ∈ s then f i hi = g i else g i = 0) ↔
      ((∀ (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s), f i hi = g i) ∧ ∀ i (hi : i ∉ s), g i = 0) := by grind
  simp [this, not_imp_comm]

statement:

theorem antidiagonal_zero : antidiagonal (0 : α →₀ ℕ) = singleton (0, 0)

name: prod_antidiagonal_swap
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_antidiagonal_swap {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (n : α →₀ ℕ)
    (f : (α →₀ ℕ) → (α →₀ ℕ) → M) :
    ∏ p ∈ antidiagonal n, f p.1 p.2 = ∏ p ∈ antidiagonal n, f p.2 p.1

name: antidiagonal_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem antidiagonal_single (a : α) (n : ℕ) :
    antidiagonal (single a n) = (antidiagonal n).map
      (Function.Embedding.prodMap ⟨_, single_injective a⟩ ⟨_, single_injective a⟩)
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨x, y⟩
  simp only [mem_antidiagonal, mem_map, mem_antidiagonal, Function.Embedding.coe_prodMap,
    Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, Prod.map_apply, Prod.mk.injEq, Prod.exists]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨x a, y a, DFunLike.congr_fun h a |>.trans single_eq_same, ?_⟩
    simp_rw [DFunLike.ext_iff, ← forall_and]
    intro i
    replace h := DFunLike.congr_fun h i
    simp_rw [single_apply, Finsupp.add_apply] at h ⊢
    obtain rfl | hai := Decidable.eq_or_ne a i
    · exact ⟨ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_left rfl⟩
    · simp_rw [ite_eq_right hai, add_eq_zero] at h ⊢
      exact h.imp Eq.symm Eq.symm
  · rintro ⟨a, b, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact (single_add _ _ _).symm

name: image_prodMap_embDomain_antidiagonal
statement:
theorem image_prodMap_embDomain_antidiagonal {β : Type*} [DecidableEq β] (f : α ↪ β)
    (y : α →₀ ℕ) : image (Prod.map (embDomain f) (embDomain f)) (antidiagonal y) =
      antidiagonal (embDomain f y)
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨u, v⟩
  simp only [mem_image, mem_antidiagonal, Prod.exists, Prod.map_apply,
    Prod.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨w, z, h, hw, hz⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨u.comapDomain f f.injective.injOn,
    ⟨v.comapDomain f f.injective.injOn, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩⟩
  · rw [← hw, ← hz, ← embDomain_add, h]
  · rw [← comapDomain_add_of_injective f.injective, h, comapDomain_embDomain]
  · rw [embDomain_comapDomain ((mem_range_embDomain_iff ..).mp
      (isLowerSet_range_embDomain f (le_iff_exists_add.mpr ⟨v, h.symm⟩) (by simp)))]
  · rw [embDomain_comapDomain ((mem_range_embDomain_iff ..).mp
      (isLowerSet_range_embDomain f (le_iff_exists_add'.mpr ⟨u, h.symm⟩) (by simp)))]

name: image_sumElim_product_antidiagonal
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨u, v⟩
  simp only [mem_antidiagonal, mem_image, mem_product, Prod.mk.injEq, Prod.exists]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨a, b, a', b', h1, h2, h3⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦
    ⟨u.comapDomain Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective.injOn, v.comapDomain Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective.injOn,
    u.comapDomain Sum.inr Sum.inr_injective.injOn, v.comapDomain Sum.inr Sum.inr_injective.injOn,
    ⟨?_, ?_⟩, comapDomain_sumElim_comapDomain .., comapDomain_sumElim_comapDomain ..⟩⟩
  · rw [← h2, ← h3, ← sumElim_add, h1.left, h1.right]
  · rw [← comapDomain_add_of_injective Sum.inl_injective, h, comapDomain_inl_sumElim]
  · rw [← comapDomain_add_of_injective Sum.inr_injective, h, comapDomain_inr_sumElim]

name: embSigma_apply
statement:
@[grind =]
theorem embSigma_apply [DecidableEq κ] {k : κ} (f : ι k →₀ M) (i : Σ k, ι k) :
    embSigma f i = if h : i.1 = k then f (h ▸ i.2) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with ⟨k, i⟩
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    simp only [embSigma, Embedding.sigmaMk]
    apply embDomain_apply_self
  · simp only [embSigma, Embedding.sigmaMk]
    rw [embDomain_of_notMem_range]
    simp_all

name: embSigma_apply_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem embSigma_apply_self {k : κ} (f : ι k →₀ M) (i : ι k) :
    embSigma f ⟨k, i⟩ = f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [embSigma]
  exact embDomain_apply_self (Embedding.sigmaMk k) f i

name: embSigma_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem embSigma_apply_of_ne {k k' : κ} (f : ι k →₀ M) (hk : k' ≠ k) (i : ι k') :
    embSigma f ⟨k', i⟩ = 0

name: support_embSigma
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem support_embSigma {k : κ} (f : ι k →₀ M) :
    (embSigma f).support = f.support.map (Embedding.sigmaMk k)

name: embSigma_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem embSigma_zero {k : κ} : embSigma (0 : ι k →₀ M) = 0

name: embSigma_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem embSigma_eq_zero {k : κ} {f : ι k →₀ M} :
    embSigma f = 0 ↔ f = 0

name: embSigma_injective
statement:
theorem embSigma_injective {k : κ} :
    Injective (embSigma : (ι k →₀ M) → (Σ k, ι k) →₀ M)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  ext i
  have := congr_fun (congrArg (⇑) h) ⟨k, i⟩
  simpa using this

name: embSigma_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem embSigma_inj {k : κ} {f g : ι k →₀ M} :
    embSigma f = embSigma g ↔ f = g

name: embSigma_add
statement:
theorem embSigma_add {k : κ} (f g : ι k →₀ M) :
    embSigma (f + g) = embSigma f + embSigma g
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨k', i⟩
  by_cases hk : k' = k
  · subst hk
    simp
  · simp [embSigma_apply_of_ne _ hk]

name: embSigma_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem embSigma_single [Zero M] {k : κ} (i : ι k) (m : M) :
    embSigma (single i m) = single ⟨k, i⟩ m

name: split_embSigma_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem split_embSigma_self {k : κ} (f : ι k →₀ M) :
    split (embSigma f) k = f

name: split_embSigma_of_ne
statement:
theorem split_embSigma_of_ne {k k' : κ} (f : ι k →₀ M) (hk : k' ≠ k) :
    split (embSigma f) k' = 0
proof:

statement:
theorem single_le_sum {α M N : Type*} [Zero M] [AddCommMonoid N]
    [PartialOrder N] [IsOrderedAddMonoid N] (f : α →₀ M) {g : α → M → N}
    (h : 0 ≤ (g · ·)) (a : α) :
    ((single a (f a)).sum g) ≤ f.sum g
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (f a) 0 with H | H
  · rw [H, single_zero, sum_zero_index]
    exact sum_nonneg' (fun i ↦ h i (f i))
  · rw [sum, support_single _ H, sum_singleton, single_eq_same]
    apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun i hi ↦ h i (f i))
    simpa [mem_support_iff, ne_eq] using H

    g (f a) ≤ f.sum fun _ m ↦ g m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← sum_single_index (h := fun (_ : α) m ↦ g m) (a := a) (b := f a) hg]
  apply single_le_sum _ (fun _ m ↦ h m)

name: single_of_embDomain_single
statement:
theorem single_of_embDomain_single (l : α →₀ M) (f : α ↪ β) (a : β) (b : M) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : l.embDomain f = single a b) : ∃ x, l = single x b ∧ f x = a
proof:
:= by
  classical
    have h_map_support : Finset.map f l.support = {a} := by
      rw [← support_embDomain, h, support_single _ hb]
    have ha : a ∈ Finset.map f l.support := by simp only [h_map_support, Finset.mem_singleton]
    rcases Finset.mem_map.1 ha with ⟨c, _hc₁, hc₂⟩
    use c
    constructor
    · ext d
      rw [← embDomain_apply_self f l, h]
      grind
    · exact hc₂

  intro f g h

    refine ext_iff'.2 ⟨hsup, fun x hx => apply_eq_of_mem_graph <| h.symm ▸ ?_⟩

statement:

proof:
:= by
  ext b
  simp only [mem_support_iff, ne_eq, mem_map]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := mem_range_of_mapDomain_ne_zero h
    exact ⟨a, by simpa [f.injective] using h⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩

name: mapDomain_support
statement:
theorem mapDomain_support [DecidableEq β] {f : α → β} {s : α →₀ M} :
    (s.mapDomain f).support ⊆ s.support.image f
proof:
:=
  Finset.Subset.trans support_sum <|
    Finset.Subset.trans (Finset.biUnion_mono fun _ _ => support_single_subset) <| by
      rw [Finset.biUnion_singleton]

name: mapDomain_apply'
statement:
theorem mapDomain_apply' (S : Set α) {f : α → β} (x : α →₀ M) (hS : (x.support : Set α) ⊆ S)
    (hf : Set.InjOn f S) {a : α} (ha : a ∈ S) : mapDomain f x (f a) = x a
proof:
:= by
  classical
    rw [mapDomain, sum_apply, sum]
    simp_rw [single_apply]
    by_cases hax : a ∈ x.support
    · rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hax, ite_eq_left rfl]
      convert! add_zero (x a)
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi => ite_eq_right ?_
      exact (hf.mono hS).ne (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hi) hax (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hi)
    · rw [notMem_support_iff.1 hax]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i hi => ite_eq_right ?_
      exact hf.ne (hS hi) ha (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hi hax)

name: mapDomain_support_of_injOn
statement:
theorem mapDomain_support_of_injOn [DecidableEq β] {f : α → β} (s : α →₀ M)
    (hf : Set.InjOn f s.support) : (mapDomain f s).support = Finset.image f s.support
proof:
:=
  Finset.Subset.antisymm mapDomain_support <| by
    intro x hx
    simp only [mem_image, mem_support_iff, Ne] at hx
    rcases hx with ⟨hx_w, hx_h_left, rfl⟩
    simp only [mem_support_iff, Ne]
    rw [mapDomain_apply' (↑s.support : Set _) _ _ hf]
    · exact hx_h_left
    · simp_rw [mem_coe, mem_support_iff, Ne]
      exact hx_h_left
    · exact Subset.refl _

name: mapDomain_support_of_injective
statement:
theorem mapDomain_support_of_injective [DecidableEq β] {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (s : α →₀ M) : (mapDomain f s).support = Finset.image f s.support

name: prod_mapDomain_index
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_mapDomain_index [CommMonoid N] {f : α → β} {s : α →₀ M} {h : β → M → N}
    (h_zero : ∀ b, h b 0 = 1) (h_add : ∀ b m₁ m₂, h b (m₁ + m₂) = h b m₁ * h b m₂) :
    (mapDomain f s).prod h = s.prod fun a m => h (f a) m

name: sum_mapDomain_index_addMonoidHom
embDomain_eq_mapDomain
statement: theorem embDomain_eq_mapDomain (f : α ↪ β) (v : α →₀ M) : embDomain f v = mapDomain f v
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  by_cases h : a ∈ Set.range f
  · rcases h with ⟨a, rfl⟩
    rw [mapDomain_apply_of_injective f.injective, embDomain_apply_self]
  · rw [mapDomain_of_notMem_range, embDomain_of_notMem_range] <;> assumption

name: prod_mapDomain_index_inj
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk f hf, ← embDomain_eq_mapDomain, prod_embDomain]

name: mapDomain_injective
statement:
theorem mapDomain_injective {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (mapDomain f : (α →₀ M) → β →₀ M)
proof:
:= by
  intro v₁ v₂ eq
  ext a
  have : mapDomain f v₁ (f a) = mapDomain f v₂ (f a) := by rw [eq]
  rwa [mapDomain_apply_of_injective hf, mapDomain_apply_of_injective hf] at this

name: mapDomain_surjective
statement:
theorem mapDomain_surjective {f : α → β} (hf : f.Surjective) :
    (mapDomain (M := M) f).Surjective
proof:

  use mapDomain (surjInv hf) x
  rw [← mapDomain_comp, (rightInverse_surjInv hf).id, mapDomain_id]

name: mapDomain_fintype
statement:
lemma mapDomain_fintype [Fintype α] (f : α → β) (g : α →₀ M) :

name: mapDomain.addMonoidHom_comp_mapRange
statement:
theorem mapDomain.addMonoidHom_comp_mapRange [AddCommMonoid N] (f : α → β) (g : M →+ N) :
    (mapDomain.addMonoidHom f).comp (mapRange.addMonoidHom g) =

name: mapDomain_mapRange
statement:
theorem mapDomain_mapRange [AddCommMonoid N] (f : α → β) (v : α →₀ M) (g : M → N) (h0 : g 0 = 0)
    (hadd : ∀ x y, g (x + y) = g x + g y) :
    mapDomain f (mapRange g h0 v) = mapRange g h0 (mapDomain f v)

name: sum_update_add
statement:
theorem sum_update_add [AddZeroClass α] [AddCommMonoid β] (f : ι →₀ α) (i : ι) (a : α)
    (g : ι → α → β) (hg : ∀ i, g i 0 = 0)
    (hgg : ∀ (j : ι) (a₁ a₂ : α), g j (a₁ + a₂) = g j a₁ + g j a₂) :
    (f.update i a).sum g + g i (f i) = f.sum g + g i a
proof:
:= by
  rw [update_eq_erase_add_single, sum_add_index' hg hgg]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Finsupp.update_self f i]
  rw [update_eq_erase_add_single, sum_add_index' hg hgg, add_assoc, add_assoc]
  congr 1
  rw [add_comm, sum_single_index (hg _), sum_single_index (hg _)]

name: mapDomain_injOn
statement:
theorem mapDomain_injOn (S : Set α) {f : α → β} (hf : Set.InjOn f S) :
    Set.InjOn (mapDomain f : (α →₀ M) → β →₀ M) { w | (w.support : Set α) ⊆ S }
proof:
:= by
  intro v₁ hv₁ v₂ hv₂ eq
  ext a
  classical
    by_cases h : a ∈ v₁.support ∪ v₂.support
    · rw [← mapDomain_apply' S _ hv₁ hf _, ← mapDomain_apply' S _ hv₂ hf _, eq] <;>
        · apply Set.union_subset hv₁ hv₂
          exact mod_cast h
    · simp_all

name: equivMapDomain_eq_mapDomain
statement:
theorem equivMapDomain_eq_mapDomain {M} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : α ≃ β) (l : α →₀ M) :

name: comapDomain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapDomain_apply [Zero M] (f : α → β) (l : β →₀ M) (hf : Set.InjOn f (f ⁻¹' ↑l.support))
    (a : α) : comapDomain f l hf a = l (f a)

name: prod_comapDomain
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_comapDomain [Zero M] [CommMonoid N] (f : α → β) (l : β →₀ M) (g : β → M → N)
    (hf : Set.BijOn f (f ⁻¹' ↑l.support) ↑l.support) :
    (comapDomain f l hf.injOn).prod (g ∘ f) = l.prod g
proof:
:=
  Finset.prod_preimage_of_bij f _ hf fun x => g x (l x)

name: eq_zero_of_comapDomain_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_comapDomain_eq_zero [Zero M] (f : α → β) (l : β →₀ M)
    (hf : Set.BijOn f (f ⁻¹' ↑l.support) ↑l.support) : comapDomain f l hf.injOn = 0 → l = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← support_eq_empty, ← support_eq_empty, comapDomain]
  simp_rw [Finset.ext_iff, Finset.notMem_empty, iff_false, mem_preimage]
  intro h a ha
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hf.2.2 ha
  exact h b (hb.2.symm ▸ ha)

name: comapDomain_single_of_not_mem_range
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comapDomain_single_of_not_mem_range [Zero M] {f : α → β} {b : β} (hb : b ∉ Set.range f)
    (m : M) (hf) : comapDomain f (single b m) hf = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext a
  simp only [comapDomain, single_apply, coe_mk, coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, ite_eq_right_iff]
  rintro rfl
  simp at hb

name: embDomain_comapDomain
statement:
lemma embDomain_comapDomain {f : α ↪ β} {g : β →₀ M} (hg : ↑g.support ⊆ Set.range f) :
    embDomain f (comapDomain f g f.injective.injOn) = g
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  by_cases hb : b ∈ Set.range f
  · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hb
    rw [embDomain_apply_self, comapDomain_apply]
  · replace hg : g b = 0 := notMem_support_iff.mp <| mt (hg ·) hb
    rw [embDomain_of_notMem_range _ _ _ hb, hg]

name: comapDomain_embDomain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapDomain_embDomain (f : α ↪ β) (l : α →₀ M) :
    comapDomain f (embDomain f l) f.injective.injOn = l

name: comapDomain_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapDomain_zero (f : α → β)
    (hif : Set.InjOn f (f ⁻¹' ↑(0 : β →₀ M).support) := Finset.coe_empty ▸ (Set.injOn_empty f)) :
    comapDomain f (0 : β →₀ M) hif = (0 : α →₀ M)

name: comapDomain_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapDomain_single (f : α → β) (a : α) (m : M)
    (hif : Set.InjOn f (f ⁻¹' (single (f a) m).support)) :
    comapDomain f (Finsupp.single (f a) m) hif = Finsupp.single a m
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with (rfl | hm)
  · simp_rw [single_zero, comapDomain_zero]
  · rw [eq_single_iff, comapDomain_apply, comapDomain_support, ← Finset.coe_subset, coe_preimage,
      support_single _ hm, coe_singleton, coe_singleton, single_eq_same]
    rw [support_single _ hm, coe_singleton] at hif
    exact ⟨fun x hx => hif hx rfl hx, rfl⟩

name: comapDomain_surjective
statement:
lemma comapDomain_surjective {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Surjective fun l : β →₀ M ↦ Finsupp.comapDomain f l hf.injOn
proof:
:= by
  intro l'
  use l'.embDomain ⟨f, hf⟩
  exact Finsupp.comapDomain_embDomain ..

name: comapDomain_add
statement:
theorem comapDomain_add (v₁ v₂ : β →₀ M) (hv₁ : Set.InjOn f (f ⁻¹' ↑v₁.support))
    (hv₂ : Set.InjOn f (f ⁻¹' ↑v₂.support)) (hv₁₂ : Set.InjOn f (f ⁻¹' ↑(v₁ + v₂).support)) :
    comapDomain f (v₁ + v₂) hv₁₂ = comapDomain f v₁ hv₁ + comapDomain f v₂ hv₂

name: comapDomain_add_of_injective
statement:
theorem comapDomain_add_of_injective (hf : Function.Injective f) (v₁ v₂ : β →₀ M) :
    comapDomain f (v₁ + v₂) hf.injOn =
      comapDomain f v₁ hf.injOn + comapDomain f v₂ hf.injOn

name: mapDomain_comapDomain
statement:
theorem mapDomain_comapDomain (hf : Function.Injective f) (l : β →₀ M)
    (hl : ↑l.support ⊆ Set.range f) :
    mapDomain f (comapDomain f l hf.injOn) = l
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← embDomain_comapDomain (f := ⟨f, hf⟩) hl (M := M), embDomain_eq_mapDomain]
  rfl

name: mapDomain_comapDomain_nat_add_one
statement:
theorem mapDomain_comapDomain_nat_add_one (l : ℕ →₀ M) :
    mapDomain (· + 1) (comapDomain.addMonoidHom (add_left_injective 1) l) = l.erase 0
proof:
:= by
  refine .trans ?_ (mapDomain_comapDomain _ (add_left_injective 1) _ fun _ ↦ ?_)
  · congr; ext; simp
  · simp_all [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]

name: comapDomain_mapDomain
statement:
theorem comapDomain_mapDomain (hf : Function.Injective f) (l : α →₀ M) :
    comapDomain f (mapDomain f l) hf.injOn = l

name: mem_range_mapDomain_iff
statement:
lemma mem_range_mapDomain_iff (hf : Function.Injective f) (x : β →₀ M) :
    x ∈ Set.range (Finsupp.mapDomain f) ↔ ∀ b ∉ Set.range f, x b = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨y, hy⟩ x hx ↦ hy ▸ Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range y x hx, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  refine ⟨Finsupp.comapDomain f x hf.injOn, Finsupp.mapDomain_comapDomain f hf _ fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hc
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, ne_eq] at hi
  exact hi (h _ hc)

name: filter_apply
statement: theorem filter_apply (a : α) : f.filter p a = if p a then f a else 0

name: filter_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma filter_eq [DecidableEq α] (f : α →₀ M) (a : α) :
    f.filter (a = ·) = single a (f a)
proof: := by ext; rw [filter_apply, single_apply]; congr!; simp_all

name: filter_eq'
statement:
@[simp] lemma filter_eq' [DecidableEq α] (f : α →₀ M) (a : α) :
    f.filter (· = a) = single a (f a)

name: filter_eq_indicator
statement: theorem filter_eq_indicator : ⇑(f.filter p) = Set.indicator { x | p x } f

name: filter_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem filter_eq_zero_iff : f.filter p = 0 ↔ ∀ x, p x → f x = 0

name: filter_eq_self_iff
statement: theorem filter_eq_self_iff : f.filter p = f ↔ ∀ x, f x ≠ 0 → p x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [DFunLike.ext_iff, filter_eq_indicator, Set.indicator_apply_eq_self, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
    not_imp_comm]

name: filter_apply_pos
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_apply_pos {a : α} (h : p a) : f.filter p a = f a

name: filter_apply_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_apply_neg {a : α} (h : ¬p a) : f.filter p a = 0

name: support_filter
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_filter : (f.filter p).support = {x ∈ f.support | p x}

name: filter_zero
statement: theorem filter_zero : (0 : α →₀ M).filter p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← support_eq_empty, support_filter, support_zero, Finset.filter_empty]

name: filter_single_of_pos
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_single_of_pos {a : α} {b : M} (h : p a) : (single a b).filter p = single a b

name: filter_single_of_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_single_of_neg {a : α} {b : M} (h : ¬p a) : (single a b).filter p = 0
proof:
:=
  (filter_eq_zero_iff _ _).2 fun _ hpx =>
    single_apply_eq_zero.2 fun hxa => absurd hpx (hxa.symm ▸ h)

name: prod_filter_index
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_filter_index [CommMonoid N] (g : α → M → N) :
    (f.filter p).prod g = ∏ x ∈ (f.filter p).support, g x (f x)
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun x hx => ?_
  rw [support_filter, Finset.mem_filter] at hx
  rw [filter_apply_pos _ _ hx.2]

name: prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod_filter_mul_prod_filter_not [CommMonoid N] (g : α → M → N) :
    (f.filter p).prod g * (f.filter fun a => ¬p a).prod g = f.prod g

name: prod_div_prod_filter
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod_div_prod_filter [CommGroup G] (g : α → M → G) :
    f.prod g / (f.filter p).prod g = (f.filter fun a => ¬p a).prod g

name: filter_add_filter_not
statement:
@[simp]
lemma filter_add_filter_not (f : α →₀ M) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    f.filter p + f.filter (¬ p ·) = f

name: mem_frange
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem mem_frange {f : α →₀ M} {y : M} : y ∈ f.frange ↔ y ≠ 0 ∧ y ∈ Set.range f
proof:
:= by
  rw [frange, @Finset.mem_image _ _ (Classical.decEq _) _ f.support]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩ => ⟨hx2 ▸ mem_support_iff.1 hx1, x, hx2⟩, fun ⟨hy, x, hx⟩ =>
    ⟨x, mem_support_iff.2 (hx.symm ▸ hy), hx⟩⟩

name: zero_notMem_frange
statement: theorem zero_notMem_frange {f : α →₀ M} : (0 : M) ∉ f.frange

name: frange_single
statement: theorem frange_single {x : α} {y : M} : frange (single x y) ⊆ {y}

name: mem_frange_of_mem
statement: theorem mem_frange_of_mem {x} {f : α →₀ M} (h : x ∈ f.support) : f x ∈ f.frange

name: range_subset_insert_frange
statement: theorem range_subset_insert_frange (f : α →₀ M) : Set.range f ⊆ insert 0 f.frange

name: finite_range
statement: theorem finite_range (f : α →₀ M) : (Set.range f).Finite

name: support_subtypeDomain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem support_subtypeDomain [D : DecidablePred p] {f : α →₀ M} :
    (subtypeDomain p f).support = f.support.subtype p

name: subtypeDomain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subtypeDomain_apply {a : Subtype p} {v : α →₀ M} : (subtypeDomain p v) a = v a.val

name: subtypeDomain_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subtypeDomain_zero : subtypeDomain p (0 : α →₀ M) = 0

name: subtypeDomain_eq_iff_forall
statement:
theorem subtypeDomain_eq_iff_forall {f g : α →₀ M} :
    f.subtypeDomain p = g.subtypeDomain p ↔ ∀ x, p x → f x = g x

name: subtypeDomain_eq_iff
proof:
:=
  subtypeDomain_eq_iff_forall.trans
    ⟨fun H ↦ Finsupp.ext fun _a ↦ (em _).elim (H _ <| hf _ ·) fun haf ↦ (em _).elim (H _ <| hg _ ·)
        fun hag ↦ (notMem_support_iff.mp haf).trans (notMem_support_iff.mp hag).symm,
      fun H _ _ ↦ congr($H _)⟩

name: subtypeDomain_eq_zero_iff'
statement: theorem subtypeDomain_eq_zero_iff' {f : α →₀ M} : f.subtypeDomain p = 0 ↔ ∀ x, p x → f x = 0

name: subtypeDomain_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem subtypeDomain_eq_zero_iff {f : α →₀ M} (hf : ∀ x ∈ f.support, p x) :
    f.subtypeDomain p = 0 ↔ f = 0

name: prod_subtypeDomain_index
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.prod_bij (fun p _ ↦ p) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ <;> aesop

name: subtypeDomain_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subtypeDomain_add {v v' : α →₀ M} :
    (v + v').subtypeDomain p = v.subtypeDomain p + v'.subtypeDomain p

name: filter_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_add [DecidablePred p] {v v' : α →₀ M} :
    (v + v').filter p = v.filter p + v'.filter p

name: subtypeDomain_sum
statement:
theorem subtypeDomain_sum {s : Finset ι} {h : ι → α →₀ M} :
    (∑ c ∈ s, h c).subtypeDomain p = ∑ c ∈ s, (h c).subtypeDomain p

name: subtypeDomain_finsupp_sum
statement:
theorem subtypeDomain_finsupp_sum [Zero N] {s : β →₀ N} {h : β → N → α →₀ M} :
    (s.sum h).subtypeDomain p = s.sum fun c d => (h c d).subtypeDomain p

name: filter_sum
statement:
theorem filter_sum [DecidablePred p] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α →₀ M) :
    (∑ a ∈ s, f a).filter p = ∑ a ∈ s, filter p (f a)

name: filter_eq_sum
statement:
theorem filter_eq_sum (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f : α →₀ M) :
    f.filter p = ∑ i ∈ f.support.filter p, single i (f i)
proof:
:=
  (f.filter p).sum_single.symm.trans <|
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx => by
      rw [filter_apply_pos _ _ (mem_filter.1 hx).2]

name: subtypeDomain_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subtypeDomain_neg : (-v).subtypeDomain p = -v.subtypeDomain p

name: subtypeDomain_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subtypeDomain_sub : (v - v').subtypeDomain p = v.subtypeDomain p - v'.subtypeDomain p

name: filter_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_neg (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f : α →₀ G) : filter p (-f) = -filter p f

name: filter_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_sub (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f₁ f₂ : α →₀ G) :
    filter p (f₁ - f₂) = filter p f₁ - filter p f₂

name: mem_support_multiset_sum
statement:
theorem mem_support_multiset_sum [AddCommMonoid M] {s : Multiset (α →₀ M)} (a : α) :
    a ∈ s.sum.support → ∃ f ∈ s, a ∈ (f : α →₀ M).support
proof:
:=
  Multiset.induction_on s (fun h => False.elim (by simp at h))
    (by
      intro f s ih ha
      by_cases h : a ∈ f.support
      · exact ⟨f, Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _, h⟩
      · simp_rw [Multiset.sum_cons, mem_support_iff, add_apply, notMem_support_iff.1 h,
          zero_add] at ha
        rcases ih (mem_support_iff.2 ha) with ⟨f', h₀, h₁⟩
        exact ⟨f', Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem h₀, h₁⟩)

name: mem_support_finsetSum
statement:
theorem mem_support_finsetSum [AddCommMonoid M] {s : Finset ι} {h : ι → α →₀ M} (a : α)
    (ha : a ∈ (∑ c ∈ s, h c).support) : ∃ c ∈ s, a ∈ (h c).support
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, hf, hfa⟩ := mem_support_multiset_sum a ha
  let ⟨c, hc, Eq⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.1 hf
  ⟨c, hc, Eq.symm ▸ hfa⟩

name: uncurry_apply
statement: protected theorem uncurry_apply (f : α →₀ β →₀ M) (x : α × β) : f.uncurry x = f x.1 x.2

name: uncurry_apply_pair
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem uncurry_apply_pair (f : α →₀ β →₀ M) (a : α) (b : β) :
    f.uncurry (a, b) = f a b

name: uncurry_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma uncurry_single (a : α) (b : β) (m : M) :
    (single a (single b m)).uncurry = single (a, b) m
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨x, y⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne a x with rfl | hne <;> classical simp [single_apply, *]

name: sum_uncurry_index
statement:
theorem sum_uncurry_index [AddCommMonoid N] (f : α →₀ β →₀ M) (g : α × β → M → N) :
    f.uncurry.sum (fun p c => g p c) = f.sum fun a f => f.sum fun b ↦ g (a, b)

name: sum_uncurry_index'
statement:
theorem sum_uncurry_index' [AddCommMonoid N] (f : α →₀ β →₀ M) (g : α → β → M → N) :
    f.uncurry.sum (fun p c => g p.1 p.2 c) = f.sum fun a f => f.sum (g a)

name: curry_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curry_apply (f : α × β →₀ M) (x : α) (y : β) : f.curry x y = f (x, y)

name: support_curry
statement:
@[simp]
lemma support_curry [DecidableEq α] (f : α × β →₀ M) :
    f.curry.support = f.support.image Prod.fst

name: curry_uncurry
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curry_uncurry (f : α →₀ β →₀ M) : f.uncurry.curry = f

name: uncurry_curry
statement:
@[simp]
theorem uncurry_curry (f : α × β →₀ M) : f.curry.uncurry = f

name: curry_single
statement:
@[simp]
lemma curry_single (a : α × β) (m : M) :
    (single a m).curry = single a.1 (single a.2 m)

name: sum_curry_index
statement:
theorem sum_curry_index [AddCommMonoid N] (f : α × β →₀ M) (g : α → β → M → N) :
    (f.curry.sum fun a f => f.sum (g a)) = f.sum fun p c => g p.1 p.2 c

name: filter_curry
statement:
theorem filter_curry (f : α × β →₀ M) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    (f.filter fun a : α × β => p a.1).curry = f.curry.filter p
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp [filter_apply, apply_ite (DFunLike.coe · b)]

name: coe_curryAddEquiv
statement: @[simp] lemma coe_curryAddEquiv : (curryAddEquiv : (α × β →₀ M) → α →₀ β →₀ M) = .curry

name: coe_sumElim
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_sumElim (f : α →₀ γ) (g : β →₀ γ) : ⇑(sumElim f g) = Sum.elim f g

name: sumElim_apply
statement: theorem sumElim_apply (f : α →₀ γ) (g : β →₀ γ) (x : α ⊕ β) : sumElim f g x = Sum.elim f g x

name: sumElim_inl
statement: lemma sumElim_inl (f : α →₀ γ) (g : β →₀ γ) (x : α) : sumElim f g (Sum.inl x) = f x

name: sumElim_inr
statement: lemma sumElim_inr (f : α →₀ γ) (g : β →₀ γ) (x : β) : sumElim f g (Sum.inr x) = g x

name: sumElim_zero_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma sumElim_zero_zero : sumElim 0 0 = (0 : α ⊕ β →₀ γ)

name: sumElim_single_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma sumElim_single_zero (a : α) (c : γ) :
    sumElim (single a c) (0 : β →₀ γ) = single (.inl a) c

name: sumElim_zero_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma sumElim_zero_single (b : β) (c : γ) :
    sumElim (0 : α →₀ γ) (single b c) = single (.inr b) c

name: sumElim_single_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma sumElim_single_single [AddMonoid M] (a : α) (b : β) (m₁ m₂ : M) :
    sumElim (single a m₁) (single b m₂) = single (.inl a) m₁ + single (.inr b) m₂

name: sumElim_eq_add
statement:
lemma sumElim_eq_add [AddCommMonoid M] (f : α →₀ M) (g : β →₀ M) :
    sumElim f g = mapDomain Sum.inl f + mapDomain Sum.inr g

name: mapDomain_swap_sumElim
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapDomain_swap_sumElim [AddCommMonoid M] (f : α →₀ M) (g : β →₀ M) :
    mapDomain Sum.swap (sumElim f g) = sumElim g f

name: prod_sumElim
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma prod_sumElim {ι₁ ι₂ α M : Type*} [Zero α] [CommMonoid M]
    (f₁ : ι₁ →₀ α) (f₂ : ι₂ →₀ α) (g : ι₁ ⊕ ι₂ → α → M) :
    (f₁.sumElim f₂).prod g = f₁.prod (g ∘ Sum.inl) * f₂.prod (g ∘ Sum.inr)

name: comapDomain_inl_sumElim
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comapDomain_inl_sumElim (f : α →₀ γ) (g : β →₀ γ) :
    comapDomain Sum.inl (f.sumElim g) Sum.inl_injective.injOn = f

name: comapDomain_inr_sumElim
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comapDomain_inr_sumElim (f : α →₀ γ) (g : β →₀ γ) :
    comapDomain Sum.inr (f.sumElim g) Sum.inr_injective.injOn = g

name: embDomain_inl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma embDomain_inl (a : α →₀ γ) :
    embDomain Function.Embedding.inl a = sumElim a (0 : β →₀ γ)

name: embDomain_inr
statement:
@[simp]
lemma embDomain_inr (b : β →₀ γ) :
    embDomain Function.Embedding.inr b = sumElim (0 : α →₀ γ) b

name: comapDomain_sumElim_comapDomain
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comapDomain_sumElim_comapDomain (c : α ⊕ β →₀ γ) :
    (comapDomain Sum.inl c Sum.inl_injective.injOn).sumElim
      (comapDomain Sum.inr c Sum.inr_injective.injOn) = c

name: sumElim_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sumElim_add [AddZeroClass M] (a b : α →₀ M) (c d : β →₀ M) :
    (a + b).sumElim (c + d) = a.sumElim c + b.sumElim d

name: fst_sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp
statement:
theorem fst_sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp {α β γ : Type*} [Zero γ] (f : α ⊕ β →₀ γ) (x : α) :
    (sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp f).1 x = f (Sum.inl x)

name: snd_sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp
statement:
theorem snd_sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp {α β γ : Type*} [Zero γ] (f : α ⊕ β →₀ γ) (y : β) :
    (sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp f).2 y = f (Sum.inr y)

name: sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp_symm_inl
statement:
theorem sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp_symm_inl {α β γ : Type*} [Zero γ] (fg : (α →₀ γ) × (β →₀ γ))
    (x : α) : (sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp.symm fg) (Sum.inl x) = fg.1 x

name: sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp_symm_inr
statement:
theorem sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp_symm_inr {α β γ : Type*} [Zero γ] (fg : (α →₀ γ) × (β →₀ γ))
    (y : β) : (sumFinsuppEquivProdFinsupp.symm fg) (Sum.inr y) = fg.2 y

name: fst_sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp
statement:
theorem fst_sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp {α β : Type*} (f : α ⊕ β →₀ M) (x : α) :
    (sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp f).1 x = f (Sum.inl x)

name: snd_sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp
statement:
theorem snd_sumFinsuppAddEquivProdFinsupp {α β : Type*} (f : α ⊕ β →₀ M) (y : β) :

name: mapDomain_support_of_subsingletonAddUnits
statement:
theorem mapDomain_support_of_subsingletonAddUnits [DecidableEq β] [AddCommMonoid M]
    (f : α → β) [Subsingleton (AddUnits M)] (x : α →₀ M) :
      (x.mapDomain f).support = x.support.image f
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  rw [mem_support_iff, ne_eq, Finset.mem_image]
  refine ⟨?_, fun ⟨i, i_in, hi⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · simpa [mapDomain, sum, single_apply] using fun i h h' _ ↦ ⟨i, h, h'⟩
  simpa [mapDomain, sum, ← hi, single_apply] using ⟨i, by simp [mem_support_iff.mp i_in]⟩

statement:
theorem mapDomain_apply_eq_sum [DecidableEq β] [AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → β)

name: mapDomain_apply_eq_zero_iff_of_subsingletonAddUnits
statement:
theorem mapDomain_apply_eq_zero_iff_of_subsingletonAddUnits [AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → β)

proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ Finsupp.ext (fun i ↦ ?_), fun h ↦ by rw [h, mapDomain_zero]⟩
  replace h := Finsupp.ext_iff.mp h (f i)
  simp [mapDomain_apply_eq_sum] at h; grind

theorem toMultiset_map (f : α →₀ ℕ) (g : α → β) :

proof:
:= by
  refine f.induction ?_ ?_
  · rw [toMultiset_zero, Multiset.map_zero, mapDomain_zero, toMultiset_zero]
  · intro a n f _ _ ih
    rw [toMultiset_add, Multiset.map_add, ih, mapDomain_add, mapDomain_single,
      toMultiset_single, toMultiset_add, toMultiset_single, ← Multiset.coe_mapAddMonoidHom,
      (Multiset.mapAddMonoidHom g).map_nsmul]

statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem prod_toMultiset [CommMonoid α] (f : α →₀ ℕ) :

proof:
:= by
  refine f.induction ?_ ?_
  · rw [toMultiset_zero, Multiset.prod_zero, Finsupp.prod_zero_index]
  · intro a n f _ _ ih
    rw [toMultiset_add, Multiset.prod_add, ih, toMultiset_single, Multiset.prod_nsmul,
      Finsupp.prod_add_index' pow_zero pow_add, Finsupp.prod_single_index, Multiset.prod_singleton]
    exact pow_zero a

name: toFinset_toMultiset

theorem toFinset_toMultiset [DecidableEq α] (f : α →₀ ℕ) : f.toMultiset.toFinset = f.support
proof:
:= by
  refine f.induction ?_ ?_
  · rw [toMultiset_zero, Multiset.toFinset_zero, support_zero]
  · intro a n f ha hn ih
    rw [toMultiset_add, Multiset.toFinset_add, ih, toMultiset_single, support_add_eq,
      support_single _ hn, Multiset.toFinset_nsmul _ _ hn, Multiset.toFinset_singleton]
    refine Disjoint.mono_left support_single_subset ?_
    rwa [Finset.disjoint_singleton_left]

name: count_toMultiset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_toMultiset [DecidableEq α] (f : α →₀ ℕ) (a : α) : (toMultiset f).count a = f a
proof:
:=
  calc
    (toMultiset f).count a = Finsupp.sum f (fun x n => (n • {x} : Multiset α).count a) := by
      rw [toMultiset_apply]; exact map_sum (Multiset.countAddMonoidHom a) _ f.support
    _ = f.sum fun x n => n * ({x} : Multiset α).count a := by simp only [Multiset.count_nsmul]
    _ = f a * ({a} : Multiset α).count a :=
      sum_eq_single _
        (fun a' _ H => by simp only [Multiset.count_singleton, ite_false, H.symm, mul_zero])
        (fun _ => zero_mul _)
    _ = f a := by rw [Multiset.count_singleton_self, mul_one]

name: mulHom_ext

theorem mulHom_ext [MulOneClass N] ⦃f g : Multiplicative (α →₀ M) →* N⦄
    (H : ∀ x y, f (Multiplicative.ofAdd <| single x y) = g (Multiplicative.ofAdd <| single x y)) :

proof:
:=
  MonoidHom.ext <|
    DFunLike.congr_fun <| by
      have := addHom_ext (f := f.toAdditiveRight) (g := g.toAdditiveRight) H
      ext
      rw [DFunLike.ext_iff] at this

name: ext_iff'
statement: theorem ext_iff' {f g : α →₀ M} : f = g ↔ f.support = g.support ∧ ∀ x ∈ f.support, f x = g x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h ▸ ⟨rfl, fun _ _ => rfl⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ =>
    ext fun a => by
      classical
      exact if h : a ∈ f.support then h₂ a h else by
        have hf : f a = 0 := notMem_support_iff.1 h
        have hg : g a = 0 := by rwa [h₁, notMem_support_iff] at h
        rw [hf, hg]⟩

name: range_mapRange
statement:
lemma range_mapRange (e : M → N) (he₀ : e 0 = 0) :
    Set.range (Finsupp.mapRange (α := α) e he₀) = {g | ∀ i, g i ∈ Set.range e}
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Set.mem_ofPred]
  constructor
  · grind
  · intro h
    classical
    choose f h using h
    use onFinset g.support (fun x ↦ if x ∈ g.support then f x else 0) (by simp_all)
    grind

name: mapRange_injective

proof:

  rw [Finsupp.ext_iff] at h ⊢
  simpa only [mapRange_apply, he.eq_iff] using h

proof:
:=
  ⟨mapRange_injective e he₀ he.1, mapRange_surjective e he₀ he.2⟩

statement:
theorem weight_apply (f : σ →₀ R) :
    weight w f = Finsupp.sum f (fun i c => c • w i)

statement:

:=

statement:
theorem weight_single_one_apply [DecidableEq σ] (s : σ) (f : σ →₀ R) :
