statement:
theorem weight_single (s : σ) (r : R) :
    weight w (Finsupp.single s r) = r • w s

name: weight_eq_sum
statement: theorem weight_eq_sum [Fintype σ] (f : σ →₀ R) : weight w f = ∑ i, f i • w i
proof:
:= by
  rw [weight_apply, f.sum_fintype (fun i c ↦ c • w i) fun _ ↦ zero_smul _ _]

name: nonTorsionWeight_of
statement:
theorem nonTorsionWeight_of [IsDomain R] [IsTorsionFree R M] (hw : ∀ i : σ, w i ≠ 0) :
    NonTorsionWeight R w where
  eq_zero_of_smul_eq_zero {n s} h
proof:
:= by
    rw [smul_eq_zero, or_iff_not_imp_right] at h
    exact h (hw s)

name: NonTorsionWeight.ne_zero
statement:
theorem NonTorsionWeight.ne_zero [Nontrivial R] [NonTorsionWeight R w] (s : σ) :
    w s ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h ↦ by
  rw [← one_smul R (w s)] at h
  apply zero_ne_one.symm (α := R)
  exact NonTorsionWeight.eq_zero_of_smul_eq_zero h

name: weight_sub_single_add
statement:
lemma weight_sub_single_add {f : σ →₀ ℕ} {i : σ} (hi : f i ≠ 0) :
    (f - single i 1).weight w + w i = f.weight w
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← sub_add_single_one_cancel hi, weight_apply]
  rw [sum_add_index', sum_single_index, one_smul, weight_apply]
  exacts [zero_smul .., fun _ ↦ zero_smul .., fun _ _ _ ↦ add_smul ..]

name: le_weight
statement:
theorem le_weight (w : σ → ℕ) {s : σ} (hs : w s ≠ 0) (f : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    f s ≤ weight w f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [weight_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  by_cases h : s ∈ f.support
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_add_sum_sdiff_singleton_of_mem h]
    refine le_trans ?_ (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
    apply Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right
    exact Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hs
  · simp only [notMem_support_iff] at h
    rw [h]
    apply zero_le

name: le_weight_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem le_weight_of_ne_zero (hw : ∀ s, 0 ≤ w s) {s : σ} {f : σ →₀ ℕ} (hs : f s ≠ 0) :
    w s ≤ weight w f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [weight_apply, Finsupp.sum]
  trans f s • w s
  · apply le_smul_of_one_le_left (hw s)
    exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hs
  · rw [← Finsupp.mem_support_iff] at hs
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_add_sum_sdiff_singleton_of_mem hs]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right <| Finset.sum_nonneg <|
      fun i _ ↦ nsmul_nonneg (hw i) (f i)

name: le_weight_of_ne_zero'
statement: theorem le_weight_of_ne_zero' {s : σ} {f : σ →₀ ℕ} (hs : f s ≠ 0) : w s ≤ weight w f

name: weight_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem weight_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero
    (w : σ → M) [NonTorsionWeight ℕ w] {f : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    weight w f = 0 ↔ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext s
    simp only [Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
    by_contra hs
    apply NonTorsionWeight.ne_zero ℕ w s
    rw [← nonpos_iff_eq_zero, ← h]
    exact le_weight_of_ne_zero' w hs
  · intro h
    rw [h, map_zero]

name: finite_of_nat_weight_le
statement:
theorem finite_of_nat_weight_le [Finite σ] (w : σ → ℕ) (hw : ∀ x, w x ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    {d : σ →₀ ℕ | weight w d ≤ n}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set fg := Finset.antidiagonal (Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm (Function.const σ n)) with hfg
  suffices {d : σ →₀ ℕ | weight w d ≤ n} ⊆ ↑(fg.image fun uv => uv.fst) by
    exact Set.Finite.subset (Finset.finite_toSet _) this
  intro d hd
  rw [hfg]
  simp only [Finset.coe_image, Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe,
    Finset.mem_antidiagonal, Prod.exists, exists_and_right, exists_eq_right]
  use Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm (Function.const σ n) - d
  ext x
  dsimp at hd
  grw [← le_weight _ (hw x)] at hd
  simp [*]

name: finite_of_nat_weight_lt
statement:
theorem finite_of_nat_weight_lt [Finite σ] (w : σ → ℕ) (hw : ∀ x, w x ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    {d : σ →₀ ℕ | weight w d < n}.Finite

statement:
theorem finite_of_nat_weight_eq [Finite σ] (w : σ → ℕ) (hw : ∀ x, w x ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :

statement: theorem degree_apply (d : σ →₀ R) : degree d = ∑ i ∈ d.support, d i

name: degree_eq_sum
statement: theorem degree_eq_sum [Fintype σ] (f : σ →₀ R) : f.degree = ∑ i, f i

name: degree_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_single (a : σ) (r : R) : (Finsupp.single a r).degree = r

name: degree_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma degree_eq_zero_iff {R : Type*}
    [AddCommMonoid R] [PartialOrder R] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd R]
    (d : σ →₀ R) :
    degree d = 0 ↔ d = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [degree_apply, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff, mem_support_iff, ne_eq, _root_.not_imp_self,
    DFunLike.ext_iff, coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]

name: le_degree
statement:
theorem le_degree {R : Type*}
    [AddCommMonoid R] [PartialOrder R] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd R]
    (s : σ) (f : σ →₀ R) :
    f s ≤ degree f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : s ∈ f.support
  · exact Finset.single_le_sum_of_canonicallyOrdered h
  · simp only [notMem_support_iff] at h
    simp only [h, zero_le]

name: degree_eq_weight_one
statement:
theorem degree_eq_weight_one {R : Type*} [Semiring R] :
    degree (R := R) (σ := σ) = weight (fun _ ↦ 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  simp [weight_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: finite_of_degree_le
statement:
theorem finite_of_degree_le [Finite σ] (n : ℕ) :
    {f : σ →₀ ℕ | degree f ≤ n}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [degree_eq_weight_one]
  refine finite_of_nat_weight_le (Function.const σ 1) ?_ n
  intro _
  simp only [Function.const_apply, ne_eq, one_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true]

name: finite_of_degree_lt
statement: lemma finite_of_degree_lt [Finite σ] (n : ℕ) : {f : σ →₀ ℕ | degree f < n}.Finite

name: finite_of_degree_eq
statement: lemma finite_of_degree_eq [Finite σ] (n : ℕ) : {f : σ →₀ ℕ | f.degree = n}.Finite

name: range_single_one
statement:
lemma range_single_one :
    Set.range (fun a : σ ↦ Finsupp.single a 1) = { d | d.degree = 1 }
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · simp [Set.range_subset_iff]
  · intro p (hp : p.sum (fun a k ↦ k) = 1)
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (Finsupp.sum_eq_one_iff _).mp hp
    use a

name: degree_mapDomain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem degree_mapDomain {τ : Type*} (f : σ → τ) [AddCommMonoid M] (x : σ →₀ M) :
    degree (x.mapDomain f) = degree x

name: degree_comapDomain_le_of_canonicallyOrderedAdd
statement:
theorem degree_comapDomain_le_of_canonicallyOrderedAdd {τ : Type*} {f : σ → τ} [AddCommMonoid M]
    [PartialOrder M] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd M] {x : τ →₀ M} (hf : Set.InjOn f (f ⁻¹' x.support)) :
      degree (x.comapDomain f hf) ≤ degree x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa [degree, comapDomain, Finset.sum_preimage' f x.support hf x] using
    Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset (Finset.filter_subset ..)

name: degree_mono
statement:
lemma degree_mono {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R] [PartialOrder R] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd R] :
    Monotone (Finsupp.degree (σ := σ) (R := R))

name: exists_le_degree_eq
statement:
lemma exists_le_degree_eq {σ : Type*} (f : σ →₀ ℕ) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ f.degree) :
    ∃ g ≤ f, g.degree = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [degree_eq_zero_iff]
  | succ n IH =>
    obtain ⟨g, hgf, rfl⟩ := IH (by lia)
    obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := le_iff_exists_add.mp hgf
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : f.support.Nonempty := by aesop
    exact ⟨g + .single i 1, add_le_add_right (by simp; grind) _, by simp⟩

name: degree_preimage_add
statement:
lemma degree_preimage_add {σ : Type*} (s t : Set ℕ) :
    degree (σ := σ) ⁻¹' (s + t) = degree (σ := σ) ⁻¹' s + degree (σ := σ) ⁻¹' t
proof:
:= by
  refine (Set.preimage_add_preimage_subset ..).antisymm' ?_
  rintro f ⟨m, hm, n, hn, e : m + n = _⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hgf, rfl⟩ := exists_le_degree_eq f m (by grind)
  obtain ⟨f, rfl⟩ := le_iff_exists_add.mp hgf
  exact Set.add_mem_add hm (by simp_all)

name: degree_preimage_nsmul
statement:
lemma degree_preimage_nsmul {σ : Type*} (s : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    degree (σ := σ) ⁻¹' (n • s) = n • degree (σ := σ) ⁻¹' s
proof:
:= by
  obtain (_ | n) := n; · contradiction
  induction n <;> simp_all [succ_nsmul, degree_preimage_add]

name: nsmul_single_one_image
statement:
lemma nsmul_single_one_image {α : Type*} {n : ℕ} {s : Set α} :
    n • (single · 1) '' s = {x : α →₀ ℕ | x.degree = n ∧ ↑x.support ⊆ s}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction n with
  | zero => aesop (add simp degree_eq_zero_iff)
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [succ_nsmul, ih]
    refine subset_antisymm ?_ fun f ⟨f_deg, f_supp⟩ ↦ ?_
    · simp [Set.subset_def, Set.mem_add, @forall_comm (α →₀ ℕ)]; grind
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : f.support.Nonempty := by aesop
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := le_iff_exists_add'.mp
      (show single i 1 ≤ f by simpa [Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero] using hi)
    exact ⟨x, by aesop (add simp Set.subset_def), _, ⟨_, f_supp (by simp_all), rfl⟩, hx.symm⟩

name: image_pow_eq_finsuppProd_image
statement:
theorem image_pow_eq_finsuppProd_image {α β : Type*} [CommMonoid β] {f : α → β} {n} {s : Set α} :
    (f '' s) ^ n = (·.prod (f · ^ ·)) '' {x : α →₀ ℕ | x.degree = n ∧ ↑x.support ⊆ s}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices ∀ (s : Set (α →₀ ℕ)), ((·.prod (f · ^ ·)) '' s) ^ n = (·.prod (f · ^ ·)) '' (n • s) by
    simp [← nsmul_single_one_image, ← this, Set.image_image]
  intro s
  refine (Set.image_pow (⟨⟨(·.prod (f · ^ ·)) ∘ Multiplicative.toAdd, by simp⟩,
    by simp [Finsupp.prod_add_index, pow_add]⟩ : Multiplicative (α →₀ ℕ) →* β) _ _).symm.trans ?_
  simp [-Function.comp_apply, Set.image_comp, show Multiplicative.toAdd '' s = s from
    Set.image_id _]

statement:
@[simp]
theorem toAList_keys_toFinset [DecidableEq α] (f : α →₀ M) :

name: mem_toAlist
statement:

theorem mem_toAlist {f : α →₀ M} {x : α} : x ∈ f.toAList ↔ f x ≠ 0

statement:

theorem lookupFinsupp_apply [DecidableEq α] (l : AList fun _x : α => M) (a : α) :

name: lookupFinsupp_support
statement:
@[simp]

name: lookupFinsupp_eq_iff_of_ne_zero
statement:

proof:

name: lookupFinsupp_eq_zero_iff

name: List.support_sum_subset
statement:
theorem List.support_sum_subset [AddZeroClass M] (l : List (ι →₀ M)) :
    l.sum.support ⊆ l.foldr (Finsupp.support · ⊔ ·) ∅
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl IH =>
    simp only [List.sum_cons]
    exact Finsupp.support_add.trans (Finset.union_subset_union Finset.Subset.rfl IH)

name: Multiset.support_sum_subset
statement:
theorem Multiset.support_sum_subset [AddCommMonoid M] (s : Multiset (ι →₀ M)) :

proof:
:= by
  induction s using Quot.inductionOn
  simpa only [Multiset.quot_mk_to_coe'', Multiset.sum_coe, Multiset.map_coe, Multiset.sup_coe,
    List.foldr_map] using! List.support_sum_subset _

name: List.mem_foldr_sup_support_iff
statement:
theorem List.mem_foldr_sup_support_iff [Zero M] {l : List (ι →₀ M)} {x : ι} :
    x ∈ l.foldr (Finsupp.support · ⊔ ·) ∅ ↔ ∃ f ∈ l, x ∈ f.support
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.sup_eq_union, Finsupp.mem_support_iff]
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl IH =>
    simp only [foldr, Finset.mem_union, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, ne_eq, IH,
      mem_cons, exists_eq_or_imp]

    x ∈ (s.map Finsupp.support).sup ↔ ∃ f ∈ s, x ∈ f.support
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _ ↦ by
    simpa only [Multiset.quot_mk_to_coe'', Multiset.map_coe, Multiset.sup_coe, List.foldr_map]
    using! List.mem_foldr_sup_support_iff

name: List.support_sum_eq
statement:
theorem List.support_sum_eq [AddZeroClass M] (l : List (ι →₀ M))
    (hl : l.Pairwise (_root_.Disjoint on Finsupp.support)) :
    l.sum.support = l.foldr (Finsupp.support · ⊔ ·) ∅
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl IH =>
    simp only [List.pairwise_cons] at hl
    simp only [List.sum_cons, List.foldr_cons]
    rw [Finsupp.support_add_eq, IH hl.right, Finset.sup_eq_union]
    suffices _root_.Disjoint hd.support (tl.foldr (fun x y ↦ (Finsupp.support x ⊔ y)) ∅) by
      exact Finset.disjoint_of_subset_right (List.support_sum_subset _) this
    rw [← List.foldr_map, ← Finset.bot_eq_empty, List.foldr_sup_eq_sup_toFinset,
      Finset.disjoint_sup_right]
    intro f hf
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map] at hf
    obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := hf
    exact hl.left _ hf

name: Multiset.support_sum_eq
statement:
theorem Multiset.support_sum_eq [AddCommMonoid M] (s : Multiset (ι →₀ M))
    (hs : s.Pairwise (_root_.Disjoint on Finsupp.support)) :
    s.sum.support = (s.map Finsupp.support).sup
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Quot.inductionOn with | _ a
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hd⟩ := hs
  suffices a.Pairwise (_root_.Disjoint on Finsupp.support) by
    convert! List.support_sum_eq a this
    simp only [quot_mk_to_coe'', map_coe, sup_coe,
      Finset.sup_eq_union, Finset.bot_eq_empty, List.foldr_map]
  simp only [Multiset.quot_mk_to_coe'', Multiset.coe_eq_coe] at hl
  exact hl.symm.pairwise hd fun h ↦ _root_.Disjoint.symm h

name: Finset.support_sum_eq
statement:
theorem Finset.support_sum_eq [AddCommMonoid M] (s : Finset (ι →₀ M))
    (hs : (s : Set (ι →₀ M)).PairwiseDisjoint Finsupp.support) :
    (s.sum id).support = Finset.sup s Finsupp.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices s.1.Pairwise (_root_.Disjoint on Finsupp.support) by
    convert! Multiset.support_sum_eq s.1 this
    exact (Finset.sum_val _).symm
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hn⟩ : ∃ l : List (ι →₀ M), l.toFinset = s ∧ l.Nodup := by
    refine ⟨s.toList, ?_, Finset.nodup_toList _⟩
    simp
  subst hl
  rwa [List.toFinset_val, List.dedup_eq_self.mpr hn, Multiset.pairwise_coe_iff_pairwise,
    ← List.pairwiseDisjoint_iff_coe_toFinset_pairwise_disjoint hn]

name: sigmaFinsuppEquivDFinsupp_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sigmaFinsuppEquivDFinsupp_single [DecidableEq ι] [Zero N] (a : Σ i, η i) (n : N) :
    sigmaFinsuppEquivDFinsupp (Finsupp.single a n) =
      @DFinsupp.single _ (fun i => η i →₀ N) _ _ a.1 (Finsupp.single a.2 n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, a⟩ := a
  ext j b
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h
    classical simp [split_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
  suffices Finsupp.single (⟨i, a⟩ : Σ i, η i) n ⟨j, b⟩ = 0 by
    simp [split_apply, dite_eq_right h, this]
  have H : (⟨i, a⟩ : Σ i, η i) ≠ ⟨j, b⟩ := by simp [h]
  classical rw [Finsupp.single_apply, ite_eq_right H]

theorem ofEquiv_val (E : σ ≃ τ) (F : Ctop α σ) (a : τ) : F.ofEquiv E a = F (E.symm a)

name: toTopsp_isTopologicalBasis
statement:
theorem toTopsp_isTopologicalBasis (F : Ctop α σ) :
    @TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis _ F.toTopsp (Set.range F.f)
proof:
:=
  letI := F.toTopsp
  ⟨fun _u ⟨a, e₁⟩ _v ⟨b, e₂⟩ ↦
    e₁ ▸ e₂ ▸ fun x h ↦ ⟨_, ⟨_, rfl⟩, F.inter_mem a b x h, F.inter_sub a b x h⟩,
    eq_univ_iff_forall.2 fun x ↦ ⟨_, ⟨_, rfl⟩, F.top_mem x⟩, rfl⟩

name: mem_nhds_toTopsp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_nhds_toTopsp (F : Ctop α σ) {s : Set α} {a : α} :
    s ∈ @nhds _ F.toTopsp a ↔ ∃ b, a ∈ F b ∧ F b ⊆ s
proof:
:=
  (@TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis.mem_nhds_iff _ F.toTopsp _ _ _
        F.toTopsp_isTopologicalBasis).trans <|
    ⟨fun ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, h⟩ ↦ ⟨x, h⟩, fun ⟨x, h⟩ ↦ ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, h⟩⟩

name: is_basis
statement:
protected theorem is_basis [T : TopologicalSpace α] (F : Realizer α) :
    TopologicalSpace.IsTopologicalBasis (Set.range F.F.f)
proof:
:= by
  have := toTopsp_isTopologicalBasis F.F; rwa [F.eq] at this

name: mem_nhds
statement:
protected theorem mem_nhds [T : TopologicalSpace α] (F : Realizer α) {s : Set α} {a : α} :
    s ∈ 𝓝 a ↔ ∃ b, a ∈ F.F b ∧ F.F b ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  have := @mem_nhds_toTopsp _ _ F.F s a; rwa [F.eq] at this

name: isOpen_iff
statement:
theorem isOpen_iff [TopologicalSpace α] (F : Realizer α) {s : Set α} :
    IsOpen s ↔ ∀ a ∈ s, ∃ b, a ∈ F.F b ∧ F.F b ⊆ s

name: isClosed_iff
statement:
theorem isClosed_iff [TopologicalSpace α] (F : Realizer α) {s : Set α} :
    IsClosed s ↔ ∀ a, (∀ b, a ∈ F.F b → ∃ z, z ∈ F.F b ∩ s) → a ∈ s
proof:
:=
  isOpen_compl_iff.symm.trans <|
    F.isOpen_iff.trans <|
      forall_congr' fun a ↦
        show (a ∉ s → ∃ b : F.σ, a ∈ F.F b ∧ ∀ z ∈ F.F b, z ∉ s) ↔ _ by
          have := Classical.propDecidable; rw [not_imp_comm]
          simp [not_exists, not_and, not_forall, and_comm]

name: mem_interior_iff
statement:
theorem mem_interior_iff [TopologicalSpace α] (F : Realizer α) {s : Set α} {a : α} :
    a ∈ interior s ↔ ∃ b, a ∈ F.F b ∧ F.F b ⊆ s

name: isOpen
statement: protected theorem isOpen [TopologicalSpace α] (F : Realizer α) (s : F.σ) : IsOpen (F.F s)
proof:
:=
  isOpen_iff_nhds.2 fun a m ↦ by simpa using F.mem_nhds.2 ⟨s, m, Subset.refl _⟩

name: ext'
statement:
theorem ext' [T : TopologicalSpace α] {σ : Type*} {F : Ctop α σ}
    (H : ∀ a s, s ∈ 𝓝 a ↔ ∃ b, a ∈ F b ∧ F b ⊆ s) : F.toTopsp = T
proof:
:= by
  refine TopologicalSpace.ext_nhds fun x ↦ ?_
  ext s
  rw [mem_nhds_toTopsp, H]

name: ext
statement:
theorem ext [T : TopologicalSpace α] {σ : Type*} {F : Ctop α σ} (H₁ : ∀ a, IsOpen (F a))
    (H₂ : ∀ a s, s ∈ 𝓝 a → ∃ b, a ∈ F b ∧ F b ⊆ s) : F.toTopsp = T
proof:
:=
  ext' fun a s ↦ ⟨H₂ a s, fun ⟨_b, h₁, h₂⟩ ↦ mem_nhds_iff.2 ⟨_, h₂, H₁ _, h₁⟩⟩

name: tendsto_nhds_iff

theorem tendsto_nhds_iff {m : β → α} {f : Filter β} (F : f.Realizer) (R : Realizer α) {a : α} :

name: LocallyFinite.Realizer.to_locallyFinite
statement:
theorem LocallyFinite.Realizer.to_locallyFinite [TopologicalSpace α] {F : Ctop.Realizer α}
    {f : β → Set α} (R : LocallyFinite.Realizer F f) : LocallyFinite f
proof:
:= fun a ↦
  ⟨_, F.mem_nhds.2 ⟨(R.bas a).1, (R.bas a).2, Subset.rfl⟩, have := R.sets a; Set.toFinite _⟩

name: locallyFinite_iff_exists_realizer
statement:
theorem locallyFinite_iff_exists_realizer [TopologicalSpace α] (F : Ctop.Realizer α)
    {f : β → Set α} : LocallyFinite f ↔ Nonempty (LocallyFinite.Realizer F f)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦
    let ⟨g, h₁⟩ := Classical.axiom_of_choice h
    let ⟨g₂, h₂⟩ :=
      Classical.axiom_of_choice fun x ↦
        show ∃ b : F.σ, x ∈ F.F b ∧ F.F b ⊆ g x from
          let ⟨h, _h'⟩ := h₁ x
          F.mem_nhds.1 h
    ⟨⟨fun x ↦ ⟨g₂ x, (h₂ x).1⟩, fun x ↦
        Finite.fintype <|
          let ⟨_h, h'⟩ := h₁ x
          h'.subset fun _i hi ↦ hi.mono (inter_subset_inter_right _ (h₂ x).2)⟩⟩,
    fun ⟨R⟩ ↦ R.to_locallyFinite⟩

name: le_iff
statement:
theorem le_iff {f g : Filter α} (F : f.Realizer) (G : g.Realizer) :
    f ≤ g ↔ ∀ b : G.σ, ∃ a : F.σ, F.F a ≤ G.F b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H t ↦ F.mem_sets.1 (H (G.mem_sets.2 ⟨t, Subset.refl _⟩)), fun H _ h ↦
    F.mem_sets.2 <|
      let ⟨s, h₁⟩ := G.mem_sets.1 h
      let ⟨t, h₂⟩ := H s
      ⟨t, Subset.trans h₂ h₁⟩⟩

name: tendsto_iff
statement:
theorem tendsto_iff (f : α → β) {l₁ : Filter α} {l₂ : Filter β} (L₁ : l₁.Realizer)
    (L₂ : l₂.Realizer) : Tendsto f l₁ l₂ ↔ ∀ b, ∃ a, ∀ x ∈ L₁.F a, f x ∈ L₂.F b
proof:
:=
  (le_iff (L₁.map f) L₂).trans <| forall_congr' fun _ ↦ exists_congr fun _ ↦ image_subset_iff

name: ne_bot_iff
statement: theorem ne_bot_iff {f : Filter α} (F : f.Realizer) : f ≠ ⊥ ↔ ∀ a : F.σ, (F.F a).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [not_iff_comm, ← le_bot_iff, F.le_iff Realizer.bot, not_forall]
  simp only [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨x, e⟩ _ ↦ ⟨x, le_of_eq e⟩, fun h ↦
    let ⟨x, h⟩ := h ()
    ⟨x, le_bot_iff.1 h⟩⟩

name: flatten_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem flatten_pure (s : WSeq α) : flatten (Computation.pure s) = s
proof:
:= by
  refine Seq.eq_of_bisim (fun s1 s2 => flatten (Computation.pure s2) = s1) ?_ rfl
  intro s' s h
  rw [← h]
  simp only [Seq.BisimO, flatten, Seq.omap, pure_def, Seq.corec_eq, destruct_pure]
  cases Seq.destruct s with
  | none => simp
  | some val =>
    obtain ⟨o, s'⟩ := val
    simp

statement:
@[simp]
theorem flatten_think (c : Computation (WSeq α)) : flatten c.think = think (flatten c)

name: destruct_flatten
statement:
@[simp]
theorem destruct_flatten (c : Computation (WSeq α)) : destruct (flatten c) = c >>= destruct
proof:
:= by
  refine
    Computation.eq_of_bisim
      (fun c1 c2 => c1 = c2 ∨ ∃ c, c1 = destruct (flatten c) ∧ c2 = Computation.bind c destruct) ?_
      (Or.inr ⟨c, rfl, rfl⟩)
  intro c1 c2 h
  exact
    match c1, c2, h with
    | c, _, Or.inl rfl => by cases c.destruct <;> simp
    | _, _, Or.inr ⟨c, rfl, rfl⟩ => by
      induction c using Computation.recOn with
      | pure a => simp; cases (destruct a).destruct <;> simp
      | think c' => simpa using Or.inr ⟨c', rfl, rfl⟩

  | zero => simp [drop]

name: destruct_tail
statement: theorem destruct_tail (s : WSeq α) : destruct (tail s) = destruct s >>= tail.aux
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tail, destruct_flatten]; rw [← bind_pure_comp, LawfulMonad.bind_assoc]
  apply congr_arg; ext1 (_ | ⟨a, s⟩) <;> apply (@pure_bind Computation _ _ _ _ _ _).trans _ <;> simp

name: drop.aux_none
statement:
theorem drop.aux_none : ∀ n, @drop.aux α n none = Computation.pure none
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 =>
    show Computation.bind (Computation.pure none) (drop.aux n) = Computation.pure none by
      rw [ret_bind, drop.aux_none n]

name: destruct_dropn
statement:
theorem destruct_dropn : ∀ (s : WSeq α) (n), destruct (drop s n) = destruct s >>= drop.aux n
  | _, 0 => (bind_pure' _).symm
  | s, n + 1 => by
    rw [← dropn_tail, destruct_dropn _ n, destruct_tail, LawfulMonad.bind_assoc]
    rfl

name: head_terminates_of_head_tail_terminates
statement:
theorem head_terminates_of_head_tail_terminates (s : WSeq α) [T : Terminates (head (tail s))] :
    Terminates (head s)
proof:
:=
  (head_terminates_iff _).2 <| by
    rcases (head_terminates_iff _).1 T with ⟨⟨a, h⟩⟩
    simp? [tail] at h says simp only [tail, destruct_flatten, bind_map_left] at h
    rcases exists_of_mem_bind h with ⟨s', h1, _⟩
    exact terminates_of_mem h1

name: destruct_some_of_destruct_tail_some
statement:
theorem destruct_some_of_destruct_tail_some {s : WSeq α} {a} (h : some a ∈ destruct (tail s)) :
    ∃ a', some a' ∈ destruct s
proof:
:= by
  unfold tail Functor.map at h; simp only [destruct_flatten] at h
  rcases exists_of_mem_bind h with ⟨t, tm, td⟩; clear h
  rcases Computation.exists_of_mem_map tm with ⟨t', ht', ht2⟩; clear tm
  rcases t' with - | t' <;> rw [← ht2] at td <;> simp only [destruct_nil] at td
  · have := mem_unique td (ret_mem _)
    contradiction
  · exact ⟨_, ht'⟩

name: head_some_of_head_tail_some
statement:
theorem head_some_of_head_tail_some {s : WSeq α} {a} (h : some a ∈ head (tail s)) :
    ∃ a', some a' ∈ head s
proof:
:= by
  unfold head at h
  rcases Computation.exists_of_mem_map h with ⟨o, md, e⟩; clear h
  rcases o with - | o <;> [injection e; injection e with h']; clear h'
  obtain ⟨a, am⟩ := destruct_some_of_destruct_tail_some md
  exact ⟨_, Computation.mem_map (@Prod.fst α (WSeq α) <$> ·) am⟩

name: head_some_of_get
statement:
theorem head_some_of_get?_some {s : WSeq α} {a n} (h : some a ∈ get? s n) :
    ∃ a', some a' ∈ head s
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing a with
  | zero => exact ⟨_, h⟩
  | succ n IH =>
      let ⟨a', h'⟩ := head_some_of_head_tail_some h
      exact IH h'

name: get
statement:
theorem get?_terminates_le {s : WSeq α} {m n} (h : m ≤ n) :
    Terminates (get? s n) → Terminates (get? s m)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact id
  | step _ IH => exact fun T ↦ IH (@head_terminates_of_head_tail_terminates _ _ T)

name: head_terminates_of_get
statement:
theorem head_terminates_of_get?_terminates {s : WSeq α} {n} :

name: destruct_terminates_of_get
statement:
theorem destruct_terminates_of_get?_terminates {s : WSeq α} {n} (T : Terminates (get? s n)) :
    Terminates (destruct s)

name: mem_rec_on
statement:
theorem mem_rec_on {C : WSeq α → Prop} {a s} (M : a ∈ s) (h1 : ∀ b s', a = b ∨ C s' → C (cons b s'))
    (h2 : ∀ s, C s → C (think s)) : C s
proof:
:= by
  apply Seq.mem_rec_on M
  intro o s' h; rcases o with - | b
  · apply h2
    cases h
    · contradiction
    · assumption
  · apply h1
    apply Or.imp_left _ h
    intro h
    injection h

name: mem_think
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_think (s : WSeq α) (a) : a ∈ think s ↔ a ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, al⟩ := s
  change (some (some a) ∈ some none::f) ↔ some (some a) ∈ f
  constructor <;> intro h
  · apply (Stream'.eq_or_mem_of_mem_cons h).resolve_left
    intro
    injections
  · apply Stream'.mem_cons_of_mem _ h

name: eq_or_mem_iff_mem
statement:
theorem eq_or_mem_iff_mem {s : WSeq α} {a a' s'} :
    some (a', s') ∈ destruct s → (a ∈ s ↔ a = a' ∨ a ∈ s')
proof:
:= by
  generalize e : destruct s = c
  intro h
  revert s
  apply Computation.memRecOn h <;> [skip; intro c IH] <;> intro s m <;>
    induction s using WSeq.recOn <;>
    have := congr_arg Computation.destruct m
  case h1.nil | h1.think | h2.nil | h2.cons => simp at this
  case h2.think => simp at this; simp [IH this]
  case h1.cons =>
    simp only [destruct_cons, destruct_pure, Sum.inl.injEq, Option.some.injEq,
      Prod.mk.injEq] at this
    obtain ⟨i1, i2⟩ := this
    rw [i1, i2]
    dsimp only [cons, Membership.mem, WSeq.Mem, Seq.Mem, Seq.cons]
    have h_a_eq_a' : a = a' ↔ some (some a) = some (some a') := by simp
    rw [h_a_eq_a']
    refine ⟨Stream'.eq_or_mem_of_mem_cons, fun o => ?_⟩
    rcases o with e | m
    · rw [e]
      apply Stream'.mem_cons
    · exact Stream'.mem_cons_of_mem _ m

name: mem_cons_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_cons_iff (s : WSeq α) (b) {a} : a ∈ cons b s ↔ a = b ∨ a ∈ s

name: mem_cons_of_mem
statement: theorem mem_cons_of_mem {s : WSeq α} (b) {a} (h : a ∈ s) : a ∈ cons b s

name: mem_cons
statement: theorem mem_cons (s : WSeq α) (a) : a ∈ cons a s

name: mem_of_mem_tail
statement: theorem mem_of_mem_tail {s : WSeq α} {a} (h : a ∈ tail s) : a ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨n, e⟩ := h
  revert s
  induction n <;> intro s m e <;> induction s using WSeq.recOn
  case zero.nil | succ.nil => simpa using m
  case zero.cons | succ.cons => exact WSeq.mem_cons_iff .. |>.mpr <| Or.inr (by simpa using m)
  case zero.think => injections
  case succ.think n IH s =>
    simp only [tail_think, mem_think] at m e ⊢
    apply IH m
    rw [e]
    cases tail s
    rfl

name: mem_of_mem_dropn
statement:
theorem mem_of_mem_dropn {s : WSeq α} {a} : ∀ {n}, a ∈ drop s n → a ∈ s
  | 0, h => h
  | n + 1, h => @mem_of_mem_dropn s a n (mem_of_mem_tail h)

name: get
statement: theorem get?_mem {s : WSeq α} {a n} : some a ∈ get? s n → a ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s <;> intro h
  case zero =>
    rcases Computation.exists_of_mem_map h with ⟨o, h1, h2⟩
    rcases o with - | o
    · injection h2
    injection h2 with h'
    obtain ⟨a', s'⟩ := o
    exact (eq_or_mem_iff_mem h1).2 (Or.inl h'.symm)
  case succ n IH =>
    have := @IH (tail s)
    rw [get?_tail] at this
    exact mem_of_mem_tail (this h)

name: exists_get
statement: theorem exists_get?_of_mem {s : WSeq α} {a} (h : a ∈ s) : ∃ n, some a ∈ get? s n
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_rec_on h
  · intro a' s' h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exists 0
      simp only [get?, drop, head_cons]
      rw [h]
      apply ret_mem
    · obtain ⟨n, h⟩ := h
      exists n + 1
      simpa [get?]
  · intro s' h
    obtain ⟨n, h⟩ := h
    exists n
    simp only [get?, dropn_think, head_think]
    apply think_mem h

name: exists_dropn_of_mem
statement:
theorem exists_dropn_of_mem {s : WSeq α} {a} (h : a ∈ s) :
    ∃ n s', some (a, s') ∈ destruct (drop s n)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨n, h⟩ := exists_get?_of_mem h
  ⟨n, by
    rcases (head_terminates_iff _).1 ⟨⟨_, h⟩⟩ with ⟨⟨o, om⟩⟩
    have := Computation.mem_unique (Computation.mem_map _ om) h
    rcases o with - | o
    · injection this
    injection this with i
    obtain ⟨a', s'⟩ := o
    dsimp at i
    rw [i] at om
    exact ⟨_, om⟩⟩

name: head_terminates_of_mem
statement: theorem head_terminates_of_mem {s : WSeq α} {a} (h : a ∈ s) : Terminates (head s)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, h⟩ := exists_get?_of_mem h
  head_terminates_of_get?_terminates ⟨⟨_, h⟩⟩

name: of_mem_append
statement: theorem of_mem_append {s₁ s₂ : WSeq α} {a : α} : a ∈ append s₁ s₂ → a ∈ s₁ ∨ a ∈ s₂

name: mem_append_left
statement: theorem mem_append_left {s₁ s₂ : WSeq α} {a : α} : a ∈ s₁ → a ∈ append s₁ s₂

name: exists_of_mem_map
statement:
theorem exists_of_mem_map {f} {b : β} : ∀ {s : WSeq α}, b ∈ map f s → ∃ a, a ∈ s ∧ f a = b
  | ⟨g, al⟩, h => by
    let ⟨o, om, oe⟩
proof:
:= Seq.exists_of_mem_map h
    rcases o with - | a
    · injection oe
    injection oe with h'
    exact ⟨a, om, h'⟩

name: ofList_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofList_nil : ofList [] = (nil : WSeq α)

name: ofList_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofList_cons (a : α) (l) : ofList (a::l) = cons a (ofList l)
proof:
:=
  show Seq.map some (Seq.ofList (a::l)) = Seq.cons (some a) (Seq.map some (Seq.ofList l)) by simp

name: toList'_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toList'_nil (l : List α) :
    Computation.corec (fun ⟨l, s⟩ =>
      match Seq.destruct s with
      | none => Sum.inl l.reverse
      | some (none, s') => Sum.inr (l, s')
      | some (some a, s') => Sum.inr (a::l, s')) (l, nil) = Computation.pure l.reverse

name: toList'_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toList'_cons (l : List α) (s : WSeq α) (a : α) :
    Computation.corec (fun ⟨l, s⟩ =>
      match Seq.destruct s with
      | none => Sum.inl l.reverse
      | some (none, s') => Sum.inr (l, s')
      | some (some a, s') => Sum.inr (a::l, s')) (l, cons a s) =
      (Computation.corec (fun ⟨l, s⟩ =>
        match Seq.destruct s with
        | none => Sum.inl l.reverse
        | some (none, s') => Sum.inr (l, s')
        | some (some a, s') => Sum.inr (a::l, s')) (a::l, s)).think

name: toList'_think
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toList'_think (l : List α) (s : WSeq α) :
    Computation.corec (fun ⟨l, s⟩ =>
      match Seq.destruct s with
      | none => Sum.inl l.reverse
      | some (none, s') => Sum.inr (l, s')
      | some (some a, s') => Sum.inr (a::l, s')) (l, think s) =
      (Computation.corec (fun ⟨l, s⟩ =>
        match Seq.destruct s with
        | none => Sum.inl l.reverse
        | some (none, s') => Sum.inr (l, s')
        | some (some a, s') => Sum.inr (a::l, s')) (l, s)).think

name: toList'_map
statement:
theorem toList'_map (l : List α) (s : WSeq α) :
    Computation.corec (fun ⟨l, s⟩ =>
      match Seq.destruct s with
      | none => Sum.inl l.reverse
      | some (none, s') => Sum.inr (l, s')
      | some (some a, s') => Sum.inr (a :: l, s')) (l, s) = (l.reverse ++ ·) <$> toList s
proof:
:= by
  refine
    Computation.eq_of_bisim
      (fun c1 c2 =>
        ∃ (l' : List α) (s : WSeq α),
          c1 = Computation.corec (fun ⟨l, s⟩ =>
            match Seq.destruct s with
            | none => Sum.inl l.reverse
            | some (none, s') => Sum.inr (l, s')
            | some (some a, s') => Sum.inr (a::l, s')) (l' ++ l, s) ∧
            c2 = Computation.map (l.reverse ++ ·) (Computation.corec (fun ⟨l, s⟩ =>
              match Seq.destruct s with
              | none => Sum.inl l.reverse
              | some (none, s') => Sum.inr (l, s')
              | some (some a, s') => Sum.inr (a::l, s')) (l', s)))
      ?_ ⟨[], s, rfl, rfl⟩
  intro s1 s2 h; rcases h with ⟨l', s, h⟩; rw [h.left, h.right]
  induction s using WSeq.recOn
  case nil => simp
  case cons a s => refine ⟨a :: l', s, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp
  case think s => refine ⟨l', s, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp

name: toList_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toList_cons (a : α) (s) : toList (cons a s) = (List.cons a <$> toList s).think
proof:
:=
  destruct_eq_think <| by
    unfold toList
    simp only [toList'_cons, Computation.destruct_think, Sum.inr.injEq]
    rw [toList'_map]
    simp only [List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append, List.singleton_append]
    rfl

name: toList_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toList_nil : toList (nil : WSeq α) = Computation.pure []

name: toList_ofList
statement: theorem toList_ofList (l : List α) : l ∈ toList (ofList l)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l IH => simpa [ret_mem] using! think_mem (Computation.mem_map _ IH)

name: destruct_ofSeq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem destruct_ofSeq (s : Seq α) :
    destruct (ofSeq s) = Computation.pure (s.head.map fun a => (a, ofSeq s.tail))
proof:
:=
  destruct_eq_pure <| by
    simp only [destruct, Seq.destruct, Option.map_eq_map, ofSeq, Computation.corec_eq, rmap,
      Seq.head]
    rw [show Seq.get? (some <$> s) 0 = some <$> Seq.get? s 0 by apply Seq.map_get?]
    rcases Seq.get? s 0 with - | a
    · rfl
    dsimp only [(· <$> ·)]
    simp

name: head_ofSeq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem head_ofSeq (s : Seq α) : head (ofSeq s) = Computation.pure s.head
proof:
:= by
  simp only [head, Option.map_eq_map, destruct_ofSeq, Computation.map_pure, Option.map_map]
  cases Seq.head s <;> rfl

name: tail_ofSeq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tail_ofSeq (s : Seq α) : tail (ofSeq s) = ofSeq s.tail
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tail, destruct_ofSeq, map_pure', flatten_pure]
  induction s using Seq.recOn <;> simp only [ofSeq, Seq.tail_nil, Seq.head_nil,
    Option.map_none, Seq.tail_cons, Seq.head_cons, Option.map_some]
  · rfl

name: dropn_ofSeq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dropn_ofSeq (s : Seq α) : ∀ n, drop (ofSeq s) n = ofSeq (s.drop n)
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
    simp only [drop, Seq.drop]
    rw [dropn_ofSeq s n, tail_ofSeq]

name: get
statement: theorem get?_ofSeq (s : Seq α) (n) : get? (ofSeq s) n = Computation.pure (Seq.get? s n)

name: map_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_nil (f : α → β) : map f nil = nil

name: map_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_cons (f : α → β) (a s) : map f (cons a s) = cons (f a) (map f s)

name: map_think
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_think (f : α → β) (s) : map f (think s) = think (map f s)

name: map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id (s : WSeq α) : map id s = s

name: map_ret
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_ret (f : α → β) (a) : map f (ret a) = ret (f a)

name: map_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_append (f : α → β) (s t) : map f (append s t) = append (map f s) (map f t)

name: map_comp
statement: theorem map_comp (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (s : WSeq α) : map (g ∘ f) s = map g (map f s)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [map]; rw [← Seq.map_comp]
  apply congr_fun; apply congr_arg
  ext ⟨⟩ <;> rfl

name: mem_map
statement: theorem mem_map (f : α → β) {a : α} {s : WSeq α} : a ∈ s → f a ∈ map f s

name: exists_of_mem_join
statement: theorem exists_of_mem_join {a : α} : ∀ {S : WSeq (WSeq α)}, a ∈ join S → ∃ s, s ∈ S ∧ a ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  suffices
    ∀ ss : WSeq α,
      a ∈ ss → ∀ s S, append s (join S) = ss → a ∈ append s (join S) → a ∈ s ∨ ∃ s, s ∈ S ∧ a ∈ s
    from fun S h => (this _ h nil S (by simp) (by simp [h])).resolve_left (notMem_nil _)
  intro ss h
  apply mem_rec_on h
  · intro b ss o s S ej m
    induction s using WSeq.recOn <;>
      [induction S using WSeq.recOn; skip; skip] <;>
      have := congr_arg Seq.destruct ej
    case nil.nil | nil.cons | nil.think | think => simp at this
    case cons =>
      simp only [cons_append, seq_destruct_cons, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at this
      cases this with
      | intro b' s =>
        subst b' ss
        simp? at m ⊢ says simp only [cons_append, mem_cons_iff] at m ⊢
        rcases o with e | IH
        · simp [e]
        rcases m with e | m
        · simp [e]
        exact Or.imp_left Or.inr (IH _ _ rfl m)
  · intro ss IH s S ej m
    induction s using WSeq.recOn <;>
      [induction S using WSeq.recOn; skip; skip] <;>
      have := congr_arg Seq.destruct ej
    case nil.cons | nil.think | think => simp at this; simp_all
    case nil.nil | cons => simp at this

name: exists_of_mem_bind
statement:
theorem exists_of_mem_bind {s : WSeq α} {f : α → WSeq β} {b} (h : b ∈ bind s f) :
    ∃ a ∈ s, b ∈ f a
proof:
:=
  let ⟨t, tm, bt⟩ := exists_of_mem_join h
  let ⟨a, as, e⟩ := exists_of_mem_map tm
  ⟨a, as, by rwa [e]⟩

name: destruct_map
statement:
theorem destruct_map (f : α → β) (s : WSeq α) :
    destruct (map f s) = Computation.map (Option.map (Prod.map f (map f))) (destruct s)
proof:
:= by
  apply
    Computation.eq_of_bisim fun c1 c2 =>
      ∃ s,
        c1 = destruct (map f s) ∧
          c2 = Computation.map (Option.map (Prod.map f (map f))) (destruct s)
  · intro c1 c2 h
    obtain ⟨s, h⟩ := h
    rw [h.left, h.right]
    induction s using WSeq.recOn
    case nil | cons => simp
    case think s => exact ⟨s, by simp⟩
  · exact ⟨s, rfl, rfl⟩

name: destruct_append
statement:
theorem destruct_append (s t : WSeq α) :
    destruct (append s t) = (destruct s).bind (destruct_append.aux t)
proof:
:= by
  apply
    Computation.eq_of_bisim
      (fun c1 c2 =>
        ∃ s t, c1 = destruct (append s t) ∧ c2 = (destruct s).bind (destruct_append.aux t))
      _ ⟨s, t, rfl, rfl⟩
  intro c1 c2 h; rcases h with ⟨s, t, h⟩; rw [h.left, h.right]
  induction s using WSeq.recOn
  case nil =>
    induction t using WSeq.recOn
    case nil | cons => simp
    case think t => exact ⟨nil, t, by simp⟩
  case cons => simp
  case think s => exact ⟨s, t, by simp⟩

name: destruct_join
statement:
theorem destruct_join (S : WSeq (WSeq α)) :
    destruct (join S) = (destruct S).bind destruct_join.aux
proof:
:= by
  apply
    Computation.eq_of_bisim
      (fun c1 c2 =>
        c1 = c2 ∨ ∃ S, c1 = destruct (join S) ∧ c2 = (destruct S).bind destruct_join.aux)
      _ (Or.inr ⟨S, rfl, rfl⟩)
  intro c1 c2 h
  exact
    match c1, c2, h with
    | c, _, Or.inl <| rfl => by cases c.destruct <;> simp
    | _, _, Or.inr ⟨S, rfl, rfl⟩ => by
      induction S using WSeq.recOn
      case nil | cons => simp
      case think S => exact Or.inr ⟨S, by simp⟩

name: map_join
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_join (f : α → β) (S) : map f (join S) = join (map (map f) S)
proof:
:= by
  apply
    Seq.eq_of_bisim fun s1 s2 =>
      ∃ s S, s1 = append s (map f (join S)) ∧ s2 = append s (join (map (map f) S))
  · rintro s1 s2 ⟨s, S, rfl, rfl⟩
    induction s using WSeq.recOn
    · induction S using WSeq.recOn with
      | nil => simp
      | cons s S => simpa using ⟨map f s, S, rfl, rfl⟩
      | think S => simpa using ⟨nil, S, by simp, by simp⟩
    · simpa using ⟨_, _, rfl, rfl⟩
    · simpa using ⟨_, _, rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨nil, S, by simp, by simp⟩

name: LiftRelO.imp
statement:
theorem LiftRelO.imp {R S : α → β → Prop} {C D : WSeq α → WSeq β → Prop} (H1 : ∀ a b, R a b → S a b)
    (H2 : ∀ s t, C s t → D s t) : ∀ {o p}, LiftRelO R C o p → LiftRelO S D o p
  | none, none, _ => trivial
  | some (_, _), some (_, _), h => And.imp (H1 _ _) (H2 _ _) h
  | none, some _, h => False.elim h
  | some (_, _), none, h => False.elim h

name: LiftRelO.imp_right
statement:
theorem LiftRelO.imp_right (R : α → β → Prop) {C D : WSeq α → WSeq β → Prop}
    (H : ∀ s t, C s t → D s t) {o p} : LiftRelO R C o p → LiftRelO R D o p

name: LiftRelO.swap
statement:
theorem LiftRelO.swap (R : α → β → Prop) (C) :
    swap (LiftRelO R C) = LiftRelO (swap R) (swap C)
proof:
:= by
  funext x y
  rcases x with ⟨⟩ | ⟨hx, jx⟩ <;> rcases y with ⟨⟩ | ⟨hy, jy⟩ <;> rfl

name: BisimO.imp
statement:
theorem BisimO.imp {R S : WSeq α → WSeq α → Prop} (H : ∀ s t, R s t → S s t) {o p} :
    BisimO R o p → BisimO S o p

name: liftRel_destruct
statement:
theorem liftRel_destruct {R : α → β → Prop} {s : WSeq α} {t : WSeq β} :
    LiftRel R s t → Computation.LiftRel (LiftRelO R (LiftRel R)) (destruct s) (destruct t)
  | ⟨R, h1, h2⟩ => by
    refine Computation.LiftRel.imp ?_ _ _ (h2 h1)
    apply LiftRelO.imp_right
    exact fun s' t' h' => ⟨R, h', @h2⟩

name: liftRel_destruct_iff
statement:
theorem liftRel_destruct_iff {R : α → β → Prop} {s : WSeq α} {t : WSeq β} :
    LiftRel R s t ↔ Computation.LiftRel (LiftRelO R (LiftRel R)) (destruct s) (destruct t)
proof:
:=
  ⟨liftRel_destruct, fun h =>
    ⟨fun s t =>
      LiftRel R s t ∨ Computation.LiftRel (LiftRelO R (LiftRel R)) (destruct s) (destruct t),
      Or.inr h, fun {s t} h => by
      have h : Computation.LiftRel (LiftRelO R (LiftRel R)) (destruct s) (destruct t) := by
        obtain h | h := h
        · exact liftRel_destruct h
        · assumption
      apply Computation.LiftRel.imp _ _ _ h
      apply LiftRelO.imp_right
      intro s t
      apply Or.inl⟩⟩

name: LiftRel.swap_lem
statement:
theorem LiftRel.swap_lem {R : α → β → Prop} {s1 s2} (h : LiftRel R s1 s2) :
    LiftRel (swap R) s2 s1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨swap (LiftRel R), h, fun {s t} (h : LiftRel R t s) => ?_⟩
  rw [← LiftRelO.swap, Computation.LiftRel.swap]
  apply liftRel_destruct h

name: LiftRel.swap
statement: theorem LiftRel.swap (R : α → β → Prop) : swap (LiftRel R) = LiftRel (swap R)
proof:
:=
  funext fun _ => funext fun _ => propext ⟨LiftRel.swap_lem, LiftRel.swap_lem⟩

name: LiftRel.equiv
statement:
theorem LiftRel.equiv (R : α → α → Prop) (H : Equivalence R) : Equivalence (LiftRel R) where
  refl
proof:
:= @LiftRel.refl α R H.stdRefl |>.refl
  symm := @LiftRel.symm α R H.stdSymm |>.symm _ _
  trans := @LiftRel.trans α R H.isTrans |>.trans _ _ _

name: Equiv.refl
statement:
@[refl]
theorem Equiv.refl : ∀ s : WSeq α, s ~ʷ s

name: Equiv.symm
statement:
@[symm]
theorem Equiv.symm : ∀ {s t : WSeq α}, s ~ʷ t → t ~ʷ s

name: Equiv.trans
statement:
@[trans]
theorem Equiv.trans : ∀ {s t u : WSeq α}, s ~ʷ t → t ~ʷ u → s ~ʷ u

name: Equiv.equivalence
statement: theorem Equiv.equivalence : Equivalence (@Equiv α)

name: destruct_congr
statement:
theorem destruct_congr {s t : WSeq α} :
    s ~ʷ t → Computation.LiftRel (BisimO (· ~ʷ ·)) (destruct s) (destruct t)

name: destruct_congr_iff
statement:
theorem destruct_congr_iff {s t : WSeq α} :
    s ~ʷ t ↔ Computation.LiftRel (BisimO (· ~ʷ ·)) (destruct s) (destruct t)

name: liftRel_dropn_destruct
statement:
theorem liftRel_dropn_destruct {R : α → β → Prop} {s t} (H : LiftRel R s t) :
    ∀ n, Computation.LiftRel (LiftRelO R (LiftRel R)) (destruct (drop s n)) (destruct (drop t n))
  | 0 => liftRel_destruct H
  | n + 1 => by
    simp only [drop, destruct_tail]
    apply liftRel_bind
    · apply liftRel_dropn_destruct H n
    exact fun {a b} o =>
      match a, b, o with
      | none, none, _ => by simp
      | some (a, s), some (b, t), ⟨_, h2⟩ => by simpa [tail.aux] using liftRel_destruct h2

name: exists_of_liftRel_left
statement:
theorem exists_of_liftRel_left {R : α → β → Prop} {s t} (H : LiftRel R s t) {a} (h : a ∈ s) :
    ∃ b, b ∈ t ∧ R a b
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨n, h⟩ := exists_get?_of_mem h
  let ⟨some (_, s'), sd, rfl⟩ := Computation.exists_of_mem_map h
  let ⟨some (b, t'), td, ⟨ab, _⟩⟩ := (liftRel_dropn_destruct H n).left sd
  exact ⟨b, get?_mem (Computation.mem_map (Prod.fst.{v, v} <$> ·) td), ab⟩

name: exists_of_liftRel_right
statement:
theorem exists_of_liftRel_right {R : α → β → Prop} {s t} (H : LiftRel R s t) {b} (h : b ∈ t) :
    ∃ a, a ∈ s ∧ R a b
proof: := by rw [← LiftRel.swap] at H; exact exists_of_liftRel_left H h

name: liftRel_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftRel_nil (R : α → β → Prop) : LiftRel R nil nil

name: liftRel_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftRel_cons (R : α → β → Prop) (a b s t) :
    LiftRel R (cons a s) (cons b t) ↔ R a b ∧ LiftRel R s t

name: liftRel_think_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftRel_think_left (R : α → β → Prop) (s t) : LiftRel R (think s) t ↔ LiftRel R s t

name: liftRel_think_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftRel_think_right (R : α → β → Prop) (s t) : LiftRel R s (think t) ↔ LiftRel R s t

name: cons_congr
statement: theorem cons_congr {s t : WSeq α} (a : α) (h : s ~ʷ t) : cons a s ~ʷ cons a t
proof:
:= by
  unfold Equiv; simpa using! h

name: think_equiv
statement: theorem think_equiv (s : WSeq α) : think s ~ʷ s
proof: := by unfold Equiv; simpa using! Equiv.refl _

name: think_congr
statement: theorem think_congr {s t : WSeq α} (h : s ~ʷ t) : think s ~ʷ think t
proof:
:= by
  unfold Equiv; simpa using! h

name: head_congr
statement: theorem head_congr : ∀ {s t : WSeq α}, s ~ʷ t → head s ~ head t
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {s t : WSeq α}, s ~ʷ t → ∀ {o}, o ∈ head s → o ∈ head t from fun s t h o =>
    ⟨this h, this h.symm⟩
  intro s t h o ho
  rcases @Computation.exists_of_mem_map _ _ _ _ (destruct s) ho with ⟨ds, dsm, dse⟩
  rw [← dse]
  obtain ⟨l, r⟩ := destruct_congr h
  rcases l dsm with ⟨dt, dtm, dst⟩
  rcases ds with - | a <;> rcases dt with - | b
  · apply Computation.mem_map _ dtm
  · cases b
    cases dst
  · cases a
    cases dst
  · obtain ⟨a, s'⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨b, t'⟩ := b
    rw [dst.left]
    exact @Computation.mem_map _ _ (@Functor.map _ _ (α × WSeq α) _ Prod.fst)
      (some (b, t')) (destruct t) dtm

name: flatten_equiv
statement: theorem flatten_equiv {c : Computation (WSeq α)} {s} (h : s ∈ c) : flatten c ~ʷ s
proof:
:= by
  apply Computation.memRecOn h
  · simp [Equiv.refl]
  · intro s'
    apply Equiv.trans
    simp [think_equiv]

name: liftRel_flatten
statement:
theorem liftRel_flatten {R : α → β → Prop} {c1 : Computation (WSeq α)} {c2 : Computation (WSeq β)}
    (h : c1.LiftRel (LiftRel R) c2) : LiftRel R (flatten c1) (flatten c2)
proof:
:=
  let S s t := ∃ c1 c2, s = flatten c1 ∧ t = flatten c2 ∧ Computation.LiftRel (LiftRel R) c1 c2
  ⟨S, ⟨c1, c2, rfl, rfl, h⟩, fun {s t} h =>
    match s, t, h with
    | _, _, ⟨c1, c2, rfl, rfl, h⟩ => by
      simp only [destruct_flatten]; apply liftRel_bind _ _ h
      intro a b ab; apply Computation.LiftRel.imp _ _ _ (liftRel_destruct ab)
      intro a b; apply LiftRelO.imp_right
      intro s t h; refine ⟨Computation.pure s, Computation.pure t, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [h]⟩

name: flatten_congr
statement:
theorem flatten_congr {c1 c2 : Computation (WSeq α)} :
    Computation.LiftRel Equiv c1 c2 → flatten c1 ~ʷ flatten c2

name: tail_congr
statement: theorem tail_congr {s t : WSeq α} (h : s ~ʷ t) : tail s ~ʷ tail t
proof:
:= by
  apply flatten_congr
  dsimp only [(· <$> ·)]; rw [← Computation.bind_pure, ← Computation.bind_pure]
  apply liftRel_bind _ _ (destruct_congr h)
  intro a b h; simp only [comp_apply, liftRel_pure]
  rcases a with - | a <;> rcases b with - | b
  · trivial
  · cases h
  · cases a
    cases h
  · obtain ⟨a, s'⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨b, t'⟩ := b
    exact h.right

name: dropn_congr
statement: theorem dropn_congr {s t : WSeq α} (h : s ~ʷ t) (n) : drop s n ~ʷ drop t n
proof:
:= by
  induction n <;> simp [*, tail_congr, drop]

name: get
statement: theorem get?_congr {s t : WSeq α} (h : s ~ʷ t) (n) : get? s n ~ get? t n

name: mem_congr
statement: theorem mem_congr {s t : WSeq α} (h : s ~ʷ t) (a) : a ∈ s ↔ a ∈ t
proof:
:=
  suffices ∀ {s t : WSeq α}, s ~ʷ t → a ∈ s → a ∈ t from ⟨this h, this h.symm⟩
  fun {_ _} h as =>
  let ⟨_, hn⟩ := exists_get?_of_mem as
  get?_mem ((get?_congr h _ _).1 hn)

name: Equiv.ext
statement: theorem Equiv.ext {s t : WSeq α} (h : ∀ n, get? s n ~ get? t n) : s ~ʷ t
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun s t => ∀ n, get? s n ~ get? t n, h, fun {s t} h => by
    refine liftRel_def.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← head_terminates_iff, ← head_terminates_iff]
      exact terminates_congr (h 0)
    · intro a b ma mb
      rcases a with - | a <;> rcases b with - | b
      · trivial
      · injection mem_unique (Computation.mem_map _ ma) ((h 0 _).2 (Computation.mem_map _ mb))
      · injection mem_unique (Computation.mem_map _ ma) ((h 0 _).2 (Computation.mem_map _ mb))
      · obtain ⟨a, s'⟩ := a
        obtain ⟨b, t'⟩ := b
        injection mem_unique (Computation.mem_map _ ma) ((h 0 _).2 (Computation.mem_map _ mb)) with
          ab
        refine ⟨ab, fun n => ?_⟩
        refine
          (get?_congr (flatten_equiv (Computation.mem_map _ ma)) n).symm.trans
            ((?_ : get? (tail s) n ~ get? (tail t) n).trans
              (get?_congr (flatten_equiv (Computation.mem_map _ mb)) n))
        rw [get?_tail, get?_tail]
        apply h⟩

name: liftRel_map
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun s1 s2 => ∃ s t, s1 = map f1 s ∧ s2 = map f2 t ∧ LiftRel R s t, ⟨s1, s2, rfl, rfl, h1⟩,
    fun {s1 s2} h =>
    match s1, s2, h with
    | _, _, ⟨s, t, rfl, rfl, h⟩ => by
      simp only [exists_and_left, destruct_map]
      apply Computation.liftRel_map _ _ (liftRel_destruct h)
      intro o p h
      rcases o with - | a <;> rcases p with - | b
      · simp
      · cases b; cases h
      · cases a; cases h
      · obtain ⟨a, s⟩ := a; obtain ⟨b, t⟩ := b
        obtain ⟨r, h⟩ := h
        exact ⟨h2 r, s, rfl, t, rfl, h⟩⟩

name: map_congr
statement: theorem map_congr (f : α → β) {s t : WSeq α} (h : s ~ʷ t) : map f s ~ʷ map f t

name: liftRel_append
statement:
theorem liftRel_append (R : α → β → Prop) {s1 s2 : WSeq α} {t1 t2 : WSeq β} (h1 : LiftRel R s1 t1)
    (h2 : LiftRel R s2 t2) : LiftRel R (append s1 s2) (append t1 t2)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun s t => LiftRel R s t ∨ ∃ s1 t1, s = append s1 s2 ∧ t = append t1 t2 ∧ LiftRel R s1 t1,
    Or.inr ⟨s1, t1, rfl, rfl, h1⟩, fun {s t} h =>
    match s, t, h with
    | s, t, Or.inl h => by
      apply Computation.LiftRel.imp _ _ _ (liftRel_destruct h)
      intro a b; apply LiftRelO.imp_right
      intro s t; apply Or.inl
    | _, _, Or.inr ⟨s1, t1, rfl, rfl, h⟩ => by
      simp only [exists_and_left, destruct_append]
      apply Computation.liftRel_bind _ _ (liftRel_destruct h)
      intro o p h
      rcases o with - | a <;> rcases p with - | b
      · simp only [destruct_append.aux]
        apply Computation.LiftRel.imp _ _ _ (liftRel_destruct h2)
        intro a b
        apply LiftRelO.imp_right
        intro s t
        apply Or.inl
      · cases b; cases h
      · cases a; cases h
      · obtain ⟨a, s⟩ := a; obtain ⟨b, t⟩ := b
        obtain ⟨r, h⟩ := h
        simpa using ⟨r, Or.inr ⟨s, rfl, t, rfl, h⟩⟩⟩

name: liftRel_join.lem
statement:
theorem liftRel_join.lem (R : α → β → Prop) {S T} {U : WSeq α → WSeq β → Prop}
    (ST : LiftRel (LiftRel R) S T)
    (HU :
      ∀ s1 s2,
        (∃ s t S T,
            s1 = append s (join S) ∧
              s2 = append t (join T) ∧ LiftRel R s t ∧ LiftRel (LiftRel R) S T) →
          U s1 s2)
    {a} (ma : a ∈ destruct (join S)) : ∃ b, b ∈ destruct (join T) ∧ LiftRelO R U a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, h⟩ := exists_results_of_mem ma; clear ma; revert S T ST a
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with | _ n IH
  intro S T ST a ra; simp only [destruct_join] at ra
  exact
    let ⟨o, m, k, rs1, rs2, en⟩ := of_results_bind ra
    let ⟨p, mT, rop⟩ := Computation.exists_of_liftRel_left (liftRel_destruct ST) rs1.mem
    match o, p, rop, rs1, rs2, mT with
    | none, none, _, _, rs2, mT => by
      simp only [destruct_join]
      exact ⟨none, mem_bind mT (ret_mem _), by rw [eq_of_pure_mem rs2.mem]; trivial⟩
    | some (s, S'), some (t, T'), ⟨st, ST'⟩, _, rs2, mT => by
      simp? [destruct_append] at rs2 says simp only [destruct_join.aux, destruct_append] at rs2
      exact
        let ⟨k1, rs3, ek⟩ := of_results_think rs2
        let ⟨o', m1, n1, rs4, rs5, ek1⟩ := of_results_bind rs3
        let ⟨p', mt, rop'⟩ := Computation.exists_of_liftRel_left (liftRel_destruct st) rs4.mem
        match o', p', rop', rs4, rs5, mt with
        | none, none, _, _, rs5', mt => by
          have : n1 < n := by
            rw [en, ek, ek1]
            apply lt_of_lt_of_le _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
            apply Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
          let ⟨ob, mb, rob⟩ := IH _ this ST' rs5'
          refine ⟨ob, ?_, rob⟩
          · simp +unfoldPartialApp only [destruct_join, destruct_join.aux]
            apply mem_bind mT
            simp only [destruct_append]
            apply think_mem
            apply mem_bind mt
            exact mb
        | some (a, s'), some (b, t'), ⟨ab, st'⟩, _, rs5, mt => by
          simp only [destruct_append.aux] at rs5
          refine ⟨some (b, append t' (join T')), ?_, ?_⟩
          · simp +unfoldPartialApp only [destruct_join, destruct_join.aux]
            apply mem_bind mT
            simp only [destruct_append]
            apply think_mem
            apply mem_bind mt
            apply ret_mem
          rw [eq_of_pure_mem rs5.mem]
          exact ⟨ab, HU _ _ ⟨s', t', S', T', rfl, rfl, st', ST'⟩⟩

name: liftRel_join
statement:
theorem liftRel_join (R : α → β → Prop) {S : WSeq (WSeq α)} {T : WSeq (WSeq β)}
    (h : LiftRel (LiftRel R) S T) : LiftRel R (join S) (join T)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun s1 s2 =>
    ∃ s t S T,
      s1 = append s (join S) ∧ s2 = append t (join T) ∧ LiftRel R s t ∧ LiftRel (LiftRel R) S T,
    ⟨nil, nil, S, T, by simp, by simp, by simp, h⟩, fun {s1 s2} ⟨s, t, S, T, h1, h2, st, ST⟩ => by
    rw [h1, h2]; rw [destruct_append, destruct_append]
    apply Computation.liftRel_bind _ _ (liftRel_destruct st)
    exact fun {o p} h =>
      match o, p, h with
      | some (a, s), some (b, t), ⟨h1, h2⟩ => by
        simpa using ⟨h1, s, t, S, rfl, T, rfl, h2, ST⟩
      | none, none, _ => by
        
        dsimp only [destruct_append.aux, Computation.LiftRel]; constructor
        · intro
          apply liftRel_join.lem _ ST fun _ _ => id
        · intro b mb
          rw [← LiftRelO.swap]
          apply liftRel_join.lem (swap R)
          · rw [← LiftRel.swap R, ← LiftRel.swap]
            apply ST
          · rw [← LiftRel.swap R, ← LiftRel.swap (LiftRel R)]
            exact fun s1 s2 ⟨s, t, S, T, h1, h2, st, ST⟩ => ⟨t, s, T, S, h2, h1, st, ST⟩
          · exact mb⟩

name: join_congr
statement: theorem join_congr {S T : WSeq (WSeq α)} (h : LiftRel Equiv S T) : join S ~ʷ join T

name: liftRel_bind
bind_congr
statement:
theorem bind_congr {s1 s2 : WSeq α} {f1 f2 : α → WSeq β} (h1 : s1 ~ʷ s2) (h2 : ∀ a, f1 a ~ʷ f2 a) :
    bind s1 f1 ~ʷ bind s2 f2
proof:
:=
  liftRel_bind _ _ h1 fun {a b} h => by rw [h]; apply h2

name: join_ret
statement:
@[simp]
theorem join_ret (s : WSeq α) : join (ret s) ~ʷ s

name: join_map_ret
statement:
@[simp]
theorem join_map_ret (s : WSeq α) : join (map ret s) ~ʷ s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun s1 s2 => join (map ret s2) = s1, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro s' s h; rw [← h]
  apply liftRel_rec fun c1 c2 => ∃ s, c1 = destruct (join (map ret s)) ∧ c2 = destruct s
  · exact fun {c1 c2} h =>
      match c1, c2, h with
      | _, _, ⟨s, rfl, rfl⟩ => by
        clear h
        have (s : WSeq α) : ∃ s' : WSeq α,
            (map ret s).join.destruct = (map ret s').join.destruct ∧ destruct s = s'.destruct :=
          ⟨s, rfl, rfl⟩
        induction s using WSeq.recOn <;> simp [ret, this]
  · exact ⟨s, rfl, rfl⟩

name: join_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem join_append (S T : WSeq (WSeq α)) : join (append S T) ~ʷ append (join S) (join T)
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨fun s1 s2 =>
      ∃ s S T, s1 = append s (join (append S T)) ∧ s2 = append s (append (join S) (join T)),
      ⟨nil, S, T, by simp, by simp⟩, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 h
  apply
    liftRel_rec
      (fun c1 c2 =>
        ∃ (s : WSeq α) (S T : _),
          c1 = destruct (append s (join (append S T))) ∧
            c2 = destruct (append s (append (join S) (join T))))
      _ _ _
      (let ⟨s, S, T, h1, h2⟩ := h
      ⟨s, S, T, congr_arg destruct h1, congr_arg destruct h2⟩)
  rintro c1 c2 ⟨s, S, T, rfl, rfl⟩
  induction s using WSeq.recOn with
  | nil =>
    induction S using WSeq.recOn with
    | nil =>
      simp only [nil_append, join_nil]
      induction T using WSeq.recOn with
      | nil => simp
      | cons s T =>
        simp only [join_cons, destruct_think, Computation.destruct_think, liftRelAux_inr_inr]
        refine ⟨s, nil, T, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp
      | think T =>
        simp only [join_think, destruct_think, Computation.destruct_think, liftRelAux_inr_inr]
        refine ⟨nil, nil, T, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp
    | cons s S => simpa using ⟨s, S, T, rfl, rfl⟩
    | think S => refine ⟨nil, S, T, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp
  | cons a s => simpa using ⟨s, S, T, rfl, rfl⟩
  | think s => simpa using ⟨s, S, T, rfl, rfl⟩

name: bind_ret
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bind_ret (f : α → β) (s) : bind s (ret ∘ f) ~ʷ map f s

name: ret_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ret_bind (a : α) (f : α → WSeq β) : bind (ret a) f ~ʷ f a

name: join_join
statement:
@[simp]
theorem join_join (SS : WSeq (WSeq (WSeq α))) : join (join SS) ~ʷ join (map join SS)
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨fun s1 s2 =>
      ∃ s S SS,
        s1 = append s (join (append S (join SS))) ∧
          s2 = append s (append (join S) (join (map join SS))),
      ⟨nil, nil, SS, by simp, by simp⟩, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 h
  apply
    liftRel_rec
      (fun c1 c2 =>
        ∃ s S SS,
          c1 = destruct (append s (join (append S (join SS)))) ∧
            c2 = destruct (append s (append (join S) (join (map join SS)))))
      _ (destruct s1) (destruct s2)
      (let ⟨s, S, SS, h1, h2⟩ := h
      ⟨s, S, SS, by simp [h1], by simp [h2]⟩)
  intro c1 c2 h
  exact
    match c1, c2, h with
    | _, _, ⟨s, S, SS, rfl, rfl⟩ => by
      clear h
      induction s using WSeq.recOn with
      | nil =>
        induction S using WSeq.recOn with
        | nil =>
          simp only [nil_append, join_nil]
          induction SS using WSeq.recOn with
          | nil => simp
          | cons S SS => refine ⟨nil, S, SS, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp
          | think SS => refine ⟨nil, nil, SS, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp
        | cons s S => simpa using ⟨s, S, SS, rfl, rfl⟩
        | think S => refine ⟨nil, S, SS, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp
      | cons a s => simpa using ⟨s, S, SS, rfl, rfl⟩
      | think s => simpa using ⟨s, S, SS, rfl, rfl⟩

name: bind_assoc_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bind_assoc_comp (s : WSeq α) (f : α → WSeq β) (g : β → WSeq γ) :
    bind (bind s f) g ~ʷ bind s ((fun y : WSeq β => bind y g) ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bind, map_join]
  rw [← map_comp f (map g), ← Function.comp_def, comp_assoc, map_comp (map g ∘ f) join s]
  exact join_join (map (map g ∘ f) s)

name: bind_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bind_assoc (s : WSeq α) (f : α → WSeq β) (g : β → WSeq γ) :
    bind (bind s f) g ~ʷ bind s fun x : α => bind (f x) g
proof:
:= by
  exact bind_assoc_comp s f g

name: length_eq_map
statement: theorem length_eq_map (s : WSeq α) : length s = Computation.map List.length (toList s)
proof:
:= by
  refine
    Computation.eq_of_bisim
      (fun c1 c2 =>
        ∃ (l : List α) (s : WSeq α),
          c1 = Computation.corec (fun ⟨n, s⟩ =>
            match Seq.destruct s with
            | none => Sum.inl n
            | some (none, s') => Sum.inr (n, s')
            | some (some _, s') => Sum.inr (n + 1, s')) (l.length, s) ∧
            c2 = Computation.map List.length (Computation.corec (fun ⟨l, s⟩ =>
              match Seq.destruct s with
              | none => Sum.inl l.reverse
              | some (none, s') => Sum.inr (l, s')
              | some (some a, s') => Sum.inr (a::l, s')) (l, s)))
      ?_ ⟨[], s, rfl, rfl⟩
  intro s1 s2 h; rcases h with ⟨l, s, h⟩; rw [h.left, h.right]
  induction s using WSeq.recOn with
  | nil => simp [nil]
  | cons a s => simpa using ⟨a::l, s, by simp, by simp⟩
  | think s => simpa using ⟨l, s, by simp, by simp⟩

name: productive_iff
statement: theorem productive_iff (s : WSeq α) : Productive s ↔ ∀ n, (get? s n).Terminates

name: productive_congr
statement: theorem productive_congr {s t : WSeq α} (h : s ~ʷ t) : Productive s ↔ Productive t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [productive_iff]; exact forall_congr' fun n => terminates_congr <| get?_congr h _

name: toSeq_ofSeq
statement: theorem toSeq_ofSeq (s : Seq α) : toSeq (ofSeq s) = s
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext; funext n
  dsimp [toSeq]; apply get_eq_of_mem
  rw [get?_ofSeq]; apply ret_mem

name: quotientSpanNatEquivZMod_comp_Quotient_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientSpanNatEquivZMod_comp_Quotient_mk (n : ℕ) :
    (Int.quotientSpanNatEquivZMod n : _ →+* _).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(n : ℤ)})) =
      Int.castRingHom (ZMod n)

name: quotientSpanEquivZMod_comp_Quotient_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientSpanEquivZMod_comp_Quotient_mk (n : ℤ) :
    (Int.quotientSpanEquivZMod n : _ →+* _).comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(n : ℤ)})) =

name: quotientSpanEquivZMod_comp_castRingHom

@[simp]
theorem quotientSpanEquivZMod_comp_castRingHom (n : ℤ) :

name: ZMod.prodEquivPi_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ZMod.prodEquivPi_apply {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a : ι → ℕ)
    (coprime : Pairwise (Nat.Coprime on a)) (b : ZMod (∏ i, a i)) (i : ι) :
    prodEquivPi a coprime b i = castHom (dvd_prod_of_mem a (mem_univ i)) _ b
proof:
:=
  RingHom.congr_fun (Subsingleton.elim ((Pi.evalRingHom (fun _ ↦ ZMod _) i).comp
    (prodEquivPi a coprime).toRingHom) _) b

name: ZMod.smul_units_def
statement:
lemma ZMod.smul_units_def (z : ZMod 2) (au : Additive ℤˣ) :
    z • au = z.val • au

name: ZMod.natCast_smul_units
statement: lemma ZMod.natCast_smul_units (n : ℕ) (au : Additive ℤˣ) : (n : ZMod 2) • au = n • au

name: ofMul_uzpow
statement: @[simp] lemma ofMul_uzpow (u : ℤˣ) (r : R) : Additive.ofMul (u ^ r) = r • Additive.ofMul u

name: toMul_uzpow
statement: @[simp] lemma toMul_uzpow (u : Additive ℤˣ) (r : R) : (r • u).toMul = u.toMul ^ r

name: uzpow_natCast
statement: @[norm_cast] lemma uzpow_natCast (u : ℤˣ) (n : ℕ) : u ^ (n : R) = u ^ n
proof:
:= by
  change ((n : R) • Additive.ofMul u).toMul = _
  rw [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul, toMul_nsmul, toMul_ofMul]

name: uzpow_coe_nat
statement:
lemma uzpow_coe_nat (s : ℤˣ) (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] :
    s ^ (ofNat(n) : R) = s ^ (ofNat(n) : ℕ)

name: one_uzpow
statement: @[simp] lemma one_uzpow (x : R) : (1 : ℤˣ) ^ x = 1

name: mul_uzpow
statement: lemma mul_uzpow (s₁ s₂ : ℤˣ) (x : R) : (s₁ * s₂) ^ x = s₁ ^ x * s₂ ^ x

name: uzpow_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma uzpow_zero (s : ℤˣ) : (s ^ (0 : R) : ℤˣ) = (1 : ℤˣ)

name: uzpow_one
statement: @[simp] lemma uzpow_one (s : ℤˣ) : (s ^ (1 : R) : ℤˣ) = s

name: uzpow_mul
statement: lemma uzpow_mul (s : ℤˣ) (x y : R) : s ^ (x * y) = (s ^ x) ^ y
proof:
:=
  Additive.ofMul.injective <| mul_comm x y ▸ mul_smul y x (Additive.ofMul s)

name: uzpow_add
statement: lemma uzpow_add (s : ℤˣ) (x y : R) : s ^ (x + y) = s ^ x * s ^ y

name: uzpow_sub
statement: lemma uzpow_sub (s : ℤˣ) (x y : R) : s ^ (x - y) = s ^ x / s ^ y

name: uzpow_neg
statement: lemma uzpow_neg (s : ℤˣ) (x : R) : s ^ (-x) = (s ^ x)⁻¹

name: uzpow_intCast
statement: @[norm_cast] lemma uzpow_intCast (u : ℤˣ) (z : ℤ) : u ^ (z : R) = u ^ z
proof:
:= by
  change ((z : R) • Additive.ofMul u).toMul = _
  rw [Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, toMul_zsmul, toMul_ofMul]

name: valMinAbs_def_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma valMinAbs_def_zero (x : ZMod 0) : valMinAbs x = x

name: valMinAbs_def_pos
statement:
lemma valMinAbs_def_pos : ∀ {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (x : ZMod n),
    valMinAbs x = if x.val ≤ n / 2 then (x.val : ℤ) else x.val - n
  | 0, _, x => by cases NeZero.ne 0 rfl
  | n + 1, _, x => rfl

@[simp, norm_cast]

name: coe_valMinAbs
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma coe_valMinAbs : ∀ {n : ℕ} (x : ZMod n), (x.valMinAbs : ZMod n) = x
  | 0, _ => Int.cast_id
  | k@(n + 1), x => by
    rw [valMinAbs_def_pos]
    split_ifs
    · rw [Int.cast_natCast, natCast_zmod_val]
    · rw [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_natCast, natCast_zmod_val, Int.cast_natCast, natCast_self,
        sub_zero]

name: injective_valMinAbs
statement: lemma injective_valMinAbs : (valMinAbs : ZMod n → ℤ).Injective

name: valMinAbs_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem valMinAbs_inj : a.valMinAbs = b.valMinAbs ↔ a = b

name: valMinAbs_nonneg_iff
statement: lemma valMinAbs_nonneg_iff [NeZero n] (x : ZMod n) : 0 ≤ x.valMinAbs ↔ x.val ≤ n / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [valMinAbs_def_pos]; split_ifs with h
  · exact iff_of_true (Nat.cast_nonneg _) h
  · exact iff_of_false (sub_lt_zero.2 <| Int.ofNat_lt.2 x.val_lt).not_ge h

name: valMinAbs_mul_two_eq_iff
statement: lemma valMinAbs_mul_two_eq_iff (a : ZMod n) : a.valMinAbs * 2 = n ↔ 2 * a.val = n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with - | n
  · simp
  by_cases h : a.val ≤ n.succ / 2
  · dsimp [valMinAbs]
    rw [ite_eq_left h, ← Int.natCast_inj, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_two, mul_comm, Int.natCast_add,
      Nat.cast_one]
  apply iff_of_false _ (mt _ h)
  · intro he
    rw [← a.valMinAbs_nonneg_iff, ← mul_nonneg_iff_left_nonneg_of_pos, he] at h
    exacts [h (Nat.cast_nonneg _), zero_lt_two]
  · rw [mul_comm]
    exact fun h => (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le zero_lt_two).2 h.le

name: valMinAbs_mem_Ioc
statement: lemma valMinAbs_mem_Ioc [NeZero n] (x : ZMod n) : x.valMinAbs * 2 ∈ Set.Ioc (-n : ℤ) n
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [valMinAbs_def_pos, Nat.le_div_two_iff_mul_two_le]; split_ifs with h
  · exact ⟨(neg_lt_zero.2 <| mod_cast NeZero.pos n).trans_le (by positivity), h⟩
  · refine ⟨?_, le_trans (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg ?_ zero_le_two) <| Nat.cast_nonneg _⟩
    · linarith only [h]
    · grind

name: valMinAbs_spec
statement:
lemma valMinAbs_spec [NeZero n] (x : ZMod n) (y : ℤ) :
    x.valMinAbs = y ↔ x = y ∧ y * 2 ∈ Set.Ioc (-n : ℤ) n where
  mp
proof:
:= by rintro rfl; exact ⟨x.coe_valMinAbs.symm, x.valMinAbs_mem_Ioc⟩
  mpr h := by
    rw [← sub_eq_zero]
    apply @Int.eq_zero_of_abs_lt_dvd n
    · rw [← intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd, Int.cast_sub, coe_valMinAbs, h.1, sub_self]
    rw [← mul_lt_mul_iff_left₀ (@zero_lt_two ℤ _ _ _ _ _)]
    nth_rw 1 [← abs_eq_self.2 (@zero_le_two ℤ _ _ _ _)]
    rw [← abs_mul, sub_mul, abs_lt]
    constructor <;> linarith only [x.valMinAbs_mem_Ioc.1, x.valMinAbs_mem_Ioc.2, h.2.1, h.2.2]

name: natAbs_valMinAbs_le
statement: lemma natAbs_valMinAbs_le [NeZero n] (x : ZMod n) : x.valMinAbs.natAbs ≤ n / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.le_div_two_iff_mul_two_le]
  rcases x.valMinAbs.natAbs_eq with h | h
  · rw [← h]
    exact x.valMinAbs_mem_Ioc.2
  · rw [← neg_le_neg_iff, ← neg_mul, ← h]
    exact x.valMinAbs_mem_Ioc.1.le

name: eq_neg_of_valMinAbs_eq_neg_valMinAbs
statement: theorem eq_neg_of_valMinAbs_eq_neg_valMinAbs (h : a.valMinAbs = -b.valMinAbs) : a = -b
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_zero_or_neZero n with rfl | hn <;> simp_all [valMinAbs_spec]

name: valMinAbs_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma valMinAbs_zero : ∀ n, (0 : ZMod n).valMinAbs = 0
  | 0 => by simp only [valMinAbs_def_zero]
  | n + 1 => by simp only [valMinAbs_def_pos, ite_true, Int.ofNat_zero, zero_le, val_zero]

@[simp]

name: valMinAbs_eq_zero

@[simp]
lemma valMinAbs_eq_zero (x : ZMod n) : x.valMinAbs = 0 ↔ x = 0

name: natCast_natAbs_valMinAbs
statement:
lemma natCast_natAbs_valMinAbs [NeZero n] (a : ZMod n) :
    (a.valMinAbs.natAbs : ZMod n) = if a.val ≤ (n : ℕ) / 2 then a else -a
proof:
:= by
  have : (a.val : ℤ) - n ≤ 0 := by
    rw [sub_nonpos, Int.ofNat_le]
    exact a.val_le
  rw [valMinAbs_def_pos]
  split_ifs
  · rw [Int.natAbs_natCast, natCast_zmod_val]
  · rw [← Int.cast_natCast, Int.ofNat_natAbs_of_nonpos this, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_sub,
      Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_natCast, natCast_self, sub_zero, natCast_zmod_val]

name: valMinAbs_neg_of_ne_half
statement: lemma valMinAbs_neg_of_ne_half (ha : 2 * a.val ≠ n) : (-a).valMinAbs = -a.valMinAbs
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_zero_or_neZero n with rfl | h
  · rfl
  refine (valMinAbs_spec _ _).2 ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Int.cast_neg, coe_valMinAbs]
  · rw [neg_mul, neg_lt_neg_iff]
    exact a.valMinAbs_mem_Ioc.2.lt_of_ne (mt a.valMinAbs_mul_two_eq_iff.1 ha)
  · linarith only [a.valMinAbs_mem_Ioc.1]

name: natAbs_valMinAbs_neg
statement:
@[simp]
lemma natAbs_valMinAbs_neg (a : ZMod n) : (-a).valMinAbs.natAbs = a.valMinAbs.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h2a : 2 * a.val = n
  · rw [a.neg_eq_self_iff.2 (Or.inr h2a)]
  · rw [valMinAbs_neg_of_ne_half h2a, Int.natAbs_neg]

name: natAbs_valMinAbs_eq_natAbs_valMinAbs
statement:
theorem natAbs_valMinAbs_eq_natAbs_valMinAbs :
    a.valMinAbs.natAbs = b.valMinAbs.natAbs ↔ a = b ∨ a = -b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [Int.natAbs_eq_natAbs_iff, valMinAbs_inj]
    exact Or.imp_right eq_neg_of_valMinAbs_eq_neg_valMinAbs
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · rfl
    · rw [natAbs_valMinAbs_neg]

name: abs_valMinAbs_eq_abs_valMinAbs
statement:
theorem abs_valMinAbs_eq_abs_valMinAbs :
    |a.valMinAbs| = |b.valMinAbs| ↔ a = b ∨ a = -b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← natAbs_valMinAbs_eq_natAbs_valMinAbs, Int.abs_eq_natAbs, Int.abs_eq_natAbs]
  norm_cast

lemma prime_ne_zero (p q : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] [hq : Fact q.Prime] (hpq : p ≠ q) :

proof:

  rwa [← Nat.cast_zero, Ne, natCast_eq_natCast_iff, Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd,
    ← hp.1.coprime_iff_not_dvd, Nat.coprime_primes hp.1 hq.1]

statement: lemma valMinAbs_natCast_of_le_half (ha : a ≤ n / 2) : (a : ZMod n).valMinAbs = a
proof:

  cases n
  · simp
  · simp [valMinAbs_def_pos, val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (ha.trans_lt <| Nat.div_lt_self' _ 0),
      ha]

lemma valMinAbs_natCast_of_half_lt (ha : n / 2 < a) (ha' : a < n) :

proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · cases not_lt_bot ha'
  · simp [valMinAbs_def_pos, val_natCast, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ha', ha.not_ge]

name: valMinAbs_natCast_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma valMinAbs_natCast_eq_self [NeZero n] : (a : ZMod n).valMinAbs = a ↔ a ≤ n / 2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ha => ?_, valMinAbs_natCast_of_le_half⟩
  rw [← Int.natAbs_natCast a, ← ha]
  exact natAbs_valMinAbs_le (n := n) a

name: natAbs_valMinAbs_add_le
statement:
lemma natAbs_valMinAbs_add_le (a b : ZMod n) :
    (a + b).valMinAbs.natAbs ≤ (a.valMinAbs + b.valMinAbs).natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with - | n
  · rfl
  apply natAbs_min_of_le_div_two n.succ
  · simp_rw [Int.cast_add, coe_valMinAbs]
  · apply natAbs_valMinAbs_le

name: cast_add_eq_ite
statement:
theorem cast_add_eq_ite {n : ℕ} (a b : ZMod n) :
    (cast (a + b) : ℤ) =
      if (n : ℤ) ≤ cast a + cast b then (cast a + cast b - n : ℤ) else cast a + cast b
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with - | n
  · simp; rfl
  change Fin (n + 1) at a b
  change ((((a + b) : Fin (n + 1)) : ℕ) : ℤ) = if ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (a : ℕ) + b then _ else _
  simp only [Fin.val_add_eq_ite, Int.natCast_succ]
  norm_cast
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Nat.cast_sub h]
    congr
  · rfl

name: castHom_bijective
statement:
theorem castHom_bijective [Fintype R] (h : Fintype.card R = n) :
    Function.Bijective (ZMod.castHom (dvd_refl n) R)
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero n :=
    ⟨by
      intro hn
      rw [hn] at h
      exact (Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp h).elim' 0⟩
  rw [Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card, ZMod.card, h, eq_self_iff_true, and_true]
  apply ZMod.castHom_injective

lemma ringEquivOfPrime_eq_ringEquiv [Fintype R] {p : ℕ} [CharP R p] (hp : p.Prime)

@[simp]
theorem val_eq_zero : ∀ {n : ℕ} (a : ZMod n), a.val = 0 ↔ a = 0

name: val_intCast
statement: theorem val_intCast {n : ℕ} (a : ℤ) [NeZero n] : ↑(a : ZMod n).val = a % n
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (0 : ℤ) ≤ ↑(a : ZMod n).val := Int.natCast_nonneg _
  have hlt : ↑(a : ZMod n).val < (n : ℤ) := Int.ofNat_lt.mpr (ZMod.val_lt a)
  refine (Int.emod_eq_of_lt hle hlt).symm.trans ?_
  rw [← ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff', Int.cast_natCast, ZMod.natCast_val, ZMod.cast_id]

name: natCast_eq_natCast_iff
statement: theorem natCast_eq_natCast_iff (a b c : ℕ) : (a : ZMod c) = (b : ZMod c) ↔ a ≡ b [MOD c]
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Int.natCast_modEq_iff] using ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff a b c

statement: theorem natCast_eq_natCast_iff' (a b c : ℕ) : (a : ZMod c) = (b : ZMod c) ↔ a % c = b % c

name: val_neg_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem val_neg_one (n : ℕ) : (-1 : ZMod n.succ).val = n
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [val, Fin.val_neg']
  cases n
  · simp
  · dsimp [ZMod, ZMod.cast]
    rw [Fin.coe_neg_one]

name: cast_neg_one
statement: theorem cast_neg_one {R : Type*} [Ring R] (n : ℕ) : cast (-1 : ZMod n) = (n - 1 : R)
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with - | n
  · dsimp [ZMod, ZMod.cast]; simp
  · rw [← natCast_val, val_neg_one, Nat.cast_succ, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: cast_sub_one
statement:
theorem cast_sub_one {R : Type*} [Ring R] {n : ℕ} (k : ZMod n) :
    (cast (k - 1 : ZMod n) : R) = (if k = 0 then (n : R) else cast k) - 1
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hk
  · rw [hk, zero_sub, ZMod.cast_neg_one]
  · cases n
    · dsimp [ZMod, ZMod.cast]
      rw [Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_one]
    · dsimp [ZMod, ZMod.cast, ZMod.val]
      rw [Fin.coe_sub_one, ite_eq_right]
      · rw [Nat.cast_sub, Nat.cast_one]
        rwa [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero, ← Ne, ← Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero] at hk
      · exact hk

name: natCast_eq_iff
statement:
theorem natCast_eq_iff (p : ℕ) (n : ℕ) (z : ZMod p) [NeZero p] :
    ↑n = z ↔ ∃ k, n = z.val + p * k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    refine ⟨n / p, ?_⟩
    rw [val_natCast, Nat.mod_add_div]
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [Nat.cast_add, natCast_zmod_val, Nat.cast_mul, natCast_self, zero_mul,
      add_zero]

name: intCast_eq_iff
statement:
theorem intCast_eq_iff (p : ℕ) (n : ℤ) (z : ZMod p) [NeZero p] :
    ↑n = z ↔ ∃ k, n = z.val + p * k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    refine ⟨n / p, ?_⟩
    rw [val_intCast, Int.emod_add_mul_ediv]
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_natCast, natCast_val,
      ZMod.natCast_self, zero_mul, add_zero, cast_id]

@[push_cast, simp]
theorem intCast_mod (a : ℤ) (b : ℕ) : ((a % b : ℤ) : ZMod b) = (a : ZMod b)

name: ker_intCastAddHom

theorem ker_intCastAddHom (n : ℕ) :

name: cast_injective_of_le
statement:
theorem cast_injective_of_le {m n : ℕ} [nzm : NeZero m] (h : m ≤ n) :
    Function.Injective (@cast (ZMod n) _ m)
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | zero => cases nzm; simp_all
  | succ m =>
    rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ f
    simp only [cast, val, natCast_eq_natCast_iff',
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (hx.trans_le h), Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (hy.trans_le h)] at f
    apply Fin.ext
    exact f

name: cast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_of_le

theorem cast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_of_le {m n : ℕ} [NeZero m] (h : m ≤ n) (a : ZMod m) :
    (cast a : ZMod n) = 0 ↔ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ZMod.cast_zero (n := m)]
  exact Injective.eq_iff' (cast_injective_of_le h) rfl

theorem natCast_toNat (p : ℕ) : ∀ {z : ℤ} (_h : 0 ≤ z), (z.toNat : ZMod p) = z

name: val_add_of_lt

theorem val_add_of_lt {n : ℕ} {a b : ZMod n} (h : a.val + b.val < n) :

proof:
:= by

statement:
theorem val_add_val_of_le {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {a b : ZMod n} (h : n ≤ a.val + b.val) :
    a.val + b.val = (a + b).val + n
proof:
:= by
  rw [val_add, Nat.add_mod_add_of_le_add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (val_lt _),
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (val_lt _)]
  rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (val_lt _), Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (val_lt _)]

statement:
theorem val_add_of_le {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {a b : ZMod n} (h : n ≤ a.val + b.val) :

proof:
:= by

name: val_add_le
statement: theorem val_add_le {n : ℕ} (a b : ZMod n) : (a + b).val ≤ a.val + b.val
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · simpa [ZMod.val] using! Int.natAbs_add_le _ _

    apply Int.natAbs_mul

name: val_mul_le

theorem val_mul_of_lt {n : ℕ} {a b : ZMod n} (h : a.val * b.val < n) :

statement:
theorem val_mul_iff_lt {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (a b : ZMod n) :

  constructor <;> intro h

  · apply ZMod.val_mul_of_lt h

name: one_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma one_eq_zero_iff {n : ℕ} : (1 : ZMod n) = 0 ↔ n = 1

name: inv_zero
statement:
theorem inv_zero : ∀ n : ℕ, (0 : ZMod n)⁻¹ = 0
  | 0 => Int.sign_zero
  | n + 1 =>
    show (Nat.gcdA _ (n + 1) : ZMod (n + 1)) = 0 by
      simp [Nat.gcdA, Nat.xgcd, Nat.xgcdAux, Nat.strongRec_eq]

name: mul_inv_eq_gcd
statement: theorem mul_inv_eq_gcd {n : ℕ} (a : ZMod n) : a * a⁻¹ = Nat.gcd a.val n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with - | n
  · dsimp [ZMod] at a ⊢
    calc
      _ = a * Int.sign a := rfl
      _ = a.natAbs := by rw [Int.mul_sign_self]
      _ = a.natAbs.gcd 0 := by rw [Nat.gcd_zero_right]
  · calc
      a * a⁻¹ = a * a⁻¹ + n.succ * Nat.gcdB (val a) n.succ := by
        rw [natCast_self, zero_mul, add_zero]
      _ = ↑(↑a.val * Nat.gcdA (val a) n.succ + n.succ * Nat.gcdB (val a) n.succ) := by
        push_cast
        rw [natCast_zmod_val]
        rfl
      _ = Nat.gcd a.val n.succ := by rw [← Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab a.val n.succ]; rfl

name: inv_one
statement: @[simp] protected lemma inv_one (n : ℕ) : (1⁻¹ : ZMod n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 1
  · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  · simpa [ZMod.val_one'' hn] using mul_inv_eq_gcd (1 : ZMod n)

statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem natCast_mod (a : ℕ) (n : ℕ) : ((a % n : ℕ) : ZMod n) = a

theorem coe_mul_inv_eq_one {n : ℕ} (x : ℕ) (h : Nat.Coprime x n) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.Coprime, Nat.gcd_comm, Nat.gcd_rec] at h
  rw [mul_inv_eq_gcd, val_natCast, h, Nat.cast_one]

name: mul_val_inv
statement: lemma mul_val_inv (hmn : m.Coprime n) : (m * (m⁻¹ : ZMod n).val : ZMod n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0
  · simp [m.coprime_zero_right.1 hmn]
  have : NeZero n := ⟨hn⟩
  rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_val, ZMod.coe_mul_inv_eq_one _ hmn]

name: coe_unitOfCoprime
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_unitOfCoprime {n : ℕ} (x : ℕ) (h : Nat.Coprime x n) :
    (unitOfCoprime x h : ZMod n) = x

name: val_coe_unit_coprime
statement: theorem val_coe_unit_coprime {n : ℕ} (u : (ZMod n)ˣ) : Nat.Coprime (u : ZMod n).val n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with - | n
  · rcases Int.units_eq_one_or u with (rfl | rfl) <;> simp
  apply Nat.coprime_of_mul_modEq_one ((u⁻¹ : Units (ZMod (n + 1))) : ZMod (n + 1)).val
  have := Units.ext_iff.1 (mul_inv_cancel u)
  rw [Units.val_one] at this
  rw [← natCast_eq_natCast_iff, Nat.cast_one, ← this]; clear this
  rw [← natCast_zmod_val ((u * u⁻¹ : Units (ZMod (n + 1))) : ZMod (n + 1))]
  rw [Units.val_mul, val_mul, natCast_mod]

name: isUnit_iff_coprime
statement: lemma isUnit_iff_coprime (m n : ℕ) : IsUnit (m : ZMod n) ↔ m.Coprime n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, fun H ↦ (unitOfCoprime m H).isUnit⟩
  have H' := val_coe_unit_coprime H.unit
  rw [IsUnit.unit_spec, val_natCast, Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one] at H'
  rw [Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one, Nat.gcd_comm, ← H']
  exact Nat.gcd_rec n m

statement:
@[simp]
lemma coprime_mod_iff_coprime (m n : ℕ) : (m % n).Coprime n ↔ m.Coprime n
proof:
:= by
  suffices (m % n).gcd n = m.gcd n by grind
  exact Nat.ModEq.gcd_eq (by simp [Nat.ModEq])

theorem prime_natCast_not_isUnit_pow {p d : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hd : 0 < d) :

name: inv_coe_unit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_coe_unit {n : ℕ} (u : (ZMod n)ˣ) : (u : ZMod n)⁻¹ = (u⁻¹ : (ZMod n)ˣ)
proof:
:= by
  have := congr_arg ((↑) : ℕ → ZMod n) (val_coe_unit_coprime u)
  rw [← mul_inv_eq_gcd, Nat.cast_one] at this
  exact (Units.inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right this).symm

name: mul_inv_of_unit
statement: theorem mul_inv_of_unit {n : ℕ} (a : ZMod n) (h : IsUnit a) : a * a⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨u, rfl⟩
  rw [inv_coe_unit, u.mul_inv]

name: inv_mul_of_unit
statement: theorem inv_mul_of_unit {n : ℕ} (a : ZMod n) (h : IsUnit a) : a⁻¹ * a = 1

name: inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one
statement: protected theorem inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one (n : ℕ) (a b : ZMod n) (h : a * b = 1) : a⁻¹ = b
proof:
:=
  left_inv_eq_right_inv (inv_mul_of_unit a ⟨⟨a, b, h, mul_comm a b ▸ h⟩, rfl⟩) h
