    Finset.powerset s = (range (s.card + 1)).biUnion fun i => powersetCard i s
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [disjiUnion_eq_biUnion] using powerset_card_disjiUnion s

name: powersetCard_sup
statement:
theorem powersetCard_sup [DecidableEq α] (u : Finset α) (n : ℕ) (hn : n < u.card) :
    (powersetCard n.succ u).sup id = u
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simp_rw [Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_powersetCard]
    rintro x ⟨h, -⟩
    exact h
  · rw [sup_eq_biUnion, subset_iff]
    intro x hx
    simp only [mem_biUnion, id]
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, t ∈ powersetCard n (u.erase x) := powersetCard_nonempty.2
      (le_trans (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hn) pred_card_le_card_erase)
    refine ⟨insert x t, ?_, mem_insert_self _ _⟩
    rw [← insert_erase hx, powersetCard_succ_insert (notMem_erase _ _)]
    exact mem_union_right _ (mem_image_of_mem _ ht)

name: powersetCard_biUnion
statement:
lemma powersetCard_biUnion [DecidableEq α] {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≠ 0) (hrs : r ≤ #s) :
    (s.powersetCard r).biUnion id = s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hr
  rw [← sup_eq_biUnion]
  exact powersetCard_sup _ _ hrs

name: eq_of_powersetCard_eq
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa [powersetCard_biUnion hr₀, ← hab, hra] using congr(($h).biUnion id)

name: powersetCard_injOn
powersetCard_map
statement:
theorem powersetCard_map {β : Type*} (f : α ↪ β) (n : ℕ) (s : Finset α) :
    powersetCard n (s.map f) = (powersetCard n s).map (mapEmbedding f).toEmbedding
proof:
:=
  ext fun t => by
    simp only [mem_powersetCard, mem_map]
    constructor
    · classical
      intro h
      have : map f (filter (fun x => (f x ∈ t)) s) = t := by grind
      refine ⟨_, ?_, this⟩
      rw [← card_map f, this, h.2]; simp
    · rintro ⟨a, ⟨has, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      simp [has]

statement:
theorem mem_finsupp_iff {t : ι → Finset α} :
    f ∈ s.finsupp t ↔ f.support ⊆ s ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, f i ∈ t i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine mem_map.trans ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨support_indicator_subset _ _, fun i hi => ?_⟩
    convert! mem_pi.1 hf i hi
    exact indicator_of_mem hi _
  · refine fun h => ⟨fun i _ => f i, mem_pi.2 h.2, ?_⟩
    ext i
    exact ite_eq_left_iff.2 fun hi => (notMem_support_iff.1 fun H => hi <| h.1 H).symm

    f ∈ s.finsupp t ↔ ∀ i, f i ∈ t i
proof:
:= by
  refine
    mem_finsupp_iff.trans
      (forall_and.symm.trans <|
        forall_congr' fun i =>
          ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h =>
            ⟨fun hi => ht <| mem_support_iff.2 fun H => mem_support_iff.1 hi ?_, fun _ => h⟩⟩)
  · by_cases hi : i ∈ s
    · exact h.2 hi
    · rw [notMem_support_iff.1 (mt h.1 hi), notMem_support_iff.1 fun H => hi <| ht H]
      exact zero_mem_zero
  · rwa [H, mem_zero] at h

name: fold_op_distrib
statement:
theorem fold_op_distrib {f g : α → β} {b₁ b₂ : β} :

name: fold_const
statement:
theorem fold_const [hd : Decidable (s = ∅)] (c : β) (h : op c (op b c) = op b c) :
    Finset.fold op b (fun _ => c) s = if s = ∅ then b else op b c
proof:
:= by
  classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on generalizing hd with
    | empty => simp
    | insert x s hx IH =>
      simp only [Finset.fold_insert hx, IH, ite_false, Finset.insert_ne_empty]
      split_ifs
      · rw [hc.comm]
      · exact h

name: fold_hom
proof:
:= by

statement:
theorem fold_union_inter [DecidableEq α] {s₁ s₂ : Finset α} {b₁ b₂ : β} :

proof:
:= by
  unfold fold
  rw [← fold_add op, ← Multiset.map_add, union_val, inter_val, union_add_inter, Multiset.map_add,
    hc.comm, fold_add]

name: fold_insert_idem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fold_insert_idem [DecidableEq α] [hi : Std.IdempotentOp op] :
    (insert a s).fold op b f = f a * s.fold op b f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a ∈ s
  · rw [← insert_erase h]
    simp [-insert_erase_eq_insert, ← ha.assoc, hi.idempotent]
  · apply fold_insert h

name: fold_image_idem
statement:
theorem fold_image_idem [DecidableEq α] {g : γ → α} {s : Finset γ} [hi : Std.IdempotentOp op] :
    (image g s).fold op b f = s.fold op b (f ∘ g)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => rw [fold_empty, image_empty, fold_empty]
  | cons x xs hx ih =>
    have := Classical.decEq γ
    rw [fold_cons, cons_eq_insert, image_insert, fold_insert_idem, ih]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]

name: fold_ite'
statement:
theorem fold_ite' {g : α → β} (hb : op b b = b) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    Finset.fold op b (fun i => ite (p i) (f i) (g i)) s =
      op (Finset.fold op b f (s.filter p)) (Finset.fold op b g (s.filter fun i => ¬p i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp [hb]
    | insert x s hx IH =>
      simp only [Finset.fold_insert hx]
      split_ifs with h
      · have : x ∉ Finset.filter p s := by simp [hx]
        simp [Finset.filter_insert, h, Finset.fold_insert this, ha.assoc, IH]
      · have : x ∉ Finset.filter (fun i => ¬ p i) s := by simp [hx]
        simp [Finset.filter_insert, h, Finset.fold_insert this, IH, ← ha.assoc, hc.comm]

name: fold_ite
statement:
theorem fold_ite [Std.IdempotentOp op] {g : α → β} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    Finset.fold op b (fun i => ite (p i) (f i) (g i)) s =
      op (Finset.fold op b f (s.filter p)) (Finset.fold op b g (s.filter fun i => ¬p i))

name: fold_op_rel_iff_and
statement:
theorem fold_op_rel_iff_and {r : β → β → Prop} (hr : ∀ {x y z}, r x (op y z) ↔ r x y ∧ r x z)
    {c : β} : r c (s.fold op b f) ↔ r c b ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, r c (f x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | insert a s ha IH =>
      rw [Finset.fold_insert ha, hr, IH, ← and_assoc, @and_comm (r c (f a)), and_assoc]
      simp

name: fold_op_rel_iff_or
statement:
theorem fold_op_rel_iff_or {r : β → β → Prop} (hr : ∀ {x y z}, r x (op y z) ↔ r x y ∨ r x z)
    {c : β} : r c (s.fold op b f) ↔ r c b ∨ ∃ x ∈ s, r c (f x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | insert a s ha IH =>
      rw [Finset.fold_insert ha, hr, IH, ← or_assoc, @or_comm (r c (f a)), or_assoc]
      simp

name: IsPWO.mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsPWO.mul [CommMonoid α] [PartialOrder α] [IsOrderedCancelMonoid α]
    (hs : s.IsPWO) (ht : t.IsPWO) : IsPWO (s * t)
proof:
:= by

name: IsWF.mul

theorem IsWF.mul (hs : s.IsWF) (ht : t.IsWF) : IsWF (s * t)

name: IsWF.min_mul
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem IsWF.min_mul (hs : s.IsWF) (ht : t.IsWF) (hsn : s.Nonempty) (htn : t.Nonempty) :
    (hs.mul ht).min (hsn.mul htn) = hs.min hsn * ht.min htn
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (IsWF.min_le _ _ (mem_mul.2 ⟨_, hs.min_mem _, _, ht.min_mem _, rfl⟩)) ?_
  rw [IsWF.le_min_iff]
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
  exact mul_le_mul' (hs.min_le _ hx) (ht.min_le _ hy)

name: mem_mulAntidiagonal

proof:
:=
  fun a ⟨b, hb⟩ => by
  rw [mem_mulAntidiagonal] at hb
  exact ⟨b.1, hb.1, b.2, hb.2⟩

name: isPWO_support_mulAntidiagonal

name: mulAntidiagonal_min_mul_min
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem mulAntidiagonal_min_mul_min {α} [CommMonoid α] [LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedCancelMonoid α]
    {s t : Set α} (hs : s.IsWF) (ht : t.IsWF) (hns : s.Nonempty) (hnt : t.Nonempty) :
    mulAntidiagonal hs.isPWO ht.isPWO (hs.min hns * ht.min hnt) = {(hs.min hns, ht.min hnt)}
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨a, b⟩
  simp only [mem_mulAntidiagonal, mem_singleton, Prod.ext_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨has, hat, hst⟩
    obtain rfl :=
      (hs.min_le hns has).eq_of_not_lt fun hlt =>
        (mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le hlt <| ht.min_le hnt hat).ne' hst
    exact ⟨rfl, mul_left_cancel hst⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hs.min_mem _, ht.min_mem _, rfl⟩

name: induction_on_pi_of_choice
statement:
theorem induction_on_pi_of_choice (r : ∀ i, α i → Finset (α i) → Prop)
    (H_ex : ∀ (i) (s : Finset (α i)), s.Nonempty → ∃ x ∈ s, r i x (s.erase x))
    {p : (∀ i, Finset (α i)) → Prop} (f : ∀ i, Finset (α i)) (h0 : p fun _ ↦ ∅)
    (step :
      ∀ (g : ∀ i, Finset (α i)) (i : ι) (x : α i),
        r i x (g i) → p g → p (update g i (insert x (g i)))) :
    p f
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype ι
  induction hs : univ.sigma f using Finset.strongInductionOn generalizing f with | _ s ihs
  subst s
  rcases eq_empty_or_nonempty (univ.sigma f) with he | hne
  · convert! h0 using 1
    simpa [funext_iff] using he
  · rcases sigma_nonempty.1 hne with ⟨i, -, hi⟩
    rcases H_ex i (f i) hi with ⟨x, x_mem, hr⟩
    set g := update f i ((f i).erase x) with hg
    clear_value g
    have hx' : x ∉ g i := by
      rw [hg, update_self]
      apply notMem_erase
    rw [show f = update g i (insert x (g i)) by
      rw [hg, update_idem, update_self, insert_erase x_mem, update_eq_self]] at hr ihs ⊢
    clear hg
    rw [update_self, erase_insert hx'] at hr
    refine step _ _ _ hr (ihs (univ.sigma g) ?_ _ rfl)
    rw [ssubset_iff_of_subset (sigma_mono (Subset.refl _) _)]
    exacts [⟨⟨i, x⟩, mem_sigma.2 ⟨mem_univ _, by simp⟩, by simp [hx']⟩,
      (@le_update_iff _ _ _ _ g g i _).2 ⟨subset_insert _ _, fun _ _ ↦ le_rfl⟩]

name: induction_on_pi
statement:
theorem induction_on_pi {p : (∀ i, Finset (α i)) → Prop} (f : ∀ i, Finset (α i)) (h0 : p fun _ ↦ ∅)
    (step : ∀ (g : ∀ i, Finset (α i)) (i : ι), ∀ x ∉ g i, p g → p (update g i (insert x (g i)))) :
    p f
proof:
:=
  induction_on_pi_of_choice (fun _ x s ↦ x ∉ s) (fun _ s ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨x, hx, notMem_erase x s⟩) f
    h0 step

name: induction_on_pi_max
statement:
theorem induction_on_pi_max [∀ i, LinearOrder (α i)] {p : (∀ i, Finset (α i)) → Prop}
    (f : ∀ i, Finset (α i)) (h0 : p fun _ ↦ ∅)
    (step :
      ∀ (g : ∀ i, Finset (α i)) (i : ι) (x : α i),
        (∀ y ∈ g i, y < x) → p g → p (update g i (insert x (g i)))) :
    p f
proof:
:=
  induction_on_pi_of_choice (fun _ x s ↦ ∀ y ∈ s, y < x)
    (fun _ s hs ↦ ⟨s.max' hs, s.max'_mem hs, fun _ ↦ s.lt_max'_of_mem_erase_max' _⟩) f h0 step

name: induction_on_pi_min
statement:
theorem induction_on_pi_min [∀ i, LinearOrder (α i)] {p : (∀ i, Finset (α i)) → Prop}
    (f : ∀ i, Finset (α i)) (h0 : p fun _ ↦ ∅)
    (step :
      ∀ (g : ∀ i, Finset (α i)) (i : ι) (x : α i),
        (∀ y ∈ g i, x < y) → p g → p (update g i (insert x (g i)))) :
    p f
proof:
:=
  induction_on_pi_max (α := fun i ↦ (α i)ᵒᵈ) _ h0 step

name: biUnion_slice

theorem biUnion_slice [DecidableEq α] : (Iic <| Fintype.card α).biUnion 𝒜.slice = 𝒜
proof:
:=
  Subset.antisymm (biUnion_subset.2 fun _r _ => slice_subset) fun s hs =>

  rw [← card_biUnion, biUnion_slice]
  exact Finset.pairwiseDisjoint_slice.subset (Set.subset_univ _)

:= by
  by_cases! s0 : (s.erase x).Nonempty
  · refine ne_of_eq_of_ne (coe_max' s0).symm ?_
    exact WithBot.coe_eq_coe.not.mpr (max'_erase_ne_self _)
  · rw [s0, max_empty]
    exact WithBot.bot_ne_coe

name: exists_next_right
statement:
@[to_dual exists_next_left]
theorem exists_next_right {x : α} {s : Finset α} (h : ∃ y ∈ s, x < y) :
    ∃ y ∈ s, x < y ∧ ∀ z ∈ s, x < z → y ≤ z
proof:
:=
  have Hne : (s.filter (x < ·)).Nonempty := h.imp fun y hy => mem_filter.2 (by simpa)
  have aux := mem_filter.1 (min'_mem _ Hne)
  ⟨min' _ Hne, aux.1, by simp, fun z hzs hz => min'_le _ _ <| mem_filter.2 ⟨hzs, by simpa⟩⟩

name: card_le_of_interleaved
statement:
theorem card_le_of_interleaved {s t : Finset α}
    (h : ∀ᵉ (x ∈ s) (y ∈ s),
        x < y → (∀ z ∈ s, z ∉ Set.Ioo x y) → ∃ z ∈ t, x < z ∧ z < y) :
    s.card ≤ t.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  replace h : ∀ᵉ (x ∈ s) (y ∈ s), x < y → ∃ z ∈ t, x < z ∧ z < y := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    rcases exists_next_right ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ with ⟨a, has, hxa, ha⟩
    rcases h x hx a has hxa fun z hzs hz => hz.2.not_ge <| ha _ hzs hz.1 with ⟨b, hbt, hxb, hba⟩
    exact ⟨b, hbt, hxb, hba.trans_le <| ha _ hy hxy⟩
  set f : α → WithTop α := fun x => (t.filter fun y => x < y).min
  have f_mono : StrictMonoOn f s := by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    rcases h x hx y hy hxy with ⟨a, hat, hxa, hay⟩
    calc
      f x ≤ a := min_le (mem_filter.2 ⟨hat, by simpa⟩)
      _ < f y :=
        (Finset.lt_inf_iff <| WithTop.coe_lt_top a).2 fun b hb =>
          WithTop.coe_lt_coe.2 <| hay.trans (by simpa using (mem_filter.1 hb).2)
  calc
    s.card = (s.image f).card := (card_image_of_injOn f_mono.injOn).symm
    _ ≤ (insert ⊤ (t.image (↑)) : Finset (WithTop α)).card :=
      card_mono <| image_subset_iff.2 fun x _ =>
          insert_subset_insert _ (image_subset_image <| filter_subset _ _)
            (min_mem_insert_top_image_coe _)
    _ ≤ t.card + 1 := (card_insert_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_right card_image_le _)

name: card_le_sdiff_of_interleaved
statement:
theorem card_le_sdiff_of_interleaved {s t : Finset α}
    (h :
      ∀ᵉ (x ∈ s) (y ∈ s),
        x < y → (∀ z ∈ s, z ∉ Set.Ioo x y) → ∃ z ∈ t, x < z ∧ z < y) :
    s.card ≤ (t \ s).card + 1
proof:
:=
  card_le_of_interleaved fun x hx y hy hxy hs =>
    let ⟨z, hzt, hxz, hzy⟩ := h x hx y hy hxy hs
    ⟨z, mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hzt, fun hzs => hs z hzs ⟨hxz, hzy⟩⟩, hxz, hzy⟩

name: induction_on_max
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := elab_as_elim)
/
`s : Finset α` provided that:

* it is true on the empty `Finset`,
* for every `s : Finset α` and an element `a` strictly less than all elements of `s`, `p s`
  implies `p (insert a s)`. -/]
theorem induction_on_max
    [DecidableEq α] {motive : Finset α → Prop} (s : Finset α) (empty : motive ∅)
    (insert : ∀ a s, (∀ x ∈ s, x < a) → motive s → motive (insert a s)) : motive s
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.eraseInduction with | _ s ih
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with (rfl | hne)
  · exact empty
  · have H : s.max' hne ∈ s := max'_mem s hne
    rw [← insert_erase H]
    exact insert _ _ (fun x ↦ s.lt_max'_of_mem_erase_max' hne) (ih _ H)

name: induction_on_max_value
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := elab_as_elim)
/
ordered type : a predicate is true on all `s : Finset α` provided that:

* it is true on the empty `Finset`,
* for every `s : Finset α` and an element `a` such that for elements of `s` denoted by `x` we have
  `f a ≤ f x`, `p s` implies `p (insert a s)`. -/]
theorem induction_on_max_value
    [DecidableEq ι] (f : ι → α) {motive : Finset ι → Prop} (s : Finset ι) (empty : motive ∅)
    (insert : ∀ a s, a ∉ s → (∀ x ∈ s, f x ≤ f a) → motive s → motive (insert a s)) : motive s
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.eraseInduction with | _ s ihs
  rcases (s.image f).eq_empty_or_nonempty with (hne | hne)
  · simp only [image_eq_empty] at hne
    simp only [hne, empty]
  · have H : (s.image f).max' hne ∈ s.image f := max'_mem (s.image f) hne
    simp only [mem_image] at H
    rcases H with ⟨a, has, hfa⟩
    rw [← insert_erase has]
    refine insert _ _ (notMem_erase a s) (fun x hx => ?_) (ihs a has)
    rw [hfa]
    exact le_max' _ _ (mem_image_of_mem _ <| mem_of_mem_erase hx)

name: exists_max_image
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem exists_max_image (s : Finset β) (f : β → α) (h : s.Nonempty) :
    ∃ x ∈ s, ∀ x' ∈ s, f x' ≤ f x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := max_of_nonempty (h.image f)
  rcases mem_image.mp (mem_of_max hy) with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨x, hx, fun x' hx' => le_max_of_eq (mem_image_of_mem f hx') hy⟩

name: isGLB_iff_isLeast
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem isGLB_iff_isLeast [LinearOrder α] (i : α) (s : Finset α) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    IsGLB (s : Set α) i ↔ IsLeast (↑s) i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun his => ?_, IsLeast.isGLB⟩
  suffices i = min' s hs by
    rw [this]
    exact isLeast_min' s hs
  rw [IsGLB, IsGreatest, mem_lowerBounds, mem_upperBounds] at his
  exact le_antisymm (his.1 (Finset.min' s hs) (Finset.min'_mem s hs)) (his.2 _ (Finset.min'_le s))

name: isGLB_mem
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem isGLB_mem [LinearOrder α] {i : α} (s : Finset α) (his : IsGLB (s : Set α) i)
    (hs : s.Nonempty) : i ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mem_coe]
  exact ((isGLB_iff_isLeast i s hs).mp his).1

proof:

  exact ⟨y, mem_toFinset.mp hys, fun _ hz ↦ hy _ (mem_toFinset.mpr hz)⟩

name: antidiagonal_filter_snd_le_of_le
statement:
@[simp] lemma antidiagonal_filter_snd_le_of_le {n k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ n) :
    {a ∈ antidiagonal n | a.snd ≤ k} = (antidiagonal k).map
      (Embedding.prodMap ⟨_, add_left_injective (n - k)⟩ (Embedding.refl ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨i, j⟩
  suffices i + j = n ∧ j ≤ k ↔ ∃ a, a + j = k ∧ a + (n - k) = i by simpa
  refine ⟨fun hi ↦ ⟨k - j, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hi.2, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [add_comm, tsub_add_eq_add_tsub h, ← hi.1, add_assoc, Nat.add_sub_of_le hi.2,
      add_tsub_cancel_right]
  · rintro ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hl ▸ Nat.le_add_left j l⟩
    rw [add_assoc, add_comm, add_assoc, add_comm j l, hl]
    exact Nat.sub_add_cancel h

name: antidiagonal_filter_fst_le_of_le
statement:
@[simp] lemma antidiagonal_filter_fst_le_of_le {n k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ n) :
    {a ∈ antidiagonal n | a.fst ≤ k} = (antidiagonal k).map
      (Embedding.prodMap (Embedding.refl ℕ) ⟨_, add_left_injective (n - k)⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have aux₁ : fun a ↦ a.fst ≤ k = (fun a ↦ a.snd ≤ k) ∘ (Equiv.prodComm ℕ ℕ).symm := rfl
  have aux₂ : ∀ i j, (∃ a b, a + b = k ∧ b = i ∧ a + (n - k) = j) ↔
                      ∃ a b, a + b = k ∧ a = i ∧ b + (n - k) = j :=
    fun i j ↦ by rw [exists_comm]; exact exists₂_congr (fun a b ↦ by rw [add_comm])
  rw [← map_prodComm_antidiagonal]
  simp_rw [aux₁, ← map_filter, antidiagonal_filter_snd_le_of_le h, map_map]
  ext ⟨i, j⟩
  simpa using aux₂ i j

name: antidiagonal_filter_le_fst_of_le
statement:
@[simp] lemma antidiagonal_filter_le_fst_of_le {n k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ n) :
    {a ∈ antidiagonal n | k ≤ a.fst} = (antidiagonal (n - k)).map
      (Embedding.prodMap ⟨_, add_left_injective k⟩ (Embedding.refl ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨i, j⟩
  suffices i + j = n ∧ k ≤ i ↔ ∃ a, a + j = n - k ∧ a + k = i by simpa
  refine ⟨fun hi ↦ ⟨i - k, ?_, tsub_add_cancel_of_le hi.2⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Nat.sub_add_comm hi.2, hi.1]
  · rintro ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, Nat.le_add_left k l⟩
    rw [add_right_comm, hl]
    exact tsub_add_cancel_of_le h

name: antidiagonal_filter_le_snd_of_le
statement:
@[simp] lemma antidiagonal_filter_le_snd_of_le {n k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ n) :
    {a ∈ antidiagonal n | k ≤ a.snd} = (antidiagonal (n - k)).map
      (Embedding.prodMap (Embedding.refl ℕ) ⟨_, add_left_injective k⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have aux₁ : fun a ↦ k ≤ a.snd = (fun a ↦ k ≤ a.fst) ∘ (Equiv.prodComm ℕ ℕ).symm := rfl
  have aux₂ : ∀ i j, (∃ a b, a + b = n - k ∧ b = i ∧ a + k = j) ↔
                      ∃ a b, a + b = n - k ∧ a = i ∧ b + k = j :=
    fun i j ↦ by rw [exists_comm]; exact exists₂_congr (fun a b ↦ by rw [add_comm])
  rw [← map_prodComm_antidiagonal]
  simp_rw [aux₁, ← map_filter, antidiagonal_filter_le_fst_of_le h,
    map_map]
  ext ⟨i, j⟩
  simpa using aux₂ i j

name: sup_preimage_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_preimage_self {α β : Type*} [Nonempty α] [SemilatticeSup β] [OrderBot β]
    {s : Finset β} {f : α → β} (hf : Set.BijOn f (f ⁻¹' ↑s) s) :
    (preimage s f hf.2.1).sup f = s.sup id
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfinvs : ∀ x ∈ s, (f ∘ invFunOn f (f ⁻¹' ↑s)) x = id x := hf.invOn_invFunOn.2
  rw [← sup_congr (Eq.refl s) hfinvs, ← sup_image]
  congr
  exact (image_eq_preimage_of_leftInvOn_injOn hf.invOn_invFunOn.2 hf.2.1).symm

name: sup_preimage_val_id
proof:
:= Subtype.semilatticeSup Psup
    letI := Subtype.orderBot Pbot
    (t.preimage Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective.injOn).sup id =
      (⟨t.sup id, sup_induction Pbot (fun _ h _ => Psup h) ht⟩ : Subtype P) := by
  let : OrderBot (Subtype P) := Subtype.orderBot Pbot
  ext
  simp only [sup_coe, id_eq]
  apply sup_preimage_self
  refine ⟨mapsTo_preimage _ _, injOn_of_injective Subtype.val_injective, ?_⟩
  intro x hx; simpa using ⟨hx, ht x hx⟩

name: sym_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sym_succ : s.sym (n + 1) = s.sup fun a ↦ (s.sym n).image <| Sym.cons a

name: mem_sym_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_sym_iff {m : Sym α n} : m ∈ s.sym n ↔ ∀ a ∈ m, a ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine mem_singleton.trans ⟨?_, fun _ ↦ Sym.eq_nil_of_card_zero _⟩
    rintro rfl
    exact fun a ha ↦ (Finset.notMem_empty _ ha).elim
  | succ n ih => ?_
  refine mem_sup.trans ⟨?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, he⟩ b hb
    rw [mem_image] at he
    obtain ⟨m, he, rfl⟩ := he
    rw [Sym.mem_cons] at hb
    obtain rfl | hb := hb
    · exact ha
    · exact ih.1 he _ hb
  · obtain ⟨a, m, rfl⟩ := m.exists_eq_cons_of_succ
    exact
      ⟨a, h _ <| Sym.mem_cons_self _ _,
        mem_image_of_mem _ <| ih.2 fun b hb ↦ h _ <| Sym.mem_cons_of_mem hb⟩

name: sym_map
statement:
lemma sym_map [DecidableEq β] {n : ℕ} (g : α ↪ β) (s : Finset α) :
    (s.map g).sym n = (s.sym n).map ⟨Sym.map g, Sym.map_injective g.injective _⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext d
  simp only [mem_sym_iff, mem_map, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk]
  refine ⟨fun hd ↦ ?_, fun ⟨b, hb, hd'⟩ d' hd ↦ ?_⟩
  · let g' : {x // x ∈ d} → α := fun ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ (hd x hx).choose
    refine ⟨(fun p ↦ Sym.map g' p) d.attach, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [Sym.mem_map, Sym.mem_attach, true_and, Subtype.exists, forall_exists_index, g']
      intro i e he hi
      rw [← hi]
      exact (hd e he).choose_spec.1
    · simp only [Sym.map_map, Function.comp_apply, g']
      convert! Sym.attach_map_coe d with ⟨x, hx⟩ hx'
      exact (hd x hx).choose_spec.2
  · rw [← hd', Sym.mem_map] at hd
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hd
    exact ⟨a, hb a ha, rfl⟩

name: sym_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sym_singleton (a : α) (n : ℕ) : ({a} : Finset α).sym n = {Sym.replicate n a}
proof:

  eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.2
    ⟨replicate_mem_sym (mem_singleton.2 rfl) _, fun _s hs ↦

  · refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨Nat.succ_ne_zero _, eq_empty_of_sym_eq_empty h⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨_, rfl⟩
    exact sym_empty _

statement:
theorem sym_fill_mem (a : α) {i : Fin (n + 1)} {m : Sym α (n - i)} (h : m ∈ s.sym (n - i)) :

proof:
:=
  mem_sym_iff.2 fun b hb ↦
    mem_insert.2 <| (Sym.mem_fill_iff.1 hb).imp And.right <| mem_sym_iff.1 h b

proof:

    mem_erase.2 <| (Multiset.mem_filter.1 H).symm.imp Ne.symm <| mem_sym_iff.1 h b

name: val_prod_eq_prod_count_pow
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem val_prod_eq_prod_count_pow [CommMonoid α] {n : ℕ} {k : Sym α n}
    {s : Finset α} (hk : k ∈ s.sym n) :
    k.val.prod = ∏ d ∈ s, d ^ Multiset.count d k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.prod_multiset_count_of_subset _ s]
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl (by simp)
  intro x hx
  simp only [Sym.val_eq_coe, Multiset.mem_toFinset, Sym.mem_coe] at hx
  simp only [Finset.mem_sym_iff] at hk
  exact hk x hx

name: Nat.Coprime.mul_injOn_divisors
statement:
theorem Nat.Coprime.mul_injOn_divisors {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m.Coprime n) :
    Set.InjOn (fun p : ℕ × ℕ ↦ p.1 * p.2) ↑(divisors m ×ˢ divisors n)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨dm₁, dn₁⟩ h₁ ⟨dm₂, dn₂⟩ h₂ hd
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_product, mem_divisors] at *
  suffices dm₁ = dm₂ from Prod.ext this <| by
    rwa [this, Nat.mul_right_inj (by simp [·] at h₂)] at hd
  exact dvd_antisymm
    (hmn.coprime_dvd_left h₁.1.1 |>.coprime_dvd_right h₂.2.1
      |>.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right (hd ▸ dm₁.dvd_mul_right dn₁))
    (hmn.coprime_dvd_left h₂.1.1 |>.coprime_dvd_right h₁.2.1
      |>.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right (hd ▸ dm₂.dvd_mul_right dn₂))

name: Nat.Coprime.divisors_mul
statement:
theorem Nat.Coprime.divisors_mul {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m.Coprime n) :
    divisors (m * n) = (divisors m ×ˢ divisors n).attach.map
      ⟨fun p => p.val.1 * p.val.2,
        fun i j hxy => Subtype.ext <| hmn.mul_injOn_divisors i.prop j.prop hxy⟩
proof:
:= calc
  _ = ((divisors m ×ˢ divisors n).attach.image Subtype.val).image fun p ↦ p.1 * p.2 := by
    rw [Finset.attach_image_val, ← Finset.mul_def, Nat.divisors_mul]
  _ = _ := by rw [Finset.map_eq_image, Finset.image_image]; rfl

name: image_subtype_ne_univ_eq_image_erase
statement:
theorem image_subtype_ne_univ_eq_image_erase [Fintype α] [DecidableEq β] (k : β) (b : α → β) :
    image (fun i : { a // b a ≠ k } => b ↑i) univ = (image b univ).erase k
proof:
:= by
  apply subset_antisymm
  · rw [image_subset_iff]
    intro i _
    apply mem_erase_of_ne_of_mem i.2 (mem_image_of_mem _ (mem_univ _))
  · intro i hi
    rw [mem_image]
    rcases mem_image.1 (erase_subset _ _ hi) with ⟨a, _, ha⟩
    subst ha
    exact ⟨⟨a, ne_of_mem_erase hi⟩, mem_univ _, rfl⟩

name: Finset.exists_equiv_extend_of_card_eq
proof:
:= by
  classical
    induction s using Finset.induction generalizing f with
    | empty =>
      obtain ⟨e⟩ : Nonempty (α ≃ ↥t) := by rwa [← Fintype.card_eq, Fintype.card_coe]
      use e
      simp
    | insert a s has H => ?_
    have hfst' : Finset.image f s ⊆ t := (Finset.image_mono _ (s.subset_insert a)).trans hfst
    have hfs' : Set.InjOn f s := hfs.mono (s.subset_insert a)
    obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := H hfst' hfs'
    have hfat : f a ∈ t := hfst (mem_image_of_mem _ (s.mem_insert_self a))
    use g'.trans (Equiv.swap (⟨f a, hfat⟩ : t) (g' a))
    simp_rw [mem_insert]
    rintro i (rfl | hi)
    · simp
    rw [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne, hg' _ hi]
    · exact
        ne_of_apply_ne Subtype.val
          (ne_of_eq_of_ne (hg' _ hi) <|
            hfs.ne (subset_insert _ _ hi) (mem_insert_self _ _) <| ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hi has)
    · exact g'.injective.ne (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hi has)

name: Set.MapsTo.exists_equiv_extend_of_card_eq
proof:
:= by
  classical
    let s' : Finset α := s.toFinset
    have hfst' : s'.image f ⊆ t := by simpa [s', ← Finset.coe_subset] using! hfst
    have hfs' : Set.InjOn f s' := by simpa [s'] using! hfs
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Finset.exists_equiv_extend_of_card_eq hαt hfst' hfs'
    refine ⟨g, fun i hi => ?_⟩
    apply hg
    simpa [s'] using! hi

theorem Fintype.card_subtype_eq_or_eq_of_ne {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {a b : α}

proof:
:=
  Fintype.card_subtype_or_disjoint _ _ fun _ ha hb _ hc ↦ ha _ hc ▸ hb _ hc ▸ h <| rfl

name: Ioi_zero_eq_map

statement:

    #{i | v.get i = a} = v.toList.count a
proof:
:= by
  induction v with
  | nil => simp
  | @cons n x xs hxs =>
    simp_rw [card_filter_univ_succ', Vector.get_cons_zero, Vector.toList_cons, Vector.get_cons_succ,
      hxs, List.count_cons, add_comm (ite (x = a) 1 0), beq_iff_eq]

name: lt_card_filter_univ_iff_apply_of_imp
statement:
theorem lt_card_filter_univ_iff_apply_of_imp {j : Fin n} (p : Fin n → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (hp : ∀ i j, j ≤ i → p i → p j) :
    j < #{i | p i} ↔ p j
proof:
:= by
  have h1 (k : Fin n) (hk : ¬ p k) : #{i | p i} ≤ k := by
    rw [← Fin.card_Iio]
    exact card_le_card (by grind)
  refine ⟨by grind, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra! hc
  let q : Fin n → Prop := (· < #{i | p i})
  have : univ.filter q = univ.filter p :=
    eq_of_subset_of_card_le (by grind) (by rw [card_filter_val_lt]; grind)
  have : j ∈ univ.filter p := by grind
  grind

name: surjective_of_injective
statement: theorem surjective_of_injective {f : α → α} (hinj : Injective f) : Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  have := Classical.propDecidable
  cases nonempty_fintype α
  have h₁ : image f univ = univ :=
    eq_of_subset_of_card_le (subset_univ _)
      ((card_image_of_injective univ hinj).symm ▸ le_rfl)
  have h₂ : x ∈ image f univ := h₁.symm ▸ mem_univ x
  obtain ⟨y, h⟩ := mem_image.1 h₂
  exact ⟨y, h.2⟩

statement:
theorem wellFounded_of_trans_of_irrefl (r : α → α → Prop) [IsTrans α r] [Std.Irrefl r] :
    WellFounded r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases nonempty_fintype α
  have (x y) (hxy : r x y) : #{z | r z x} < #{z | r z y} :=
    Finset.card_lt_card <| by
      simp_rw [lt_iff_le_not_ge, Finset.subset_iff, mem_filter_univ]
      exact
        ⟨fun z hzx => _root_.trans hzx hxy,
          not_forall_of_exists_not ⟨x, Classical.not_imp.2 ⟨hxy, irrefl x⟩⟩⟩
  exact Subrelation.wf (this _ _) (measure _).wf

name: Fintype.induction_subsingleton_or_nontrivial
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem Fintype.induction_subsingleton_or_nontrivial {P : ∀ (α) [Fintype α], Prop} (α : Type*)
    [Fintype α] (hbase : ∀ (α) [Fintype α] [Subsingleton α], P α)
    (hstep : ∀ (α) [Fintype α] [Nontrivial α],
      (∀ (β) [Fintype β], Fintype.card β < Fintype.card α → P β) → P α) :
    P α
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, Fintype.card α = n := ⟨Fintype.card α, rfl⟩
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing α with | _ n ih
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial α with hsing | hnontriv
  · apply hbase
  · apply hstep
    intro β _ hlt
    rw [hn] at hlt
    exact ih (Fintype.card β) hlt _ rfl

name: induction_empty_option
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_empty_option {P : ∀ (α : Type u) [Fintype α], Prop}
    (of_equiv : ∀ (α β) [Fintype β] (e : α ≃ β), @P α (@Fintype.ofEquiv α β ‹_› e.symm) → @P β ‹_›)
    (h_empty : P PEmpty) (h_option : ∀ (α) [Fintype α], P α → P (Option α)) (α : Type u)
    [h_fintype : Fintype α] : P α
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ :=
    let f_empty := fun i => by convert! h_empty
    let h_option : ∀ {α : Type u} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α],
          (∀ (h : Fintype α), P α) → ∀ (h : Fintype (Option α)), P (Option α) := by
      rintro α hα - Pα hα'
      convert! h_option α (Pα _)
    @truncRecEmptyOption (fun α => ∀ h, @P α h) (@fun α β e hα hβ => @of_equiv α β hβ e (hα _))
      f_empty h_option α _ (Classical.decEq α)
  exact p _

name: Finite.induction_empty_option
statement:
theorem Finite.induction_empty_option {P : Type u → Prop} (of_equiv : ∀ {α β}, α ≃ β → P α → P β)
    (h_empty : P PEmpty) (h_option : ∀ {α} [Fintype α], P α → P (Option α)) (α : Type u)
    [Finite α] : P α
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype α
  refine Fintype.induction_empty_option ?_ ?_ ?_ α
  exacts [fun α β _ => of_equiv, h_empty, @h_option]

      H.elim (and_imp.2 <| @Prod.infinite_of_left α β) (and_imp.2 <| @Prod.infinite_of_right α β)⟩

proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_unit, card_eq]
  exact
    ⟨fun ⟨a⟩ => ⟨a.symm (), fun y => a.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩,
     fun ⟨x, hx⟩ =>
      ⟨⟨fun _ => (), fun _ => x, fun _ => (hx _).trans (hx _).symm, fun _ =>
          Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩⟩

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    let ⟨d, h⟩ := Fintype.card_eq_one_iff.mp h
    ⟨{  default := d
        uniq := h }⟩,
    fun ⟨_h⟩ => Fintype.card_unique⟩

name: card_le_one_iff
statement: theorem card_le_one_iff : card α ≤ 1 ↔ ∀ a b : α, a = b
proof:
:=
  let n := card α
  have hn : n = card α := rfl
  match n, hn with
  | 0, ha =>
    ⟨fun _h => fun a => (card_eq_zero_iff.1 ha.symm).elim a, fun _ => ha ▸ Nat.le_succ _⟩
  | 1, ha =>
    ⟨fun _h => fun a b => by
      let ⟨x, hx⟩ := card_eq_one_iff.1 ha.symm
      rw [hx a, hx b], fun _ => ha ▸ le_rfl⟩
  | n + 2, ha =>
    ⟨fun h => False.elim <| by rw [← ha] at h; cases h with | step h => cases h; , fun h =>
      card_unit ▸ card_le_of_injective (fun _ => ()) fun _ _ _ => h _ _⟩

    ⟨h.1.injective_of_finite <| equivOfCardEq h.2, h.1⟩⟩

name: _root_.Function.LeftInverse.rightInverse_of_card_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.LeftInverse.rightInverse_of_card_le {f : α → β} {g : β → α}
    (hfg : LeftInverse f g) (hcard : card α ≤ card β) : RightInverse f g
proof:
:=
  have hsurj : Surjective f := surjective_iff_hasRightInverse.2 ⟨g, hfg⟩
  rightInverse_of_injective_of_leftInverse
    ((bijective_iff_surjective_and_card _).2
        ⟨hsurj, le_antisymm hcard (card_le_of_surjective f hsurj)⟩).1
    hfg

  of_not_fintype fun h => by
    classical
      refine lt_irrefl (Fintype.card α) ?_
      calc
        Fintype.card α ≤ Fintype.card s := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf

name: natEmbeddingAux_injective
statement:
private theorem natEmbeddingAux_injective (α : Type*) [Infinite α] :
    Function.Injective (natEmbeddingAux α)
proof:
:= by
  rintro m n h
  let := Classical.decEq α
  wlog hmlen : m ≤ n generalizing m n
  · exact (this h.symm <| le_of_not_ge hmlen).symm
  by_contra hmn
  have hmn : m < n := lt_of_le_of_ne hmlen hmn
  refine (Classical.choose_spec (exists_notMem_finset
    ((Multiset.range n).pmap (fun m (_ : m < n) ↦ natEmbeddingAux α m)
      (fun _ ↦ Multiset.mem_range.1)).toFinset)) ?_
  refine Multiset.mem_toFinset.2 (Multiset.mem_pmap.2 ⟨m, Multiset.mem_range.2 hmn, ?_⟩)
  rw [h, natEmbeddingAux]

statement:
theorem exists_superset_card_eq [Infinite α] (s : Finset α) (n : ℕ) (hn : #s ≤ n) :
    ∃ t : Finset α, s ⊆ t ∧ #t = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => exact ⟨s, subset_rfl, Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hn⟩
  | succ n IH =>
    rcases hn.eq_or_lt with hn' | hn'
    · exact ⟨s, subset_rfl, hn'⟩
    obtain ⟨t, hs, ht⟩ := IH _ (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hn')
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_notMem_finset t
    refine ⟨Finset.cons x t hx, hs.trans (Finset.subset_cons _), ?_⟩
    simp [ht]

name: length_permsOfList
statement:
theorem length_permsOfList : ∀ l : List α, length (permsOfList l) = l.length !
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => by
    simp [Nat.factorial_succ, permsOfList, length_permsOfList, succ_mul, add_comm]

name: mem_permsOfList_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_permsOfList_of_mem {l : List α} {f : Perm α} (h : ∀ x, f x ≠ x → x ∈ l) :
    f ∈ permsOfList l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing f with
  | nil =>
    simp only [not_mem_nil] at h
    exact List.mem_singleton.2 (Equiv.ext fun x => Decidable.byContradiction <| h x)
  | cons a l IH =>
  by_cases hfa : f a = a
  · refine mem_append_left _ (IH fun x hx => mem_of_ne_of_mem ?_ (h x hx))
    rintro rfl
    exact hx hfa
  have hfa' : f (f a) ≠ f a := mt (fun h => f.injective h) hfa
  have : ∀ x : α, (Equiv.swap a (f a) * f) x ≠ x → x ∈ l := by
    simp
    grind
  suffices f ∈ permsOfList l ∨ ∃ b ∈ l, ∃ g ∈ permsOfList l, Equiv.swap a b * g = f by
    simpa only [permsOfList, exists_prop, List.mem_map, mem_append, List.mem_flatMap]
  refine or_iff_not_imp_left.2 fun _hfl => ⟨f a, ?_, Equiv.swap a (f a) * f, IH this, ?_⟩
  · exact mem_of_ne_of_mem hfa (h _ hfa')
  · rw [← mul_assoc, mul_def (Equiv.swap a (f a)) (Equiv.swap a (f a)), Equiv.swap_swap,
      ← Perm.one_def, one_mul]

name: mem_of_mem_permsOfList
statement:
theorem mem_of_mem_permsOfList :
    ∀ {l : List α} {f : Perm α}, f ∈ permsOfList l → {x : α} → f x ≠ x → x ∈ l
  | [], f, h, heq_iff_eq => by
    have : f = 1
proof:
:= by simpa [permsOfList] using h
    rw [this]; simp
  | a :: l, f, h, x =>
    (mem_append.1 h).elim (fun h hx => mem_cons_of_mem _ (mem_of_mem_permsOfList h hx))
      fun h hx =>
      let ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 h
      let ⟨g, hg₁, hg₂⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy'
      if hxa : x = a then by simp [hxa]
      else
        if hxy : x = y then mem_cons_of_mem _ <| by rwa [hxy]
        else mem_cons_of_mem a <| mem_of_mem_permsOfList hg₁ <| by
              rw [eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq.2 hg₂, mul_apply, swap_inv, swap_apply_def]
              split_ifs <;> [exact Ne.symm hxy; exact Ne.symm hxa; exact hx]

name: mem_permsOfList_iff
statement:
theorem mem_permsOfList_iff {l : List α} {f : Perm α} :
    f ∈ permsOfList l ↔ ∀ {x}, f x ≠ x → x ∈ l

name: nodup_permsOfList
statement:
theorem nodup_permsOfList : ∀ {l : List α}, l.Nodup → (permsOfList l).Nodup
  | [], _ => by simp [permsOfList]
  | a :: l, hl => by
    have hl' : l.Nodup
proof:
:= hl.of_cons
    have hln' : (permsOfList l).Nodup := nodup_permsOfList hl'
    have hmeml : ∀ {f : Perm α}, f ∈ permsOfList l → f a = a := fun {f} hf =>
      not_not.1 (mt (mem_of_mem_permsOfList hf) (nodup_cons.1 hl).1)
    rw [permsOfList, List.nodup_append', List.nodup_flatMap, pairwise_iff_getElem]
    refine ⟨?_, ⟨⟨?_,?_ ⟩, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact hln'
    · exact fun _ _ => hln'.map fun _ _ => mul_left_cancel
    · intro i j hi hj hij x hx₁ hx₂
      let ⟨f, hf⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx₁
      let ⟨g, hg⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx₂
      have hix : x a = l[i] := by
        rw [← hf.2, mul_apply, hmeml hf.1, swap_apply_left]
      have hiy : x a = l[j] := by
        rw [← hg.2, mul_apply, hmeml hg.1, swap_apply_left]
      have hieqj : i = j := hl'.getElem_inj_iff.1 (hix.symm.trans hiy)
      exact absurd hieqj (_root_.ne_of_lt hij)
    · intro f hf₁ hf₂
      let ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 hf₂
      let ⟨g, hg⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx'
      obtain rfl : g.symm x = a := f.injective <| by rw [hmeml hf₁, ← hg.2]; simp
      have hxa : x ≠ g.symm x := fun h => (List.nodup_cons.1 hl).1 (h ▸ hx)
      exact (List.nodup_cons.1 hl).1 <| mem_of_mem_permsOfList hg.1 (by simpa using hxa)

name: mem_perms_of_finset_iff
statement:
theorem mem_perms_of_finset_iff :
    ∀ {s : Finset α} {f : Perm α}, f ∈ permsOfFinset s ↔ ∀ {x}, f x ≠ x → x ∈ s

name: exists_seq_of_forall_finset_exists
statement:
theorem exists_seq_of_forall_finset_exists {α : Type*} (P : α → Prop) (r : α → α → Prop)
    (h : ∀ s : Finset α, (∀ x ∈ s, P x) → ∃ y, P y ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, r x y) :
    ∃ f : ℕ → α, (∀ n, P (f n)) ∧ ∀ m n, m < n → r (f m) (f n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
    have : Nonempty α := by
      rcases h ∅ (by simp) with ⟨y, _⟩
      exact ⟨y⟩
    choose! F hF using h
    have h' : ∀ s : Finset α, ∃ y, (∀ x ∈ s, P x) → P y ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, r x y := fun s => ⟨F s, hF s⟩
    set f := seqOfForallFinsetExistsAux P r h' with hf
    have A : ∀ n : ℕ, P (f n) := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with | _ n IH
      have IH' : ∀ x : Fin n, P (f x) := fun n => IH n.1 n.2
      rw [hf, seqOfForallFinsetExistsAux]
      exact
        (Classical.choose_spec
            (h' (Finset.image (fun i : Fin n => f i) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))))
            (by simp [IH'])).1
    refine ⟨f, A, fun m n hmn => ?_⟩
    conv_rhs => rw [hf]
    rw [seqOfForallFinsetExistsAux]
    apply
      (Classical.choose_spec
          (h' (Finset.image (fun i : Fin n => f i) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)))) (by simp [A])).2
    exact Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨⟨m, hmn⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩

name: exists_seq_of_forall_finset_exists'
statement:
theorem exists_seq_of_forall_finset_exists' {α : Type*} (P : α → Prop) (r : α → α → Prop)
    [Std.Symm r] (h : ∀ s : Finset α, (∀ x ∈ s, P x) → ∃ y, P y ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, r x y) :
    ∃ f : ℕ → α, (∀ n, P (f n)) ∧ Pairwise (r on f)
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_seq_of_forall_finset_exists P r h with ⟨f, hf, hf'⟩
  refine ⟨f, hf, fun m n hmn => ?_⟩
  grind +splitIndPred

name: list_ind
proof:
:=
  match l with
  | [] => cast (congr_arg _ (funext₂ nofun)) (f nofun)
  | i :: l => by
    rw [← List.Pi.cons_eta q]
    induction List.Pi.head q using Quotient.ind with | _ a
    refine @list_ind _ (fun q ↦ C (List.Pi.cons _ _ ⟦a⟧ q)) ?_ (List.Pi.tail q)
    intro as
    rw [List.Pi.cons_map a as (fun i ↦ Quotient.mk (S i))]
    exact f _

name: card_embedding_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_embedding_eq {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [emb : Fintype (α ↪ β)] :
    ‖α ↪ β‖ = ‖β‖.descFactorial ‖α‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subsingleton.elim emb Embedding.fintype]
  refine Fintype.induction_empty_option (P := fun t ↦ ‖t ↪ β‖ = ‖β‖.descFactorial ‖t‖)
        (fun α₁ α₂ h₂ e ih ↦ ?_) (?_) (fun γ h ih ↦ ?_) α <;> clear! α
  · let := Fintype.ofEquiv _ e.symm
    rw [← card_congr (Equiv.embeddingCongr e (Equiv.refl β)), ih, card_congr e]
  · rw [card_pempty, Nat.descFactorial_zero, card_eq_one_iff]
    exact ⟨Embedding.ofIsEmpty, fun x ↦ DFunLike.ext _ _ isEmptyElim⟩
  · classical
    rw [card_option, Nat.descFactorial_succ, card_congr (Embedding.optionEmbeddingEquiv γ β),
        card_sigma, ← ih]
    simp only [Fintype.card_compl_set, Fintype.card_range, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Nat.nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm]

This is a version of `Finset.sum_sigma` specialized to the case of summation over `Finset.univ`. -/]

name: card_filter_piFinset_eq_of_mem
statement:
lemma card_filter_piFinset_eq_of_mem [∀ i, DecidableEq (α i)]
    (s : ∀ i, Finset (α i)) (i : ι) {a : α i} (ha : a ∈ s i) :
    #{f ∈ piFinset s | f i = a} = ∏ j ∈ univ.erase i, #(s j)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∏ j, #(Function.update s i {a} j) := by
      rw [← piFinset_update_singleton_eq_filter_piFinset_eq _ _ ha, Fintype.card_piFinset]
    _ = ∏ j, Function.update (fun j ↦ #(s j)) i 1 j :=
      Fintype.prod_congr _ _ fun j ↦ by obtain rfl | hji := eq_or_ne j i <;> simp [*]
    _ = _ := by simp [prod_update_of_mem, erase_eq]

statement:
lemma card_filter_piFinset_eq [∀ i, DecidableEq (α i)] (s : ∀ i, Finset (α i)) (i : ι) (a : α i) :
    #{f ∈ piFinset s | f i = a} = if a ∈ s i then ∏ b ∈ univ.erase i, #(s b) else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [card_filter_piFinset_eq_of_mem _ _ h]
  · rw [filter_piFinset_of_notMem _ _ _ h, Finset.card_empty]

name: Finset.card_filter_length_eq_le
statement:
lemma Finset.card_filter_length_eq_le [Fintype α] {T : Finset (List α)} {s : ℕ} :
    (T.filter (fun x => x.length = s)).card ≤ (Fintype.card α) ^ s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ ≤ (Finset.univ.image List.ofFn).card := by
          apply Finset.card_le_card
          intro a ha
          let hlen := Finset.mem_filter.mp ha
          exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨
              (fun j : Fin s => a.get ⟨j.val, by simp [hlen]⟩),
              by simp,
              List.ext_get (by simp [hlen]) (by simp)⟩
    _ = Fintype.card α ^ s := by
          simp [card_image_of_injective univ List.ofFn_injective]

name: Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range
statement:
theorem Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range [CommMonoid α] (f : ℕ → α) (n : ℕ) :
    ∏ i : Fin n, f i = ∏ i ∈ range n, f i
proof:
:=
  calc
    ∏ i : Fin n, f i = ∏ i : { x // x ∈ range n }, f i :=
      Fintype.prod_equiv (Fin.equivSubtype.trans (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (by simp))) _ _ (by simp)
    _ = ∏ i ∈ range n, f i := by rw [← attach_eq_univ, prod_attach]

name: Finset.prod_fin_eq_prod_range

theorem Finset.prod_fin_eq_prod_range [CommMonoid β] {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → β) :
    ∏ i, c i = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, if h : i < n then c ⟨i, h⟩ else 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range, Finset.prod_congr rfl]
  rintro ⟨i, hi⟩ _
  simp only [hi, dite_eq_left]

name: destruct_eq_pure
statement: theorem destruct_eq_pure {s : Computation α} {a : α} : destruct s = Sum.inl a → s = pure a
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [destruct]
  cases f0 : s.1 0 <;> intro h
  · contradiction
  · apply Subtype.ext
    funext n
    induction n with
    | zero => injection h with h'; rwa [h'] at f0
    | succ n IH => exact s.2 IH

name: destruct_eq_think

proof:
:= by
  dsimp [destruct]
  rcases f0 : s.1 0 with - | a' <;> intro h
  · injection h with h'
    rw [← h']
    obtain ⟨f, al⟩ := s
    apply Subtype.ext
    dsimp [think, tail]
    rw [← f0]
    exact (Stream'.eta f).symm
  · contradiction

name: corec_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem corec_eq (f : β → α ⊕ β) (b : β) : destruct (corec f b) = rmap (corec f) (f b)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [corec, destruct]
  rw [show Stream'.corec' (Corec.f f) (Sum.inr b) 0 =
    Sum.rec Option.some (fun _ ↦ none) (f b) by
    dsimp [Corec.f, Stream'.corec', Stream'.corec, Stream'.map, Stream'.get, Stream'.iterate]
    match (f b) with
    | Sum.inl x => rfl
    | Sum.inr x => rfl]
  rcases h : f b with a | b'; · rfl
  dsimp [Corec.f, destruct]
  apply congr_arg; apply Subtype.ext
  dsimp [corec, tail]
  rw [Stream'.corec'_eq, Stream'.tail_cons]
  dsimp [Corec.f]; rw [h]

name: eq_of_bisim
statement: theorem eq_of_bisim (bisim : IsBisimulation R) {s₁ s₂} (r : s₁ ~ s₂) : s₁ = s₂
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Stream'.eq_of_bisim fun x y => ∃ s s' : Computation α, s.1 = x ∧ s'.1 = y ∧ R s s'
  · dsimp [Stream'.IsBisimulation]
    intro t₁ t₂ e
    match t₁, t₂, e with
    | _, _, ⟨s, s', rfl, rfl, r⟩ =>
      suffices head s = head s' ∧ R (tail s) (tail s') from
        And.imp id (fun r => ⟨tail s, tail s', by cases s; rfl, by cases s'; rfl, r⟩) this
      have h := bisim r; revert r h
      refine recOn s ?_ ?_ <;> intro r' <;> refine recOn s' ?_ ?_ <;> intro a' r h
      · constructor <;> dsimp at h
        · rw [h]
        · rw [h] at r
          rwa [tail_pure, tail_pure, h]
      · rw [destruct_pure, destruct_think] at h
        exact False.elim h
      · rw [destruct_pure, destruct_think] at h
        exact False.elim h
      · simp_all
  · exact ⟨s₁, s₂, rfl, rfl, r⟩

name: Results.len_unique
statement:
theorem Results.len_unique {s : Computation α} {a b m n} (h1 : Results s a m) (h2 : Results s b n) :
    m = n
proof: := by have := h1.terminates; have := h2.terminates; rw [← h1.length, h2.length]

name: exists_results_of_mem
statement: theorem exists_results_of_mem {s : Computation α} {a} (h : a ∈ s) : ∃ n, Results s a n
proof:
:=
  haveI := terminates_of_mem h
  ⟨_, results_of_terminates' s h⟩

name: get_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem get_pure (a : α) : get (pure a) = a

name: length_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_pure (a : α) : length (pure a) = 0
proof:
:=
  let h := Computation.ret_terminates a
  Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero <| Nat.find_min' ((terminates_def (pure a)).1 h) rfl

name: results_pure
statement: theorem results_pure (a : α) : Results (pure a) a 0

name: length_think
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_think (s : Computation α) [h : Terminates s] : length (think s) = length s + 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact Nat.find_min' _ (Nat.find_spec ((terminates_def _).1 h))
  · have : (Option.isSome ((think s).val (length (think s))) : Prop) :=
      Nat.find_spec ((terminates_def _).1 s.think_terminates)
    revert this; rcases length (think s) with - | n <;> intro this
    · simp [think, Stream'.cons] at this
    · apply Nat.succ_le_succ
      apply Nat.find_min'
      apply this

name: results_think
statement: theorem results_think {s : Computation α} {a n} (h : Results s a n) : Results (think s) a (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  haveI := h.terminates
  ⟨think_mem h.mem, by rw [length_think, h.length]⟩

name: of_results_think
statement:
theorem of_results_think {s : Computation α} {a n} (h : Results (think s) a n) :
    ∃ m, Results s a m ∧ n = m + 1
proof:
:= by
  have := of_think_terminates h.terminates
  have := results_of_terminates' _ (of_think_mem h.mem)
  exact ⟨_, this, Results.len_unique h (results_think this)⟩

name: results_think_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem results_think_iff {s : Computation α} {a n} : Results (think s) a (n + 1) ↔ Results s a n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    let ⟨n', r, e⟩ := of_results_think h
    injection e with h'; rwa [h'], results_think⟩

name: results_thinkN
statement:
theorem results_thinkN {s : Computation α} {a m} :
    ∀ n, Results s a m → Results (thinkN s n) a (m + n)
  | 0, h => h
  | n + 1, h => results_think (results_thinkN n h)

name: results_thinkN_pure
statement: theorem results_thinkN_pure (a : α) (n) : Results (thinkN (pure a) n) a n
proof:
:= by
  have := results_thinkN n (results_pure a); rwa [Nat.zero_add] at this

name: length_thinkN
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_thinkN (s : Computation α) [_h : Terminates s] (n) :
    length (thinkN s n) = length s + n

name: eq_thinkN
statement: theorem eq_thinkN {s : Computation α} {a n} (h : Results s a n) : s = thinkN (pure a) n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s with | zero | succ n IH <;>
  induction s using recOn with | pure a' | think s
  · rw [← eq_of_pure_mem h.mem]
    rfl
  · obtain ⟨n, h⟩ := of_results_think h
    cases h
    contradiction
  · have := h.len_unique (results_pure _)
    contradiction
  · rw [IH (results_think_iff.1 h)]
    rfl

name: eq_thinkN'
statement:
theorem eq_thinkN' (s : Computation α) [_h : Terminates s] :
    s = thinkN (pure (get s)) (length s)

name: has_bind_eq_bind
statement: theorem has_bind_eq_bind {β} (c : Computation α) (f : α → Computation β) : c >>= f = bind c f

name: map_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_pure (f : α → β) (a) : map f (pure a) = pure (f a)

name: map_think
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_think (f : α → β) : ∀ s, map f (think s) = think (map f s)
  | ⟨s, al⟩ => by apply Subtype.ext; dsimp [think, map]; rw [Stream'.map_cons]

@[simp]

name: destruct_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem destruct_map (f : α → β) (s) : destruct (map f s) = lmap f (rmap (map f) (destruct s))
proof:
:= by
  induction s using recOn <;> simp

name: map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : ∀ s : Computation α, map id s = s
  | ⟨f, al⟩ => by
    apply Subtype.ext; simp only [map, comp_apply, id_eq]
    have e : @Option.rec α (fun _ => Option α) none some = id
proof:
:= by ext ⟨⟩ <;> rfl
    have h : ((fun x : Option α => x) = id) := rfl
    simp [e, h, Stream'.map_id]

name: map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) : ∀ s : Computation α, map (g ∘ f) s = map g (map f s)
  | ⟨s, al⟩ => by
    apply Subtype.ext; dsimp [map]
    apply congr_arg fun f : _ → Option γ => Stream'.map f s
    ext ⟨⟩ <;> rfl

@[simp]

name: ret_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ret_bind (a) (f : α → Computation β) : bind (pure a) f = f a
proof:
:= by
  apply
    eq_of_bisim fun c₁ c₂ => c₁ = bind (pure a) f ∧ c₂ = f a ∨ c₁ = corec (Bind.f f) (Sum.inr c₂)
  · intro c₁ c₂ h
    match c₁, c₂, h with
    | _, _, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ =>
      simp only [BisimO, bind, Bind.f, corec_eq, rmap, destruct_pure]
      rcases destruct (f a) with b | cb <;> simp [Bind.g]
    | _, c, Or.inr rfl =>
      simp only [BisimO, Bind.f, corec_eq, rmap]
      rcases destruct c with b | cb <;> simp [Bind.g]
  · simp

name: think_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem think_bind (c) (f : α → Computation β) : bind (think c) f = think (bind c f)

name: bind_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bind_pure (f : α → β) (s) : bind s (pure ∘ f) = map f s
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_bisim fun c₁ c₂ => c₁ = c₂ ∨ ∃ s, c₁ = bind s (pure ∘ f) ∧ c₂ = map f s
  · intro c₁ c₂ h
    match c₁, c₂, h with
    | _, c₂, Or.inl (Eq.refl _) => rcases destruct c₂ with b | cb <;> simp
    | _, _, Or.inr ⟨s, rfl, rfl⟩ =>
      induction s using recOn with
      | pure s => simp
      | think s => simpa using Or.inr ⟨s, rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨s, rfl, rfl⟩

name: bind_pure'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bind_pure' (s : Computation α) : bind s pure = s
proof:
:= by
  simpa using bind_pure id s

name: bind_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bind_assoc (s : Computation α) (f : α → Computation β) (g : β → Computation γ) :
    bind (bind s f) g = bind s fun x : α => bind (f x) g
proof:
:= by
  apply
    eq_of_bisim fun c₁ c₂ =>
      c₁ = c₂ ∨ ∃ s, c₁ = bind (bind s f) g ∧ c₂ = bind s fun x : α => bind (f x) g
  · intro c₁ c₂ h
    match c₁, c₂, h with
    | _, c₂, Or.inl (Eq.refl _) => rcases destruct c₂ with b | cb <;> simp
    | _, _, Or.inr ⟨s, rfl, rfl⟩ =>
      induction s using recOn with
      | pure s =>
        simp only [BisimO, ret_bind]; generalize f s = fs
        induction fs using recOn with
        | pure t => rw [ret_bind]; rcases destruct (g t) with b | cb <;> simp
        | think => simp
      | think s => simpa [BisimO] using Or.inr ⟨s, rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨s, rfl, rfl⟩

name: results_bind
statement:
theorem results_bind {s : Computation α} {f : α → Computation β} {a b m n} (h1 : Results s a m)
    (h2 : Results (f a) b n) : Results (bind s f) b (n + m)
proof:
:= by
  have := h1.mem; revert m
  apply memRecOn this _ fun s IH => _
  · intro _ h1
    rw [ret_bind]
    rw [h1.len_unique (results_pure _)]
    exact h2
  · intro _ h3 _ h1
    rw [think_bind]
    obtain ⟨m', h⟩ := of_results_think h1
    obtain ⟨h1, e⟩ := h
    rw [e]
    exact results_think (h3 h1)

name: mem_bind
statement:
theorem mem_bind {s : Computation α} {f : α → Computation β} {a b} (h1 : a ∈ s) (h2 : b ∈ f a) :
    b ∈ bind s f
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, h1⟩ := exists_results_of_mem h1
  let ⟨_, h2⟩ := exists_results_of_mem h2
  (results_bind h1 h2).mem

name: get_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem get_bind (s : Computation α) (f : α → Computation β) [Terminates s]
    [Terminates (f (get s))] : get (bind s f) = get (f (get s))

name: length_bind
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_bind (s : Computation α) (f : α → Computation β) [_T1 : Terminates s]
    [_T2 : Terminates (f (get s))] : length (bind s f) = length (f (get s)) + length s

name: of_results_bind
statement:
theorem of_results_bind {s : Computation α} {f : α → Computation β} {b k} :
    Results (bind s f) b k → ∃ a m n, Results s a m ∧ Results (f a) b n ∧ k = n + m
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing s with | zero | succ n IH <;>
  induction s using recOn with intro h | pure a | think s'
  · simp only [ret_bind] at h
    exact ⟨_, _, _, results_pure _, h, rfl⟩
  · have := congr_arg head (eq_thinkN h)
    contradiction
  · simp only [ret_bind] at h
    exact ⟨_, _, n + 1, results_pure _, h, rfl⟩
  · simp only [think_bind, results_think_iff] at h
    let ⟨a, m, n', h1, h2, e'⟩ := IH h
    rw [e']
    exact ⟨a, m.succ, n', results_think h1, h2, rfl⟩

name: exists_of_mem_bind
statement:
theorem exists_of_mem_bind {s : Computation α} {f : α → Computation β} {b} (h : b ∈ bind s f) :
    ∃ a ∈ s, b ∈ f a
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, h⟩ := exists_results_of_mem h
  let ⟨a, _, _, h1, h2, _⟩ := of_results_bind h
  ⟨a, h1.mem, h2.mem⟩

name: bind_promises
statement:
theorem bind_promises {s : Computation α} {f : α → Computation β} {a b} (h1 : s ~> a)
    (h2 : f a ~> b) : bind s f ~> b
proof:
:= fun b' bB => by
  rcases exists_of_mem_bind bB with ⟨a', a's, ba'⟩
  rw [← h1 a's] at ba'; exact h2 ba'

name: has_map_eq_map
statement: theorem has_map_eq_map {β} (f : α → β) (c : Computation α) : f <$> c = map f c

name: pure_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pure_def (a) : (return a : Computation α) = pure a

name: map_pure'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_pure' {α β} : ∀ (f : α → β) (a), f <$> pure a = pure (f a)

name: map_think'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_think' {α β} : ∀ (f : α → β) (s), f <$> think s = think (f <$> s)

name: mem_map
statement: theorem mem_map (f : α → β) {a} {s : Computation α} (m : a ∈ s) : f a ∈ map f s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bind_pure]; apply mem_bind m; apply ret_mem

name: exists_of_mem_map
statement:
theorem exists_of_mem_map {f : α → β} {b : β} {s : Computation α} (h : b ∈ map f s) :
    ∃ a, a ∈ s ∧ f a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bind_pure] at h
  let ⟨a, as, fb⟩ := exists_of_mem_bind h
  exact ⟨a, as, mem_unique (ret_mem _) fb⟩

name: terminates_map_iff
statement: theorem terminates_map_iff (f : α → β) (s : Computation α) : Terminates (map f s) ↔ Terminates s
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨⟨_, h⟩⟩ =>
    let ⟨_, h1, _⟩ := exists_of_mem_map h
    ⟨⟨_, h1⟩⟩,
    @Computation.terminates_map _ _ _ _⟩

name: ret_orElse
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ret_orElse (a : α) (c₂ : Computation α) : (pure a <|> c₂) = pure a

name: orElse_pure
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orElse_pure (c₁ : Computation α) (a : α) : (think c₁ <|> pure a) = pure a

name: orElse_think
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orElse_think (c₁ c₂ : Computation α) : (think c₁ <|> think c₂) = think (c₁ <|> c₂)

name: empty_orElse
statement:
@[simp]
theorem empty_orElse (c) : (empty α <|> c) = c
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_bisim (fun c₁ c₂ => (empty α <|> c₂) = c₁) _ rfl
  intro s' s h; rw [← h]
  induction s using recOn with rw [think_empty]
  | pure s => simp
  | think s => simp only [BisimO, orElse_think, destruct_think]; rw [← think_empty]

name: orElse_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orElse_empty (c : Computation α) : (c <|> empty α) = c
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_bisim (fun c₁ c₂ => (c₂ <|> empty α) = c₁) _ rfl
  intro s' s h; rw [← h]
  induction s using recOn with rw [think_empty]
  | pure s => simp
  | think s => simp only [BisimO, orElse_think, destruct_think]; rw [← think_empty]

name: Equiv.refl
statement:
@[refl]
theorem Equiv.refl (s : Computation α) : s ~ s

name: Equiv.symm
statement:
@[symm]
theorem Equiv.symm {s t : Computation α} : s ~ t → t ~ s

name: Equiv.trans
statement:
@[trans]
theorem Equiv.trans {s t u : Computation α} : s ~ t → t ~ u → s ~ u
proof:
:= fun h1 h2 a =>
  (h1 a).trans (h2 a)

name: Equiv.equivalence
statement: theorem Equiv.equivalence : Equivalence (@Equiv α)

name: equiv_of_mem
statement: theorem equiv_of_mem {s t : Computation α} {a} (h1 : a ∈ s) (h2 : a ∈ t) : s ~ t
proof:
:= fun a' =>
  ⟨fun ma => by rw [mem_unique ma h1]; exact h2, fun ma => by rw [mem_unique ma h2]; exact h1⟩

name: terminates_congr
statement: theorem terminates_congr {c₁ c₂ : Computation α} (h : c₁ ~ c₂) : Terminates c₁ ↔ Terminates c₂

name: promises_congr
statement: theorem promises_congr {c₁ c₂ : Computation α} (h : c₁ ~ c₂) (a) : c₁ ~> a ↔ c₂ ~> a
proof:
:=
  forall_congr' fun a' => imp_congr (h a') Iff.rfl

name: get_equiv
statement:
theorem get_equiv {c₁ c₂ : Computation α} (h : c₁ ~ c₂) [Terminates c₁] [Terminates c₂] :
    get c₁ = get c₂

name: think_equiv
statement: theorem think_equiv (s : Computation α) : think s ~ s

name: thinkN_equiv
statement: theorem thinkN_equiv (s : Computation α) (n) : thinkN s n ~ s

name: bind_congr
statement:
theorem bind_congr {s1 s2 : Computation α} {f1 f2 : α → Computation β} (h1 : s1 ~ s2)
    (h2 : ∀ a, f1 a ~ f2 a) : bind s1 f1 ~ bind s2 f2
proof:
:= fun b =>
  ⟨fun h =>
    let ⟨a, ha, hb⟩ := exists_of_mem_bind h
    mem_bind ((h1 a).1 ha) ((h2 a b).1 hb),
    fun h =>
    let ⟨a, ha, hb⟩ := exists_of_mem_bind h
    mem_bind ((h1 a).2 ha) ((h2 a b).2 hb)⟩

name: equiv_pure_of_mem
statement: theorem equiv_pure_of_mem {s : Computation α} {a} (h : a ∈ s) : s ~ pure a

name: LiftRel.swap
statement:
theorem LiftRel.swap (R : α → β → Prop) (ca : Computation α) (cb : Computation β) :
    LiftRel (swap R) cb ca ↔ LiftRel R ca cb

name: lift_eq_iff_equiv
statement: theorem lift_eq_iff_equiv (c₁ c₂ : Computation α) : LiftRel (· = ·) c₁ c₂ ↔ c₁ ~ c₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ a =>
    ⟨fun a1 => by let ⟨b, b2, ab⟩ := h1 a1; rwa [ab],
     fun a2 => by let ⟨b, b1, ab⟩ := h2 a2; rwa [← ab]⟩,
    fun e => ⟨fun {a} a1 => ⟨a, (e _).1 a1, rfl⟩, fun {a} a2 => ⟨a, (e _).2 a2, rfl⟩⟩⟩

name: LiftRel.equiv
statement:
theorem LiftRel.equiv (R : α → α → Prop) (H : Equivalence R) : Equivalence (LiftRel R) where
  refl
proof:
:= @LiftRel.refl α R H.stdRefl |>.refl
  symm := @LiftRel.symm α R H.stdSymm |>.symm _ _
  trans := @LiftRel.trans α R H.isTrans |>.trans _ _ _

name: LiftRel.imp
statement:
theorem LiftRel.imp {R S : α → β → Prop} (H : ∀ {a b}, R a b → S a b) (s t) :
    LiftRel R s t → LiftRel S s t
  | ⟨l, r⟩ =>
    ⟨fun {_} as =>
      let ⟨b, bt, ab⟩
proof:
:= l as
      ⟨b, bt, H ab⟩,
      fun {_} bt =>
      let ⟨a, as, ab⟩ := r bt
      ⟨a, as, H ab⟩⟩

name: terminates_of_liftRel
statement:
theorem terminates_of_liftRel {R : α → β → Prop} {s t} :
    LiftRel R s t → (Terminates s ↔ Terminates t)
  | ⟨l, r⟩ =>
    ⟨fun ⟨⟨_, as⟩⟩ =>
      let ⟨b, bt, _⟩
proof:
:= l as
      ⟨⟨b, bt⟩⟩,
      fun ⟨⟨_, bt⟩⟩ =>
      let ⟨a, as, _⟩ := r bt
      ⟨⟨a, as⟩⟩⟩

name: rel_of_liftRel
statement:
theorem rel_of_liftRel {R : α → β → Prop} {ca cb} :
    LiftRel R ca cb → ∀ {a b}, a ∈ ca → b ∈ cb → R a b
  | ⟨l, _⟩, a, b, ma, mb => by
    let ⟨b', mb', ab'⟩
proof:
:= l ma
    rw [mem_unique mb mb']; exact ab'

name: liftRel_of_mem
statement:
theorem liftRel_of_mem {R : α → β → Prop} {a b ca cb} (ma : a ∈ ca) (mb : b ∈ cb) (ab : R a b) :
    LiftRel R ca cb
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun {a'} ma' => by rw [mem_unique ma' ma]; exact ⟨b, mb, ab⟩, fun {b'} mb' => by
    rw [mem_unique mb' mb]; exact ⟨a, ma, ab⟩⟩

name: exists_of_liftRel_left
statement:
theorem exists_of_liftRel_left {R : α → β → Prop} {ca cb} (H : LiftRel R ca cb) {a} (h : a ∈ ca) :
    ∃ b, b ∈ cb ∧ R a b

name: exists_of_liftRel_right
statement:
theorem exists_of_liftRel_right {R : α → β → Prop} {ca cb} (H : LiftRel R ca cb) {b} (h : b ∈ cb) :
    ∃ a, a ∈ ca ∧ R a b

name: liftRel_def
statement:
theorem liftRel_def {R : α → β → Prop} {ca cb} :
    LiftRel R ca cb ↔ (Terminates ca ↔ Terminates cb) ∧ ∀ {a b}, a ∈ ca → b ∈ cb → R a b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    ⟨terminates_of_liftRel h, fun {a b} ma mb => by
      let ⟨b', mb', ab⟩ := h.left ma
      rwa [mem_unique mb mb']⟩,
    fun ⟨l, r⟩ =>
    ⟨fun {_} ma =>
      let ⟨⟨b, mb⟩⟩ := l.1 ⟨⟨_, ma⟩⟩
      ⟨b, mb, r ma mb⟩,
      fun {_} mb =>
      let ⟨⟨a, ma⟩⟩ := l.2 ⟨⟨_, mb⟩⟩
      ⟨a, ma, r ma mb⟩⟩⟩

name: liftRel_bind
proof:
:=
  let ⟨l1, r1⟩ := h1
  ⟨fun {_} cB =>
    let ⟨_, a1, c₁⟩ := exists_of_mem_bind cB
    let ⟨_, b2, ab⟩ := l1 a1
    let ⟨l2, _⟩ := h2 ab
    let ⟨_, d2, cd⟩ := l2 c₁
    ⟨_, mem_bind b2 d2, cd⟩,
    fun {_} dB =>
    let ⟨_, b1, d1⟩ := exists_of_mem_bind dB
    let ⟨_, a2, ab⟩ := r1 b1
    let ⟨_, r2⟩ := h2 ab
    let ⟨_, c₂, cd⟩ := r2 d1
    ⟨_, mem_bind a2 c₂, cd⟩⟩

name: liftRel_pure_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftRel_pure_left (R : α → β → Prop) (a : α) (cb : Computation β) :
    LiftRel R (pure a) cb ↔ ∃ b, b ∈ cb ∧ R a b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨l, _⟩ => l (ret_mem _), fun ⟨b, mb, ab⟩ =>
    ⟨fun {a'} ma' => by rw [eq_of_pure_mem ma']; exact ⟨b, mb, ab⟩, fun {b'} mb' =>
      ⟨_, ret_mem _, by rw [mem_unique mb' mb]; exact ab⟩⟩⟩

name: liftRel_pure_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftRel_pure_right (R : α → β → Prop) (ca : Computation α) (b : β) :
    LiftRel R ca (pure b) ↔ ∃ a, a ∈ ca ∧ R a b

name: liftRel_pure
statement:
theorem liftRel_pure (R : α → β → Prop) (a : α) (b : β) :
    LiftRel R (pure a) (pure b) ↔ R a b

name: liftRel_think_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftRel_think_left (R : α → β → Prop) (ca : Computation α) (cb : Computation β) :
    LiftRel R (think ca) cb ↔ LiftRel R ca cb
proof:
:=
  and_congr (forall_congr' fun _ => imp_congr ⟨of_think_mem, think_mem⟩ Iff.rfl)
    (forall_congr' fun _ =>
      imp_congr Iff.rfl <| exists_congr fun _ => and_congr ⟨of_think_mem, think_mem⟩ Iff.rfl)

name: liftRel_think_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftRel_think_right (R : α → β → Prop) (ca : Computation α) (cb : Computation β) :
    LiftRel R ca (think cb) ↔ LiftRel R ca cb
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LiftRel.swap R, ← LiftRel.swap R]; apply liftRel_think_left

name: liftRel_mem_cases
statement:
theorem liftRel_mem_cases {R : α → β → Prop} {ca cb} (Ha : ∀ a ∈ ca, LiftRel R ca cb)
    (Hb : ∀ b ∈ cb, LiftRel R ca cb) : LiftRel R ca cb
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun {_} ma => (Ha _ ma).left ma, fun {_} mb => (Hb _ mb).right mb⟩

name: liftRel_congr
statement:
theorem liftRel_congr {R : α → β → Prop} {ca ca' : Computation α} {cb cb' : Computation β}
    (ha : ca ~ ca') (hb : cb ~ cb') : LiftRel R ca cb ↔ LiftRel R ca' cb'
proof:
:=
  and_congr
    (forall_congr' fun _ => imp_congr (ha _) <| exists_congr fun _ => and_congr (hb _) Iff.rfl)
    (forall_congr' fun _ => imp_congr (hb _) <| exists_congr fun _ => and_congr (ha _) Iff.rfl)

name: liftRel_map
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bind_pure, ← bind_pure]; apply liftRel_bind _ _ h1; simpa

name: map_congr
statement:
theorem map_congr {s1 s2 : Computation α} {f : α → β}
    (h1 : s1 ~ s2) : map f s1 ~ map f s2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lift_eq_iff_equiv]
  exact liftRel_map Eq _ ((lift_eq_iff_equiv _ _).2 h1) fun {a} b => congr_arg _

name: liftRelAux_inl_inl
statement: @[simp] lemma liftRelAux_inl_inl {a : α} {b : β} : LiftRelAux R C (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inl b) = R a b

name: liftRelAux_inl_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma liftRelAux_inl_inr {a : α} {cb} :
    LiftRelAux R C (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inr cb) = ∃ b, b ∈ cb ∧ R a b

name: liftRelAux_inr_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma liftRelAux_inr_inl {b : β} {ca} :
    LiftRelAux R C (Sum.inr ca) (Sum.inl b) = ∃ a, a ∈ ca ∧ R a b

name: liftRelAux_inr_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma liftRelAux_inr_inr {ca cb} :
    LiftRelAux R C (Sum.inr ca) (Sum.inr cb) = C ca cb

name: LiftRelAux.ret_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem LiftRelAux.ret_left (R : α → β → Prop) (C : Computation α → Computation β → Prop) (a cb) :
    LiftRelAux R C (Sum.inl a) (destruct cb) ↔ ∃ b, b ∈ cb ∧ R a b
proof:
:= by
  induction cb using recOn with
  | pure b =>
    exact
      ⟨fun h => ⟨_, ret_mem _, h⟩, fun ⟨b', mb, h⟩ => by rw [mem_unique (ret_mem _) mb]; exact h⟩
  | think cb =>
    rw [destruct_think]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨b, h, r⟩ => ⟨b, think_mem h, r⟩, fun ⟨b, h, r⟩ => ⟨b, of_think_mem h, r⟩⟩

name: LiftRelAux.swap
statement:
theorem LiftRelAux.swap (R : α → β → Prop) (C) (a b) :
    LiftRelAux (swap R) (swap C) b a = LiftRelAux R C a b
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with a | ca <;> rcases b with b | cb <;> simp only [LiftRelAux]

name: LiftRelAux.ret_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem LiftRelAux.ret_right (R : α → β → Prop) (C : Computation α → Computation β → Prop) (b ca) :
    LiftRelAux R C (destruct ca) (Sum.inl b) ↔ ∃ a, a ∈ ca ∧ R a b

name: LiftRelRec.lem
statement:
theorem LiftRelRec.lem {R : α → β → Prop} (C : Computation α → Computation β → Prop)
    (H : ∀ {ca cb}, C ca cb → LiftRelAux R C (destruct ca) (destruct cb)) (ca cb) (Hc : C ca cb) (a)
    (ha : a ∈ ca) : LiftRel R ca cb
proof:
:= by
  revert cb
  refine memRecOn (C := (fun ca ↦ ∀ (cb : Computation β), C ca cb → LiftRel R ca cb))
    ha ?_ (fun ca' IH => ?_) <;> intro cb Hc <;> have h := H Hc
  · simp only [destruct_pure, LiftRelAux.ret_left] at h
    simp [h]
  · simp only [liftRel_think_left]
    induction cb using recOn with
    | pure b => simpa using h
    | think cb => simpa [h] using IH _ h

name: liftRel_rec
statement:
theorem liftRel_rec {R : α → β → Prop} (C : Computation α → Computation β → Prop)
    (H : ∀ {ca cb}, C ca cb → LiftRelAux R C (destruct ca) (destruct cb)) (ca cb) (Hc : C ca cb) :
    LiftRel R ca cb
proof:
:=
  liftRel_mem_cases (LiftRelRec.lem C (@H) ca cb Hc) fun b hb =>
    (LiftRel.swap _ _ _).2 <|
      LiftRelRec.lem (swap C) (fun {_ _} h => cast (LiftRelAux.swap _ _ _ _).symm <| H h) cb ca Hc b
        hb

name: length'_of_terminates
statement:
theorem length'_of_terminates {s : Seq α} (h : s.Terminates) :
    s.length' = s.length h

name: length'_of_not_terminates
statement:
theorem length'_of_not_terminates {s : Seq α} (h : ¬ s.Terminates) :
    s.length' = ⊤

name: length_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_nil : length (nil : Seq α) terminates_nil = 0

name: length'_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length'_nil : length' (nil : Seq α) = 0

name: length_cons
statement:
theorem length_cons {x : α} {s : Seq α} (h : s.Terminates) :
    (cons x s).length (terminates_cons_iff.mpr h) = s.length h + 1

name: length'_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length'_cons (x : α) (s : Seq α) :
    (cons x s).length' = s.length' + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : (cons x s).Terminates <;> have h' := h <;> rw [terminates_cons_iff] at h'
  · simp [length'_of_terminates h, length'_of_terminates h', length_cons h']
  · simp [length'_of_not_terminates h, length'_of_not_terminates h']

name: length_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_eq_zero {s : Seq α} {h : s.Terminates} :
    s.length h = 0 ↔ s = nil

name: length'_eq_zero_iff_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length'_eq_zero_iff_nil (s : Seq α) :
    s.length' = 0 ↔ s = nil

name: length'_ne_zero_iff_cons
statement:
theorem length'_ne_zero_iff_cons (s : Seq α) :
    s.length' ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ x s', s = cons x s'

name: length_le_iff'
statement:
theorem length_le_iff' {s : Seq α} {n : ℕ} :
    (∃ h, s.length h ≤ n) ↔ s.TerminatedAt n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [length, Nat.find_le_iff, TerminatedAt, Terminates, exists_prop]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, k, hkn, hk⟩
    exact le_stable s hkn hk
  · intro hn
    exact ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, ⟨n, le_rfl, hn⟩⟩

name: length_le_iff
statement:
theorem length_le_iff {s : Seq α} {n : ℕ} {h : s.Terminates} :
    s.length h ≤ n ↔ s.TerminatedAt n

name: length'_le_iff
statement:
theorem length'_le_iff {s : Seq α} {n : ℕ} :
    s.length' ≤ n ↔ s.TerminatedAt n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : s.Terminates
  · simpa [length'_of_terminates h, ENat.natCast_le_natCast] using length_le_iff
  · simpa [length'_of_not_terminates h] using forall_not_of_not_exists h n

name: lt_length_iff'
statement:
theorem lt_length_iff' {s : Seq α} {n : ℕ} :
    (∀ h : s.Terminates, n < s.length h) ↔ ∃ a, a ∈ s.get? n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Terminates, TerminatedAt, length, Nat.lt_find_iff, forall_exists_index, Option.mem_def,
    ← Option.ne_none_iff_exists', ne_eq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h hn
    exact h n hn n le_rfl hn
  · intro hn _ _ k hkn hk
    exact hn <| le_stable s hkn hk

name: lt_length_iff
statement:
theorem lt_length_iff {s : Seq α} {n : ℕ} {h : s.Terminates} :
    n < s.length h ↔ ∃ a, a ∈ s.get? n

name: lt_length'_iff
statement:
theorem lt_length'_iff {s : Seq α} {n : ℕ} :
    n < s.length' ↔ ∃ a, a ∈ s.get? n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : s.Terminates
  · simpa [length'_of_terminates h, ENat.natCast_lt_natCast] using lt_length_iff
  · simp only [length'_of_not_terminates h, ENat.natCast_lt_top, Option.mem_def, true_iff]
    rw [not_terminates_iff] at h
    rw [← Option.isSome_iff_exists]
    exact h n

name: ofStream_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofStream_cons (a : α) (s) : ofStream (a::s) = cons a (ofStream s)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext; simp only [ofStream, cons]; rw [Stream'.map_cons]

name: terminatedAt_ofList
statement:
theorem terminatedAt_ofList (l : List α) :
    (ofList l).TerminatedAt l.length

name: terminates_ofList
statement: theorem terminates_ofList (l : List α) : (ofList l).Terminates

name: take_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem take_nil {n : ℕ} : (nil (α := α)).take n = List.nil

name: take_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem take_zero {s : Seq α} : s.take 0 = []

name: take_succ_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem take_succ_cons {n : ℕ} {x : α} {s : Seq α} :
    (cons x s).take (n + 1) = x :: s.take n

name: getElem
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem getElem?_take : ∀ (n k : ℕ) (s : Seq α),
    (s.take k)[n]? = if n < k then s.get? n else none
  | n, 0, s => by simp [take]
  | n, k + 1, s => by
    rw [take]
    cases h : destruct s with
    | none =>
      simp [destruct_eq_none h]
    | some a =>
      match a with
      | (x, r) =>
        rw [destruct_eq_cons h]
        match n with
        | 0 => simp
        | n + 1 => simp [List.getElem?_cons_succ, getElem?_take]

name: get
statement:
theorem get?_mem_take {s : Seq α} {m n : ℕ} (h_mn : m < n) {x : α}
    (h_get : s.get? m = some x) : x ∈ s.take n
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing n s with
  | zero =>
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := Nat.exists_add_one_eq.mpr h_mn
    rw [← hl, take, head_eq_some h_get]
    simp
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt h_mn
    have : ∃ y, s.get? 0 = some y := by
      apply ge_stable _ _ h_get
      simp
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := this
    rw [take, head_eq_some hy]
    simp only [destruct_cons, List.mem_cons]
    right
    apply ih (by lia)
    rwa [get?_tail]

name: length_take_le
statement: theorem length_take_le {s : Seq α} {n : ℕ} : (s.take n).length ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [take]
    cases s.destruct with
    | none => simp
    | some v =>
      obtain ⟨x, r⟩ := v
      simpa using ih

name: length_take_of_le_length
statement:
theorem length_take_of_le_length {s : Seq α} {n : ℕ}
    (hle : ∀ h : s.Terminates, n ≤ s.length h) : (s.take n).length = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => simp [take]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [take, destruct]
      let ⟨a, ha⟩ := lt_length_iff'.1 (fun ht => lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.succ_pos _) (hle ht))
      simp only [Option.mem_def.1 ha, Option.map_eq_map, Option.map_some, List.length_cons,
        Nat.add_right_cancel_iff]
      rw [ih]
      intro h
      simp only [length, tail, Nat.le_find_iff, TerminatedAt, get?_mk, Stream'.tail]
      intro m hmn hs
      have := lt_length_iff'.1 (fun ht => (Nat.lt_of_succ_le (hle ht)))
      rw [le_stable s (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hmn) hs] at this
      simp at this

name: length_toList
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_toList (s : Seq α) (h : s.Terminates) : (toList s h).length = length s h
proof:
:= by
  rw [toList, length_take_of_le_length]
  intro _
  exact le_rfl

name: getElem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem getElem?_toList (s : Seq α) (h : s.Terminates) (n : ℕ) : (toList s h)[n]? = s.get? n
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp only [toList, getElem?_take, Nat.lt_find_iff, length,
    Option.ite_none_right_eq_some, and_iff_right_iff_imp, TerminatedAt]
  intro h m hmn
  let ⟨a, ha⟩ := ge_stable s hmn h
  simp [ha]

name: ofList_toList
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofList_toList (s : Seq α) (h : s.Terminates) :
    ofList (toList s h) = s

name: toList_ofList
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toList_ofList (l : List α) : toList (ofList l) (terminates_ofList l) = l

name: toList_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toList_nil : toList (nil : Seq α) ⟨0, terminatedAt_zero_iff.2 rfl⟩ = []

name: getLast
statement:
theorem getLast?_toList (s : Seq α) (h : s.Terminates) :
    (toList s h).getLast? = s.get? (s.length h - 1)

name: cons_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cons_append (a : α) (s t) : append (cons a s) t = cons a (append s t)
proof:
:=
  destruct_eq_cons <| by
    dsimp [append]; rw [corec_eq]
    dsimp [append]; rw [destruct_cons]

name: nil_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nil_append (s : Seq α) : append nil s = s
proof:
:= by
  apply coinduction2; intro s
  dsimp [append]; rw [corec_eq]
  dsimp [append]
  cases s
  · trivial
  · rw [destruct_cons]
    dsimp
    exact ⟨rfl, _, rfl, rfl⟩

name: append_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem append_nil (s : Seq α) : append s nil = s
proof:
:= by
  apply coinduction2 s; intro s
  cases s
  · trivial
  · rw [cons_append, destruct_cons, destruct_cons]
    dsimp
    exact ⟨rfl, _, rfl, rfl⟩

name: append_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem append_assoc (s t u : Seq α) : append (append s t) u = append s (append t u)
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_bisim fun s1 s2 => ∃ s t u, s1 = append (append s t) u ∧ s2 = append s (append t u)
  · rintro _ _ ⟨s, t, u, rfl, rfl⟩
    cases s with
    | nil =>
      cases t with
      | nil =>
        cases u with
        | nil => simp
        | cons _ u => simpa using ⟨nil, nil, u, by simp, by simp⟩
      | cons _ t => simpa using ⟨nil, t, u, by simp, by simp⟩
    | cons _ s => simpa using ⟨s, t, u, rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨s, t, u, rfl, rfl⟩

name: of_mem_append
statement: theorem of_mem_append {s₁ s₂ : Seq α} {a : α} (h : a ∈ append s₁ s₂) : a ∈ s₁ ∨ a ∈ s₂
proof:
:= by
  have := h; revert this
  generalize e : append s₁ s₂ = ss; intro h; revert s₁
  apply mem_rec_on h _
  intro b s' o s₁
  cases s₁ with
  | nil =>
    intro m _
    apply Or.inr
    simpa using m
  | cons c t₁ =>
    intro m e
    have := congr_arg destruct e
    rcases show a = c ∨ a ∈ append t₁ s₂ by simpa using m with e' | m
    · rw [e']
      exact Or.inl (mem_cons _ _)
    · obtain ⟨i1, i2⟩ := show c = b ∧ append t₁ s₂ = s' by simpa using e
      rcases o with e' | IH
      · simp [i1, e']
      · exact Or.imp_left (mem_cons_of_mem _) (IH m i2)

name: mem_append_left
statement: theorem mem_append_left {s₁ s₂ : Seq α} {a : α} (h : a ∈ s₁) : a ∈ append s₁ s₂
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_rec_on h; intros; simp [*]

name: ofList_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofList_append (l l' : List α) : ofList (l ++ l') = append (ofList l) (ofList l')

name: ofStream_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofStream_append (l : List α) (s : Stream' α) :
    ofStream (l ++ₛ s) = append (ofList l) (ofStream s)
proof:
:= by
  induction l <;> simp [*, Stream'.nil_append_stream, Stream'.cons_append_stream]

name: map_get
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_get? (f : α → β) : ∀ s n, get? (map f s) n = (get? s n).map f
  | ⟨_, _⟩, _ => rfl

@[simp]

name: map_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_nil (f : α → β) : map f nil = nil

name: map_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_cons (f : α → β) (a) : ∀ s, map f (cons a s) = cons (f a) (map f s)
  | ⟨s, al⟩ => by apply Subtype.ext; dsimp [cons, map]; rw [Stream'.map_cons]; rfl

@[simp]

name: map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id : ∀ s : Seq α, map id s = s
  | ⟨s, al⟩ => by
    apply Subtype.ext; dsimp [map]
    rw [Option.map_id, Stream'.map_id]

@[simp]

name: map_tail
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_tail (f : α → β) : ∀ s, map f (tail s) = tail (map f s)
  | ⟨s, al⟩ => by apply Subtype.ext; dsimp [tail, map]

name: map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) : ∀ s : Seq α, map (g ∘ f) s = map g (map f s)
  | ⟨s, al⟩ => by
    apply Subtype.ext; dsimp [map]
    apply congr_arg fun f : _ → Option γ => Stream'.map f s
    ext ⟨⟩ <;> rfl

@[simp]

name: terminatedAt_map_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem terminatedAt_map_iff {f : α → β} {s : Seq α} {n : ℕ} :
    (map f s).TerminatedAt n ↔ s.TerminatedAt n

name: terminates_map_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem terminates_map_iff {f : α → β} {s : Seq α} :
    (map f s).Terminates ↔ s.Terminates

name: length_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_map {s : Seq α} {f : α → β} (h : (s.map f).Terminates) :
    (s.map f).length h = s.length (terminates_map_iff.1 h)

name: length'_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length'_map {s : Seq α} {f : α → β} :
    (s.map f).length' = s.length'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : (s.map f).Terminates <;> have h' := h <;> rw [terminates_map_iff] at h'
  · rw [length'_of_terminates h, length'_of_terminates h', length_map h]
  · rw [length'_of_not_terminates h, length'_of_not_terminates h']

name: mem_map
statement:
theorem mem_map (f : α → β) {a : α} : ∀ {s : Seq α}, a ∈ s → f a ∈ map f s
  | ⟨_, _⟩ => Stream'.mem_map (Option.map f)

name: exists_of_mem_map
statement: theorem exists_of_mem_map {f} {b : β} : ∀ {s : Seq α}, b ∈ map f s → ∃ a, a ∈ s ∧ f a = b
proof:
:=
  fun {s} h => by match s with
  | ⟨g, al⟩ =>
    let ⟨o, om, oe⟩ := @Stream'.exists_of_mem_map _ _ (Option.map f) (some b) g h
    rcases o with - | a
    · injection oe
    · injection oe with h'; exact ⟨a, om, h'⟩

name: map_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_append (f : α → β) (s t) : map f (append s t) = append (map f s) (map f t)
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_bisim (fun s1 s2 => ∃ s t, s1 = map f (append s t) ∧ s2 = append (map f s) (map f t))
    ?_ ⟨s, t, rfl, rfl⟩
  rintro s1 s2 ⟨s, t, rfl, rfl⟩
  cases s with
  | nil =>
    cases t with
    | nil => simp
    | cons _ t => simpa using ⟨nil, t, by simp, by simp⟩
  | cons _ s => simpa using ⟨s, t, rfl, rfl⟩

name: join_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem join_nil : join nil = (nil : Seq α)

name: join_cons_nil
statement: theorem join_cons_nil (a : α) (S) : join (cons (a, nil) S) = cons a (join S)

name: join_cons_cons
statement:
theorem join_cons_cons (a b : α) (s S) :
    join (cons (a, cons b s) S) = cons a (join (cons (b, s) S))

name: join_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem join_cons (a : α) (s S) : join (cons (a, s) S) = cons a (append s (join S))
proof:
:= by
  apply
    eq_of_bisim
      (fun s1 s2 => s1 = s2 ∨ ∃ a s S, s1 = join (cons (a, s) S) ∧ s2 = cons a (append s (join S)))
      _ (Or.inr ⟨a, s, S, rfl, rfl⟩)
  intro s1 s2 h
  exact
    match s1, s2, h with
    | s, _, Or.inl <| Eq.refl s => by
      cases s; · trivial
      · rw [destruct_cons]
        exact ⟨rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩
    | _, _, Or.inr ⟨a, s, S, rfl, rfl⟩ => by
      cases s
      · simp [join_cons_nil]
      · simpa only [BisimO, join_cons_cons, destruct_cons, cons_append, true_and] using
          Or.inr ⟨_, _, S, rfl, rfl⟩

name: join_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem join_append (S T : Seq (Seq1 α)) : join (append S T) = append (join S) (join T)
proof:
:= by
  apply
    eq_of_bisim fun s1 s2 =>
      ∃ s S T, s1 = append s (join (append S T)) ∧ s2 = append s (append (join S) (join T))
  · rintro s1 s2 ⟨s, S, T, rfl, rfl⟩
    cases s with
    | nil =>
      cases S with
      | nil =>
        cases T with
        | nil => simp
        | cons s T =>
          obtain ⟨a, s⟩ := s
          simpa using ⟨s, nil, T, by simp, by simp⟩
      | cons s S =>
        obtain ⟨a, s⟩ := s
        simpa using ⟨s, S, T, rfl, rfl⟩
    | cons _ s => simpa using ⟨s, S, T, rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨nil, S, T, by simp, by simp⟩

name: drop_get
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem drop_get? {n m : ℕ} {s : Seq α} : (s.drop n).get? m = s.get? (n + m)
proof:

  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => simp [drop]

    convert! ih using 2

name: dropn_add

name: dropn_tail

name: head_dropn

    cases s with

    | cons x s =>
      simp only [drop_succ_cons, length'_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      convert! drop_length' using 1
      generalize s.length' = m
      enat_to_nat
      lia

all_of_get
