name: all_coind_drop_motive
statement:
lemma all_coind_drop_motive {s : Seq α} (motive : Seq α → Prop) (base : motive s)
    (step : ∀ hd tl, motive (.cons hd tl) → motive tl) (n : ℕ) :
    motive (s.drop n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa
  | succ m ih =>
    simp only [drop]
    generalize s.drop m = t at *
    cases t
    · simpa
    · exact step _ _ ih

name: all_coind
statement:
theorem all_coind {s : Seq α} {p : α → Prop}
    (motive : Seq α → Prop) (base : motive s)
    (step : ∀ hd tl, motive (.cons hd tl) → p hd ∧ motive tl) :
    ∀ x ∈ s, p x
proof:
:= by
  apply all_of_get
  intro n
  have := all_coind_drop_motive motive base (fun hd tl ih ↦ (step hd tl ih).right) n
  rw [← head_dropn]
  generalize s.drop n = s' at this
  cases s' with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl => simp [(step hd tl this).left]

name: map_all_iff
statement:
theorem map_all_iff {β : Type u} {f : α → β} {p : β → Prop} {s : Seq α} :
    (∀ x ∈ (s.map f), p x) ↔ (∀ x ∈ s, (p ∘ f) x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ hx ↦ ?_, fun _ _ hx ↦ ?_⟩
  · solve_by_elim [mem_map f hx]
  · obtain ⟨_, _, hx'⟩ := exists_of_mem_map hx
    rw [← hx']
    solve_by_elim

name: take_all
statement:
theorem take_all {s : Seq α} {p : α → Prop} (h_all : ∀ x ∈ s, p x) {n : ℕ} {x : α}
    (hx : x ∈ s.take n) : p x
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => simp [take] at hx
  | succ m ih =>
    cases s with
    | nil => simp at hx
    | cons hd tl =>
      simp only [take_succ_cons, List.mem_cons, mem_cons_iff, forall_eq_or_imp] at hx h_all
      rcases hx with (rfl | hx)
      exacts [h_all.left, ih h_all.right hx]

name: set_all
statement:
theorem set_all {p : α → Prop} {s : Seq α} (h_all : ∀ x ∈ s, p x) {n : ℕ} {x : α}
    (hx : p x) : ∀ y ∈ (s.set n x), p y
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  simp only [mem_iff_exists_get?] at hy
  obtain ⟨m, hy⟩ := hy
  rcases eq_or_ne n m with (rfl | h_nm)
  · by_cases h_term : s.TerminatedAt n
    · simp [get?_set_of_terminatedAt _ h_term] at hy
    · simp_all [get?_set_of_not_terminatedAt _ h_term]
  · rw [get?_set_of_ne _ _ h_nm.symm] at hy
    apply h_all _ (get?_mem hy.symm)

@[simp]
theorem Pairwise.nil {R : α → α → Prop} : Pairwise R (@nil α)

name: Pairwise.cons
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Pairwise] at *
  intro i j h_ij x hx y hy
  cases j with
  | zero => simp at h_ij
  | succ k =>
    simp only [get?_cons_succ] at hy
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      simp only [get?_cons_zero, Option.mem_def, Option.some.injEq] at hx
      exact hx ▸ all_get h_hd hy
    | succ n => exact h_tl n k (by lia) x hx y hy

name: Pairwise.cons_elim
statement:
theorem Pairwise.cons_elim {R : α → α → Prop} {hd : α} {tl : Seq α}
    (h : Pairwise R (.cons hd tl)) : (∀ x ∈ tl, R hd x) ∧ Pairwise R tl
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Pairwise] at *
  refine ⟨?_, fun i j h_ij ↦ h (i + 1) (j + 1) (by lia)⟩
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_iff_exists_get?] at hx
  obtain ⟨n, hx⟩ := hx
  simpa [← hx] using h 0 (n + 1) (by lia)

statement:
@[simp]
theorem Pairwise_cons_nil {R : α → α → Prop} {hd : α} : Pairwise R (cons hd nil)

name: Pairwise_cons_cons_head
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Pairwise] at h
  simpa using h 0 1 Nat.one_pos

name: Pairwise.cons_cons_of_trans
proof:
:= by
  apply Pairwise.cons _ h_tl
  simp only [mem_cons_iff, forall_eq_or_imp]
  exact ⟨h_hd, fun x hx ↦ Trans.simple h_hd ((cons_elim h_tl).left x hx)⟩

name: Pairwise.coind
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Pairwise]
  intro i j h_ij x hx y hy
  obtain ⟨k, hj⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt h_ij
  rw [← head_dropn] at hx
  rw [hj, ← head_dropn, Nat.add_assoc, dropn_add, head_dropn] at hy
  have := all_coind_drop_motive motive base (fun hd tl ih ↦ (step hd tl ih).right) i
  generalize s.drop i = s' at *
  cases s' with
  | nil => simp at hx
  | cons hd tl =>
    simp only [head_cons, Option.mem_def, Option.some.injEq, get?_cons_succ] at hx hy
    exact hx ▸ all_get (step hd tl this).left hy

name: Pairwise.coind_trans
statement:
theorem Pairwise.coind_trans {R : α → α → Prop} [IsTrans α R] {s : Seq α}
    (motive : Seq α → Prop) (base : motive s)
    (step : ∀ hd tl, motive (.cons hd tl) → (∀ x ∈ tl.head, R hd x) ∧ motive tl) :
    Pairwise R s
proof:
:= by
  have h_succ {n} {x y} (hx : s.get? n = some x) (hy : s.get? (n + 1) = some y) : R x y := by
    rw [← head_dropn] at hx
    have := all_coind_drop_motive motive base (fun hd tl ih ↦ (step hd tl ih).right)
    exact (step x (s.drop (n + 1)) (head_eq_some hx ▸ this n)).left _ (by simpa)
  simp only [Pairwise]
  intro i j h_ij x hx y hy
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt h_ij
  clear h_ij
  induction k generalizing y with
  | zero => exact h_succ hx hy
  | succ k ih =>
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := ge_stable (m := i + k + 1) _ (by lia) hy
    exact _root_.trans (ih z hz) <| h_succ hz hy

statement:
theorem Pairwise_tail {R : α → α → Prop} {s : Seq α} (h : s.Pairwise R) :

statement:
theorem Pairwise_drop {R : α → α → Prop} {s : Seq α} (h : s.Pairwise R) {n : ℕ} :

  | zero => simpa
  | succ m ih => simp [drop, Pairwise_tail ih]

name: at_least_as_long_as_coind
statement:
theorem at_least_as_long_as_coind {a : Seq α} {b : Seq β}
    (motive : Seq α → Seq β → Prop) (base : motive a b)
    (step : ∀ a b, motive a b →
      (∀ b_hd b_tl, (b = .cons b_hd b_tl) → ∃ a_hd a_tl, a = .cons a_hd a_tl ∧ motive a_tl b_tl)) :
    b.length' ≤ a.length'
proof:
:= by
  have (n) (hb : b.drop n ≠ .nil) : motive (a.drop n) (b.drop n) := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa
    | succ m ih =>
      simp only [drop] at hb ⊢
      generalize b.drop m = tb at *
      cases tb with
      | nil => simp at hb
      | cons tb_hd tb_tl =>
        simp only [ne_eq, cons_ne_nil, not_false_eq_true, forall_const] at ih
        obtain ⟨a_hd, a_tl, ha, h_tail⟩ := step (a.drop m) (.cons tb_hd tb_tl) ih _ _ rfl
        simpa [ha]
  by_cases ha : a.Terminates; swap
  · simp [length'_of_not_terminates ha]
  simp only [length'_of_terminates ha, length'_le_iff]
  by_contra hb
  have hb_cons : b.drop (a.length ha) ≠ .nil := by
    intro hb'
    simp only [← length'_eq_zero_iff_nil, drop_length', tsub_eq_zero_iff_le, length'_le_iff] at hb'
    contradiction
  specialize this (a.length ha) hb_cons
  generalize b.drop (a.length ha) = b' at *
  cases b' with
  | nil =>
    contradiction
  | cons b_hd b_tl =>
    obtain ⟨a_hd, a_tl, ha', _⟩ := step _ _ this _ _ rfl
    apply_fun length' at ha'
    simp only [drop_length', length'_of_terminates ha, tsub_self, length'_cons] at ha'
    generalize a_tl.length' = u at ha'
    enat_to_nat
    lia

name: map_join'

@[simp]
theorem map_join' (f : α → β) (S) : Seq.map f (Seq.join S) = Seq.join (Seq.map (map f) S)
proof:
:= by
  apply
    Seq.eq_of_bisim fun s1 s2 =>
      ∃ s S,
        s1 = Seq.append s (Seq.map f (Seq.join S)) ∧ s2 = append s (Seq.join (Seq.map (map f) S))
  · rintro s1 s2 ⟨s, S, rfl, rfl⟩
    cases s with
    | nil =>
      cases S with
      | nil => simp
      | cons x S =>
        obtain ⟨a, s⟩ := x
        simpa [map] using ⟨_, _, rfl, rfl⟩
    | cons _ s => simpa using ⟨s, S, rfl, rfl⟩
  · simpa using ⟨nil, S, by simp, by simp⟩

name: join_join
statement:
@[simp]
theorem join_join (SS : Seq (Seq1 (Seq1 α))) :
    Seq.join (Seq.join SS) = Seq.join (Seq.map join SS)
proof:
:= by
  apply
    Seq.eq_of_bisim fun s1 s2 =>
      ∃ s SS,
        s1 = Seq.append s (Seq.join (Seq.join SS)) ∧ s2 = Seq.append s (Seq.join (Seq.map join SS))
  · rintro s1 s2 ⟨s, SS, rfl, rfl⟩
    cases s with
    | nil =>
      cases SS with
      | nil => simp
      | cons S SS =>
        obtain ⟨⟨x, s⟩, S⟩ := S
        cases s with
        | nil => simpa using ⟨_, _, rfl, rfl⟩
        | cons x s => simpa using ⟨Seq.cons x (append s (Seq.join S)), SS, by simp, by simp⟩
    | cons _ s => simpa using ⟨s, SS, rfl, rfl⟩
  · simpa using ⟨nil, SS, by simp, by simp⟩

name: bind_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bind_assoc (s : Seq1 α) (f : α → Seq1 β) (g : β → Seq1 γ) :
    bind (bind s f) g = bind s fun x : α => bind (f x) g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, s⟩ := s
  simp only [bind, map_pair, map_join]
  rw [← map_comp]
  simp only [show (fun x => join (map g (f x))) = join ∘ (map g ∘ f) from rfl]
  rw [map_comp _ join]
  generalize Seq.map (map g ∘ f) s = SS
  rcases map g (f a) with ⟨⟨a, s⟩, S⟩
  induction s using recOn with | nil => ?_ | cons x s_1 => ?_ <;>
  induction S using recOn with | nil => simp | cons x_1 s_2 => ?_
  · obtain ⟨x, t⟩ := x_1
    cases t <;> simp
  · obtain ⟨y, t⟩ := x_1; simp

proof:
:=
  have : s.get? n ≠ none := by simp [s_nth_eq_some]
  have : s.get? m ≠ none := mt (s.le_stable m_le_n) this
  Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.mp this

  · obtain ⟨f, al⟩ := s

name: corec_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem corec_eq (f : β → Option (α × β)) (b : β) :
    destruct (corec f b) = omap (corec f) (f b)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [corec, destruct, get]
  rw [show Stream'.corec' (Corec.f f) (some b) 0 = (Corec.f f (some b)).1 from rfl]
  dsimp [Corec.f]
  rcases h : f b with - | s; · rfl
  obtain ⟨a, b'⟩ := s; dsimp [Corec.f]
  apply congr_arg fun b' => some (a, b')
  apply Subtype.ext
  dsimp [corec, tail]
  rw [Stream'.corec'_eq, Stream'.tail_cons]
  dsimp [Corec.f]; rw [h]

name: eq_of_bisim
statement: theorem eq_of_bisim (bisim : IsBisimulation R) {s₁ s₂} (r : s₁ ~ s₂) : s₁ = s₂
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Stream'.eq_of_bisim fun x y => ∃ s s' : Seq α, s.1 = x ∧ s'.1 = y ∧ R s s'
  · dsimp [Stream'.IsBisimulation]
    intro t₁ t₂ e
    exact
    match t₁, t₂, e with
    | _, _, ⟨s, s', rfl, rfl, r⟩ => by
      suffices head s = head s' ∧ R (tail s) (tail s') from
        And.imp id (fun r => ⟨tail s, tail s', by cases s using Subtype.recOn; rfl,
          by cases s' using Subtype.recOn; rfl, r⟩) this
      have := bisim r; revert r this
      cases s <;> cases s'
      · intro r _
        constructor
        · rfl
        · assumption
      · intro _ this
        rw [destruct_nil, destruct_cons] at this
        exact False.elim this
      · intro _ this
        rw [destruct_nil, destruct_cons] at this
        exact False.elim this
      · simp
  · exact ⟨s₁, s₂, rfl, rfl, r⟩

name: eq_of_bisim'
statement:
theorem eq_of_bisim' {s₁ s₂ : Seq α}
    (motive : Seq α → Seq α → Prop)
    (base : motive s₁ s₂)
    (step : ∀ s₁ s₂, motive s₁ s₂ →
      (s₁ = nil ∧ s₂ = nil) ∨
      (∃ x s₁' s₂', s₁ = cons x s₁' ∧ s₂ = cons x s₂' ∧ motive s₁' s₂')) :
    s₁ = s₂
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_bisim motive _ base
  intro s₁ s₂ h
  rcases step s₁ s₂ h with ⟨h_nil₁, h_nil₂⟩ | ⟨_, _, _, h₁, h₂, _⟩
  · simp [h_nil₁, h_nil₂]
  · simpa [h₁, h₂]

name: eq_of_bisim_strong
statement:
theorem eq_of_bisim_strong {s₁ s₂ : Seq α}
    (motive : Seq α → Seq α → Prop)
    (base : motive s₁ s₂)
    (step : ∀ s₁ s₂, motive s₁ s₂ →
      (s₁ = s₂) ∨
      (∃ x s₁' s₂', s₁ = cons x s₁' ∧ s₂ = cons x s₂' ∧ (motive s₁' s₂'))) : s₁ = s₂
proof:
:= by
  let motive' : Seq α → Seq α → Prop := fun s₁ s₂ => s₁ = s₂ ∨ motive s₁ s₂
  apply eq_of_bisim' motive' (by grind)
  intro s₁ s₂ ih
  simp only [motive'] at ih ⊢
  rcases ih with (rfl | ih)
  · cases s₁ <;> grind
  rcases step s₁ s₂ ih with (rfl | ⟨hd, s₁', s₂', _⟩)
  · cases s₁ <;> grind
  · grind

name: coinduction
statement:
theorem coinduction :
    ∀ {s₁ s₂ : Seq α},
      head s₁ = head s₂ →
        (∀ (β : Type u) (fr : Seq α → β), fr s₁ = fr s₂ → fr (tail s₁) = fr (tail s₂)) → s₁ = s₂
  | _, _, hh, ht =>
    Subtype.ext (Stream'.coinduction hh fun β fr => ht β fun s => fr s.1)

name: coinduction2
statement:
theorem coinduction2 (s) (f g : Seq α → Seq β)
    (H :
      ∀ s,
        BisimO (fun s1 s2 : Seq β => ∃ s : Seq α, s1 = f s ∧ s2 = g s) (destruct (f s))
          (destruct (g s))) :
    f s = g s
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_bisim (fun s1 s2 => ∃ s, s1 = f s ∧ s2 = g s) ?_ ⟨s, rfl, rfl⟩
  intro s1 s2 h; rcases h with ⟨s, h1, h2⟩
  rw [h1, h2]; apply H

name: mem_rec_on
statement:
theorem mem_rec_on {C : Seq α → Prop} {a s} (M : a ∈ s)
    (h1 : ∀ b s', a = b ∨ C s' → C (cons b s')) : C s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, e⟩ := M; unfold Stream'.get at e
  induction k generalizing s with
  | zero =>
    have TH : s = cons a (tail s) := by
      apply destruct_eq_cons
      unfold destruct get? Functor.map
      rw [← e]
      rfl
    rw [TH]
    apply h1 _ _ (Or.inl rfl)
  | succ k IH =>
    cases s with
    | nil => injection e
    | cons b s' =>
      have h_eq : (cons b s').val (Nat.succ k) = s'.val k := by cases s' using Subtype.recOn; rfl
      rw [h_eq] at e
      apply h1 _ _ (Or.inr (IH e))

name: terminates_parallel.aux
proof:
:= by
  have lem1 :
    ∀ l S, (∃ a : α, parallel.aux2 l = Sum.inl a) → Terminates (corec parallel.aux1 (l, S)) := by
    intro l S e
    obtain ⟨a, e⟩ := e
    have : corec parallel.aux1 (l, S) = return a := by
      apply destruct_eq_pure
      simp only [parallel.aux1, rmap, corec_eq]
      rw [e]
    rw [this]
    exact ret_terminates a
  intro l S c m T
  revert l S
  apply @terminatesRecOn _ _ c T _ _
  · intro a l S m
    apply lem1
    induction l with | nil => simp at m | cons c l IH => ?_
    simp only [List.mem_cons] at m
    rcases m with e | m
    · rw [← e]
      simp only [parallel.aux2, rmap, List.foldr_cons, destruct_pure]
      split <;> simp
    · obtain ⟨a', e⟩ := IH m
      simp only [parallel.aux2, rmap, List.foldr_cons] at ⊢ e
      rw [e]
      exact ⟨a', rfl⟩
  · intro s IH l S m
    have H1 (l') (e' : parallel.aux2 l = Sum.inr l') : s ∈ l' := by
      induction l generalizing l' with | nil => simp at m | cons c l IH' => ?_
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at m
      rcases m with e | m <;> simp only [parallel.aux2, rmap, List.foldr_cons] at e'
      · rw [← e] at e'
        
        revert e'
        split
        · simp
        · simp only [destruct_think, Sum.inr.injEq]
          rintro rfl
          simp
      · rcases e : List.foldr (fun c o =>
            match o with
            | Sum.inl a => Sum.inl a
            | Sum.inr ls => rmap (fun c' => c' :: ls) (destruct c))
          (Sum.inr List.nil) l with a' | ls <;> simp only [rmap] at e <;> rw [e] at e'
        · contradiction
        have := IH' m _ e
        grind
    rcases h : parallel.aux2 l with a | l'
    · exact lem1 _ _ ⟨a, h⟩
    · have H2 : corec parallel.aux1 (l, S) = think _ := destruct_eq_think (by
        simp only [parallel.aux1, rmap, corec_eq]
        rw [h])
      rw [H2]
      refine @Computation.think_terminates _ _ ?_
      have := H1 _ h
      rcases Seq.destruct S with (_ | ⟨_ | c, S'⟩) <;> apply IH <;> simp [this]

name: terminates_parallel
statement:
theorem terminates_parallel {S : WSeq (Computation α)} {c} (h : c ∈ S) [T : Terminates c] :
    Terminates (parallel S)
proof:
:= by
  suffices
    ∀ (n) (l : List (Computation α)) (S c),
      c ∈ l ∨ some (some c) = Seq.get? S n → Terminates c → Terminates (corec parallel.aux1 (l, S))
    from
    let ⟨n, h⟩ := h
    this n [] S c (Or.inr h) T
  intro n; induction n <;> intro l S c o T
  case zero =>
    rcases o with a | a
    · exact terminates_parallel.aux a T
    have H : Seq.destruct S = some (some c, Seq.tail S) := by simp [Seq.destruct, (· <$> ·), ← a]
    rcases h : parallel.aux2 l with a | l'
    · have C : corec parallel.aux1 (l, S) = pure a := by
        apply destruct_eq_pure
        rw [corec_eq, parallel.aux1]
        rw [h]
        simp only [rmap]
      rw [C]
      infer_instance
    · have C : corec parallel.aux1 (l, S) = _ := destruct_eq_think (by
        simp only [corec_eq, rmap, parallel.aux1.eq_1]
        rw [h, H])
      rw [C]
      refine @Computation.think_terminates _ _ ?_
      apply terminates_parallel.aux _ T
      simp
  case succ n IH =>
    rcases o with a | a
    · exact terminates_parallel.aux a T
    rcases h : parallel.aux2 l with a | l'
    · have C : corec parallel.aux1 (l, S) = pure a := by
        apply destruct_eq_pure
        rw [corec_eq, parallel.aux1]
        rw [h]
        simp only [rmap]
      rw [C]
      infer_instance
    · have C : corec parallel.aux1 (l, S) = _ := destruct_eq_think (by
        simp only [corec_eq, rmap, parallel.aux1.eq_1]
        rw [h])
      rw [C]
      refine @Computation.think_terminates _ _ ?_
      have TT : ∀ l', Terminates (corec parallel.aux1 (l', S.tail)) := by
        intro
        apply IH _ _ _ (Or.inr _) T
        rw [a, Seq.get?_tail]
      rcases e : Seq.get? S 0 with - | o
      · grind [Seq.get?_zero_eq_none, Seq.get?_nil]
      · have D : Seq.destruct S = some (o, S.tail) := by
          dsimp [Seq.destruct]
          rw [e]
          rfl
        rw [D]
        cases o <;> simp [TT]

name: exists_of_mem_parallel
statement:
theorem exists_of_mem_parallel {S : WSeq (Computation α)} {a} (h : a ∈ parallel S) :
    ∃ c ∈ S, a ∈ c
proof:
:= by
  suffices
    ∀ C, a ∈ C → ∀ (l : List (Computation α)) (S),
      corec parallel.aux1 (l, S) = C → ∃ c, (c ∈ l ∨ c ∈ S) ∧ a ∈ c from
    let ⟨c, h1, h2⟩ := this _ h [] S rfl
    ⟨c, h1.resolve_left <| List.not_mem_nil, h2⟩
  let F : List (Computation α) → α ⊕ (List (Computation α)) → Prop := by
    intro l a
    rcases a with a | l'
    · exact ∃ c ∈ l, a ∈ c
    · exact ∀ a', (∃ c ∈ l', a' ∈ c) → ∃ c ∈ l, a' ∈ c
  have lem1 (l) : F l (parallel.aux2 l) := by
    induction l <;> simp only [parallel.aux2, List.foldr]
    case nil =>
      intro a h
      assumption
    case cons c l IH =>
      simp only [parallel.aux2] at IH
      
      revert IH
      cases List.foldr (fun c o =>
        match o with
        | Sum.inl a => Sum.inl a
        | Sum.inr ls => rmap (fun c' => c' :: ls) (destruct c)) (Sum.inr List.nil) l <;>
        intro IH <;> simp only
      · rcases IH with ⟨c', cl, ac⟩
        exact ⟨c', List.Mem.tail _ cl, ac⟩
      · rcases h : destruct c with a | c' <;> simp only [rmap]
        · refine ⟨c, List.mem_cons_self, ?_⟩
          rw [destruct_eq_pure h]
          apply ret_mem
        · intro a' h
          rcases h with ⟨d, dm, ad⟩
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp dm with e | dl
          · rw [e] at ad
            refine ⟨c, List.mem_cons_self, ?_⟩
            rw [destruct_eq_think h]
            exact think_mem ad
          · obtain ⟨d, dm⟩ := IH a' ⟨d, dl, ad⟩
            obtain ⟨dm, ad⟩ := dm
            exact ⟨d, List.Mem.tail _ dm, ad⟩
  intro C aC
  
  apply memRecOn aC <;> [skip; intro C' IH] <;> intro l S e <;> have e' := congr_arg destruct e <;>
    have := lem1 l <;> simp only [parallel.aux1, corec_eq, destruct_pure, destruct_think] at e' <;>
    revert this e' <;> rcases parallel.aux2 l with a' | l' <;> intro this e' <;>
    [injection e' with h'; injection e'; injection e'; injection e' with h']
  · rw [h'] at this
    rcases this with ⟨c, cl, ac⟩
    exact ⟨c, Or.inl cl, ac⟩
  · rcases e : Seq.destruct S with - | a <;> rw [e] at h'
    · exact
        let ⟨d, o, ad⟩ := IH _ _ h'
        let ⟨c, cl, ac⟩ := this a ⟨d, o.resolve_right (WSeq.notMem_nil _), ad⟩
        ⟨c, Or.inl cl, ac⟩
    · obtain ⟨o, S'⟩ := a
      obtain - | c := o <;> simp only at h' <;> rcases IH _ _ h' with ⟨d, dl | dS', ad⟩
      · exact
          let ⟨c, cl, ac⟩ := this a ⟨d, dl, ad⟩
          ⟨c, Or.inl cl, ac⟩
      · refine ⟨d, Or.inr ?_, ad⟩
        rw [Seq.destruct_eq_cons e]
        exact Seq.mem_cons_of_mem _ dS'
      · simp only [List.mem_cons] at dl
        rcases dl with dc | dl
        · rw [dc] at ad
          refine ⟨c, Or.inr ?_, ad⟩
          rw [Seq.destruct_eq_cons e]
          apply Seq.mem_cons
        · exact
            let ⟨c, cl, ac⟩ := this a ⟨d, dl, ad⟩
            ⟨c, Or.inl cl, ac⟩
      · refine ⟨d, Or.inr ?_, ad⟩
        rw [Seq.destruct_eq_cons e]
        exact Seq.mem_cons_of_mem _ dS'

name: map_parallel
statement: theorem map_parallel (f : α → β) (S) : map f (parallel S) = parallel (S.map (map f))
proof:
:= by
  refine
    eq_of_bisim
      (fun c1 c2 =>
        ∃ l S,
          c1 = map f (corec parallel.aux1 (l, S)) ∧
            c2 = corec parallel.aux1 (l.map (map f), S.map (map f)))
      ?_ ⟨[], S, rfl, rfl⟩
  intro c1 c2 h
  exact
    match c1, c2, h with
    | _, _, ⟨l, S, rfl, rfl⟩ => by
      have : parallel.aux2 (l.map (map f))
          = lmap f (rmap (List.map (map f)) (parallel.aux2 l)) := by
        simp only [parallel.aux2, rmap, lmap]
        induction l with
        | nil => grind
        | cons => grind [destruct_map, lmap, rmap]
      simp only [BisimO, destruct_map, lmap, rmap, corec_eq, parallel.aux1.eq_1]
      rw [this]
      rcases parallel.aux2 l with a | l'
      · simp
      simp only [lmap, rmap]
      induction S using WSeq.recOn <;> simpa using ⟨_, _, rfl, rfl⟩

name: parallel_empty
statement: theorem parallel_empty (S : WSeq (Computation α)) (h : S.head ~> none) : parallel S = empty _
proof:
:=
  eq_empty_of_not_terminates fun ⟨⟨a, m⟩⟩ => by
    let ⟨c, cs, _⟩ := exists_of_mem_parallel m
    let ⟨n, nm⟩ := WSeq.exists_get?_of_mem cs
    let ⟨c', h'⟩ := WSeq.head_some_of_get?_some nm
    injection h h'

name: parallel_promises
statement: theorem parallel_promises {S : WSeq (Computation α)} {a} (H : ∀ s ∈ S, s ~> a) : parallel S ~> a
proof:
:=
  fun _ ma' =>
  let ⟨_, cs, ac⟩ := exists_of_mem_parallel ma'
  H _ cs ac

name: mem_parallel
statement:
theorem mem_parallel {S : WSeq (Computation α)} {a} (H : ∀ s ∈ S, s ~> a) {c} (cs : c ∈ S)
    (ac : a ∈ c) : a ∈ parallel S
proof:
:= by
  have := terminates_of_mem ac
  have := terminates_parallel cs
  exact mem_of_promises _ (parallel_promises H)

name: parallel_congr_lem
statement:
theorem parallel_congr_lem {S T : WSeq (Computation α)} {a} (H : S.LiftRel Equiv T) :
    (∀ s ∈ S, s ~> a) ↔ ∀ t ∈ T, t ~> a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h1 _ tT =>
    let ⟨_, sS, se⟩ := WSeq.exists_of_liftRel_right H tT
    (promises_congr se _).1 (h1 _ sS),
    fun h2 _ sS =>
    let ⟨_, tT, se⟩ := WSeq.exists_of_liftRel_left H sS
    (promises_congr se _).2 (h2 _ tT)⟩

name: parallel_congr_left
statement:
theorem parallel_congr_left {S T : WSeq (Computation α)} {a} (h1 : ∀ s ∈ S, s ~> a)
    (H : S.LiftRel Equiv T) : parallel S ~ parallel T
proof:
:=
  let h2 := (parallel_congr_lem H).1 h1
  fun a' =>
  ⟨fun h => by
    have aa := parallel_promises h1 h
    rw [← aa]
    rw [← aa] at h
    exact
      let ⟨s, sS, as⟩ := exists_of_mem_parallel h
      let ⟨t, tT, st⟩ := WSeq.exists_of_liftRel_left H sS
      let aT := (st _).1 as
      mem_parallel h2 tT aT,
    fun h => by
    have aa := parallel_promises h2 h
    rw [← aa]
    rw [← aa] at h
    exact
      let ⟨s, sS, as⟩ := exists_of_mem_parallel h
      let ⟨t, tT, st⟩ := WSeq.exists_of_liftRel_right H sS
      let aT := (st _).2 as
      mem_parallel h1 tT aT⟩

name: isCyclic_of_card_le_two
statement:
theorem isCyclic_of_card_le_two (hα : Nat.card α ≤ 2) :
    IsCyclic (Perm α)
proof:
:= by
  apply isCyclic_of_card_dvd_prime (p := 2)
  simpa [card_perm] using factorial_dvd_factorial hα

name: isMulCommutative_iff_card_le_two
statement:
theorem isMulCommutative_iff_card_le_two :
    IsMulCommutative (Perm α) ↔ Nat.card α ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h ↦ (isCyclic_of_card_le_two h).isMulCommutative⟩
  classical
  rintro ⟨⟨h⟩⟩
  rw [← not_lt, ← Set.ncard_univ, Set.two_lt_ncard_iff]
  rintro ⟨a, b, c, _, _, _, hab, hac, hbc⟩
  apply hbc
  simp_rw [Perm.ext_iff] at h
  simpa [swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hab hac] using h (swap a b) (swap b c) a

theorem modEq_iff_natModEq {a b n : ℕ} : a ≡ b [PMOD n] ↔ a ≡ b [MOD n]

:= by
  constructor
  · rw [modEq_iff_nsmul, Nat.ModEq]
    rintro ⟨k, l, h⟩
    simpa using congr($h % n)
  · rw [Nat.ModEq]
    intro h
    rw [← Nat.div_add_mod' a n, ← Nat.div_add_mod' b n, ← Nat.nsmul_eq_mul, ← Nat.nsmul_eq_mul, h]
    exact nsmul_add_modEq _ |>.trans (nsmul_add_modEq _).symm

:= by
  rw [modEq_iff_dvd' h, dvd_def]
  exact exists_congr (fun _ => Nat.sub_eq_iff_eq_add' h)

name: le_of_lt_add
statement: theorem le_of_lt_add (h1 : a ≡ b [MOD m]) (h2 : a < b + m) : a ≤ b
proof:
:=
  (le_total a b).elim id fun h3 =>
    Nat.le_of_sub_eq_zero
      (eq_zero_of_dvd_of_lt ((modEq_iff_dvd' h3).mp h1.symm) (by lia))

name: add_le_of_lt
statement: theorem add_le_of_lt (h1 : a ≡ b [MOD m]) (h2 : a < b) : a + m ≤ b

name: dvd_iff
statement: theorem dvd_iff (h : a ≡ b [MOD m]) (hdm : d ∣ m) : d ∣ a ↔ d ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← modEq_zero_iff_dvd]
  replace h := h.of_dvd hdm
  exact ⟨h.symm.trans, h.trans⟩

name: gcd_eq
statement: theorem gcd_eq (h : a ≡ b [MOD m]) : gcd a m = gcd b m
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := gcd_dvd_right a m
  have h2 := gcd_dvd_right b m
  exact
    dvd_antisymm (dvd_gcd ((h.dvd_iff h1).mp (gcd_dvd_left a m)) h1)
      (dvd_gcd ((h.dvd_iff h2).mpr (gcd_dvd_left b m)) h2)

name: eq_of_abs_lt
statement: lemma eq_of_abs_lt (h : a ≡ b [MOD m]) (h2 : |(b : ℤ) - a| < m) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  apply Int.ofNat.inj
  rw [eq_comm, ← sub_eq_zero]
  exact Int.eq_zero_of_abs_lt_dvd h.dvd h2

name: eq_of_lt_of_lt
statement: lemma eq_of_lt_of_lt (h : a ≡ b [MOD m]) (ha : a < m) (hb : b < m) : a = b

name: cancel_left_div_gcd
statement: lemma cancel_left_div_gcd (hm : 0 < m) (h : c * a ≡ c * b [MOD m]) : a ≡ b [MOD m / gcd m c]
proof:
:= by
  let d := gcd m c
  have hmd := gcd_dvd_left m c
  have hcd := gcd_dvd_right m c
  rw [modEq_iff_dvd]
  refine @Int.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right_of_gcd_one (m / d) (c / d) (b - a) ?_ ?_
  · show (m / d : ℤ) ∣ c / d * (b - a)
    rw [mul_comm, ← Int.mul_ediv_assoc (b - a) (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr hcd), mul_comm]
    apply Int.ediv_dvd_ediv (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mpr hmd)
    rw [Int.mul_sub]
    exact modEq_iff_dvd.mp h
  · show Int.gcd (m / d) (c / d) = 1
    simp only [d, ← Int.natCast_div, Int.gcd_natCast_natCast (m / d) (c / d),
      gcd_div hmd hcd, Nat.div_self (gcd_pos_of_pos_left c hm)]

name: cancel_right_div_gcd
statement: lemma cancel_right_div_gcd (hm : 0 < m) (h : a * c ≡ b * c [MOD m]) : a ≡ b [MOD m / gcd m c]
proof:
:= by
  apply cancel_left_div_gcd hm
  simpa [mul_comm] using h

name: cancel_left_div_gcd'
statement:
lemma cancel_left_div_gcd' (hm : 0 < m) (hcd : c ≡ d [MOD m]) (h : c * a ≡ d * b [MOD m]) :
    a ≡ b [MOD m / gcd m c]

name: cancel_right_div_gcd'
statement:
lemma cancel_right_div_gcd' (hm : 0 < m) (hcd : c ≡ d [MOD m]) (h : a * c ≡ b * d [MOD m]) :
    a ≡ b [MOD m / gcd m c]

name: cancel_left_of_coprime
statement: lemma cancel_left_of_coprime (hmc : gcd m c = 1) (h : c * a ≡ c * b [MOD m]) : a ≡ b [MOD m]
proof:
:= by
  rcases m.eq_zero_or_pos with (rfl | hm)
  · simp only [gcd_zero_left] at hmc
    simp only [hmc, one_mul, modEq_zero_iff] at h
    subst h
    rfl
  simpa [hmc] using h.cancel_left_div_gcd hm

name: cancel_right_of_coprime
statement: lemma cancel_right_of_coprime (hmc : gcd m c = 1) (h : a * c ≡ b * c [MOD m]) : a ≡ b [MOD m]
proof:
:=
  cancel_left_of_coprime hmc <| by simpa [mul_comm] using h

name: chineseRemainder'_lt_lcm
statement:
theorem chineseRemainder'_lt_lcm (h : a ≡ b [MOD gcd n m]) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    ↑(chineseRemainder' h) < lcm n m
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [chineseRemainder']
  rw [dite_eq_right hn, dite_eq_right hm, Subtype.coe_mk, xgcd_val, ← Int.toNat_natCast (lcm n m)]
  have lcm_pos := Int.natCast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (lcm_ne_zero hn hm))
  exact (Int.toNat_lt_toNat lcm_pos).mpr (Int.emod_lt_of_pos _ lcm_pos)

name: chineseRemainder_lt_mul
statement:
theorem chineseRemainder_lt_mul (co : n.Coprime m) (a b : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    ↑(chineseRemainder co a b) < n * m

name: mod_lcm
statement: theorem mod_lcm (hn : a ≡ b [MOD n]) (hm : a ≡ b [MOD m]) : a ≡ b [MOD lcm n m]

name: chineseRemainder_modEq_unique
statement:
theorem chineseRemainder_modEq_unique (co : n.Coprime m) {a b z}
    (hzan : z ≡ a [MOD n]) (hzbm : z ≡ b [MOD m]) : z ≡ chineseRemainder co a b [MOD n * m]
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Nat.Coprime.lcm_eq_mul co] using
    mod_lcm (hzan.trans ((chineseRemainder co a b).prop.1).symm)
      (hzbm.trans ((chineseRemainder co a b).prop.2).symm)

name: modEq_and_modEq_iff_modEq_mul
statement:
theorem modEq_and_modEq_iff_modEq_mul {a b m n : ℕ} (hmn : m.Coprime n) :
    a ≡ b [MOD m] ∧ a ≡ b [MOD n] ↔ a ≡ b [MOD m * n]
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    rw [Nat.modEq_iff_dvd, Nat.modEq_iff_dvd, ← Int.dvd_natAbs, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast,
      ← Int.dvd_natAbs, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast] at h
    rw [Nat.modEq_iff_dvd, ← Int.dvd_natAbs, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast]
    exact hmn.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd h.1 h.2,
   fun h => ⟨h.of_mul_right _, h.of_mul_left _⟩⟩

name: coprime_of_mul_modEq_one
statement: theorem coprime_of_mul_modEq_one (b : ℕ) {a n : ℕ} (h : a * b ≡ 1 [MOD n]) : a.Coprime n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hh⟩ := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a n
  rw [Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one, ← Nat.dvd_one, ← Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd]
  calc
    1 ≡ a * b [MOD a.gcd n] := (hh ▸ h).symm.of_mul_right g
    _ ≡ 0 * b [MOD a.gcd n] := (Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd.mpr (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)).mul_right b
    _ = 0 := by rw [zero_mul]

name: add_mod_add_ite
statement:
theorem add_mod_add_ite (a b c : ℕ) :
    ((a + b) % c + if c ≤ a % c + b % c then c else 0) = a % c + b % c
proof:
:=
  have : (a + b) % c = (a % c + b % c) % c := ((mod_modEq _ _).add <| mod_modEq _ _).symm
  if hc0 : c = 0 then by simp [hc0, Nat.mod_zero]
  else by
    rw [this]
    split_ifs with h
    · have h2 : (a % c + b % c) / c < 2 :=
        Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul
          (by
            rw [mul_two]
            exact
              add_lt_add (Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hc0))
                (Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hc0)))
      have h0 : 0 < (a % c + b % c) / c := Nat.div_pos h (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hc0)
      rw [← @add_right_cancel_iff _ _ _ (c * ((a % c + b % c) / c)), add_comm _ c, add_assoc,
        mod_add_div, le_antisymm (le_of_lt_succ h2) h0, mul_one, add_comm]
    · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge h), add_zero]

name: add_mod_of_add_mod_lt
statement:
theorem add_mod_of_add_mod_lt {a b c : ℕ} (hc : a % c + b % c < c) :
    (a + b) % c = a % c + b % c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_mod_add_ite, ite_eq_right (not_le_of_gt hc), add_zero]

name: add_mod_add_of_le_add_mod
statement:
theorem add_mod_add_of_le_add_mod {a b c : ℕ} (hc : c ≤ a % c + b % c) :
    (a + b) % c + c = a % c + b % c

name: add_div_eq_of_add_mod_lt
statement:
theorem add_div_eq_of_add_mod_lt {a b c : ℕ} (hc : a % c + b % c < c) :
    (a + b) / c = a / c + b / c
proof:
:=
  if hc0 : c = 0 then by simp [hc0]
  else by rw [Nat.add_div (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hc0), ite_eq_right (not_le_of_gt hc), add_zero]

name: add_div_of_dvd_right
statement: protected theorem add_div_of_dvd_right {a b c : ℕ} (hca : c ∣ a) : (a + b) / c = a / c + b / c
proof:
:=
  if h : c = 0 then by simp [h]
  else
    add_div_eq_of_add_mod_lt
      (by
        rw [Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hca, zero_add]
        exact Nat.mod_lt _ (zero_lt_of_ne_zero h))

name: add_div_of_dvd_left
statement: protected theorem add_div_of_dvd_left {a b c : ℕ} (hca : c ∣ b) : (a + b) / c = a / c + b / c

name: add_div_eq_of_le_mod_add_mod
statement:
theorem add_div_eq_of_le_mod_add_mod {a b c : ℕ} (hc : c ≤ a % c + b % c) (hc0 : 0 < c) :
    (a + b) / c = a / c + b / c + 1

name: add_div_le_add_div
statement:
@[deprecated Nat.div_add_div_le_add_div (since := "2026-08-05")]
theorem add_div_le_add_div (a b c : ℕ) : a / c + b / c ≤ (a + b) / c

name: add_div_le_div_add_div_add_one
statement: theorem add_div_le_div_add_div_add_one (a b c : ℕ) : (a + b) / c ≤ a / c + b / c + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : c = 0
  · simp [h]
  · rw [Nat.add_div (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h), Nat.add_le_add_iff_left]
    split <;> decide

name: le_mod_add_mod_of_dvd_add_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem le_mod_add_mod_of_dvd_add_of_not_dvd {a b c : ℕ} (h : c ∣ a + b) (ha : ¬c ∣ a) :
    c ≤ a % c + b % c
proof:
:=
  by_contradiction fun hc => by
    have : (a + b) % c = a % c + b % c := add_mod_of_add_mod_lt (lt_of_not_ge hc)
    simp_all [dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]

name: mod_sub_of_le
statement: lemma mod_sub_of_le {a b n : ℕ} (h : b ≤ a % n) : a % n - b = (a - b) % n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hn; · simp only [mod_zero]
  nth_rw 2 [← div_add_mod a n]; rw [Nat.add_sub_assoc h, mul_add_mod]
  exact (mod_eq_of_lt <| (sub_le ..).trans_lt (mod_lt a hn)).symm

name: odd_mul_odd
statement: theorem odd_mul_odd {n m : ℕ} : n % 2 = 1 → m % 2 = 1 → n * m % 2 = 1

name: odd_mul_odd_div_two
statement:
theorem odd_mul_odd_div_two {m n : ℕ} (hm1 : m % 2 = 1) (hn1 : n % 2 = 1) :
    m * n / 2 = m * (n / 2) + m / 2
proof:
:=
  have hn0 : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => by simp_all
  mul_right_injective₀ two_ne_zero <| by
    dsimp
    rw [mul_add, two_mul_odd_div_two hm1, mul_left_comm, two_mul_odd_div_two hn1,
      two_mul_odd_div_two (Nat.odd_mul_odd hm1 hn1), Nat.mul_sub, mul_one, ←
      Nat.add_sub_assoc (by lia), Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right m hn0)]

name: odd_of_mod_four_eq_one
statement: theorem odd_of_mod_four_eq_one {n : ℕ} : n % 4 = 1 → n % 2 = 1

name: odd_of_mod_four_eq_three
statement: theorem odd_of_mod_four_eq_three {n : ℕ} : n % 4 = 3 → n % 2 = 1

name: odd_mod_four_iff
statement: theorem odd_mod_four_iff {n : ℕ} : n % 2 = 1 ↔ n % 4 = 1 ∨ n % 4 = 3
proof:
:=
  have help : ∀ m : ℕ, m < 4 → m % 2 = 1 → m = 1 ∨ m = 3 := by decide
  ⟨fun hn =>
    help (n % 4) (mod_lt n (by lia)) <| (mod_mod_of_dvd n (by decide : 2 ∣ 4)).trans hn,
    fun h => Or.elim h odd_of_mod_four_eq_one odd_of_mod_four_eq_three⟩

name: mod_eq_of_modEq
statement: lemma mod_eq_of_modEq {a b n} (h : a ≡ b [MOD n]) (hb : b < n) : a % n = b

name: ext_div_modEq
statement: theorem ext_div_modEq {n a b : ℕ} (h0 : a / n = b / n) (h1 : a ≡ b [MOD n]) : a = b

name: ext_div_modEq_iff
statement: theorem ext_div_modEq_iff (n a b : ℕ) : a = b ↔ a / n = b / n ∧ a ≡ b [MOD n]

name: modEq_iff_eq_of_div_eq
statement:
theorem modEq_iff_eq_of_div_eq {n a b : ℕ} (h : a / n = b / n) :
    a ≡ b [MOD n] ↔ a = b

name: nth_of_card_le
statement:
theorem nth_of_card_le (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) {n : ℕ} (hn : #hf.toFinset ≤ n) :
    nth p n = 0
proof: := by rw [nth, dite_eq_left hf, List.getD_eq_default]; rwa [Finset.length_sort]

name: nth_eq_getD_sort
statement:
theorem nth_eq_getD_sort (h : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) (n : ℕ) :
    nth p n = h.toFinset.sort.getD n 0

name: nth_eq_orderEmbOfFin
statement:
theorem nth_eq_orderEmbOfFin (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) {n : ℕ} (hn : n < #hf.toFinset) :
    nth p n = hf.toFinset.orderEmbOfFin rfl ⟨n, hn⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [nth_eq_getD_sort hf, Finset.orderEmbOfFin_apply, List.getD_eq_getElem, Fin.getElem_fin]

name: nth_strictMonoOn
statement:
theorem nth_strictMonoOn (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) :
    StrictMonoOn (nth p) (Set.Iio #hf.toFinset)
proof:
:= by
  rintro m (hm : m < _) n (hn : n < _) h
  simp only [nth_eq_orderEmbOfFin, *]
  exact OrderEmbedding.strictMono _ h

name: nth_lt_nth_of_lt_card
statement:
theorem nth_lt_nth_of_lt_card (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) {m n : ℕ} (h : m < n)
    (hn : n < #hf.toFinset) : nth p m < nth p n

name: nth_le_nth_of_lt_card
statement:
theorem nth_le_nth_of_lt_card (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n)
    (hn : n < #hf.toFinset) : nth p m ≤ nth p n

name: lt_of_nth_lt_nth_of_lt_card
statement:
theorem lt_of_nth_lt_nth_of_lt_card (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) {m n : ℕ} (h : nth p m < nth p n)
    (hm : m < #hf.toFinset) : m < n
proof:
:=
  not_le.1 fun hle => h.not_ge <| nth_le_nth_of_lt_card hf hle hm

name: le_of_nth_le_nth_of_lt_card
statement:
theorem le_of_nth_le_nth_of_lt_card (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) {m n : ℕ} (h : nth p m ≤ nth p n)
    (hm : m < #hf.toFinset) : m ≤ n
proof:
:=
  not_lt.1 fun hlt => h.not_gt <| nth_lt_nth_of_lt_card hf hlt hm

name: nth_injOn
statement: theorem nth_injOn (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) : (Set.Iio #hf.toFinset).InjOn (nth p)

name: range_nth_of_finite
statement:
theorem range_nth_of_finite (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) :
    Set.range (nth p) = insert 0 (Set.ofPred p)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, ← nth_eq_getD_sort hf, mem_sort,
    Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] using! Set.range_list_getD (hf.toFinset.sort (· ≤ ·)) 0

name: image_nth_Iio_card
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_nth_Iio_card (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) :
    nth p '' Set.Iio #hf.toFinset = Set.ofPred p
proof:
:=
  calc
    nth p '' Set.Iio #hf.toFinset = Set.range (hf.toFinset.orderEmbOfFin rfl) := by
      ext x
      simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_range, Fin.exists_iff, ← nth_eq_orderEmbOfFin hf,
        Set.mem_Iio, exists_prop]
    _ = Set.ofPred p := by rw [range_orderEmbOfFin, Set.Finite.coe_toFinset]

name: nth_mem_of_lt_card
statement:
theorem nth_mem_of_lt_card {n : ℕ} (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) (hlt : n < #hf.toFinset) :
    p (nth p n)

name: exists_lt_card_finite_nth_eq
statement:
theorem exists_lt_card_finite_nth_eq (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) {x} (h : p x) :
    ∃ n, n < #hf.toFinset ∧ nth p n = x
proof:
:= by
  rwa [← @Set.mem_ofPred_eq _ _ p, ← image_nth_Iio_card hf] at h

name: nth_apply_eq_orderIsoOfNat
statement:
theorem nth_apply_eq_orderIsoOfNat (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) (n : ℕ) :
    nth p n = @Nat.Subtype.orderIsoOfNat (Set.ofPred p) hf.to_subtype n

name: nth_eq_orderIsoOfNat
statement:
theorem nth_eq_orderIsoOfNat (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) :
    nth p = (↑) ∘ @Nat.Subtype.orderIsoOfNat (Set.ofPred p) hf.to_subtype

name: nth_strictMono
statement: theorem nth_strictMono (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) : StrictMono (nth p)

name: nth_injective
statement: theorem nth_injective (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) : Function.Injective (nth p)

name: nth_monotone
statement: theorem nth_monotone (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) : Monotone (nth p)

name: nth_lt_nth
statement: theorem nth_lt_nth (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) {k n} : nth p k < nth p n ↔ k < n

name: nth_le_nth
statement: theorem nth_le_nth (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) {k n} : nth p k ≤ nth p n ↔ k ≤ n

name: range_nth_of_infinite
statement:
theorem range_nth_of_infinite (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) :
    Set.range (nth p) = Set.ofPred p
proof:
:= by
  rw [nth_eq_orderIsoOfNat hf]
  have := hf.to_subtype
  classical exact Nat.Subtype.coe_comp_ofNat_range

name: nth_mem_of_infinite
statement: theorem nth_mem_of_infinite (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) (n : ℕ) : p (nth p n)

name: exists_lt_card_nth_eq
statement:
theorem exists_lt_card_nth_eq {x} (h : p x) :
    ∃ n, (∀ hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite, n < #hf.toFinset) ∧ nth p n = x
proof:
:= by
  refine (Set.ofPred p).finite_or_infinite.elim (fun hf => ?_) fun hf => ?_
  · rcases exists_lt_card_finite_nth_eq hf h with ⟨n, hn, hx⟩
    exact ⟨n, fun _ => hn, hx⟩
  · rw [← @Set.mem_ofPred_eq _ _ p, ← range_nth_of_infinite hf] at h
    rcases h with ⟨n, hx⟩
    exact ⟨n, fun hf' => absurd hf' hf, hx⟩

name: subset_range_nth
statement: theorem subset_range_nth : Set.ofPred p ⊆ Set.range (nth p)
proof:
:= fun x (hx : p x) =>
  let ⟨n, _, hn⟩ := exists_lt_card_nth_eq hx
  ⟨n, hn⟩

name: range_nth_subset
statement: theorem range_nth_subset : Set.range (nth p) ⊆ insert 0 (Set.ofPred p)
proof:
:=
  (Set.ofPred p).finite_or_infinite.elim (fun h => (range_nth_of_finite h).subset) fun h =>
    (range_nth_of_infinite h).trans_subset (Set.subset_insert _ _)

name: nth_mem
statement: theorem nth_mem (n : ℕ) (h : ∀ hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite, n < #hf.toFinset) : p (nth p n)
proof:
:=
  (Set.ofPred p).finite_or_infinite.elim (fun hf => nth_mem_of_lt_card hf (h hf)) fun h =>
    nth_mem_of_infinite h n

name: nth_lt_nth'
statement:
theorem nth_lt_nth' {m n : ℕ} (hlt : m < n) (h : ∀ hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite, n < #hf.toFinset) :
    nth p m < nth p n
proof:
:=
  (Set.ofPred p).finite_or_infinite.elim (fun hf => nth_lt_nth_of_lt_card hf hlt (h _)) fun hf =>
    (nth_lt_nth hf).2 hlt

name: nth_le_nth'
statement:
theorem nth_le_nth' {m n : ℕ} (hle : m ≤ n) (h : ∀ hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite, n < #hf.toFinset) :
    nth p m ≤ nth p n
proof:
:=
  (Set.ofPred p).finite_or_infinite.elim (fun hf => nth_le_nth_of_lt_card hf hle (h _)) fun hf =>
    (nth_le_nth hf).2 hle

name: le_nth
statement: theorem le_nth {n : ℕ} (h : ∀ hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite, n < #hf.toFinset) : n ≤ nth p n
proof:
:=
  (Set.ofPred p).finite_or_infinite.elim
    (fun hf => ((nth_strictMonoOn hf).mono <| Set.Iic_subset_Iio.2 (h _)).Iic_id_le _ le_rfl)
    fun hf => (nth_strictMono hf).id_le _

name: isLeast_nth
statement:
theorem isLeast_nth {n} (h : ∀ hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite, n < #hf.toFinset) :
    IsLeast {i | p i ∧ ∀ k < n, nth p k < i} (nth p n)
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨nth_mem n h, fun _k hk => nth_lt_nth' hk h⟩, fun _x hx =>
    let ⟨k, hk, hkx⟩ := exists_lt_card_nth_eq hx.1
    (lt_or_ge k n).elim (fun hlt => absurd hkx (hx.2 _ hlt).ne) fun hle => hkx ▸ nth_le_nth' hle hk⟩

name: isLeast_nth_of_lt_card
statement:
theorem isLeast_nth_of_lt_card {n : ℕ} (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) (hn : n < #hf.toFinset) :
    IsLeast {i | p i ∧ ∀ k < n, nth p k < i} (nth p n)

name: isLeast_nth_of_infinite
statement:
theorem isLeast_nth_of_infinite (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) (n : ℕ) :
    IsLeast {i | p i ∧ ∀ k < n, nth p k < i} (nth p n)
proof:
:=
  isLeast_nth fun h => absurd h hf

name: nth_eq_sInf
statement: theorem nth_eq_sInf (p : ℕ → Prop) (n : ℕ) : nth p n = sInf {x | p x ∧ ∀ k < n, nth p k < x}
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hn : ∀ hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite, n < #hf.toFinset
  · exact (isLeast_nth hn).csInf_eq.symm
  · rcases hn with ⟨hf, hn⟩
    rw [nth_of_card_le _ hn]
    refine ((congr_arg sInf <| Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun k hk => ?_).trans sInf_empty).symm
    rcases exists_lt_card_nth_eq hk.1 with ⟨k, hlt, rfl⟩
    exact (hk.2 _ ((hlt hf).trans_le hn)).false

name: nth_zero
statement: theorem nth_zero : nth p 0 = sInf (Set.ofPred p)

name: nth_zero_of_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nth_zero_of_zero (h : p 0) : nth p 0 = 0

name: nth_zero_of_exists
statement: theorem nth_zero_of_exists [DecidablePred p] (h : ∃ n, p n) : nth p 0 = Nat.find h

name: nth_eq_zero
statement:
theorem nth_eq_zero {n} :
    nth p n = 0 ↔ p 0 ∧ n = 0 ∨ ∃ hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite, #hf.toFinset ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [or_iff_not_imp_right, not_exists, not_le]
    exact fun hn => ⟨h ▸ nth_mem _ hn, nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1 <| h ▸ le_nth hn⟩
  · rintro (⟨h₀, rfl⟩ | ⟨hf, hle⟩)
    exacts [nth_zero_of_zero h₀, nth_of_card_le hf hle]

name: lt_card_toFinset_of_nth_ne_zero
statement:
lemma lt_card_toFinset_of_nth_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (h : nth p n ≠ 0) (hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) :
    n < #hf.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ne_eq, nth_eq_zero, not_or, not_exists, not_le] at h
  exact h.2 hf

name: nth_mem_of_ne_zero
statement: lemma nth_mem_of_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (h : nth p n ≠ 0) : p (Nat.nth p n)

name: nth_eq_zero_mono
statement: theorem nth_eq_zero_mono (h₀ : ¬p 0) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (ha : nth p a = 0) : nth p b = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nth_eq_zero, h₀, false_and, false_or] at ha ⊢
  exact ha.imp fun hf hle => hle.trans hab

name: nth_ne_zero_anti
statement: lemma nth_ne_zero_anti (h₀ : ¬p 0) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : nth p b ≠ 0) : nth p a ≠ 0

name: le_nth_of_lt_nth_succ
statement: theorem le_nth_of_lt_nth_succ {k a : ℕ} (h : a < nth p (k + 1)) (ha : p a) : a ≤ nth p k
proof:
:= by
  rcases (Set.ofPred p).finite_or_infinite with hf | hf
  · rcases exists_lt_card_finite_nth_eq hf ha with ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    rcases lt_or_ge (k + 1) #hf.toFinset with hk | hk
    · rwa [(nth_strictMonoOn hf).lt_iff_lt hn hk, Nat.lt_succ_iff,
        ← (nth_strictMonoOn hf).le_iff_le hn (k.lt_succ_self.trans hk)] at h
    · rw [nth_of_card_le _ hk] at h
      exact absurd h (zero_le _).not_gt
  · rcases subset_range_nth ha with ⟨n, rfl⟩
    rwa [nth_lt_nth hf, Nat.lt_succ_iff, ← nth_le_nth hf] at h

name: nth_mem_anti
statement: lemma nth_mem_anti {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) (h : p (nth p b)) : p (nth p a)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h' : ∀ hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite, a < #hf.toFinset
  · exact nth_mem a h'
  · simp only [not_forall, not_lt] at h'
    have h'b : ∃ hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite, #hf.toFinset ≤ b := by
      rcases h' with ⟨hf, ha⟩
      exact ⟨hf, ha.trans hab⟩
    have ha0 : nth p a = 0 := by simp [nth_eq_zero, h']
    have hb0 : nth p b = 0 := by simp [nth_eq_zero, h'b]
    rw [ha0]
    rwa [hb0] at h

name: nth_le_of_strictMonoOn_of_mapsTo
statement:
lemma nth_le_of_strictMonoOn_of_mapsTo {p : ℕ → Prop} (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hmaps : Set.MapsTo f { n : ℕ | ∀ hf : Set.Finite (Set.ofPred p), n < hf.toFinset.card }
      (Set.ofPred p))
    (hmono : StrictMonoOn f { n : ℕ | ∀ hf : Set.Finite (Set.ofPred p), n < hf.toFinset.card })
      {n : ℕ} :
    nth p n ≤ f n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hn : (∀ hf : Set.Finite (Set.ofPred p), n < hf.toFinset.card)
  · induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with | _ n ih =>
    rw [nth_eq_sInf]
    refine csInf_le (by simp) ⟨hmaps hn, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    have : f k < f n := by apply hmono <;> grind
    grind
  · rcases hn with ⟨hf, hn⟩
    rw [nth, dite_eq_left hf, List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by simp [hn])]
    exact Nat.zero_le _

name: le_nth_of_monotoneOn_of_surjOn
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.nth_zero]
    refine le_csInf ⟨_, nth_mem _ hn⟩ fun b hb => ?_
    rcases hsurj hb with ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    exact hmono hn hk (Nat.zero_le _)
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [nth_eq_sInf]
    refine le_csInf ?_ ?_
    · use nth p (n + 1), nth_mem _ hn
      exact fun k hk => nth_lt_nth' hk hn
    rintro b ⟨hb, h⟩
    rcases hsurj hb with ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩
    apply hmono hn hm
    rw [Nat.succ_le_iff]
    apply hmono.reflect_lt <;> grind

name: eq_nth_of_strictMonoOn_of_mapsTo_of_surjOn
proof:
:=
  fun _ hi => le_antisymm
    (Nat.le_nth_of_monotoneOn_of_surjOn _ hsurj hmono.monotoneOn hi)
    (Nat.nth_le_of_strictMonoOn_of_mapsTo _ hmaps hmono)

name: nth_comp_of_strictMono
statement:
lemma nth_comp_of_strictMono {n : ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f)
    (h0 : ∀ k, p k → k ∈ Set.range f) (h : ∀ hfi : (Set.ofPred p).Finite, n < hfi.toFinset.card) :
    f (nth (fun i ↦ p (f i)) n) = nth p n
proof:
:= by
  have hs {p' : ℕ → Prop} (h0p' : ∀ k, p' k → k ∈ Set.range f) :
      f '' {i | p' (f i)} = Set.ofPred p' := by
    ext i
    refine ⟨fun ⟨_, hi, h⟩ ↦ h ▸ hi, fun he ↦ ?_⟩
    rcases h0p' _ he with ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨t, he, rfl⟩
  induction n using Nat.case_strong_induction_on
  case _ =>
    simp_rw [nth_zero]
    replace h := nth_mem _ h
    rw [← hs h0, ← hf.monotone.map_csInf]
    rcases h0 _ h with ⟨t, ht⟩
    exact ⟨t, Set.mem_ofPred_eq ▸ ht ▸ h⟩
  case _ n ih =>
    repeat nth_rw 1 [nth_eq_sInf]
    have h0' : ∀ k', (p k' ∧ ∀ k < n + 1, nth p k < k') → k' ∈ Set.range f := fun _ h ↦ h0 _ h.1
    rw [← hs h0', ← hf.monotone.map_csInf]
    · convert! rfl using 8 with k m' hm
      nth_rw 2 [← hf.lt_iff_lt]
      convert! Iff.rfl using 2
      exact ih m' (Nat.lt_add_one_iff.mp hm) fun hfi ↦ hm.trans (h hfi)
    · rcases h0 _ (nth_mem _ h) with ⟨t, ht⟩
      exact ⟨t, ht ▸ (nth_mem _ h), fun _ hk ↦ ht ▸ nth_lt_nth' hk h⟩

name: nth_add
statement:
lemma nth_add {m n : ℕ} (h0 : ∀ k < m, ¬p k) (h : nth p n ≠ 0) :
    nth (fun i ↦ p (i + m)) n + m = nth p n
proof:
:= by
  refine nth_comp_of_strictMono (strictMono_id.add_const m) (fun k hk ↦ ?_)
    (fun hf ↦ lt_card_toFinset_of_nth_ne_zero h hf)
  by_contra hn
  simp_rw [id_eq, Set.mem_range, eq_comm] at hn
  exact h0 _ (not_le.mp fun h ↦ hn (le_iff_exists_add'.mp h)) hk

name: nth_add_eq_sub
statement:
lemma nth_add_eq_sub {m n : ℕ} (h0 : ∀ k < m, ¬p k) (h : nth p n ≠ 0) :
    nth (fun i ↦ p (i + m)) n = nth p n - m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nth_add h0 h, Nat.add_sub_cancel]

name: nth_add_one
statement:
lemma nth_add_one {n : ℕ} (h0 : ¬p 0) (h : nth p n ≠ 0) :
    nth (fun i ↦ p (i + 1)) n + 1 = nth p n

name: nth_add_one_eq_sub
statement:
lemma nth_add_one_eq_sub {n : ℕ} (h0 : ¬p 0) (h : nth p n ≠ 0) :
    nth (fun i ↦ p (i + 1)) n = nth p n - 1

name: count_nth_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_nth_zero : count p (nth p 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [count_eq_card_filter_range, card_eq_zero, filter_eq_empty_iff, nth_zero]
  exact fun n h₁ h₂ => (mem_range.1 h₁).not_ge (Nat.sInf_le h₂)

name: filter_range_nth_subset_insert
statement:
theorem filter_range_nth_subset_insert (k : ℕ) :
    {n ∈ range (nth p (k + 1)) | p n} ⊆ insert (nth p k) {n ∈ range (nth p k) | p n}
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  simp only [mem_insert, mem_filter, mem_range] at ha ⊢
  exact (le_nth_of_lt_nth_succ ha.1 ha.2).eq_or_lt.imp_right fun h => ⟨h, ha.2⟩

name: filter_range_nth_eq_insert
proof:
:= by
  refine (filter_range_nth_subset_insert p k).antisymm fun a ha => ?_
  simp only [mem_insert, mem_filter, mem_range] at ha ⊢
  have : nth p k < nth p (k + 1) := nth_lt_nth' k.lt_succ_self hlt
  rcases ha with (rfl | ⟨hlt, hpa⟩)
  · exact ⟨this, nth_mem _ fun hf => k.lt_succ_self.trans (hlt hf)⟩
  · exact ⟨hlt.trans this, hpa⟩

name: filter_range_nth_eq_insert_of_finite
filter_range_nth_eq_insert_of_infinite
statement:
theorem filter_range_nth_eq_insert_of_infinite (hp : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) (k : ℕ) :
    {n ∈ range (nth p (k + 1)) | p n} = insert (nth p k) {n ∈ range (nth p k) | p n}
proof:
:=
  filter_range_nth_eq_insert fun hf => absurd hf hp

name: count_nth
statement:
theorem count_nth {n : ℕ} (hn : ∀ hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite, n < #hf.toFinset) :
    count p (nth p n) = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact count_nth_zero _
  | succ k ihk =>
    rw [count_eq_card_filter_range, filter_range_nth_eq_insert hn, card_insert_of_notMem,
      ← count_eq_card_filter_range, ihk fun hf => lt_of_succ_lt (hn hf)]
    simp

name: count_nth_of_lt_card_finite
statement:
theorem count_nth_of_lt_card_finite {n : ℕ} (hp : (Set.ofPred p).Finite) (hlt : n < #hp.toFinset) :
    count p (nth p n) = n

name: count_nth_of_infinite
statement: theorem count_nth_of_infinite (hp : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) (n : ℕ) : count p (nth p n) = n
proof:
:=
  count_nth fun hf => absurd hf hp

name: surjective_count_of_infinite_setOfPred
statement:
theorem surjective_count_of_infinite_setOfPred (h : {n | p n}.Infinite) :
    Function.Surjective (Nat.count p)
proof:
:=
  fun n => ⟨nth p n, count_nth_of_infinite h n⟩

name: count_nth_succ
statement:
theorem count_nth_succ {n : ℕ} (hn : ∀ hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite, n < #hf.toFinset) :
    count p (nth p n + 1) = n + 1
proof: := by rw [count_succ, count_nth hn, ite_eq_left (nth_mem _ hn)]

name: count_nth_succ_of_infinite
statement:
lemma count_nth_succ_of_infinite (hp : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) (n : ℕ) :
    count p (nth p n + 1) = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [count_succ, count_nth_of_infinite hp, ite_eq_left (nth_mem_of_infinite hp _)]

name: nth_count
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nth_count {n : ℕ} (hpn : p n) : nth p (count p n) = n
proof:
:=
  have : ∀ hf : (Set.ofPred p).Finite, count p n < #hf.toFinset := fun hf => count_lt_card hf hpn
  count_injective (nth_mem _ this) hpn (count_nth this)

name: nth_lt_of_lt_count
statement: theorem nth_lt_of_lt_count {n k : ℕ} (h : k < count p n) : nth p k < n
proof:
:= by
  refine (count_monotone p).reflect_lt ?_
  rwa [count_nth]
  exact fun hf => h.trans_le (count_le_card hf n)

name: le_nth_of_count_le
statement: theorem le_nth_of_count_le {n k : ℕ} (h : n ≤ nth p k) : count p n ≤ k
proof:
:=
  not_lt.1 fun hlt => h.not_gt <| nth_lt_of_lt_count hlt

name: count_eq_zero
statement: protected theorem count_eq_zero (h : ∃ n, p n) {n : ℕ} : count p n = 0 ↔ n ≤ nth p 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [nth_zero_of_exists h, le_find_iff h, Nat.count_iff_forall_not]

name: nth_count_eq_sInf
statement: theorem nth_count_eq_sInf (n : ℕ) : nth p (count p n) = sInf {i : ℕ | p i ∧ n ≤ i}
proof:
:= by
  refine (nth_eq_sInf _ _).trans (congr_arg sInf ?_)
  refine Set.ext fun a => and_congr_right fun hpa => ?_
  refine ⟨fun h => not_lt.1 fun ha => ?_, fun hn k hk => lt_of_lt_of_le (nth_lt_of_lt_count hk) hn⟩
  have hn : nth p (count p a) < a := h _ (count_strict_mono hpa ha)
  rwa [nth_count hpa, lt_self_iff_false] at hn

name: le_nth_count'
statement: theorem le_nth_count' {n : ℕ} (hpn : ∃ k, p k ∧ n ≤ k) : n ≤ nth p (count p n)

name: le_nth_count
statement: theorem le_nth_count (hp : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) (n : ℕ) : n ≤ nth p (count p n)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨m, hp, hn⟩ := hp.exists_gt n
  le_nth_count' ⟨m, hp, hn.le⟩

name: gc_count_nth
statement: theorem gc_count_nth (hp : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) : GaloisConnection (count p) (nth p)

name: count_le_iff_le_nth
statement:
theorem count_le_iff_le_nth (hp : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) {a b : ℕ} :
    count p a ≤ b ↔ a ≤ nth p b

name: lt_nth_iff_count_lt
statement:
theorem lt_nth_iff_count_lt (hp : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) {a b : ℕ} :
    a < count p b ↔ nth p a < b

name: nth_add_one_le_iff
statement:
theorem nth_add_one_le_iff (hp : (Set.ofPred p).Infinite) {n q : ℕ} (hq : p q) :
    nth p (n + 1) ≤ q ↔ nth p n < q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← nth_count hq, nth_le_nth hp, nth_lt_nth hp, add_one_le_iff]

name: nth_of_forall
statement: theorem nth_of_forall {n : ℕ} (hp : ∀ n' ≤ n, p n') : nth p n = n
proof:
:= by
  classical nth_rw 1 [← count_of_forall (hp · ·.le), nth_count (hp n le_rfl)]

name: nth_true
statement: @[simp] theorem nth_true (n : ℕ) : nth (fun _ ↦ True) n = n

name: nth_of_forall_not
statement: theorem nth_of_forall_not {n : ℕ} (hp : ∀ n' ≥ n, ¬p n') : nth p n = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : Set.ofPred p ⊆ Finset.range n := by
    intro n' hn'
    contrapose! hp
    exact ⟨n', by simpa using hp, Set.mem_ofPred.mp hn'⟩
  rw [nth_of_card_le ((finite_toSet _).subset this)]
  · refine (Finset.card_le_card ?_).trans_eq (Finset.card_range n)
    exact Set.Finite.toFinset_subset.mpr this

name: nth_false
statement: @[simp] theorem nth_false (n : ℕ) : nth (fun _ ↦ False) n = 0

name: bitwise_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bitwise_zero_left (m : Nat) : bitwise f 0 m = if f false true then m else 0

name: bitwise_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bitwise_zero_right (n : Nat) : bitwise f n 0 = if f true false then n else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold bitwise
  simp only [ite_self, Nat.zero_div, ite_true, ite_eq_right_iff]
  rintro ⟨⟩
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: bitwise_zero
statement: lemma bitwise_zero : bitwise f 0 0 = 0

name: bitwise_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma bitwise_of_ne_zero {n m : Nat} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    bitwise f n m = bit (f (bodd n) (bodd m)) (bitwise f (n / 2) (m / 2))
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => unfold bitwise
  have mod_two_iff_bod x : (x % 2 = 1 : Bool) = bodd x := by
    simp only [mod_two_of_bodd]; cases bodd x <;> rfl
  simp [hn, hm, mod_two_iff_bod, bit, two_mul]

name: binaryRec_of_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [binaryRec, dite_eq_right h, eqRec_eq_cast, eqRec_eq_cast]; rfl

name: bitwise_bit
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bitwise_bit {f : Bool → Bool → Bool} (h : f false false = false := by rfl) (a m b n) :
    bitwise f (bit a m) (bit b n) = bit (f a b) (bitwise f m n)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => unfold bitwise
  simp only [bit, Bool.cond_eq_ite]
  have h4 x : (x + x + 1) / 2 = x := by rw [← two_mul, add_comm]; simp [add_mul_div_left]
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp <;> split_ifs
    <;> simp_all +decide [two_mul]

name: bit_mod_two_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma bit_mod_two_eq_zero_iff (a x) :
    bit a x % 2 = 0 ↔ !a

name: bit_mod_two_eq_one_iff
statement:
lemma bit_mod_two_eq_one_iff (a x) :
    bit a x % 2 = 1 ↔ a

name: lor_bit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lor_bit : ∀ a m b n, bit a m ||| bit b n = bit (a || b) (m ||| n)

name: land_bit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem land_bit : ∀ a m b n, bit a m &&& bit b n = bit (a && b) (m &&& n)

name: ldiff_bit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ldiff_bit : ∀ a m b n, ldiff (bit a m) (bit b n) = bit (a && not b) (ldiff m n)

name: xor_bit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem xor_bit : ∀ a m b n, bit a m ^^^ bit b n = bit (bne a b) (m ^^^ n)

name: testBit_lor
statement: theorem testBit_lor : ∀ m n k, testBit (m ||| n) k = (testBit m k || testBit n k)

name: testBit_land
statement: theorem testBit_land : ∀ m n k, testBit (m &&& n) k = (testBit m k && testBit n k)

name: testBit_ldiff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem testBit_ldiff : ∀ m n k, testBit (ldiff m n) k = (testBit m k && not (testBit n k))

name: bitwise_bit'
statement:
lemma bitwise_bit' {f : Bool → Bool → Bool} (a : Bool) (m : Nat) (b : Bool) (n : Nat)
    (ham : m = 0 → a = true) (hbn : n = 0 → b = true) :
    bitwise f (bit a m) (bit b n) = bit (f a b) (bitwise f m n)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => unfold bitwise
  rw [← bit_ne_zero_iff] at ham hbn
  simp only [ham, hbn, bit_mod_two_eq_one_iff, Bool.decide_coe, ← div2_val, div2_bit,
    ite_false]
  conv_rhs => simp only [bit, two_mul, Bool.cond_eq_ite]

name: bitwise_eq_binaryRec
statement:
lemma bitwise_eq_binaryRec (f : Bool → Bool → Bool) :
    bitwise f =
    binaryRec (fun n => cond (f false true) n 0) fun a m Ia =>
      binaryRec (cond (f true false) (bit a m) 0) fun b n _ => bit (f a b) (Ia n)
proof:
:= by
  funext x y
  induction x using binaryRec' generalizing y with
  | zero => simp only [bitwise_zero_left, binaryRec_zero, Bool.cond_eq_ite]
  | bit xb x hxb ih =>
    rw [← bit_ne_zero_iff] at hxb
    simp_rw [binaryRec_of_ne_zero _ _ hxb, bodd_bit, div2_bit, eq_rec_constant]
    induction y using binaryRec' with
    | zero => simp only [bitwise_zero_right, binaryRec_zero, Bool.cond_eq_ite]
    | bit yb y hyb =>
      rw [← bit_ne_zero_iff] at hyb
      simp_rw [binaryRec_of_ne_zero _ _ hyb, bitwise_of_ne_zero hxb hyb, bodd_bit, div2_bit,
        bit_div_two, eq_rec_constant, ih]

name: zero_of_testBit_eq_false
statement: theorem zero_of_testBit_eq_false {n : ℕ} (h : ∀ i, testBit n i = false) : n = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.binaryRec with | zero => rfl | bit b n hn => ?_
  have : b = false := by simpa using h 0
  rw [this, bit_false, hn fun i => by rw [← h (i + 1), testBit_bit_succ]]

name: testBit_eq_false_of_lt
statement: theorem testBit_eq_false_of_lt {n i} (h : n < 2 ^ i) : n.testBit i = false

name: testBit_eq_inth
statement: theorem testBit_eq_inth (n i : ℕ) : n.testBit i = n.bits.getI i
proof:
:= by
  induction i generalizing n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [testBit, shiftRight_zero, one_and_eq_mod_two, mod_two_of_bodd,
      bodd_eq_bits_head, List.getI_zero_eq_headI]
    cases List.headI (bits n) <;> rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    conv_lhs => rw [← bit_bodd_div2 n]
    rw [testBit_bit_succ, ih n.div2, div2_bits_eq_tail]
    cases n.bits <;> simp

name: exists_most_significant_bit
statement:
theorem exists_most_significant_bit {n : ℕ} (h : n ≠ 0) :
    ∃ i, testBit n i = true ∧ ∀ j, i < j → testBit n j = false
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.binaryRec with | zero => exact False.elim (h rfl) | bit b n hn => ?_
  by_cases h' : n = 0
  · subst h'
    rw [show b = true by
        revert h
        cases b <;> simp]
    refine ⟨0, ⟨by rw [testBit_bit_zero], fun j hj => ?_⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ := exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hj)
    rw [testBit_bit_succ, zero_testBit]
  · obtain ⟨k, ⟨hk, hk'⟩⟩ := hn h'
    refine ⟨k + 1, ⟨by rw [testBit_bit_succ, hk], fun j hj => ?_⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ := exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (show j ≠ 0 by intro x; subst x; simp at hj)
    exact (testBit_bit_succ _ _ _).trans (hk' _ (lt_of_succ_lt_succ hj))

name: lt_of_testBit
statement:
theorem lt_of_testBit {n m : ℕ} (i : ℕ) (hn : testBit n i = false) (hm : testBit m i = true)
    (hnm : ∀ j, i < j → testBit n j = testBit m j) : n < m
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.binaryRec generalizing i m with
  | zero =>
    rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero]
    rintro rfl
    simp at hm
  | bit b n hn' =>
    induction m using Nat.binaryRec generalizing i with
    | zero => exact False.elim (Bool.false_ne_true ((zero_testBit i).symm.trans hm))
    | bit b' m hm' =>
      by_cases hi : i = 0
      · subst hi
        simp only [testBit_bit_zero] at hn hm
        have : n = m :=
          eq_of_testBit_eq fun i => by convert! hnm (i + 1) (Nat.zero_lt_succ _) using 1
          <;> rw [testBit_bit_succ]
        rw [hn, hm, this, bit_false, bit_true]
        exact Nat.lt_succ_self _
      · obtain ⟨i', rfl⟩ := exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hi
        simp only [testBit_bit_succ] at hn hm
        have := hn' _ hn hm fun j hj => by
          convert! hnm j.succ (succ_lt_succ hj) using 1 <;> rw [testBit_bit_succ]
        exact bit_lt_bit b b' this

name: bitwise_swap
statement:
theorem bitwise_swap {f : Bool → Bool → Bool} :
    bitwise (Function.swap f) = Function.swap (bitwise f)
proof:
:= by
  funext m n
  simp only [Function.swap]
  induction m using Nat.binaryRec' generalizing n with
  | zero => simp
  | bit bm m hm ihm =>
    induction n using Nat.binaryRec' with
    | zero => simp
    | bit bn n hn => rw [bitwise_bit' _ _ _ _ hm hn, bitwise_bit' _ _ _ _ hn hm, ihm]

name: bitwise_comm
statement:
theorem bitwise_comm {f : Bool → Bool → Bool} (hf : ∀ b b', f b b' = f b' b) (n m : ℕ) :
    bitwise f n m = bitwise f m n
proof:
:=
  suffices bitwise f = swap (bitwise f) by conv_lhs => rw [this]
  calc
    bitwise f = bitwise (swap f) := congr_arg _ <| funext fun _ => funext <| hf _
    _ = swap (bitwise f) := bitwise_swap

name: and_two_pow
statement: lemma and_two_pow (n i : ℕ) : n &&& 2 ^ i = (n.testBit i).toNat * 2 ^ i
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_testBit_eq fun j => ?_
  obtain rfl | hij := Decidable.eq_or_ne i j <;> cases h : n.testBit i
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]
  · simp [testBit_two_pow_of_ne hij]
  · simp [testBit_two_pow_of_ne hij]

name: xor_trichotomy
statement:
theorem xor_trichotomy {a b c : ℕ} (h : a ^^^ b ^^^ c ≠ 0) :
    b ^^^ c < a ∨ c ^^^ a < b ∨ a ^^^ b < c
proof:
:= by
  set v := a ^^^ b ^^^ c with hv
  
  have hab : a ^^^ b = c ^^^ v := by
    rw [Nat.xor_comm c, Nat.xor_xor_cancel_right]
  have hbc : b ^^^ c = a ^^^ v := by
    rw [← Nat.xor_assoc, Nat.xor_xor_cancel_left]
  have hca : c ^^^ a = b ^^^ v := by
    rw [hv, Nat.xor_assoc, Nat.xor_comm a, ← Nat.xor_assoc, Nat.xor_xor_cancel_left]
  
  
  obtain ⟨i, ⟨hi, hi'⟩⟩ := exists_most_significant_bit h
  have : testBit a i ∨ testBit b i ∨ testBit c i := by
    contrapose! hi
    simp_rw [Bool.eq_false_eq_not_eq_true] at hi ⊢
    rw [testBit_xor, testBit_xor, hi.1, hi.2.1, hi.2.2]
    rfl
  
  
  obtain h | h | h := this
  on_goal 1 => left; rw [hbc]
  on_goal 2 => right; left; rw [hca]
  on_goal 3 => right; right; rw [hab]
  all_goals
    refine lt_of_testBit i ?_ h fun j hj => ?_
    · rw [testBit_xor, h, hi]
      rfl
    · simp only [testBit_xor, hi' _ hj, Bool.bne_false]

name: lt_xor_cases
statement: theorem lt_xor_cases {a b c : ℕ} (h : a < b ^^^ c) : a ^^^ c < b ∨ a ^^^ b < c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ha | hb | hc := xor_trichotomy <| Nat.xor_assoc _ _ _ ▸ xor_ne_zero_iff.2 h.ne
  exacts [(h.asymm ha).elim, Or.inl <| Nat.xor_comm _ _ ▸ hb, Or.inr hc]

name: xor_mod_two_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem xor_mod_two_eq {m n : ℕ} : (m ^^^ n) % 2 = (m + n) % 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : (m + n) % 2 = 0
  · simp only [h, mod_two_eq_zero_iff_testBit_zero, testBit_zero, xor_mod_two_eq_one, decide_not,
      Bool.decide_iff_dist, Bool.not_eq_false', beq_iff_eq, decide_eq_decide]
    lia
  · simp only [mod_two_ne_zero] at h
    simp only [h, xor_mod_two_eq_one]
    lia

name: even_xor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem even_xor {m n : ℕ} : Even (m ^^^ n) ↔ (Even m ↔ Even n)

name: xor_one_of_even
statement:
@[simp]
theorem xor_one_of_even {n : ℕ} (h : Even n) : n ^^^ 1 = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n =>
    simp +instances [HXor.hXor, instXorOp, xor, bitwise, even_iff.mp h, ← mul_two,
      div_two_mul_two_of_even h]

name: xor_one_of_odd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem xor_one_of_odd {n : ℕ} (h : Odd n) : n ^^^ 1 = n - 1
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    exact not_odd_zero h |>.elim
  | succ n =>
    simp +instances only [HXor.hXor, instXorOp, xor, bitwise, reduceDiv, bitwise_zero_right]
    grind

name: xor_range
statement:
theorem xor_range (n : ℕ) : (List.range (n + 1)).foldl (· ^^^ ·) 0 =
    match Fin.ofNat 4 n with | 0 => n | 1 => 1 | 2 => n + 1 | 3 => 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    nth_rw 3 [← show Fin.ofNat 4 1 = (1 : ℕ) from Fin.val_ofNat ..]
    rw [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append, ih, ← Fin.ofNat_add, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]
    match h : Fin.ofNat 4 n with
    | 0 =>
      rw [Fin.zero_add, ← xor_one_of_even <| even_iff.mpr ?_, xor_xor_cancel_left]
      rw [← @mod_mod_of_dvd _ 4 _ <| by simp, ← Fin.val_ofNat 4, h]
      rfl
    | 1 =>
      rw [Nat.xor_comm]
      refine xor_one_of_even <| even_iff.mpr ?_
      rw [add_mod, ← @mod_mod_of_dvd _ 4 n <| by simp, ← Fin.val_ofNat 4, h]
      rfl
    | 2 =>
      apply Nat.xor_self
    | 3 =>
      apply zero_xor

name: shiftLeft_lt
statement: lemma shiftLeft_lt {x n m : ℕ} (h : x < 2 ^ n) : x <<< m < 2 ^ (n + m)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Nat.pow_add, shiftLeft_eq, Nat.mul_lt_mul_right (Nat.two_pow_pos _), h]

name: append_lt
statement: lemma append_lt {x y n m} (hx : x < 2 ^ n) (hy : y < 2 ^ m) : y <<< n ||| x < 2 ^ (n + m)
proof:
:= by
  apply bitwise_lt_two_pow
  · rw [add_comm]; apply shiftLeft_lt hy
  · apply lt_of_lt_of_le hx <| Nat.pow_le_pow_right (le_succ _) (le_add_right _ _)

  wlog hmn : m < n
  · exact this hn hm heq.symm h.symm (by grind)

  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt (lt_of_count_lt_count h)
  rw [add_assoc, count_add, Nat.lt_add_right_iff_pos] at h
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hp⟩ := count_ne_iff_exists.mp h.ne'
  simp_rw [Set.mem_Ico]

proof:
:= by
  by_cases h' : n.bit b = 0
  case pos =>

    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, imp_false, not_true_eq_false, or_false] at h
    unfold binaryRec
    exact h.symm
  case neg =>
    rw [binaryRec, dite_eq_right h']
    change congrArg motive (n.bit b).bit_testBit_zero_shiftRight_one ▸ bit _ _ _ = _
    generalize congrArg motive (n.bit b).bit_testBit_zero_shiftRight_one = e; revert e
    rw [testBit_bit_zero, bit_shiftRight_one]
    intros; rfl

  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>

proof:

  induction n using binaryRec with
  | zero => simp
  | bit b n hs =>
    have hrw : (fun i ↦ 2 ^ i) ∘ (fun x ↦ x + 1) = fun i ↦ 2 * 2 ^ i := by
      ext i; simp [pow_add, mul_comm]
    cases b
    · simpa [hrw, List.sum_map_mul_left]
    simp [hrw, List.sum_map_mul_left, hs, add_comm (a := 1)]

name: bitIndices_sum_map_two_pow
statement:
theorem bitIndices_sum_map_two_pow {L : List ℕ} (hL : List.SortedLT L) :
    (L.map (fun i ↦ 2 ^ i)).sum.bitIndices = L
proof:
:= by
  cases L with | nil => simp | cons a L =>
  obtain ⟨haL, hL⟩ := pairwise_cons.1 hL.pairwise
  simp_rw [Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le] at haL
  have h' : ∃ (L₀ : List ℕ), L₀.SortedLT ∧ L = L₀.map (· + a + 1) := by
    refine ⟨L.map (· - (a+1)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rwa [sortedLT_iff_pairwise, pairwise_map, Pairwise.and_mem,
        Pairwise.iff (S := fun x y ↦ x ∈ L ∧ y ∈ L ∧ x < y), ← Pairwise.and_mem]
      simp only [and_congr_right_iff]
      exact fun x y hx _ ↦ by rw [tsub_lt_tsub_iff_right (haL _ hx)]
    have h' : ∀ x ∈ L, ((fun x ↦ x + a + 1) ∘ (fun x ↦ x - (a + 1))) x = x := fun x hx ↦ by
      simp only [add_assoc, Function.comp_apply]; rw [tsub_add_cancel_of_le (haL _ hx)]
    simp [List.map_congr_left h']
  obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀, rfl⟩ := h'
  have hrw : (2 ^ ·) ∘ (· + a + 1) = fun i ↦ 2 ^ a * (2 * 2 ^ i) := by
    ext x; simp only [Function.comp_apply, pow_add, pow_one]; ac_rfl
  simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_map, List.sum_map_mul_left, List.sum_cons, hrw]
  nth_rw 1 [← mul_one (a := 2 ^ a)]
  rw [← mul_add, bitIndices_two_pow_mul, add_comm, bitIndices_two_mul_add_one,
    bitIndices_sum_map_two_pow hL₀]
  simp [add_comm (a := 1), add_assoc]

name: leRec_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma leRec_self {n} {motive : (m : ℕ) → n ≤ m → Sort*}
    (refl : motive n (Nat.le_refl _))
    (le_succ_of_le : ∀ ⦃k⦄ (h : n ≤ k), motive k h → motive (k + 1) (le_succ_of_le h)) :
    (leRec (motive := motive) refl le_succ_of_le (Nat.le_refl _) :
    motive n (Nat.le_refl _)) = refl
proof:
:= by
  cases n <;> simp [leRec, Or.by_cases, dite_eq_right]

name: leRec_succ
statement:
@[simp]
lemma leRec_succ {n} {motive : (m : ℕ) → n ≤ m → Sort*}
    (refl : motive n (Nat.le_refl _))
    (le_succ_of_le : ∀ ⦃k⦄ (h : n ≤ k), motive k h → motive (k + 1) (le_succ_of_le h))
    (h1 : n ≤ m) {h2 : n ≤ m + 1} :
    (leRec (motive := motive) refl le_succ_of_le h2) =
      le_succ_of_le h1 (leRec (motive := motive) refl le_succ_of_le h1)
proof:
:= by
  conv =>
    lhs
    rw [leRec, Or.by_cases, dite_eq_left h1]

name: leRec_succ'
statement:
lemma leRec_succ' {n} {motive : (m : ℕ) → n ≤ m → Sort*} (refl le_succ_of_le) :
    (leRec (motive := motive) refl le_succ_of_le (le_succ _)) = le_succ_of_le _ refl

name: leRec_trans
statement:
lemma leRec_trans {n m k} {motive : (m : ℕ) → n ≤ m → Sort*} (refl le_succ_of_le)
    (hnm : n ≤ m) (hmk : m ≤ k) :
    leRec (motive := motive) refl le_succ_of_le (Nat.le_trans hnm hmk) =
      leRec
        (leRec refl (fun _ h => le_succ_of_le h) hnm)
        (fun _ h => le_succ_of_le <| Nat.le_trans hnm h) hmk
proof:
:= by
  induction hmk with
  | refl => rw [leRec_self]
  | step hmk ih => rw [leRec_succ _ _ (Nat.le_trans hnm hmk), ih, leRec_succ]

name: leRec_succ_left
leRecOn_self
statement:
lemma leRecOn_self {C : ℕ → Sort*} {n} {next : ∀ {k}, C k → C (k + 1)} (x : C n) :
    (leRecOn n.le_refl next x : C n) = x

name: leRecOn_succ
statement:
lemma leRecOn_succ {C : ℕ → Sort*} {n m} (h1 : n ≤ m) {h2 : n ≤ m + 1} {next} (x : C n) :
    (leRecOn h2 next x : C (m + 1)) = next (leRecOn h1 next x : C m)

name: leRecOn_succ'
statement:
lemma leRecOn_succ' {C : ℕ → Sort*} {n} {h : n ≤ n + 1} {next : ∀ {k}, C k → C (k + 1)} (x : C n) :
    (leRecOn h next x : C (n + 1)) = next x

name: leRecOn_trans
statement:
lemma leRecOn_trans {C : ℕ → Sort*} {n m k} (hnm : n ≤ m) (hmk : m ≤ k) {next} (x : C n) :
    (leRecOn (Nat.le_trans hnm hmk) (@next) x : C k) =
      leRecOn hmk (@next) (leRecOn hnm (@next) x)

name: leRecOn_succ_left
le_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
lemma le_induction {m : ℕ} {P : ∀ n, m ≤ n → Prop} (base : P m m.le_refl)
    (succ : ∀ n hmn, P n hmn → P (n + 1) (le_succ_of_le hmn)) : ∀ n hmn, P n hmn

name: strong_induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
protected theorem strong_induction_on {p : ℕ → Prop} (n : ℕ)

name: decreasingInduction_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma decreasingInduction_self {n} {motive : (m : ℕ) → m ≤ n → Sort*} (of_succ self) :
    (decreasingInduction (motive := motive) of_succ self (Nat.le_refl _)) = self

name: decreasingInduction_succ
statement:
lemma decreasingInduction_succ {n} {motive : (m : ℕ) → m ≤ n + 1 → Sort*} (of_succ self)
    (mn : m ≤ n) (msn : m ≤ n + 1) :
    (decreasingInduction (motive := motive) of_succ self msn : motive m msn) =
      decreasingInduction (motive := fun m h => motive m (le_succ_of_le h))
        (fun _ _ => of_succ _ _) (of_succ _ _ self) mn

name: decreasingInduction_succ'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma decreasingInduction_succ' {n} {motive : (m : ℕ) → m ≤ n + 1 → Sort*} (of_succ self) :
    decreasingInduction (motive := motive) of_succ self n.le_succ = of_succ _ _ self

name: decreasingInduction_trans
statement:
lemma decreasingInduction_trans {motive : (m : ℕ) → m ≤ k → Sort*} (hmn : m ≤ n) (hnk : n ≤ k)
    (of_succ self) :
    (decreasingInduction (motive := motive) of_succ self (Nat.le_trans hmn hnk) : motive m _) =
    decreasingInduction (fun _ _ => of_succ _ _) (decreasingInduction of_succ self hnk) hmn
proof:
:= by
  induction hnk with
  | refl => rw [decreasingInduction_self]
  | step hnk ih =>
      rw [decreasingInduction_succ _ _ (Nat.le_trans hmn hnk), ih, decreasingInduction_succ]

name: decreasingInduction_succ_left
statement:
lemma decreasingInduction_succ_left {motive : (m : ℕ) → m ≤ n → Sort*} (of_succ self)
    (smn : m + 1 ≤ n) (mn : m ≤ n) :
    decreasingInduction (motive := motive) of_succ self mn =
      of_succ m smn (decreasingInduction of_succ self smn)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subsingleton.elim mn (Nat.le_trans (le_succ m) smn),
    decreasingInduction_trans (n := m + 1) (Nat.le_succ m),
    decreasingInduction_succ']

name: diag_induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem diag_induction (P : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) (ha : ∀ a, P (a + 1) (a + 1)) (hb : ∀ b, P 0 (b + 1))
    (hd : ∀ a b, a < b → P (a + 1) b → P a (b + 1) → P (a + 1) (b + 1)) : ∀ a b, a < b → P a b
  | 0, _ + 1, _ => hb _
  | a + 1, b + 1, h => by
    apply hd _ _ (Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right.1 h)
    · have : a + 1 = b ∨ a + 1 < b
proof:
:= by lia
      rcases this with (rfl | h)
      · exact ha _
      apply diag_induction P ha hb hd (a + 1) b h
    apply diag_induction P ha hb hd a (b + 1)
    apply Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_succ _) h

name: not_pos_pow_dvd
statement: lemma not_pos_pow_dvd {a n : ℕ} (ha : 1 < a) (hn : 1 < n) : ¬ a ^ n ∣ a
proof:
:=
  not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (Nat.lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one ha)
    (lt_of_eq_of_lt (Nat.pow_one a).symm ((Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right ha).2 hn))

proof:
