name: pair_unpair
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pair_unpair (n : ℕ) : pair (unpair n).1 (unpair n).2 = n
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [unpair]; let s := sqrt n
  have sm : s * s + (n - s * s) = n := Nat.add_sub_cancel' (sqrt_le _)
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [s, pair, h, sm]
  · have hl : n - s * s - s ≤ s := Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add.2
      (Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add'.2 <| by rw [← Nat.add_assoc]; apply sqrt_le_add)
    simp [s, pair, hl.not_gt, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_sub_cancel' (le_of_not_gt h), sm]

name: pair_eq_of_unpair_eq
statement: theorem pair_eq_of_unpair_eq {n a b} (H : unpair n = (a, b)) : pair a b = n

name: unpair_pair
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unpair_pair (a b : ℕ) : unpair (pair a b) = (a, b)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [pair]; split_ifs with h
  · show unpair (b * b + a) = (a, b)
    have be : sqrt (b * b + a) = b := sqrt_add_eq _ (le_trans (le_of_lt h) (Nat.le_add_left _ _))
    simp [unpair, be, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, h]
  · show unpair (a * a + a + b) = (a, b)
    have ae : sqrt (a * a + (a + b)) = a := by
      rw [sqrt_add_eq]
      exact Nat.add_le_add_left (le_of_not_gt h) _
    simp [unpair, ae, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]

name: surjective_unpair
statement: theorem surjective_unpair : Surjective unpair

name: pair_eq_pair
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pair_eq_pair {a b c d : ℕ} : pair a b = pair c d ↔ a = c ∧ b = d

name: unpair_lt
statement: theorem unpair_lt {n : ℕ} (n1 : 1 ≤ n) : (unpair n).1 < n
proof:
:= by
  let s := sqrt n
  simp only [unpair]
  by_cases h : n - s * s < s <;> simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, gt_iff_lt, s]
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le h (sqrt_le_self _)
  · simp only [not_lt] at h
    have s0 : 0 < s := sqrt_pos.2 n1
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h (Nat.sub_lt n1 (Nat.mul_pos s0 s0))

name: unpair_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unpair_zero : unpair 0 = 0

name: unpair_left_le
statement:
theorem unpair_left_le : ∀ n : ℕ, (unpair n).1 ≤ n
  | 0 => by simp
  | _ + 1 => le_of_lt (unpair_lt (Nat.succ_pos _))

name: left_le_pair
statement: theorem left_le_pair (a b : ℕ) : a ≤ pair a b
proof: := by simpa using unpair_left_le (pair a b)

name: right_le_pair
statement: theorem right_le_pair (a b : ℕ) : b ≤ pair a b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a < b
  · simpa [pair, h] using le_trans (le_mul_self _) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  · simp [pair, h]

name: unpair_right_le
statement: theorem unpair_right_le (n : ℕ) : (unpair n).2 ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  simpa using right_le_pair n.unpair.1 n.unpair.2

name: pair_lt_pair_left
statement: theorem pair_lt_pair_left {a₁ a₂} (b) (h : a₁ < a₂) : pair a₁ b < pair a₂ b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h₁ : a₁ < b <;> simp only [pair, h₁, ↓reduceIte, Nat.add_assoc]
  · by_cases h₂ : a₂ < b
    · simp [h₂, h]
    simp only [h₂, ↓reduceIte]
    apply Nat.add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt
    · exact Nat.mul_self_le_mul_self (not_lt.mp h₂)
    · exact Nat.lt_add_right _ h
  · simp at h₁
    simp only [not_lt_of_gt (lt_of_le_of_lt h₁ h), ite_false]
    apply add_lt_add
    · exact Nat.mul_self_lt_mul_self h
    · apply Nat.add_lt_add_right; assumption

name: pair_lt_pair_right
statement: theorem pair_lt_pair_right (a) {b₁ b₂} (h : b₁ < b₂) : pair a b₁ < pair a b₂
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h₁ : a < b₁
  · simpa [pair, h₁, Nat.add_assoc, lt_trans h₁ h, h] using mul_self_lt_mul_self h
  · simp only [pair, h₁, ↓reduceIte, Nat.add_assoc]
    by_cases h₂ : a < b₂; swap; · simp [h₂, h]
    simp only [h₂, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_comm _ a, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_left]
    rwa [Nat.add_comm, ← sqrt_lt, sqrt_add_eq]
    exact le_trans (not_lt.mp h₁) (Nat.le_add_left _ _)

name: pair_lt_max_add_one_sq
statement: theorem pair_lt_max_add_one_sq (m n : ℕ) : pair m n < (max m n + 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pair, Nat.pow_two, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_one, Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_assoc]
  split_ifs <;> simp [Nat.le_of_lt, not_lt.1, *] <;> lia

name: max_sq_add_min_le_pair
statement: theorem max_sq_add_min_le_pair (m n : ℕ) : max m n ^ 2 + min m n ≤ pair m n
proof:
:= by
  rw [pair]
  rcases lt_or_ge m n with h | h
  · rw [ite_eq_left h, max_eq_right h.le, min_eq_left h.le, Nat.pow_two]
  rw [ite_eq_right h.not_gt, max_eq_left h, min_eq_right h, Nat.pow_two, Nat.add_assoc,
    Nat.add_le_add_iff_left]
  exact Nat.le_add_left _ _

name: add_le_pair
statement: theorem add_le_pair (m n : ℕ) : m + n ≤ pair m n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pair, Nat.add_assoc]
  split_ifs
  · have := le_mul_self n
    lia
  · exact Nat.le_add_left _ _

name: unpair_add_le
statement: theorem unpair_add_le (n : ℕ) : (unpair n).1 + (unpair n).2 ≤ n

name: iSup_unpair
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem iSup_unpair {α} [CompleteLattice α] (f : ℕ → ℕ → α) :
    ⨆ n : ℕ, f n.unpair.1 n.unpair.2 = ⨆ (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ), f i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (iSup_prod : ⨆ i : ℕ × ℕ, f i.1 i.2 = _), ← Nat.surjective_unpair.iSup_comp]

name: iUnion_unpair_prod
statement:
theorem iUnion_unpair_prod {α β} {s : ℕ → Set α} {t : ℕ → Set β} :
    ⋃ n : ℕ, s n.unpair.fst ×ˢ t n.unpair.snd = (⋃ n, s n) ×ˢ ⋃ n, t n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Set.iUnion_prod]
  exact surjective_unpair.iUnion_comp (fun x => s x.fst ×ˢ t x.snd)

name: iUnion_unpair
statement:
theorem iUnion_unpair {α} (f : ℕ → ℕ → Set α) :
    ⋃ n : ℕ, f n.unpair.1 n.unpair.2 = ⋃ (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ), f i j

name: iInter_unpair
statement:
theorem iInter_unpair {α} (f : ℕ → ℕ → Set α) :
    ⋂ n : ℕ, f n.unpair.1 n.unpair.2 = ⋂ (i : ℕ) (j : ℕ), f i j

name: log_of_left_le_one
statement: theorem log_of_left_le_one {b : ℕ} (hb : b ≤ 1) (n) : log b n = 0

name: log_of_lt
statement: theorem log_of_lt {b n : ℕ} (hb : n < b) : log b n = 0
proof:
:= by
  fun_cases log with
  | case1 => rfl
  | case2 => fun_cases log.go with grind

name: log.go_aux
statement:
private theorem log.go_aux {n b fuel : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hfuel : n < b ^ (fuel + 1)) (hbn : b ≤ n) :
    n < (b * b) ^ fuel
proof:
:= by
  obtain hfuel₀ : fuel ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp [Nat.not_lt_of_le hbn] at hfuel
  rw [← Nat.pow_two, ← Nat.pow_mul]
  exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hfuel <| Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by grind) (by grind)

name: log.go_spec
statement:
lemma log.go_spec {b n fuel : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hfuel : n < b ^ fuel) :
    (log.go n b fuel).1 = n / b ^ (log.go n b fuel).2 ∧
      b ^ (log.go n b fuel).2 ≤ n ∧ n < b ^ ((log.go n b fuel).2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing b with
  | zero => simp_all
  | succ fuel ih =>
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge n b with
    | inl hnb =>
      simp [go, hnb, one_le_iff_ne_zero, hn]
    | inr hnb =>
      rcases ih (Nat.one_mul 1 ▸ Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt hb hb) (go_aux hb hfuel hnb)
        with ⟨ih₁, ih₂, ih₃⟩
      simp_all only [go, ite_eq_right (Nat.not_lt_of_le hnb), ← Nat.pow_two, ← Nat.pow_mul,
        Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul, Nat.pow_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hb), Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul,
        ← Nat.pow_add_one, ← Nat.pow_add_one', Nat.mul_add_one]
      split <;> simp_all

name: log_lt_iff_lt_pow
statement:
theorem log_lt_iff_lt_pow {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) {x y : ℕ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    log b y < x ↔ y < b ^ x
proof:
:= by
  rcases log.go_spec hb hy (Nat.lt_pow_self hb) with ⟨-, H₁, H₂⟩
  rw [log, ite_eq_right (Nat.not_le_of_lt hb)]
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge (log.go y b y).snd x with
  | inl h =>
    exact iff_of_true h <| Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le H₂ <| Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hb) h
  | inr h =>
    refine iff_of_false (Nat.not_lt_of_ge h) <| Nat.not_lt_of_ge <| Nat.le_trans ?_ H₁
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hb) h

name: log_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_eq_zero_iff {b n : ℕ} : log b n = 0 ↔ n < b ∨ b ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 1 b with hb | hb
  · rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
    · grind [log_of_lt]
    · rw [← Nat.lt_one_iff, log_lt_iff_lt_pow hb hn, Nat.pow_one, or_iff_left (Nat.not_le_of_lt hb)]
  · simp [hb, log_of_left_le_one]

name: log_pos_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_pos_iff {b n : ℕ} : 0 < log b n ↔ b ≤ n ∧ 1 < b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, Ne, log_eq_zero_iff, not_or, not_lt, not_le]

name: log_pos
statement:
@[bound]
theorem log_pos {b n : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hbn : b ≤ n) : 0 < log b n

name: log_of_one_lt_of_le
statement: theorem log_of_one_lt_of_le {b n : ℕ} (h : 1 < b) (hn : b ≤ n) : log b n = log b (n / b) + 1
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_forall_gt_iff
  rintro (_ | c)
  · simp
  · have : n / b ≠ 0 := by simp [*, Nat.ne_zero_of_lt h]
    rw [log_lt_iff_lt_pow, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right, log_lt_iff_lt_pow,
      Nat.pow_add_one, Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul] <;> grind

name: log_zero_left
statement: @[simp] lemma log_zero_left : ∀ n, log 0 n = 0

name: log_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_zero_right (b : ℕ) : log b 0 = 0

name: log_one_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_one_left : ∀ n, log 1 n = 0

name: log_one_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_one_right (b : ℕ) : log b 1 = 0

name: le_log_iff_pow_le
statement:
theorem le_log_iff_pow_le {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) {x y : ℕ} (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    x ≤ log b y ↔ b ^ x ≤ y

name: pow_le_of_le_log
statement: theorem pow_le_of_le_log {b x y : ℕ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (h : x ≤ log b y) : b ^ x ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  refine (le_or_gt b 1).elim (fun hb => ?_) fun hb => (le_log_iff_pow_le hb hy).1 h
  rw [log_of_left_le_one hb, Nat.le_zero] at h
  rwa [h, Nat.pow_zero, one_le_iff_ne_zero]

name: le_log_of_pow_le
statement: theorem le_log_of_pow_le {b x y : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (h : b ^ x ≤ y) : x ≤ log b y
proof:
:= by
  rcases ne_or_eq y 0 with (hy | rfl)
  exacts [(le_log_iff_pow_le hb hy).2 h, (h.not_gt (Nat.pow_pos (Nat.zero_lt_one.trans hb))).elim]

name: pow_log_le_self
statement: theorem pow_log_le_self (b : ℕ) {x : ℕ} (hx : x ≠ 0) : b ^ log b x ≤ x

name: log_lt_of_lt_pow
statement: theorem log_lt_of_lt_pow {b x y : ℕ} (hy : y ≠ 0) : y < b ^ x → log b y < x

name: log_lt_of_lt_pow'
statement: theorem log_lt_of_lt_pow' {b x y : ℕ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hlt : y < b ^ x) : log b y < x
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne y 0 with rfl | hy
  · grind [log_zero_right]
  · exact log_lt_of_lt_pow hy hlt

name: lt_pow_of_log_lt
statement: theorem lt_pow_of_log_lt {b x y : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) : log b y < x → y < b ^ x

name: log_lt_self
statement: lemma log_lt_self (b : ℕ) {x : ℕ} (hx : x ≠ 0) : log b x < x
proof:
:=
  match le_or_gt b 1 with
  | .inl h => log_of_left_le_one h x ▸ Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.2 hx
  | .inr h => log_lt_of_lt_pow hx <| Nat.lt_pow_self h

name: log_le_self
statement: lemma log_le_self (b x : ℕ) : log b x ≤ x
proof:
:=
  if hx : x = 0 then by simp [hx]
  else (log_lt_self b hx).le

name: lt_pow_succ_log_self
statement: theorem lt_pow_succ_log_self {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (x : ℕ) : x < b ^ (log b x).succ

name: log_eq_iff
statement:
theorem log_eq_iff {b m n : ℕ} (h : m ≠ 0 ∨ 1 < b ∧ n ≠ 0) :
    log b n = m ↔ b ^ m ≤ n ∧ n < b ^ (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases em (1 < b ∧ n ≠ 0) with (⟨hb, hn⟩ | hbn)
  · rw [le_antisymm_iff, ← Nat.lt_succ_iff, le_log_iff_pow_le, log_lt_iff_lt_pow,
      and_comm] <;> assumption
  have hm : m ≠ 0 := h.resolve_right hbn
  rw [not_and_or, not_lt, Ne, not_not] at hbn
  rcases hbn with (hb | rfl)
  · obtain rfl | rfl := le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.1 hb <;>
      simp only [log_zero_left, log_one_left] <;> lia
  · simp [@eq_comm _ 0, hm]

name: log_eq_of_pow_le_of_lt_pow
statement:
theorem log_eq_of_pow_le_of_lt_pow {b m n : ℕ} (h₁ : b ^ m ≤ n) (h₂ : n < b ^ (m + 1)) :
    log b n = m
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with (rfl | hm)
  · rw [Nat.pow_one] at h₂
    exact log_of_lt h₂
  · exact (log_eq_iff (Or.inl hm)).2 ⟨h₁, h₂⟩

name: log_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_pow {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (x : ℕ) : log b (b ^ x) = x

name: log_eq_one_iff'
statement: theorem log_eq_one_iff' {b n : ℕ} : log b n = 1 ↔ b ≤ n ∧ n < b * b

name: log_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem log_eq_one_iff {b n : ℕ} : log b n = 1 ↔ n < b * b ∧ 1 < b ∧ b ≤ n
proof:
:=
  log_eq_one_iff'.trans
    ⟨fun h => ⟨h.2, lt_mul_self_iff.1 (h.1.trans_lt h.2), h.1⟩, fun h => ⟨h.2.2, h.1⟩⟩

name: log_mul_base
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_mul_base {b n : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hn : n ≠ 0) : log b (n * b) = log b n + 1
proof:
:= by
  apply log_eq_of_pow_le_of_lt_pow <;> rw [pow_succ', Nat.mul_comm b]
  exacts [Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (pow_log_le_self _ hn),
    (Nat.mul_lt_mul_right (Nat.zero_lt_one.trans hb)).2 (lt_pow_succ_log_self hb _)]

name: pow_log_le_add_one
statement:
theorem pow_log_le_add_one (b : ℕ) : ∀ x, b ^ log b x ≤ x + 1
  | 0 => by rw [log_zero_right, Nat.pow_zero]
  | x + 1 => (pow_log_le_self b x.succ_ne_zero).trans (x + 1).le_succ

name: log_monotone
statement: theorem log_monotone {b : ℕ} : Monotone (log b)
proof:
:= by
  refine monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n => ?_
  rcases le_or_gt b 1 with hb | hb
  · rw [log_of_left_le_one hb]
    exact zero_le _
  · exact le_log_of_pow_le hb (pow_log_le_add_one _ _)

name: log_mono_right
statement:
@[mono, gcongr]
theorem log_mono_right {b n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) : log b n ≤ log b m

name: log_lt_log_succ_iff
statement:
theorem log_lt_log_succ_iff {b n : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    log b n < log b (n + 1) ↔ b ^ log b (n + 1) = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, fun H ↦ ?_⟩
  · apply le_antisymm _ (Nat.lt_pow_of_log_lt hb H)
    exact Nat.pow_log_le_self b (Ne.symm (Nat.zero_ne_add_one n))
  · apply Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow hn
    simp [H]

name: log_eq_log_succ_iff
statement:
theorem log_eq_log_succ_iff {b n : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    log b n = log b (n + 1) ↔ b ^ log b (n + 1) ≠ n + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_eq, ← log_lt_log_succ_iff hb hn, not_lt]
  simp only [le_antisymm_iff, and_iff_right_iff_imp]
  exact fun _ ↦ log_monotone (le_add_right n 1)

name: log_anti_left
statement: theorem log_anti_left {b c n : ℕ} (hc : 1 < c) (hb : c ≤ b) : log b n ≤ log c n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn); · rw [log_zero_right, log_zero_right]
  apply le_log_of_pow_le hc
  calc
    c ^ log b n ≤ b ^ log b n := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hb _
    _ ≤ n := pow_log_le_self _ hn

name: log_antitone_left
statement: theorem log_antitone_left {n : ℕ} : AntitoneOn (fun b => log b n) (Set.Ioi 1)
proof:
:= fun _ hc _ _ hb =>
  log_anti_left (Set.mem_Iio.1 hc) hb

name: log_mono
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem log_mono {b c m n : ℕ} (hc : 1 < c) (hb : c ≤ b) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    log b m ≤ log c n

name: log_div_base
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_div_base (b n : ℕ) : log b (n / b) = log b n - 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt b 1 with hb | hb
  · rw [log_of_left_le_one hb, log_of_left_le_one hb, Nat.zero_sub]
  rcases lt_or_ge n b with h | h
  · rw [div_eq_of_lt h, log_of_lt h, log_zero_right]
  rw [log_of_one_lt_of_le hb h, Nat.add_sub_cancel_right]

name: log_div_base_pow
statement: lemma log_div_base_pow (b n k : ℕ) : log b (n / b ^ k) = log b n - k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => grind
  | succ k hk => rw [Nat.pow_succ, ← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, log_div_base, hk, sub_add_eq]

name: log_div_mul_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_div_mul_self (b n : ℕ) : log b (n / b * b) = log b n
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt b 1 with hb | hb
  · rw [log_of_left_le_one hb, log_of_left_le_one hb]
  rcases lt_or_ge n b with h | h
  · rw [div_eq_of_lt h, Nat.zero_mul, log_zero_right, log_of_lt h]
  rw [log_mul_base hb (Nat.div_pos h (by lia)).ne', log_div_base,
    Nat.sub_add_cancel (succ_le_iff.2 <| log_pos hb h)]

name: add_pred_div_lt
statement: theorem add_pred_div_lt {b n : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : (n + b - 1) / b < n
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by lia), ← succ_le_iff, ← pred_eq_sub_one,
    succ_pred_eq_of_pos (by lia)]
  exact Nat.add_le_mul hn hb

name: log_two_bit
statement: lemma log_two_bit {b n} (hn : n ≠ 0) : Nat.log 2 (n.bit b) = Nat.log 2 n + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← log_div_mul_self, bit_div_two, log_mul_base Nat.one_lt_two hn]

name: log2_eq_log_two
statement: lemma log2_eq_log_two {n : ℕ} : Nat.log2 n = Nat.log 2 n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
  · rw [log2_zero, log_zero_right]
  apply eq_of_forall_le_iff
  intro m
  rw [Nat.le_log2 hn, Nat.le_log_iff_pow_le Nat.one_lt_two hn]

name: log_pow_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma log_pow_left (b k n : ℕ) : log (b ^ k) n = log b n / k
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
  · simp
  · rcases k.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hk
    · simp
    · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 1 b with hb | hb
      · refine eq_of_forall_le_iff fun c ↦ ?_
        rw [le_log_iff_pow_le (Nat.one_lt_pow (Nat.ne_of_gt hk) hb) hn, Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hk,
          le_log_iff_pow_le hb hn, Nat.pow_mul']
      · rw [log_of_left_le_one hb, Nat.zero_div, log_of_left_le_one]
        rwa [Nat.pow_le_one_iff (Nat.ne_of_gt hk)]

name: clog_of_left_le_one
statement: theorem clog_of_left_le_one {b : ℕ} (hb : b ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) : clog b n = 0

name: clog_of_right_le_one
statement: theorem clog_of_right_le_one {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ 1) (b : ℕ) : clog b n = 0

name: clog_zero_left
statement: @[simp] lemma clog_zero_left (n : ℕ) : clog 0 n = 0

name: clog_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma clog_zero_right (b : ℕ) : clog b 0 = 0

name: clog_one_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem clog_one_left (n : ℕ) : clog 1 n = 0

name: clog_one_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem clog_one_right (b : ℕ) : clog b 1 = 0

name: clog.go_spec
statement:
theorem clog.go_spec {n b fuel} (hn : 1 < n) (hb : 1 < b) (hfuel : n < b ^ fuel) :
    (go n b fuel).1 = b ^ ((go n b fuel).2 + 1) / n ∧
      b ^ (go n b fuel).2 < n ∧ n ≤ b ^ ((go n b fuel).2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing b with
  | zero => simp_all
  | succ fuel ih =>
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge b n with
    | inr hbn => simp_all [go]
    | inl hbn =>
      rcases ih (Nat.one_mul 1 ▸ Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt hb hb)
        (log.go_aux hb hfuel (Nat.le_of_lt hbn)) with ⟨ih₁, ih₂, ih₃⟩
      simp_all only [go, ite_eq_right (Nat.not_le_of_gt hbn), ← Nat.pow_two, ← Nat.pow_mul,
        Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hbn), Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul,
        Nat.mul_comm n b, Nat.mul_add_one, @Nat.pow_add_one' _ (2 * _ + 1),
        Nat.mul_lt_mul_left, Nat.mul_div_mul_left, Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hb]
      split <;> simp_all [Nat.mul_add_one, Nat.pow_add_one']

name: clog_le_iff_le_pow
statement: theorem clog_le_iff_le_pow {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) {x y : ℕ} : clog b x ≤ y ↔ x ≤ b ^ y
proof:
:= by
  fun_cases clog with
  | case1 h =>
    rcases clog.go_spec h.2 hb (Nat.lt_pow_self hb) with ⟨-, H₁, H₂⟩
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge (clog.go x b x).2 y with
    | inl hy =>
      rw [← Nat.add_one_le_iff] at hy
      exact iff_of_true hy <| Nat.le_trans H₂ <| Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hb) hy
    | inr hy =>
      apply_rules [iff_of_false, Nat.not_le_of_gt, Nat.lt_add_one_of_le]
      exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hb) hy) H₁
  | case2 h => grind [Nat.one_le_pow]

name: clog_pos
statement: theorem clog_pos {b n : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hn : 1 < n) : 0 < clog b n

name: clog_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem clog_of_one_lt {b n : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hn : 1 < n) :
    clog b n = clog b ((n + b - 1) / b) + 1
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_forall_ge_iff
  rintro (_ | c)
  · simp [Nat.ne_of_gt <| clog_pos hb hn]
  · simp only [clog_le_iff_le_pow, Nat.pow_add_one, Nat.add_le_add_iff_right, Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hb,
      div_le_iff_le_mul, hb]
    grind

name: clog_of_two_le
statement:
theorem clog_of_two_le {b n : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    clog b n = clog b ((n + b - 1) / b) + 1

name: clog_eq_one
statement: theorem clog_eq_one {b n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (h : n ≤ b) : clog b n = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [clog_of_two_le (hn.trans h) hn, clog_of_right_le_one]
  rw [← Nat.lt_succ_iff, Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul] <;> lia

name: clog_le_of_le_pow
statement: theorem clog_le_of_le_pow {b x y : ℕ} (h : x ≤ b ^ y) : clog b x ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 1 b with hb | hb
  · rwa [clog_le_iff_le_pow hb]
  · grind [clog_of_left_le_one]

name: lt_clog_iff_pow_lt
statement: theorem lt_clog_iff_pow_lt {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) {x y : ℕ} : y < clog b x ↔ b ^ y < x

name: pow_lt_of_lt_clog
statement: theorem pow_lt_of_lt_clog {b x y : ℕ} (h : y < clog b x) : b ^ y < x

name: clog_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem clog_pow (b x : ℕ) (hb : 1 < b) : clog b (b ^ x) = x
proof:
:=
  eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun z ↦ by rw [clog_le_iff_le_pow hb, Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right hb]

name: pow_pred_clog_lt_self
statement:
theorem pow_pred_clog_lt_self {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) {x : ℕ} (hx : 1 < x) :
    b ^ (clog b x).pred < x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lt_clog_iff_pow_lt hb]
  exact pred_lt (clog_pos hb hx).ne'

name: le_pow_clog
statement: theorem le_pow_clog {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (x : ℕ) : x ≤ b ^ clog b x

name: clog_mono_right
statement:
@[mono, gcongr]
theorem clog_mono_right (b : ℕ) {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) : clog b n ≤ clog b m
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt b 1 with hb | hb
  · rw [clog_of_left_le_one hb]
    exact zero_le _
  · rw [clog_le_iff_le_pow hb]
    exact h.trans (le_pow_clog hb _)

name: clog_anti_left
statement: theorem clog_anti_left {b c n : ℕ} (hc : 1 < c) (hb : c ≤ b) : clog b n ≤ clog c n
proof:
:= by
  rw [clog_le_iff_le_pow (lt_of_lt_of_le hc hb)]
  calc
    n ≤ c ^ clog c n := le_pow_clog hc _
    _ ≤ b ^ clog c n := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hb _

name: clog_monotone
statement: theorem clog_monotone (b : ℕ) : Monotone (clog b)

name: clog_antitone_left
statement: theorem clog_antitone_left {n : ℕ} : AntitoneOn (fun b : ℕ => clog b n) (Set.Ioi 1)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hc _ _ hb => clog_anti_left (Set.mem_Iio.1 hc) hb

name: clog_mono
statement:
@[mono, gcongr]
theorem clog_mono {b c m n : ℕ} (hc : 1 < c) (hb : c ≤ b) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    clog b m ≤ clog c n

name: log_le_clog
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_le_clog (b n : ℕ) : log b n ≤ clog b n
proof:
:= by
  obtain hb | hb := le_or_gt b 1
  · rw [log_of_left_le_one hb]
    exact zero_le _
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    rw [log_zero_right]
    exact zero_le _
  | succ n =>
    exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right hb).1
      ((pow_log_le_self b n.succ_ne_zero).trans <| le_pow_clog hb _)

name: clog_lt_clog_succ_iff
statement:
theorem clog_lt_clog_succ_iff {b n : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) :
    clog b n < clog b (n + 1) ↔ b ^ clog b n = n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, fun H ↦ ?_⟩
  · apply le_antisymm _ (le_pow_clog hb n)
    apply le_of_lt_succ
    exact (lt_clog_iff_pow_lt hb).mp H
  · rw [lt_clog_iff_pow_lt hb, H]
    exact n.lt_add_one

name: clog_eq_clog_succ_iff
statement:
theorem clog_eq_clog_succ_iff {b n : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) :
    clog b n = clog b (n + 1) ↔ b ^ clog b n ≠ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_eq, ← clog_lt_clog_succ_iff hb, not_lt]
  simp only [le_antisymm_iff, and_iff_right_iff_imp]
  exact fun _ ↦ clog_monotone b (le_add_right n 1)

name: clog_pow_left
statement: theorem clog_pow_left (b k n : ℕ) : clog (b ^ k) n = (clog b n + (k - 1)) / k
proof:
:= by
  rcases k.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hk
  · simp
  · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge 1 b with hb | hb
    · refine eq_of_forall_lt_iff fun c ↦ ?_
      rw [lt_clog_iff_pow_lt (Nat.one_lt_pow (Nat.ne_of_gt hk) hb), Nat.lt_div_iff_mul_lt hk,
        Nat.add_sub_cancel, lt_clog_iff_pow_lt hb, Nat.pow_mul']
    · suffices (k - 1) / k = 0 by grind [clog_of_left_le_one, Nat.pow_le_one_iff]
      apply Nat.div_eq_of_lt
      grind

name: wf
statement:
protected theorem wf : (∃ x, p x) → WellFounded (Upto.GT p)
  | ⟨x, h⟩ => by
    suffices Upto.GT p = InvImage (· < ·) fun y : Nat.Upto p => x - y.val by
      rw [this]
      exact (measure _).wf
    ext ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, _⟩
    dsimp [InvImage, Upto.GT]
    rw [tsub_lt_tsub_iff_left_of_le (le_of_not_gt fun h' => ha _ h' h)]

/
def zero : Nat.Upto p

name: wf_lbp
statement: private theorem wf_lbp (H : ∃ n, p n) : WellFounded (@lbp p)
proof:
:=
  ⟨let ⟨n, pn⟩ := H
    suffices ∀ m k, n ≤ k + m → Acc lbp k from fun _ => this _ _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
    fun m =>
    Nat.recOn m
      (fun _ kn =>
        ⟨_, fun y r =>
          match y, r with
          | _, ⟨rfl, a⟩ => absurd pn (a _ kn)⟩)
      fun m IH k kn =>
      ⟨_, fun y r =>
        match y, r with
        | _, ⟨rfl, _a⟩ => IH _ (by rw [Nat.add_right_comm]; exact kn)⟩⟩

name: find_spec
statement: protected theorem find_spec : p (Nat.find H)

name: find_min
statement: protected theorem find_min : ∀ {m : ℕ}, m < Nat.find H → ¬p m

name: find_min'
statement: protected theorem find_min' {m : ℕ} (h : p m) : Nat.find H ≤ m
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_of_not_gt fun l => Nat.find_min H l h

name: find_eq_iff
statement: lemma find_eq_iff (h : ∃ n : ℕ, p n) : Nat.find h = m ↔ p m ∧ ∀ n < m, ¬p n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · grind [Nat.find_min]
  · rintro ⟨hm, hlt⟩
    have := Nat.find_min' h hm
    grind

name: find_lt_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma find_lt_iff (h : ∃ n : ℕ, p n) (n : ℕ) : Nat.find h < n ↔ ∃ m < n, p m
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h2 ↦ ⟨Nat.find h, h2, Nat.find_spec h⟩,
    fun ⟨_, hmn, hm⟩ ↦ Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.find_min' h hm) hmn⟩

name: find_le_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma find_le_iff (h : ∃ n : ℕ, p n) (n : ℕ) : Nat.find h ≤ n ↔ ∃ m ≤ n, p m

name: le_find_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma le_find_iff (h : ∃ n : ℕ, p n) (n : ℕ) : n ≤ Nat.find h ↔ ∀ m < n, ¬p m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← not_lt, find_lt_iff, not_exists, not_and]

name: lt_find_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma lt_find_iff (h : ∃ n : ℕ, p n) (n : ℕ) : n < Nat.find h ↔ ∀ m ≤ n, ¬p m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← succ_le_iff, le_find_iff, succ_le_succ_iff]

name: find_eq_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma find_eq_zero (h : ∃ n : ℕ, p n) : Nat.find h = 0 ↔ p 0

name: find_mono_of_le
statement:
lemma find_mono_of_le [DecidablePred q] {x : ℕ} (hx : q x) (hpq : ∀ n ≤ x, q n → p n) :
    Nat.find ⟨x, show p x from hpq _ le_rfl hx⟩ ≤ Nat.find ⟨x, hx⟩

name: find_mono
statement:
lemma find_mono [DecidablePred q] (h : ∀ n, q n → p n) {hp : ∃ n, p n} {hq : ∃ n, q n} :
    Nat.find hp ≤ Nat.find hq
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, hq⟩ := hq; find_mono_of_le hq fun _ _ ↦ h _

name: find_congr
statement:
lemma find_congr [DecidablePred q] {x : ℕ} (hx : p x) (hpq : ∀ n ≤ x, p n ↔ q n) :
    Nat.find ⟨x, hx⟩ = Nat.find ⟨x, show q x from hpq _ le_rfl |>.1 hx⟩
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (find_mono_of_le (hpq _ le_rfl |>.1 hx) fun _ h ↦ (hpq _ h).mpr)
    (find_mono_of_le hx fun _ h ↦ (hpq _ h).mp)

name: find_congr'
statement:
lemma find_congr' [DecidablePred q] {hp : ∃ n, p n} {hq : ∃ n, q n} (hpq : ∀ {n}, p n ↔ q n) :
    Nat.find hp = Nat.find hq
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, hp⟩ := hp; find_congr hp fun _ _ ↦ hpq

name: find_le
statement: lemma find_le {h : ∃ n, p n} (hn : p n) : Nat.find h ≤ n

name: find_comp_succ
statement:
lemma find_comp_succ (h₁ : ∃ n, p n) (h₂ : ∃ n, p (n + 1)) (h0 : ¬p 0) :
    Nat.find h₁ = Nat.find h₂ + 1
proof:
:= by
  refine (find_eq_iff _).2 ⟨Nat.find_spec h₂, fun n hn ↦ ?_⟩
  cases n
  exacts [h0, @Nat.find_min (fun n ↦ p (n + 1)) _ h₂ _ (succ_lt_succ_iff.1 hn)]

name: find_pos
statement: lemma find_pos (h : ∃ n : ℕ, p n) : 0 < Nat.find h ↔ ¬p 0

name: find_add
statement:
lemma find_add {hₘ : ∃ m, p (m + n)} {hₙ : ∃ n, p n} (hn : n ≤ Nat.find hₙ) :
    Nat.find hₘ + n = Nat.find hₙ
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ((le_find_iff _ _).2 fun m hm hpm => Nat.not_le.2 hm ?_) ?_
  · have hnm : n ≤ m := le_trans hn (find_le hpm)
    refine Nat.add_le_of_le_sub hnm (find_le ?_)
    rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel hnm]
  · rw [← Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add]
    refine (le_find_iff _ _).2 fun m hm hpm => Nat.not_le.2 hm ?_
    rw [Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add]
    exact find_le hpm

name: findGreatest_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma findGreatest_zero : Nat.findGreatest P 0 = 0

name: findGreatest_succ
statement:
lemma findGreatest_succ (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.findGreatest P (n + 1) = if P (n + 1) then n + 1 else Nat.findGreatest P n

name: findGreatest_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma findGreatest_eq : ∀ {n}, P n → Nat.findGreatest P n = n
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, h => by simp [Nat.findGreatest, h]

@[simp]

name: findGreatest_of_not
statement:
@[simp]
lemma findGreatest_of_not (h : ¬ P (n + 1)) : findGreatest P (n + 1) = findGreatest P n

name: findGreatest_eq_iff
statement:
lemma findGreatest_eq_iff :
    Nat.findGreatest P k = m ↔ m ≤ k ∧ (m ≠ 0 → P m) ∧ ∀ ⦃n⦄, m < n → n ≤ k → ¬P n
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing m with
  | zero =>
    rw [eq_comm, Iff.comm]
    simp only [Nat.le_zero, ne_eq, findGreatest_zero, and_iff_left_iff_imp]
    rintro rfl
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ (h rfl).elim, fun n hlt heq ↦ by lia⟩
  | succ k ihk =>
    by_cases hk : P (k + 1)
    · rw [findGreatest_eq hk]
      constructor
      · rintro rfl
        exact ⟨le_refl _, fun _ ↦ hk, fun n hlt hle ↦ by lia⟩
      · rintro ⟨hle, h0, hm⟩
        rcases Decidable.lt_or_eq_of_le hle with hlt | rfl
        exacts [(hm hlt (le_refl _) hk).elim, rfl]
    · rw [findGreatest_of_not hk, ihk]
      grind

name: findGreatest_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma findGreatest_eq_zero_iff : Nat.findGreatest P k = 0 ↔ ∀ ⦃n⦄, 0 < n → n ≤ k → ¬P n

name: findGreatest_pos
statement: @[simp] lemma findGreatest_pos : 0 < Nat.findGreatest P k ↔ ∃ n, 0 < n ∧ n ≤ k ∧ P n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, Ne, findGreatest_eq_zero_iff]; push Not; rfl

name: findGreatest_spec
statement: lemma findGreatest_spec (hmb : m ≤ n) (hm : P m) : P (Nat.findGreatest P n)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Nat.findGreatest P n = 0
  · cases m
    · rwa [h]
    exact ((findGreatest_eq_zero_iff.1 h) (zero_lt_succ _) hmb hm).elim
  · exact (findGreatest_eq_iff.1 rfl).2.1 h

name: findGreatest_le
statement: lemma findGreatest_le (n : ℕ) : Nat.findGreatest P n ≤ n

name: le_findGreatest
statement: lemma le_findGreatest (hmb : m ≤ n) (hm : P m) : m ≤ Nat.findGreatest P n
proof:
:=
  le_of_not_gt fun hlt => (findGreatest_eq_iff.1 rfl).2.2 hlt hmb hm

name: findGreatest_mono_right
statement:
lemma findGreatest_mono_right (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] {m n} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    Nat.findGreatest P m ≤ Nat.findGreatest P n
proof:
:= by
  induction hmn with
  | refl => simp
  | step hmk ih =>
    rw [findGreatest_succ]
    split_ifs
    · exact le_trans ih <| le_trans (findGreatest_le _) (le_succ _)
    · exact ih

name: findGreatest_mono_left
statement:
lemma findGreatest_mono_left [DecidablePred Q] (hPQ : ∀ n, P n → Q n) (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.findGreatest P n ≤ Nat.findGreatest Q n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n hn =>
    by_cases h : P (n + 1)
    · rw [findGreatest_eq h, findGreatest_eq (hPQ _ h)]
    · rw [findGreatest_of_not h]
      exact le_trans hn (Nat.findGreatest_mono_right _ <| le_succ _)

name: findGreatest_mono
statement:
lemma findGreatest_mono [DecidablePred Q] (hPQ : ∀ n, P n → Q n) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    Nat.findGreatest P m ≤ Nat.findGreatest Q n

name: findGreatest_is_greatest
statement: theorem findGreatest_is_greatest (hk : Nat.findGreatest P n < k) (hkb : k ≤ n) : ¬P k

name: findGreatest_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem findGreatest_of_ne_zero (h : Nat.findGreatest P n = m) (h0 : m ≠ 0) : P m

name: eta

proof:
:=
  funext fun i => by cases i <;> rfl

name: ext

theorem get_drop (n m : ℕ) (s : Stream' α) : get (drop m s) n = get s (m + n)

name: drop_drop

@[simp]
theorem drop_drop (n m : ℕ) (s : Stream' α) : drop n (drop m s) = drop (m + n) s

name: get_tail

name: tail_drop'
statement: @[simp] theorem tail_drop' {i : ℕ} {s : Stream' α} : tail (drop i s) = s.drop (i + 1)

name: get_succ_cons

@[simp]
theorem get_succ_cons (n : ℕ) (s : Stream' α) (x : α) : get (x :: s) n.succ = get s n

name: get_cons_append_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma get_cons_append_zero {a : α} {x : List α} {s : Stream' α} :

name: append_eq_cons

name: drop_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem drop_zero {s : Stream' α} : s.drop 0 = s

name: cons_injective2
statement: theorem cons_injective2 : Function.Injective2 (cons : α → Stream' α → Stream' α)
proof:
:= fun x y s t h =>
  ⟨by rw [← get_zero_cons x s, h, get_zero_cons],
    Stream'.ext fun n => by rw [← get_succ_cons n _ x, h, get_succ_cons]⟩

name: cons_injective_left
statement: theorem cons_injective_left (s : Stream' α) : Function.Injective fun x => cons x s

name: cons_injective_right
statement: theorem cons_injective_right (x : α) : Function.Injective (cons x)
