statement: theorem all_def (p : α → Prop) (s : Stream' α) : All p s = ∀ n, p (get s n)

name: any_def
statement: theorem any_def (p : α → Prop) (s : Stream' α) : Any p s = ∃ n, p (get s n)

name: mem_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_cons (a : α) (s : Stream' α) : a ∈ a::s

name: mem_cons_of_mem
statement: theorem mem_cons_of_mem {a : α} {s : Stream' α} (b : α) : a ∈ s → a ∈ b::s
proof:
:= fun ⟨n, h⟩ =>
  Exists.intro (succ n) (by rw [get_succ, tail_cons, h])

name: eq_or_mem_of_mem_cons
statement: theorem eq_or_mem_of_mem_cons {a b : α} {s : Stream' α} : (a ∈ b::s) → a = b ∨ a ∈ s
proof:
:=
    fun ⟨n, h⟩ => by
  rcases n with - | n'
  · left
    exact h
  · right
    rw [get_succ, tail_cons] at h
    exact ⟨n', h⟩

name: mem_of_get_eq
statement: theorem mem_of_get_eq {n : ℕ} {s : Stream' α} {a : α} : a = get s n → a ∈ s

name: mem_iff_exists_get_eq
statement:
theorem mem_iff_exists_get_eq {s : Stream' α} {a : α} : a ∈ s ↔ ∃ n, a = s.get n where
  mp
proof:
:= by simp [Membership.mem, any_def]
  mpr h := mem_of_get_eq h.choose_spec

name: drop_map
statement: theorem drop_map (n : ℕ) (s : Stream' α) : drop n (map f s) = map f (drop n s)

name: get_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem get_map (n : ℕ) (s : Stream' α) : get (map f s) n = f (get s n)

name: tail_map
statement: theorem tail_map (s : Stream' α) : tail (map f s) = map f (tail s)

name: head_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem head_map (s : Stream' α) : head (map f s) = f (head s)

name: map_eq
statement: theorem map_eq (s : Stream' α) : map f s = f (head s)::map f (tail s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Stream'.eta (map f s), tail_map, head_map]

name: map_cons
statement: theorem map_cons (a : α) (s : Stream' α) : map f (a::s) = f a::map f s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Stream'.eta (map f (a::s)), map_eq]; rfl

name: map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id (s : Stream' α) : map id s = s

name: map_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_map (g : β → δ) (f : α → β) (s : Stream' α) : map g (map f s) = map (g ∘ f) s

name: map_tail
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_tail (s : Stream' α) : map f (tail s) = tail (map f s)

name: mem_map
statement: theorem mem_map {a : α} {s : Stream' α} : a ∈ s → f a ∈ map f s
proof:
:= fun ⟨n, h⟩ =>
  Exists.intro n (by rw [get_map, h])

name: exists_of_mem_map
statement: theorem exists_of_mem_map {f} {b : β} {s : Stream' α} : b ∈ map f s → ∃ a, a ∈ s ∧ f a = b
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨n, h⟩ => ⟨get s n, ⟨n, rfl⟩, h.symm⟩

name: drop_zip
statement:
theorem drop_zip (n : ℕ) (s₁ : Stream' α) (s₂ : Stream' β) :
    drop n (zip f s₁ s₂) = zip f (drop n s₁) (drop n s₂)

name: get_zip
statement:
@[simp]
theorem get_zip (n : ℕ) (s₁ : Stream' α) (s₂ : Stream' β) :
    get (zip f s₁ s₂) n = f (get s₁ n) (get s₂ n)

name: head_zip
statement: theorem head_zip (s₁ : Stream' α) (s₂ : Stream' β) : head (zip f s₁ s₂) = f (head s₁) (head s₂)

name: tail_zip
statement:
theorem tail_zip (s₁ : Stream' α) (s₂ : Stream' β) :
    tail (zip f s₁ s₂) = zip f (tail s₁) (tail s₂)

name: zip_eq
statement:
theorem zip_eq (s₁ : Stream' α) (s₂ : Stream' β) :
    zip f s₁ s₂ = f (head s₁) (head s₂)::zip f (tail s₁) (tail s₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Stream'.eta (zip f s₁ s₂)]; rfl

name: get_enum
statement:
@[simp]
theorem get_enum (s : Stream' α) (n : ℕ) : get (enum s) n = (n, s.get n)

name: enum_eq_zip
statement: theorem enum_eq_zip (s : Stream' α) : enum s = zip Prod.mk nats s

name: mem_const
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_const (a : α) : a ∈ const a

name: const_eq
statement: theorem const_eq (a : α) : const a = a::const a
proof:
:= by
  apply Stream'.ext; intro n
  cases n <;> rfl

name: tail_const
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tail_const (a : α) : tail (const a) = const a
proof:
:=
  suffices tail (a::const a) = const a by rwa [← const_eq] at this
  rfl

name: map_const
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_const (f : α → β) (a : α) : map f (const a) = const (f a)

name: get_const
statement:
@[simp]
theorem get_const (n : ℕ) (a : α) : get (const a) n = a

name: drop_const
statement:
@[simp]
theorem drop_const (n : ℕ) (a : α) : drop n (const a) = const a

name: head_iterate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem head_iterate (f : α → α) (a : α) : head (iterate f a) = a

name: get_succ_iterate'
statement:
theorem get_succ_iterate' (n : ℕ) (f : α → α) (a : α) :
    get (iterate f a) (succ n) = f (get (iterate f a) n)

name: tail_iterate
statement: theorem tail_iterate (f : α → α) (a : α) : tail (iterate f a) = iterate f (f a)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rw [get_tail]
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [get_succ_iterate', ih, get_succ_iterate']

name: iterate_eq
statement: theorem iterate_eq (f : α → α) (a : α) : iterate f a = a::iterate f (f a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Stream'.eta (iterate f a)]
  rw [tail_iterate]; rfl

name: get_zero_iterate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem get_zero_iterate (f : α → α) (a : α) : get (iterate f a) 0 = a

name: get_succ_iterate
statement:
theorem get_succ_iterate (n : ℕ) (f : α → α) (a : α) :
    get (iterate f a) (succ n) = get (iterate f (f a)) n

name: get_of_bisim
statement:
theorem get_of_bisim (bisim : IsBisimulation R) {s₁ s₂} :
    ∀ n, s₁ ~ s₂ → get s₁ n = get s₂ n ∧ drop (n + 1) s₁ ~ drop (n + 1) s₂
  | 0, h => bisim h
  | n + 1, h =>
    match bisim h with
    | ⟨_, trel⟩ => get_of_bisim bisim n trel

name: eq_of_bisim
statement: theorem eq_of_bisim (bisim : IsBisimulation R) {s₁ s₂} : s₁ ~ s₂ → s₁ = s₂
proof:
:= fun r =>
  Stream'.ext fun n => And.left (get_of_bisim R bisim n r)

name: bisim_simple
statement:
theorem bisim_simple (s₁ s₂ : Stream' α) :
    head s₁ = head s₂ → s₁ = tail s₁ → s₂ = tail s₂ → s₁ = s₂
proof:
:= fun hh ht₁ ht₂ =>
  eq_of_bisim (fun s₁ s₂ => head s₁ = head s₂ ∧ s₁ = tail s₁ ∧ s₂ = tail s₂)
    (fun s₁ s₂ ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ => by grind)
    (And.intro hh (And.intro ht₁ ht₂))

name: coinduction
statement:
theorem coinduction {s₁ s₂ : Stream' α} :
    head s₁ = head s₂ →
      (∀ (β : Type u) (fr : Stream' α → β),
      fr s₁ = fr s₂ → fr (tail s₁) = fr (tail s₂)) → s₁ = s₂
proof:
:=
  fun hh ht =>
  eq_of_bisim
    (fun s₁ s₂ =>
      head s₁ = head s₂ ∧
        ∀ (β : Type u) (fr : Stream' α → β), fr s₁ = fr s₂ → fr (tail s₁) = fr (tail s₂))
    (fun s₁ s₂ h =>
      have h₁ : head s₁ = head s₂ := And.left h
      have h₂ : head (tail s₁) = head (tail s₂) := And.right h α (@head α) h₁
      have h₃ :
        ∀ (β : Type u) (fr : Stream' α → β),
          fr (tail s₁) = fr (tail s₂) → fr (tail (tail s₁)) = fr (tail (tail s₂)) :=
        fun β fr => And.right h β fun s => fr (tail s)
      And.intro h₁ (And.intro h₂ h₃))
    (And.intro hh ht)

name: iterate_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_id (a : α) : iterate id a = const a
proof:
:=
  coinduction rfl fun β fr ch => by rw [tail_iterate, tail_const]; exact ch

name: map_iterate
statement: theorem map_iterate (f : α → α) (a : α) : iterate f (f a) = map f (iterate f a)
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    unfold map iterate get
    rw [map, get] at ih
    rw [iterate]
    exact congrArg f ih

name: corec_def
statement: theorem corec_def (f : α → β) (g : α → α) (a : α) : corec f g a = map f (iterate g a)

name: corec_eq
statement: theorem corec_eq (f : α → β) (g : α → α) (a : α) : corec f g a = f a :: corec f g (g a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [corec_def, map_eq, head_iterate, tail_iterate]; rfl

name: corec_id_id_eq_const
statement: theorem corec_id_id_eq_const (a : α) : corec id id a = const a

name: corec_id_f_eq_iterate
statement: theorem corec_id_f_eq_iterate (f : α → α) (a : α) : corec id f a = iterate f a

name: corec'_eq
statement: theorem corec'_eq (f : α → β × α) (a : α) : corec' f a = (f a).1 :: corec' f (f a).2

name: unfolds_eq
statement: theorem unfolds_eq (g : α → β) (f : α → α) (a : α) : unfolds g f a = g a :: unfolds g f (f a)

name: get_unfolds_head_tail
statement: theorem get_unfolds_head_tail (n : ℕ) (s : Stream' α) : get (unfolds head tail s) n = get s n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [get_succ, get_succ, unfolds_eq, tail_cons, ih]

name: unfolds_head_eq
statement: theorem unfolds_head_eq : ∀ s : Stream' α, unfolds head tail s = s
proof:
:= fun s =>
  Stream'.ext fun n => get_unfolds_head_tail n s

name: interleave_eq
statement: theorem interleave_eq (s₁ s₂ : Stream' α) : s₁ ⋈ s₂ = head s₁::head s₂::(tail s₁ ⋈ tail s₂)
proof:
:= by
  let t := tail s₁ ⋈ tail s₂
  change s₁ ⋈ s₂ = head s₁::head s₂::t
  unfold interleave; unfold corecOn; rw [corec_eq]; dsimp; rw [corec_eq]; rfl

name: tail_interleave
statement: theorem tail_interleave (s₁ s₂ : Stream' α) : tail (s₁ ⋈ s₂) = s₂ ⋈ tail s₁
proof:
:= by
  unfold interleave corecOn; rw [corec_eq]; rfl

name: interleave_tail_tail
statement: theorem interleave_tail_tail (s₁ s₂ : Stream' α) : tail s₁ ⋈ tail s₂ = tail (tail (s₁ ⋈ s₂))

name: get_interleave_left
statement:
theorem get_interleave_left : ∀ (n : ℕ) (s₁ s₂ : Stream' α),
    get (s₁ ⋈ s₂) (2 * n) = get s₁ n
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, s₁, s₂ => by
    change get (s₁ ⋈ s₂) (succ (succ (2 * n))) = get s₁ (succ n)
    rw [get_succ, get_succ, interleave_eq, tail_cons, tail_cons]
    rw [get_interleave_left n (tail s₁) (tail s₂)]
    rfl

name: get_interleave_right
statement:
theorem get_interleave_right : ∀ (n : ℕ) (s₁ s₂ : Stream' α),
    get (s₁ ⋈ s₂) (2 * n + 1) = get s₂ n
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, s₁, s₂ => by
    change get (s₁ ⋈ s₂) (succ (succ (2 * n + 1))) = get s₂ (succ n)
    rw [get_succ, get_succ, interleave_eq, tail_cons, tail_cons,
      get_interleave_right n (tail s₁) (tail s₂)]
    rfl

name: mem_interleave_left
statement: theorem mem_interleave_left {a : α} {s₁ : Stream' α} (s₂ : Stream' α) : a ∈ s₁ → a ∈ s₁ ⋈ s₂
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨n, h⟩ => Exists.intro (2 * n) (by rw [h, get_interleave_left])

name: mem_interleave_right
statement: theorem mem_interleave_right {a : α} {s₁ : Stream' α} (s₂ : Stream' α) : a ∈ s₂ → a ∈ s₁ ⋈ s₂
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨n, h⟩ => Exists.intro (2 * n + 1) (by rw [h, get_interleave_right])

name: odd_eq
statement: theorem odd_eq (s : Stream' α) : odd s = even (tail s)

name: head_even
statement:
@[simp]
theorem head_even (s : Stream' α) : head (even s) = head s

name: tail_even
statement: theorem tail_even (s : Stream' α) : tail (even s) = even (tail (tail s))

name: even_cons_cons
statement: theorem even_cons_cons (a₁ a₂ : α) (s : Stream' α) : even (a₁::a₂::s) = a₁::even s

name: even_tail
statement: theorem even_tail (s : Stream' α) : even (tail s) = odd s

name: even_interleave
statement: theorem even_interleave (s₁ s₂ : Stream' α) : even (s₁ ⋈ s₂) = s₁
proof:
:=
  eq_of_bisim (fun s₁' s₁ => ∃ s₂, s₁' = even (s₁ ⋈ s₂))
    (fun s₁' s₁ ⟨s₂, h₁⟩ => by
      rw [h₁]
      constructor
      · rfl
      · exact ⟨tail s₂, by rw [interleave_eq, even_cons_cons, tail_cons]⟩)
    (Exists.intro s₂ rfl)

name: interleave_even_odd
statement: theorem interleave_even_odd (s₁ : Stream' α) : even s₁ ⋈ odd s₁ = s₁
proof:
:=
  eq_of_bisim (fun s' s => s' = even s ⋈ odd s)
    (fun s' s (h : s' = even s ⋈ odd s) => by
      rw [h]; constructor
      · rfl
      · simp [odd_eq, odd_eq, tail_interleave, tail_even])
    rfl

name: get_even
statement:
theorem get_even : ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : Stream' α), get (even s) n = get s (2 * n)
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | succ n, s => by
    change get (even s) (succ n) = get s (succ (succ (2 * n)))
    rw [get_succ, get_succ, tail_even, get_even n]; rfl

name: get_odd
statement: theorem get_odd : ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : Stream' α), get (odd s) n = get s (2 * n + 1)
proof:
:= fun n s => by
  rw [odd_eq, get_even]; rfl

name: mem_of_mem_even
statement: theorem mem_of_mem_even (a : α) (s : Stream' α) : a ∈ even s → a ∈ s
proof:
:= fun ⟨n, h⟩ =>
  Exists.intro (2 * n) (by rw [h, get_even])

name: mem_of_mem_odd
statement: theorem mem_of_mem_odd (a : α) (s : Stream' α) : a ∈ odd s → a ∈ s
proof:
:= fun ⟨n, h⟩ =>
  Exists.intro (2 * n + 1) (by rw [h, get_odd])

name: nil_append_stream
statement: @[simp] theorem nil_append_stream (s : Stream' α) : appendStream' [] s = s

name: cons_append_stream
statement:
theorem cons_append_stream (a : α) (l : List α) (s : Stream' α) :
    appendStream' (a::l) s = a::appendStream' l s

name: append_append_stream
statement:
@[simp] theorem append_append_stream : ∀ (l₁ l₂ : List α) (s : Stream' α),
    l₁ ++ l₂ ++ₛ s = l₁ ++ₛ (l₂ ++ₛ s)
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | List.cons a l₁, l₂, s => by
    rw [List.cons_append, cons_append_stream, cons_append_stream, append_append_stream l₁]

name: get_append_left
statement: lemma get_append_left (h : n < x.length) : (x ++ₛ a).get n = x[n]
proof:
:= by
  induction x generalizing n with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons b x ih =>
    rcases n with (_ | n)
    · simp
    · simp [ih n (by simpa using h), cons_append_stream]

name: get_append_right
statement: @[simp] lemma get_append_right : (x ++ₛ a).get (x.length + n) = a.get n

name: get_append_length
statement: @[simp] lemma get_append_length : (x ++ₛ a).get x.length = a.get 0

name: append_right_injective
statement: lemma append_right_injective (h : x ++ₛ a = x ++ₛ b) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  ext n; replace h := congr_arg (fun a ↦ a.get (x.length + n)) h; simpa using h

name: append_right_inj
statement: @[simp] lemma append_right_inj : x ++ₛ a = x ++ₛ b ↔ a = b

name: append_left_injective
statement: lemma append_left_injective (h : x ++ₛ a = y ++ₛ b) (hl : x.length = y.length) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem hl
  intros
  rw [← get_append_left, ← get_append_left, h]

name: map_append_stream
statement:
theorem map_append_stream (f : α → β) :
    ∀ (l : List α) (s : Stream' α), map f (l ++ₛ s) = List.map f l ++ₛ map f s
  | [], _ => rfl
  | List.cons a l, s => by
    rw [cons_append_stream, List.map_cons, map_cons, cons_append_stream, map_append_stream f l]

name: drop_append_stream
statement:
theorem drop_append_stream : ∀ (l : List α) (s : Stream' α), drop l.length (l ++ₛ s) = s
  | [], s => rfl
  | List.cons a l, s => by
    rw [List.length_cons, drop_succ, cons_append_stream, tail_cons, drop_append_stream l s]

name: append_stream_head_tail
statement: theorem append_stream_head_tail (s : Stream' α) : [head s] ++ₛ tail s = s

name: mem_append_stream_right
statement:
theorem mem_append_stream_right : ∀ {a : α} (l : List α) {s : Stream' α}, a ∈ s → a ∈ l ++ₛ s
  | _, [], _, h => h
  | a, List.cons _ l, s, h =>
    have ih : a ∈ l ++ₛ s

name: mem_append_stream_left
statement:
theorem mem_append_stream_left : ∀ {a : α} {l : List α} (s : Stream' α), a ∈ l → a ∈ l ++ₛ s
  | _, [], _, h => absurd h List.not_mem_nil
  | a, List.cons b l, s, h =>
    Or.elim (List.eq_or_mem_of_mem_cons h) (fun aeqb : a = b => Exists.intro 0 aeqb)
      fun ainl : a ∈ l => mem_cons_of_mem b (mem_append_stream_left s ainl)

@[simp]

name: take_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem take_zero (s : Stream' α) : take 0 s = []

name: take_succ
statement: theorem take_succ (n : ℕ) (s : Stream' α) : take (succ n) s = head s::take n (tail s)

name: take_succ_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem take_succ_cons {a : α} (n : ℕ) (s : Stream' α) :
    take (n + 1) (a::s) = a :: take n s

name: take_succ'
statement:
theorem take_succ' {s : Stream' α} : ∀ n, s.take (n + 1) = s.take n ++ [s.get n]
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by rw [take_succ, take_succ' n, ← List.cons_append, ← take_succ, get_tail]

@[simp]

name: length_take
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_take (n : ℕ) (s : Stream' α) : (take n s).length = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s <;> simp [*, take_succ]

name: take_take
statement:
@[simp]
theorem take_take {s : Stream' α} : ∀ {m n}, (s.take n).take m = s.take (min n m)
  | 0, n => by rw [Nat.min_zero, List.take_zero, take_zero]
  | m, 0 => by rw [Nat.zero_min, take_zero, List.take_nil]
  | m + 1, n + 1 => by rw [take_succ, List.take_succ_cons, Nat.succ_min_succ, take_succ, take_take]

@[simp] theorem concat_take_get {n : ℕ} {s : Stream' α} : s.take n ++ [s.get n] = s.take (n + 1)

name: concat_take_get
statement: @[simp] theorem concat_take_get {n : ℕ} {s : Stream' α} : s.take n ++ [s.get n] = s.take (n + 1)

name: getElem
statement:
theorem getElem?_take {s : Stream' α} : ∀ {k n}, k < n → (s.take n)[k]? = s.get k
  | 0, _ + 1, _ => by simp only [length_take, zero_lt_succ, List.getElem?_eq_getElem]; rfl
  | k + 1, n + 1, h => by
    rw [take_succ, List.getElem?_cons_succ, getElem?_take (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h), get_succ]

name: getElem
statement:
theorem getElem?_take_succ (n : ℕ) (s : Stream' α) :
    (take (succ n) s)[n]? = some (get s n)

name: dropLast_take
statement:
@[simp] theorem dropLast_take {n : ℕ} {xs : Stream' α} :
    (Stream'.take n xs).dropLast = Stream'.take (n - 1) xs
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n => rw [take_succ', List.dropLast_concat, Nat.add_one_sub_one]

name: append_take_drop
statement:
@[simp]
theorem append_take_drop (n : ℕ) (s : Stream' α) : appendStream' (take n s) (drop n s) = s
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [take_succ, drop_succ, cons_append_stream, ih (tail s), Stream'.eta]

name: append_take
statement: lemma append_take : x ++ (a.take n) = (x ++ₛ a).take (x.length + n)
proof:
:= by
  induction x <;> simp [take, Nat.add_comm, cons_append_stream, *]

name: take_get
statement: @[simp] lemma take_get (h : m < (a.take n).length) : (a.take n)[m] = a.get m
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← append_take_drop n a]; rw [get_append_left]

name: take_append_of_le_length
statement:
theorem take_append_of_le_length (h : n ≤ x.length) :
    (x ++ₛ a).take n = x.take n
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem (by simp [h])
  intro _ _ _; rw [List.getElem_take, take_get, get_append_left]

name: take_add
statement: lemma take_add : a.take (m + n) = a.take m ++ (a.drop m).take n
proof:
:= by
  apply append_left_injective _ _ (a.drop (m + n)) ((a.drop m).drop n) <;>
    simp [-drop_drop]

name: take_prefix_take_left
statement: @[gcongr] lemma take_prefix_take_left (h : m ≤ n) : a.take m <+: a.take n
proof:
:= by
  rw [(by simp [h] : a.take m = (a.take n).take m)]
  apply List.take_prefix

name: take_prefix
statement: @[simp] lemma take_prefix : a.take m <+: a.take n ↔ m ≤ n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ by simpa using h.length_le, take_prefix_take_left m n a⟩

name: map_take
statement: lemma map_take (f : α → β) : (a.take n).map f = (a.map f).take n

name: take_drop
statement: lemma take_drop : (a.drop m).take n = (a.take (m + n)).drop m

name: drop_append_of_le_length
statement:
lemma drop_append_of_le_length (h : n ≤ x.length) :
    (x ++ₛ a).drop n = x.drop n ++ₛ a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  ext k; rcases lt_or_ge k m with _ | hk
  · rw [get_drop, get_append_left, get_append_left, List.getElem_drop]; simpa [hm]
  · obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hk
    have hm' : m = (x.drop n).length := by simp [hm]
    simp_rw [get_drop, ← Nat.add_assoc, ← hm, get_append_right, hm', get_append_right]

name: take_theorem
statement: theorem take_theorem (s₁ s₂ : Stream' α) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, take n s₁ = take n s₂) : s₁ = s₂
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa [take] using h 1
  | succ n =>
    have h₁ : some (get s₁ (succ n)) = some (get s₂ (succ n)) := by
      rw [← getElem?_take_succ, ← getElem?_take_succ, h (succ (succ n))]
    injection h₁

name: cycle_g_cons
statement:
protected theorem cycle_g_cons (a : α) (a₁ : α) (l₁ : List α) (a₀ : α) (l₀ : List α) :
    Stream'.cycleG (a, a₁::l₁, a₀, l₀) = (a₁, l₁, a₀, l₀)

name: cycle_eq
statement:
theorem cycle_eq : ∀ (l : List α) (h : l ≠ []), cycle l h = l ++ₛ cycle l h
  | [], h => absurd rfl h
  | List.cons a l, _ =>
    have gen (l' a') : corec Stream'.cycleF Stream'.cycleG (a', l', a, l) =
        (a'::l') ++ₛ corec Stream'.cycleF Stream'.cycleG (a, l, a, l)
proof:
:= by
      induction l' generalizing a' with
      | nil => rw [corec_eq]; rfl
      | cons a₁ l₁ ih => rw [corec_eq, Stream'.cycle_g_cons, ih a₁]; rfl
    gen l a

name: mem_cycle
statement: theorem mem_cycle {a : α} {l : List α} : ∀ h : l ≠ [], a ∈ l → a ∈ cycle l h
proof:
:= fun h ainl => by
  rw [cycle_eq]; exact mem_append_stream_left _ ainl

name: cycle_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cycle_singleton (a : α) : cycle [a] (by simp) = const a
proof:
:=
  coinduction rfl fun β fr ch => by rwa [cycle_eq, const_eq]

name: tails_eq
statement: theorem tails_eq (s : Stream' α) : tails s = tail s::tails (tail s)

name: get_tails
statement:
@[simp]
theorem get_tails (n : ℕ) (s : Stream' α) : get (tails s) n = drop n (tail s)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [get_succ, drop_succ, tails_eq, tail_cons, ih]

name: tails_eq_iterate
statement: theorem tails_eq_iterate (s : Stream' α) : tails s = iterate tail (tail s)

name: inits_core_eq
statement:
theorem inits_core_eq (l : List α) (s : Stream' α) :
    initsCore l s = l::initsCore (l ++ [head s]) (tail s)

name: tail_inits
statement:
theorem tail_inits (s : Stream' α) :
    tail (inits s) = initsCore [head s, head (tail s)] (tail (tail s))

name: inits_tail
statement: theorem inits_tail (s : Stream' α) : inits (tail s) = initsCore [head (tail s)] (tail (tail s))

name: cons_get_inits_core
statement:
theorem cons_get_inits_core (a : α) (n : ℕ) (l : List α) (s : Stream' α) :
    (a :: get (initsCore l s) n) = get (initsCore (a :: l) s) n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing l s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [get_succ, inits_core_eq, tail_cons, ih, inits_core_eq (a :: l) s]
    rfl

name: get_inits
statement:
@[simp]
theorem get_inits (n : ℕ) (s : Stream' α) : get (inits s) n = take (succ n) s
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => rw [get_succ, take_succ, ← ih, tail_inits, inits_tail, cons_get_inits_core]

name: inits_eq
statement:
theorem inits_eq (s : Stream' α) :
    inits s = [head s]::map (List.cons (head s)) (inits (tail s))
proof:
:= by
  apply Stream'.ext; intro n
  cases n
  · rfl
  · rw [get_inits, get_succ, tail_cons, get_map, get_inits]
    rfl

name: zip_inits_tails
statement: theorem zip_inits_tails (s : Stream' α) : zip appendStream' (inits s) (tails s) = const s

name: identity
statement: theorem identity (s : Stream' α) : pure id ⊛ s = s

name: composition
statement:
theorem composition (g : Stream' (β → δ)) (f : Stream' (α → β)) (s : Stream' α) :
    pure comp ⊛ g ⊛ f ⊛ s = g ⊛ (f ⊛ s)

name: homomorphism
statement: theorem homomorphism (f : α → β) (a : α) : pure f ⊛ pure a = pure (f a)

name: interchange
statement:
theorem interchange (fs : Stream' (α → β)) (a : α) :
    fs ⊛ pure a = (pure fun f : α → β => f a) ⊛ fs

name: map_eq_apply
statement: theorem map_eq_apply (f : α → β) (s : Stream' α) : map f s = pure f ⊛ s

name: get_nats
statement: theorem get_nats (n : ℕ) : get nats n = n

name: nats_eq
statement: theorem nats_eq : nats = cons 0 (map succ nats)
proof:
:= by
  apply Stream'.ext; intro n
  cases n
  · rfl
  rw [get_succ]; rfl

name: Float.Zero.valid
statement: theorem Float.Zero.valid : ValidFinite emin 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨by
    rw [add_sub_assoc]
    apply le_add_of_nonneg_right
    apply sub_nonneg_of_le
    apply Int.ofNat_le_ofNat_of_le
    exact C.precPos,
    suffices prec ≤ 2 * emax by
      rw [← Int.ofNat_le] at this
      rw [← sub_nonneg] at *
      simp only [emin, emax] at *
      lia
    le_trans C.precMax (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ Nat.zero_lt_two),
    by (simp [sub_eq_add_neg, Int.natCast_nonneg])⟩

name: eq_iff_rel_eq
statement: theorem eq_iff_rel_eq {r₁ r₂ : Setoid α} : r₁ = r₂ ↔ ⇑r₁ = ⇑r₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h ▸ rfl, fun h => Setoid.ext fun _ _ => h ▸ Iff.rfl⟩

name: le_def
statement: theorem le_def {r s : Setoid α} : r ≤ s ↔ ∀ {x y}, r x y → s x y

name: le_iff_rel_le
statement: theorem le_iff_rel_le {r₁ r₂ : Setoid α} : r₁ ≤ r₂ ↔ ⇑r₁ ≤ ⇑r₂

name: refl'
statement:
@[refl]
theorem refl' (r : Setoid α) (x) : r x x

name: symm'
statement:
@[symm]
theorem symm' (r : Setoid α) : ∀ {x y}, r x y → r y x

name: trans'
statement:
@[trans]
theorem trans' (r : Setoid α) : ∀ {x y z}, r x y → r y z → r x z

name: comm'
statement: theorem comm' (s : Setoid α) {x y} : s x y ↔ s y x

name: comm
statement: theorem comm [Setoid α] {x y : α} : x ≈ y ↔ y ≈ x

name: ker_mk_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_mk_eq (r : Setoid α) : ker (@Quotient.mk'' _ r) = r

name: ker_apply_mk_out
statement: theorem ker_apply_mk_out {f : α → β} (a : α) : f (⟦a⟧ : Quotient (Setoid.ker f)).out = f a

name: ker_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_def {f : α → β} {x y : α} : ker f x y ↔ f x = f y

name: prod_apply
statement:
lemma prod_apply {r : Setoid α} {s : Setoid β} {x₁ x₂ : α} {y₁ y₂ : β} :
    @Setoid.r _ (r.prod s) (x₁, y₁) (x₂, y₂) ↔ (@Setoid.r _ r x₁ x₂ ∧ @Setoid.r _ s y₁ y₂)

name: piSetoid_apply
statement:
lemma piSetoid_apply {ι : Sort*} {α : ι → Sort*} {r : ∀ i, Setoid (α i)} {x y : ∀ i, α i} :
    @Setoid.r _ (@piSetoid _ _ r) x y ↔ ∀ i, @Setoid.r _ (r i) (x i) (y i)

name: inf_def
statement: theorem inf_def {r s : Setoid α} : ⇑(r ⊓ s) = ⇑r ⊓ ⇑s

name: inf_iff_and
statement: theorem inf_iff_and {r s : Setoid α} {x y} : (r ⊓ s) x y ↔ r x y ∧ s x y

name: sInf_def
statement: theorem sInf_def {s : Set (Setoid α)} : ⇑(sInf s) = sInf ((⇑) '' s)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [sInf_image, iInf_apply, iInf_Prop_eq]
  rfl

name: top_def
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem top_def : ⇑(⊤ : Setoid α) = ⊤

name: bot_def
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem bot_def : ⇑(⊥ : Setoid α) = (· = ·)

name: mk_eq_top
statement: @[simp] lemma mk_eq_top {r : α → α → Prop} (iseqv) : mk r iseqv = ⊤ ↔ r = ⊤

name: mk_eq_bot
statement: @[simp] lemma mk_eq_bot {r : α → α → Prop} (iseqv) : mk r iseqv = ⊥ ↔ r = (· = ·)

name: eq_top_iff
statement: theorem eq_top_iff {s : Setoid α} : s = (⊤ : Setoid α) ↔ ∀ x y : α, s x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.eq_top_iff, Setoid.le_def, Setoid.top_def]
  simp only [Pi.top_apply, Prop.top_eq_true, forall_true_left]

name: ker_eq_bot_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_eq_bot_iff {f : α → β} : ker f = ⊥ ↔ f.Injective

name: sInf_equiv
statement:
lemma sInf_equiv {S : Set (Setoid α)} {x y : α} :
    letI
proof:
:= sInf S
    x ≈ y ↔ ∀ s ∈ S, s x y := Iff.rfl

name: sInf_iff
statement:
lemma sInf_iff {S : Set (Setoid α)} {x y : α} :
    sInf S x y ↔ ∀ s ∈ S, s x y

name: quotient_mk_sInf_eq
statement:
lemma quotient_mk_sInf_eq {S : Set (Setoid α)} {x y : α} :
    Quotient.mk (sInf S) x = Quotient.mk (sInf S) y ↔ ∀ s ∈ S, s x y

name: eqvGen_eq
statement:
theorem eqvGen_eq (r : α → α → Prop) :
    EqvGen.setoid r = sInf { s : Setoid α | ∀ ⦃x y⦄, r x y → s x y }
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (fun _ _ H =>
      EqvGen.rec (fun _ _ h _ hs => hs h) (refl' _) (fun _ _ _ => symm' _)
        (fun _ _ _ _ _ => trans' _) H)
    (sInf_le fun _ _ h => EqvGen.rel _ _ h)

name: sup_eq_eqvGen
statement:
theorem sup_eq_eqvGen (r s : Setoid α) :
    r ⊔ s = EqvGen.setoid fun x y => r x y ∨ s x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [eqvGen_eq]
  apply congr_arg sInf
  simp only [le_def, or_imp, ← forall_and]

name: sup_def
statement: theorem sup_def {r s : Setoid α} : r ⊔ s = EqvGen.setoid (⇑r ⊔ ⇑s)

name: sSup_eq_eqvGen
statement:
theorem sSup_eq_eqvGen (S : Set (Setoid α)) :
    sSup S = EqvGen.setoid fun x y => ∃ r : Setoid α, r ∈ S ∧ r x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [eqvGen_eq]
  apply congr_arg sInf
  simp only [upperBounds, le_def, and_imp, exists_imp]
  ext
  exact ⟨fun H x y r hr => H hr, fun H r hr x y => H r hr⟩

name: sSup_def
statement: theorem sSup_def {s : Set (Setoid α)} : sSup s = EqvGen.setoid (sSup ((⇑) '' s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sSup_eq_eqvGen, sSup_image]
  congr with (x y)
  simp only [iSup_apply, iSup_Prop_eq, exists_prop]

name: eqvGen_of_setoid
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eqvGen_of_setoid (r : Setoid α) : EqvGen.setoid r.r = r
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (by rw [eqvGen_eq]; exact sInf_le fun _ _ => id) EqvGen.rel

name: eqvGen_idem
statement: theorem eqvGen_idem (r : α → α → Prop) : EqvGen.setoid (EqvGen.setoid r) = EqvGen.setoid r

name: eqvGen_le
statement:
theorem eqvGen_le {r : α → α → Prop} {s : Setoid α} (h : ∀ x y, r x y → s x y) :
    EqvGen.setoid r ≤ s

name: eqvGen_mono
statement:
theorem eqvGen_mono {r s : α → α → Prop} (h : ∀ x y, r x y → s x y) :
    EqvGen.setoid r ≤ EqvGen.setoid s
proof:
:=
  eqvGen_le fun _ _ hr => EqvGen.rel _ _ <| h _ _ hr

name: injective_iff_ker_bot
statement: theorem injective_iff_ker_bot (f : α → β) : Injective f ↔ ker f = ⊥

name: ker_iff_mem_preimage
statement: theorem ker_iff_mem_preimage {f : α → β} {x y} : ker f x y ↔ x ∈ f ⁻¹' {f y}

name: lift_unique
statement:
theorem lift_unique {r : Setoid α} {f : α → β} (H : r ≤ ker f) (g : Quotient r → β)
    (Hg : f = g ∘ Quotient.mk'') : Quotient.lift f H = g
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨x⟩
  rw [← Quotient.mk, Quotient.lift_mk f H, Hg, Function.comp_apply, Quotient.mk''_eq_mk]

name: kerLift_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerLift_mk (f : α → β) (x : α) : kerLift f ⟦x⟧ = f x

name: kerLift_injective
statement: theorem kerLift_injective (f : α → β) : Injective <| kerLift f
proof:
:=
  fun x y => Quotient.inductionOn₂' x y fun _ _ h => Quotient.sound' h

name: ker_eq_lift_of_injective
statement:
theorem ker_eq_lift_of_injective {r : Setoid α} (f : α → β) (H : r ≤ ker f)
    (h : Injective (Quotient.lift f H)) : ker f = r
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (fun x y hk =>
      Quotient.exact <| h <| show Quotient.lift f H ⟦x⟧ = Quotient.lift f H ⟦y⟧ from hk)
    H

name: lift_injective_iff_ker_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem lift_injective_iff_ker_eq_of_le {r : Setoid α} {f : α → β}
    (hle : r ≤ ker f) : Injective (Quotient.lift f hle) ↔ ker f = r
proof:
:=
  ⟨ker_eq_lift_of_injective f hle, fun h ↦ h ▸ kerLift_injective _⟩

name: range_kerLift_eq_range
statement: @[simp] theorem range_kerLift_eq_range : Set.range (kerLift f) = Set.range f

name: coe_map_of_ker_le
statement:
theorem coe_map_of_ker_le (r : Setoid α) (f : α → β) (hf : ker f ≤ r) :
    ⇑(map r f) = Relation.Map r f f ⊔ (· = ·)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (sup_le Relation.EqvGen.rel (by rintro _ _ rfl; exact .refl _))
  rintro _ _ hxy
  induction hxy with
  | rel _ _ hab => exact .inl hab
  | refl _ => exact .inr rfl
  | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.imp (Std.Symm.symm _ _) (Std.Symm.symm _ _)
  | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih1 ih2 =>
    rcases ih1 with ih1 | rfl
    · rcases ih2 with ih2 | rfl
      · exact .inl <| r.iseqv.isTrans.map hf |>.trans _ _ _ ih1 ih2
      · exact .inl ih1
    · exact ih2

name: mapOfSurjective_eq_map
statement:
theorem mapOfSurjective_eq_map (h : ker f ≤ r) (hf : Surjective f) :
    map r f = mapOfSurjective r f h hf
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eqvGen_of_setoid (mapOfSurjective r f h hf)]; rfl

name: comap_rel_eq
statement: theorem comap_rel_eq (f : α → β) (r : Setoid β) : ⇑(comap f r) = (⇑r on f)

name: comap_rel
statement: theorem comap_rel (f : α → β) (r : Setoid β) (x y : α) : comap f r x y ↔ r (f x) (f y)

name: comap_eq
statement: theorem comap_eq {f : α → β} {r : Setoid β} : comap f r = ker (@Quotient.mk'' _ r ∘ f)
proof:
:=
  ext fun x y => show _ ↔ ⟦_⟧ = ⟦_⟧ by rw [Quotient.eq]; rfl

name: comap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_id (c : Setoid α) : c.comap id = c

name: comap_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_comp (c : Setoid γ) (g : β → γ) (f : α → β) : c.comap (g ∘ f) = (c.comap g).comap f

name: comap_injective
statement:
theorem comap_injective (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Injective (comap f)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => ext <| hf.forall₂.2 <| Setoid.ext_iff.1 h

name: le_comap_map
statement: theorem le_comap_map {r : Setoid α} {f : α → β} : r ≤ comap f (r.map f)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ ⟨_, _, h, rfl, rfl⟩

name: comap_map_of_ker_le
statement:
theorem comap_map_of_ker_le (f : α → β) (r : Setoid α) (hf : ker f ≤ r) :
    comap f (r.map f) = r
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ le_comap_map
  rw [le_iff_rel_le, comap_rel_eq, coe_map_of_ker_le _ _ hf]
  rintro x y (⟨a, b, h, ha, hb⟩ | h)
  · replace ha := hf ha
    replace hb := hf hb
    exact trans (symm ha) (trans h hb)
  · exact hf h

name: comap_map_eq
statement: theorem comap_map_eq (f : α → β) (r : Setoid α) (hf : f.Injective) : comap f (r.map f) = r
proof:
:=
  comap_map_of_ker_le f r <| ker_eq_bot_iff.2 hf ▸ bot_le

name: comap_surjective
statement:
theorem comap_surjective (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Surjective (Setoid.comap f)
proof:
:=
  fun r => ⟨_, comap_map_eq f r hf⟩

name: Quotient.subsingleton_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Quotient.subsingleton_iff {s : Setoid α} : Subsingleton (Quotient s) ↔ s = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp only [_root_.subsingleton_iff, eq_top_iff, Setoid.le_def, Setoid.top_def, Pi.top_apply]
  refine Quotient.mk'_surjective.forall.trans (forall_congr' fun a => ?_)
  refine Quotient.mk'_surjective.forall.trans (forall_congr' fun b => ?_)
  simp_rw [Prop.top_eq_true, true_implies, Quotient.eq']

name: Quot.subsingleton_iff
statement:
theorem Quot.subsingleton_iff (r : α → α → Prop) :
    Subsingleton (Quot r) ↔ Relation.EqvGen r = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp only [_root_.subsingleton_iff, _root_.eq_top_iff, Pi.le_def, Pi.top_apply]
  refine Quot.mk_surjective.forall.trans (forall_congr' fun a => ?_)
  refine Quot.mk_surjective.forall.trans (forall_congr' fun b => ?_)
  rw [Quot.eq]
  simp

name: eq_of_mem_eqv_class
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_eqv_class {c : Set (Set α)} (H : ∀ a, ∃! b ∈ c, a ∈ b) {x b b'}
    (hc : b ∈ c) (hb : x ∈ b) (hc' : b' ∈ c) (hb' : x ∈ b') : b = b'

name: mem_classes
statement: theorem mem_classes (r : Setoid α) (y) : { x | r x y } ∈ r.classes

name: classes_ker_subset_fiber_set
statement:
theorem classes_ker_subset_fiber_set {β : Type*} (f : α → β) :
    (Setoid.ker f).classes ⊆ Set.range fun y => { x | f x = y }
proof:
:= by
  rintro s ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [Set.mem_range]
  exact ⟨f x, rfl⟩

name: finite_classes_ker
statement: theorem finite_classes_ker {α β : Type*} [Finite β] (f : α → β) : (Setoid.ker f).classes.Finite

name: card_classes_ker_le
statement:
theorem card_classes_ker_le {α β : Type*} [Fintype β] (f : α → β)
    [Fintype (Setoid.ker f).classes] : Fintype.card (Setoid.ker f).classes ≤ Fintype.card β

name: eq_iff_classes_eq
statement:
theorem eq_iff_classes_eq {r₁ r₂ : Setoid α} :
    r₁ = r₂ ↔ ∀ x, { y | r₁ x y } = { y | r₂ x y }
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _x => h ▸ rfl, fun h => ext fun x => Set.ext_iff.1 <| h x⟩

name: rel_iff_exists_classes
statement: theorem rel_iff_exists_classes (r : Setoid α) {x y} : r x y ↔ ∃ c ∈ r.classes, x ∈ c ∧ y ∈ c
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨_, r.mem_classes y, h, r.refl' y⟩, fun ⟨c, ⟨z, hz⟩, hx, hy⟩ => by
    subst c
    exact r.trans' hx (r.symm' hy)⟩

name: classes_inj
statement: theorem classes_inj {r₁ r₂ : Setoid α} : r₁ = r₂ ↔ r₁.classes = r₂.classes
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h ▸ rfl, fun h => ext fun a b => by simp only [rel_iff_exists_classes, h]⟩

name: empty_notMem_classes
statement: theorem empty_notMem_classes {r : Setoid α} : ∅ ∉ r.classes
proof:
:= fun ⟨y, hy⟩ =>
  Set.notMem_empty y <| hy.symm ▸ r.refl' y

name: classes_eqv_classes
statement: theorem classes_eqv_classes {r : Setoid α} (a) : ∃! b ∈ r.classes, a ∈ b
proof:
:=
  ExistsUnique.intro { x | r x a } ⟨r.mem_classes a, r.refl' _⟩ <| by
    rintro y ⟨⟨_, rfl⟩, ha⟩
    ext x
    exact ⟨fun hx => r.trans' hx (r.symm' ha), fun hx => r.trans' hx ha⟩

name: eq_of_mem_classes
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_classes {r : Setoid α} {x b} (hc : b ∈ r.classes) (hb : x ∈ b) {b'}
    (hc' : b' ∈ r.classes) (hb' : x ∈ b') : b = b'
proof:
:=
  eq_of_mem_eqv_class classes_eqv_classes hc hb hc' hb'

name: eq_eqv_class_of_mem
statement:
theorem eq_eqv_class_of_mem {c : Set (Set α)} (H : ∀ a, ∃! b ∈ c, a ∈ b) {s y}
    (hs : s ∈ c) (hy : y ∈ s) : s = { x | mkClasses c H x y }
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx _s' hs' hx'
    rwa [eq_of_mem_eqv_class H hs' hx' hs hx]
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨b', ⟨hc, hb'⟩, _⟩ := H x
    rwa [eq_of_mem_eqv_class H hs hy hc (hx b' hc hb')]

name: eqv_class_mem
statement:
theorem eqv_class_mem {c : Set (Set α)} (H : ∀ a, ∃! b ∈ c, a ∈ b) {y} :
    { x | mkClasses c H x y } ∈ c
proof:
:=
  (H y).elim fun _ hc _ => eq_eqv_class_of_mem H hc.1 hc.2 ▸ hc.1

name: eqv_class_mem'
statement:
theorem eqv_class_mem' {c : Set (Set α)} (H : ∀ a, ∃! b ∈ c, a ∈ b) {x} :
    { y : α | mkClasses c H x y } ∈ c
proof:
:= by
  convert! @Setoid.eqv_class_mem _ _ H x using 3
  rw [Setoid.comm']

name: eqv_classes_disjoint
statement:
theorem eqv_classes_disjoint {c : Set (Set α)} (H : ∀ a, ∃! b ∈ c, a ∈ b) :
    c.PairwiseDisjoint id
proof:
:= fun _b₁ h₁ _b₂ h₂ h =>
  Set.disjoint_left.2 fun x hx1 hx2 =>
    (H x).elim fun _b _hc _hx => h <| eq_of_mem_eqv_class H h₁ hx1 h₂ hx2

name: eqv_classes_of_disjoint_union
statement:
theorem eqv_classes_of_disjoint_union {c : Set (Set α)} (hu : Set.sUnion c = @Set.univ α)
    (H : c.PairwiseDisjoint id) (a) : ∃! b ∈ c, a ∈ b
proof:
:=
  let ⟨b, hc, ha⟩ := Set.mem_sUnion.1 <| show a ∈ _ by rw [hu]; exact Set.mem_univ a
  ExistsUnique.intro b ⟨hc, ha⟩ fun _ hc' => H.elim_set hc'.1 hc _ hc'.2 ha

name: mkClasses_classes
statement: theorem mkClasses_classes (r : Setoid α) : mkClasses r.classes classes_eqv_classes = r
proof:
:=
  ext fun x _y =>
    ⟨fun h => r.symm' (h { z | r z x } (r.mem_classes x) <| r.refl' x), fun h _b hb hx =>
      eq_of_mem_classes (r.mem_classes x) (r.refl' x) hb hx ▸ r.symm' h⟩

name: sUnion_classes
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sUnion_classes (r : Setoid α) : ⋃₀ r.classes = Set.univ
proof:
:=
  Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun x => Set.mem_sUnion.2 ⟨{ y | r y x }, ⟨x, rfl⟩, Setoid.refl _⟩

name: quotientEquivClasses_mk_eq
proof:
:=
  (@Subtype.ext_iff _ _ _ ⟨{ x | r x a }, Setoid.mem_classes r a⟩).mp rfl

name: nonempty_of_mem_partition
statement:
theorem nonempty_of_mem_partition {c : Set (Set α)} (hc : IsPartition c) {s} (h : s ∈ c) :
    s.Nonempty
proof:
:=
  Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 fun hs0 => hc.1 <| hs0 ▸ h

name: isPartition_classes
statement: theorem isPartition_classes (r : Setoid α) : IsPartition r.classes

name: IsPartition.pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
theorem IsPartition.pairwiseDisjoint {c : Set (Set α)} (hc : IsPartition c) :
    c.PairwiseDisjoint id

name: _root_.Set.PairwiseDisjoint.isPartition_of_exists_of_ne_empty
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h₃, fun a ↦ existsUnique_of_exists_of_unique (h₂ a) ?_⟩
  intro b₁ b₂ hb₁ hb₂
  apply h₁.elim hb₁.1 hb₂.1
  simp only [Set.not_disjoint_iff]
  exact ⟨a, hb₁.2, hb₂.2⟩

name: IsPartition.sUnion_eq_univ
statement: theorem IsPartition.sUnion_eq_univ {c : Set (Set α)} (hc : IsPartition c) : ⋃₀ c = Set.univ
proof:
:=
  Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun x =>
    Set.mem_sUnion.2 <|
      let ⟨t, ht⟩ := hc.2 x
      ⟨t, by
        simp only at ht
        tauto⟩

name: exists_of_mem_partition
statement:
theorem exists_of_mem_partition {c : Set (Set α)} (hc : IsPartition c) {s} (hs : s ∈ c) :
    ∃ y, s = { x | mkClasses c hc.2 x y }
proof:
:=
  let ⟨y, hy⟩ := nonempty_of_mem_partition hc hs
  ⟨y, eq_eqv_class_of_mem hc.2 hs hy⟩

name: classes_mkClasses
statement:
theorem classes_mkClasses (c : Set (Set α)) (hc : IsPartition c) :
    (mkClasses c hc.2).classes = c
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨b, ⟨hb, hy⟩, _⟩ := hc.2 y
    rwa [← eq_eqv_class_of_mem _ hb hy]
  · exact exists_of_mem_partition hc

name: Partitions.ext_iff
statement: lemma Partitions.ext_iff (p q : Partitions α) : p = q ↔ p.toSet = q.toSet

name: Partitions.isPartition
statement: lemma Partitions.isPartition (p : Partitions α) : IsPartition p.toSet

name: Finpartition.isPartition_parts
statement:
theorem Finpartition.isPartition_parts {α} (f : Finpartition (Set.univ : Set α)) :
    Setoid.IsPartition (f.parts : Set (Set α))

name: exists_mem
statement: theorem exists_mem (x : α) : ∃ i, x ∈ s i

name: iUnion
statement: theorem iUnion : ⋃ i, s i = univ

name: disjoint
statement: theorem disjoint : Pairwise (Disjoint on s)
proof:
:= fun {_i _j} h =>
  disjoint_left.mpr fun {_x} hxi hxj => h (hs.eq_of_mem hxi hxj)

name: mem_iff_index_eq
statement: theorem mem_iff_index_eq {x i} : x ∈ s i ↔ hs.index x = i
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hxi => (hs.eq_of_mem hxi (hs.mem_index x)).symm, fun h => h ▸ hs.mem_index _⟩

name: eq
statement: theorem eq (i) : s i = { x | hs.index x = i }

name: index_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem index_some (i : ι) : hs.index (hs.some i) = i

name: some_index
statement: theorem some_index (x : α) : hs.setoid (hs.some (hs.index x)) x

name: proj_eq_iff
statement: theorem proj_eq_iff {x y : α} : hs.proj x = hs.proj y ↔ hs.index x = hs.index y

name: proj_some_index
statement:
@[simp]
theorem proj_some_index (x : α) : hs.proj (hs.some (hs.index x)) = hs.proj x

name: equivQuotient_index_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivQuotient_index_apply (x : α) : hs.equivQuotient (hs.index x) = hs.proj x

name: equivQuotient_symm_proj_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivQuotient_symm_proj_apply (x : α) : hs.equivQuotient.symm (hs.proj x) = hs.index x

name: equivQuotient_index
statement: theorem equivQuotient_index : hs.equivQuotient ∘ hs.index = hs.proj

name: out_proj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem out_proj (x : α) : hs.out (hs.proj x) = hs.some (hs.index x)

name: index_out
statement: theorem index_out (x : hs.Quotient) : hs.index x.out = hs.index (hs.out x)

name: proj_out
statement:
@[simp]
theorem proj_out (x : hs.Quotient) : hs.proj (hs.out x) = x
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn' x fun x => Quotient.sound' <| hs.some_index x

name: class_of
statement: theorem class_of {x : α} : Set.ofPred (hs.setoid x) = s (hs.index x)

name: proj_fiber
statement: theorem proj_fiber (x : hs.Quotient) : hs.proj ⁻¹' {x} = s (hs.equivQuotient.symm x)
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn' x fun x => by
    ext y
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, hs.mem_iff_index_eq]
    exact Quotient.eq''

name: piecewise_apply
statement: lemma piecewise_apply {β : Type*} {f : ι → α → β} (x : α) : hs.piecewise f x = f (hs.index x) x

name: piecewise_inj
statement:
theorem piecewise_inj (h_injOn : ∀ i, InjOn (f i) (s i))
    (h_disjoint : PairwiseDisjoint (univ : Set ι) fun i => (f i) '' (s i)) :
    Injective (piecewise hs f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  suffices hs.index x = hs.index y by
    apply h_injOn (hs.index x) (hs.mem_index x) (this ▸ hs.mem_index y)
    simpa only [piecewise_apply, this] using h
  apply h_disjoint.elim trivial trivial
  contrapose! h
  exact h.ne_of_mem (mem_image_of_mem _ (hs.mem_index x)) (mem_image_of_mem _ (hs.mem_index y))

name: piecewise_bij
statement:
theorem piecewise_bij {t : ι → Set β} (ht : IndexedPartition t)
    (hf : ∀ i, BijOn (f i) (s i) (t i)) :
    Bijective (piecewise hs f)
proof:
:= by
  set g := piecewise hs f with hg
  have hg_bij (i) : BijOn g (s i) (t i) := by
    refine (hf i).congr fun x hx => ?_
    rw [hg, piecewise_apply, hs.mem_iff_index_eq.mp hx]
  have hg_inj : InjOn g (⋃ i, s i) := by
    refine injOn_of_injective (piecewise_inj hs (fun i ↦ BijOn.injOn (hf i)) ?_)
    simp only [fun i ↦ BijOn.image_eq (hf i)]
    rintro i - j - hij
    exact ht.disjoint hij
  rw [← bijOn_univ, ← hs.iUnion, ← ht.iUnion]
  exact bijOn_iUnion hg_bij hg_inj

name: piecewise_preimage
statement:
theorem piecewise_preimage (f : ι → α → β) (t : Set β) :
    hs.piecewise f ⁻¹' t = ⋃ i, s i ∩ (f i ⁻¹' t)
proof:
:= by
  refine ext fun x => ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun ⟨a, ⟨i, hi⟩, ha⟩ => ?_⟩
  · rw [mem_preimage, piecewise_apply, ← mem_preimage] at hx
    exact mem_iUnion_of_mem (hs.index x) (mem_inter (hs.mem_index x) hx)
  · rw [← hi, ← (mem_iff_index_eq hs).mp ha.1] at ha
    simp_all [piecewise_apply]

name: range_piecewise
statement: theorem range_piecewise (f : ι → α → β) : range (hs.piecewise f) = ⋃ i, f i '' s i
proof:
:= by
  refine ext fun x => ⟨?_, fun ⟨t, ⟨i, hi⟩, ht⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact mem_iUnion_of_mem (hs.index x) ⟨x, hs.mem_index x, rfl⟩
  · simp only [← hi, mem_image] at ht
    obtain ⟨a, ha1, ha2⟩ := ht
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    simp only [hs.mem_iff_index_eq] at ha1
    simpa [hs.mem_iff_index_eq, ← ha1] using! ha2

name: range_piecewise_subset
statement: theorem range_piecewise_subset (f : ι → α → β) : range (hs.piecewise f) ⊆ ⋃ i, range (f i)
proof:
:=
  fun x ⟨y, hy⟩ => by simpa [IndexedPartition.piecewise_apply] using ⟨hs.index y, y, hy⟩

name: epow_def
statement:
lemma epow_def {x y : ℕ∞} :
    x ^ y = if y < ⊤ then x ^ y.toNat else if x = 0 then 0 else if x = 1 then 1 else ⊤
proof:
:= by
  cases y with
  | top => simp only [lt_self_iff_false, ↓reduceIte]; rfl
  | coe n => simp only [natCast_lt_top, ↓reduceIte, toNat_natCast]; rfl

name: epow_natCast
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma epow_natCast {y : ℕ} : x ^ (y : ℕ∞) = x ^ y

name: zero_epow_top
statement:
@[simp]
lemma zero_epow_top : (0 : ℕ∞) ^ (⊤ : ℕ∞) = 0

name: zero_epow
statement: lemma zero_epow (h : y ≠ 0) : (0 : ℕ∞) ^ y = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction y with
  | top => exact zero_epow_top
  | coe y => rwa [epow_natCast, pow_eq_zero_iff', eq_self 0, true_and, ← y.cast_ne_zero (R := ℕ∞)]

name: one_epow
statement:
@[simp]
lemma one_epow : (1 : ℕ∞) ^ y = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction y with
  | top => rfl
  | coe y => rw [epow_natCast, one_pow]

name: top_epow_top
statement:
@[simp]
lemma top_epow_top : (⊤ : ℕ∞) ^ (⊤ : ℕ∞) = ⊤

name: top_epow
statement: lemma top_epow (h : y ≠ 0) : (⊤ : ℕ∞) ^ y = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  induction y with
  | top => exact top_epow_top
  | coe y => rwa [epow_natCast, pow_eq_top_iff, eq_self ⊤, true_and, ← y.cast_ne_zero (R := ℕ∞)]

name: epow_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma epow_zero : x ^ (0 : ℕ∞) = 1

name: epow_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma epow_one : x ^ (1 : ℕ∞) = x

name: epow_top
statement: lemma epow_top (h : 1 < x) : x ^ (⊤ : ℕ∞) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have : (0 : ℕ∞) ≤ 1 := zero_le_one
  rw [epow_def, ite_eq_right, ite_eq_right, ite_eq_right] <;> grind

name: epow_right_mono
statement: lemma epow_right_mono (h : x ≠ 0) : Monotone (fun y : ℕ∞ ↦ x ^ y)
proof:
:= by
  intro y z y_z
  induction y
  · rw [top_le_iff.1 y_z]
  induction z
  · rcases lt_trichotomy x 1 with x_0 | rfl | x_2
    · exact (h (Order.lt_one_iff.1 x_0)).rec
    · simp only [one_epow, le_refl]
    · simp only [epow_top x_2, le_top]
  · exact pow_right_mono₀ (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 h) (Nat.cast_le.1 y_z)

name: one_le_epow
statement: lemma one_le_epow (h : x ≠ 0) : 1 ≤ x ^ y
proof:
:= by
  simpa using epow_right_mono h zero_le

name: epow_pos
statement: lemma epow_pos (h : x ≠ 0) : 0 < x ^ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Order.one_le_iff_pos]; exact one_le_epow h

name: epow_left_mono
statement: lemma epow_left_mono : Monotone (fun x : ℕ∞ ↦ x ^ y)
proof:
:= by
  intro x z x_z
  simp only
  induction y
  · rcases lt_trichotomy x 1 with x_0 | rfl | x_2
    · rw [Order.lt_one_iff.1 x_0, zero_epow_top]; exact bot_le
    · rw [one_epow]; exact one_le_epow (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.1 x_z)
    · rw [epow_top (x_2.trans_le x_z)]; exact le_top
  · simp only [epow_natCast, (pow_left_mono _) x_z]

name: epow_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma epow_eq_zero_iff : x ^ y = 0 ↔ x = 0 ∧ y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨?_, fun y_0 ↦ ?_⟩, fun h ↦ h.1.symm ▸ zero_epow h.2⟩
  · contrapose! h
    exact (epow_pos h).ne'
  · rw [y_0, epow_zero] at h; contradiction

name: epow_eq_one_iff
statement: lemma epow_eq_one_iff : x ^ y = 1 ↔ x = 1 ∨ y = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ or_iff_not_imp_right.2 fun y_0 ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by rcases h with h | h <;> simp [h]⟩
  rcases lt_trichotomy x 1 with x_0 | rfl | x_2
  · rw [Order.lt_one_iff.1 x_0, zero_epow y_0] at h; contradiction
  · rfl
  · have := epow_right_mono x_2.ne_zero (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 y_0)
    simp only [epow_one, h] at this
    exact (not_lt_of_ge this x_2).rec

name: epow_add
statement: lemma epow_add : x ^ (y + z) = x ^ y * x ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy x 1 with x_0 | rfl | x_2
  · rw [Order.lt_one_iff.1 x_0]
    rcases eq_zero_or_pos y with rfl | y_0
    · simp only [zero_add, epow_zero, one_mul]
    · rw [zero_epow y_0.ne.symm, zero_mul]
      exact zero_epow (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg y_0 bot_le).ne.symm
  · simp only [one_epow, mul_one]
  · induction y
    · rw [top_add, epow_top x_2, top_mul]
      exact (epow_pos x_2.ne_zero).ne'
    induction z
    · rw [add_top, epow_top x_2, mul_top]
      exact (epow_pos x_2.ne_zero).ne'
    simp only [← Nat.cast_add, epow_natCast, pow_add x]

name: mul_epow
statement: lemma mul_epow : (x * y) ^ z = x ^ z * y ^ z
proof:
:= by
  induction z
  · rcases lt_trichotomy x 1 with x_0 | rfl | x_2
    · simp only [Order.lt_one_iff.1 x_0, zero_mul, zero_epow_top]
    · simp only [one_mul, one_epow]
    · rcases lt_trichotomy y 1 with y_0 | rfl | y_2
      · simp only [Order.lt_one_iff.1 y_0, mul_zero, zero_epow_top]
      · simp
      · rw [epow_top x_2, epow_top y_2, mul_top top_ne_zero]
        exact epow_top (one_lt_mul x_2.le y_2)
  · simp only [epow_natCast, mul_pow x y]

name: epow_mul
statement: lemma epow_mul : x ^ (y * z) = (x ^ y) ^ z
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne y 0 with y_0 | y_0
  · simp [y_0]
  rcases eq_or_ne z 0 with z_0 | z_0
  · simp [z_0]
  rcases lt_trichotomy x 1 with x_0 | rfl | x_2
  · rw [Order.lt_one_iff.1 x_0, zero_epow y_0, zero_epow z_0, zero_epow (mul_ne_zero y_0 z_0)]
  · simp only [one_epow]
  · induction y
    · rw [top_mul z_0, epow_top x_2, top_epow z_0]
    induction z
    · rw [mul_top y_0, epow_top x_2, epow_top]
      apply (epow_right_mono x_2.ne_zero (Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 y_0)).trans_lt'
      simp [x_2]
    · simp only [← Nat.cast_mul, epow_natCast, pow_mul x]

statement:
theorem iInf_sum {ι α : Type*} {f : ι → α → ℕ∞} {s : Finset α} [Nonempty ι]
    (h : ∀ (t : Finset α) (i j : ι), ∃ k, ∀ a ∈ t, f k a ≤ f i a ∧ f k a ≤ f j a) :
    ⨅ i, ∑ a ∈ s, f i a = ∑ a ∈ s, ⨅ i, f i a
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction_on with
  | empty => simp only [Finset.sum_empty, ciInf_const]
  | cons a s ha ih =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_cons, ← ih]
    refine (iInf_add_iInf fun i j => ?_).symm
    refine (h (Finset.cons a s ha) i j).imp fun k hk => ?_
    rw [Finset.forall_mem_cons] at hk
    exact add_le_add hk.1.1 (Finset.sum_le_sum fun a ha => (hk.2 a ha).2)

  | singleton => simp [Hlt _ (mem_singleton_self _)]

proof:

  apply sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty hs Hle

name: sSup_eq_top_of_infinite

proof:
:= by
  apply (sSup_eq_top ..).mpr
  intro x hx
  cases x with
  | top => simp at hx
  | coe x =>
    contrapose! h
    apply Finite.subset <| Finite.Set.finite_image {n : ℕ | n ≤ x} (fun (n : ℕ) => (n : ℕ∞))
    intro y hy
    specialize h y hy
    have hxt : y < ⊤ := lt_of_le_of_lt h hx
    use y.toNat
    simp [toNat_le_of_le_natCast h, LT.lt.ne_top hxt]

name: mul_iSup
statement: lemma mul_iSup (a : ℕ∞) (f : ι → ℕ∞) : a * ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ i, a * f i
proof:
:= by
  refine (iSup_le fun i ↦ mul_le_mul' rfl.le <| le_iSup_iff.2 fun _ a ↦ a i).antisymm' <|
    le_iSup_iff.2 fun d h ↦ ?_
  obtain rfl | hne := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp
  obtain hι | hι := isEmpty_or_nonempty ι
  · simp
  cases d with
  | top => simp
  | coe d =>
  have hlt : ⨆ i, f i < ⊤ := by
    rw [lt_top_iff_ne_top]
    intro htop
    obtain ⟨i, hi : d < f i⟩ := (iSup_eq_top ..).1 htop d (by simp)
    exact (((h i).trans_lt hi).trans_le (ENat.self_le_mul_left _ hne)).false
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_eq_iSup_of_lt_top hlt
  rw [← hj]
  apply h

lemma iSup_add_iSup_le [Nonempty ι] [Nonempty κ] {g : κ → ℕ∞} (h : ∀ i j, f i + g j ≤ a) :
    iSup f + iSup g ≤ a
proof: := by simp_rw [iSup_add, add_iSup]; exact iSup₂_le h

name: biSup_add_biSup_le'
statement:
lemma biSup_add_biSup_le' {p : ι → Prop} {q : κ → Prop} (hp : ∃ i, p i) (hq : ∃ j, q j)
    {g : κ → ℕ∞} (h : ∀ i, p i → ∀ j, q j → f i + g j ≤ a) :
    (⨆ i, ⨆ _ : p i, f i) + ⨆ j, ⨆ _ : q j, g j ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [biSup_add' hp, add_biSup' hq]
  exact iSup₂_le fun i hi => iSup₂_le (h i hi)

name: biSup_add_biSup_le
statement:
lemma biSup_add_biSup_le {ι κ : Type*} {s : Set ι} {t : Set κ} (hs : s.Nonempty) (ht : t.Nonempty)
    {f : ι → ℕ∞} {g : κ → ℕ∞} {a : ℕ∞} (h : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ t, f i + g j ≤ a) :
    (⨆ i ∈ s, f i) + ⨆ j ∈ t, g j ≤ a

name: iSup_add_iSup
statement: lemma iSup_add_iSup (h : ∀ i j, ∃ k, f i + g j ≤ f k + g k) : iSup f + iSup g = ⨆ i, f i + g i
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι
  · simp
  · refine le_antisymm ?_ (iSup_le fun a => add_le_add (le_iSup _ _) (le_iSup _ _))
    refine iSup_add_iSup_le fun i j => ?_
    rcases h i j with ⟨k, hk⟩
    exact le_iSup_of_le k hk

name: iSup_add_iSup_of_monotone
statement:
lemma iSup_add_iSup_of_monotone {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] {f g : ι → ℕ∞}
    (hf : Monotone f) (hg : Monotone g) : iSup f + iSup g = ⨆ a, f a + g a
proof:
:=
  iSup_add_iSup fun i j ↦ (exists_ge_ge i j).imp fun _k ⟨hi, hj⟩ ↦ by gcongr <;> apply_rules

name: smul_iSup
statement:
lemma smul_iSup {R} [SMul R ℕ∞] [IsScalarTower R ℕ∞ ℕ∞] (f : ι → ℕ∞) (c : R) :
    c • ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ i, c • f i

name: smul_sSup
statement:
lemma smul_sSup {R} [SMul R ℕ∞] [IsScalarTower R ℕ∞ ℕ∞] (s : Set ℕ∞) (c : R) :
    c • sSup s = ⨆ a ∈ s, c • a

name: sub_iSup
statement: lemma sub_iSup [Nonempty ι] (ha : a ≠ ⊤) : a - ⨆ i, f i = ⨅ i, a - f i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ | h := em (∃ i, a < f i)
  · rw [tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.2 <| le_iSup_of_le _ hi.le, iInf_eq_bot.2, bot_eq_zero]
    exact fun x hx ↦ ⟨i, by simpa [hi.le, tsub_eq_zero_of_le]⟩
  simp_rw [not_exists, not_lt] at h
  refine le_antisymm (le_iInf fun i ↦ tsub_le_tsub_left (le_iSup ..) _) <|
    ENat.le_sub_of_add_le_left (ne_top_of_le_ne_top ha <| iSup_le h) <|
    add_le_of_le_tsub_right_of_le (iInf_le_of_le (Classical.arbitrary _) tsub_le_self) <|
    iSup_le fun i ↦ ?_
  rw [← ENat.sub_sub_cancel ha (h _)]
  exact tsub_le_tsub_left (iInf_le (a - f ·) i) _

name: iInf_add
statement: lemma iInf_add : iInf f + a = ⨅ i, f i + a
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_iInf fun _ ↦ add_le_add (iInf_le _ _) le_rfl) <|
    (tsub_le_iff_right.1 <| le_iInf fun _ ↦ tsub_le_iff_right.2 <| iInf_le _ _)

name: sub_iInf
statement: theorem sub_iInf : (a - ⨅ i, f i) = ⨆ i, a - f i
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun c => ?_
  rw [tsub_le_iff_right, add_comm, iInf_add]
  simp [tsub_le_iff_right, add_comm]

name: sInf_add
statement: theorem sInf_add {s : Set ℕ∞} : sInf s + a = ⨅ b ∈ s, b + a

name: add_iInf
statement: theorem add_iInf {a : ℕ∞} : a + iInf f = ⨅ b, a + f b

name: iInf_add_iInf
statement: theorem iInf_add_iInf (h : ∀ i j, ∃ k, f k + g k ≤ f i + g j) : iInf f + iInf g = ⨅ a, f a + g a
proof:
:=
  suffices ⨅ a, f a + g a ≤ iInf f + iInf g from
    le_antisymm (le_iInf fun _ => add_le_add (iInf_le _ _) (iInf_le _ _)) this
  calc
    ⨅ a, f a + g a ≤ ⨅ (a) (a'), f a + g a' :=
      le_iInf₂ fun a a' => let ⟨k, h⟩ := h a a'; iInf_le_of_le k h
    _ = iInf f + iInf g := by simp_rw [iInf_add, add_iInf]

name: iInf_add_iInf_of_monotone
statement:
lemma iInf_add_iInf_of_monotone {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] [IsCodirectedOrder ι] {f g : ι → ℕ∞}
    (hf : Monotone f) (hg : Monotone g) : iInf f + iInf g = ⨅ a, f a + g a
proof:
:=
  iInf_add_iInf fun i j ↦ (exists_le_le i j).imp fun _k ⟨hi, hj⟩ ↦ by gcongr <;> apply_rules

name: add_iInf
statement:
lemma add_iInf₂ {κ : ι → Sort*} (f : (i : ι) → κ i → ℕ∞) :
    a + ⨅ (i) (j), f i j = ⨅ (i) (j), a + f i j

name: iInf
statement:
lemma iInf₂_add {κ : ι → Sort*} (f : (i : ι) → κ i → ℕ∞) :
    (⨅ (i) (j), f i j) + a = ⨅ (i) (j), f i j + a

name: add_sInf
statement: lemma add_sInf {s : Set ℕ∞} : a + sInf s = ⨅ b ∈ s, a + b

name: le_iInf_add_iInf
statement:
lemma le_iInf_add_iInf {g : κ → ℕ∞} (h : ∀ i j, a ≤ f i + g j) :
    a ≤ iInf f + iInf g
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [iInf_add, add_iInf]; exact le_iInf₂ h

name: le_iInf
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [iInf₂_add, add_iInf₂]
  exact le_iInf₂ fun i hi => le_iInf₂ (h i hi)

name: sqrt_eq
statement: theorem sqrt_eq (q : ℚ) : Rat.sqrt (q * q) = |q|
proof:
:= by
  rw [sqrt, mul_self_num, mul_self_den, Int.sqrt_eq, Nat.sqrt_eq, abs_def, divInt_ofNat]

name: exists_mul_self
statement: theorem exists_mul_self (x : ℚ) : (∃ q, q * q = x) ↔ Rat.sqrt x * Rat.sqrt x = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨n, hn⟩ => by rw [← hn, sqrt_eq, abs_mul_abs_self], fun h => ⟨Rat.sqrt x, h⟩⟩

name: sqrt_nonneg
statement: lemma sqrt_nonneg (q : ℚ) : 0 ≤ Rat.sqrt q

name: sqrt_intCast
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem sqrt_intCast (z : ℤ) : Rat.sqrt (z : ℚ) = Int.sqrt z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sqrt, num_intCast, den_intCast, Nat.sqrt_one, mkRat_one]

name: sqrt_natCast
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem sqrt_natCast (n : ℕ) : Rat.sqrt (n : ℚ) = Nat.sqrt n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.cast_natCast, sqrt_intCast, Int.sqrt_natCast, Int.cast_natCast]

name: sqrt_ofNat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sqrt_ofNat (n : ℕ) : Rat.sqrt (ofNat(n) : ℚ) = Nat.sqrt (OfNat.ofNat n)

name: num_dvd
statement: theorem num_dvd (a) {b : ℤ} (b0 : b ≠ 0) : (a /. b).num ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  rcases e : a /. b with ⟨n, d, h, c⟩
  rw [Rat.mk_eq_divInt, divInt_eq_divInt_iff b0 (mod_cast h)] at e
  refine Int.natAbs_dvd.1 <| Int.dvd_natAbs.1 <| Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 <|
    c.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right ?_
  have := congr_arg Int.natAbs e
  simp only [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_natCast] at this; simp [this]

name: den_dvd
statement: theorem den_dvd (a b : ℤ) : ((a /. b).den : ℤ) ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases b0 : b = 0; · simp [b0]
  rcases e : a /. b with ⟨n, d, h, c⟩
  rw [mk_eq_divInt,
    divInt_eq_divInt_iff b0 (ne_of_gt (Int.natCast_pos.2 (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h)))] at e
  refine Int.dvd_natAbs.1 <| Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 <| c.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left ?_
  rw [← Int.natAbs_mul, ← Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, Int.dvd_natAbs, ← e]; simp

name: num_den_mk
statement:
theorem num_den_mk {q : ℚ} {n d : ℤ} (hd : d ≠ 0) (qdf : q = n /. d) :
    ∃ c : ℤ, n = c * q.num ∧ d = c * q.den
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0
  · simp [qdf]
  have : q.num * d = n * ↑q.den := by
    refine (divInt_eq_divInt_iff ?_ hd).mp ?_
    · exact Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr (Rat.den_nz _)
    · rwa [num_divInt_den]
  have hqdn : q.num ∣ n := by
    rw [qdf]
    exact Rat.num_dvd _ hd
  refine ⟨n / q.num, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Int.ediv_mul_cancel hqdn]
  · refine Int.eq_mul_div_of_mul_eq_mul_of_dvd_left ?_ hqdn this
    rw [qdf]
    exact Rat.num_ne_zero.2 ((divInt_ne_zero hd).mpr hn)

name: add_den_dvd_lcm
statement: theorem add_den_dvd_lcm (q₁ q₂ : ℚ) : (q₁ + q₂).den ∣ q₁.den.lcm q₂.den
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_def, normalize_eq, Nat.div_dvd_iff_dvd_mul (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
    (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_right _ (by simp [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero])), ← Nat.gcd_mul_lcm,
    mul_dvd_mul_iff_right (Nat.lcm_ne_zero (by simp) (by simp)), Nat.dvd_gcd_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, dvd_mul_right _ _⟩
  rw [← Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, Int.dvd_natAbs]
  apply Int.dvd_add
    <;> apply dvd_mul_of_dvd_right <;> rw [Int.natCast_dvd_natCast]
    <;> [exact Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _; exact Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _]

name: sub_den_dvd_lcm
statement: theorem sub_den_dvd_lcm (q₁ q₂ : ℚ) : (q₁ - q₂).den ∣ q₁.den.lcm q₂.den
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_den] using add_den_dvd_lcm q₁ (-q₂)

name: add_den_dvd
statement: theorem add_den_dvd (q₁ q₂ : ℚ) : (q₁ + q₂).den ∣ q₁.den * q₂.den

name: sub_den_dvd
statement: theorem sub_den_dvd (q₁ q₂ : ℚ) : (q₁ - q₂).den ∣ q₁.den * q₂.den

name: mul_den_dvd
statement: theorem mul_den_dvd (q₁ q₂ : ℚ) : (q₁ * q₂).den ∣ q₁.den * q₂.den
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_def, normalize_eq]
  apply Nat.div_dvd_of_dvd
  apply Nat.gcd_dvd_right

name: mul_num
statement:
theorem mul_num (q₁ q₂ : ℚ) :
    (q₁ * q₂).num = q₁.num * q₂.num / Nat.gcd (q₁.num * q₂.num).natAbs (q₁.den * q₂.den)

name: mul_den
statement:
theorem mul_den (q₁ q₂ : ℚ) :
    (q₁ * q₂).den =
      q₁.den * q₂.den / Nat.gcd (q₁.num * q₂.num).natAbs (q₁.den * q₂.den)

name: add_intCast_den
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_intCast_den (q : ℚ) (n : ℤ) : (q + n).den = q.den
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.dvd_antisymm
  · simpa using add_den_dvd q n
  · simpa using add_den_dvd (q + n) (-n)

name: intCast_add_den
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intCast_add_den (n : ℤ) (q : ℚ) : (n + q).den = q.den

name: sub_intCast_den
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sub_intCast_den (q : ℚ) (n : ℤ) : (q - n).den = q.den

name: intCast_sub_den
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intCast_sub_den (n : ℤ) (q : ℚ) : (n - q).den = q.den

name: add_natCast_den
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_natCast_den (q : ℚ) (n : ℕ) : (q + n).den = q.den

name: natCast_add_den
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natCast_add_den (n : ℕ) (q : ℚ) : (n + q).den = q.den

name: sub_natCast_den
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sub_natCast_den (q : ℚ) (n : ℕ) : (q - n).den = q.den

name: natCast_sub_den
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natCast_sub_den (n : ℕ) (q : ℚ) : (n - q).den = q.den

name: add_ofNat_den
statement: @[simp] theorem add_ofNat_den (q : ℚ) (n : ℕ) : (q + ofNat(n)).den = q.den

name: ofNat_add_den
statement: @[simp] theorem ofNat_add_den (n : ℕ) (q : ℚ) : (ofNat(n) + q).den = q.den

name: sub_ofNat_den
statement: @[simp] theorem sub_ofNat_den (q : ℚ) (n : ℕ) : (q - ofNat(n)).den = q.den

name: ofNat_sub_den
statement: @[simp] theorem ofNat_sub_den (n : ℕ) (q : ℚ) : (ofNat(n) - q).den = q.den

name: den_mul_den_eq_den_mul_gcd
statement:
theorem den_mul_den_eq_den_mul_gcd (q₁ q₂ : ℚ) :
    q₁.den * q₂.den = (q₁ * q₂).den * ((q₁.num * q₂.num).natAbs.gcd (q₁.den * q₂.den))

name: num_mul_num_eq_num_mul_gcd
statement:
theorem num_mul_num_eq_num_mul_gcd (q₁ q₂ : ℚ) :
    q₁.num * q₂.num = (q₁ * q₂).num * ((q₁.num * q₂.num).natAbs.gcd (q₁.den * q₂.den))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_num]
  refine (Int.ediv_mul_cancel ?_).symm
  rw [← Int.dvd_natAbs]
  exact Int.ofNat_dvd.mpr (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)

name: mul_self_num
statement: theorem mul_self_num (q : ℚ) : (q * q).num = q.num * q.num
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_num, Int.natAbs_mul, Nat.Coprime.gcd_eq_one, Int.ofNat_one, Int.ediv_one]
  exact (q.reduced.mul_right q.reduced).mul_left (q.reduced.mul_right q.reduced)

name: mul_self_den
statement: theorem mul_self_den (q : ℚ) : (q * q).den = q.den * q.den
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rat.mul_den, Int.natAbs_mul, Nat.Coprime.gcd_eq_one, Nat.div_one]
  exact (q.reduced.mul_right q.reduced).mul_left (q.reduced.mul_right q.reduced)

name: add_num_den
statement:
theorem add_num_den (q r : ℚ) :
    q + r = (q.num * r.den + q.den * r.num : ℤ) /. (↑q.den * ↑r.den : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hqd : (q.den : ℤ) ≠ 0 := Int.natCast_ne_zero_iff_pos.2 q.den_pos
  have hrd : (r.den : ℤ) ≠ 0 := Int.natCast_ne_zero_iff_pos.2 r.den_pos
  conv_lhs => rw [← num_divInt_den q, ← num_divInt_den r, divInt_add_divInt _ _ hqd hrd]
  rw [mul_comm r.num q.den]

name: isSquare_iff
statement: theorem isSquare_iff {q : ℚ} : IsSquare q ↔ IsSquare q.num ∧ IsSquare q.den
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨qr, rfl⟩
    rw [Rat.mul_self_num, mul_self_den]
    simp only [IsSquare.mul_self, and_self]
  · rintro ⟨⟨nr, hnr⟩, ⟨dr, hdr⟩⟩
    refine ⟨nr / dr, ?_⟩
    rw [div_mul_div_comm, ← Int.cast_mul, ← Nat.cast_mul, ← hnr, ← hdr, num_div_den]

name: isSquare_natCast_iff
statement:
@[norm_cast, simp]
theorem isSquare_natCast_iff {n : ℕ} : IsSquare (n : ℚ) ↔ IsSquare n
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isSquare_iff, num_natCast, den_natCast, IsSquare.one, and_true, Int.isSquare_natCast_iff]

name: isSquare_intCast_iff
statement:
@[norm_cast, simp]
theorem isSquare_intCast_iff {z : ℤ} : IsSquare (z : ℚ) ↔ IsSquare z
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [isSquare_iff, num_intCast, den_intCast, IsSquare.one, and_true]

name: isSquare_ofNat_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isSquare_ofNat_iff {n : ℕ} :
    IsSquare (ofNat(n) : ℚ) ↔ IsSquare (OfNat.ofNat n : ℕ)

name: mkRat_add_mkRat_of_den
statement:
theorem mkRat_add_mkRat_of_den (n₁ n₂ : Int) {d : Nat} (h : d ≠ 0) :
    mkRat n₁ d + mkRat n₂ d = mkRat (n₁ + n₂) d
proof:
:= by
  rw [mkRat_add_mkRat _ _ h h, ← add_mul, mkRat_mul_right h]

name: exists_eq_mul_div_num_and_eq_mul_div_den
statement:
theorem exists_eq_mul_div_num_and_eq_mul_div_den (n : ℤ) {d : ℤ} (d_ne_zero : d ≠ 0) :
    ∃ c : ℤ, n = c * ((n : ℚ) / d).num ∧ (d : ℤ) = c * ((n : ℚ) / d).den
proof:
:=
  haveI : (n : ℚ) / d = Rat.divInt n d := by rw [← Rat.divInt_eq_div]
  Rat.num_den_mk d_ne_zero this

name: mul_num_den'
statement:
theorem mul_num_den' (q r : ℚ) :
    (q * r).num * q.den * r.den = q.num * r.num * (q * r).den
proof:
:= by
  let s := q.num * r.num /. (q.den * r.den : ℤ)
  have hs : (q.den * r.den : ℤ) ≠ 0 := Int.natCast_ne_zero_iff_pos.mpr (Nat.mul_pos q.pos r.pos)
  obtain ⟨c, ⟨c_mul_num, c_mul_den⟩⟩ :=
    exists_eq_mul_div_num_and_eq_mul_div_den (q.num * r.num) hs
  rw [c_mul_num, mul_assoc, mul_comm]
  nth_rw 1 [c_mul_den]
  rw [Int.mul_assoc, Int.mul_assoc, mul_eq_mul_left_iff, or_iff_not_imp_right]
  intro
  have h : _ = s := divInt_mul_divInt q.num r.num
  rw [num_divInt_den, num_divInt_den] at h
  rw [h, mul_comm, ← Rat.eq_iff_mul_eq_mul, ← divInt_eq_div]

name: add_num_den'
statement:
theorem add_num_den' (q r : ℚ) :
    (q + r).num * q.den * r.den = (q.num * r.den + r.num * q.den) * (q + r).den
proof:
:= by
  let s := divInt (q.num * r.den + r.num * q.den) (q.den * r.den : ℤ)
  have hs : (q.den * r.den : ℤ) ≠ 0 := Int.natCast_ne_zero_iff_pos.mpr (Nat.mul_pos q.pos r.pos)
  obtain ⟨c, ⟨c_mul_num, c_mul_den⟩⟩ :=
    exists_eq_mul_div_num_and_eq_mul_div_den (q.num * r.den + r.num * q.den) hs
  rw [c_mul_num, mul_assoc, mul_comm]
  nth_rw 1 [c_mul_den]
  repeat rw [Int.mul_assoc]
  apply mul_eq_mul_left_iff.2
  rw [or_iff_not_imp_right]
  intro
  have h : _ = s := divInt_add_divInt q.num r.num (mod_cast q.den_ne_zero) (mod_cast r.den_ne_zero)
  rw [num_divInt_den, num_divInt_den] at h
  rw [h]
  rw [mul_comm]
  apply Rat.eq_iff_mul_eq_mul.mp
  rw [← divInt_eq_div]

name: substr_num_den'
statement:
theorem substr_num_den' (q r : ℚ) :
    (q - r).num * q.den * r.den = (q.num * r.den - r.num * q.den) * (q - r).den
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_mul, ← num_neg_eq_neg_num, ← den_neg_eq_den r,
    add_num_den' q (-r)]

name: inv_neg
statement: protected theorem inv_neg (q : ℚ) : (-q)⁻¹ = -q⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [← num_divInt_den q]
  simp only [Rat.neg_divInt, Rat.inv_divInt, Rat.divInt_neg]

name: num_div_eq_of_coprime
statement:
theorem num_div_eq_of_coprime {a b : ℤ} (hb0 : 0 < b) (h : Nat.Coprime a.natAbs b.natAbs) :
    (a / b : ℚ).num = a
proof:
:= by
  lift b to ℕ using hb0.le
  simp only [Int.natAbs_natCast, Int.natCast_pos] at h hb0
  rw [← Rat.divInt_eq_div, ← mk_eq_divInt (nz := hb0.ne') (c := h)]

name: den_div_eq_of_coprime
statement:
theorem den_div_eq_of_coprime {a b : ℤ} (hb0 : 0 < b) (h : Nat.Coprime a.natAbs b.natAbs) :
    ((a / b : ℚ).den : ℤ) = b
proof:
:= by
  lift b to ℕ using hb0.le
  simp only [Int.natAbs_natCast, Int.natCast_pos] at h hb0
  rw [← Rat.divInt_eq_div, ← mk_eq_divInt (nz := hb0.ne') (c := h)]

name: div_int_inj
statement:
theorem div_int_inj {a b c d : ℤ} (hb0 : 0 < b) (hd0 : 0 < d) (h1 : Nat.Coprime a.natAbs b.natAbs)
    (h2 : Nat.Coprime c.natAbs d.natAbs) (h : (a : ℚ) / b = (c : ℚ) / d) : a = c ∧ b = d
proof:
:= by
  apply And.intro
  · rw [← num_div_eq_of_coprime hb0 h1, h, num_div_eq_of_coprime hd0 h2]
  · rw [← den_div_eq_of_coprime hb0 h1, h, den_div_eq_of_coprime hd0 h2]

theorem intCast_div_self (n : ℤ) : ((n / n : ℤ) : ℚ) = n / n

  · subst hn
    simp
  · have : (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by rwa [← intCast_inj]  at hn
    simp only [Int.ediv_self hn, Int.cast_one, div_self this]

name: addSubmonoid_closure_range_pow
statement:
@[simp] lemma addSubmonoid_closure_range_pow {n : ℕ} (hn₀ : n ≠ 0) :
    closure (range fun x : ℚ≥0 ↦ x ^ n) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine (eq_top_iff' _).2 fun x ↦ ?_
  suffices x = (x.num * x.den ^ (n - 1)) • (x.den : ℚ≥0)⁻¹ ^ n by
    rw [this]
    exact nsmul_mem (subset_closure <| mem_range_self _) _
  rw [nsmul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  rw [mul_assoc, pow_sub₀, pow_one, mul_right_comm, ← mul_pow, mul_inv_cancel₀, one_pow, one_mul,
    ← div_eq_mul_inv, num_div_den]
  all_goals simp [x.den_pos.ne', Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero, *]

proof:
:= by
  convert! (AddMonoidHom.map_mclosure NNRat.coeHom <| range fun x ↦ x ^ n).symm
  · have (x : ℚ) : ∃ y : ℚ≥0, y ^ n = x ^ n := ⟨x.nnabs, by simp [hn.pow_abs]⟩
    simp [subset_antisymm_iff, range_subset_iff, this]
  · ext
    simp [NNRat.addSubmonoid_closure_range_pow hn₀, NNRat.exists]

name: lift_binop_eq
statement:
theorem lift_binop_eq (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) (f₁ : ℤ → ℤ → ℤ → ℤ → ℤ) (f₂ : ℤ → ℤ → ℤ → ℤ → ℤ)
    (fv :
      ∀ {n₁ d₁ h₁ c₁ n₂ d₂ h₂ c₂},
        f ⟨n₁, d₁, h₁, c₁⟩ ⟨n₂, d₂, h₂, c₂⟩ = f₁ n₁ d₁ n₂ d₂ /. f₂ n₁ d₁ n₂ d₂)
    (f0 : ∀ {n₁ d₁ n₂ d₂}, d₁ ≠ 0 → d₂ ≠ 0 → f₂ n₁ d₁ n₂ d₂ ≠ 0) (a b c d : ℤ)
    (b0 : b ≠ 0) (d0 : d ≠ 0)
    (H :
      ∀ {n₁ d₁ n₂ d₂}, a * d₁ = n₁ * b → c * d₂ = n₂ * d →
        f₁ n₁ d₁ n₂ d₂ * f₂ a b c d = f₁ a b c d * f₂ n₁ d₁ n₂ d₂) :
    f (a /. b) (c /. d) = f₁ a b c d /. f₂ a b c d
proof:
:= by
  generalize ha : a /. b = x; obtain ⟨n₁, d₁, h₁, c₁⟩ := x; rw [mk_eq_divInt] at ha
  generalize hc : c /. d = x; obtain ⟨n₂, d₂, h₂, c₂⟩ := x; rw [mk_eq_divInt] at hc
  rw [fv]
  have d₁0 := Int.ofNat_ne_zero.2 h₁
  have d₂0 := Int.ofNat_ne_zero.2 h₂
  exact (divInt_eq_divInt_iff (f0 d₁0 d₂0) (f0 b0 d0)).2
    (H ((divInt_eq_divInt_iff b0 d₁0).1 ha) ((divInt_eq_divInt_iff d0 d₂0).1 hc))

name: floor_intCast_div_natCast
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem floor_intCast_div_natCast (n : ℤ) (d : ℕ) : ⌊(↑n / ↑d : ℚ)⌋ = n / (↑d : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rat.floor_def']
  obtain rfl | hd := eq_zero_or_pos (a := d)
  · simp
  set q := (n : ℚ) / d with q_eq
  obtain ⟨c, n_eq_c_mul_num, d_eq_c_mul_denom⟩ : ∃ c, n = c * q.num ∧ (d : ℤ) = c * q.den := by
    rw [q_eq]
    exact mod_cast @Rat.exists_eq_mul_div_num_and_eq_mul_div_den n d (mod_cast hd.ne')
  rw [n_eq_c_mul_num, d_eq_c_mul_denom]
  refine (Int.mul_ediv_mul_of_pos _ _ <| pos_of_mul_pos_left ?_ <| Int.natCast_nonneg q.den).symm
  rwa [← d_eq_c_mul_denom, Int.natCast_pos]

theorem isNat_intFloor_ofIsNNRat (r : α) (n : ℕ) (d : ℕ) :
    IsNNRat r n d → IsNat ⌊r⌋ (n / d)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨inv, rfl⟩
  constructor
  simp only [invOf_eq_inv, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [← Int.ofNat_ediv_ofNat, ← floor_natCast_div_natCast n d,

name: isInt_intFloor_ofIsRat_neg
statement:
theorem isInt_intFloor_ofIsRat_neg (r : α) (n : ℕ) (d : ℕ) :
    IsRat r (.negOfNat n) d → IsInt ⌊r⌋ (.negOfNat (-(-n / d) : ℤ).toNat)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨inv, rfl⟩
  constructor
  simp only [invOf_eq_inv, ← div_eq_mul_inv, Int.cast_id]
  rw [← ceil_intCast_div_natCast n d, Int.cast_natCast]
  rw [@negOfNat_eq (toNat _), ofNat_eq_natCast,
    natCast_toNat_eq_self.mpr (ceil_nonneg (div_nonneg n.cast_nonneg d.cast_nonneg)),
    ← Int.cast_natCast n, ceil_intCast_div_natCast n d, neg_neg, ← ofNat_eq_natCast, ← negOfNat_eq,
    ← floor_intCast_div_natCast (.negOfNat n) d, ← floor_cast (α := α), Rat.cast_div,

name: num_lt_succ_floor_mul_den
statement: theorem num_lt_succ_floor_mul_den (q : ℚ) : q.num < (⌊q⌋ + 1) * q.den
proof:
:= by
  suffices (q.num : ℚ) < (⌊q⌋ + 1) * q.den from mod_cast this
  suffices (q.num : ℚ) < (q - fract q + 1) * q.den by
    have : (⌊q⌋ : ℚ) = q - fract q := eq_sub_of_add_eq <| floor_add_fract q
    rwa [this]
  suffices (q.num : ℚ) < q.num + (1 - fract q) * q.den by
    have : (q - fract q + 1) * q.den = q.num + (1 - fract q) * q.den := by
      calc
        (q - fract q + 1) * q.den = (q + (1 - fract q)) * q.den := by ring
        _ = q * q.den + (1 - fract q) * q.den := by rw [add_mul]
        _ = q.num + (1 - fract q) * q.den := by simp
    rwa [this]
  suffices 0 < (1 - fract q) * q.den by
    rw [← sub_lt_iff_lt_add']
    simpa
  have : 0 < 1 - fract q := by
    have : fract q < 1 := fract_lt_one q
    have : 0 + fract q < 1 := by simp [this]
    rwa [lt_sub_iff_add_lt]
  exact mul_pos this (by exact mod_cast q.pos)

name: fract_inv_num_lt_num_of_pos
statement: theorem fract_inv_num_lt_num_of_pos {q : ℚ} (q_pos : 0 < q) : (fract q⁻¹).num < q.num
proof:
:= by
  
  have q_num_pos : 0 < q.num := Rat.num_pos.mpr q_pos
  
  have q_num_abs_eq_q_num : (q.num.natAbs : ℤ) = q.num := Int.natAbs_of_nonneg q_num_pos.le
  set q_inv : ℚ := q.den / q.num with q_inv_def
  have q_inv_eq : q⁻¹ = q_inv := by rw [q_inv_def, inv_def, divInt_eq_div, Int.cast_natCast]
  suffices (q_inv - ⌊q_inv⌋).num < q.num by rwa [q_inv_eq]
  suffices ((q.den - q.num * ⌊q_inv⌋ : ℚ) / q.num).num < q.num by
    simp only [gt_iff_lt, q_inv]
    field_simp
    simp [q_inv, this]
  suffices (q.den : ℤ) - q.num * ⌊q_inv⌋ < q.num by
    
    have : ((q.den - q.num * ⌊q_inv⌋ : ℚ) / q.num).num = q.den - q.num * ⌊q_inv⌋ := by
      suffices ((q.den : ℤ) - q.num * ⌊q_inv⌋).natAbs.Coprime q.num.natAbs from
        mod_cast Rat.num_div_eq_of_coprime q_num_pos this
      have tmp := Nat.coprime_sub_mul_floor_rat_div_of_coprime q.reduced.symm
      simpa only [Nat.cast_natAbs, abs_of_nonneg q_num_pos.le] using! tmp
    rwa [this]
  
  have q_inv_num_denom_ineq : q⁻¹.num - ⌊q⁻¹⌋ * q⁻¹.den < q⁻¹.den := by
    have : q⁻¹.num < (⌊q⁻¹⌋ + 1) * q⁻¹.den := Rat.num_lt_succ_floor_mul_den q⁻¹
    have : q⁻¹.num < ⌊q⁻¹⌋ * q⁻¹.den + q⁻¹.den := by rwa [right_distrib, one_mul] at this
    rwa [← sub_lt_iff_lt_add'] at this
  
  
  have : q_inv.num = q.den ∧ q_inv.den = q.num.natAbs := by
    have coprime_q_denom_q_num : q.den.Coprime q.num.natAbs := q.reduced.symm
    have : Int.natAbs q.den = q.den := by simp
    rw [← this] at coprime_q_denom_q_num
    rw [q_inv_def]
    constructor
    · exact mod_cast Rat.num_div_eq_of_coprime q_num_pos coprime_q_denom_q_num
    · suffices (((q.den : ℚ) / q.num).den : ℤ) = q.num.natAbs by exact mod_cast this
      rw [q_num_abs_eq_q_num]
      exact mod_cast Rat.den_div_eq_of_coprime q_num_pos coprime_q_denom_q_num
  rwa [q_inv_eq, this.left, this.right, q_num_abs_eq_q_num, mul_comm] at q_inv_num_denom_ineq

  | bit1 p =>

      show ↑p + 1 + ↑p + 1 = ↑p + ↑p + 1 + 1 by simp [add_left_comm]

@[norm_cast]
theorem add_to_nat : ∀ m n, ((m + n : PosNum) : ℕ) = m + n
  | 1, b => by rw [one_add b, succ_to_nat, add_comm, cast_one]
  | a, 1 => by rw [add_one a, succ_to_nat, cast_one]
  | bit0 a, bit0 b => (congr_arg (fun n ↦ n + n) (add_to_nat a b)).trans <| add_add_add_comm _ _ _ _
  | bit0 a, bit1 b =>
    (congr_arg (fun n ↦ (n + n) + 1) (add_to_nat a b)).trans <|
      show (a + b + (a + b) + 1 : ℕ) = a + a + (b + b + 1) by simp [add_left_comm]
  | bit1 a, bit0 b =>
    (congr_arg (fun n ↦ (n + n) + 1) (add_to_nat a b)).trans <|
      show (a + b + (a + b) + 1 : ℕ) = a + a + 1 + (b + b) by simp [add_comm, add_left_comm]
  | bit1 a, bit1 b =>
    show (succ (a + b) + succ (a + b) : ℕ) = a + a + 1 + (b + b + 1) by
      rw [succ_to_nat, add_to_nat a b]; simp [add_left_comm]

  | bit1 a, 1 => congr_arg bit1 (add_one a)
  | bit0 _, bit0 _ => rfl

statement: theorem cmp_swap (m) : ∀ n, (cmp m n).swap = cmp n m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with | one => ?_ | bit1 m IH => ?_ | bit0 m IH => ?_ <;>
    intro n <;> obtain - | n | n := n <;> unfold cmp <;>
      try { rfl } <;> rw [← IH] <;> cases cmp m n <;> rfl

name: cmp_to_nat
statement:
theorem cmp_to_nat : ∀ m n, (Ordering.casesOn (cmp m n) ((m : ℕ) < n) (m = n) ((n : ℕ) < m) : Prop)
  | 1, 1 => rfl
  | bit0 a, 1 =>
    let h : (1 : ℕ) ≤ a
proof:
:= to_nat_pos a
    Nat.add_le_add h h
  | bit1 a, 1 => Nat.succ_lt_succ <| to_nat_pos <| bit0 a
  | 1, bit0 b =>
    let h : (1 : ℕ) ≤ b := to_nat_pos b
    Nat.add_le_add h h
  | 1, bit1 b => Nat.succ_lt_succ <| to_nat_pos <| bit0 b
  | bit0 a, bit0 b => by
    dsimp [cmp]
    have := cmp_to_nat a b; revert this; cases cmp a b <;> dsimp <;> intro this
    · exact Nat.add_lt_add this this
    · rw [this]
    · exact Nat.add_lt_add this this
  | bit0 a, bit1 b => by
    dsimp [cmp]
    have := cmp_to_nat a b; revert this; cases cmp a b <;> dsimp <;> intro this
    · exact Nat.le_succ_of_le (Nat.add_lt_add this this)
    · rw [this]
      apply Nat.lt_succ_self
    · exact cmp_to_nat_lemma this
  | bit1 a, bit0 b => by
    dsimp [cmp]
    have := cmp_to_nat a b; revert this; cases cmp a b <;> dsimp <;> intro this
    · exact cmp_to_nat_lemma this
    · rw [this]
      apply Nat.lt_succ_self
    · exact Nat.le_succ_of_le (Nat.add_lt_add this this)
  | bit1 a, bit1 b => by
    dsimp [cmp]
    have := cmp_to_nat a b; revert this; cases cmp a b <;> dsimp <;> intro this
    · exact Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.add_lt_add this this)
    · rw [this]
    · exact Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.add_lt_add this this)

  | bit0 p => by
      simpa only [Nat.bit_false, Bool.cond_false, two_mul, of_to_nat' p] using!
        Num.ofNat'_bit false p
  | bit1 p => by
      simpa only [Nat.bit_true, Bool.cond_true, two_mul, of_to_nat' p] using!

proof:

name: castNum_eq_bitwise
statement:
theorem castNum_eq_bitwise {f : Num → Num → Num} {g : Bool → Bool → Bool}
    (p : PosNum → PosNum → Num)
    (gff : g false false = false) (f00 : f 0 0 = 0)
    (f0n : ∀ n, f 0 (pos n) = cond (g false true) (pos n) 0)
    (fn0 : ∀ n, f (pos n) 0 = cond (g true false) (pos n) 0)
    (fnn : ∀ m n, f (pos m) (pos n) = p m n) (p11 : p 1 1 = cond (g true true) 1 0)
    (p1b : ∀ b n, p 1 (PosNum.bit b n) = bit (g true b) (cond (g false true) (pos n) 0))
    (pb1 : ∀ a m, p (PosNum.bit a m) 1 = bit (g a true) (cond (g true false) (pos m) 0))
    (pbb : ∀ a b m n, p (PosNum.bit a m) (PosNum.bit b n) = bit (g a b) (p m n)) :
    ∀ m n : Num, (f m n : ℕ) = Nat.bitwise g m n
proof:
:= by
  intro m n
  obtain - | m := m <;> obtain - | n := n <;>
      try simp only [show zero = 0 from rfl, show ((0 : Num) : ℕ) = 0 from rfl]
  · rw [f00, Nat.bitwise_zero]; rfl
  · rw [f0n, Nat.bitwise_zero_left]
    cases g false true <;> rfl
  · rw [fn0, Nat.bitwise_zero_right]
    cases g true false <;> rfl
  · rw [fnn]
    have this b (n : PosNum) : (cond b (↑n) 0 : ℕ) = ↑(cond b (pos n) 0 : Num) := by
      cases b <;> rfl
    have this' b (n : PosNum) : ↑(pos (PosNum.bit b n)) = Nat.bit b ↑n := by
      cases b <;> simp
    induction m generalizing n with | one => ?_ | bit1 m IH => ?_ | bit0 m IH => ?_ <;>
    obtain - | n | n := n
    any_goals simp only [show one = 1 from rfl, show pos 1 = 1 from rfl,
      show PosNum.bit0 = PosNum.bit false from rfl, show PosNum.bit1 = PosNum.bit true from rfl,
      show ((1 : Num) : ℕ) = Nat.bit true 0 from rfl]
    all_goals
      repeat rw [this']
      rw [Nat.bitwise_bit gff]
    any_goals rw [Nat.bitwise_zero, p11]; cases g true true <;> rfl
    any_goals rw [Nat.bitwise_zero_left, ← Bool.cond_eq_ite, this, ← bit_to_nat, p1b]
    any_goals rw [Nat.bitwise_zero_right, ← Bool.cond_eq_ite, this, ← bit_to_nat, pb1]
    all_goals
      rw [← show ∀ n : PosNum, ↑(p m n) = Nat.bitwise g ↑m ↑n from IH]
      rw [← bit_to_nat, pbb]

  · symm
    apply Nat.zero_shiftRight
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => cases m <;> rfl
  | succ n IH => ?_
  have hdiv2 : ∀ m, Nat.div2 (m + m) = m := by intro; rw [Nat.div2_val]; lia
  obtain - | m | m := m <;> dsimp only [PosNum.shiftr, ← PosNum.shiftr_eq_shiftRight]
  · rw [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
    symm
    apply Nat.div_eq_of_lt
    simp
  · trans
    · apply IH
    change Nat.shiftRight m n = Nat.shiftRight (m + m + 1) (n + 1)
    rw [add_comm n 1, @Nat.shiftRight_eq _ (1 + n), Nat.shiftRight_add]
    apply congr_arg fun x => Nat.shiftRight x n
    simp [-add_assoc, Nat.shiftRight_succ, Nat.shiftRight_zero, ← Nat.div2_val, hdiv2]
  · trans
    · apply IH
    change Nat.shiftRight m n = Nat.shiftRight (m + m) (n + 1)
    rw [add_comm n 1, @Nat.shiftRight_eq _ (1 + n), Nat.shiftRight_add]
    apply congr_arg fun x => Nat.shiftRight x n
    simp [-add_assoc, Nat.shiftRight_succ, Nat.shiftRight_zero, ← Nat.div2_val, hdiv2]

name: castNum_testBit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem castNum_testBit (m n) : testBit m n = Nat.testBit m n
proof:
:= by
  cases m with dsimp only [testBit]
  | zero =>
    rw [show (Num.zero : Nat) = 0 from rfl, Nat.zero_testBit]
  | pos m =>
    rw [cast_pos]
    induction n generalizing m <;> obtain - | m | m := m
        <;> simp only [PosNum.testBit]
    · rfl
    · rw [PosNum.cast_bit1, ← two_mul, ← congr_fun Nat.bit_true, Nat.testBit_bit_zero]
    · rw [PosNum.cast_bit0, ← two_mul, ← congr_fun Nat.bit_false, Nat.testBit_bit_zero]
    · simp [Nat.testBit_add_one]
    case succ.bit1 n IH =>
      rw [PosNum.cast_bit1, ← two_mul, ← congr_fun Nat.bit_true, Nat.testBit_bit_succ, IH]
    case succ.bit0 n IH =>
      rw [PosNum.cast_bit0, ← two_mul, ← congr_fun Nat.bit_false, Nat.testBit_bit_succ, IH]

  | 0 => rfl
