name: cast_bit0
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem cast_bit0 [AddGroupWithOne α] : ∀ n : ZNum, (n.bit0 : α) = (n : α) + n
  | 0 => (add_zero _).symm
  | pos p => by rw [ZNum.bit0, cast_pos, cast_pos]; rfl
  | neg p => by
    rw [ZNum.bit0, cast_neg, cast_neg, PosNum.cast_bit0, neg_add_rev]

@[simp, norm_cast]

name: cast_bit1
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem cast_bit1 [AddGroupWithOne α] : ∀ n : ZNum, (n.bit1 : α) = ((n : α) + n) + 1
  | 0 => by simp [ZNum.bit1]
  | pos p => by rw [ZNum.bit1, cast_pos, cast_pos]; rfl
  | neg p => by
    rw [ZNum.bit1, cast_neg, cast_neg]
    rcases e : pred' p with - | a <;>
      have ep : p = _
proof:
:= (succ'_pred' p).symm.trans (congr_arg Num.succ' e)
    · conv at ep => change p = 1
      subst p
      simp
    · dsimp only [Num.succ'] at ep
      subst p
      have : (↑(-↑a : ℤ) : α) = -1 + ↑(-↑a + 1 : ℤ) := by simp [add_comm (-↑a : ℤ) 1]
      simpa using this

name: cast_bitm1
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cast_bitm1 [AddGroupWithOne α] (n : ZNum) : (n.bitm1 : α) = (n : α) + n - 1
proof:
:= by
  conv =>
    lhs
    rw [← zneg_zneg n]
  rw [← zneg_bit1, cast_zneg, cast_bit1]
  have : ((-1 + n + n : ℤ) : α) = (n + n + -1 : ℤ) := by simp [add_comm]
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using this

name: cast_to_znum
statement:
theorem cast_to_znum : ∀ n : PosNum, (n : ZNum) = ZNum.pos n
  | 1 => rfl
  | bit0 p => by
      have
proof:
:= congr_arg ZNum.bit0 (cast_to_znum p)
      rwa [← ZNum.bit0_of_bit0] at this
  | bit1 p => by
      have := congr_arg ZNum.bit1 (cast_to_znum p)
      rwa [← ZNum.bit1_of_bit1] at this

name: cast_sub'
statement:
theorem cast_sub' [AddGroupWithOne α] : ∀ m n : PosNum, (sub' m n : α) = m - n
  | a, 1 => by
    rw [sub'_one, Num.cast_toZNum, ← Num.cast_to_nat, pred'_to_nat, ← Nat.sub_one]
    simp
  | 1, b => by
    rw [one_sub', Num.cast_toZNumNeg, ← neg_sub, neg_inj, ← Num.cast_to_nat, pred'_to_nat,
        ← Nat.sub_one]
    simp
  | bit0 a, bit0 b => by
    rw [sub', ZNum.cast_bit0, cast_sub' a b]
    have : ((a + -b + (a + -b) : ℤ) : α) = a + a + (-b + -b)
proof:
:= by simp [add_left_comm]
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using this
  | bit0 a, bit1 b => by
    rw [sub', ZNum.cast_bitm1, cast_sub' a b]
    have : ((-b + (a + (-b + -1)) : ℤ) : α) = (a + -1 + (-b + -b) : ℤ) := by
      simp [add_comm, add_left_comm]
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using this
  | bit1 a, bit0 b => by
    rw [sub', ZNum.cast_bit1, cast_sub' a b]
    have : ((-b + (a + (-b + 1)) : ℤ) : α) = (a + 1 + (-b + -b) : ℤ) := by
      simp [add_comm, add_left_comm]
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using this
  | bit1 a, bit1 b => by
    rw [sub', ZNum.cast_bit0, cast_sub' a b]
    have : ((-b + (a + -b) : ℤ) : α) = a + (-b + -b) := by simp [add_left_comm]
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using this

name: pred_succ
statement:

theorem pred_succ : ∀ n : ZNum, n.pred.succ = n
  | 0 => rfl

  | ZNum.pos p => by rw [ZNum.pred, ← toZNum_succ, Num.succ, PosNum.succ'_pred', toZNum]

name: succ_ofInt'
statement:
theorem succ_ofInt' : ∀ n, ZNum.ofInt' (n + 1) = ZNum.ofInt' n + 1
  | (n : ℕ) => by
    change ZNum.ofInt' (n + 1 : ℕ) = ZNum.ofInt' (n : ℕ) + 1
    dsimp only [ZNum.ofInt', ZNum.ofInt']
    rw [Num.ofNat'_succ, Num.add_one, toZNum_succ, ZNum.add_one]
  | -[0+1] => by
    change ZNum.ofInt' 0 = ZNum.ofInt' (-[0+1]) + 1
    dsimp only [ZNum.ofInt', ZNum.ofInt']
    rw [ofNat'_succ, ofNat'_zero]; rfl
  | -[(n + 1)+1] => by
    change ZNum.ofInt' -[n+1] = ZNum.ofInt' -[(n + 1)+1] + 1
    dsimp only [ZNum.ofInt', ZNum.ofInt']
    rw [@Num.ofNat'_succ (n + 1), Num.add_one, toZNumNeg_succ,
      @ofNat'_succ n, Num.add_one, ZNum.add_one, pred_succ]

name: ofInt'_toZNum
statement:
theorem ofInt'_toZNum : ∀ n : ℕ, toZNum n = ZNum.ofInt' n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [Nat.cast_succ, Num.add_one, toZNum_succ, ofInt'_toZNum n, Nat.cast_succ, succ_ofInt',
      ZNum.add_one]

name: mem_ofZNum'
statement:
theorem mem_ofZNum' : ∀ {m : Num} {n : ZNum}, m ∈ ofZNum' n ↔ n = toZNum m
  | 0, 0 => ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩
  | pos _, 0 => ⟨nofun, nofun⟩
  | m, ZNum.pos p =>
    Option.some_inj.trans <| by cases m <;> constructor <;> intro h <;> try cases h <;> rfl
  | m, ZNum.neg p => ⟨nofun, fun h => by cases m <;> cases h⟩

name: ofZNum'_toNat
statement:
theorem ofZNum'_toNat : ∀ n : ZNum, (↑) <$> ofZNum' n = Int.toNat? n
  | 0 => rfl
  | ZNum.pos p => show _ = Int.toNat? p by rw [← PosNum.to_nat_to_int p]; rfl
  | ZNum.neg p =>
    (congr_arg fun x => Int.toNat? (-x)) <|
      show ((p.pred' + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = p by rw [← succ'_to_nat]; simp

name: ofZNum_toNat
statement:
theorem ofZNum_toNat : ∀ n : ZNum, (ofZNum n : ℕ) = Int.toNat n
  | 0 => rfl
  | ZNum.pos p => show _ = Int.toNat p by rw [← PosNum.to_nat_to_int p]; rfl
  | ZNum.neg p =>
    (congr_arg fun x => Int.toNat (-x)) <|
      show ((p.pred' + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = p by rw [← succ'_to_nat]; simp

statement:
@[simp]
theorem cast_ofZNum [AddMonoidWithOne α] (n : ZNum) : (ofZNum n : α) = Int.toNat n

name: sub_to_nat
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem sub_to_nat (m n) : ((m - n : Num) : ℕ) = m - n
proof:
:=
  show (ofZNum _ : ℕ) = _ by
    rw [ofZNum_toNat, cast_sub', ← to_nat_to_int, ← to_nat_to_int, Int.toNat_sub]

name: cast_add
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem cast_add [AddGroupWithOne α] : ∀ m n, ((m + n : ZNum) : α) = m + n
  | 0, a => by cases a <;> exact (_root_.zero_add _).symm
  | b, 0 => by cases b <;> exact (_root_.add_zero _).symm
  | pos _, pos _ => PosNum.cast_add _ _
  | pos a, neg b => by simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using! PosNum.cast_sub' (α := α) _ _
  | neg a, pos b =>
    have : (↑b + -↑a : α) = -↑a + ↑b
proof:
:= by
      rw [← PosNum.cast_to_int a, ← PosNum.cast_to_int b, ← Int.cast_neg, ← Int.cast_add (-a)]
      simp [add_comm]
    (PosNum.cast_sub' _ _).trans <| (sub_eq_add_neg _ _).trans this
  | neg a, neg b =>
    show -(↑(a + b) : α) = -a + -b by
      rw [PosNum.cast_add, neg_eq_iff_eq_neg, neg_add_rev, neg_neg, neg_neg,
          ← PosNum.cast_to_int a, ← PosNum.cast_to_int b, ← Int.cast_add, ← Int.cast_add, add_comm]

name: cast_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cast_succ [AddGroupWithOne α] (n) : ((succ n : ZNum) : α) = n + 1

name: mul_to_int
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem mul_to_int : ∀ m n, ((m * n : ZNum) : ℤ) = m * n
  | 0, a => by cases a <;> exact (zero_mul _).symm
  | b, 0 => by cases b <;> exact (mul_zero _).symm
  | pos a, pos b => PosNum.cast_mul a b
  | pos a, neg b => show -↑(a * b) = ↑a * -↑b by rw [PosNum.cast_mul, neg_mul_eq_mul_neg]
  | neg a, pos b => show -↑(a * b) = -↑a * ↑b by rw [PosNum.cast_mul, neg_mul_eq_neg_mul]
  | neg a, neg b => show ↑(a * b) = -↑a * -↑b by rw [PosNum.cast_mul, neg_mul_neg]

name: cast_mul
statement: theorem cast_mul [NonAssocRing α] (m n) : ((m * n : ZNum) : α) = m * n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cast_to_int, mul_to_int, Int.cast_mul, cast_to_int, cast_to_int]

name: ofInt'_neg
statement:
theorem ofInt'_neg : ∀ n : ℤ, ofInt' (-n) = -ofInt' n
  | -[n+1] => show ofInt' (n + 1 : ℕ) = _ by simp only [ofInt', Num.zneg_toZNumNeg]
  | 0 => show Num.toZNum (Num.ofNat' 0) = -Num.toZNum (Num.ofNat' 0) by rw [Num.ofNat'_zero]; rfl
  | (n + 1 : ℕ) => show Num.toZNumNeg _ = -Num.toZNum _ by rw [Num.zneg_toZNum]

name: of_to_int'
statement:
theorem of_to_int' : ∀ n : ZNum, ZNum.ofInt' n = n
  | 0 => by
    dsimp [ofInt', cast_zero]
    simp only [Num.ofNat'_zero, Num.toZNum]
  | pos a => by rw [cast_pos, ← PosNum.cast_to_nat, ← Num.ofInt'_toZNum, PosNum.of_to_nat]; rfl
  | neg a => by
    rw [cast_neg, ofInt'_neg, ← PosNum.cast_to_nat, ← Num.ofInt'_toZNum, PosNum.of_to_nat]; rfl

name: to_int_inj
statement: theorem to_int_inj {m n : ZNum} : (m : ℤ) = n ↔ m = n

name: cmp_to_int
statement:
theorem cmp_to_int : ∀ m n, (Ordering.casesOn (cmp m n) ((m : ℤ) < n) (m = n) ((n : ℤ) < m) : Prop)
  | 0, 0 => rfl
  | pos a, pos b => by simpa using! PosNum.cmp_to_nat a b
  | neg a, neg b => by
    have
proof:
:= PosNum.cmp_to_nat b a; revert this; dsimp [cmp]
    cases PosNum.cmp b a <;> [simp; simp +contextual; simp]
  | pos _, 0 => PosNum.cast_pos _
  | pos _, neg _ => lt_trans (neg_lt_zero.2 <| PosNum.cast_pos _) (PosNum.cast_pos _)
  | 0, neg _ => neg_lt_zero.2 <| PosNum.cast_pos _
  | neg _, 0 => neg_lt_zero.2 <| PosNum.cast_pos _
  | neg _, pos _ => lt_trans (neg_lt_zero.2 <| PosNum.cast_pos _) (PosNum.cast_pos _)
  | 0, pos _ => PosNum.cast_pos _

name: lt_to_int
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem lt_to_int {m n : ZNum} : (m : ℤ) < n ↔ m < n
proof:
:=
  show (m : ℤ) < n ↔ cmp m n = Ordering.lt from
    match cmp m n, cmp_to_int m n with
    | Ordering.lt, h => by simp only at h; simp [h]
    | Ordering.eq, h => by simp only at h; simp [h]
    | Ordering.gt, h => by simp [not_lt_of_gt h]

name: le_to_int
statement: theorem le_to_int {m n : ZNum} : (m : ℤ) ≤ n ↔ m ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_lt]; exact not_congr lt_to_int

name: cast_lt
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem cast_lt [Ring α] [PartialOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] {m n : ZNum} :
    (m : α) < n ↔ m < n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cast_to_int m, ← cast_to_int n, Int.cast_lt, lt_to_int]

name: cast_le
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem cast_le [Ring α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] {m n : ZNum} :
    (m : α) ≤ n ↔ m ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_lt]; exact not_congr cast_lt

name: cast_inj
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem cast_inj [Ring α] [PartialOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α] {m n : ZNum} :
    (m : α) = n ↔ m = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cast_to_int m, ← cast_to_int n, Int.cast_inj (α := α), to_int_inj]

  ⟨fun ⟨k, e⟩ => ⟨k, by rw [← of_to_int n, e]; simp⟩, fun ⟨k, e⟩ => ⟨k, by simp [e]⟩⟩

name: divMod_to_nat_aux
statement:
theorem divMod_to_nat_aux {n d : PosNum} {q r : Num} (h₁ : (r : ℕ) + d * ((q : ℕ) + q) = n)
    (h₂ : (r : ℕ) < 2 * d) :
    ((divModAux d q r).2 + d * (divModAux d q r).1 : ℕ) = ↑n ∧ ((divModAux d q r).2 : ℕ) < d
proof:
:= by
  unfold divModAux
  have : ∀ {r₂}, Num.ofZNum' (Num.sub' r (Num.pos d)) = some r₂ ↔ (r : ℕ) = r₂ + d := by
    intro r₂
    apply Num.mem_ofZNum'.trans
    rw [← ZNum.to_int_inj, Num.cast_toZNum, Num.cast_sub', sub_eq_iff_eq_add, ← Int.natCast_inj]
    simp
  rcases e : Num.ofZNum' (Num.sub' r (Num.pos d)) with - | r₂
  · rw [Num.cast_bit0, two_mul]
    refine ⟨h₁, lt_of_not_ge fun h => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r₂, e'⟩ := Nat.le.dest h
    rw [← Num.to_of_nat r₂, add_comm] at e'
    cases e.symm.trans (this.2 e'.symm)
  · have := this.1 e
    simp only [Num.cast_bit1]
    constructor
    · rwa [two_mul, add_comm _ 1, mul_add, mul_one, ← add_assoc, ← this]
    · rwa [this, two_mul, add_lt_add_iff_right] at h₂

name: divMod_to_nat
statement:
theorem divMod_to_nat (d n : PosNum) :
    (n / d : ℕ) = (divMod d n).1 ∧ (n % d : ℕ) = (divMod d n).2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.div_mod_unique (PosNum.cast_pos _)]
  induction n with
  | one =>
    exact divMod_to_nat_aux (by simp) (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (PosNum.cast_pos d : (0 : ℕ) < d))
  | bit1 n IH =>
    unfold divMod
    
    revert IH; obtain ⟨q, r⟩ := divMod d n; intro IH
    simp only at IH ⊢
    apply divMod_to_nat_aux <;> simp only [Num.cast_bit1, cast_bit1]
    · rw [← two_mul, ← two_mul, add_right_comm, mul_left_comm, ← mul_add, IH.1]
    · lia
  | bit0 n IH =>
    unfold divMod
    
    revert IH; obtain ⟨q, r⟩ := divMod d n; intro IH
    simp only at IH ⊢
    apply divMod_to_nat_aux
    · simp only [Num.cast_bit0, cast_bit0]
      rw [← two_mul, ← two_mul, mul_left_comm, ← mul_add, ← IH.1]
    · simpa using IH.2

name: gcd_to_nat_aux
statement:
theorem gcd_to_nat_aux :
    ∀ {n} {a b : Num}, a ≤ b → (a * b).natSize ≤ n → (gcdAux n a b : ℕ) = Nat.gcd a b
  | 0, 0, _, _ab, _h => (Nat.gcd_zero_left _).symm
  | 0, pos _, 0, ab, _h => (not_lt_of_ge ab).elim rfl
  | 0, pos _, pos _, _ab, h => (not_lt_of_ge h).elim <| PosNum.natSize_pos _
  | Nat.succ _, 0, _, _ab, _h => (Nat.gcd_zero_left _).symm
  | Nat.succ n, pos a, b, ab, h => by
    simp only [gcdAux, cast_pos]
    rw [Nat.gcd_rec, gcd_to_nat_aux, mod_to_nat]
    · rfl
    · rw [← le_to_nat, mod_to_nat]
      exact le_of_lt (Nat.mod_lt _ (PosNum.cast_pos _))
    rw [natSize_to_nat, mul_to_nat, Nat.size_le] at h ⊢
    rw [mod_to_nat, mul_comm]
    rw [pow_succ, ← Nat.mod_add_div b (pos a)] at h
    refine lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right (lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ h) (Nat.zero_le 2)
    rw [mul_two, mul_add]
    gcongr _ + _ * ?_
    grw [Nat.mod_lt, ← le_to_nat.2 ab]
    · simp
    · exact PosNum.cast_pos _

name: gcd_to_nat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gcd_to_nat : ∀ a b, (gcd a b : ℕ) = Nat.gcd a b
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ a b : Num, (a * b).natSize ≤ a.natSize + b.natSize := by
    intros
    simp only [natSize_to_nat, cast_mul]
    rw [Nat.size_le, pow_add]
    exact mul_lt_mul'' (Nat.lt_size_self _) (Nat.lt_size_self _) (Nat.zero_le _) (Nat.zero_le _)
  intros
  unfold gcd
  split_ifs with h
  · exact gcd_to_nat_aux h (this _ _)
  · rw [Nat.gcd_comm]
    exact gcd_to_nat_aux (le_of_not_ge h) (this _ _)

statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem div_to_int : ∀ n d, ((n / d : ZNum) : ℤ) = n / d
  | 0, 0 => by simp [Int.ediv_zero]
  | 0, pos _ => (Int.zero_ediv _).symm
  | 0, neg _ => (Int.zero_ediv _).symm
  | pos _, 0 => (Int.ediv_zero _).symm
  | neg _, 0 => (Int.ediv_zero _).symm
  | pos n, pos d => (Num.cast_toZNum _).trans <| by rw [← Num.to_nat_to_int]; simp
  | pos n, neg d => (Num.cast_toZNumNeg _).trans <| by rw [← Num.to_nat_to_int]; simp
  | neg n, pos d =>
    show -_ = -_ / ↑d by
      rw [n.to_int_eq_succ_pred, d.to_int_eq_succ_pred, ← PosNum.to_nat_to_int, Num.succ'_to_nat,
        Num.div_to_nat]
      change -[n.pred' / ↑d+1] = -[n.pred' / (d.pred' + 1)+1]
      rw [d.to_nat_eq_succ_pred]
  | neg n, neg d =>
    show ↑(PosNum.pred' n / Num.pos d).succ' = -_ / -↑d by
      rw [n.to_int_eq_succ_pred, d.to_int_eq_succ_pred, ← PosNum.to_nat_to_int, Num.succ'_to_nat,
        Num.div_to_nat]
      change (Nat.succ (_ / d) : ℤ) = Nat.succ (n.pred' / (d.pred' + 1))
      rw [d.to_nat_eq_succ_pred]

statement:
theorem minFacAux_to_nat {fuel : ℕ} {n k : PosNum} (h : Nat.sqrt n < fuel + k.bit1) :
    (minFacAux n fuel k : ℕ) = Nat.minFacAux n k.bit1
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing k <;> rw [minFacAux, Nat.minFacAux]
  case zero =>
    rw [Nat.zero_add, Nat.sqrt_lt] at h
    simp only [h, ite_true]
  case succ fuel ih =>
    simp_rw [← mul_to_nat]
    simp only [cast_lt, dvd_to_nat]
    split_ifs <;> try rfl
    rw [ih] <;> [congr; convert! Nat.lt_succ_of_lt h using 1] <;>
      simp only [cast_bit1, cast_succ, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, add_assoc,
        add_left_comm, ← one_add_one_eq_two]

name: minFac_to_nat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minFac_to_nat (n : PosNum) : (minFac n : ℕ) = Nat.minFac n
proof:
:= by
  obtain - | n := n
  · simp [minFac]
  · rw [minFac, Nat.minFac_eq, ite_eq_right]
    swap
    · simp [← two_mul]
    rw [minFacAux_to_nat]
    · rfl
    simp only [cast_one, cast_bit1]
    rw [Nat.sqrt_lt]
    calc
      (n : ℕ) + (n : ℕ) + 1 ≤ (n : ℕ) + (n : ℕ) + (n : ℕ) := by simp
      _ = (n : ℕ) * (1 + 1 + 1) := by simp only [mul_add, mul_one]
      _ < _ := by simp [mul_lt_mul]
  · rw [minFac, Nat.minFac_eq, ite_eq_left]
    · rfl
    simp [← two_mul]

    Lex r s a b ↔ r a.1 b.1 ∨ ∃ h : a.1 = b.1, s b.1 (h.rec a.2) b.2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨a, b, hij⟩ | ⟨i, hab⟩)
    · exact Or.inl hij
    · exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, hab⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, a⟩ := a
    dsimp only
    rintro (h | ⟨rfl, h⟩)
    · exact Lex.left _ _ h
    · exact Lex.right _ h

name: Lex.mono
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hij⟩ | ⟨i, hab⟩ := h
  · exact Lex.left _ _ (hr _ _ hij)
  · exact Lex.right _ (hs _ _ _ hab)

statement: theorem le_def [∀ i, LE (α i)] {a b : Σ i, α i} : a ≤ b ↔ ∃ h : a.1 = b.1, h.rec a.2 ≤ b.2

name: Function.Injective.sigma_map
statement:
theorem Function.Injective.sigma_map {f₁ : α₁ → α₂} {f₂ : ∀ a, β₁ a → β₂ (f₁ a)}
    (h₁ : Injective f₁) (h₂ : ∀ a, Injective (f₂ a)) : Injective (Sigma.map f₁ f₂)
  | ⟨i, x⟩, ⟨j, y⟩, h => by
    obtain rfl : i = j
proof:
:= h₁ (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp h).1
    obtain rfl : x = y := h₂ i (sigma_mk_injective h)
    rfl

name: Function.Injective.of_sigma_map
statement:
theorem Function.Injective.of_sigma_map {f₁ : α₁ → α₂} {f₂ : ∀ a, β₁ a → β₂ (f₁ a)}
    (h : Injective (Sigma.map f₁ f₂)) (a : α₁) : Injective (f₂ a)
proof:
:= fun x y hxy ↦
  sigma_mk_injective <| @h ⟨a, x⟩ ⟨a, y⟩ (Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq hxy))

proof:

  simp only [Surjective, Sigma.forall, h₁.forall]
  exact fun i ↦ (h₂ _).forall.2 fun x ↦ ⟨⟨i, x⟩, rfl⟩

name: Sigma.curry_update
statement:
theorem Sigma.curry_update {γ : ∀ a, β a → Type*} [DecidableEq α] [∀ a, DecidableEq (β a)]
    (i : Σ a, β a) (f : (i : Σ a, β a) → γ i.1 i.2) (x : γ i.1 i.2) :
    Sigma.curry (Function.update f i x) =
      Function.update (Sigma.curry f) i.1 (Function.update (Sigma.curry f i.1) i.2 x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ia, ib⟩ := i
  ext ja jb
  unfold Sigma.curry
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne ia ja
  · simp
    grind
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne (ne_of_apply_ne Sigma.fst _), Function.update_of_ne]
    · exact ha.symm
    · exact ha.symm

theorem existsUnique_equiv (a : ℤ) {b : ℤ} (hb : 0 < b) :

proof:
:=
  ⟨a % b, emod_nonneg _ (ne_of_gt hb),
    by
      have : a % b < |b| := emod_lt_abs _ (ne_of_gt hb)
      rwa [abs_of_pos hb] at this, by simp [ModEq]⟩

name: bodd_add_div2

theorem bodd_add_div2 : ∀ n, cond (bodd n) 1 0 + 2 * div2 n = n
  | (n : ℕ) => by
    rw [show (cond (bodd n) 1 0 : ℤ) = (cond (bodd n) 1 0 : ℕ) by cases bodd n <;> rfl]
    exact congr_arg ofNat n.bodd_add_div2
  | -[n+1] => by
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (congr_arg negSucc n.bodd_add_div2)
    dsimp [bodd]; cases Nat.bodd n <;> dsimp [cond, not, div2, Int.mul]
    · change -[2 * Nat.div2 n+1] = _
      rw [zero_add]
    · rw [zero_add, add_comm]
      rfl

name: shiftLeft_natCast_right
statement:
lemma shiftLeft_natCast_right (m : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    m <<< (n : ℤ) = m <<< n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.shiftLeft_eq']
  unfold_projs; cases m <;> simp only [Nat.shiftLeft'_false, natCast_shiftLeft, ofNat_eq_natCast,
    Nat.pow_eq, Int.natCast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_def]
  · grind [Int.shiftLeft_eq']
  · simp only [negSucc_eq, ← natCast_add_one, Nat.shiftLeft'_true_eq_mul_pow]

name: shiftLeft_add'
statement:
theorem shiftLeft_add' : ∀ (m : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ), m <<< (n + k) = (m <<< (n : ℤ)) <<< k
  | (m : ℕ), n, (k : ℕ) =>
    congr_arg ofNat (by simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq, Nat.pow_add, mul_assoc])
  | -[_+1], _, (k : ℕ) => congr_arg negSucc (Nat.shiftLeft'_add _ _ _ _)
  | (m : ℕ), n, -[k+1] =>
    subNatNat_elim n k.succ (fun n k i => (↑m) <<< i = (Nat.shiftLeft' false m n) >>> k)
      (fun (i n : ℕ) => by simp [← Nat.shiftLeft_sub _])
      fun i n => by
        simp_rw [negSucc_eq, shiftLeft_neg, Nat.shiftLeft'_false, Nat.shiftRight_add,
          ← Nat.shiftLeft_sub _ le_rfl, Nat.sub_self, Nat.shiftLeft_zero, ← shiftRight_natCast,
          ← shiftRight_add', Nat.cast_one]
  | -[m+1], n, -[k+1] =>
    subNatNat_elim n k.succ
      (fun n k i => -[m+1] <<< i = -[(Nat.shiftLeft' true m n) >>> k+1])
      (fun i n =>
        congr_arg negSucc <| by
          rw [← Nat.shiftLeft'_sub, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]; apply Nat.le_add_right)
      fun i n =>
      congr_arg negSucc <| by rw [add_assoc, Nat.shiftRight_add, ← Nat.shiftLeft'_sub _ _ le_rfl,
          Nat.sub_self, Nat.shiftLeft']

name: shiftLeft_sub
statement: theorem shiftLeft_sub (m : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ) : m <<< (n - k) = (m <<< (n : ℤ)) >>> k

name: shiftLeft_eq_mul_pow
statement:
theorem shiftLeft_eq_mul_pow : ∀ (m : ℤ) (n : ℕ), m <<< (n : ℤ) = m * (2 ^ n : ℕ)
  | (m : ℕ), _ => congr_arg ((↑) : ℕ → ℤ) (by simp [Nat.shiftLeft_eq])
  | -[_+1], _ => @congr_arg ℕ ℤ _ _ (fun i => -i) (Nat.shiftLeft'_true_eq_mul_pow _ _)

  | -[_+1] => congr_arg ((↑) : ℕ → ℤ) (by simp)

/
@[simp]

name: xgcd_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem xgcd_zero_left {s t r' s' t'} : xgcdAux 0 s t r' s' t' = (r', s', t')

name: xgcdAux_rec
statement:
theorem xgcdAux_rec {r s t r' s' t'} (h : 0 < r) :
    xgcdAux r s t r' s' t' = xgcdAux (r' % r) (s' - r' / r * s) (t' - r' / r * t) r s t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero h.ne'
  rw [xgcdAux, Nat.strongRec_eq]
  rfl

name: gcdA_zero_left

proof:

name: xgcdAux_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem xgcdAux_fst (x y) : ∀ s t s' t', (xgcdAux x s t y s' t').1 = gcd x y
proof:
:=
  gcd.induction x y (by simp) fun x y h IH s t s' t' => by
    simp only [h, xgcdAux_rec, IH]
    rw [← gcd_rec]

name: xgcdAux_val
statement: theorem xgcdAux_val (x y) : xgcdAux x 1 0 y 0 1 = (gcd x y, xgcd x y)

name: xgcd_val
statement: theorem xgcd_val (x y) : xgcd x y = (gcdA x y, gcdB x y)

name: xgcdAux_P
statement:
private theorem xgcdAux_P {r r'} :
    ∀ {s t s' t'}, P x y (r, s, t) → P x y (r', s', t') → P x y (xgcdAux r s t r' s' t')
proof:
:= by
  induction r, r' using gcd.induction with
  | H0 => simp
  | H1 a b h IH =>
    intro s t s' t' p p'
    rw [xgcdAux_rec h]; refine IH ?_ p; dsimp [P] at *
    rw [Int.emod_def]; generalize (b / a : ℤ) = k
    rw [p, p', Int.mul_sub, sub_add_eq_add_sub, Int.mul_sub, Int.add_mul, mul_comm k t,
      mul_comm k s, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, add_comm (x * s * k), ← add_sub_assoc, sub_sub]

name: gcd_eq_gcd_ab
statement: theorem gcd_eq_gcd_ab : (gcd x y : ℤ) = x * gcdA x y + y * gcdB x y
proof:
:= by
  have := @xgcdAux_P x y x y 1 0 0 1 (by simp [P]) (by simp [P])
  rwa [xgcdAux_val, xgcd_val] at this

name: exists_mul_mod_eq_gcd
statement: theorem exists_mul_mod_eq_gcd {k n : ℕ} (hk : gcd n k < k) : ∃ m < k, n * m % k = gcd n k
proof:
:= by
  have hk' := Int.ofNat_ne_zero.2 (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hk).ne'
  have key := congr(($(gcd_eq_gcd_ab n k) % k).toNat)
  rw [Int.add_mul_emod_self_left, ← Int.natCast_mod, Int.toNat_natCast, mod_eq_of_lt hk] at key
  refine ⟨(n.gcdA k % k).toNat, ?_, (Int.ofNat_inj.1 ?_).trans key.symm⟩
  · rw [Int.toNat_lt (Int.emod_nonneg _ hk')]
    exact Int.emod_lt _ hk'
  rw [Int.natCast_mod, Int.natCast_mul, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg _ hk'),
    Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg _ hk'), Int.mul_emod, Int.emod_emod, ← Int.mul_emod]

name: exists_mul_mod_eq_one_of_coprime
statement:
theorem exists_mul_mod_eq_one_of_coprime {k n : ℕ} (hkn : Coprime n k) (hk : 1 < k) :
    ∃ m < k, n * m % k = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [hkn, hk] using exists_mul_mod_eq_gcd (k := k) (n := n)

name: exists_mul_mod_eq_of_coprime
statement:
theorem exists_mul_mod_eq_of_coprime {k n : ℕ} (r : ℕ) (hkn : Coprime n k) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    ∃ m < k, n * m % k = r % k
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hk : k = 1 ∨ 1 < k := by lia
  · simp [mod_one]
  obtain ⟨m, -, hm⟩ := exists_mul_mod_eq_one_of_coprime hkn hk
  use (m * r) % k, mod_lt _ (by lia)
  rw [mul_mod, mod_mod, ← mul_mod, ← mul_assoc, mul_mod, hm, one_mul, mod_mod]

name: gcd_def
statement: theorem gcd_def (i j : ℤ) : gcd i j = Nat.gcd i.natAbs j.natAbs

name: gcd_eq_gcd_ab
statement:
theorem gcd_eq_gcd_ab : ∀ x y : ℤ, (gcd x y : ℤ) = x * gcdA x y + y * gcdB x y
  | (m : ℕ), (n : ℕ) => Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab _ _
  | (m : ℕ), -[n+1] =>
    show (_ : ℤ) = _ + -(n + 1) * -_ by rw [Int.neg_mul_neg]; apply Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab
  | -[m+1], (n : ℕ) =>
    show (_ : ℤ) = -(m + 1) * -_ + _ by rw [Int.neg_mul_neg]; apply Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab
  | -[m+1], -[n+1] =>
    show (_ : ℤ) = -(m + 1) * -_ + -(n + 1) * -_ by
      rw [Int.neg_mul_neg, Int.neg_mul_neg]
      apply Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab

name: lcm_def
statement: theorem lcm_def (i j : ℤ) : lcm i j = Nat.lcm (natAbs i) (natAbs j)

name: gcd_eq_one_of_gcd_mul_right_eq_one_left
statement:
theorem gcd_eq_one_of_gcd_mul_right_eq_one_left {a : ℤ} {m n : ℕ} (h : a.gcd (m * n) = 1) :
    a.gcd m = 1
proof:
:=
  Nat.dvd_one.mp <| h ▸ gcd_dvd_gcd_mul_right_right a m n

name: gcd_eq_one_of_gcd_mul_right_eq_one_right
statement:
theorem gcd_eq_one_of_gcd_mul_right_eq_one_right {a : ℤ} {m n : ℕ} (h : a.gcd (m * n) = 1) :
    a.gcd n = 1
proof:
:=
  Nat.dvd_one.mp <| h ▸ gcd_dvd_gcd_mul_left_right a n m

name: ne_zero_of_gcd
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_gcd {x y : ℤ} (hc : gcd x y ≠ 0) : x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hc
  rw [hc.left, hc.right, gcd_zero_right, natAbs_zero]

name: exists_gcd_one
statement:
theorem exists_gcd_one {m n : ℤ} (H : 0 < gcd m n) :
    ∃ m' n' : ℤ, gcd m' n' = 1 ∧ m = m' * gcd m n ∧ n = n' * gcd m n

name: exists_gcd_one'
statement:
theorem exists_gcd_one' {m n : ℤ} (H : 0 < gcd m n) :
    ∃ (g : ℕ) (m' n' : ℤ), 0 < g ∧ gcd m' n' = 1 ∧ m = m' * g ∧ n = n' * g
proof:
:=
  let ⟨m', n', h⟩ := exists_gcd_one H
  ⟨_, m', n', H, h⟩

name: gcd_dvd_iff
statement: theorem gcd_dvd_iff {a b : ℤ} {n : ℕ} : gcd a b ∣ n ↔ ∃ x y : ℤ, ↑n = a * x + b * y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← Nat.mul_div_cancel' h, Int.natCast_mul, gcd_eq_gcd_ab, Int.add_mul, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, y, h⟩
    rw [← Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, h]
    exact Int.dvd_add (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (gcd_dvd_left ..))
      (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (gcd_dvd_right ..))

name: gcd_greatest
statement:
theorem gcd_greatest {a b d : ℤ} (hd_pos : 0 ≤ d) (hda : d ∣ a) (hdb : d ∣ b)
    (hd : ∀ e : ℤ, e ∣ a → e ∣ b → e ∣ d) : d = gcd a b
proof:
:=
  dvd_antisymm hd_pos (natCast_nonneg (gcd a b)) (dvd_coe_gcd hda hdb)
    (hd _ (gcd_dvd_left ..) (gcd_dvd_right ..))

name: dvd_of_dvd_mul_left_of_gcd_one
statement:
theorem dvd_of_dvd_mul_left_of_gcd_one {a b c : ℤ} (habc : a ∣ b * c) (hab : gcd a c = 1) :
    a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  have := gcd_eq_gcd_ab a c
  simp only [hab, Int.ofNat_zero, Int.natCast_succ, zero_add] at this
  have : b * a * gcdA a c + b * c * gcdB a c = b := by simp [mul_assoc, ← Int.mul_add, ← this]
  rw [← this]
  exact Int.dvd_add (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_left a b)) (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left habc)

name: dvd_of_dvd_mul_right_of_gcd_one
statement:
theorem dvd_of_dvd_mul_right_of_gcd_one {a b c : ℤ} (habc : a ∣ b * c) (hab : gcd a b = 1) :
    a ∣ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm] at habc
  exact dvd_of_dvd_mul_left_of_gcd_one habc hab

name: gcd_least_linear
statement:
theorem gcd_least_linear {a b : ℤ} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    IsLeast { n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ ∃ x y : ℤ, ↑n = a * x + b * y } (a.gcd b)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← gcd_dvd_iff]
  constructor
  · simpa [and_true, dvd_refl, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] using gcd_pos_of_ne_zero_left b ha
  · simp only [lowerBounds, and_imp, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    exact fun n hn_pos hn => Nat.le_of_dvd hn_pos hn

name: pow_gcd_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) gcd_nsmul_eq_zero]
lemma pow_gcd_eq_one : a ^ m.gcd n = 1 ↔ a ^ m = 1 ∧ a ^ n = 1 where
  mp hmn
proof:
:= by
    constructor
    · rw [← Nat.mul_div_cancel' (m.gcd_dvd_left n), pow_mul, hmn, one_pow]
    · rw [← Nat.mul_div_cancel' (m.gcd_dvd_right n), pow_mul, hmn, one_pow]
  mpr
  | ⟨hm, hn⟩ => by
    obtain _ | m := m
    · simpa
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := IsUnit.of_pow_eq_one hm m.succ_ne_zero
    rw [← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, ← Units.val_one (α := M), ← zpow_natCast, ← Units.ext_iff] at *
    rw [Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab, zpow_add, zpow_mul, zpow_mul, hn, hm, one_zpow, one_zpow, one_mul]

name: pow_eq_one_iff_of_coprime
statement:
@[to_additive]
lemma pow_eq_one_iff_of_coprime (hmn : m.Coprime n) : a ^ m = 1 ∧ a ^ n = 1 ↔ a = 1

name: pow_intGCD_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) intGCD_nsmul_eq_zero]
lemma pow_intGCD_eq_one : a ^ m.gcd n = 1 ↔ a ^ m = 1 ∧ a ^ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain m | m := m <;> obtain n | n := n <;> simp

name: Commute.pow_eq_pow_iff_of_coprime
statement:
protected lemma Commute.pow_eq_pow_iff_of_coprime (hab : Commute a b) (hmn : m.Coprime n) :
    a ^ m = b ^ n ↔ ∃ c, a = c ^ n ∧ b = c ^ m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, by rintro ⟨c, rfl, rfl⟩; rw [← pow_mul, ← pow_mul']⟩
  by_cases m = 0; · simp_all
  by_cases n = 0; · simp_all
  by_cases hb : b = 0; · exact ⟨0, by simp_all⟩
  by_cases ha : a = 0; · exact ⟨0, by have := h.symm; simp_all⟩
  refine ⟨a ^ Nat.gcdB m n * b ^ Nat.gcdA m n, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
  · refine (pow_one _).symm.trans ?_
    conv_lhs => rw [← zpow_natCast, ← hmn, Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab]
    simp only [zpow_add₀ ha, zpow_add₀ hb, ← zpow_natCast, (hab.zpow_zpow₀ _ _).mul_zpow,
      ← zpow_mul, mul_comm (Nat.gcdB m n), mul_comm (Nat.gcdA m n)]
    simp only [zpow_mul, zpow_natCast, h]
    exact ((Commute.pow_pow (by aesop) _ _).zpow_zpow₀ _ _).symm

name: pow_eq_pow_iff_of_coprime
statement: lemma pow_eq_pow_iff_of_coprime (hmn : m.Coprime n) : a ^ m = b ^ n ↔ ∃ c, a = c ^ n ∧ b = c ^ m

name: toNNReal_eq_one_iff

theorem toNNReal_eq_one_iff {e : ℝ≥0} (m : ℤᵐ⁰) (he0 : e ≠ 0) (he1 : e ≠ 1) :

proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_map, mem_filter, mem_Ico, castEmbedding_apply]
  constructor
  · simp_rw [forall_exists_index, ← natCast_modEq_iff]; intro y ⟨h, c⟩; subst c; exact_mod_cast h
  · intro h; lift x to ℕ using (by omega); exact ⟨x, by simp_all [natCast_modEq_iff]⟩

name: count_modEq_card_eq_ceil
statement:
theorem count_modEq_card_eq_ceil (v : ℕ) :
    b.count (· ≡ v [MOD r]) = ⌈(b - (v % r : ℕ)) / (r : ℚ)⌉
proof:
:= by
  have hr' : 0 < (r : ℚ) := by positivity
  rw [count_eq_card_filter_range, ← Ico_zero_eq_range, Ico_filter_modEq_card _ _ hr,
    max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr <| by gcongr; positivity)]
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [← div_add_mod v r, cast_add, cast_mul, add_comm]
    tactic => simp_rw [← sub_sub, sub_div (_ - _), mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hr'.ne',
      Int.ceil_sub_natCast]
    rw [sub_sub_sub_cancel_right, cast_zero, zero_sub]
  rw [sub_eq_self, ceil_eq_zero_iff, Set.mem_Ioc, div_le_iff₀ hr', lt_div_iff₀ hr', neg_one_mul,
    zero_mul, neg_lt_neg_iff, cast_lt]
  exact ⟨mod_lt _ hr, by simp⟩

name: count_modEq_card
statement:
theorem count_modEq_card (v : ℕ) :
    b.count (· ≡ v [MOD r]) = b / r + if v % r < b % r then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hr' : 0 < (r : ℚ) := by positivity
  rw [← ofNat_inj, count_modEq_card_eq_ceil _ hr, cast_add]
  conv_lhs => rw [← div_add_mod b r, cast_add, cast_mul, ← add_sub, _root_.add_div,
    mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hr'.ne', add_comm, Int.ceil_add_natCast, add_comm]
  rw [add_right_inj]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [← cast_sub h.le, Int.ceil_eq_iff, div_le_iff₀ hr', lt_div_iff₀ hr', cast_one, Int.cast_one,
      sub_self, zero_mul, cast_pos, tsub_pos_iff_lt, one_mul, cast_le, tsub_le_iff_right]
    exact ⟨h, ((mod_lt _ hr).trans_le (by simp)).le⟩
  · rw [cast_zero, ceil_eq_zero_iff, Set.mem_Ioc, div_le_iff₀ hr', lt_div_iff₀ hr', zero_mul,
      tsub_nonpos, ← neg_eq_neg_one_mul, neg_lt_sub_iff_lt_add, ← cast_add, cast_lt, cast_le]
    exact ⟨(mod_lt _ hr).trans_le (by simp), not_lt.mp h⟩

name: image_Ico_emod
statement: theorem image_Ico_emod (n a : ℤ) (h : 0 ≤ a) : (Ico n (n + a)).image (· % a) = Ico 0 a
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_lt_of_le h
  · simp
  ext i
  simp only [mem_image, mem_Ico]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, _, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨emod_nonneg i ha.ne', emod_lt_of_pos i ha⟩
  rintro ⟨hi₀, hia⟩
  have hn := Int.emod_add_mul_ediv n a
  obtain hi | hi := lt_or_ge i (n % a)
  · refine ⟨i + a * (n / a + 1), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · calc
        n = 0 + n % a + a * (n / a) := by simp [hn]
        _ ≤ i + a + a * (n / a) := by gcongr; exact (Int.emod_lt_of_pos n ha).le
        _ = i + a * (n / a + 1) := by grind
    · calc
        i + a * (n / a + 1) < n % a + a * (n / a + 1) := by gcongr
        _ = n + a := by rw [mul_add, mul_one, ← add_assoc, hn]
    · rw [Int.add_mul_emod_self_left, Int.emod_eq_of_lt hi₀ hia]
  · refine ⟨i + a * (n / a), ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact hn.symm.le.trans (add_le_add_left hi _)
    · rw [add_comm n a]
      refine add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le hia (le_trans ?_ hn.le)
      simp only [le_add_iff_nonneg_left]
      exact Int.emod_nonneg n (ne_of_gt ha)
    · rw [Int.add_mul_emod_self_left, Int.emod_eq_of_lt hi₀ hia]

name: succ_dvd_or_succ_dvd_of_succ_sum_dvd_mul
proof:
:=
  have hpm' : p ^ k ∣ m.natAbs := Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.1 <| Int.dvd_natAbs.2 hpm
  have hpn' : p ^ l ∣ n.natAbs := Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.1 <| Int.dvd_natAbs.2 hpn
  have hpmn' : p ^ (k + l + 1) ∣ m.natAbs * n.natAbs := by
    rw [← Int.natAbs_mul]; apply Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.1 <| Int.dvd_natAbs.2 hpmn
  let hsd := Nat.succ_dvd_or_succ_dvd_of_succ_sum_dvd_mul p_prime hpm' hpn' hpmn'
  hsd.elim (fun hsd1 => Or.inl (by apply Int.dvd_natAbs.1; apply Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 hsd1))

name: induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim, induction_eliminator] protected lemma induction_on {motive : ℤ → Prop} (i : ℤ)
    (zero : motive 0) (succ : ∀ i : ℕ, motive i → motive (i + 1))
    (pred : ∀ i : ℕ, motive (-i) → motive (-i - 1)) : motive i
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | ofNat i =>
    induction i with
    | zero => exact zero
    | succ i ih => exact succ _ ih
  | negSucc i =>
    suffices ∀ n : ℕ, motive (-n) from this (i + 1)
    intro n; induction n with
    | zero => simp [zero]
    | succ n ih => simpa [natCast_succ, Int.neg_add, Int.sub_eq_add_neg] using pred _ ih

proof:
:= by
  unfold Int.inductionOn'
  rw! [show z - b = (z - b).toNat by lia, show z + 1 - b = ((z - b).toNat + 1 : ℕ) by lia]
  grind [inductionOn'.pos, show b + (z - b).toNat = z by lia]

name: inductionOn'_sub_one
statement:
theorem inductionOn'_sub_one (hz : z ≤ b) :
    (z - 1).inductionOn' b zero succ pred = pred z hz (z.inductionOn' b zero succ pred)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Int.inductionOn'
  conv => lhs; unfold inductionOn'.neg
  by_cases z = b
  · rw! [show z - 1 - b = -[(b - z).toNat+1] by lia, show z - b = 0 by lia]
    grind [inductionOn'.pos]
  rw! [show z - 1 - b = -[(b - z).toNat+1] by lia, show z - b = -[(b - z - 1).toNat+1] by lia]
  grind

name: strongRec_of_ge
statement:
lemma strongRec_of_ge :
    ∀ hn : m ≤ n, m.strongRec lt ge n = ge n hn fun k _ ↦ m.strongRec lt ge k
proof:
:= by
  refine m.strongRec (fun n hnm hmn ↦ (Int.not_lt.mpr hmn hnm).elim) (fun n _ ih hn ↦ ?_) n
  rw [Int.strongRec, dite_eq_right (Int.not_lt.mpr hn)]
  congr; revert ih
  refine n.inductionOn' m (fun _ ↦ ?_) (fun k hmk ih' ih ↦ ?_) (fun k hkm ih' _ ↦ ?_) <;> ext l hl
  · rw [inductionOn'_self, strongRec_of_lt hl]
  · rw [inductionOn'_add_one hmk]; split_ifs with hlm
    · rw [strongRec_of_lt hlm]
    · rw [ih' fun l hl ↦ ih l (Int.lt_trans hl k.lt_succ), ih _ hl]
  · rw [inductionOn'_sub_one hkm, ih']
    exact fun l hlk hml ↦ (Int.not_lt.mpr hkm <| Int.lt_of_le_of_lt hml hlk).elim

proof:

  rcases le_total 1 r with h | h
  · rw [log_of_one_le_right _ h, Nat.log_of_left_le_one hb, Int.ofNat_zero]

name: log_of_right_le_zero
statement: theorem log_of_right_le_zero (b : ℕ) {r : R} (hr : r ≤ 0) : log b r = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [log_of_right_le_one _ (hr.trans zero_le_one),
    Nat.clog_of_right_le_one ((Nat.ceil_eq_zero.mpr <| inv_nonpos.2 hr).trans_le zero_le_one),

name: zpow_log_le_self
statement: theorem zpow_log_le_self {b : ℕ} {r : R} (hb : 1 < b) (hr : 0 < r) : (b : R) ^ log b r ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total 1 r with hr1 | hr1
  · rw [log_of_one_le_right _ hr1]
    rw [zpow_natCast, ← Nat.cast_pow, ← Nat.le_floor_iff hr.le]
    exact Nat.pow_log_le_self b (Nat.floor_pos.mpr hr1).ne'
  · rw [log_of_right_le_one _ hr1, zpow_neg]
    exact_mod_cast inv_le_of_inv_le₀ hr (Nat.ceil_le.1 <| Nat.le_pow_clog hb _)

name: lt_zpow_succ_log_self
statement: theorem lt_zpow_succ_log_self {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (r : R) : r < (b : R) ^ (log b r + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt r 0 with hr | hr
  · rw [log_of_right_le_zero _ hr, zero_add, zpow_one]
    exact hr.trans_lt (zero_lt_one.trans_le <| mod_cast hb.le)
  rcases le_or_gt 1 r with hr1 | hr1
  · rw [log_of_one_le_right _ hr1, Int.ofNat_add_one_out]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_of_floor_lt <| Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self hb _
  · rw [log_of_right_le_one _ hr1.le]
    have hcri : 1 < r⁻¹ := (one_lt_inv₀ hr).2 hr1
    have : 1 ≤ Nat.clog b ⌈r⁻¹⌉₊ :=
      Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.clog_pos hb <| Nat.one_lt_cast.1 <| hcri.trans_le (Nat.le_ceil _))
    rw [neg_add_eq_sub, ← neg_sub, ← Int.ofNat_one, ← Int.ofNat_sub this, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast,
      lt_inv_comm₀ hr (pow_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr <| zero_lt_one.trans hb) _), ← Nat.cast_pow]
    refine Nat.lt_ceil.1 ?_
    exact Nat.pow_pred_clog_lt_self hb <| Nat.one_lt_cast.1 <| hcri.trans_le <| Nat.le_ceil _

name: log_zero_left

@[simp]
theorem log_zero_left (r : R) : log 0 r = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [log, Nat.log_zero_left, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.clog_zero_left, neg_zero, ite_self]

name: log_one_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_one_left (r : R) : log 1 r = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : 1 ≤ r
  · simp_all only [log, ↓reduceIte, Nat.log_one_left, Nat.cast_zero]
  · simp only [log, Nat.log_one_left, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.clog_one_left, neg_zero, ite_self]

name: log_zpow
statement: theorem log_zpow {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (z : ℤ) : log b (b ^ z : R) = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg z
  · rw [log_of_one_le_right _ (one_le_zpow₀ (mod_cast hb.le) <| Int.natCast_nonneg _), zpow_natCast,
      ← Nat.cast_pow, Nat.floor_natCast, Nat.log_pow hb]
  · rw [log_of_right_le_one _ (zpow_le_one_of_nonpos₀ (mod_cast hb.le) <|
      neg_nonpos.2 (Int.natCast_nonneg _)),
      zpow_neg, inv_inv, zpow_natCast, ← Nat.cast_pow, Nat.ceil_natCast, Nat.clog_pow _ _ hb]

name: log_mono_right
statement:
@[mono, gcongr]
theorem log_mono_right {b : ℕ} {r₁ r₂ : R} (h₀ : 0 < r₁) (h : r₁ ≤ r₂) : log b r₁ ≤ log b r₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total r₁ 1 with h₁ | h₁ <;> rcases le_total r₂ 1 with h₂ | h₂
  · have h₀' : 0 < r₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le h₀ h
    rw [log_of_right_le_one _ h₁, log_of_right_le_one _ h₂, neg_le_neg_iff, Nat.cast_le]
    exact Nat.clog_mono_right b <| Nat.ceil_mono <| (inv_le_inv₀ h₀' h₀).2 h
  · rw [log_of_right_le_one _ h₁, log_of_one_le_right _ h₂]
    exact (neg_nonpos.mpr (Int.natCast_nonneg _)).trans (Int.natCast_nonneg _)
  · obtain rfl := le_antisymm h (h₂.trans h₁)
    rfl
  · rw [log_of_one_le_right _ h₁, log_of_one_le_right _ h₂, Nat.cast_le]
    exact Nat.log_mono_right (Nat.floor_mono h)

name: lt_zpow_iff_log_lt
statement:
theorem lt_zpow_iff_log_lt {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) {x : ℤ} {r : R} (hr : 0 < r) :
    r < (b : R) ^ x ↔ log b r < x

name: zpow_le_iff_le_log
statement:
theorem zpow_le_iff_le_log {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) {x : ℤ} {r : R} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (b : R) ^ x ≤ r ↔ x ≤ log b r

name: clog_of_one_le_right
statement: theorem clog_of_one_le_right (b : ℕ) {r : R} (hr : 1 ≤ r) : clog b r = Nat.clog b ⌈r⌉₊

name: clog_of_right_le_one
statement: theorem clog_of_right_le_one (b : ℕ) {r : R} (hr : r ≤ 1) : clog b r = -Nat.log b ⌊r⁻¹⌋₊
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hr := hr.eq_or_lt
  · rw [clog, ite_eq_left hr, inv_one, Nat.ceil_one, Nat.floor_one, Nat.log_one_right,
      Nat.clog_one_right, Int.ofNat_zero, neg_zero]
  · exact ite_eq_right hr.not_ge

name: clog_of_right_le_zero
statement: theorem clog_of_right_le_zero (b : ℕ) {r : R} (hr : r ≤ 0) : clog b r = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [clog, ite_eq_right (hr.trans_lt zero_lt_one).not_ge, neg_eq_zero, Int.natCast_eq_zero,
    Nat.log_eq_zero_iff]
  rcases le_or_gt b 1 with hb | hb
  · exact Or.inr hb
  · refine Or.inl (lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ hb)
    exact Nat.floor_le_one_of_le_one ((inv_nonpos.2 hr).trans zero_le_one)

name: clog_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem clog_inv (b : ℕ) (r : R) : clog b r⁻¹ = -log b r
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_ge 0 r with hrp | hrp
  · obtain hr | hr := le_total 1 r
    · rw [clog_of_right_le_one _ (inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hr), log_of_one_le_right _ hr, inv_inv]
    · rw [clog_of_one_le_right _ ((one_le_inv₀ hrp).2 hr), log_of_right_le_one _ hr, neg_neg]
  · rw [clog_of_right_le_zero _ (inv_nonpos.mpr hrp), log_of_right_le_zero _ hrp, neg_zero]

name: log_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_inv (b : ℕ) (r : R) : log b r⁻¹ = -clog b r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inv_inv r, clog_inv, neg_neg, inv_inv]

name: neg_log_inv_eq_clog
statement: theorem neg_log_inv_eq_clog (b : ℕ) (r : R) : -log b r⁻¹ = clog b r

name: neg_clog_inv_eq_log
statement: theorem neg_clog_inv_eq_log (b : ℕ) (r : R) : -clog b r⁻¹ = log b r

name: clog_natCast
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem clog_natCast (b : ℕ) (n : ℕ) : clog b (n : R) = Nat.clog b n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with - | n
  · simp [clog_of_right_le_one]
  · rw [clog_of_one_le_right, (Nat.ceil_eq_iff (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)).mpr] <;> simp

name: clog_ofNat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem clog_ofNat (b : ℕ) (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] :
    clog b (ofNat(n) : R) = Nat.clog b ofNat(n)

name: clog_of_left_le_one
statement: theorem clog_of_left_le_one {b : ℕ} (hb : b ≤ 1) (r : R) : clog b r = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_log_inv_eq_clog, log_of_left_le_one hb, neg_zero]

name: self_le_zpow_clog
statement: theorem self_le_zpow_clog {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (r : R) : r ≤ (b : R) ^ clog b r
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt r 0 with hr | hr
  · rw [clog_of_right_le_zero _ hr, zpow_zero]
    exact hr.trans zero_le_one
  rw [← neg_log_inv_eq_clog, zpow_neg, le_inv_comm₀ hr (zpow_pos ..)]
  · exact zpow_log_le_self hb (inv_pos.mpr hr)
  · exact Nat.cast_pos.mpr (zero_le_one.trans_lt hb)

name: zpow_pred_clog_lt_self
statement:
theorem zpow_pred_clog_lt_self {b : ℕ} {r : R} (hb : 1 < b) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (b : R) ^ (clog b r - 1) < r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_log_inv_eq_clog, ← neg_add', zpow_neg, inv_lt_comm₀ _ hr]
  · exact lt_zpow_succ_log_self hb _
  · exact zpow_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr <| zero_le_one.trans_lt hb) _

name: clog_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem clog_zero_right (b : ℕ) : clog b (0 : R) = 0

name: clog_one_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem clog_one_right (b : ℕ) : clog b (1 : R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [clog_of_one_le_right _ le_rfl, Nat.ceil_one, Nat.clog_one_right, Int.ofNat_zero]

name: clog_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem clog_zero_left (r : R) : clog 0 r = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : 1 ≤ r
  · simp only [clog, Nat.clog_zero_left, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.log_zero_left, neg_zero, ite_self]
  · simp only [clog, hr, ite_eq_right_of_eq_false, Nat.log_zero_left, Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero]

name: clog_one_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem clog_one_left (r : R) : clog 1 r = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [clog, Nat.log_one_left, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.clog_one_left, neg_zero, ite_self]

name: clog_zpow
statement: theorem clog_zpow {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (z : ℤ) : clog b (b ^ z : R) = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_log_inv_eq_clog, ← zpow_neg, log_zpow hb, neg_neg]

name: clog_mono_right
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem clog_mono_right {b : ℕ} {r₁ r₂ : R} (h₀ : 0 < r₁) (h : r₁ ≤ r₂) :
    clog b r₁ ≤ clog b r₂
proof:
:= by
  have h₀' : 0 < r₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le h₀ h
  rw [← neg_log_inv_eq_clog, ← neg_log_inv_eq_clog, neg_le_neg_iff]
  exact log_mono_right (inv_pos_of_pos h₀') <| (inv_le_inv₀ h₀' h₀).2 h

name: zpow_lt_iff_lt_clog
statement:
theorem zpow_lt_iff_lt_clog {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) {x : ℤ} {r : R} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (b : R) ^ x < r ↔ x < clog b r

name: le_zpow_iff_clog_le
statement:
theorem le_zpow_iff_clog_le {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) {x : ℤ} {r : R} (hr : 0 < r) :
    r ≤ (b : R) ^ x ↔ clog b r ≤ x

name: Int.natAbs_eq_iff_associated
statement: theorem Int.natAbs_eq_iff_associated {a b : ℤ} : a.natAbs = b.natAbs ↔ Associated a b
proof:
:= by
  refine Int.natAbs_eq_natAbs_iff.trans ?_
  constructor
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · rfl
    · exact ⟨-1, by simp⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    obtain rfl | rfl := Int.units_eq_one_or u
    · exact Or.inl (by simp)
    · exact Or.inr (by simp)

name: AbsoluteValue.map_units_int
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AbsoluteValue.map_units_int (abv : AbsoluteValue ℤ S) (x : ℤˣ) : abv x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or x with (rfl | rfl) <;> simp

name: AbsoluteValue.map_units_intCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AbsoluteValue.map_units_intCast [Nontrivial R] (abv : AbsoluteValue R S) (x : ℤˣ) :
    abv ((x : ℤ) : R) = 1
proof: := by rcases Int.units_eq_one_or x with (rfl | rfl) <;> simp

name: AbsoluteValue.map_units_int_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AbsoluteValue.map_units_int_smul (abv : AbsoluteValue R S) (x : ℤˣ) (y : R) :
    abv (x • y) = abv y
proof: := by rcases Int.units_eq_one_or x with (rfl | rfl) <;> simp

name: recEmptyOption_of_card_eq_zero
statement:
theorem recEmptyOption_of_card_eq_zero {P : Type u → Sort v}
    (finChoice : (n : ℕ) → Fin (n + 1))
    (congr : {α β : Type u} → (_ : FinEnum α) → (_ : FinEnum β) → card β = card α → P α → P β)
    (empty : P PEmpty.{u + 1})
    (option : {α : Type u} → FinEnum α → P α → P (Option α))
    (α : Type u) [FinEnum α] (h : card α = 0) (_ : FinEnum PEmpty.{u + 1}) :
    recEmptyOption finChoice congr empty option α =
      congr _ _ (h.trans card_eq_zero.symm) empty
proof:
:= by
  unfold recEmptyOption
  split
  · congr 1; exact Subsingleton.allEq _ _
  · exact Nat.noConfusion <| h.symm.trans ‹_›

name: recEmptyOption_of_card_pos
statement:
theorem recEmptyOption_of_card_pos {P : Type u → Sort v}
    (finChoice : (n : ℕ) → Fin (n + 1))
    (congr : {α β : Type u} → (_ : FinEnum α) → (_ : FinEnum β) → card β = card α → P α → P β)
    (empty : P PEmpty.{u + 1})
    (option : {α : Type u} → FinEnum α → P α → P (Option α))
    (α : Type u) [FinEnum α] (h : 0 < card α) :
    recEmptyOption finChoice congr empty option α =
      congr (insertNone _ <| finChoice (card α - 1)) ‹_›
        (congrArg (· + 1) card_fin |>.trans <| (card α).succ_pred_eq_of_pos h).symm
        (option ULift.instFinEnum <|
          recEmptyOption finChoice congr empty option (ULift.{u} <| Fin (card α - 1)))
proof:
:= by
  conv => lhs; unfold recEmptyOption
  split
  · exact absurd (‹_› ▸ h) (card α).lt_irrefl
  · rcases Nat.succ.inj <| (card α).succ_pred_eq_of_pos h |>.trans ‹_› with rfl; rfl

name: mem_sumLift
statement:
theorem mem_sumLift₂ :
    c ∈ sumLift₂ f g a b ↔
      (∃ a₁ b₁ c₁, a = inl a₁ ∧ b = inl b₁ ∧ c = inl c₁ ∧ c₁ ∈ f a₁ b₁) ∨
        ∃ a₂ b₂ c₂, a = inr a₂ ∧ b = inr b₂ ∧ c = inr c₂ ∧ c₂ ∈ g a₂ b₂
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rcases a with a | a <;> rcases b with b | b
    · rw [sumLift₂, mem_map]
      rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
      exact Or.inl ⟨a, b, c, rfl, rfl, rfl, hc⟩
    · refine fun h ↦ (notMem_empty _ h).elim
    · refine fun h ↦ (notMem_empty _ h).elim
    · rw [sumLift₂, mem_map]
      rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
      exact Or.inr ⟨a, b, c, rfl, rfl, rfl, hc⟩
  · rintro (⟨a, b, c, rfl, rfl, rfl, h⟩ | ⟨a, b, c, rfl, rfl, rfl, h⟩) <;> exact mem_map_of_mem _ h

name: inl_mem_sumLift
statement:
theorem inl_mem_sumLift₂ {c₁ : γ₁} :
    inl c₁ ∈ sumLift₂ f g a b ↔ ∃ a₁ b₁, a = inl a₁ ∧ b = inl b₁ ∧ c₁ ∈ f a₁ b₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_sumLift₂, or_iff_left]
  · simp only [inl.injEq, exists_and_left, exists_eq_left']
  rintro ⟨_, _, c₂, _, _, h, _⟩
  exact inl_ne_inr h

name: inr_mem_sumLift
statement:
theorem inr_mem_sumLift₂ {c₂ : γ₂} :
    inr c₂ ∈ sumLift₂ f g a b ↔ ∃ a₂ b₂, a = inr a₂ ∧ b = inr b₂ ∧ c₂ ∈ g a₂ b₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_sumLift₂, or_iff_right]
  · simp only [inr.injEq, exists_and_left, exists_eq_left']
  rintro ⟨_, _, c₂, _, _, h, _⟩
  exact inr_ne_inl h

name: sumLift
statement:
theorem sumLift₂_eq_empty :
    sumLift₂ f g a b = ∅ ↔
      (∀ a₁ b₁, a = inl a₁ → b = inl b₁ → f a₁ b₁ = ∅) ∧
        ∀ a₂ b₂, a = inr a₂ → b = inr b₂ → g a₂ b₂ = ∅
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · constructor <;>
    · rintro a b rfl rfl
      exact map_eq_empty.1 h
  cases a <;> cases b
  · exact map_eq_empty.2 (h.1 _ _ rfl rfl)
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · exact map_eq_empty.2 (h.2 _ _ rfl rfl)

name: sumLift
statement:
theorem sumLift₂_nonempty :
    (sumLift₂ f g a b).Nonempty ↔
      (∃ a₁ b₁, a = inl a₁ ∧ b = inl b₁ ∧ (f a₁ b₁).Nonempty) ∨
        ∃ a₂ b₂, a = inr a₂ ∧ b = inr b₂ ∧ (g a₂ b₂).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nonempty_iff_ne_empty, Ne, sumLift₂_eq_empty, not_and_or, not_forall, exists_prop]

name: sumLift
statement:
theorem sumLift₂_mono (h₁ : ∀ a b, f₁ a b ⊆ g₁ a b) (h₂ : ∀ a b, f₂ a b ⊆ g₂ a b) :
    ∀ a b, sumLift₂ f₁ f₂ a b ⊆ sumLift₂ g₁ g₂ a b
  | inl _, inl _ => map_subset_map.2 (h₁ _ _)
  | inl _, inr _ => Subset.rfl
  | inr _, inl _ => Subset.rfl
  | inr _, inr _ => map_subset_map.2 (h₂ _ _)

end SumLift₂

section SumLexLift
variable (f₁ f₁' : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁) (f₂ f₂' : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂)
  (g₁ g₁' : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁) (g₂ g₂' : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂)

/
`α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂`  to a map `α₁ ⊕ α₂ → β₁ ⊕ β₂ → Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂)`. Could be generalized to
alternative monads if we can make sure to keep computability and universe polymorphism. -/
def sumLexLift : α₁ ⊕ α₂ → β₁ ⊕ β₂ → Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂)
  | inl a, inl b => (f₁ a b).map Embedding.inl
  | inl a, inr b => (g₁ a b).disjSum (g₂ a b)
  | inr _, inl _ => ∅
  | inr a, inr b => (f₂ a b).map ⟨_, inr_injective⟩

@[simp]

name: sumLexLift_inl_inl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sumLexLift_inl_inl (a : α₁) (b : β₁) :
    sumLexLift f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ (inl a) (inl b) = (f₁ a b).map Embedding.inl

name: sumLexLift_inl_inr
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sumLexLift_inl_inr (a : α₁) (b : β₂) :
    sumLexLift f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ (inl a) (inr b) = (g₁ a b).disjSum (g₂ a b)

name: sumLexLift_inr_inl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sumLexLift_inr_inl (a : α₂) (b : β₁) : sumLexLift f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ (inr a) (inl b) = ∅

name: sumLexLift_inr_inr
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sumLexLift_inr_inr (a : α₂) (b : β₂) :
    sumLexLift f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ (inr a) (inr b) = (f₂ a b).map ⟨_, inr_injective⟩

name: mem_sumLexLift
statement:
lemma mem_sumLexLift :
    c ∈ sumLexLift f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ a b ↔
      (∃ a₁ b₁ c₁, a = inl a₁ ∧ b = inl b₁ ∧ c = inl c₁ ∧ c₁ ∈ f₁ a₁ b₁) ∨
        (∃ a₁ b₂ c₁, a = inl a₁ ∧ b = inr b₂ ∧ c = inl c₁ ∧ c₁ ∈ g₁ a₁ b₂) ∨
          (∃ a₁ b₂ c₂, a = inl a₁ ∧ b = inr b₂ ∧ c = inr c₂ ∧ c₂ ∈ g₂ a₁ b₂) ∨
            ∃ a₂ b₂ c₂, a = inr a₂ ∧ b = inr b₂ ∧ c = inr c₂ ∧ c₂ ∈ f₂ a₂ b₂
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · obtain a | a := a <;> obtain b | b := b
    · rw [sumLexLift, mem_map]
      rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
      exact Or.inl ⟨a, b, c, rfl, rfl, rfl, hc⟩
    · refine fun h ↦ (mem_disjSum.1 h).elim ?_ ?_
      · rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨a, b, c, rfl, rfl, rfl, hc⟩)
      · rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr <| Or.inl ⟨a, b, c, rfl, rfl, rfl, hc⟩)
    · exact fun h ↦ (notMem_empty _ h).elim
    · rw [sumLexLift, mem_map]
      rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
      exact Or.inr (Or.inr <| Or.inr <| ⟨a, b, c, rfl, rfl, rfl, hc⟩)
  · rintro (⟨a, b, c, rfl, rfl, rfl, hc⟩ | ⟨a, b, c, rfl, rfl, rfl, hc⟩ |
      ⟨a, b, c, rfl, rfl, rfl, hc⟩ | ⟨a, b, c, rfl, rfl, rfl, hc⟩)
    · exact mem_map_of_mem _ hc
    · exact inl_mem_disjSum.2 hc
    · exact inr_mem_disjSum.2 hc
    · exact mem_map_of_mem _ hc

name: inl_mem_sumLexLift
statement:
lemma inl_mem_sumLexLift {c₁ : γ₁} :
    inl c₁ ∈ sumLexLift f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ a b ↔
      (∃ a₁ b₁, a = inl a₁ ∧ b = inl b₁ ∧ c₁ ∈ f₁ a₁ b₁) ∨
        ∃ a₁ b₂, a = inl a₁ ∧ b = inr b₂ ∧ c₁ ∈ g₁ a₁ b₂

name: inr_mem_sumLexLift
statement:
lemma inr_mem_sumLexLift {c₂ : γ₂} :
    inr c₂ ∈ sumLexLift f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ a b ↔
      (∃ a₁ b₂, a = inl a₁ ∧ b = inr b₂ ∧ c₂ ∈ g₂ a₁ b₂) ∨
        ∃ a₂ b₂, a = inr a₂ ∧ b = inr b₂ ∧ c₂ ∈ f₂ a₂ b₂

name: sumLexLift_mono
statement:
lemma sumLexLift_mono (hf₁ : ∀ a b, f₁ a b ⊆ f₁' a b) (hf₂ : ∀ a b, f₂ a b ⊆ f₂' a b)
    (hg₁ : ∀ a b, g₁ a b ⊆ g₁' a b) (hg₂ : ∀ a b, g₂ a b ⊆ g₂' a b) (a : α₁ ⊕ α₂)
    (b : β₁ ⊕ β₂) : sumLexLift f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ a b ⊆ sumLexLift f₁' f₂' g₁' g₂' a b
proof:
:= by
  cases a <;> cases b
  exacts [map_subset_map.2 (hf₁ _ _), disjSum_mono (hg₁ _ _) (hg₂ _ _), Subset.rfl,
    map_subset_map.2 (hf₂ _ _)]

name: sumLexLift_eq_empty
statement:
lemma sumLexLift_eq_empty :
    sumLexLift f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ a b = ∅ ↔
      (∀ a₁ b₁, a = inl a₁ → b = inl b₁ → f₁ a₁ b₁ = ∅) ∧
        (∀ a₁ b₂, a = inl a₁ → b = inr b₂ → g₁ a₁ b₂ = ∅ ∧ g₂ a₁ b₂ = ∅) ∧
          ∀ a₂ b₂, a = inr a₂ → b = inr b₂ → f₂ a₂ b₂ = ∅
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  any_goals rintro a b rfl rfl; exact map_eq_empty.1 h
  · rintro a b rfl rfl; exact disjSum_eq_empty.1 h
  cases a <;> cases b
  · exact map_eq_empty.2 (h.1 _ _ rfl rfl)
  · simp [h.2.1 _ _ rfl rfl]
  · rfl
  · exact map_eq_empty.2 (h.2.2 _ _ rfl rfl)

name: sumLexLift_nonempty
statement:
lemma sumLexLift_nonempty :
    (sumLexLift f₁ f₂ g₁ g₂ a b).Nonempty ↔
      (∃ a₁ b₁, a = inl a₁ ∧ b = inl b₁ ∧ (f₁ a₁ b₁).Nonempty) ∨
        (∃ a₁ b₂, a = inl a₁ ∧ b = inr b₂ ∧ ((g₁ a₁ b₂).Nonempty ∨ (g₂ a₁ b₂).Nonempty)) ∨
          ∃ a₂ b₂, a = inr a₂ ∧ b = inr b₂ ∧ (f₂ a₂ b₂).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nonempty_iff_ne_empty, Ne, sumLexLift_eq_empty, not_and_or, exists_prop, not_forall]

name: noMinOrder_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem noMinOrder_iff [LT α] [LT β] : NoMinOrder (α ⊕ β) ↔ NoMinOrder α ∧ NoMinOrder β
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ =>
    ⟨⟨fun a => by
        obtain ⟨b | b, h⟩ := exists_lt (inl a : α ⊕ β)
        · exact ⟨b, inl_lt_inl_iff.1 h⟩
        · exact (not_inr_lt_inl h).elim⟩,
      ⟨fun a => by
        obtain ⟨b | b, h⟩ := exists_lt (inr a : α ⊕ β)
        · exact (not_inl_lt_inr h).elim
        · exact ⟨b, inr_lt_inr_iff.1 h⟩⟩⟩,
    fun h => @Sum.noMinOrder _ _ _ _ h.1 h.2⟩

name: noMaxOrder_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem noMaxOrder_iff [LT α] [LT β] : NoMaxOrder (α ⊕ β) ↔ NoMaxOrder α ∧ NoMaxOrder β
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ =>
    ⟨⟨fun a => by
        obtain ⟨b | b, h⟩ := exists_gt (inl a : α ⊕ β)
        · exact ⟨b, inl_lt_inl_iff.1 h⟩
        · exact (not_inl_lt_inr h).elim⟩,
      ⟨fun a => by
        obtain ⟨b | b, h⟩ := exists_gt (inr a : α ⊕ β)
        · exact (not_inr_lt_inl h).elim
        · exact ⟨b, inr_lt_inr_iff.1 h⟩⟩⟩,
    fun h => @Sum.noMaxOrder _ _ _ _ h.1 h.2⟩

name: denselyOrdered_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem denselyOrdered_iff [LT α] [LT β] :
    DenselyOrdered (α ⊕ β) ↔ DenselyOrdered α ∧ DenselyOrdered β
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ =>
    ⟨⟨fun a b h => by
        obtain ⟨c | c, ha, hb⟩ := @exists_between (α ⊕ β) _ _ _ _ (inl_lt_inl_iff.2 h)
        · exact ⟨c, inl_lt_inl_iff.1 ha, inl_lt_inl_iff.1 hb⟩
        · exact (not_inl_lt_inr ha).elim⟩,
      ⟨fun a b h => by
        obtain ⟨c | c, ha, hb⟩ := @exists_between (α ⊕ β) _ _ _ _ (inr_lt_inr_iff.2 h)
        · exact (not_inl_lt_inr hb).elim
        · exact ⟨c, inr_lt_inr_iff.1 ha, inr_lt_inr_iff.1 hb⟩⟩⟩,
    fun h => @Sum.denselyOrdered _ _ _ _ h.1 h.2⟩

name: rec_update_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma rec_update_left {γ : α ⊕ β → Sort*} [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (f : ∀ a, γ (.inl a)) (g : ∀ b, γ (.inr b)) (a : α) (x : γ (.inl a)) :
    Sum.rec (update f a x) g = update (Sum.rec f g) (.inl a) x
proof:
:=
  Function.rec_update Sum.inl_injective (Sum.rec · g) (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun
    | _, _, .inl _, h => (h _ rfl).elim
    | _, _, .inr _, _ => rfl) _ _ _

    Sum.rec f (update g b x) = update (Sum.rec f g) (.inr b) x
proof:
:=
  Function.rec_update Sum.inr_injective (Sum.rec f) (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun

    | _, _, .inl _, _ => rfl) _ _ _

name: Injective.sumElim
statement:
theorem Injective.sumElim {γ : Sort*} {f : α → γ} {g : β → γ} (hf : Injective f) (hg : Injective g)
    (hfg : ∀ a b, f a ≠ g b) : Injective (Sum.elim f g)
  | inl _, inl _, h => congr_arg inl <| hf h
  | inl _, inr _, h => (hfg _ _ h).elim
  | inr _, inl _, h => (hfg _ _ h.symm).elim
  | inr _, inr _, h => congr_arg inr <| hg h

name: Injective.sumMap
statement:

    Injective (Sum.map f g)

  | inr _, inr _, h => congr_arg inr <| hg <| inr.inj h

name: Surjective.sumMap
statement:
theorem Surjective.sumMap {f : α → β} {g : α' → β'} (hf : Surjective f) (hg : Surjective g) :
    Surjective (Sum.map f g)
  | inl y =>
    let ⟨x, hx⟩
proof:
:= hf y
    ⟨inl x, congr_arg inl hx⟩
  | inr y =>
    let ⟨x, hx⟩ := hg y
    ⟨inr x, congr_arg inr hx⟩

name: elim_injective
statement:
@[simp]
theorem elim_injective {γ : Sort*} {f : α → γ} {g : β → γ} :
    Injective (Sum.elim f g) ↔ Injective f ∧ Injective g ∧ ∀ a b, f a ≠ g b where
  mp h
proof:
:= ⟨h.comp inl_injective, h.comp inr_injective, fun _ _ => h.ne inl_ne_inr⟩
  mpr | ⟨hf, hg, hfg⟩ => hf.sumElim hg hfg

name: elim_injective'
statement:

theorem elim_injective' {γ : Sort*} {f : α → γ} :
    Injective (Sum.elim f : (β → γ) → (α ⊕ β → γ))
proof:
:=
  fun g₁ g₂ hg ↦ funext fun b ↦ by simpa using congr_fun hg (Sum.inr b)

name: map_injective
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_injective {f : α → γ} {g : β → δ} :
    Injective (Sum.map f g) ↔ Injective f ∧ Injective g where
  mp h
proof:
:= ⟨.of_comp <| h.comp inl_injective, .of_comp <| h.comp inr_injective⟩
  mpr | ⟨hf, hg⟩ => hf.sumMap hg

name: map_surjective
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_surjective {f : α → γ} {g : β → δ} :
    Surjective (Sum.map f g) ↔ Surjective f ∧ Surjective g where
  mp h
proof:
:= ⟨
      (fun c => by
        obtain ⟨a | b, h⟩ := h (inl c)
        · exact ⟨a, inl_injective h⟩
        · cases h),
      (fun d => by
        obtain ⟨a | b, h⟩ := h (inr d)
        · cases h
        · exact ⟨b, inr_injective h⟩)⟩
  mpr | ⟨hf, hg⟩ => hf.sumMap hg

    Nodup l ↔ Function.Injective (fun i : Fin l.length => l[i.1])
proof:
:=
  pairwise_iff_getElem.trans
    ⟨fun h i j hg => by
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i; obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := j
      rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy i j with (hij | rfl | hji)
      · exact (h i j hi hj hij hg).elim
      · rfl
      · exact (h j i hj hi hji hg.symm).elim,
      fun hinj i j hi hj hij h => Nat.ne_of_lt hij (Fin.val_eq_of_eq (@hinj ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ h))⟩

statement:
theorem nodup_iff_getElem?_ne_getElem? {l : List α} :
    l.Nodup ↔ ∀ i j : ℕ, i < j → j < l.length → l[i]? ≠ l[j]?

name: Nodup.ne_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem Nodup.ne_singleton_iff {l : List α} (h : Nodup l) (x : α) :
    l ≠ [x] ↔ l = [] ∨ ∃ y ∈ l, y ≠ x
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl hl =>
    specialize hl h.of_cons
    by_cases hx : tl = [x]
    · simpa [hx, and_comm, and_or_left] using h
    · rw [← Ne, hl] at hx
      rcases hx with (rfl | ⟨y, hy, hx⟩)
      · simp
      · suffices ∃ y ∈ hd :: tl, y ≠ x by simpa [ne_nil_of_mem hy]
        exact ⟨y, mem_cons_of_mem _ hy, hx⟩

name: not_nodup_of_get_eq_of_ne
statement:
theorem not_nodup_of_get_eq_of_ne (xs : List α) (n m : Fin xs.length)
    (h : xs.get n = xs.get m) (hne : n ≠ m) : ¬Nodup xs
proof:
:= by
  rw [nodup_iff_injective_get]
  exact fun hinj => hne (hinj h)

name: Nodup.head_eq_getLast_iff
statement:
lemma Nodup.head_eq_getLast_iff (hne : l ≠ []) (hnd : l.Nodup) :
    l.head hne = l.getLast hne ↔ ∃ x, l = [x]

name: get_idxOf
statement:
theorem get_idxOf [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {l : List α} (H : Nodup l) (i : Fin l.length) :
    idxOf (get l i) l = i

name: nodup_iff_count_le_one
statement: theorem nodup_iff_count_le_one [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {l : List α} : Nodup l ↔ ∀ a, count a l ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  nodup_iff_sublist.trans <|
    forall_congr' fun a =>
      have : replicate 2 a <+ l ↔ 1 < count a l := replicate_sublist_iff ..
      (not_congr this).trans Nat.not_lt

name: nodup_iff_count_eq_one
statement: theorem nodup_iff_count_eq_one [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] : Nodup l ↔ ∀ a ∈ l, count a l = 1
proof:
:=
  nodup_iff_count_le_one.trans <| forall_congr' fun x => by rw [← count_pos_iff]; grind

name: get_bijective_iff
statement: theorem get_bijective_iff [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] : l.get.Bijective ↔ ∀ a, l.count a = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h a ↦ (nodup_iff_count_eq_one.mp <| nodup_iff_injective_get.mpr h.injective)
    a <| mem_iff_get.mpr <| h.surjective a,
  fun h ↦ ⟨nodup_iff_injective_get.mp <| nodup_iff_count_eq_one.mpr fun a _ ↦ h a,
    fun a ↦ mem_iff_get.mp <| List.one_le_count_iff.mp <| by grind⟩⟩

name: getElem_bijective_iff
statement:
theorem getElem_bijective_iff [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] :
    (fun (n : Fin l.length) ↦ l[n]).Bijective ↔ ∀ a, l.count a = 1

name: count_eq_one_of_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_eq_one_of_mem [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {a : α} {l : List α} (d : Nodup l) (h : a ∈ l) :
    count a l = 1

name: Nodup.of_append_left
statement: theorem Nodup.of_append_left : Nodup (l₁ ++ l₂) → Nodup l₁

name: Nodup.of_append_right
statement: theorem Nodup.of_append_right : Nodup (l₁ ++ l₂) → Nodup l₂

name: nodup_append'
statement:
theorem nodup_append' {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    Nodup (l₁ ++ l₂) ↔ Nodup l₁ ∧ Nodup l₂ ∧ Disjoint l₁ l₂

name: disjoint_of_nodup_append
statement: theorem disjoint_of_nodup_append {l₁ l₂ : List α} (d : Nodup (l₁ ++ l₂)) : Disjoint l₁ l₂

name: Nodup.append
statement: theorem Nodup.append (d₁ : Nodup l₁) (d₂ : Nodup l₂) (dj : Disjoint l₁ l₂) : Nodup (l₁ ++ l₂)

name: nodup_append_comm
statement: theorem nodup_append_comm {l₁ l₂ : List α} : Nodup (l₁ ++ l₂) ↔ Nodup (l₂ ++ l₁)

name: nodup_middle
statement:
theorem nodup_middle {a : α} {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    Nodup (l₁ ++ a :: l₂) ↔ Nodup (a :: (l₁ ++ l₂))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nodup_append', not_or, and_left_comm, and_assoc, nodup_cons, mem_append,
    disjoint_cons_right]

name: Nodup.of_map
statement: theorem Nodup.of_map (f : α → β) {l : List α} : Nodup (map f l) → Nodup l

name: Nodup.map_on
statement:
theorem Nodup.map_on {f : α → β} (H : ∀ x ∈ l, ∀ y ∈ l, f x = f y → x = y) (d : Nodup l) :
    (map f l).Nodup
proof:
:=
  Pairwise.map _ (fun a b ⟨ma, mb, n⟩ e => n (H a ma b mb e)) (Pairwise.and_mem.1 d)

name: inj_on_of_nodup_map
statement:
theorem inj_on_of_nodup_map {f : α → β} {l : List α} (d : Nodup (map f l)) :
    ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ l → ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ l → f x = f y → x = y
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [map, nodup_cons, mem_map, not_exists, not_and, ← Ne.eq_def] at d
    simp only [mem_cons]
    rintro _ (rfl | h₁) _ (rfl | h₂) h₃
    · rfl
    · apply (d.1 _ h₂ h₃.symm).elim
    · apply (d.1 _ h₁ h₃).elim
    · apply ih d.2 h₁ h₂ h₃

name: nodup_map_iff_inj_on
statement:
theorem nodup_map_iff_inj_on {f : α → β} {l : List α} (d : Nodup l) :
    Nodup (map f l) ↔ ∀ x ∈ l, ∀ y ∈ l, f x = f y → x = y

name: Nodup.map
statement: protected theorem Nodup.map {f : α → β} (hf : Injective f) : Nodup l → Nodup (map f l)

name: nodup_map_iff
statement: theorem nodup_map_iff {f : α → β} {l : List α} (hf : Injective f) : Nodup (map f l) ↔ Nodup l

name: nodup_attach
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nodup_attach {l : List α} : Nodup (attach l) ↔ Nodup l
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => attach_map_subtype_val l ▸ h.map fun _ _ => Subtype.ext, fun h =>
    Nodup.of_map Subtype.val ((attach_map_subtype_val l).symm ▸ h)⟩

name: Nodup.pmap
statement:
theorem Nodup.pmap {p : α → Prop} {f : ∀ a, p a → β} {l : List α} {H}
    (hf : ∀ a ha b hb, f a ha = f b hb → a = b) (h : Nodup l) : Nodup (pmap f l H)

name: Nodup.filter
statement: theorem Nodup.filter (p : α → Bool) {l} : Nodup l → Nodup (filter p l)

name: nodup_reverse
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nodup_reverse {l : List α} : Nodup (reverse l) ↔ Nodup l
proof:
:=
  pairwise_reverse.trans <| by simp only [Nodup, Ne, eq_comm]

name: nodup_concat
statement: theorem nodup_concat (l : List α) (u : α) : (l.concat u).Nodup ↔ u ∉ l ∧ l.Nodup

name: Nodup.tail
statement: @[simp, grind ←] protected lemma Nodup.tail {l : List α} (h : Nodup l) : Nodup l.tail

name: nodup_tail_reverse
statement:
lemma nodup_tail_reverse (l : List α) (h : l[0]? = l.getLast?) :
    Nodup l.reverse.tail ↔ Nodup l.tail
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    by_cases hl : l = []
    · simp_all
    · simp_all only [List.tail_reverse, List.nodup_reverse,
        List.dropLast_cons_of_ne_nil hl, List.tail_cons]
      simp only [length_cons, Nat.zero_lt_succ, getElem?_eq_getElem,
        Nat.add_one_sub_one, Nat.lt_add_one, Option.some.injEq, List.getElem_cons,
        show l.length ≠ 0 by aesop, ↓reduceDIte, getLast?_eq_getElem?] at h
      rw [h,
        show l.Nodup = (l.dropLast ++ [l.getLast hl]).Nodup by
          simp [List.dropLast_eq_take],
        List.nodup_append_comm]
      simp [List.getLast_eq_getElem]

name: Nodup.eq_of_head_mem_of_suffix
statement:
lemma Nodup.eq_of_head_mem_of_suffix (h : l₁ <:+ l₂) {hne : l₂ ≠ []} (hl : l₂.head hne ∈ l₁)
    (hnd : l₂.Nodup) : l₁ = l₂

name: Nodup.eq_of_getLast_mem_of_prefix
statement:
lemma Nodup.eq_of_getLast_mem_of_prefix (h : l₁ <+: l₂) {hne : l₂ ≠ []} (hl : l₂.getLast hne ∈ l₁)
    (hnd : l₂.Nodup) : l₁ = l₂

name: Nodup.prefix_of_head_mem_of_infix
statement:
lemma Nodup.prefix_of_head_mem_of_infix (h : l₁ <:+: l₂) {hne : l₂ ≠ []} (hl : l₂.head hne ∈ l₁)
    (hnd : l₂.Nodup) : l₁ <+: l₂

name: Nodup.suffix_of_getLast_mem_of_infix
statement:
lemma Nodup.suffix_of_getLast_mem_of_infix (h : l₁ <:+: l₂) {hne : l₂ ≠ []}
    (hl : l₂.getLast hne ∈ l₁) (hnd : l₂.Nodup) : l₁ <:+ l₂

name: Nodup.eq_of_head_mem_of_getLast_mem_of_infix
statement:
lemma Nodup.eq_of_head_mem_of_getLast_mem_of_infix (h : l₁ <:+: l₂) {hne : l₂ ≠ []}
    (hlh : l₂.head hne ∈ l₁) (hlg : l₂.getLast hne ∈ l₁) (hnd : l₂.Nodup) : l₁ = l₂

name: Nodup.erase_getElem
statement:
theorem Nodup.erase_getElem [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {l : List α} (hl : l.Nodup)
    (i : Nat) (h : i < l.length) : l.erase l[i] = l.eraseIdx ↑i
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l IH =>
    cases i with
    | zero => simp
    | succ i => grind

name: Nodup.erase_get
statement:
theorem Nodup.erase_get [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {l : List α} (hl : l.Nodup) (i : Fin l.length) :
    l.erase (l.get i) = l.eraseIdx ↑i

name: Nodup.diff
statement: theorem Nodup.diff [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] : l₁.Nodup → (l₁.diff l₂).Nodup

name: nodup_flatten
statement:
theorem nodup_flatten {L : List (List α)} :
    Nodup (flatten L) ↔ (∀ l ∈ L, Nodup l) ∧ Pairwise Disjoint L
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Nodup, pairwise_flatten, disjoint_left.symm, forall_mem_ne]

name: nodup_flatMap
statement:
theorem nodup_flatMap {l₁ : List α} {f : α → List β} :
    Nodup (l₁.flatMap f) ↔
      (∀ x ∈ l₁, Nodup (f x)) ∧ Pairwise (Disjoint on f) l₁
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.flatMap, nodup_flatten, pairwise_map, and_comm, mem_map,
    exists_imp, and_imp]
  rw [show (∀ (l : List β) (x : α), f x = l → x ∈ l₁ → Nodup l) ↔ ∀ x : α, x ∈ l₁ → Nodup (f x)
      from forall_comm.trans <| forall_congr' fun _ => forall_eq']

name: Nodup.product
statement:
protected theorem Nodup.product {l₂ : List β} (d₁ : l₁.Nodup) (d₂ : l₂.Nodup) :
    (l₁ ×ˢ l₂).Nodup
proof:
:=
  nodup_flatMap.2
    ⟨fun a _ => d₂.map <| LeftInverse.injective fun b => (rfl : (a, b).2 = b),
      d₁.imp fun {a₁ a₂} n x h₁ h₂ => by
        rcases mem_map.1 h₁ with ⟨b₁, _, rfl⟩
        rcases mem_map.1 h₂ with ⟨b₂, mb₂, ⟨⟩⟩
        exact n rfl⟩

name: Nodup.sigma
statement:
theorem Nodup.sigma {σ : α → Type*} {l₂ : ∀ a, List (σ a)} (d₁ : Nodup l₁)
    (d₂ : ∀ a, Nodup (l₂ a)) : (l₁.sigma l₂).Nodup
proof:
:=
  nodup_flatMap.2
    ⟨fun a _ => (d₂ a).map fun b b' h => by injection h with _ h,
      d₁.imp fun {a₁ a₂} n x h₁ h₂ => by
        rcases mem_map.1 h₁ with ⟨b₁, _, rfl⟩
        rcases mem_map.1 h₂ with ⟨b₂, mb₂, ⟨⟩⟩
        exact n rfl⟩

name: Nodup.filterMap
statement:
protected theorem Nodup.filterMap {f : α → Option β} (h : ∀ a a' b, b ∈ f a → b ∈ f a' → a = a') :
    Nodup l → Nodup (filterMap f l)
proof:
:=
  (Pairwise.filterMap f) @fun a a' n b bm b' bm' e => n <| h a a' b' (by rw [← e]; exact bm) bm'

name: Nodup.concat
statement: protected theorem Nodup.concat (h : a ∉ l) (h' : l.Nodup) : (l.concat a).Nodup

name: Nodup.insert
statement: protected theorem Nodup.insert [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (h : l.Nodup) : (l.insert a).Nodup
proof:
:=
  if h' : a ∈ l then by rw [insert_of_mem h']; exact h
  else by rw [insert_of_not_mem h', nodup_cons]; constructor <;> assumption

name: Nodup.union
statement: theorem Nodup.union [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (l₁ : List α) (h : Nodup l₂) : (l₁ ∪ l₂).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil => exact h
  | cons a l₁ ih => exact (ih h).insert

name: Nodup.inter
statement: theorem Nodup.inter [BEq α] (l₂ : List α) : Nodup l₁ → Nodup (l₁ ∩ l₂)

name: Nodup.sdiff_eq_filter
statement:
theorem Nodup.sdiff_eq_filter [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List α} (_ : l₁.Nodup), l₁.diff l₂ = l₁.filter (· ∉ l₂)
  | l₁, [], _ => by simp
  | l₁, a :: l₂, hl₁ => by
    rw [diff_cons, (hl₁.erase _).sdiff_eq_filter, hl₁.erase_eq_filter, filter_filter]
    simp only [decide_not, bne, Bool.and_comm, decide_mem_cons, Bool.not_or]

@[deprecated (since := "2026-06-03")] alias Nodup.diff_eq_filter

name: Nodup.mem_sdiff_iff
statement:
theorem Nodup.mem_sdiff_iff [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] (hl₁ : l₁.Nodup) :
    a ∈ l₁.diff l₂ ↔ a ∈ l₁ ∧ a ∉ l₂

name: Nodup.set
statement:
protected theorem Nodup.set :
    ∀ {l : List α} {n : ℕ} {a : α} (_ : l.Nodup) (_ : a ∉ l), (l.set n a).Nodup
  | [], _, _, _, _ => nodup_nil
  | _ :: _, 0, _, hl, ha => nodup_cons.2 ⟨mt (mem_cons_of_mem _) ha, (nodup_cons.1 hl).2⟩
  | _ :: _, _ + 1, _, hl, ha =>
    nodup_cons.2
      ⟨fun h =>
        (mem_or_eq_of_mem_set h).elim (nodup_cons.1 hl).1 fun hba => ha (hba ▸ mem_cons_self),
        hl.of_cons.set (mt (mem_cons_of_mem _) ha)⟩

name: Nodup.map_update
statement:
theorem Nodup.map_update [DecidableEq α] {l : List α} (hl : l.Nodup) (f : α → β) (x : α) (y : β) :
    l.map (Function.update f x y) =
      if x ∈ l then (l.map f).set (l.idxOf x) y else l.map f
proof:
:= by
  induction l with | nil => simp | cons hd tl ihl => ?_
  rw [nodup_cons] at hl
  simp only [mem_cons, map, ihl hl.2]
  by_cases H : hd = x
  · subst hd
    simp [hl.1]
  · simp [Ne.symm H, H, ← apply_ite (cons (f hd))]

name: Nodup.pairwise_of_forall_ne
statement:
theorem Nodup.pairwise_of_forall_ne {l : List α} {r : α → α → Prop} (hl : l.Nodup)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ l, a ≠ b → r a b) : l.Pairwise r

name: Nodup.take_eq_filter_mem
statement:
theorem Nodup.take_eq_filter_mem [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] :
    ∀ {l : List α} {n : ℕ} (_ : l.Nodup), l.take n = l.filter (l.take n).elem
  | [], n, _ => by simp
  | b::l, 0, _ => by simp
  | b::l, n + 1, hl => by
    rw [take_succ_cons, Nodup.take_eq_filter_mem (Nodup.of_cons hl), filter_cons_of_pos (by simp)]
    congr 1
    refine List.filter_congr ?_
    intro x hx
    have : x ≠ b
proof:
:= fun h => (nodup_cons.1 hl).1 (h ▸ hx)
    simp +contextual [List.mem_filter, this, hx]

name: reduceOption_cons_of_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reduceOption_cons_of_some (x : α) (l : List (Option α)) :
    reduceOption (some x :: l) = x :: l.reduceOption

name: reduceOption_cons_of_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reduceOption_cons_of_none (l : List (Option α)) :
    reduceOption (none :: l) = l.reduceOption

name: reduceOption_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reduceOption_nil : @reduceOption α [] = []

name: reduceOption_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reduceOption_map {l : List (Option α)} {f : α → β} :
    reduceOption (map (Option.map f) l) = map f (reduceOption l)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp only [reduceOption_nil, map_nil]
  | cons hd tl hl =>
    cases hd <;> simpa [Option.map_some, map, eq_self_iff_true, reduceOption_cons_of_some] using hl

name: reduceOption_append
statement:
theorem reduceOption_append (l l' : List (Option α)) :
    (l ++ l').reduceOption = l.reduceOption ++ l'.reduceOption

name: reduceOption_replicate_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reduceOption_replicate_none {n : ℕ} : (replicate n (@none α)).reduceOption = []

name: reduceOption_eq_nil_iff
statement:
theorem reduceOption_eq_nil_iff (l : List (Option α)) :
    l.reduceOption = [] ↔ ∃ n, l = replicate n none
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [reduceOption]
  rw [filterMap_eq_nil_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨l.length, eq_replicate_of_mem h⟩
  · grind

name: reduceOption_eq_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem reduceOption_eq_singleton_iff (l : List (Option α)) (a : α) :
    l.reduceOption = [a] ↔ ∃ m n, l = replicate m none ++ some a :: replicate n none
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [reduceOption]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [filterMap_eq_cons_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨l₁, _, l₂, h, hl₁, ⟨⟩, hl₂⟩ := h
    rw [filterMap_eq_nil_iff] at hl₂
    apply eq_replicate_of_mem at hl₁
    apply eq_replicate_of_mem at hl₂
    rw [h, hl₁, hl₂]
    use l₁.length, l₂.length
  · intro ⟨_, _, h⟩
    simp only [h, filterMap_append, filterMap_cons_some, filterMap_replicate_of_none, id_eq,
      nil_append, Option.some.injEq]

name: reduceOption_eq_append_iff
statement:
theorem reduceOption_eq_append_iff (l : List (Option α)) (l'₁ l'₂ : List α) :
    l.reduceOption = l'₁ ++ l'₂ ↔
      ∃ l₁ l₂, l = l₁ ++ l₂ ∧ l₁.reduceOption = l'₁ ∧ l₂.reduceOption = l'₂

name: reduceOption_eq_concat_iff
statement:
theorem reduceOption_eq_concat_iff (l : List (Option α)) (l' : List α) (a : α) :
    l.reduceOption = l'.concat a ↔
      ∃ l₁ l₂, l = l₁ ++ some a :: l₂ ∧ l₁.reduceOption = l' ∧ l₂.reduceOption = []
proof:
:= by
  rw [concat_eq_append]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [reduceOption_eq_append_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨l₁, _, h, hl₁, hl₂⟩ := h
    rw [reduceOption_eq_singleton_iff] at hl₂
    obtain ⟨m, n, hl₂⟩ := hl₂
    use l₁ ++ replicate m none, replicate n none
    simp_rw [h, reduceOption_append, reduceOption_replicate_none, append_assoc, append_nil, hl₁,
      hl₂, and_self]
  · intro ⟨_, _, h, hl₁, hl₂⟩
    rw [h, reduceOption_append, reduceOption_cons_of_some, hl₁, hl₂]

name: reduceOption_length_eq
statement:
theorem reduceOption_length_eq {l : List (Option α)} :
    l.reduceOption.length = (l.filter Option.isSome).length
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp_rw [reduceOption_nil, filter_nil, length]
  | cons hd tl hl => cases hd <;> simp [hl]

name: length_eq_reduceOption_length_add_filter_none
statement:
theorem length_eq_reduceOption_length_add_filter_none {l : List (Option α)} :
    l.length = l.reduceOption.length + (l.filter Option.isNone).length

name: reduceOption_length_le
statement: theorem reduceOption_length_le (l : List (Option α)) : l.reduceOption.length ≤ l.length

name: reduceOption_length_eq_iff
statement:
theorem reduceOption_length_eq_iff {l : List (Option α)} :
    l.reduceOption.length = l.length ↔ ∀ x ∈ l, Option.isSome x

name: reduceOption_length_lt_iff
statement:
theorem reduceOption_length_lt_iff {l : List (Option α)} :
    l.reduceOption.length < l.length ↔ none ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.lt_iff_le_and_ne, and_iff_right (reduceOption_length_le l), Ne,
    reduceOption_length_eq_iff]
  induction l
  · simp
  · grind [cases Option]

name: reduceOption_singleton
statement: theorem reduceOption_singleton (x : Option α) : [x].reduceOption = x.toList

name: reduceOption_concat
statement:
theorem reduceOption_concat (l : List (Option α)) (x : Option α) :
    (l.concat x).reduceOption = l.reduceOption ++ x.toList
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing x with
  | nil => cases x <;> simp [Option.toList]
  | cons hd tl hl =>
    simp only [concat_eq_append, reduceOption_append] at hl
    cases hd <;> simp [hl, reduceOption_append]

name: reduceOption_concat_of_some
statement:
theorem reduceOption_concat_of_some (l : List (Option α)) (x : α) :
    (l.concat (some x)).reduceOption = l.reduceOption.concat x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reduceOption_nil, concat_eq_append, reduceOption_append, reduceOption_cons_of_some]

name: reduceOption_mem_iff
statement: theorem reduceOption_mem_iff {l : List (Option α)} {x : α} : x ∈ l.reduceOption ↔ some x ∈ l
proof:
:= by

name: reduceOption_getElem
statement:
theorem reduceOption_getElem?_iff {l : List (Option α)} {x : α} :
    (∃ i : ℕ, l[i]? = some (some x)) ↔ ∃ i : ℕ, l.reduceOption[i]? = some x

name: rightInverse_unzip_zip
statement:
theorem rightInverse_unzip_zip :
    RightInverse (unzip : List (α × β) → List α × List β) (uncurry zip)

name: zip_swap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zip_swap : ∀ (l₁ : List α) (l₂ : List β), (zip l₁ l₂).map Prod.swap = zip l₂ l₁
  | [], _ => zip_nil_right.symm
  | l₁, [] => by rw [zip_nil_right]; rfl
  | a :: l₁, b :: l₂ => by
    simp only [zip_cons_cons, map_cons, zip_swap l₁ l₂, Prod.swap_prod_mk]

name: forall_zipWith
statement:
theorem forall_zipWith {f : α → β → γ} {p : γ → Prop} :
    ∀ {l₁ : List α} {l₂ : List β}, length l₁ = length l₂ →
      (Forall p (zipWith f l₁ l₂) ↔ Forall₂ (fun x y => p (f x y)) l₁ l₂)
  | [], [], _ => by simp
  | a :: l₁, b :: l₂, h => by
    simp only [length_cons, succ_inj] at h
    simp [forall_zipWith h]

name: unzip_swap
statement: theorem unzip_swap (l : List (α × β)) : unzip (l.map Prod.swap) = (unzip l).swap

name: zipWith_congr
statement:
@[congr]
theorem zipWith_congr (f g : α → β → γ) (la : List α) (lb : List β)
    (h : List.Forall₂ (fun a b => f a b = g a b) la lb) : zipWith f la lb = zipWith g la lb
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hfg _ ih => exact congr_arg₂ _ hfg ih

name: zipWith_zipWith_left
statement:
theorem zipWith_zipWith_left (f : δ → γ → ε) (g : α → β → δ) :
    ∀ (la : List α) (lb : List β) (lc : List γ),
      zipWith f (zipWith g la lb) lc = zipWith3 (fun a b c => f (g a b) c) la lb lc
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | _ :: as, _ :: bs, _ :: cs => congr_arg (cons _) <| zipWith_zipWith_left f g as bs cs

name: zipWith_zipWith_right
statement:
theorem zipWith_zipWith_right (f : α → δ → ε) (g : β → γ → δ) :
    ∀ (la : List α) (lb : List β) (lc : List γ),
      zipWith f la (zipWith g lb lc) = zipWith3 (fun a b c => f a (g b c)) la lb lc
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | _ :: as, _ :: bs, _ :: cs => congr_arg (cons _) <| zipWith_zipWith_right f g as bs cs

@[simp]

name: zipWith3_same_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zipWith3_same_left (f : α → α → β → γ) :
    ∀ (la : List α) (lb : List β), zipWith3 f la la lb = zipWith (fun a b => f a a b) la lb
  | [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | _ :: as, _ :: bs => congr_arg (cons _) <| zipWith3_same_left f as bs

@[simp]

name: zipWith3_same_mid
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zipWith3_same_mid (f : α → β → α → γ) :
    ∀ (la : List α) (lb : List β), zipWith3 f la lb la = zipWith (fun a b => f a b a) la lb
  | [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | _ :: as, _ :: bs => congr_arg (cons _) <| zipWith3_same_mid f as bs

@[simp]

name: zipWith3_same_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zipWith3_same_right (f : α → β → β → γ) :
    ∀ (la : List α) (lb : List β), zipWith3 f la lb lb = zipWith (fun a b => f a b b) la lb
  | [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _, [] => rfl
  | _ :: as, _ :: bs => congr_arg (cons _) <| zipWith3_same_right f as bs

name: length_revzip
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_revzip (l : List α) : length (revzip l) = length l
proof:
:= by

name: unzip_revzip
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unzip_revzip (l : List α) : (revzip l).unzip = (l, l.reverse)

name: revzip_map_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem revzip_map_fst (l : List α) : (revzip l).map Prod.fst = l

name: revzip_map_snd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem revzip_map_snd (l : List α) : (revzip l).map Prod.snd = l.reverse

name: reverse_revzip
statement: theorem reverse_revzip (l : List α) : reverse l.revzip = revzip l.reverse
proof:

  simp [unzip_eq_map, revzip, map_reverse, map_fst_zip, map_snd_zip]

name: revzip_swap
