name: mem_zip_inits_tails
statement:
theorem mem_zip_inits_tails {l : List α} {init tail : List α} :
    (init, tail) ∈ zip l.inits l.tails ↔ init ++ tail = l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing init tail <;> simp_rw [tails, inits, zip_cons_cons]
  case nil => simp
  case cons hd tl ih =>
    constructor <;> rw [mem_cons, zip_map_left, mem_map, Prod.exists]
    · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨_, _, h, rfl, rfl⟩)
      · simp
      · simp [ih.mp h]
    · rcases init with - | ⟨hd', tl'⟩
      · simp
      · intro h
        right
        use tl', tail
        simp_all

name: length_splitLengths
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_splitLengths : (sz.splitLengths l).length = sz.length
proof:
:= by
  induction sz generalizing l <;> simp [splitLengths, *]

name: splitLengths_nil
statement:
@[simp]
lemma splitLengths_nil : [].splitLengths l = []

name: splitLengths_cons
statement:
@[simp]
lemma splitLengths_cons (n : ℕ) :
    (n :: sz).splitLengths l = l.take n :: sz.splitLengths (l.drop n)

name: take_splitLength
statement: theorem take_splitLength (i : ℕ) : (sz.splitLengths l).take i = (sz.take i).splitLengths l
proof:
:= by
  induction i generalizing sz l
  case zero => simp
  case succ i hi =>
    cases sz
    · simp
    · simp only [splitLengths_cons, take_succ_cons, hi]

name: length_splitLengths_getElem_le
statement:
theorem length_splitLengths_getElem_le {i : ℕ} {hi : i < (sz.splitLengths l).length} :
    (sz.splitLengths l)[i].length ≤ sz[i]'(by simpa using hi)
proof:
:= by
  induction sz generalizing l i
  · simp at hi
  case cons head tail tail_ih =>
    simp only [splitLengths_cons]
    cases i
    · simp
    · simp only [getElem_cons_succ, tail_ih]

name: flatten_splitLengths
statement: theorem flatten_splitLengths (h : l.length ≤ sz.sum) : (sz.splitLengths l).flatten = l
proof:
:= by
  induction sz generalizing l
  · simp_all
  case cons head tail ih =>
    simp only [splitLengths_cons, flatten_cons]
    rw [ih, take_append_drop]
    simpa [add_comm] using h

name: map_splitLengths_length
statement:
theorem map_splitLengths_length (h : sz.sum ≤ l.length) :
    (sz.splitLengths l).map length = sz
proof:
:= by
  induction sz generalizing l
  · simp
  case cons head tail ih =>
    simp only [sum_cons] at h
    simp only [splitLengths_cons, map_cons, length_take, cons.injEq, min_eq_left_iff]
    rw [ih]
    · simp [Nat.le_of_add_right_le h]
    · simp [Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h]

name: length_splitLengths_getElem_eq
statement:
theorem length_splitLengths_getElem_eq {i : ℕ} (hi : i < sz.length)
    (h : (sz.take (i + 1)).sum ≤ l.length) :
    ((sz.splitLengths l)[i]'(by simpa)).length = sz[i]
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.getElem_take' (hj := i.lt_add_one)]
  simp only [take_splitLength]
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [List.getElem_take' (hj := i.lt_add_one)]
    simp +singlePass only [← map_splitLengths_length l _ h]
    rw [getElem_map]

name: splitLengths_length_getElem
statement:
theorem splitLengths_length_getElem {α : Type*} (l : List α) (sz : List ℕ)
    (h : sz.sum ≤ l.length) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < (sz.splitLengths l).length) :
    (sz.splitLengths l)[i].length = sz[i]'(by simpa using hi)
proof:
:= by
  have := map_splitLengths_length l sz h
  rw [← List.getElem_map List.length]
  · simp [this]
  · simpa using hi

name: length_mem_splitLengths
statement:
theorem length_mem_splitLengths {α : Type*} (l : List α) (sz : List ℕ) (b : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ n ∈ sz, n ≤ b) : ∀ l₂ ∈ sz.splitLengths l, l₂.length ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.forall_mem_iff_forall_getElem]
  intro i hi
  have := length_splitLengths_getElem_le l sz (hi := hi)
  have := h (sz[i]'(by simpa using hi)) (getElem_mem ..)
  lia

name: countP_lt_length_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem countP_lt_length_iff {l : List α} {p : α → Bool} :

name: count_lt_length_iff
statement:

theorem count_lt_length_iff {a : α} : l.count a < l.length ↔ ∃ b ∈ l, b ≠ a

name: countP_erase
statement:
lemma countP_erase (p : α → Bool) (l : List α) (a : α) :
    countP p (l.erase a) = countP p l - if a ∈ l ∧ p a then 1 else 0

name: count_diff
statement:
lemma count_diff (a : α) (l₁ : List α) :
    ∀ l₂, count a (l₁.diff l₂) = count a l₁ - count a l₂
  | [] => rfl
  | b :: l₂ => by
    simp only [diff_cons, count_diff, count_erase, beq_iff_eq, Nat.sub_right_comm, count_cons,
      Nat.sub_add_eq]

name: countP_diff
statement:
lemma countP_diff (hl : l₂ <+~ l₁) (p : α → Bool) :
    countP p (l₁.diff l₂) = countP p l₁ - countP p l₂
proof:
:= by
  refine (Nat.sub_eq_of_eq_add ?_).symm
  rw [← countP_append]
  exact ((subperm_append_diff_self_of_count_le <| subperm_ext_iff.1 hl).symm.trans
    perm_append_comm).countP_eq _

name: count_map_of_injective
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_map_of_injective [BEq β] [LawfulBEq β] (l : List α) (f : α → β)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (x : α) : count (f x) (map f l) = count x l
proof:
:= by
  simp only [count, countP_map]
  unfold Function.comp
  simp only [hf.beq_eq]

  (isChain_iff _ _).trans <| by
    simp only [cons_ne_nil, List.cons_eq_cons, exists_and_right,

statement:
theorem isChain_split {c : α} {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    IsChain R (l₁ ++ c :: l₂) ↔ IsChain R (l₁ ++ [c]) ∧ IsChain R (c :: l₂)

  induction l₁ using twoStepInduction generalizing l₂ with grind

theorem isChain_append_cons_cons {b c : α} {l₁ l₂ : List α} :

name: isChain_cons_append_cons_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isChain_cons_append_cons_cons {a b c : α} {l₁ l₂ : List α} :

    IsChain R (a :: (l₁ ++ [b])) ∧ R b c ∧ IsChain R (c :: l₂)

name: isChain_iff_forall_rel_of_append_cons_cons
statement:
theorem isChain_iff_forall_rel_of_append_cons_cons {l : List α} :
    IsChain R l ↔ ∀ ⦃a b l₁ l₂⦄, l = l₁ ++ a :: b :: l₂ → R a b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h _ _ _ _ eq => (isChain_append_cons_cons.mp (eq ▸ h)).2.1, ?_⟩
  induction l using twoStepInduction with
  | nil | singleton => grind
  | cons_cons head head' tail _ ih =>
    refine fun h ↦ isChain_cons_cons.mpr ⟨h (nil_append _).symm, ih _ fun ⦃a b l₁ l₂⦄ eq => ?_⟩
    apply h
    rw [eq, cons_append]

name: isChain_append
statement:
theorem isChain_append :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List α},
      IsChain R (l₁ ++ l₂) ↔ IsChain R l₁ ∧ IsChain R l₂ ∧ ∀ x ∈ l₁.getLast?, ∀ y ∈ l₂.head?, R x y
  | [], l => by simp
  | [a], l => by simp [isChain_cons, and_comm]
  | a :: b :: l₁, l₂ => by
    rw [cons_append, cons_append, isChain_cons_cons, isChain_cons_cons,
      ← cons_append, isChain_append, and_assoc]
    simp

statement: theorem IsChain.right_of_append (h : IsChain R (l₁ ++ l₂)) : IsChain R l₂

name: IsChain.rel_getLast_head_of_append
statement:
theorem IsChain.rel_getLast_head_of_append {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h : (l₁ ++ l₂).IsChain R)
    (h₁ : l₁ ≠ []) (h₂ : l₂ ≠ []) : R (l₁.getLast h₁) (l₂.head h₂)
proof:
:=
  match l₁, l₂ with
  | [_], _ :: _ => h.rel
  | _ :: _ :: _, _ :: _ => h.tail.rel_getLast_head_of_append (by simp) (by simp)

name: IsChain.infix

proof:
:= by

  exact h.left_of_append.right_of_append

statement:

statement:
theorem exists_not_getElem_of_not_isChain (h : ¬List.IsChain R l) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ h : n + 1 < l.length, ¬R l[n] l[n + 1]

name: isChain_reverse
statement: theorem isChain_reverse {l : List α} : l.reverse.IsChain R ↔ l.IsChain (fun a b => R b a)
proof:
:= by
  induction l using twoStepInduction with
  | nil => grind
  | singleton a => grind
  | cons_cons a b l IH IH2 =>
    rw [isChain_cons_cons, reverse_cons, reverse_cons, append_assoc, cons_append, nil_append,
      isChain_split, ← reverse_cons, IH2, and_comm, isChain_pair]

name: IsChain.append_overlap
statement:
theorem IsChain.append_overlap {l₁ l₂ l₃ : List α} (h₁ : IsChain R (l₁ ++ l₂))
    (h₂ : IsChain R (l₂ ++ l₃)) (hn : l₂ ≠ []) : IsChain R (l₁ ++ l₂ ++ l₃)
proof:
:=
  h₁.append h₂.right_of_append <| by
    simpa only [getLast?_append_of_ne_nil _ hn] using (isChain_append.1 h₂).2.2

name: isChain_flatten
statement:
lemma isChain_flatten : ∀ {L : List (List α)}, [] ∉ L →
    (IsChain R L.flatten ↔ (∀ l ∈ L, IsChain R l) ∧
    L.IsChain (fun l₁ l₂ => ∀ᵉ (x ∈ l₁.getLast?) (y ∈ l₂.head?), R x y))
| [], _ => by simp
| [l], _ => by simp [flatten]
| (l₁ :: l₂ :: L), hL => by
    rw [mem_cons, not_or, ← Ne] at hL
    rw [flatten_cons, isChain_append, isChain_flatten hL.2, forall_mem_cons, isChain_cons_cons]
    rw [mem_cons, not_or, ← Ne] at hL
    simp only [forall_mem_cons, and_assoc, flatten_cons, head?_append_of_ne_nil _ hL.2.1.symm]
    exact Iff.rfl.and (Iff.rfl.and <| Iff.rfl.and and_comm)

name: isChain_attachWith
statement:
theorem isChain_attachWith {l : List α} {p : α → Prop} (h : ∀ x ∈ l, p x)
    {r : {a // p a} → {a // p a} → Prop} :
    (l.attachWith p h).IsChain r ↔ l.IsChain fun a b ↦ ∃ ha hb, r ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩

name: isChain_attach
statement:
theorem isChain_attach {l : List α} {r : {a // a ∈ l} → {a // a ∈ l} → Prop} :
    l.attach.IsChain r ↔ l.IsChain fun a b ↦ ∃ ha hb, r ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩

name: exists_isChain_cons_of_relationReflTransGen
statement:
theorem exists_isChain_cons_of_relationReflTransGen (h : Relation.ReflTransGen r a b) :
    ∃ l, IsChain r (a :: l) ∧ getLast (a :: l) (cons_ne_nil _ _) = b
proof:
:= by
  refine Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on h ?_ ?_
  · exact ⟨[], .singleton _, rfl⟩
  · intro c d e _ ih
    obtain ⟨l, hl₁, hl₂⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨d :: l, .cons_cons e hl₁, ?_⟩
    rwa [getLast_cons_cons]

name: exists_isChain_ne_nil_of_relationReflTransGen
statement:
theorem exists_isChain_ne_nil_of_relationReflTransGen (h : Relation.ReflTransGen r a b) :
    ∃ l, ∃ (hl : l ≠ []), IsChain r l ∧ l.head hl = a ∧ getLast l hl = b

name: IsChain.induction
statement:
theorem IsChain.induction (p : α → Prop) (l : List α) (h : IsChain r l)
    (carries : ∀ ⦃x y : α⦄, r x y → p x → p y) (initial : (lne : l ≠ []) → p (l.head lne)) :
    ∀ i ∈ l, p i
proof:
:= by
  induction l using twoStepInduction with grind

name: IsChain.cons_induction
statement:
theorem IsChain.cons_induction (p : α → Prop) (l : List α) (h : IsChain r (a :: l))
    (carries : ∀ ⦃x y : α⦄, r x y → p x → p y) (initial : p a) : ∀ i ∈ l, p i
proof:
:= fun _ hi =>
  h.induction _ _ carries (fun _ => initial) _ (mem_cons_of_mem _ hi)

name: IsChain.concat_induction
statement:
theorem IsChain.concat_induction (p : α → Prop) (l : List α) (h : IsChain r (l ++ [b]))
    (hb : head (l ++ [b]) (concat_ne_nil _ _) = a) (carries : ∀ ⦃x y : α⦄, r x y → p x → p y)
    (initial : p a) : ∀ i ∈ l ++ [b], p i

name: IsChain.concat_induction_head
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem IsChain.concat_induction_head (p : α → Prop) (l : List α) (h : IsChain r (l ++ [b]))
    (hb : head (l ++ [b]) (concat_ne_nil _ _) = a) (carries : ∀ ⦃x y : α⦄, r x y → p x → p y)
    (initial : p a) : p b
proof:
:=
  (IsChain.concat_induction p l h hb carries initial) _ mem_concat_self

name: IsChain.backwards_induction
statement:
theorem IsChain.backwards_induction (p : α → Prop) (l : List α) (h : IsChain r l)
    (carries : ∀ ⦃x y : α⦄, r x y → p y → p x) (final : (lne : l ≠ []) → p (getLast l lne)) :
    ∀ i ∈ l, p i
proof:
:= by
  have H : IsChain (flip (flip r)) l := h
  replace H := (isChain_reverse.mpr H).induction _ _ (fun _ _ h ↦ carries h)
  grind

name: IsChain.backwards_concat_induction
statement:
theorem IsChain.backwards_concat_induction (p : α → Prop) (l : List α) (h : IsChain r (l ++ [b]))
    (carries : ∀ ⦃x y : α⦄, r x y → p y → p x) (final : p b) : ∀ i ∈ l, p i
proof:
:= fun _ hi =>
  h.backwards_induction _ _ carries (fun _ => getLast_concat ▸ final) _ (mem_append_left _ hi)

name: IsChain.backwards_cons_induction
statement:
theorem IsChain.backwards_cons_induction (p : α → Prop) (l : List α) (h : IsChain r (a :: l))
    (hb : getLast (a :: l) (cons_ne_nil _ _) = b) (carries : ∀ ⦃x y : α⦄, r x y → p y → p x)
    (final : p b) : ∀ i ∈ a :: l, p i

name: IsChain.backwards_cons_induction_head
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem IsChain.backwards_cons_induction_head (p : α → Prop) (l : List α) (h : IsChain r (a :: l))
    (hb : getLast (a :: l) (cons_ne_nil _ _) = b) (carries : ∀ ⦃x y : α⦄, r x y → p y → p x)
    (final : p b) : p a
proof:
:=
  (IsChain.backwards_cons_induction p l h hb carries final) _ mem_cons_self

name: relationReflTransGen_of_exists_isChain
statement:
theorem relationReflTransGen_of_exists_isChain (l : List α) (hl₁ : IsChain r l) (hne : l ≠ []) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen r (head l hne) (getLast l hne)
proof:
:=
  IsChain.induction (Relation.ReflTransGen r (head l hne) ·) l hl₁
  (fun _ _ h₁ h₂ => Trans.trans h₂ h₁) (fun _ => Relation.ReflTransGen.refl) _ (getLast_mem _)

name: relationReflTransGen_of_exists_isChain_cons
statement:
theorem relationReflTransGen_of_exists_isChain_cons (l : List α) (hl₁ : IsChain r (a :: l))
    (hl₂ : getLast (a :: l) (cons_ne_nil _ _) = b) : Relation.ReflTransGen r a b
proof:
:=
  IsChain.backwards_cons_induction_head _ l hl₁ hl₂ (fun _ _ => Relation.ReflTransGen.head)
  Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

name: IsChain.cons_of_le
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | nil => grind
  | cons b bs =>
    apply hm.cons_cons
    cases as with
    | nil =>
      simp only [le_iff_lt_or_eq, reduceCtorEq, or_false] at hmas
      exact (List.not_lt_nil _ hmas).elim
    | cons a' as =>
      rw [List.isChain_cons_cons] at ha
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ ha.1
      rw [le_iff_lt_or_eq] at hmas
      rcases hmas with hmas | hmas
      · exact head_le_of_lt hmas
      · simp_all only [List.cons.injEq, le_refl]

lemma IsChain.isChain_cons {α : Type*} {R : α → α → Prop} {l : List α} {v : α}

proof:

  induction i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i h =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ', Function.comp_apply, h (by lia)]
    rw [List.isChain_iff_getElem] at hl
    apply hl

name: isChain_eq_iff_eq_replicate
statement:
theorem isChain_eq_iff_eq_replicate {l : List α} :
    IsChain (· = ·) l ↔ ∀ a ∈ l.head?, l = replicate l.length a
proof:
:= by
  induction l using twoStepInduction with
  | nil | singleton => simp
  | cons_cons a b l IH IH2 =>
    simp +contextual [isChain_cons_cons, eq_comm, IH2, replicate_succ]

name: WellFoundedRelation.asymmetric
statement:
theorem WellFoundedRelation.asymmetricₙ [WellFoundedRelation α] {l : List α} (hne : l ≠ [])
    (h : l.IsChain WellFoundedRelation.rel) :
    ¬WellFoundedRelation.rel (l.getLast hne) (l.head hne)
proof:
:=
  match l with
  | [x] => irrefl x
  | _ :: _ :: _ =>
    fun hr ↦ asymmetricₙ (List.cons_ne_nil _ _) (h.dropLast.cons_cons hr) (h.rel_getLast_dropLast _)

name: WellFounded.asymmetric

theorem WellFounded.asymmetricₙ (wf : WellFounded r) (hne : l ≠ []) (h : l.IsChain r) :

name: WellFounded.listPairwise_reverse_compl
statement:
theorem WellFounded.listPairwise_reverse_compl (wf : WellFounded r) (h : l.IsChain r) :
    l.reverse.Pairwise rᶜ
proof:
:= by
  refine List.pairwise_iff_forall_infix.mpr fun l' hne hsub ↦ ?_
  have := wf.asymmetricₙ (by grind) <| h.infix <| l.reverse_reverse ▸ hsub.reverse
  simpa

name: Acc.list_chain'
statement:
theorem Acc.list_chain' {l : List.chains r} (acc : ∀ a ∈ l.val.head?, Acc r a) :
    Acc (List.lex_chains r) l
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_ | ⟨a, l⟩, hl⟩ := l
  · apply Acc.intro; rintro ⟨_⟩ ⟨_⟩
  specialize acc a _
  · rw [List.head?_cons, Option.mem_some_iff]
  /- For an r-decreasing chain of the form a :: l, apply induction on a -/
  induction acc generalizing l with
  | intro a _ ih =>
    /- Bundle l with a proof that it is r-decreasing to form l' -/
    have hl' := (List.isChain_cons.1 hl).2
    let l' : List.chains r := ⟨l, hl'⟩
    have : Acc (List.lex_chains r) l' := by
      rcases l with - | ⟨b, l⟩
      · apply Acc.intro; rintro ⟨_⟩ ⟨_⟩
      /- l' is accessible by induction hypothesis -/
      · apply ih b (List.isChain_cons_cons.1 hl).1
    /- make l' a free variable and induct on l' -/
    revert hl
    rw [(by rfl : l = l'.1)]
    clear_value l'
    induction this with
    | intro l _ ihl =>
      intro hl
      apply Acc.intro
      rintro ⟨_ | ⟨b, m⟩, hm⟩ (_ | hr | hr)
      · apply Acc.intro; rintro ⟨_⟩ ⟨_⟩
      · apply ih b hr
      · apply ihl ⟨m, (List.isChain_cons.1 hm).2⟩ hr

name: WellFounded.list_chain'
statement:
theorem WellFounded.list_chain' (hwf : WellFounded r) :
    WellFounded (List.lex_chains r)

name: length_iterate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_iterate (f : α → α) (a : α) (n : ℕ) : length (iterate f a n) = n
proof:

name: iterate_eq_nil
statement:

theorem iterate_eq_nil {f : α → α} {a : α} {n : ℕ} : iterate f a n = [] ↔ n = 0

name: getElem
statement:
theorem getElem?_iterate (f : α → α) (a : α) :
    ∀ (n i : ℕ), i < n → (iterate f a n)[i]? = f^[i] a
  | n + 1, 0, _ => by simp
  | n + 1, i + 1, h => by simp [getElem?_iterate f (f a) n i (by simpa using h)]

@[simp]

name: getElem_iterate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem getElem_iterate (f : α → α) (a : α) (n : ℕ) (i : Nat) (h : i < (iterate f a n).length) :
    (iterate f a n)[i] = f^[i] a

name: mem_iterate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_iterate {f : α → α} {a : α} {n : ℕ} {b : α} :
    b ∈ iterate f a n ↔ ∃ m < n, b = f^[m] a

name: range_map_iterate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem range_map_iterate (n : ℕ) (f : α → α) (a : α) :
    (List.range n).map (f^[·] a) = List.iterate f a n

name: iterate_add
statement:
theorem iterate_add (f : α → α) (a : α) (m n : ℕ) :
    iterate f a (m + n) = iterate f a m ++ iterate f (f^[m] a) n
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing a with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [iterate, add_right_comm, iterate, ih, Nat.iterate, cons_append]

name: take_iterate
statement:
theorem take_iterate (f : α → α) (a : α) (m n : ℕ) :
    take m (iterate f a n) = iterate f a (min m n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← range_map_iterate, ← range_map_iterate, ← map_take, take_range]

name: mem_sections
statement: theorem mem_sections {L : List (List α)} {f} : f ∈ sections L ↔ Forall₂ (· ∈ ·) f L
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · induction L generalizing f
    · cases mem_singleton.1 h
      exact Forall₂.nil
    simp only [sections, mem_flatMap, mem_map] at h
    rcases h with ⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩
    simp only [*, forall₂_cons, true_and]
  · induction h with
    | nil => simp only [sections, mem_singleton]
    | @cons a l f L al fL fs =>
      simp only [sections, mem_flatMap, mem_map]
      exact ⟨f, fs, a, al, rfl⟩

name: mem_sections_length
statement: theorem mem_sections_length {L : List (List α)} {f} (h : f ∈ sections L) : length f = length L

setOfPred_mem_eq_empty_iff
statement:

name: injOn_insertIdx_index_of_notMem
statement:
theorem injOn_insertIdx_index_of_notMem (l : List α) (x : α) (hx : x ∉ l) :
    Set.InjOn (fun k => l.insertIdx k x) { n | n ≤ l.length }
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn m hm h
  induction l generalizing n m with
  | nil =>
    simp_all [Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.ofPred_eq_eq_singleton, length]
  | cons hd tl IH =>
    simp only [length, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hn hm
    simp only [mem_cons, not_or] at hx
    cases n <;> cases m
    · rfl
    · simp [hx.left] at h
    · simp [Ne.symm hx.left] at h
    · simp only [insertIdx_succ_cons, cons.injEq, true_and] at h
      rw [Nat.succ_inj]
      refine IH hx.right ?_ ?_ h
      · simpa [Nat.succ_le_succ_iff] using hn
      · simpa [Nat.succ_le_succ_iff] using hm

name: foldr_range_subset_of_range_subset
statement:
theorem foldr_range_subset_of_range_subset {f : β → α → α} {g : γ → α → α}
    (hfg : Set.range f ⊆ Set.range g) (a : α) : Set.range (foldr f a) ⊆ Set.range (foldr g a)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨l, rfl⟩
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
  | cons b l H =>
    obtain ⟨c, hgf⟩ := hfg (Set.mem_range_self b)
    obtain ⟨m, hgf'⟩ := H
    rw [foldr_cons, ← hgf, ← hgf']
    exact ⟨c :: m, rfl⟩

name: foldl_range_subset_of_range_subset
proof:
:= by
  change (Set.range fun l => _) ⊆ Set.range fun l => _
  
  simp_rw [← (foldr_reverse), Set.range_comp' _ reverse,
    reverse_involutive.bijective.surjective.range_eq, Set.image_univ]
  exact foldr_range_subset_of_range_subset hfg a

name: foldr_range_eq_of_range_eq
statement:
theorem foldr_range_eq_of_range_eq {f : β → α → α} {g : γ → α → α} (hfg : Set.range f = Set.range g)
    (a : α) : Set.range (foldr f a) = Set.range (foldr g a)

mapAccumr_eq_foldr
statement:
theorem mapAccumr_eq_foldr {σ : Type*} (f : α → σ → σ × β) : ∀ (as : List α) (s : σ),
    mapAccumr f as s = List.foldr (fun a s =>
                                    let r := f a s.1
                                    (r.1, r.2 :: s.2)) (s, []) as
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: as, s => by
    simp only [mapAccumr, foldr, mapAccumr_eq_foldr f as]

name: pairwise_iff_forall_infix
statement:
theorem pairwise_iff_forall_infix {α : Type*} {l : List α} {R : α → α → Prop} :
    l.Pairwise R ↔
      ∀ l', (h : 1 < l'.length) → l' <:+: l → R (l'.head <| by grind) (l'.getLast <| by grind)
proof:
:= by
  refine l.pairwise_iff_getElem.trans ⟨fun h l' hne ⟨l₁, l₂, hl⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h i j hi hj hij ↦ ?_⟩
  · grind [getElem_append_left', getElem_append_right']
  · grind [h _ _ <| List.drop_suffix i _ |>.isInfix.trans <| l.take_prefix (j + 1) |>.isInfix]

name: Pairwise.forall_of_forall
statement:
theorem Pairwise.forall_of_forall [Std.Symm R] (H₁ : ∀ x ∈ l, R x x) (H₂ : l.Pairwise R) :
    ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ l → ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ l → R x y

name: Pairwise.forall
statement:
theorem Pairwise.forall [Std.Symm R] (hl : l.Pairwise R) :
    ∀ ⦃a⦄, a ∈ l → ∀ ⦃b⦄, b ∈ l → a ≠ b → R a b
proof:
:= by
  have : Std.Symm fun x y ↦ x ≠ y → R x y := { symm a b h hne := symm <| h hne.symm }
  apply Pairwise.forall_of_forall
  · exact fun _ _ ↦ absurd rfl
  · exact hl.imp @fun a b h _ ↦ by exact h

name: Pairwise.set_pairwise
statement: theorem Pairwise.set_pairwise (hl : Pairwise R l) [Std.Symm R] : { x | x ∈ l }.Pairwise R

name: pairwise_of_reflexive_of_forall_ne
statement:
theorem pairwise_of_reflexive_of_forall_ne [Std.Refl R] (h : ∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ l, a ≠ b → R a b) :
    l.Pairwise R
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairwise_iff_forall_sublist]
  intro a b hab
  if heq : a = b then
    cases heq; apply refl
  else
    apply h <;> try (apply hab.subset; simp)
    exact heq

name: pairwise_append_of_mem
statement:
theorem pairwise_append_of_mem [Std.Symm R] [IsTrans α R] (ha : a ∈ l₁) (hb : b ∈ l₂) :
    (l₁ ++ l₂).Pairwise R ↔ R a b ∧ l₁.Pairwise R ∧ l₂.Pairwise R
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairwise_append, ← and_rotate, and_congr_left_iff, and_imp]
  refine fun h₁ h₂ ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ h a ha b hb, fun hab x hx y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  have : R a y := eq_or_ne b y |>.elim (· ▸ hab) (trans_of R hab <| h₂.forall hb hy ·)
  exact eq_or_ne x a |>.elim (· ▸ this) fun hne ↦ trans_of R (h₁.forall hx ha hne) this

name: pairwise_cons_of_mem
statement:
theorem pairwise_cons_of_mem [Std.Symm R] [IsTrans α R] (h : b ∈ l) :
    (a :: l).Pairwise R ↔ R a b ∧ l.Pairwise R
proof:
:= by
  simpa using pairwise_append_of_mem (l₁ := [a]) (by simp) h

theorem Pairwise.rel_head_tail (h₁ : l.Pairwise R) (ha : a ∈ l.tail) :

name: Pairwise.rel_head_of_rel_head_head
statement:
theorem Pairwise.rel_head_of_rel_head_head (h₁ : l.Pairwise R) (ha : a ∈ l)
    (hhead : R (l.head <| ne_nil_of_mem ha) (l.head <| ne_nil_of_mem ha)) :
    R (l.head <| ne_nil_of_mem ha) a

name: Pairwise.rel_head
statement:
theorem Pairwise.rel_head [Std.Refl R] (h₁ : l.Pairwise R) (ha : a ∈ l) :
    R (l.head <| ne_nil_of_mem ha) a

name: Pairwise.rel_dropLast_getLast
statement:
theorem Pairwise.rel_dropLast_getLast (h : l.Pairwise R) (ha : a ∈ l.dropLast) :
    R a (l.getLast <| ne_nil_of_mem <| dropLast_subset _ ha)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pairwise_reverse] at h
  rw [getLast_eq_head_reverse]
  exact h.rel_head_tail (by rwa [tail_reverse, mem_reverse])

name: Pairwise.rel_getLast_of_rel_getLast_getLast
statement:
theorem Pairwise.rel_getLast_of_rel_getLast_getLast (h₁ : l.Pairwise R) (ha : a ∈ l)
    (hlast : R (l.getLast <| ne_nil_of_mem ha) (l.getLast <| ne_nil_of_mem ha)) :
    R a (l.getLast <| ne_nil_of_mem ha)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dropLast_concat_getLast (ne_nil_of_mem ha), mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at ha
  exact ha.elim h₁.rel_dropLast_getLast (· ▸ hlast)

name: Pairwise.rel_getLast
statement:
theorem Pairwise.rel_getLast [Std.Refl R] (h₁ : l.Pairwise R) (ha : a ∈ l) :
    R a (l.getLast <| ne_nil_of_mem ha)

name: Pairwise.head
statement:
theorem Pairwise.head!_le [Inhabited α] [Std.Refl R] (h : l.Pairwise R)
    (ha : a ∈ l) : R l.head! a
proof:
:= by
  cases l
  · contradiction
  · cases ha with
    | head => exact refl_of ..
    | tail => exact rel_of_pairwise_cons h (by assumption)

name: pairwise_replicate_of_refl
statement: theorem pairwise_replicate_of_refl {n} [Std.Refl R] : (replicate n a).Pairwise R

statement:
theorem pairwise_cons_cons_iff_of_trans [IsTrans α R] {l : List α} {a b : α} :

statement:
theorem Pairwise.cons_cons_of_trans [IsTrans α R] {l : List α} {a b : α} :
    R a b → Pairwise R (b :: l) → Pairwise R (a :: b :: l)

name: Pairwise.rel_get_of_lt
statement:
theorem Pairwise.rel_get_of_lt {l : List α} (h : l.Pairwise R) {a b : Fin l.length} (hab : a < b) :

name: Pairwise.rel_get_of_le
statement:
theorem Pairwise.rel_get_of_le [Std.Refl R] {l : List α} (h : l.Pairwise R) {a b : Fin l.length}
    (hab : a ≤ b) : R (l.get a) (l.get b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hlt := Fin.eq_or_lt_of_le hab; exacts [refl _, (pairwise_iff_get.1 h) _ _ hlt]

name: Pairwise.decide
statement:
theorem Pairwise.decide [DecidableRel R] (l : List α) (h : Pairwise R l) :
    Pairwise (fun a b => decide (R a b) = true) l
proof:
:= by
  refine h.imp fun {a b} h => by simpa using h

statement:
theorem tfae_append :
    TFAE (l₁ ++ l₂) ↔ TFAE l₁ ∧ TFAE l₂ ∧ (∀ a ∈ l₁, ∀ b ∈ l₂, a ↔ b)

theorem tfae_append_of_mem (ha : a ∈ l₁) (hb : b ∈ l₂) :

statement:
@[simp]
theorem tfae_cons_of_mem (h : a ∈ l) : TFAE (a :: l) ↔ TFAE l

statement: theorem tfae_concat (h : b ∈ l) : TFAE (l ++ [a]) ↔ (a ↔ b) ∧ TFAE l
proof:
:= by
  simp [tfae_append_of_mem (l₁ := l) (l₂ := [a]) (b := a) h, iff_comm]

name: tfae_concat_of_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tfae_concat_of_mem (h : a ∈ l) : TFAE (l ++ [a]) ↔ TFAE l

name: tfae_of_cycle
statement:
theorem tfae_of_cycle (h_chain : List.IsChain (· → ·) (a :: b :: l))
    (h_last : getLastD l b → a) : TFAE (a :: b :: l)
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a b with
  | nil => simp_all [iff_def]
  | cons c l IH =>
    simp only [tfae_cons_cons, getLastD_cons, isChain_cons_cons] at *
    rcases h_chain with ⟨ab, ⟨bc, ch⟩⟩
    have := IH ⟨bc, ch⟩ (ab ∘ h_last)
    exact ⟨⟨ab, h_last ∘ (this.2 c (.head _) _ getLastD_mem_cons).1 ∘ bc⟩, this⟩

name: foldl_argAux_eq_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldl_argAux_eq_none : l.foldl (argAux r) o = none ↔ l = [] ∧ o = none
proof:
:=
  List.reverseRecOn l (by simp) fun tl hd => by
    simp only [foldl_append, foldl_cons, argAux, foldl_nil, append_eq_nil_iff]
    cases foldl (argAux r) o tl
    · simp
    · simp only
      split_ifs <;> simp

name: foldl_argAux_mem
statement: private theorem foldl_argAux_mem (l) : ∀ a m : α, m ∈ foldl (argAux r) (some a) l → m ∈ a :: l
proof:
:=
  List.reverseRecOn l (by simp [eq_comm]) <| by
    intro _ _ _ _
    simp only [foldl_append, foldl_cons, foldl_nil, argAux]
    cases _ : foldl _ _ _ <;> grind

name: argAux_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem argAux_self (hr₀ : Std.Irrefl r) (a : α) : argAux r (some a) a = a

name: not_of_mem_foldl_argAux
statement:
theorem not_of_mem_foldl_argAux (hr₀ : Std.Irrefl r) (hr₁ : IsTrans α r) :
    ∀ {a m : α} {o : Option α}, a ∈ l → m ∈ foldl (argAux r) o l → ¬r a m
proof:
:= by
  induction l using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => simp
  | append_singleton tl a ih => ?_
  intro b m o hb ho
  rw [foldl_append, foldl_cons, foldl_nil, argAux] at ho
  rcases hf : foldl (argAux r) o tl with - | c
  · rw [hf] at ho
    rw [foldl_argAux_eq_none] at hf
    simp_all [hf.1, hf.2, hr₀.irrefl _]
  rw [hf, Option.mem_def] at ho
  grind +splitIndPred

name: argmax_nil
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem argmax_nil (f : α → β) : argmax f [] = none

name: argmax_singleton
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem argmax_singleton {f : α → β} {a : α} : argmax f [a] = a

name: not_lt_of_mem_argmax
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem not_lt_of_mem_argmax : a ∈ l → m ∈ argmax f l → ¬f m < f a
proof:
:=
  not_of_mem_foldl_argAux _ ⟨fun x h => lt_irrefl (f x) h⟩
    ⟨fun _ _ z hxy hyz => lt_trans (a := f z) hyz hxy⟩

name: argmax_concat
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem argmax_concat (f : α → β) (a : α) (l : List α) :
    argmax f (l ++ [a]) =
      Option.casesOn (argmax f l) (some a) fun c => if f c < f a then some a else some c

name: argmax_mem
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem argmax_mem : ∀ {l : List α} {m : α}, m ∈ argmax f l → m ∈ l
  | [], m => by simp
  | hd :: tl, m => by simpa [argmax, argAux] using foldl_argAux_mem _ tl hd m

@[to_dual (attr := simp)]

name: argmax_eq_none
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem argmax_eq_none : l.argmax f = none ↔ l = []

name: le_of_mem_argmax
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem le_of_mem_argmax : a ∈ l → m ∈ argmax f l → f a ≤ f m
proof:
:= fun ha hm =>
  le_of_not_gt <| not_lt_of_mem_argmax ha hm

name: argmax_cons
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem argmax_cons (f : α → β) (a : α) (l : List α) :
    argmax f (a :: l) =
      Option.casesOn (argmax f l) (some a) fun c => if f a < f c then some c else some a
proof:
:=
  List.reverseRecOn l rfl fun hd tl ih => by
    rw [← cons_append, argmax_concat, ih, argmax_concat]
    rcases h : argmax f hd with - | m
    · simp
    dsimp
    rw [← apply_ite, ← apply_ite]
    grind -abstractProof

name: index_of_argmax
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem index_of_argmax :
    ∀ {l : List α} {m : α}, m ∈ argmax f l → ∀ {a}, a ∈ l → f m ≤ f a → l.idxOf m ≤ l.idxOf a
  | [], m, _, _, _, _ => by simp
  | hd :: tl, m, hm, a, ha, ham => by
    simp only [idxOf_cons, argmax_cons, Option.mem_def] at hm ⊢
    cases h : argmax f tl
    · rw [h] at hm
      simp_all
    rw [h] at hm
    dsimp only at hm
    simp only [beq_iff_eq]
    obtain ha | ha
proof:
:= ha <;> split_ifs at hm <;> injection hm with hm <;> subst hm
    · cases not_le_of_gt ‹_› ‹_›
    · rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
    · rw [ite_eq_right, ite_eq_right]
      · exact Nat.succ_le_succ (index_of_argmax h (by assumption) ham)
      · exact ne_of_apply_ne f (lt_of_lt_of_le ‹_› ‹_›).ne
      · exact ne_of_apply_ne _ ‹f hd < f _›.ne
    · rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
      exact Nat.zero_le _

name: mem_argmax_iff
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem mem_argmax_iff :
    m ∈ argmax f l ↔
      m ∈ l ∧ (∀ a ∈ l, f a ≤ f m) ∧ ∀ a ∈ l, f m ≤ f a → l.idxOf m ≤ l.idxOf a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hm => ⟨argmax_mem hm, fun _ ha => le_of_mem_argmax ha hm, fun _ => index_of_argmax hm⟩,
    by
      rintro ⟨hml, ham, hma⟩
      rcases harg : argmax f l with - | n
      · simp_all
      · have :=
          Nat.le_antisymm (hma n (argmax_mem harg) (le_of_mem_argmax hml harg))
            (index_of_argmax harg hml (ham _ (argmax_mem harg)))
        rw [(idxOf_inj hml).1 this, Option.mem_def]⟩

name: argmax_eq_some_iff
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem argmax_eq_some_iff :
    argmax f l = some m ↔
      m ∈ l ∧ (∀ a ∈ l, f a ≤ f m) ∧ ∀ a ∈ l, f m ≤ f a → l.idxOf m ≤ l.idxOf a

name: maximum_nil
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem maximum_nil : maximum ([] : List α) = ⊥

name: maximum_singleton
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem maximum_singleton (a : α) : maximum [a] = a

name: maximum_mem
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem maximum_mem {l : List α} {m : α} : (maximum l : WithTop α) = m → m ∈ l

name: maximum_eq_bot
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem maximum_eq_bot {l : List α} : l.maximum = ⊥ ↔ l = []

name: not_maximum_lt_of_mem
statement:
@[to_dual not_lt_minimum_of_mem]
theorem not_maximum_lt_of_mem : a ∈ l → (maximum l : WithBot α) = m → ¬m < a

name: not_maximum_lt_of_mem'
statement:
@[to_dual not_lt_minimum_of_mem']
theorem not_maximum_lt_of_mem' (ha : a ∈ l) : ¬maximum l < (a : WithBot α)
proof:
:= by
  cases h : l.maximum <;> simp_all [not_maximum_lt_of_mem ha]

name: maximum_concat
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem maximum_concat (a : α) (l : List α) : maximum (l ++ [a]) = max (maximum l) a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [maximum, argmax_concat, id]
  cases argmax id l
  · exact (max_eq_right bot_le).symm
  · simp [WithBot.some_eq_coe, max_def_lt, WithBot.coe_lt_coe]

name: le_maximum_of_mem
statement:
@[to_dual minimum_le_of_mem]
theorem le_maximum_of_mem : a ∈ l → (maximum l : WithBot α) = m → a ≤ m

name: le_maximum_of_mem'
statement:
@[to_dual minimum_le_of_mem']
theorem le_maximum_of_mem' (ha : a ∈ l) : (a : WithBot α) ≤ maximum l

name: maximum_cons
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem maximum_cons (a : α) (l : List α) : maximum (a :: l) = max ↑a (maximum l)
proof:
:=
  List.reverseRecOn l (by simp) fun tl hd ih => by
    rw [← cons_append, maximum_concat, ih, maximum_concat, max_assoc]

name: maximum_append
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma maximum_append (l₁ l₂ : List α) : (l₁ ++ l₂).maximum = max l₁.maximum l₂.maximum
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ with
  | nil => simp
  | cons _ _ ih => rw [maximum_cons, cons_append, maximum_cons, ih, ← max_assoc]

name: maximum_le_of_forall_le
statement:
@[to_dual le_minimum_of_forall_le]
theorem maximum_le_of_forall_le {b : WithBot α} (h : ∀ a ∈ l, a ≤ b) : l.maximum ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [maximum_cons, max_le_iff]
    exact ⟨h a (by simp), ih fun a w => h a (mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr w))⟩

name: maximum_mono
statement:
@[to_dual minimum_anti]
theorem maximum_mono {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h : l₁ ⊆ l₂) : l₁.maximum ≤ l₂.maximum

name: maximum_eq_coe_iff
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem maximum_eq_coe_iff : maximum l = m ↔ m ∈ l ∧ ∀ a ∈ l, a ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [maximum, ← WithBot.some_eq_coe, argmax_eq_some_iff]
  simp only [id_eq, and_congr_right_iff, and_iff_left_iff_imp]
  intro _ h a hal hma
  rw [_root_.le_antisymm hma (h a hal)]

name: coe_le_maximum_iff
statement:
@[to_dual minimum_le_coe_iff]
theorem coe_le_maximum_iff : a ≤ l.maximum ↔ ∃ b, b ∈ l ∧ a ≤ b

name: maximum_ne_bot_of_ne_nil
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem maximum_ne_bot_of_ne_nil (h : l ≠ []) : l.maximum ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  match l, h with | _ :: _, _ => by simp [maximum_cons]

name: maximum_ne_bot_of_length_pos
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem maximum_ne_bot_of_length_pos (h : 0 < l.length) : l.maximum ≠ ⊥
proof:
:=
  match l, h with | _ :: _, _ => by simp [maximum_cons]

name: coe_maximum_of_length_pos
statement:
@[to_dual /
def maximum_of_length_pos (h : 0 < l.length) : α :=
  WithBot.unbot l.maximum (maximum_ne_bot_of_length_pos h)

@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
lemma coe_maximum_of_length_pos (h : 0 < l.length) :
    (l.maximum_of_length_pos h : α) = l.maximum

name: le_maximum_of_length_pos_iff
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp) minimum_of_length_pos_le_iff]
theorem le_maximum_of_length_pos_iff {b : α} (h : 0 < l.length) :
    b ≤ maximum_of_length_pos h ↔ b ≤ l.maximum

name: maximum_of_length_pos_mem
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem maximum_of_length_pos_mem (h : 0 < l.length) :
    maximum_of_length_pos h ∈ l

name: le_maximum_of_length_pos_of_mem
statement:
@[to_dual minimum_of_length_pos_le_of_mem]
theorem le_maximum_of_length_pos_of_mem (h : a ∈ l) (w : 0 < l.length) :
    a ≤ l.maximum_of_length_pos w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [le_maximum_of_length_pos_iff]
  exact le_maximum_of_mem' h

name: getElem_le_maximum_of_length_pos
statement:
@[to_dual minimum_of_length_pos_le_getElem]
theorem getElem_le_maximum_of_length_pos {i : ℕ} (w : i < l.length) (h := (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt w)) :
    l[i] ≤ l.maximum_of_length_pos h

name: Perm.maximum_eq
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem Perm.maximum_eq {l l' : List α} (h : l ~ l') :
    l.maximum = l'.maximum

name: getD_max
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma getD_max?_eq_unbotD_maximum (l : List α) (d : α) : l.max?.getD d = l.maximum.unbotD d
proof:
:= by
  cases hy : l.maximum with
  | bot => simp [List.maximum_eq_bot.mp hy]
  | coe y =>
    rw [List.maximum_eq_coe_iff] at hy
    simp only [WithBot.unbotD_coe]
    cases hz : l.max? with
    | none => simp [List.max?_eq_none_iff.mp hz] at hy
    | some z =>
      have : Std.Antisymm (α := α) (· ≤ ·) := ⟨fun _ _ => _root_.le_antisymm⟩
      rw [List.max?_eq_some_iff] at hz
      · rw [Option.getD_some]
        exact _root_.le_antisymm (hy.right _ hz.left) (hz.right _ hy.left)

name: foldr_max_of_ne_nil
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem foldr_max_of_ne_nil (h : l ≠ []) : ↑(l.foldr max ⊥) = l.maximum
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => contradiction
  | cons hd tl IH =>
    rw [maximum_cons, foldr, WithBot.coe_max]
    by_cases h : tl = []
    · simp [h]
    · simp [IH h]

name: max_le_of_forall_le
statement:
@[to_dual le_min_of_forall_le]
theorem max_le_of_forall_le (l : List α) (a : α) (h : ∀ x ∈ l, x ≤ a) : l.foldr max ⊥ ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons y l IH => simpa [h y mem_cons_self] using IH fun x hx => h x <| mem_cons_of_mem _ hx

name: le_max_of_le
statement:
@[to_dual min_le_of_le]
theorem le_max_of_le {l : List α} {a x : α} (hx : x ∈ l) (h : a ≤ x) : a ≤ l.foldr max ⊥
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact absurd hx not_mem_nil
  | cons y l IH =>
    obtain hl | hl := hx
    · simp only [foldr]
      exact le_max_of_le_left h
    · exact le_max_of_le_right (IH (by assumption))

name: le_max_of_le'
statement:
@[to_dual min_le_of_le']
theorem le_max_of_le' {l : List α} {a x : α} (b : α) (hx : x ∈ l) (h : a ≤ x) :
    a ≤ l.foldr max b
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact absurd hx List.not_mem_nil
  | cons y l IH =>
    simp only [List.foldr]
    obtain rfl | hl := mem_cons.mp hx
    · exact le_max_of_le_left h
    · exact le_max_of_le_right (IH hl)

name: sublist_insertIdx
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sublist_insertIdx (l : List α) (n : ℕ) (a : α) : l <+ (l.insertIdx n a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [eraseIdx_insertIdx_self] using eraseIdx_sublist (l.insertIdx n a) n

name: subset_insertIdx
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subset_insertIdx (l : List α) (n : ℕ) (a : α) : l ⊆ l.insertIdx n a

name: insertIdx_eraseIdx_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insertIdx_eraseIdx_self {l : List α} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ length l) (a : α) :
    (l.eraseIdx n).insertIdx n a = l.set n a
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing l <;> cases l <;> simp_all

name: insertIdx_eraseIdx_getElem
statement:
theorem insertIdx_eraseIdx_getElem {l : List α} {n : ℕ} (hn : n < length l) :
    (l.eraseIdx n).insertIdx n l[n] = l

name: eq_or_mem_of_mem_insertIdx
statement:
theorem eq_or_mem_of_mem_insertIdx {l : List α} {n : ℕ} {a b : α} (h : a ∈ l.insertIdx n b) :
    a = b ∨ a ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge (length l) n with
  | inl hn =>
    rw [insertIdx_of_length_lt hn] at h
    exact .inr h
  | inr hn =>
    rwa [mem_insertIdx hn] at h

name: insertIdx_subset_cons
statement: theorem insertIdx_subset_cons (n : ℕ) (a : α) (l : List α) : l.insertIdx n a ⊆ a :: l
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  simpa using eq_or_mem_of_mem_insertIdx hb

name: insertIdx_pmap
statement:
theorem insertIdx_pmap {p : α → Prop} (f : ∀ a, p a → β) {l : List α} {a : α} {n : ℕ}
    (hl : ∀ x ∈ l, p x) (ha : p a) :
    (l.pmap f hl).insertIdx n (f a ha) = (l.insertIdx n a).pmap f
      (fun _ h ↦ (eq_or_mem_of_mem_insertIdx h).elim (fun heq ↦ heq ▸ ha) (hl _))
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing l with
  | zero => cases l <;> simp
  | succ n ihn => cases l <;> simp_all

name: map_insertIdx
statement:
theorem map_insertIdx (f : α → β) (l : List α) (n : ℕ) (a : α) :
    (l.insertIdx n a).map f = (l.map f).insertIdx n (f a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pmap_eq_map] using (insertIdx_pmap (fun a _ ↦ f a) (fun _ _ ↦ trivial) trivial).symm

name: eraseIdx_pmap
statement:
theorem eraseIdx_pmap {p : α → Prop} (f : ∀ a, p a → β) {l : List α} (hl : ∀ a ∈ l, p a) (n : ℕ) :
    (pmap f l hl).eraseIdx n = (l.eraseIdx n).pmap f fun a ha ↦ hl a (eraseIdx_subset ha)
proof:
:=
  match l, hl, n with
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | a :: _, _, 0 => rfl
  | a :: as, h, n + 1 => by rw [forall_mem_cons] at h; simp [eraseIdx_pmap f h.2 n]

name: eraseIdx_map
statement:
theorem eraseIdx_map (f : α → β) (l : List α) (n : ℕ) :
    (map f l).eraseIdx n = (l.eraseIdx n).map f
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pmap_eq_map] using eraseIdx_pmap (fun a _ ↦ f a) (fun _ _ ↦ trivial) n

name: get_insertIdx_of_lt
statement:
theorem get_insertIdx_of_lt (l : List α) (x : α) (n k : ℕ) (hn : k < n) (hk : k < l.length)
    (hk' : k < (l.insertIdx n x).length := by grind) :
    (l.insertIdx n x).get ⟨k, hk'⟩ = l.get ⟨k, hk⟩

name: get_insertIdx_self
statement:
theorem get_insertIdx_self (l : List α) (x : α) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ l.length)
    (hn' : n < (l.insertIdx n x).length :=
      (by rwa [length_insertIdx_of_le_length hn, Nat.lt_succ_iff])) :
    (l.insertIdx n x).get ⟨n, hn'⟩ = x

name: getElem_insertIdx_add_succ
statement:
theorem getElem_insertIdx_add_succ (l : List α) (x : α) (n k : ℕ) (hk' : n + k < l.length)
    (hk : n + k + 1 < (l.insertIdx n x).length := (by
      rwa [length_insertIdx_of_le_length (by lia), Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff])) :
    (l.insertIdx n x)[n + k + 1] = l[n + k]

name: get_insertIdx_add_succ
statement:
theorem get_insertIdx_add_succ (l : List α) (x : α) (n k : ℕ) (hk' : n + k < l.length)
    (hk : n + k + 1 < (l.insertIdx n x).length := (by
      rwa [length_insertIdx_of_le_length (by lia), Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff])) :
    (l.insertIdx n x).get ⟨n + k + 1, hk⟩ = get l ⟨n + k, hk'⟩

name: insertIdx_injective
statement:
theorem insertIdx_injective (n : ℕ) (x : α) :
    Function.Injective (fun l : List α => l.insertIdx n x)
proof:
:= by
  intro l₁ l₂ hl
  simpa using congr($hl |>.eraseIdx n)

name: take_insertIdx_eq_take_of_le
statement:
theorem take_insertIdx_eq_take_of_le (l : List α) x i j (h : i ≤ j) :
    (l.insertIdx j x).take i = l.take i

name: take_eraseIdx_eq_take_of_le
statement:
theorem take_eraseIdx_eq_take_of_le (l : List α) i j (h : i ≤ j) :
    (l.eraseIdx j).take i = l.take i

name: offDiag_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem offDiag_nil : offDiag ([] : List α) = []

name: offDiag_cons_perm
statement:
theorem offDiag_cons_perm (a : α) (l : List α) :
    offDiag (a :: l) ~ map (a, ·) l ++ map (·, a) l ++ l.offDiag
proof:
:= by
  simp only [offDiag, zipIdx_cons']
  have : map (fun x ↦ (x.fst, a)) l.zipIdx = map (·, a) l := by
    conv_rhs => rw [← zipIdx_map_fst 0 l, map_map, Function.comp_def]
  simp [append_assoc, perm_append_left_iff, flatMap_map,
    ← (map_append_flatMap_perm _ _ _).congr_left, this]

name: offDiag_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem offDiag_singleton (a : α) : offDiag [a] = []

name: length_offDiag'
statement: theorem length_offDiag' (l : List α) : length l.offDiag = length l * (length l - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ x ∈ l.zipIdx, length (eraseIdx l x.2) = length l - 1 := fun x hx ↦
    length_eraseIdx_of_lt <| snd_lt_of_mem_zipIdx hx
  simp [offDiag, map_congr_left this]

name: length_offDiag
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_offDiag (l : List α) : length l.offDiag = length l ^ 2 - length l

name: mem_offDiag_iff_getElem
statement:
theorem mem_offDiag_iff_getElem {x : α × α} :
    x ∈ l.offDiag ↔ ∃ (i : ℕ) (_ : i < l.length) (j : ℕ) (_ : j < l.length),
      i ≠ j ∧ l[i] = x.1 ∧ l[j] = x.2
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨x, y⟩
  simp only [offDiag, exists_mem_zipIdx, mem_eraseIdx_iff_getElem, mem_flatMap, mem_map,
    Nat.zero_add, Prod.ext_iff, ← exists_and_right, exists_and_left, @exists_comm α, and_assoc,
    exists_eq_left', ne_comm]

name: count_offDiag_eq_mul_sub_ite
statement:
theorem count_offDiag_eq_mul_sub_ite [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (a b : α) :
    count (a, b) l.offDiag = count a l * count b l - if a = b then count a l else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons c l ihl =>
    have H₁ {x y z : α} : count (x, y) (map (z, ·) l) = if z = x then count y l else 0 := by
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [h, count_map_of_injective l (x, ·) (by simp [Function.Injective])]
      · simp [count_eq_zero, h]
    have H₂ {x y z : α} : count (x, y) (map (·, z) l) = if z = y then count x l else 0 := by
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [h, count_map_of_injective l (·, y) (by simp [Function.Injective])]
      · simp [count_eq_zero, h]
    simp only [(offDiag_cons_perm _ _).count_eq, count_append, ihl, H₁, H₂, count_cons, beq_iff_eq]
    have := Nat.le_mul_self (count c l)
    split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> grind

name: Perm.offDiag
statement:
@[gcongr]
protected theorem Perm.offDiag {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h : l₁ ~ l₂) : l₁.offDiag ~ l₂.offDiag

name: Nodup.offDiag
statement: protected theorem Nodup.offDiag (h : l.Nodup) : l.offDiag.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  let := Classical.decEq α
  rw [nodup_iff_count_le_one]
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩
  rw [count_offDiag_eq_mul_sub_ite l x y]
  grind

name: Nodup.of_offDiag
statement: protected theorem Nodup.of_offDiag (h : l.offDiag.Nodup) : l.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  let := Classical.decEq α
  simp only [nodup_iff_count_le_one, Prod.forall, count_offDiag_eq_mul_sub_ite] at *
  intro a
  specialize h a a
  contrapose h
  rw [Nat.not_le] at h
  suffices 1 + l.count a < l.count a * l.count a by simpa
  calc
    1 + l.count a < l.count a + l.count a := by simpa
    _ ≤ l.count a * l.count a := by
      rw [← Nat.two_mul]
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h

name: nodup_offDiag
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nodup_offDiag : l.offDiag.Nodup ↔ l.Nodup

name: Nodup.mem_offDiag
statement:
theorem Nodup.mem_offDiag (h : l.Nodup) {x : α × α} :
    x ∈ l.offDiag ↔ x.1 ∈ l ∧ x.2 ∈ l ∧ x.1 ≠ x.2
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨x, y⟩
  simp_rw [mem_offDiag_iff_getElem, mem_iff_getElem, Ne]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, j, hj, hne, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩, mt h.getElem_inj_iff.1 hne⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩, hne⟩
    exact ⟨i, hi, j, hj, mt h.getElem_inj_iff.2 hne, rfl, rfl⟩

name: map_prodMap_offDiag
statement:
theorem map_prodMap_offDiag {β : Type*} (f : α → β) (l : List α) :
    map (Prod.map f f) l.offDiag = (map f l).offDiag
proof:
:= by
  simp [offDiag, map_flatMap, zipIdx_map, flatMap_map, eraseIdx_map, Function.comp_def]

name: lex_cons_iff
statement:
theorem lex_cons_iff {r : α → α → Prop} [Std.Irrefl r] {a l₁ l₂} :
    Lex r (a :: l₁) (a :: l₂) ↔ Lex r l₁ l₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by obtain - | h | h := h; exacts [(irrefl_of r a h).elim, h], Lex.cons⟩

name: lex_nil_or_eq_nil
statement: theorem lex_nil_or_eq_nil {r : α → α → Prop} (l : List α) : List.Lex r [] l ∨ l = []

name: lex_singleton_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lex_singleton_iff {r : α → α → Prop} (a b : α) : List.Lex r [a] [b] ↔ r a b

name: append_right
statement:
theorem append_right (r : α → α → Prop) : ∀ {s₁ s₂} (t), Lex r s₁ s₂ → Lex r s₁ (s₂ ++ t)
  | _, _, _, nil => nil
  | _, _, _, cons h => cons (append_right r _ h)
  | _, _, _, rel r => rel r

name: append_left
statement:
theorem append_left (R : α → α → Prop) {t₁ t₂} (h : Lex R t₁ t₂) : ∀ s, Lex R (s ++ t₁) (s ++ t₂)
  | [] => h
  | _ :: l => cons (append_left R h l)

name: imp
statement:
theorem imp {r s : α → α → Prop} (H : ∀ a b, r a b → s a b) : ∀ l₁ l₂, Lex r l₁ l₂ → Lex s l₁ l₂
  | _, _, nil => nil
  | _, _, cons h => cons (imp H _ _ h)
  | _, _, rel r => rel (H _ _ r)

name: to_ne
statement:
theorem to_ne : ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List α}, Lex (· ≠ ·) l₁ l₂ → l₁ ≠ l₂
  | _, _, cons h, e => to_ne h (List.cons.inj e).2
  | _, _, rel r, e => r (List.cons.inj e).1

name: _root_.Decidable.List.Lex.ne_iff
statement:
theorem _root_.Decidable.List.Lex.ne_iff [DecidableEq α] {l₁ l₂ : List α}
    (H : length l₁ ≤ length l₂) : Lex (· ≠ ·) l₁ l₂ ↔ l₁ ≠ l₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨to_ne, fun h => by
    induction l₁ generalizing l₂ <;> rcases l₂ with - | ⟨b, l₂⟩
    · contradiction
    · apply nil
    · exact (not_lt_of_ge H).elim (succ_pos _)
    case cons.cons a l₁ IH =>
      by_cases ab : a = b
      · subst b
        exact .cons <| IH (le_of_succ_le_succ H) (mt (congr_arg _) h)
      · exact .rel ab ⟩

name: ne_iff
statement: theorem ne_iff {l₁ l₂ : List α} (H : length l₁ ≤ length l₂) : Lex (· ≠ ·) l₁ l₂ ↔ l₁ ≠ l₂

name: lt_iff_lex_lt
statement: theorem lt_iff_lex_lt [LT α] (l l' : List α) : List.lt l l' ↔ Lex (· < ·) l l'

name: head_le_of_lt
statement:
theorem head_le_of_lt [Preorder α] {a a' : α} {l l' : List α} (h : (a' :: l') < (a :: l)) :
    a' ≤ a
proof:
:=
  match h with
  | .cons _ => le_rfl
  | .rel h => h.le

name: head
statement:
theorem head!_le_of_lt [Preorder α] [Inhabited α] (l l' : List α) (h : l' < l) (hl' : l' ≠ []) :
    l'.head! ≤ l.head!
proof:
:= by
  replace h : List.Lex (· < ·) l' l := h
  by_cases hl : l = []
  · simp [hl] at h
  · rw [← List.cons_head!_tail hl', ← List.cons_head!_tail hl] at h
    exact head_le_of_lt h

name: cons_le_cons
statement:
theorem cons_le_cons [LinearOrder α] (a : α) {l l' : List α} (h : l' ≤ l) :
    a :: l' ≤ a :: l
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_lt_or_eq] at h ⊢
  exact h.imp .cons (congr_arg _)

statement: theorem tfae_nil : TFAE []

@[simp]
theorem tfae_singleton (p) : TFAE [p]

statement:
@[simp]
theorem tfae_reverse : TFAE l.reverse ↔ TFAE l

statement: theorem tfae_of_forall (h : ∀ a ∈ l, a ↔ b) : TFAE l

theorem TFAE.out {l} (h : TFAE l) (i j : Nat) {a b}
    (h₁ : l[i - 1]? = some a := by rfl)

name: forall_tfae
statement:
theorem forall_tfae {α : Type*} (l : List (α → Prop)) (H : ∀ a : α, (l.map (fun p ↦ p a)).TFAE) :
    (l.map (fun p ↦ ∀ a, p a)).TFAE
proof:
:= by
  simp only [TFAE, List.forall_mem_map]
  intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂
  exact forall_congr' fun a ↦ H a (p₁ a) (mem_map_of_mem hp₁)
    (p₂ a) (mem_map_of_mem hp₂)

name: exists_tfae
statement:
theorem exists_tfae {α : Type*} (l : List (α → Prop)) (H : ∀ a : α, (l.map (fun p ↦ p a)).TFAE) :

proof:
:= by
  simp only [TFAE, List.forall_mem_map]
  intro p₁ hp₁ p₂ hp₂
  exact exists_congr fun a ↦ H a (p₁ a) (mem_map_of_mem hp₁)

name: permutationsAux2_fst
statement:
theorem permutationsAux2_fst (t : α) (ts : List α) (r : List β) :
    ∀ (ys : List α) (f : List α → β), (permutationsAux2 t ts r ys f).1 = ys ++ ts
  | [], _ => rfl
  | y :: ys, f => by simp [permutationsAux2, permutationsAux2_fst t _ _ ys]

@[simp]

name: permutationsAux2_snd_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem permutationsAux2_snd_nil (t : α) (ts : List α) (r : List β) (f : List α → β) :
    (permutationsAux2 t ts r [] f).2 = r

name: permutationsAux2_snd_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem permutationsAux2_snd_cons (t : α) (ts : List α) (r : List β) (y : α) (ys : List α)
    (f : List α → β) :
    (permutationsAux2 t ts r (y :: ys) f).2 =
      f (t :: y :: ys ++ ts) :: (permutationsAux2 t ts r ys fun x : List α => f (y :: x)).2

name: permutationsAux2_append
statement:
theorem permutationsAux2_append (t : α) (ts : List α) (r : List β) (ys : List α) (f : List α → β) :
    (permutationsAux2 t ts nil ys f).2 ++ r = (permutationsAux2 t ts r ys f).2
proof:
:= by
  induction ys generalizing f <;> simp [*]

name: permutationsAux2_comp_append
statement:
theorem permutationsAux2_comp_append {t : α} {ts ys : List α} {r : List β} (f : List α → β) :
    ((permutationsAux2 t [] r ys) fun x => f (x ++ ts)).2 = (permutationsAux2 t ts r ys f).2
proof:
:= by
  induction ys generalizing f with
  | nil => simp
  | cons ys_hd _ ys_ih => simp [ys_ih fun xs => f (ys_hd :: xs)]

name: map_permutationsAux2'
statement:
theorem map_permutationsAux2' {α' β'} (g : α → α') (g' : β → β') (t : α) (ts ys : List α)
    (r : List β) (f : List α → β) (f' : List α' → β') (H : ∀ a, g' (f a) = f' (map g a)) :
    map g' (permutationsAux2 t ts r ys f).2 =
      (permutationsAux2 (g t) (map g ts) (map g' r) (map g ys) f').2
proof:
:= by
  induction ys generalizing f f' with
  | nil => simp
  | cons ys_hd _ ys_ih =>
    simp only [map, permutationsAux2_snd_cons, cons_append, cons.injEq]
    rw [ys_ih]
    · refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
      simp only [← map_cons, ← map_append]; apply H
    · intro a; apply H

name: map_permutationsAux2
statement:
theorem map_permutationsAux2 (t : α) (ts : List α) (ys : List α) (f : List α → β) :
    (permutationsAux2 t ts [] ys id).2.map f = (permutationsAux2 t ts [] ys f).2
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_permutationsAux2' id, map_id, map_id]
  · rfl
  simp

name: permutationsAux2_snd_eq
statement:
theorem permutationsAux2_snd_eq (t : α) (ts : List α) (r : List β) (ys : List α) (f : List α → β) :
    (permutationsAux2 t ts r ys f).2 =
      ((permutationsAux2 t [] [] ys id).2.map fun x => f (x ++ ts)) ++ r

name: map_map_permutationsAux2
statement:
theorem map_map_permutationsAux2 {α'} (g : α → α') (t : α) (ts ys : List α) :
    map (map g) (permutationsAux2 t ts [] ys id).2 =
      (permutationsAux2 (g t) (map g ts) [] (map g ys) id).2

name: map_map_permutations'Aux
statement:
theorem map_map_permutations'Aux (f : α → β) (t : α) (ts : List α) :
    map (map f) (permutations'Aux t ts) = permutations'Aux (f t) (map f ts)
proof:
:= by
  induction ts with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a ts ih => simp only [permutations'Aux, map_cons, map_map, ← ih, Function.comp_def]

name: permutations'Aux_eq_permutationsAux2
statement:
theorem permutations'Aux_eq_permutationsAux2 (t : α) (ts : List α) :
    permutations'Aux t ts = (permutationsAux2 t [] [ts ++ [t]] ts id).2
proof:
:= by
  induction ts with | nil => rfl | cons a ts ih => ?_
  simp only [permutations'Aux, ih, cons_append, permutationsAux2_snd_cons, append_nil, id_eq,
    cons.injEq, true_and]
  simp +singlePass only [← permutationsAux2_append]
  simp [map_permutationsAux2]

name: mem_permutationsAux2
statement:
theorem mem_permutationsAux2 {t : α} {ts : List α} {ys : List α} {l l' : List α} :
    l' ∈ (permutationsAux2 t ts [] ys (l ++ ·)).2 ↔
      ∃ l₁ l₂, l₂ ≠ [] ∧ ys = l₁ ++ l₂ ∧ l' = l ++ l₁ ++ t :: l₂ ++ ts
proof:
:= by
  induction ys generalizing l with
  | nil => simp +contextual
  | cons y ys ih => ?_
  rw [permutationsAux2_snd_cons,
    show (fun x : List α => l ++ y :: x) = (l ++ [y] ++ ·) by simp, mem_cons, ih]
  constructor
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨l₁, l₂, l0, rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨[], y :: ys, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨y :: l₁, l₂, l0, by simp⟩
  · rintro ⟨_ | ⟨y', l₁⟩, l₂, l0, ye, rfl⟩
    · simp [ye]
    · simp only [cons_append] at ye
      rcases ye with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact Or.inr ⟨l₁, l₂, l0, by simp⟩

name: mem_permutationsAux2'
statement:
theorem mem_permutationsAux2' {t : α} {ts : List α} {ys : List α} {l : List α} :
    l ∈ (permutationsAux2 t ts [] ys id).2 ↔
      ∃ l₁ l₂, l₂ ≠ [] ∧ ys = l₁ ++ l₂ ∧ l = l₁ ++ t :: l₂ ++ ts
proof:
:= by
  rw [show @id (List α) = ([] ++ ·) by funext _; rfl]; apply mem_permutationsAux2

name: length_permutationsAux2
statement:
theorem length_permutationsAux2 (t : α) (ts : List α) (ys : List α) (f : List α → β) :
    length (permutationsAux2 t ts [] ys f).2 = length ys
proof:
:= by
  induction ys generalizing f <;> simp [*]

name: foldr_permutationsAux2
statement:
theorem foldr_permutationsAux2 (t : α) (ts : List α) (r L : List (List α)) :
    foldr (fun y r => (permutationsAux2 t ts r y id).2) r L =
      (L.flatMap fun y => (permutationsAux2 t ts [] y id).2) ++ r
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons l L ih => simp_rw [foldr_cons, ih, flatMap_cons, append_assoc, permutationsAux2_append]

name: mem_foldr_permutationsAux2
statement:
theorem mem_foldr_permutationsAux2 {t : α} {ts : List α} {r L : List (List α)} {l' : List α} :
    l' ∈ foldr (fun y r => (permutationsAux2 t ts r y id).2) r L ↔
      l' ∈ r ∨ ∃ l₁ l₂, l₁ ++ l₂ ∈ L ∧ l₂ ≠ [] ∧ l' = l₁ ++ t :: l₂ ++ ts
proof:
:= by
  have :
    (∃ a : List α,
        a ∈ L ∧ ∃ l₁ l₂ : List α, ¬l₂ = nil ∧ a = l₁ ++ l₂ ∧ l' = l₁ ++ t :: (l₂ ++ ts)) ↔
      ∃ l₁ l₂ : List α, ¬l₂ = nil ∧ l₁ ++ l₂ ∈ L ∧ l' = l₁ ++ t :: (l₂ ++ ts) :=
    ⟨fun ⟨_, aL, l₁, l₂, l0, e, h⟩ => ⟨l₁, l₂, l0, e ▸ aL, h⟩, fun ⟨l₁, l₂, l0, aL, h⟩ =>
      ⟨_, aL, l₁, l₂, l0, rfl, h⟩⟩
  rw [foldr_permutationsAux2]
  simp only [mem_permutationsAux2', ← this, or_comm, and_left_comm, mem_append, mem_flatMap,
    append_assoc, cons_append]

name: length_foldr_permutationsAux2
statement:
theorem length_foldr_permutationsAux2 (t : α) (ts : List α) (r L : List (List α)) :
    length (foldr (fun y r => (permutationsAux2 t ts r y id).2) r L) =
      (map length L).sum + length r

name: length_foldr_permutationsAux2'
statement:
theorem length_foldr_permutationsAux2' (t : α) (ts : List α) (r L : List (List α)) (n)
    (H : ∀ l ∈ L, length l = n) :
    length (foldr (fun y r => (permutationsAux2 t ts r y id).2) r L) = n * length L + length r
proof:
:= by
  rw [length_foldr_permutationsAux2, (_ : (map length L).sum = n * length L)]
  induction L with
  | nil => simp
  | cons l L ih =>
    have sum_map : (map length L).sum = n * length L := ih fun l m => H l (mem_cons_of_mem _ m)
    have length_l : length l = n := H _ mem_cons_self
    simp [sum_map, length_l, Nat.add_comm, mul_succ]

name: permutationsAux_nil
statement:

theorem permutationsAux_nil (is : List α) : permutationsAux [] is = []

name: permutationsAux_cons
statement:

theorem permutationsAux_cons (t : α) (ts is : List α) :
    permutationsAux (t :: ts) is =

name: map_permutationsAux
statement:
theorem map_permutationsAux (f : α → β) :
    ∀ ts is :
    List α, map (map f) (permutationsAux ts is) = permutationsAux (map f ts) (map f is)
proof:
:= by
  refine permutationsAux.rec (by simp) ?_
  introv IH1 IH2; rw [map] at IH2
  simp only [foldr_permutationsAux2, map_append, map, map_map_permutationsAux2, permutations,
    flatMap_map, IH1, append_assoc, permutationsAux_cons, flatMap_cons, ← IH2, map_flatMap]

name: map_permutations
statement:
theorem map_permutations (f : α → β) (ts : List α) :
    map (map f) (permutations ts) = permutations (map f ts)
proof:
:= by
  rw [permutations, permutations, map, map_permutationsAux, map]

name: map_permutations'
statement:
theorem map_permutations' (f : α → β) (ts : List α) :
    map (map f) (permutations' ts) = permutations' (map f ts)
proof:
:= by
  induction ts with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons t ts ih => simp [← ih, map_flatMap, ← map_map_permutations'Aux, flatMap_map]

name: permutationsAux_append
statement:
theorem permutationsAux_append (is is' ts : List α) :
    permutationsAux (is ++ ts) is' =
      (permutationsAux is is').map (· ++ ts) ++ permutationsAux ts (is.reverse ++ is')
proof:
:= by
  induction is generalizing is' with | nil => simp | cons t is ih =>
  simp only [foldr_permutationsAux2, ih, map_flatMap, cons_append, permutationsAux_cons, map_append,
    reverse_cons, append_assoc]
  congr 2
  funext _
  rw [map_permutationsAux2]
  simp +singlePass only [← permutationsAux2_comp_append]
  simp only [id, append_assoc]

name: permutations_append
statement:
theorem permutations_append (is ts : List α) :
    permutations (is ++ ts) = (permutations is).map (· ++ ts) ++ permutationsAux ts is.reverse

name: perm_of_mem_permutationsAux
statement:
theorem perm_of_mem_permutationsAux :
    ∀ {ts is l : List α}, l ∈ permutationsAux ts is → l ~ ts ++ is
proof:
:= by
  show ∀ (ts is l : List α), l ∈ permutationsAux ts is → l ~ ts ++ is
  refine permutationsAux.rec (by simp) ?_
  introv IH1 IH2 m
  rw [permutationsAux_cons, permutations, mem_foldr_permutationsAux2] at m
  rcases m with (m | ⟨l₁, l₂, m, _, rfl⟩)
  · exact (IH1 _ m).trans perm_middle
  · have p : l₁ ++ l₂ ~ is := by
      simp only [mem_cons] at m
      rcases m with e | m
      · simp [e]
      exact is.append_nil ▸ IH2 _ m
    exact ((perm_middle.trans (p.cons _)).append_right _).trans (perm_append_comm.cons _)

name: perm_of_mem_permutations
statement: theorem perm_of_mem_permutations {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h : l₁ ∈ permutations l₂) : l₁ ~ l₂
proof:
:=
  (eq_or_mem_of_mem_cons h).elim (fun e => e ▸ Perm.refl _) fun m =>
    append_nil l₂ ▸ perm_of_mem_permutationsAux m

name: length_permutationsAux
statement:
theorem length_permutationsAux :
    ∀ ts is : List α, length (permutationsAux ts is) + is.length ! = (length ts + length is)!
proof:
:= by
  refine permutationsAux.rec (by simp) ?_
  intro t ts is IH1 IH2
  have IH2 : length (permutationsAux is nil) + 1 = is.length ! := by simpa using IH2
  simp only [List.length_cons, factorial, Nat.mul_comm, add_eq] at IH1
  rw [permutationsAux_cons,
    length_foldr_permutationsAux2' _ _ _ _ _ fun l m => (perm_of_mem_permutations m).length_eq,
    permutations, length, length, IH2, Nat.succ_add, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.mul_comm (_ + 1),
    ← Nat.succ_eq_add_one, ← IH1, Nat.add_comm (_ * _), Nat.add_assoc, Nat.mul_succ, Nat.mul_comm]

name: length_permutations
statement: theorem length_permutations (l : List α) : length (permutations l) = (length l)!

name: mem_permutations_of_perm_lemma
mem_permutationsAux_of_perm
statement:
theorem mem_permutationsAux_of_perm :
    ∀ {ts is l : List α},
      l ~ is ++ ts → (∃ (is' : _) (_ : is' ~ is), l = is' ++ ts) ∨ l ∈ permutationsAux ts is
proof:
:= by
  show ∀ (ts is l : List α),
      l ~ is ++ ts → (∃ (is' : _) (_ : is' ~ is), l = is' ++ ts) ∨ l ∈ permutationsAux ts is
  refine permutationsAux.rec (by simp) ?_
  intro t ts is IH1 IH2 l p
  rw [permutationsAux_cons, mem_foldr_permutationsAux2]
  rcases IH1 _ (p.trans perm_middle) with (⟨is', p', e⟩ | m)
  · clear p
    subst e
    rcases append_of_mem (p'.symm.subset mem_cons_self) with ⟨l₁, l₂, e⟩
    subst is'
    have p := (perm_middle.symm.trans p').cons_inv
    rcases l₂ with - | ⟨a, l₂'⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨l₁, by simpa using p⟩
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨l₁, a :: l₂', mem_permutations_of_perm_lemma (IH2 _) p, by simp⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl m)

name: perm_permutations'Aux_comm
statement:
theorem perm_permutations'Aux_comm (a b : α) (l : List α) :
    (permutations'Aux a l).flatMap (permutations'Aux b) ~
      (permutations'Aux b l).flatMap (permutations'Aux a)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact Perm.swap [a, b] [b, a] []
  | cons c l ih => ?_
  simp only [permutations'Aux, flatMap_cons, map_cons, map_map, cons_append]
  apply Perm.swap'
  have :
    ∀ a b,
      (map (cons c) (permutations'Aux a l)).flatMap (permutations'Aux b) ~
        map (cons b ∘ cons c) (permutations'Aux a l) ++
          map (cons c) ((permutations'Aux a l).flatMap (permutations'Aux b)) := by
    intro a' b'
    simp only [flatMap_map, permutations'Aux]
    change (permutations'Aux _ l).flatMap (fun a => ([b' :: c :: a] ++
      map (cons c) (permutations'Aux _ a))) ~ _
    refine (flatMap_append_perm _ (fun x => [b' :: c :: x]) _).symm.trans ?_
    rw [← map_eq_flatMap, ← map_flatMap]
    exact Perm.refl _
  refine (((this _ _).append_left _).trans ?_).trans ((this _ _).append_left _).symm
  rw [← append_assoc, ← append_assoc]
  exact perm_append_comm.append (ih.map _)

name: Perm.permutations'
statement: theorem Perm.permutations' {s t : List α} (p : s ~ t) : permutations' s ~ permutations' t
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | cons _ _ IH => exact IH.flatMap_right _
  | swap =>
    dsimp
    rw [flatMap_assoc, flatMap_assoc]
    apply Perm.flatMap_left
    intro l' _
    apply perm_permutations'Aux_comm
  | trans _ _ IH₁ IH₂ => exact IH₁.trans IH₂

name: permutations_perm_permutations'
statement: theorem permutations_perm_permutations' (ts : List α) : ts.permutations ~ ts.permutations'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, h⟩ : ∃ n, length ts < n := ⟨_, Nat.lt_succ_self _⟩
  induction n generalizing ts with | zero => cases h | succ n IH => ?_
  refine List.reverseRecOn ts (fun _ => ?_) (fun ts t _ h => ?_) h; · simp [permutations]
  rw [← concat_eq_append, length_concat, Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff] at h
  have IH₂ := (IH ts.reverse (by rwa [length_reverse])).trans (reverse_perm _).permutations'
  simp only [permutations_append, foldr_permutationsAux2, permutationsAux_nil,
    permutationsAux_cons, append_nil]
  refine
    (perm_append_comm.trans ((IH₂.flatMap_right _).append ((IH _ h).map _))).trans
      (Perm.trans ?_ perm_append_comm.permutations')
  rw [map_eq_flatMap, singleton_append, permutations']
  refine (flatMap_append_perm _ _ _).trans ?_
  refine Perm.of_eq ?_
  congr
  funext _
  rw [permutations'Aux_eq_permutationsAux2, permutationsAux2_append]

statement:

theorem mem_permutations' {s t : List α} : s ∈ permutations' t ↔ s ~ t

name: getElem_permutations'Aux
statement:
theorem getElem_permutations'Aux (s : List α) (x : α) (n : ℕ)
    (hn : n < length (permutations'Aux x s)) :
    (permutations'Aux x s)[n] = s.insertIdx n x
proof:
:= by
  induction s generalizing n with
  | nil =>
    simp only [permutations'Aux, length, Nat.zero_add, lt_one_iff] at hn
    simp [hn]
  | cons y s IH =>
    cases n
    · simp
    · simpa [get] using IH _ _

name: DecEq_eq
statement:
private theorem DecEq_eq [DecidableEq α] :
    List.instBEq = @instBEqOfDecidableEq (List α) instDecidableEqList
proof:
:=
  congr_arg BEq.mk <| by
    funext l₁ l₂
    change (l₁ == l₂) = _
    rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, @beq_iff_eq _ (_), decide_eq_true_iff]

name: count_permutations'Aux_self
statement:
theorem count_permutations'Aux_self [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) :
    count (x :: l) (permutations'Aux x l) = length (takeWhile (x = ·) l) + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing x with
  | nil => simp [takeWhile, count]
  | cons y l IH =>
    rw [permutations'Aux, count_cons_self]
    by_cases hx : x = y
    · subst hx
      simpa [takeWhile, Nat.succ_inj, DecEq_eq] using IH _
    · rw [takeWhile]
      simp only [mem_map, cons.injEq, Ne.symm hx, false_and, and_false, exists_false,
        not_false_iff, count_eq_zero_of_not_mem, Nat.zero_add, hx, decide_false, length_nil]

statement:

theorem length_permutations'Aux (s : List α) (x : α) :

proof:

name: injective_permutations'Aux
statement: theorem injective_permutations'Aux (x : α) : Function.Injective (permutations'Aux x)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  apply insertIdx_injective s.length x
  dsimp
  have hl : s.length = t.length := by simpa using congr_arg length h
  rw [← get_permutations'Aux s x s.length (by simp),
    ← get_permutations'Aux t x s.length (by simp [hl])]
  simp only [get_eq_getElem, h, hl]

name: nodup_permutations'Aux_of_notMem
statement:
theorem nodup_permutations'Aux_of_notMem (s : List α) (x : α) (hx : x ∉ s) :
    Nodup (permutations'Aux x s)
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | nil => simp
  | cons y s IH =>
    simp only [not_or, mem_cons] at hx
    simp only [permutations'Aux, nodup_cons, mem_map, cons.injEq, exists_eq_right_right, not_and]
    refine ⟨fun _ => Ne.symm hx.left, ?_⟩
    rw [nodup_map_iff]
    · exact IH hx.right
    · simp

name: nodup_permutations'Aux_iff
statement: theorem nodup_permutations'Aux_iff {s : List α} {x : α} : Nodup (permutations'Aux x s) ↔ x ∉ s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h H ↦ ?_, nodup_permutations'Aux_of_notMem _ _⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, hk'⟩ := get_of_mem H
  rw [nodup_iff_injective_get] at h
  apply k.succ_ne_self.symm
  have kl : k < (permutations'Aux x s).length := by simpa [Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hk.le
  have k1l : k + 1 < (permutations'Aux x s).length := by simpa using hk
  rw [← @Fin.mk.inj_iff _ _ _ kl k1l]; apply h
  rw [get_permutations'Aux, get_permutations'Aux]
  have hl : length (s.insertIdx k x) = length (s.insertIdx (k + 1) x) := by
    rw [length_insertIdx_of_le_length hk.le, length_insertIdx_of_le_length (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk)]
  exact ext_get hl fun n hn hn' => by grind

name: nodup_permutations
statement: theorem nodup_permutations (s : List α) (hs : Nodup s) : Nodup s.permutations
proof:
:= by
  rw [(permutations_perm_permutations' s).nodup_iff]
  induction hs with
  | nil => simp
  | @cons x l h h' IH =>
    rw [permutations']
    rw [nodup_flatMap]
    constructor
    · intro ys hy
      rw [mem_permutations'] at hy
      rw [nodup_permutations'Aux_iff, hy.mem_iff]
      exact fun H => h x H rfl
    · refine IH.pairwise_of_forall_ne fun as ha bs hb H => ?_
      rw [Function.onFun, disjoint_iff_ne]
      rintro a ha' b hb' rfl
      obtain ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, hn'⟩ := get_of_mem ha'
      obtain ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, hm'⟩ := get_of_mem hb'
      rw [mem_permutations'] at ha hb
      have hl : as.length = bs.length := (ha.trans hb.symm).length_eq
      simp only [Nat.lt_succ_iff, length_permutations'Aux] at hn hm
      rw [get_permutations'Aux] at hn' hm'
      have hx : (as.insertIdx n x)[m]'(by
          rwa [length_insertIdx_of_le_length hn, Nat.lt_succ_iff, hl]) = x := by
        simp [hn', ← hm']
      have hx' : (bs.insertIdx m x)[n]'(by
          rwa [length_insertIdx_of_le_length hm, Nat.lt_succ_iff, ← hl]) = x := by
        simp [hm', ← hn']
      rcases lt_trichotomy n m with (ht | ht | ht)
      · suffices x ∈ bs by exact h x (hb.subset this) rfl
        rw [← hx', getElem_insertIdx_of_lt ht]
        exact getElem_mem _
      · simp only [ht] at hm' hn'
        rw [← hm'] at hn'
        exact H (insertIdx_injective _ _ hn')
      · suffices x ∈ as by exact h x (ha.subset this) rfl
        rw [← hx, getElem_insertIdx_of_lt ht]
        exact getElem_mem _

name: permutations_take_two
statement:
lemma permutations_take_two (x y : α) (s : List α) :

name: nodup_permutations_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nodup_permutations_iff {s : List α} : Nodup s.permutations ↔ Nodup s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, nodup_permutations s⟩
  contrapose
  rw [← exists_duplicate_iff_not_nodup]
  intro ⟨x, hs⟩
  rw [duplicate_iff_sublist] at hs
  obtain ⟨l, ht⟩ := List.Sublist.exists_perm_append hs
  rw [List.Perm.nodup_iff (List.Perm.permutations ht), ← exists_duplicate_iff_not_nodup]
  use x :: x :: l
  rw [List.duplicate_iff_sublist, ← permutations_take_two]
  exact take_sublist 2 _

statement:
theorem nodupKeys_middle {s : Sigma β} :
    (l₁ ++ s :: l₂).NodupKeys ↔ (s :: (l₁ ++ l₂)).NodupKeys

name: notMem_keys_of_nodupKeys_cons
statement:
theorem notMem_keys_of_nodupKeys_cons {s : Sigma β} {l : List (Sigma β)} (h : NodupKeys (s :: l)) :
    s.1 ∉ l.keys

name: nodupKeys_of_nodupKeys_cons
statement:
theorem nodupKeys_of_nodupKeys_cons {s : Sigma β} {l : List (Sigma β)} (h : NodupKeys (s :: l)) :

name: NodupKeys.eq_of_fst_eq
statement:
theorem NodupKeys.eq_of_fst_eq {l : List (Sigma β)} (nd : NodupKeys l) {s s' : Sigma β} (h : s ∈ l)
    (h' : s' ∈ l) : s.1 = s'.1 → s = s'
proof:
:=
  @Pairwise.forall_of_forall _ (fun s s' : Sigma β => s.1 = s'.1 → s = s') _
    ⟨fun _ _ H h => (H h.symm).symm⟩ (fun _ _ _ => rfl)
    ((nodupKeys_iff_pairwise.1 nd).imp fun h h' => (h h').elim) _ h _ h'

name: NodupKeys.eq_of_mk_mem
statement:
theorem NodupKeys.eq_of_mk_mem {a : α} {b b' : β a} {l : List (Sigma β)} (nd : NodupKeys l)
    (h : Sigma.mk a b ∈ l) (h' : Sigma.mk a b' ∈ l) : b = b'

statement: theorem nodupKeys_singleton (s : Sigma β) : NodupKeys [s]

name: NodupKeys.sublist
statement: theorem NodupKeys.sublist {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)} (h : l₁ <+ l₂) : NodupKeys l₂ → NodupKeys l₁

@[grind →]
protected theorem NodupKeys.nodup {l : List (Sigma β)} : NodupKeys l → Nodup l
