name: nodupKeys_flatten
statement:
theorem nodupKeys_flatten {L : List (List (Sigma β))} :
    NodupKeys (flatten L) ↔ (∀ l ∈ L, NodupKeys l) ∧ Pairwise Disjoint (L.map keys)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nodupKeys_iff_pairwise, pairwise_flatten, pairwise_map]
  refine and_congr (forall₂_congr fun l _ => by simp [nodupKeys_iff_pairwise]) ?_
  simp [keys, disjoint_iff_ne, Sigma.forall]

name: nodup_zipIdx_map_snd
statement: theorem nodup_zipIdx_map_snd (l : List α) : (l.zipIdx.map Prod.snd).Nodup

name: mem_ext
statement:
theorem mem_ext {l₀ l₁ : List (Sigma β)} (nd₀ : l₀.Nodup) (nd₁ : l₁.Nodup)
    (h : ∀ x, x ∈ l₀ ↔ x ∈ l₁) : l₀ ~ l₁

name: dlookup_nil
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem dlookup_nil (a : α) : dlookup a [] = @none (β a)

name: dlookup_cons_eq
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem dlookup_cons_eq (l) (a : α) (b : β a) : dlookup a (⟨a, b⟩ :: l) = some b

name: dlookup_cons_ne
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem dlookup_cons_ne (l) {a} : ∀ s : Sigma β, a ≠ s.1 → dlookup a (s :: l) = dlookup a l
  | ⟨_, _⟩, h => dite_eq_right h.symm

@[grind =]

name: dlookup_isSome
statement:
@[grind =]
theorem dlookup_isSome {a : α} {l : List (Sigma β)} : (dlookup a l).isSome ↔ a ∈ l.keys
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons s _ _ => by_cases a = s.fst <;> grind

name: dlookup_eq_none
statement: theorem dlookup_eq_none {a : α} {l : List (Sigma β)} : dlookup a l = none ↔ a ∉ l.keys

name: of_mem_dlookup
statement:
theorem of_mem_dlookup {a : α} {b : β a} {l : List (Sigma β)} :
    b ∈ dlookup a l → Sigma.mk a b ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => grind
  | cons s _ _ => by_cases a = s.fst <;> grind

name: mem_dlookup
statement:
theorem mem_dlookup {a} {b : β a} {l : List (Sigma β)} (nd : l.NodupKeys) (h : Sigma.mk a b ∈ l) :
    b ∈ dlookup a l
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b', h'⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp (dlookup_isSome.mpr (mem_keys_of_mem h))
  cases nd.eq_of_mk_mem h (of_mem_dlookup h')
  exact h'

name: map_dlookup_eq_find
statement:
theorem map_dlookup_eq_find (a : α) (l : List (Sigma β)) :
    (dlookup a l).map (Sigma.mk a) = find? (fun s => a = s.1) l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => grind
  | cons s _ _ => by_cases s.fst = a <;> grind

name: mem_dlookup_iff
statement:
theorem mem_dlookup_iff {a : α} {b : β a} {l : List (Sigma β)} (nd : l.NodupKeys) :
    b ∈ dlookup a l ↔ Sigma.mk a b ∈ l

name: perm_dlookup
statement:
theorem perm_dlookup (a : α) {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)} (nd₁ : l₁.NodupKeys) (p : l₁ ~ l₂) :
    dlookup a l₁ = dlookup a l₂
proof:
:= by
  have nd₂ := (perm_nodupKeys p).mp nd₁
  ext b; simp only [← Option.mem_def, mem_dlookup_iff nd₁, mem_dlookup_iff nd₂, p.mem_iff]

name: lookup_ext
statement:
theorem lookup_ext {l₀ l₁ : List (Sigma β)} (nd₀ : l₀.NodupKeys) (nd₁ : l₁.NodupKeys)
    (h : ∀ x y, y ∈ l₀.dlookup x ↔ y ∈ l₁.dlookup x) : l₀ ~ l₁

name: dlookup_map
statement:
theorem dlookup_map (l : List (Sigma β))
    {f : α → α'} (hf : Function.Injective f) (g : ∀ a, β a → β' (f a)) (a : α) :
    (l.map (.map f g)).dlookup (f a) = (l.dlookup a).map (g a)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => grind
  | cons s _ _ =>
    have (h : a ≠ s.fst) : ¬ f a = (⟨f s.fst, g s.fst s.snd⟩ : Sigma β').fst := fun he => h <| hf he
    by_cases a = s.fst <;> grind [Sigma.map]

name: dlookup_map
statement:
theorem dlookup_map₁ {β : Type v} (l : List (Σ _ : α, β))
    {f : α → α'} (hf : Function.Injective f) (a : α) :
    (l.map (.map f fun _ => id) : List (Σ _ : α', β)).dlookup (f a) = l.dlookup a
proof:
:= by
  have := dlookup_map (β' := fun _ => β) (f := f) (g := fun _ => id)
  grind [Option.map_id']

name: dlookup_map
statement:
theorem dlookup_map₂ {γ δ : α → Type*} {l : List (Σ a, γ a)} {f : ∀ a, γ a → δ a} (a : α) :
    (l.map (.map id f) : List (Σ a, δ a)).dlookup a = (l.dlookup a).map (f a)

name: NodupKeys.map
statement:
theorem NodupKeys.map₁ {β : Type v} (f : α → α') (hf : Function.Injective f) {l : List (Σ _ : α, β)}
    (nd : l.NodupKeys) : (l.map (.map f fun _ => id) : List (Σ _ : α', β)).NodupKeys
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact nodupKeys_nil
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [map_cons, nodupKeys_cons] at nd ⊢
    exact ⟨mt (fun h => by
      simp only [keys, map_map] at h ⊢
      obtain ⟨x, hm, he⟩ := mem_map.mp h
      exact mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hm, hf he⟩) nd.1, ih nd.2⟩

name: map
statement:
theorem map₂_keys {β β' : α → Type*} (f : (a : α) → β a → β' a) (l : List (Σ a, β a)) :
    (l.map (.map id f)).keys = l.keys

name: NodupKeys.map
statement:
theorem NodupKeys.map₂ {β β' : α → Type*} (f : (a : α) → β a → β' a) (l : List (Σ a, β a))
    (nd : l.NodupKeys) : (l.map (.map id f)).NodupKeys

name: dlookup_append
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem dlookup_append (l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)) (a : α) :
    (l₁ ++ l₂).dlookup a = (l₁.dlookup a).or (l₂.dlookup a)
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s _ _ => by_cases a = s.fst <;> grind

name: sublist_dlookup
statement:
theorem sublist_dlookup {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)} {a : α} {b : β a}
    (nd₂ : l₂.NodupKeys) (s : l₁ <+ l₂) (mem : b ∈ l₁.dlookup a) : b ∈ l₂.dlookup a

name: lookupAll_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookupAll_nil (a : α) : lookupAll a [] = @nil (β a)

name: lookupAll_cons_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookupAll_cons_eq (l) (a : α) (b : β a) : lookupAll a (⟨a, b⟩ :: l) = b :: lookupAll a l

name: lookupAll_cons_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookupAll_cons_ne (l) {a} : ∀ s : Sigma β, a ≠ s.1 → lookupAll a (s :: l) = lookupAll a l
  | ⟨_, _⟩, h => dite_eq_right h.symm

name: lookupAll_eq_nil
statement:
theorem lookupAll_eq_nil {a : α} :
    ∀ {l : List (Sigma β)}, lookupAll a l = [] ↔ ∀ b : β a, Sigma.mk a b ∉ l
  | [] => by simp
  | ⟨a', b⟩ :: l => by
    by_cases h : a = a'
    · subst a'
      simp only [lookupAll_cons_eq, mem_cons, Sigma.mk.inj_iff, heq_eq_eq, true_and, not_or,
        false_iff, not_forall, not_and, not_not, reduceCtorEq]
      use b
      simp
    · simp [h, lookupAll_eq_nil]

name: head
statement:
theorem head?_lookupAll (a : α) : ∀ l : List (Sigma β), head? (lookupAll a l) = dlookup a l
  | [] => by simp
  | ⟨a', b⟩ :: l => by
    by_cases h : a = a'
    · subst h; simp
    · rw [lookupAll_cons_ne, dlookup_cons_ne, head?_lookupAll a l] <;> assumption

name: mem_lookupAll
statement:
theorem mem_lookupAll {a : α} {b : β a} :
    ∀ {l : List (Sigma β)}, b ∈ lookupAll a l ↔ Sigma.mk a b ∈ l
  | [] => by simp
  | ⟨a', b'⟩ :: l => by
    by_cases h : a = a'
    · subst h
      simp [*, mem_lookupAll]
    · simp [*, mem_lookupAll]

name: lookupAll_sublist
statement:
theorem lookupAll_sublist (a : α) : ∀ l : List (Sigma β), (lookupAll a l).map (Sigma.mk a) <+ l
  | [] => by simp
  | ⟨a', b'⟩ :: l => by
    by_cases h : a = a'
    · subst h
      simp only [lookupAll_cons_eq, List.map]
      exact (lookupAll_sublist a l).cons_cons _
    · simp only [ne_eq, h, not_false_iff, lookupAll_cons_ne]
      exact (lookupAll_sublist a l).cons _

name: lookupAll_length_le_one
statement:
theorem lookupAll_length_le_one (a : α) {l : List (Sigma β)} (h : l.NodupKeys) :
    length (lookupAll a l) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have := Nodup.sublist ((lookupAll_sublist a l).map _) h
  rw [map_map] at this
  rwa [← nodup_replicate, ← map_const]

name: lookupAll_eq_dlookup
statement:
theorem lookupAll_eq_dlookup (a : α) {l : List (Sigma β)} (h : l.NodupKeys) :
    lookupAll a l = (dlookup a l).toList
proof:
:= by
  rw [← head?_lookupAll]
  have h1 := lookupAll_length_le_one a h; revert h1
  rcases lookupAll a l with (_ | ⟨b, _ | ⟨c, l⟩⟩) <;> intro h1 <;> try rfl
  exact absurd h1 (by simp)

name: lookupAll_nodup
statement: theorem lookupAll_nodup (a : α) {l : List (Sigma β)} (h : l.NodupKeys) : (lookupAll a l).Nodup

name: perm_lookupAll
statement:
theorem perm_lookupAll (a : α) {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)} (nd₁ : l₁.NodupKeys)
    (p : l₁ ~ l₂) : lookupAll a l₁ = lookupAll a l₂
proof:
:= by
  have nd₂ := (perm_nodupKeys p).mp nd₁
  simp [lookupAll_eq_dlookup, nd₁, nd₂, perm_dlookup a nd₁ p]

name: kreplace_of_forall_not
statement:
theorem kreplace_of_forall_not (a : α) (b : β a) {l : List (Sigma β)}
    (H : ∀ b : β a, Sigma.mk a b ∉ l) : kreplace a b l = l

name: kreplace_self
statement:
theorem kreplace_self {a : α} {b : β a} {l : List (Sigma β)} (nd : NodupKeys l)
    (h : Sigma.mk a b ∈ l) : kreplace a b l = l
proof:
:= by
  refine (lookmap_congr ?_).trans (lookmap_id' (Option.guard fun (s : Sigma β) => a = s.1) ?_ _)
  · rintro ⟨a', b'⟩ h'
    dsimp [Option.guard]
    split_ifs
    · subst a'
      simp [nd.eq_of_mk_mem h h']
    · simp_all
    · simp_all
    · rfl
  · simp

name: keys_kreplace
statement: theorem keys_kreplace (a : α) (b : β a) : ∀ l : List (Sigma β), (kreplace a b l).keys = l.keys
proof:
:=
  lookmap_map_eq _ _ <| by
    rintro ⟨a₁, b₂⟩ ⟨a₂, b₂⟩
    dsimp
    split_ifs with h <;> simp +contextual [h]

name: kreplace_nodupKeys
statement:
theorem kreplace_nodupKeys (a : α) (b : β a) {l : List (Sigma β)} :
    (kreplace a b l).NodupKeys ↔ l.NodupKeys

name: Perm.kreplace
statement:
theorem Perm.kreplace {a : α} {b : β a} {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)} (nd : l₁.NodupKeys) :
    l₁ ~ l₂ → kreplace a b l₁ ~ kreplace a b l₂
proof:
:=
  perm_lookmap _ <| by
    refine nd.pairwise_ne.imp ?_
    intro x y h z h₁ w h₂
    split_ifs at h₁ h₂ with h_2 h_1 <;> cases h₁ <;> cases h₂
    exact (h (h_2.symm.trans h_1)).elim

name: kerase_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerase_nil {a} : @kerase _ β _ a [] = []

name: kerase_cons_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerase_cons_eq {a} {s : Sigma β} {l : List (Sigma β)} (h : a = s.1) :
    kerase a (s :: l) = l

name: kerase_cons_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerase_cons_ne {a} {s : Sigma β} {l : List (Sigma β)} (h : a ≠ s.1) :
    kerase a (s :: l) = s :: kerase a l

name: kerase_of_notMem_keys
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerase_of_notMem_keys {a} {l : List (Sigma β)} (h : a ∉ l.keys) : kerase a l = l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ ih => simp [not_or] at h; simp [h.1, ih h.2]

name: kerase_sublist
statement: theorem kerase_sublist (a : α) (l : List (Sigma β)) : kerase a l <+ l

name: kerase_keys_subset
statement: theorem kerase_keys_subset (a) (l : List (Sigma β)) : (kerase a l).keys ⊆ l.keys

name: mem_keys_of_mem_keys_kerase
statement:
theorem mem_keys_of_mem_keys_kerase {a₁ a₂} {l : List (Sigma β)} :
    a₁ ∈ (kerase a₂ l).keys → a₁ ∈ l.keys

name: exists_of_kerase
statement:
theorem exists_of_kerase {a : α} {l : List (Sigma β)} (h : a ∈ l.keys) :
    ∃ (b : β a) (l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)),
      a ∉ l₁.keys ∧ l = l₁ ++ ⟨a, b⟩ :: l₂ ∧ kerase a l = l₁ ++ l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => cases h
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    by_cases e : a = hd.1
    · subst e
      exact ⟨hd.2, [], tl, by simp, by cases hd; rfl, by simp⟩
    · simp only [keys_cons, mem_cons] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · exact absurd h e
      rcases ih h with ⟨b, tl₁, tl₂, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
      exact ⟨b, hd :: tl₁, tl₂, not_mem_cons_of_ne_of_not_mem e h₁, by (rw [h₂]; rfl), by
            simp [e, h₃]⟩

name: mem_keys_kerase_of_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_keys_kerase_of_ne {a₁ a₂} {l : List (Sigma β)} (h : a₁ ≠ a₂) :
    a₁ ∈ (kerase a₂ l).keys ↔ a₁ ∈ l.keys
proof:
:=
  (Iff.intro mem_keys_of_mem_keys_kerase) fun p =>
    if q : a₂ ∈ l.keys then
      match l, kerase a₂ l, exists_of_kerase q, p with
      | _, _, ⟨_, _, _, _, rfl, rfl⟩, p => by simpa [keys, h] using p
    else by simp [q, p]

name: keys_kerase
statement: theorem keys_kerase {a} {l : List (Sigma β)} : (kerase a l).keys = l.keys.erase a
proof:
:= by
  rw [keys, kerase, erase_eq_eraseP, eraseP_map, Function.comp_def]
  congr

name: kerase_kerase
statement:
theorem kerase_kerase {a a'} {l : List (Sigma β)} :
    (kerase a' l).kerase a = (kerase a l).kerase a'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a = a'
  · subst a'; rfl
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs =>
    by_cases a' = x.1
    · subst a'
      simp [kerase_cons_ne h, kerase_cons_eq rfl]
    by_cases h' : a = x.1
    · subst a
      simp [kerase_cons_eq rfl, kerase_cons_ne (Ne.symm h)]
    · simp [kerase_cons_ne, *]

name: NodupKeys.kerase
statement: theorem NodupKeys.kerase (a : α) : NodupKeys l → (kerase a l).NodupKeys

name: Perm.kerase
statement:
theorem Perm.kerase {a : α} {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)} (nd : l₁.NodupKeys) :
    l₁ ~ l₂ → kerase a l₁ ~ kerase a l₂
proof:
:= by
  apply Perm.eraseP
  apply (nodupKeys_iff_pairwise.1 nd).imp
  intros; simp_all

name: notMem_keys_kerase
statement:
@[simp]
theorem notMem_keys_kerase (a) {l : List (Sigma β)} (nd : l.NodupKeys) :
    a ∉ (kerase a l).keys
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [nodupKeys_cons] at nd
    by_cases h : a = hd.1
    · subst h
      simp [nd.1]
    · simp [h, ih nd.2]

name: dlookup_kerase
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dlookup_kerase (a) {l : List (Sigma β)} (nd : l.NodupKeys) :
    dlookup a (kerase a l) = none

name: dlookup_kerase_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dlookup_kerase_ne {a a'} {l : List (Sigma β)} (h : a ≠ a') :
    dlookup a (kerase a' l) = dlookup a l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    obtain ⟨ah, bh⟩ := hd
    by_cases h₁ : a = ah <;> by_cases h₂ : a' = ah
    · subst h₁ h₂
      cases Ne.irrefl h
    · subst h₁
      simp [h₂]
    · subst h₂
      simp [h]
    · simp [h₁, h₂, ih]

name: kerase_append_left
statement:
theorem kerase_append_left {a} :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)}, a ∈ l₁.keys → kerase a (l₁ ++ l₂) = kerase a l₁ ++ l₂
  | [], _, h => by cases h
  | s :: l₁, l₂, h₁ => by
    if h₂ : a = s.1 then simp [h₂]
    else simp_all [kerase_append_left]

name: kerase_append_right
statement:
theorem kerase_append_right {a} :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)}, a ∉ l₁.keys → kerase a (l₁ ++ l₂) = l₁ ++ kerase a l₂
  | [], _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: l₁, l₂, h => by
    simp only [keys_cons, mem_cons, not_or] at h
    simp [h.1, kerase_append_right h.2]

name: kerase_comm
statement:
theorem kerase_comm (a₁ a₂) (l : List (Sigma β)) :
    kerase a₂ (kerase a₁ l) = kerase a₁ (kerase a₂ l)
proof:
:=
  if h : a₁ = a₂ then by simp [h]
  else
    if ha₁ : a₁ ∈ l.keys then
      if ha₂ : a₂ ∈ l.keys then
        match l, kerase a₁ l, exists_of_kerase ha₁, ha₂ with
        | _, _, ⟨b₁, l₁, l₂, a₁_nin_l₁, rfl, rfl⟩, _ =>
          if h' : a₂ ∈ l₁.keys then by
            simp [kerase_append_left h',
              kerase_append_right (mt (mem_keys_kerase_of_ne h).mp a₁_nin_l₁)]
          else by
            simp [kerase_append_right h', kerase_append_right a₁_nin_l₁,
              @kerase_cons_ne _ _ _ a₂ ⟨a₁, b₁⟩ _ (Ne.symm h)]
      else by simp [ha₂, mt mem_keys_of_mem_keys_kerase ha₂]
    else by simp [ha₁, mt mem_keys_of_mem_keys_kerase ha₁]

name: sizeOf_kerase
statement:
theorem sizeOf_kerase [SizeOf (Sigma β)] (x : α)
    (xs : List (Sigma β)) : SizeOf.sizeOf (List.kerase x xs) ≤ SizeOf.sizeOf xs
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons y ys => by_cases x = y.1 <;> simp [*]

name: kinsert_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kinsert_def {a} {b : β a} {l : List (Sigma β)} : kinsert a b l = ⟨a, b⟩ :: kerase a l

name: mem_keys_kinsert
statement:
theorem mem_keys_kinsert {a a'} {b' : β a'} {l : List (Sigma β)} :
    a ∈ (kinsert a' b' l).keys ↔ a = a' ∨ a ∈ l.keys
proof: := by by_cases h : a = a' <;> simp [h]

name: kinsert_nodupKeys
statement:
theorem kinsert_nodupKeys (a) (b : β a) {l : List (Sigma β)} (nd : l.NodupKeys) :
    (kinsert a b l).NodupKeys

name: Perm.kinsert
statement:
theorem Perm.kinsert {a} {b : β a} {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)} (nd₁ : l₁.NodupKeys) (p : l₁ ~ l₂) :
    kinsert a b l₁ ~ kinsert a b l₂

name: dlookup_kinsert
statement:
theorem dlookup_kinsert {a} {b : β a} (l : List (Sigma β)) :
    dlookup a (kinsert a b l) = some b

name: dlookup_kinsert_ne
statement:
theorem dlookup_kinsert_ne {a a'} {b' : β a'} {l : List (Sigma β)} (h : a ≠ a') :
    dlookup a (kinsert a' b' l) = dlookup a l

name: kextract_eq_dlookup_kerase
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kextract_eq_dlookup_kerase (a : α) :
    ∀ l : List (Sigma β), kextract a l = (dlookup a l, kerase a l)
  | [] => rfl
  | ⟨a', b⟩ :: l => by
    simp only [kextract]; split_ifs with h
    · subst a'
      simp [kerase]
    · simp [Ne.symm h, kextract_eq_dlookup_kerase a l, kerase]

/-! ### `dedupKeys` -/


/
def dedupKeys : List (Sigma β) → List (Sigma β)

name: dedupKeys_cons
statement:
theorem dedupKeys_cons {x : Sigma β} (l : List (Sigma β)) :
    dedupKeys (x :: l) = kinsert x.1 x.2 (dedupKeys l)

name: nodupKeys_dedupKeys
statement: theorem nodupKeys_dedupKeys (l : List (Sigma β)) : NodupKeys (dedupKeys l)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [dedupKeys]
  generalize hl : nil = l'
  have : NodupKeys l' := by
    rw [← hl]
    apply nodup_nil
  clear hl
  induction l with
  | nil => apply this
  | cons x xs l_ih =>
    cases x
    simp only [foldr_cons, kinsert_def, nodupKeys_cons]
    constructor
    · simp only [keys_kerase]
      apply l_ih.not_mem_erase
    · exact l_ih.kerase _

name: dlookup_dedupKeys
statement: theorem dlookup_dedupKeys (a : α) (l : List (Sigma β)) : dlookup a (dedupKeys l) = dlookup a l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons l_hd _ l_ih =>
    obtain ⟨a', b⟩ := l_hd
    by_cases h : a = a'
    · subst a'
      rw [dedupKeys_cons, dlookup_kinsert, dlookup_cons_eq]
    · rw [dedupKeys_cons, dlookup_kinsert_ne h, l_ih, dlookup_cons_ne]
      exact h

name: sizeOf_cons_le_sizeOf_cons
statement:
theorem sizeOf_cons_le_sizeOf_cons {α : Type*} [SizeOf α] {l r : List α} (a : α)
    (h : SizeOf.sizeOf l ≤ SizeOf.sizeOf r) :
    SizeOf.sizeOf (a :: l) ≤ SizeOf.sizeOf (a :: r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cons.sizeOf_spec, cons.sizeOf_spec]
  exact Nat.add_le_add_iff_left.mpr h

name: sizeOf_dedupKeys
statement:
theorem sizeOf_dedupKeys [SizeOf (Sigma β)]
    (xs : List (Sigma β)) : SizeOf.sizeOf (dedupKeys xs) ≤ SizeOf.sizeOf xs
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [dedupKeys]
  | cons x xs h =>
    simp only [dedupKeys_cons, kinsert_def, Sigma.eta]
    exact sizeOf_cons_le_sizeOf_cons x (le_trans (sizeOf_kerase x.fst xs.dedupKeys) h)

name: nil_kunion
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nil_kunion {l : List (Sigma β)} : kunion [] l = l

name: kunion_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kunion_nil : ∀ {l : List (Sigma β)}, kunion l [] = l
  | [] => rfl
  | _ :: l => by rw [kunion, kerase_nil, kunion_nil]

@[simp]

name: kunion_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kunion_cons {s} {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)} :
    kunion (s :: l₁) l₂ = s :: kunion l₁ (kerase s.1 l₂)

name: mem_keys_kunion
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_keys_kunion {a} {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)} :
    a ∈ (kunion l₁ l₂).keys ↔ a ∈ l₁.keys ∨ a ∈ l₂.keys
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil => simp
  | cons s l₁ ih => by_cases h : a = s.1 <;> [simp [h]; simp [h, ih]]

name: kunion_kerase
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kunion_kerase {a} :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)}, kunion (kerase a l₁) (kerase a l₂) = kerase a (kunion l₁ l₂)
  | [], _ => rfl
  | s :: _, l => by by_cases h : a = s.1 <;> simp [h, kerase_comm a s.1 l, kunion_kerase]

name: NodupKeys.kunion
statement: theorem NodupKeys.kunion (nd₁ : l₁.NodupKeys) (nd₂ : l₂.NodupKeys) : (kunion l₁ l₂).NodupKeys
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil => simp only [nil_kunion, nd₂]
  | cons s l₁ ih =>
    simp only [nodupKeys_cons] at nd₁
    simp [nd₁.1, nd₂, ih nd₁.2 (nd₂.kerase s.1)]

name: Perm.kunion_right
statement:
theorem Perm.kunion_right {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)} (p : l₁ ~ l₂) (l) :
    kunion l₁ l ~ kunion l₂ l
proof:
:= by
  induction p generalizing l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hd _ ih =>
    simp [ih (List.kerase _ _)]
  | swap s₁ s₂ l => simp [kerase_comm, Perm.swap]
  | trans _ _ ih₁₂ ih₂₃ => exact Perm.trans (ih₁₂ l) (ih₂₃ l)

name: Perm.kunion_left
statement:
theorem Perm.kunion_left :
    ∀ (l) {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)}, l₁.NodupKeys → l₁ ~ l₂ → kunion l l₁ ~ kunion l l₂
  | [], _, _, _, p => p
  | s :: l, _, _, nd₁, p => ((p.kerase nd₁).kunion_left l <| nd₁.kerase s.1).cons s

name: Perm.kunion
statement:
theorem Perm.kunion {l₁ l₂ l₃ l₄ : List (Sigma β)} (nd₃ : l₃.NodupKeys) (p₁₂ : l₁ ~ l₂)
    (p₃₄ : l₃ ~ l₄) : kunion l₁ l₃ ~ kunion l₂ l₄

name: dlookup_kunion_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dlookup_kunion_left {a} {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)} (h : a ∈ l₁.keys) :
    dlookup a (kunion l₁ l₂) = dlookup a l₁
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons s _ ih =>
    simp only [keys_cons, mem_cons] at h
    rcases h with rfl | h <;> obtain ⟨a'⟩ := s
    · simp
    · rw [kunion_cons]
      by_cases h' : a = a'
      · subst h'
        simp
      · simp [h', ih h]

name: dlookup_kunion_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dlookup_kunion_right {a} {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)} (h : a ∉ l₁.keys) :
    dlookup a (kunion l₁ l₂) = dlookup a l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil => simp
  | cons _ _ ih => simp_all [not_or]

name: mem_dlookup_kunion
statement:
theorem mem_dlookup_kunion {a} {b : β a} {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)} :
    b ∈ dlookup a (kunion l₁ l₂) ↔ b ∈ dlookup a l₁ ∨ a ∉ l₁.keys ∧ b ∈ dlookup a l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil => simp
  | cons s _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨a'⟩ := s
    by_cases h₁ : a = a'
    · subst h₁
      simp
    · simp [h₁, @ih (kerase a' l₂)]

name: dlookup_kunion_eq_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dlookup_kunion_eq_some {a} {b : β a} {l₁ l₂ : List (Sigma β)} :
    dlookup a (kunion l₁ l₂) = some b ↔
      dlookup a l₁ = some b ∨ a ∉ l₁.keys ∧ dlookup a l₂ = some b

name: mem_dlookup_kunion_middle
proof:
:=
  match mem_dlookup_kunion.mp h₁ with
  | Or.inl h => mem_dlookup_kunion.mpr (Or.inl (mem_dlookup_kunion.mpr (Or.inl h)))
  | Or.inr h => mem_dlookup_kunion.mpr <| Or.inr ⟨mt mem_keys_kunion.mp (not_or.mpr ⟨h.1, h₂⟩), h.2⟩

name: dedup_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dedup_nil : dedup [] = ([] : List α)

name: dedup_cons_of_mem'
statement: theorem dedup_cons_of_mem' {a : α} {l : List α} (h : a ∈ dedup l) : dedup (a :: l) = dedup l
proof:
:=
  pwFilter_cons_of_neg <| by simpa only [forall_mem_ne, not_not] using! h

name: dedup_cons_of_notMem'
statement:
theorem dedup_cons_of_notMem' {a : α} {l : List α} (h : a ∉ dedup l) :
    dedup (a :: l) = a :: dedup l
proof:
:=
  pwFilter_cons_of_pos <| by simpa only [forall_mem_ne] using! h

name: dedup_cons'
statement:
theorem dedup_cons' (a : α) (l : List α) :
    dedup (a :: l) = if a ∈ dedup l then dedup l else a :: dedup l

name: mem_dedup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_dedup {a : α} {l : List α} : a ∈ dedup l ↔ a ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  have := not_congr (@forall_mem_pwFilter α (· ≠ ·) _ ?_ a l)
  · simpa only [dedup, forall_mem_ne, not_not] using this
  · intro x y z xz
    exact not_and_or.1 <| mt (fun h ↦ h.1.trans h.2) xz

name: dedup_cons_of_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dedup_cons_of_mem {a : α} {l : List α} (h : a ∈ l) : dedup (a :: l) = dedup l

name: dedup_cons_of_notMem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dedup_cons_of_notMem {a : α} {l : List α} (h : a ∉ l) : dedup (a :: l) = a :: dedup l

name: dedup_cons
statement:
theorem dedup_cons (a : α) (l : List α) :
    dedup (a :: l) = if a ∈ l then dedup l else a :: dedup l
proof:
:= by
  simpa using dedup_cons' a l

name: dedup_sublist
statement: theorem dedup_sublist : ∀ l : List α, dedup l <+ l

name: dedup_subset
statement: theorem dedup_subset : ∀ l : List α, dedup l ⊆ l

name: subset_dedup
statement: theorem subset_dedup (l : List α) : l ⊆ dedup l

name: nodup_dedup
statement: theorem nodup_dedup : ∀ l : List α, Nodup (dedup l)

name: headI_dedup
statement:
theorem headI_dedup [Inhabited α] (l : List α) :
    l.dedup.headI = if l.headI ∈ l.tail then l.tail.dedup.headI else l.headI
proof:
:=
  match l with
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => by by_cases ha : a ∈ l <;> simp [ha, List.dedup_cons_of_mem]

name: tail_dedup
statement:
theorem tail_dedup [Inhabited α] (l : List α) :
    l.dedup.tail = if l.headI ∈ l.tail then l.tail.dedup.tail else l.tail.dedup
proof:
:=
  match l with
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => by by_cases ha : a ∈ l <;> simp [ha, List.dedup_cons_of_mem]

name: dedup_eq_self
statement: theorem dedup_eq_self {l : List α} : dedup l = l ↔ Nodup l

name: nodup_iff_sublist_dedup
statement: theorem nodup_iff_sublist_dedup {l : List α} : l.Nodup ↔ l <+ l.dedup

name: nodup_iff_length_dedup_eq
statement: theorem nodup_iff_length_dedup_eq {l : List α} : l.Nodup ↔ l.dedup.length = l.length

name: nodup_iff_le_length_dedup
statement: theorem nodup_iff_le_length_dedup {l : List α} : l.Nodup ↔ l.length ≤ l.dedup.length

name: dedup_eq_cons
statement:
theorem dedup_eq_cons (l : List α) (a : α) (l' : List α) :
    l.dedup = a :: l' ↔ a ∈ l ∧ a ∉ l' ∧ l.dedup.tail = l'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨mem_dedup.1 (h.symm ▸ mem_cons_self), fun ha => ?_, by rw [h, tail_cons]⟩
    have := count_pos_iff.2 ha
    have : count a l.dedup ≤ 1 := nodup_iff_count_le_one.1 (nodup_dedup l) a
    rw [h, count_cons_self] at this
    lia
  · have := @List.cons_head!_tail α ⟨a⟩ _ (ne_nil_of_mem (mem_dedup.2 h.1))
    have hal : a ∈ l.dedup := mem_dedup.2 h.1
    rw [← this, mem_cons, or_iff_not_imp_right] at hal
    exact this ▸ h.2.2.symm ▸ cons_eq_cons.2 ⟨(hal (h.2.2.symm ▸ h.2.1)).symm, rfl⟩

name: dedup_eq_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dedup_eq_nil (l : List α) : l.dedup = [] ↔ l = []
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact Iff.rfl
  | cons a l hl =>
    by_cases h : a ∈ l
    · simp only [List.dedup_cons_of_mem h, hl, List.ne_nil_of_mem h, reduceCtorEq]
    · simp only [List.dedup_cons_of_notMem h, List.cons_ne_nil]

name: Nodup.dedup
statement: protected theorem Nodup.dedup {l : List α} (h : l.Nodup) : l.dedup = l

name: dedup_idem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dedup_idem {l : List α} : dedup (dedup l) = dedup l

name: dedup_append
statement: theorem dedup_append (l₁ l₂ : List α) : dedup (l₁ ++ l₂) = l₁ ∪ dedup l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ with | nil => rfl | cons a l₁ IH => ?_
  simp only [cons_union] at *
  rw [← IH, cons_append]
  by_cases h : a ∈ dedup (l₁ ++ l₂)
  · rw [dedup_cons_of_mem' h, insert_of_mem h]
  · rw [dedup_cons_of_notMem' h, insert_of_not_mem h]

name: dedup_map_of_injective
statement:
theorem dedup_map_of_injective [DecidableEq β] {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (xs : List α) :
    (xs.map f).dedup = xs.dedup.map f
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [map_cons]
    by_cases h : x ∈ xs
    · rw [dedup_cons_of_mem h, dedup_cons_of_mem (mem_map_of_mem h), ih]
    · rw [dedup_cons_of_notMem h, dedup_cons_of_notMem <| (mem_map_of_injective hf).not.mpr h, ih,
        map_cons]

name: Subset.dedup_append_right
statement:
theorem Subset.dedup_append_right {xs ys : List α} (h : xs ⊆ ys) :
    dedup (xs ++ ys) = dedup ys

name: Disjoint.union_eq
statement:
theorem Disjoint.union_eq {xs ys : List α} (h : Disjoint xs ys) :
    xs ∪ ys = xs.dedup ++ ys
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [cons_union]
    rw [disjoint_cons_left] at h
    by_cases hx : x ∈ xs
    · rw [dedup_cons_of_mem hx, insert_of_mem (mem_union_left hx _), ih h.2]
    · rw [dedup_cons_of_notMem hx, insert_of_not_mem, ih h.2, cons_append]
      rw [mem_union_iff, not_or]
      exact ⟨hx, h.1⟩

name: Disjoint.dedup_append
statement:
theorem Disjoint.dedup_append {xs ys : List α} (h : Disjoint xs ys) :
    dedup (xs ++ ys) = dedup xs ++ dedup ys
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.dedup_append, Disjoint.union_eq]
  intro a hx hy
  exact h hx (mem_dedup.mp hy)

name: replicate_dedup
statement:
theorem replicate_dedup {x : α} : ∀ {k}, k ≠ 0 → (replicate k x).dedup = [x]
  | 0, h => (h rfl).elim
  | 1, _ => rfl
  | n + 2, _ => by
    rw [replicate_succ, dedup_cons_of_mem (mem_replicate.2 ⟨n.succ_ne_zero, rfl⟩),
      replicate_dedup n.succ_ne_zero]

name: count_dedup
statement: theorem count_dedup (l : List α) (a : α) : l.dedup.count a = if a ∈ l then 1 else 0

name: Perm.dedup
statement: theorem Perm.dedup {l₁ l₂ : List α} (p : l₁ ~ l₂) : dedup l₁ ~ dedup l₂
proof:
:=
  perm_iff_count.2 fun a =>
    if h : a ∈ l₁ then by
      simp [h, nodup_dedup, p.subset h]
    else by
      simp [h, count_eq_zero_of_not_mem, mt p.mem_iff.2]

name: count_finRange
statement:
@[simp]
lemma count_finRange {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n) : count a (finRange n) = 1

name: idxOf_finRange
statement: @[simp] theorem idxOf_finRange {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) : (finRange k).idxOf i = i

name: ofFn_eq_pmap
statement:
theorem ofFn_eq_pmap {n} {f : Fin n → α} :
    ofFn f = pmap (fun i hi => f ⟨i, hi⟩) (range n) fun _ => mem_range.1

name: ofFn_id
statement: theorem ofFn_id (n) : ofFn id = finRange n

name: ofFn_eq_map
statement: theorem ofFn_eq_map {n} {f : Fin n → α} : ofFn f = (finRange n).map f

name: nodup_ofFn_ofInjective
statement:
theorem nodup_ofFn_ofInjective {n} {f : Fin n → α} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Nodup (ofFn f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofFn_eq_pmap]
  exact nodup_range.pmap fun _ _ _ _ H => Fin.val_eq_of_eq <| hf H

name: nodup_ofFn
statement: theorem nodup_ofFn {n} {f : Fin n → α} : Nodup (ofFn f) ↔ Function.Injective f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, nodup_ofFn_ofInjective⟩
  refine Fin.consInduction ?_ (fun x₀ xs ih => ?_) f
  · intro _
    exact Function.injective_of_subsingleton _
  · intro h
    rw [Fin.cons_injective_iff]
    simp_rw [ofFn_succ, Fin.cons_succ, nodup_cons, Fin.cons_zero, mem_ofFn] at h
    exact h.imp_right ih

name: Equiv.Perm.map_finRange_perm
statement:
theorem Equiv.Perm.map_finRange_perm {n : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    map σ (finRange n) ~ finRange n
proof:
:= by
  rw [perm_ext_iff_of_nodup ((nodup_finRange n).map σ.injective) <| nodup_finRange n]
  simpa [mem_map, mem_finRange] using! σ.surjective

name: Equiv.Perm.ofFn_comp_perm
statement:
theorem Equiv.Perm.ofFn_comp_perm {n : ℕ} {α : Type u} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (f : Fin n → α) :
    ofFn (f ∘ σ) ~ ofFn f
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofFn_eq_map, ofFn_eq_map, ← map_map]
  exact σ.map_finRange_perm.map f

name: Forall
statement: theorem Forall₂.imp (H : ∀ a b, R a b → S a b) {l₁ l₂} (h : Forall₂ R l₁ l₂) : Forall₂ S l₁ l₂

name: Forall
statement:
theorem Forall₂.mp {Q : α → β → Prop} (h : ∀ a b, Q a b → R a b → S a b) :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂}, Forall₂ Q l₁ l₂ → Forall₂ R l₁ l₂ → Forall₂ S l₁ l₂
  | [], [], Forall₂.nil, Forall₂.nil => Forall₂.nil
  | a :: _, b :: _, Forall₂.cons hr hrs, Forall₂.cons hq hqs =>
    Forall₂.cons (h a b hr hq) (Forall₂.mp h hrs hqs)

name: Forall
statement:
theorem Forall₂.flip : ∀ {a b}, Forall₂ (flip R) b a → Forall₂ R a b
  | _, _, Forall₂.nil => Forall₂.nil
  | _ :: _, _ :: _, Forall₂.cons h₁ h₂ => Forall₂.cons h₁ h₂.flip

@[simp]

name: forall
statement:
@[simp]
theorem forall₂_same : ∀ {l : List α}, Forall₂ Rₐ l l ↔ ∀ x ∈ l, Rₐ x x
  | [] => by simp
  | a :: l => by simp [@forall₂_same l]

name: forall
statement: theorem forall₂_refl [Std.Refl Rₐ] (l : List α) : Forall₂ Rₐ l l

name: forall
statement:
@[simp]
theorem forall₂_eq_eq_eq : Forall₂ ((· = ·) : α → α → Prop) = Eq
proof:
:= by
  funext a b; apply propext
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h
    · rfl
    simp only [*]
  · rintro rfl
    exact forall₂_refl _

name: forall
statement:
@[simp]
theorem forall₂_nil_left_iff {l} : Forall₂ R nil l ↔ l = nil
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H => by cases H; rfl, by rintro rfl; exact Forall₂.nil⟩

name: forall
statement:
@[simp]
theorem forall₂_nil_right_iff {l} : Forall₂ R l nil ↔ l = nil
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H => by cases H; rfl, by rintro rfl; exact Forall₂.nil⟩

name: forall
statement:
theorem forall₂_cons_left_iff {a l u} :
    Forall₂ R (a :: l) u ↔ ∃ b u', R a b ∧ Forall₂ R l u' ∧ u = b :: u'
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro
    (fun h =>
      match u, h with
      | b :: u', Forall₂.cons h₁ h₂ => ⟨b, u', h₁, h₂, rfl⟩)
    fun h =>
    match u, h with
    | _, ⟨_, _, h₁, h₂, rfl⟩ => Forall₂.cons h₁ h₂

name: forall
statement:
theorem forall₂_cons_right_iff {b l u} :
    Forall₂ R u (b :: l) ↔ ∃ a u', R a b ∧ Forall₂ R u' l ∧ u = a :: u'
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro
    (fun h =>
      match u, h with
      | b :: u', Forall₂.cons h₁ h₂ => ⟨b, u', h₁, h₂, rfl⟩)
    fun h =>
    match u, h with
    | _, ⟨_, _, h₁, h₂, rfl⟩ => Forall₂.cons h₁ h₂

name: forall
statement:
theorem forall₂_and_left {p : α → Prop} :
    ∀ l u, Forall₂ (fun a b => p a ∧ R a b) l u ↔ (∀ a ∈ l, p a) ∧ Forall₂ R l u
  | [], u => by
    simp only [forall₂_nil_left_iff, forall_prop_of_false not_mem_nil, imp_true_iff, true_and]
  | a :: l, u => by

statement:
theorem forall₂_zip : ∀ {l₁ l₂}, Forall₂ R l₁ l₂ → ∀ {a b}, (a, b) ∈ zip l₁ l₂ → R a b
  | _, _, Forall₂.cons h₁ h₂, x, y, hx => by
    rw [zip, zipWith, mem_cons] at hx
    match hx with
    | Or.inl rfl => exact h₁
    | Or.inr h₃ => exact forall₂_zip h₂ h₃

name: forall

    Forall₂ R l₁ l₂ ↔ length l₁ = length l₂ ∧ ∀ {a b}, (a, b) ∈ zip l₁ l₂ → R a b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨Forall₂.length_eq h, @forall₂_zip _ _ _ _ _ h⟩, fun h => by
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h
    induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
    | nil =>
      cases length_eq_zero_iff.1 h₁.symm
      constructor
    | cons a l₁ IH =>
      rcases l₂ with - | ⟨b, l₂⟩
      · simp at h₁
      · simp only [length_cons, succ.injEq] at h₁
        exact Forall₂.cons (h₂ <| by simp [zip])
          (IH h₁ fun h => h₂ <| by
            simp only [zip, zipWith, mem_cons, Prod.mk.injEq]; right
            simpa [zip] using h)⟩

inductive SublistForall₂ (R : α → β → Prop) : List α → List β → Prop
  | nil {l} : SublistForall₂ R [] l
  | cons {a₁ a₂ l₁ l₂} : R a₁ a₂ → SublistForall₂ R l₁ l₂ → SublistForall₂ R (a₁ :: l₁) (a₂ :: l₂)
  | cons_right {a l₁ l₂} : SublistForall₂ R l₁ l₂ → SublistForall₂ R l₁ (a :: l₂)

name: sublistForall
statement:
theorem sublistForall₂_iff {l₁ : List α} {l₂ : List β} :
    SublistForall₂ R l₁ l₂ ↔ ∃ l, Forall₂ R l₁ l ∧ l <+ l₂
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · induction h with
    | nil => exact ⟨nil, Forall₂.nil, nil_sublist _⟩
    | @cons a b l1 l2 rab _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨l, hl1, hl2⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨b :: l, Forall₂.cons rab hl1, hl2.cons_cons b⟩
    | cons_right _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨l, hl1, hl2⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨l, hl1, hl2.trans (Sublist.cons _ (Sublist.refl _))⟩
  · obtain ⟨l, hl1, hl2⟩ := h
    revert l₁
    induction hl2 with
    | slnil =>
      intro l₁ hl1
      rw [forall₂_nil_right_iff.1 hl1]
      exact SublistForall₂.nil
    | cons _ _ ih => intro l₁ hl1; exact SublistForall₂.cons_right (ih hl1)
    | cons_cons _ _ ih =>
      intro l₁ hl1
      obtain - | ⟨hr, hl⟩ := hl1
      exact SublistForall₂.cons hr (ih hl)

name: sublist_of_orderEmbedding_getElem
statement:
theorem sublist_of_orderEmbedding_getElem?_eq {l l' : List α} (f : ℕ ↪o ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ ix : ℕ, l[ix]? = l'[f ix]?) : l <+ l'
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing l' f with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl IH => ?_
  have : some hd = l'[f 0]? := by simpa using hf 0
  rw [eq_comm, List.getElem?_eq_some_iff] at this
  obtain ⟨w, h⟩ := this
  let f' : ℕ ↪o ℕ :=
    OrderEmbedding.ofMapLEIff (fun i => f (i + 1) - (f 0 + 1)) fun a b => by
      rw [Nat.sub_le_sub_iff_right, OrderEmbedding.le_iff_le, Nat.succ_le_succ_iff]
      rw [Nat.succ_le_iff, OrderEmbedding.lt_iff_lt]
      exact b.succ_pos
  have : ∀ ix, tl[ix]? = (l'.drop (f 0 + 1))[f' ix]? := by
    intro ix
    rw [List.getElem?_drop, OrderEmbedding.coe_ofMapLEIff, Nat.add_sub_cancel', ← hf]
    · simp only [getElem?_cons_succ]
    rw [Nat.succ_le_iff, OrderEmbedding.lt_iff_lt]
    exact ix.succ_pos
  rw [← List.take_append_drop (f 0 + 1) l', ← List.singleton_append]
  apply List.Sublist.append _ (IH _ this)
  rw [List.singleton_sublist, ← h, l'.getElem_take' _ (Nat.lt_succ_self _)]
  exact List.getElem_mem _

name: sublist_iff_exists_orderEmbedding_getElem
statement:
theorem sublist_iff_exists_orderEmbedding_getElem?_eq {l l' : List α} :
    l <+ l' ↔ ∃ f : ℕ ↪o ℕ, ∀ ix : ℕ, l[ix]? = l'[f ix]?
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H
    induction H with
    | slnil => simp
    | cons _ _ IH =>
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := IH
      refine ⟨f.trans (OrderEmbedding.ofStrictMono (· + 1) fun _ => by simp), ?_⟩
      simpa using hf
    | cons_cons _ _ IH =>
      obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := IH
      refine
        ⟨OrderEmbedding.ofMapLEIff (fun ix : ℕ => if ix = 0 then 0 else (f ix.pred).succ) ?_, ?_⟩
      · rintro ⟨_ | a⟩ ⟨_ | b⟩ <;> simp [Nat.succ_le_succ_iff]
      · rintro ⟨_ | i⟩
        · simp
        · simpa using hf _
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    exact sublist_of_orderEmbedding_getElem?_eq f hf

name: sublist_iff_exists_fin_orderEmbedding_get_eq
statement:
theorem sublist_iff_exists_fin_orderEmbedding_get_eq {l l' : List α} :
    l <+ l' ↔
      ∃ f : Fin l.length ↪o Fin l'.length,
        ∀ ix : Fin l.length, l.get ix = l'.get (f ix)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sublist_iff_exists_orderEmbedding_getElem?_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    have h : ∀ {i : ℕ}, i < l.length → f i < l'.length := by
      intro i hi
      specialize hf i
      rw [getElem?_eq_getElem hi, eq_comm, getElem?_eq_some_iff] at hf
      obtain ⟨h, -⟩ := hf
      exact h
    refine ⟨OrderEmbedding.ofMapLEIff (fun ix => ⟨f ix, h ix.is_lt⟩) ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp
    · intro i
      apply Option.some_injective
      simpa [getElem?_eq_getElem i.2, getElem?_eq_getElem (h i.2)] using hf i
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    refine
      ⟨OrderEmbedding.ofStrictMono (fun i => if hi : i < l.length then f ⟨i, hi⟩ else i + l'.length)
          ?_,
        ?_⟩
    · intro i j h
      dsimp only
      split_ifs with hi hj hj
      · rwa [Fin.val_fin_lt, f.lt_iff_lt]
      · lia
      · exact absurd (h.trans hj) hi
      · simpa using h
    · grind

name: duplicate_iff_exists_distinct_get
statement:
theorem duplicate_iff_exists_distinct_get {l : List α} {x : α} :
    l.Duplicate x ↔
      ∃ (n m : Fin l.length) (_ : n < m),
        x = l.get n ∧ x = l.get m
proof:
:= by
  classical
    rw [duplicate_iff_two_le_count, ← replicate_sublist_iff,
      sublist_iff_exists_fin_orderEmbedding_get_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
      refine ⟨f ⟨0, by simp⟩, f ⟨1, by simp⟩, f.lt_iff_lt.2 (Nat.zero_lt_one), ?_⟩
      rw [← hf, ← hf]; simp
    · rintro ⟨n, m, hnm, h, h'⟩
      refine ⟨OrderEmbedding.ofStrictMono (fun i => if (i : ℕ) = 0 then n else m) ?_, ?_⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨_ | i⟩, hi⟩ ⟨⟨_ | j⟩, hj⟩
        · simp
        · simp [hnm]
        · simp
        · simp only [Nat.lt_succ_iff, Nat.succ_le_succ_iff, replicate, length, Nat.le_zero] at hi hj
          simp [hi, hj]
      · rintro ⟨⟨_ | i⟩, hi⟩
        · simpa using h
        · simpa using h'

proof:
:= by
  induction as generalizing arr with
  | nil => simp only [mapIdxMAux', mapIdxM.go, seqRight_eq, map_pure, seq_pure]
  | cons head tail ih =>

    have : (arr.push ⟨⟩).size = arr.size + 1 := Array.size_push _

  · obtain hm | hm := h
    · exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, hm⟩

  induction h with
  | slnil => exact hx
  | cons y _ IH => exact (IH hx).duplicate_cons _
  | cons_cons y h IH =>
    rw [duplicate_cons_iff] at hx ⊢
    rcases hx with (⟨rfl, hx⟩ | hx)
    · simp [h.subset hx]
    · simp [IH hx]

    · rw [duplicate_cons_iff_of_ne hx, IH]
      refine ⟨sublist_cons_of_sublist y, fun h => ?_⟩
      cases h
      · assumption
      · contradiction

  · intro h; refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩; (suffices [x] = [y] by simpa using this); apply h; rfl
  · intro hα l1 l2 hl
    induction l1 generalizing l2 <;> cases l2

    · next ih _ _ =>

theorem mem_head?_append_of_mem_head? {s t : List α} {x : α} (h : x ∈ s.head?) :
    x ∈ (s ++ t).head?

name: head
statement:
theorem head?_append_of_ne_nil :
    ∀ (l₁ : List α) {l₂ : List α} (_ : l₁ ≠ []), head? (l₁ ++ l₂) = head? l₁
  | _ :: _, _, _ => rfl

name: tail_append_singleton_of_ne_nil
statement:
theorem tail_append_singleton_of_ne_nil {a : α} {l : List α} (h : l ≠ nil) :
    tail (l ++ [a]) = tail l ++ [a]

name: cons_head
statement:
theorem cons_head?_tail : ∀ {l : List α} {a : α}, a ∈ head? l → a :: tail l = l
  | [], a, h => by contradiction
  | b :: l, a, h => by
    have : b = a

name: head
statement:
theorem head!_mem_head? [Inhabited α] : ∀ {l : List α}, l ≠ [] → head! l ∈ head? l
  | [], h => by contradiction
  | _ :: _, _ => rfl

name: cons_head
statement: theorem cons_head!_tail [Inhabited α] {l : List α} (h : l ≠ []) : head! l :: tail l = l

name: head
statement: theorem head!_mem_self [Inhabited α] {l : List α} (h : l ≠ nil) : l.head! ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  have h' : l.head! ∈ l.head! :: l.tail := mem_cons_self
  rwa [cons_head!_tail h] at h'

name: get_eq_getElem
statement:
theorem get_eq_getElem? (l : List α) (i : Fin l.length) :
    l.get i = l[i]?.get (by simp)

name: exists_mem_iff_getElem
statement:
theorem exists_mem_iff_getElem {l : List α} {p : α → Prop} :
    (∃ x ∈ l, p x) ↔ ∃ (i : ℕ) (_ : i < l.length), p l[i]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_iff_getElem]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨_x, ⟨i, hi, hix⟩, hxp⟩ ↦ ⟨i, hi, hix ▸ hxp⟩, fun ⟨i, hi, hp⟩ ↦ ⟨_, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, hp⟩⟩

name: exists_mem_iff_get
statement:
theorem exists_mem_iff_get {l : List α} {p : α → Prop} :
    (∃ x ∈ l, p x) ↔ ∃ (i : Fin l.length), p (l.get i)
proof:
:=
  exists_mem_iff_getElem.trans ⟨fun ⟨i, hi, h⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, h⟩, fun ⟨i, h⟩ ↦ ⟨i, i.isLt, h⟩⟩

name: forall_mem_iff_getElem
statement:
theorem forall_mem_iff_getElem {l : List α} {p : α → Prop} :
    (∀ x ∈ l, p x) ↔ ∀ (i : ℕ) (_ : i < l.length), p l[i]

name: forall_mem_iff_get
statement:
theorem forall_mem_iff_get {l : List α} {p : α → Prop} :
    (∀ x ∈ l, p x) ↔ ∀ (i : Fin l.length), p (l.get i)
proof:
:=
  forall_mem_iff_getElem.trans ⟨fun h i ↦ h i i.isLt, fun h i hi ↦ h ⟨i, hi⟩⟩

name: get_surjective_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem get_surjective_iff {l : List α} : l.get.Surjective ↔ (∀ x, x ∈ l)

name: getElem_fin_surjective_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem getElem_fin_surjective_iff {l : List α} :
    (fun (n : Fin l.length) ↦ l[n.val]).Surjective ↔ (∀ x, x ∈ l)

name: getElem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem getElem?_surjective_iff {l : List α} : (fun (n : ℕ) ↦ l[n]?).Surjective ↔ (∀ x, x ∈ l)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h x ↦ mem_iff_getElem?.mpr <| h x, fun h x ↦ ?_⟩
  cases x with
  | none => exact ⟨l.length, getElem?_eq_none <| Nat.le_refl _⟩
  | some x => exact mem_iff_getElem?.mp <| h x

name: get_tail
statement:
theorem get_tail (l : List α) (i) (h : i < l.tail.length)
    (h' : i + 1 < l.length := (by simp only [length_tail] at h; lia)) :
    l.tail.get ⟨i, h⟩ = l.get ⟨i + 1, h'⟩

name: getElem_mem_tail
statement:
theorem getElem_mem_tail {k : ℕ} (l : List α) (h : k ≠ 0) (hk : k < l.length) :
    l[k]'hk ∈ l.tail

name: tail_eq_nil_iff
statement: theorem tail_eq_nil_iff : l.tail = [] ↔ l.length ≤ 1

name: dropLast_eq_nil_iff
statement: theorem dropLast_eq_nil_iff : l.dropLast = [] ↔ l.length ≤ 1

name: eq_of_head
statement:
theorem eq_of_head?_eq_of_tail_eq (hh : l₁.head? = l₂.head?) (ht : l₁.tail = l₂.tail) :
    l₁ = l₂
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hnil : l₁ = [] ∨ l₂ = []
  · grind [head?_eq_none_iff]
  · grind [cons_head_tail hnil.1, cons_head_tail hnil.2]

name: eq_of_tail_eq_of_dropLast_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_tail_eq_of_dropLast_eq (h : 1 < l₁.length) (ht : l₁.tail = l₂.tail)
    (hd : l₁.dropLast = l₂.dropLast) : l₁ = l₂
proof:
:= by
  have hnil : l₁.dropLast ≠ [] ∧ l₂.dropLast ≠ [] := by grind [dropLast_eq_nil_iff]
  grind [cons_head_tail, head_dropLast hnil.1, head_dropLast hnil.2]

name: cons_sublist_cons'
statement: lemma cons_sublist_cons' {a b : α} : a :: l₁ <+ b :: l₂ ↔ a :: l₁ <+ l₂ ∨ a = b ∧ l₁ <+ l₂

name: sublist_cons_of_sublist
statement: theorem sublist_cons_of_sublist (a : α) (h : l₁ <+ l₂) : l₁ <+ a :: l₂

name: sublist_singleton
statement: @[simp] lemma sublist_singleton {l : List α} {a : α} : l <+ [a] ↔ l = [] ∨ l = [a]

name: Sublist.antisymm
statement: theorem Sublist.antisymm (s₁ : l₁ <+ l₂) (s₂ : l₂ <+ l₁) : l₁ = l₂

name: Sublist.of_cons_of_ne
statement: theorem Sublist.of_cons_of_ne {a b} (h₁ : a ≠ b) (h₂ : a :: l₁ <+ b :: l₂) : a :: l₁ <+ l₂
proof:
:=
  match h₁, h₂ with
  | _, .cons _ h => h

name: idxOf_cons_eq
statement:
theorem idxOf_cons_eq {a b : α} (l : List α) : b = a → idxOf a (b :: l) = 0
  | e => by rw [← e]; exact idxOf_cons_self

@[simp]

name: idxOf_cons_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idxOf_cons_ne {a b : α} (l : List α) (h : b ≠ a) : idxOf a (b :: l) = succ (idxOf a l)

name: idxOf_eq_length_iff
statement: theorem idxOf_eq_length_iff {a : α} {l : List α} : idxOf a l = length l ↔ a ∉ l

name: idxOf_of_notMem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idxOf_of_notMem {l : List α} {a : α} : a ∉ l → idxOf a l = length l

name: idxOf_eq_zero_iff_eq_nil_or_head_eq
statement:
theorem idxOf_eq_zero_iff_eq_nil_or_head_eq {l : List α} (a : α) :
    l.idxOf a = 0 ↔ l = [] ∨ l.head? = a

name: idxOf_eq_zero_iff_head_eq
statement:
theorem idxOf_eq_zero_iff_head_eq {l : List α} (hl : l ≠ []) {a : α} :
    l.idxOf a = 0 ↔ l.head hl = a

name: idxOf_append_of_mem
statement: theorem idxOf_append_of_mem {a : α} (h : a ∈ l₁) : idxOf a (l₁ ++ l₂) = idxOf a l₁

name: idxOf_append_of_notMem
statement:
theorem idxOf_append_of_notMem {a : α} (h : a ∉ l₁) :
    idxOf a (l₁ ++ l₂) = l₁.length + idxOf a l₂

name: IsPrefix.idxOf_le
statement: theorem IsPrefix.idxOf_le (hl : l₁ <+: l₂) (a : α) : l₁.idxOf a ≤ l₂.idxOf a

name: IsPrefix.idxOf_eq_of_mem
statement:
theorem IsPrefix.idxOf_eq_of_mem (hl : l₁ <+: l₂) {a : α} (ha : a ∈ l₁) :
    l₁.idxOf a = l₂.idxOf a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l₃, rfl⟩ := hl
  exact idxOf_append_of_mem ha |>.symm

name: IsPrefix.mem_iff_idxOf_lt_length
statement:
theorem IsPrefix.mem_iff_idxOf_lt_length (hl : l₁ <+: l₂) (a : α) :
    a ∈ l₁ ↔ l₂.idxOf a < l₁.length
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact hl.idxOf_eq_of_mem h ▸ idxOf_lt_length_of_mem h
  · have := hl.idxOf_le a
    grind [List.idxOf_lt_length_iff]

name: IsSuffix.idxOf_le
statement:
theorem IsSuffix.idxOf_le (hl : l₁ <:+ l₂) (a : α) :
    l₂.idxOf a ≤ l₂.length - l₁.length + l₁.idxOf a

name: IsSuffix.idxOf_add_length_le
statement:
theorem IsSuffix.idxOf_add_length_le (hl : l₁ <:+ l₂) (a : α) :
    l₂.idxOf a + l₁.length ≤ l₁.idxOf a + l₂.length

name: mem_take_iff_idxOf_lt
statement:
theorem mem_take_iff_idxOf_lt {a : α} {n : ℕ} {l : List α} (ha : a ∈ l) :
    a ∈ l.take n ↔ l.idxOf a < n

name: mem_dropLast_iff_idxOf_lt
statement:
theorem mem_dropLast_iff_idxOf_lt {l : List α} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ l) :
    a ∈ l.dropLast ↔ l.idxOf a < l.length - 1

name: succ_idxOf_lt_length_of_mem_dropLast
statement:
theorem succ_idxOf_lt_length_of_mem_dropLast {l : List α} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ l.dropLast) :
    l.idxOf a + 1 < l.length

name: idxOf_getLast
statement:
theorem idxOf_getLast {l : List α} (hl : l ≠ []) (hl' : l.getLast hl ∉ l.dropLast) :
    l.idxOf (l.getLast hl) = l.length - 1
proof:
:=
  Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.le_pred_of_lt <| l.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem <| getLast_mem hl) <| by
    contrapose hl'
    rwa [mem_dropLast_iff_idxOf_lt <| getLast_mem hl, ← Nat.not_le]

name: idxOf_tail_of_head_ne
statement:
theorem idxOf_tail_of_head_ne {a : α} (hl : l ≠ []) (ha : l.head hl ≠ a) :
    l.tail.idxOf a = l.idxOf a - 1

name: getElem
statement: theorem getElem?_length (l : List α) : l[l.length]? = none

name: getElem_map_rev
statement:
theorem getElem_map_rev (f : α → β) {l} {n : Nat} {h : n < l.length} :
    f l[n] = (map f l)[n]'((l.length_map f).symm ▸ h)

name: get_length_sub_one
statement:
theorem get_length_sub_one {l : List α} (h : l.length - 1 < l.length) :
    l.get ⟨l.length - 1, h⟩ = l.getLast (by rintro rfl; exact Nat.lt_irrefl 0 h)

name: ext_getElem
statement:
theorem ext_getElem?' {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h' : ∀ n < max l₁.length l₂.length, l₁[n]? = l₂[n]?) :
    l₁ = l₂

name: ext_get_iff
statement:
theorem ext_get_iff {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    l₁ = l₂ ↔ l₁.length = l₂.length ∧ ∀ n h₁ h₂, get l₁ ⟨n, h₁⟩ = get l₂ ⟨n, h₂⟩
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨rfl, fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl⟩
  · intro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    exact ext_get h₁ h₂

name: ext_getElem
statement:
theorem ext_getElem?_iff' {l₁ l₂ : List α} : l₁ = l₂ ↔
    ∀ n < max l₁.length l₂.length, l₁[n]? = l₂[n]?

name: ext_getElem
statement:
theorem ext_getElem! [Inhabited α] (hl : length l₁ = length l₂) (h : ∀ n : ℕ, l₁[n]! = l₂[n]!) :
    l₁ = l₂
proof:
:=
  ext_getElem hl fun n h₁ h₂ ↦ by simpa only [← getElem!_pos] using h n

name: idxOf_get
statement: theorem idxOf_get [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {a : α} {l : List α} (h) : get l ⟨idxOf a l, h⟩ = a

name: getElem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem getElem?_idxOf [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {a : α} {l : List α} (h : a ∈ l) :
    l[idxOf a l]? = some a

name: idxOf_inj
statement:
theorem idxOf_inj [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] {l : List α} {x y : α} (hx : x ∈ l) :
    idxOf x l = idxOf y l ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ h ▸ rfl⟩
  rw [← getElem_idxOf (idxOf_lt_length_iff.mpr hx)]
  simp [h]

name: get_reverse'
statement:
theorem get_reverse' (l : List α) (n) (hn') :
    l.reverse.get n = l.get ⟨l.length - 1 - n, hn'⟩

name: eq_cons_of_length_one
statement: theorem eq_cons_of_length_one {l : List α} (h : l.length = 1) : l = [l.get ⟨0, by lia⟩]
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_get (by convert! h) (by grind)

name: getElem_set_of_ne
statement:
theorem getElem_set_of_ne {l : List α} {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≠ j) (a : α)
    (hj : j < (l.set i a).length) :
    (l.set i a)[j] = l[j]'(by simpa using hj)

name: flatMap_pure_eq_map
statement: theorem flatMap_pure_eq_map (f : α → β) (l : List α) : l.flatMap (pure ∘ f) = map f l

name: flatMap_congr
statement:
theorem flatMap_congr {l : List α} {f g : α → List β} (h : ∀ x ∈ l, f x = g x) :
    l.flatMap f = l.flatMap g

name: infix_flatMap_of_mem
statement:
theorem infix_flatMap_of_mem {a : α} {as : List α} (h : a ∈ as) (f : α → List α) :
    f a <:+: as.flatMap f

name: map_eq_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_eq_map {α β} (f : α → β) (l : List α) : f <$> l = map f l

name: comp_map
statement: theorem comp_map (h : β → γ) (g : α → β) (l : List α) : map (h ∘ g) l = map h (map g l)

name: map_comp_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_comp_map (g : β → γ) (f : α → β) : map g ∘ map f = map (g ∘ f)

name: _root_.Function.LeftInverse.list_map
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.LeftInverse.list_map {f : α → β} {g : β → α} (h : LeftInverse f g) :
    LeftInverse (map f) (map g)
  | [] => by simp_rw [map_nil]
  | x :: xs => by simp_rw [map_cons, h x, h.list_map xs]

nonrec theorem _root_.Function.RightInverse.list_map {f : α → β} {g : β → α}
    (h : RightInverse f g) : RightInverse (map f) (map g)

name: map_leftInverse_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_leftInverse_iff {f : α → β} {g : β → α} :
    LeftInverse (map f) (map g) ↔ LeftInverse f g

name: map_rightInverse_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_rightInverse_iff {f : α → β} {g : β → α} :
    RightInverse (map f) (map g) ↔ RightInverse f g

name: map_involutive_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_involutive_iff {f : α → α} :
    Involutive (map f) ↔ Involutive f

name: _root_.Function.Injective.list_map
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.Injective.list_map {f : α → β} (h : Injective f) :
    Injective (map f)
  | [], [], _ => rfl
  | x :: xs, y :: ys, hxy => by
    injection hxy with hxy hxys
    rw [h hxy, h.list_map hxys]

@[simp]

name: map_injective_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_injective_iff {f : α → β} : Injective (map f) ↔ Injective f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h x y hxy => ?_, (·.list_map)⟩
  suffices [x] = [y] by simpa using this
  apply h
  simp [hxy]

name: _root_.Function.Surjective.list_map
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.Surjective.list_map {f : α → β} (h : Surjective f) :
    Surjective (map f)

name: map_surjective_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_surjective_iff {f : α → β} : Surjective (map f) ↔ Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h x => ?_, (·.list_map)⟩
  let ⟨[y], hxy⟩ := h [x]
  exact ⟨_, List.singleton_injective hxy⟩

name: _root_.Function.Bijective.list_map
statement: theorem _root_.Function.Bijective.list_map {f : α → β} (h : Bijective f) : Bijective (map f)

name: map_bijective_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_bijective_iff {f : α → β} : Bijective (map f) ↔ Bijective f

name: eq_of_mem_map_const
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_map_const {b₁ b₂ : β} {l : List α} (h : b₁ ∈ map (const α b₂) l) :
    b₁ = b₂
proof: := by rw [map_const] at h; exact eq_of_mem_replicate h

name: eq_nil_or_concat'
statement: lemma eq_nil_or_concat' (l : List α) : l = [] ∨ ∃ L b, l = L ++ [b]

name: foldl_ext
statement:
theorem foldl_ext (f g : α → β → α) (a : α) {l : List β} (H : ∀ a : α, ∀ b ∈ l, f a b = g a b) :
    foldl f a l = foldl g a l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    unfold foldl
    rw [ih _ fun a b bin => H a b <| mem_cons_of_mem _ bin, H a hd mem_cons_self]

name: foldr_ext
statement:
theorem foldr_ext (f g : α → β → β) (b : β) {l : List α} (H : ∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b : β, f a b = g a b) :
    foldr f b l = foldr g b l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with | nil => rfl | cons hd tl ih => ?_
  simp only [mem_cons, or_imp, forall_and, forall_eq] at H
  simp only [foldr, ih H.2, H.1]

name: foldl_concat
statement:
theorem foldl_concat
    (f : β → α → β) (b : β) (x : α) (xs : List α) :
    List.foldl f b (xs ++ [x]) = f (List.foldl f b xs) x

name: foldr_concat
statement:
theorem foldr_concat
    (f : α → β → β) (b : β) (x : α) (xs : List α) :
    List.foldr f b (xs ++ [x]) = (List.foldr f (f x b) xs)

name: foldl_fixed'
statement:
theorem foldl_fixed' {f : α → β → α} {a : α} (hf : ∀ b, f a b = a) : ∀ l : List β, foldl f a l = a
  | [] => rfl
  | b :: l => by rw [foldl_cons, hf b, foldl_fixed' hf l]

name: foldr_fixed'
statement:
theorem foldr_fixed' {f : α → β → β} {b : β} (hf : ∀ a, f a b = b) : ∀ l : List α, foldr f b l = b
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => by rw [foldr_cons, foldr_fixed' hf l, hf a]

@[simp]

name: foldl_fixed
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldl_fixed {a : α} : ∀ l : List β, foldl (fun a _ => a) a l = a

name: foldr_fixed
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foldr_fixed {b : β} : ∀ l : List α, foldr (fun _ b => b) b l = b

name: reverse_foldl
statement: theorem reverse_foldl {l : List α} : reverse (foldl (fun t h => h :: t) [] l) = l

name: foldl_hom
statement:
theorem foldl_hom₂ (l : List ι) (f : α → β → γ) (op₁ : α → ι → α) (op₂ : β → ι → β)
    (op₃ : γ → ι → γ) (a : α) (b : β) (h : ∀ a b i, f (op₁ a i) (op₂ b i) = op₃ (f a b) i) :
    foldl op₃ (f a b) l = f (foldl op₁ a l) (foldl op₂ b l)
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm <| by
    revert a b
    induction l <;> intros <;> [rfl; simp only [*, foldl]]

name: foldr_hom
statement:
theorem foldr_hom₂ (l : List ι) (f : α → β → γ) (op₁ : ι → α → α) (op₂ : ι → β → β)
    (op₃ : ι → γ → γ) (a : α) (b : β) (h : ∀ a b i, f (op₁ i a) (op₂ i b) = op₃ i (f a b)) :
    foldr op₃ (f a b) l = f (foldr op₁ a l) (foldr op₂ b l)
proof:
:= by
  revert a
  induction l <;> intros <;> [rfl; simp only [*, foldr]]

name: injective_foldl_comp
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing f with
  | nil => exact hf
  | cons lh lt l_ih =>
    apply l_ih fun _ h => hl _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
    apply Function.Injective.comp hf
    apply hl _ mem_cons_self

name: append_cons_inj_of_notMem
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [append_eq_append_iff, cons_eq_append_iff, cons_eq_cons]
    rintro (⟨c, rfl, ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨d, rfl, rfl⟩⟩ |
      ⟨c, rfl, ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨d, rfl, rfl⟩⟩) <;> simp_all
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    rfl

name: foldrM_eq_foldr
statement:
theorem foldrM_eq_foldr (f : α → β → m β) (b l) :
    foldrM f b l = foldr (fun a mb => mb >>= f a) (pure b) l

name: foldlM_eq_foldl
statement:
theorem foldlM_eq_foldl (f : β → α → m β) (b l) :
    List.foldlM f b l = foldl (fun mb a => mb >>= fun b => f b a) (pure b) l
proof:
:= by
  suffices h :
    ∀ mb : m β, (mb >>= fun b => List.foldlM f b l) = foldl (fun mb a => mb >>= fun b => f b a) mb l
    by simp [← h (pure b)]
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons _ _ l_ih => intro; simp only [List.foldlM, foldl, ← l_ih, functor_norm]

name: length_eq_length_filter_add
statement:
theorem length_eq_length_filter_add {l : List (α)} (f : α → Bool) :
    l.length = (l.filter f).length + (l.filter (!f ·)).length
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← List.countP_eq_length_filter, l.length_eq_countP_add_countP f, Bool.not_eq_true,
    Bool.decide_eq_false]

name: filterMap_eq_flatMap_toList
statement:
theorem filterMap_eq_flatMap_toList (f : α → Option β) (l : List α) :
    l.filterMap f = l.flatMap fun a ↦ (f a).toList
proof:
:= by
  induction l with | nil => ?_ | cons a l ih => ?_ <;> simp [filterMap_cons]
  rcases f a <;> simp [ih]

name: filterMap_congr
filterMap_eq_map_iff_forall_eq_some
statement:
theorem filterMap_eq_map_iff_forall_eq_some {f : α → Option β} {g : α → β} {l : List α} :
    l.filterMap f = l.map g ↔ ∀ x ∈ l, f x = some (g x) where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    induction l with | nil => simp | cons a l ih => ?_
    rcases ha : f a with - | b
    · intro h
      have : (filterMap f l).length = l.length + 1 := by grind
      grind
    · simp +contextual [ha, ih]
  mpr h := Eq.trans (filterMap_congr <| by simpa) (congr_fun filterMap_eq_map _)

name: filterMap_none
statement:
@[simp]
lemma filterMap_none (l : List α) :
    l.filterMap (fun _ ↦ @Option.none β) = []

name: filter_singleton
statement: theorem filter_singleton {a : α} : [a].filter p = bif p a then [a] else []

name: filter_eq_foldr
statement:
theorem filter_eq_foldr (p : α → Bool) (l : List α) :
    filter p l = foldr (fun a out => bif p a then a :: out else out) [] l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp [filter, ih]
    cases p a <;> rfl

name: filter_subset_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_subset_self (l : List α) : filter p l ⊆ l

name: of_mem_filter
statement: theorem of_mem_filter {a : α} {l} (h : a ∈ filter p l) : p a

name: mem_of_mem_filter
statement: theorem mem_of_mem_filter {a : α} {l} (h : a ∈ filter p l) : a ∈ l

name: mem_filter_of_mem
statement: theorem mem_filter_of_mem {a : α} {l} (h₁ : a ∈ l) (h₂ : p a) : a ∈ filter p l

name: monotone_filter_right
statement:
theorem monotone_filter_right (l : List α) ⦃p q : α → Bool⦄
    (h : ∀ a, p a → q a) : l.filter p <+ l.filter q

name: map_filter
statement:
lemma map_filter {f : α → β} (hf : Injective f) (l : List α)
    [DecidablePred fun b => ∃ a, p a ∧ f a = b] :
    (l.filter p).map f = (l.map f).filter fun b => ∃ a, p a ∧ f a = b

name: filter_attach'
statement:
lemma filter_attach' (l : List α) (p : {a // a ∈ l} → Bool) [DecidableEq α] :
    l.attach.filter p =
      (l.filter fun x => ∃ h, p ⟨x, h⟩).attach.map (Subtype.map id fun _ => mem_of_mem_filter)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine map_injective_iff.2 Subtype.coe_injective ?_
  simp [comp_def, map_filter _ Subtype.coe_injective]

name: filter_attach
statement:
lemma filter_attach (l : List α) (p : α → Bool) :
    (l.attach.filter fun x => p x : List {x // x ∈ l}) =
      (l.filter p).attach.map (Subtype.map id fun _ => mem_of_mem_filter)
proof:
:=
  map_injective_iff.2 Subtype.coe_injective <| by
    simp_rw [map_map, comp_def, Subtype.map, id, ← Function.comp_apply (g := Subtype.val),
      ← filter_map, attach_map_subtype_val]

name: filter_comm
statement: lemma filter_comm (q) (l : List α) : filter p (filter q l) = filter q (filter p l)

name: filter_true
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_true (l : List α) :
    filter (fun _ => true) l = l

name: filter_false
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_false (l : List α) :
    filter (fun _ => false) l = []

name: length_eraseP_add_one
statement:
theorem length_eraseP_add_one {l : List α} {a} (al : a ∈ l) (pa : p a) :
    (l.eraseP p).length + 1 = l.length

name: length_erase_add_one
statement:
theorem length_erase_add_one {a : α} {l : List α} (h : a ∈ l) :
    (l.erase a).length + 1 = l.length

name: map_erase
statement:
theorem map_erase [BEq β] [LawfulBEq β] {f : α → β} (finj : Injective f) {a : α} (l : List α) :
    map f (l.erase a) = (map f l).erase (f a)
proof:
:= by
  have : (a == ·) = (f a == f ·) := by ext b; simp [finj.eq_iff]
  rw [erase_eq_eraseP, erase_eq_eraseP, eraseP_map, this]; rfl

name: map_foldl_erase
statement:
theorem map_foldl_erase [BEq β] [LawfulBEq β] {f : α → β} (finj : Injective f) {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    map f (foldl List.erase l₁ l₂) = foldl (fun l a => l.erase (f a)) (map f l₁) l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₂ generalizing l₁ <;> [rfl; simp only [foldl_cons, map_erase finj, *]]

name: erase_getElem
statement:
theorem erase_getElem [BEq ι] [LawfulBEq ι] {l : List ι} {i : ℕ} (hi : i < l.length) :
    Perm (l.erase l[i]) (l.eraseIdx i)
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing i with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l IH => cases i with grind

name: length_eraseIdx_add_one
statement:
theorem length_eraseIdx_add_one {l : List ι} {i : ℕ} (h : i < l.length) :
    (l.eraseIdx i).length + 1 = l.length

name: map_diff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_diff [BEq α] [LawfulBEq α] [BEq β] [LawfulBEq β] {f : α → β}
    (finj : Injective f) {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    map f (l₁.diff l₂) = (map f l₁).diff (map f l₂)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [diff_eq_foldl, foldl_map, map_foldl_erase finj]

name: choose_spec
statement: theorem choose_spec (hp : ∃ a, a ∈ l ∧ p a) : choose p l hp ∈ l ∧ p (choose p l hp)

name: choose_mem
statement: theorem choose_mem (hp : ∃ a, a ∈ l ∧ p a) : choose p l hp ∈ l

name: choose_property
statement: theorem choose_property (hp : ∃ a, a ∈ l ∧ p a) : p (choose p l hp)

name: forall_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem forall_cons (p : α → Prop) (x : α) : ∀ l : List α, Forall p (x :: l) ↔ p x ∧ Forall p l
  | [] => (and_iff_left_of_imp fun _ ↦ trivial).symm
  | _ :: _ => Iff.rfl

@[simp]

name: forall_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem forall_append {p : α → Prop} : ∀ {xs ys : List α},
    Forall p (xs ++ ys) ↔ Forall p xs ∧ Forall p ys
  | [] => by simp
  | _ :: _ => by simp [forall_append, and_assoc]

name: forall_iff_forall_mem
statement:
theorem forall_iff_forall_mem : ∀ {l : List α}, Forall p l ↔ ∀ x ∈ l, p x
  | [] => (iff_true_intro <| forall_mem_nil _).symm
  | x :: l => by rw [forall_mem_cons, forall_cons, forall_iff_forall_mem]

name: Forall.imp
statement:
theorem Forall.imp (h : ∀ x, p x → q x) : ∀ {l : List α}, Forall p l → Forall q l
  | [] => id
  | x :: l => by
    simp only [forall_cons, and_imp]
    rw [← and_imp]
    exact And.imp (h x) (Forall.imp h)

@[simp]

name: forall_map_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem forall_map_iff {p : β → Prop} (f : α → β) : Forall p (l.map f) ↔ Forall (p ∘ f) l

name: get_attach
statement:
theorem get_attach (l : List α) (i) :
    (l.attach.get i).1 = l.get ⟨i, length_attach (l := l) ▸ i.2⟩

name: disjoint_pmap
statement:
theorem disjoint_pmap {p : α → Prop} {f : ∀ a : α, p a → β} {s t : List α}
    (hs : ∀ a ∈ s, p a) (ht : ∀ a ∈ t, p a)
    (hf : ∀ (a a' : α) (ha : p a) (ha' : p a'), f a ha = f a' ha' → a = a')
    (h : Disjoint s t) :
    Disjoint (s.pmap f hs) (t.pmap f ht)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Disjoint, mem_pmap]
  rintro b ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ ⟨a', ha', ha''⟩
  apply h ha
  rwa [hf a a' (hs a ha) (ht a' ha') ha''.symm]

name: disjoint_map
statement:
theorem disjoint_map {f : α → β} {s t : List α} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (h : Disjoint s t) : Disjoint (s.map f) (t.map f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pmap_eq_map (fun _ _ ↦ trivial), ← pmap_eq_map (fun _ _ ↦ trivial)]
  exact disjoint_pmap _ _ (fun _ _ _ _ h' ↦ hf h') h

name: Disjoint.of_map
statement:
theorem Disjoint.of_map {f : α → β} {s t : List α} (h : Disjoint (s.map f) (t.map f)) :
    Disjoint s t
proof:
:= fun _a has hat ↦
  h (mem_map_of_mem has) (mem_map_of_mem hat)

name: Disjoint.map_iff
statement:
theorem Disjoint.map_iff {f : α → β} {s t : List α} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Disjoint (s.map f) (t.map f) ↔ Disjoint s t
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h.of_map, fun h ↦ h.map hf⟩

name: Perm.disjoint_left
statement:
theorem Perm.disjoint_left {l₁ l₂ l : List α} (p : List.Perm l₁ l₂) :
    Disjoint l₁ l ↔ Disjoint l₂ l

statement:
theorem Perm.disjoint_right {l₁ l₂ l : List α} (p : List.Perm l₁ l₂) :
    Disjoint l l₁ ↔ Disjoint l l₂

statement:
@[simp]
theorem disjoint_reverse_left {l₁ l₂ : List α} : Disjoint l₁.reverse l₂ ↔ Disjoint l₁ l₂

statement:
@[simp]
theorem disjoint_reverse_right {l₁ l₂ : List α} : Disjoint l₁ l₂.reverse ↔ Disjoint l₁ l₂

name: lookup_graph
statement:
lemma lookup_graph (f : α → β) {a : α} {as : List α} (h : a ∈ as) :

name: range'_0
statement:
@[simp]
lemma range'_0 (a b : ℕ) : range' a b 0 = replicate b a
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero => simp
  | succ b ih => simp [range'_succ, ih, replicate_succ]

name: left_le_of_mem_range'
statement: lemma left_le_of_mem_range' {a b s x : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ List.range' a b s) : a ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_range'.mp hx
  exact le_add_right a (s * i)

name: Shortlex.of_length_lt
statement: theorem Shortlex.of_length_lt {s t : List α} (h : s.length < t.length) : Shortlex r s t

name: Shortlex.of_lex
statement:
theorem Shortlex.of_lex {s t : List α} (len_eq : s.length = t.length) (h_lex : List.Lex r s t) :
    Shortlex r s t
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.lex_def.mpr
  right
  exact ⟨len_eq, h_lex⟩

name: shortlex_def
statement:
theorem shortlex_def {s t : List α} :
    Shortlex r s t ↔ s.length < t.length ∨ s.length = t.length ∧ Lex r s t

name: shortlex_iff_lex
statement:
theorem shortlex_iff_lex {s t : List α} (h : s.length = t.length) :
    Shortlex r s t ↔ List.Lex r s t

name: shortlex_cons_iff
statement:
theorem shortlex_cons_iff [Std.Irrefl r] {a : α} {s t : List α} :
    Shortlex r (a :: s) (a :: t) ↔ Shortlex r s t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shortlex_def, length_cons, add_lt_add_iff_right, add_left_inj, List.lex_cons_iff]

name: not_shortlex_nil_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem not_shortlex_nil_right {s : List α} : ¬ Shortlex r s []

name: shortlex_nil_or_eq_nil
statement:
theorem shortlex_nil_or_eq_nil : ∀ s : List α, Shortlex r [] s ∨ s = []
  | [] => .inr rfl
  | _ :: tail => .inl <| .of_length_lt tail.length.succ_pos

@[simp]

name: shortlex_singleton_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shortlex_singleton_iff (a b : α) : Shortlex r [a] [b] ↔ r a b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shortlex_def, length_singleton, lt_self_iff_false, lex_singleton_iff, true_and,
    false_or]

name: append_right
statement:
theorem append_right {s₁ s₂ : List α} (t : List α) (h : Shortlex r s₁ s₂) :
    Shortlex r s₁ (s₂ ++ t)
proof:
:= by
  rcases shortlex_def.mp h with h1 | h2
  · apply of_length_lt
    rw [List.length_append]
    lia
  cases t with
  | nil =>
    rw [List.append_nil]
    exact h
  | cons head tail =>
    apply of_length_lt
    rw [List.length_append, List.length_cons]
    lia

name: append_left
statement:
theorem append_left {t₁ t₂ : List α} (h : Shortlex r t₁ t₂) (s : List α) :
    Shortlex r (s ++ t₁) (s ++ t₂)
proof:
:= by
  rcases shortlex_def.mp h with h1 | h2
  · apply of_length_lt
    rw [List.length_append, List.length_append]
    lia
  cases s with
  | nil =>
    rw [List.nil_append, List.nil_append]
    exact h
  | cons head tail =>
    apply of_lex
    · simp only [List.cons_append, List.length_cons, List.length_append,
      add_left_inj, add_right_inj]
      exact h2.1
    exact List.Lex.append_left r h2.2 (head :: tail)

name: _root_.Acc.shortlex
statement:
private theorem _root_.Acc.shortlex {a : α} {b : List α} (aca : Acc r a)
    (acb : Acc (Shortlex r) b)
    (ih : ∀ s : List α, s.length < (a :: b).length → Acc (Shortlex r) s) :
    Acc (Shortlex r) (a :: b)
proof:
:= by
  induction aca generalizing b with
  | intro xa _ iha =>
    induction acb with
    | intro xb _ ihb =>
      refine Acc.intro (xa :: xb) fun p lt => ?_
      rcases shortlex_def.mp lt with h1 | ⟨h2len, h2lex⟩
      · exact ih _ h1
      · cases h2lex with
        | nil => simp at h2len
        | @cons x xs _ h =>
          simp only [length_cons, add_left_inj] at h2len
          refine ihb _ (of_lex h2len h) fun l hl => ?_
          apply ih
          rw [List.length_cons, ← h2len]
          exact hl
        | @rel x xs _ _ h =>
          simp only [List.length_cons, add_left_inj] at h2len
          refine iha _ h (ih xs (by rw [h2len]; simp)) fun l hl => ?_
          apply ih
          rw [List.length_cons, ← h2len]
          exact hl

name: wf
statement: theorem wf (h : WellFounded r) : WellFounded (Shortlex r)
proof:
:= .intro fun a => by
  induction len_a : a.length using Nat.caseStrongRecOn generalizing a with
  | zero =>
    rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff] at len_a
    rw [len_a]
    exact Acc.intro _ <| fun _ ylt => (not_shortlex_nil_right ylt).elim
  | ind n ih =>
    obtain ⟨head, tail, rfl⟩ := List.exists_of_length_succ a len_a
    rw [List.length_cons, add_left_inj] at len_a
    apply Acc.shortlex (WellFounded.apply h head) (ih n le_rfl tail len_a)
    intro l ll
    apply ih l.length _ _ rfl
    rw [← len_a]
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ ll

name: orderedInsert_nil
statement: @[simp, grind =] theorem orderedInsert_nil (a : α) : [].orderedInsert r a = [a]

name: orderedInsert_cons
statement:
@[simp, grind =] theorem orderedInsert_cons (a b : α) (l : List α) :
    (b :: l).orderedInsert r a = if r a b then a :: b :: l else b :: l.orderedInsert r a

name: orderedInsert_cons_of_le
statement:
theorem orderedInsert_cons_of_le {a b : α} (l : List α) (h : a ≼ b) :
    orderedInsert r a (b :: l) = a :: b :: l

name: orderedInsert_of_not_le
statement:
theorem orderedInsert_of_not_le {a b : α} (l : List α) (h : ¬ a ≼ b) :
    orderedInsert r a (b :: l) = b :: orderedInsert r a l

name: insertionSort_nil
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem insertionSort_nil : [].insertionSort r = []

name: insertionSort_cons
statement:
@[simp, grind =] theorem insertionSort_cons (a : α) (l : List α) :
    (a :: l).insertionSort r = orderedInsert r a (insertionSort r l)

name: orderedInsert_length
statement:
theorem orderedInsert_length (L : List α) (a : α) :
    (L.orderedInsert r a).length = L.length + 1

name: orderedInsert_eq_take_drop
statement:
theorem orderedInsert_eq_take_drop (a : α) (l : List α) :
    l.orderedInsert r a = (l.takeWhile fun b => ¬a ≼ b) ++ a :: l.dropWhile fun b => ¬a ≼ b

name: insertionSort_cons_eq_take_drop
statement:
theorem insertionSort_cons_eq_take_drop (a : α) (l : List α) :
    insertionSort r (a :: l) =
      ((insertionSort r l).takeWhile fun b => ¬a ≼ b) ++
        a :: (insertionSort r l).dropWhile fun b => ¬a ≼ b

name: mem_orderedInsert
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_orderedInsert {a b : α} {l : List α} :
    a ∈ orderedInsert r b l ↔ a = b ∨ a ∈ l

name: map_orderedInsert
statement:
theorem map_orderedInsert (f : α → β) (l : List α) (x : α)
    (hl₁ : ∀ a ∈ l, a ≼ x ↔ f a ≼ f x) (hl₂ : ∀ a ∈ l, x ≼ a ↔ f x ≼ f a) :
    (l.orderedInsert r x).map f = (l.map f).orderedInsert s (f x)

name: perm_orderedInsert
statement:
theorem perm_orderedInsert (a) : ∀ l : List α, orderedInsert r a l ~ a :: l
  | [] => Perm.refl _
  | b :: l => by
    by_cases h : a ≼ b
    · simp [h]
    · simpa [h] using ((perm_orderedInsert a l).cons _).trans (Perm.swap _ _ _)

name: orderedInsert_count
statement:
theorem orderedInsert_count [DecidableEq α] (L : List α) (a b : α) :
    count a (L.orderedInsert r b) = count a L + if b = a then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [(L.perm_orderedInsert r b).count_eq, count_cons]
  simp

name: perm_insertionSort
statement: theorem perm_insertionSort (l : List α) : insertionSort r l ~ l

name: mem_insertionSort
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_insertionSort {l : List α} {x : α} : x ∈ l.insertionSort r ↔ x ∈ l

name: length_insertionSort
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_insertionSort (l : List α) : (insertionSort r l).length = l.length

name: insertionSort_cons_of_forall_rel
statement:
theorem insertionSort_cons_of_forall_rel {a : α} {l : List α} (h : ∀ b ∈ l, r a b) :
    insertionSort r (a :: l) = a :: insertionSort r l
proof:
:= by
  rw [insertionSort_cons]
  cases hi : insertionSort r l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b m =>
    rw [orderedInsert_cons_of_le]
    apply h b <| (mem_insertionSort r).1 _
    rw [hi]
    exact mem_cons_self

name: map_insertionSort
statement:
theorem map_insertionSort (f : α → β) (l : List α) (hl : ∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ l, a ≼ b ↔ f a ≼ f b) :
    (l.insertionSort r).map f = (l.map f).insertionSort s
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp_rw [List.forall_mem_cons, forall_and] at hl
    simp_rw [List.map, insertionSort_cons]
    rw [List.map_orderedInsert _ s, ih hl.2.2]
    · simpa only [mem_insertionSort] using hl.2.1
    · simpa only [mem_insertionSort] using hl.1.2

name: Pairwise.insertionSort_eq
statement: theorem Pairwise.insertionSort_eq {l : List α} : Pairwise r l → insertionSort r l = l

name: erase_orderedInsert
statement:
theorem erase_orderedInsert [DecidableEq α] [Std.Refl r] (x : α) (xs : List α) :
    (xs.orderedInsert r x).erase x = xs

name: erase_orderedInsert_of_notMem
statement:
theorem erase_orderedInsert_of_notMem [DecidableEq α]
    {x : α} {xs : List α} (hx : x ∉ xs) :
    (xs.orderedInsert r x).erase x = xs

name: orderedInsert_erase
statement:
theorem orderedInsert_erase [DecidableEq α] [Std.Antisymm r] (x : α) (xs : List α) (hx : x ∈ xs)
    (hxs : Pairwise r xs) :
    (xs.erase x).orderedInsert r x = xs

name: sublist_orderedInsert
statement: theorem sublist_orderedInsert (x : α) (xs : List α) : xs <+ xs.orderedInsert r x

name: cons_sublist_orderedInsert
statement:
theorem cons_sublist_orderedInsert {l c : List α} {a : α} (hl : c <+ l) (ha : ∀ a' ∈ c, a ≼ a') :
    a :: c <+ orderedInsert r a l

name: Sublist.orderedInsert_sublist
statement:
theorem Sublist.orderedInsert_sublist [IsTrans α r] {as bs} (x) (hs : as <+ bs)
    (hb : bs.Pairwise r) : orderedInsert r x as <+ orderedInsert r x bs
proof:
:= by
  cases as with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a as =>
    cases bs with
    | nil => contradiction
    | cons b bs =>
      unfold orderedInsert
      cases hs <;> split_ifs with hr
      · exact .cons_cons _ <| .cons _ ‹a :: as <+ bs›
      · have ih := orderedInsert_sublist x ‹a :: as <+ bs› hb.of_cons
        simp only [hr, orderedInsert_cons, ite_true] at ih
        exact .trans ih <| .cons _ (.refl _)
      · have hba := pairwise_cons.mp hb |>.left _ (mem_of_cons_sublist ‹a :: as <+ bs›)
        exact absurd (trans_of _ ‹r x b› hba) hr
      · have ih := orderedInsert_sublist x ‹a :: as <+ bs› hb.of_cons
        rw [orderedInsert_cons, ite_eq_right hr] at ih
        exact .cons _ ih
      · simp_all
      · exact .cons_cons _ <| orderedInsert_sublist x ‹as <+ bs› hb.of_cons

name: Pairwise.orderedInsert
statement:
theorem Pairwise.orderedInsert (a : α) : ∀ l, Pairwise r l → Pairwise r (orderedInsert r a l)
  | [], _ => pairwise_singleton _ a
  | b :: l, h => by
    by_cases h' : a ≼ b
    · grind
    · suffices ∀ b' : α, b' ∈ List.orderedInsert r a l → r b b' by
        simpa [orderedInsert_cons, h', h.of_cons.orderedInsert a l]
      intro b' bm
      rcases (mem_orderedInsert r).mp bm with rfl | bm
      · exact (total_of r _ _).resolve_left h'
      · exact rel_of_pairwise_cons h bm

variable (r)

/

name: pairwise_insertionSort
statement:
theorem pairwise_insertionSort : ∀ l, Pairwise r (insertionSort r l)
  | [] => Pairwise.nil
  | a :: l => (pairwise_insertionSort l).orderedInsert a _

end TotalAndTransitive

/
If `c` is a sorted sublist of `l`, then `c` is still a sublist of `insertionSort r l`.

name: sublist_insertionSort
statement:
theorem sublist_insertionSort {l c : List α} (hr : c.Pairwise r) (hc : c <+ l) :
    c <+ insertionSort r l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing c with
  | nil         => grind
  | cons _ _ ih =>
    cases hc with
    | cons  _ h => exact ih hr h |>.trans (sublist_orderedInsert ..)
    | cons_cons _ h =>
      obtain ⟨hr, hp⟩ := pairwise_cons.mp hr
      exact cons_sublist_orderedInsert (ih hp h) hr

name: pair_sublist_insertionSort

name: sublist_insertionSort'
statement:
theorem sublist_insertionSort' {l c : List α} (hs : c.Pairwise r) (hc : c <+~ l) :
    c <+ insertionSort r l
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨d, hc, hd⟩ := hc
  induction l generalizing c d with
  | nil         => grind [nil_perm]
  | cons a _ ih =>
    cases hd with
    | cons  _ h => exact ih hs _ hc h |>.trans (sublist_orderedInsert ..)
    | cons_cons _ h =>
      specialize ih (hs.erase _) _ (erase_cons_head a ‹List _› ▸ hc.erase a) h
      have hm := hc.mem_iff.mp <| mem_cons_self ..
      have he := orderedInsert_erase _ _ hm hs
      exact he ▸ Sublist.orderedInsert_sublist _ ih (pairwise_insertionSort ..)

name: sublist_of_subperm_of_pairwise
statement:

    (hs₁ : l₁.Pairwise r) (hs₂ : l₂.Pairwise r) : l₁ <+ l₂
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨_, h, h'⟩ := hp
  exact Sublist.trans (h.eq_of_pairwise' (hs₂.sublist h') hs₁ ▸ Sublist.refl _) h'

statement:
theorem Subset.antisymm_of_pairwise [Std.Irrefl r] {l₁ l₂ : List α}
    (h₁ : Pairwise r l₁) (h₂ : Pairwise r l₂) (hl₁₂ : l₁ ⊆ l₂) (hl₁₂' : l₂ ⊆ l₁) : l₁ = l₂
proof:
:=
  ((subperm_of_subset h₁.nodup hl₁₂).antisymm
    (subperm_of_subset h₂.nodup hl₁₂')).eq_of_pairwise' h₁ h₂

name: Pairwise.merge
statement:
theorem Pairwise.merge {l l' : List α} (h : Pairwise r l) (h' : Pairwise r l') :
    Pairwise r (merge l l' (r · ·))
proof:
:= by
  simpa using pairwise_merge (le := (r · ·))
    (fun a b c h₁ h₂ => by simpa using _root_.trans (by simpa using h₁) (by simpa using h₂))
    (fun a b => by simpa using Std.Total.total a b)
    l l' (by simpa using h) (by simpa using h')

name: pairwise_mergeSort'
statement: theorem pairwise_mergeSort' (l : List α) : Pairwise r (mergeSort l (r · ·))
proof:
:= by
  simpa using pairwise_mergeSort (le := (r · ·))
    (fun _ _ _ => by simpa using trans_of r)
    (by simpa using total_of r)
    l

    (pairwise_mergeSort' r l) (pairwise_insertionSort r l)

proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons head tail ih =>
    simp only [triplewise_cons, length_cons, pairwise_iff_getElem, ih]
    refine ⟨fun ⟨hh, ht⟩ i j k hij hjk hk ↦ ?_,
            fun h ↦ ⟨fun i j hi hj hij ↦ ?_, fun i j k hij hjk hk ↦ ?_⟩⟩
    · grind
    · simpa using! h 0 (i + 1) (j + 1) (by lia) (by lia) (by lia)
    · simpa using! h (i + 1) (j + 1) (k + 1) (by lia) (by lia) (by lia)

name: length_mapAccumr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_mapAccumr :
    ∀ (f : α → γ → γ × β) (x : List α) (s : γ), length (mapAccumr f x s).2 = length x
  | f, _ :: x, s => congr_arg succ (length_mapAccumr f x s)
  | _, [], _ => rfl

/
def mapAccumr₂ (f : α → β → γ → γ × δ) : List α → List β → γ → γ × List δ
  | [], _, c => (c, [])
  | _, [], c => (c, [])
  | x :: xr, y :: yr, c =>
    let r
proof:
:= mapAccumr₂ f xr yr c
    let q := f x y r.1
    (q.1, q.2 :: r.2)

name: length_mapAccumr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_mapAccumr₂ :
    ∀ (f : α → β → γ → γ × δ) (x y c), length (mapAccumr₂ f x y c).2 = min (length x) (length y)
  | f, _ :: x, _ :: y, c =>
    calc
      succ (length (mapAccumr₂ f x y c).2) = succ (min (length x) (length y))
proof:
:=
        congr_arg succ (length_mapAccumr₂ f x y c)
      _ = min (succ (length x)) (succ (length y)) := Eq.symm (succ_min_succ (length x) (length y))
  | _, _ :: _, [], _ => rfl
  | _, [], _ :: _, _ => rfl
  | _, [], [], _ => rfl
