name: mem_inits
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_inits : ∀ s t : List α, s ∈ inits t ↔ s <+: t
  | s, [] =>
    suffices s = nil ↔ s <+: nil by simpa only [inits, mem_singleton]
    ⟨fun h => h.symm ▸ prefix_rfl, eq_nil_of_prefix_nil⟩
  | s, a :: t =>
    suffices (s = nil ∨ ∃ l ∈ inits t, a :: l = s) ↔ s <+: a :: t by simpa
    ⟨fun o =>
      match s, o with
      | _, Or.inl rfl => ⟨_, rfl⟩
      | s, Or.inr ⟨r, hr, hs⟩ => by
        let ⟨s, ht⟩
proof:
:= (mem_inits _ _).1 hr
        rw [← hs, ← ht]; exact ⟨s, rfl⟩,
      fun mi =>
      match s, mi with
      | [], ⟨_, rfl⟩ => Or.inl rfl
      | b :: s, ⟨r, hr⟩ =>
        (List.noConfusion rfl (heq_of_eq hr)) fun ba (st : s ++ r ≍ t) =>
          Or.inr <| by rw [eq_of_heq ba]; exact ⟨_, (mem_inits _ _).2 ⟨_, eq_of_heq st⟩, rfl⟩⟩

name: mem_tails
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_tails : ∀ s t : List α, s ∈ tails t ↔ s <:+ t
  | s, [] => by
    simp only [tails, mem_singleton, suffix_nil]
  | s, a :: t => by
    simp only [tails, mem_cons, mem_tails s t]
    exact
      show s = a :: t ∨ s <:+ t ↔ s <:+ a :: t from
        ⟨fun o =>
          match s, t, o with
          | _, t, Or.inl rfl => suffix_rfl
          | s, _, Or.inr ⟨l, rfl⟩ => ⟨a :: l, rfl⟩,
          fun e =>
          match s, t, e with
          | _, t, ⟨[], rfl⟩ => Or.inl rfl
          | s, t, ⟨b :: l, he⟩ =>
            List.noConfusion rfl (heq_of_eq he) fun _ lt => Or.inr ⟨l, eq_of_heq lt⟩⟩

name: modifyLast.go_concat
statement:
private theorem modifyLast.go_concat (f : α → α) (a : α) (tl : List α) (r : Array α) :
    modifyLast.go f (tl ++ [a]) r = (r.toListAppend <| modifyLast.go f (tl ++ [a]) #[])
proof:
:= by
  cases tl with
  | nil =>
    simp only [nil_append, modifyLast.go]; simp
  | cons hd tl =>
    simp only [cons_append]
    rw [modifyLast.go, modifyLast.go]
    case x_3 | x_3 => exact append_ne_nil_of_right_ne_nil tl (cons_ne_nil a [])
    rw [modifyLast.go_concat _ _ tl _, modifyLast.go_concat _ _ tl (Array.push #[] hd)]
    simp only [Array.toListAppend_eq, Array.toList_push, nil_append,
      append_assoc]

name: modifyLast_concat
statement:
theorem modifyLast_concat (f : α → α) (a : α) (l : List α) :
    modifyLast f (l ++ [a]) = l ++ [f a]
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil =>
    simp only [nil_append, modifyLast, modifyLast.go, Array.toListAppend_eq]
  | cons _ tl =>
    simp only [cons_append, modifyLast]
    rw [modifyLast.go]
    case x_3 => exact append_ne_nil_of_right_ne_nil tl (cons_ne_nil a [])
    rw [modifyLast.go_concat, Array.toListAppend_eq, Array.toList_push, List.toList_toArray,
      nil_append, cons_append, nil_append, cons_inj_right]
    exact modifyLast_concat _ _ tl

name: modifyLast_append_of_right_ne_nil
statement:
theorem modifyLast_append_of_right_ne_nil (f : α → α) (l₁ l₂ : List α) (_ : l₂ ≠ []) :
    modifyLast f (l₁ ++ l₂) = l₁ ++ modifyLast f l₂
proof:
:= by
  cases l₂ with
  | nil => contradiction
  | cons hd tl =>
    cases tl with
    | nil =>
      simp only [modifyLast, modifyLast.go, Array.toListAppend_eq, nil_append]
      exact modifyLast_concat _ hd _
    | cons hd' tl' =>
      rw [append_cons, ← nil_append (hd :: hd' :: tl'), append_cons [], nil_append,
        modifyLast_append_of_right_ne_nil _ (l₁ ++ [hd]) (hd' :: tl') _,
        modifyLast_append_of_right_ne_nil _ [hd] (hd' :: tl') _,
        append_assoc]
      all_goals { exact cons_ne_nil _ _ }

name: hasPeriod_iff_getElem
statement:
lemma hasPeriod_iff_getElem? {p : ℕ} {w : List α} :
    HasPeriod w p ↔ ∀ i < w.length - p, w[i]? = w[i + p]?
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [HasPeriod]
    intro pref j len
    have i1 : j < w.length := by lia
    have i2 : j + p < w.length := by lia
    have min : p < w.length := by lia
    have : j + p - (List.take p w).length = j := by
      simp_all [min_eq_left_of_lt]
    simp_all [getElem_append_right, IsPrefix.getElem pref, min_eq_left_of_lt]
  · intro lhs
    rw [HasPeriod]
    have drop : drop p w <+: w := by
      simp only [prefix_iff_getElem?, length_drop, getElem_drop]
      intro i leni
      have len : i + p < w.length := by lia
      simp_all only [getElem?_pos, add_comm p i]
    rw [← prefix_append_right_inj (w.take p)] at drop
    simp_all

name: HasPeriod.getElem
statement:
lemma HasPeriod.getElem?_mod (p i : ℕ) (w : List α) (per : HasPeriod w p)
    (less : i < w.length) : w[i % p]? = w[i]?
proof:
:= by
  by_cases p_zero : p = 0
  · rw [p_zero, mod_zero]
  · cases lt_or_ge i p with
    | inl small =>
        have eq : i % p = i := mod_eq_of_lt small
        rw [eq]
    | inr large =>
        have len' : i - p < w.length := by lia
        have IH : w[(i - p) % p]? = w[i - p]? := per.getElem?_mod p (i - p) w len'
        rw [hasPeriod_iff_getElem?] at per
        have minus : i - p < w.length - p := by lia
        have per' := per (i - p) minus
        simp only [large, Nat.sub_add_cancel] at per'
        have mod : i % p = (i - p) % p := mod_eq_sub_mod large
        aesop

name: hasPeriod_iff_forall_getElem
statement:
lemma hasPeriod_iff_forall_getElem?_mod {p : ℕ} {w : List α} :
    HasPeriod w p ↔ (∀ i < w.length, w[i]? = w[i % p]?)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro per i len
    exact Eq.symm (per.getElem?_mod p i w len)
  · intro mod
    rw [hasPeriod_iff_getElem?]
    intro i less
    rw [mod (i + p) (by lia), add_mod_right, mod i (by lia)]

name: HasPeriod.factor
statement:
lemma HasPeriod.factor {u v w : List α} {p : ℕ} (per : HasPeriod (u ++ v ++ w) p) :
    HasPeriod v p
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ j < v.length - p, v[j]? = v[j + p]? by simpa [hasPeriod_iff_getElem?]
  intro j len
  have shift_position : (u ++ (v ++ w))[j + u.length]? = v[j]? := by
    rw [getElem?_append_right, Nat.add_sub_cancel, getElem?_append_left]
    all_goals lia
  have shift_position' : (u ++ (v ++ w))[j + u.length + p]? = v[j + p]? := by
    have eq : j + u.length + p - u.length = j + p := by lia
    rw [getElem?_append_right]
    · rw [getElem?_append_left]
      · exact congrArg (getElem? v) eq
      · lia
    · lia
  have : ∀ i < u.length + (v.length + w.length) - p,
      (u ++ (v ++ w))[i]? = (u ++ (v ++ w))[i + p]? := by
    simp_all [hasPeriod_iff_getElem?]
  rw [← shift_position', ← shift_position]
  exact this (j + u.length) (by lia)

statement:
lemma HasPeriod.infix {u w : List α} {p : ℕ} (per : HasPeriod w p) (h : u <:+: w) :

proof:

  exact per.factor

statement:
lemma HasPeriod.drop_prefix {w : List α} (p : ℕ) (per : HasPeriod w p) :

name: HasPeriod.take_append
statement:
lemma HasPeriod.take_append (p n : ℕ) (w : List α) (dvd : p ∣ n)
    (len : n ≤ w.length) (per : HasPeriod w p) : HasPeriod (take n w ++ w) p
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p with rfl | p_pos
  · simp_all [HasPeriod]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | pos
  · simp_all
  rw [hasPeriod_iff_forall_getElem?_mod]
  have mod_w : ∀ i < w.length, w[i % p]? = w[i]? := (per.getElem?_mod)
  suffices ∀ i < n + w.length, (take n w ++ w)[i]? = (take n w ++ w)[i % p]? by simp_all
  intro i less_i
  have mod_p : ∀ j < n + length w, (take n w ++ w)[j]? = w[j % p]? := by
    intro j less_j
    by_cases j_lt_n : j < n
    · 
      calc
        (take n w ++ w)[j]? = (take n w)[j]? := getElem?_append_left (by simp_all)
        _ = w[j]? := getElem?_take_of_lt j_lt_n
        _ = w[j % p]? := Eq.symm (mod_w j (by lia))
    · 
      have j_minus : j - n < w.length := by lia
      have n_le_j : n ≤ j := le_of_not_gt j_lt_n; clear j_lt_n;
      have j_mod : (j - n) % p = j % p := by
        calc
          (j - n) % p = (j - p * (n / p)) % p := by rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' dvd]
          _ = j % p := sub_mul_mod ((Nat.mul_div_cancel' dvd).symm ▸ n_le_j)
      calc
        (take n w ++ w)[j]? = w[j - (take n w).length]? := getElem?_append_right (by simp_all)
        _ = w[j - n]? := by simp_all
        _ = w[(j - n) % p]? := Eq.symm (mod_w (j - n) (by lia))
        _ = w[j % p]? := by rw [j_mod]
  have less_mod : i % p < n + w.length := by
    have : i % p < p := mod_lt i p_pos; have : p ≤ n := le_of_dvd pos dvd; lia
  rw [mod_p i less_i, mod_p (i % p) less_mod, mod_mod]

name: HasPeriod.drop_of_hasPeriod_add
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasPeriod_iff_getElem?] at per_plus per_q ⊢
  simp only [length_drop, getElem?_drop]
  intro i i_lt
  calc
     w[q + i]? = w[i + q]? := congrArg (getElem? w) (add_comm q i)
     _ = w[i]? := (per_q i (by lia)).symm
     _ = w[i + (k + q)]? := per_plus i (by lia)
     _ = w[q + (i + k)]? := congr_arg (getElem? w) (by lia)

name: HasPeriod.gcd
statement:
theorem HasPeriod.gcd {w : List α} {p q : ℕ} (per_p : HasPeriod w p) (per_q : HasPeriod w q)
    (len : p + q - p.gcd q ≤ w.length) : HasPeriod w (p.gcd q)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos p with rfl | p_pos
  · simp_all [HasPeriod]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos q with rfl | q_pos
  · simp_all
  cases hyp : compare p q with
  | lt => 
      have p_lt_q := Nat.compare_eq_lt.mp hyp
      exact (gcd_comm q p ▸ per_q.gcd) per_p (add_comm p q ▸ len)
  | eq => simpa [(Nat.compare_eq_eq).mp hyp]
  | gt =>
      have q_lt_p : q < p := Nat.compare_eq_gt.mp hyp
      have gcd_lt_p : p.gcd q < p := by
        have : p.gcd q ≠ p := by
          simp [gcd_eq_left_iff_dvd, not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt q_pos q_lt_p]
        exact this.lt_of_le (gcd_le_left q p_pos)
      have per_diff : HasPeriod (drop q w) (p - q) := by
        have : p = (p - q) + q := by lia
        exact per_q.drop_of_hasPeriod_add (this ▸ per_p)
      have per_q' : HasPeriod (drop q w) q := by
        apply @HasPeriod.factor _ (take q w) (drop q w) [] q
        all_goals simp_all
      have gcd_stable : (p - q).gcd q = p.gcd q := gcd_sub_self_left (le_of_lt q_lt_p)
      have drop_len : q ≤ (drop q w).length := by
        rw [length_drop]
        have : p.gcd q ≤ p - q := by
          rw [← gcd_stable]; apply gcd_le_left q; lia
        lia
      have take_eq : take q (drop q w) = take q w := by
          let ⟨z, hz⟩ := per_q.drop_prefix
          convert_to take q (drop q w) = take q (drop q w ++ z)
          · rw [hz]
          exact (take_append_of_le_length drop_len).symm
      
      have IH : HasPeriod (drop q w) ((p - q).gcd q) :=
        per_diff.gcd per_q' (by simp; lia)
      convert_to HasPeriod (take q (drop q w) ++ drop q w) (p.gcd q)
      · rw [take_eq, take_append_drop q w]
      · exact (gcd_stable ▸ IH).take_append (p.gcd q) q (drop q w)
          (gcd_dvd_right p q) drop_len
  termination_by (q, p)
  decreasing_by
    all_goals grind

@[simp, norm_cast]

name: toFinsupp_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toFinsupp_nil [DecidablePred fun i => getD ([] : List M) i 0 ≠ 0] :
    toFinsupp ([] : List M) = 0

name: toFinsupp_singleton
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_singleton (x : M) [DecidablePred (getD [x] · 0 ≠ 0)] :
    toFinsupp [x] = Finsupp.single 0 x

name: toFinsupp_append
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_append {R : Type*} [AddZeroClass R] (l₁ l₂ : List R)
    [DecidablePred (getD (l₁ ++ l₂) · 0 ≠ 0)] [DecidablePred (getD l₁ · 0 ≠ 0)]
    [DecidablePred (getD l₂ · 0 ≠ 0)] :
    toFinsupp (l₁ ++ l₂) =
      toFinsupp l₁ + (toFinsupp l₂).embDomain (addLeftEmbedding l₁.length)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [toFinsupp_apply, Finsupp.add_apply]
  cases lt_or_ge n l₁.length with
  | inl h =>
    rw [getD_append _ _ _ _ h, Finsupp.embDomain_of_notMem_range, add_zero]
    rintro ⟨k, rfl : length l₁ + k = n⟩
    lia
  | inr h =>
    rcases Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [getD_append_right _ _ _ _ h, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, getD_eq_default _ _ h, zero_add]
    exact Eq.symm (Finsupp.embDomain_apply_self _ _ _)

name: toFinsupp_cons_eq_single_add_embDomain
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_cons_eq_single_add_embDomain {R : Type*} [AddZeroClass R] (x : R) (xs : List R)
    [DecidablePred (getD (x::xs) · 0 ≠ 0)] [DecidablePred (getD xs · 0 ≠ 0)] :
    toFinsupp (x::xs) =
      Finsupp.single 0 x + (toFinsupp xs).embDomain (addRightEmbedding 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
    convert! toFinsupp_append [x] xs using 3
    · exact (toFinsupp_singleton x).symm
    · ext n
      exact add_comm n 1

name: toFinsupp_concat_eq_toFinsupp_add_single
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_concat_eq_toFinsupp_add_single {R : Type*} [AddZeroClass R] (x : R) (xs : List R)
    [DecidablePred fun i => getD (xs ++ [x]) i 0 ≠ 0] [DecidablePred fun i => getD xs i 0 ≠ 0] :
    toFinsupp (xs ++ [x]) = toFinsupp xs + Finsupp.single xs.length x
proof:
:= by
  classical rw [toFinsupp_append, toFinsupp_singleton, Finsupp.embDomain_single,
    addLeftEmbedding_apply, add_zero]

name: toFinsupp_eq_sum_mapIdx_single
statement:
theorem toFinsupp_eq_sum_mapIdx_single {R : Type*} [AddMonoid R] (l : List R)
    [DecidablePred (getD l · 0 ≠ 0)] :
    toFinsupp l = (l.mapIdx fun n r => Finsupp.single n r).sum
proof:
:= by
  /- Porting note: `induction` fails to substitute `l = []` in
  `[DecidablePred (getD l · 0 ≠ 0)]`, so we manually do some `revert`/`intro` as a workaround -/
  revert l; intro l
  induction l using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => exact toFinsupp_nil
  | append_singleton x xs ih =>
    classical simp [toFinsupp_concat_eq_toFinsupp_add_single, sum_append, ih]

name: foldl_cons_nil
statement: lemma foldl_cons_nil : l.foldl (flip cons) [] = l.reverse

name: foldl_cons_eq_apply_foldl

name: splitBy_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem splitBy_nil (r : α → α → Bool) : splitBy r [] = []

name: splitByLoop_eq_append
statement:
private theorem splitByLoop_eq_append {r : α → α → Bool} {l : List α} {a : α} {g : List α}
    (gs : List (List α)) : splitBy.loop r l a g gs = gs.reverse ++ splitBy.loop r l a g []
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a g gs with
  | nil => simp [splitBy.loop]
  | cons b l IH =>
    simp_rw [splitBy.loop]
    split <;> rw [IH]
    conv_rhs => rw [IH]
    simp

name: flatten_splitByLoop
statement:
private theorem flatten_splitByLoop {r : α → α → Bool} {l : List α} {a : α} {g : List α} :
    (splitBy.loop r l a g []).flatten = g.reverse ++ a :: l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a g with
  | nil => simp [splitBy.loop]
  | cons b l IH =>
    rw [splitBy.loop, splitByLoop_eq_append [_]]
    split <;> simp [IH]

name: flatten_splitBy
statement:
@[simp]
theorem flatten_splitBy (r : α → α → Bool) (l : List α) : (l.splitBy r).flatten = l
proof:
:=
  match l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ => flatten_splitByLoop

name: splitBy_eq_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem splitBy_eq_nil {r : α → α → Bool} {l : List α} : l.splitBy r = [] ↔ l = []
proof:
:= by
  have := flatten_splitBy r l
  refine ⟨fun _ ↦ ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp_all

name: splitBy_ne_nil
statement: theorem splitBy_ne_nil {r : α → α → Bool} {l : List α} : l.splitBy r ≠ [] ↔ l ≠ []

name: nil_notMem_splitByLoop
statement:
private theorem nil_notMem_splitByLoop {r : α → α → Bool} {l : List α} {a : α} {g : List α} :
    [] ∉ splitBy.loop r l a g []
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a g with
  | nil => simp [splitBy.loop]
  | cons b l IH =>
    rw [splitBy.loop]
    split
    · exact IH
    · rw [splitByLoop_eq_append, mem_append]
      simpa using IH

name: nil_notMem_splitBy
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nil_notMem_splitBy (r : α → α → Bool) (l : List α) : [] ∉ l.splitBy r
proof:
:=
  match l with
  | nil => not_mem_nil
  | cons _ _ => nil_notMem_splitByLoop

name: ne_nil_of_mem_splitBy
statement: theorem ne_nil_of_mem_splitBy {r : α → α → Bool} {l : List α} (h : m ∈ l.splitBy r) : m ≠ []

name: head_head_splitBy
statement:
theorem head_head_splitBy (r : α → α → Bool) {l : List α} (hn : l ≠ []) :
    ((l.splitBy r).head (splitBy_ne_nil.2 hn)).head
      (ne_nil_of_mem_splitBy (head_mem _)) = l.head hn

name: getLast_getLast_splitBy
statement:
theorem getLast_getLast_splitBy (r : α → α → Bool) {l : List α} (hn : l ≠ []) :
    ((l.splitBy r).getLast (splitBy_ne_nil.2 hn)).getLast
      (ne_nil_of_mem_splitBy (getLast_mem _)) = l.getLast hn

name: isChain_of_mem_splitByLoop
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a g with
  | nil =>
    rw [splitBy.loop, reverse_cons, mem_append, mem_reverse, mem_singleton] at h
    obtain hm | rfl := h
    · cases not_mem_nil hm
    · apply List.isChain_reverse.1
      rw [reverse_reverse]
      exact isChain_cons.2 ⟨hga, hg⟩
  | cons b l IH =>
    simp only [splitBy.loop, reverse_cons] at h
    split at h
    · apply IH _ (isChain_cons.2 ⟨hga, hg⟩) h
      grind
    · rw [splitByLoop_eq_append, mem_append, reverse_singleton, mem_singleton] at h
      obtain rfl | hm := h
      · apply List.isChain_reverse.1
        rw [reverse_append, reverse_cons, reverse_nil, nil_append, reverse_reverse]
        exact isChain_cons.2 ⟨hga, hg⟩
      · grind

name: isChain_of_mem_splitBy
statement:
theorem isChain_of_mem_splitBy {r : α → α → Bool} {l : List α} (h : m ∈ l.splitBy r) :
    m.IsChain fun x y ↦ r x y
proof:
:= by
  match l, h with
  | a::l, h => apply isChain_of_mem_splitByLoop _ _ h <;> simp

name: isChain_getLast_head_splitByLoop
statement:
private theorem isChain_getLast_head_splitByLoop {r : α → α → Bool} (l : List α) {a : α}
    {g : List α} {gs : List (List α)} (hgs' : [] ∉ gs)
    (hgs : gs.IsChain fun b a ↦ ∃ ha hb, r (a.getLast ha) (b.head hb) = false)
    (hga : ∀ m ∈ gs.head?, ∃ ha hb, r (m.getLast ha) ((g.reverse ++ [a]).head hb) = false) :
    (splitBy.loop r l a g gs).IsChain fun a b ↦ ∃ ha hb, r (a.getLast ha) (b.head hb) = false
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a g gs with
  | nil =>
    rw [splitBy.loop, reverse_cons]
    apply List.isChain_reverse.1
    simpa using isChain_cons.2 ⟨hga, hgs⟩
  | cons b l IH =>
    rw [splitBy.loop]
    split
    · refine IH hgs' hgs fun m hm ↦ ?_
      obtain ⟨ha, _, H⟩ := hga m hm
      refine ⟨ha, append_ne_nil_of_right_ne_nil _ (cons_ne_nil _ _), ?_⟩
      rwa [reverse_cons, head_append_of_ne_nil]
    · apply IH
      · simpa using hgs'
      · rw [reverse_cons]
        apply isChain_cons.2 ⟨hga, hgs⟩
      · simpa

name: isChain_getLast_head_splitBy
statement:
theorem isChain_getLast_head_splitBy (r : α → α → Bool) (l : List α) :
    (l.splitBy r).IsChain fun a b ↦ ∃ ha hb, r (a.getLast ha) (b.head hb) = false
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => exact isChain_nil
  | cons _ _ =>
    apply isChain_getLast_head_splitByLoop _ not_mem_nil isChain_nil
    rintro _ ⟨⟩

name: splitByLoop_append
statement:
private theorem splitByLoop_append {r : α → α → Bool} {l g : List α} {a : α}
    (h : (g.reverse ++ a :: l).IsChain fun x y ↦ r x y)
    (ha : ∀ x ∈ m.head?, r ((a :: l).getLast (cons_ne_nil a l)) x = false) :
    splitBy.loop r (l ++ m) a g [] = (g.reverse ++ a :: l) :: m.splitBy r
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a g with
  | nil =>
    rw [nil_append]
    cases m with
    | nil => simp [splitBy.loop]
    | cons c m => simp_all [splitBy.loop, splitByLoop_eq_append [_], splitBy]
  | cons b l IH => simp_all [splitBy.loop]

name: splitBy_of_isChain
statement:
theorem splitBy_of_isChain {r : α → α → Bool} {l : List α} (hn : l ≠ [])
    (h : l.IsChain fun x y ↦ r x y) : splitBy r l = [l]
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => contradiction
  | cons a l => rw [splitBy, ← append_nil l, splitByLoop_append] <;> simp [h]

name: splitBy_append_of_isChain
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => contradiction
  | cons a l => rw [cons_append, splitBy, splitByLoop_append h ha]; simp

name: splitBy_flatten
statement:
theorem splitBy_flatten {r : α → α → Bool} {l : List (List α)} (hn : [] ∉ l)
    (hc : ∀ m ∈ l, m.IsChain fun x y ↦ r x y)
    (hc' : l.IsChain fun a b ↦ ∃ ha hb, r (a.getLast ha) (b.head hb) = false) :
    l.flatten.splitBy r = l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l IH =>
    rw [mem_cons, not_or, eq_comm] at hn
    rw [flatten_cons, splitBy_append_of_isChain hn.1 (hc _ mem_cons_self),
      IH hn.2 (fun m hm ↦ hc _ (mem_cons_of_mem a hm)) hc'.tail]
    intro y hy
    rw [← head_of_mem_head? hy]
    rw [isChain_cons] at hc'
    obtain ⟨x, hx, _⟩ := flatten_ne_nil_iff.1 (ne_nil_of_mem (mem_of_mem_head? hy))
    obtain ⟨_, _, H⟩ := hc'.1 (l.head (ne_nil_of_mem hx)) (head_mem_head? _)
    rwa [head_flatten_eq_head_head]

name: splitBy_eq_iff
statement:
theorem splitBy_eq_iff {r : α → α → Bool} {l : List (List α)} :
    m.splitBy r = l ↔ m = l.flatten ∧ [] ∉ l ∧ (∀ m ∈ l, m.IsChain fun x y ↦ r x y) ∧
      l.IsChain fun a b ↦ ∃ ha hb, r (a.getLast ha) (b.head hb) = false
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨(flatten_splitBy r m).symm, nil_notMem_splitBy r m, fun _ ↦ isChain_of_mem_splitBy,
      isChain_getLast_head_splitBy r m⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, hn, hc, hc'⟩
    exact splitBy_flatten hn hc hc'

name: splitBy_append
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hl := eq_or_ne l []
  · simp
  obtain rfl | hm := eq_or_ne m []
  · simp
  rw [splitBy_eq_iff]
  refine ⟨by simp, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩; · aesop (add apply unsafe isChain_of_mem_splitBy)
  rw [isChain_append]
  refine ⟨isChain_getLast_head_splitBy _ _, isChain_getLast_head_splitBy _ _, fun x hx y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  use ne_nil_of_mem_splitBy (mem_of_mem_getLast? hx), ne_nil_of_mem_splitBy (mem_of_mem_head? hy)
  apply ha
  · simp_rw [← getLast_of_mem_getLast? hx, getLast_getLast_splitBy _ hl]
    exact getLast_mem_getLast? _
  · simp_rw [← head_of_mem_head? hy, head_head_splitBy _ hm]
    exact head_mem_head? _

name: splitBy_append_cons
statement:
theorem splitBy_append_cons {r : α → α → Bool} {l : List α} {a : α} (m : List α)
    (ha : ∀ x ∈ l.getLast?, r x a = false) :
    (l ++ a :: m).splitBy r = l.splitBy r ++ (a :: m).splitBy r

name: keys_subset_keys_of_entries_subset_entries

theorem keys_subset_keys_of_entries_subset_entries
    {s₁ s₂ : AList β} (h : s₁.entries ⊆ s₂.entries) : s₁.keys ⊆ s₂.keys
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  let : DecidableEq α := Classical.decEq α
  have := h (mem_lookup_iff.1 (Option.get_mem (lookup_isSome.2 hk)))
  rw [← mem_lookup_iff, Option.mem_def] at this
  rw [← mem_keys, ← lookup_isSome, this]
  exact Option.isSome_some

name: entries_insert_of_notMem

theorem entries_insert_of_notMem {a} {b : β a} {s : AList β} (h : a ∉ s) :

name: insert_of_notMem
statement:
theorem insert_of_notMem {a} {b : β a} {s : AList β} (h : a ∉ s) :
    insert a b s = ⟨⟨a, b⟩ :: s.entries, nodupKeys_cons.2 ⟨h, s.2⟩⟩

name: insert_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insert_empty (a) (b : β a) : insert a b ∅ = singleton a b

name: mem_insert
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_insert {a a'} {b' : β a'} (s : AList β) : a ∈ insert a' b' s ↔ a = a' ∨ a ∈ s

name: keys_insert
statement:
@[simp]
theorem keys_insert {a} {b : β a} (s : AList β) : (insert a b s).keys = a :: s.keys.erase a

name: perm_insert
statement:
theorem perm_insert {a} {b : β a} {s₁ s₂ : AList β} (p : s₁.entries ~ s₂.entries) :
    (insert a b s₁).entries ~ (insert a b s₂).entries
proof:
:= by
  simp only [entries_insert]; exact p.kinsert s₁.nodupKeys

name: lookup_insert
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookup_insert {a} {b : β a} (s : AList β) : lookup a (insert a b s) = some b

name: lookup_insert_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookup_insert_ne {a a'} {b' : β a'} {s : AList β} (h : a ≠ a') :
    lookup a (insert a' b' s) = lookup a s

name: lookup_insert_eq_none
statement:
@[simp] theorem lookup_insert_eq_none {l : AList β} {k k' : α} {v : β k} :
    (l.insert k v).lookup k' = none ↔ (k' ≠ k) ∧ l.lookup k' = none
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : k' = k
  · subst h; simp
  · simp_all [lookup_insert_ne h]

name: lookup_to_alist
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookup_to_alist {a} (s : List (Sigma β)) : lookup a s.toAList = s.dlookup a

name: insert_insert
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insert_insert {a} {b b' : β a} (s : AList β) :
    (s.insert a b).insert a b' = s.insert a b'

name: insert_insert_of_ne
statement:
theorem insert_insert_of_ne {a a'} {b : β a} {b' : β a'} (s : AList β) (h : a ≠ a') :
    ((s.insert a b).insert a' b').entries ~ ((s.insert a' b').insert a b).entries
proof:
:= by
  simp only [entries_insert]; rw [kerase_cons_ne, kerase_cons_ne, kerase_comm] <;>
    [apply Perm.swap; exact h; exact h.symm]

name: insert_singleton_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insert_singleton_eq {a : α} {b b' : β a} : insert a b (singleton a b') = singleton a b
proof:
:=
  ext <| by
    simp only [AList.entries_insert, List.kerase_cons_eq, AList.singleton_entries]

name: entries_toAList
statement:
@[simp]
theorem entries_toAList (xs : List (Sigma β)) : (List.toAList xs).entries = dedupKeys xs

name: toAList_cons
statement:
theorem toAList_cons (a : α) (b : β a) (xs : List (Sigma β)) :
    List.toAList (⟨a, b⟩ :: xs) = insert a b xs.toAList

name: mk_cons_eq_insert
statement:
theorem mk_cons_eq_insert (c : Sigma β) (l : List (Sigma β)) (h : (c :: l).NodupKeys) :
    (⟨c :: l, h⟩ : AList β) = insert c.1 c.2 ⟨l, nodupKeys_of_nodupKeys_cons h⟩

name: insertRec_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insertRec_empty {C : AList β → Sort*} (H0 : C ∅)
    (IH : ∀ (a : α) (b : β a) (l : AList β), a ∉ l → C l → C (l.insert a b)) :
    @insertRec α β _ C H0 IH ∅ = H0
proof:
:= by
  change @insertRec α β _ C H0 IH ⟨[], _⟩ = H0
  rw [insertRec]

name: insertRec_insert
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := l
  suffices @insertRec α β _ C H0 IH ⟨c :: l, nodupKeys_cons.2 ⟨h, hl⟩⟩ ≍
      IH c.1 c.2 ⟨l, hl⟩ h (@insertRec α β _ C H0 IH ⟨l, hl⟩) by
    cases c
    apply eq_of_heq
    convert! this <;> rw [insert_of_notMem h]
  rw [insertRec]
  apply cast_heq

name: insertRec_insert_mk
statement:
theorem insertRec_insert_mk {C : AList β → Sort*} (H0 : C ∅)
    (IH : ∀ (a : α) (b : β a) (l : AList β), a ∉ l → C l → C (l.insert a b)) {a : α} (b : β a)
    {l : AList β} (h : a ∉ l) :
    @insertRec α β _ C H0 IH (l.insert a b) = IH a b l h (@insertRec α β _ C H0 IH l)
proof:
:=
  @insertRec_insert α β _ C H0 IH ⟨a, b⟩ l h

name: extract_eq_lookup_erase
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extract_eq_lookup_erase (a : α) (s : AList β) : extract a s = (lookup a s, erase a s)

name: union_entries
statement:
@[simp]
theorem union_entries {s₁ s₂ : AList β} : (s₁ ∪ s₂).entries = kunion s₁.entries s₂.entries

name: empty_union
statement:
@[simp]
theorem empty_union {s : AList β} : (∅ : AList β) ∪ s = s

name: union_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem union_empty {s : AList β} : s ∪ (∅ : AList β) = s

name: mem_union
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_union {a} {s₁ s₂ : AList β} : a ∈ s₁ ∪ s₂ ↔ a ∈ s₁ ∨ a ∈ s₂

name: perm_union
statement:
theorem perm_union {s₁ s₂ s₃ s₄ : AList β} (p₁₂ : s₁.entries ~ s₂.entries)
    (p₃₄ : s₃.entries ~ s₄.entries) : (s₁ ∪ s₃).entries ~ (s₂ ∪ s₄).entries

name: union_erase
statement: theorem union_erase (a : α) (s₁ s₂ : AList β) : erase a (s₁ ∪ s₂) = erase a s₁ ∪ erase a s₂

name: lookup_union_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookup_union_left {a} {s₁ s₂ : AList β} : a ∈ s₁ → lookup a (s₁ ∪ s₂) = lookup a s₁

name: lookup_union_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookup_union_right {a} {s₁ s₂ : AList β} : a ∉ s₁ → lookup a (s₁ ∪ s₂) = lookup a s₂

name: mem_lookup_union
statement:
theorem mem_lookup_union {a} {b : β a} {s₁ s₂ : AList β} :
    b ∈ lookup a (s₁ ∪ s₂) ↔ b ∈ lookup a s₁ ∨ a ∉ s₁ ∧ b ∈ lookup a s₂

name: lookup_union_eq_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookup_union_eq_some {a} {b : β a} {s₁ s₂ : AList β} :
    lookup a (s₁ ∪ s₂) = some b ↔ lookup a s₁ = some b ∨ a ∉ s₁ ∧ lookup a s₂ = some b

name: mem_lookup_union_middle
statement:
theorem mem_lookup_union_middle {a} {b : β a} {s₁ s₂ s₃ : AList β} :
    b ∈ lookup a (s₁ ∪ s₃) → a ∉ s₂ → b ∈ lookup a (s₁ ∪ s₂ ∪ s₃)

name: insert_union
statement:
theorem insert_union {a} {b : β a} {s₁ s₂ : AList β} :
    insert a b (s₁ ∪ s₂) = insert a b s₁ ∪ s₂

name: union_assoc
statement: theorem union_assoc {s₁ s₂ s₃ : AList β} : (s₁ ∪ s₂ ∪ s₃).entries ~ (s₁ ∪ (s₂ ∪ s₃)).entries

name: union_comm_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem union_comm_of_disjoint {s₁ s₂ : AList β} (h : Disjoint s₁ s₂) :
    (s₁ ∪ s₂).entries ~ (s₂ ∪ s₁).entries
proof:
:=
  lookup_ext (AList.nodupKeys _) (AList.nodupKeys _)
    (by
      intros; simp only [union_entries, Option.mem_def, dlookup_kunion_eq_some]
      constructor <;> intro h'
      · rcases h' with h' | h'
        · right
          refine ⟨?_, h'⟩
          apply h
          rw [keys, ← List.dlookup_isSome, h']
          exact rfl
        · left
          rw [h'.2]
      · rcases h' with h' | h'
        · right
          refine ⟨?_, h'⟩
          intro h''
          apply h _ h''
          rw [keys, ← List.dlookup_isSome, h']
          exact rfl
        · left
          rw [h'.2])

name: destutter'_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem destutter'_nil : destutter' R a [] = [a]

name: destutter'_cons
statement:
theorem destutter'_cons :
    (b :: l).destutter' R a = if R a b then a :: destutter' R b l else destutter' R a l

name: destutter'_cons_pos
statement:
@[simp]
theorem destutter'_cons_pos (h : R b a) : (a :: l).destutter' R b = b :: l.destutter' R a

name: destutter'_cons_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem destutter'_cons_neg (h : ¬R b a) : (a :: l).destutter' R b = l.destutter' R b

name: destutter'_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem destutter'_singleton : [b].destutter' R a = if R a b then [a, b] else [a]

name: destutter'_sublist
statement: theorem destutter'_sublist (a) : l.destutter' R a <+ a :: l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b l hl =>
    rw [destutter']
    split_ifs
    · exact Sublist.cons_cons a (hl b)
    · exact (hl a).trans ((l.sublist_cons_self b).cons_cons a)

name: mem_destutter'
statement: theorem mem_destutter' (a) : a ∈ l.destutter' R a
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b l hl =>
    rw [destutter']
    split_ifs
    · simp
    · assumption

name: isChain_destutter'
statement: theorem isChain_destutter' (l : List α) (a : α) : (l.destutter' R a).IsChain R
proof:
:= by
  induction l using twoStepInduction generalizing a with
  | nil => simp
  | singleton => simp [apply_ite]
  | cons_cons b c l IH IH2 =>
    simp_rw [destutter'_cons, apply_ite (IsChain R ·), IH, ite_true_right] at IH2
    simp_rw [destutter'_cons, apply_ite (IsChain R ·),
      apply_ite (IsChain R <| a :: ·), IH, isChain_cons_cons,
      ite_true_right, ite_prop_iff_and, imp_and]
    exact ⟨⟨⟨Function.swap <| fun _ => id, fun _ => IH2 c b⟩,
      Function.swap <| fun _ => IH2 b a⟩, fun _ => IH2 c a⟩

name: isChain_cons_destutter'_of_rel
statement:
theorem isChain_cons_destutter'_of_rel (l : List α) {a b} (hab : R a b) :
    (a :: l.destutter' R b).IsChain R
proof:
:= by
  simpa [destutter'_cons, hab] using isChain_destutter' R (b :: l) a

name: destutter'_of_isChain_cons
statement: theorem destutter'_of_isChain_cons (h : (a :: l).IsChain R) : l.destutter' R a = a :: l
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b l hb =>
    obtain ⟨h, hc⟩ := isChain_cons_cons.mp h
    rw [l.destutter'_cons_pos h, hb hc]

name: destutter'_eq_self_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem destutter'_eq_self_iff (a) : l.destutter' R a = a :: l ↔ (a :: l).IsChain R
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    rw [← h]
    exact l.isChain_destutter' R a, destutter'_of_isChain_cons _ _⟩

name: destutter'_ne_nil
statement: theorem destutter'_ne_nil : l.destutter' R a ≠ []

name: destutter_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem destutter_nil : ([] : List α).destutter R = []

name: destutter_cons'
statement: theorem destutter_cons' : (a :: l).destutter R = destutter' R a l

name: destutter_cons_cons
statement:
theorem destutter_cons_cons :
    (a :: b :: l).destutter R = if R a b then a :: destutter' R b l else destutter' R a l

name: destutter_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem destutter_singleton : destutter R [a] = [a]

name: destutter_pair
statement:
@[simp]
theorem destutter_pair : destutter R [a, b] = if R a b then [a, b] else [a]

name: destutter_sublist
statement:
theorem destutter_sublist : ∀ l : List α, l.destutter R <+ l
  | [] => Sublist.slnil
  | h :: l => l.destutter'_sublist R h

name: isChain_destutter
statement:
theorem isChain_destutter : ∀ l : List α, (l.destutter R).IsChain R
  | [] => .nil
  | h :: l => l.isChain_destutter' R h

name: destutter_of_isChain
statement:
theorem destutter_of_isChain : ∀ l : List α, l.IsChain R → l.destutter R = l
  | [], _ => rfl
  | _ :: l, h => l.destutter'_of_isChain_cons _ h

@[simp]

name: destutter_eq_self_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem destutter_eq_self_iff : ∀ l : List α, l.destutter R = l ↔ l.IsChain R
  | [] => by simp
  | a :: l => l.destutter'_eq_self_iff R a

name: destutter_idem
statement: theorem destutter_idem : (l.destutter R).destutter R = l.destutter R

name: destutter_eq_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem destutter_eq_nil : ∀ {l : List α}, destutter R l = [] ↔ l = []
  | [] => Iff.rfl
  | _ :: l => ⟨fun h => absurd h <| l.destutter'_ne_nil R, fun h => nomatch h⟩

variable {R}

/

name: map_destutter
statement:
theorem map_destutter {f : α → β} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ a ∈ l, ∀ b ∈ l, R a b ↔ R₂ (f a) (f b)) →
    (l.destutter R).map f = (l.map f).destutter R₂
  | [], hl => by simp
  | [a], hl => by simp
  | a :: b :: l, hl => by
    have
proof:
:= hl a (by simp) b (by simp)
    simp_rw [map_cons, destutter_cons_cons, ← this]
    by_cases hr : R a b <;>
      simp [hr, ← destutter_cons', map_destutter fun c hc d hd ↦ hl _ (cons_subset_cons _
        (subset_cons_self _ _) hc) _ (cons_subset_cons _ (subset_cons_self _ _) hd),
        map_destutter fun c hc d hd ↦ hl _ (subset_cons_self _ _ hc) _ (subset_cons_self _ _ hd)]

name: map_destutter_ne
statement:
theorem map_destutter_ne {f : α → β} (h : Injective f) [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] :
    (l.destutter (· ≠ ·)).map f = (l.map f).destutter (· ≠ ·)

name: length_destutter'_cotrans_ge
statement:
theorem length_destutter'_cotrans_ge [i : IsTrans α Rᶜ] :
    ∀ {a} {l : List α}, ¬R b a → (l.destutter' R b).length ≤ (l.destutter' R a).length
  | a, [], hba => by simp
  | a, c :: l, hba => by
    by_cases hbc : R b c
    case pos =>
      have hac : ¬Rᶜ a c
proof:
:= (mt (_root_.trans hba)) (not_not.2 hbc)
      simp_rw [destutter', ite_eq_left (not_not.1 hac), ite_eq_left hbc, length_cons, le_refl]
    case neg =>
      simp only [destutter', ite_eq_right hbc]
      by_cases hac : R a c
      case pos =>
        simp only [ite_eq_left hac, length_cons]
        exact Nat.le_succ_of_le (length_destutter'_cotrans_ge hbc)
      case neg =>
        simp only [ite_eq_right hac]
        exact length_destutter'_cotrans_ge hba

name: length_destutter'_congr
statement:
theorem length_destutter'_congr [IsEquiv α Rᶜ] (hab : ¬R a b) :
    (l.destutter' R a).length = (l.destutter' R b).length
proof:
:=
  (length_destutter'_cotrans_ge hab).antisymm <| length_destutter'_cotrans_ge (symm hab : Rᶜ b a)

name: Sublist.length_destutter'_mono
statement:
theorem Sublist.length_destutter'_mono [IsEquiv α Rᶜ] (h : a :: l₁ <+ b :: l₂) :
    (List.destutter' R a l₁).length ≤ (List.destutter' R b l₂).length
-/

name: le_length_destutter'_cons
statement:
theorem le_length_destutter'_cons [IsEquiv α Rᶜ] :
    ∀ {l : List α}, (l.destutter' R b).length ≤ ((b :: l).destutter' R a).length
  | [] => by by_cases hab : (R a b) <;> simp_all [Nat.le_succ]
  | c :: cs => by
    by_cases hab : R a b
    case pos => simp [destutter', ite_eq_left hab, Nat.le_succ]
    obtain hac | hac : R a c ∨ Rᶜ a c
proof:
:= em _
    · have hbc : ¬Rᶜ b c := mt (_root_.trans hab) (not_not.2 hac)
      simp [destutter', ite_eq_left hac, ite_eq_left (not_not.1 hbc), ite_eq_right hab]
    · have hbc : ¬R b c := trans (symm hab) hac
      simp only [destutter', ite_eq_right hbc, ite_eq_right hac, ite_eq_right hab]
      exact (length_destutter'_congr cs hab).ge

name: length_destutter_le_length_destutter_cons
statement:
theorem length_destutter_le_length_destutter_cons [IsEquiv α Rᶜ] :
    ∀ {l : List α}, (l.destutter R).length ≤ ((a :: l).destutter R).length
  | [] => by simp [destutter]
  | b :: l => le_length_destutter'_cons

variable {l l₁ l₂}

/

name: length_destutter_ne_le_length_destutter_cons
statement:
theorem length_destutter_ne_le_length_destutter_cons [DecidableEq α] :
    (l.destutter (· ≠ ·)).length ≤ ((a :: l).destutter (· ≠ ·)).length

name: IsChain.length_le_length_destutter
statement:
lemma IsChain.length_le_length_destutter [IsEquiv α Rᶜ] :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List α}, l₁ <+ l₂ → l₁.IsChain R → l₁.length ≤ (l₂.destutter R).length
  
  | [], [], _, _ => by simp
  
  | l₁, _, .cons (l₂ := l₂) a hl, hl₁ =>
    (hl₁.length_le_length_destutter hl).trans length_destutter_le_length_destutter_cons
  
  | _, _, .cons_cons (l₁ := []) (l₂ := l₁) a hl, hl₁ => by simp [Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero]
  
  | _, _, .cons_cons a <| .cons (l₁ := l₁) (l₂ := l₂) b hl, hl₁ => by
    by_cases hab : R a b
    · simpa [destutter_cons_cons, hab] using! hl₁.tail.length_le_length_destutter (hl.cons _)
    · simpa [destutter_cons_cons, hab] using! hl₁.length_le_length_destutter (hl.cons_cons _)
  
  | _, _, .cons_cons a <| .cons_cons (l₁ := l₁) (l₂ := l₂) b hl, hl₁ => by
    simpa [destutter_cons_cons, rel_of_isChain_cons_cons hl₁]
      using! hl₁.tail.length_le_length_destutter (hl.cons_cons _)

/

In other words, `l.destutter (· ≠ ·)` is a `≠`-chain sublist of `l`, and is at least as long as any
other `≠`-chain sublist. -/

name: IsChain.length_le_length_destutter_ne
statement:
lemma IsChain.length_le_length_destutter_ne [DecidableEq α] (hl : l₁ <+ l₂)
    (hl₁ : l₁.IsChain (· ≠ ·)) : l₁.length ≤ (l₂.destutter (· ≠ ·)).length

name: Pairwise.destutter_eq_dedup
statement:
lemma Pairwise.destutter_eq_dedup [DecidableEq α] {r : α → α → Prop} [Std.Antisymm r] :
    ∀ {l : List α}, l.Pairwise r → l.destutter (· ≠ ·) = l.dedup
  | [], h => by simp
  | [x], h => by simp
  | x :: y :: xs, h => by
    rw [pairwise_cons] at h
    rw [destutter_cons_cons, ← destutter_cons', ← destutter_cons', h.2.destutter_eq_dedup]
    obtain rfl | hxy
proof:
:= eq_or_ne x y
    · simpa using h.2.destutter_eq_dedup
    · simp only [mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp, pairwise_cons] at h
      have : x ∉ xs := fun hx ↦ hxy (antisymm h.1.1 (h.2.1 x hx))
      rw [ite_eq_left hxy, dedup_cons_of_notMem (a := x) (by simp [*])]

name: take_one_drop_eq_of_lt_length
statement:
theorem take_one_drop_eq_of_lt_length {l : List α} {n : ℕ} (h : n < l.length) :
    (l.drop n).take 1 = [l.get ⟨n, h⟩]
proof:
:= by
  rw [drop_eq_getElem_cons h, take, take]
  simp

name: take_eq_self_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma take_eq_self_iff (x : List α) {n : ℕ} : x.take n = x ↔ x.length ≤ n

name: take_self_eq_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma take_self_eq_iff (x : List α) {n : ℕ} : x = x.take n ↔ x.length ≤ n

name: take_eq_left_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma take_eq_left_iff {x y : List α} {n : ℕ} :
    (x ++ y).take n = x.take n ↔ y = [] ∨ n ≤ x.length

name: left_eq_take_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma left_eq_take_iff {x y : List α} {n : ℕ} :
    x.take n = (x ++ y).take n ↔ y = [] ∨ n ≤ x.length

name: drop_take_append_drop
statement:
@[simp] lemma drop_take_append_drop (x : List α) (m n : ℕ) :
    (x.drop m).take n ++ x.drop (m + n) = x.drop m

name: drop_take_append_drop'
statement:
@[simp] lemma drop_take_append_drop' (x : List α) (m n : ℕ) :
    (x.drop m).take n ++ x.drop (n + m) = x.drop m

name: take_concat_get'
statement:
lemma take_concat_get' (l : List α) (i : ℕ) (h : i < l.length) :
    l.take i ++ [l[i]] = l.take (i + 1)

name: cons_getElem_drop_succ
statement:
theorem cons_getElem_drop_succ {l : List α} {n : Nat} {h : n < l.length} :
    l[n] :: l.drop (n + 1) = l.drop n

name: cons_get_drop_succ
statement:
theorem cons_get_drop_succ {l : List α} {n} :
    l.get n :: l.drop (n.1 + 1) = l.drop n.1

name: drop_length_sub_one
statement: lemma drop_length_sub_one {l : List α} (h : l ≠ []) : l.drop (l.length - 1) = [l.getLast h]
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => aesop
  | cons a l ih =>
    by_cases hl : l = []
    · simp_all
    rw [length_cons, Nat.add_one_sub_one, List.drop_length_cons hl a]
    simp [getLast_cons, hl]

name: tail_iterate
statement: theorem tail_iterate (l : List α) (n : ℕ) : (List.tail^[n]) l = l.drop n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing l with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => cases l <;> simp [*]

name: tail_take_eq_take_tail

name: Prime.dvd_prod_iff
statement: theorem Prime.dvd_prod_iff {p : M} {L : List M} (pp : Prime p) : p ∣ L.prod ↔ ∃ a ∈ L, p ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction L with
    | nil =>
      rw [prod_nil] at h
      exact absurd h pp.not_dvd_one
    | cons L_hd L_tl L_ih =>
      rw [prod_cons] at h
      rcases pp.dvd_or_dvd h with hd | hd
      · exact ⟨L_hd, mem_cons_self, hd⟩
      · obtain ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩ := L_ih hd
        exact ⟨x, mem_cons_of_mem L_hd hx1, hx2⟩
  · exact fun ⟨a, ha1, ha2⟩ => dvd_trans ha2 (dvd_prod ha1)

name: Prime.not_dvd_prod
statement:
theorem Prime.not_dvd_prod {p : M} {L : List M} (pp : Prime p) (hL : ∀ a ∈ L, ¬p ∣ a) :
    ¬p ∣ L.prod
proof:
:=
  mt (Prime.dvd_prod_iff pp).1 <| not_exists.2 fun a => not_and.2 (hL a)

name: mem_list_primes_of_dvd_prod
statement:
theorem mem_list_primes_of_dvd_prod {p : M} (hp : Prime p) {L : List M} (hL : ∀ q ∈ L, Prime q)
    (hpL : p ∣ L.prod) : p ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩ := hp.dvd_prod_iff.mp hpL
  rwa [(prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp (hL x hx1)).mp hx2]

name: perm_of_prod_eq_prod
statement:
theorem perm_of_prod_eq_prod :
    ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List M}, l₁.prod = l₂.prod → (∀ p ∈ l₁, Prime p) → (∀ p ∈ l₂, Prime p) → Perm l₁ l₂
  | [], [], _, _, _ => Perm.nil
  | [], a :: l, h₁, _, h₃ =>
    have ha : a ∣ 1
proof:
:= prod_nil (α := M) ▸ h₁.symm ▸ (prod_cons (l := l)).symm ▸ dvd_mul_right _ _
    absurd ha (Prime.not_dvd_one (h₃ a mem_cons_self))
  | a :: l, [], h₁, h₂, _ =>
    have ha : a ∣ 1 := prod_nil (α := M) ▸ h₁ ▸ (prod_cons (l := l)).symm ▸ dvd_mul_right _ _
    absurd ha (Prime.not_dvd_one (h₂ a mem_cons_self))
  | a :: l₁, b :: l₂, h, hl₁, hl₂ => by
    classical
      have hl₁' : ∀ p ∈ l₁, Prime p := fun p hp => hl₁ p (mem_cons_of_mem _ hp)
      have hl₂' : ∀ p ∈ (b :: l₂).erase a, Prime p := fun p hp => hl₂ p (mem_of_mem_erase hp)
      have ha : a ∈ b :: l₂ :=
        mem_list_primes_of_dvd_prod (hl₁ a mem_cons_self) hl₂
          (h ▸ by rw [prod_cons]; exact dvd_mul_right _ _)
      have hb : b :: l₂ ~ a :: (b :: l₂).erase a := perm_cons_erase ha
      have hl : prod l₁ = prod ((b :: l₂).erase a) :=
        (mul_right_inj' (hl₁ a mem_cons_self).ne_zero).1 <| by
          rwa [← prod_cons, ← prod_cons, ← hb.prod_eq]
      exact Perm.trans ((perm_of_prod_eq_prod hl hl₁' hl₂').cons _) hb.symm

name: getElem_range'_1
statement:
theorem getElem_range'_1 {n m} (i) (H : i < (range' n m).length) :

name: isChain_range
statement:
theorem isChain_range (r : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) (n : ℕ) :
    IsChain r (range n) ↔ ∀ m < n - 1, r m m.succ
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn =>
    simp only [range_succ, Nat.add_one_sub_one, Nat.lt_sub_iff_add_lt] at hn ⊢
    cases n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n =>
      simp only [range_succ, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right, succ_eq_add_one, append_assoc, cons_append,
        nil_append, isChain_append_cons_cons, IsChain.singleton, and_true] at hn ⊢
      rw [hn, forall_lt_succ_right]

name: isChain_range_succ
statement:
theorem isChain_range_succ (r : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) (n : ℕ) :
    IsChain r (range n.succ) ↔ ∀ m < n, r m m.succ

name: isChain_cons_range_succ
statement:
theorem isChain_cons_range_succ (r : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) (n a : ℕ) :
    IsChain r (a :: range n.succ) ↔ r a 0 ∧ ∀ m < n, r m m.succ
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_succ_eq_map, isChain_cons_cons, and_congr_right_iff,
    ← isChain_range_succ, range_succ_eq_map]
  exact fun _ => Iff.rfl

name: ranges_disjoint
statement:
theorem ranges_disjoint (l : List ℕ) :
    Pairwise Disjoint (ranges l)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact Pairwise.nil
  | cons a l hl =>
    simp only [ranges, pairwise_cons]
    constructor
    · intro s hs
      obtain ⟨s', _, rfl⟩ := mem_map.mp hs
      intro u hu
      rw [mem_map]
      rw [mem_range] at hu
      lia
    · rw [pairwise_map]
      apply Pairwise.imp _ hl
      intro u v
      apply disjoint_map
      exact fun u v => Nat.add_left_cancel

name: ranges_length
statement:
theorem ranges_length (l : List ℕ) :
    l.ranges.map length = l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp only [ranges, map_nil]
  | cons a l hl => 
    simp only [ranges, map_cons, length_range, map_map, cons.injEq, true_and]
    conv_rhs => rw [← hl]
    apply map_congr_left
    intro s _
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, length_map]

name: dropWhile_get_zero_not
statement:
theorem dropWhile_get_zero_not (l : List α) (hl : 0 < (l.dropWhile p).length) :
    ¬p ((l.dropWhile p).get ⟨0, hl⟩)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => cases hl
  | cons hd tl IH =>
    simp only [dropWhile]
    by_cases hp : p hd
    · simp_all only [get_eq_getElem]
      apply IH
      simp_all only [dropWhile_cons_of_pos]
    · simp [hp]

name: length_dropWhile_le
statement: theorem length_dropWhile_le (l : List α) : (dropWhile p l).length ≤ l.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons head tail ih =>
    simp only [dropWhile, length_cons]
    split
    · lia
    · simp

name: dropWhile_eq_nil_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dropWhile_eq_nil_iff : dropWhile p l = [] ↔ ∀ x ∈ l, p x
proof:

  | cons x xs IH => by_cases hp : p x <;> simp [hp, IH]

name: dropWhile_eq_self_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dropWhile_eq_self_iff : dropWhile p l = l ↔ ∀ hl : 0 < l.length, ¬p (l[0]'hl)
proof:
:= by
  rcases l with - | ⟨hd, tl⟩
  · simp
  · rw [dropWhile]
    by_cases h_p_hd : p hd
    · simp only [h_p_hd, length_cons, Nat.zero_lt_succ, getElem_cons_zero, not_true_eq_false,
        imp_false, iff_false]
      intro h
      replace h := congrArg length h
      have := length_dropWhile_le p tl
      simp at h
      lia
    · simp [h_p_hd]

name: takeWhile_eq_self_iff

name: takeWhile_eq_nil_iff

name: mem_takeWhile_imp

proof:

  induction l with simp [takeWhile] at hx
  | cons hd tl IH =>
    cases hp : p hd
    · simp [hp] at hx
    · rw [hp, mem_cons] at hx

      · exact hp
      · exact IH hx

name: takeWhile_takeWhile
statement:
theorem takeWhile_takeWhile (p q : α → Bool) (l : List α) :
    takeWhile p (takeWhile q l) = takeWhile (fun a => p a ∧ q a) l
proof:

  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl IH => by_cases hp : p hd <;> by_cases hq : q hd <;> simp [takeWhile, hp, hq, IH]

name: find
statement:
lemma find?_eq_head?_dropWhile_not :
    l.find? p = (l.dropWhile (fun x ↦ !(p x))).head?
proof:
:= by
  induction l
  case nil => simp
  case cons head tail hi =>
    set ph := p head with phh
    rcases ph with rfl | rfl
    · have phh' : ¬(p head = true) := by simp [phh.symm]
      rw [find?_cons_of_neg phh', dropWhile_cons_of_pos]
      · exact hi
      · simpa using phh
    · rw [find?_cons_of_pos phh.symm, dropWhile_cons_of_neg]
      · simp
      · simpa using phh

name: find
statement:
lemma find?_eq_head_dropWhile_not (h : ∃ x ∈ l, p x) :

name: find

proof:

  · simp
  · simpa using h

name: ofFn_succ'
statement:
theorem ofFn_succ' {n} (f : Fin (succ n) → α) :
    ofFn f = (ofFn fun i => f (Fin.castSucc i)).concat (f (Fin.last _))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [ofFn_zero, concat_nil, ofFn_succ, ofFn_zero, Fin.last_zero]
  | succ n IH =>
    rw [ofFn_succ, IH, ofFn_succ, concat_cons, Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_last]

name: ofFn_fin_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofFn_fin_append {m n} (a : Fin m → α) (b : Fin n → α) :
    List.ofFn (Fin.append a b) = List.ofFn a ++ List.ofFn b

name: ofFn_mul
statement:
theorem ofFn_mul {m n} (f : Fin (m * n) → α) :
    List.ofFn f = List.flatten (List.ofFn fun i : Fin m => List.ofFn fun j : Fin n => f ⟨i * n + j,
    calc
      ↑i * n + j < (i + 1) * n :=
        (Nat.add_lt_add_left j.prop _).trans_eq (by rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul])
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ i.prop⟩)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [ofFn_zero, Nat.zero_mul, ofFn_zero]
  | succ m IH =>
    simp_rw [ofFn_succ', succ_mul]
    simp [ofFn_add, IH]
    rfl

name: ofFn_mul'
statement:
theorem ofFn_mul' {m n} (f : Fin (m * n) → α) :
    List.ofFn f = List.flatten (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => List.ofFn fun j : Fin m => f ⟨m * i + j,
    calc
      m * i + j < m * (i + 1) :=
        (Nat.add_lt_add_left j.prop _).trans_eq (by rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one])
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ i.prop⟩)

name: ofFn_get

  | [] => by rw [ofFn_zero]

name: find
statement:
lemma find?_ofFn_eq_some {n} {f : Fin n → α} {p : α → Bool} {b : α} :
    (ofFn f).find? p = some b ↔ p b = true ∧ ∃ i, f i = b ∧ ∀ j < i, ¬(p (f j) = true)
proof:
:= by
  rw [find?_eq_some_iff_getElem]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨hpb, i, hi, hfb, h⟩ ↦
      ⟨hpb, ⟨⟨i, length_ofFn (f := f) ▸ hi⟩, by simpa
        using! hfb, fun j hj ↦ by simpa using! h j hj⟩⟩,
    fun ⟨hpb, i, hfb, h⟩ ↦
      ⟨hpb, ⟨i, (length_ofFn (f := f)).symm ▸ i.isLt, by simpa using! hfb,
        fun j hj ↦ by simpa using! h ⟨j, by lia⟩ (by simpa using! hj)⟩⟩⟩

name: find
proof:
:= by
  simp only [find?_ofFn_eq_some, h.eq_iff, Bool.not_eq_true, exists_eq_left]

name: of_reverse_eq

proof:
:= by
  refine bidirectionalRecOn l (fun _ => Palindrome.nil) (fun a _ => Palindrome.singleton a) ?_
  intro x l y hp hr
  rw [reverse_cons, reverse_append] at hr
  rw [head_eq_of_cons_eq hr]
  have : Palindrome l := hp (append_inj_left' (tail_eq_of_cons_eq hr) rfl)

name: lookmap.go_append

name: lookmap_nil
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem lookmap_nil : [].lookmap f = []

name: lookmap_cons_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookmap_cons_none {a : α} (l : List α) (h : f a = none) :
    (a :: l).lookmap f = a :: l.lookmap f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lookmap, lookmap.go, Array.toListAppend_eq, nil_append]
  rw [lookmap.go_append, lookmap, h]; simp

name: lookmap_cons_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lookmap_cons_some {a b : α} (l : List α) (h : f a = some b) :
    (a :: l).lookmap f = b :: l
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lookmap, lookmap.go, Array.toListAppend_eq, nil_append]
  rw [h]

name: lookmap_cons
statement:
@[grind =]
theorem lookmap_cons {a : α} {l : List α} :
    (a :: l).lookmap f = match f a with
    | none => a :: l.lookmap f
    | some b => b :: l
proof:
:= by
  cases h : f a <;> simp_all

name: lookmap_some
statement:
theorem lookmap_some : ∀ l : List α, l.lookmap some = l
  | [] => rfl
  | _ :: rest => lookmap_cons_some some rest rfl

name: lookmap_none
statement:
theorem lookmap_none : ∀ l : List α, (l.lookmap fun _ => none) = l
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => (lookmap_cons_none _ l rfl).trans (congrArg (cons a) (lookmap_none l))

name: lookmap_congr
statement:
theorem lookmap_congr {f g : α → Option α} :
    ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ a ∈ l, f a = g a) → l.lookmap f = l.lookmap g
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, H => by
    obtain ⟨H₁, H₂⟩
proof:
:= forall_mem_cons.1 H
    rcases h : g a with - | b
    · simp [h, H₁.trans h, lookmap_congr H₂]
    · simp [lookmap_cons_some _ _ h, lookmap_cons_some _ _ (H₁.trans h)]

name: lookmap_of_forall_not
statement: theorem lookmap_of_forall_not {l : List α} (H : ∀ a ∈ l, f a = none) : l.lookmap f = l

name: lookmap_map_eq
statement:
theorem lookmap_map_eq (g : α → β) (h : ∀ (a), ∀ b ∈ f a, g a = g b) :
    ∀ l : List α, map g (l.lookmap f) = map g l
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => by
    rcases h' : f a with - | b
    · simpa [h'] using lookmap_map_eq _ h l
    · simp [lookmap_cons_some _ _ h', h _ _ h']

name: lookmap_id'
statement: theorem lookmap_id' (h : ∀ (a), ∀ b ∈ f a, a = b) (l : List α) : l.lookmap f = l
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_id (l.lookmap f), lookmap_map_eq, map_id]; exact h

name: length_lookmap
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem length_lookmap (l : List α) : length (l.lookmap f) = length l
proof:
:= by
  rw [← length_map, lookmap_map_eq _ fun _ => (), length_map]; simp

name: perm_lookmap
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a p IH =>
    cases h : f a
    · simpa [h] using IH (pairwise_cons.1 H).2
    · simp [lookmap_cons_some _ _ h, p]
  | swap a b l =>
    rcases h₁ : f a with - | c <;> rcases h₂ : f b with - | d
    · simpa [h₁, h₂] using Perm.swap _ _ _
    · simpa [h₁, lookmap_cons_some _ _ h₂] using Perm.swap _ _ _
    · simpa [lookmap_cons_some _ _ h₁, h₂] using Perm.swap _ _ _
    · rcases (pairwise_cons.1 H).1 _ (mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl)) _ h₂ _ h₁ with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact Perm.refl _
  | trans p₁ _ IH₁ IH₂ =>
    refine (IH₁ H).trans (IH₂ ((p₁.pairwise_iff ?_).1 H))
    grind

name: forall_mem_zipIdx
statement:
theorem forall_mem_zipIdx {l : List α} {n : ℕ} {p : α × ℕ → Prop} :
    (∀ x ∈ l.zipIdx n, p x) ↔ ∀ (i : ℕ) (_ : i < length l), p (l[i], n + i)

name: forall_mem_zipIdx'
statement:
theorem forall_mem_zipIdx' {l : List α} {p : α × ℕ → Prop} :
    (∀ x ∈ l.zipIdx, p x) ↔ ∀ (i : ℕ) (_ : i < length l), p (l[i], i)

name: exists_mem_zipIdx
statement:
theorem exists_mem_zipIdx {l : List α} {n : ℕ} {p : α × ℕ → Prop} :
    (∃ x ∈ l.zipIdx n, p x) ↔ ∃ (i : ℕ) (_ : i < length l), p (l[i], n + i)

name: exists_mem_zipIdx'
statement:
theorem exists_mem_zipIdx' {l : List α} {p : α × ℕ → Prop} :
    (∃ x ∈ l.zipIdx, p x) ↔ ∃ (i : ℕ) (_ : i < length l), p (l[i], i)

name: reverseRec_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reverseRec_nil {motive : List α → Sort*} (nil : motive [])
    (append_singleton : ∀ (l : List α) (a : α), motive l → motive (l ++ [a])) :
    [].reverseRec nil append_singleton = nil

name: reverseRec_concat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reverseRec_concat {motive : List α → Sort*} (x : α) (xs : List α) (nil : motive [])
    (append_singleton : ∀ (l : List α) (a : α), motive l → motive (l ++ [a])) :
    (xs ++ [x]).reverseRec nil append_singleton =
    append_singleton xs x (xs.reverseRec nil append_singleton)

name: reverseRecOn_nil
statement:
theorem reverseRecOn_nil {motive : List α → Sort*} (nil : motive [])
    (append_singleton : ∀ (l : List α) (a : α), motive l → motive (l ++ [a])) :
    reverseRecOn [] nil append_singleton = nil

name: reverseRecOn_concat
statement:
theorem reverseRecOn_concat {motive : List α → Sort*} (x : α) (xs : List α) (nil : motive [])
    (append_singleton : ∀ (l : List α) (a : α), motive l → motive (l ++ [a])) :
    (xs ++ [x]).reverseRecOn nil append_singleton =
      append_singleton xs x (reverseRecOn xs nil append_singleton)

name: bidirectionalRec_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bidirectionalRec_nil {motive : List α → Sort*}
    (nil : motive []) (singleton : ∀ a : α, motive [a])
    (cons_append : ∀ (a : α) (l : List α) (b : α), motive l → motive (a :: (l ++ [b]))) :
    bidirectionalRec nil singleton cons_append [] = nil

name: bidirectionalRec_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bidirectionalRec_singleton {motive : List α → Sort*}
    (nil : motive []) (singleton : ∀ a : α, motive [a])
    (cons_append : ∀ (a : α) (l : List α) (b : α), motive l → motive (a :: (l ++ [b]))) (a : α) :
    bidirectionalRec nil singleton cons_append [a] = singleton a

name: bidirectionalRec_cons_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bidirectionalRec_cons_append {motive : List α → Sort*}
    (nil : motive []) (singleton : ∀ a : α, motive [a])
    (cons_append : ∀ (a : α) (l : List α) (b : α), motive l → motive (a :: (l ++ [b])))
    (a : α) (l : List α) (b : α) :
    bidirectionalRec nil singleton cons_append (a :: (l ++ [b])) =
      cons_append a l b (bidirectionalRec nil singleton cons_append l)

name: recNeNil_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem recNeNil_singleton {motive : (l : List α) → l ≠ [] → Sort*} (x : α)
    (singleton : ∀ x, motive [x] (cons_ne_nil x []))
    (cons : ∀ x xs h, motive xs h → motive (x :: xs) (cons_ne_nil x xs)) :
    recNeNil singleton cons [x] (cons_ne_nil x []) = singleton x

name: recNeNil_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem recNeNil_cons {motive : (l : List α) → l ≠ [] → Sort*} (x : α) (xs : List α) (h : xs ≠ [])
    (singleton : ∀ x, motive [x] (cons_ne_nil x []))
    (cons : ∀ x xs h, motive xs h → motive (x :: xs) (cons_ne_nil x xs)) :
    recNeNil singleton cons (x :: xs) (cons_ne_nil x xs) =
      cons x xs h (recNeNil singleton cons xs h)

name: twoStepInduction_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoStepInduction_nil {motive : (l : List α) → Sort*} (nil : motive [])
    (singleton : ∀ x, motive [x])
    (cons_cons : ∀ x y xs, motive xs → (∀ y, motive (y :: xs)) → motive (x :: y :: xs)) :
    twoStepInduction nil singleton cons_cons [] = nil

name: twoStepInduction_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoStepInduction_singleton {motive : (l : List α) → Sort*} (x : α) (nil : motive [])
    (singleton : ∀ x, motive [x])
    (cons_cons : ∀ x y xs, motive xs → (∀ y, motive (y :: xs)) → motive (x :: y :: xs)) :
    twoStepInduction nil singleton cons_cons [x] = singleton x

name: twoStepInduction_cons_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem twoStepInduction_cons_cons {motive : (l : List α) → Sort*} (x y : α) (xs : List α)
    (nil : motive []) (singleton : ∀ x, motive [x])
    (cons_cons : ∀ x y xs, motive xs → (∀ y, motive (y :: xs)) → motive (x :: y :: xs)) :
    twoStepInduction nil singleton cons_cons (x :: y :: xs) =
    cons_cons x y xs
    (twoStepInduction nil singleton cons_cons xs)
    (fun y => twoStepInduction nil singleton cons_cons (y :: xs))

name: mem_union_left
statement: theorem mem_union_left (h : a ∈ l₁) (l₂ : List α) : a ∈ l₁ ∪ l₂

name: mem_union_right
statement: theorem mem_union_right (l₁ : List α) (h : a ∈ l₂) : a ∈ l₁ ∪ l₂

name: sublist_suffix_of_union
statement:
theorem sublist_suffix_of_union : ∀ l₁ l₂ : List α, ∃ t, t <+ l₁ ∧ t ++ l₂ = l₁ ∪ l₂
  | [], _ => ⟨[], by rfl, rfl⟩
  | a :: l₁, l₂ =>
    let ⟨t, s, e⟩
proof:
:= sublist_suffix_of_union l₁ l₂
    if h : a ∈ l₁ ∪ l₂ then
      ⟨t, sublist_cons_of_sublist _ s, by
        simp only [e, cons_union, insert_of_mem h]⟩
    else
      ⟨a :: t, s.cons_cons _, by
        simp only [cons_append, cons_union, e, insert_of_not_mem h]⟩

name: suffix_union_right
statement: theorem suffix_union_right (l₁ l₂ : List α) : l₂ <:+ l₁ ∪ l₂

name: union_sublist_append
statement: theorem union_sublist_append (l₁ l₂ : List α) : l₁ ∪ l₂ <+ l₁ ++ l₂
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, s, e⟩ := sublist_suffix_of_union l₁ l₂
  e ▸ (append_sublist_append_right _).2 s

name: forall_mem_union
statement: theorem forall_mem_union : (∀ x ∈ l₁ ∪ l₂, p x) ↔ (∀ x ∈ l₁, p x) ∧ ∀ x ∈ l₂, p x

name: forall_mem_of_forall_mem_union_left
statement: theorem forall_mem_of_forall_mem_union_left (h : ∀ x ∈ l₁ ∪ l₂, p x) : ∀ x ∈ l₁, p x

name: forall_mem_of_forall_mem_union_right

name: Subset.union_eq_right
statement: theorem Subset.union_eq_right {xs ys : List α} (h : xs ⊆ ys) : xs ∪ ys = ys
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [cons_union, insert_of_mem <| mem_union_right _ <| h mem_cons_self,
      ih <| subset_of_cons_subset h]

theorem inter_cons (l₁ : List α) :

theorem inter_nil' (l : List α) : l ∩ [] = []

theorem nil_bagInter (l : List α) : [].bagInter l = []

theorem bagInter_nil (l : List α) : l.bagInter [] = []

statement:

theorem cons_bagInter_of_mem (l₁ : List α) (h : a ∈ l₂) :
    (a :: l₁).bagInter l₂ = a :: l₁.bagInter (l₂.erase a)

statement:

name: bagInter_nil_iff_inter_nil
statement:
theorem bagInter_nil_iff_inter_nil : ∀ l₁ l₂ : List α, l₁.bagInter l₂ = [] ↔ l₁ ∩ l₂ = []
  | [], l₂ => by simp
  | b :: l₁, l₂ => by
    by_cases h : b ∈ l₂
    · simp [h]
    · simpa [h] using bagInter_nil_iff_inter_nil l₁ l₂

@[simp]

name: Sublist.bagInter_inter
statement: theorem Sublist.bagInter_inter : (l₁.bagInter l₂).Sublist (l₁ ∩ l₂)
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil => simp
  | cons _ _ ih =>
    rw [cons_bagInter]
    split
    · rw [inter_cons_of_mem _ (by assumption), cons_sublist_cons]
      exact ih.trans <| Sublist.inter_left (by grind [erase_sublist])
    · simp_all

name: nil_product
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nil_product (l : List β) : (@nil α) ×ˢ l = []

name: product_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem product_cons (a : α) (l₁ : List α) (l₂ : List β) :
    (a :: l₁) ×ˢ l₂ = map (fun b => (a, b)) l₂ ++ (l₁ ×ˢ l₂)

name: product_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem product_nil : ∀ l : List α, l ×ˢ (@nil β) = []
  | [] => rfl
  | _ :: l => by simp [product_cons, product_nil l]

@[simp]

name: mem_product
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_product {l₁ : List α} {l₂ : List β} {a : α} {b : β} :
    (a, b) ∈ l₁ ×ˢ l₂ ↔ a ∈ l₁ ∧ b ∈ l₂
proof:
:= by
  simp_all [SProd.sprod, product, mem_flatMap, mem_map, Prod.ext_iff, and_left_comm]

name: length_product
statement:
theorem length_product (l₁ : List α) (l₂ : List β) :
    length (l₁ ×ˢ l₂) = length l₁ * length l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ with
  | nil => exact (Nat.zero_mul _).symm
  | cons x l₁ IH =>
    simp only [length, product_cons, length_append, IH, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, length_map,
      Nat.add_comm]

name: nil_sigma

theorem sigma_nil : ∀ l : List α, (l.sigma fun a => @nil (σ a)) = []
  | [] => rfl
  | _ :: l => by simp [sigma_cons, sigma_nil l]

@[simp]

name: mem_sigma
statement:

theorem mem_sigma {l₁ : List α} {l₂ : ∀ a, List (σ a)} {a : α} {b : σ a} :
    Sigma.mk a b ∈ l₁.sigma l₂ ↔ a ∈ l₁ ∧ b ∈ l₂ a
proof:
:= by
  simp [List.sigma, mem_flatMap, mem_map, exists_and_left, and_left_comm,
    exists_eq_left, exists_eq_right]

name: mem_antidiagonal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_antidiagonal {n : ℕ} {x : ℕ × ℕ} : x ∈ antidiagonal n ↔ x.1 + x.2 = n
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨x, y⟩
  simp [antidiagonal]
  grind

name: length_antidiagonal

name: antidiagonal_zero
