name: nodup_antidiagonal
statement: theorem nodup_antidiagonal (n : ℕ) : Nodup (antidiagonal n)
proof:
:=
  nodup_range.map ((@LeftInverse.injective ℕ (ℕ × ℕ) Prod.fst fun i ↦ (i, n - i)) fun _ ↦ rfl)

name: antidiagonal_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem antidiagonal_succ {n : ℕ} :
    antidiagonal (n + 1) = (0, n + 1) :: (antidiagonal n).map (Prod.map Nat.succ id)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [antidiagonal, range_succ_eq_map, map_cons, Nat.add_succ_sub_one,
    Nat.add_zero, id, Nat.sub_zero, map_map, Prod.map_apply]
  apply congr rfl (congr rfl _)
  ext; simp

name: antidiagonal_succ'
statement:
theorem antidiagonal_succ' {n : ℕ} :
    antidiagonal (n + 1) = (antidiagonal n).map (Prod.map id Nat.succ) ++ [(n + 1, 0)]

name: antidiagonal_succ_succ'
statement:
theorem antidiagonal_succ_succ' {n : ℕ} :
    antidiagonal (n + 2) =
      (0, n + 2) :: (antidiagonal n).map (Prod.map Nat.succ Nat.succ) ++ [(n + 2, 0)]

name: map_swap_antidiagonal
statement:
theorem map_swap_antidiagonal {n : ℕ} :
    (antidiagonal n).map Prod.swap = (antidiagonal n).reverse
proof:
:= by
  rw [antidiagonal, map_map, ← List.map_reverse, range_eq_range', reverse_range', ←
    range_eq_range', map_map]
  apply map_congr_left
  simp +contextual [Nat.sub_sub_self, Nat.lt_succ_iff]

name: sublists'_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sublists'_nil : sublists' (@nil α) = [[]]

name: sublists'_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sublists'_singleton (a : α) : sublists' [a] = [[], [a]]

name: sublists'Aux_eq_array_foldl
statement:
theorem sublists'Aux_eq_array_foldl (a : α) : ∀ (r₁ r₂ : List (List α)),
    sublists'Aux a r₁ r₂ = ((r₁.toArray).foldl (init := r₂.toArray)
      (fun r l => r.push (a :: l))).toList
proof:
:= by
  intro r₁ r₂
  rw [sublists'Aux, Array.foldl_toList]
  have := List.foldl_hom Array.toList (g₁ := fun r l => r.push (a :: l))
    (g₂ := fun r l => r ++ [a :: l]) (l := r₁) (init := r₂.toArray) (by simp)
  simpa using this

name: sublists'_eq_sublists'Aux
statement:
theorem sublists'_eq_sublists'Aux (l : List α) :
    sublists' l = l.foldr (fun a r => sublists'Aux a r r) [[]]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sublists', sublists'Aux_eq_array_foldl]
  rw [← List.foldr_hom Array.toList]
  · intros; congr

name: sublists'Aux_eq_map
statement:
theorem sublists'Aux_eq_map (a : α) (r₁ : List (List α)) : ∀ (r₂ : List (List α)),
    sublists'Aux a r₁ r₂ = r₂ ++ map (cons a) r₁
proof:
:=
  List.reverseRecOn r₁ (fun _ => by simp [sublists'Aux]) fun r₁ l ih r₂ => by
    rw [map_append, map_singleton, ← append_assoc, ← ih, sublists'Aux, foldl_append, foldl]
    simp [sublists'Aux]

name: sublists'_cons
statement:
@[simp 900]
theorem sublists'_cons (a : α) (l : List α) :
    sublists' (a :: l) = sublists' l ++ map (cons a) (sublists' l)

name: mem_sublists'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_sublists' {s t : List α} : s ∈ sublists' t ↔ s <+ t
proof:
:= by
  induction t generalizing s with
  | nil =>
    simp only [sublists'_nil, mem_singleton]
    exact ⟨fun h => by rw [h], eq_nil_of_sublist_nil⟩
  | cons a t IH => ?_
  simp only [sublists'_cons, mem_append, IH, mem_map]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · rcases h with (h | ⟨s, h, rfl⟩)
    · exact sublist_cons_of_sublist _ h
    · exact h.cons_cons _
  · obtain - | ⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩ := h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨_, h, rfl⟩

name: length_sublists'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_sublists' : ∀ l : List α, length (sublists' l) = 2 ^ length l
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => by
    simp +arith only [sublists'_cons, length_append, length_sublists' l,
      length_map, length, Nat.pow_succ']

@[simp]

name: sublists_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sublists_nil : sublists (@nil α) = [[]]

name: sublists_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sublists_singleton (a : α) : sublists [a] = [[], [a]]

name: sublistsAux_eq_array_foldl
statement:
theorem sublistsAux_eq_array_foldl :
    sublistsAux = fun (a : α) (r : List (List α)) =>
      (r.toArray.foldl (init := #[])
        fun r l => (r.push l).push (a :: l)).toList
proof:
:= by
  funext a r
  simp only [sublistsAux]
  have := foldl_hom Array.toList (g₁ := fun r l => (r.push l).push (a :: l))
    (g₂ := fun r l => r ++ [l, a :: l]) (l := r) (init := #[]) (by simp)
  simpa using this

name: sublistsAux_eq_flatMap
statement:
theorem sublistsAux_eq_flatMap :
    sublistsAux = fun (a : α) (r : List (List α)) => r.flatMap fun l => [l, a :: l]
proof:
:=
  funext fun a => funext fun r =>
  List.reverseRecOn r
    (by simp [sublistsAux])
    (fun r l ih => by
      rw [flatMap_append, ← ih, flatMap_singleton, sublistsAux, foldl_append]
      simp [sublistsAux])

name: sublists_append
statement:
theorem sublists_append (l₁ l₂ : List α) :
    sublists (l₁ ++ l₂) = (sublists l₂) >>= (fun x => (sublists l₁).map (· ++ x))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sublists, foldr_append]
  induction l₁ with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l₁ ih =>
    rw [foldr_cons, ih]
    simp [List.flatMap, flatten_flatten, Function.comp_def]

name: sublists_cons
statement:
theorem sublists_cons (a : α) (l : List α) :
    sublists (a :: l) = sublists l >>= (fun x => [x, a :: x])
proof:
:=
  show sublists ([a] ++ l) = _ by
  rw [sublists_append]
  simp only [sublists_singleton, map_cons, bind_eq_flatMap, nil_append, cons_append, map_nil]

name: sublists_concat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sublists_concat (l : List α) (a : α) :
    sublists (l ++ [a]) = sublists l ++ map (fun x => x ++ [a]) (sublists l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sublists_append, sublists_singleton, bind_eq_flatMap, flatMap_cons, flatMap_cons, flatMap_nil,
     map_id'' append_nil, append_nil]

name: sublists_reverse
statement: theorem sublists_reverse (l : List α) : sublists (reverse l) = map reverse (sublists' l)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    simp only [reverse_cons, sublists_append, sublists'_cons, map_append, ih, sublists_singleton,
      bind_eq_flatMap, map_map, flatMap_cons, append_nil, flatMap_nil, Function.comp_def]

name: sublists_eq_sublists'
statement: theorem sublists_eq_sublists' (l : List α) : sublists l = map reverse (sublists' (reverse l))

name: sublists'_reverse
statement: theorem sublists'_reverse (l : List α) : sublists' (reverse l) = map reverse (sublists l)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sublists_eq_sublists', map_map, map_id'' reverse_reverse, Function.comp_def]

name: sublists'_eq_sublists
statement: theorem sublists'_eq_sublists (l : List α) : sublists' l = map reverse (sublists (reverse l))

name: mem_sublists
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_sublists {s t : List α} : s ∈ sublists t ↔ s <+ t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← reverse_sublist, ← mem_sublists', sublists'_reverse,
    mem_map_of_injective reverse_injective]

name: length_sublists
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_sublists (l : List α) : length (sublists l) = 2 ^ length l
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sublists_eq_sublists', length_map, length_sublists', length_reverse]

name: map_pure_sublist_sublists
statement: theorem map_pure_sublist_sublists (l : List α) : map pure l <+ sublists l
proof:
:= by
  induction l using reverseRecOn <;> simp only [map, map_append, sublists_concat]
  · simp only [sublists_nil, sublist_cons_self]
  case append_singleton l a ih =>
    exact ((append_sublist_append_left _).2 <|
              singleton_sublist.2 <| mem_map.2 ⟨[], mem_sublists.2 (nil_sublist _), by rfl⟩).trans
          ((append_sublist_append_right _).2 ih)

name: sublistsLenAux_append
statement:
theorem sublistsLenAux_append :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (l : List α) (f : List α → β) (g : β → γ) (r : List β) (s : List γ),
      sublistsLenAux n l (g ∘ f) (r.map g ++ s) = (sublistsLenAux n l f r).map g ++ s
  | 0, l, f, g, r, s => by unfold sublistsLenAux; simp
  | _ + 1, [], _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, a :: l, f, g, r, s => by
    unfold sublistsLenAux
    simp only [show (g ∘ f) ∘ List.cons a = g ∘ f ∘ List.cons a by rfl,
      sublistsLenAux_append]

name: sublistsLenAux_eq
statement:
theorem sublistsLenAux_eq (l : List α) (n) (f : List α → β) (r) :
    sublistsLenAux n l f r = (sublistsLen n l).map f ++ r

name: sublistsLenAux_zero
statement:
theorem sublistsLenAux_zero (l : List α) (f : List α → β) (r) :
    sublistsLenAux 0 l f r = f [] :: r

name: sublistsLen_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sublistsLen_zero (l : List α) : sublistsLen 0 l = [[]]

name: sublistsLen_succ_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sublistsLen_succ_nil (n) : sublistsLen (n + 1) (@nil α) = []

name: sublistsLen_succ_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sublistsLen_succ_cons (n) (a : α) (l) :
    sublistsLen (n + 1) (a :: l) = sublistsLen (n + 1) l ++ (sublistsLen n l).map (cons a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sublistsLen, sublistsLenAux, sublistsLenAux_eq, sublistsLenAux_eq, map_id,
      append_nil]; rfl

name: sublistsLen_one
statement: theorem sublistsLen_one (l : List α) : sublistsLen 1 l = l.reverse.map ([·])
proof:
:=
  l.rec (by rw [sublistsLen_succ_nil, reverse_nil, map_nil]) fun a s ih ↦ by
    rw [sublistsLen_succ_cons, ih, reverse_cons, map_append, sublistsLen_zero]; rfl

name: length_sublistsLen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_sublistsLen :
    ∀ (n) (l : List α), length (sublistsLen n l) = Nat.choose (length l) n
  | 0, l => by simp
  | _ + 1, [] => by simp
  | n + 1, a :: l => by
    rw [sublistsLen_succ_cons, length_append, length_sublistsLen (n + 1) l,
      length_map, length_sublistsLen n l, length_cons, Nat.choose_succ_succ, Nat.add_comm]

name: sublistsLen_sublist_sublists'
statement:
theorem sublistsLen_sublist_sublists' :
    ∀ (n) (l : List α), sublistsLen n l <+ sublists' l
  | 0, l => by simp
  | _ + 1, [] => nil_sublist _
  | n + 1, a :: l => by
    rw [sublistsLen_succ_cons, sublists'_cons]
    exact (sublistsLen_sublist_sublists' _ _).append ((sublistsLen_sublist_sublists' _ _).map _)

name: sublistsLen_sublist_of_sublist
statement:
theorem sublistsLen_sublist_of_sublist (n) {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h : l₁ <+ l₂) :
    sublistsLen n l₁ <+ sublistsLen n l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing l₁ l₂ with | zero => simp | succ n IHn => ?_
  induction h with
  | slnil => rfl
  | cons a _ IH =>
    refine IH.trans ?_
    rw [sublistsLen_succ_cons]
    apply sublist_append_left
  | cons_cons a s IH => simpa only [sublistsLen_succ_cons] using IH.append ((IHn s).map _)

name: length_of_sublistsLen
statement:
theorem length_of_sublistsLen :
    ∀ {n} {l l' : List α}, l' ∈ sublistsLen n l → length l' = n
  | 0, l, l', h => by simp_all
  | n + 1, a :: l, l', h => by
    rw [sublistsLen_succ_cons, mem_append, mem_map] at h
    rcases h with (h | ⟨l', h, rfl⟩)
    · exact length_of_sublistsLen h
    · exact congr_arg (· + 1) (length_of_sublistsLen h)

name: mem_sublistsLen_self
statement:
theorem mem_sublistsLen_self {l l' : List α} (h : l' <+ l) :
    l' ∈ sublistsLen (length l') l
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | slnil => simp
  | @cons l₁ l₂ a s IH =>
    rcases l₁ with - | ⟨b, l₁⟩
    · simp
    · rw [length, sublistsLen_succ_cons]
      exact mem_append_left _ IH
  | cons_cons a s IH =>
    rw [length, sublistsLen_succ_cons]
    exact mem_append_right _ (mem_map.2 ⟨_, IH, rfl⟩)

name: mem_sublistsLen
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_sublistsLen {n} {l l' : List α} :
    l' ∈ sublistsLen n l ↔ l' <+ l ∧ length l' = n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    ⟨mem_sublists'.1 ((sublistsLen_sublist_sublists' _ _).subset h), length_of_sublistsLen h⟩,
    fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => h₂ ▸ mem_sublistsLen_self h₁⟩

name: sublistsLen_of_length_lt
statement: theorem sublistsLen_of_length_lt {n} {l : List α} (h : l.length < n) : sublistsLen n l = []
proof:
:=
  eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem.mpr fun _ =>
    mem_sublistsLen.not.mpr fun ⟨hs, hl⟩ => (h.trans_eq hl.symm).not_ge (Sublist.length_le hs)

name: sublistsLen_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sublistsLen_length : ∀ l : List α, sublistsLen l.length l = [l]
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => by
    simp only [length, sublistsLen_succ_cons, sublistsLen_length, map,
      sublistsLen_of_length_lt (lt_succ_self _), nil_append]

open Function

name: Pairwise.sublists'
statement:
theorem Pairwise.sublists' {R} :
    ∀ {l : List α}, Pairwise R l → Pairwise (Lex (Function.swap R)) (sublists' l)
  | _, Pairwise.nil => pairwise_singleton _ _
  | _, @Pairwise.cons _ _ a l H₁ H₂ => by
    simp only [sublists'_cons, pairwise_append, pairwise_map, mem_sublists', mem_map, exists_imp,
      and_imp]
    refine ⟨H₂.sublists', H₂.sublists'.imp fun l₁ => Lex.cons l₁, ?_⟩
    rintro l₁ sl₁ x l₂ _ rfl
    rcases l₁ with - | ⟨b, l₁⟩; · constructor
    exact Lex.rel (H₁ _ <| sl₁.subset mem_cons_self)

name: pairwise_sublists
statement:
theorem pairwise_sublists {R} {l : List α} (H : Pairwise R l) :
    Pairwise (Lex R on reverse) (sublists l)
proof:
:= by
  have := (pairwise_reverse.2 H).sublists'
  rwa [sublists'_reverse, pairwise_map] at this

name: nodup_sublists
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nodup_sublists {l : List α} : Nodup (sublists l) ↔ Nodup l
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => (h.sublist (map_pure_sublist_sublists _)).of_map _, fun h =>
    (pairwise_sublists h).imp @fun l₁ l₂ h => by simpa using h.to_ne⟩

name: nodup_sublists'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nodup_sublists' {l : List α} : Nodup (sublists' l) ↔ Nodup l
proof:
:= by
  rw [sublists'_eq_sublists, nodup_map_iff reverse_injective, nodup_sublists, nodup_reverse]

name: nodup_sublistsLen
statement: theorem nodup_sublistsLen (n : ℕ) {l : List α} (h : Nodup l) : (sublistsLen n l).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  have : Pairwise (· ≠ ·) l.sublists' := Pairwise.imp
    (fun h => Lex.to_ne (by convert! h using 3; simp [eq_comm])) h.sublists'
  exact this.sublist (sublistsLen_sublist_sublists' _ _)

name: sublists_map
statement:
theorem sublists_map (f : α → β) : ∀ (l : List α),
    sublists (map f l) = map (map f) (sublists l)
  | [] => by simp
  | a::l => by
    rw [map_cons, sublists_cons, bind_eq_flatMap, sublists_map f l, sublists_cons,
      bind_eq_flatMap, map_eq_flatMap, map_eq_flatMap]
    induction sublists l <;> simp [*]

name: sublists'_map
statement:
theorem sublists'_map (f : α → β) : ∀ (l : List α),
    sublists' (map f l) = map (map f) (sublists' l)
  | [] => by simp
  | a::l => by simp [map_cons, sublists'_cons, sublists'_map f l, Function.comp]

name: sublists_perm_sublists'
statement: theorem sublists_perm_sublists' (l : List α) : sublists l ~ sublists' l
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_get_finRange l, sublists_map, sublists'_map]
  apply Perm.map
  apply (perm_ext_iff_of_nodup _ _).mpr
  · simp
  · exact nodup_sublists.mpr (nodup_finRange _)
  · exact (nodup_sublists'.mpr (nodup_finRange _))

name: Sublist.sublists'
proof:
:= by
  induction sublist with
  | slnil => exact .refl _
  | cons a _ ih =>
    rw [sublists'_cons]
    exact ih.trans (List.sublist_append_left ..)
  | cons_cons a _ ih =>
    rw [sublists'_cons, sublists'_cons]
    exact ih.append (ih.map _)

name: sublists'_sublist_sublists'_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sublists'_sublist_sublists'_iff {l₁ l₂ : List α} :
    l₁.sublists' <+ l₂.sublists' ↔ l₁ <+ l₂ where
  mpr
proof:
:= Sublist.sublists'
  mp sublist := mem_sublists'.mp <| sublist.subset <| mem_sublists'.mpr <| .refl _

name: subperm_of_sublists'_subperm_sublists'
statement:
theorem subperm_of_sublists'_subperm_sublists' {l₁ l₂ : List α}
    (subperm : l₁.sublists' <+~ l₂.sublists') : l₁ <+~ l₂

name: sublists_cons_perm_append
statement:
theorem sublists_cons_perm_append (a : α) (l : List α) :
    sublists (a :: l) ~ sublists l ++ map (cons a) (sublists l)

name: revzip_sublists
statement: theorem revzip_sublists (l l₁ l₂ : List α) (h : (l₁, l₂) ∈ revzip l.sublists) : l₁ ++ l₂ ~ l
proof:
:= by
  rw [revzip] at h
  induction l using List.reverseRecOn generalizing l₁ l₂ with
  | nil =>
    have : l₁ = [] ∧ l₂ = [] := by simpa using h
    simp [this]
  | append_singleton l' a ih =>
    rw [sublists_concat, reverse_append, zip_append (by simp), ← map_reverse, zip_map_right,
      zip_map_left] at *
    simp only [Prod.mk_inj, mem_map, mem_append, Prod.map_apply, Prod.exists] at h
    rcases h with (⟨l₁, l₂', h, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨l₁', l₂, h, rfl, rfl⟩)
    · rw [← append_assoc]
      exact (ih _ _ h).append_right _
    · rw [append_assoc]
      apply (perm_append_comm.append_left _).trans
      rw [← append_assoc]
      exact (ih _ _ h).append_right _

name: revzip_sublists'
statement: theorem revzip_sublists' (l l₁ l₂ : List α) (h : (l₁, l₂) ∈ revzip l.sublists') : l₁ ++ l₂ ~ l
proof:
:= by
  rw [revzip] at h
  induction l generalizing l₁ l₂ with
  | nil =>
    simp_all only [sublists'_nil, reverse_cons, reverse_nil, nil_append, zip_cons_cons,
      zip_nil_right, mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq, append_nil, Perm.refl]
  | cons a l IH =>
    rw [sublists'_cons, reverse_append, zip_append, ← map_reverse, zip_map_right, zip_map_left] at *
      <;> [simp only [mem_append, mem_map, Prod.map_apply, id_eq, Prod.mk.injEq, Prod.exists,
        exists_eq_right_right] at h; simp]
    rcases h with (⟨l₁, l₂', h, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨l₁', h, rfl⟩)
    · exact perm_middle.trans ((IH _ _ h).cons _)
    · exact (IH _ _ h).cons _

name: range_bind_sublistsLen_perm
statement:
theorem range_bind_sublistsLen_perm (l : List α) :
    ((List.range (l.length + 1)).flatMap fun n => sublistsLen n l) ~ sublists' l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [range_succ]
  | cons h tl l_ih =>
    simp_rw [range_succ_eq_map, length, flatMap_cons, flatMap_map, sublistsLen_succ_cons,
      sublists'_cons, List.sublistsLen_zero, List.singleton_append]
    refine ((flatMap_append_perm (range (tl.length + 1)) _ _).symm.cons _).trans ?_
    simp_rw [← List.map_flatMap, ← cons_append]
    rw [← List.singleton_append, ← List.sublistsLen_zero tl]
    refine Perm.append ?_ (l_ih.map _)
    rw [List.range_succ, flatMap_append, flatMap_singleton,
      sublistsLen_of_length_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self _), append_nil,
      ← List.flatMap_map Nat.succ fun n => sublistsLen n tl,
      ← flatMap_cons (f := fun n => sublistsLen n tl), ← range_succ_eq_map]
    exact l_ih

name: nextOr_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nextOr_nil (x d : α) : nextOr [] x d = d

name: nextOr_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nextOr_singleton (x y d : α) : nextOr [y] x d = d

name: nextOr_self_cons_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nextOr_self_cons_cons (xs : List α) (x y d : α) : nextOr (x :: y :: xs) x d = y

name: nextOr_cons_of_ne
statement:
theorem nextOr_cons_of_ne (xs : List α) (y x d : α) (h : x ≠ y) :
    nextOr (y :: xs) x d = nextOr xs x d
proof:
:= by
  rcases xs with - | ⟨z, zs⟩
  · rfl
  · exact ite_eq_right h

name: nextOr_eq_nextOr_of_mem_dropLast
statement:
theorem nextOr_eq_nextOr_of_mem_dropLast (xs : List α) (x d d' : α) (x_mem : x ∈ xs.dropLast) :
    nextOr xs x d = nextOr xs x d'
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => cases x_mem
  | cons y ys IH => ?_
  rcases ys with - | ⟨z, zs⟩
  · simp at x_mem
  by_cases h : x = y
  · rw [h, nextOr_self_cons_cons, nextOr_self_cons_cons]
  · rw [nextOr, nextOr, IH]
    simpa [h] using x_mem

name: mem_of_nextOr_ne
statement: theorem mem_of_nextOr_ne {xs : List α} {x d : α} (h : nextOr xs x d ≠ d) : x ∈ xs
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons y ys IH => ?_
  rcases ys with - | ⟨z, zs⟩
  · simp at h
  · by_cases hx : x = y
    · simp [hx]
    · rw [nextOr_cons_of_ne _ _ _ _ hx] at h
      simpa [hx] using IH h

name: nextOr_concat
statement: theorem nextOr_concat {xs : List α} {x : α} (d : α) (h : x ∉ xs) : nextOr (xs ++ [x]) x d = d
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons z zs IH =>
    obtain ⟨hz, hzs⟩ := not_or.mp (mt mem_cons.2 h)
    rw [cons_append, nextOr_cons_of_ne _ _ _ _ hz, IH hzs]

name: nextOr_mem
statement: theorem nextOr_mem {xs : List α} {x d : α} (hd : d ∈ xs) : nextOr xs x d ∈ xs
proof:
:= by
  revert hd
  suffices ∀ xs' : List α, (∀ x ∈ xs, x ∈ xs') → d ∈ xs' → nextOr xs x d ∈ xs' by
    exact this xs fun _ => id
  intro xs' hxs' hd
  induction xs with
  | nil => exact hd
  | cons y ys ih => ?_
  rcases ys with - | ⟨z, zs⟩
  · exact hd
  rw [nextOr]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact hxs' _ (mem_cons_of_mem _ mem_cons_self)
  · exact ih fun _ h => hxs' _ (mem_cons_of_mem _ h)

name: next_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem next_singleton (x y : α) (h : x ∈ [y]) : next [y] x h = y

name: prev_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prev_singleton (x y : α) (h : x ∈ [y]) : prev [y] x h = y

name: next_cons_cons_eq'
statement:
theorem next_cons_cons_eq' (y z : α) (h : x ∈ y :: z :: l) (hx : x = y) :
    next (y :: z :: l) x h = z

name: next_cons_cons_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem next_cons_cons_eq (z : α) (h : x ∈ x :: z :: l) : next (x :: z :: l) x h = z
proof:
:=
  next_cons_cons_eq' l x x z h rfl

name: next_cons_eq_next_of_mem_dropLast
statement:
theorem next_cons_eq_next_of_mem_dropLast (h : x ∈ l.dropLast) (y : α) (hy : x ≠ y) :
    next (y :: l) x (mem_cons_of_mem _ <| mem_of_mem_dropLast h) =
      next l x (mem_of_mem_dropLast h)
proof:
:= by
  rwa [next, next, nextOr_cons_of_ne _ _ _ _ hy, nextOr_eq_nextOr_of_mem_dropLast]

name: next_cons_concat
statement:
theorem next_cons_concat (y : α) (hy : x ≠ y) (hx : x ∉ l)
    (h : x ∈ y :: l ++ [x] := mem_append_right _ (mem_singleton_self x)) :
    next (y :: l ++ [x]) x h = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [next, nextOr_concat]
  · simp
  · simp [hy, hx]

name: next_getLast_cons
statement:
theorem next_getLast_cons (h : x ∈ l) (y : α) (h : x ∈ y :: l) (hy : x ≠ y)
    (hx : x = getLast (y :: l) (cons_ne_nil _ _)) (hl : Nodup l) : next (y :: l) x h = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [next, get, ← dropLast_append_getLast (cons_ne_nil y l), hx, nextOr_concat]
  subst hx
  intro H
  obtain ⟨_ | k, hk, hk'⟩ := getElem_of_mem H
  · grind
  suffices k + 1 = l.length by simp [this] at hk
  rcases l with - | ⟨hd, tl⟩
  · simp at hk
  · rw [nodup_iff_injective_get] at hl
    rw [length, Nat.succ_inj]
    exact Fin.val_eq_of_eq <| @hl ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_succ_lt <| by simpa using hk⟩
      ⟨tl.length, by simp⟩ (by grind)

name: prev_getLast_cons'
statement:
theorem prev_getLast_cons' (y : α) (hxy : x ∈ y :: l) (hx : x = y) :
    prev (y :: l) x hxy = getLast (y :: l) (cons_ne_nil _ _)

name: prev_getLast_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prev_getLast_cons (h : x ∈ x :: l) :
    prev (x :: l) x h = getLast (x :: l) (cons_ne_nil _ _)
proof:
:=
  prev_getLast_cons' l x x h rfl

name: prev_head_eq_getLast
statement: theorem prev_head_eq_getLast (hl : l ≠ []) : l.prev (l.head hl) (head_mem hl) = l.getLast hl
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => contradiction
  | cons head tail => apply prev_getLast_cons

name: prev_cons_cons_eq'
statement:
theorem prev_cons_cons_eq' (y z : α) (h : x ∈ y :: z :: l) (hx : x = y) :
    prev (y :: z :: l) x h = getLast (z :: l) (cons_ne_nil _ _)

name: prev_cons_cons_eq
statement:
theorem prev_cons_cons_eq (z : α) (h : x ∈ x :: z :: l) :
    prev (x :: z :: l) x h = getLast (z :: l) (cons_ne_nil _ _)
proof:
:=
  prev_cons_cons_eq' l x x z h rfl

name: prev_cons_cons_of_ne'
statement:
theorem prev_cons_cons_of_ne' (y z : α) (h : x ∈ y :: z :: l) (hy : x ≠ y) (hz : x = z) :
    prev (y :: z :: l) x h = y
proof:
:= by
  cases l
  · simp [prev, hz]
  · rw [prev, dite_eq_right hy, ite_eq_left hz]

name: prev_cons_cons_of_ne
statement:
theorem prev_cons_cons_of_ne (y : α) (h : x ∈ y :: x :: l) (hy : x ≠ y) :
    prev (y :: x :: l) x h = y

name: prev_ne_cons_cons
statement:
theorem prev_ne_cons_cons (y z : α) (h : x ∈ y :: z :: l) (hy : x ≠ y) (hz : x ≠ z) :
    prev (y :: z :: l) x h = prev (z :: l) x (by simpa [hy] using h)
proof:
:= by
  cases l
  · simp [hy, hz] at h
  · rw [prev, dite_eq_right hy, ite_eq_right hz]

name: next_mem
statement: theorem next_mem (h : x ∈ l) : l.next x h ∈ l

name: prev_mem
statement: theorem prev_mem (h : x ∈ l) : l.prev x h ∈ l
proof:
:= by
  rcases l with - | ⟨hd, tl⟩
  · simp at h
  induction tl generalizing hd with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd' tl hl =>
    by_cases hx : x = hd
    · simp only [hx, prev_cons_cons_eq]
      exact mem_cons_of_mem _ (getLast_mem _)
    · rw [prev, dite_eq_right hx]
      split_ifs with hm
      · exact mem_cons_self
      · exact mem_cons_of_mem _ (hl _ _)

name: nextOr_eq_getElem
statement:
theorem nextOr_eq_getElem?_idxOf_succ_of_mem_dropLast {l : List α} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ l.dropLast)
    (d : α) : l.nextOr a d = l[l.idxOf a + 1]?
proof:
:= by
  match l with
  | nil => simp at ha
  | [head] => simp at ha
  | x :: y :: tail =>
    rw [getElem?_cons_succ, nextOr]
    split_ifs with hx
    · grind
    rw [idxOf_cons_ne _ <| Ne.symm hx, nextOr_eq_getElem?_idxOf_succ_of_mem_dropLast]
    grind

name: nextOr_eq_getElem_idxOf_succ_of_mem_dropLast
statement:
theorem nextOr_eq_getElem_idxOf_succ_of_mem_dropLast {l : List α} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ l.dropLast)
    (d : α) : l.nextOr a d = l[l.idxOf a + 1]'(succ_idxOf_lt_length_of_mem_dropLast ha)

name: nextOr_infix_of_mem_dropLast
statement:
theorem nextOr_infix_of_mem_dropLast {l : List α} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ l.dropLast) (d : α) :
    [a, l.nextOr a d] <:+: l
proof:
:= by
  refine infix_iff_getElem?.mpr ⟨l.idxOf a, ?_, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  · have ⟨_, _⟩ := l.dropLast_prefix
    grind
  by_cases hi₁ : i = 1
  · grind [next, nextOr_eq_getElem?_idxOf_succ_of_mem_dropLast]
  · grind [getElem?_idxOf, mem_of_mem_dropLast]

name: nextOr_getLast_of_notMem_dropLast
statement:
theorem nextOr_getLast_of_notMem_dropLast {l : List α} (hl : l ≠ []) (h : l.getLast hl ∉ l.dropLast)
    (d : α) : l.nextOr (l.getLast hl) d = d
proof:
:= by
  match l with
  | nil | [_] => simp
  | x :: y :: tail =>
    unfold nextOr
    split_ifs with h'
    · grind
    apply nextOr_getLast_of_notMem_dropLast
    grind

name: next_getLast_eq_head_of_notMem_dropLast
statement:
theorem next_getLast_eq_head_of_notMem_dropLast {l : List α} (hl : l ≠ [])
    (h : l.getLast hl ∉ l.dropLast) : l.next (l.getLast hl) (getLast_mem hl) = l.head hl

name: next_eq_getElem
statement:
theorem next_eq_getElem {l : List α} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ l) :
    l.next a ha = l[(l.idxOf a + 1) % l.length]'(Nat.mod_lt _ <| by grind)
proof:
:= by
  have hl := ne_nil_of_mem ha
  by_cases ha' : a ∈ l.dropLast
  · simp [next, nextOr_eq_getElem_idxOf_succ_of_mem_dropLast ha',
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt <| succ_idxOf_lt_length_of_mem_dropLast ha']
  grind [dropLast_append_getLast, next_getLast_eq_head_of_notMem_dropLast, Nat.mod_self]

name: next_getElem
statement:
theorem next_getElem (l : List α) (h : Nodup l) (i : Nat) (hi : i < l.length) :
    l.next l[i] (get_mem ..) = l[(i + 1) % l.length]'(Nat.mod_lt _ (i.zero_le.trans_lt hi))

name: prev_eq_getElem
statement:
theorem prev_eq_getElem?_idxOf_pred_of_ne_head {l : List α} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ l)
    (ha₀ : a ≠ l.head (ne_nil_of_mem ha)) : l.prev a ha = l[l.idxOf a - 1]?
proof:
:= by
  match l with
  | nil | [_] => grind
  | x :: y :: tail =>
    have ih := (y :: tail).prev_eq_getElem?_idxOf_pred_of_ne_head (a := a)
    grind [prev]

name: prev_eq_getElem_idxOf_pred_of_ne_head
statement:
theorem prev_eq_getElem_idxOf_pred_of_ne_head {l : List α} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ l)
    (ha₀ : a ≠ l.head (ne_nil_of_mem ha)) :
    l.prev a ha = l[l.idxOf a - 1]'(by grind [idxOf_lt_length_of_mem])

name: prev_infix_of_mem_tail
statement:
theorem prev_infix_of_mem_tail {l : List α} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ l)
    (ha₀ : a ≠ l.head (ne_nil_of_mem ha)) : [l.prev a ha, a] <:+: l
proof:
:= by
  have := cons_head_tail (ne_nil_of_mem ha) ▸ idxOf_cons_ne _ <| Ne.symm ha₀
  refine infix_iff_getElem?.mpr ⟨l.idxOf a - 1, by grind, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  by_cases hi₁ : i = 1
  · subst hi₁
    grind
  grind [prev_eq_getElem?_idxOf_pred_of_ne_head]

name: prev_eq_getElem
statement:
theorem prev_eq_getElem {l : List α} {a : α} (ha : a ∈ l) :
    l.prev a ha = l[(l.idxOf a + (l.length - 1)) % l.length]'(Nat.mod_lt _ <| by grind)
proof:
:= by
  cases l with | nil => grind | cons head tail =>
  by_cases ha₀ : a = head
  · subst ha₀
    simp
    grind
  rw [prev_eq_getElem_idxOf_pred_of_ne_head ha ha₀]
  congr
  rw [← Nat.add_sub_assoc, Nat.sub_add_comm, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
  all_goals grind

name: prev_getElem
statement:
theorem prev_getElem (l : List α) (h : Nodup l) (i : Nat) (hi : i < l.length) :
    l.prev l[i] (get_mem ..) = l[(i + (l.length - 1)) % l.length]'(Nat.mod_lt _ (by lia))

name: next_getLast_eq_head
statement:
@[simp]
theorem next_getLast_eq_head (l : List α) (h : l ≠ []) (hn : l.Nodup) :
    l.next (l.getLast h) (getLast_mem h) = l.head h
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : l.length - 1 + 1 = l.length := by grind [length_pos_iff]
  simp [getLast_eq_getElem h, head_eq_getElem h, next_getElem l hn (l.length - 1) (by grind), h1]

name: pmap_next_eq_rotate_one
statement: theorem pmap_next_eq_rotate_one (h : Nodup l) : (l.pmap l.next fun _ h => h) = l.rotate 1
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intros
    rw [getElem_pmap, getElem_rotate, next_getElem _ h]

name: pmap_prev_eq_rotate_length_sub_one
statement:
theorem pmap_prev_eq_rotate_length_sub_one (h : Nodup l) :
    (l.pmap l.prev fun _ h => h) = l.rotate (l.length - 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro n hn hn'
    rw [getElem_rotate, getElem_pmap, prev_getElem _ h]

name: prev_next
statement:
theorem prev_next (l : List α) (h : Nodup l) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ l) :
    prev l (next l x hx) (next_mem _ _ _) = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := getElem_of_mem hx
  simp only [next_getElem, prev_getElem, h, Nat.mod_add_mod]
  rcases l with - | ⟨hd, tl⟩
  · simp at hn
  · have : (n + 1 + length tl) % (length tl + 1) = n := by
      rw [length_cons] at hn
      rw [add_assoc, add_comm 1, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn]
    simp only [length_cons, Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub, Nat.sub_zero, this]

name: next_prev
statement:
theorem next_prev (l : List α) (h : Nodup l) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ l) :
    next l (prev l x hx) (prev_mem _ _ _) = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := getElem_of_mem hx
  simp only [next_getElem, prev_getElem, h, Nat.mod_add_mod]
  rcases l with - | ⟨hd, tl⟩
  · simp at hn
  · have : (n + length tl + 1) % (length tl + 1) = n := by
      rw [length_cons] at hn
      rw [add_assoc, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn]
    simp [this]

name: prev_reverse_eq_next
statement:
theorem prev_reverse_eq_next (l : List α) (h : Nodup l) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ l) :
    prev l.reverse x (mem_reverse.mpr hx) = next l x hx
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := getElem_of_mem hx
  have lpos : 0 < l.length := k.zero_le.trans_lt hk
  have key : l.length - 1 - k < l.length := by lia
  rw [← getElem_pmap l.next (fun _ h => h) (by simpa using hk)]
  simp_rw [getElem_eq_getElem_reverse (l := l), pmap_next_eq_rotate_one _ h]
  rw [← getElem_pmap l.reverse.prev fun _ h => h]
  · simp_rw [pmap_prev_eq_rotate_length_sub_one _ (nodup_reverse.mpr h), rotate_reverse,
      length_reverse, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.sub_lt lpos Nat.succ_pos'),
      Nat.sub_sub_self (Nat.succ_le_of_lt lpos)]
    rw [getElem_eq_getElem_reverse]
    · simp [Nat.sub_sub_self (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt hk)]
  · simpa

name: next_reverse_eq_prev
statement:
theorem next_reverse_eq_prev (l : List α) (h : Nodup l) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ l) :
    next l.reverse x (mem_reverse.mpr hx) = prev l x hx
proof:
:= by
  convert! (prev_reverse_eq_next l.reverse (nodup_reverse.mpr h) x (mem_reverse.mpr hx)).symm
  exact (reverse_reverse l).symm

name: isRotated_next_eq
statement:
theorem isRotated_next_eq {l l' : List α} (h : l ~r l') (hn : Nodup l) {x : α} (hx : x ∈ l) :
    l.next x hx = l'.next x (h.mem_iff.mp hx)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := getElem_of_mem hx
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := id h
  rw [next_getElem _ hn]
  simp_rw [getElem_eq_getElem_rotate _ n k]
  rw [next_getElem _ (h.nodup_iff.mp hn), getElem_eq_getElem_rotate _ n]
  simp [add_assoc]

name: isRotated_prev_eq
statement:
theorem isRotated_prev_eq {l l' : List α} (h : l ~r l') (hn : Nodup l) {x : α} (hx : x ∈ l) :
    l.prev x hx = l'.prev x (h.mem_iff.mp hx)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← next_reverse_eq_prev _ hn, ← next_reverse_eq_prev _ (h.nodup_iff.mp hn)]
  exact isRotated_next_eq h.reverse (nodup_reverse.mpr hn) _

name: coe_eq_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_eq_coe {l₁ l₂ : List α} : (l₁ : Cycle α) = (l₂ : Cycle α) ↔ l₁ ~r l₂

name: mk_eq_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq_coe (l : List α) : Quot.mk _ l = (l : Cycle α)

name: mk''_eq_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk''_eq_coe (l : List α) : Quotient.mk'' l = (l : Cycle α)

name: coe_cons_eq_coe_append
statement:
theorem coe_cons_eq_coe_append (l : List α) (a : α) :
    (↑(a :: l) : Cycle α) = (↑(l ++ [a]) : Cycle α)

name: coe_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_nil : ↑([] : List α) = @nil α

name: coe_eq_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_eq_nil (l : List α) : (l : Cycle α) = nil ↔ l = []

name: empty_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem empty_eq : ∅ = @nil α

name: induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim, induction_eliminator]
theorem induction_on {motive : Cycle α → Prop} (s : Cycle α) (nil : motive nil)
    (cons : ∀ (a) (l : List α), motive ↑l → motive ↑(a :: l)) : motive s
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn' s fun l => by
    refine List.recOn l ?_ ?_ <;> simp only [mk''_eq_coe, coe_nil]
    assumption'

name: mem_coe_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_coe_iff {a : α} {l : List α} : a ∈ (↑l : Cycle α) ↔ a ∈ l

name: notMem_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem notMem_nil (a : α) : a ∉ nil

name: reverse_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reverse_coe (l : List α) : (l : Cycle α).reverse = l.reverse

name: mem_reverse_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_reverse_iff {a : α} {s : Cycle α} : a ∈ s.reverse ↔ a ∈ s

name: reverse_reverse
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reverse_reverse (s : Cycle α) : s.reverse.reverse = s

name: reverse_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reverse_nil : nil.reverse = @nil α

name: length_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_coe (l : List α) : length (l : Cycle α) = l.length

name: length_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_nil : length (@nil α) = 0

name: length_reverse
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_reverse (s : Cycle α) : s.reverse.length = s.length

name: subsingleton_nil
statement: theorem subsingleton_nil : Subsingleton (@nil α)

name: length_subsingleton_iff
statement: theorem length_subsingleton_iff {s : Cycle α} : Subsingleton s ↔ length s ≤ 1

name: subsingleton_reverse_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subsingleton_reverse_iff {s : Cycle α} : s.reverse.Subsingleton ↔ s.Subsingleton

name: Subsingleton.congr
statement:
theorem Subsingleton.congr {s : Cycle α} (h : Subsingleton s) :
    ∀ ⦃x⦄ (_hx : x ∈ s) ⦃y⦄ (_hy : y ∈ s), x = y
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Quot.inductionOn with | _ l
  simp only [length_subsingleton_iff, length_coe, mk_eq_coe, le_iff_lt_or_eq, Nat.lt_add_one_iff,
    length_eq_zero_iff, length_eq_one_iff, Nat.not_lt_zero, false_or] at h
  rcases h with (rfl | ⟨z, rfl⟩) <;> simp

name: nontrivial_coe_nodup_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nontrivial_coe_nodup_iff {l : List α} (hl : l.Nodup) :
    Nontrivial (l : Cycle α) ↔ 2 ≤ l.length
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nontrivial]
  rcases l with (_ | ⟨hd, _ | ⟨hd', tl⟩⟩)
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp only [mem_cons, mem_coe_iff, List.length, Ne, Nat.succ_le_succ_iff,
      Nat.zero_le, iff_true]
    refine ⟨hd, hd', ?_, by simp⟩
    simp only [not_or, mem_cons, nodup_cons] at hl
    exact hl.left.left

name: nontrivial_reverse_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nontrivial_reverse_iff {s : Cycle α} : s.reverse.Nontrivial ↔ s.Nontrivial

name: length_nontrivial
statement: theorem length_nontrivial {s : Cycle α} (h : Nontrivial s) : 2 ≤ length s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy, hx, hy⟩ := h
  induction s using Quot.inductionOn with | _ l
  rcases l with (_ | ⟨hd, _ | ⟨hd', tl⟩⟩)
  · simp at hx
  · simp only [mem_coe_iff, mk_eq_coe, mem_singleton] at hx hy
    simp [hx, hy] at hxy
  · simp [Nat.succ_le_succ_iff]

name: nodup_coe_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nodup_coe_iff {l : List α} : Nodup (l : Cycle α) ↔ l.Nodup

name: nodup_reverse_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nodup_reverse_iff {s : Cycle α} : s.reverse.Nodup ↔ s.Nodup

name: Subsingleton.nodup
statement: theorem Subsingleton.nodup {s : Cycle α} (h : Subsingleton s) : Nodup s
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Quot.inductionOn with | _ l
  obtain - | ⟨hd, tl⟩ := l
  · simp
  · have : tl = [] := by simpa [Subsingleton, length_eq_zero_iff, Nat.succ_le_succ_iff] using h
    simp [this]

name: Nodup.nontrivial_iff
statement: theorem Nodup.nontrivial_iff {s : Cycle α} (h : Nodup s) : Nontrivial s ↔ ¬Subsingleton s
proof:
:= by
  rw [length_subsingleton_iff]
  induction s using Quotient.inductionOn'
  simp only [mk''_eq_coe, nodup_coe_iff] at h
  simp [h, Nat.succ_le_iff]

name: coe_toMultiset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_toMultiset (l : List α) : (l : Cycle α).toMultiset = l

name: nil_toMultiset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nil_toMultiset : nil.toMultiset = (0 : Multiset α)

name: card_toMultiset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_toMultiset (s : Cycle α) : Multiset.card s.toMultiset = s.length

name: toMultiset_eq_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toMultiset_eq_nil {s : Cycle α} : s.toMultiset = 0 ↔ s = Cycle.nil

name: map_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_nil {β : Type*} (f : α → β) : map f nil = nil

name: map_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_coe {β : Type*} (f : α → β) (l : List α) : map f ↑l = List.map f l

name: map_eq_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_eq_nil {β : Type*} (f : α → β) (s : Cycle α) : map f s = nil ↔ s = nil

name: mem_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_map {β : Type*} {f : α → β} {b : β} {s : Cycle α} :
    b ∈ s.map f ↔ ∃ a, a ∈ s ∧ f a = b

name: lists_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lists_coe (l : List α) : lists (l : Cycle α) = ↑l.cyclicPermutations

name: mem_lists_iff_coe_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_lists_iff_coe_eq {s : Cycle α} {l : List α} : l ∈ s.lists ↔ (l : Cycle α) = s
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn' s fun l => by
    rw [lists, Quotient.liftOn'_mk'']
    simp

name: lists_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lists_nil : lists (@nil α) = {([] : List α)}

name: toFinset_toMultiset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toFinset_toMultiset (s : Cycle α) : s.toMultiset.toFinset = s.toFinset

name: coe_toFinset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_toFinset (l : List α) : (l : Cycle α).toFinset = l.toFinset

name: nil_toFinset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nil_toFinset : (@nil α).toFinset = ∅

name: toFinset_eq_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toFinset_eq_nil {s : Cycle α} : s.toFinset = ∅ ↔ s = Cycle.nil

name: next_reverse_eq_prev
statement:
theorem next_reverse_eq_prev (s : Cycle α) (hs : Nodup s) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ s) :
    s.reverse.next (nodup_reverse_iff.mpr hs) x (mem_reverse_iff.mpr hx) = s.prev hs x hx

name: next_reverse_eq_prev'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem next_reverse_eq_prev' (s : Cycle α) (hs : Nodup s.reverse) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ s.reverse) :
    s.reverse.next hs x hx = s.prev (nodup_reverse_iff.mp hs) x (mem_reverse_iff.mp hx)

name: prev_mem
statement: theorem prev_mem (s : Cycle α) (hs : Nodup s) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ s) : s.prev hs x hx ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← next_reverse_eq_prev, ← mem_reverse_iff]
  apply next_mem

name: Chain.nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Chain.nil (r : α → α → Prop) : Cycle.Chain r (@nil α)

name: chain_coe_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem chain_coe_cons (r : α → α → Prop) (a : α) (l : List α) :
    Chain r (a :: l) ↔ List.IsChain r (a :: (l ++ [a]))

name: chain_singleton
statement: theorem chain_singleton (r : α → α → Prop) (a : α) : Chain r [a] ↔ r a a

name: chain_ne_nil
statement:
theorem chain_ne_nil (r : α → α → Prop) {l : List α} :
    ∀ hl : l ≠ [], Chain r l ↔ List.IsChain r (getLast l hl :: l)
proof:
:=
  l.reverseRecOn (fun hm => hm.irrefl.elim) (by
    intro m a _H _
    rw [← coe_cons_eq_coe_append, chain_coe_cons, getLast_append_singleton])

name: chain_map
statement:
theorem chain_map {β : Type*} {r : α → α → Prop} (f : β → α) {s : Cycle β} :
    Chain r (s.map f) ↔ Chain (fun a b => r (f a) (f b)) s
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn s fun l => by
    rcases l with - | ⟨a, l⟩
    · rfl
    · simp [← concat_eq_append, ← map_concat, List.isChain_cons_map f]

name: chain_range_succ
statement:
theorem chain_range_succ (r : ℕ → ℕ → Prop) (n : ℕ) :
    Chain r (List.range n.succ) ↔ r n 0 ∧ ∀ m < n, r m m.succ
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_succ, ← coe_cons_eq_coe_append, chain_coe_cons, ← range_succ, isChain_cons_range_succ]

name: Chain.imp
statement:
theorem Chain.imp {r₁ r₂ : α → α → Prop} (H : ∀ a b, r₁ a b → r₂ a b) (p : Chain r₁ s) :
    Chain r₂ s
proof:
:= by
  induction s
  · trivial
  · rw [chain_coe_cons] at p ⊢
    exact p.imp H

name: chain_mono
statement: theorem chain_mono : Monotone (Chain : (α → α → Prop) → Cycle α → Prop)

name: chain_of_pairwise
statement: theorem chain_of_pairwise : (∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ s, r a b) → Chain r s
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | nil => exact fun _ ↦ Cycle.Chain.nil r
  | cons a l => ?_
  intro hs
  have Ha : a ∈ (a :: l : Cycle α) := by simp
  have Hl : ∀ {b} (_hb : b ∈ l), b ∈ (a :: l : Cycle α) := @fun b hb => by simp [hb]
  rw [Cycle.chain_coe_cons]
  apply Pairwise.isChain
  rw [pairwise_cons]
  exact
    ⟨fun b hb => by grind,
      pairwise_append.2
        ⟨pairwise_of_forall_mem_list fun b hb c hc => hs b (Hl hb) c (Hl hc),
          pairwise_singleton r a, fun b hb c hc => by grind⟩⟩

name: chain_iff_pairwise
statement: theorem chain_iff_pairwise [IsTrans α r] : Chain r s ↔ ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ s, r a b
proof:
:=
  ⟨by
    induction s with
    | nil => exact fun _ b hb ↦ (notMem_nil _ hb).elim
    | cons a l => ?_
    intro hs b hb c hc
    rw [Cycle.chain_coe_cons, List.isChain_iff_pairwise] at hs
    simp only [pairwise_append, pairwise_cons, mem_append, mem_singleton, List.not_mem_nil,
      IsEmpty.forall_iff, imp_true_iff, Pairwise.nil, forall_eq, true_and] at hs
    simp only [mem_coe_iff, mem_cons] at hb hc
    rcases hb with (rfl | hb) <;> rcases hc with (rfl | hc)
    · exact hs.1 c (Or.inr rfl)
    · exact hs.1 c (Or.inl hc)
    · exact hs.2.2 b hb
    · exact _root_.trans (hs.2.2 b hb) (hs.1 c (Or.inl hc)), Cycle.chain_of_pairwise⟩

name: Chain.eq_nil_of_irrefl
statement: theorem Chain.eq_nil_of_irrefl [IsTrans α r] [Std.Irrefl r] (h : Chain r s) : s = Cycle.nil
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l h =>
    have ha : a ∈ a :: l := mem_cons_self
    exact (irrefl_of r a <| chain_iff_pairwise.1 h a ha a ha).elim

name: Chain.eq_nil_of_well_founded
statement: theorem Chain.eq_nil_of_well_founded [IsWellFounded α r] (h : Chain r s) : s = Cycle.nil

name: forall_eq_of_chain
statement:
theorem forall_eq_of_chain [IsTrans α r] [Std.Antisymm r] (hs : Chain r s) {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ s)
    (hb : b ∈ s) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [chain_iff_pairwise] at hs
  exact antisymm (hs a ha b hb) (hs b hb a ha)

name: find
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x _ ih =>
    grind
  | swap x y l =>
    dsimp [Set.Subsingleton] at hp
    by_cases p x <;> by_cases p y <;> grind
  | trans _ _ ih1 ih2 =>
    refine (ih1 ?_).trans (ih2 ?_) <;> grind

name: find
statement:
@[congr]
theorem find?_congr {p₁ p₂ : α → Bool} {l : List α} (h : ∀ x ∈ l, p₁ x = p₂ x) :
    l.find? p₁ = l.find? p₂

name: zero_bot
statement: theorem zero_bot (n : ℕ) : Ico 0 n = range n

name: length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length (n m : ℕ) : length (Ico n m) = m - n

name: pairwise_lt
statement: theorem pairwise_lt (n m : ℕ) : Pairwise (· < ·) (Ico n m)

name: nodup
statement: theorem nodup (n m : ℕ) : Nodup (Ico n m)

name: mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem {n m l : ℕ} : l ∈ Ico n m ↔ n ≤ l ∧ l < m
proof:
:= by
  suffices n ≤ l ∧ l < n + (m - n) ↔ n ≤ l ∧ l < m by simp [Ico, this]
  lia

name: eq_nil_of_le
statement: theorem eq_nil_of_le {n m : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) : Ico n m = []

name: map_add
statement: theorem map_add (n m k : ℕ) : (Ico n m).map (k + ·) = Ico (n + k) (m + k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ico, Ico, map_add_range', Nat.add_sub_add_right m k, Nat.add_comm n k]

name: map_sub
statement:
theorem map_sub (n m k : ℕ) (h₁ : k ≤ n) :
    ((Ico n m).map fun x => x - k) = Ico (n - k) (m - k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ico, Ico, Nat.sub_sub_sub_cancel_right h₁, map_sub_range' h₁]

name: self_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem self_empty {n : ℕ} : Ico n n = []

name: eq_empty_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eq_empty_iff {n m : ℕ} : Ico n m = [] ↔ m ≤ n
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro (fun h => Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le.mp <| by rw [← length, h, List.length]) eq_nil_of_le

name: append_consecutive
statement:
theorem append_consecutive {n m l : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) (hml : m ≤ l) :
    Ico n m ++ Ico m l = Ico n l
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [Ico]
  convert! range'_append using 2
  · rw [Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hnm]
  · lia

name: inter_consecutive
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inter_consecutive (n m l : ℕ) : Ico n m ∩ Ico m l = []
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem.2
  intro a
  simp only [and_imp, not_and, not_lt, List.mem_inter_iff, List.Ico.mem]
  intro _ h₂ h₃
  exfalso
  exact not_lt_of_ge h₃ h₂

name: bagInter_consecutive
succ_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem succ_singleton {n : ℕ} : Ico n (n + 1) = [n]

name: succ_top
statement: theorem succ_top {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) : Ico n (m + 1) = Ico n m ++ [m]
proof:
:= by
  rwa [← succ_singleton, append_consecutive]
  exact Nat.le_succ _

name: eq_cons
statement: theorem eq_cons {n m : ℕ} (h : n < m) : Ico n m = n :: Ico (n + 1) m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← append_consecutive (Nat.le_succ n) h, succ_singleton]
  rfl

name: pred_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pred_singleton {m : ℕ} (h : 0 < m) : Ico (m - 1) m = [m - 1]

name: isChain_succ
statement: theorem isChain_succ (n m : ℕ) : IsChain (fun a b => b = succ a) (Ico n m)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h : n < m
  · rw [eq_cons h]
    unfold List.Ico
    exact isChain_range' _ (_ + 1) 1
  · rw [eq_nil_of_le h]
    exact .nil

name: notMem_top
statement: theorem notMem_top {n m : ℕ} : m ∉ Ico n m

name: filter_lt_of_top_le
statement:
theorem filter_lt_of_top_le {n m l : ℕ} (hml : m ≤ l) :
    ((Ico n m).filter fun x => x < l) = Ico n m
proof:
:=
  filter_eq_self.2 fun k hk => by
    simp only [(lt_of_lt_of_le (mem.1 hk).2 hml), decide_true]

name: filter_lt_of_le_bot
statement: theorem filter_lt_of_le_bot {n m l : ℕ} (hln : l ≤ n) : ((Ico n m).filter fun x => x < l) = []
proof:
:=
  filter_eq_nil_iff.2 fun k hk => by
     simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, not_lt]
     apply le_trans hln
     exact (mem.1 hk).1

name: filter_lt_of_ge
statement:
theorem filter_lt_of_ge {n m l : ℕ} (hlm : l ≤ m) :
    ((Ico n m).filter fun x => x < l) = Ico n l
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total n l with hnl | hln
  · rw [← append_consecutive hnl hlm, filter_append, filter_lt_of_top_le (le_refl l),
      filter_lt_of_le_bot (le_refl l), append_nil]
  · rw [eq_nil_of_le hln, filter_lt_of_le_bot hln]

name: filter_lt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_lt (n m l : ℕ) :
    ((Ico n m).filter fun x => x < l) = Ico n (min m l)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total m l with hml | hlm
  · rw [min_eq_left hml, filter_lt_of_top_le hml]
  · rw [min_eq_right hlm, filter_lt_of_ge hlm]

name: filter_le_of_le_bot
statement:
theorem filter_le_of_le_bot {n m l : ℕ} (hln : l ≤ n) :
    ((Ico n m).filter fun x => l ≤ x) = Ico n m
proof:
:=
  filter_eq_self.2 fun k hk => by
    rw [decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact le_trans hln (mem.1 hk).1

name: filter_le_of_top_le
statement: theorem filter_le_of_top_le {n m l : ℕ} (hml : m ≤ l) : ((Ico n m).filter fun x => l ≤ x) = []
proof:
:=
  filter_eq_nil_iff.2 fun k hk => by
    rw [decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact not_le_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le (mem.1 hk).2 hml)

name: filter_le_of_le
statement:
theorem filter_le_of_le {n m l : ℕ} (hnl : n ≤ l) :
    ((Ico n m).filter fun x => l ≤ x) = Ico l m
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total l m with hlm | hml
  · rw [← append_consecutive hnl hlm, filter_append, filter_le_of_top_le (le_refl l),
      filter_le_of_le_bot (le_refl l), nil_append]
  · rw [eq_nil_of_le hml, filter_le_of_top_le hml]

name: filter_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_le (n m l : ℕ) : ((Ico n m).filter fun x => l ≤ x) = Ico (max n l) m
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total n l with hnl | hln
  · rw [max_eq_right hnl, filter_le_of_le hnl]
  · rw [max_eq_left hln, filter_le_of_le_bot hln]

name: filter_lt_of_succ_bot
statement:
theorem filter_lt_of_succ_bot {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n < m) :
    ((Ico n m).filter fun x => x < n + 1) = [n]
proof:
:= by
  have r : min m (n + 1) = n + 1 := (@inf_eq_right _ _ m (n + 1)).mpr hnm
  simp [filter_lt n m (n + 1), r]

name: filter_le_of_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_le_of_bot {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n < m) : ((Ico n m).filter fun x => x ≤ n) = [n]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← filter_lt_of_succ_bot hnm]
  exact filter_congr fun _ _ => by
    simpa using Nat.lt_succ_iff.symm

name: trichotomy
statement: theorem trichotomy (n a b : ℕ) : n < a ∨ b ≤ n ∨ n ∈ Ico a b

name: sym2_map
statement:
theorem sym2_map (f : α → β) (xs : List α) :
    (xs.map f).sym2 = xs.sym2.map (Sym2.map f)
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [List.sym2]
  | cons x xs ih => simp [List.sym2, ih, Function.comp]

name: mem_sym2_cons_iff
statement:
theorem mem_sym2_cons_iff {x : α} {xs : List α} {z : Sym2 α} :
    z ∈ (x :: xs).sym2 ↔ z = s(x, x) ∨ (∃ y, y ∈ xs ∧ z = s(x, y)) ∨ z ∈ xs.sym2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.sym2, map_cons, cons_append, mem_cons, mem_append, mem_map]
  simp only [eq_comm]

name: sym2_eq_nil_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sym2_eq_nil_iff {xs : List α} : xs.sym2 = [] ↔ xs = []

name: left_mem_of_mk_mem_sym2
statement:
theorem left_mem_of_mk_mem_sym2 {xs : List α} {a b : α}
    (h : s(a, b) ∈ xs.sym2) : a ∈ xs
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => exact (not_mem_nil h).elim
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [mem_cons]
    rw [mem_sym2_cons_iff] at h
    obtain (h | ⟨c, hc, h⟩ | h) := h
    · rw [Sym2.eq_iff, ← and_or_left] at h
      exact .inl h.1
    · rw [Sym2.eq_iff] at h
      obtain (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) := h <;> simp [hc]
    · exact .inr <| ih h

name: right_mem_of_mk_mem_sym2
statement:
theorem right_mem_of_mk_mem_sym2 {xs : List α} {a b : α}
    (h : s(a, b) ∈ xs.sym2) : b ∈ xs
proof:
:= by
  rw [Sym2.eq_swap] at h
  exact left_mem_of_mk_mem_sym2 h

name: mk_mem_sym2
statement:
theorem mk_mem_sym2 {xs : List α} {a b : α} (ha : a ∈ xs) (hb : b ∈ xs) :
    s(a, b) ∈ xs.sym2
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp at ha
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [mem_sym2_cons_iff]
    grind

name: mk_mem_sym2_iff
statement:
theorem mk_mem_sym2_iff {xs : List α} {a b : α} :
    s(a, b) ∈ xs.sym2 ↔ a ∈ xs ∧ b ∈ xs
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨left_mem_of_mk_mem_sym2 h, right_mem_of_mk_mem_sym2 h⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩
    exact mk_mem_sym2 ha hb

name: mem_sym2_iff
statement:
theorem mem_sym2_iff {xs : List α} {z : Sym2 α} :
    z ∈ xs.sym2 ↔ ∀ y ∈ z, y ∈ xs
proof:
:= by
  refine z.ind (fun a b => ?_)
  simp [mk_mem_sym2_iff]

name: setOfPred_mem_sym2
statement:
lemma setOfPred_mem_sym2 {xs : List α} :
    {z : Sym2 α | z ∈ xs.sym2} = {x : α | x ∈ xs}.sym2
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun z ↦ z.ind fun a b => by simp [mk_mem_sym2_iff]

name: Nodup.sym2
statement: protected theorem Nodup.sym2 {xs : List α} (h : xs.Nodup) : xs.sym2.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp only [List.sym2, nodup_nil]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [List.sym2]
    specialize ih h.of_cons
    rw [nodup_cons] at h
    refine Nodup.append (Nodup.cons ?notmem (h.2.map ?inj)) ih ?disj
    case disj =>
      intro z hz hz'
      simp only [mem_cons, mem_map] at hz
      obtain ⟨_, (rfl | _), rfl⟩ := hz
        <;> simp [left_mem_of_mk_mem_sym2 hz'] at h
    case notmem =>
      intro h'
      simp only [h.1, mem_map, Sym2.eq_iff, true_and, or_self, exists_eq_right] at h'
    case inj =>
      intro a b
      simp only [Sym2.eq_iff, true_and]
      rintro (rfl | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) <;> rfl

name: map_mk_sublist_sym2
statement:
theorem map_mk_sublist_sym2 (x : α) (xs : List α) (h : x ∈ xs) :
    map (fun y ↦ s(x, y)) xs <+ xs.sym2
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x' xs ih =>
    simp only [map_cons, List.sym2, cons_append]
    cases h with
    | head =>
      exact (sublist_append_left _ _).cons_cons _
    | tail _ h =>
      refine .cons _ ?_
      rw [← singleton_append]
      refine .append ?_ (ih h)
      rw [singleton_sublist, mem_map]
      exact ⟨_, h, Sym2.eq_swap⟩

name: map_mk_disjoint_sym2
statement:
theorem map_mk_disjoint_sym2 (x : α) (xs : List α) (h : x ∉ xs) :
    (map (fun y ↦ s(x, y)) xs).Disjoint xs.sym2
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x' xs ih => aesop (add simp mk_mem_sym2_iff, unfold safe List.Disjoint)

name: dedup_sym2
statement: theorem dedup_sym2 [DecidableEq α] (xs : List α) : xs.sym2.dedup = xs.dedup.sym2
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp only [List.sym2, dedup_nil]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.sym2, map_cons, cons_append]
    obtain hm | hm := Decidable.em (x ∈ xs)
    · rw [dedup_cons_of_mem hm, ← ih, dedup_cons_of_mem,
        List.Subset.dedup_append_right (map_mk_sublist_sym2 _ _ hm).subset]
      refine mem_append_left _ ?_
      rw [mem_map]
      exact ⟨_, hm, Sym2.eq_swap⟩
    · rw [dedup_cons_of_notMem hm, List.sym2, map_cons, ← ih, dedup_cons_of_notMem, cons_append,
        List.Disjoint.dedup_append, dedup_map_of_injective]
      · exact (Sym2.mkEmbedding _).injective
      · exact map_mk_disjoint_sym2 x xs hm
      · simp [hm, mem_sym2_iff]

name: Perm.sym2
statement:
protected theorem Perm.sym2 {xs ys : List α} (h : xs ~ ys) :
    xs.sym2 ~ ys.sym2
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x h ih =>
    simp only [List.sym2, map_cons, cons_append, perm_cons]
    exact (h.map _).append ih
  | swap x y xs =>
    simp only [List.sym2, map_cons, cons_append]
    conv => enter [1, 2, 1]; rw [Sym2.eq_swap]
    
    refine Perm.trans (Perm.swap ..) (Perm.trans (Perm.cons _ ?_) (Perm.swap ..))
    simp only [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, ← Multiset.cons_coe,
      ← Multiset.coe_add, ← Multiset.singleton_add]
    simp only [add_left_comm]
  | trans _ _ ih1 ih2 => exact ih1.trans ih2

name: Sublist.sym2
statement: protected theorem Sublist.sym2 {xs ys : List α} (h : xs <+ ys) : xs.sym2 <+ ys.sym2
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | slnil => apply slnil
  | cons a h ih =>
    simp only [List.sym2]
    exact Sublist.append (nil_sublist _) ih
  | cons_cons a h ih =>
    simp only [List.sym2, map_cons, cons_append]
    exact cons_cons _ (append (Sublist.map _ h) ih)

name: Subperm.sym2
statement: protected theorem Subperm.sym2 {xs ys : List α} (h : xs <+~ ys) : xs.sym2 <+~ ys.sym2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨xs', hx, h⟩ := h
  exact hx.sym2.symm.subperm.trans h.sym2.subperm

name: length_sym2
statement: theorem length_sym2 {xs : List α} : xs.sym2.length = Nat.choose (xs.length + 1) 2
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [List.sym2, length_append, length_map, length_cons,
        Nat.choose_succ_succ, ← ih, Nat.choose_one_right]

name: sym_one_eq
statement: theorem sym_one_eq : xs.sym 1 = xs.map (· ::ₛ .nil)
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp only [List.sym, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.reduceAdd, map_nil]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [map_cons, ← ih, List.sym, List.sym, map_singleton, singleton_append]

name: sym2_eq_sym_two
statement: theorem sym2_eq_sym_two : xs.sym2.map (Sym2.equivSym α) = xs.sym 2
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp only [List.sym, map_eq_nil_iff, sym2_eq_nil_iff]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [List.sym, ← ih, sym_one_eq, map_map, List.sym2, map_append, map_map]
    rfl

name: sym_map
statement:
theorem sym_map {β : Type*} (f : α → β) (n : ℕ) (xs : List α) :
    (xs.map f).sym n = (xs.sym n).map (Sym.map f)
proof:
:=
  match n, xs with
  | 0, _ => by simp only [List.sym]; rfl
  | n + 1, [] => by simp [List.sym]
  | n + 1, x :: xs => by
    rw [map_cons, List.sym, ← map_cons, sym_map f n (x :: xs), sym_map f (n + 1) xs]
    simp only [map_map, List.sym, map_append, append_cancel_right_eq]
    congr
    ext s
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Sym.map_cons]

name: Sublist.sym
statement: protected theorem Sublist.sym (n : ℕ) {xs ys : List α} (h : xs <+ ys) : xs.sym n <+ ys.sym n
proof:
:=
  match n, h with
  | 0, _ => by simp [List.sym]
  | n + 1, .slnil => by simp only [refl]
  | n + 1, .cons a h => by
    rw [List.sym, ← nil_append (List.sym (n + 1) xs)]
    apply Sublist.append (nil_sublist _)
    exact h.sym (n + 1)
  | n + 1, .cons_cons a h => by
    rw [List.sym, List.sym]
    apply Sublist.append
    · exact ((cons_cons a h).sym n).map _
    · exact h.sym (n + 1)

name: sym_sublist_sym_cons
statement: theorem sym_sublist_sym_cons {a : α} : xs.sym n <+ (a :: xs).sym n

name: mem_of_mem_of_mem_sym
statement:
theorem mem_of_mem_of_mem_sym {n : ℕ} {xs : List α} {a : α} {z : Sym α n}
    (ha : a ∈ z) (hz : z ∈ xs.sym n) : a ∈ xs
proof:
:=
  match n, xs with
  | 0, xs => by
    cases Sym.eq_nil_of_card_zero z
    simp at ha
  | n + 1, [] => by simp [List.sym] at hz
  | n + 1, x :: xs => by
    rw [List.sym, mem_append, mem_map] at hz
    obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ | hz := hz
    · rw [Sym.mem_cons] at ha
      obtain rfl | ha := ha
      · simp
      · exact mem_of_mem_of_mem_sym ha hz
    · rw [mem_cons]
      right
      exact mem_of_mem_of_mem_sym ha hz

name: first_mem_of_cons_mem_sym
statement:
theorem first_mem_of_cons_mem_sym {xs : List α} {n : ℕ} {a : α} {z : Sym α n}
    (h : a ::ₛ z ∈ xs.sym (n + 1)) : a ∈ xs

name: Nodup.sym
statement: protected theorem Nodup.sym (n : ℕ) {xs : List α} (h : xs.Nodup) : (xs.sym n).Nodup
proof:
:=
  match n, xs with
  | 0, _ => by simp [List.sym]
  | n + 1, [] => by simp [List.sym]
  | n + 1, x :: xs => by
    rw [List.sym]
    refine Nodup.append (Nodup.map ?inj (Nodup.sym n h)) (Nodup.sym (n + 1) h.of_cons) ?disj
    case inj =>
      intro z z'
      simp
    case disj =>
      intro z hz hz'
      rw [mem_map] at hz
      obtain ⟨z, _hz, rfl⟩ := hz
      have := first_mem_of_cons_mem_sym hz'
      simp only [nodup_cons, this, not_true_eq_false, false_and] at h

name: length_sym
statement:
theorem length_sym {n : ℕ} {xs : List α} :
    (xs.sym n).length = Nat.multichoose xs.length n
proof:
:=
  match n, xs with
  | 0, _ => by rw [List.sym, Nat.multichoose]; rfl
  | n + 1, [] => by simp [List.sym]
  | n + 1, x :: xs => by
    rw [List.sym, length_append, length_map, length_cons]
    rw [@length_sym n (x :: xs), @length_sym (n + 1) xs]
    rw [Nat.multichoose_succ_succ, length_cons, add_comm]

name: rotate_mod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate_mod (l : List α) (n : ℕ) : l.rotate (n % l.length) = l.rotate n

name: rotate_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate_nil (n : ℕ) : ([] : List α).rotate n = []

name: rotate_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate_zero (l : List α) : l.rotate 0 = l

name: rotate'_nil
statement: theorem rotate'_nil (n : ℕ) : ([] : List α).rotate' n = []

name: rotate'_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate'_zero (l : List α) : l.rotate' 0 = l

name: rotate'_cons_succ
statement:
theorem rotate'_cons_succ (l : List α) (a : α) (n : ℕ) :
    (a :: l : List α).rotate' n.succ = (l ++ [a]).rotate' n

name: length_rotate'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_rotate' : ∀ (l : List α) (n : ℕ), (l.rotate' n).length = l.length
  | [], _ => by simp
  | _ :: _, 0 => rfl
  | a :: l, n + 1 => by rw [List.rotate', length_rotate' (l ++ [a]) n]; simp

name: rotate'_eq_drop_append_take
statement:
theorem rotate'_eq_drop_append_take :
    ∀ {l : List α} {n : ℕ}, n ≤ l.length → l.rotate' n = l.drop n ++ l.take n
  | [], n, h => by simp
  | l, 0, h => by simp
  | a :: l, n + 1, h => by
    have hnl : n ≤ l.length
proof:
:= le_of_succ_le_succ h
    have hnl' : n ≤ (l ++ [a]).length := by
      rw [length_append, length_cons, List.length]; exact le_of_succ_le h
    rw [rotate'_cons_succ, rotate'_eq_drop_append_take hnl', drop, take,
        drop_append_of_le_length hnl, take_append_of_le_length hnl]; simp

name: rotate'_rotate'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate'_rotate' : ∀ (l : List α) (n m : ℕ), (l.rotate' n).rotate' m = l.rotate' (n + m)
  | a :: l, 0, m => by simp
  | [], n, m => by simp
  | a :: l, n + 1, m => by
    rw [rotate'_cons_succ, rotate'_rotate' _ n, Nat.add_right_comm, ← rotate'_cons_succ,
      Nat.succ_eq_add_one]

@[simp]

name: rotate'_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate'_length (l : List α) : rotate' l l.length = l

name: rotate'_length_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate'_length_mul (l : List α) : ∀ n : ℕ, l.rotate' (l.length * n) = l
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 =>
    calc
      l.rotate' (l.length * (n + 1)) =
          (l.rotate' (l.length * n)).rotate' (l.rotate' (l.length * n)).length
proof:
:= by
        simp [-rotate'_length, Nat.mul_succ, rotate'_rotate']
      _ = l := by rw [rotate'_length, rotate'_length_mul l n]

name: rotate'_mod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate'_mod (l : List α) (n : ℕ) : l.rotate' (n % l.length) = l.rotate' n
proof:
:=
  calc l.rotate' (n % l.length)
    _ = (l.rotate' (n % l.length)).rotate'
        ((l.rotate' (n % l.length)).length * (n / l.length)) := by rw [rotate'_length_mul]
    _ = l.rotate' n := by rw [rotate'_rotate', length_rotate', Nat.mod_add_div]

name: rotate_eq_rotate'
statement: theorem rotate_eq_rotate' (l : List α) (n : ℕ) : l.rotate n = l.rotate' n
proof:
:=
  if h : l.length = 0 then by simp_all [length_eq_zero_iff]
  else by
    rw [← rotate'_mod,
        rotate'_eq_drop_append_take (le_of_lt (Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h)))]
    simp [rotate]

name: rotate_cons_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem rotate_cons_succ (l : List α) (a : α) (n : ℕ) :
    (a :: l : List α).rotate (n + 1) = (l ++ [a]).rotate n

name: mem_rotate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_rotate : ∀ {l : List α} {a : α} {n : ℕ}, a ∈ l.rotate n ↔ a ∈ l
  | [], _, n => by simp
  | a :: l, _, 0 => by simp
  | a :: l, _, n + 1 => by simp [rotate_cons_succ, mem_rotate, or_comm]

@[simp]

name: length_rotate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_rotate (l : List α) (n : ℕ) : (l.rotate n).length = l.length

name: rotate_replicate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate_replicate (a : α) (n : ℕ) (k : ℕ) : (replicate n a).rotate k = replicate n a
proof:
:=
  eq_replicate_iff.2 ⟨by rw [length_rotate, length_replicate], fun b hb =>
    eq_of_mem_replicate <| mem_rotate.1 hb⟩

name: rotate_eq_drop_append_take
statement:
theorem rotate_eq_drop_append_take {l : List α} {n : ℕ} :
    n ≤ l.length → l.rotate n = l.drop n ++ l.take n

name: rotate_eq_drop_append_take_mod
statement:
theorem rotate_eq_drop_append_take_mod {l : List α} {n : ℕ} :
    l.rotate n = l.drop (n % l.length) ++ l.take (n % l.length)
proof:
:= by
  rcases l.length.zero_le.eq_or_lt with hl | hl
  · simp [eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hl.symm]
  rw [← rotate_eq_drop_append_take (n.mod_lt hl).le, rotate_mod]

name: rotate_append_length_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate_append_length_eq (l l' : List α) : (l ++ l').rotate l.length = l' ++ l
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotate_eq_rotate']
  induction l generalizing l'
  · simp
  · simp_all [rotate']

name: rotate_rotate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate_rotate (l : List α) (n m : ℕ) : (l.rotate n).rotate m = l.rotate (n + m)

name: rotate_length
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate_length (l : List α) : rotate l l.length = l

name: rotate_length_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate_length_mul (l : List α) (n : ℕ) : l.rotate (l.length * n) = l

name: rotate_perm
statement: theorem rotate_perm (l : List α) (n : ℕ) : l.rotate n ~ l
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotate_eq_rotate']
  induction n generalizing l with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn =>
    rcases l with - | ⟨hd, tl⟩
    · simp
    · rw [rotate'_cons_succ]
      exact (hn _).trans (perm_append_singleton _ _)

name: nodup_rotate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nodup_rotate {l : List α} {n : ℕ} : Nodup (l.rotate n) ↔ Nodup l

name: rotate_eq_nil_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate_eq_nil_iff {l : List α} {n : ℕ} : l.rotate n = [] ↔ l = []
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing l with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn =>
    rcases l with - | ⟨hd, tl⟩
    · simp
    · simp [rotate_cons_succ, hn]

name: nil_eq_rotate_iff
statement: theorem nil_eq_rotate_iff {l : List α} {n : ℕ} : [] = l.rotate n ↔ [] = l

name: rotate_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate_singleton (x : α) (n : ℕ) : [x].rotate n = [x]

name: zipWith_rotate_distrib
statement:
theorem zipWith_rotate_distrib {β γ : Type*} (f : α → β → γ) (l : List α) (l' : List β) (n : ℕ)
    (h : l.length = l'.length) :
    (zipWith f l l').rotate n = zipWith f (l.rotate n) (l'.rotate n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotate_eq_drop_append_take_mod, rotate_eq_drop_append_take_mod,
    rotate_eq_drop_append_take_mod, h, zipWith_append, ← drop_zipWith, ←
    take_zipWith, List.length_zipWith, h, min_self]
  rw [length_drop, length_drop, h]

name: zipWith_rotate_one
statement:
theorem zipWith_rotate_one {β : Type*} (f : α → α → β) (x y : α) (l : List α) :
    zipWith f (x :: y :: l) ((x :: y :: l).rotate 1) = f x y :: zipWith f (y :: l) (l ++ [x])

name: getElem
statement:
theorem getElem?_rotate {l : List α} {n m : ℕ} (hml : m < l.length) :
    (l.rotate n)[m]? = l[(m + n) % l.length]?
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotate_eq_drop_append_take_mod]
  rcases lt_or_ge m (l.drop (n % l.length)).length with hm | hm
  · rw [getElem?_append_left hm, getElem?_drop, ← add_mod_mod]
    rw [length_drop, Nat.lt_sub_iff_add_lt] at hm
    rw [mod_eq_of_lt hm, Nat.add_comm]
  · have hlt : n % length l < length l := mod_lt _ (m.zero_le.trans_lt hml)
    rw [getElem?_append_right hm, getElem?_take_of_lt, length_drop]
    · congr 1
      rw [length_drop] at hm
      have hm' := Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add'.1 hm
      have : n % length l + m - length l < length l := by
        rw [Nat.sub_lt_iff_lt_add hm']
        exact Nat.add_lt_add hlt hml
      conv_rhs => rw [Nat.add_comm m, ← mod_add_mod, mod_eq_sub_mod hm', mod_eq_of_lt this]
      lia
    · rwa [Nat.sub_lt_iff_lt_add' hm, length_drop, Nat.sub_add_cancel hlt.le]

name: getElem_rotate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem getElem_rotate (l : List α) (n : ℕ) (k : Nat) (h : k < (l.rotate n).length) :
    (l.rotate n)[k] =
      l[(k + n) % l.length]'(mod_lt _ (length_rotate l n ▸ k.zero_le.trans_lt h))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Option.some_inj, ← getElem?_eq_getElem, ← getElem?_eq_getElem, getElem?_rotate]
  exact h.trans_eq (length_rotate _ _)

name: get_rotate
statement:
theorem get_rotate (l : List α) (n : ℕ) (k : Fin (l.rotate n).length) :
    (l.rotate n).get k = l.get ⟨(k + n) % l.length, mod_lt _ (length_rotate l n ▸ k.pos)⟩

name: head
statement:
@[simp]
theorem head?_rotate {l : List α} {n : ℕ} (h : n < l.length) : head? (l.rotate n) = l[n]?
proof:
:= by
  rw [head?_eq_getElem?, getElem?_rotate (n.zero_le.trans_lt h), Nat.zero_add, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h]

name: get_rotate_one
statement:
theorem get_rotate_one (l : List α) (k : Fin (l.rotate 1).length) :
    (l.rotate 1).get k = l.get ⟨(k + 1) % l.length, mod_lt _ (length_rotate l 1 ▸ k.pos)⟩

name: getElem_eq_getElem_rotate
statement:
theorem getElem_eq_getElem_rotate (l : List α) (n : ℕ) (k : Nat) (hk : k < l.length) :
    l[k] = ((l.rotate n)[(l.length - n % l.length + k) % l.length]'
      ((Nat.mod_lt _ (k.zero_le.trans_lt hk)).trans_eq (length_rotate _ _).symm))
proof:
:= by
  rw [getElem_rotate]
  refine congr_arg l.get (Fin.eq_of_val_eq ?_)
  simp only [mod_add_mod]
  rw [← add_mod_mod, Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.sub_add_cancel, add_mod_left, mod_eq_of_lt]
  exacts [hk, (mod_lt _ (k.zero_le.trans_lt hk)).le]

name: get_eq_get_rotate
statement:
theorem get_eq_get_rotate (l : List α) (n : ℕ) (k : Fin l.length) :
    l.get k = (l.rotate n).get ⟨(l.length - n % l.length + k) % l.length,
      (Nat.mod_lt _ (k.1.zero_le.trans_lt k.2)).trans_eq (length_rotate _ _).symm⟩

name: rotate_eq_self_iff_eq_replicate
statement:
theorem rotate_eq_self_iff_eq_replicate [hα : Nonempty α] :
    ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ n, l.rotate n = l) ↔ ∃ a, l = replicate l.length a
  | [] => by simp
  | a :: l => ⟨fun h => ⟨a, ext_getElem length_replicate.symm fun n h₁ h₂ => by
      rw [getElem_replicate, ← Option.some_inj, ← getElem?_eq_getElem, ← head?_rotate h₁, h,
        head?_cons]⟩,
    fun ⟨b, hb⟩ n => by rw [hb, rotate_replicate]⟩

name: rotate_one_eq_self_iff_eq_replicate
statement:
theorem rotate_one_eq_self_iff_eq_replicate [Nonempty α] {l : List α} :
    l.rotate 1 = l ↔ ∃ a : α, l = List.replicate l.length a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    rotate_eq_self_iff_eq_replicate.mp fun n =>
      Nat.rec l.rotate_zero (fun n hn => by rwa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, ← l.rotate_rotate, hn]) n,
    fun h => rotate_eq_self_iff_eq_replicate.mpr h 1⟩

name: rotate_injective
statement: theorem rotate_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective fun l : List α => l.rotate n
proof:
:= by
  rintro l l' (h : l.rotate n = l'.rotate n)
  have hle : l.length = l'.length := (l.length_rotate n).symm.trans (h.symm ▸ l'.length_rotate n)
  rw [rotate_eq_drop_append_take_mod, rotate_eq_drop_append_take_mod] at h
  obtain ⟨hd, ht⟩ := append_inj h (by simp_all)
  rw [← take_append_drop _ l, ht, hd, take_append_drop]

name: rotate_eq_rotate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate_eq_rotate {l l' : List α} {n : ℕ} : l.rotate n = l'.rotate n ↔ l = l'

name: rotate_eq_iff
statement:
theorem rotate_eq_iff {l l' : List α} {n : ℕ} :
    l.rotate n = l' ↔ l = l'.rotate (l'.length - n % l'.length)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← @rotate_eq_rotate _ l _ n, rotate_rotate, ← rotate_mod l', add_mod]
  rcases l'.length.zero_le.eq_or_lt with hl | hl
  · rw [eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hl.symm, rotate_nil]
  · rcases (Nat.zero_le (n % l'.length)).eq_or_lt with hn | hn
    · simp [← hn]
    · rw [mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.sub_lt hl hn), Nat.sub_add_cancel, mod_self, rotate_zero]
      exact (Nat.mod_lt _ hl).le

name: rotate_eq_singleton_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotate_eq_singleton_iff {l : List α} {n : ℕ} {x : α} : l.rotate n = [x] ↔ l = [x]

name: singleton_eq_rotate_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem singleton_eq_rotate_iff {l : List α} {n : ℕ} {x : α} : [x] = l.rotate n ↔ [x] = l

name: reverse_rotate
statement:
theorem reverse_rotate (l : List α) (n : ℕ) :
    (l.rotate n).reverse = l.reverse.rotate (l.length - n % l.length)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← length_reverse, ← rotate_eq_iff]
  induction n generalizing l with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn =>
    rcases l with - | ⟨hd, tl⟩
    · simp
    · rw [rotate_cons_succ, ← rotate_rotate, hn]
      simp

name: rotate_reverse
statement:
theorem rotate_reverse (l : List α) (n : ℕ) :
    l.reverse.rotate n = (l.rotate (l.length - n % l.length)).reverse
proof:
:= by
  rw [← reverse_reverse l]
  simp_rw [reverse_rotate, reverse_reverse, rotate_eq_iff, rotate_rotate, length_rotate,
    length_reverse]
  rw [← length_reverse]
  let k := n % l.reverse.length
  rcases hk' : k with - | k'
  · simp_all! [k, length_reverse, ← rotate_rotate]
  · rcases l with - | ⟨x, l⟩
    · simp
    · rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, Nat.sub_add_cancel, rotate_length]
      · exact Nat.sub_le _ _
      · exact Nat.sub_lt (by simp) (by simp_all! [k])

name: map_rotate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_rotate {β : Type*} (f : α → β) (l : List α) (n : ℕ) :
    map f (l.rotate n) = (map f l).rotate n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing l with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn =>
    rcases l with - | ⟨hd, tl⟩
    · simp
    · simp [hn]

name: Nodup.rotate_congr
statement:
theorem Nodup.rotate_congr {l : List α} (hl : l.Nodup) (hn : l ≠ []) (i j : ℕ)
    (h : l.rotate i = l.rotate j) : i % l.length = j % l.length
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rotate_mod l i, ← rotate_mod l j] at h
  simpa only [head?_rotate, mod_lt, length_pos_of_ne_nil hn, getElem?_eq_getElem, Option.some_inj,
    hl.getElem_inj_iff, Fin.ext_iff] using congr_arg head? h

name: Nodup.rotate_congr_iff
statement:
theorem Nodup.rotate_congr_iff {l : List α} (hl : l.Nodup) {i j : ℕ} :
    l.rotate i = l.rotate j ↔ i % l.length = j % l.length ∨ l = []
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne l [] with rfl | hn
  · simp
  · simp only [hn, or_false]
    refine ⟨hl.rotate_congr hn _ _, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [← rotate_mod, h, rotate_mod]

name: Nodup.rotate_eq_self_iff
statement:
theorem Nodup.rotate_eq_self_iff {l : List α} (hl : l.Nodup) {n : ℕ} :
    l.rotate n = l ↔ n % l.length = 0 ∨ l = []

name: IsRotated.refl

name: IsRotated.symm
statement:
@[symm]
theorem IsRotated.symm (h : l ~r l') : l' ~r l
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h
  rcases l with - | ⟨hd, tl⟩
  · exists 0
  · use (hd :: tl).length * n - n
    rw [rotate_rotate, Nat.add_sub_cancel', rotate_length_mul]
    exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by simp)

name: isRotated_iff_mod
statement: theorem isRotated_iff_mod : l ~r l' ↔ ∃ n ≤ l.length, l.rotate n = l'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun ⟨n, _, h⟩ => ⟨n, h⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h
  rcases l with - | ⟨hd, tl⟩
  · simp
  · refine ⟨n % (hd :: tl).length, ?_, rotate_mod _ _⟩
    refine (Nat.mod_lt _ ?_).le
    simp

name: isRotated_iff_mem_map_range

proof:

  simp_rw [mem_map, mem_range, isRotated_iff_mod]
  exact
    ⟨fun ⟨n, hn, h⟩ => ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hn, h⟩,
      fun ⟨n, hn, h⟩ => ⟨n, Nat.le_of_lt_succ hn, h⟩⟩

theorem IsRotated.map {β : Type*} {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h : l₁ ~r l₂) (f : α → β) :

proof:

  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h

  use n

name: IsRotated.cons_getLast_dropLast
statement:
theorem IsRotated.cons_getLast_dropLast
    (L : List α) (hL : L ≠ []) : L.getLast hL :: L.dropLast ~r L
proof:
:= by
  induction L using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => simp at hL
  | append_singleton a L _ =>
    simp only [getLast_append, dropLast_concat]
    apply IsRotated.symm
    apply isRotated_concat

name: IsRotated.dropLast_tail
statement:
theorem IsRotated.dropLast_tail {α}
    {L : List α} (hL : L ≠ []) (hL' : L.head hL = L.getLast hL) : L.dropLast ~r L.tail
proof:
:=
  match L with
  | [] => by simp
  | [_] => by simp
  | a :: b :: L => by
    simp only [head_cons, ne_eq, reduceCtorEq, not_false_eq_true, getLast_cons] at hL'
    simp [hL', IsRotated.cons_getLast_dropLast]

name: comp_isRotated_sublist
statement:
theorem comp_isRotated_sublist :
    Relation.Comp (IsRotated (α := α)) Sublist = Relation.Comp Sublist IsRotated
proof:
:= by
  ext
  refine ⟨fun ⟨L₁, hLr, hL⟩ => ?_, fun ⟨L₂, hL, hLr⟩ => ?_⟩ <;>
    obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := isRotated_iff_mod.mp hLr
  · obtain ⟨L₂L, L₂R, rfl, hL₂L, hL₂R⟩ := append_sublist_iff.mp (rotate_eq_drop_append_take hn ▸ hL)
    exact ⟨L₂R ++ L₂L, by simpa using hL₂R.append hL₂L, isRotated_append⟩
  · obtain ⟨lL, lR, rfl, hL, hR⟩ := sublist_append_iff.mp <| take_append_drop n L₂ ▸ hL
    refine ⟨lR ++ lL, isRotated_append.symm, ?_⟩
    simpa [rotate_eq_drop_append_take hn] using hR.append hL

name: cyclicPermutations_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cyclicPermutations_nil : cyclicPermutations ([] : List α) = [[]]

name: cyclicPermutations_cons
statement:
theorem cyclicPermutations_cons (x : α) (l : List α) :
    cyclicPermutations (x :: l) = dropLast (zipWith (· ++ ·) (tails (x :: l)) (inits (x :: l)))

name: cyclicPermutations_of_ne_nil
statement:
theorem cyclicPermutations_of_ne_nil (l : List α) (h : l ≠ []) :
    cyclicPermutations l = dropLast (zipWith (· ++ ·) (tails l) (inits l))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, tl, rfl⟩ := exists_cons_of_ne_nil h
  exact cyclicPermutations_cons _ _

name: cyclicPermutations_ne_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cyclicPermutations_ne_nil : ∀ l : List α, cyclicPermutations l ≠ []
  | a::l, h => by simpa using congr_arg length h

@[simp]

name: getElem_cyclicPermutations
statement:
@[simp]
theorem getElem_cyclicPermutations (l : List α) (n : Nat) (h : n < length (cyclicPermutations l)) :
    (cyclicPermutations l)[n] = l.rotate n
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l =>
    simp only [cyclicPermutations_cons, getElem_dropLast, getElem_zipWith, getElem_tails,
      getElem_inits]
    rw [rotate_eq_drop_append_take (by simpa using h.le)]

name: get_cyclicPermutations
statement:
theorem get_cyclicPermutations (l : List α) (n : Fin (length (cyclicPermutations l))) :
    (cyclicPermutations l).get n = l.rotate n

name: head_cyclicPermutations
statement:
@[simp]
theorem head_cyclicPermutations (l : List α) :
    (cyclicPermutations l).head (cyclicPermutations_ne_nil l) = l
proof:
:= by
  have h : 0 < length (cyclicPermutations l) := length_pos_of_ne_nil (cyclicPermutations_ne_nil _)
  rw [← get_mk_zero h, get_cyclicPermutations, Fin.val_mk, rotate_zero]

name: head
statement:
@[simp]
theorem head?_cyclicPermutations (l : List α) : (cyclicPermutations l).head? = l

statement: theorem cyclicPermutations_injective : Function.Injective (@cyclicPermutations α)

  simpa using congr_arg head? h

  simp

name: mem_cyclicPermutations_self
statement: theorem mem_cyclicPermutations_self (l : List α) : l ∈ cyclicPermutations l

name: cyclicPermutations_rotate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cyclicPermutations_rotate (l : List α) (k : ℕ) :
    (l.rotate k).cyclicPermutations = l.cyclicPermutations.rotate k
proof:
:= by
  have : (l.rotate k).cyclicPermutations.length = length (l.cyclicPermutations.rotate k) := by
    cases l
    · simp
    · rw [length_cyclicPermutations_of_ne_nil] <;> simp
  refine ext_get this fun n hn hn' => ?_
  rw [get_rotate, get_cyclicPermutations, rotate_rotate, ← rotate_mod, Nat.add_comm]
  cases l <;> simp

name: mem_cyclicPermutations_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_cyclicPermutations_iff : l ∈ cyclicPermutations l' ↔ l ~r l'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp_rw [mem_iff_get, get_cyclicPermutations]
    rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact .forall _ _
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [cyclicPermutations_rotate, mem_rotate]
    apply mem_cyclicPermutations_self

name: Nodup.cyclicPermutations
statement:
protected theorem Nodup.cyclicPermutations {l : List α} (hn : Nodup l) :
    Nodup (cyclicPermutations l)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne l [] with rfl | hl
  · simp
  · rw [nodup_iff_injective_get]
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ h
    simp only [length_cyclicPermutations_of_ne_nil l hl] at hi hj
    simpa [hn.rotate_congr_iff, mod_eq_of_lt, *] using h

theorem IsChain.count_not_cons :

  | _, [], _h => rfl
  | b, x :: l, h => by
    grind [h.of_cons.count_not_cons]

namespace IsChain

variable {l : List Bool}

name: count_not_eq_count
statement:
theorem count_not_eq_count (hl : IsChain (· ≠ ·) l) (h2 : Even (length l)) (b : Bool) :
    count (!b) l = count b l
proof:
:= by
  rcases l with - | ⟨x, l⟩
  · rfl
  grind [count_cons_of_ne x.not_ne_self.symm, hl.count_not_cons]

statement:
theorem count_not_le_count_add_one (hl : IsChain (· ≠ ·) l) (b : Bool) :
    count (!b) l ≤ count b l + 1
proof:
:= by
  cases l
  · exact zero_le
  grind [hl.count_not_cons]

statement:

name: two_mul_count_bool_of_even
statement:
theorem two_mul_count_bool_of_even (hl : IsChain (· ≠ ·) l) (h2 : Even (length l)) (b : Bool) :
    2 * count b l = length l
proof:
:= by
  rw [← count_not_add_count l b, hl.count_not_eq_count h2, two_mul]

name: two_mul_count_bool_eq_ite
statement:
theorem two_mul_count_bool_eq_ite (hl : IsChain (· ≠ ·) l) (b : Bool) :
    2 * count b l =
      if Even (length l) then length l else
      if Option.some b == l.head? then length l + 1 else length l - 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h2 : Even (length l)
  · rw [ite_eq_left h2, hl.two_mul_count_bool_of_even h2]
  · rcases l with - | ⟨x, l⟩
    · exact (h2 .zero).elim
    grind [hl.tail.two_mul_count_bool_of_even]

name: length_div_two_le_count_bool
statement:
theorem length_div_two_le_count_bool (hl : IsChain (· ≠ ·) l) (b : Bool) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.div_le_iff_le_mul_add_pred two_pos, ← tsub_le_iff_right]
  exact length_sub_one_le_two_mul_count_bool hl b
