name: ltb_cons_addChar'
statement:
theorem ltb_cons_addChar' (c : Char) (s₁ s₂ : Legacy.Iterator) :
    ltb ⟨ofList (c :: s₁.s.toList), s₁.i + c⟩ ⟨ofList (c :: s₂.s.toList), s₂.i + c⟩ =
      ltb s₁ s₂
proof:
:= by
  fun_induction ltb s₁ s₂ with
  | case1 s₁ s₂ h₁ h₂ h ih =>
    rw [ltb, Legacy.Iterator.hasNext_cons_addChar, Legacy.Iterator.hasNext_cons_addChar,
      ite_eq_left (by simpa using h₁), ite_eq_left (by simpa using h₂), ite_eq_left, ← ih]
    · simp only [Legacy.Iterator.next, Pos.Raw.next, get_cons_addChar, ofList_toList]
      congr 2 <;> apply Pos.Raw.add_char_right_comm
    · simpa only [Legacy.Iterator.curr, get_cons_addChar, ofList_toList] using h
  | case2 s₁ s₂ h₁ h₂ h =>
    rw [ltb, Legacy.Iterator.hasNext_cons_addChar, Legacy.Iterator.hasNext_cons_addChar,
      ite_eq_left (by simpa using h₁), ite_eq_left (by simpa using h₂), ite_eq_right]
    · simp only [Legacy.Iterator.curr, get_cons_addChar, ofList_toList]
    · simpa only [Legacy.Iterator.curr, get_cons_addChar, ofList_toList] using h
  | case3 s₁ s₂ h₁ h₂ =>
    rw [ltb, Legacy.Iterator.hasNext_cons_addChar, Legacy.Iterator.hasNext_cons_addChar,
      ite_eq_left (by simpa using h₁), ite_eq_right (by simpa using h₂)]
  | case4 s₁ s₂ h₁ =>
    rw [ltb, Legacy.Iterator.hasNext_cons_addChar, ite_eq_right (by simpa using h₁)]

name: lt_iff_ltb
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lt_iff_ltb {s₁ s₂ : String} :
    s₁ < s₂ ↔ ltb (String.Legacy.iter s₁) (String.Legacy.iter s₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Iff.comm]
  obtain ⟨s₁, rfl⟩ := s₁.exists_eq_ofList
  obtain ⟨s₂, rfl⟩ := s₂.exists_eq_ofList
  simp only [lt_iff_toList_lt, String.Legacy.iter, String.Legacy.mkIterator, String.toList_ofList]
  induction s₁ generalizing s₂ <;> cases s₂
  · unfold ltb; decide
  · rename_i c₂ cs₂; apply iff_of_true
    · unfold ltb
      simp [Legacy.Iterator.hasNext, Char.utf8Size_pos]
    · apply List.nil_lt_cons
  · rename_i c₁ cs₁ ih; apply iff_of_false
    · unfold ltb
      simp [Legacy.Iterator.hasNext]
    · apply not_lt_of_gt; apply List.nil_lt_cons
  · rename_i c₁ cs₁ ih c₂ cs₂; unfold ltb
    simp only [Legacy.Iterator.hasNext, Pos.Raw.byteIdx_zero, rawEndPos_ofList, utf8Len_cons,
      add_pos_iff, Char.utf8Size_pos, or_true, decide_true, ↓reduceIte, Legacy.Iterator.curr,
      Pos.Raw.get, String.toList_ofList, Pos.Raw.utf8GetAux, Legacy.Iterator.next, Pos.Raw.next,
      Bool.ite_eq_true_distrib, decide_eq_true_eq]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst c₂
      suffices ltb ⟨ofList (c₁ :: cs₁), (0 : Pos.Raw) + c₁⟩
          ⟨ofList (c₁ :: cs₂), (0 : Pos.Raw) + c₁⟩ =
            ltb ⟨ofList cs₁, 0⟩ ⟨ofList cs₂, 0⟩ by
        rw [this]; exact (ih cs₂).trans List.lex_cons_iff.symm
      apply ltb_cons_addChar
    · refine ⟨List.Lex.rel, fun e ↦ ?_⟩
      cases e <;> rename_i h'
      · assumption
      · contradiction

name: equitableOn_iff_exists_le_le_add_one
statement:
theorem equitableOn_iff_exists_le_le_add_one {s : Set α} {f : α → ℕ} :
    s.EquitableOn f ↔ ∃ b, ∀ a ∈ s, b ≤ f a ∧ f a ≤ b + 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun ⟨b, hb⟩ x y hx hy => by grw [(hb x hx).2, (hb y hy).1]⟩
  obtain rfl | ⟨x, hx⟩ := s.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · simp
  intro hs
  by_cases! h : ∀ y ∈ s, f x ≤ f y
  · exact ⟨f x, fun y hy => ⟨h _ hy, hs hy hx⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwx⟩ := h
  refine ⟨f w, fun y hy => ⟨Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ ?_, hs hy hw⟩⟩
  rw [(Nat.succ_le_of_lt hwx).antisymm (hs hx hw)]
  exact hs hx hy

name: equitableOn_iff_le_le_add_one
statement:
theorem equitableOn_iff_le_le_add_one :
    EquitableOn (s : Set α) f ↔
      ∀ a ∈ s, (∑ i ∈ s, f i) / s.card ≤ f a ∧ f a ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, f i) / s.card + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.equitableOn_iff_exists_le_le_add_one]
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => ⟨_, h⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
  by_cases! h : ∀ a ∈ s, f a = b + 1
  · intro a ha
    rw [h _ ha, sum_const_nat h, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (card_pos.2 ⟨a, ha⟩)]
    exact ⟨le_rfl, Nat.le_succ _⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ := h
  suffices h : b = (∑ i ∈ s, f i) / s.card by
    simp_rw [← h]
    apply hb
  symm
  refine
    Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le (le_trans (by simp [mul_comm]) (sum_le_sum fun a ha => (hb a ha).1))
      ((sum_lt_sum (fun a ha => (hb a ha).2) ⟨_, hx₁, (hb _ hx₁).2.lt_of_ne hx₂⟩).trans_le ?_)
  rw [mul_comm, sum_const_nat]
  exact fun _ _ => rfl

name: enumerate_eq_none_of_sel
statement:
theorem enumerate_eq_none_of_sel {s : Set α} (h : sel s = none) : ∀ {n}, enumerate sel s n = none
  | 0 => by simp [h, enumerate]
  | n + 1 => by simp [h, enumerate]

name: enumerate_eq_none
statement:
theorem enumerate_eq_none :
    ∀ {s n₁ n₂}, enumerate sel s n₁ = none → n₁ ≤ n₂ → enumerate sel s n₂ = none
  | _, 0, _ => fun h _ ↦ enumerate_eq_none_of_sel sel h
  | s, n + 1, m => fun h hm ↦ by
    cases hs : sel s
    · exact enumerate_eq_none_of_sel sel hs
    · cases m with
      | zero => contradiction
      | succ m' =>
        simp only [enumerate, hs] at h ⊢
        have hm : n ≤ m'
proof:
:= Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ hm
        exact enumerate_eq_none h hm

name: enumerate_mem
statement:
theorem enumerate_mem (h_sel : ∀ s a, sel s = some a → a ∈ s) :
    ∀ {s n a}, enumerate sel s n = some a → a ∈ s
  | s, 0, a => h_sel s a
  | s, n + 1, a => by
    cases h : sel s with
    | none => simp [enumerate_eq_none_of_sel, h]
    | some a' =>
      simp only [enumerate, h]
      exact fun h' : enumerate sel (s \ {a'}) n = some a ↦
        have : a ∈ s \ {a'}

name: enumerate_inj
statement:
theorem enumerate_inj {n₁ n₂ : ℕ} {a : α} {s : Set α} (h_sel : ∀ s a, sel s = some a → a ∈ s)
    (h₁ : enumerate sel s n₁ = some a) (h₂ : enumerate sel s n₂ = some a) : n₁ = n₂
proof:
:= by
  wlog! hn : n₁ ≤ n₂ generalizing n₁ n₂
  · exact (this h₂ h₁ hn.le).symm
  rcases Nat.le.dest hn with ⟨m, rfl⟩
  clear hn
  induction n₁ generalizing s with
  | zero =>
    cases m with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ m =>
      have h' : enumerate sel (s \ {a}) m = some a := by
        simp_all only [enumerate, Nat.add_eq, zero_add]; exact h₂
      have : a ∈ s \ {a} := enumerate_mem sel h_sel h'
      simp_all
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [show k + 1 + m = (k + m) + 1 by lia] at h₂
    cases h : sel s <;> simp_all [enumerate]; tauto

name: encard_ne_add_one
statement:
theorem encard_ne_add_one (a : α) :
    ({x | x ≠ a}).encard + 1 = ENat.card α
proof:
:= by
  have : Disjoint {x | x ≠ a} {a} := disjoint_singleton_right.mpr <| by simp
  replace this := (Set.encard_union_eq this).symm
  have aux : {x | x ≠ a} ∪ {a} = univ := by ext x; simp [eq_or_ne x a]
  rwa [encard_singleton, aux, encard_univ] at this

name: Finite.encard_eq_coe
statement: theorem Finite.encard_eq_coe (h : s.Finite) : s.encard = ENat.toNat s.encard

name: Finite.exists_encard_eq_coe
statement: theorem Finite.exists_encard_eq_coe (h : s.Finite) : ∃ (n : ℕ), s.encard = n

name: encard_lt_top_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem encard_lt_top_iff : s.encard < ⊤ ↔ s.Finite
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ by_contra fun h' ↦ h.ne (Infinite.encard_eq h'), Finite.encard_lt_top⟩

name: encard_eq_top_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem encard_eq_top_iff : s.encard = ⊤ ↔ s.Infinite

name: encard_ne_top_iff
statement: theorem encard_ne_top_iff : s.encard ≠ ⊤ ↔ s.Finite

name: finite_of_encard_le_coe
statement: theorem finite_of_encard_le_coe {k : ℕ} (h : s.encard ≤ k) : s.Finite

name: finite_of_encard_eq_coe
statement: theorem finite_of_encard_eq_coe {k : ℕ} (h : s.encard = k) : s.Finite

name: encard_le_coe_iff
statement: theorem encard_le_coe_iff {k : ℕ} : s.encard ≤ k ↔ s.Finite ∧ ∃ (n₀ : ℕ), s.encard = n₀ ∧ n₀ ≤ k
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨finite_of_encard_le_coe h, by rwa [ENat.le_natCast_iff] at h⟩,
    fun ⟨_,⟨n₀,hs, hle⟩⟩ ↦ by rwa [hs, Nat.cast_le]⟩

name: encard_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem encard_prod {s : Set α} {t : Set β} : (s ×ˢ t).encard = s.encard * t.encard

name: encard_pi_eq_prod_encard
statement:
@[simp]
theorem encard_pi_eq_prod_encard [h : Fintype α] {ι : α → Type*} {s : ∀ i : α, Set (ι i)} :
    (Set.pi Set.univ s).encard = ∏ i, (s i).encard
proof:
:= by
  unfold encard ENat.card
  simp [Cardinal.mk_congr (Equiv.Set.univPi s), Cardinal.prod_eq_of_fintype]

name: encard_le_encard
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem encard_le_encard (h : s ⊆ t) : s.encard ≤ t.encard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← union_sdiff_cancel h, encard_union_eq disjoint_sdiff_right]; exact le_self_add

name: encard_le_card
statement: theorem encard_le_card : s.encard ≤ ENat.card α

name: encard_mono
statement: theorem encard_mono {α : Type*} : Monotone (encard : Set α → ℕ∞)

name: encard_sdiff_add_encard_of_subset
statement: theorem encard_sdiff_add_encard_of_subset (h : s ⊆ t) : (t \ s).encard + s.encard = t.encard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← encard_union_eq disjoint_sdiff_left, sdiff_union_of_subset h]

name: encard_sdiff
statement:
theorem encard_sdiff (h : s ⊆ t) (hs : s.Finite) :
    (t \ s).encard = t.encard - s.encard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← @Set.encard_sdiff_add_encard_of_subset _ s t h]
  exact (ENat.addLECancellable_of_ne_top <| encard_ne_top_iff.mpr hs).eq_tsub_of_add_eq rfl

name: one_le_encard_iff_nonempty
statement: @[simp] theorem one_le_encard_iff_nonempty : 1 ≤ s.encard ↔ s.Nonempty

name: encard_lt_one
statement: lemma encard_lt_one : s.encard < 1 ↔ s = ∅

name: encard_sdiff_add_encard_inter
statement:
theorem encard_sdiff_add_encard_inter (s t : Set α) :
    (s \ t).encard + (s ∩ t).encard = s.encard

name: encard_union_add_encard_inter
statement:
theorem encard_union_add_encard_inter (s t : Set α) :
    (s ∪ t).encard + (s ∩ t).encard = s.encard + t.encard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sdiff_union_self, encard_union_eq disjoint_sdiff_left, add_right_comm,
    encard_sdiff_add_encard_inter]

name: encard_eq_encard_iff_encard_sdiff_eq_encard_sdiff
statement:
theorem encard_eq_encard_iff_encard_sdiff_eq_encard_sdiff (h : (s ∩ t).Finite) :
    s.encard = t.encard ↔ (s \ t).encard = (t \ s).encard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← encard_sdiff_add_encard_inter s t, ← encard_sdiff_add_encard_inter t s, inter_comm t s,
    (ENat.addLECancellable_of_lt_top h.encard_lt_top).inj_left]

name: encard_le_encard_iff_encard_sdiff_le_encard_sdiff
statement:
theorem encard_le_encard_iff_encard_sdiff_le_encard_sdiff (h : (s ∩ t).Finite) :
    s.encard ≤ t.encard ↔ (s \ t).encard ≤ (t \ s).encard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← encard_sdiff_add_encard_inter s t, ← encard_sdiff_add_encard_inter t s, inter_comm t s,
    ENat.add_le_add_iff_right h.encard_lt_top.ne]

name: encard_lt_encard_iff_encard_sdiff_lt_encard_sdiff
statement:
theorem encard_lt_encard_iff_encard_sdiff_lt_encard_sdiff (h : (s ∩ t).Finite) :
    s.encard < t.encard ↔ (s \ t).encard < (t \ s).encard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← encard_sdiff_add_encard_inter s t, ← encard_sdiff_add_encard_inter t s, inter_comm t s,
    ENat.add_lt_add_iff_right h.encard_lt_top.ne]

name: encard_union_le
statement: theorem encard_union_le (s t : Set α) : (s ∪ t).encard ≤ s.encard + t.encard

name: finite_iff_finite_of_encard_eq_encard
statement: theorem finite_iff_finite_of_encard_eq_encard (h : s.encard = t.encard) : s.Finite ↔ t.Finite

name: infinite_iff_infinite_of_encard_eq_encard
statement:
theorem infinite_iff_infinite_of_encard_eq_encard (h : s.encard = t.encard) :
    s.Infinite ↔ t.Infinite

name: Finite.finite_of_encard_le
statement:
theorem Finite.finite_of_encard_le {s : Set α} {t : Set β} (hs : s.Finite)
    (h : t.encard ≤ s.encard) : t.Finite

name: Finite.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le'
statement:
lemma Finite.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le' (ht : t.Finite) (hst : s ⊆ t) (hts : t.encard ≤ s.encard) :
    s = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zero_add (a := encard s), ← encard_sdiff_add_encard_of_subset hst] at hts
  have hdiff :=
    (ENat.addLECancellable_of_lt_top (ht.subset hst).encard_lt_top).add_le_add_iff_right.mp hts
  rw [nonpos_iff_eq_zero, encard_eq_zero, sdiff_eq_empty] at hdiff
  exact hst.antisymm hdiff

name: Finite.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le
statement:
theorem Finite.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le (hs : s.Finite) (hst : s ⊆ t)
    (hts : t.encard ≤ s.encard) : s = t

name: Finite.encard_lt_encard
statement: theorem Finite.encard_lt_encard (hs : s.Finite) (h : s ⊂ t) : s.encard < t.encard
proof:
:=
  (encard_mono h.subset).lt_of_ne fun he ↦ h.ne (hs.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le h.subset he.symm.le)

name: encard_strictMono
statement: theorem encard_strictMono [Finite α] : StrictMono (encard : Set α → ℕ∞)

name: Finite.encard_strictMonoOn
statement: theorem Finite.encard_strictMonoOn : StrictMonoOn (α := Set α) encard (Set.ofPred Set.Finite)

name: Finite.encard_lt_card
statement: theorem Finite.encard_lt_card (hfin : s.Finite) (hne : s ≠ univ) : s.encard < ENat.card α

name: encard_sdiff_add_encard
statement: theorem encard_sdiff_add_encard (s t : Set α) : (s \ t).encard + t.encard = (s ∪ t).encard

name: encard_le_encard_sdiff_add_encard
statement: theorem encard_le_encard_sdiff_add_encard (s t : Set α) : s.encard ≤ (s \ t).encard + t.encard

name: tsub_encard_le_encard_sdiff
statement: theorem tsub_encard_le_encard_sdiff (s t : Set α) : s.encard - t.encard ≤ (s \ t).encard

name: encard_add_encard_compl
statement: theorem encard_add_encard_compl (s : Set α) : s.encard + sᶜ.encard = (univ : Set α).encard

name: encard_insert_le
statement: theorem encard_insert_le (s : Set α) (x : α) : (insert x s).encard ≤ s.encard + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← union_singleton, ← encard_singleton x]; apply encard_union_le

name: one_le_encard_insert
statement: theorem one_le_encard_insert (s : Set α) : 1 ≤ (insert a s).encard

name: encard_singleton_inter
statement: theorem encard_singleton_inter (s : Set α) (x : α) : ({x} ∩ s).encard ≤ 1

name: encard_sdiff_singleton_add_one
statement:
theorem encard_sdiff_singleton_add_one (h : a ∈ s) :
    (s \ {a}).encard + 1 = s.encard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← encard_insert_of_notMem (fun h ↦ h.2 rfl), insert_sdiff_singleton, insert_eq_of_mem h]

name: encard_sdiff_singleton_of_mem
statement:
theorem encard_sdiff_singleton_of_mem (h : a ∈ s) :
    (s \ {a}).encard = s.encard - 1

name: encard_tsub_one_le_encard_sdiff_singleton
statement:
theorem encard_tsub_one_le_encard_sdiff_singleton (s : Set α) (x : α) :
    s.encard - 1 ≤ (s \ {x}).encard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← encard_singleton x]; apply tsub_encard_le_encard_sdiff

name: encard_exchange
statement: theorem encard_exchange (ha : a ∉ s) (hb : b ∈ s) : (insert a (s \ {b})).encard = s.encard
proof:
:= by
  rw [encard_insert_of_notMem, encard_sdiff_singleton_add_one hb]
  simp_all only [mem_sdiff, mem_singleton_iff, false_and, not_false_eq_true]

name: encard_exchange'
statement: theorem encard_exchange' (ha : a ∉ s) (hb : b ∈ s) : (insert a s \ {b}).encard = s.encard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← insert_sdiff_singleton_comm (by rintro rfl; exact ha hb), encard_exchange ha hb]

name: encard_eq_add_one_iff
statement:
theorem encard_eq_add_one_iff {k : ℕ∞} :
    s.encard = k + 1 ↔ (∃ a t, a ∉ t ∧ insert a t = s ∧ t.encard = k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := nonempty_of_encard_ne_zero (s := s) (by simp [h])
    refine ⟨a, s \ {a}, fun h ↦ h.2 rfl, by rwa [insert_sdiff_singleton, insert_eq_of_mem], ?_⟩
    rw [encard_sdiff_singleton_of_mem ha, h,
      (ENat.addLECancellable_of_ne_top ENat.one_ne_top).add_tsub_cancel_right]
  rintro ⟨a, t, h, rfl, rfl⟩
  rw [encard_insert_of_notMem h]

name: eq_empty_or_encard_eq_top_or_encard_sdiff_singleton_lt
statement:
theorem eq_empty_or_encard_eq_top_or_encard_sdiff_singleton_lt (s : Set α) :
    s = ∅ ∨ s.encard = ⊤ ∨ ∃ a ∈ s, (s \ {a}).encard < s.encard
proof:
:= by
  refine s.eq_empty_or_nonempty.elim Or.inl (Or.inr ∘ fun ⟨a,ha⟩ ↦
    (s.finite_or_infinite.elim (fun hfin ↦ Or.inr ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩) (Or.inl ∘ Infinite.encard_eq)))
  rw [← encard_sdiff_singleton_add_one ha]; nth_rw 1 [← add_zero (encard _)]
  exact ENat.add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt hfin.sdiff.encard_lt_top.ne le_rfl zero_lt_one

name: encard_pair
statement: theorem encard_pair {x y : α} (hne : x ≠ y) : ({x, y} : Set α).encard = 2

name: encard_eq_one
statement: theorem encard_eq_one : s.encard = 1 ↔ ∃ x, s = {x}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ by rw [hx, encard_singleton]⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := nonempty_of_encard_ne_zero (s := s) (by rw [h]; simp)
  exact ⟨x, ((finite_singleton x).eq_of_subset_of_encard_le (by simpa) (by simp [h])).symm⟩

name: encard_le_one_iff_eq
statement: theorem encard_le_one_iff_eq : s.encard ≤ 1 ↔ s = ∅ ∨ ∃ x, s = {x}
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_iff_lt_or_eq, lt_iff_not_ge, Order.one_le_iff_ne_zero, not_not, encard_eq_zero,
    encard_eq_one]

name: encard_le_one_iff
statement: theorem encard_le_one_iff : s.encard ≤ 1 ↔ ∀ a b, a ∈ s → b ∈ s → a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [encard_le_one_iff_eq, or_iff_not_imp_left, ← Ne, ← nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
  refine ⟨fun h a b has hbs ↦ ?_,
    fun h ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨x, ((singleton_subset_iff.2 hx).antisymm' (fun y hy ↦ h _ _ hy hx))⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := h ⟨_, has⟩
  rw [(has : a = x), (hbs : b = x)]

name: encard_le_one_iff_subsingleton
statement: theorem encard_le_one_iff_subsingleton : s.encard ≤ 1 ↔ s.Subsingleton

name: one_lt_encard_iff_nontrivial
statement: theorem one_lt_encard_iff_nontrivial : 1 < s.encard ↔ s.Nontrivial

name: one_lt_encard_iff
statement: theorem one_lt_encard_iff : 1 < s.encard ↔ ∃ a b, a ∈ s ∧ b ∈ s ∧ a ≠ b

name: exists_ne_of_one_lt_encard
statement: theorem exists_ne_of_one_lt_encard (h : 1 < s.encard) (a : α) : ∃ b ∈ s, b ≠ a
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h'
  obtain ⟨b, b', hb, hb', hne⟩ := one_lt_encard_iff.1 h
  apply hne
  rw [h' b hb, h' b' hb']

name: encard_eq_two
statement: theorem encard_eq_two : s.encard = 2 ↔ ∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ s = {x, y}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨x, y, hne, hs⟩ ↦ by rw [hs, encard_pair hne]⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := nonempty_of_encard_ne_zero (s := s) (by rw [h]; simp)
  rw [← insert_eq_of_mem hx, ← insert_sdiff_singleton, encard_insert_of_notMem (fun h ↦ h.2 rfl),
    ← one_add_one_eq_two, (ENat.addLECancellable_of_ne_top ENat.one_ne_top).inj_left,
    encard_eq_one] at h
  obtain ⟨y, h⟩ := h
  refine ⟨x, y, by rintro rfl; exact (h.symm.subset rfl).2 rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [← h, insert_sdiff_singleton, insert_eq_of_mem hx]

name: encard_eq_three
statement:
theorem encard_eq_three {α : Type u_1} {s : Set α} :
    encard s = 3 ↔ ∃ x y z, x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ z ∧ y ≠ z ∧ s = {x, y, z}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨x, y, z, hxy, hyz, hxz, hs⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := nonempty_of_encard_ne_zero (s := s) (by rw [h]; simp)
    rw [← insert_eq_of_mem hx, ← insert_sdiff_singleton,
      encard_insert_of_notMem (fun h ↦ h.2 rfl), (by exact rfl : (3 : ℕ∞) = 2 + 1),
      (ENat.addLECancellable_of_ne_top ENat.one_ne_top).inj_left, encard_eq_two] at h
    obtain ⟨y, z, hne, hs⟩ := h
    refine ⟨x, y, z, ?_, ?_, hne, ?_⟩
    · rintro rfl; exact (hs.symm.subset (Or.inl rfl)).2 rfl
    · rintro rfl; exact (hs.symm.subset (Or.inr rfl)).2 rfl
    rw [← hs, insert_sdiff_singleton, insert_eq_of_mem hx]
  rw [hs, encard_insert_of_notMem, encard_insert_of_notMem, encard_singleton] <;> aesop

name: encard_eq_four
statement:
theorem encard_eq_four {α : Type u_1} {s : Set α} :
    encard s = 4 ↔ ∃ x y z w, x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ z ∧ x ≠ w ∧ y ≠ z ∧ y ≠ w ∧ z ≠ w ∧ s = {x, y, z, w}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨x, y, z, w, hxy, hxz, hxw, hyz, hyw, hzw, hs⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := nonempty_of_encard_ne_zero (s := s) (by rw [h]; simp)
    rw [← insert_eq_of_mem hx, ← insert_sdiff_singleton,
      encard_insert_of_notMem (fun h ↦ h.2 rfl), (by exact rfl : (4 : ℕ∞) = 3 + 1),
      (ENat.addLECancellable_of_ne_top ENat.one_ne_top).inj_left, encard_eq_three] at h
    obtain ⟨y, z, w, hyz, hyw, hzw, hs⟩ := h
    refine ⟨x, y, z, w, ?_, ?_, ?_, hyz, hyw, hzw, ?_⟩
    · rintro rfl; exact (hs.symm.subset (Or.inl rfl)).2 rfl
    · rintro rfl; exact (hs.symm.subset (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))).2 rfl
    · rintro rfl; exact (hs.symm.subset (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))).2 rfl
    rw [← hs, insert_sdiff_singleton, insert_eq_of_mem hx]
  rw [hs, encard_insert_of_notMem, encard_insert_of_notMem, encard_insert_of_notMem,
    encard_singleton] <;> grind

name: Nat.encard_range
statement: theorem Nat.encard_range (k : ℕ) : {i | i < k}.encard = k
proof:
:= by
  convert! encard_coe_eq_coe_finsetCard (Finset.range k) using 1
  · rw [Finset.coe_range, Iio_def]
  rw [Finset.card_range]

name: Finite.eq_insert_of_subset_of_encard_eq_succ
statement:
theorem Finite.eq_insert_of_subset_of_encard_eq_succ (hs : s.Finite) (h : s ⊆ t)
    (hst : t.encard = s.encard + 1) : ∃ a, t = insert a s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← encard_sdiff_add_encard_of_subset h, add_comm _ 1,
    (ENat.addLECancellable_of_lt_top hs.encard_lt_top).inj_left, encard_eq_one] at hst
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hst; use x; rw [← sdiff_union_of_subset h, hx, singleton_union]

name: exists_subset_encard_eq
statement: theorem exists_subset_encard_eq {k : ℕ∞} (hk : k ≤ s.encard) : ∃ t, t ⊆ s ∧ t.encard = k
proof:
:= by
  induction k using ENat.nat_induction with
  | zero => exact ⟨∅, empty_subset _, by simp⟩
  | succ n IH =>
    obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀s, ht₀⟩ := IH (le_trans (by simp) hk)
    simp only [Nat.cast_succ] at *
    have hne : t₀ ≠ s := by
      rintro rfl; rw [ht₀, ← Nat.cast_one, ← Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_le] at hk; simp at hk
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_of_ssubset (ht₀s.ssubset_of_ne hne)
    exact ⟨insert x t₀, insert_subset hx.1 ht₀s, by rw [encard_insert_of_notMem hx.2, ht₀]⟩
  | top => rw [top_le_iff] at hk; exact ⟨s, Subset.rfl, hk⟩

name: exists_superset_subset_encard_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain (hs | hs) := eq_or_ne s.encard ⊤
  · rw [hs, top_le_iff] at hsk; subst hsk; exact ⟨s, Subset.rfl, hst, hs⟩
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := exists_add_of_le hsk
  obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := exists_add_of_le hkt
  have hk : k ≤ encard (t \ s) := by
    rw [← encard_sdiff_add_encard_of_subset hst, add_comm] at hkt
    exact WithTop.le_of_add_le_add_right hs hkt
  obtain ⟨r', hr', rfl⟩ := exists_subset_encard_eq hk
  refine ⟨s ∪ r', subset_union_left, union_subset hst (hr'.trans sdiff_subset), ?_⟩
  rw [encard_union_eq (disjoint_of_subset_right hr' disjoint_sdiff_right)]

name: InjOn.encard_image
statement: theorem InjOn.encard_image (h : InjOn f s) : (f '' s).encard = s.encard

name: encard_congr
statement: theorem encard_congr (e : s ≃ t) : s.encard = t.encard

name: _root_.Function.Injective.encard_image
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.Injective.encard_image (hf : f.Injective) (s : Set α) :
    (f '' s).encard = s.encard

name: _root_.Function.Injective.encard_range
statement:
theorem _root_.Function.Injective.encard_range (hf : f.Injective) :
    (range f).encard = ENat.card α

name: _root_.Function.Embedding.encard_le
statement: theorem _root_.Function.Embedding.encard_le (e : s ↪ t) : s.encard ≤ t.encard

name: encard_image_le
statement: theorem encard_image_le (f : α → β) (s : Set α) : (f '' s).encard ≤ s.encard
proof:
:= by
  obtain (h | h) := isEmpty_or_nonempty α
  · rw [s.eq_empty_of_isEmpty]; simp
  grw [← (f.invFunOn_injOn_image s).encard_image, f.invFunOn_image_image_subset s]

name: Finite.injOn_of_encard_image_eq
statement:
theorem Finite.injOn_of_encard_image_eq (hs : s.Finite) (h : (f '' s).encard = s.encard) :
    InjOn f s
proof:
:= by
  obtain (h' | hne) := isEmpty_or_nonempty α
  · simp
  rw [← (f.invFunOn_injOn_image s).encard_image] at h
  rw [injOn_iff_invFunOn_image_image_eq_self]
  exact hs.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le' (f.invFunOn_image_image_subset s) h.symm.le

name: encard_preimage_of_injective_subset_range
statement:
theorem encard_preimage_of_injective_subset_range (hf : f.Injective) (ht : t ⊆ range f) :
    (f ⁻¹' t).encard = t.encard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hf.encard_image, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, inter_eq_self_of_subset_left ht]

name: encard_preimage_of_bijective
statement: lemma encard_preimage_of_bijective (hf : f.Bijective) (t : Set β) : (f ⁻¹' t).encard = t.encard

name: encard_le_encard_of_injOn
statement:
theorem encard_le_encard_of_injOn (hf : MapsTo f s t) (f_inj : InjOn f s) :
    s.encard ≤ t.encard

name: encard_preimage_val_le_encard_left
statement: lemma encard_preimage_val_le_encard_left (P Q : Set α) : (P ↓∩ Q).encard ≤ P.encard

name: encard_preimage_val_le_encard_right
statement: lemma encard_preimage_val_le_encard_right (P Q : Set α) : (P ↓∩ Q).encard ≤ Q.encard
proof:
:=
  Function.Embedding.encard_le ⟨fun ⟨⟨x, _⟩, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨x, hx⟩, fun _ _ h ↦ by
    simpa [Subtype.coe_inj] using h⟩

name: Finite.exists_injOn_of_encard_le
statement:
theorem Finite.exists_injOn_of_encard_le [Nonempty β] {s : Set α} {t : Set β} (hs : s.Finite)
    (hle : s.encard ≤ t.encard) : ∃ (f : α → β), s ⊆ f ⁻¹' t ∧ InjOn f s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain (rfl | h | ⟨a, has, -⟩) := s.eq_empty_or_encard_eq_top_or_encard_sdiff_singleton_lt
  · simp
  · exact (encard_ne_top_iff.mpr hs h).elim
  obtain ⟨b, hbt⟩ := encard_pos.1 ((encard_pos.2 ⟨_, has⟩).trans_le hle)
  have hle' : (s \ {a}).encard ≤ (t \ {b}).encard := by
    rwa [← ENat.add_le_add_iff_right ENat.one_ne_top,
    encard_sdiff_singleton_add_one has, encard_sdiff_singleton_add_one hbt]
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀s, hinj⟩ := exists_injOn_of_encard_le hs.sdiff hle'
  simp only [preimage_sdiff, subset_def, mem_sdiff, mem_singleton_iff, mem_preimage, and_imp]
    at hf₀s
  use Function.update f₀ a b
  rw [← insert_eq_of_mem has, ← insert_sdiff_singleton, injOn_insert (fun h ↦ h.2 rfl)]
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_singleton_iff, insert_sdiff_singleton, subset_def,
    mem_insert_iff, mem_preimage, Function.update_apply, forall_eq_or_imp, ite_true, and_imp,
    mem_image, ite_eq_left_iff, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, exists_prop, and_iff_right hbt]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun x hxs hxa ↦ ⟨hxa, (hf₀s x hxs hxa).2⟩⟩
  · rintro x hx; split_ifs with h
    · assumption
    · exact (hf₀s x hx h).1
  exact InjOn.congr hinj (fun x ⟨_, hxa⟩ ↦ by rwa [Function.update_of_ne])

name: Finite.exists_bijOn_of_encard_eq
statement:
theorem Finite.exists_bijOn_of_encard_eq [Nonempty β] (hs : s.Finite) (h : s.encard = t.encard) :
    ∃ (f : α → β), BijOn f s t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hinj⟩ := hs.exists_injOn_of_encard_le h.le; use f
  convert! hinj.bijOn_image
  rw [(hs.image f).eq_of_subset_of_encard_le (image_subset_iff.mpr hf)
    (h.symm.trans hinj.encard_image.symm).le]

name: exists_ne_map_eq_of_encard_lt_of_maps_to
statement:
lemma exists_ne_map_eq_of_encard_lt_of_maps_to (hc : t.encard < s.encard) (hf : MapsTo f s t) :
    ∃ᵉ (a₁ ∈ s) (a₂ ∈ s), a₁ ≠ a₂ ∧ f a₁ = f a₂
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hc
  suffices Function.Injective (hf.restrict f) by
    let f' : s ↪ t := ⟨hf.restrict, this⟩
    exact f'.encard_le
  simpa only [hf.restrict_inj, not_imp_not] using! hc

name: ncard_def
statement: theorem ncard_def (s : Set α) : s.ncard = ENat.toNat s.encard

name: Finite.cast_ncard_eq
statement: theorem Finite.cast_ncard_eq (hs : s.Finite) : s.ncard = s.encard
proof:
:= by
  rwa [ncard, ENat.natCast_toNat_eq_self, ne_eq, encard_eq_top_iff, Set.Infinite, not_not]

name: coe_ncard_eq_encard
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_ncard_eq_encard [Finite s] : s.ncard = s.encard

name: ncard_le_encard
statement: lemma ncard_le_encard (s : Set α) : s.ncard ≤ s.encard

name: _root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem _root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq (s : Set α) : Nat.card s = s.ncard

name: ncard_eq_toFinset_card
statement:
theorem ncard_eq_toFinset_card (s : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    s.ncard = hs.toFinset.card

name: ncard_eq_toFinset_card'
statement:
theorem ncard_eq_toFinset_card' (s : Set α) [Fintype s] :
    s.ncard = s.toFinset.card

name: fintypeCard_eq_ncard
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fintypeCard_eq_ncard [Fintype s] : Fintype.card s = s.ncard

name: cast_ncard
statement:
lemma cast_ncard {s : Set α} (hs : s.Finite) :
    (s.ncard : Cardinal) = Cardinal.mk s

name: encard_le_coe_iff_finite_ncard_le
statement: theorem encard_le_coe_iff_finite_ncard_le {k : ℕ} : s.encard ≤ k ↔ s.Finite ∧ s.ncard ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [encard_le_coe_iff, and_congr_right_iff]
  exact fun hfin ↦ ⟨fun ⟨n₀, hn₀, hle⟩ ↦ by rwa [ncard_def, hn₀, ENat.toNat_natCast],
    fun h ↦ ⟨s.ncard, by rw [hfin.cast_ncard_eq], h⟩⟩

name: Infinite.ncard
statement: theorem Infinite.ncard (hs : s.Infinite) : s.ncard = 0

name: ncard_le_ncard
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem ncard_le_ncard (hst : s ⊆ t) (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    s.ncard ≤ t.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cast_le (α := ℕ∞), ht.cast_ncard_eq, (ht.subset hst).cast_ncard_eq]
  exact encard_mono hst

name: ncard_mono
statement: theorem ncard_mono [Finite α] : @Monotone (Set α) _ _ _ ncard

name: ncard_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem ncard_eq_zero (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    s.ncard = 0 ↔ s = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cast_inj (R := ℕ∞), hs.cast_ncard_eq, Nat.cast_zero, encard_eq_zero]

name: ncard_coe_finset
statement: @[simp, norm_cast] theorem ncard_coe_finset (s : Finset α) : (s : Set α).ncard = s.card

name: ncard_univ
statement: @[simp] theorem ncard_univ (α : Type*) : (univ : Set α).ncard = Nat.card α

name: ncard_le_card
statement: theorem ncard_le_card [Finite α] (s : Set α) : s.ncard ≤ Nat.card α

name: ncard_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem ncard_empty (α : Type*) : (∅ : Set α).ncard = 0

name: ncard_pos
statement: theorem ncard_pos (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : 0 < s.ncard ↔ s.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [pos_iff_ne_zero, Ne, ncard_eq_zero hs, nonempty_iff_ne_empty]

name: ncard_ne_zero_of_mem
statement: theorem ncard_ne_zero_of_mem {a : α} (h : a ∈ s) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : s.ncard ≠ 0

name: finite_of_ncard_ne_zero
statement: theorem finite_of_ncard_ne_zero (hs : s.ncard ≠ 0) : s.Finite

name: finite_of_ncard_pos
statement: theorem finite_of_ncard_pos (hs : 0 < s.ncard) : s.Finite

name: nonempty_of_ncard_ne_zero
statement: theorem nonempty_of_ncard_ne_zero (hs : s.ncard ≠ 0) : s.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonempty_iff_ne_empty]; rintro rfl; simp at hs

name: ncard_singleton
statement: @[simp] theorem ncard_singleton (a : α) : ({a} : Set α).ncard = 1

name: ncard_singleton_inter
statement: theorem ncard_singleton_inter (a : α) (s : Set α) : ({a} ∩ s).ncard ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cast_le (α := ℕ∞), (toFinite _).cast_ncard_eq, Nat.cast_one]
  apply encard_singleton_inter

name: ncard_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ncard_prod {s : Set α} {t : Set β} : (s ×ˢ t).ncard = s.ncard * t.ncard

name: ncard_powerset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ncard_powerset (s : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    (𝒫 s).ncard = 2 ^ s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  have h := Cardinal.mk_powerset s
  rw [← cast_ncard hs.powerset, ← cast_ncard hs] at h
  norm_cast at h

name: ncard_insert_of_notMem
statement:
@[simp] theorem ncard_insert_of_notMem {a : α} (h : a ∉ s) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    (insert a s).ncard = s.ncard + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cast_inj (R := ℕ∞), (hs.insert a).cast_ncard_eq, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
    hs.cast_ncard_eq, encard_insert_of_notMem h]

name: ncard_insert_of_mem
statement: theorem ncard_insert_of_mem {a : α} (h : a ∈ s) : ncard (insert a s) = s.ncard

name: ncard_insert_le
statement: theorem ncard_insert_le (a : α) (s : Set α) : (insert a s).ncard ≤ s.ncard + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain hs | hs := s.finite_or_infinite
  · to_encard_tac; rw [hs.cast_ncard_eq, (hs.insert _).cast_ncard_eq]; apply encard_insert_le
  rw [(hs.mono (subset_insert a s)).ncard]
  exact Nat.zero_le _

name: one_le_ncard_insert
statement:
theorem one_le_ncard_insert (a : α) (s : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    1 ≤ (insert a s).ncard

name: ncard_insert_eq_ite
statement:
theorem ncard_insert_eq_ite {a : α} [Decidable (a ∈ s)] (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    ncard (insert a s) = if a ∈ s then s.ncard else s.ncard + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a ∈ s
  · rw [ncard_insert_of_mem h, ite_eq_left h]
  · rw [ncard_insert_of_notMem h hs, ite_eq_right h]

name: ncard_le_ncard_insert
statement: theorem ncard_le_ncard_insert (a : α) (s : Set α) : s.ncard ≤ (insert a s).ncard
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine
    s.finite_or_infinite.elim (fun h ↦ ?_) (fun h ↦ by (rw [h.ncard]; exact Nat.zero_le _))
  rw [ncard_insert_eq_ite h]; split_ifs <;> simp

name: ncard_pair
statement: theorem ncard_pair {a b : α} (h : a ≠ b) : ({a, b} : Set α).ncard = 2

name: ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one
statement:
theorem ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one {a : α} (h : a ∈ s)
    (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : (s \ {a}).ncard + 1 = s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  to_encard_tac
  rw [hs.cast_ncard_eq, hs.sdiff.cast_ncard_eq, encard_sdiff_singleton_add_one h]

name: ncard_sdiff_singleton_of_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem ncard_sdiff_singleton_of_mem {a : α} (h : a ∈ s) :
    (s \ {a}).ncard = s.ncard - 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases s.infinite_or_finite with hs | hs
  · simp_all [ncard, Infinite.sdiff hs (finite_singleton a)]
  · exact eq_tsub_of_add_eq (ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one h hs)

name: ncard_sdiff_singleton_lt_of_mem
statement:
theorem ncard_sdiff_singleton_lt_of_mem {a : α} (h : a ∈ s) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    (s \ {a}).ncard < s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_sdiff_singleton_add_one h hs]; apply lt_add_one

name: ncard_sdiff_singleton_le
statement: theorem ncard_sdiff_singleton_le (s : Set α) (a : α) : (s \ {a}).ncard ≤ s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  obtain hs | hs := s.finite_or_infinite
  · apply ncard_le_ncard sdiff_subset hs
  convert! Nat.zero_le _
  exact (hs.sdiff (by simp)).ncard

name: pred_ncard_le_ncard_sdiff_singleton
statement:
theorem pred_ncard_le_ncard_sdiff_singleton (s : Set α) (a : α) :
    s.ncard - 1 ≤ (s \ {a}).ncard
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a ∈ s
  · rw [ncard_sdiff_singleton_of_mem h]
  rw [sdiff_singleton_eq_self h]
  apply Nat.pred_le

name: ncard_exchange
statement: theorem ncard_exchange {a b : α} (ha : a ∉ s) (hb : b ∈ s) : (insert a (s \ {b})).ncard = s.ncard

name: ncard_exchange'
statement:
theorem ncard_exchange' {a b : α} (ha : a ∉ s) (hb : b ∈ s) :
    (insert a s \ {b}).ncard = s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_exchange ha hb, ← singleton_union, ← singleton_union, union_sdiff_distrib,
    sdiff_singleton_eq_self fun h ↦ ha (by rwa [← mem_singleton_iff.mp h])]

name: odd_card_insert_iff
statement:
lemma odd_card_insert_iff {a : α} (ha : a ∉ s) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    Odd (insert a s).ncard ↔ Even s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [ncard_insert_of_notMem ha hs, Nat.odd_add]
  simp only [← Nat.not_even_iff_odd, Nat.not_even_one, iff_false, Decidable.not_not]

name: even_card_insert_iff
statement:
lemma even_card_insert_iff {a : α} (ha : a ∉ s) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    Even (insert a s).ncard ↔ Odd s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [ncard_insert_of_notMem ha hs, Nat.even_add_one, Nat.not_even_iff_odd]

name: ncard_image_le
statement: theorem ncard_image_le (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : (f '' s).ncard ≤ s.ncard

name: InjOn.ncard_image
statement: theorem InjOn.ncard_image (H : Set.InjOn f s) : (f '' s).ncard = s.ncard

name: injOn_of_ncard_image_eq
statement:
theorem injOn_of_ncard_image_eq (h : (f '' s).ncard = s.ncard) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    Set.InjOn f s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cast_inj (R := ℕ∞), hs.cast_ncard_eq, (hs.image _).cast_ncard_eq] at h
  exact hs.injOn_of_encard_image_eq h

name: ncard_image_iff
statement:
theorem ncard_image_iff (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    (f '' s).ncard = s.ncard ↔ Set.InjOn f s

name: ncard_image_of_injective
statement: theorem ncard_image_of_injective (s : Set α) (H : f.Injective) : (f '' s).ncard = s.ncard

name: ncard_preimage_of_injective_subset_range
statement:
theorem ncard_preimage_of_injective_subset_range {s : Set β} (H : f.Injective)
    (hs : s ⊆ Set.range f) :
    (f ⁻¹' s).ncard = s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_image_of_injective _ H, image_preimage_eq_iff.mpr hs]

name: fiber_ncard_ne_zero_iff_mem_image
statement:
theorem fiber_ncard_ne_zero_iff_mem_image {y : β} (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    { x ∈ s | f x = y }.ncard ≠ 0 ↔ y ∈ f '' s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨nonempty_of_ncard_ne_zero, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  exact @ncard_ne_zero_of_mem _ ({ x ∈ s | f x = f z }) z (mem_sep hz rfl)
    (hs.subset (sep_subset _ _))

name: ncard_map
statement: @[simp] theorem ncard_map (f : α ↪ β) : (f '' s).ncard = s.ncard

name: ncard_subtype
statement:
@[simp] theorem ncard_subtype (P : α → Prop) (s : Set α) :
    { x : Subtype P | (x : α) ∈ s }.ncard = (s ∩ Set.ofPred P).ncard
proof:
:= by
  convert! (ncard_image_of_injective _ (@Subtype.coe_injective _ P)).symm
  ext x
  simp [← and_assoc, exists_eq_right]

name: ncard_inter_le_ncard_left
statement:
theorem ncard_inter_le_ncard_left (s t : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    (s ∩ t).ncard ≤ s.ncard

name: ncard_inter_le_ncard_right
statement:
theorem ncard_inter_le_ncard_right (s t : Set α) (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    (s ∩ t).ncard ≤ t.ncard

name: eq_of_subset_of_ncard_le
statement:
theorem eq_of_subset_of_ncard_le (h : s ⊆ t) (h' : t.ncard ≤ s.ncard)
    (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : s = t
proof:
:=
  ht.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le' h
    (by rwa [← Nat.cast_le (α := ℕ∞), ht.cast_ncard_eq, (ht.subset h).cast_ncard_eq] at h')

name: subset_iff_eq_of_ncard_le
statement:
theorem subset_iff_eq_of_ncard_le (h : t.ncard ≤ s.ncard) (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    s ⊆ t ↔ s = t
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hst ↦ eq_of_subset_of_ncard_le hst h ht, Eq.subset⟩

name: map_eq_of_subset
statement:
theorem map_eq_of_subset {f : α ↪ α} (h : f '' s ⊆ s) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    f '' s = s

name: sep_of_ncard_eq
statement:
theorem sep_of_ncard_eq {a : α} {P : α → Prop} (h : { x ∈ s | P x }.ncard = s.ncard) (ha : a ∈ s)
    (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : P a

name: ncard_lt_ncard
statement:
theorem ncard_lt_ncard (h : s ⊂ t) (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    s.ncard < t.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cast_lt (α := ℕ∞), ht.cast_ncard_eq, (ht.subset h.subset).cast_ncard_eq]
  exact (ht.subset h.subset).encard_lt_encard h

name: ncard_lt_card
statement: theorem ncard_lt_card [Finite α] (h : s ≠ univ) : s.ncard < Nat.card α

name: ncard_strictMono
statement: theorem ncard_strictMono [Finite α] : @StrictMono (Set α) _ _ _ ncard

name: Finite.ncard_strictMonoOn
statement: theorem Finite.ncard_strictMonoOn : StrictMonoOn (α := Set α) ncard (Set.ofPred Set.Finite)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ ht hlt ↦ ncard_lt_ncard hlt ht

name: ncard_eq_of_bijective
statement:
theorem ncard_eq_of_bijective {n : ℕ} (f : ∀ i, i < n → α)
    (hf : ∀ a ∈ s, ∃ i, ∃ h : i < n, f i h = a) (hf' : ∀ (i) (h : i < n), f i h ∈ s)
    (f_inj : ∀ (i j) (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n), f i hi = f j hj → i = j) : s.ncard = n
proof:
:= by
  let f' : Fin n → α := fun i ↦ f i.val i.is_lt
  suffices himage : s = f' '' Set.univ by
    rw [← Fintype.card_fin n, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← Set.ncard_univ, himage]
    exact InjOn.ncard_image <| fun i _hi j _hj h ↦ Fin.ext <| f_inj i.val j.val i.is_lt j.is_lt h
  ext x
  simp only [image_univ, mem_range]
  refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ?_, fun ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, hx⟩ ↦ hx ▸ hf' i hi⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := hf x hx
  use ⟨i, hi⟩

name: ncard_congr
statement:
theorem ncard_congr {t : Set β} (f : ∀ a ∈ s, β) (h₁ : ∀ a ha, f a ha ∈ t)
    (h₂ : ∀ a b ha hb, f a ha = f b hb → a = b) (h₃ : ∀ b ∈ t, ∃ a ha, f a ha = b) :
    s.ncard = t.ncard
proof:
:= by
  set f' : s → t := fun x ↦ ⟨f x.1 x.2, h₁ _ _⟩
  have hbij : f'.Bijective := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ hxy
      simp only [f', Subtype.mk.injEq] at hxy ⊢
      exact h₂ _ _ hx hy hxy
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := h₃ y hy
    simp only [Subtype.exists]
    exact ⟨_, ha, rfl⟩
  simp_rw [← _root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
  exact Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective f' hbij)

name: ncard_congr'
statement: theorem ncard_congr' {S : Set α} {T : Set β} (f : S ≃ T) : Set.ncard S = Set.ncard T

name: ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn
statement:
theorem ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn {t : Set β} (f : α → β) (hf : ∀ a ∈ s, f a ∈ t) (f_inj : InjOn f s)
    (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    s.ncard ≤ t.ncard
proof:
:= by
  have hle := encard_le_encard_of_injOn hf f_inj
  to_encard_tac; rwa [ht.cast_ncard_eq, (ht.finite_of_encard_le hle).cast_ncard_eq]

name: ncard_range_of_injective
statement:
theorem ncard_range_of_injective (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    (range f).ncard = Nat.card α
proof:
:= by
  rw [← image_univ, ncard_image_of_injective univ hf, ncard_univ]

name: BijOn.ncard_eq
statement: theorem BijOn.ncard_eq {t : Set β} (h : Set.BijOn f s t) : s.ncard = t.ncard

name: exists_ne_map_eq_of_ncard_lt_of_maps_to
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h'
  simp only [Ne, not_exists, not_and, not_imp_not] at h'
  exact (ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn f hf h' ht).not_gt hc

name: le_ncard_of_inj_on_range
statement:
theorem le_ncard_of_inj_on_range {n : ℕ} (f : ℕ → α) (hf : ∀ i < n, f i ∈ s)
    (f_inj : ∀ i < n, ∀ j < n, f i = f j → i = j) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    n ≤ s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hs]
  apply Finset.le_card_of_inj_on_range <;> simpa

name: surj_on_of_inj_on_of_ncard_le
statement:
theorem surj_on_of_inj_on_of_ncard_le {t : Set β} (f : ∀ a ∈ s, β) (hf : ∀ a ha, f a ha ∈ t)
    (hinj : ∀ a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂, f a₁ ha₁ = f a₂ ha₂ → a₁ = a₂) (hst : t.ncard ≤ s.ncard)
    (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    ∀ b ∈ t, ∃ a ha, b = f a ha
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  set f' : s → t := fun x ↦ ⟨f x.1 x.2, hf _ _⟩
  have finj : f'.Injective := by
    rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ hxy
    simp only [f', Subtype.mk.injEq] at hxy ⊢
    apply hinj _ _ hx hy hxy
  have hft := ht.fintype
  have hft' := Fintype.ofInjective f' finj
  set f'' : ∀ a, a ∈ s.toFinset → β := fun a h ↦ f a (by simpa using h)
  convert! @Finset.surj_on_of_inj_on_of_card_le _ _ _ t.toFinset f'' _ _ _ _ (by simpa) using 1
  · simp [f'']
  · simp [f'', hf]
  · intro a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ h
    rw [mem_toFinset] at ha₁ ha₂
    exact hinj _ _ ha₁ ha₂ h
  rwa [← ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ← ncard_eq_toFinset_card']

name: inj_on_of_surj_on_of_ncard_le
statement:
theorem inj_on_of_surj_on_of_ncard_le {t : Set β} (f : ∀ a ∈ s, β) (hf : ∀ a ha, f a ha ∈ t)
    (hsurj : ∀ b ∈ t, ∃ a ha, f a ha = b) (hst : s.ncard ≤ t.ncard) ⦃a₁⦄ (ha₁ : a₁ ∈ s) ⦃a₂⦄
    (ha₂ : a₂ ∈ s) (ha₁a₂ : f a₁ ha₁ = f a₂ ha₂) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    a₁ = a₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set f' : s → t := fun x ↦ ⟨f x.1 x.2, hf _ _⟩
  have hsurj : f'.Surjective := by
    rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hsurj y hy
    simp only [Subtype.exists]
    exact ⟨_, ha, rfl⟩
  have := hs.fintype
  have := Fintype.ofSurjective _ hsurj
  set f'' : ∀ a, a ∈ s.toFinset → β := fun a h ↦ f a (by simpa using h)
  exact
    @Finset.inj_on_of_surj_on_of_card_le _ _ _ t.toFinset f''
      (fun a ha ↦ by { rw [mem_toFinset] at ha ⊢; exact hf a ha }) (by simpa)
      (by { rwa [← ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ← ncard_eq_toFinset_card'] }) a₁
      (by simpa) a₂ (by simpa) (by simpa)

name: ncard_coe
statement:
theorem ncard_coe {α : Type*} (s : Set α) :
    Set.ncard (Set.univ : Set (Set.Elem s)) = s.ncard

name: ncard_graphOn
statement: @[simp] lemma ncard_graphOn (s : Set α) (f : α → β) : (s.graphOn f).ncard = s.ncard

name: ncard_powerset_ncard
statement:
lemma ncard_powerset_ncard (hs : s.Finite) (n : ℕ) :
    {t ⊆ s | t.ncard = n}.ncard = s.ncard.choose n
proof:
:= by
  lift s to Finset α using hs
  have h₁ : {t ⊆ (s : Set α) | t.ncard = n} ⊆ range ((↑) : Finset α → Set α) := by
    intro t ht
    rw [Finset.mem_range_coe_iff]
    exact s.finite_toSet.subset ht.1
  have h₂ : (↑) ⁻¹' {t ⊆ (s : Set α) | t.ncard = n} = (s.powersetCard n : Set (Finset α)) := by
    ext t
    simp
  grind [ncard_coe_finset, ncard_preimage_of_injective_subset_range, Finset.card_powersetCard]

name: ncard_union_add_ncard_inter
statement:
theorem ncard_union_add_ncard_inter (s t : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac)
    (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : (s ∪ t).ncard + (s ∩ t).ncard = s.ncard + t.ncard
proof:
:= by
  to_encard_tac; rw [hs.cast_ncard_eq, ht.cast_ncard_eq, (hs.union ht).cast_ncard_eq,
    (hs.subset inter_subset_left).cast_ncard_eq, encard_union_add_encard_inter]

name: ncard_inter_add_ncard_union
statement:
theorem ncard_inter_add_ncard_union (s t : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac)
    (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : (s ∩ t).ncard + (s ∪ t).ncard = s.ncard + t.ncard

name: ncard_union_le
statement: theorem ncard_union_le (s t : Set α) : (s ∪ t).ncard ≤ s.ncard + t.ncard
proof:
:= by
  obtain (h | h) := (s ∪ t).finite_or_infinite
  · to_encard_tac
    rw [h.cast_ncard_eq, (h.subset subset_union_left).cast_ncard_eq,
      (h.subset subset_union_right).cast_ncard_eq]
    apply encard_union_le
  rw [h.ncard]
  apply zero_le

name: ncard_union_eq
statement:
theorem ncard_union_eq (h : Disjoint s t) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac)
    (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : (s ∪ t).ncard = s.ncard + t.ncard
proof:
:= by
  to_encard_tac
  rw [hs.cast_ncard_eq, ht.cast_ncard_eq, (hs.union ht).cast_ncard_eq, encard_union_eq h]

name: ncard_union_eq_iff
statement:
theorem ncard_union_eq_iff (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac)
    (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : (s ∪ t).ncard = s.ncard + t.ncard ↔ Disjoint s t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_union_add_ncard_inter s t hs ht, left_eq_add,
    ncard_eq_zero (hs.inter_of_left t), disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]

name: ncard_union_lt
statement:
theorem ncard_union_lt (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac)
    (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) (h : ¬ Disjoint s t) :
    (s ∪ t).ncard < s.ncard + t.ncard

name: ncard_sdiff_add_ncard_of_subset
statement:
theorem ncard_sdiff_add_ncard_of_subset (h : s ⊆ t) (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    (t \ s).ncard + s.ncard = t.ncard
proof:
:= by
  to_encard_tac
  rw [ht.cast_ncard_eq, (ht.subset h).cast_ncard_eq, ht.sdiff.cast_ncard_eq,
    encard_sdiff_add_encard_of_subset h]

name: ncard_sdiff'
statement:
theorem ncard_sdiff' (hst : s ⊆ t) (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    (t \ s).ncard = t.ncard - s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_sdiff_add_ncard_of_subset hst ht, add_tsub_cancel_right]

name: ncard_sdiff
statement:
theorem ncard_sdiff (hst : s ⊆ t) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    (t \ s).ncard = t.ncard - s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  obtain ht | ht := t.finite_or_infinite
  · exact ncard_sdiff' hst ht
  · rw [ht.ncard, Nat.zero_sub, (ht.sdiff hs).ncard]

name: cast_ncard_sdiff
statement:
lemma cast_ncard_sdiff {R : Type*} [AddGroupWithOne R] (hst : s ⊆ t) (ht : t.Finite) :
    ((t \ s).ncard : R) = t.ncard - s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [ncard_sdiff hst (ht.subset hst), Nat.cast_sub (ncard_le_ncard hst ht)]

name: ncard_le_ncard_sdiff_add_ncard
statement:
theorem ncard_le_ncard_sdiff_add_ncard (s t : Set α) (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    s.ncard ≤ (s \ t).ncard + t.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rcases s.finite_or_infinite with hs | hs
  · to_encard_tac
    rw [ht.cast_ncard_eq, hs.cast_ncard_eq, hs.sdiff.cast_ncard_eq]
    apply encard_le_encard_sdiff_add_encard
  convert! Nat.zero_le _
  rw [hs.ncard]

name: le_ncard_sdiff
statement:
theorem le_ncard_sdiff (s t : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    t.ncard - s.ncard ≤ (t \ s).ncard

name: ncard_sdiff_add_ncard
statement:
theorem ncard_sdiff_add_ncard (s t : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac)
    (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    (s \ t).ncard + t.ncard = (s ∪ t).ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_union_eq disjoint_sdiff_left hs.sdiff ht, sdiff_union_self]

name: sdiff_nonempty_of_ncard_lt_ncard
statement:
theorem sdiff_nonempty_of_ncard_lt_ncard (h : s.ncard < t.ncard)
    (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : (t \ s).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty, Ne, sdiff_eq_empty]
  exact fun h' ↦ h.not_ge (ncard_le_ncard h' hs)

name: exists_mem_notMem_of_ncard_lt_ncard
statement:
theorem exists_mem_notMem_of_ncard_lt_ncard (h : s.ncard < t.ncard)
    (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : ∃ e, e ∈ t ∧ e ∉ s

name: ncard_inter_add_ncard_sdiff_eq_ncard
statement:
@[simp] theorem ncard_inter_add_ncard_sdiff_eq_ncard (s t : Set α)
    (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : (s ∩ t).ncard + (s \ t).ncard = s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_union_eq (disjoint_of_subset_left inter_subset_right disjoint_sdiff_right)
    (hs.inter_of_left _) hs.sdiff, union_comm, sdiff_union_inter]

name: ncard_eq_ncard_iff_ncard_sdiff_eq_ncard_sdiff
statement:
theorem ncard_eq_ncard_iff_ncard_sdiff_eq_ncard_sdiff (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac)
    (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : s.ncard = t.ncard ↔ (s \ t).ncard = (t \ s).ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_inter_add_ncard_sdiff_eq_ncard s t hs, ← ncard_inter_add_ncard_sdiff_eq_ncard t s ht,
    inter_comm, add_right_inj]

name: ncard_le_ncard_iff_ncard_sdiff_le_ncard_sdiff
statement:
theorem ncard_le_ncard_iff_ncard_sdiff_le_ncard_sdiff (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac)
    (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : s.ncard ≤ t.ncard ↔ (s \ t).ncard ≤ (t \ s).ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_inter_add_ncard_sdiff_eq_ncard s t hs, ← ncard_inter_add_ncard_sdiff_eq_ncard t s ht,
    inter_comm, add_le_add_iff_left]

name: ncard_lt_ncard_iff_ncard_sdiff_lt_ncard_sdiff
statement:
theorem ncard_lt_ncard_iff_ncard_sdiff_lt_ncard_sdiff (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac)
    (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : s.ncard < t.ncard ↔ (s \ t).ncard < (t \ s).ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_inter_add_ncard_sdiff_eq_ncard s t hs, ← ncard_inter_add_ncard_sdiff_eq_ncard t s ht,
    inter_comm, add_lt_add_iff_left]

name: ncard_add_ncard_compl
statement:
theorem ncard_add_ncard_compl (s : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac)
    (hsc : sᶜ.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : s.ncard + sᶜ.ncard = Nat.card α
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_univ, ← ncard_union_eq (@disjoint_compl_right _ _ s) hs hsc, union_compl_self]

name: ncard_compl_add_ncard
statement:
theorem ncard_compl_add_ncard (s : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac)
    (hsc : sᶜ.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : sᶜ.ncard + s.ncard = Nat.card α
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, ncard_add_ncard_compl s hs hsc]

name: ncard_compl
statement:
theorem ncard_compl (s : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac)
    (hsc : sᶜ.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : sᶜ.ncard = Nat.card α - s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_add_ncard_compl s hs hsc, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]

name: ncard_compl_of_ncard_eq_add
proof:
:= by
  rwa [← ncard_compl_add_ncard s, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at h

name: eq_univ_iff_ncard
statement:
theorem eq_univ_iff_ncard [Finite α] (s : Set α) :
    s = univ ↔ ncard s = Nat.card α
proof:
:= by
  rw [← compl_empty_iff, ← ncard_eq_zero, ← ncard_add_ncard_compl s, left_eq_add]

name: even_ncard_compl_iff
statement:
lemma even_ncard_compl_iff [Finite α] (heven : Even (Nat.card α)) (s : Set α) :
    Even sᶜ.ncard ↔ Even s.ncard

name: odd_ncard_compl_iff
statement:
lemma odd_ncard_compl_iff [Finite α] (heven : Even (Nat.card α)) (s : Set α) :
    Odd sᶜ.ncard ↔ Odd s.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.not_even_iff_odd, even_ncard_compl_iff heven, Nat.not_even_iff_odd]

name: nonempty_inter_of_lt_ncard_add_ncard
statement:
theorem nonempty_inter_of_lt_ncard_add_ncard [Finite α]
    (h : Nat.card α < s.ncard + t.ncard) : (s ∩ t).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_union_add_ncard_inter s t] at h
  replace h := (s ∪ t).ncard_le_card.trans_lt h
  rwa [lt_add_iff_pos_right, ncard_pos] at h

name: nonempty_inter_of_le_ncard_add_ncard
statement:
theorem nonempty_inter_of_le_ncard_add_ncard [Finite α]
    (h' : Nat.card α ≤ s.ncard + t.ncard) (h : s ∪ t ≠ univ) :
    (s ∩ t).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ncard_union_add_ncard_inter s t] at h'
  replace h := (ncard_lt_card h).trans_le h'
  rwa [lt_add_iff_pos_right, ncard_pos] at h

name: union_ne_univ_of_ncard_add_ncard_lt
statement:
theorem union_ne_univ_of_ncard_add_ncard_lt
    (h : s.ncard + t.ncard < Nat.card α) : s ∪ t ≠ univ
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  rw [← ncard_univ, ← h]
  exact ncard_union_le s t

name: nonempty_inter_compl_of_ncard_add_ncard_lt
statement:
theorem nonempty_inter_compl_of_ncard_add_ncard_lt
    (h : s.ncard + t.ncard < Nat.card α) : (sᶜ ∩ tᶜ).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [← compl_union, nonempty_compl]
  exact union_ne_univ_of_ncard_add_ncard_lt h

name: exists_subsuperset_card_eq
statement:
lemma exists_subsuperset_card_eq {n : ℕ} (hst : s ⊆ t) (hsn : s.ncard ≤ n) (hnt : n ≤ t.ncard) :
    ∃ u, s ⊆ u ∧ u ⊆ t ∧ u.ncard = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ht | ht := t.infinite_or_finite
  · rw [ht.ncard, Nat.le_zero, ← ht.ncard] at hnt
    exact ⟨t, hst, Subset.rfl, hnt.symm⟩
  lift s to Finset α using ht.subset hst
  lift t to Finset α using ht
  obtain ⟨u, hsu, hut, hu⟩ := Finset.exists_subsuperset_card_eq (mod_cast hst) (by simpa using hsn)
    (mod_cast hnt)
  exact ⟨u, mod_cast hsu, mod_cast hut, mod_cast hu⟩

name: exists_subset_card_eq
statement: lemma exists_subset_card_eq {n : ℕ} (hns : n ≤ s.ncard) : ∃ t ⊆ s, t.ncard = n
proof:
:= by
  simpa using exists_subsuperset_card_eq s.empty_subset (by simp) hns

name: Infinite.exists_subset_ncard_eq
statement:
theorem Infinite.exists_subset_ncard_eq {s : Set α} (hs : s.Infinite) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ t, t ⊆ s ∧ t.Finite ∧ t.ncard = k
proof:
:= by
  have := hs.to_subtype
  obtain ⟨t', -, rfl⟩ := @Infinite.exists_subset_card_eq s univ infinite_univ k
  refine ⟨Subtype.val '' (t' : Set s), by simp, Finite.image _ (by simp), ?_⟩
  rw [ncard_image_of_injective _ Subtype.coe_injective]
  simp

name: Infinite.exists_superset_ncard_eq
statement:
theorem Infinite.exists_superset_ncard_eq {s t : Set α} (ht : t.Infinite) (hst : s ⊆ t)
    (hs : s.Finite) {k : ℕ} (hsk : s.ncard ≤ k) : ∃ s', s ⊆ s' ∧ s' ⊆ t ∧ s'.ncard = k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁, hs₁fin, hs₁card⟩ := (ht.sdiff hs).exists_subset_ncard_eq (k - s.ncard)
  refine ⟨s ∪ s₁, subset_union_left, union_subset hst (hs₁.trans sdiff_subset), ?_⟩
  rwa [ncard_union_eq (disjoint_of_subset_right hs₁ disjoint_sdiff_right) hs hs₁fin, hs₁card,
    add_tsub_cancel_of_le]

name: exists_subset_or_subset_of_two_mul_lt_ncard
statement:
theorem exists_subset_or_subset_of_two_mul_lt_ncard {n : ℕ} (hst : 2 * n < (s ∪ t).ncard) :
    ∃ r : Set α, n < r.ncard ∧ (r ⊆ s ∨ r ⊆ t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hu := finite_of_ncard_ne_zero ((Nat.zero_le _).trans_lt hst).ne.symm
  rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hu,
    Finite.toFinset_union (hu.subset subset_union_left)
      (hu.subset subset_union_right)] at hst
  obtain ⟨r', hnr', hr'⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_or_subset_of_two_mul_lt_card hst
  exact ⟨r', by simpa, by simpa using hr'⟩

name: _root_.Finset.exists_not_mem_of_card_lt_enatCard
statement:
lemma _root_.Finset.exists_not_mem_of_card_lt_enatCard {s : Finset α} (hs : s.card < ENat.card α) :
    ∃ a, a ∉ s
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hs
  simp [← Set.encard_coe_eq_coe_finsetCard, Set.eq_univ_of_forall (α := α) (s := s) hs]

name: ncard_eq_one
statement: @[simp] theorem ncard_eq_one : s.ncard = 1 ↔ ∃ a, s = {a}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, by rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩; rw [ncard_singleton]⟩
  have hft := (finite_of_ncard_ne_zero (ne_zero_of_eq_one h)).fintype
  simp_rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card', @Finset.card_eq_one _ (toFinset s)] at h
  refine h.imp fun a ha ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [Set.ext_iff, mem_singleton_iff]
  simp only [Finset.ext_iff, mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha
  exact ha

name: exists_eq_insert_iff_ncard
statement:
theorem exists_eq_insert_iff_ncard (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    (∃ a ∉ s, insert a s = t) ↔ s ⊆ t ∧ s.ncard + 1 = t.ncard
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases t.finite_or_infinite with ht | ht
  · rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hs, ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ ht,
      ← @Finite.toFinset_subset_toFinset _ _ _ hs ht, ← Finset.exists_eq_insert_iff]
    convert! Iff.rfl using 2; simp only [Finite.mem_toFinset]
    ext x
    simp [Finset.ext_iff, Set.ext_iff]
  simp only [ht.ncard, add_eq_zero, and_false, iff_false, not_exists, not_and,
    reduceCtorEq]
  rintro x - rfl
  exact ht (hs.insert x)

name: ncard_le_one
statement:
theorem ncard_le_one (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    s.ncard ≤ 1 ↔ ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ s, a = b

name: ncard_le_one_iff_subsingleton
statement:
@[simp] theorem ncard_le_one_iff_subsingleton [Finite s] :
    s.ncard ≤ 1 ↔ s.Subsingleton

name: ncard_le_one_iff
statement:
theorem ncard_le_one_iff (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    s.ncard ≤ 1 ↔ ∀ {a b}, a ∈ s → b ∈ s → a = b

name: ncard_le_one_iff_eq
statement:
theorem ncard_le_one_iff_eq (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
    s.ncard ≤ 1 ↔ s = ∅ ∨ ∃ a, s = {a}
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ⟨x, hx⟩ := s.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · exact iff_of_true (by simp) (Or.inl rfl)
  rw [ncard_le_one_iff hs]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ Or.inr ⟨x, (singleton_subset_iff.mpr hx).antisymm' fun y hy ↦ h hy hx⟩, ?_⟩
  grind

name: ncard_le_one_iff_subset_singleton
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hs, Finset.card_le_one_iff_subset_singleton,
    Finite.toFinset_subset, Finset.coe_singleton]

name: ncard_le_one_of_subsingleton
statement: theorem ncard_le_one_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton α] (s : Set α) : s.ncard ≤ 1

name: one_lt_ncard_iff_nontrivial
statement:
theorem one_lt_ncard_iff_nontrivial [Finite s] :
    1 < s.ncard ↔ s.Nontrivial

name: one_lt_ncard_iff_nontrivial_and_finite
statement:

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hs ↦ ?_, fun ⟨hs_nontrivial, hs_finite⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · have := finite_of_ncard_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hs)
    rw [← Set.finite_coe_iff] at this
    exact ⟨one_lt_ncard_iff_nontrivial.mp hs, this⟩
  · rw [← Set.finite_coe_iff] at hs_finite
    rwa [one_lt_ncard_iff_nontrivial]

name: exists_ne_of_one_lt_ncard
statement: theorem exists_ne_of_one_lt_ncard (hs : 1 < s.ncard) (a : α) : ∃ b, b ∈ s ∧ b ≠ a
proof:
:= by
  have hsf := finite_of_ncard_ne_zero (zero_lt_one.trans hs).ne.symm

name: eq_insert_of_ncard_eq_succ
statement:

    ∃ a t, a ∉ t ∧ insert a t = s ∧ t.ncard = n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsf := finite_of_ncard_pos (n.zero_lt_succ.trans_eq h.symm)
  rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hsf, Finset.card_eq_succ] at h
  obtain ⟨a, t, hat, hts, rfl⟩ := h
  simp only [Finset.ext_iff, Finset.mem_insert, Finite.mem_toFinset] at hts
  refine ⟨a, t, hat, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [Set.ext_iff, hts]
  · simp

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨eq_insert_of_ncard_eq_succ, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨a, t, hat, h, rfl⟩
  rw [← h, ncard_insert_of_notMem hat (hs.subset ((subset_insert a t).trans_eq h))]

proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : s.Finite
  · simp [(ncard_union_eq_iff (.image _ hs) (.image _ hs)).2 disjoint_image_inl_image_inr,
      ncard_image_of_injective _ Sum.inl_injective, ncard_image_of_injective _ Sum.inr_injective]
  · simp [(infinite_union.2 <| .inl <| .image Sum.inl_injective.injOn hs).ncard, Infinite.ncard hs]

name: Function.Surjective.card_le_card_add_one_iff
statement:
theorem Function.Surjective.card_le_card_add_one_iff
    {α β : Type*} [Finite α] {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Nat.card α ≤ Nat.card β + 1 ↔ ∀ a b c d,
      f a = f b → f c = f d → a ≠ b → c ≠ d → {a, b} = ({c, d} : Set α)
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty α
  · simp
  
  let g := Function.surjInv hf
  
  rw [← Set.ncard_range_of_injective (Function.injective_surjInv hf),
    ← Set.ncard_add_ncard_compl (Set.range g), add_le_add_iff_left]
  replace hf : ∀ b, f (g b) = b := Function.surjInv_eq hf
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [Set.ncard_le_one_iff_subset_singleton] at h
    
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h
    simp only [Set.subset_def, Set.mem_compl_iff] at hx
    
    suffices ∀ a b : α, f a = f b → a ≠ b → a = x ∨ a = g (f x) by grind
    intro a b
    by_cases ha : a ∈ Set.range g <;> by_cases hb : b ∈ Set.range g <;> grind
  · 
    rw [Set.ncard_le_one]
    simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_range, not_exists, ← ne_eq]
    intro a ha b hb
    
    simpa [(ha (f b)).symm] using congrArg (a ∈ ·) (h a (g (f a)) b (g (f b))
      (hf (f a)).symm (hf (f b)).symm (ha (f a)).symm (hb (f b)).symm)

name: Set.ncard_le_ncard_image_add_one_iff
statement:
theorem Set.ncard_le_ncard_image_add_one_iff {α β : Type*} (s : Set α) [Finite s] (f : α → β) :
    s.ncard ≤ (f '' s).ncard + 1 ↔ ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ s, ∀ c ∈ s, ∀ d ∈ s,
      f a = f b → f c = f d → a ≠ b → c ≠ d → {a, b} = ({c, d} : Set α)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Subtype.ext_iff, ← (Set.image_injective.mpr Subtype.val_injective).eq_iff] using
      (Set.surjective_mapsTo_image_restrict f s).card_le_card_add_one_iff

statement: theorem range_list_map (f : α → β) : range (map f) = { l | ∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ range f }
proof:
:= by
  refine antisymm (range_subset_iff.2 fun l => forall_mem_map.2 fun y _ => mem_range_self _)
      fun l hl => ?_
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
  | cons a l ihl =>
    rcases ihl fun x hx => hl x <| subset_cons_self _ _ hx with ⟨l, rfl⟩
    rcases hl a mem_cons_self with ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a :: l, map_cons⟩

  rw [← range_list_get, ← range_comp]
  refine (range_subset_iff.2 fun n => ?_).antisymm (insert_subset_iff.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩)
  · exact (le_or_gt l.length n).imp getElem?_eq_none_iff.mpr
      (fun hlt => ⟨⟨_, hlt⟩, (getElem?_eq_getElem hlt).symm⟩)
  · exact ⟨_, getElem?_eq_none_iff.mpr le_rfl⟩
  · exact range_subset_iff.2 fun k => ⟨_, getElem?_eq_getElem _⟩

name: upperClosure_sups
statement:
@[simp]
theorem upperClosure_sups [SemilatticeSup α] (s t : Set α) :
    upperClosure (s ⊻ t) = upperClosure s ⊔ upperClosure t
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_upperClosure, Set.mem_sups,
    UpperSet.coe_sup, Set.mem_inter_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨b, hb, c, hc, rfl⟩, ha⟩
    exact ⟨⟨b, hb, le_sup_left.trans ha⟩, c, hc, le_sup_right.trans ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨b, hb, hab⟩, c, hc, hac⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨b, hb, c, hc, rfl⟩, sup_le hab hac⟩

name: lowerClosure_infs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lowerClosure_infs [SemilatticeInf α] (s t : Set α) :
    lowerClosure (s ⊼ t) = lowerClosure s ⊓ lowerClosure t
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_lowerClosure, Set.mem_infs]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨b, hb, c, hc, rfl⟩, ha⟩
    exact ⟨⟨b, hb, ha.trans inf_le_left⟩, c, hc, ha.trans inf_le_right⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨b, hb, hab⟩, c, hc, hac⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨b, hb, c, hc, rfl⟩, le_inf hab hac⟩

statement:
theorem piecewise_insert [DecidableEq α] (j : α) [∀ i, Decidable (i ∈ insert j s)] :

proof:
:= by
  simp +unfoldPartialApp only [piecewise, mem_insert_iff]
  ext i
  by_cases h : i = j
  · rw [h]
    simp
  · by_cases h' : i ∈ s <;> simp [h, h']

proof:
:= by
  ext y
  by_cases hy : y = x
  · subst y
    simp
  · simp [hy]

name: piecewise_le
statement:
theorem piecewise_le {δ : α → Type*} [∀ i, Preorder (δ i)] {s : Set α} [∀ j, Decidable (j ∈ s)]

    s.piecewise f₁ f₂ ≤ g
proof: := fun i => if h : i ∈ s then by simp [*] else by simp [*]

name: le_piecewise
statement:
theorem le_piecewise {δ : α → Type*} [∀ i, Preorder (δ i)] {s : Set α} [∀ j, Decidable (j ∈ s)]

    g ≤ s.piecewise f₁ f₂
proof:
:=
  @piecewise_le α (fun i => (δ i)ᵒᵈ) _ s _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂

name: piecewise_comp
statement:
lemma piecewise_comp (f g : α → γ) (h : β → α) :
    letI : DecidablePred (· ∈ h ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= @instDecidablePredComp _ (· ∈ s) _ h _;
    (s.piecewise f g) ∘ h = (h ⁻¹' s).piecewise (f ∘ h) (g ∘ h) := rfl

name: MapsTo.piecewise_ite
statement:
theorem MapsTo.piecewise_ite {s s₁ s₂ : Set α} {t t₁ t₂ : Set β} {f₁ f₂ : α → β}
    [∀ i, Decidable (i ∈ s)] (h₁ : MapsTo f₁ (s₁ ∩ s) (t₁ ∩ t))
    (h₂ : MapsTo f₂ (s₂ ∩ sᶜ) (t₂ ∩ tᶜ)) :
    MapsTo (s.piecewise f₁ f₂) (s.ite s₁ s₂) (t.ite t₁ t₂)
proof:
:= by
  refine (h₁.congr ?_).union_union (h₂.congr ?_)
  exacts [(piecewise_eqOn s f₁ f₂).symm.mono inter_subset_right,
    (piecewise_eqOn_compl s f₁ f₂).symm.mono inter_subset_right]

name: eqOn_piecewise
statement:
theorem eqOn_piecewise {f f' g : α → β} {t} :

proof:
:= by
  simp only [EqOn, ← forall_and]
  refine forall_congr' fun a => ?_; by_cases a ∈ s <;> simp [*]

name: range_piecewise
statement: theorem range_piecewise (f g : α → β) : range (s.piecewise f g) = f '' s ∪ g '' sᶜ
proof:
:= by
  ext y; constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    by_cases h : x ∈ s <;> [left; right] <;> use x <;> simp [h]
  · rintro (⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ | ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩) <;> use x <;> simp_all

name: injective_piecewise_iff
statement:
theorem injective_piecewise_iff {f g : α → β} :
    Injective (s.piecewise f g) ↔
      InjOn f s ∧ InjOn g sᶜ ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∉ s, f x ≠ g y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← injOn_univ, ← union_compl_self s, injOn_union (@disjoint_compl_right _ _ s),
    (piecewise_eqOn s f g).injOn_iff, (piecewise_eqOn_compl s f g).injOn_iff]
  refine and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr Iff.rfl <| forall₄_congr fun x hx y hy => ?_)
  rw [piecewise_eq_of_mem s f g hx, piecewise_eq_of_notMem s f g hy]

    Sigma.mk i '' g i ⁻¹' s ⊆ Sigma.map f g ⁻¹' Sigma.mk (f i) '' s
proof:

    Sigma.mk i '' g i ⁻¹' s = Sigma.map f g ⁻¹' Sigma.mk (f i) '' s
proof:
:= by
  refine (image_sigmaMk_preimage_sigmaMap_subset f g i s).antisymm ?_
  rintro ⟨j, x⟩ ⟨y, hys, hxy⟩
  simp only [hf.eq_iff, Sigma.map, Sigma.ext_iff] at hxy
  grind

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    IsCancelSMul.left_cancel _ _ _

          exact x.2.2.2.symm).symm,
    fun h =>
    IsCancelSMul.right_cancel _ _ _

          exact x.2.2.2.symm).symm⟩

statement:

theorem eq_of_fst_le_fst_of_snd_le_snd (h₁ : (x : G × P).1 ≤ (y : G × P).1)
    (h₂ : (x : G × P).2 ≤ (y : G × P).2) : x = y
proof:
:=
  eq_of_fst_eq_fst <|
    h₁.eq_of_not_lt fun hlt =>
      (smul_lt_smul_of_lt_of_le hlt h₂).ne <|
        (mem_smulAntidiagonal.1 x.2).2.2.trans (mem_smulAntidiagonal.1 y.2).2.2.symm

name: finite_of_isPWO

theorem finite_of_isPWO (hs : s.IsPWO) (ht : t.IsPWO) (a) : (smulAntidiagonal s t a).Finite
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  have h1 : (smulAntidiagonal s t a).PartiallyWellOrderedOn (Prod.fst ⁻¹'o (· ≤ ·)) :=
    fun f ↦ hs fun n ↦ ⟨_, (mem_smulAntidiagonal.1 (f n).2).1⟩
  have h2 : (smulAntidiagonal s t a).PartiallyWellOrderedOn (Prod.snd ⁻¹'o (· ≤ ·)) :=
    fun f ↦ ht fun n ↦ ⟨_, (mem_smulAntidiagonal.1 (f n).2).2.1⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := h1.exists_monotone_subseq fun n ↦ (h.natEmbedding _ n).2
  obtain ⟨m, n, mn, h2'⟩ := h2 fun n ↦ h.natEmbedding _ _
  refine mn.ne (g.injective <| (h.natEmbedding _).injective ?_)
  exact eq_of_fst_le_fst_of_snd_le_snd (hg _ _ mn.le) h2'

statement: theorem prod_subset_prod_iff : s ×ˢ t ⊆ s₁ ×ˢ t₁ ↔ s ⊆ s₁ ∧ t ⊆ t₁ ∨ s = ∅ ∨ t = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rcases (s ×ˢ t).eq_empty_or_nonempty with h | h
  · simp [h, prod_eq_empty_iff.1 h]
  have st : s.Nonempty ∧ t.Nonempty := by rwa [prod_nonempty_iff] at h
  refine ⟨fun H => Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · have := image_mono (f := Prod.fst) H
    rwa [fst_image_prod _ st.2, fst_image_prod _ (h.mono H).snd] at this
  · have := image_mono (f := Prod.snd) H
    rwa [snd_image_prod st.1, snd_image_prod (h.mono H).fst] at this
  · intro H
    simp only [st.1.ne_empty, st.2.ne_empty, or_false] at H
    exact prod_mono H.1 H.2

name: prod_eq_prod_iff_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem prod_eq_prod_iff_of_nonempty (h : (s ×ˢ t).Nonempty) :
    s ×ˢ t = s₁ ×ˢ t₁ ↔ s = s₁ ∧ t = t₁
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    have h₁ : (s₁ ×ˢ t₁ : Set _).Nonempty := by rwa [← heq]
    rw [prod_nonempty_iff] at h h₁
    rw [← fst_image_prod s h.2, ← fst_image_prod s₁ h₁.2, heq, eq_self_iff_true, true_and, ←
      snd_image_prod h.1 t, ← snd_image_prod h₁.1 t₁, heq]
  · grind

name: prod_eq_prod_iff
statement:
theorem prod_eq_prod_iff :
    s ×ˢ t = s₁ ×ˢ t₁ ↔ s = s₁ ∧ t = t₁ ∨ (s = ∅ ∨ t = ∅) ∧ (s₁ = ∅ ∨ t₁ = ∅)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  rcases eq_empty_or_nonempty (s ×ˢ t) with h | h
  · simp_rw [h, @eq_comm _ ∅, prod_eq_empty_iff, prod_eq_empty_iff.mp h, true_and,
      or_iff_right_iff_imp]
    rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact prod_eq_empty_iff.mp h
  rw [prod_eq_prod_iff_of_nonempty h]
  rw [nonempty_iff_ne_empty, Ne, prod_eq_empty_iff] at h
  simp_rw [h, false_and, or_false]

name: range_const_eq_diagonal

proof:
:= by
  refine (range_eq_iff _ _).mpr ⟨fun _ _ _ ↦ rfl, fun f hf ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty α with h | ⟨⟨a⟩⟩

name: preimage_map_fst_pullbackDiagonal
statement:
theorem preimage_map_fst_pullbackDiagonal {f : X → Y} {g : Z → Y} :
    @map_fst X Y Z f g ⁻¹' pullbackDiagonal f = pullbackDiagonal (@snd X Y Z f g)
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨⟨p₁, p₂⟩, he⟩

name: Function.Injective.preimage_pullbackDiagonal

theorem Function.Injective.preimage_pullbackDiagonal {f : X → Y} {g : Z → X} (inj : g.Injective) :

name: image_toPullbackDiag
statement:
theorem image_toPullbackDiag (f : X → Y) (s : Set X) :
    toPullbackDiag f '' s = pullbackDiagonal f ∩ Subtype.val ⁻¹' s ×ˢ s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨rfl, hx, hx⟩
  · obtain ⟨⟨x, y⟩, h⟩ := x
    rintro ⟨rfl : x = y, h2x⟩
    exact mem_image_of_mem _ h2x.1

name: range_toPullbackDiag
statement: theorem range_toPullbackDiag (f : X → Y) : range (toPullbackDiag f) = pullbackDiagonal f

statement:

name: pi_if
statement:
theorem pi_if {p : ι → Prop} [h : DecidablePred p] (s : Set ι) (t₁ t₂ : ∀ i, Set (α i)) :
    (pi s fun i => if p i then t₁ i else t₂ i) =
      pi ({ i ∈ s | p i }) t₁ ∩ pi ({ i ∈ s | ¬p i }) t₂
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · constructor <;>
      · rintro i ⟨his, hpi⟩
        simpa [*] using h i
  · rintro ⟨ht₁, ht₂⟩ i his
    by_cases p i <;> simp_all

name: pi_update_of_notMem
statement:
theorem pi_update_of_notMem [DecidableEq ι] (hi : i ∉ s) (f : ∀ j, α j) (a : α i)
    (t : ∀ j, α j → Set (β j)) : (s.pi fun j => t j (update f i a j)) = s.pi fun j => t j (f j)
proof:
:=
  (pi_congr rfl) fun j hj => by
    rw [update_of_ne]
    exact fun h => hi (h ▸ hj)

name: pi_update_of_mem
statement:
theorem pi_update_of_mem [DecidableEq ι] (hi : i ∈ s) (f : ∀ j, α j) (a : α i)
    (t : ∀ j, α j → Set (β j)) :
    (s.pi fun j => t j (update f i a j)) = { x | x i ∈ t i a } ∩ (s \ {i}).pi fun j => t j (f j)
proof:
:=
  calc
    (s.pi fun j => t j (update f i a j)) = ({i} ∪ s \ {i}).pi fun j => t j (update f i a j) := by
        rw [union_sdiff_self, union_eq_self_of_subset_left (singleton_subset_iff.2 hi)]
    _ = { x | x i ∈ t i a } ∩ (s \ {i}).pi fun j => t j (f j) := by
        rw [union_pi, singleton_pi', update_self, pi_update_of_notMem]; simp

name: univ_pi_update
statement:
theorem univ_pi_update [DecidableEq ι] {β : ι → Type*} (i : ι) (f : ∀ j, α j) (a : α i)

    (pi univ fun j => t j (update f i a j)) = { x | x i ∈ t i a } ∩ pi {i}ᶜ fun j => t j (f j)

name: univ_pi_update_univ

theorem univ_pi_update_univ [DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) (s : Set (α i)) :
    pi univ (update (fun j : ι => (univ : Set (α j))) i s) = eval i ⁻¹' s
proof:
:= by
  rw [univ_pi_update i (fun j => (univ : Set (α j))) s fun j t => t, pi_univ, inter_univ, preimage]

name: eval_image_pi_subset

name: subset_eval_image_pi

proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := ht
  refine fun y hy => ⟨update f i y, fun j hj => ?_, update_self ..⟩
  obtain rfl | hji := eq_or_ne j i <;> simp [*, hf _ hj]

name: eval_image_pi

name: eval_image_pi_of_notMem
statement:
lemma eval_image_pi_of_notMem [Decidable (s.pi t).Nonempty] (hi : i ∉ s) :
    eval i '' s.pi t = if (s.pi t).Nonempty then univ else ∅
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext xᵢ
  simp only [eval, mem_image, mem_pi, Set.Nonempty, mem_ite_empty_right, mem_univ, and_true]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨Function.update x i xᵢ, ?_⟩
    simpa +contextual [(ne_of_mem_of_not_mem · hi)]

name: eval_image_univ_pi
statement:

name: piMap_mapsTo_pi
proof:
:=

name: piMap_image_pi_subset
statement:
theorem piMap_image_pi_subset {f : ∀ i, α i → β i} (t : ∀ i, Set (α i)) :
    Pi.map f '' s.pi t ⊆ s.pi fun i ↦ f i '' t i

name: piMap_image_pi
statement:
theorem piMap_image_pi {f : ∀ i, α i → β i} (hf : ∀ i ∉ s, Surjective (f i)) (t : ∀ i, Set (α i)) :
    Pi.map f '' s.pi t = s.pi fun i ↦ f i '' t i
proof:
:= by
  refine Subset.antisymm (piMap_image_pi_subset _) fun b hb => ?_
  have (i : ι) : ∃ a, f i a = b i ∧ (i ∈ s → a ∈ t i) := by
    if hi : i ∈ s then
      exact (hb i hi).imp fun a ⟨hat, hab⟩ ↦ ⟨hab, fun _ ↦ hat⟩
    else
      exact (hf i hi (b i)).imp fun a ha ↦ ⟨ha, (absurd · hi)⟩
  choose a hab hat using this
  exact ⟨a, hat, funext hab⟩

name: piMap_image_univ_pi
statement:
theorem piMap_image_univ_pi (f : ∀ i, α i → β i) (t : ∀ i, Set (α i)) :

name: range_piMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem range_piMap (f : ∀ i, α i → β i) : range (Pi.map f) = pi univ fun i ↦ range (f i)
proof:

name: subset_pi_iff
statement: theorem subset_pi_iff {s'} : s' ⊆ pi s t ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, s' ⊆ (· i) ⁻¹' t i

statement:
theorem update_mem_pi_iff [DecidableEq ι] {a : ∀ i, α i} {i : ι} {b : α i} :

name: update_mem_pi_iff_of_mem
statement:
theorem update_mem_pi_iff_of_mem [DecidableEq ι] {a : ∀ i, α i} {i : ι} {b : α i}
    (ha : a ∈ pi s t) : update a i b ∈ pi s t ↔ i ∈ s → b ∈ t i
proof:
:= by

name: univ_pi_eq_singleton_iff
statement: theorem univ_pi_eq_singleton_iff {a} : pi univ t = {a} ↔ ∀ i, t i = {a i}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ i => ⟨by grind, fun x hx => ?_⟩, by grind⟩
  rw [← h₂ _ fun j _ => (update_mem_pi_iff_of_mem h₁).mpr (fun _ => hx) j trivial, update_self]

name: pi_subset_pi_iff
statement: theorem pi_subset_pi_iff : pi s t₁ ⊆ pi s t₂ ↔ (∀ i ∈ s, t₁ i ⊆ t₂ i) ∨ pi s t₁ = ∅
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨fun h => or_iff_not_imp_right.2 ?_, fun h => h.elim pi_mono fun h' => h'.symm ▸ empty_subset _⟩
  rw [← Ne, ← nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
  intro hne i hi
  simpa only [eval_image_pi hi hne, eval_image_pi hi (hne.mono h)] using
    image_mono (f := fun f : ∀ i, α i => f i) h

name: univ_pi_subset_univ_pi_iff
statement:
theorem univ_pi_subset_univ_pi_iff :
    pi univ t₁ ⊆ pi univ t₂ ↔ (∀ i, t₁ i ⊆ t₂ i) ∨ ∃ i, t₁ i = ∅

name: eval_preimage
statement:
theorem eval_preimage [DecidableEq ι] {s : Set (α i)} :

proof:
:= by

name: eval_preimage'

name: update_preimage_pi
statement:
theorem update_preimage_pi [DecidableEq ι] {f : ∀ i, α i} (hi : i ∈ s)
    (hf : ∀ j ∈ s, j ≠ i → f j ∈ t j) : update f i ⁻¹' s.pi t = t i
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun hx j hj => ?_⟩
  · convert! h i hi
    simp
  · obtain rfl | h := eq_or_ne j i
    · simpa
    · rw [update_of_ne h]
      exact hf j hj h

name: update_image
statement:
theorem update_image [DecidableEq ι] (x : (i : ι) → β i) (i : ι) (s : Set (β i)) :
    update x i '' s = Set.univ.pi (update (fun j ↦ {x j}) i s)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp only [mem_image, update_eq_iff, ne_eq, and_left_comm (a := _ ∈ s), exists_eq_left, mem_pi,
    mem_univ, true_implies]
  rw [forall_update_iff (p := fun x s => y x ∈ s)]
  simp [eq_comm]

proof:
:=
  update_preimage_pi (mem_univ i) fun j _ => hf j

name: piCongrLeft_symm_preimage_pi
statement:
theorem piCongrLeft_symm_preimage_pi (f : ι' ≃ ι) (s : Set ι') (t : ∀ i, Set (α i)) :
    (f.piCongrLeft α).symm ⁻¹' s.pi (fun i' => t <| f i') = (f '' s).pi t

name: piCongrLeft_symm_preimage_univ_pi
statement:
theorem piCongrLeft_symm_preimage_univ_pi (f : ι' ≃ ι) (t : ∀ i, Set (α i)) :
    (f.piCongrLeft α).symm ⁻¹' univ.pi (fun i' => t <| f i') = univ.pi t
proof:
:= by
  simpa [f.surjective.range_eq] using piCongrLeft_symm_preimage_pi f univ t

name: piCongrLeft_preimage_pi
statement:
theorem piCongrLeft_preimage_pi (f : ι' ≃ ι) (s : Set ι') (t : ∀ i, Set (α i)) :
    f.piCongrLeft α ⁻¹' (f '' s).pi t = s.pi fun i => t (f i)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.ext
  rw [← (f.piCongrLeft α).symm.forall_congr_right]
  simp

name: piCongrLeft_preimage_univ_pi

name: exists_range_eq_graphOn_univ
statement:
lemma exists_range_eq_graphOn_univ {f : α → β × γ} (hf₁ : Surjective (Prod.fst ∘ f))
    (hf : ∀ g₁ g₂, (f g₁).1 = (f g₂).1 → (f g₁).2 = (f g₂).2) :
    ∃ f' : β → γ, range f = univ.graphOn f'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ (f (hf₁ h).choose).snd, ?_⟩
  ext x
  simp only [mem_range, comp_apply, mem_graphOn, mem_univ, true_and]
  refine ⟨?_, fun hi ↦ ⟨(hf₁ x.1).choose, Prod.ext (hf₁ x.1).choose_spec hi⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
  exact hf _ _ (hf₁ (f g).1).choose_spec

name: exists_equiv_range_eq_graphOn_univ
statement:
lemma exists_equiv_range_eq_graphOn_univ {f : α → β × γ} (hf₁ : Surjective (Prod.fst ∘ f))
    (hf₂ : Surjective (Prod.snd ∘ f)) (hf : ∀ g₁ g₂, (f g₁).1 = (f g₂).1 ↔ (f g₁).2 = (f g₂).2) :
    ∃ e : β ≃ γ, range f = univ.graphOn e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₁, he₁⟩ := exists_range_eq_graphOn_univ hf₁ fun _ _ ↦ (hf _ _).1
  obtain ⟨e₂, he₂⟩ := exists_range_eq_graphOn_univ (f := Equiv.prodComm _ _ ∘ f) (by simpa) <|
    by simp [hf]
  have he₁₂ h i : e₁ h = i ↔ e₂ i = h := by
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at he₁ he₂
    aesop (add simp [Prod.swap_eq_iff_eq_swap])
  exact ⟨
  { toFun := e₁
    invFun := e₂
    left_inv := fun h ↦ by rw [← he₁₂]
    right_inv := fun i ↦ by rw [he₁₂] }, he₁⟩

name: exists_eq_mgraphOn_univ
statement:
lemma exists_eq_mgraphOn_univ {s : Set (β × γ)}
    (hs₁ : Bijective (Prod.fst ∘ (Subtype.val : s → β × γ))) : ∃ f : β → γ, s = univ.graphOn f
proof:
:= by
  simpa using exists_range_eq_graphOn_univ hs₁.surjective
    fun a b h ↦ congr_arg (Prod.snd ∘ (Subtype.val : s → β × γ)) (hs₁.injective h)

@[simp]
theorem iUnionLift_mk {i : ι} (x : S i) (hx : (x : α) ∈ T) :

name: iUnionLift_inclusion
statement:
theorem iUnionLift_inclusion {i : ι} (x : S i) (h : S i ⊆ T) :
    iUnionLift S f hf T hT (Set.inclusion h x) = f i x

name: iUnionLift_of_mem
statement:
theorem iUnionLift_of_mem (x : T) {i : ι} (hx : (x : α) ∈ S i) :
    iUnionLift S f hf T hT x = f i ⟨x, hx⟩
proof: := by obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x; exact hf _ _ _ _ _

name: preimage_iUnionLift
statement:
theorem preimage_iUnionLift (t : Set β) :
    iUnionLift S f hf T hT ⁻¹' t =
      inclusion hT ⁻¹' (⋃ i, inclusion (subset_iUnion S i) '' f i ⁻¹' t)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_preimage, mem_iUnion, mem_image]
  constructor
  · rcases mem_iUnion.1 (hT x.prop) with ⟨i, hi⟩
    refine fun h => ⟨i, ⟨x, hi⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    rwa [iUnionLift_of_mem x hi] at h
  · rintro ⟨i, ⟨y, hi⟩, h, hxy⟩
    obtain rfl : y = x := congr_arg Subtype.val hxy
    rwa [iUnionLift_of_mem x hi]

name: iUnionLift_const
statement:
theorem iUnionLift_const (c : T) (ci : ∀ i, S i) (hci : ∀ i, (ci i : α) = c) (cβ : β)
    (h : ∀ i, f i (ci i) = cβ) : iUnionLift S f hf T hT c = cβ
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 (hT c.prop)
  have : ci i = ⟨c, hi⟩ := Subtype.ext (hci i)
  rw [iUnionLift_of_mem _ hi, ← this, h]

name: iUnionLift_unary
statement:
theorem iUnionLift_unary (u : T → T) (ui : ∀ i, S i → S i)
    (hui :
      ∀ (i) (x : S i),
        u (Set.inclusion (show S i ⊆ T from hT'.symm ▸ Set.subset_iUnion S i) x) =
          Set.inclusion (show S i ⊆ T from hT'.symm ▸ Set.subset_iUnion S i) (ui i x))
    (uβ : β → β) (h : ∀ (i) (x : S i), f i (ui i x) = uβ (f i x)) (x : T) :
    iUnionLift S f hf T (le_of_eq hT') (u x) = uβ (iUnionLift S f hf T (le_of_eq hT') x)
proof:
:= by
  subst hT'
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 x.prop
  rw [iUnionLift_of_mem x hi, ← h i]
  have : x = Set.inclusion (Set.subset_iUnion S i) ⟨x, hi⟩ := by
    cases x
    rfl
  conv_lhs => rw [this, hui, iUnionLift_inclusion]

name: iUnionLift_binary
statement:
theorem iUnionLift_binary (dir : Directed (· ≤ ·) S) (op : T → T → T) (opi : ∀ i, S i → S i → S i)
    (hopi :
      ∀ i x y,
        Set.inclusion (show S i ⊆ T from hT'.symm ▸ Set.subset_iUnion S i) (opi i x y) =
          op (Set.inclusion (show S i ⊆ T from hT'.symm ▸ Set.subset_iUnion S i) x)
            (Set.inclusion (show S i ⊆ T from hT'.symm ▸ Set.subset_iUnion S i) y))
    (opβ : β → β → β) (h : ∀ (i) (x y : S i), f i (opi i x y) = opβ (f i x) (f i y)) (x y : T) :
    iUnionLift S f hf T (le_of_eq hT') (op x y) =
      opβ (iUnionLift S f hf T (le_of_eq hT') x) (iUnionLift S f hf T (le_of_eq hT') y)
proof:
:= by
  subst hT'
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 x.prop
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 y.prop
  rcases dir i j with ⟨k, hik, hjk⟩
  rw [iUnionLift_of_mem x (hik hi), iUnionLift_of_mem y (hjk hj), ← h k]
  have hx : x = Set.inclusion (Set.subset_iUnion S k) ⟨x, hik hi⟩ := by
    cases x
    rfl
  have hy : y = Set.inclusion (Set.subset_iUnion S k) ⟨y, hjk hj⟩ := by
    cases y
    rfl
  have hxy : (Set.inclusion (Set.subset_iUnion S k) (opi k ⟨x, hik hi⟩ ⟨y, hjk hj⟩) : α) ∈ S k :=
    (opi k ⟨x, hik hi⟩ ⟨y, hjk hj⟩).prop
  conv_lhs => rw [hx, hy, ← hopi, iUnionLift_of_mem _ hxy]

statement: theorem preimage_liftCover (t : Set β) : liftCover S f hf hS ⁻¹' t = ⋃ i, (↑) '' f i ⁻¹' t

  change (iUnionLift S f hf univ hS.symm.subset ∘ fun a => ⟨a, mem_univ a⟩) ⁻¹' t = _
  rw [preimage_comp, preimage_iUnionLift]
