name: powersetAux'_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powersetAux'_cons (a : α) (l : List α) :
    powersetAux' (a :: l) = powersetAux' l ++ List.map (cons a) (powersetAux' l)

name: powerset_aux'_perm
statement: theorem powerset_aux'_perm {l₁ l₂ : List α} (p : l₁ ~ l₂) : powersetAux' l₁ ~ powersetAux' l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | cons _ _ IH =>
    simp only [powersetAux'_cons]
    exact IH.append (IH.map _)
  | swap a b =>
    simp only [powersetAux'_cons, map_append, List.map_map, append_assoc]
    apply Perm.append_left
    rw [← append_assoc, ← append_assoc,
      (by funext s; simp [cons_swap] : cons b ∘ cons a = cons a ∘ cons b)]
    exact perm_append_comm.append_right _
  | trans _ _ IH₁ IH₂ => exact IH₁.trans IH₂

name: powersetAux_perm
statement: theorem powersetAux_perm {l₁ l₂ : List α} (p : l₁ ~ l₂) : powersetAux l₁ ~ powersetAux l₂

name: powerset_coe
statement: theorem powerset_coe (l : List α) : @powerset α l = ((sublists l).map (↑) : List (Multiset α))
proof:
:=
  congr_arg ((↑) : List (Multiset α) → Multiset (Multiset α)) powersetAux_eq_map_coe

name: powerset_coe'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powerset_coe' (l : List α) : @powerset α l = ((sublists' l).map (↑) : List (Multiset α))

name: powerset_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powerset_zero : @powerset α 0 = {0}

name: powerset_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powerset_cons (a : α) (s) : powerset (a ::ₘ s) = powerset s + map (cons a) (powerset s)
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn s fun l => by simp [Function.comp_def]

name: mem_powerset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_powerset {s t : Multiset α} : s ∈ powerset t ↔ s ≤ t
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ s t <| by simp [Subperm, and_comm]

name: map_single_le_powerset
statement: theorem map_single_le_powerset (s : Multiset α) : s.map singleton ≤ powerset s
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn s fun l => by
    simp only [powerset_coe, quot_mk_to_coe, coe_le, map_coe]
    change l.map (((↑) : List α → Multiset α) ∘ pure) <+~ (sublists l).map (↑)
    rw [← List.map_map]
    exact ((map_pure_sublist_sublists _).map _).subperm

name: zero_mem_powerset
statement: theorem zero_mem_powerset (s : Multiset α) : 0 ∈ s.powerset

name: self_mem_powerset
statement: theorem self_mem_powerset (s : Multiset α) : s ∈ s.powerset

name: card_powerset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_powerset (s : Multiset α) : card (powerset s) = 2 ^ card s

name: powerset_eq_singleton_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powerset_eq_singleton_zero_iff (s : Multiset α) : powerset s = {0} ↔ s = 0 where
  mpr
proof:
:= by
    intro rfl
    exact powerset_zero
  mp powerset := by
    simpa using congr(card $powerset)

name: revzip_powersetAux
statement: theorem revzip_powersetAux {l : List α} ⦃x⦄ (h : x ∈ revzip (powersetAux l)) : x.1 + x.2 = ↑l
proof:
:= by
  rw [revzip, powersetAux_eq_map_coe, ← map_reverse, zip_map, ← revzip, List.mem_map] at h
  simp only [Prod.map_apply, Prod.exists] at h
  rcases h with ⟨l₁, l₂, h, rfl, rfl⟩
  exact Quot.sound (revzip_sublists _ _ _ h)

name: revzip_powersetAux'
statement:
theorem revzip_powersetAux' {l : List α} ⦃x⦄ (h : x ∈ revzip (powersetAux' l)) :
    x.1 + x.2 = ↑l
proof:
:= by
  rw [revzip, powersetAux', ← map_reverse, zip_map, ← revzip, List.mem_map] at h
  simp only [Prod.map_apply, Prod.exists] at h
  rcases h with ⟨l₁, l₂, h, rfl, rfl⟩
  exact Quot.sound (revzip_sublists' _ _ _ h)

name: revzip_powersetAux_lemma
proof:
:= by
  have :
    Forall₂ (fun (p : Multiset α × Multiset α) (s : Multiset α) => p = (s, ↑l - s)) (revzip l')
      ((revzip l').map Prod.fst) := by
    rw [forall₂_map_right_iff, forall₂_same]
    rintro ⟨s, t⟩ h
    dsimp
    rw [← H h, add_tsub_cancel_left]
  rw [← forall₂_eq_eq_eq, forall₂_map_right_iff]
  simpa using this

name: revzip_powersetAux_perm_aux'
statement:
theorem revzip_powersetAux_perm_aux' {l : List α} :
    revzip (powersetAux l) ~ revzip (powersetAux' l)
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq α
  rw [revzip_powersetAux_lemma l revzip_powersetAux, revzip_powersetAux_lemma l revzip_powersetAux']
  exact powersetAux_perm_powersetAux'.map _

name: revzip_powersetAux_perm
statement:
theorem revzip_powersetAux_perm {l₁ l₂ : List α} (p : l₁ ~ l₂) :
    revzip (powersetAux l₁) ~ revzip (powersetAux l₂)
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq α
  simp only [fun l : List α => revzip_powersetAux_lemma l revzip_powersetAux, coe_eq_coe.2 p]
  exact (powersetAux_perm p).map _

name: powerset_le_powerset_iff_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powerset_le_powerset_iff_le {s t : Multiset α} :
    s.powerset ≤ t.powerset ↔ s ≤ t where
  mp powerset
proof:
:= Multiset.mem_powerset.mp <| Multiset.mem_of_le powerset (self_mem_powerset s)
  mpr le :=
    leInductionOn le fun hsub => by
      rw [powerset_coe', powerset_coe', coe_le]
      apply Sublist.subperm
      apply Sublist.map
      exact Sublist.sublists' hsub

name: powerset_injective
statement: lemma powerset_injective : Function.Injective (@Multiset.powerset α)
proof:
:= by
  intro a₁ a₂ a
  exact le_antisymm
    (powerset_le_powerset_iff_le.mp (le_of_eq a))
    (powerset_le_powerset_iff_le.mp (le_of_eq a.symm))

name: powerset_strictMono
statement: lemma powerset_strictMono : StrictMono (@Multiset.powerset α)

name: powerset_mono
statement: lemma powerset_mono : Monotone (@Multiset.powerset α)

name: powersetCardAux_eq_map_coe
statement:
theorem powersetCardAux_eq_map_coe {n} {l : List α} :
    powersetCardAux n l = (sublistsLen n l).map (↑)

name: mem_powersetCardAux
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_powersetCardAux {n} {l : List α} {s} : s ∈ powersetCardAux n l ↔ s ≤ ↑l ∧ card s = n
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn s <| by
    simp only [quot_mk_to_coe, powersetCardAux_eq_map_coe, List.mem_map, mem_sublistsLen,
      coe_eq_coe, coe_le, Subperm, coe_card]
    exact fun l₁ =>
      ⟨fun ⟨l₂, ⟨s, e⟩, p⟩ => ⟨⟨_, p, s⟩, p.symm.length_eq.trans e⟩,
       fun ⟨⟨l₂, p, s⟩, e⟩ => ⟨_, ⟨s, p.length_eq.trans e⟩, p⟩⟩

name: powersetCardAux_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powersetCardAux_zero (l : List α) : powersetCardAux 0 l = [0]

name: powersetCardAux_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powersetCardAux_nil (n : ℕ) : powersetCardAux (n + 1) (@nil α) = []

name: powersetCardAux_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powersetCardAux_cons (n : ℕ) (a : α) (l : List α) :
    powersetCardAux (n + 1) (a :: l) =
      powersetCardAux (n + 1) l ++ List.map (cons a) (powersetCardAux n l)

name: powersetCardAux_perm
statement:
theorem powersetCardAux_perm {n} {l₁ l₂ : List α} (p : l₁ ~ l₂) :
    powersetCardAux n l₁ ~ powersetCardAux n l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing l₁ l₂ with | zero => simp | succ n IHn => ?_
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ p IH =>
    simp only [powersetCardAux_cons]
    exact IH.append ((IHn p).map _)
  | swap a b =>
    simp only [powersetCardAux_cons, append_assoc]
    apply Perm.append_left
    cases n
    · simp [Perm.swap]
    simp only [powersetCardAux_cons, map_append, List.map_map]
    rw [← append_assoc, ← append_assoc,
      (by funext s; simp [cons_swap] : cons b ∘ cons a = cons a ∘ cons b)]
    exact perm_append_comm.append_right _
  | trans _ _ IH₁ IH₂ => exact IH₁.trans IH₂

name: powersetCard_coe'
statement: theorem powersetCard_coe' (n) (l : List α) : @powersetCard α n l = powersetCardAux n l

name: powersetCard_coe
statement:
theorem powersetCard_coe (n) (l : List α) :
    @powersetCard α n l = ((sublistsLen n l).map (↑) : List (Multiset α))
proof:
:=
  congr_arg ((↑) : List (Multiset α) → Multiset (Multiset α)) powersetCardAux_eq_map_coe

name: powersetCard_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powersetCard_zero_left (s : Multiset α) : powersetCard 0 s = {0}
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn s fun l => by simp [powersetCard_coe']

name: powersetCard_zero_right
statement: theorem powersetCard_zero_right (n : ℕ) : @powersetCard α (n + 1) 0 = 0

name: powersetCard_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powersetCard_cons (n : ℕ) (a : α) (s) :
    powersetCard (n + 1) (a ::ₘ s) = powersetCard (n + 1) s + map (cons a) (powersetCard n s)
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn s fun l => by simp [powersetCard_coe']

name: powersetCard_one
statement: theorem powersetCard_one (s : Multiset α) : powersetCard 1 s = s.map singleton
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn s fun l ↦ by
    simp [powersetCard_coe, sublistsLen_one, map_reverse, Function.comp_def]

name: mem_powersetCard
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_powersetCard {n : ℕ} {s t : Multiset α} : s ∈ powersetCard n t ↔ s ≤ t ∧ card s = n
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn t fun l => by simp [powersetCard_coe']

name: card_powersetCard
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_powersetCard (n : ℕ) (s : Multiset α) :
    card (powersetCard n s) = Nat.choose (card s) n

name: powersetCard_le_powerset
statement: theorem powersetCard_le_powerset (n : ℕ) (s : Multiset α) : powersetCard n s ≤ powerset s
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn s fun l => by
    simp only [quot_mk_to_coe, powersetCard_coe, powerset_coe', coe_le]
    exact ((sublistsLen_sublist_sublists' _ _).map _).subperm

name: powersetCard_mono
statement:
theorem powersetCard_mono (n : ℕ) {s t : Multiset α} (h : s ≤ t) :
    powersetCard n s ≤ powersetCard n t
proof:
:=
  leInductionOn h fun {l₁ l₂} h => by
    simp only [powersetCard_coe, coe_le]
    exact ((sublistsLen_sublist_of_sublist _ h).map _).subperm

name: powersetCard_eq_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powersetCard_eq_empty {α : Type*} (n : ℕ) {s : Multiset α} (h : card s < n) :
    powersetCard n s = 0

name: powersetCard_card_add
statement:
theorem powersetCard_card_add (s : Multiset α) {i : ℕ} (hi : 0 < i) :
    s.powersetCard (card s + i) = 0

name: powersetCard_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powersetCard_self (s : Multiset α) : powersetCard s.card s = {s}
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons _ _ ih => simp [ih]

name: powersetCard_map
statement:
theorem powersetCard_map {β : Type*} (f : α → β) (n : ℕ) (s : Multiset α) :
    powersetCard n (s.map f) = (powersetCard n s).map (map f)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction generalizing n with
  | empty => cases n <;> simp [powersetCard_zero_left]
  | cons t s ih => cases n <;> simp [ih]

name: _root_.Disjoint.powersetCard_powersetCard_multiset
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_left]
  intro u hu hv
  rw [mem_powersetCard] at hu hv
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := card_pos_iff_exists_mem.mp
    (hn.elim (fun h => hu.2.symm ▸ Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h)
             (fun h => hv.2.symm ▸ Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h))
  exact disjoint_left.1 h (mem_of_le hu.1 hx) (mem_of_le hv.1 hx)

name: disjoint_powersetCard_of_ne
statement:
lemma disjoint_powersetCard_of_ne {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≠ n) (s t : Multiset α) :
    Disjoint (powersetCard m s) (powersetCard n t)

name: pairwise_disjoint_powersetCard
statement:
theorem pairwise_disjoint_powersetCard (s : Multiset α) :
    _root_.Pairwise fun i j => Disjoint (s.powersetCard i) (s.powersetCard j)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hij => disjoint_powersetCard_of_ne hij s s

name: bind_powerset_len
statement:
theorem bind_powerset_len {α : Type*} (S : Multiset α) :
    (bind (Multiset.range (card S + 1)) fun k => S.powersetCard k) = S.powerset
proof:
:= by
  induction S using Quotient.inductionOn
  simp_rw [quot_mk_to_coe, powerset_coe', powersetCard_coe, ← coe_range, coe_bind,
    ← List.map_flatMap, coe_card]
  exact coe_eq_coe.mpr ((List.range_bind_sublistsLen_perm _).map _)

name: nodup_powerset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nodup_powerset {s : Multiset α} : Nodup (powerset s) ↔ Nodup s
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => (nodup_of_le (map_single_le_powerset _) h).of_map _,
    Quotient.inductionOn s fun l h => by
      simp only [quot_mk_to_coe, powerset_coe', coe_nodup]
      refine (nodup_sublists'.2 h).map_on ?_
      exact fun x sx y sy e =>
        (h.perm_iff_eq_of_sublist (mem_sublists'.1 sx) (mem_sublists'.1 sy)).1 (Quotient.exact e)⟩

name: Nodup.powersetCard
statement:
protected theorem Nodup.powersetCard {n : ℕ} {s : Multiset α} (h : Nodup s) :
    Nodup (powersetCard n s)

name: coe_replicate
statement: theorem coe_replicate (n : ℕ) (a : α) : (List.replicate n a : Multiset α) = replicate n a

name: replicate_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem replicate_zero (a : α) : replicate 0 a = 0

name: replicate_succ
statement: @[simp] theorem replicate_succ (a : α) (n) : replicate (n + 1) a = a ::ₘ replicate n a

name: replicate_add
statement: theorem replicate_add (m n : ℕ) (a : α) : replicate (m + n) a = replicate m a + replicate n a

name: replicate_one
statement: theorem replicate_one (a : α) : replicate 1 a = {a}

name: card_replicate
statement: @[simp] theorem card_replicate (n) (a : α) : card (replicate n a) = n

name: mem_replicate
statement: theorem mem_replicate {a b : α} {n : ℕ} : b ∈ replicate n a ↔ n ≠ 0 ∧ b = a

name: eq_of_mem_replicate
statement: theorem eq_of_mem_replicate {a b : α} {n} : b ∈ replicate n a → b = a

name: eq_replicate_card
statement: theorem eq_replicate_card {a : α} {s : Multiset α} : s = replicate (card s) a ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, b = a
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _l => coe_eq_coe.trans <| perm_replicate.trans eq_replicate_length

name: eq_replicate
statement:
theorem eq_replicate {a : α} {n} {s : Multiset α} :
    s = replicate n a ↔ card s = n ∧ ∀ b ∈ s, b = a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h.symm ▸ ⟨card_replicate _ _, fun _b => eq_of_mem_replicate⟩,
    fun ⟨e, al⟩ => e ▸ eq_replicate_of_mem al⟩

name: replicate_right_injective
statement: theorem replicate_right_injective {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : Injective (@replicate α n)

name: replicate_right_inj
statement:
@[simp] theorem replicate_right_inj {a b : α} {n : ℕ} (h : n ≠ 0) :
    replicate n a = replicate n b ↔ a = b

name: replicate_left_injective
statement: theorem replicate_left_injective (a : α) : Injective (replicate · a)

name: replicate_subset_singleton
statement: theorem replicate_subset_singleton (n : ℕ) (a : α) : replicate n a ⊆ {a}

name: replicate_le_coe
statement: theorem replicate_le_coe {a : α} {n} {l : List α} : replicate n a ≤ l ↔ List.replicate n a <+ l
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨_l', p, s⟩ => perm_replicate.1 p ▸ s, Sublist.subperm⟩

name: replicate_le_replicate
statement: theorem replicate_le_replicate (a : α) {k n : ℕ} : replicate k a ≤ replicate n a ↔ k ≤ n

name: replicate_mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem replicate_mono (a : α) {k n : ℕ} (h : k ≤ n) : replicate k a ≤ replicate n a

name: le_replicate_iff
statement:
theorem le_replicate_iff {m : Multiset α} {a : α} {n : ℕ} :
    m ≤ replicate n a ↔ ∃ k ≤ n, m = replicate k a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨card m, (card_mono h).trans_eq (card_replicate _ _),
      eq_replicate_card.2 fun _ hb => eq_of_mem_replicate <| subset_of_le h hb⟩,
    fun ⟨_, hkn, hm⟩ => hm.symm ▸ (replicate_le_replicate _).2 hkn⟩

name: lt_replicate_succ
statement:
theorem lt_replicate_succ {m : Multiset α} {x : α} {n : ℕ} :
    m < replicate (n + 1) x ↔ m ≤ replicate n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_iff_cons_le]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x', hx'⟩
    have := eq_of_mem_replicate (mem_of_le hx' (mem_cons_self _ _))
    rwa [this, replicate_succ, cons_le_cons_iff] at hx'
  · intro h
    rw [replicate_succ]
    exact ⟨x, cons_le_cons _ h⟩

name: count_replicate_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_replicate_self (a : α) (n : ℕ) : count a (replicate n a) = n
proof:
:= by
  convert! List.count_replicate_self (a := a)
  rw [← coe_count, coe_replicate]

name: count_replicate
statement: theorem count_replicate (a b : α) (n : ℕ) : count a (replicate n b) = if b = a then n else 0
proof:
:= by
  convert! List.count_replicate (a := a)
  · rw [← coe_count, coe_replicate]
  · simp

name: le_count_iff_replicate_le
statement:
theorem le_count_iff_replicate_le {a : α} {s : Multiset α} {n : ℕ} :
    n ≤ count a s ↔ replicate n a ≤ s
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _l => by
    simp only [quot_mk_to_coe'', coe_count]
    exact replicate_sublist_iff.symm.trans replicate_le_coe.symm

name: rel_replicate_left
statement:
theorem rel_replicate_left {m : Multiset α} {a : α} {r : α → α → Prop} {n : ℕ} :
    (replicate n a).Rel r m ↔ card m = n ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ m → r a x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    ⟨(card_eq_card_of_rel h).symm.trans (card_replicate _ _), fun x hx => by
      obtain ⟨b, hb1, hb2⟩ := exists_mem_of_rel_of_mem (rel_flip.2 h) hx
      rwa [eq_of_mem_replicate hb1] at hb2⟩,
    fun h =>
    rel_of_forall (fun _ _ hx hy => (eq_of_mem_replicate hx).symm ▸ h.2 _ hy)
      (Eq.trans (card_replicate _ _) h.1.symm)⟩

name: rel_replicate_right
statement:
theorem rel_replicate_right {m : Multiset α} {a : α} {r : α → α → Prop} {n : ℕ} :
    m.Rel r (replicate n a) ↔ card m = n ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ m → r x a

name: nodup_iff_le
statement: theorem nodup_iff_le {s : Multiset α} : Nodup s ↔ ∀ a : α, ¬a ::ₘ a ::ₘ 0 ≤ s
proof:
:=
  Quot.induction_on s fun _ =>
    nodup_iff_sublist.trans <| forall_congr' fun a => not_congr (@replicate_le_coe _ a 2 _).symm

name: nodup_iff_ne_cons_cons
statement: theorem nodup_iff_ne_cons_cons {s : Multiset α} : s.Nodup ↔ ∀ a t, s ≠ a ::ₘ a ::ₘ t
proof:
:=
  nodup_iff_le.trans
    ⟨fun h a _ s_eq => h a (s_eq.symm ▸ cons_le_cons a (cons_le_cons a (zero_le _))), fun h a le =>
      let ⟨t, s_eq⟩ := le_iff_exists_add.mp le
      h a t (by rwa [cons_add, cons_add, Multiset.zero_add] at s_eq)⟩

name: nodup_iff_pairwise
statement: theorem nodup_iff_pairwise {α} {s : Multiset α} : Nodup s ↔ Pairwise (· ≠ ·) s

name: Nodup.pairwise
statement: protected theorem Nodup.pairwise : (∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ s, a ≠ b → r a b) → Nodup s → Pairwise r s
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn s fun l h hl => ⟨l, rfl, hl.imp_of_mem fun {a b} ha hb => h a ha b hb⟩

name: filter_coe
statement: @[simp, norm_cast] lemma filter_coe (l : List α) : filter p l = l.filter p

name: filter_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_zero : filter p 0 = 0

name: filter_congr
statement:
@[congr]
theorem filter_congr {p q : α → Prop} [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred q] {s : Multiset α} :
    (∀ x ∈ s, p x ↔ q x) → filter p s = filter q s
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _l h => congr_arg ofList <| List.filter_congr <| by simpa using h

name: filter_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_add (s t : Multiset α) : filter p (s + t) = filter p s + filter p t
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ s t fun _l₁ _l₂ => congr_arg ofList <| filter_append _ _

name: filter_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_le (s : Multiset α) : filter p s ≤ s

name: filter_subset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_subset (s : Multiset α) : filter p s ⊆ s

name: filter_le_filter
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem filter_le_filter {s t} (h : s ≤ t) : filter p s ≤ filter p t

name: monotone_filter_left
statement: theorem monotone_filter_left : Monotone (filter p)

name: monotone_filter_right
statement:
theorem monotone_filter_right (s : Multiset α) ⦃p q : α → Prop⦄ [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred q]
    (h : ∀ b, p b → q b) :
    s.filter p ≤ s.filter q
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn s fun l => (l.monotone_filter_right <| by simpa using h).subperm

name: filter_cons_of_pos
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_cons_of_pos {a : α} (s) : p a → filter p (a ::ₘ s) = a ::ₘ filter p s
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _ h => congr_arg ofList <| List.filter_cons_of_pos <| by simpa using h

name: filter_cons_of_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_cons_of_neg {a : α} (s) : ¬p a → filter p (a ::ₘ s) = filter p s
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _ h => congr_arg ofList <| List.filter_cons_of_neg <| by simpa using h

name: mem_filter
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_filter {a : α} {s} : a ∈ filter p s ↔ a ∈ s ∧ p a

name: of_mem_filter
statement: theorem of_mem_filter {a : α} {s} (h : a ∈ filter p s) : p a

name: mem_of_mem_filter
statement: theorem mem_of_mem_filter {a : α} {s} (h : a ∈ filter p s) : a ∈ s

name: mem_filter_of_mem
statement: theorem mem_filter_of_mem {a : α} {l} (m : a ∈ l) (h : p a) : a ∈ filter p l

name: filter_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_eq_self {s} : filter p s = s ↔ ∀ a ∈ s, p a
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _l =>
    Iff.trans ⟨fun h => filter_sublist.eq_of_length (congr_arg card h),
      congr_arg ofList⟩ <| by simp

name: filter_eq_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_eq_nil {s} : filter p s = 0 ↔ ∀ a ∈ s, ¬p a
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _l =>
    Iff.trans ⟨fun h => eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (congr_arg card h), congr_arg ofList⟩ (by simp)

name: filter_true
statement:
@[simp]
lemma filter_true (s : Multiset α) : s.filter (fun _ ↦ True) = s

name: filter_false
statement:
@[simp]
lemma filter_false (s : Multiset α) : s.filter (fun _ ↦ False) = 0

name: le_filter
statement: theorem le_filter {s t} : s ≤ filter p t ↔ s ≤ t ∧ ∀ a ∈ s, p a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨le_trans h (filter_le _ _), fun _a m => of_mem_filter (mem_of_le h m)⟩, fun ⟨h, al⟩ =>
    filter_eq_self.2 al ▸ filter_le_filter p h⟩

name: filter_cons
statement:
theorem filter_cons {a : α} (s : Multiset α) :
    filter p (a ::ₘ s) = (if p a then {a} else 0) + filter p s
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [filter_cons_of_pos _ h, singleton_add]
  · rw [filter_cons_of_neg _ h, Multiset.zero_add]

name: filter_singleton
statement:
theorem filter_singleton {a : α} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    filter p {a} = if p a then {a} else ∅
proof:
:= by
  simp only [singleton, filter_cons, filter_zero, Multiset.add_zero, empty_eq_zero]

name: filter_filter
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_filter (q) [DecidablePred q] (s : Multiset α) :
    filter p (filter q s) = filter (fun a => p a ∧ q a) s
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun l => by simp

name: filter_comm
statement:
lemma filter_comm (q) [DecidablePred q] (s : Multiset α) :
    filter p (filter q s) = filter q (filter p s)

name: filter_add_filter
statement:
theorem filter_add_filter (q) [DecidablePred q] (s : Multiset α) :
    filter p s + filter q s = filter (fun a => p a ∨ q a) s + filter (fun a => p a ∧ q a) s
proof:
:=
  Multiset.induction_on s rfl fun a s IH => by by_cases p a <;> by_cases q a <;> simp [*]

name: filter_add_not
statement: theorem filter_add_not (s : Multiset α) : filter p s + filter (fun a => ¬p a) s = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [filter_add_filter, filter_eq_self.2, filter_eq_nil.2]
  · simp only [Multiset.add_zero]
  · simp [-Bool.not_eq_true, -not_and]
  · simp only [implies_true, Decidable.em]

name: filter_map
statement: theorem filter_map (f : β → α) (s : Multiset β) : filter p (map f s) = map f (filter (p ∘ f) s)
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun l => by simp [List.filter_map]; rfl

name: map_filter
statement:
lemma map_filter {f : α → β} (hf : Injective f) (s : Multiset α)
    [DecidablePred fun b => ∃ a, p a ∧ f a = b] :
    (s.filter p).map f = (s.map f).filter fun b => ∃ a, p a ∧ f a = b

name: card_filter_le_iff
statement:
lemma card_filter_le_iff (s : Multiset α) (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (n : ℕ) :
    card (s.filter P) ≤ n ↔ ∀ s' ≤ s, n < card s' → ∃ a ∈ s', ¬ P a
proof:
:= by
  fconstructor
  · intro H s' hs' s'_card
    by_contra! rid
    have card := card_le_card (monotone_filter_left P hs') |>.trans H
    exact s'_card.not_ge (filter_eq_self.mpr rid ▸ card)
  · contrapose!
    exact fun H ↦ ⟨s.filter P, filter_le _ _, H, fun a ha ↦ (mem_filter.mp ha).2⟩

name: filterMap_coe
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma filterMap_coe (f : α → Option β) (l : List α) : filterMap f l = l.filterMap f

name: filterMap_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filterMap_zero (f : α → Option β) : filterMap f 0 = 0

name: filterMap_cons_none
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filterMap_cons_none {f : α → Option β} (a : α) (s : Multiset α) (h : f a = none) :
    filterMap f (a ::ₘ s) = filterMap f s
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _ => congr_arg ofList <| List.filterMap_cons_none h

name: filterMap_cons_some
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _ => congr_arg ofList <| List.filterMap_cons_some h

name: filterMap_cons
statement:
theorem filterMap_cons (f : α → Option β) (a : α) (s : Multiset α) :
    filterMap f (a ::ₘ s) = ((f a).map singleton).getD 0 + filterMap f s
proof:
:= by
  cases h : f a with
  | none => simp [filterMap_cons_none a s h]
  | some b => simp [filterMap_cons_some f a s h]

name: filterMap_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filterMap_add (f : α → Option β) (s t : Multiset α) :
    filterMap f (s + t) = filterMap f s + filterMap f t
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ s t fun _l₁ _l₂ => congr_arg ofList <| filterMap_append

name: filterMap_eq_map
statement: theorem filterMap_eq_map (f : α → β) : filterMap (some ∘ f) = map f
proof:
:=
  funext fun s =>
    Quot.inductionOn s fun l => congr_arg ofList <| congr_fun List.filterMap_eq_map l

name: filterMap_eq_filter
statement: theorem filterMap_eq_filter : filterMap (Option.guard p) = filter p
proof:
:=
  funext fun s =>
    Quot.inductionOn s fun l => congr_arg ofList <| by
      rw [← List.filterMap_eq_filter]

name: filterMap_filterMap
statement:
theorem filterMap_filterMap (f : α → Option β) (g : β → Option γ) (s : Multiset α) :
    filterMap g (filterMap f s) = filterMap (fun x => (f x).bind g) s
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _ => congr_arg ofList List.filterMap_filterMap

name: map_filterMap
statement:
theorem map_filterMap (f : α → Option β) (g : β → γ) (s : Multiset α) :
    map g (filterMap f s) = filterMap (fun x => (f x).map g) s
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _ => congr_arg ofList List.map_filterMap

name: filterMap_map
statement:
theorem filterMap_map (f : α → β) (g : β → Option γ) (s : Multiset α) :
    filterMap g (map f s) = filterMap (g ∘ f) s
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _ => congr_arg ofList List.filterMap_map

name: filter_filterMap
statement:
theorem filter_filterMap (f : α → Option β) (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (s : Multiset α) :
    filter p (filterMap f s) = filterMap (fun x => (f x).filter p) s
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _ => congr_arg ofList List.filter_filterMap

name: filterMap_filter
statement:
theorem filterMap_filter (f : α → Option β) (s : Multiset α) :
    filterMap f (filter p s) = filterMap (fun x => if p x then f x else none) s
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun l => congr_arg ofList <| by
    simpa using List.filterMap_filter (f := f) (p := p)

name: filterMap_some
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filterMap_some (s : Multiset α) : filterMap some s = s
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _ => congr_arg ofList List.filterMap_some

name: mem_filterMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_filterMap (f : α → Option β) (s : Multiset α) {b : β} :
    b ∈ filterMap f s ↔ ∃ a, a ∈ s ∧ f a = some b

name: map_filterMap_of_inv
statement:
theorem map_filterMap_of_inv (f : α → Option β) (g : β → α) (H : ∀ x : α, (f x).map g = some x)
    (s : Multiset α) : map g (filterMap f s) = s
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _ => congr_arg ofList <| List.map_filterMap_of_inv H

name: filterMap_le_filterMap
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem filterMap_le_filterMap (f : α → Option β) {s t : Multiset α} (h : s ≤ t) :
    filterMap f s ≤ filterMap f t

name: map_filter_eq_filterMap
statement:
theorem map_filter_eq_filterMap (f : α → β) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (s : Multiset α) :
    map f (filter p s) = filterMap (fun a => if p a then .some (f a) else .none) s
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ih =>
    simp only [filter_cons, map_add, ih, filterMap_cons, Option.map_ite]; clear ih; congr
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: countP_eq_card_filter
statement: theorem countP_eq_card_filter (s) : countP p s = card (filter p s)

name: countP_filter
statement:
@[simp]
theorem countP_filter (q) [DecidablePred q] (s : Multiset α) :
    countP p (filter q s) = countP (fun a => p a ∧ q a) s

name: countP_eq_countP_filter_add
statement:
theorem countP_eq_countP_filter_add (s) (p q : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred q] :
    countP p s = (filter q s).countP p + (filter (fun a => ¬q a) s).countP p
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun l => by
    convert! l.countP_eq_countP_filter_add (p ·) (q ·)
    simp

name: countP_map
statement:
theorem countP_map (f : α → β) (s : Multiset α) (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    countP p (map f s) = card (s.filter fun a => p (f a))
proof:
:= by
  refine Multiset.induction_on s ?_ fun a t IH => ?_
  · rw [map_zero, countP_zero, filter_zero, card_zero]
  · rw [map_cons, countP_cons, IH, filter_cons, card_add, apply_ite card, card_zero, card_singleton,
      Nat.add_comm]

name: filter_attach
statement:
lemma filter_attach (s : Multiset α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    (s.attach.filter fun a : {a // a ∈ s} ↦ p ↑a) =
      (s.filter p).attach.map (Subtype.map id fun _ ↦ Multiset.mem_of_mem_filter)
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn s fun l ↦ congr_arg _ (List.filter_attach l p)

name: count_filter_of_pos
statement:
@[simp]
theorem count_filter_of_pos {p} [DecidablePred p] {a} {s : Multiset α} (h : p a) :
    count a (filter p s) = count a s
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _l => by
    simp only [quot_mk_to_coe'', filter_coe, coe_count]
    apply count_filter
    simpa using h

name: count_filter_of_neg
statement:
theorem count_filter_of_neg {p} [DecidablePred p] {a} {s : Multiset α} (h : ¬p a) :
    count a (filter p s) = 0

name: count_filter
statement:
theorem count_filter {p} [DecidablePred p] {a} {s : Multiset α} :
    count a (filter p s) = if p a then count a s else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · exact count_filter_of_pos h
  · exact count_filter_of_neg h

name: count_map
statement:
theorem count_map {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) (s : Multiset α) [DecidableEq β] (b : β) :
    count b (map f s) = card (s.filter fun a => b = f a)

name: count_map_eq_count
statement:
theorem count_map_eq_count [DecidableEq β] (f : α → β) (s : Multiset α)
    (hf : Set.InjOn f { x : α | x ∈ s }) (x) (H : x ∈ s) : (s.map f).count (f x) = s.count x
proof:
:= by
  suffices (filter (fun a : α => f x = f a) s).count x = card (filter (fun a : α => f x = f a) s) by
    rw [count, countP_map, ← this]
    exact count_filter_of_pos <| rfl
  · rw [eq_replicate_card.2 fun b hb => (hf H (mem_filter.1 hb).left _).symm]
    · simp
    · simp only [mem_filter, and_imp, @eq_comm _ (f x), imp_self, implies_true]

name: count_map_eq_count'
statement:
theorem count_map_eq_count' [DecidableEq β] (f : α → β) (s : Multiset α) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (x : α) : (s.map f).count (f x) = s.count x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : x ∈ s
  · exact count_map_eq_count f _ hf.injOn _ H
  · rw [count_eq_zero_of_notMem H, count_eq_zero, mem_map]
    rintro ⟨k, hks, hkx⟩
    rw [hf hkx] at hks
    contradiction

name: filter_eq'
statement: theorem filter_eq' (s : Multiset α) (b : α) : s.filter (· = b) = replicate (count b s) b
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn s fun l => by
    simp only [quot_mk_to_coe, filter_coe, coe_count]
    rw [List.filter_eq, coe_replicate]

name: filter_eq
statement: theorem filter_eq (s : Multiset α) (b : α) : s.filter (Eq b) = replicate (count b s) b

name: filter_sub
statement:
@[simp]
lemma filter_sub (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (s t : Multiset α) :
    filter p (s - t) = filter p s - filter p t
proof:
:= by
  revert s; refine Multiset.induction_on t (by simp) fun a t IH s => ?_
  rw [sub_cons, IH]
  by_cases h : p a
  · rw [filter_cons_of_pos _ h, sub_cons]
    congr
    by_cases m : a ∈ s
    · rw [← cons_inj_right a, ← filter_cons_of_pos _ h, cons_erase (mem_filter_of_mem m h),
        cons_erase m]
    · rw [erase_of_notMem m, erase_of_notMem (mt mem_of_mem_filter m)]
  · rw [filter_cons_of_neg _ h]
    by_cases m : a ∈ s
    · rw [(by rw [filter_cons_of_neg _ h] : filter p (erase s a) = filter p (a ::ₘ erase s a)),
        cons_erase m]
    · rw [erase_of_notMem m]

name: sub_filter_eq_filter_not
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sub_filter_eq_filter_not (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (s : Multiset α) :
    s - s.filter p = s.filter fun a ↦ ¬ p a
proof: := by ext a; by_cases h : p a <;> simp [h]

name: map_le_map_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_le_map_iff {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Injective f) {s t : Multiset α} :
    s.map f ≤ t.map f ↔ s ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  classical
    refine ⟨fun h => le_iff_count.mpr fun a => ?_, map_le_map⟩
    simpa [count_map_eq_count' f _ hf] using le_iff_count.mp h (f a)

name: count_eq_card_filter_eq
statement:
theorem count_eq_card_filter_eq [DecidableEq α] (s : Multiset α) (a : α) :
    s.count a = card (s.filter (a = ·))

name: map_count_True_eq_filter_card
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_count_True_eq_filter_card (s : Multiset α) (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    [DecidableEq Prop] : (s.map p).count True = card (s.filter p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [count_eq_card_filter_eq, eq_iff_iff, true_iff, filter_map, comp_apply, card_map]

name: filter_attach'
statement:
lemma filter_attach' (s : Multiset α) (p : {a // a ∈ s} → Prop) [DecidableEq α]
    [DecidablePred p] :
    s.attach.filter p =
      (s.filter fun x ↦ ∃ h, p ⟨x, h⟩).attach.map (Subtype.map id fun _ ↦ mem_of_mem_filter)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Multiset.map_injective Subtype.val_injective ?_
  rw [map_filter _ Subtype.val_injective]
  simp only [Subtype.exists, exists_and_right, exists_eq_right, attach_map_val, Subtype.map, id,
    map_map, comp]

name: Nodup.filter
statement: theorem Nodup.filter (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] {s} : Nodup s → Nodup (filter p s)

name: Nodup.erase_eq_filter
statement:
theorem Nodup.erase_eq_filter [DecidableEq α] (a : α) {s} :
    Nodup s → s.erase a = Multiset.filter (· ≠ a) s
proof:
:=
  Quot.induction_on s fun _ d =>
    congr_arg ((↑) : List α → Multiset α) <| by simpa using! List.Nodup.erase_eq_filter d a

name: Nodup.filterMap
statement:
protected theorem Nodup.filterMap (f : α → Option β) (H : ∀ a a' b, b ∈ f a → b ∈ f a' → a = a') :
    Nodup s → Nodup (filterMap f s)

name: Nodup.mem_erase_iff
statement:
theorem Nodup.mem_erase_iff [DecidableEq α] {a b : α} {l} (d : Nodup l) :
    a ∈ l.erase b ↔ a ≠ b ∧ a ∈ l

name: Nodup.notMem_erase
statement: theorem Nodup.notMem_erase [DecidableEq α] {a : α} {s} (h : Nodup s) : a ∉ s.erase a

name: quot_mk_to_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quot_mk_to_coe (l : List α) : @Eq (Multiset α) ⟦l⟧ l

name: quot_mk_to_coe'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quot_mk_to_coe' (l : List α) : @Eq (Multiset α) (Quot.mk (· ≈ ·) l) l

name: quot_mk_to_coe''
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quot_mk_to_coe'' (l : List α) : @Eq (Multiset α) (Quot.mk Setoid.r l) l

name: lift_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_coe {α β : Type*} (x : List α) (f : List α → β)
    (h : ∀ a b : List α, a ≈ b → f a = f b) : Quotient.lift f h (x : Multiset α) = f x

name: coe_eq_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_eq_coe {l₁ l₂ : List α} : (l₁ : Multiset α) = l₂ ↔ l₁ ~ l₂

name: mem_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_coe {a : α} {l : List α} : a ∈ (l : Multiset α) ↔ a ∈ l

name: coe_subset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_subset {l₁ l₂ : List α} : (l₁ : Multiset α) ⊆ l₂ ↔ l₁ ⊆ l₂

name: Subset.refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Subset.refl (s : Multiset α) : s ⊆ s

name: Subset.trans
statement: theorem Subset.trans {s t u : Multiset α} : s ⊆ t → t ⊆ u → s ⊆ u
proof: := fun h₁ h₂ _ m => h₂ (h₁ m)

name: subset_iff
statement: theorem subset_iff {s t : Multiset α} : s ⊆ t ↔ ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ∈ s → x ∈ t

name: mem_of_subset
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem mem_of_subset {s t : Multiset α} {a : α} (h : s ⊆ t) : a ∈ s → a ∈ t

name: subset_of_le
statement: theorem subset_of_le : s ≤ t → s ⊆ t

name: mem_of_le
statement: theorem mem_of_le (h : s ≤ t) : a ∈ s → a ∈ t

name: notMem_mono
statement: theorem notMem_mono (h : s ⊆ t) : a ∉ t → a ∉ s

name: coe_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_le {l₁ l₂ : List α} : (l₁ : Multiset α) ≤ l₂ ↔ l₁ <+~ l₂

name: leInductionOn
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem leInductionOn {C : Multiset α → Multiset α → Prop} {s t : Multiset α} (h : s ≤ t)
    (H : ∀ {l₁ l₂ : List α}, l₁ <+ l₂ → C l₁ l₂) : C s t
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ s t (fun l₁ _ ⟨l, p, s⟩ => (show ⟦l⟧ = ⟦l₁⟧ from Quot.sound p) ▸ H s) h

name: coe_card
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_card (l : List α) : card (l : Multiset α) = length l

name: card_le_card
statement: theorem card_le_card {s t : Multiset α} (h : s ≤ t) : card s ≤ card t

name: eq_of_le_of_card_le
statement: theorem eq_of_le_of_card_le {s t : Multiset α} (h : s ≤ t) : card t ≤ card s → s = t
proof:
:=
  leInductionOn h fun s h₂ => congr_arg _ <| s.eq_of_length_le h₂

name: card_lt_card
statement: theorem card_lt_card {s t : Multiset α} (h : s < t) : card s < card t
proof:
:=
  lt_of_not_ge fun h₂ => _root_.ne_of_lt h <| eq_of_le_of_card_le (le_of_lt h) h₂

name: card_mono
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem card_mono : Monotone (@card α)

name: card_strictMono
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma card_strictMono : StrictMono (@card α)

name: coe_reverse
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_reverse (l : List α) : (reverse l : Multiset α) = l

name: coe_pmap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_pmap {p : α → Prop} (f : ∀ a, p a → β) (l : List α) (H : ∀ a ∈ l, p a) :
    pmap f l H = l.pmap f H

name: pmap_congr
statement:
theorem pmap_congr {p q : α → Prop} {f : ∀ a, p a → β} {g : ∀ a, q a → β} (s : Multiset α) :
    ∀ {H₁ H₂}, (∀ a ∈ s, ∀ (h₁ h₂), f a h₁ = g a h₂) → pmap f s H₁ = pmap g s H₂
proof:
:=
  @(Quot.inductionOn s (fun l _H₁ _H₂ h => congr_arg _ <| List.pmap_congr_left l h))

name: mem_pmap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_pmap {p : α → Prop} {f : ∀ a, p a → β} {s H b} :
    b ∈ pmap f s H ↔ ∃ (a : _) (h : a ∈ s), f a (H a h) = b

name: card_pmap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_pmap {p : α → Prop} (f : ∀ a, p a → β) (s H) : card (pmap f s H) = card s

name: coe_attach
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_attach (l : List α) : @Eq (Multiset { x // x ∈ l }) (@attach α l) l.attach

name: mem_attach
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_attach (s : Multiset α) : ∀ x, x ∈ s.attach

name: card_attach
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_attach {m : Multiset α} : card (attach m) = card m

name: pairwise_coe_iff
statement:
theorem pairwise_coe_iff {r : α → α → Prop} {l : List α} :
    Multiset.Pairwise r l ↔ ∃ l' : List α, l ~ l' ∧ l'.Pairwise r

name: pairwise_coe_iff_pairwise
statement:
theorem pairwise_coe_iff_pairwise {r : α → α → Prop} [Std.Symm r] {l : List α} :
    Multiset.Pairwise r l ↔ l.Pairwise r
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨_l', Eq, h⟩ ↦ Quotient.exact Eq |>.pairwise_iff symm |>.mpr h, fun h ↦ ⟨l, rfl, h⟩⟩

name: coe_nodup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_nodup {l : List α} : @Nodup α l ↔ l.Nodup

name: Nodup.ext
statement: theorem Nodup.ext {s t : Multiset α} : Nodup s → Nodup t → (s = t ↔ ∀ a, a ∈ s ↔ a ∈ t)
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ s t fun _ _ d₁ d₂ => Quotient.eq.trans <| perm_ext_iff_of_nodup d₁ d₂

name: le_iff_subset
statement: theorem le_iff_subset {s t : Multiset α} : Nodup s → (s ≤ t ↔ s ⊆ t)
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ s t fun _ _ d => ⟨subset_of_le, d.subperm⟩

name: nodup_of_le
statement: theorem nodup_of_le {s t : Multiset α} (h : s ≤ t) : Nodup t → Nodup s

name: union_def
statement: lemma union_def (s t : Multiset α) : s ∪ t = s - t + t

name: le_union_left
statement: lemma le_union_left : s ≤ s ∪ t

name: le_union_right
statement: lemma le_union_right : t ≤ s ∪ t

name: eq_union_left
statement: lemma eq_union_left : t ≤ s → s ∪ t = s

name: union_le_union_right
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma union_le_union_right (h : s ≤ t) (u) : s ∪ u ≤ t ∪ u

name: union_le
statement: lemma union_le (h₁ : s ≤ u) (h₂ : t ≤ u) : s ∪ t ≤ u
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eq_union_left h₂]; exact union_le_union_right h₁ t

name: mem_union
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_union : a ∈ s ∪ t ↔ a ∈ s ∨ a ∈ t

name: map_union
statement:
@[simp]
lemma map_union [DecidableEq β] {f : α → β} (finj : Function.Injective f) {s t : Multiset α} :
    map f (s ∪ t) = map f s ∪ map f t
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ s t fun l₁ l₂ =>
    congr_arg ofList (by rw [List.map_append, List.map_diff finj])

name: zero_union
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_union : 0 ∪ s = s

name: union_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma union_zero : s ∪ 0 = s

name: count_union
statement:
@[simp]
lemma count_union (a : α) (s t : Multiset α) : count a (s ∪ t) = max (count a s) (count a t)

name: filter_union
statement:
@[simp] lemma filter_union (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (s t : Multiset α) :
    filter p (s ∪ t) = filter p s ∪ filter p t

name: inter_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma inter_zero (s : Multiset α) : s ∩ 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun l => congr_arg ofList l.bagInter_nil

name: zero_inter
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_inter (s : Multiset α) : 0 ∩ s = 0
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun l => congr_arg ofList l.nil_bagInter

name: cons_inter_of_pos
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cons_inter_of_pos (s : Multiset α) : a ∈ t → (a ::ₘ s) ∩ t = a ::ₘ s ∩ t.erase a
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ s t fun _l₁ _l₂ h => congr_arg ofList <| cons_bagInter_of_mem _ h

name: cons_inter_of_neg
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cons_inter_of_neg (s : Multiset α) : a ∉ t → (a ::ₘ s) ∩ t = s ∩ t
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ s t fun _l₁ _l₂ h => congr_arg ofList <| cons_bagInter_of_not_mem _ h

name: inter_le_left
statement: lemma inter_le_left : s ∩ t ≤ s

name: inter_le_right
statement: lemma inter_le_right : s ∩ t ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on generalizing t with
  | empty => exact (zero_inter t).symm ▸ zero_le _
  | cons a s IH =>
    by_cases h : a ∈ t
    · simpa [h] using cons_le_cons a (IH (t := t.erase a))
    · simp [h, IH]

name: le_inter
statement: lemma le_inter (h₁ : s ≤ t) (h₂ : s ≤ u) : s ≤ t ∩ u
proof:
:= by
  revert s u; refine @(Multiset.induction_on t ?_ fun a t IH => ?_) <;> intro s u h₁ h₂
  · simpa only [zero_inter] using h₁
  by_cases h : a ∈ u
  · rw [cons_inter_of_pos _ h, ← erase_le_iff_le_cons]
    exact IH (erase_le_iff_le_cons.2 h₁) (erase_le_erase _ h₂)
  · rw [cons_inter_of_neg _ h]
    exact IH ((le_cons_of_notMem <| mt (mem_of_le h₂) h).1 h₁) h₂

name: mem_inter
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_inter : a ∈ s ∩ t ↔ a ∈ s ∧ a ∈ t
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨mem_of_le inter_le_left h, mem_of_le inter_le_right h⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => by
    rw [← cons_erase h₁, cons_inter_of_pos _ h₂]; apply mem_cons_self⟩

name: sup_eq_union
statement: @[simp] lemma sup_eq_union (s t : Multiset α) : s ⊔ t = s ∪ t

name: inf_eq_inter
statement: @[simp] lemma inf_eq_inter (s t : Multiset α) : s ⊓ t = s ∩ t

name: le_inter_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma le_inter_iff : s ≤ t ∩ u ↔ s ≤ t ∧ s ≤ u

name: union_le_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma union_le_iff : s ∪ t ≤ u ↔ s ≤ u ∧ t ≤ u

name: union_comm
statement: lemma union_comm (s t : Multiset α) : s ∪ t = t ∪ s

name: inter_comm
statement: lemma inter_comm (s t : Multiset α) : s ∩ t = t ∩ s

name: eq_union_right
statement: lemma eq_union_right (h : s ≤ t) : s ∪ t = t

name: union_le_union_left
statement: @[gcongr] lemma union_le_union_left (h : s ≤ t) (u) : u ∪ s ≤ u ∪ t

name: union_le_add
statement: lemma union_le_add (s t : Multiset α) : s ∪ t ≤ s + t

name: union_add_distrib
statement: lemma union_add_distrib (s t u : Multiset α) : s ∪ t + u = s + u ∪ (t + u)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [(· ∪ ·), union, eq_comm, Multiset.add_assoc, Multiset.add_left_inj] using
    show s + u - (t + u) = s - t by
      rw [t.add_comm, Multiset.sub_add_eq_sub_sub, Multiset.add_sub_cancel_right]

name: add_union_distrib
statement: lemma add_union_distrib (s t u : Multiset α) : s + (t ∪ u) = s + t ∪ (s + u)

name: cons_union_distrib
statement: lemma cons_union_distrib (a : α) (s t : Multiset α) : a ::ₘ (s ∪ t) = a ::ₘ s ∪ a ::ₘ t
proof:
:= by
  simpa using add_union_distrib (a ::ₘ 0) s t

name: inter_add_distrib
statement: lemma inter_add_distrib (s t u : Multiset α) : s ∩ t + u = (s + u) ∩ (t + u)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := lt_iff_cons_le.1 <| h.lt_of_le <| le_inter
    (Multiset.add_le_add_right inter_le_left) (Multiset.add_le_add_right inter_le_right)
  rw [← cons_add] at ha
  exact (lt_cons_self (s ∩ t) a).not_ge <| le_inter
    (Multiset.le_of_add_le_add_right (ha.trans inter_le_left))
    (Multiset.le_of_add_le_add_right (ha.trans inter_le_right))

name: add_inter_distrib
statement: lemma add_inter_distrib (s t u : Multiset α) : s + t ∩ u = (s + t) ∩ (s + u)

name: cons_inter_distrib
statement: lemma cons_inter_distrib (a : α) (s t : Multiset α) : a ::ₘ s ∩ t = (a ::ₘ s) ∩ (a ::ₘ t)

name: union_add_inter
statement: lemma union_add_inter (s t : Multiset α) : s ∪ t + s ∩ t = s + t
proof:
:= by
  apply _root_.le_antisymm
  · rw [union_add_distrib]
    refine union_le (Multiset.add_le_add_left inter_le_right) ?_
    rw [Multiset.add_comm]
    exact Multiset.add_le_add_right inter_le_left
  · rw [Multiset.add_comm, add_inter_distrib]
    refine le_inter (Multiset.add_le_add_right le_union_right) ?_
    rw [Multiset.add_comm]
    exact Multiset.add_le_add_right le_union_left

name: sub_add_inter
statement: lemma sub_add_inter (s t : Multiset α) : s - t + s ∩ t = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [inter_comm]
  revert s; refine Multiset.induction_on t (by simp) fun a t IH s => ?_
  by_cases h : a ∈ s
  · rw [cons_inter_of_pos _ h, sub_cons, add_cons, IH, cons_erase h]
  · rw [cons_inter_of_neg _ h, sub_cons, erase_of_notMem h, IH]

name: sub_inter
statement: lemma sub_inter (s t : Multiset α) : s - s ∩ t = s - t

name: count_inter
statement:
@[simp]
lemma count_inter (a : α) (s t : Multiset α) : count a (s ∩ t) = min (count a s) (count a t)
proof:
:= by
  apply @Nat.add_left_cancel (count a (s - t))
  rw [← count_add, sub_add_inter, count_sub, Nat.sub_add_min_cancel]

name: coe_inter
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_inter (s t : List α) : (s ∩ t : Multiset α) = (s.bagInter t : List α)

name: filter_inter
statement:
@[simp] lemma filter_inter (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (s t : Multiset α) :
    filter p (s ∩ t) = filter p s ∩ filter p t
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_inter (filter_le_filter _ inter_le_left) (filter_le_filter _ inter_le_right)) <|
    le_filter.2 ⟨inf_le_inf (filter_le _ _) (filter_le _ _), fun _a h =>
      of_mem_filter (mem_of_le inter_le_left h)⟩

name: replicate_inter
statement:
@[simp]
theorem replicate_inter (n : ℕ) (x : α) (s : Multiset α) :
    replicate n x ∩ s = replicate (min n (s.count x)) x
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [count_inter, count_replicate, count_replicate]
  by_cases h : x = y
  · simp only [h, ite_true]
  · simp only [h, ite_false, Nat.zero_min]

name: inter_replicate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inter_replicate (s : Multiset α) (n : ℕ) (x : α) :
    s ∩ replicate n x = replicate (min (s.count x) n) x

name: inter_add_sub_of_add_eq_add
statement:
theorem inter_add_sub_of_add_eq_add [DecidableEq α] {M N P Q : Multiset α} (h : M + N = P + Q) :
    (N ∩ Q) + (P - M) = N
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Multiset.count_add, Multiset.count_inter, Multiset.count_sub]
  have h0 : M.count x + N.count x = P.count x + Q.count x := by
    rw [Multiset.ext] at h
    simp_all only [Multiset.count_add]
  omega

name: disjoint_left
statement: theorem disjoint_left {s t : Multiset α} : Disjoint s t ↔ ∀ {a}, a ∈ s → a ∉ t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h a hs ht ↦ ?_, fun h u hs ht ↦ ?_⟩
  · simpa using h (singleton_le.mpr hs) (singleton_le.mpr ht)
  · rw [le_bot_iff, bot_eq_zero, eq_zero_iff_forall_notMem]
    exact fun a ha ↦ h (subset_of_le hs ha) (subset_of_le ht ha)

name: coe_disjoint
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_disjoint (l₁ l₂ : List α) : Disjoint (l₁ : Multiset α) l₂ ↔ l₁.Disjoint l₂

name: disjoint_right
statement: theorem disjoint_right {s t : Multiset α} : Disjoint s t ↔ ∀ {a}, a ∈ t → a ∉ s

name: disjoint_iff_ne
statement: theorem disjoint_iff_ne {s t : Multiset α} : Disjoint s t ↔ ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ t, a ≠ b

name: disjoint_of_subset_left
statement:
theorem disjoint_of_subset_left {s t u : Multiset α} (h : s ⊆ u) (d : Disjoint u t) :
    Disjoint s t
proof:
:=
  disjoint_left.mpr fun ha ↦ disjoint_left.mp d <| h ha

name: disjoint_of_subset_right
statement:
theorem disjoint_of_subset_right {s t u : Multiset α} (h : t ⊆ u) (d : Disjoint s u) :
    Disjoint s t

name: zero_disjoint
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_disjoint (l : Multiset α) : Disjoint 0 l

name: singleton_disjoint
statement:
@[simp]
theorem singleton_disjoint {l : Multiset α} {a : α} : Disjoint {a} l ↔ a ∉ l

name: disjoint_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem disjoint_singleton {l : Multiset α} {a : α} : Disjoint l {a} ↔ a ∉ l

name: disjoint_add_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem disjoint_add_left {s t u : Multiset α} :
    Disjoint (s + t) u ↔ Disjoint s u ∧ Disjoint t u

name: disjoint_add_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem disjoint_add_right {s t u : Multiset α} :
    Disjoint s (t + u) ↔ Disjoint s t ∧ Disjoint s u

name: disjoint_cons_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem disjoint_cons_left {a : α} {s t : Multiset α} :
    Disjoint (a ::ₘ s) t ↔ a ∉ t ∧ Disjoint s t

name: disjoint_cons_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem disjoint_cons_right {a : α} {s t : Multiset α} :
    Disjoint s (a ::ₘ t) ↔ a ∉ s ∧ Disjoint s t

name: inter_eq_zero_iff_disjoint
statement:
theorem inter_eq_zero_iff_disjoint [DecidableEq α] {s t : Multiset α} :
    s ∩ t = 0 ↔ Disjoint s t

name: disjoint_union_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem disjoint_union_left [DecidableEq α] {s t u : Multiset α} :
    Disjoint (s ∪ t) u ↔ Disjoint s u ∧ Disjoint t u

name: disjoint_union_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem disjoint_union_right [DecidableEq α] {s t u : Multiset α} :
    Disjoint s (t ∪ u) ↔ Disjoint s t ∧ Disjoint s u

name: add_eq_union_iff_disjoint
statement:
theorem add_eq_union_iff_disjoint [DecidableEq α] {s t : Multiset α} :
    s + t = s ∪ t ↔ Disjoint s t
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← inter_eq_zero_iff_disjoint, ext, count_add, count_union, count_inter, count_zero,
    Nat.min_eq_zero_iff, Nat.add_eq_max_iff]

name: add_eq_union_left_of_le
statement:
lemma add_eq_union_left_of_le [DecidableEq α] {s t u : Multiset α} (h : t ≤ s) :
    u + s = u ∪ t ↔ Disjoint u s ∧ s = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_eq_union_iff_disjoint]
  refine ⟨fun h0 ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [and_iff_right_of_imp]
    · exact (Multiset.le_of_add_le_add_left <| h0.trans_le <| union_le_add u t).antisymm h
    · rintro rfl
      exact h0
  · rintro ⟨h0, rfl⟩
    exact h0

name: add_eq_union_right_of_le
statement:
lemma add_eq_union_right_of_le [DecidableEq α] {x y z : Multiset α} (h : z ≤ y) :
    x + y = x ∪ z ↔ y = z ∧ Disjoint x y
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [and_comm] using add_eq_union_left_of_le h

name: disjoint_map_map
statement:
theorem disjoint_map_map {f : α → γ} {g : β → γ} {s : Multiset α} {t : Multiset β} :
    Disjoint (s.map f) (t.map g) ↔ ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ t, f a ≠ g b

name: map_set_pairwise
statement:
theorem map_set_pairwise {f : α → β} {r : β → β → Prop} {m : Multiset α}
    (h : { a | a ∈ m }.Pairwise fun a₁ a₂ => r (f a₁) (f a₂)) : { b | b ∈ m.map f }.Pairwise r
proof:
:=
  fun b₁ h₁ b₂ h₂ hn => by
    obtain ⟨⟨a₁, H₁, rfl⟩, a₂, H₂, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.1 h₁, Multiset.mem_map.1 h₂
    exact h H₁ H₂ (mt (congr_arg f) hn)

name: nodup_add
statement: theorem nodup_add {s t : Multiset α} : Nodup (s + t) ↔ Nodup s ∧ Nodup t ∧ Disjoint s t
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ s t fun _ _ => by simp [nodup_append, disjoint_iff_ne]

name: disjoint_of_nodup_add
statement: theorem disjoint_of_nodup_add {s t : Multiset α} (d : Nodup (s + t)) : Disjoint s t

name: Nodup.add_iff
statement: theorem Nodup.add_iff (d₁ : Nodup s) (d₂ : Nodup t) : Nodup (s + t) ↔ Disjoint s t

name: Nodup.inter_left
statement: lemma Nodup.inter_left [DecidableEq α] (t) : Nodup s → Nodup (s ∩ t)

name: Nodup.inter_right
statement: lemma Nodup.inter_right [DecidableEq α] (s) : Nodup t → Nodup (s ∩ t)

name: nodup_union
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nodup_union [DecidableEq α] {s t : Multiset α} : Nodup (s ∪ t) ↔ Nodup s ∧ Nodup t
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨nodup_of_le le_union_left h, nodup_of_le le_union_right h⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ =>
    nodup_iff_count_le_one.2 fun a => by
      rw [count_union]
      exact max_le (nodup_iff_count_le_one.1 h₁ a) (nodup_iff_count_le_one.1 h₂ a)⟩

name: fold_eq_foldr
statement:
theorem fold_eq_foldr (b : α) (s : Multiset α) :
    fold op b s = foldr op b s

name: coe_fold_r
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_fold_r (b : α) (l : List α) : fold op b l = l.foldr op b

name: coe_fold_l
statement: theorem coe_fold_l (b : α) (l : List α) : fold op b l = l.foldl op b

name: fold_eq_foldl
statement:
theorem fold_eq_foldl (b : α) (s : Multiset α) :
    fold op b s = foldl op b s

name: fold_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fold_zero (b : α) : (0 : Multiset α).fold op b = b

name: fold_cons_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fold_cons_left : ∀ (b a : α) (s : Multiset α), (a ::ₘ s).fold op b = a * s.fold op b

name: fold_cons_right
statement: theorem fold_cons_right (b a : α) (s : Multiset α) : (a ::ₘ s).fold op b = s.fold op b * a

name: fold_cons'_right
statement: theorem fold_cons'_right (b a : α) (s : Multiset α) : (a ::ₘ s).fold op b = s.fold op (b * a)

name: fold_cons'_left
statement: theorem fold_cons'_left (b a : α) (s : Multiset α) : (a ::ₘ s).fold op b = s.fold op (a * b)

name: fold_add
statement:
theorem fold_add (b₁ b₂ : α) (s₁ s₂ : Multiset α) :
    (s₁ + s₂).fold op (b₁ * b₂) = s₁.fold op b₁ * s₂.fold op b₂
proof:
:=
  Multiset.induction_on s₂
    (by rw [Multiset.add_zero, fold_zero, ← fold_cons'_right, ← fold_cons_right op])
    (fun a b h => by rw [fold_cons_left, add_cons, fold_cons_left, h, ← ha.assoc, hc.comm a,
      ha.assoc])

name: fold_singleton
statement: theorem fold_singleton (b a : α) : ({a} : Multiset α).fold op b = a * b

name: fold_distrib
statement:
theorem fold_distrib {f g : β → α} (u₁ u₂ : α) (s : Multiset β) :
    (s.map fun x => f x * g x).fold op (u₁ * u₂) = (s.map f).fold op u₁ * (s.map g).fold op u₂
proof:
:=
  Multiset.induction_on s (by simp) (fun a b h => by
    rw [map_cons, fold_cons_left, h, map_cons, fold_cons_left, map_cons,
      fold_cons_right, ha.assoc, ← ha.assoc (g a), hc.comm (g a),
      ha.assoc, hc.comm (g a), ha.assoc])

name: fold_hom
fold_union_inter
statement:
theorem fold_union_inter [DecidableEq α] (s₁ s₂ : Multiset α) (b₁ b₂ : α) :
    ((s₁ ∪ s₂).fold op b₁ * (s₁ ∩ s₂).fold op b₂) = s₁.fold op b₁ * s₂.fold op b₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fold_add op, union_add_inter, fold_add op]

name: fold_dedup_idem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fold_dedup_idem [DecidableEq α] [hi : Std.IdempotentOp op] (s : Multiset α) (b : α) :
    (dedup s).fold op b = s.fold op b
proof:
:=
  Multiset.induction_on s (by simp) fun a s IH => by
    by_cases h : a ∈ s; swap; · simp [IH, h]
    simp only [h, dedup_cons_of_mem, IH, fold_cons_left]
    show fold op b s = op a (fold op b s)
    rw [← cons_erase h, fold_cons_left, ← ha.assoc, hi.idempotent]

name: fmap_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fmap_def {α' β'} {s : Multiset α'} (f : α' → β') : f <$> s = s.map f

name: map_comp_coe

proof:
:= by
  funext; simp only [Function.comp_apply, fmap_def, map_coe, List.map_eq_map]

name: id_traverse
statement: theorem id_traverse {α : Type*} (x : Multiset α) : traverse (pure : α → Id α) x = pure x
proof:

  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn
  simp [traverse]

name: comp_traverse
statement:
theorem comp_traverse {G H : Type _ → Type _} [Applicative G] [Applicative H] [CommApplicative G]
    [CommApplicative H] {α β γ : Type _} (g : α → G β) (h : β → H γ) (x : Multiset α) :
    traverse (Comp.mk ∘ Functor.map h ∘ g) x =
    Comp.mk (Functor.map (traverse h) (traverse g x))
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn
  simp only [traverse, quot_mk_to_coe, lift_coe, Function.comp_apply, Functor.map_map, functor_norm]

name: map_traverse
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn
  simp only [traverse, quot_mk_to_coe, lift_coe, Function.comp_apply, Functor.map_map]
  rw [Traversable.map_traverse']
  simp only [fmap_def, Function.comp_apply, Functor.map_map, List.map_eq_map, map_coe]

name: traverse_map
statement:
theorem traverse_map {G : Type* → Type _} [Applicative G] [CommApplicative G] {α β γ : Type _}
    (g : α → β) (h : β → G γ) (x : Multiset α) : traverse h (map g x) = traverse (h ∘ g) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn
  simp only [traverse, quot_mk_to_coe, map_coe, lift_coe, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [← Traversable.traverse_map h g, List.map_eq_map]

name: naturality
statement:
theorem naturality {G H : Type _ → Type _} [Applicative G] [Applicative H] [CommApplicative G]
    [CommApplicative H] (eta : ApplicativeTransformation G H) {α β : Type _} (f : α → G β)
    (x : Multiset α) : eta (traverse f x) = traverse (@eta _ ∘ f) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn
  simp only [quot_mk_to_coe, traverse, lift_coe, Function.comp_apply,
    ApplicativeTransformation.preserves_map, LawfulTraversable.naturality]

name: range_disjoint_map_add

proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_left]
  intro x hxa hxb
  rw [range, mem_coe, List.mem_range] at hxa
  obtain ⟨c, _, rfl⟩ := mem_map.1 hxb

theorem sup_ndinsert (a : α) (s : Multiset α) : (ndinsert a s).sup = a ⊔ s.sup

name: nodup_sup_iff
statement:
theorem nodup_sup_iff {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {m : Multiset (Multiset α)} :
    m.sup.Nodup ↔ ∀ a : Multiset α, a ∈ m → a.Nodup
proof:
:= by

  | empty => simp

name: map_congr
statement:
@[congr]
theorem map_congr {f g : α → β} {s t : Multiset α} :
    s = t → (∀ x ∈ t, f x = g x) → map f s = map g t
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl h
  induction s using Quot.inductionOn
  exact congr_arg _ (List.map_congr_left h)

name: map_hcongr
statement:
theorem map_hcongr {β' : Type v} {m : Multiset α} {f : α → β} {f' : α → β'} (h : β = β')
    (hf : ∀ a ∈ m, f a ≍ f' a) : map f m ≍ map f' m
proof:
:= by
  subst h; simp at hf
  simp [map_congr rfl hf]

name: forall_mem_map_iff
statement:
theorem forall_mem_map_iff {f : α → β} {p : β → Prop} {s : Multiset α} :
    (∀ y ∈ s.map f, p y) ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, p (f x)

name: map_coe
statement: @[simp, norm_cast] lemma map_coe (f : α → β) (l : List α) : map f l = l.map f

statement:
@[simp]

name: map_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_cons (f : α → β) (a s) : map f (a ::ₘ s) = f a ::ₘ map f s

name: map_comp_cons
statement: theorem map_comp_cons (f : α → β) (t) : map f ∘ cons t = cons (f t) ∘ map f

name: map_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_singleton (f : α → β) (a : α) : ({a} : Multiset α).map f = {f a}

name: map_replicate
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_replicate (f : α → β) (k : ℕ) (a : α) : (replicate k a).map f = replicate k (f a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← coe_replicate, map_coe, List.map_replicate]

name: map_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_add (f : α → β) (s t) : map f (s + t) = map f s + map f t
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ s t fun _l₁ _l₂ => congr_arg _ map_append

name: mem_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_map {f : α → β} {b : β} {s : Multiset α} : b ∈ map f s ↔ ∃ a, a ∈ s ∧ f a = b

name: card_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_map (f : α → β) (s) : card (map f s) = card s

name: map_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_eq_zero {s : Multiset α} {f : α → β} : s.map f = 0 ↔ s = 0

name: zero_eq_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_eq_map {s : Multiset α} {f : α → β} : 0 = s.map f ↔ s = 0

name: mem_map_of_mem
statement: theorem mem_map_of_mem (f : α → β) {a : α} {s : Multiset α} (h : a ∈ s) : f a ∈ map f s

name: map_eq_singleton
statement:
theorem map_eq_singleton {f : α → β} {s : Multiset α} {b : β} :
    map f s = {b} ↔ ∃ a : α, s = {a} ∧ f a = b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : ∃ a, s = {a} := by rw [← card_eq_one, ← card_map, h, card_singleton]
    refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
    rw [← mem_singleton, ← h, ha, map_singleton, mem_singleton]
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩
    simp

name: map_eq_cons
statement:
theorem map_eq_cons [DecidableEq α] (f : α → β) (s : Multiset α) (t : Multiset β) (b : β) :
    (∃ a ∈ s, f a = b ∧ (s.erase a).map f = t) ↔ s.map f = b ::ₘ t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [← map_cons, Multiset.cons_erase ha]
  · intro h
    have : b ∈ s.map f := by
      rw [h]
      exact mem_cons_self _ _
    obtain ⟨a, h1, rfl⟩ := mem_map.mp this
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := exists_cons_of_mem h1
    rw [map_cons, cons_inj_right] at h
    refine ⟨a, mem_cons_self _ _, rfl, ?_⟩
    rw [Multiset.erase_cons_head, h]

name: mem_map_of_injective
statement:
@[simp 1100]
theorem mem_map_of_injective {f : α → β} (H : Function.Injective f) {a : α} {s : Multiset α} :
    f a ∈ map f s ↔ a ∈ s

name: map_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_map (g : β → γ) (f : α → β) (s : Multiset α) : map g (map f s) = map (g ∘ f) s

name: map_id
statement: theorem map_id (s : Multiset α) : map id s = s

name: map_id'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id' (s : Multiset α) : map (fun x => x) s = s

name: map_const
statement: theorem map_const (s : Multiset α) (b : β) : map (const α b) s = replicate (card s) b

name: map_const'
statement: @[simp] theorem map_const' (s : Multiset α) (b : β) : map (fun _ ↦ b) s = replicate (card s) b

name: eq_of_mem_map_const
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_map_const {b₁ b₂ : β} {l : List α} (h : b₁ ∈ map (Function.const α b₂) l) :
    b₁ = b₂
proof:
:=
  eq_of_mem_replicate (n := card (l : Multiset α)) <| by rwa [map_const] at h

name: map_le_map
statement:
@[simp, gcongr]
theorem map_le_map {f : α → β} {s t : Multiset α} (h : s ≤ t) : map f s ≤ map f t

name: map_lt_map
statement:
@[simp, gcongr]
theorem map_lt_map {f : α → β} {s t : Multiset α} (h : s < t) : s.map f < t.map f
proof:
:= by
  refine (map_le_map h.le).lt_of_not_ge fun H => h.ne <| eq_of_le_of_card_le h.le ?_
  rw [← s.card_map f, ← t.card_map f]
  exact card_le_card H

name: map_mono
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem map_mono (f : α → β) : Monotone (map f)

name: map_strictMono
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem map_strictMono (f : α → β) : StrictMono (map f)

name: map_subset_map
statement:
@[simp, gcongr]
theorem map_subset_map {f : α → β} {s t : Multiset α} (H : s ⊆ t) : map f s ⊆ map f t
proof:
:= fun _b m =>
  let ⟨a, h, e⟩ := mem_map.1 m
  mem_map.2 ⟨a, H h, e⟩

name: map_erase
statement:
theorem map_erase [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) (x : α)
    (s : Multiset α) : (s.erase x).map f = (s.map f).erase (f x)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with | empty => simp | cons y s ih => ?_
  by_cases hxy : y = x
  · cases hxy
    simp
  · rw [s.erase_cons_tail hxy, map_cons, map_cons, (s.map f).erase_cons_tail (hf.ne hxy), ih]

name: map_erase_of_mem
statement:
theorem map_erase_of_mem [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (f : α → β)
    (s : Multiset α) {x : α} (h : x ∈ s) : (s.erase x).map f = (s.map f).erase (f x)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with | empty => simp | cons y s ih => ?_
  rcases eq_or_ne y x with rfl | hxy
  · simp
  replace h : x ∈ s := by simpa [hxy.symm] using h
  rw [s.erase_cons_tail hxy, map_cons, map_cons, ih h, erase_cons_tail_of_mem (mem_map_of_mem f h)]

name: map_surjective_of_surjective
statement:
theorem map_surjective_of_surjective {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Surjective (map f)
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
  | cons x s ih =>
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hf x
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨y ::ₘ t, map_cons _ _ _⟩

statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_foldr (f : α → β → β) [LeftCommutative f] (b : β) (l : List α) :

statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_foldl (f : β → α → β) [RightCommutative f] (b : β) (l : List α) :

name: coe_foldr_swap

name: foldr_swap
statement:
theorem foldr_swap (f : α → β → β) [LeftCommutative f] (b : β) (s : Multiset α) :

name: foldl_swap
statement:
theorem foldl_swap (f : β → α → β) [RightCommutative f] (b : β) (s : Multiset α) :

name: foldr_induction'
statement:
theorem foldr_induction' (f : α → β → β) [LeftCommutative f] (x : β) (q : α → Prop)
    (p : β → Prop) (s : Multiset α) (hpqf : ∀ a b, q a → p b → p (f a b)) (px : p x)
    (q_s : ∀ a ∈ s, q a) : p (foldr f x s)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction with
  | empty => simpa
  | cons a s ihs =>
    simp only [forall_mem_cons, foldr_cons] at q_s ⊢
    exact hpqf _ _ q_s.1 (ihs q_s.2)

name: foldr_induction
statement:
theorem foldr_induction (f : α → α → α) [LeftCommutative f] (x : α) (p : α → Prop)
    (s : Multiset α) (p_f : ∀ a b, p a → p b → p (f a b)) (px : p x) (p_s : ∀ a ∈ s, p a) :
    p (foldr f x s)
proof:
:=
  foldr_induction' f x p p s p_f px p_s

name: foldl_induction'
statement:
theorem foldl_induction' (f : β → α → β) [RightCommutative f] (x : β) (q : α → Prop)
    (p : β → Prop) (s : Multiset α) (hpqf : ∀ a b, q a → p b → p (f b a)) (px : p x)
    (q_s : ∀ a ∈ s, q a) : p (foldl f x s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [foldl_swap]
  exact foldr_induction' (fun x y => f y x) x q p s hpqf px q_s

name: foldl_induction
statement:
theorem foldl_induction (f : α → α → α) [RightCommutative f] (x : α) (p : α → Prop)
    (s : Multiset α) (p_f : ∀ a b, p a → p b → p (f b a)) (px : p x) (p_s : ∀ a ∈ s, p a) :
    p (foldl f x s)
proof:
:=
  foldl_induction' f x p p s p_f px p_s

name: pmap_eq_map
statement:
theorem pmap_eq_map (p : α → Prop) (f : α → β) (s : Multiset α) :
    ∀ H, @pmap _ _ p (fun a _ => f a) s H = map f s
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _ H => congr_arg _ <| List.pmap_eq_map H

name: map_pmap
statement:
theorem map_pmap {p : α → Prop} (g : β → γ) (f : ∀ a, p a → β) (s) :
    ∀ H, map g (pmap f s H) = pmap (fun a h => g (f a h)) s H
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _ H => congr_arg _ <| List.map_pmap H

name: pmap_eq_map_attach
statement:
theorem pmap_eq_map_attach {p : α → Prop} (f : ∀ a, p a → β) (s) :
    ∀ H, pmap f s H = s.attach.map fun x => f x.1 (H _ x.2)
proof:
:=
  Quot.inductionOn s fun _ H => congr_arg _ <| List.pmap_eq_map_attach H

name: attach_map_val'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem attach_map_val' (s : Multiset α) (f : α → β) : (s.attach.map fun i => f i.val) = s.map f

name: attach_map_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem attach_map_val (s : Multiset α) : s.attach.map Subtype.val = s

name: attach_cons
statement:
theorem attach_cons (a : α) (m : Multiset α) :
    (a ::ₘ m).attach =
      ⟨a, mem_cons_self a m⟩ ::ₘ m.attach.map fun p => ⟨p.1, mem_cons_of_mem p.2⟩
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn m fun l =>
    congr_arg _ <|
      congr_arg (List.cons _) <| by
        rw [List.map_pmap]; exact List.pmap_congr_left _ fun _ _ _ _ => Subtype.ext rfl

name: erase_attach_map_val
statement:
lemma erase_attach_map_val (s : Multiset α) (x : {x // x ∈ s}) :
    (s.attach.erase x).map (↑) = s.erase x

name: erase_attach_map
statement:
lemma erase_attach_map (s : Multiset α) (f : α → β) (x : {x // x ∈ s}) :
    (s.attach.erase x).map (fun j : {x // x ∈ s} ↦ f j) = (s.erase x).map f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← Function.comp_apply (f := f)]
  rw [← map_map, erase_attach_map_val]

name: sub_eq_fold_erase
statement: lemma sub_eq_fold_erase (s t : Multiset α) : s - t = foldl erase s t
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ s t fun l₁ l₂ => by
    change ofList (l₁.diff l₂) = foldl erase l₁ l₂
    rw [diff_eq_foldl l₁ l₂]
    symm
    exact foldl_hom _ fun x y => rfl

name: rel_map_left
statement:
theorem rel_map_left {s : Multiset γ} {f : γ → α} :
    ∀ {t}, Rel r (s.map f) t ↔ Rel (fun a b => r (f a) b) s t

name: rel_map_right
statement:
theorem rel_map_right {s : Multiset α} {t : Multiset γ} {f : γ → β} :
    Rel r s (t.map f) ↔ Rel (fun a b => r a (f b)) s t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rel_flip, rel_map_left, ← rel_flip]; rfl

name: rel_map
statement:
theorem rel_map {s : Multiset α} {t : Multiset β} {f : α → γ} {g : β → δ} :
    Rel p (s.map f) (t.map g) ↔ Rel (fun a b => p (f a) (g b)) s t

  Multiset.induction_on s ⟨0, rfl⟩ fun a _s ⟨t, ht⟩ =>

proof:

name: map_eq_map_of_bij_of_nodup
statement:
theorem map_eq_map_of_bij_of_nodup (f : α → γ) (g : β → γ) {s : Multiset α} {t : Multiset β}
    (hs : s.Nodup) (ht : t.Nodup) (i : ∀ a ∈ s, β) (hi : ∀ a ha, i a ha ∈ t)
    (i_inj : ∀ a₁ ha₁ a₂ ha₂, i a₁ ha₁ = i a₂ ha₂ → a₁ = a₂)
    (i_surj : ∀ b ∈ t, ∃ a ha, i a ha = b) (h : ∀ a ha, f a = g (i a ha)) : s.map f = t.map g
proof:
:= by
  have : t = s.attach.map fun x => i x.1 x.2 := by
    rw [ht.ext]
    · aesop
    · exact hs.attach.map fun x y hxy ↦ Subtype.ext <| i_inj _ x.2 _ y.2 hxy
  calc
    s.map f = s.pmap (fun x _ => f x) fun _ => id := by rw [pmap_eq_map]
    _ = s.attach.map fun x => f x.1 := by rw [pmap_eq_map_attach]
    _ = t.map g := by rw [this, Multiset.map_map]; exact map_congr rfl fun x _ => h _ _

statement:

theorem find?_add (s t : Multiset α) (hp) :

proof:

  exact List.find?_append

name: find
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem find?_eq_some_iff {a : α} {s : Multiset α} (hp) :
    s.find? p hp = some a ↔ a ∈ s ∧ p a
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons x s ih =>
    rw [find?_cons]
    split
    · dsimp [Set.Subsingleton] at hp
      specialize hp ⟨mem_cons_self _ _, ‹p x›⟩
      grind
    · simp_rw [ih]
      grind

name: find
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem find?_eq_none_iff {s : Multiset α} (hp) :

proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons x s ih =>
    rw [find?_cons]
    dsimp [Set.Subsingleton] at hp
    grind

name: find
statement:
@[congr]
theorem find?_congr {p₁ p₂ : α → Prop} [DecidablePred p₁] [DecidablePred p₂] {s : Multiset α}
    (hp₁ : {x ∈ s | p₁ x}.Subsingleton) (h : ∀ x ∈ s, p₁ x ↔ p₂ x) :
    s.find? p₁ hp₁ = s.find? p₂
      (by simp_rw +contextual [← exists_prop, ← h, exists_prop, hp₁])
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Quotient.ind
  exact List.find?_congr fun x hx ↦ by simp [h x (by simpa using hx)]

name: find
statement:

proof:
:= by
  ext a
  refine find?_eq_some_iff _ |>.trans ?_
  simp only [Option.some.injEq, choose_eq_iff]

statement:

proof:
:= by
  cases n

name: scanl_get
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scanl_get (i : Fin n) :
    (scanl f b v).get i.succ = f ((scanl f b v).get (Fin.castSucc i)) (v.get i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with - | n
  · exact i.elim0
  induction n generalizing b with
  | zero =>
    have i0 : i = 0 := Fin.eq_zero _
    simp [scanl_singleton, i0, get_zero]; simp [get_eq_get_toList]
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [← cons_head_tail v, scanl_cons, get_cons_succ]
    refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ i
    · simp
    · intro i'
      simp only [hn, Fin.castSucc_succ, get_cons_succ]

  | 0, _ => rfl

/
returning a vector inside the monad. -/
def mmap {m} [Monad m] {α} {β : Type u} (f : α → m β) : ∀ {n}, Vector α n → m (Vector β n)
  | 0, _ => pure nil
  | _ + 1, xs => do
    let h' ← f xs.head
    let t' ← mmap f xs.tail
    pure (h' ::ᵥ t')

@[simp]

name: mmap_nil

name: mmap_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mmap_cons {m} [Monad m] {α β} (f : α → m β) (a) :
    ∀ {n} (v : Vector α n),
      mmap f (a ::ᵥ v) = do
        let h' ← f a
        let t' ← mmap f v
        pure (h' ::ᵥ t')
  | _, ⟨_, rfl⟩ => rfl

/
Define `C v` by induction on `v : Vector α n`.

This function has two arguments: `nil` handles the base case on `C nil`,
and `cons` defines the inductive step using `∀ x : α, C w → C (x ::ᵥ w)`.

It is used as the default induction principle for the `induction` tactic.
-/
@[elab_as_elim, induction_eliminator]
def inductionOn {C : ∀ {n : ℕ}, Vector α n → Sort*} {n : ℕ} (v : Vector α n)
    (nil : C nil) (cons : ∀ {n : ℕ} {x : α} {w : Vector α n}, C w → C (x ::ᵥ w)) : C v
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rcases v with ⟨_ | ⟨-, -⟩, - | -⟩
    exact nil
  | succ n ih =>
    rcases v with ⟨_ | ⟨a, v⟩, v_property⟩
    cases v_property
    exact cons (ih ⟨v, (add_left_inj 1).mp v_property⟩)

name: inductionOn_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inductionOn_nil {C : ∀ {n : ℕ}, Vector α n → Sort*}
    (nil : C nil) (cons : ∀ {n : ℕ} {x : α} {w : Vector α n}, C w → C (x ::ᵥ w)) :
    Vector.nil.inductionOn nil cons = nil

name: inductionOn_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inductionOn_cons {C : ∀ {n : ℕ}, Vector α n → Sort*} {n : ℕ} (x : α) (v : Vector α n)
    (nil : C nil) (cons : ∀ {n : ℕ} {x : α} {w : Vector α n}, C w → C (x ::ᵥ w)) :
    (x ::ᵥ v).inductionOn nil cons = cons (v.inductionOn nil cons : C v)

name: insertIdx_val

theorem insertIdx_val {i : Fin (n + 1)} {v : Vector α n} :

name: eraseIdx_val

  | _ => rfl

name: eraseIdx_insertIdx_self
statement:
theorem eraseIdx_insertIdx_self {v : Vector α n} {i : Fin (n + 1)} :

name: eraseIdx_insertIdx'
statement:
theorem eraseIdx_insertIdx' {v : Vector α (n + 1)} :
    ∀ {i : Fin (n + 1)} {j : Fin (n + 2)},
      eraseIdx (j.succAbove i) (insertIdx a j v) = insertIdx a (i.predAbove j) (eraseIdx i v)
  | ⟨i, hi⟩, ⟨j, hj⟩ => by
    dsimp [insertIdx, eraseIdx, Fin.succAbove, Fin.predAbove]
    rw [Subtype.mk_eq_mk]
    simp only [Fin.lt_def]
    split_ifs with hij
    · rcases Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero
        (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.1 (lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) hij)) with ⟨j, rfl⟩
      rw [← List.insertIdx_eraseIdx_of_ge]
      · simp; rfl
      · simpa
      · simpa [Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hij
    · dsimp
      rw [← List.insertIdx_eraseIdx_of_le]
      · rfl
      · simpa
      · simpa [not_lt] using hij

name: insertIdx_comm
statement:
theorem insertIdx_comm (a b : α) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (h : i ≤ j) :
    ∀ v : Vector α n,
      (v.insertIdx a i).insertIdx b j.succ = (v.insertIdx b j).insertIdx a (Fin.castSucc i)
  | ⟨l, hl⟩ => by
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    simp only [insertIdx_val, Fin.val_succ, Fin.castSucc, Fin.val_castAdd]
    apply List.insertIdx_comm
    · assumption
    · rw [hl]
      exact Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ j.2

end InsertIdx

name: comp_traverse

@[nolint unusedArguments]

    Vector.traverse (Comp.mk ∘ Functor.map f ∘ g) x =
      Comp.mk (Vector.traverse f <$> Vector.traverse g x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | nil =>
    simp! [cast, *, functor_norm]
    rfl
  | cons ih =>
    rw [Vector.traverse_def, ih]
    simp [functor_norm, Function.comp_def]

  | nil => simp! [functor_norm, cast, η.preserves_pure]

proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Vector.eq_nil v, Vector.map_nil, Vector.toList_nil] using List.not_mem_nil

name: mem_map_succ_iff
statement:
theorem mem_map_succ_iff (b : β) (v : Vector α (n + 1)) (f : α → β) :
    b ∈ (v.map f).toList ↔ f v.head = b ∨ ∃ a : α, a ∈ v.tail.toList ∧ f a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_succ_iff, head_map, tail_map, mem_map_iff, @eq_comm _ b]

name: mapAccumr_mapAccumr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapAccumr_mapAccumr :
    mapAccumr f₁ (mapAccumr f₂ xs s₂).snd s₁
    = let m

        ((r₁.fst, r₂.fst), r₁.snd)

      (m.fst.fst, m.snd) := by
  induction xs using Vector.revInductionOn generalizing s₁ s₂ <;> simp_all

name: mapAccumr_bisim
statement:
theorem mapAccumr_bisim {f₁ : α → σ₁ → σ₁ × β} {f₂ : α → σ₂ → σ₂ × β} {s₁ : σ₁} {s₂ : σ₂}
    (R : σ₁ → σ₂ → Prop) (h₀ : R s₁ s₂)
    (hR : ∀ {s q} a, R s q → R (f₁ a s).1 (f₂ a q).1 ∧ (f₁ a s).2 = (f₂ a q).2) :
    R (mapAccumr f₁ xs s₁).fst (mapAccumr f₂ xs s₂).fst
    ∧ (mapAccumr f₁ xs s₁).snd = (mapAccumr f₂ xs s₂).snd
proof:
:= by
  induction xs using Vector.revInductionOn generalizing s₁ s₂
  next => exact ⟨h₀, rfl⟩
  next xs x ih =>
    rcases (hR x h₀) with ⟨hR, _⟩
    simp only [mapAccumr_snoc, ih hR, true_and]
    congr 1

name: mapAccumr_bisim_tail
statement:
theorem mapAccumr_bisim_tail {f₁ : α → σ₁ → σ₁ × β} {f₂ : α → σ₂ → σ₂ × β} {s₁ : σ₁} {s₂ : σ₂}
    (h : ∃ R : σ₁ → σ₂ → Prop, R s₁ s₂ ∧
      ∀ {s q} a, R s q → R (f₁ a s).1 (f₂ a q).1 ∧ (f₁ a s).2 = (f₂ a q).2) :
    (mapAccumr f₁ xs s₁).snd = (mapAccumr f₂ xs s₂).snd
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨R, h₀, hR⟩
  exact (mapAccumr_bisim R h₀ hR).2

name: mapAccumr
proof:
:= by

  next => exact ⟨h₀, rfl⟩
  next xs ys x y ih =>
    rcases (hR x y h₀) with ⟨hR, _⟩
    simp only [mapAccumr₂_snoc, ih hR, true_and]
    congr 1

name: mapAccumr
proof:
:= by

  exact (mapAccumr₂_bisim R h₀ hR).2

name: map_eq_mapAccumr
statement:
protected theorem map_eq_mapAccumr {f : α → β} :
    map f xs = (mapAccumr (fun x (_ : Unit) ↦ ((), f x)) xs ()).snd
proof:
:= by
  induction xs using Vector.revInductionOn <;> simp_all

name: mapAccumr_eq_map
statement:
theorem mapAccumr_eq_map {f : α → σ → σ × β} {s₀ : σ} (S : Set σ) (h₀ : s₀ ∈ S)
    (closure : ∀ a s, s ∈ S → (f a s).1 ∈ S)
    (out : ∀ a s s', s ∈ S → s' ∈ S → (f a s).2 = (f a s').2) :
    (mapAccumr f xs s₀).snd = map (f · s₀ |>.snd) xs
proof:
:= by
  rw [Vector.map_eq_mapAccumr]
  apply mapAccumr_bisim_tail
  use fun s _ => s ∈ S, h₀
  exact @fun s _q a h => ⟨closure a s h, out a s s₀ h h₀⟩

name: map
statement:
protected theorem map₂_eq_mapAccumr₂ {f : α → β → γ} :
    map₂ f xs ys = (mapAccumr₂ (fun x y (_ : Unit) ↦ ((), f x y)) xs ys ()).snd
proof:
:= by
  induction xs, ys using Vector.revInductionOn₂ <;> simp_all

name: mapAccumr
statement:
theorem mapAccumr₂_eq_map₂ {f : α → β → σ → σ × γ} {s₀ : σ} (S : Set σ) (h₀ : s₀ ∈ S)
    (closure : ∀ a b s, s ∈ S → (f a b s).1 ∈ S)
    (out : ∀ a b s s', s ∈ S → s' ∈ S → (f a b s).2 = (f a b s').2) :
    (mapAccumr₂ f xs ys s₀).snd = map₂ (f · · s₀ |>.snd) xs ys
proof:
:= by
  rw [Vector.map₂_eq_mapAccumr₂]
  apply mapAccumr₂_bisim_tail
  use fun s _ => s ∈ S, h₀
  exact @fun s _q a b h => ⟨closure a b s h, out a b s s₀ h h₀⟩

name: mapAccumr_eq_map_of_constant_state
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapAccumr_eq_map_of_constant_state (f : α → σ → σ × β) (s : σ) (h : ∀ a, (f a s).fst = s) :
    mapAccumr f xs s = (s, (map (fun x => (f x s).snd) xs))
proof:
:= by
  induction xs using revInductionOn <;> simp_all

name: mapAccumr
statement:

theorem mapAccumr₂_eq_map₂_of_constant_state (f : α → β → σ → σ × γ) (s : σ)
    (h : ∀ a b, (f a b s).fst = s) :
    mapAccumr₂ f xs ys s = (s, (map₂ (fun x y => (f x y s).snd) xs ys))
proof:

  induction xs, ys using revInductionOn₂ <;> simp_all

name: mapAccumr_eq_map_of_unused_state
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapAccumr_eq_map_of_unused_state (f : α → σ → σ × β) (f' : α → β) (s : σ)
    (h : ∀ a s, (f a s).snd = f' a) :
    (mapAccumr f xs s).snd = (map f' xs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapAccumr_eq_map Set.univ (Set.mem_univ _) (fun _ _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
    (fun a s s' _ _ => by rw [h, h])]
  simp_all

name: mapAccumr
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapAccumr₂_eq_map₂_of_unused_state (f : α → β → σ → σ × γ) (f' : α → β → γ) (s : σ)
    (h : ∀ a b s, (f a b s).snd = f' a b) :
    (mapAccumr₂ f xs ys s).snd = (map₂ (fun x y => (f x y s).snd) xs ys)
proof:
:=
  mapAccumr₂_eq_map₂ .univ (Set.mem_univ _) (fun _ _ _ _ => Set.mem_univ _)
    (fun a b s s' _ _ => by rw [h, h])

name: mapAccumr_redundant_pair
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapAccumr_redundant_pair (f : α → (σ × σ) → (σ × σ) × β)
    (h : ∀ x s, (f x (s, s)).fst.fst = (f x (s, s)).fst.snd) :
    (mapAccumr f xs (s, s)).snd = (mapAccumr (fun x (s : σ) =>
      (f x (s, s) |>.fst.fst, f x (s, s) |>.snd)
    ) xs s).snd
proof:
:=
  mapAccumr_bisim_tail <| by
    use fun (s₁, s₂) s => s₂ = s ∧ s₁ = s
    simp_all

name: mapAccumr

theorem mapAccumr₂_redundant_pair (f : α → β → (σ × σ) → (σ × σ) × γ)

    (mapAccumr₂ f xs ys (s, s)).snd = (mapAccumr₂ (fun x y (s : σ) =>
      (f x y (s, s) |>.fst.fst, f x y (s, s) |>.snd)
    ) xs ys s).snd
proof:
:=
  mapAccumr₂_bisim_tail <| by
    use fun (s₁, s₂) s => s₂ = s ∧ s₁ = s
    simp_all

lemma fromRows_mulVec [Fintype n] (A₁ : Matrix m₁ n R) (A₂ : Matrix m₂ n R) (v : n → R) :

name: sumElim_vecMul_fromRows
statement:
lemma sumElim_vecMul_fromRows [Fintype m₁] [Fintype m₂] (B₁ : Matrix m₁ n R) (B₂ : Matrix m₂ n R)
    (v₁ : m₁ → R) (v₂ : m₂ → R) :
    Sum.elim v₁ v₂ ᵥ* fromRows B₁ B₂ = v₁ ᵥ* B₁ + v₂ ᵥ* B₂

name: vecMul_fromRows
statement:
@[simp]
lemma vecMul_fromRows [Fintype m₁] [Fintype m₂]

    v ᵥ* fromRows B₁ B₂ = v ∘ Sum.inl ᵥ* B₁ + v ∘ Sum.inr ᵥ* B₂

name: fromCols_mulVec_sumElim
statement:
lemma fromCols_mulVec_sumElim [Fintype n₁] [Fintype n₂]

    fromCols A₁ A₂ *ᵥ Sum.elim v₁ v₂ = A₁ *ᵥ v₁ + A₂ *ᵥ v₂

name: fromCols_mulVec
statement:
@[simp]
lemma fromCols_mulVec [Fintype n₁] [Fintype n₂]
    (A₁ : Matrix m n₁ R) (A₂ : Matrix m n₂ R) (v : n₁ ⊕ n₂ → R) :
    fromCols A₁ A₂ *ᵥ v = A₁ *ᵥ v ∘ Sum.inl + A₂ *ᵥ v ∘ Sum.inr

statement:

lemma fromRows_mul [Fintype n] (A₁ : Matrix m₁ n R) (A₂ : Matrix m₂ n R) (B : Matrix n m R) :
