name: finite_option
statement: theorem finite_option {s : Set (Option α)} : s.Finite ↔ { x : α | some x ∈ s }.Finite
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h.preimage_embedding Embedding.some, fun h =>
    ((h.image some).insert none).subset fun x =>
      x.casesOn (fun _ => Or.inl rfl) fun _ hx => Or.inr <| mem_image_of_mem _ hx⟩

name: Finite.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem Finite.induction_on {motive : ∀ s : Set α, s.Finite → Prop} (s : Set α) (hs : s.Finite)
    (empty : motive ∅ finite_empty)
    (insert : ∀ {a s}, a ∉ s →
      ∀ hs : Set.Finite s, motive s hs → motive (insert a s) (hs.insert a)) :
    motive s hs
proof:
:= by
  lift s to Finset α using hs
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction_on with
  | empty => simpa
  | cons a s ha ih => simpa using @insert a s ha (Set.toFinite _) (ih _)

name: Finite.induction_on_subset
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem Finite.induction_on_subset {motive : ∀ s : Set α, s.Finite → Prop} (s : Set α)
    (hs : s.Finite) (empty : motive ∅ finite_empty)
    (insert : ∀ {a t}, a ∈ s → ∀ hts : t ⊆ s, a ∉ t → motive t (hs.subset hts) →
      motive (insert a t) ((hs.subset hts).insert a)) : motive s hs
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Finite.induction_on (motive := fun t _ => ∀ hts : t ⊆ s, motive t (hs.subset hts)) s hs
    (fun _ => empty) ?_ .rfl
  intro a s has _ hCs haS
  rw [insert_subset_iff] at haS
  exact insert haS.1 haS.2 has (hCs haS.2)

name: seq_of_forall_finite_exists
statement:
theorem seq_of_forall_finite_exists {γ : Type*} {P : γ → Set γ → Prop}
    (h : ∀ t : Set γ, t.Finite → ∃ c, P c t) : ∃ u : ℕ → γ, ∀ n, P (u n) (u '' Iio n)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty γ := (h ∅ finite_empty).nonempty
  choose! c hc using h
  set f : (n : ℕ) → (g : (m : ℕ) → m < n → γ) → γ := fun n g => c (range fun k : Iio n => g k.1 k.2)
  set u : ℕ → γ := fun n ↦ Nat.strongRecOn n f
  refine ⟨u, fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  convert! hc (u '' Iio n) ((finite_lt_nat _).image _)
  rw [image_eq_range]
  exact Nat.strongRecOn_eq f n

name: card_empty
statement: theorem card_empty : Fintype.card (∅ : Set α) = 0

name: card_fintypeInsertOfNotMem
statement:
theorem card_fintypeInsertOfNotMem {a : α} (s : Set α) [Fintype s] (h : a ∉ s) :

name: card_insert
statement:
theorem card_insert {a : α} (s : Set α) [Fintype s] (h : a ∉ s)
    {d : Fintype (insert a s : Set α)} : @Fintype.card _ d = Fintype.card s + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_fintypeInsertOfNotMem s h]; congr!

name: card_image_of_inj_on
statement:
theorem card_image_of_inj_on {s : Set α} [Fintype s] {f : α → β} [Fintype (f '' s)]
    (H : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, f x = f y → x = y) : Fintype.card (f '' s) = Fintype.card s
proof:
:=
  haveI := Classical.propDecidable
  calc
    Fintype.card (f '' s) = (s.toFinset.image f).card := Fintype.card_of_finset' _ (by simp)
    _ = s.toFinset.card :=
      Finset.card_image_of_injOn fun x hx y hy hxy =>
        H x (mem_toFinset.1 hx) y (mem_toFinset.1 hy) hxy
    _ = Fintype.card s := (Fintype.card_of_finset' _ fun _ => mem_toFinset).symm

name: card_image_of_injective
statement:
theorem card_image_of_injective (s : Set α) [Fintype s] {f : α → β} [Fintype (f '' s)]

name: card_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_singleton (a : α) : Fintype.card ({a} : Set α) = 1

name: card_lt_card
statement:
theorem card_lt_card {s t : Set α} [Fintype s] [Fintype t] (h : s ⊂ t) :
    Fintype.card s < Fintype.card t
proof:
:=
  Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_not_surjective (Set.inclusion h.1) (Set.inclusion_injective h.1)
    fun hst => (ssubset_iff_subset_ne.1 h).2 (eq_of_inclusion_surjective hst)

name: card_le_card
statement:
theorem card_le_card {s t : Set α} [Fintype s] [Fintype t] (hsub : s ⊆ t) :
    Fintype.card s ≤ Fintype.card t

name: eq_of_subset_of_card_le
statement:
theorem eq_of_subset_of_card_le {s t : Set α} [Fintype s] [Fintype t] (hsub : s ⊆ t)
    (hcard : Fintype.card t ≤ Fintype.card s) : s = t
proof:
:=
  (eq_or_ssubset_of_subset hsub).elim id fun h => absurd hcard <| not_le_of_gt <| card_lt_card h

theorem card_range_of_injective [Fintype α] {f : α → β} (hf : Injective f) [Fintype (range f)] :

name: card_ne_eq
statement:
theorem card_ne_eq [Fintype α] (a : α) [Fintype { x : α | x ≠ a }] :
    Fintype.card { x : α | x ≠ a } = Fintype.card α - 1
proof:
:= by
  have := Classical.decEq α
  rw [← toFinset_card, toFinset_ofPred, Finset.filter_ne',
    Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ _), Finset.card_univ]

statement:
theorem infinite_range_of_injective [Infinite α] {f : α → β} (hi : Injective f) :

statement:

proof:

name: not_injOn_infinite_finite_image
statement:
theorem not_injOn_infinite_finite_image {f : α → β} {s : Set α} (h_inf : s.Infinite)
    (h_fin : (f '' s).Finite) : ¬InjOn f s
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite (f '' s) := finite_coe_iff.mpr h_fin
  have : Infinite s := infinite_coe_iff.mpr h_inf
  have h := not_injective_infinite_finite
            ((f '' s).codRestrict (s.domRestrict f) fun x => ⟨x, x.property, rfl⟩)
  contrapose h
  rwa [injective_codRestrict, ← injOn_iff_injective]

name: exists_card_eq
statement:
lemma exists_card_eq [Infinite α] : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ s : Finset α, s.card = n
  | 0 => ⟨∅, card_empty⟩
  | n + 1 => by
    classical
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩
proof:
:= exists_card_eq n
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := s.exists_notMem
    exact ⟨insert a s, card_insert_of_notMem ha⟩

name: exists_subset_injOn_image_eq_of_surjOn
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hus, hf, himg⟩ := hfs.exists_subset_injOn_image_eq
  refine ⟨(Finite.of_finite_image (by simp [himg]) hf).toFinset, by simpa, by simpa, ?_⟩
  simpa [← Finset.coe_inj]

name: Finite.of_forall_not_lt_lt
statement: lemma Finite.of_forall_not_lt_lt (h : ∀ ⦃x y z : α⦄, x < y → y < z → False) : Finite α
proof:
:= by
  nontriviality α
  rcases exists_pair_ne α with ⟨x, y, hne⟩
  refine @Finite.of_fintype α ⟨{x, y}, fun z => ?_⟩
  simpa [hne] using eq_or_eq_or_eq_of_forall_not_lt_lt h z x y

name: Set.finite_of_forall_not_lt_lt
statement:
lemma Set.finite_of_forall_not_lt_lt (h : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, ∀ z ∈ s, x < y → y < z → False) :
    Set.Finite s
proof:
:=
  @Set.toFinite _ s <| Finite.of_forall_not_lt_lt <| by simpa only [SetCoe.forall'] using! h

name: Finite.finite_subsets
statement: theorem Finite.finite_subsets {α : Type u} {a : Set α} (h : a.Finite) : { b | b ⊆ a }.Finite
proof:
:= by
  convert! ((Finset.powerset h.toFinset).map Finset.coeEmb.1).finite_toSet
  ext s
  simpa [← @exists_finite_iff_finset α fun t => t ⊆ a ∧ t = s, Finite.subset_toFinset,
    ← and_assoc, Finset.coeEmb] using h.subset

name: Finite.exists_subset_finite_image_eq
proof:
:= by
  have : Finite u := Finite.to_subtype hu
  choose g hg hg' using hsu
  let g' (x : u) : α := g x.property
  exact ⟨range g', fun a ha ↦ by aesop, finite_range _, by aesop⟩

lemma _root_.Function.Injective.range_eq_range_iff_subset [Finite α]

    range f = range g ↔ range f ⊆ range g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite α

name: toFinset_iUnion
statement:
lemma toFinset_iUnion [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] (f : β → Set α)
    [∀ w, Fintype (f w)] :

    Finset.biUnion (Finset.univ : Finset β) (fun x => (f x).toFinset)
proof:
:= by

statement:
theorem finite_biUnion {ι : Type*} (s : Set ι) [Finite s] (t : ι → Set α)

proof:
:= by
  rw [biUnion_eq_iUnion]
  have : ∀ i : s, Finite (t i) := fun i => H i i.property
  infer_instance

statement: theorem finite_iUnion [Finite ι] {f : ι → Set α} (H : ∀ i, (f i).Finite) : (⋃ i, f i).Finite

theorem Finite.biUnion' {ι} {s : Set ι} (hs : s.Finite) {t : ∀ i ∈ s, Set α}

proof:
:= by
  have := hs.to_subtype

theorem Finite.biUnion {ι} {s : Set ι} (hs : s.Finite) {t : ι → Set α}

proof:

name: Finite.sInter
statement:
theorem Finite.sInter {α : Type*} {s : Set (Set α)} {t : Set α} (ht : t ∈ s) (hf : t.Finite) :

name: Finite.iUnion
statement:
theorem Finite.iUnion {ι : Type*} {s : ι → Set α} {t : Set ι} (ht : t.Finite)
    (hs : ∀ i ∈ t, (s i).Finite) (he : ∀ i, i ∉ t → s i = ∅) : (⋃ i, s i).Finite
proof:
:= by
  suffices ⋃ i, s i ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ t, s i by exact (ht.biUnion hs).subset this
  refine iUnion_subset fun i x hx => ?_
  by_cases hi : i ∈ t
  · exact mem_biUnion hi hx
  · rw [he i hi, mem_empty_iff_false] at hx
    contradiction

name: finite_iUnion_iff
statement:
lemma finite_iUnion_iff {ι : Type*} {s : ι → Set α} (hs : Pairwise fun i j ↦ Disjoint (s i) (s j)) :
    (⋃ i, s i).Finite ↔ (∀ i, (s i).Finite) ∧ {i | (s i).Nonempty}.Finite where
  mp h
proof:
:= by
    refine ⟨fun i ↦ h.subset <| subset_iUnion _ _, ?_⟩
    let u (i : {i | (s i).Nonempty}) : ⋃ i, s i := ⟨i.2.choose, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i.1, i.2.choose_spec⟩⟩
    have u_inj : Function.Injective u := by
      rintro ⟨i, hi⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩ hij
      ext
      refine hs.eq <| not_disjoint_iff.2 ⟨u ⟨i, hi⟩, hi.choose_spec, ?_⟩
      rw [hij]
      exact hj.choose_spec
    have : Finite (⋃ i, s i) := h
    exact .of_injective u u_inj
  mpr h := h.2.iUnion (fun _ _ ↦ h.1 _) (by simp [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty])

statement:
protected lemma Infinite.iUnion {ι : Sort*} {s : ι → Set α} (i : ι) (hi : (s i).Infinite) :

statement:
lemma Infinite.iUnion₂ {ι : Sort*} {κ : ι → Sort*} {s : ∀ i, κ i → Set α} (i : ι) (j : κ i)

name: finite_iUnion_of_subsingleton

@[simp] lemma finite_iUnion_of_subsingleton {ι : Sort*} [Subsingleton ι] {s : ι → Set α} :
    (⋃ i, s i).Finite ↔ ∀ i, (s i).Finite
proof:

name: PairwiseDisjoint.finite_biUnion_iff
statement:
lemma PairwiseDisjoint.finite_biUnion_iff {f : β → Set α} {s : Set β} (hs : s.PairwiseDisjoint f) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [finite_iUnion_iff (by aesop (add unfold safe [Pairwise, PairwiseDisjoint, Set.Pairwise]))]
  simp

name: Finite.preimage'
statement:
theorem Finite.preimage' (h : s.Finite) (hf : ∀ b ∈ s, (f ⁻¹' {b}).Finite) :

name: finite_subset_iUnion
statement:
theorem finite_subset_iUnion {s : Set α} (hs : s.Finite) {ι} {t : ι → Set α} (h : s ⊆ ⋃ i, t i) :
    ∃ I : Set ι, I.Finite ∧ s ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ I, t i
proof:
:= by
  have := hs.to_subtype
  choose f hf using show ∀ x : s, ∃ i, x.1 ∈ t i by simpa [subset_def] using h
  refine ⟨range f, finite_range f, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  rw [biUnion_range, mem_iUnion]
  exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hf _⟩

name: eq_finite_iUnion_of_finite_subset_iUnion
statement:
theorem eq_finite_iUnion_of_finite_subset_iUnion {ι} {s : ι → Set α} {t : Set α} (tfin : t.Finite)
    (h : t ⊆ ⋃ i, s i) :
    ∃ I : Set ι,
      I.Finite ∧
        ∃ σ : { i | i ∈ I } → Set α, (∀ i, (σ i).Finite) ∧ (∀ i, σ i ⊆ s i) ∧ t = ⋃ i, σ i
proof:
:=
  let ⟨I, Ifin, hI⟩ := finite_subset_iUnion tfin h
  ⟨I, Ifin, fun x => s x ∩ t, fun _ => tfin.subset inter_subset_right, fun _ =>
    inter_subset_left, by
    ext x
    rw [mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · intro x_in
      rcases mem_iUnion.mp (hI x_in) with ⟨i, _, ⟨hi, rfl⟩, H⟩
      exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, ⟨H, x_in⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, -, H⟩
      exact H⟩

statement:

theorem Finite.iSup_biInf_of_monotone {ι ι' α : Type*} [Preorder ι'] [Nonempty ι']
    [IsDirectedOrder ι'] [Order.Frame α] {s : Set ι} (hs : s.Finite) {f : ι → ι' → α}

proof:

  | empty => simp [iSup_const]
  | insert _ _ ihs =>
    rw [forall_mem_insert] at hf
    simp only [iInf_insert, ← ihs hf.2]

name: _root_.iInf_iSup_eq_of_finite
statement:
theorem _root_.iInf_iSup_eq_of_finite {ι : Sort v} {κ : ι → Sort w} [Order.Frame α] [Finite ι]
    {f : Π a, κ a → α} : ⨅ a, ⨆ b, f a b = ⨆ g : (Π a, κ a), ⨅ a, f a (g a)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ {ι : Type v} {κ : ι → Type w} [Finite ι] (f : Π a, κ a → α),
      ⨅ a, ⨆ b, f a b = ⨆ g : (Π a, κ a), ⨅ a, f a (g a) by
    simpa [← Equiv.plift.symm.iInf_comp, ← Equiv.plift.symm.iSup_comp,
        ← (Equiv.plift.piCongr fun a => @Equiv.plift (κ a.down)).symm.iSup_comp] using!
      this (κ := fun a => PLift (κ a.down)) fun (a : PLift ι) b => f a.down b.down
  intro ι κ _ f
  induction ι using Finite.induction_empty_option with
  | of_equiv e h => simp [← e.iInf_comp, ← e.piCongrLeft κ |>.iSup_comp, h]
  | h_empty => simp [iSup_const]
  | h_option h =>
    simp only [iInf_option, h, ← (Equiv.piOptionEquivProd (β := κ)).symm.iSup_comp,
      Equiv.piOptionEquivProd_symm_apply, iSup_prod, ← inf_iSup_eq, ← iSup_inf_eq]

name: Finite.biInf_iSup_eq
statement:
theorem Finite.biInf_iSup_eq {ι : Type v} {κ : ι → Sort w} [Nonempty (Π a, κ a)] [Order.Frame α]
    {s : Set ι} (hs : s.Finite) {f : Π a, κ a → α} :
    ⨅ a ∈ s, ⨆ b, f a b = ⨆ g : (Π a, κ a), ⨅ a ∈ s, f a (g a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices h : ∀ {κ : ι → Type w} [Nonempty (Π a, κ a)] (f : Π a, κ a → α),
      ⨅ a ∈ s, ⨆ b, f a b = ⨆ g : (Π a, κ a), ⨅ a ∈ s, f a (g a) by
    have : Nonempty (Π a, PLift (κ a)) := (Equiv.piCongrRight fun _ => Equiv.plift).nonempty
    simpa [← Equiv.plift.symm.iSup_comp, ← (Equiv.piCongrRight fun _ => Equiv.plift).symm.iSup_comp]
      using h (κ := fun a => PLift (κ a)) fun a b => f a b.down
  intro κ _ f
  have := hs.to_subtype
  have : Nonempty (Π a : { a // a ∉ s }, κ ↑a) := ‹Nonempty (Π a, κ a)›.map fun f a ↦ f a
  simp [← iInf_subtype'', iInf_iSup_eq_of_finite (ι := s),
    ← Equiv.piEquivPiSubtypeProd (· ∈ s) _ |>.symm.iSup_comp, iSup_prod, iSup_const]

lemma Directed.exists_mem_subset_of_finset_subset_biUnion {α ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι]

    rcases hs.imp_right iht with ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, j, hj⟩

    exact ⟨k, hik hi, hj.trans hjk⟩

statement:
theorem injective_iff_injective_of_iUnion_eq_univ :

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H i => (U i).restrictPreimage_injective H, fun H x y e => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp
      (show f x ∈ Set.iUnion U by rw [hU]; trivial)
  injection @H i ⟨x, hi⟩ ⟨y, show f y ∈ U i from e ▸ hi⟩ (Subtype.ext e)

  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ :=

  exact ⟨_, congr_arg Subtype.val (H i ⟨x, hi⟩).choose_spec⟩

statement:
theorem InjOn.image_iInter_eq [Nonempty ι] {s : ι → Set α} {f : α → β} (h : InjOn f (⋃ i, s i)) :
    (f '' ⋂ i, s i) = ⋂ i, f '' s i
proof:
:= by
  inhabit ι
  refine Subset.antisymm (image_iInter_subset s f) fun y hy => ?_
  simp only [mem_iInter, mem_image] at hy
  choose x hx hy using hy
  refine ⟨x default, mem_iInter.2 fun i => ?_, hy _⟩
  suffices x default = x i by
    rw [this]
    apply hx
  replace hx : ∀ i, x i ∈ ⋃ j, s j := fun i => (subset_iUnion _ _) (hx i)
  apply h (hx _) (hx _)
  simp only [hy]

  have : Nonempty { i // p i } := nonempty_subtype.2 hp

  simpa only [iUnion, iSup_subtype'] using h

statement:
lemma biUnion_compl_eq_of_pairwise_disjoint_of_iUnion_eq_univ {ι : Type*} {Es : ι → Set α}
    (Es_union : ⋃ i, Es i = univ) (Es_disj : Pairwise fun i j ↦ Disjoint (Es i) (Es j))
    (I : Set ι) :
    (⋃ i ∈ I, Es i)ᶜ = ⋃ i ∈ Iᶜ, Es i
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨i, hix⟩ : ∃ i, x ∈ Es i := by simp [← mem_iUnion, Es_union]
  have obs : ∀ (J : Set ι), x ∈ ⋃ j ∈ J, Es j ↔ i ∈ J := by
    refine fun J ↦ ⟨?_, fun i_in_J ↦ by simpa only [mem_iUnion, exists_prop] using ⟨i, i_in_J, hix⟩⟩
    intro x_in_U
    simp only [mem_iUnion, exists_prop] at x_in_U
    obtain ⟨j, j_in_J, hjx⟩ := x_in_U
    rwa [show i = j by by_contra i_ne_j; exact Disjoint.ne_of_mem (Es_disj i_ne_j) hix hjx rfl]
  have obs' : ∀ (J : Set ι), x ∈ (⋃ j ∈ J, Es j)ᶜ ↔ i ∉ J :=
    fun J ↦ by simpa only [mem_compl_iff, not_iff_not] using obs J
  rw [obs, obs', mem_compl_iff]

name: sigmaToiUnion_injective
statement:
theorem sigmaToiUnion_injective (h : Pairwise (Disjoint on t)) :
    Injective (sigmaToiUnion t)
  | ⟨a₁, b₁, h₁⟩, ⟨a₂, b₂, h₂⟩, eq =>
    have b_eq : b₁ = b₂
proof:
:= congr_arg Subtype.val eq
    have a_eq : a₁ = a₂ :=
      by_contradiction fun ne =>
        have : b₁ ∈ t a₁ ∩ t a₂ := ⟨h₁, b_eq.symm ▸ h₂⟩
        (h ne).le_bot this
    Sigma.eq a_eq <| Subtype.ext <| by subst b_eq; subst a_eq; rfl

statement:
theorem iUnion_range_eq_sUnion {α β : Type*} (C : Set (Set α)) {f : ∀ s : C, β → (s : Type _)}
    (hf : ∀ s : C, Surjective (f s)) : ⋃ y : β, range (fun s : C => (f s y).val) = ⋃₀ C
proof:
:= by
  ext x; constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, ⟨y, rfl⟩, ⟨s, hs⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨_, hs, ?_⟩
    exact (f ⟨s, hs⟩ y).2
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hf ⟨s, hs⟩ ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨_, ⟨y, rfl⟩, ⟨s, hs⟩, ?_⟩
    exact congr_arg Subtype.val hy

proof:
:= by
  ext x; rw [mem_iUnion, mem_iUnion]; constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨i, (f i y).2⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hf i ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact ⟨y, i, congr_arg Subtype.val hy⟩

proof:
:= by
  refine sdiff_subset_comm.2 fun x hx a ha => ?_
  simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_pi, mem_iUnion, not_exists, mem_preimage, not_and, not_not] at hx

name: directedOn_iUnion
statement:
theorem directedOn_iUnion {r} {f : ι → Set α} (hd : Directed (· ⊆ ·) f)
    (h : ∀ x, DirectedOn r (f x)) : DirectedOn r (⋃ x, f x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [DirectedOn, mem_iUnion, exists_imp]
  exact fun a₁ b₁ fb₁ a₂ b₂ fb₂ =>
    let ⟨z, zb₁, zb₂⟩ := hd b₁ b₂
    let ⟨x, xf, xa₁, xa₂⟩ := h z a₁ (zb₁ fb₁) a₂ (zb₂ fb₂)
    ⟨x, ⟨z, xf⟩, xa₁, xa₂⟩

proof:

  exact directedOn_iUnion (directedOn_iff_directed.mp hd) (fun i ↦ h i.1 i.2)

name: Nodup.pairwise_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Nodup.pairwise_coe [Std.Symm r] (hl : l.Nodup) :
    { a | a ∈ l }.Pairwise r ↔ l.Pairwise r
proof:
:= by
  induction l with | nil => simp | cons a l ih => ?_
  rw [List.nodup_cons] at hl
  have : ∀ b ∈ l, ¬a = b → r a b ↔ r a b := fun b hb =>
    imp_iff_right (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hb hl.1).symm
  simp [Set.ofPred_or, Set.pairwise_insert_of_symm, ih hl.2, and_comm, forall₂_congr this]

statement:
theorem Std.Symm.pairwise_on [LinearOrder ι] [Std.Symm r] (f : ι → α) :
    Pairwise (r on f) ↔ ∀ ⦃m n⦄, m < n → r (f m) (f n) where
  mp h _m _n hmn
proof:
:= h hmn.ne
  mpr h _m _n hmn := hmn.lt_or_gt.elim (@h _ _) fun h' ↦ symm_of r <| h h'

name: Pairwise.disjoint_extend_bot
statement:
theorem Pairwise.disjoint_extend_bot [PartialOrder γ] [OrderBot γ]
    {e : α → β} {f : α → γ} (hf : Pairwise (Disjoint on f)) (he : FactorsThrough f e) :
    Pairwise (Disjoint on extend e f ⊥)
proof:
:= by
  intro b₁ b₂ hne
  rcases em (∃ a₁, e a₁ = b₁) with ⟨a₁, rfl⟩ | hb₁
  · rcases em (∃ a₂, e a₂ = b₂) with ⟨a₂, rfl⟩ | hb₂
    · simpa only [onFun, he.extend_apply] using! hf (ne_of_apply_ne e hne)
    · simpa only [onFun, extend_apply' _ _ _ hb₂] using! disjoint_bot_right
  · simpa only [onFun, extend_apply' _ _ _ hb₁] using! disjoint_bot_left

name: Nonempty.pairwise_iff_exists_forall
statement:
theorem Nonempty.pairwise_iff_exists_forall [IsEquiv α r] {s : Set ι} (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    s.Pairwise (r on f) ↔ ∃ z, ∀ x ∈ s, r (f x) z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rcases hs with ⟨y, hy⟩
    refine fun H => ⟨f y, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    rcases eq_or_ne x y with (rfl | hne)
    · apply Std.Refl.refl
    · exact H hx hy hne
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩ x hx y hy _
    exact @IsTrans.trans α r _ (f x) z (f y) (hz _ hx) (symm <| hz _ hy)

proof:
:= by
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with (rfl | hne)
  · simp
  · exact hne.pairwise_iff_exists_forall

proof:
:=
  fun ⟨_, _⟩ ⟨hi, hi'⟩ ⟨_, _⟩ ⟨hj, hj'⟩ hij =>
  disjoint_left.2 fun ⟨_, _⟩ ⟨hai, hbi⟩ ⟨haj, hbj⟩ =>
    hij <| Prod.ext (hs.elim_set hi hj _ hai haj) <| ht.elim_set hi' hj' _ hbi hbj

name: pairwiseDisjoint_pi
proof:
:=
  fun _ hI _ hJ hIJ =>
  disjoint_left.2 fun a haI haJ =>
    hIJ <|
      funext fun i =>
        (hs i).elim_set (hI i trivial) (hJ i trivial) (a i) (haI i trivial) (haJ i trivial)

name: pairwiseDisjoint_image_right_iff
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hs x hx y hy (h : f _ _ = _) => ?_, fun hs x hx y hy h => ?_⟩
  · suffices x.1 = y.1 by exact Prod.ext this (hf _ hx.1 <| h.trans <| by rw [this])
    refine hs.elim hx.1 hy.1 (not_disjoint_iff.2 ⟨_, mem_image_of_mem _ hx.2, ?_⟩)
    rw [h]
    exact mem_image_of_mem _ hy.2
  · refine disjoint_iff_inf_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨a, ha, hab⟩, b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact h (congr_arg Prod.fst <| hs (mk_mem_prod hx ha) (mk_mem_prod hy hb) hab)

name: pairwiseDisjoint_image_left_iff
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ht x hx y hy (h : f _ _ = _) => ?_, fun ht x hx y hy h => ?_⟩
  · suffices x.2 = y.2 by exact Prod.ext (hf _ hx.2 <| h.trans <| by rw [this]) this
    refine ht.elim hx.2 hy.2 (not_disjoint_iff.2 ⟨_, mem_image_of_mem _ hx.1, ?_⟩)
    rw [h]
    exact mem_image_of_mem _ hy.1
  · refine disjoint_iff_inf_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨⟨a, ha, hab⟩, b, hb, rfl⟩
    exact h (congr_arg Prod.snd <| ht (mk_mem_prod ha hx) (mk_mem_prod hb hy) hab)

name: exists_ne_mem_inter_of_not_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
lemma exists_ne_mem_inter_of_not_pairwiseDisjoint
    {f : ι → Set α} (h : ¬ s.PairwiseDisjoint f) :
    ∃ i ∈ s, ∃ j ∈ s, i ≠ j ∧ ∃ x : α, x ∈ f i ∩ f j
proof:
:= by
  change ¬ ∀ i, i ∈ s → ∀ j, j ∈ s → i ≠ j → ∀ t, t ≤ f i → t ≤ f j → t ≤ ⊥ at h
  simp only [not_forall] at h
  obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, h_ne, t, hfi, hfj, ht⟩ := h
  replace ht : t.Nonempty := by
    rwa [le_bot_iff, bot_eq_empty, ← Ne, ← nonempty_iff_ne_empty] at ht
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ht
  exact ⟨i, hi, j, hj, h_ne, x, hfi hx, hfj hx⟩

name: exists_lt_mem_inter_of_not_pairwiseDisjoint
statement:
lemma exists_lt_mem_inter_of_not_pairwiseDisjoint [LinearOrder ι]
    {f : ι → Set α} (h : ¬ s.PairwiseDisjoint f) :
    ∃ i ∈ s, ∃ j ∈ s, i < j ∧ ∃ x, x ∈ f i ∩ f j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, hne, x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ := exists_ne_mem_inter_of_not_pairwiseDisjoint h
  rcases lt_or_lt_iff_ne.mpr hne with h_lt | h_lt
  · exact ⟨i, hi, j, hj, h_lt, x, hx₁, hx₂⟩
  · exact ⟨j, hj, i, hi, h_lt, x, hx₂, hx₁⟩

name: exists_ne_mem_inter_of_not_pairwise_disjoint
statement:
lemma exists_ne_mem_inter_of_not_pairwise_disjoint
    {f : ι → Set α} (h : ¬ Pairwise (Disjoint on f)) :
    ∃ i j : ι, i ≠ j ∧ ∃ x, x ∈ f i ∩ f j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pairwise_univ] at h
  obtain ⟨i, _hi, j, _hj, h⟩ := exists_ne_mem_inter_of_not_pairwiseDisjoint h
  exact ⟨i, j, h⟩

proof:

statement:
lemma subsingleton_setOfPred_mem_iff_pairwise_disjoint {f : ι → Set α} :

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ _ hij ↦ disjoint_left.2 fun a hi hj ↦ hij (h a hi hj),
   fun h _ _ hx _ hy ↦ by_contra fun hne ↦ disjoint_left.1 (h hne) hx hy⟩

name: pairwise_iUnion
statement:
theorem pairwise_iUnion {f : κ → Set α} (hd : Directed (· ⊆ ·) f) :
    (⋃ n, f n).Pairwise r ↔ ∀ n, (f n).Pairwise r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H n
    exact Pairwise.mono (subset_iUnion _ _) H
  · intro H i hi j hj hij
    rcases mem_iUnion.1 hi with ⟨m, hm⟩
    rcases mem_iUnion.1 hj with ⟨n, hn⟩
    rcases hd m n with ⟨p, mp, np⟩
    exact H p (mp hm) (np hn) hij

name: pairwise_iUnion
statement:
theorem pairwise_iUnion₂ {s : Set (Set α)} (hd : DirectedOn (· ⊆ ·) s)
    (r : α → α → Prop) (h : ∀ a ∈ s, a.Pairwise r) : (⋃ a ∈ s, a).Pairwise r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Set.Pairwise, mem_iUnion, exists_prop, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
  intro x S hS hx y T hT hy hne
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hSU, hTU⟩ := hd S hS T hT
  exact h U hU (hSU hx) (hTU hy) hne

name: pairwise_iUnion
statement:
theorem pairwise_iUnion₂_iff {s : Set (Set α)} (hd : DirectedOn (· ⊆ ·) s) :
    (⋃ a ∈ s, a).Pairwise r ↔ ∀ a ∈ s, a.Pairwise r
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h a ha ↦ h.mono <| subset_iUnion₂_of_subset a ha (by rfl), pairwise_iUnion₂ hd _⟩

statement:
theorem pairwise_sUnion {r : α → α → Prop} {s : Set (Set α)} (hd : DirectedOn (· ⊆ ·) s) :

statement:

name: PairwiseDisjoint.biUnion
proof:
:= by
  rintro a ha b hb hab
  simp_rw [Set.mem_iUnion] at ha hb
  obtain ⟨c, hc, ha⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hb⟩ := hb
  obtain hcd | hcd := eq_or_ne (g c) (g d)
  · exact hg d hd (hcd ▸ ha) hb hab
  · exact (hs hc hd <| ne_of_apply_ne _ hcd).mono
      (le_iSup₂ (f := fun i _ => f i) a ha)
      (le_iSup₂ (f := fun i _ => f i) b hb)

name: PairwiseDisjoint.prod_left
statement:
theorem PairwiseDisjoint.prod_left {f : ι × ι' → α}
    (hs : s.PairwiseDisjoint fun i => ⨆ i' ∈ t, f (i, i'))
    (ht : t.PairwiseDisjoint fun i' => ⨆ i ∈ s, f (i, i')) :
    (s ×ˢ t : Set (ι × ι')).PairwiseDisjoint f
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hi ⟨j, j'⟩ hj h
  rw [mem_prod] at hi hj
  obtain rfl | hij := eq_or_ne i j
  · refine (ht hi.2 hj.2 <| (Prod.mk_right_injective _).ne_iff.1 h).mono ?_ ?_
    · convert! le_iSup₂ (α := α) i hi.1; rfl
    · convert! le_iSup₂ (α := α) i hj.1; rfl
  · refine (hs hi.1 hj.1 hij).mono ?_ ?_
    · convert! le_iSup₂ (α := α) i' hi.2; rfl
    · convert! le_iSup₂ (α := α) j' hj.2; rfl

name: pairwiseDisjoint_prod_left
statement:
theorem pairwiseDisjoint_prod_left {s : Set ι} {t : Set ι'} {f : ι × ι' → α} :
    (s ×ˢ t : Set (ι × ι')).PairwiseDisjoint f ↔
      (s.PairwiseDisjoint fun i => ⨆ i' ∈ t, f (i, i')) ∧
        t.PairwiseDisjoint fun i' => ⨆ i ∈ s, f (i, i')
proof:
:= by
  refine
      ⟨fun h => ⟨fun i hi j hj hij => ?_, fun i hi j hj hij => ?_⟩, fun h => h.1.prod_left h.2⟩ <;>
    simp_rw [Function.onFun, iSup_disjoint_iff, disjoint_iSup_iff] <;>
    intro i' hi' j' hj'
  · exact h (mk_mem_prod hi hi') (mk_mem_prod hj hj') (ne_of_apply_ne Prod.fst hij)
  · exact h (mk_mem_prod hi' hi) (mk_mem_prod hj' hj) (ne_of_apply_ne Prod.snd hij)

name: biUnion_sdiff_biUnion_eq
statement:
theorem biUnion_sdiff_biUnion_eq {s t : Set ι} {f : ι → Set α} (h : (s ∪ t).PairwiseDisjoint f) :
    ((⋃ i ∈ s, f i) \ ⋃ i ∈ t, f i) = ⋃ i ∈ s \ t, f i
proof:
:= by
  refine
    (biUnion_sdiff_biUnion_subset f s t).antisymm
      (iUnion₂_subset fun i hi a ha => (mem_sdiff _).2 ⟨mem_biUnion hi.1 ha, ?_⟩)
  rw [mem_iUnion₂]; rintro ⟨j, hj, haj⟩
  exact (h (Or.inl hi.1) (Or.inr hj) (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hj hi.2).symm).le_bot ⟨ha, haj⟩

name: coe_biUnionEqSigmaOfDisjoint_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_biUnionEqSigmaOfDisjoint_symm_apply {α ι : Type*} {s : Set ι}
    {f : ι → Set α} (h : s.PairwiseDisjoint f) (x : (i : s) × f i) :

lemma coe_snd_biUnionEqSigmaOfDisjoint {α ι : Type*} {s : Set ι}

    ((Set.biUnionEqSigmaOfDisjoint h x).snd : α) = x

name: Set.pairwiseDisjoint_iff
statement:
lemma Set.pairwiseDisjoint_iff :
    s.PairwiseDisjoint f ↔ ∀ ⦃i⦄, i ∈ s → ∀ ⦃j⦄, j ∈ s → (f i ∩ f j).Nonempty → i = j
proof:
:= by
  simp [Set.PairwiseDisjoint, Set.Pairwise, Function.onFun, not_imp_comm (a := _ = _),
    not_disjoint_iff_nonempty_inter]

name: Set.pairwiseDisjoint_pair_insert
statement:
lemma Set.pairwiseDisjoint_pair_insert {s : Set α} {a : α} (ha : a ∉ s) :
    s.powerset.PairwiseDisjoint fun t ↦ ({t, insert a t} : Set (Set α))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairwiseDisjoint_iff]
  rintro i hi j hj
  have := insert_erase_invOn.2.injOn (notMem_subset hi ha) (notMem_subset hj ha)
  aesop (add simp [Set.Nonempty, Set.subset_def])

name: Set.PairwiseDisjoint.subset_of_biUnion_subset_biUnion
statement:
theorem Set.PairwiseDisjoint.subset_of_biUnion_subset_biUnion (h₀ : (s ∪ t).PairwiseDisjoint f)
    (h₁ : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).Nonempty) (h : ⋃ i ∈ s, f i ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ t, f i) : s ⊆ t
proof:
:= by
  rintro i hi
  obtain ⟨a, hai⟩ := h₁ i hi
  obtain ⟨j, hj, haj⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.1 (h <| mem_iUnion₂_of_mem hi hai)
  rwa [h₀.eq (subset_union_left hi) (subset_union_right hj)
      (not_disjoint_iff.2 ⟨a, hai, haj⟩)]

name: Pairwise.subset_of_biUnion_subset_biUnion
statement:
theorem Pairwise.subset_of_biUnion_subset_biUnion (h₀ : Pairwise (Disjoint on f))
    (h₁ : ∀ i ∈ s, (f i).Nonempty) (h : ⋃ i ∈ s, f i ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ t, f i) : s ⊆ t

name: Pairwise.biUnion_injective
statement:
theorem Pairwise.biUnion_injective (h₀ : Pairwise (Disjoint on f)) (h₁ : ∀ i, (f i).Nonempty) :
    Injective fun s : Set ι => ⋃ i ∈ s, f i
proof:
:= fun _s _t h =>
  ((h₀.subset_of_biUnion_subset_biUnion fun _ _ => h₁ _) <| h.subset).antisymm <|
    (h₀.subset_of_biUnion_subset_biUnion fun _ _ => h₁ _) <| h.superset

name: pairwiseDisjoint_unique
proof:
:= by
  refine existsUnique_of_exists_of_unique ?ex ?unique
  · simpa only [mem_iUnion, exists_prop] using hy
  · rintro i j ⟨his, hi⟩ ⟨hjs, hj⟩
    exact h_disjoint.elim his hjs <| not_disjoint_iff.mpr ⟨y, ⟨hi, hj⟩⟩

name: subperm_iff_count
statement: lemma subperm_iff_count [DecidableEq α] : l₁ <+~ l₂ ↔ ∀ a, count a l₁ ≤ count a l₂
proof:
:=
  subperm_ext_iff.trans <| forall_congr' fun a ↦ by
    by_cases ha : a ∈ l₁ <;> simp [ha, count_eq_zero_of_not_mem]

name: subperm_iff
statement: lemma subperm_iff : l₁ <+~ l₂ ↔ ∃ l, l ~ l₂ ∧ l₁ <+ l
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun ⟨l, h₁, h₂⟩ ↦ h₂.subperm.trans h₁.subperm⟩
  rintro ⟨l, h₁, h₂⟩
  obtain ⟨l', h₂⟩ := h₂.exists_perm_append
  exact ⟨l₁ ++ l', (h₂.trans (h₁.append_right _)).symm, (prefix_append _ _).sublist⟩

name: subperm_singleton_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma subperm_singleton_iff : l <+~ [a] ↔ l = [] ∨ l = [a]
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [subperm_iff]
    rintro ⟨s, hla, h⟩
    rwa [perm_singleton.mp hla, sublist_singleton] at h
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    exacts [nil_subperm, Subperm.refl _]

name: subperm_cons_self
statement: lemma subperm_cons_self : l <+~ a :: l

name: Subperm.append
statement:
theorem Subperm.append {l₁ l₂ r₁ r₂ : List α} :
    l₁ <+~ l₂ → r₁ <+~ r₂ → (l₁ ++ r₁) <+~ (l₂ ++ r₂)
  | ⟨l, hl_perm, hl_sub⟩, ⟨r, hr_perm, hr_sub⟩ =>
    ⟨l ++ r, hl_perm.append hr_perm, hl_sub.append hr_sub⟩

name: map_subperm_map_iff
statement:
theorem map_subperm_map_iff {α β} {l₁ l₂ : List α} {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    (l₁.map f) <+~ (l₂.map f) ↔ l₁ <+~ l₂ where
  mpr a
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨l, hl_perm, hl_sub⟩ := a
    exact ⟨l.map f, hl_perm.map f, hl_sub.map f⟩
  mp a := by
    obtain ⟨w, ⟨perm, sublist⟩⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨x, ⟨sublistₓ, mapₓ⟩⟩ := sublist_map_iff.mp sublist
    use x
    constructor
    · rw [mapₓ] at perm
      exact (map_perm_map_iff hf).mp perm
    · exact sublistₓ

statement: lemma perm_rfl : l ~ l

statement: theorem Perm.subset_congr_left {l₁ l₂ l₃ : List α} (h : l₁ ~ l₂) : l₁ ⊆ l₃ ↔ l₂ ⊆ l₃

  ⟨fun h' => h'.trans h.subset, fun h' => h'.trans h.symm.subset⟩

name: set_perm_cons_eraseIdx
statement:
theorem set_perm_cons_eraseIdx {n : ℕ} (h : n < l.length) (a : α) :
    l.set n a ~ a :: l.eraseIdx n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← insertIdx_eraseIdx_self (Nat.ne_of_lt h)]
  apply perm_insertIdx
  rw [length_eraseIdx_of_lt h]
  exact Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt h

name: getElem_cons_eraseIdx_perm
statement:
theorem getElem_cons_eraseIdx_perm {n : ℕ} (h : n < l.length) :
    l[n] :: l.eraseIdx n ~ l

name: perm_insertIdx_iff_of_le
statement:
theorem perm_insertIdx_iff_of_le {l₁ l₂ : List α} {m n : ℕ} (hm : m ≤ l₁.length)
    (hn : n ≤ l₂.length) (a : α) : l₁.insertIdx m a ~ l₂.insertIdx n a ↔ l₁ ~ l₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel_congr_left (perm_insertIdx _ _ hm), rel_congr_right (perm_insertIdx _ _ hn), perm_cons]

name: perm_insertIdx_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem perm_insertIdx_iff {l₁ l₂ : List α} {n : ℕ} {a : α} :
    l₁.insertIdx n a ~ l₂.insertIdx n a ↔ l₁ ~ l₂
proof:
:= by
  wlog hle : length l₁ ≤ length l₂ generalizing l₁ l₂
  · rw [perm_comm, this (Nat.le_of_not_ge hle), perm_comm]
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge (length l₁) n with
  | inl hn₁ =>
    rw [insertIdx_of_length_lt hn₁]
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge (length l₂) n with
    | inl hn₂ => rw [insertIdx_of_length_lt hn₂]
    | inr hn₂ =>
      apply iff_of_false
      · intro h
        rw [h.length_eq] at hn₁
        grind
      · grind [Perm.length_eq]
  | inr hn₁ =>
    exact perm_insertIdx_iff_of_le hn₁ (Nat.le_trans hn₁ hle) _

name: Perm.insertIdx
statement:
@[gcongr]
protected theorem Perm.insertIdx {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h : l₁ ~ l₂) (n : ℕ) (a : α) :
    l₁.insertIdx n a ~ l₂.insertIdx n a

name: perm_eraseIdx_of_getElem
statement:
theorem perm_eraseIdx_of_getElem?_eq {l₁ l₂ : List α} {m n : ℕ} (h : l₁[m]? = l₂[n]?) :
    eraseIdx l₁ m ~ eraseIdx l₂ n ↔ l₁ ~ l₂
proof:
:= by
  cases Nat.lt_or_ge m l₁.length with
  | inl hm =>
    rw [getElem?_eq_getElem hm, eq_comm, getElem?_eq_some_iff] at h
    cases h with
    | intro hn hnm =>
      rw [← perm_cons l₁[m], rel_congr_left (getElem_cons_eraseIdx_perm ..), ← hnm,
        rel_congr_right (getElem_cons_eraseIdx_perm ..)]
  | inr hm =>
    rw [getElem?_eq_none hm, eq_comm, getElem?_eq_none_iff] at h
    rw [eraseIdx_of_length_le h, eraseIdx_of_length_le hm]

name: perm_comp_perm
statement: theorem perm_comp_perm : (Perm ∘r Perm : List α → List α → Prop) = Perm
proof:
:= by
  funext a c; apply propext
  constructor
  · exact fun ⟨b, hab, hba⟩ => Perm.trans hab hba
  · exact fun h => ⟨a, Perm.refl a, h⟩

name: perm_comp_forall
statement:
theorem perm_comp_forall₂ {l u v} (hlu : Perm l u) (huv : Forall₂ r u v) :
    (Forall₂ r ∘r Perm) l v
proof:
:= by
  induction hlu generalizing v with
  | nil => cases huv; exact ⟨[], Forall₂.nil, Perm.nil⟩
  | cons u _hlu ih =>
    obtain - | ⟨hab, huv'⟩ := huv
    rcases ih huv' with ⟨l₂, h₁₂, h₂₃⟩
    exact ⟨_ :: l₂, Forall₂.cons hab h₁₂, h₂₃.cons _⟩
  | swap a₁ a₂ h₂₃ =>
    obtain - | ⟨h₁, hr₂₃⟩ := huv
    obtain - | ⟨h₂, h₁₂⟩ := hr₂₃
    exact ⟨_, Forall₂.cons h₂ (Forall₂.cons h₁ h₁₂), Perm.swap _ _ _⟩
  | trans _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    rcases ih₂ huv with ⟨lb₂, hab₂, h₂₃⟩
    rcases ih₁ hab₂ with ⟨lb₁, hab₁, h₁₂⟩
    exact ⟨lb₁, hab₁, Perm.trans h₁₂ h₂₃⟩

name: forall
statement: theorem forall₂_comp_perm_eq_perm_comp_forall₂ : Forall₂ r ∘r Perm = Perm ∘r Forall₂ r
proof:
:= by
  funext l₁ l₃; apply propext
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨l₂, h₁₂, h₂₃⟩
    have : Forall₂ (flip r) l₂ l₁ := h₁₂.flip
    rcases perm_comp_forall₂ h₂₃.symm this with ⟨l', h₁, h₂⟩
    exact ⟨l', h₂.symm, h₁.flip⟩
  · exact fun ⟨l₂, h₁₂, h₂₃⟩ => perm_comp_forall₂ h₁₂ h₂₃

name: eq_map_comp_perm
statement: theorem eq_map_comp_perm (f : α → β) : (· = map f ·) ∘r (· ~ ·) = (· ~ map f ·)
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← Relation.comp_eq_fun (map f)]
  simp only [← forall₂_eq_eq_eq, forall₂_map_right_iff, forall₂_comp_perm_eq_perm_comp_forall₂]

name: rel_perm_imp
statement: theorem rel_perm_imp (hr : RightUnique r) : (Forall₂ r ⇒ Forall₂ r ⇒ (· → ·)) Perm Perm
proof:
:=
  fun a b h₁ c d h₂ h =>
  have : (flip (Forall₂ r) ∘r Perm ∘r Forall₂ r) b d := ⟨a, h₁, c, h, h₂⟩
  have : ((flip (Forall₂ r) ∘r Forall₂ r) ∘r Perm) b d := by
    rwa [← forall₂_comp_perm_eq_perm_comp_forall₂, ← Relation.comp_assoc] at this
  let ⟨b', ⟨_, hbc, hcb⟩, hbd⟩ := this
  have : b' = b := right_unique_forall₂' hr hcb hbc
  this ▸ hbd

name: rel_perm
statement: theorem rel_perm (hr : BiUnique r) : (Forall₂ r ⇒ Forall₂ r ⇒ (· ↔ ·)) Perm Perm
proof:
:=
  fun _a _b hab _c _d hcd =>
  Iff.intro (rel_perm_imp hr.2 hab hcd) (rel_perm_imp hr.left.flip hab.flip hcd.flip)

theorem Perm.foldl_eq {f : β → α → β} {l₁ l₂ : List α} [rcomm : RightCommutative f] (p : l₁ ~ l₂) :

name: Perm.foldr_eq
statement:
theorem Perm.foldr_eq {f : α → β → β} {l₁ l₂ : List α} [lcomm : LeftCommutative f] (p : l₁ ~ l₂) :
    ∀ b, foldr f b l₁ = foldr f b l₂
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  induction p using Perm.recOnSwap' generalizing b with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ r => simp [r b]
  | swap' _ _ _ r => simp only [foldr_cons]; rw [lcomm.left_comm, r b]
  | trans _ _ r₁ r₂ => exact Eq.trans (r₁ b) (r₂ b)

  rcases o₁ with - | a <;> rcases o₂ with - | b; · rfl

  · cases p.length_eq
  · exact Option.mem_toList.1 (p.symm.subset <| by simp)

name: perm_replicate_append_replicate
statement:
theorem perm_replicate_append_replicate
    [DecidableEq α] {l : List α} {a b : α} {m n : ℕ} (h : a ≠ b) :
    l ~ replicate m a ++ replicate n b ↔ count a l = m ∧ count b l = n ∧ l ⊆ [a, b]
proof:
:= by
  rw [perm_iff_count, ← Decidable.and_forall_ne a, ← Decidable.and_forall_ne b]
  suffices l ⊆ [a, b] ↔ ∀ c, c ≠ b → c ≠ a → c ∉ l by
    simp +contextual [count_replicate, h, this, count_eq_zero, Ne.symm]
  trans ∀ c, c ∈ l → c = b ∨ c = a
  · simp [subset_def, or_comm]
  · exact forall_congr' fun _ => by rw [← and_imp, ← not_or, not_imp_not]

  map f l ~ map f l' ↔ Relation.Comp (· = map f ·) (· ~ ·) (map f l) l' := by rw [eq_map_comp_perm]
  _ ↔ l ~ l' := by simp [Relation.Comp, map_inj_right hf]

theorem flatMap_append_perm (l : List α) (f g : α → List β) :
    l.flatMap f ++ l.flatMap g ~ l.flatMap fun x => f x ++ g x
proof:

  induction l with | nil => simp | cons a l IH => ?_
  simp only [flatMap_cons, append_assoc]
  refine (Perm.trans ?_ (IH.append_left _)).append_left _
  rw [← append_assoc, ← append_assoc]

statement:
theorem Perm.inter_append {l t₁ t₂ : List α} (h : Disjoint t₁ t₂) :
    l ∩ (t₁ ++ t₂) ~ l ∩ t₁ ++ l ∩ t₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs l_ih =>
    by_cases h₁ : x ∈ t₁
    · have h₂ : x ∉ t₂ := h h₁
      simp [*]
    by_cases h₂ : x ∈ t₂
    · simp only [*, inter_cons_of_notMem, false_or, mem_append, inter_cons_of_mem,
        not_false_iff]
      exact perm_cons_append_cons _ l_ih
    · simp [*]

name: Perm.take_inter
statement:
theorem Perm.take_inter {xs ys : List α} (n : ℕ) (h : xs ~ ys)
    (h' : ys.Nodup) : xs.take n ~ ys ∩ (xs.take n)
proof:
:= calc
  xs.take n ~ xs.filter (xs.take n).elem := by
    conv_lhs => rw [Nodup.take_eq_filter_mem ((Perm.nodup_iff h).2 h')]
  _ ~ ys ∩ (xs.take n) := Perm.filter _ h

name: Perm.drop_inter
statement:
theorem Perm.drop_inter {xs ys : List α} (n : ℕ) (h : xs ~ ys) (h' : ys.Nodup) :
    xs.drop n ~ ys ∩ (xs.drop n)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h'' : n ≤ xs.length
  · let n' := xs.length - n
    have h₀ : n = xs.length - n' := by rwa [Nat.sub_sub_self]
    have h₁ : xs.drop n = (xs.reverse.take n').reverse := by
      rw [take_reverse, h₀, reverse_reverse]
    rw [h₁]
    apply (reverse_perm _).trans
    rw [inter_reverse]
    apply Perm.take_inter _ _ h'
    apply (reverse_perm _).trans; assumption
  · grind [drop_eq_nil_of_le]

name: Perm.dropSlice_inter
statement:
theorem Perm.dropSlice_inter {xs ys : List α} (n m : ℕ) (h : xs ~ ys)
    (h' : ys.Nodup) : List.dropSlice n m xs ~ ys ∩ List.dropSlice n m xs
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dropSlice_eq]
  have : n ≤ n + m := Nat.le_add_right _ _
  have h₂ := h.nodup_iff.2 h'
  apply Perm.trans _ (Perm.inter_append _).symm
  · exact Perm.append (Perm.take_inter _ h h') (Perm.drop_inter _ h h')
  · exact disjoint_take_drop h₂ this

          MonoidWithZeroHom.ext_nat (h_pos _))
        n

name: fib_add_two
statement: theorem fib_add_two (n : ℤ) : fib (n + 2) = fib n + fib (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with (n | n)
  · dsimp
    rw [← Nat.cast_ofNat, ← Nat.cast_add, ← Nat.cast_add_one, fib_natCast, fib_natCast,
      Nat.fib_add_two, Nat.cast_add]
  · rw [negSucc_eq, ← Nat.cast_add_one, fib_neg_natCast]
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, neg_add_rev, reduceNeg, add_comm,
      add_assoc, reduceAdd, add_neg_cancel_comm_assoc, fib_neg_natCast]
    if hn0 : n = 0 then simp [hn0] else
    symm
    calc _ = (-1) ^ (n + 1) * ((n.fib - (n + 1).fib : ℤ)) := by grind
      _ = _ := by
        have : -(n : ℤ) + 1 = -((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by grind
        obtain (⟨n, rfl⟩ | ⟨n, rfl⟩) := n.even_or_odd
        · rw [Nat.fib_add_one hn0, this, fib_neg_natCast, pow_add, ← two_mul,
            Nat.sub_add_cancel (by grind)]
          simp
        · rw [Nat.fib_add_one hn0, this, fib_neg_natCast, pow_add]
          simp

name: fib_natCast_add
statement:
private theorem fib_natCast_add :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (n : ℤ), fib (m + n) = fib (m - 1) * fib n + fib m * fib (n + 1)
  | 0, _ => by simp
  | 1, _ => by simp [add_comm]
  | m + 2, n => by
    calc _ = fib (m + n) + fib (m + n + 1)
proof:
:= by grind [fib_add_two]
      _ = fib (m - 1) * fib n + fib m * fib (n + 1) + fib ((m + 1 : ℕ) + n) := by
        rw [fib_natCast_add]; grind
      _ = fib (m - 1) * fib n + fib m * fib (n + 1) + fib m * fib n +
          fib (m + 1) * fib (n + 1) := by rw [fib_natCast_add]; grind
      _ = _ := by grind [fib_add_two]

name: fib_add_natCast
statement:
private theorem fib_add_natCast :
    ∀ (m : ℤ) (n : ℕ), fib (m + n) = fib (m - 1) * fib n + fib m * fib (n + 1)
  | _, 0 => by simp
  | _, 1 => by grind [fib_add_two, fib_two, fib_one]
  | n, m + 2 =>
    calc _ = fib (m + n) + fib (m + n + 1)
proof:
:= by grind [fib_add_two]
      _ = fib (m - 1) * fib n + fib m * fib (n + 1) + fib ((m + 1 : ℕ) + n) := by
        rw [fib_natCast_add]; grind
      _ = fib (m - 1) * fib n + fib m * fib (n + 1) + fib m * fib n +
          fib (m + 1) * fib (n + 1) := by rw [fib_natCast_add]; grind
      _ = _ := by grind [fib_add_two]

name: fib_neg_natCast_add_neg_natCast
statement:
private theorem fib_neg_natCast_add_neg_natCast :
    ∀ (m n : ℕ), fib (-m + -n) = fib (-m - 1) * fib (-n) + fib (-m) * fib (-n + 1)
  | _, 0 => by simp
  | _, 1 => by simp [sub_eq_neg_add, add_comm]
  | m, n + 2 =>
    calc _ = fib (-m + -n) - fib (-m + -(n + 1 : ℕ))
proof:
:= by grind [fib_add_two]
      _ = fib (-m - 1) * fib (-n) + fib (-m) * fib (-n + 1) -
          fib (-m - 1) * fib (-n - 1) - fib (-m) * fib (-n) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [fib_neg_natCast_add_neg_natCast, fib_neg_natCast_add_neg_natCast]
        grind
      _ = _ := by grind [fib_add_two]

name: fib_add
statement: theorem fib_add (m n : ℤ) : fib (m + n) = fib (m - 1) * fib n + fib m * fib (n + 1)

  · exact fib_natCast_add _ _

name: cast_divNat_of_ne_zero
statement:
@[norm_cast] lemma cast_divNat_of_ne_zero (a : ℕ) {b : ℕ} (hb : (b : α) ≠ 0) :
    divNat a b = (a / b : α)
proof:
:= by
  rcases e : divNat a b with ⟨⟨n, d, h, c⟩, hn⟩
  rw [← Rat.num_nonneg] at hn
  lift n to ℕ using hn
  have hd : (d : α) ≠ 0 := by
    refine fun hd ↦ hb ?_
    have : Rat.divInt a b = _ := congr_arg NNRat.cast e
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : d ∣ b := by simpa [Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, this] using Rat.den_dvd a b
    simp [*]
  have hb' : b ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; exact hb Nat.cast_zero
  simp_rw [Rat.mk_eq_divInt, mk_divInt, divNat_inj hb' h] at e
  rw [cast_def]
  dsimp
  rw [Commute.div_eq_div_iff _ hd hb]
  · norm_cast
    rw [e]
  exact b.commute_cast _

name: cast_divInt_of_ne_zero
statement:
@[norm_cast]
lemma cast_divInt_of_ne_zero (a : ℤ) {b : ℤ} (b0 : (b : α) ≠ 0) : (a /. b : α) = a / b
proof:
:= by
  have b0' : b ≠ 0 := by
    refine mt ?_ b0
    simp +contextual
  rcases e : a /. b with ⟨n, d, h, c⟩
  have d0 : (d : α) ≠ 0 := by
    intro d0
    have dd := den_dvd a b
    rcases show (d : ℤ) ∣ b by rwa [e] at dd with ⟨k, ke⟩
    have : (b : α) = (d : α) * (k : α) := by rw [ke, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast]
    rw [d0, zero_mul] at this
    contradiction
  rw [mk_eq_divInt] at e
  have := congr_arg ((↑) : ℤ → α)
    ((divInt_eq_divInt_iff b0' <| ne_of_gt <| Int.natCast_pos.2 h.bot_lt).1 e)
  rw [Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast] at this
  rw [eq_comm, cast_def, div_eq_mul_inv, eq_div_iff_mul_eq d0, mul_assoc, (d.commute_cast _).eq,
    ← mul_assoc, this, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ b0, mul_one]

name: cast_injective
statement:
@[stacks 09FR "Characteristic zero case."]
lemma cast_injective : Injective ((↑) : ℚ → α)
  | ⟨n₁, d₁, d₁0, c₁⟩, ⟨n₂, d₂, d₂0, c₂⟩, h => by
    have d₁a : (d₁ : α) ≠ 0
proof:
:= Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 d₁0
    have d₂a : (d₂ : α) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 d₂0
    rw [mk_eq_divInt, mk_eq_divInt] at h ⊢
    rw [cast_divInt_of_ne_zero _ (by simpa), cast_divInt_of_ne_zero _ (by simpa)] at h
    norm_cast at h
    rwa [eq_div_iff_mul_eq d₂a, division_def, mul_assoc, (d₁.cast_commute (d₂ : α)).inv_left₀.eq,
      ← mul_assoc, ← division_def, eq_comm, eq_div_iff_mul_eq d₁a, eq_comm, ← Int.cast_natCast d₁,
      ← Int.cast_mul, ← Int.cast_natCast d₂, ← Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_inj, ← mkRat_eq_iff d₁0 d₂0]
      at h

name: cast_injective
statement: lemma cast_injective : Injective ((↑) : ℚ≥0 → α)
proof:
:= by
  rintro p q hpq
  rw [NNRat.cast_def, NNRat.cast_def, Commute.div_eq_div_iff] at hpq
  on_goal 1 => rw [← p.num_div_den, ← q.num_div_den, div_eq_div_iff]
  · norm_cast at hpq ⊢
  any_goals norm_cast
  any_goals apply den_ne_zero
  exact Nat.cast_commute ..
