name: ratSqrt_nonneg
statement: theorem ratSqrt_nonneg (x prec : ℕ) : 0 ≤ ratSqrt x prec

name: ratSqrt_sq_le
statement: theorem ratSqrt_sq_le (x : ℕ) {prec : ℕ} (h : 0 < prec) : (ratSqrt x prec) ^ 2 ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  unfold ratSqrt
  rw [div_pow, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  norm_cast
  exact sqrt_le' (x * prec ^ 2)

name: lt_ratSqrt_add_inv_prec_sq
statement:
theorem lt_ratSqrt_add_inv_prec_sq (x : ℕ) {prec : ℕ} (h : 0 < prec) :
    x < (ratSqrt x prec + 1 / prec) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold ratSqrt
  rw [← mul_lt_mul_iff_of_pos_right (a := (prec ^ 2 : ℚ)) (by positivity)]
  rw [← mul_pow, add_mul]
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀, div_mul_cancel₀]
  · norm_cast
    exact lt_succ_sqrt' (x * prec ^ 2)
  all_goals norm_cast; positivity

name: Setoid.IsPartition.ncard_eq_finsum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hst (t : Set α) : (s ∩ t).Finite := hs.inter_of_left t
  have hst' (t : Set α) : Nat.card ↑(s ∩ t) = (hst t).toFinset.card :=
    Nat.card_eq_card_finite_toFinset (hst t)
  suffices hs' : _ by
    rw [finsum_def, dite_eq_left hs']
    simp only [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Nat.card_eq_card_finite_toFinset hs]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t ht ↦ by exact hst' ↑t)]
    rw [← Finset.card_sigma, eq_comm]
    apply Finset.card_nbij' (fun ⟨t, x⟩ ↦ x)
      (fun x ↦ ⟨⟨(hP.2 x).exists.choose, (hP.2 x).exists.choose_spec.1⟩, x⟩)
    · rintro ⟨t, x⟩
      simp +contextual
    · intro x
      simp only [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_sigma, Function.mem_support, Set.mem_inter_iff,
        Finset.mem_coe]
      intro hx
      refine ⟨Nat.card_ne_zero.mpr ⟨?_, hst (hP.right x).exists.choose⟩,
        hx, (hP.2 x).exists.choose_spec.2⟩
      simp only [nonempty_subtype, Set.mem_inter_iff]
      use x, hx, (hP.2 x).exists.choose_spec.2
    · rintro ⟨t, x⟩
      simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Function.mem_support, Nat.card_ne_zero,
        Set.mem_inter_iff, Sigma.mk.inj_iff, heq_eq_eq, and_true, and_imp, Finset.mem_coe]
      simp only [nonempty_subtype, Set.mem_inter_iff, forall_exists_index, and_imp]
      intro y hy hyt _ hxs hxt
      rw [← Subtype.coe_inj]
      exact (hP.2 x).unique (hP.2 x).exists.choose_spec ⟨t.prop, hxt⟩
    · intro t
      simp only [implies_true]
  let f : Function.support (fun (t : P) ↦ (s ∩ (t : Set α)).ncard) → s := fun ⟨t, ht⟩ ↦
    ⟨(Set.nonempty_of_ncard_ne_zero ht).choose, (Set.nonempty_of_ncard_ne_zero ht).choose_spec.1⟩
  have hf (t : Function.support (fun (t : P) ↦ (s ∩ (t : Set α)).ncard)) :
      ↑↑t ∈ P ∧ (f t : α) ∈ (t : Set α) :=
    ⟨(↑t : P).prop, (Set.nonempty_of_ncard_ne_zero t.prop).choose_spec.2⟩
  have : Finite ↑s := hs
  apply Finite.of_injective f
  intro t t' h
  simp only [← Subtype.coe_inj]
  exact (hP.2 (f t)).unique (hf t) (h ▸ hf t')

name: Subtype.coe_bot
statement:
theorem Subtype.coe_bot {s : Set ℕ} [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] [h : Nonempty s] :
    ((⊥ : s) : ℕ) = Nat.find (nonempty_subtype.1 h)

name: set_eq_univ
statement: theorem set_eq_univ {S : Set ℕ} : S = Set.univ ↔ 0 ∈ S ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, k ∈ S → k + 1 ∈ S
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rintro rfl; simp, fun ⟨h0, hs⟩ => Set.eq_univ_of_forall (set_induction h0 hs)⟩

name: exists_not_and_succ_of_not_zero_of_exists
statement:
lemma exists_not_and_succ_of_not_zero_of_exists {p : ℕ → Prop} (H' : ¬ p 0) (H : ∃ n, p n) :
    ∃ n, ¬ p n ∧ p (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let k := Nat.find H
  have hk : p k := Nat.find_spec H
  suffices 0 < k from
    ⟨k - 1, Nat.find_min H <| Nat.pred_lt this.ne', by rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel this]⟩
  by_contra! contra
  rw [le_zero_eq] at contra
  exact H' (contra ▸ hk)

name: add_pow
statement:
theorem add_pow (h : Commute x y) (n : ℕ) :
    (x + y) ^ n = ∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), x ^ m * y ^ (n - m) * n.choose m
proof:
:= by
  let t : ℕ → ℕ → R := fun n m ↦ x ^ m * y ^ (n - m) * n.choose m
  change (x + y) ^ n = ∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), t n m
  have h_first : ∀ n, t n 0 = y ^ n := fun n ↦ by
    simp only [t, choose_zero_right, pow_zero, cast_one, mul_one, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero]
  have h_last : ∀ n, t n n.succ = 0 := fun n ↦ by
    simp only [t, choose_succ_self, cast_zero, mul_zero]
  have h_middle :
      ∀ n i : ℕ, i ∈ range n.succ → (t n.succ i.succ) = x * t n i + y * t n i.succ := by
    intro n i h_mem
    have h_le : i ≤ n := le_of_lt_succ (mem_range.mp h_mem)
    dsimp only [t]
    rw [choose_succ_succ, cast_add, mul_add]
    congr 1
    · rw [pow_succ' x, succ_sub_succ, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
    · rw [← mul_assoc y, ← mul_assoc y, (h.symm.pow_right i.succ).eq]
      by_cases h_eq : i = n
      · rw [h_eq, choose_succ_self, cast_zero, mul_zero, mul_zero]
      · rw [succ_sub (lt_of_le_of_ne h_le h_eq)]
        rw [pow_succ' y, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [pow_zero, sum_range_succ, range_zero, sum_empty, zero_add]
    dsimp only [t]
    rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, choose_self, cast_one, mul_one, mul_one]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [sum_range_succ', h_first, sum_congr rfl (h_middle n), sum_add_distrib, add_assoc,
      pow_succ' (x + y), ih, add_mul, mul_sum, mul_sum]
    congr 1
    rw [sum_range_succ', sum_range_succ, h_first, h_last, mul_zero, add_zero, _root_.pow_succ']

name: add_pow'
statement:
theorem add_pow' (h : Commute x y) (n : ℕ) :
    (x + y) ^ n = ∑ m ∈ antidiagonal n, n.choose m.1 • (x ^ m.1 * y ^ m.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ fun m p ↦ n.choose m • (x ^ m * y ^ p),
    nsmul_eq_mul, cast_comm, h.add_pow]

name: add_pow
statement:
theorem add_pow [CommSemiring R] (x y : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (x + y) ^ n = ∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), x ^ m * y ^ (n - m) * n.choose m

name: sub_pow
statement:
theorem sub_pow [CommRing R] (x y : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (x - y) ^ n = ∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), (-1) ^ (m + n) * x ^ m * y ^ (n - m) * n.choose m
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_pow]
  congr! 1 with m hm
  have : (-1 : R) ^ (n - m) = (-1) ^ (n + m) := by
    rw [mem_range] at hm
    simp [show n + m = n - m + 2 * m by lia, pow_add]
  rw [neg_pow, this]
  ring

name: sum_range_choose
statement: theorem sum_range_choose (n : ℕ) : (∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), n.choose m) = 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have := (add_pow 1 1 n).symm
  simpa [one_add_one_eq_two] using this

name: sum_range_choose_halfway
statement: theorem sum_range_choose_halfway (m : ℕ) : (∑ i ∈ range (m + 1), (2 * m + 1).choose i) = 4 ^ m
proof:
:=
  have : (∑ i ∈ range (m + 1), (2 * m + 1).choose (2 * m + 1 - i)) =
      ∑ i ∈ range (m + 1), (2 * m + 1).choose i :=
    sum_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ choose_symm <| by linarith [mem_range.1 hi]
  mul_right_injective₀ two_ne_zero <|
    calc
      (2 * ∑ i ∈ range (m + 1), (2 * m + 1).choose i) =
          (∑ i ∈ range (m + 1), (2 * m + 1).choose i) +
            ∑ i ∈ range (m + 1), (2 * m + 1).choose (2 * m + 1 - i) := by rw [two_mul, this]
      _ = (∑ i ∈ range (m + 1), (2 * m + 1).choose i) +
            ∑ i ∈ Ico (m + 1) (2 * m + 2), (2 * m + 1).choose i := by
        rw [range_eq_Ico, sum_Ico_reflect _ _ (by lia)]
        congr
        lia
      _ = ∑ i ∈ range (2 * m + 2), (2 * m + 1).choose i := sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ (by lia)
      _ = 2 ^ (2 * m + 1) := sum_range_choose (2 * m + 1)
      _ = 2 * 4 ^ m := by rw [pow_succ, pow_mul, mul_comm]; rfl

name: choose_middle_le_pow
statement: theorem choose_middle_le_pow (n : ℕ) : (2 * n + 1).choose n ≤ 4 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have t : (2 * n + 1).choose n ≤ ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), (2 * n + 1).choose i :=
    single_le_sum (fun x _ ↦ by lia) (self_mem_range_succ n)
  simpa [sum_range_choose_halfway n] using t

name: four_pow_le_two_mul_add_one_mul_central_binom
statement:
theorem four_pow_le_two_mul_add_one_mul_central_binom (n : ℕ) :
    4 ^ n ≤ (2 * n + 1) * (2 * n).choose n
proof:
:=
  calc
    4 ^ n = (1 + 1) ^ (2 * n) := by simp [pow_mul]
    _ = ∑ m ∈ range (2 * n + 1), (2 * n).choose m := by simp [-Nat.reduceAdd, add_pow]
    _ ≤ ∑ _ ∈ range (2 * n + 1), (2 * n).choose (2 * n / 2) := by gcongr; apply choose_le_middle
    _ = (2 * n + 1) * choose (2 * n) n := by simp

name: sum_Icc_choose
statement: theorem sum_Icc_choose (n k : ℕ) : ∑ m ∈ Icc k n, m.choose k = (n + 1).choose (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_ge n k with h | h
  · rw [choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by lia), Icc_eq_empty_of_lt h, sum_empty]
  · induction n, h using le_induction with
    | base => simp
    | succ n _ ih =>
      rw [← Ico_insert_right (by lia), sum_insert (by simp), Ico_add_one_right_eq_Icc, ih,
        choose_succ_succ' (n + 1)]

name: sum_range_add_choose
statement:
lemma sum_range_add_choose (n k : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (i + k).choose k = (n + k + 1).choose (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sum_Icc_choose, range_eq_Ico]
  convert! (sum_map _ (addRightEmbedding k) (·.choose k)).symm using 2
  rw [map_add_right_Ico, zero_add, add_right_comm, Ico_add_one_right_eq_Icc]

name: sum_range_mul_choose
statement:
theorem sum_range_mul_choose (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), i * (n.choose i) = n * 2 ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : n = 0
  · simp [h]
  apply (mul_right_inj' two_ne_zero).1
  calc
    2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), i * n.choose i
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n - i) * n.choose (n - i)
        + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), i * n.choose i := by
      rw [two_mul, ← sum_flip]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n - i) * n.choose i
        + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), i * n.choose i := by
      congr! 2 with _ h'
      rw [choose_symm (mem_range_succ_iff.mp h')]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), n * n.choose i := by
      rw [← sum_add_distrib]
      congr! 1 with _ h'
      rw [← add_mul, Nat.sub_add_cancel (mem_range_succ_iff.mp h')]
    _ = n * 2 ^ n := by
      rw [← mul_sum, Nat.sum_range_choose]
    _ = 2 * (n * 2 ^ (n - 1)) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm 2 n, mul_assoc, mul_pow_sub_one h]

name: sum_range_multichoose
statement:
lemma sum_range_multichoose (n k : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), k.multichoose i = (n + k).choose k
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => simp [Finset.sum_range_succ']
  | succ k => grind [multichoose_eq, choose_symm_of_eq_add, sum_range_add_choose]

name: Int.alternating_sum_range_choose_eq_choose
statement:
theorem Int.alternating_sum_range_choose_eq_choose {n m : ℕ} :
    (∑ k ∈ range (m + 1), ((-1) ^ k * (n + 1).choose k : ℤ)) = (-1) ^ m * n.choose m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m hm =>
    rw [sum_range_succ, hm, choose_succ_succ]
    grind

name: Int.alternating_sum_range_choose
statement:
theorem Int.alternating_sum_range_choose {n : ℕ} :
    (∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), ((-1) ^ m * n.choose m : ℤ)) = if n = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n => simp [Int.alternating_sum_range_choose_eq_choose]

name: Int.alternating_sum_range_choose_of_ne
statement:
theorem Int.alternating_sum_range_choose_of_ne {n : ℕ} (h0 : n ≠ 0) :
    (∑ m ∈ range (n + 1), ((-1) ^ m * n.choose m : ℤ)) = 0

name: sum_powerset_apply_card
statement:
theorem sum_powerset_apply_card {α β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] (f : ℕ → α) {x : Finset β} :
    ∑ m ∈ x.powerset, f #m = ∑ m ∈ range (#x + 1), (#x).choose m • f m
proof:
:= by
  trans ∑ m ∈ range (#x + 1), ∑ j ∈ x.powerset with #j = m, f #j
  · refine (sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to ?_ _).symm
    intro y hy
    rw [mem_range, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
    rw [mem_powerset] at hy
    exact card_le_card hy
  · refine sum_congr rfl fun y _ ↦ ?_
    rw [← card_powersetCard, ← sum_const]
    refine sum_congr powersetCard_eq_filter.symm fun z hz ↦ ?_
    rw [(mem_powersetCard.1 hz).2]

name: sum_powerset_neg_one_pow_card
statement:
theorem sum_powerset_neg_one_pow_card {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {x : Finset α} :
    (∑ m ∈ x.powerset, (-1 : ℤ) ^ #m) = if x = ∅ then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_powerset_apply_card]
  simp only [nsmul_eq_mul', ← card_eq_zero, Int.alternating_sum_range_choose]

name: sum_powerset_neg_one_pow_card_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem sum_powerset_neg_one_pow_card_of_nonempty {α : Type*} {x : Finset α} (h0 : x.Nonempty) :
    (∑ m ∈ x.powerset, (-1 : ℤ) ^ #m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [sum_powerset_neg_one_pow_card]
  exact ite_eq_right (nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mp h0)

name: prod_pow_choose_succ
statement:
@[to_additive sum_choose_succ_nsmul]
theorem prod_pow_choose_succ {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) (n : ℕ) :
    (∏ i ∈ range (n + 2), f i (n + 1 - i) ^ (n + 1).choose i) =
      (∏ i ∈ range (n + 1), f i (n + 1 - i) ^ n.choose i) *
        ∏ i ∈ range (n + 1), f (i + 1) (n - i) ^ n.choose i
proof:
:= by
  have A : (∏ i ∈ range (n + 1), f (i + 1) (n - i) ^ (n.choose (i + 1))) * f 0 (n + 1) =
      ∏ i ∈ range (n + 1), f i (n + 1 - i) ^ (n.choose i) := by
    rw [prod_range_succ, prod_range_succ']; simp
  rw [prod_range_succ']
  simpa [choose_succ_succ, pow_add, prod_mul_distrib, A, mul_assoc] using mul_comm _ _

name: prod_antidiagonal_pow_choose_succ
statement:
@[to_additive sum_antidiagonal_choose_succ_nsmul]
theorem prod_antidiagonal_pow_choose_succ {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) (n : ℕ) :
    (∏ ij ∈ antidiagonal (n + 1), f ij.1 ij.2 ^ (n + 1).choose ij.1) =
      (∏ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, f ij.1 (ij.2 + 1) ^ n.choose ij.1) *
        ∏ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, f (ij.1 + 1) ij.2 ^ n.choose ij.2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Nat.prod_antidiagonal_eq_prod_range_succ_mk, prod_pow_choose_succ]
  have : ∀ i ∈ range (n + 1), i ≤ n := fun i hi ↦ by simpa [Nat.lt_succ_iff] using hi
  congr 1
  · refine prod_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ ?_
    rw [tsub_add_eq_add_tsub (this _ hi)]
  · refine prod_congr rfl fun i hi ↦ ?_
    rw [choose_symm (this _ hi)]

name: sum_choose_succ_mul
statement:
theorem sum_choose_succ_mul (f : ℕ → ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ range (n + 2), ((n + 1).choose i : R) * f i (n + 1 - i)) =
      (∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), (n.choose i : R) * f i (n + 1 - i)) +
        ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), (n.choose i : R) * f (i + 1) (n - i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul] using sum_choose_succ_nsmul f n

name: sum_antidiagonal_choose_succ_mul
statement:
theorem sum_antidiagonal_choose_succ_mul (f : ℕ → ℕ → R) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal (n + 1), ((n + 1).choose ij.1 : R) * f ij.1 ij.2) =
      (∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, (n.choose ij.1 : R) * f ij.1 (ij.2 + 1)) +
        ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, (n.choose ij.2 : R) * f (ij.1 + 1) ij.2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul] using sum_antidiagonal_choose_succ_nsmul f n

name: sum_antidiagonal_choose_add
statement:
theorem sum_antidiagonal_choose_add (d n : ℕ) :
    (∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal n, (d + ij.2).choose d) = (d + n + 1).choose (d + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn => rw [Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ, hn, Nat.choose_succ_succ (d + (n + 1)), ← add_assoc]

name: dvd_choose_add
statement:
theorem dvd_choose_add (hp : Prime p) (hap : a < p) (hbp : b < p) (h : p ≤ a + b) :
    p ∣ choose (a + b) a
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : p ∣ (a + b)! := hp.dvd_factorial.2 h
  rw [← add_choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial, ← choose_symm_add, hp.dvd_mul, hp.dvd_mul,
    hp.dvd_factorial, hp.dvd_factorial] at h₁
  exact (h₁.resolve_right hbp.not_ge).resolve_right hap.not_ge

name: dvd_choose
statement: lemma dvd_choose (hp : Prime p) (ha : a < p) (hab : b - a < p) (h : p ≤ b) : p ∣ choose b a
proof:
:=
  have : a + (b - a) = b := Nat.add_sub_of_le (ha.le.trans h)
  this ▸ hp.dvd_choose_add ha hab (this.symm ▸ h)

name: dvd_choose_self
statement: lemma dvd_choose_self (hp : Prime p) (hk : k ≠ 0) (hkp : k < p) : p ∣ choose p k
proof:
:=
  hp.dvd_choose hkp (sub_lt ((zero_le _).trans_lt hkp) <| zero_lt_of_ne_zero hk) le_rfl

name: coprime_choose_of_lt
statement:
lemma coprime_choose_of_lt (hp : p.Prime) (hb : b < p) (ha : a ≤ b) :
    p.Coprime (b.choose a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.choose_eq_descFactorial_div_factorial]
  exact (hp.coprime_descFactorial_of_lt_of_le hb ha).coprime_div_right
    (Nat.factorial_dvd_descFactorial b a)

name: choose_zero_right
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem choose_zero_right (n : ℕ) : choose n 0 = 1

name: choose_zero_succ
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem choose_zero_succ (k : ℕ) : choose 0 (succ k) = 0

name: choose_succ_succ
statement:
@[grind =]
theorem choose_succ_succ (n k : ℕ) : choose (succ n) (succ k) = choose n k + choose n (succ k)

name: choose_succ_succ'
statement: theorem choose_succ_succ' (n k : ℕ) : choose (n + 1) (k + 1) = choose n k + choose n (k + 1)

name: choose_succ_left
statement:
theorem choose_succ_left (n k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    choose (n + 1) k = choose n (k - 1) + choose n k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, k = l + 1 := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hk
  rfl

name: choose_succ_right
statement:
theorem choose_succ_right (n k : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    choose n (k + 1) = choose (n - 1) k + choose (n - 1) (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, n = l + 1 := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hn
  rfl

name: choose_eq_choose_pred_add
statement:
theorem choose_eq_choose_pred_add {n k : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hk : 0 < k) :
    choose n k = choose (n - 1) (k - 1) + choose (n - 1) k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, k = l + 1 := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hk
  rw [choose_succ_right _ _ hn, Nat.add_one_sub_one]

name: choose_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
@[grind <=]
theorem choose_eq_zero_of_lt : ∀ {n k}, n < k → choose n k = 0
  | _, 0, hk => absurd hk (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | 0, _ + 1, _ => choose_zero_succ _
  | n + 1, k + 1, hk => by
    have hnk : n < k
proof:
:= lt_of_succ_lt_succ hk
    have hnk1 : n < k + 1 := lt_of_succ_lt hk
    rw [choose_succ_succ, choose_eq_zero_of_lt hnk, choose_eq_zero_of_lt hnk1]

name: choose_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem choose_self (n : ℕ) : choose n n = 1

name: choose_succ_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem choose_succ_self (n : ℕ) : choose n (succ n) = 0

name: choose_one_right
statement:
@[simp]
lemma choose_one_right (n : ℕ) : choose n 1 = n
proof: := by induction n <;> simp [*, choose, Nat.add_comm]

name: triangle_succ
statement: theorem triangle_succ (n : ℕ) : (n + 1) * (n + 1 - 1) / 2 = n * (n - 1) / 2 + n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_mul_div_left, Nat.mul_comm 2 n, ← Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.mul_comm]
  cases n <;> rfl; apply zero_lt_succ

name: choose_two_right
statement: theorem choose_two_right (n : ℕ) : choose n 2 = n * (n - 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [triangle_succ n, choose, ih]
    simp [Nat.add_comm]

name: choose_pos
statement:
theorem choose_pos : ∀ {n k}, k ≤ n → 0 < choose n k
  | 0, _, hk => by rw [Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hk]; decide
  | n + 1, 0, _ => by simp
  | _ + 1, _ + 1, hk => Nat.add_pos_left (choose_pos (le_of_succ_le_succ hk)) _

name: choose_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem choose_eq_zero_iff {n k : ℕ} : n.choose k = 0 ↔ n < k

name: choose_ne_zero_iff
statement: theorem choose_ne_zero_iff {n k : ℕ} : n.choose k ≠ 0 ↔ k ≤ n

name: choose_ne_zero
statement: lemma choose_ne_zero {n k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ n) : n.choose k ≠ 0

name: add_one_mul_choose_eq
statement:
theorem add_one_mul_choose_eq : ∀ n k, (n + 1) * choose n k = choose (n + 1) (k + 1) * (k + 1)
  | 0, 0 => by decide
  | 0, k + 1 => by simp [choose]
  | n + 1, 0 => by simp [choose, mul_succ, Nat.add_comm]
  | n + 1, k + 1 => by
    rw [choose_succ_succ' (n + 1) (k + 1), Nat.add_mul _ _ (k + 1 + 1), ← add_one_mul_choose_eq n,
      mul_add_one, ← add_one_mul_choose_eq n, Nat.add_right_comm _ _ (_ * _), ← Nat.mul_add,
      ← choose_succ_succ', ← add_one_mul]

name: choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial
statement:
theorem choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial : ∀ {n k}, k ≤ n → choose n k * k ! * (n - k)! = n !
  | 0, _, hk => by simp [Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hk]
  | n + 1, 0, _ => by simp
  | n + 1, succ k, hk => by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hk with hk₁ | hk₁
    · have h : choose n k * k.succ ! * (n - k)! = (k + 1) * n !
proof:
:= by
        rw [← choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial (le_of_succ_le_succ hk)]
        simp [factorial_succ, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
      have h₁ : (n - k)! = (n - k) * (n - k.succ)! := by
        rw [← succ_sub_succ, succ_sub (le_of_lt_succ hk₁), factorial_succ]
      have h₂ : choose n (succ k) * k.succ ! * ((n - k) * (n - k.succ)!) = (n - k) * n ! := by
        rw [← choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial (le_of_lt_succ hk₁)]
        simp [factorial_succ, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc]
      have h₃ : k * n ! ≤ n * n ! := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (le_of_succ_le_succ hk)
      rw [choose_succ_succ, Nat.add_mul, Nat.add_mul, succ_sub_succ, h, h₁, h₂, Nat.add_mul,
        Nat.mul_sub_right_distrib, factorial_succ, ← Nat.add_sub_assoc h₃, Nat.add_assoc,
        ← Nat.add_mul, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, Nat.add_comm]
    · rw [hk₁]; simp [Nat.mul_comm, choose, Nat.sub_self]

name: choose_mul
statement:
theorem choose_mul {n k s : ℕ} (hsk : s ≤ k) :
    n.choose k * k.choose s = n.choose s * (n - s).choose (k - s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain hnk | hkn := lt_or_ge n k
  · grind
  have h : 0 < (n - k)! * (k - s)! * s ! := by apply_rules [factorial_pos, Nat.mul_pos]
  apply Nat.mul_right_cancel h
  calc
    _ = n.choose s * s ! * ((n - s).choose (k - s) * (k - s)! * (n - s - (k - s))!) := by
      grind [choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial]
    _ = n.choose s * (n - s).choose (k - s) * ((n - k)! * (k - s)! * s !) := by
      grind

name: choose_eq_factorial_div_factorial
statement:
theorem choose_eq_factorial_div_factorial {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    choose n k = n ! / (k ! * (n - k)!)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hk, Nat.mul_assoc]
  exact (mul_div_left _ (Nat.mul_pos (factorial_pos _) (factorial_pos _))).symm

name: add_choose
statement: theorem add_choose (i j : ℕ) : (i + j).choose j = (i + j)! / (i ! * j !)
proof:
:= by
  rw [choose_eq_factorial_div_factorial (Nat.le_add_left j i), Nat.add_sub_cancel_right,
    Nat.mul_comm]

name: add_choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial
statement:
theorem add_choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial (i j : ℕ) :
    (i + j).choose j * i ! * j ! = (i + j)!

name: factorial_mul_factorial_dvd_factorial
statement: theorem factorial_mul_factorial_dvd_factorial {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) : k ! * (n - k)! ∣ n !
proof:
:= by
  rw [← choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial hk, Nat.mul_assoc]; exact Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _

name: factorial_mul_factorial_dvd_factorial_add
statement: theorem factorial_mul_factorial_dvd_factorial_add (i j : ℕ) : i ! * j ! ∣ (i + j)!
proof:
:= by
  suffices i ! * (i + j - i)! ∣ (i + j)! by
    rwa [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left i j] at this
  exact factorial_mul_factorial_dvd_factorial (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

name: choose_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem choose_symm {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) : choose n (n - k) = choose n k
proof:
:= by
  rw [choose_eq_factorial_div_factorial hk, choose_eq_factorial_div_factorial (Nat.sub_le _ _),
    Nat.sub_sub_self hk, Nat.mul_comm]

name: choose_symm_of_eq_add
statement: theorem choose_symm_of_eq_add {n a b : ℕ} (h : n = a + b) : Nat.choose n a = Nat.choose n b
proof:
:= by
  suffices choose n (n - b) = choose n b by
    rw [h, Nat.add_sub_cancel_right] at this; rwa [h]
  exact choose_symm (h ▸ le_add_left _ _)

name: choose_symm_add
statement: theorem choose_symm_add {a b : ℕ} : choose (a + b) a = choose (a + b) b

name: choose_symm_half
statement: theorem choose_symm_half (m : ℕ) : choose (2 * m + 1) (m + 1) = choose (2 * m + 1) m
proof:
:= by
  apply choose_symm_of_eq_add
  rw [Nat.add_comm m 1, Nat.add_assoc 1 m m, Nat.add_comm (2 * m) 1, Nat.two_mul m]

name: choose_succ_right_eq
statement: theorem choose_succ_right_eq (n k : ℕ) : choose n (k + 1) * (k + 1) = choose n k * (n - k)
proof:
:= by
  have e : (n + 1) * choose n k = choose n (k + 1) * (k + 1) + choose n k * (k + 1) := by
    rw [← Nat.add_mul, Nat.add_comm (choose _ _), ← choose_succ_succ, add_one_mul_choose_eq]
  rw [← Nat.sub_eq_of_eq_add e, Nat.mul_comm, ← Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, Nat.add_sub_add_right]

name: choose_succ_self_right
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem choose_succ_self_right : ∀ n : ℕ, (n + 1).choose n = n + 1
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by rw [choose_succ_succ, choose_succ_self_right n, choose_self]

name: choose_mul_succ_eq
statement: theorem choose_mul_succ_eq (n k : ℕ) : n.choose k * (n + 1) = (n + 1).choose k * (n + 1 - k)
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k =>
    obtain hk | hk := le_or_gt (k + 1) (n + 1)
    · rw [choose_succ_succ, Nat.add_mul, succ_sub_succ, ← choose_succ_right_eq, ← succ_sub_succ,
        Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, Nat.add_sub_cancel' (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hk)]
    · rw [choose_eq_zero_of_lt hk, choose_eq_zero_of_lt (n.lt_succ_self.trans hk), Nat.zero_mul,
        Nat.zero_mul]

name: choose_mul_add
statement:
theorem choose_mul_add {m n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (m * n + n).choose n = (m + 1) * (m * n + n - 1).choose (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.mul_left_inj (Nat.mul_ne_zero (factorial_ne_zero (m * n)) (factorial_ne_zero n))]
  set p := n - 1
  have hp : n = p + 1 := (succ_pred_eq_of_ne_zero hn).symm
  simp only [hp, add_succ_sub_one]
  calc
    (m * (p + 1) + (p + 1)).choose (p + 1) * ((m * (p + 1))! * (p + 1)!)
      = (m * (p + 1) + (p + 1)).choose (p + 1) * (m * (p + 1))! * (p + 1)! := by lia
    _ = (m * (p + 1) + (p + 1))! := by rw [add_choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial]
    _ = ((m * (p + 1) + p) + 1)! := by lia
    _ = ((m * (p + 1) + p) + 1) * (m * (p + 1) + p)! := by rw [factorial_succ]
    _ = (m * (p + 1) + p)! * ((p + 1) * (m + 1)) := by lia
    _ = ((m * (p + 1) + p).choose p * (m * (p + 1))! * (p)!) * ((p + 1) * (m + 1)) := by
      rw [add_choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial]
    _ = (m * (p + 1) + p).choose p * (m * (p + 1))! * (((p + 1) * (p)!) * (m + 1)) := by lia
    _ = (m * (p + 1) + p).choose p * (m * (p + 1))! * ((p + 1)! * (m + 1)) := by rw [factorial_succ]
    _ = (m + 1) * (m * (p + 1) + p).choose p * ((m * (p + 1))! * (p + 1)!) := by lia

name: choose_mul_right
statement:
theorem choose_mul_right {m n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (m * n).choose n = m * (m * n - 1).choose (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · simp only [hm, Nat.zero_mul, Nat.choose_eq_zero_iff]
    exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
  · set p := m - 1; have hp : m = p + 1 := (succ_pred_eq_of_ne_zero hm).symm
    simp only [hp]
    rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, choose_mul_add hn]

name: ascFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose
statement:
theorem ascFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose (n k : ℕ) :
    (n + 1).ascFactorial k = k ! * (n + k).choose k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.mul_comm]
  apply Nat.mul_right_cancel (n + k - k).factorial_pos
  rw [choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial <| Nat.le_add_left k n, Nat.add_sub_cancel_right,
    ← factorial_mul_ascFactorial, Nat.mul_comm]

name: ascFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose'
statement:
theorem ascFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose' (n k : ℕ) :
    n.ascFactorial k = k ! * (n + k - 1).choose k
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · cases k
    · rw [ascFactorial_zero, choose_zero_right, factorial_zero, Nat.mul_one]
    · simp only [zero_ascFactorial, Nat.zero_add, succ_sub_succ_eq_sub,
        Nat.sub_zero, choose_succ_self, Nat.mul_zero]
  rw [ascFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose]
  simp only [succ_add_sub_one]

name: factorial_dvd_ascFactorial
statement: theorem factorial_dvd_ascFactorial (n k : ℕ) : k ! ∣ n.ascFactorial k

name: choose_eq_asc_factorial_div_factorial
statement:
theorem choose_eq_asc_factorial_div_factorial (n k : ℕ) :
    (n + k).choose k = (n + 1).ascFactorial k / k !
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel k.factorial_pos
  rw [← ascFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose]
  exact (Nat.mul_div_cancel' <| factorial_dvd_ascFactorial _ _).symm

name: choose_eq_asc_factorial_div_factorial'
statement:
theorem choose_eq_asc_factorial_div_factorial' (n k : ℕ) :
    (n + k - 1).choose k = n.ascFactorial k / k !

name: descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose
statement: theorem descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose (n k : ℕ) : n.descFactorial k = k ! * n.choose k
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := Nat.lt_or_ge n k
  · rw [descFactorial_eq_zero_iff_lt.2 h, choose_eq_zero_of_lt h, Nat.mul_zero]
  rw [Nat.mul_comm]
  apply Nat.mul_right_cancel (n - k).factorial_pos
  rw [choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial h, ← factorial_mul_descFactorial h, Nat.mul_comm]

name: factorial_dvd_descFactorial
statement: theorem factorial_dvd_descFactorial (n k : ℕ) : k ! ∣ n.descFactorial k

name: choose_eq_descFactorial_div_factorial
statement: theorem choose_eq_descFactorial_div_factorial (n k : ℕ) : n.choose k = n.descFactorial k / k !

name: choose_eq_fast_choose
statement: @[csimp] lemma choose_eq_fast_choose : Nat.choose = fast_choose

name: choose_le_succ_of_lt_half_left
statement:
theorem choose_le_succ_of_lt_half_left {r n : ℕ} (h : r < n / 2) :
    choose n r ≤ choose n (r + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right ?_ (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (h.trans_le (n.div_le_self 2)))
  rw [← choose_succ_right_eq]
  apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
  rw [← Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le, Nat.lt_sub_iff_add_lt, ← Nat.mul_two]
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right h Nat.zero_lt_two) (n.div_mul_le_self 2)

name: choose_le_middle_of_le_half_left
statement:
private theorem choose_le_middle_of_le_half_left {n r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ n / 2) :
    choose n r ≤ choose n (n / 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction hr using decreasingInduction with
  | self => rfl
  | of_succ k hk ih => exact (choose_le_succ_of_lt_half_left hk).trans ih

name: choose_le_middle
statement: theorem choose_le_middle (r n : ℕ) : choose n r ≤ choose n (n / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt r n with b | b
  · rcases le_or_gt r (n / 2) with a | h
    · apply choose_le_middle_of_le_half_left a
    · rw [← choose_symm b]
      apply choose_le_middle_of_le_half_left
      lia
  · rw [choose_eq_zero_of_lt b]
    apply zero_le

name: choose_le_succ
statement: theorem choose_le_succ (a c : ℕ) : choose a c ≤ choose a.succ c

name: choose_le_add
statement: theorem choose_le_add (a b c : ℕ) : choose a c ≤ choose (a + b) c
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | zero => simp
  | succ b_n b_ih => exact b_ih.trans (choose_le_succ (a + b_n) c)

name: choose_le_choose
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem choose_le_choose {a b : ℕ} (c : ℕ) (h : a ≤ b) : choose a c ≤ choose b c
proof:
:=
  Nat.add_sub_cancel' h ▸ choose_le_add a (b - a) c

name: choose_mono
statement: theorem choose_mono (b : ℕ) : Monotone fun a => choose a b

name: choose_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem choose_eq_one_iff {n k : ℕ} : n.choose k = 1 ↔ k = 0 ∨ n = k
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy k n with hk | rfl | hk
  · grind [k.choose_mono hk]
  · simp
  · grind

name: multichoose_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem multichoose_zero_right (n : ℕ) : multichoose n 0 = 1

name: multichoose_zero_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem multichoose_zero_succ (k : ℕ) : multichoose 0 (k + 1) = 0

name: multichoose_succ_succ
statement:
theorem multichoose_succ_succ (n k : ℕ) :
    multichoose (n + 1) (k + 1) = multichoose n (k + 1) + multichoose (n + 1) k

name: multichoose_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem multichoose_one (k : ℕ) : multichoose 1 k = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k IH => simp [multichoose_succ_succ 0 k, IH]

name: multichoose_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem multichoose_two (k : ℕ) : multichoose 2 k = k + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k IH => rw [multichoose, IH]; simp [Nat.add_comm]

name: multichoose_one_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem multichoose_one_right (n : ℕ) : multichoose n 1 = n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n IH => simp [multichoose_succ_succ n 0, IH]

name: multichoose_eq
statement:
theorem multichoose_eq : ∀ n k : ℕ, multichoose n k = (n + k - 1).choose k
  | _, 0 => by simp
  | 0, k + 1 => by simp
  | n + 1, k + 1 => by
    have : n + (k + 1) < (n + 1) + (k + 1)
proof:
:= Nat.add_lt_add_right (Nat.lt_succ_self _) _
    have : (n + 1) + k < (n + 1) + (k + 1) := Nat.add_lt_add_left (Nat.lt_succ_self _) _
    rw [multichoose_succ_succ, Nat.add_comm, Nat.succ_add_sub_one, ← Nat.add_assoc,
      Nat.choose_succ_succ]
    simp [multichoose_eq n (k + 1), multichoose_eq (n + 1) k]

name: dvd_choose_add_sub_one_iff
statement:
lemma dvd_choose_add_sub_one_iff (hp : Prime p) (hpn : n < p) :
    p ∣ choose (k + n - 1) n ↔ ∃ i < n, p ∣ k + i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hp.dvd_ascFactorial_iff, Nat.ascFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose']
  exact ⟨fun h => dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h (n !),
    fun h => (hp.coprime_factorial_of_lt hpn).dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h⟩

name: dvd_choose_iff
statement:
lemma dvd_choose_iff (hp : Prime p) (hpn : n < p) (hnk : n ≤ k) :
    p ∣ choose k n ↔ ∃ i < n, p ∣ k - i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · grind [dvd_one, Nat.not_prime_one]
  rw [show k = (k - n + 1) + n - 1 by grind, hp.dvd_choose_add_sub_one_iff hpn]
  constructor <;>
    rintro ⟨i, hlt, hdvd⟩ <;>
    refine ⟨n - i - 1, by grind, ?_⟩ <;>
    convert hdvd using 1 <;>
    grind

name: choose_modEq_choose_mod_mul_choose_div
statement:
theorem choose_modEq_choose_mod_mul_choose_div :
    choose n k ≡ choose (n % p) (k % p) * choose (n / p) (k / p) [ZMOD p]
proof:
:= by
  have decompose : ((X : (ZMod p)[X]) + 1) ^ n = (X + 1) ^ (n % p) * (X ^ p + 1) ^ (n / p) := by
    simpa using add_pow_eq_mul_pow_add_pow_div_char (X : (ZMod p)[X]) 1 p _
  simp only [← ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff,
    ← coeff_X_add_one_pow _ n k, ← eq_intCast (Int.castRingHom (ZMod p)), ← coeff_map,
    Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_one, map_X, decompose]
  simp only [add_pow, one_pow, mul_one, ← pow_mul, sum_mul_sum]
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, 1, 2, k, 2, k']
    rw [← mul_assoc, mul_right_comm _ _ (X ^ (p * k')), ← pow_add, mul_assoc, ← cast_mul]
  have h_iff : ∀ x ∈ range (n % p + 1) ×ˢ range (n / p + 1),
      k = x.1 + p * x.2 ↔ (k % p, k / p) = x := by
    intro ⟨x₁, x₂⟩ hx
    rw [Prod.mk.injEq]
    constructor <;> intro h
    · simp only [mem_product, mem_range] at hx
      have h' : x₁ < p := lt_of_lt_of_le hx.left <| mod_lt _ Fin.pos'
      rw [h, add_mul_mod_self_left, add_mul_div_left _ _ Fin.pos', eq_comm (b := x₂)]
      exact ⟨mod_eq_of_lt h', right_eq_add.mpr (div_eq_of_lt h')⟩
    · rw [← h.left, ← h.right, mod_add_div]
  simp only [finsetSum_coeff, coeff_mul_natCast, coeff_X_pow, ite_mul, zero_mul, ← cast_mul]
  rw [← sum_product', sum_congr rfl (fun a ha ↦ if_congr (h_iff a ha) rfl rfl), sum_ite_eq]
  split_ifs with h
  · simp
  · rw [mem_product, mem_range, mem_range, not_and_or, Nat.lt_succ_iff, not_le, not_lt] at h
    cases h <;> simp [choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by tauto)]

name: choose_modEq_choose_mod_mul_choose_div_nat
statement:
theorem choose_modEq_choose_mod_mul_choose_div_nat :
    choose n k ≡ choose (n % p) (k % p) * choose (n / p) (k / p) [MOD p]

name: choose_modEq_choose_mul_prod_range_choose
statement:
theorem choose_modEq_choose_mul_prod_range_choose (a : ℕ) :
    choose n k ≡ choose (n / p ^ a) (k / p ^ a) *
      ∏ i ∈ range a, choose (n / p ^ i % p) (k / p ^ i % p) [ZMOD p]
proof:
:=
  match a with
  | Nat.zero => by simp
  | Nat.succ a => (choose_modEq_choose_mul_prod_range_choose a).trans <| by
    rw [prod_range_succ, cast_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_right_comm]
    gcongr
    apply choose_modEq_choose_mod_mul_choose_div.trans
    simp_rw [pow_succ, Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, mul_comm, Int.ModEq.refl]

name: choose_modEq_prod_range_choose
statement:
theorem choose_modEq_prod_range_choose {a : ℕ} (ha₁ : n < p ^ a) (ha₂ : k < p ^ a) :
    choose n k ≡ ∏ i ∈ range a, choose (n / p ^ i % p) (k / p ^ i % p) [ZMOD p]
proof:
:= by
  apply (choose_modEq_choose_mul_prod_range_choose a).trans
  simp_rw [Nat.div_eq_of_lt ha₁, Nat.div_eq_of_lt ha₂, choose, cast_one, one_mul, cast_prod,
    Int.ModEq.refl]

name: choose_modEq_prod_range_choose_nat
statement:
theorem choose_modEq_prod_range_choose_nat {a : ℕ} (ha₁ : n < p ^ a) (ha₂ : k < p ^ a) :
    choose n k ≡ ∏ i ∈ range a, choose (n / p ^ i % p) (k / p ^ i % p) [MOD p]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.natCast_modEq_iff]
  exact_mod_cast choose_modEq_prod_range_choose ha₁ ha₂

name: choose_mul_mul_modEq_choose
statement:
theorem choose_mul_mul_modEq_choose :
    choose (p * a) (p * b) ≡ choose a b [ZMOD p]

name: choose_mul_mul_modEq_choose_nat
statement:
theorem choose_mul_mul_modEq_choose_nat :
    choose (p * a) (p * b) ≡ choose a b [MOD p]

name: choose_pow_mul_pow_mul_modEq_choose
statement:
theorem choose_pow_mul_pow_mul_modEq_choose :
    choose (p ^ k * a) (p ^ k * b) ≡ choose a b [ZMOD p]
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [Int.ModEq.refl]
  | succ k ih =>
    grw [Nat.pow_succ', mul_assoc, mul_assoc, choose_mul_mul_modEq_choose, ih]

name: choose_pow_mul_pow_mul_modEq_choose_nat
statement:
theorem choose_pow_mul_pow_mul_modEq_choose_nat :
    choose (p ^ k * a) (p ^ k * b) ≡ choose a b [MOD p]

name: eq_pow_multiplicity_of_choose_modEq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_pow_multiplicity_of_choose_modEq_zero (hn : 0 < n)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ Icc 1 (n - 1), n.choose i ≡ 0 [ZMOD p]) : n = p ^ multiplicity p n
proof:
:= by
  rename_i hp
  by_contra! hn₀
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := pow_multiplicity_dvd p n
  specialize h (p ^ multiplicity p n) (by grind [le_of_dvd hn (pow_multiplicity_dvd p n)])
  nth_grw 1 [← mul_one (p ^ _), hm, choose_pow_mul_pow_mul_modEq_choose, choose_one_right] at h
  suffices multiplicity p n + 1 ≤ multiplicity p n by lia
  rw [← FiniteMultiplicity.pow_dvd_iff_le_multiplicity]
  · nth_rw 2 [hm]
    simpa [pow_add] using Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left _ (dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero.mpr (by exact_mod_cast h))
  · exact finiteMultiplicity_iff.mpr ⟨hp.out.ne_one, hn⟩

name: eq_pow_multiplicity_of_choose_modEq_zero_nat
statement:
theorem eq_pow_multiplicity_of_choose_modEq_zero_nat (hn : 0 < n)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ Icc 1 (n - 1), n.choose i ≡ 0 [MOD p]) : n = p ^ multiplicity p n

name: minFac_dvd_gcd_choose_of_isPrimePow
statement:
theorem minFac_dvd_gcd_choose_of_isPrimePow (h : IsPrimePow n) :
    n.minFac ∣ (Icc 1 (n - 1)).gcd n.choose
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, _, _, hn₁⟩ := (isPrimePow_nat_iff_bounded_log_minFac _).mp h
  exact dvd_gcd_iff.mpr fun i hi => by
    nth_rw 2 [hn₁]
    exact Prime.dvd_choose_pow (minFac_prime_iff.mpr h.ne_one) (by grind) (by grind)

name: minFac_sq_ndvd_gcd_choose_of_isPrimePow
statement:
lemma minFac_sq_ndvd_gcd_choose_of_isPrimePow (h : IsPrimePow n) :
    ¬ n.minFac ^ 2 ∣ (Icc 1 (n - 1)).gcd n.choose
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, _, k_pos, hn₁⟩ := (isPrimePow_nat_iff_bounded_log_minFac _).mp h
  have isPrime := minFac_prime_iff.mpr (IsPrimePow.ne_one h)
  refine mt Finset.dvd_gcd_iff.mp ?_
  simp only [mem_Icc, not_forall]
  have : n.minFac ^ (k - 1) ≤ n.minFac ^ k := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (minFac_pos n) (sub_le k 1)
  refine ⟨n.minFac ^ (k - 1), ⟨one_le_pow _ _ (minFac_pos n), ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · refine le_sub_one_of_lt ?_
    nth_rw 2 [hn₁]
    exact Nat.pow_lt_pow_of_lt (Prime.one_lt isPrime) (sub_one_lt_of_lt k_pos)
  · refine emultiplicity_lt_iff_not_dvd.mp ?_
    nth_rw 2 [hn₁]
    rw [Nat.Prime.emultiplicity_choose_prime_pow isPrime this (pow_ne_zero _
      (Nat.Prime.ne_zero isPrime)), multiplicity_pow_self_of_prime (prime_iff.mp isPrime)]
    norm_cast
    grind

name: primeFactors_gcd_choose_of_isPrimePow
statement:
lemma primeFactors_gcd_choose_of_isPrimePow (h : IsPrimePow n) :
    ((Icc 1 (n - 1)).gcd n.choose).primeFactors = {n.minFac}
proof:
:= by
  have ne_zero : (Icc 1 (n - 1)).gcd n.choose ≠ 0 :=
    gcd_ne_zero_iff.mpr ⟨1, by simp; grind [IsPrimePow.two_le h]⟩
  have isPrime := minFac_prime_iff.mpr (IsPrimePow.ne_one h)
  refine eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr ⟨isPrime.mem_primeFactors
    (minFac_dvd_gcd_choose_of_isPrimePow h) ne_zero, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  simp only [mem_primeFactors, ne_eq] at hp
  obtain ⟨hp₁, hp₂, hp₃⟩ := hp
  have : Fact (Nat.Prime p) := ⟨hp₁⟩
  simp_rw [Finset.dvd_gcd_iff, ← modEq_zero_iff_dvd] at hp₂
  have := eq_pow_multiplicity_of_choose_modEq_zero_nat h.pos hp₂
  have dvd_pow : n.minFac ∣  p ^ multiplicity p n := this ▸ minFac_dvd _
  exact (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq isPrime hp₁).mp (isPrime.dvd_of_dvd_pow dvd_pow)|>.symm

name: gcd_choose_eq_minFac_of_isPrimePow
statement:
theorem gcd_choose_eq_minFac_of_isPrimePow (h : IsPrimePow n) :
    (Icc 1 (n - 1)).gcd n.choose = n.minFac
proof:
:= by
  have ne_zero : (Icc 1 (n - 1)).gcd n.choose ≠ 0 :=
    gcd_ne_zero_iff.mpr ⟨1, by simp; grind [IsPrimePow.two_le h]⟩
  have isPrime := minFac_prime_iff.mpr (IsPrimePow.ne_one h)
  have : multiplicity n.minFac ((Icc 1 (n - 1)).gcd n.choose) = 1 := by
    refine multiplicity_eq_of_dvd_of_not_dvd ?_ (minFac_sq_ndvd_gcd_choose_of_isPrimePow h)
    simpa using minFac_dvd_gcd_choose_of_isPrimePow h
  rw [Nat.prod_primeFactors_coe_pow_factorization ne_zero, primeFactors_gcd_choose_of_isPrimePow h]
  simp [← Nat.multiplicity_eq_factorization isPrime, this]

name: gcd_choose_eq_one_of_not_isPrimePow
statement:
theorem gcd_choose_eq_one_of_not_isPrimePow (hn : 1 < n) (hpn : ¬ IsPrimePow n) :
    (Icc 1 (n - 1)).gcd n.choose = 1
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hpn
  obtain ⟨q, hq, h⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hpn
  simp_rw [Finset.dvd_gcd_iff, ← modEq_zero_iff_dvd] at h
  have : Fact (Nat.Prime q) := ⟨hq⟩
  have := eq_pow_multiplicity_of_choose_modEq_zero_nat (zero_lt_of_lt hn) h
  refine (isPrimePow_nat_iff n).mpr ⟨q, _, hq, ?_, this.symm⟩
  contrapose! hn
  rw [this, le_zero.mp hn, pow_zero]

name: factorization_factorial
statement:
theorem factorization_factorial {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    ∀ {n b : ℕ}, log p n < b → (n)!.factorization p = ∑ i ∈ Ico 1 b, n / p ^ i
  | 0, b, _ => by simp
  | n + 1, b, hb =>
    calc
      (n + 1)!.factorization p = (n + 1).factorization p + (n)!.factorization p
proof:
:= by
        rw [factorial_succ, factorization_mul (zero_ne_add_one n).symm n.factorial_ne_zero,
          coe_add, Pi.add_apply]
      _ = #{i ∈ Ico 1 b | p ^ i ∣ n + 1} + ∑ i ∈ Ico 1 b, n / p ^ i := by
        rw [factorization_factorial hp ((log_mono_right <| le_succ _).trans_lt hb), add_left_inj]
        apply factorization_eq_card_pow_dvd_of_lt hp (zero_lt_succ n)
          (lt_pow_of_log_lt hp.one_lt hb)
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Ico 1 b, (n / p ^ i + if p ^ i ∣ n + 1 then 1 else 0) := by
        simp [Nat.add_comm, sum_add_distrib, sum_boole]
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Ico 1 b, (n + 1) / p ^ i := Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => Nat.succ_div.symm

name: sub_one_mul_factorization_factorial
statement:
theorem sub_one_mul_factorization_factorial {n p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    (p - 1) * (n)!.factorization p = n - (p.digits n).sum
proof:
:= by
  simp only [factorization_factorial hp <| lt_succ_of_lt <| Nat.lt_add_one (log p n),
    ← Finset.sum_Ico_add' _ 0 _ 1, Ico_zero_eq_range,
    ← sub_one_mul_sum_log_div_pow_eq_sub_sum_digits]

name: factorization_factorial_mul_succ
statement:
theorem factorization_factorial_mul_succ {n p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    (p * (n + 1))!.factorization p = (p * n)!.factorization p + (n + 1).factorization p + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : 2 ≤ p := hp.two_le
  have h1 : 1 ≤ p * n + 1 := Nat.le_add_left _ _
  have h2 : p * n + 1 ≤ p * (n + 1) := by linarith
  have h3 : p * n + 1 ≤ p * (n + 1) + 1 := by lia
  have h4 m (hm : m ∈ Ico (p * n + 1) (p * (n + 1))) : m.factorization p = 0 := by
    apply factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
    exact not_dvd_of_lt_of_lt_mul_succ (mem_Ico.mp hm).left (mem_Ico.mp hm).right
  rw [← prod_Ico_id_eq_factorial, factorization_prod_apply (fun _ hx ↦ ne_zero_of_lt
    (mem_Ico.mp hx).left), ← sum_Ico_consecutive _ h1 h3, add_assoc, sum_Ico_succ_top h2,
    ← prod_Ico_id_eq_factorial, factorization_prod_apply (fun _ hx ↦ ne_zero_of_lt
    (mem_Ico.mp hx).left), factorization_mul (ne_zero_of_lt h0) (zero_ne_add_one n).symm,
    coe_add, Pi.add_apply, hp.factorization_self, sum_congr rfl h4, sum_const_zero, zero_add,
    add_comm 1]

name: factorization_factorial_mul
statement:
theorem factorization_factorial_mul {n p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    (p * n)!.factorization p = (n)!.factorization p + n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    simp [factorization_factorial_mul_succ hp, ih, factorial_succ,
      factorization_mul (zero_ne_add_one n).symm (factorial_ne_zero n)]
    ring

name: factorization_factorial_le_div_pred
statement:
theorem factorization_factorial_le_div_pred {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (n : ℕ) :
    (n)!.factorization p ≤ (n / (p - 1) : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [factorization_factorial hp (Nat.lt_add_one (log p n))]
  exact Nat.geom_sum_Ico_le hp.two_le _ _

name: multiplicity_choose_aux
statement:
lemma multiplicity_choose_aux {p n b k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b, n / p ^ i =
      ((∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b, k / p ^ i) + ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b, (n - k) / p ^ i) +
        #{i ∈ Ico 1 b | p ^ i ≤ k % p ^ i + (n - k) % p ^ i}
proof:
:=
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b, n / p ^ i = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b, (k + (n - k)) / p ^ i := by
      simp only [add_tsub_cancel_of_le hkn]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b,
          (k / p ^ i + (n - k) / p ^ i + if p ^ i ≤ k % p ^ i + (n - k) % p ^ i then 1 else 0) := by
      simp only [Nat.add_div (pow_pos hp.pos _)]
    _ = _ := by simp [sum_add_distrib, sum_boole]

name: factorization_choose'
statement:
theorem factorization_choose' {p n k b : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hnb : log p (n + k) < b) :
    (choose (n + k) k).factorization p = #{i ∈ Ico 1 b | p ^ i ≤ k % p ^ i + n % p ^ i}
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : (choose (n + k) k).factorization p + (k ! * n !).factorization p
    = #{i ∈ Ico 1 b | p ^ i ≤ k % p ^ i + n % p ^ i} + (k ! * n !).factorization p := by
    have h2 := (add_tsub_cancel_right n k) ▸ choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial (le_add_left k n)
    rw [← Pi.add_apply, ← coe_add, ← factorization_mul (ne_of_gt <| choose_pos (le_add_left k n))
      (by positivity), ← mul_assoc, h2,
      factorization_factorial hp hnb, factorization_mul (factorial_ne_zero k) (factorial_ne_zero n),
      coe_add, Pi.add_apply, factorization_factorial hp ((log_mono_right (le_add_left k n)).trans_lt
      hnb), factorization_factorial hp ((log_mono_right (le_add_left n k)).trans_lt
      (add_comm n k ▸ hnb)), multiplicity_choose_aux hp (le_add_left k n)]
    simp only [add_tsub_cancel_right, add_comm]
  exact Nat.add_right_cancel h₁

name: factorization_choose
statement:
theorem factorization_choose {p n k b : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hnb : log p n < b) :
    (choose n k).factorization p = #{i ∈ Ico 1 b | p ^ i ≤ k % p ^ i + (n - k) % p ^ i}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← factorization_choose' hp ((Nat.sub_add_cancel hkn).symm ▸ hnb), Nat.sub_add_cancel hkn]

name: factorization_le_factorization_of_dvd_right
statement:
theorem factorization_le_factorization_of_dvd_right (h : b ∣ c) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    b.factorization a ≤ c.factorization a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h; simp [factorization_mul hb (Nat.ne_zero_of_mul_ne_zero_right hc)]

name: factorization_le_factorization_choose_add
statement:
theorem factorization_le_factorization_choose_add {p : ℕ} :
    ∀ {n k : ℕ}, k ≤ n → k ≠ 0 →
      n.factorization p ≤ (choose n k).factorization p + k.factorization p
  | n, 0, _, _ => by tauto
  | 0, x + 1, _, _ => by simp
  | n + 1, k + 1, hkn, hk => by
    rw [← Pi.add_apply, ← coe_add, ← factorization_mul (ne_of_gt <| choose_pos hkn)
      (zero_ne_add_one k).symm]
    refine factorization_le_factorization_of_dvd_right ?_ (zero_ne_add_one n).symm
      (Nat.mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt <| choose_pos hkn) (by positivity))
    rw [← add_one_mul_choose_eq]
    exact dvd_mul_right _ _

variable {p n k : ℕ}

name: factorization_choose_prime_pow_add_factorization
statement:
theorem factorization_choose_prime_pow_add_factorization (hp : p.Prime) (hkn : k ≤ p ^ n)
    (hk0 : k ≠ 0) : (choose (p ^ n) k).factorization p + k.factorization p = n
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hdisj : Disjoint {i ∈ Ico 1 n.succ | p ^ i ≤ k % p ^ i + (p ^ n - k) % p ^ i}
        {i ∈ Ico 1 n.succ | p ^ i ∣ k} := by
      simp +contextual [Finset.disjoint_right, dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.mod_lt _ (pow_pos hp.pos _)]
    rw [factorization_choose hp hkn (lt_succ_self _), factorization_eq_card_pow_dvd_of_lt hp
      hk0.bot_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hkn <| Nat.pow_lt_pow_succ hp.one_lt), log_pow hp.one_lt,
      ← card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, filter_union_right]
    have filter_le_Ico := (Ico 1 n.succ).card_filter_le
      fun x => p ^ x ≤ k % p ^ x + (p ^ n - k) % p ^ x ∨ p ^ x ∣ k
    rwa [card_Ico 1 n.succ] at filter_le_Ico
  · nth_rewrite 1 [← factorization_pow_self (n := n) hp]
    exact factorization_le_factorization_choose_add hkn hk0

name: factorization_choose_prime_pow
statement:
theorem factorization_choose_prime_pow {p n k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hkn : k ≤ p ^ n) (hk0 : k ≠ 0) :
    (choose (p ^ n) k).factorization p = n - k.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  nth_rewrite 2 [← factorization_choose_prime_pow_add_factorization hp hkn hk0]
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_right]

name: factorization_choose_le_log
statement: theorem factorization_choose_le_log : (choose n k).factorization p ≤ log p n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : (choose n k).factorization p = 0
  · simp [h]
  have hp : p.Prime := Not.imp_symm (choose n k).factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime h
  have hkn : k ≤ n := by
    refine le_of_not_gt fun hnk => h ?_
    simp [choose_eq_zero_of_lt hnk]
  rw [factorization_choose hp hkn (Nat.lt_add_one _)]
  exact (card_filter_le ..).trans_eq (Nat.card_Ico _ _)

name: pow_factorization_choose_le
statement: theorem pow_factorization_choose_le (hn : 0 < n) : p ^ (choose n k).factorization p ≤ n

name: factorization_choose_le_one
statement: theorem factorization_choose_le_one (p_large : n < p ^ 2) : (choose n k).factorization p ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply factorization_choose_le_log.trans
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn0); · simp
  exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (log_lt_of_lt_pow hn0 p_large)

name: factorization_choose_of_lt_three_mul
statement:
theorem factorization_choose_of_lt_three_mul (hp' : p ≠ 2) (hk : p ≤ k) (hk' : p ≤ n - k)
    (hn : n < 3 * p) : (choose n k).factorization p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases em' p.Prime with hp | hp
  · exact factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime (choose n k) hp
  rcases lt_or_ge n k with hnk | hkn
  · simp [choose_eq_zero_of_lt hnk]
  simp only [factorization_choose hp hkn (Nat.lt_add_one _), card_eq_zero, filter_eq_empty_iff,
    mem_Ico, not_le, and_imp]
  intro i hi₁ hi
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hi₁ with (rfl | hi)
  · rw [pow_one, ← add_lt_add_iff_left (2 * p), ← succ_mul, two_mul, add_add_add_comm]
    exact
      lt_of_le_of_lt
        (add_le_add
          (add_le_add_left (le_mul_of_one_le_right' ((one_le_div_iff hp.pos).mpr hk)) (k % p))
          (add_le_add_left (le_mul_of_one_le_right' ((one_le_div_iff hp.pos).mpr hk'))
            ((n - k) % p)))
        (by rwa [div_add_mod, div_add_mod, add_tsub_cancel_of_le hkn])
  · replace hn : n < p ^ i := by
      have : 3 ≤ p := lt_of_le_of_ne hp.two_le hp'.symm
      calc
        n < 3 * p := hn
        _ ≤ p * p := by gcongr
        _ = p ^ 2 := (sq p).symm
        _ ≤ p ^ i := pow_right_mono₀ hp.one_lt.le hi
    rwa [mod_eq_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt hkn hn), mod_eq_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt tsub_le_self hn),
      add_tsub_cancel_of_le hkn]

name: factorization_centralBinom_of_two_mul_self_lt_three_mul
statement:
theorem factorization_centralBinom_of_two_mul_self_lt_three_mul (n_big : 2 < n) (p_le_n : p ≤ n)
    (big : 2 * n < 3 * p) : (centralBinom n).factorization p = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine factorization_choose_of_lt_three_mul ?_ p_le_n (p_le_n.trans ?_) big
  · lia
  · rw [two_mul, add_tsub_cancel_left]

name: factorization_factorial_eq_zero_of_lt
statement: theorem factorization_factorial_eq_zero_of_lt (h : n < p) : (factorial n).factorization p = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [factorial_succ, factorization_mul n.succ_ne_zero n.factorial_ne_zero, Finsupp.coe_add,
      Pi.add_apply, hn (lt_of_succ_lt h), add_zero, factorization_eq_zero_of_lt h]

name: factorization_choose_eq_zero_of_lt
statement: theorem factorization_choose_eq_zero_of_lt (h : n < p) : (choose n k).factorization p = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hnk : n < k; · simp [choose_eq_zero_of_lt hnk]
  rw [choose_eq_factorial_div_factorial hnk,
    factorization_div (factorial_mul_factorial_dvd_factorial hnk), Finsupp.coe_tsub,
    Pi.sub_apply, factorization_factorial_eq_zero_of_lt h, zero_tsub]

name: factorization_centralBinom_eq_zero_of_two_mul_lt
statement:
theorem factorization_centralBinom_eq_zero_of_two_mul_lt (h : 2 * n < p) :
    (centralBinom n).factorization p = 0

name: le_two_mul_of_factorization_centralBinom_pos
statement:
theorem le_two_mul_of_factorization_centralBinom_pos
    (h_pos : 0 < (centralBinom n).factorization p) : p ≤ 2 * n

name: prod_pow_factorization_choose
statement:
theorem prod_pow_factorization_choose (n k : ℕ) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    (∏ p ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), p ^ (Nat.choose n k).factorization p) = choose n k
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← prod_factorization_pow_eq_self (choose_ne_zero hkn)]
  rw [eq_comm]
  apply Finset.prod_subset
  · intro p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    contrapose! hp
    rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, Classical.not_not, factorization_choose_eq_zero_of_lt hp]
  · intro p _ h2
    simp [Classical.not_not.1 (mt Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 h2)]

name: prod_pow_factorization_centralBinom
statement:
theorem prod_pow_factorization_centralBinom (n : ℕ) :
    (∏ p ∈ Finset.range (2 * n + 1), p ^ (centralBinom n).factorization p) = centralBinom n

name: add_choose_eq
statement:
theorem add_choose_eq (m n k : ℕ) :
    (m + n).choose k = ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal k, m.choose ij.1 * n.choose ij.2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (m + n).choose k = ((X + 1) ^ (m + n)).coeff k := by rw [coeff_X_add_one_pow, cast_id]
    _ = ((X + 1) ^ m * (X + 1) ^ n).coeff k := by rw [pow_add]
    _ = ∑ ij ∈ antidiagonal k, m.choose ij.1 * n.choose ij.2 := by
      rw [coeff_mul, Finset.sum_congr rfl]
      simp only [coeff_X_add_one_pow, cast_id, imp_true_iff]

name: sum_range_choose_sq
statement:
theorem sum_range_choose_sq (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (n.choose i) ^ 2 = (2 * n).choose n
proof:
:= by
  rw [two_mul, add_choose_eq, sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
  congr! 1 with _ h
  rw [choose_symm (Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.mp h), sq]

name: centralBinom_eq_two_mul_choose
statement: theorem centralBinom_eq_two_mul_choose (n : ℕ) : centralBinom n = (2 * n).choose n

name: centralBinom_pos
statement: theorem centralBinom_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < centralBinom n

name: centralBinom_ne_zero
statement: theorem centralBinom_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : centralBinom n ≠ 0

name: centralBinom_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem centralBinom_zero : centralBinom 0 = 1

name: choose_le_centralBinom
statement: theorem choose_le_centralBinom (r n : ℕ) : choose (2 * n) r ≤ centralBinom n
proof:
:=
  calc
    (2 * n).choose r ≤ (2 * n).choose (2 * n / 2) := choose_le_middle r (2 * n)
    _ = (2 * n).choose n := by rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left n zero_lt_two]

name: centralBinom_strictMono
statement: theorem centralBinom_strictMono : StrictMono centralBinom

name: two_le_centralBinom
statement: theorem two_le_centralBinom (n : ℕ) (n_pos : 0 < n) : 2 ≤ centralBinom n
proof:
:=
  calc
    2 ≤ 2 * n := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ n_pos
    _ = (2 * n).choose 1 := (choose_one_right (2 * n)).symm
    _ ≤ centralBinom n := choose_le_centralBinom 1 n

name: centralBinom_le_four_pow
statement: theorem centralBinom_le_four_pow (n : ℕ) : centralBinom n ≤ 4 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  grw [show 4 = 2 ^ 2 by rfl, ← pow_mul, centralBinom_eq_two_mul_choose, choose_le_two_pow]

name: centralBinom_lt_four_pow
statement: theorem centralBinom_lt_four_pow {n : ℕ} (h : n ≠ 0) : centralBinom n < 4 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [show 4 = 2 ^ 2 by rfl, ← pow_mul]
  apply choose_lt_two_pow
  lia

name: succ_mul_centralBinom_succ
statement:
theorem succ_mul_centralBinom_succ (n : ℕ) :
    (n + 1) * centralBinom (n + 1) = 2 * (2 * n + 1) * centralBinom n
proof:
:=
  calc
    (n + 1) * (2 * (n + 1)).choose (n + 1) = (2 * n + 2).choose (n + 1) * (n + 1) := mul_comm _ _
    _ = (2 * n + 1).choose n * (2 * n + 2) := by rw [choose_succ_right_eq, choose_mul_succ_eq]
    _ = 2 * ((2 * n + 1).choose n * (n + 1)) := by ring
    _ = 2 * ((2 * n + 1).choose n * (2 * n + 1 - n)) := by rw [two_mul n, add_assoc,
                                                               Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
    _ = 2 * ((2 * n).choose n * (2 * n + 1)) := by rw [choose_mul_succ_eq]
    _ = 2 * (2 * n + 1) * (2 * n).choose n := by rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm (2 * n + 1)]

name: four_pow_lt_mul_centralBinom
statement: theorem four_pow_lt_mul_centralBinom (n : ℕ) (n_big : 4 ≤ n) : 4 ^ n < n * centralBinom n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with | _ n IH
  rcases lt_trichotomy n 4 with (hn | rfl | hn)
  · clear IH; exact False.elim ((not_lt.2 n_big) hn)
  · norm_num [centralBinom, choose]
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hn)
  calc
    4 ^ (n + 1)
    _ = 4 * 4 ^ n := by rw [pow_succ']
    _ < 4 * (n * centralBinom n) := by gcongr; exact IH n n.lt_succ_self (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hn)
    _ ≤ 2 * (2 * n + 1) * centralBinom n := by rw [← mul_assoc]; linarith
    _ = (n + 1) * centralBinom (n + 1) := (succ_mul_centralBinom_succ n).symm

name: four_pow_le_two_mul_self_mul_centralBinom
statement:
theorem four_pow_le_two_mul_self_mul_centralBinom :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (_ : 0 < n), 4 ^ n ≤ 2 * n * centralBinom n
  | 0, pr => (Nat.not_lt_zero _ pr).elim
  | 1, _ => by simp [centralBinom, choose]
  | 2, _ => by simp [centralBinom, choose]
  | 3, _ => by simp [centralBinom, choose]
  | n + 4, _ =>
    calc
      4 ^ (n + 4) ≤ (n + 4) * centralBinom (n + 4)
proof:
:=
        (four_pow_lt_mul_centralBinom _ le_add_self).le
      _ ≤ 2 * (n + 4) * centralBinom (n + 4) := by
        rw [mul_assoc]; refine Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ zero_lt_two

name: two_dvd_centralBinom_succ
statement: theorem two_dvd_centralBinom_succ (n : ℕ) : 2 ∣ centralBinom (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  use (n + 1 + n).choose n
  rw [centralBinom_eq_two_mul_choose, two_mul, ← add_assoc,
      choose_succ_succ' (n + 1 + n) n, choose_symm_add, ← two_mul]

name: two_dvd_centralBinom_of_one_le
statement: theorem two_dvd_centralBinom_of_one_le {n : ℕ} (h : 0 < n) : 2 ∣ centralBinom n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos h]
  exact two_dvd_centralBinom_succ n.pred

name: succ_dvd_centralBinom
statement: theorem succ_dvd_centralBinom (n : ℕ) : n + 1 ∣ n.centralBinom
proof:
:= by
  have h_s : (n + 1).Coprime (2 * n + 1) := by
    rw [two_mul, add_assoc, coprime_add_self_right, coprime_self_add_left]
    exact coprime_one_left n
  apply h_s.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left
  apply Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left zero_lt_two
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← succ_mul_centralBinom_succ, mul_comm]
  exact mul_dvd_mul_left _ (two_dvd_centralBinom_succ n)

name: multinomial_pos
statement: theorem multinomial_pos : 0 < multinomial s f

name: multinomial_spec
statement: theorem multinomial_spec : (∏ i ∈ s, (f i)!) * multinomial s f = (∑ i ∈ s, f i)!

name: multinomial_empty
statement: @[simp] lemma multinomial_empty : multinomial ∅ f = 1

name: multinomial_cons
statement:
lemma multinomial_cons (ha : a ∉ s) (f : α → ℕ) :
    multinomial (s.cons a ha) f = (f a + ∑ i ∈ s, f i).choose (f a) * multinomial s f
proof:
:= by
  rw [multinomial, Nat.div_eq_iff_eq_mul_left _ (prod_factorial_dvd_factorial_sum _ _), prod_cons,
    multinomial, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm _ (f a)!,
    Nat.div_mul_cancel (prod_factorial_dvd_factorial_sum _ _), ← mul_assoc, Nat.choose_symm_add,
    Nat.add_choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial, Finset.sum_cons]
  positivity

name: multinomial_insert
statement:
lemma multinomial_insert [DecidableEq α] (ha : a ∉ s) (f : α → ℕ) :
    multinomial (insert a s) f = (f a + ∑ i ∈ s, f i).choose (f a) * multinomial s f

name: multinomial_singleton
statement: @[simp] lemma multinomial_singleton (a : α) (f : α → ℕ) : multinomial {a} f = 1

name: multinomial_insert_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem multinomial_insert_one [DecidableEq α] (h : a ∉ s) (h₁ : f a = 1) :
    multinomial (insert a s) f = (s.sum f).succ * multinomial s f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [multinomial]
  rw [Finset.sum_insert h, Finset.prod_insert h, h₁, add_comm, ← succ_eq_add_one, factorial_succ]
  simp only [factorial, succ_eq_add_one, zero_add, mul_one, one_mul]
  rw [Nat.mul_div_assoc _ (prod_factorial_dvd_factorial_sum _ _)]

name: multinomial_congr
statement:
theorem multinomial_congr {f g : α → ℕ} (h : ∀ a ∈ s, f a = g a) :
    multinomial s f = multinomial s g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [multinomial]; congr 1
  · rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h]
  · exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun a ha => by rw [h a ha]

name: multinomial_congr_of_eq_on_inter
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.mul_right_inj (prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun x _ ↦ factorial_ne_zero (g x))),
    multinomial_spec, prod_congr_of_eq_on_inter (g := fun a ↦ (f a)!) (s₂ := s) (by aesop)
    (by aesop) (by aesop), multinomial_spec s f]
  congr 1
  exact sum_congr_of_eq_on_inter (by grind) (by grind) (by grind)

name: multinomial_congr_of_sdiff
multinomial_single
statement:
theorem multinomial_single [DecidableEq α] :
    multinomial s (Pi.single a n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.mul_right_inj (prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun _ _ ↦ factorial_ne_zero _)), mul_one,
    multinomial_spec, sum_pi_single']
  split_ifs with ha
  · rw [Finset.prod_eq_single a (by simp_all) (by simp_all), Pi.single_eq_same]
  · rw [eq_comm, factorial_zero]
    apply Finset.prod_eq_one
    intro _ hb
    rw [Pi.single_apply, ite_eq_right (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hb ha), factorial_zero]

name: binomial_eq
statement:
theorem binomial_eq [DecidableEq α] (h : a ≠ b) :
    multinomial {a, b} f = (f a + f b)! / ((f a)! * (f b)!)
proof:
:= by
  simp [multinomial, Finset.sum_pair h, Finset.prod_pair h]

name: binomial_eq_choose
statement:
theorem binomial_eq_choose [DecidableEq α] (h : a ≠ b) :
    multinomial {a, b} f = (f a + f b).choose (f a)

name: binomial_spec
statement:
theorem binomial_spec [DecidableEq α] (hab : a ≠ b) :
    (f a)! * (f b)! * multinomial {a, b} f = (f a + f b)!
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Finset.sum_pair hab, Finset.prod_pair hab] using multinomial_spec {a, b} f

name: binomial_one
statement:
theorem binomial_one [DecidableEq α] (h : a ≠ b) (h₁ : f a = 1) :
    multinomial {a, b} f = (f b).succ

name: binomial_succ_succ
statement:
theorem binomial_succ_succ [DecidableEq α] (h : a ≠ b) :
    multinomial {a, b} (Function.update (Function.update f a (f a).succ) b (f b).succ) =
      multinomial {a, b} (Function.update f a (f a).succ) +
      multinomial {a, b} (Function.update f b (f b).succ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [binomial_eq_choose, Function.update_apply,
    h, Ne, ite_true, ite_false, not_false_eq_true]
  rw [ite_eq_right h.symm]
  rw [add_succ, choose_succ_succ, succ_add_eq_add_succ]
  ring

name: succ_mul_binomial
statement:
theorem succ_mul_binomial [DecidableEq α] (h : a ≠ b) :
    (f a + f b).succ * multinomial {a, b} f =
      (f a).succ * multinomial {a, b} (Function.update f a (f a).succ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [binomial_eq_choose h, binomial_eq_choose h, mul_comm (f a).succ, Function.update_self,
    Function.update_of_ne h.symm]
  rw [succ_eq_add_one, add_one_mul_choose_eq (f a + f b) (f a), succ_add (f a) (f b)]

name: multinomial_univ_two
statement:
theorem multinomial_univ_two (a b : ℕ) :
    multinomial Finset.univ ![a, b] = (a + b)! / (a ! * b !)
proof:
:= by
  rw [multinomial, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.prod_univ_two]
  dsimp only [Matrix.cons_val]

name: multinomial_univ_three
statement:
theorem multinomial_univ_three (a b c : ℕ) :
    multinomial Finset.univ ![a, b, c] = (a + b + c)! / (a ! * b ! * c !)

name: multinomial_eq
statement: theorem multinomial_eq (f : α →₀ ℕ) : f.multinomial = Nat.multinomial f.support f

name: multinomial_eq_of_support_subset
statement:
theorem multinomial_eq_of_support_subset {f : α →₀ ℕ} {s : Finset α} (h : f.support ⊆ s) :
    f.multinomial = Nat.multinomial s f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finsupp.multinomial_eq, Nat.multinomial]
  congr 1
  · simp [Finset.sum_subset h]
  · rw [Finset.prod_subset h]
    grind [Nat.factorial_eq_one]

name: multinomial_update
statement:
theorem multinomial_update (a : α) (f : α →₀ ℕ) :
    f.multinomial = (f.sum fun _ => id).choose (f a) * (f.update a 0).multinomial
proof:
:= by
  simp only [multinomial_eq]
  classical
    by_cases h : a ∈ f.support
    · rw [← Finset.insert_erase h, Nat.multinomial_insert (Finset.notMem_erase a _),
        Finset.add_sum_erase _ f h, support_update_zero]
      congr 1
      exact Nat.multinomial_congr fun _ h ↦ (Function.update_of_ne (mem_erase.1 h).1 0 f).symm
    rw [notMem_support_iff] at h
    rw [h, Nat.choose_zero_right, one_mul, ← h, update_self]

name: countPerms_filter_ne
statement:
theorem countPerms_filter_ne [DecidableEq α] (a : α) (m : Multiset α) :
    m.countPerms = m.card.choose (m.count a) * (m.filter (a ≠ ·)).countPerms
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [countPerms]
  convert! Finsupp.multinomial_update a _
  · rw [← Finsupp.card_toMultiset, m.toFinsupp_toMultiset]
  · ext1 a
    rw [toFinsupp_apply, count_filter, Finsupp.coe_update]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne h.symm, toFinsupp_apply]
    · rw [not_ne_iff.1 h, Function.update_self]

name: countPerms_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem countPerms_zero [DecidableEq α] : countPerms (0 : Multiset α) = 1

name: sum_pow_eq_sum_piAntidiag_of_commute
statement:
lemma sum_pow_eq_sum_piAntidiag_of_commute (s : Finset α) (f : α → R)
    (hc : (s : Set α).Pairwise (Commute on f)) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ n = ∑ k ∈ piAntidiag s n, multinomial s k *
      s.noncommProd (fun i ↦ f i ^ k i) (hc.mono' fun _ _ h ↦ h.pow_pow ..)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction generalizing n with
  | empty => cases n <;> simp
  | cons a s has ih => ?_
  rw [Finset.sum_cons, piAntidiag_cons, sum_disjiUnion]
  simp only [sum_map, Pi.add_apply, multinomial_cons,
    Pi.add_apply, ite_true, Nat.cast_mul, noncommProd_cons,
    ite_true, sum_add_distrib, sum_ite_eq', has, ite_false, add_zero,
    addRightEmbedding_apply]
  suffices ∀ p : ℕ × ℕ, p ∈ antidiagonal n →
    ∑ g ∈ piAntidiag s p.2, ((g a + p.1 + s.sum g).choose (g a + p.1) : R) *
      multinomial s (g + fun i ↦ ite (i = a) p.1 0) *
        (f a ^ (g a + p.1) * s.noncommProd (fun i ↦ f i ^ (g i + ite (i = a) p.1 0))
          ((hc.mono (by simp)).mono' fun i j h ↦ h.pow_pow ..)) =
      ∑ g ∈ piAntidiag s p.2, n.choose p.1 * multinomial s g * (f a ^ p.1 *
        s.noncommProd (fun i ↦ f i ^ g i) ((hc.mono (by simp)).mono' fun i j h ↦ h.pow_pow ..)) by
    rw [sum_congr rfl this]
    simp only [Nat.antidiagonal_eq_map, sum_map, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk]
    rw [(Commute.sum_right _ _ _ fun i hi ↦ hc (by simp) (by simp [hi])
      (by simpa [eq_comm] using ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hi has)).add_pow]
    simp only [ih (hc.mono (by simp)), sum_mul, mul_sum]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ sum_congr rfl fun g _ ↦ ?_
    rw [← Nat.cast_comm, (Nat.commute_cast (f a ^ i) _).left_comm, mul_assoc]
  refine fun p hp ↦ sum_congr rfl fun f hf ↦ ?_
  rw [mem_piAntidiag] at hf
  rw [not_imp_comm.1 (hf.2 _) has, zero_add, hf.1]
  congr 2
  · rw [mem_antidiagonal.1 hp]
  · rw [multinomial_congr]
    intro t ht
    rw [Pi.add_apply, ite_eq_right, add_zero]
    exact ne_of_mem_of_not_mem ht has
  refine noncommProd_congr rfl (fun t ht ↦ ?_) _
  rw [ite_eq_right, add_zero]
  exact ne_of_mem_of_not_mem ht has

name: sum_pow_of_commute
statement:
theorem sum_pow_of_commute (x : α → R) (s : Finset α)
    (hc : (s : Set α).Pairwise (Commute on x)) :
    ∀ n,
      s.sum x ^ n =
        ∑ k : s.sym n,
          k.1.1.countPerms *
            (k.1.1.map <| x).noncommProd
              (Multiset.map_set_pairwise <| hc.mono <| mem_sym_iff.1 k.2)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty =>
    rw [sum_empty]
    rintro (_ | n)
    · rw [_root_.pow_zero, Fintype.sum_subsingleton]
      swap
      · exact ⟨0, by simp [eq_iff_true_of_subsingleton]⟩
      convert! (@one_mul R _ _).symm
      convert! @Nat.cast_one R _
      simp
    · rw [_root_.pow_succ, mul_zero]
      have : IsEmpty (Finset.sym (∅ : Finset α) n.succ) := Finset.instIsEmpty
      apply (Fintype.sum_empty _).symm
  | insert a s ha ih => ?_
  intro n; specialize ih (hc.mono <| s.subset_insert a)
  rw [sum_insert ha, (Commute.sum_right s _ _ _).add_pow, sum_range]; swap
  · exact fun _ hb => hc (mem_insert_self a s) (mem_insert_of_mem hb)
      (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hb ha).symm
  · simp_rw [ih, mul_sum, sum_mul, sum_sigma', univ_sigma_univ]
    refine (Fintype.sum_equiv (symInsertEquiv ha) _ _ fun m => ?_).symm
    rw [m.1.1.countPerms_filter_ne a]
    conv in m.1.1.map _ => rw [← m.1.1.filter_add_not (a = ·), Multiset.map_add]
    simp_rw [Multiset.noncommProd_add, m.1.1.filter_eq, Multiset.map_replicate, m.1.2]
    rw [Multiset.noncommProd_eq_pow_card _ _ _ fun _ => Multiset.eq_of_mem_replicate]
    rw [Multiset.card_replicate, Nat.cast_mul, mul_assoc, Nat.cast_comm]
    congr 1; simp_rw [← mul_assoc, Nat.cast_comm]; rfl

name: sum_pow_eq_sum_piAntidiag
statement:
lemma sum_pow_eq_sum_piAntidiag (s : Finset α) (f : α → R) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ n = ∑ k ∈ piAntidiag s n, multinomial s k * ∏ i ∈ s, f i ^ k i
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← noncommProd_eq_prod]
  rw [← sum_pow_eq_sum_piAntidiag_of_commute _ _ fun _ _ _ _ _ ↦ Commute.all ..]

name: sum_pow
statement:
theorem sum_pow (x : α → R) (n : ℕ) :
    s.sum x ^ n = ∑ k ∈ s.sym n, k.val.countPerms * (k.val.map x).prod
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← sum_coe_sort]
  convert! sum_pow_of_commute x s (fun _ _ _ _ _ ↦ Commute.all ..) n
  rw [Multiset.noncommProd_eq_prod]

name: multinomial_two_mul_le_mul_multinomial
statement:
lemma multinomial_two_mul_le_mul_multinomial :
    multinomial s (fun i ↦ 2 * f i) ≤ ((∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ ∑ i ∈ s, f i) * multinomial s f
proof:
:= by
  rw [multinomial, multinomial, ← mul_sum,
    ← Nat.mul_div_assoc _ (prod_factorial_dvd_factorial_sum ..)]
  refine Nat.div_le_div_of_mul_le_mul (by positivity)
    ((prod_factorial_dvd_factorial_sum ..).trans (Nat.dvd_mul_left ..)) ?_
  calc
    (2 * ∑ i ∈ s, f i)! * ∏ i ∈ s, (f i)!
      ≤ ((2 * ∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ (∑ i ∈ s, f i) * (∑ i ∈ s, f i)!) * ∏ i ∈ s, (f i)! := by
      gcongr; exact Nat.factorial_two_mul_le _
    _ = ((∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ ∑ i ∈ s, f i) * (∑ i ∈ s, f i)! * ∏ i ∈ s, 2 ^ f i * (f i)! := by
      rw [mul_pow, ← prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, prod_mul_distrib]; ring
    _ ≤ ((∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ ∑ i ∈ s, f i) * (∑ i ∈ s, f i)! * ∏ i ∈ s, (2 * f i)! := by
      gcongr
      rw [← doubleFactorial_two_mul]
      exact doubleFactorial_le_factorial _

name: countPerms_coe_fill_of_notMem
statement:
theorem countPerms_coe_fill_of_notMem {m : Fin (n + 1)} {s : Sym α (n - m)} {x : α} (hx : x ∉ s) :
    (fill x m s : Multiset α).countPerms = n.choose m * (s : Multiset α).countPerms
proof:
:= by
  rw [Multiset.countPerms_filter_ne x]
  rw [← mem_coe] at hx
  refine congrArg₂ _ ?_ ?_
  · rw [card_coe, count_coe_fill_self_of_notMem hx]
  · refine congrArg _ ?_
    rw [coe_fill, coe_replicate, Multiset.filter_add]
    rw [Multiset.filter_eq_self.mpr]
    · rw [add_eq_left]
      rw [Multiset.filter_eq_nil]
      exact fun j hj ↦ by simp [Multiset.mem_replicate.mp hj]
    · exact fun j hj h ↦ hx <| by simpa [h] using hj

lemma toFinsupp_sum {α : Type*} [AddCommMonoid α] [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) :

proof:
:= by
  match l with
  | nil => simp
  | x :: l =>
    simp only [toFinsupp_cons_eq_single_add_embDomain, sum_cons]

name: multinomial_cons
statement:
theorem multinomial_cons (x : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) :
    (x :: l).multinomial = Nat.choose (x + l.sum) x * l.multinomial
proof:
:= by
  simp only [multinomial]
  rw [Finsupp.multinomial_update 0 (x :: l).toFinsupp]
  congr 1
  · congr
    exact List.toFinsupp_sum (x :: l)
  let succEmb : ℕ ↪ ℕ := addRightEmbedding 1
  have : (Finsupp.single 0 x + l.toFinsupp.embDomain succEmb).update 0 0 =
    (l.toFinsupp.embDomain succEmb).update 0 0 := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · simp [hi]
    · simp [Finsupp.update_apply, ite_eq_right hi, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hi]
  have h (x) : (l.toFinsupp.embDomain succEmb) (x + 1) = l[x]?.getD 0 := by
    rw [Finsupp.embDomain_apply, dite_eq_left ⟨x, by simp [succEmb]⟩]
    simp [succEmb]
  simp [toFinsupp_cons_eq_single_add_embDomain, Finsupp.multinomial_eq,
    succEmb, this, Nat.multinomial, h]

    rw [succ_nsmul', multinomial_add, hk, Finset.range_add_one,

name: choose_succ_le_two_pow
statement: theorem choose_succ_le_two_pow (n k : ℕ) : (n + 1).choose k ≤ 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases lt : n + 1 < k
  · simp [choose_eq_zero_of_lt lt]
  · cases n with
    | zero => cases k <;> simp_all
    | succ n =>
      rcases k with - | k
      · rw [choose_zero_right]
        exact Nat.one_le_two_pow
      · rw [choose_succ_succ', two_pow_succ]
        exact Nat.add_le_add (choose_succ_le_two_pow n k) (choose_succ_le_two_pow n (k + 1))

name: choose_lt_two_pow

  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel p]
  exact choose_succ_le_two_pow (n - 1) k

name: choose_le_two_pow

  · cases k <;> simp
  · exact (Nat.choose_lt_two_pow _ _ hn).le

name: binCast_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem binCast_eq [AddMonoidWithOne R] (n : ℕ) :
    (Nat.binCast n : R) = ((n : ℕ) : R)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with | ind k hk => ?_
  cases k with
  | zero => rw [Nat.binCast, Nat.cast_zero]
  | succ k =>
      rw [Nat.binCast]
      by_cases h : (k + 1) % 2 = 0
      · conv => rhs; rw [← Nat.mod_add_div (k + 1) 2]
        rw [ite_eq_left h, hk _ <| Nat.div_lt_self (Nat.succ_pos k) (Nat.le_refl 2), ← Nat.cast_add]
        rw [h, Nat.zero_add, Nat.succ_mul, Nat.one_mul]
      · conv => rhs; rw [← Nat.mod_add_div (k + 1) 2]
        rw [ite_eq_right h, hk _ <| Nat.div_lt_self (Nat.succ_pos k) (Nat.le_refl 2),
          ← Nat.cast_add]
        have h1 := Or.resolve_left (Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one (succ k)) h
        rw [h1, Nat.add_comm 1, Nat.succ_mul, Nat.one_mul]
        simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]

name: one_add_one_eq_two
statement: theorem one_add_one_eq_two [AddMonoidWithOne R] : 1 + 1 = (2 : R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cast_one, ← Nat.cast_add]
  apply congrArg
  decide

name: two_add_one_eq_three
statement: theorem two_add_one_eq_three [AddMonoidWithOne R] : 2 + 1 = (3 : R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_add_one_eq_two, ← Nat.cast_one, ← Nat.cast_add, ← Nat.cast_add]
  apply congrArg
  decide

name: three_add_one_eq_four
statement: theorem three_add_one_eq_four [AddMonoidWithOne R] : 3 + 1 = (4 : R)
proof:

  apply congrArg
  decide

name: two_add_two_eq_four

proof:
:= by

    ← two_add_one_eq_three, add_assoc]

name: cast_div
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cast_div (hnm : n ∣ m) (hn : (n : K) ≠ 0) : (↑(m / n) : K) = m / n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hnm
  have : n ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hn
  rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ <| zero_lt_of_ne_zero this, mul_comm n,
    cast_mul, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hn]

name: cast_div_charZero
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma cast_div_charZero (hnm : n ∣ m) : (↑(m / n) : K) = m / n
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0 <;> simp [*]

name: cast_div_div_div_cancel_right
statement:
lemma cast_div_div_div_cancel_right (hn : d ∣ n) (hm : d ∣ m) :
    (↑(m / d) : K) / (↑(n / d) : K) = (m : K) / n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne d 0 with (rfl | hd); · simp [Nat.zero_dvd.1 hm]
  replace hd : (d : K) ≠ 0 := by norm_cast
  rw [cast_div hm, cast_div hn, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ hd] <;> exact hd

name: IsPrimePow.minFac_pow_factorization_eq
statement:
theorem IsPrimePow.minFac_pow_factorization_eq {n : ℕ} (hn : IsPrimePow n) :
    n.minFac ^ n.factorization n.minFac = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, k, hp, hk, rfl⟩ := hn
  rw [← Nat.prime_iff] at hp
  rw [hp.pow_minFac hk.ne', hp.factorization_pow, Finsupp.single_eq_same]

name: isPrimePow_of_minFac_pow_factorization_eq
statement:
theorem isPrimePow_of_minFac_pow_factorization_eq {n : ℕ}
    (h : n.minFac ^ n.factorization n.minFac = n) (hn : n ≠ 1) : IsPrimePow n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn')
  · simp_all
  refine ⟨_, _, (Nat.minFac_prime hn).prime, ?_, h⟩
  simp [pos_iff_ne_zero, ← Finsupp.mem_support_iff, Nat.support_factorization, hn',
    Nat.minFac_prime hn, Nat.minFac_dvd]

name: isPrimePow_iff_minFac_pow_factorization_eq
statement:
theorem isPrimePow_iff_minFac_pow_factorization_eq {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 1) :
    IsPrimePow n ↔ n.minFac ^ n.factorization n.minFac = n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h.minFac_pow_factorization_eq, fun h => isPrimePow_of_minFac_pow_factorization_eq h hn⟩

name: isPrimePow_iff_factorization_eq_single
statement:
theorem isPrimePow_iff_factorization_eq_single {n : ℕ} :
    IsPrimePow n ↔ ∃ p k : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ n.factorization = Finsupp.single p k
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPrimePow_nat_iff]
  refine exists₂_congr fun p k => ?_
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, hk, hn⟩
    exact ⟨hk, by rw [← hn, Nat.Prime.factorization_pow hp]⟩
  · rintro ⟨hk, hn⟩
    have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      simp_all only [Finsupp.single_eq_zero, eq_comm, Nat.factorization_zero, hk.ne']
    rw [Nat.eq_pow_of_factorization_eq_single hn0 hn]
    exact ⟨Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors <|
      Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 (by simp [hn, hk.ne'] : n.factorization p ≠ 0), hk, rfl⟩

name: isPrimePow_iff_card_primeFactors_eq_one
statement:
theorem isPrimePow_iff_card_primeFactors_eq_one {n : ℕ} :
    IsPrimePow n ↔ n.primeFactors.card = 1

name: Nat.not_isPrimePow_iff_nontrivial_of_two_le
statement:
theorem Nat.not_isPrimePow_iff_nontrivial_of_two_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ¬ IsPrimePow n ↔ n.primeFactors.Nontrivial

name: IsPrimePow.exists_ordCompl_eq_one
statement:
theorem IsPrimePow.exists_ordCompl_eq_one {n : ℕ} (h : IsPrimePow n) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ ordCompl[p] n = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn0); · cases not_isPrimePow_zero h
  rcases isPrimePow_iff_factorization_eq_single.mp h with ⟨p, k, hk0, h1⟩
  rcases em' p.Prime with (pp | pp)
  · refine absurd ?_ hk0.ne'
    simp [← Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime n pp, h1]
  refine ⟨p, pp, ?_⟩
  refine Nat.eq_of_factorization_eq (Nat.ordCompl_pos p hn0).ne' (by simp) fun q => ?_
  rw [Nat.factorization_ordCompl n p, h1]
  simp

name: exists_ordCompl_eq_one_iff_isPrimePow
statement:
theorem exists_ordCompl_eq_one_iff_isPrimePow {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 1) :
    IsPrimePow n ↔ ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ ordCompl[p] n = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => IsPrimePow.exists_ordCompl_eq_one h, fun h => ?_⟩
  rcases h with ⟨p, pp, h⟩
  rw [isPrimePow_nat_iff]
  rw [← Nat.eq_of_dvd_of_div_eq_one (Nat.ordProj_dvd n p) h] at hn ⊢
  refine ⟨p, n.factorization p, pp, ?_, by simp⟩
  contrapose! hn
  simp [Nat.le_zero.1 hn]

name: isPrimePow_iff_unique_prime_dvd
statement: theorem isPrimePow_iff_unique_prime_dvd {n : ℕ} : IsPrimePow n ↔ ∃! p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ p ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [isPrimePow_nat_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, k, hp, hk, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨p, ⟨hp, dvd_pow_self _ hk.ne'⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro q ⟨hq, hq'⟩
    exact (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq hp).1 (hq.dvd_of_dvd_pow hq')
  rintro ⟨p, ⟨hp, hn⟩, hq⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn₀)
  · cases (hq 2 ⟨Nat.prime_two, dvd_zero 2⟩).trans (hq 3 ⟨Nat.prime_three, dvd_zero 3⟩).symm
  refine ⟨p, n.factorization p, hp, hp.factorization_pos_of_dvd hn₀ hn, ?_⟩
  simp only [and_imp] at hq
  apply Nat.dvd_antisymm (Nat.ordProj_dvd _ _)
  
  apply Nat.dvd_of_primeFactorsList_subperm hn₀
  rw [hp.primeFactorsList_pow, List.subperm_ext_iff]
  intro q hq'
  rw [Nat.mem_primeFactorsList hn₀] at hq'
  cases hq _ hq'.1 hq'.2
  simp

name: isPrimePow_pow_iff
statement: theorem isPrimePow_pow_iff {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) : IsPrimePow (n ^ k) ↔ IsPrimePow n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isPrimePow_iff_unique_prime_dvd]
  apply existsUnique_congr
  simp +contextual [Nat.prime_iff, Prime.dvd_pow_iff_dvd, hk]

name: Nat.Coprime.isPrimePow_dvd_mul
statement:
theorem Nat.Coprime.isPrimePow_dvd_mul {n a b : ℕ} (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (hn : IsPrimePow n) :
    n ∣ a * b ↔ n ∣ a ∨ n ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha)
  · simp
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with (rfl | hb)
  · simp
  refine
    ⟨?_, fun h =>
      Or.elim h (fun i => i.trans ((@dvd_mul_right a b a hab).mpr (dvd_refl a)))
          fun i => i.trans ((@dvd_mul_left a b b hab.symm).mpr (dvd_refl b))⟩
