  obtain ⟨p, k, hp, _, rfl⟩ := (isPrimePow_nat_iff _).1 hn
  simp only [hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization (mul_ne_zero ha hb), Nat.factorization_mul ha hb,
    hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization ha, hp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hb, Pi.add_apply,
    Finsupp.coe_add]
  have : a.factorization p = 0 ∨ b.factorization p = 0 := by
    rw [← Finsupp.notMem_support_iff, ← Finsupp.notMem_support_iff, ← not_and_or, ←
      Finset.mem_inter]
    intro t
    simpa using hab.disjoint_primeFactors.le_bot t
  rcases this with h | h <;> simp [h, imp_or]

name: Nat.mul_divisors_filter_prime_pow
statement:
theorem Nat.mul_divisors_filter_prime_pow {a b : ℕ} (hab : a.Coprime b) :
    {d ∈ (a * b).divisors | IsPrimePow d} = {d ∈ a.divisors ∪ b.divisors | IsPrimePow d}
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha)
  · simp only [Nat.coprime_zero_left] at hab
    simp [hab, Finset.filter_singleton, not_isPrimePow_one]
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with (rfl | hb)
  · simp only [Nat.coprime_zero_right] at hab
    simp [hab, Finset.filter_singleton, not_isPrimePow_one]
  ext n
  simp only [ha, hb, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Nat.mul_eq_zero, and_true, Ne,
    and_congr_left_iff, not_false_iff, Nat.mem_divisors, or_self_iff]
  apply hab.isPrimePow_dvd_mul

name: Nat.Primes.prodNatEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Nat.Primes.prodNatEquiv_apply (p : Nat.Primes) (k : ℕ) :
    prodNatEquiv (p, k) = ⟨p ^ (k + 1), p, k + 1, prime_iff.mp p.prop, k.add_one_pos, rfl⟩

name: Nat.Primes.coe_prodNatEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Nat.Primes.coe_prodNatEquiv_apply (p : Nat.Primes) (k : ℕ) :
    (prodNatEquiv (p, k) : ℕ) = p ^ (k + 1)

name: Nat.Primes.prodNatEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma Nat.Primes.prodNatEquiv_symm_apply {n : ℕ} (hn : IsPrimePow n) :
    prodNatEquiv.symm ⟨n, hn⟩ =
      (⟨n.minFac, minFac_prime hn.ne_one⟩, n.factorization n.minFac - 1)

name: exponent_eq_exponent_mul_factorization_of_prime_pow_eq_base_pow
statement:
theorem exponent_eq_exponent_mul_factorization_of_prime_pow_eq_base_pow :
    m = n * a.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg Nat.factorization h
  rw [Nat.Prime.factorization_pow hp, Nat.factorization_pow] at this
  simpa using congr($this p)

name: exponent_dvd_of_prime_pow_eq_pow
statement: theorem exponent_dvd_of_prime_pow_eq_pow : n ∣ m

name: exists_base_eq_prime_pow_of_prime_pow_eq_base_pow
statement: theorem exists_base_eq_prime_pow_of_prime_pow_eq_base_pow : ∃ k, a = p ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rcases exponent_dvd_of_prime_pow_eq_pow hp h with ⟨k, m_eq⟩
  rw [m_eq, pow_mul'] at h
  use k
  exact Nat.pow_left_injective hn h.symm

name: floorRoot_def
statement:
lemma floorRoot_def :
    floorRoot n a = if n = 0 ∨ a = 0 then 0 else (a.factorization ⌊/⌋ n).prod (· ^ ·)
proof:
:= by
  unfold floorRoot; split_ifs with h <;> simp [Finsupp.floorDiv_def, prod_mapRange_index pow_zero]

name: floorRoot_zero_left
statement: @[simp] lemma floorRoot_zero_left (a : ℕ) : floorRoot 0 a = 0

name: floorRoot_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma floorRoot_zero_right (n : ℕ) : floorRoot n 0 = 0

name: floorRoot_one_left
statement: @[simp] lemma floorRoot_one_left (a : ℕ) : floorRoot 1 a = a

name: floorRoot_one_right
statement: @[simp] lemma floorRoot_one_right (hn : n ≠ 0) : floorRoot n 1 = 1

name: floorRoot_pow_self
statement: @[simp] lemma floorRoot_pow_self (hn : n ≠ 0) (a : ℕ) : floorRoot n (a ^ n) = a
proof:
:= by
  simp [floorRoot_def, pos_iff_ne_zero.2, hn]; split_ifs <;> simp [*]

name: floorRoot_ne_zero
statement: lemma floorRoot_ne_zero : floorRoot n a ≠ 0 ↔ n ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ 0

name: floorRoot_eq_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma floorRoot_eq_zero : floorRoot n a = 0 ↔ n = 0 ∨ a = 0
proof:
:=
  floorRoot_ne_zero.not_right.trans <| by simp only [not_and_or, ne_eq, not_not]

name: factorization_floorRoot
statement:
@[simp] lemma factorization_floorRoot (n a : ℕ) :
    (floorRoot n a).factorization = a.factorization ⌊/⌋ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [floorRoot_def]
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain rfl | rfl := h <;> simp
  apply a.factorization_prod_pow_eq_self_of_le_factorization
  exact le_self_nsmul (by simp) (by lia) |>.trans <| smul_floorDiv_le (by lia)

name: pow_dvd_iff_dvd_floorRoot
statement: lemma pow_dvd_iff_dvd_floorRoot : a ^ n ∣ b ↔ a ∣ floorRoot n b
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0
  · simp
  obtain rfl | hb := eq_or_ne b 0
  · simp
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp [hn]
  rw [← factorization_le_iff_dvd (pow_ne_zero _ ha) hb,
    ← factorization_le_iff_dvd ha (floorRoot_ne_zero.2 ⟨hn, hb⟩), factorization_pow,
    factorization_floorRoot, le_floorDiv_iff_smul_le (β := ℕ →₀ ℕ) (pos_iff_ne_zero.2 hn)]

name: floorRoot_pow_dvd
statement: lemma floorRoot_pow_dvd : floorRoot n a ^ n ∣ a

name: ceilRoot_def
statement:
lemma ceilRoot_def :
    ceilRoot n a = if n = 0 ∨ a = 0 then 0 else (a.factorization ⌈/⌉ n).prod (· ^ ·)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ceilRoot
  split_ifs with h <;>
    simp [Finsupp.ceilDiv_def, prod_mapRange_index pow_zero, Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div]

name: ceilRoot_zero_left
statement: @[simp] lemma ceilRoot_zero_left (a : ℕ) : ceilRoot 0 a = 0

name: ceilRoot_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma ceilRoot_zero_right (n : ℕ) : ceilRoot n 0 = 0

name: ceilRoot_one_left
statement: @[simp] lemma ceilRoot_one_left (a : ℕ) : ceilRoot 1 a = a

name: ceilRoot_one_right
statement: @[simp] lemma ceilRoot_one_right (hn : n ≠ 0) : ceilRoot n 1 = 1

name: ceilRoot_pow_self
statement: @[simp] lemma ceilRoot_pow_self (hn : n ≠ 0) (a : ℕ) : ceilRoot n (a ^ n) = a
proof:
:= by
  simp [ceilRoot_def, pos_iff_ne_zero.2, hn]; split_ifs <;> simp [*]

name: ceilRoot_ne_zero
statement: lemma ceilRoot_ne_zero : ceilRoot n a ≠ 0 ↔ n ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ 0

name: ceilRoot_eq_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma ceilRoot_eq_zero : ceilRoot n a = 0 ↔ n = 0 ∨ a = 0
proof:
:=
  ceilRoot_ne_zero.not_right.trans <| by simp only [not_and_or, ne_eq, not_not]

name: factorization_ceilRoot
statement:
@[simp] lemma factorization_ceilRoot (n a : ℕ) :
    (ceilRoot n a).factorization = a.factorization ⌈/⌉ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [ceilRoot_def]
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain rfl | rfl := h <;> simp
  refine prod_pow_factorization_eq_self fun p hp ↦ ?_
  have : p.Prime ∧ p ∣ a ∧ ¬a = 0 := by simpa using support_ceilDiv_subset hp
  exact this.1

name: dvd_pow_iff_ceilRoot_dvd
statement: lemma dvd_pow_iff_ceilRoot_dvd (hn : n ≠ 0) : a ∣ b ^ n ↔ ceilRoot n a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
  · aesop
  obtain rfl | hb := eq_or_ne b 0
  · simp [hn]
  rw [← factorization_le_iff_dvd ha (pow_ne_zero _ hb),
    ← factorization_le_iff_dvd (ceilRoot_ne_zero.2 ⟨hn, ha⟩) hb, factorization_pow,
    factorization_ceilRoot, ceilDiv_le_iff_le_smul (β := ℕ →₀ ℕ) (pos_iff_ne_zero.2 hn)]

name: dvd_ceilRoot_pow
statement: lemma dvd_ceilRoot_pow (hn : n ≠ 0) : a ∣ ceilRoot n a ^ n

name: factorizationLCMLeft_zero_left
statement: @[simp] lemma factorizationLCMLeft_zero_left : factorizationLCMLeft 0 b = 1

name: factorizationLCMLeft_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma factorizationLCMLeft_zero_right : factorizationLCMLeft a 0 = 1

name: factorizationLCRight_zero_left
statement: @[simp] lemma factorizationLCRight_zero_left : factorizationLCMRight 0 b = 1

name: factorizationLCMRight_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma factorizationLCMRight_zero_right : factorizationLCMRight a 0 = 1

name: factorizationLCMLeft_pos
statement: lemma factorizationLCMLeft_pos : 0 < factorizationLCMLeft a b
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
  rw [factorizationLCMLeft, Finsupp.prod_ne_zero_iff]
  intro p _ H
  by_cases h : b.factorization p ≤ a.factorization p
  · simp only [h, reduceIte, pow_eq_zero_iff', ne_eq] at H
    simpa [H.1] using H.2
  · simp only [h, reduceIte, one_ne_zero] at H

name: factorizationLCMRight_pos
statement: lemma factorizationLCMRight_pos : 0 < factorizationLCMRight a b
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
  rw [factorizationLCMRight, Finsupp.prod_ne_zero_iff]
  intro p _ H
  by_cases h : b.factorization p ≤ a.factorization p
  · simp only [h, reduceIte, reduceCtorEq] at H
  · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, pow_eq_zero_iff', ne_eq] at H
    simpa [H.1] using H.2

name: coprime_factorizationLCMLeft_factorizationLCMRight
statement:
lemma coprime_factorizationLCMLeft_factorizationLCMRight :
    (factorizationLCMLeft a b).Coprime (factorizationLCMRight a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [factorizationLCMLeft, factorizationLCMRight]
  refine coprime_prod_left_iff.mpr fun p hp ↦ coprime_prod_right_iff.mpr fun q hq ↦ ?_
  dsimp only; split_ifs with h h'
  any_goals simp only [coprime_one_right_eq_true, coprime_one_left_eq_true]
  refine coprime_pow_primes _ _ (prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp) (prime_of_mem_primeFactors hq) ?_
  contrapose h'; rwa [← h']

name: factorizationLCMLeft_mul_factorizationLCMRight
statement:
lemma factorizationLCMLeft_mul_factorizationLCMRight (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    (factorizationLCMLeft a b) * (factorizationLCMRight a b) = lcm a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_factorization_pow_eq_self (lcm_ne_zero ha hb), factorizationLCMLeft,
    factorizationLCMRight, ← prod_mul]
  congr; ext p n; split_ifs <;> simp

name: factorizationLCMLeft_dvd_left
statement: lemma factorizationLCMLeft_dvd_left : factorizationLCMLeft a b ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha
  · simp only [dvd_zero]
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with rfl | hb
  · simp [factorizationLCMLeft]
  nth_rewrite 2 [← prod_factorization_pow_eq_self ha]
  rw [prod_of_support_subset (s := (lcm a b).factorization.support)]
  · apply prod_dvd_prod_of_dvd; rintro p -; dsimp only; split_ifs with le
    · rw [factorization_lcm ha hb]; apply pow_dvd_pow; exact sup_le le_rfl le
    · apply one_dvd
  · intro p hp; rw [mem_support_iff] at hp ⊢
    rw [factorization_lcm ha hb]; exact (lt_sup_iff.mpr <| .inl <| Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hp).ne'
  · intros; rw [pow_zero]

name: factorizationLCMRight_dvd_right
statement: lemma factorizationLCMRight_dvd_right : factorizationLCMRight a b ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | ha
  · simp [factorizationLCMRight]
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with rfl | hb
  · simp only [dvd_zero]
  nth_rewrite 2 [← prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hb]
  rw [prod_of_support_subset (s := (lcm a b).factorization.support)]
  · apply Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_dvd; rintro p -; dsimp only; split_ifs with le
    · apply one_dvd
    · rw [factorization_lcm ha hb]; apply pow_dvd_pow; exact sup_le (not_le.1 le).le le_rfl
  · intro p hp; rw [mem_support_iff] at hp ⊢
    rw [factorization_lcm ha hb]; exact (lt_sup_iff.mpr <| .inr <| Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hp).ne'
  · intros; rw [pow_zero]

name: factorization_eq_zero_of_lt
statement: theorem factorization_eq_zero_of_lt {n p : ℕ} (h : n < p) : n.factorization p = 0

name: dvd_of_factorization_pos
statement: theorem dvd_of_factorization_pos {n p : ℕ} (hn : n.factorization p ≠ 0) : p ∣ n

name: factorization_eq_zero_iff_remainder
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_zero_iff_remainder {p r : ℕ} (i : ℕ) (pp : p.Prime) (hr0 : r ≠ 0) :
    ¬p ∣ r ↔ (p * i + r).factorization p = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨factorization_eq_zero_of_remainder i, fun h => ?_⟩
  rw [factorization_eq_zero_iff] at h
  contrapose! h
  refine ⟨pp, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rwa [← Nat.dvd_add_iff_right (dvd_mul_right p i)]
  · contrapose hr0
    exact (add_eq_zero.1 hr0).2

name: factorization_eq_zero_iff'
statement: theorem factorization_eq_zero_iff' (n : ℕ) : n.factorization = 0 ↔ n = 0 ∨ n = 1

name: factorization_prod_apply
prod_factorization_eq_prod_primeFactors
statement:
lemma prod_factorization_eq_prod_primeFactors {β : Type*} [CommMonoid β] (f : ℕ → ℕ → β) :
    n.factorization.prod f = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, f p (n.factorization p)

name: prod_primeFactors_prod_factorization
statement:
lemma prod_primeFactors_prod_factorization {β : Type*} [CommMonoid β] (f : ℕ → β) :
    ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, f p = n.factorization.prod (fun p _ ↦ f p)

name: Prime.factorization_self
statement: theorem Prime.factorization_self {p : ℕ} (hp : Prime p) : p.factorization p = 1

name: factorization_pow_self
statement: theorem factorization_pow_self {p n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : (p ^ n).factorization p = n

name: eq_pow_of_factorization_eq_single
statement:
theorem eq_pow_of_factorization_eq_single {n p k : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (h : n.factorization = Finsupp.single p k) : n = p ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hn, h]
  simp

name: Prime.eq_of_factorization_pos
statement:
theorem Prime.eq_of_factorization_pos {p q : ℕ} (hp : Prime p) (h : p.factorization q ≠ 0) :
    p = q

name: factorizationEquiv_inv_apply
statement:
@[deprecated factorizationEquiv_symm_apply_coe (since := "2026-03-18")]
theorem factorizationEquiv_inv_apply {f : ℕ →₀ ℕ} (hf : ∀ p ∈ f.support, Prime p) :
    (factorizationEquiv.symm ⟨f, hf⟩).1 = f.prod (· ^ ·)

name: ordProj_of_not_prime
statement: theorem ordProj_of_not_prime (n p : ℕ) (hp : ¬p.Prime) : ordProj[p] n = 1

name: ordCompl_of_not_prime
statement: theorem ordCompl_of_not_prime (n p : ℕ) (hp : ¬p.Prime) : ordCompl[p] n = n

name: ordCompl_dvd
statement: theorem ordCompl_dvd (n p : ℕ) : ordCompl[p] n ∣ n

name: ordProj_pos
statement: theorem ordProj_pos (n p : ℕ) : 0 < ordProj[p] n
proof:
:= by
  if pp : p.Prime then simp [Nat.pow_pos pp.pos] else simp [pp]

name: ordProj_le
statement: theorem ordProj_le {n : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) : ordProj[p] n ≤ n

name: ordCompl_pos
statement: theorem ordCompl_pos {n : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) : 0 < ordCompl[p] n
proof:
:= by
  if pp : p.Prime then
    exact Nat.div_pos (ordProj_le p hn) (ordProj_pos n p)
  else
    simpa [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime n pp] using hn.bot_lt

name: ordCompl_le
statement: theorem ordCompl_le (n p : ℕ) : ordCompl[p] n ≤ n

name: ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self
statement: theorem ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self (n p : ℕ) : ordProj[p] n * ordCompl[p] n = n

name: ordProj_mul
statement:
theorem ordProj_mul {a b : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    ordProj[p] (a * b) = ordProj[p] a * ordProj[p] b

name: ordCompl_mul
statement: theorem ordCompl_mul (a b p : ℕ) : ordCompl[p] (a * b) = ordCompl[p] a * ordCompl[p] b
proof:
:= by
  if ha : a = 0 then simp [ha] else
  if hb : b = 0 then simp [hb] else
  simp only [ordProj_mul p ha hb]
  rw [div_mul_div_comm (ordProj_dvd a p) (ordProj_dvd b p)]

name: factorization_lt
statement: theorem factorization_lt {n : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) : n.factorization p < n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases pp : p.Prime
  · exact (Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right pp.one_lt).1 <| (ordProj_le p hn).trans_lt <|
      Nat.lt_pow_self pp.one_lt
  · simpa only [factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime n pp] using! hn.bot_lt

name: mul_factorization_le
statement: theorem mul_factorization_le {n p : ℕ} : p * n.factorization p ≤ n

name: factorization_le_of_le_pow
statement: theorem factorization_le_of_le_pow {n p b : ℕ} (hb : n ≤ p ^ b) : n.factorization p ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  if hn : n = 0 then simp [hn] else
  if pp : p.Prime then
    exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right pp.one_lt).1 ((ordProj_le p hn).trans hb)
  else
    simp [factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime n pp]

name: factorization_prime_le_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem factorization_prime_le_iff_dvd {d n : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → d.factorization p ≤ n.factorization p) ↔ d ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← factorization_le_iff_dvd hd hn]
  refine ⟨fun h p => (em p.Prime).elim (h p) fun hp => ?_, fun h p _ => h p⟩
  simp_rw [factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime _ hp]
  rfl

name: factorization_le_factorization_mul_left
statement:
theorem factorization_le_factorization_mul_left {a b : ℕ} (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    a.factorization ≤ (a * b).factorization
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha)
  · simp
  rw [factorization_le_iff_dvd ha <| mul_ne_zero ha hb]
  exact Dvd.intro b rfl

name: factorization_le_factorization_mul_right
statement:
theorem factorization_le_factorization_mul_right {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    b.factorization ≤ (a * b).factorization

name: Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization
statement:
theorem Prime.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization {p k n : ℕ} (pp : Prime p) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    p ^ k ∣ n ↔ k ≤ n.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← factorization_le_iff_dvd (Nat.pow_pos pp.pos).ne' hn, pp.factorization_pow, single_le_iff]

name: Prime.pow_dvd_iff_dvd_ordProj
statement:
theorem Prime.pow_dvd_iff_dvd_ordProj {p k n : ℕ} (pp : Prime p) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    p ^ k ∣ n ↔ p ^ k ∣ ordProj[p] n

name: Prime.dvd_iff_one_le_factorization
statement:
theorem Prime.dvd_iff_one_le_factorization {p n : ℕ} (pp : Prime p) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    p ∣ n ↔ 1 ≤ n.factorization p

name: exists_factorization_lt_of_lt
statement:
theorem exists_factorization_lt_of_lt {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hab : a < b) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, a.factorization p < b.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := (ha.bot_lt.trans hab).ne'
  contrapose! hab
  rw [← Finsupp.le_def, factorization_le_iff_dvd hb ha] at hab
  exact le_of_dvd ha.bot_lt hab

name: factorization_div
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorization_div {d n : ℕ} (h : d ∣ n) :
    (n / d).factorization = n.factorization - d.factorization
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne d 0 with (rfl | hd); · simp [zero_dvd_iff.mp h]
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn); · simp [tsub_eq_zero_of_le]
  apply add_left_injective d.factorization
  simp only
  rw [tsub_add_cancel_of_le <| (Nat.factorization_le_iff_dvd hd hn).mpr h, ←
    Nat.factorization_mul (Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hn.bot_lt h) hd.bot_lt).ne' hd,
    Nat.div_mul_cancel h]

name: dvd_ordProj_of_dvd
statement: theorem dvd_ordProj_of_dvd {n p : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (pp : p.Prime) (h : p ∣ n) : p ∣ ordProj[p] n

name: not_dvd_ordCompl
statement: theorem not_dvd_ordCompl {n p : ℕ} (hp : Prime p) (hn : n ≠ 0) : ¬p ∣ ordCompl[p] n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.Prime.dvd_iff_one_le_factorization hp (ordCompl_pos p hn).ne']
  rw [Nat.factorization_div (Nat.ordProj_dvd n p)]
  simp [hp.factorization]

name: coprime_ordCompl
statement: theorem coprime_ordCompl {n p : ℕ} (hp : Prime p) (hn : n ≠ 0) : Coprime p (ordCompl[p] n)

name: factorization_ordCompl
statement:
theorem factorization_ordCompl (n p : ℕ) :
    (ordCompl[p] n).factorization = n.factorization.erase p
proof:
:= by
  if hn : n = 0 then simp [hn] else
  if pp : p.Prime then ?_ else
    simp [pp]
  ext q
  rcases eq_or_ne q p with (rfl | hqp)
  · simp only [Finsupp.erase_same, factorization_eq_zero_iff, not_dvd_ordCompl pp hn]
    simp
  · rw [Finsupp.erase_ne hqp, factorization_div (ordProj_dvd n p)]
    simp [pp.factorization, hqp.symm]

name: ordProj_self_pow
statement: theorem ordProj_self_pow {p k : ℕ} (hp : Prime p) : ordProj[p] (p ^ k) = p ^ k

name: ordCompl_self_pow
statement: theorem ordCompl_self_pow {p k : ℕ} (hp : Prime p) : ordCompl[p] (p ^ k) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.eq_of_factorization_eq
  · exact pos_iff_ne_zero.mp (ordCompl_pos p (pow_ne_zero k hp.ne_zero))
  · exact one_ne_zero
  · simp [Prime.factorization_pow hp]

name: ordCompl_self_pow_mul
statement:
theorem ordCompl_self_pow_mul (n k : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (hp : Prime p) :
    ordCompl[p] (p ^ k * n) = ordCompl[p] n

name: ordCompl_eq_self_iff_zero_or_not_dvd
statement:
theorem ordCompl_eq_self_iff_zero_or_not_dvd (n : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (hp : Prime p) :
    ordCompl[p] n = n ↔ n = 0 ∨ ¬p ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases n_zero : n = 0
    · simp [n_zero]
    · right
      rw [← h]
      exact not_dvd_ordCompl hp n_zero
  · rintro (n_eq_zero | not_dvd)
    · simp [n_eq_zero]
    · simp [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd not_dvd]

name: ordCompl_pow_mul_of_not_dvd
statement:
theorem ordCompl_pow_mul_of_not_dvd {m : ℕ} (k : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hm : ¬p ∣ m) :
    ordCompl[p] (p ^ k * m) = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordCompl_self_pow_mul m k hp]
  exact (ordCompl_eq_self_iff_zero_or_not_dvd m hp).mpr (Or.inr hm)

name: ordCompl_pow_mul_eq_self_iff
statement:
theorem ordCompl_pow_mul_eq_self_iff (k m : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    ordCompl[p] (p ^ k * m) = m ↔ m = 0 ∨ ¬p ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordCompl_self_pow_mul m k hp, ordCompl_eq_self_iff_zero_or_not_dvd m hp]

name: ordCompl_div_pow_of_dvd
statement:
theorem ordCompl_div_pow_of_dvd (k : ℕ) {x p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hx : p ^ k ∣ x) :
    ordCompl[p] (x / p ^ k) = ordCompl[p] x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left m (pow_pos hp.pos k), ← ordCompl_self_pow_mul m k hp]

name: ordCompl_div_of_dvd
statement:
theorem ordCompl_div_of_dvd {x : ℕ} {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hx : p ∣ x) :
    ordCompl[p] (x / p) = ordCompl[p] x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pow_one] using ordCompl_div_pow_of_dvd 1 hp (show p ^ 1 ∣ x by simpa)

name: dvd_ordCompl_of_dvd_not_dvd
statement:
theorem dvd_ordCompl_of_dvd_not_dvd {p d n : ℕ} (hdn : d ∣ n) (hpd : ¬p ∣ d) :
    d ∣ ordCompl[p] n
proof:
:= by
  if hn0 : n = 0 then simp [hn0] else
  if hd0 : d = 0 then simp [hd0] at hpd else
  rw [← factorization_le_iff_dvd hd0 (ordCompl_pos p hn0).ne', factorization_ordCompl]
  intro q
  if hqp : q = p then
    simp [factorization_eq_zero_iff, hqp, hpd]
  else
    simp [hqp, (factorization_le_iff_dvd hd0 hn0).2 hdn q]

name: exists_eq_pow_mul_and_not_dvd
statement:
theorem exists_eq_pow_mul_and_not_dvd {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (p : ℕ) (hp : p ≠ 1) :
    ∃ e n' : ℕ, ¬p ∣ n' ∧ n = p ^ e * n'
proof:
:=
  let ⟨a', h₁, h₂⟩ :=
    (Nat.finiteMultiplicity_iff.mpr ⟨hp, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn⟩).exists_eq_pow_mul_and_not_dvd
  ⟨_, a', h₂, h₁⟩

name: exists_eq_two_pow_mul_odd
statement:
theorem exists_eq_two_pow_mul_odd {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ∃ k m : ℕ, Odd m ∧ n = 2 ^ k * m

name: dvd_iff_div_factorization_eq_tsub
statement:
theorem dvd_iff_div_factorization_eq_tsub {d n : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) (hdn : d ≤ n) :
    d ∣ n ↔ (n / d).factorization = n.factorization - d.factorization
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨factorization_div, ?_⟩
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hdn with (rfl | hd_lt_n); · simp
  have h1 : n / d ≠ 0 := by simp [*]
  intro h
  rw [dvd_iff_le_div_mul n d]
  by_contra h2
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_factorization_lt_of_lt (mul_ne_zero h1 hd) (not_le.mp h2)
  rwa [factorization_mul h1 hd, add_apply, ← lt_tsub_iff_right, h, tsub_apply,
    lt_self_iff_false] at hp

name: ordProj_dvd_ordProj_of_dvd
statement:
theorem ordProj_dvd_ordProj_of_dvd {a b : ℕ} (hb0 : b ≠ 0) (hab : a ∣ b) (p : ℕ) :
    ordProj[p] a ∣ ordProj[p] b
proof:
:= by
  rcases em' p.Prime with (pp | pp); · simp [pp]
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha0); · simp
  rw [pow_dvd_pow_iff_le_right pp.one_lt]
  exact (factorization_le_iff_dvd ha0 hb0).2 hab p

name: ordCompl_dvd_ordCompl_of_dvd
statement:
theorem ordCompl_dvd_ordCompl_of_dvd {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ∣ b) (p : ℕ) :
    ordCompl[p] a ∣ ordCompl[p] b
proof:
:= by
  rcases em' p.Prime with (pp | pp)
  · simp [pp, hab]
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with (rfl | hb0)
  · simp
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha0)
  · cases hb0 (zero_dvd_iff.1 hab)
  have ha := (Nat.div_pos (ordProj_le p ha0) (ordProj_pos a p)).ne'
  have hb := (Nat.div_pos (ordProj_le p hb0) (ordProj_pos b p)).ne'
  rw [← factorization_le_iff_dvd ha hb, factorization_ordCompl a p, factorization_ordCompl b p]
  intro q
  rcases eq_or_ne q p with (rfl | hqp)
  · simp
  simp_rw [erase_ne hqp]
  exact (factorization_le_iff_dvd ha0 hb0).2 hab q

name: ordCompl_dvd_ordCompl_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem ordCompl_dvd_ordCompl_iff_dvd (a b : ℕ) :
    (∀ p : ℕ, ordCompl[p] a ∣ ordCompl[p] b) ↔ a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun hab p => ordCompl_dvd_ordCompl_of_dvd hab p⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with (rfl | hb0)
  · simp
  if pa : a.Prime then ?_ else simpa [pa] using h a
  if pb : b.Prime then ?_ else simpa [pb] using h b
  rw [prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq pa pb]
  by_contra hab
  apply pa.ne_one
  rw [← Nat.dvd_one, ← Nat.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hb0.bot_lt, mul_one]
  simpa [Prime.factorization_self pb, Prime.factorization pa, hab] using h b

name: dvd_iff_prime_pow_dvd_dvd
statement:
theorem dvd_iff_prime_pow_dvd_dvd (n d : ℕ) :
    d ∣ n ↔ ∀ p k : ℕ, Prime p → p ^ k ∣ d → p ^ k ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn)
  · simp
  rcases eq_or_ne d 0 with (rfl | hd)
  · simp only [zero_dvd_iff, hn, false_iff, not_forall]
    exact ⟨2, n, prime_two, dvd_zero _, mt (le_of_dvd hn.bot_lt) (n.lt_two_pow_self).not_ge⟩
  refine ⟨fun h p k _ hpkd => dvd_trans hpkd h, ?_⟩
  rw [← factorization_prime_le_iff_dvd hd hn]
  intro h p pp
  simp_rw [← pp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn]
  exact h p _ pp (ordProj_dvd _ _)

name: prod_primeFactors_dvd
statement: theorem prod_primeFactors_dvd (n : ℕ) : ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst hn
    simp
  · simpa [prod_primeFactorsList hn] using (n.primeFactorsList : Multiset ℕ).toFinset_prod_dvd_prod

name: factorization_gcd
statement:
theorem factorization_gcd {a b : ℕ} (ha_pos : a ≠ 0) (hb_pos : b ≠ 0) :
    (gcd a b).factorization = a.factorization ⊓ b.factorization
proof:
:= by
  suffices (a.factorization ⊓ b.factorization).prod (· ^ ·) = gcd a b by
    rw [← this, factorization_prod_pow_eq_self_of_le_factorization inf_le_left]
  apply gcd_greatest
  · exact prod_pow_dvd_of_le_factorization inf_le_left
  · exact prod_pow_dvd_of_le_factorization inf_le_right
  · intro e hea heb
    rcases eq_or_ne e 0 with (rfl | he_pos)
    · exact absurd (zero_dvd_iff.mp hea) ha_pos
    apply dvd_prod_pow_of_factorization_le he_pos
    have hea' := (factorization_le_iff_dvd he_pos ha_pos).mpr hea
    have heb' := (factorization_le_iff_dvd he_pos hb_pos).mpr heb
    simp [hea', heb']

name: factorization_lcm
statement:
theorem factorization_lcm {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    (a.lcm b).factorization = a.factorization ⊔ b.factorization
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_right_inj (a.gcd b).factorization, ←
    factorization_mul (mt gcd_eq_zero_iff.1 fun h => ha h.1) (lcm_ne_zero ha hb), gcd_mul_lcm,
    factorization_gcd ha hb, factorization_mul ha hb]
  ext1
  exact (min_add_max _ _).symm

name: prod_primeFactors_gcd_mul_prod_primeFactors_mul
statement:
@[to_additive sum_primeFactors_gcd_add_sum_primeFactors_mul]
theorem prod_primeFactors_gcd_mul_prod_primeFactors_mul {β : Type*} [CommMonoid β] (m n : ℕ)
    (f : ℕ → β) :
    (m.gcd n).primeFactors.prod f * (m * n).primeFactors.prod f =
      m.primeFactors.prod f * n.primeFactors.prod f
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hm₀ := eq_or_ne m 0
  · simp
  obtain rfl | hn₀ := eq_or_ne n 0
  · simp
  · rw [primeFactors_mul hm₀ hn₀, primeFactors_gcd hm₀ hn₀, mul_comm, Finset.prod_union_inter]

name: setOfPred_pow_dvd_eq_Icc_factorization
statement:
theorem setOfPred_pow_dvd_eq_Icc_factorization {n p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    { i : ℕ | i ≠ 0 ∧ p ^ i ∣ n } = Set.Icc 1 (n.factorization p)

name: Icc_factorization_eq_pow_dvd
statement:
theorem Icc_factorization_eq_pow_dvd (n : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (pp : Prime p) :
    Icc 1 (n.factorization p) = {i ∈ Ico 1 n | p ^ i ∣ n}
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn)
  · simp
  ext x
  simp only [mem_Icc, Finset.mem_filter, mem_Ico, and_assoc, and_congr_right_iff,
    pp.pow_dvd_iff_le_factorization hn, iff_and_self]
  exact fun _ H => lt_of_le_of_lt H (factorization_lt p hn)

name: factorization_eq_card_pow_dvd
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_card_pow_dvd (n : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) :
    n.factorization p = #{i ∈ Ico 1 n | p ^ i ∣ n}

name: Ico_filter_pow_dvd_eq
statement:
theorem Ico_filter_pow_dvd_eq {n p b : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hb : n ≤ p ^ b) :
    {i ∈ Ico 1 n | p ^ i ∣ n} = {i ∈ Icc 1 b | p ^ i ∣ n}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_Ico, mem_Icc, and_congr_left_iff, and_congr_right_iff]
  rintro h1 -
  exact iff_of_true (lt_of_pow_dvd_right hn pp.two_le h1) <|
    (Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right pp.one_lt).1 <| (le_of_dvd hn.bot_lt h1).trans hb

name: Ico_pow_dvd_eq_Ico_of_lt
statement:
theorem Ico_pow_dvd_eq_Ico_of_lt {n p b : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hb : n < p ^ b) :
    {i ∈ Ico 1 n | p ^ i ∣ n} = {i ∈ Ico 1 b | p ^ i ∣ n}
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, mem_Ico, and_congr_left_iff, and_congr_right_iff]
  refine fun h1 h2 ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ lt_of_pow_dvd_right hn (Prime.one_lt pp) h1⟩
  rcases p with - | p
  · rw [zero_pow (by lia), zero_dvd_iff] at h1
    exact (hn h1).elim
  · rw [← Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right (Prime.one_lt pp)]
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt (le_of_dvd (Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hn) h1) hb

name: factorization_eq_card_pow_dvd_of_lt
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_card_pow_dvd_of_lt (hm : m.Prime) (hn : 0 < n) (hb : n < m ^ b) :
    n.factorization m = #{i ∈ Ico 1 b | m ^ i ∣ n}
proof:
:= by
  rwa [factorization_eq_card_pow_dvd n hm, Ico_pow_dvd_eq_Ico_of_lt hm (by lia)]

name: factorization_eq_of_coprime_left
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_of_coprime_left {p a b : ℕ} (hab : Coprime a b)
    (hpa : p ∈ a.primeFactorsList) : (a * b).factorization p = a.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  rw [factorization_mul_apply_of_coprime hab, ← primeFactorsList_count_eq,
    ← primeFactorsList_count_eq,
    count_eq_zero_of_not_mem (coprime_primeFactorsList_disjoint hab hpa), add_zero]

name: factorization_eq_of_coprime_right
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_of_coprime_right {p a b : ℕ} (hab : Coprime a b)
    (hpb : p ∈ b.primeFactorsList) : (a * b).factorization p = b.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]
  exact factorization_eq_of_coprime_left (coprime_comm.mp hab) hpb

name: eq_iff_prime_padicValNat_eq
statement:
theorem eq_iff_prime_padicValNat_eq (a b : ℕ) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    a = b ↔ ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → padicValNat p a = padicValNat p b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    simp
  · intro h
    refine eq_of_factorization_eq ha hb fun p => ?_
    by_cases pp : p.Prime
    · simp [factorization_def, pp, h p pp]
    · simp [factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime, pp]

name: prod_pow_prime_padicValNat
statement:
theorem prod_pow_prime_padicValNat (n : Nat) (hn : n ≠ 0) (m : Nat) (pr : n < m) :
    ∏ p ∈ range m with p.Prime, p ^ padicValNat p n = n
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hn]
  rw [eq_comm]
  apply Finset.prod_subset_one_on_sdiff
  · exact fun p hp => Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.2 <| pr.trans_le' <|
      le_of_mem_primeFactors hp, prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp⟩
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hp
    rw [← factorization_def n (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp1).2]
    simp [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hp2]
  · intro p hp
    simp [factorization_def n (prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp)]

name: prod_primeFactors_pow_factorization
statement:
theorem prod_primeFactors_pow_factorization (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p ^ n.factorization p

name: prod_primeFactors_coe_pow_factorization
statement:
lemma prod_primeFactors_coe_pow_factorization (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n = ∏ (p : n.primeFactors), (p : ℕ) ^ (n.factorization p)

name: pairwise_coprime_pow_primeFactors_factorization
statement:
lemma pairwise_coprime_pow_primeFactors_factorization :
    Pairwise (Function.onFun Nat.Coprime fun (p : n.primeFactors) ↦ p ^ n.factorization p)
proof:
:= by
  intro p1 p2 hp
  refine Nat.Coprime.pow (n.factorization p1) (n.factorization p2) ?_
  refine (Nat.coprime_primes ?_ ?_).mpr <| Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mpr hp
  · exact Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors p1.2
  · exact Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors p2.2

name: dvd_prod_primeFactors_pow_self
statement:
theorem dvd_prod_primeFactors_pow_self {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n ∣ (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← Finset.prod_pow, prod_primeFactors_pow_factorization hn]
  refine prod_dvd_prod_of_dvd _ _ fun i hi ↦ pow_dvd_pow i ?_
  grw [n.factorization_def <| prime_of_mem_primeFactors hi, padicValNat_le_self]

name: dvd_pow_self_iff
statement:
theorem dvd_pow_self_iff {n k : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    n ∣ k ^ n ↔ n.primeFactors ⊆ k.primeFactors
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · grw [← Nat.primeFactors_pow k hn, Nat.primeFactors_mono h <| pow_ne_zero n hk]
  · grw [dvd_prod_primeFactors_pow_self hn, prod_dvd_prod_of_subset _ _ _ h, prod_primeFactors_dvd]

name: exists_dvd_pow_iff
statement:
theorem exists_dvd_pow_iff {n k : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (∃ m, n ∣ k ^ m) ↔ n.primeFactors ⊆ k.primeFactors
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨m, h⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ⟨n, dvd_pow_self_iff hn hk |>.mpr h⟩⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with (rfl | hm)
  · simp_all
  rw [← Nat.primeFactors_pow k hm]
  exact Nat.primeFactors_mono h <| pow_ne_zero m hk

name: card_multiples
statement: theorem card_multiples (n p : ℕ) : #{e ∈ range n | p ∣ e + 1} = n / p
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn =>
    simp [Nat.succ_div, add_ite, add_zero, Finset.range_add_one, filter_insert, apply_ite card,
      card_insert_of_notMem, hn]

name: Ioc_filter_dvd_card_eq_div
statement: theorem Ioc_filter_dvd_card_eq_div (n p : ℕ) : #{x ∈ Ioc 0 n | p ∣ x} = n / p
proof:
:= by
  induction n <;> simp [Nat.succ_div, add_ite, ← insert_Ioc_right_eq_Ioc_add_one, filter_insert,
    apply_ite card, *]

name: card_multiples'
statement: lemma card_multiples' (N n : ℕ) : #{k ∈ range N.succ | k ≠ 0 ∧ n ∣ k} = N / n
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp [Finset.filter_false_of_mem]
  | succ N ih =>
    rw [Finset.range_add_one, Finset.filter_insert]
    by_cases h : n ∣ N.succ
    · simp [h, succ_div_of_dvd, ih]
    · simp [h, succ_div_of_not_dvd, ih]

name: exists_eq_pow_of_exponent_coprime_of_pow_eq_pow
statement:
theorem exists_eq_pow_of_exponent_coprime_of_pow_eq_pow
    {a b m n : ℕ} (hmn : m.Coprime n) (h : a ^ m = b ^ n) :
    ∃ c, a = c ^ n ∧ b = c ^ m
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha0 : a = 0
  · symm at h
    by_cases hm0 : m = 0
    · simp_all
    · use 0
      simp_all
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · use b
    simp_all
  let factors := a.factorization.mapRange (· / n) (Nat.zero_div n)
  set c := factors.prod (· ^ ·) with hc
  use c
  suffices ha : a = c ^ n by
    refine ⟨ha, ?_⟩
    apply Nat.pow_left_injective hn0
    simp [← h, ha, Nat.pow_right_comm]
  apply eq_of_factorization_eq ha0 (by simp [c, factors])
  intro p
  have foo (p) (hp : p ∈ factors.support) : Prime p :=
    prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finsupp.support_mapRange hp)
  rw [factorization_pow, hc, prod_pow_factorization_eq_self foo]
  suffices n ∣ a.factorization p by
    simp [factors, Nat.mul_div_cancel' this]
  refine hmn.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left ⟨b.factorization p, ?_⟩
  simpa using congr(factorization $h p)

name: exists_eq_pow_of_pow_eq_pow
statement:
theorem exists_eq_pow_of_pow_eq_pow
    {a b m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≠ 0 ∨ n ≠ 0) (h : a ^ m = b ^ n) :
    letI g
proof:
:= gcd m n; ∃ c, a = c ^ (n / g) ∧ b = c ^ (m / g) := by
  set g := gcd m n
  let m' := m / gcd m n
  let n' := n / gcd m n
  have coprime : m'.Coprime n' := by
    rcases hmn with hm | hn
    · exact gcd_div_gcd_div_gcd_of_pos_left (zero_lt_of_ne_zero hm)
    · exact gcd_div_gcd_div_gcd_of_pos_right (zero_lt_of_ne_zero hn)
  have pow_eq : a ^ m' = b ^ n' := by
    conv_lhs at h => rw [show m = m' * g from (Nat.div_mul_cancel (gcd_dvd_left m n)).symm]
    conv_rhs at h => rw [show n = n' * g from (Nat.div_mul_cancel (gcd_dvd_right m n)).symm]
    rw [pow_mul, pow_mul] at h
    have : g ≠ 0 := by
      rcases hmn with hm | hn
      · exact gcd_ne_zero_left hm
      · exact gcd_ne_zero_right hn
    exact Nat.pow_left_injective this h
  exact exists_eq_pow_of_exponent_coprime_of_pow_eq_pow coprime pow_eq

name: coe_divisors_eq_prod_pow_le_factorization
statement:
theorem coe_divisors_eq_prod_pow_le_factorization {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n.divisors = { f.prod (· ^ ·) | f ≤ n.factorization }
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.ext fun k ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨f, hle, h⟩ ↦ mem_divisors.mpr ⟨?_, hn⟩⟩
  · have hdvd := dvd_of_mem_divisors h
    have hk := ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hn hdvd
    exact ⟨_, factorization_le_iff_dvd hk hn |>.mpr hdvd, prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hk⟩
  · rw [← h, ← prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hn]
    exact prod_dvd_prod_of_subset_of_dvd (support_mono hle) fun p _ ↦ Nat.pow_dvd_pow p <| hle p

name: divisors_eq_image_Iic_factorization_prod_pow
statement:
theorem divisors_eq_image_Iic_factorization_prod_pow {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n.divisors = (Finset.Iic n.factorization).image (·.prod (· ^ ·))

name: Iic_factorization_prod_pow_injective
statement:
theorem Iic_factorization_prod_pow_injective (n : ℕ) :
    (·.val.prod (· ^ ·) : Finset.Iic n.factorization → _).Injective

name: divisors_eq_map_attach_Iic_factorization_prod_pow
statement:
theorem divisors_eq_map_attach_Iic_factorization_prod_pow {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    n.divisors = (Finset.Iic n.factorization).attach.map
      ⟨(·.val.prod (· ^ ·)), Iic_factorization_prod_pow_injective n⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.map_eq_image]
  change _ = (Finset.Iic n.factorization).attach.image ((·.prod (· ^ ·)) ∘ Subtype.val)
  rw [← Finset.image_image, Finset.attach_image_val]
  exact divisors_eq_image_Iic_factorization_prod_pow hn

name: coe_properDivisors_eq_prod_pow_lt_factorization
statement:
theorem coe_properDivisors_eq_prod_pow_lt_factorization {n : ℕ} :
    n.properDivisors = { f.prod (· ^ ·) | f < n.factorization }
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp [hn]
  refine Set.ext fun k ↦ ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨f, hlt, h⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · have ⟨hdvd, hlt⟩ := mem_properDivisors.mp h
    have hk := ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hn hdvd
    refine ⟨_, ?_, prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hk⟩
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne <| factorization_le_iff_dvd hk hn |>.mpr hdvd
    exact mt (Nat.eq_of_factorization_eq' hk hn) hlt.ne
  · have : k ∣ n := by
      rw [← h, ← prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hn]
      apply prod_dvd_prod_of_subset_of_dvd <| support_mono hlt.le
      exact fun p _ ↦ Nat.pow_dvd_pow p <| hlt.le p
    refine mem_properDivisors.mpr ⟨this, lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) this) ?_⟩
    suffices k.factorization = f from (this ▸ hlt.ne <| congrArg _ ·)
    exact h ▸ factorization_prod_pow_eq_self_of_le_factorization hlt.le

name: properDivisors_eq_image_Iio_factorization_prod_pow
statement:
theorem properDivisors_eq_image_Iio_factorization_prod_pow {n : ℕ} :
    n.properDivisors = (Finset.Iio n.factorization).image (·.prod (· ^ ·))

name: Iio_factorization_prod_pow_injective
statement:
theorem Iio_factorization_prod_pow_injective (n : ℕ) :
    (·.val.prod (· ^ ·) : Finset.Iio n.factorization → _).Injective

name: properDivisors_eq_map_attach_Iio_factorization_prod_pow
statement:
theorem properDivisors_eq_map_attach_Iio_factorization_prod_pow {n : ℕ} :
    n.properDivisors = (Finset.Iio n.factorization).attach.map
      ⟨(·.val.prod (· ^ ·)), Iio_factorization_prod_pow_injective n⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.map_eq_image]
  change _ = (Finset.Iio n.factorization).attach.image ((·.prod (· ^ ·)) ∘ Subtype.val)
  rw [← Finset.image_image, Finset.attach_image_val]
  exact properDivisors_eq_image_Iio_factorization_prod_pow

name: support_factorization
statement: @[simp] lemma support_factorization (n : ℕ) : (factorization n).support = n.primeFactors

name: factorization_def
statement: theorem factorization_def (n : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) : n.factorization p = padicValNat p n

name: factorization_le_padicValNat
statement: theorem factorization_le_padicValNat {n p : ℕ} : n.factorization p ≤ padicValNat p n

name: primeFactorsList_count_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem primeFactorsList_count_eq {n p : ℕ} : n.primeFactorsList.count p = n.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  rcases n.eq_zero_or_pos with (rfl | hn0)
  · simp [factorization, count]
  if pp : p.Prime then ?_ else
    rw [count_eq_zero_of_not_mem (mt prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList pp)]
    simp [factorization, pp]
  simp only [factorization_def _ pp]
  apply _root_.le_antisymm
  · rw [le_padicValNat_iff_replicate_subperm_primeFactorsList pp hn0.ne']
    exact List.replicate_sublist_iff.mpr le_rfl |>.subperm
  · rw [← Nat.lt_add_one_iff, lt_iff_not_ge,
      le_padicValNat_iff_replicate_subperm_primeFactorsList pp hn0.ne']
    intro h
    have := h.count_le p
    simp at this

name: factorization_eq_primeFactorsList_multiset
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_primeFactorsList_multiset (n : ℕ) :
    n.factorization = Multiset.toFinsupp (n.primeFactorsList : Multiset ℕ)

name: Prime.factorization_pos_of_dvd
statement:
theorem Prime.factorization_pos_of_dvd {n p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hn : n ≠ 0) (h : p ∣ n) :
    0 < n.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  rwa [← primeFactorsList_count_eq, count_pos_iff, mem_primeFactorsList_iff_dvd hn hp]

name: multiplicity_eq_factorization
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_factorization {n p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) :
    multiplicity p n = n.factorization p

name: prod_factorization_pow_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_factorization_pow_eq_self {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : n.factorization.prod (· ^ ·) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [factorization_eq_primeFactorsList_multiset n]
  simp only [← prod_toMultiset, Multiset.prod_coe, Multiset.toFinsupp_toMultiset]
  exact prod_primeFactorsList hn

name: eq_of_factorization_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_factorization_eq {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ p : ℕ, a.factorization p = b.factorization p) : a = b
proof:
:=
  eq_of_perm_primeFactorsList ha hb
    (by simpa only [List.perm_iff_count, primeFactorsList_count_eq] using h)

name: eq_of_factorization_eq'
statement:
theorem eq_of_factorization_eq' {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h : a.factorization = b.factorization) : a = b

name: factorization_inj
statement: theorem factorization_inj : Set.InjOn factorization { x : ℕ | x ≠ 0 }
proof:
:= fun a ha b hb h =>
  eq_of_factorization_eq ha hb fun p => by simp [h]

name: factorization_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorization_zero : factorization 0 = 0

name: factorization_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorization_one : factorization 1 = 0

name: factorization_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_zero_iff (n p : ℕ) :
    n.factorization p = 0 ↔ ¬p.Prime ∨ ¬p ∣ n ∨ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← notMem_support_iff, support_factorization, mem_primeFactors, not_and_or, not_ne_iff]

name: factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime (n : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (hp : ¬p.Prime) :
    n.factorization p = 0

name: factorization_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorization_zero_right (n : ℕ) : n.factorization 0 = 0

name: factorization_one_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorization_one_right (n : ℕ) : n.factorization 1 = 0

name: factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
statement: theorem factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd {n p : ℕ} (h : ¬p ∣ n) : n.factorization p = 0

name: factorization_eq_zero_of_remainder
statement:
theorem factorization_eq_zero_of_remainder {p r : ℕ} (i : ℕ) (hr : ¬p ∣ r) :
    (p * i + r).factorization p = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
  rwa [← Nat.dvd_add_iff_right (Dvd.intro i rfl)]

name: factorization_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorization_mul {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    (a * b).factorization = a.factorization + b.factorization
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [add_apply, ← primeFactorsList_count_eq,
    perm_iff_count.mp (perm_primeFactorsList_mul ha hb) p, count_append]

name: factorization_le_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem factorization_le_iff_dvd {d n : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    d.factorization ≤ n.factorization ↔ d ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hdn ↦ ?_, fun ⟨c, h⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hn, ← prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hd]
    exact prod_dvd_prod_of_subset_of_dvd (support_mono hdn) fun a _ ↦ pow_dvd_pow a (hdn a)
  · subst h
    rw [factorization_mul hd <| right_ne_zero_of_mul hn]
    apply self_le_add_right

name: factorization_prod
statement:
theorem factorization_prod {α : Type*} {S : Finset α} {g : α → ℕ} (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, g x ≠ 0) :
    (S.prod g).factorization = S.sum fun x => (g x).factorization
proof:
:= by
  classical
    refine Finset.induction_on' S ?_ ?_
    · simp
    · intro x T hxS hTS hxT IH
      have hT : T.prod g ≠ 0 := prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun x hx => hS x (hTS hx)
      simp [prod_insert hxT, sum_insert hxT, IH, factorization_mul (hS x hxS) hT]

name: factorization_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorization_pow (n k : ℕ) : factorization (n ^ k) = k • n.factorization
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn)
    · simp
    rw [Nat.pow_succ, mul_comm, factorization_mul hn (pow_ne_zero _ hn), ih,
      add_smul, one_smul, add_comm]

name: isSquare_iff_even_factorization
statement:
theorem isSquare_iff_even_factorization {n : ℕ} :
    IsSquare n ↔ ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → Even (n.factorization p)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : n = 0
  · simp [h0]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨m, hmn⟩ p hp
    have hm : m ≠ 0 := mul_self_ne_zero.mp (hmn ▸ h0)
    simp [hmn, factorization_mul hm hm]
  · refine fun h ↦ ⟨n.factorization.prod fun a b ↦ a ^ (b / 2), ?_⟩
    rw [← pow_two, ← powMonoidHom_apply, map_finsuppProd]
    nth_rw 1 [← prod_factorization_pow_eq_self h0]
    refine Finsupp.prod_congr fun p hp ↦ ?_
    rw [powMonoidHom_apply, ← pow_mul, div_two_mul_two_of_even (h p (prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp))]

name: isSquare_iff_nonneg_even_factorization
statement:
theorem isSquare_iff_nonneg_even_factorization {n : ℤ} :
    IsSquare n ↔ 0 ≤ n ∧ ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → Even (n.natAbs.factorization p)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ⟨m, hmn⟩
    exact ⟨by simpa [hmn] using Int.mul_nonneg_of_nonneg_or_nonpos (by omega),
      fun p hp ↦ isSquare_iff_even_factorization.mp ⟨m.natAbs, by grind⟩ p hp⟩
  · intro ⟨h0, h⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Nat.isSquare_iff_even_factorization.mpr h
    exact ⟨r, (by rw [← natAbs_of_nonneg h0, hr, Nat.cast_mul])⟩

name: Prime.factorization
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem Prime.factorization {p : ℕ} (hp : Prime p) : p.factorization = single p 1
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  rw [← primeFactorsList_count_eq, primeFactorsList_prime hp, single_apply, count_singleton',
    if_congr eq_comm] <;> rfl

name: Prime.factorization_pow
statement: theorem Prime.factorization_pow {p k : ℕ} (hp : Prime p) : (p ^ k).factorization = single p k

name: pow_succ_factorization_not_dvd
statement:
theorem pow_succ_factorization_not_dvd {n p : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hp : p.Prime) :
    ¬p ^ (n.factorization p + 1) ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [← factorization_le_iff_dvd (pow_ne_zero _ hp.ne_zero) hn] at h
  simpa [hp.factorization] using h p

name: factorization_minFac_ne_zero
statement:
lemma factorization_minFac_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) :
    n.factorization n.minFac ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine mt (factorization_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp ?_
  push Not
  exact ⟨minFac_prime (by lia), minFac_dvd n, Nat.ne_zero_of_lt hn⟩

name: prod_pow_factorization_eq_self
statement:
theorem prod_pow_factorization_eq_self (hf : ∀ p ∈ f.support, Prime p) :
    (f.prod (· ^ ·)).factorization = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.prod, factorization_prod (pow_ne_zero _ <| hf · · |>.ne_zero),
    sum_congr rfl (hf · · |>.factorization_pow)]
  exact sum_single f

name: eq_factorization_iff
statement:
theorem eq_factorization_iff (hn : n ≠ 0) (hf : ∀ p ∈ f.support, Prime p) :
    f = n.factorization ↔ f.prod (· ^ ·) = n
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> rintro rfl
  exacts [prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hn, prod_pow_factorization_eq_self hf |>.symm]

name: factorization_prod_pow_eq_self_of_le_factorization
statement:
theorem factorization_prod_pow_eq_self_of_le_factorization (hf : f ≤ n.factorization) :
    (f.prod (· ^ ·)).factorization = f
proof:
:=
  prod_pow_factorization_eq_self fun _ hp ↦ prime_of_mem_primeFactors <| support_mono hf hp

name: prod_pow_dvd_of_le_factorization
statement: theorem prod_pow_dvd_of_le_factorization (hf : f ≤ n.factorization) : f.prod (· ^ ·) ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn)
  · simp
  rwa [← factorization_le_iff_dvd ?_ hn, factorization_prod_pow_eq_self_of_le_factorization hf]
  refine f.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun _ hp ↦ ?_
  exact pow_ne_zero _ (prime_of_mem_primeFactors <| support_mono hf hp).ne_zero

name: dvd_prod_pow_of_factorization_le
statement:
theorem dvd_prod_pow_of_factorization_le (hn : n ≠ 0) (hf : n.factorization ≤ f) :
    n ∣ f.prod (· ^ ·)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_tsub_cancel_of_le hf, Finsupp.prod_add_index' (by simp) Nat.pow_add,
    prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hn]
  apply n.dvd_mul_right

name: dvd_iff_exists_le_factorization
statement:
theorem dvd_iff_exists_le_factorization {d : ℕ} (hd : d ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    d ∣ n ↔ ∃ f ≤ n.factorization, d = f.prod (· ^ ·)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← factorization_le_iff_dvd hd hn]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨_, h, prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hd |>.symm⟩, fun ⟨f, hle, hprod⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  rwa [hprod, factorization_prod_pow_eq_self_of_le_factorization hle]

name: factorization_mul_apply_of_coprime
statement:
theorem factorization_mul_apply_of_coprime {p a b : ℕ} (hab : Coprime a b) :
    (a * b).factorization p = a.factorization p + b.factorization p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← primeFactorsList_count_eq,
    perm_iff_count.mp (perm_primeFactorsList_mul_of_coprime hab), count_append]

name: factorization_mul_of_coprime
statement:
theorem factorization_mul_of_coprime {a b : ℕ} (hab : Coprime a b) :
    (a * b).factorization = a.factorization + b.factorization
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  rw [Finsupp.add_apply, factorization_mul_apply_of_coprime hab]

name: ordProj_dvd
statement: theorem ordProj_dvd (n p : ℕ) : ordProj[p] n ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  if hp : p.Prime then ?_ else simp [hp]
  rw [← primeFactorsList_count_eq]
  apply dvd_of_primeFactorsList_subperm (pow_ne_zero _ hp.ne_zero)
  rw [hp.primeFactorsList_pow, List.subperm_ext_iff]
  intro q hq
  simp [List.eq_of_mem_replicate hq]

name: ordProj_dvd_ordProj_iff_dvd
statement:
lemma ordProj_dvd_ordProj_iff_dvd (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    (∀ p : ℕ, ordProj[p] a ∣ ordProj[p] b) ↔ a ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← factorization_le_iff_dvd ha hb, Finsupp.le_def]
  congr! 1 with p
  obtain _ | _ | p := p <;> simp [Nat.pow_dvd_pow_iff_le_right]

name: _root_.induction_on_primes
statement:
lemma _root_.induction_on_primes {motive : ℕ → Prop} (zero : motive 0) (one : motive 1)
    (prime_mul : ∀ p a : ℕ, p.Prime → motive a → motive (p * a)) : ∀ n, motive n
proof:
:= by
  refine recOnPrimePow zero one ?_
  rintro a p n hp - - ha
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using ha
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc]
    exact prime_mul _ _ hp ih

name: prime_composite_induction
statement:
lemma prime_composite_induction {motive : ℕ → Prop} (zero : motive 0) (one : motive 1)
    (prime : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → motive p)
    (composite : ∀ a, 2 ≤ a → motive a → ∀ b, 2 ≤ b → motive b → motive (a * b))
    (n : ℕ) : motive n
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_on_primes zero one ?_ _
  rintro p (_ | _ | a) hp ha
  · simpa
  · simpa using prime _ hp
  · exact composite _ hp.two_le (prime _ hp) _ a.one_lt_succ_succ ha

name: multiplicative_factorization
statement:
theorem multiplicative_factorization {β : Type*} [CommMonoid β] (f : ℕ → β)
    (h_mult : ∀ x y : ℕ, Coprime x y → f (x * y) = f x * f y) (hf : f 1 = 1) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → f n = n.factorization.prod fun p k => f (p ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.recOnPosPrimePosCoprime
  · rintro p k hp - -
    simp [Prime.factorization_pow hp, Finsupp.prod_single_index _, hf]
  · simp
  · rintro -
    rw [factorization_one, hf]
    simp
  · intro a b _ _ hab ha hb hab_pos
    rw [h_mult a b hab, ha (left_ne_zero_of_mul hab_pos), hb (right_ne_zero_of_mul hab_pos),
      factorization_mul_of_coprime hab, ← prod_add_index_of_disjoint]
    exact hab.disjoint_primeFactors

name: multiplicative_factorization'
statement:
theorem multiplicative_factorization' {β : Type*} [CommMonoid β] (f : ℕ → β)
    (h_mult : ∀ x y : ℕ, Coprime x y → f (x * y) = f x * f y) (hf0 : f 0 = 1) (hf1 : f 1 = 1) :
    f n = n.factorization.prod fun p k => f (p ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0
  · simpa
  · exact multiplicative_factorization _ h_mult hf1 hn

name: factorial_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem factorial_zero : 0! = 1

name: factorial_succ
statement: theorem factorial_succ (n : ℕ) : (n + 1)! = (n + 1) * n !

name: factorial_one
statement: @[simp] theorem factorial_one : 1! = 1

name: factorial_two
statement: @[simp] theorem factorial_two : 2! = 2

name: mul_factorial_pred
statement: theorem mul_factorial_pred (hn : n ≠ 0) : n * (n - 1)! = n !

name: factorial_pos
statement:
theorem factorial_pos : ∀ n, 0 < n !
  | 0 => Nat.zero_lt_one
  | succ n => Nat.mul_pos (succ_pos _) (factorial_pos n)

name: factorial_ne_zero
statement: theorem factorial_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : n ! ≠ 0

name: factorial_dvd_factorial
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem factorial_dvd_factorial {m n} (h : m ≤ n) : m ! ∣ n !
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Nat.dvd_refl _
  | step _ ih => exact Nat.dvd_trans ih (Nat.dvd_mul_left _ _)

name: dvd_factorial
statement:
theorem dvd_factorial : ∀ {m n}, 0 < m → m ≤ n → m ∣ n !
  | succ _, _, _, h => Nat.dvd_trans (Nat.dvd_mul_right _ _) (factorial_dvd_factorial h)

@[mono, gcongr]

name: factorial_le
statement:
@[mono, gcongr]
theorem factorial_le {m n} (h : m ≤ n) : m ! ≤ n !

name: factorial_mul_pow_le_factorial
statement:
theorem factorial_mul_pow_le_factorial : ∀ {m n : ℕ}, m ! * (m + 1) ^ n ≤ (m + n)!
  | m, 0 => by simp
  | m, n + 1 => by
    rw [← Nat.add_assoc, factorial_succ, Nat.mul_comm (_ + 1), Nat.pow_succ, ← Nat.mul_assoc]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul factorial_mul_pow_le_factorial (succ_le_succ (le_add_right _ _))

name: factorial_lt
statement: theorem factorial_lt (hn : 0 < n) : n ! < m ! ↔ n < m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => not_le.mp fun hmn => Nat.not_le_of_gt h (factorial_le hmn), fun h => ?_⟩
  have : ∀ {n}, 0 < n → n ! < (n + 1)! := by
    intro k hk
    rw [factorial_succ, succ_mul, Nat.lt_add_left_iff_pos]
    exact Nat.mul_pos hk k.factorial_pos
  induction h generalizing hn with
  | refl => exact this hn
  | step hnk ih => exact lt_trans (ih hn) <| this <| lt_trans hn <| lt_of_succ_le hnk

name: factorial_lt_of_lt
statement:
@[gcongr]
lemma factorial_lt_of_lt {m n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (h : n < m) : n ! < m !

name: one_lt_factorial
statement: @[simp] lemma one_lt_factorial : 1 < n ! ↔ 1 < n

name: factorial_eq_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem factorial_eq_one : n ! = 1 ↔ n ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← not_lt, ← one_lt_factorial, h]
    apply lt_irrefl
  · rintro (_ | _ | _) <;> rfl

name: factorial_inj
statement: theorem factorial_inj (hn : 1 < n) : n ! = m ! ↔ n = m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, congr_arg _⟩
  obtain hnm | rfl | hnm := lt_trichotomy n m
  · rw [← factorial_lt <| lt_of_succ_lt hn, h] at hnm
    cases lt_irrefl _ hnm
  · rfl
  rw [← one_lt_factorial, h, one_lt_factorial] at hn
  rw [← factorial_lt <| lt_of_succ_lt hn, h] at hnm
  cases lt_irrefl _ hnm

name: factorial_inj'
statement: theorem factorial_inj' (h : 1 < n ∨ 1 < m) : n ! = m ! ↔ n = m
proof:
:= by
  obtain hn | hm := h
  · exact factorial_inj hn
  · rw [eq_comm, factorial_inj hm, eq_comm]

name: self_le_factorial
statement:
theorem self_le_factorial : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ n !
  | 0 => Nat.zero_le _
  | k + 1 => Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (Nat.one_le_of_lt k.factorial_pos)

name: lt_factorial_self
statement: theorem lt_factorial_self {n : ℕ} (hi : 3 ≤ n) : n < n !
proof:
:= by
  have : 0 < n := by lia
  have hn : 1 < pred n := le_pred_of_lt (succ_le_iff.mp hi)
  rw [← succ_pred_eq_of_pos ‹0 < n›, factorial_succ]
  exact (Nat.lt_mul_iff_one_lt_right (pred n).succ_pos).2
    ((Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hn (self_le_factorial _)))

name: add_factorial_succ_lt_factorial_add_succ
statement:
theorem add_factorial_succ_lt_factorial_add_succ {i : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (hi : 2 ≤ i) :
    i + (n + 1)! < (i + n + 1)!
proof:
:= by
  rw [factorial_succ (i + _), Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
  have := (i + n).self_le_factorial
  refine Nat.add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ ((Nat.lt_mul_iff_one_lt_right ?_).2 ?_))
    (factorial_le ?_) <;> lia

name: add_factorial_lt_factorial_add
statement:
theorem add_factorial_lt_factorial_add {i n : ℕ} (hi : 2 ≤ i) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    i + n ! < (i + n)!
proof:
:= by
  cases hn
  · rw [factorial_one]
    exact lt_factorial_self (succ_le_succ hi)
  exact add_factorial_succ_lt_factorial_add_succ _ hi

name: add_factorial_succ_le_factorial_add_succ
statement:
theorem add_factorial_succ_le_factorial_add_succ (i : ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
    i + (n + 1)! ≤ (i + (n + 1))!
proof:
:= by
  cases (le_or_gt (2 : ℕ) i)
  · rw [← Nat.add_assoc]
    apply Nat.le_of_lt
    apply add_factorial_succ_lt_factorial_add_succ
    assumption
  · match i with
    | 0 => simp
    | 1 =>
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc, factorial_succ (1 + n), Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_comm 1 n,
        Nat.add_le_add_iff_right]
      exact Nat.mul_pos n.succ_pos n.succ.factorial_pos
    | succ (succ n) => contradiction

name: add_factorial_le_factorial_add
statement: theorem add_factorial_le_factorial_add (i : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (n1 : 1 ≤ n) : i + n ! ≤ (i + n)!
proof:
:= by
  rcases n1 with - | @h
  · exact self_le_factorial _
  exact add_factorial_succ_le_factorial_add_succ i h

name: factorial_mul_pow_sub_le_factorial
statement: theorem factorial_mul_pow_sub_le_factorial {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) : n ! * n ^ (m - n) ≤ m !
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ n ! * (n + 1) ^ (m - n) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left n.le_succ _)
    _ ≤ _ := by simpa [hnm] using @Nat.factorial_mul_pow_le_factorial n (m - n)

name: factorial_le_pow
statement:
lemma factorial_le_pow : ∀ n, n ! ≤ n ^ n
  | 0 => le_refl _
  | n + 1 =>
    calc
      _ ≤ (n + 1) * n ^ n
proof:
:= Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ n.factorial_le_pow
      _ ≤ (n + 1) * (n + 1) ^ n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left n.le_succ _)
      _ = _ := by rw [pow_succ']

name: ascFactorial_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ascFactorial_zero (n : ℕ) : n.ascFactorial 0 = 1

name: ascFactorial_succ
statement: theorem ascFactorial_succ {n k : ℕ} : n.ascFactorial k.succ = (n + k) * n.ascFactorial k

name: zero_ascFactorial
statement:
theorem zero_ascFactorial : ∀ (k : ℕ), (0 : ℕ).ascFactorial k.succ = 0
  | 0 => by
    rw [ascFactorial_succ, ascFactorial_zero, Nat.zero_add, Nat.zero_mul]
  | (k + 1) => by
    rw [ascFactorial_succ, zero_ascFactorial k, Nat.mul_zero]

@[simp]

name: one_ascFactorial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_ascFactorial : ∀ (k : ℕ), (1 : ℕ).ascFactorial k = k.factorial
  | 0 => ascFactorial_zero 1
  | (k + 1) => by
    rw [ascFactorial_succ, one_ascFactorial k, Nat.add_comm, factorial_succ]

name: succ_ascFactorial
statement:
theorem succ_ascFactorial (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ k, n * n.succ.ascFactorial k = (n + k) * n.ascFactorial k
  | 0 => by rw [Nat.add_zero, ascFactorial_zero, ascFactorial_zero]
  | k + 1 => by rw [ascFactorial, Nat.mul_left_comm, succ_ascFactorial n k, ascFactorial, succ_add,
    ← Nat.add_assoc]

/
`Nat.ascFactorial_eq_div` for the version with ℕ-division. -/

name: factorial_mul_ascFactorial
statement:
theorem factorial_mul_ascFactorial (n : ℕ) : ∀ k, n ! * (n + 1).ascFactorial k = (n + k)!
  | 0 => by rw [ascFactorial_zero, Nat.add_zero, Nat.mul_one]
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [ascFactorial_succ, ← Nat.add_assoc, factorial_succ, Nat.mul_comm (n + 1 + k),
      ← Nat.mul_assoc, factorial_mul_ascFactorial n k, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.add_right_comm]

/
`Nat.ascFactorial_eq_div` for the version with ℕ-division. Consider using
`factorial_mul_ascFactorial` to avoid complications of ℕ-subtraction. -/

name: factorial_mul_ascFactorial'
statement:
theorem factorial_mul_ascFactorial' (n k : ℕ) (h : 0 < n) :
    (n - 1)! * n.ascFactorial k = (n + k - 1)!
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.sub_add_comm h, Nat.sub_one]
  nth_rw 2 [Nat.eq_add_of_sub_eq h rfl]
  rw [Nat.sub_one, factorial_mul_ascFactorial]

name: ascFactorial_mul_ascFactorial
statement:
theorem ascFactorial_mul_ascFactorial (n l k : ℕ) :
    n.ascFactorial l * (n + l).ascFactorial k = n.ascFactorial (l + k)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    cases l
    · simp only [ascFactorial_zero, Nat.add_zero, Nat.one_mul, Nat.zero_add]
    · simp only [Nat.add_right_comm, zero_ascFactorial, Nat.zero_add, Nat.zero_mul]
  | succ n' =>
    apply Nat.mul_left_cancel (factorial_pos n')
    simp only [Nat.add_assoc, ← Nat.mul_assoc, factorial_mul_ascFactorial]
    rw [Nat.add_comm 1 l, ← Nat.add_assoc, factorial_mul_ascFactorial, Nat.add_assoc]

name: ascFactorial_eq_div
statement: theorem ascFactorial_eq_div (n k : ℕ) : (n + 1).ascFactorial k = (n + k)! / n !

name: ascFactorial_eq_div'
statement:
theorem ascFactorial_eq_div' (n k : ℕ) (h : 0 < n) :
    n.ascFactorial k = (n + k - 1)! / (n - 1)!

name: ascFactorial_of_sub
statement:
theorem ascFactorial_of_sub {n k : ℕ} :
    (n - k) * (n - k + 1).ascFactorial k = (n - k).ascFactorial (k + 1)

name: ascFactorial_le
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem ascFactorial_le (k : ℕ) {n m : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) :
    n.ascFactorial k ≤ m.ascFactorial k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => exact Nat.mul_le_mul (by lia) ih

name: pow_succ_le_ascFactorial
statement:
theorem pow_succ_le_ascFactorial (n : ℕ) : ∀ k : ℕ, n ^ k ≤ n.ascFactorial k
  | 0 => by rw [ascFactorial_zero, Nat.pow_zero]
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm, ascFactorial_succ, ← succ_ascFactorial]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_refl n)
      (Nat.le_trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (le_succ n) k) (pow_succ_le_ascFactorial n.succ k))

name: pow_lt_ascFactorial'
statement: theorem pow_lt_ascFactorial' (n k : ℕ) : (n + 1) ^ (k + 2) < (n + 1).ascFactorial (k + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.pow_succ, ascFactorial, Nat.mul_comm]
  exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le' (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right k.succ_pos)
    (pow_succ_le_ascFactorial n.succ _) (Nat.pow_pos n.succ_pos)

name: pow_lt_ascFactorial
statement:
theorem pow_lt_ascFactorial (n : ℕ) : ∀ {k : ℕ}, 2 ≤ k → (n + 1) ^ k < (n + 1).ascFactorial k
  | 0 => by rintro ⟨⟩
  | 1 => by intro; contradiction
  | k + 2 => fun _ => pow_lt_ascFactorial' n k

name: ascFactorial_le_pow_add
statement:
theorem ascFactorial_le_pow_add (n : ℕ) : ∀ k : ℕ, (n + 1).ascFactorial k ≤ (n + k) ^ k
  | 0 => by rw [ascFactorial_zero, Nat.pow_zero]
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [ascFactorial_succ, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_right_comm n 1 k]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _
      (Nat.le_trans (ascFactorial_le_pow_add _ k) (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (le_succ _) _))

name: ascFactorial_le_factorial_mul_pow
statement: theorem ascFactorial_le_factorial_mul_pow (n k : ℕ) : n.ascFactorial k ≤ k ! * n ^ k
proof:
:=
  match k with
  | 0 => by simp
  | j + 1 => by
    rcases n.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hn
    · simp [zero_ascFactorial]
    rw [ascFactorial_succ, factorial_succ, pow_succ',
      Nat.mul_assoc (j + 1), Nat.mul_left_comm j !, ← Nat.mul_assoc (j + 1)]
    refine Nat.mul_le_mul ?_ (ascFactorial_le_factorial_mul_pow n j)
    rw [add_one_mul, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_le_add_iff_right]
    exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right j hn

name: ascFactorial_lt_pow_add
statement:
theorem ascFactorial_lt_pow_add (n : ℕ) : ∀ {k : ℕ}, 2 ≤ k → (n + 1).ascFactorial k < (n + k) ^ k
  | 0 => by rintro ⟨⟩
  | 1 => by intro; contradiction
  | k + 2 => fun _ => by
    rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm, ascFactorial_succ, succ_add_eq_add_succ n (k + 1)]
    exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_le_of_lt (le_refl _) (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (ascFactorial_le_pow_add n _)
      (Nat.pow_lt_pow_left (Nat.lt_succ_self _) k.succ_ne_zero)) (succ_pos _)

name: ascFactorial_pos
statement: theorem ascFactorial_pos (n k : ℕ) : 0 < (n + 1).ascFactorial k

name: descFactorial_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem descFactorial_zero (n : ℕ) : n.descFactorial 0 = 1

name: descFactorial_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem descFactorial_succ (n k : ℕ) : n.descFactorial (k + 1) = (n - k) * n.descFactorial k

name: zero_descFactorial_succ
statement: theorem zero_descFactorial_succ (k : ℕ) : (0 : ℕ).descFactorial (k + 1) = 0

name: descFactorial_one
statement: theorem descFactorial_one (n : ℕ) : n.descFactorial 1 = n

name: succ_descFactorial_succ
statement:
theorem succ_descFactorial_succ (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, (n + 1).descFactorial (k + 1) = (n + 1) * n.descFactorial k
  | 0 => by rw [descFactorial_zero, descFactorial_one, Nat.mul_one]
  | succ k => by
    rw [descFactorial_succ, succ_descFactorial_succ _ k, descFactorial_succ, succ_sub_succ,
      Nat.mul_left_comm]

name: succ_descFactorial
statement:
theorem succ_descFactorial (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ k, (n + 1 - k) * (n + 1).descFactorial k = (n + 1) * n.descFactorial k
  | 0 => by rw [Nat.sub_zero, descFactorial_zero, descFactorial_zero]
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [descFactorial, succ_descFactorial _ k, descFactorial_succ, succ_sub_succ, Nat.mul_left_comm]

name: descFactorial_self
statement:
theorem descFactorial_self : ∀ n : ℕ, n.descFactorial n = n !
  | 0 => by rw [descFactorial_zero, factorial_zero]
  | succ n => by rw [succ_descFactorial_succ, descFactorial_self n, factorial_succ]

@[simp]

name: descFactorial_eq_zero_iff_lt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem descFactorial_eq_zero_iff_lt {n : ℕ} : ∀ {k : ℕ}, n.descFactorial k = 0 ↔ n < k
  | 0 => by simp only [descFactorial_zero, Nat.one_ne_zero, Nat.not_lt_zero]
  | succ k => by
    rw [descFactorial_succ, mul_eq_zero, descFactorial_eq_zero_iff_lt, Nat.lt_succ_iff,
      Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le, Nat.lt_iff_le_and_ne, or_iff_left_iff_imp, and_imp]
    exact fun h _ => h

@[simp]

name: descFactorial_pos
statement:
@[simp]
lemma descFactorial_pos {n k : ℕ} : 0 < n.descFactorial k ↔ k ≤ n

name: descFactorial_mul_self
statement:
theorem descFactorial_mul_self (n j : ℕ) :
    n.descFactorial j * n = n.descFactorial (j + 1) + j * n.descFactorial j
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt j n with h | h
  · rw [descFactorial_succ, ← Nat.add_mul, Nat.sub_add_cancel h, Nat.mul_comm]
  · simp [descFactorial_of_lt h]

name: add_descFactorial_eq_ascFactorial
statement:
theorem add_descFactorial_eq_ascFactorial (n : ℕ) : ∀ k : ℕ,
    (n + k).descFactorial k = (n + 1).ascFactorial k
  | 0 => by rw [ascFactorial_zero, descFactorial_zero]
  | succ k => by
    rw [Nat.add_succ, succ_descFactorial_succ, ascFactorial_succ,
      add_descFactorial_eq_ascFactorial _ k, Nat.add_right_comm]

name: add_descFactorial_eq_ascFactorial'
statement:
theorem add_descFactorial_eq_ascFactorial' (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, (n + k - 1).descFactorial k = n.ascFactorial k
  | 0 => by rw [ascFactorial_zero, descFactorial_zero]
  | succ k => by
    rw [descFactorial_succ, ascFactorial_succ, ← succ_add_eq_add_succ,
      add_descFactorial_eq_ascFactorial' _ k, ← succ_ascFactorial, succ_add_sub_one,
      Nat.add_sub_cancel]

/
for the version using ℕ-division. -/

name: factorial_mul_descFactorial
statement:
theorem factorial_mul_descFactorial : ∀ {n k : ℕ}, k ≤ n → (n - k)! * n.descFactorial k = n !
  | n, 0 => fun _ => by rw [descFactorial_zero, Nat.mul_one, Nat.sub_zero]
  | 0, succ k => fun h => by
    exfalso
    exact not_succ_le_zero k h
  | succ n, succ k => fun h => by
    rw [succ_descFactorial_succ, succ_sub_succ, ← Nat.mul_assoc, Nat.mul_comm (n - k)!,
      Nat.mul_assoc, factorial_mul_descFactorial (Nat.succ_le_succ_iff.1 h), factorial_succ]

name: descFactorial_mul_descFactorial
statement:
theorem descFactorial_mul_descFactorial {k m n : ℕ} (hkm : k ≤ m) :
    (n - k).descFactorial (m - k) * n.descFactorial k = n.descFactorial m
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hmn : m ≤ n
  · apply Nat.mul_left_cancel (n - m).factorial_pos
    rw [factorial_mul_descFactorial hmn, show n - m = (n - k) - (m - k) by lia, ← Nat.mul_assoc,
      factorial_mul_descFactorial (show m - k ≤ n - k by lia),
      factorial_mul_descFactorial (le_trans hkm hmn)]
  · rw [descFactorial_eq_zero_iff_lt.mpr (show n < m by lia)]
    by_cases hkn : k ≤ n
    · rw [descFactorial_eq_zero_iff_lt.mpr (show n - k < m - k by lia), Nat.zero_mul]
    · rw [descFactorial_eq_zero_iff_lt.mpr (show n < k by lia), Nat.mul_zero]

name: descFactorial_eq_div
statement: theorem descFactorial_eq_div {n k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ n) : n.descFactorial k = n ! / (n - k)!
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel (n - k).factorial_pos
  rw [factorial_mul_descFactorial h]
  exact (Nat.mul_div_cancel' <| factorial_dvd_factorial <| Nat.sub_le n k).symm

name: descFactorial_le
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem descFactorial_le (n : ℕ) {k m : ℕ} (h : k ≤ m) :
    k.descFactorial n ≤ m.descFactorial n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [descFactorial_succ, descFactorial_succ]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.sub_le_sub_right h n) ih

name: pow_sub_le_descFactorial
statement:
theorem pow_sub_le_descFactorial (n : ℕ) : ∀ k : ℕ, (n + 1 - k) ^ k ≤ n.descFactorial k
  | 0 => by rw [descFactorial_zero, Nat.pow_zero]
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [descFactorial_succ, Nat.pow_succ, succ_sub_succ, Nat.mul_comm]
    apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
    exact (le_trans (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.sub_le_sub_right n.le_succ _) k)
      (pow_sub_le_descFactorial n k))

name: pow_sub_lt_descFactorial'
statement:
theorem pow_sub_lt_descFactorial' {n : ℕ} :
    ∀ {k : ℕ}, k + 2 ≤ n → (n - (k + 1)) ^ (k + 2) < n.descFactorial (k + 2)
  | 0, h => by
    rw [descFactorial_succ, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.pow_one, descFactorial_one]
    exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by lia) (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt h)
  | k + 1, h => by
    rw [descFactorial_succ, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]
    refine Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left ?_ (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt h)
    refine Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.sub_le_sub_right n.le_succ _) _) ?_
    rw [succ_sub_succ]
    exact pow_sub_lt_descFactorial' (Nat.le_trans (le_succ _) h)

name: pow_sub_lt_descFactorial
statement:
theorem pow_sub_lt_descFactorial {n : ℕ} :
    ∀ {k : ℕ}, 2 ≤ k → k ≤ n → (n + 1 - k) ^ k < n.descFactorial k
  | 0 => by rintro ⟨⟩
  | 1 => by intro; contradiction
  | k + 2 => fun _ h => by
    rw [succ_sub_succ]
    exact pow_sub_lt_descFactorial' h

name: descFactorial_le_pow
statement:
theorem descFactorial_le_pow (n : ℕ) : ∀ k : ℕ, n.descFactorial k ≤ n ^ k
  | 0 => by rw [descFactorial_zero, Nat.pow_zero]
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [descFactorial_succ, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm _ n]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.sub_le _ _) (descFactorial_le_pow _ k)

name: descFactorial_lt_pow
statement:
theorem descFactorial_lt_pow {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : ∀ {k : ℕ}, 2 ≤ k → n.descFactorial k < n ^ k
  | 0 => by rintro ⟨⟩
  | 1 => by intro; contradiction
  | k + 2 => fun _ => by
    rw [descFactorial_succ, pow_succ', Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_comm n]
    exact Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_le_of_lt (descFactorial_le_pow _ _) (by lia) (Nat.pow_pos <| by lia)

end DescFactorial

name: factorial_two_mul_le
statement: lemma factorial_two_mul_le (n : ℕ) : (2 * n)! ≤ (2 * n) ^ n * n !
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.two_mul, ← factorial_mul_ascFactorial, Nat.mul_comm]
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (ascFactorial_le_pow_add _ _)

name: two_pow_mul_factorial_le_factorial_two_mul
statement: lemma two_pow_mul_factorial_le_factorial_two_mul (n : ℕ) : 2 ^ n * n ! ≤ (2 * n)!
proof:
:= by
  obtain _ | n := n
  · simp
  rw [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.two_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ (n + 1)! * (n + 2) ^ (n + 1) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (le_add_left _ _) _)
    _ ≤ _ := Nat.factorial_mul_pow_le_factorial

name: ascFactorial_eq_ascFactorialBinary
statement:
@[csimp]
lemma ascFactorial_eq_ascFactorialBinary : ascFactorial = ascFactorialBinary
proof:
:= by
  ext n k
  fun_induction ascFactorialBinary with
  | case1 => simp
  | case2 => simp [ascFactorial]
  | case3 n k ih₁ ih₂ => grind [ascFactorial_mul_ascFactorial]

name: factorial_eq_factorialBinarySplitting
statement:
@[csimp]
theorem factorial_eq_factorialBinarySplitting : @factorial = @factorialBinarySplitting

name: descFactorial_eq_descFactorialBinary
statement:
@[csimp]
theorem descFactorial_eq_descFactorialBinary : descFactorial = descFactorialBinary
proof:
:= by
  ext n k
  rw [descFactorialBinary]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [descFactorial_of_lt h]
  · rw [← ascFactorial_eq_ascFactorialBinary, ← add_descFactorial_eq_ascFactorial']
    grind

name: superFactorial_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem superFactorial_zero : sf 0 = 1

name: superFactorial_succ
statement: theorem superFactorial_succ (n : ℕ) : (sf n.succ) = (n + 1)! * sf n

name: superFactorial_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem superFactorial_one : sf 1 = 1

name: superFactorial_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem superFactorial_two : sf 2 = 2

name: prod_Icc_factorial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_Icc_factorial : ∀ n : ℕ, ∏ x ∈ Icc 1 n, x ! = sf n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [← Ico_add_one_right_eq_Icc 1, prod_Ico_succ_top le_add_self, Nat.factorial_succ,
      Ico_add_one_right_eq_Icc 1 n, prod_Icc_factorial n, superFactorial, factorial, mul_comm]

@[simp]

name: prod_range_factorial_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_range_factorial_succ (n : ℕ) : ∏ x ∈ range n, (x + 1)! = sf n

name: prod_range_succ_factorial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prod_range_succ_factorial : ∀ n : ℕ, ∏ x ∈ range (n + 1), x ! = sf n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [prod_range_succ, prod_range_succ_factorial n, mul_comm, superFactorial]

name: superFactorial_two_mul
statement:
theorem superFactorial_two_mul : ∀ n : ℕ,
    sf (2 * n) = (∏ i ∈ range n, (2 * i + 1)!) ^ 2 * 2 ^ n * n !
  | 0 => rfl
  | (n + 1) => by
    simp only [prod_range_succ, mul_pow, mul_add, mul_one, superFactorial_succ,
      superFactorial_two_mul n, factorial_succ]
    ring

name: superFactorial_four_mul
statement:
theorem superFactorial_four_mul (n : ℕ) :
    sf (4 * n) = ((∏ i ∈ range (2 * n), (2 * i + 1)!) * 2 ^ n) ^ 2 * (2 * n)!
proof:
:=
  calc
    sf (4 * n) = (∏ i ∈ range (2 * n), (2 * i + 1)!) ^ 2 * 2 ^ (2 * n) * (2 * n)! := by
      rw [← superFactorial_two_mul, ← mul_assoc, Nat.mul_two]
    _ = ((∏ i ∈ range (2 * n), (2 * i + 1)!) * 2 ^ n) ^ 2 * (2 * n)! := by
      rw [pow_mul', mul_pow]

name: natCast_factorial_of_le
statement:
theorem natCast_factorial_of_le {n : ℕ} (hn_fac : IsUnit (n ! : A))
    {m : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) : IsUnit (m ! : A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := exists_add_of_le hmn
  clear hmn
  induction k generalizing m with
  | zero => simpa using hn_fac
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [← add_assoc, add_right_comm] at hn_fac
    have := ih hn_fac
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_commute _ _ |>.isUnit_mul_iff] at this
    exact this.2

name: natCast_factorial_of_lt
statement:
theorem natCast_factorial_of_lt {n : ℕ} (hn_fac : IsUnit ((n - 1)! : A))
    {m : ℕ} (hmn : m < n) : IsUnit (m ! : A)

name: natCast_factorial_of_algebra
statement:
theorem natCast_factorial_of_algebra (K : Type*) [Semifield K] [CharZero K] [Algebra K A] (n : ℕ) :
    IsUnit (n ! : A)
proof:
:= by
  suffices IsUnit (n ! : K) by
    simpa using this.map (algebraMap K A)
  simp [isUnit_iff_ne_zero, n.factorial_ne_zero]

name: natCast_factorial_iff_of_charP
statement: theorem natCast_factorial_iff_of_charP {n : ℕ} : IsUnit (n ! : A) ↔ n < p
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p.Prime := Fact.out
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [hp.pos]
  | succ n ih =>
    
    rw [factorial_succ, cast_mul, Nat.cast_commute _ _ |>.isUnit_mul_iff, ih.symm.symm,
      ← Nat.add_one_le_iff, CharP.isUnit_natCast_iff hp]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ ↦ lt_of_le_of_ne h2 (mt (· ▸ dvd_rfl) h1),
      fun h ↦ ⟨not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (Nat.succ_pos _) h, h.le⟩⟩

name: natCast_of_isNilpotent_of_coprime
statement:
lemma natCast_of_isNilpotent_of_coprime (h : p.Coprime n) :
    IsUnit (n : A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hp
  suffices ∃ a b : A, p ^ m * a + n * b = 1 by
    obtain ⟨a, b, h⟩ := this
    refine .of_mul_eq_one b ?_
    simpa [hm] using h
  refine ⟨(p ^ m).gcdA n, (p ^ m).gcdB n, ?_⟩
  norm_cast
  rw [← Nat.cast_one, ← Int.cast_natCast 1, ← (h.pow_left m).gcd_eq_one, Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab]

name: natCast_factorial_of_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem natCast_factorial_of_isNilpotent [Fact p.Prime] (h : n < p) :
    IsUnit (n ! : A)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [factorial_succ, cast_mul, IsUnit.mul_iff]
    refine ⟨.natCast_of_isNilpotent_of_coprime hp ?_, ih (by lia)⟩
    rw [Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd Fact.out]
    exact Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (by lia) h

name: Nat.castChoose_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hk
  subst hk
  rw [eq_mul_inverse_iff_mul_eq, eq_mul_inverse_iff_mul_eq, ← Nat.cast_mul, ← Nat.cast_mul,
    add_comm, Nat.add_choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial] <;>
    apply hm.natCast_factorial_of_le
  exacts [Nat.le_add_right k.1 k.2, Nat.le_add_left k.2 k.1]

name: monotone_factorial
statement: lemma monotone_factorial : Monotone factorial

name: prod_factorial_pos
statement: theorem prod_factorial_pos : 0 < ∏ i ∈ s, (f i)!

name: prod_factorial_dvd_factorial_sum
statement: theorem prod_factorial_dvd_factorial_sum : (∏ i ∈ s, (f i)!) ∣ (∑ i ∈ s, f i)!
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s has ih =>
    rw [prod_cons, Finset.sum_cons]
    exact (mul_dvd_mul_left _ ih).trans (Nat.factorial_mul_factorial_dvd_factorial_add _ _)

name: factorial_eq_prod_range_add_one
statement:
theorem factorial_eq_prod_range_add_one : ∀ n, (n)! = ∏ i ∈ range n, (i + 1)
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by rw [factorial, prod_range_succ_comm, factorial_eq_prod_range_add_one n]

name: _root_.Finset.prod_range_add_one_eq_factorial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.Finset.prod_range_add_one_eq_factorial (n : ℕ) : ∏ i ∈ range n, (i + 1) = (n)!

name: ascFactorial_eq_prod_range
statement:
theorem ascFactorial_eq_prod_range (n : ℕ) : ∀ k, n.ascFactorial k = ∏ i ∈ range k, (n + i)
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 => by rw [ascFactorial, prod_range_succ_comm, ascFactorial_eq_prod_range n k]

name: Prime.dvd_ascFactorial_iff
statement:
lemma Prime.dvd_ascFactorial_iff {p k n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    p ∣ k.ascFactorial n ↔ ∃ i < n, p ∣ k + i

name: descFactorial_eq_prod_range
statement:
theorem descFactorial_eq_prod_range (n : ℕ) : ∀ k, n.descFactorial k = ∏ i ∈ range k, (n - i)
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 => by rw [descFactorial, prod_range_succ_comm, descFactorial_eq_prod_range n k]

name: factorial_coe_dvd_prod
statement: lemma factorial_coe_dvd_prod (k : ℕ) (n : ℤ) : (k ! : ℤ) ∣ ∏ i ∈ range k, (n + i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero, Finset.prod_int_mod]
  simp_rw [← Int.emod_add_emod n]
  have hn : 0 ≤ n % k ! := Int.emod_nonneg n <| Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr k.factorial_ne_zero
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le hn
  have hdivk := x.factorial_dvd_ascFactorial k
  zify [x.ascFactorial_eq_prod_range k] at hdivk
  rwa [← Finset.prod_int_mod, ← Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero, hx]

name: doubleFactorial_pos

lemma doubleFactorial_pos : ∀ n, 0 < n‼
  | 0 | 1 => zero_lt_one
  | _n + 2 => mul_pos (succ_pos _) (doubleFactorial_pos _)

statement: theorem doubleFactorial_add_two (n : ℕ) : (n + 2)‼ = (n + 2) * n‼

statement: theorem doubleFactorial_add_one (n : ℕ) : (n + 1)‼ = (n + 1) * (n - 1)‼

name: factorial_eq_mul_doubleFactorial
statement:
theorem factorial_eq_mul_doubleFactorial : ∀ n : ℕ, (n + 1)! = (n + 1)‼ * n‼
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [doubleFactorial_add_two, factorial, factorial_eq_mul_doubleFactorial _, mul_comm _ k‼,

name: doubleFactorial_le_factorial
statement:
lemma doubleFactorial_le_factorial : ∀ n, n‼ ≤ n !
  | 0 => le_rfl
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [factorial_eq_mul_doubleFactorial]; exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ n.doubleFactorial_pos

name: doubleFactorial_two_mul
statement:
theorem doubleFactorial_two_mul : ∀ n : ℕ, (2 * n)‼ = 2 ^ n * n !
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [mul_add, mul_one, doubleFactorial_add_two, factorial, pow_succ, doubleFactorial_two_mul _,

name: doubleFactorial_eq_prod_even
statement:
theorem doubleFactorial_eq_prod_even : ∀ n : ℕ, (2 * n)‼ = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, 2 * (i + 1)
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ← doubleFactorial_eq_prod_even _, mul_comm (2 * n)‼,
      (by ring : 2 * (n + 1) = 2 * n + 2)]

name: doubleFactorial_eq_prod_odd
statement:
theorem doubleFactorial_eq_prod_odd :
    ∀ n : ℕ, (2 * n + 1)‼ = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n, (2 * (i + 1) + 1)
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ← doubleFactorial_eq_prod_odd _, mul_comm (2 * n + 1)‼,
      (by ring : 2 * (n + 1) + 1 = 2 * n + 1 + 2)]
    rfl
