namespace Mathlib.Meta.Positivity
open Lean Meta Qq

/
@[positivity Nat.doubleFactorial _]
meta def evalDoubleFactorial : PositivityExt where eval {u α} _ pα? e
proof:
:=
  match pα? with | none => pure .none | some _ => do
  match u, α, e with
  | 0, ~q(ℕ), ~q(Nat.doubleFactorial $n) =>
    assumeInstancesCommute
    return .positive q(Nat.doubleFactorial_pos $n)
  | _, _ => throwError "not Nat.doubleFactorial"

name: cast_descFactorial_two
statement: theorem cast_descFactorial_two : (a.descFactorial 2 : S) = a * (a - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [descFactorial]
  cases a
  · simp
  · simp [mul_add, add_mul]

name: gcd_greatest
statement:
theorem gcd_greatest {a b d : ℕ} (hda : d ∣ a) (hdb : d ∣ b) (hd : ∀ e : ℕ, e ∣ a → e ∣ b → e ∣ d) :
    d = a.gcd b
proof:
:=
  (dvd_antisymm (hd _ (gcd_dvd_left a b) (gcd_dvd_right a b)) (dvd_gcd hda hdb)).symm

name: gcd_right_comm
statement: theorem gcd_right_comm (a b c : ℕ) : gcd (gcd a b) c = gcd (gcd a c) b
proof:
:= by
  rw [gcd_assoc, gcd_assoc, gcd_comm b c]

name: gcd_gcd_gcd_right
statement: theorem gcd_gcd_gcd_right (a b c : ℕ) : (a.gcd c).gcd (b.gcd c) = (a.gcd b).gcd c

name: gcd_gcd_gcd_left
statement: theorem gcd_gcd_gcd_left (a b c : ℕ) : (c.gcd a).gcd (c.gcd b) = c.gcd (a.gcd b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gcd_comm c a, gcd_comm c b, gcd_gcd_gcd_right, gcd_comm]

name: pow_sub_one_mod_pow_sub_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pow_sub_one_mod_pow_sub_one (a b c : ℕ) : (a ^ c - 1) % (a ^ b - 1) = a ^ (c % b) - 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_zero_or_pos a with rfl | ha0
  · simp [zero_pow_eq]; split_ifs <;> simp
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le ha0 with rfl | ha1
  · simp
  rcases eq_zero_or_pos b with rfl | hb0
  · simp
  rcases lt_or_ge c b with h | h
  · rw [mod_eq_of_lt, mod_eq_of_lt h]
    rwa [Nat.sub_lt_sub_iff_right (one_le_pow c a ha0), Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right ha1]
  · suffices a ^ (c - b + b) - 1 = a ^ (c - b) * (a ^ b - 1) + (a ^ (c - b) - 1) by
      rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel h, add_mod_right, this, add_mod, mul_mod, mod_self,
        mul_zero, zero_mod, zero_add, mod_mod, pow_sub_one_mod_pow_sub_one]
    rw [← Nat.add_sub_assoc (one_le_pow (c - b) a ha0), ← mul_add_one, pow_add,
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (one_le_pow b a ha0)]

name: pow_sub_one_gcd_pow_sub_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pow_sub_one_gcd_pow_sub_one (a b c : ℕ) :
    gcd (a ^ b - 1) (a ^ c - 1) = a ^ gcd b c - 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_zero_or_pos b with rfl | hb
  · simp
  replace hb : c % b < b := mod_lt c hb
  rw [gcd_rec, pow_sub_one_mod_pow_sub_one, pow_sub_one_gcd_pow_sub_one, ← gcd_rec]

name: Coprime.eq_of_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem Coprime.eq_of_mul_eq_zero {m n : ℕ} (h : m.Coprime n) (hmn : m * n = 0) :
    m = 0 ∧ n = 1 ∨ m = 1 ∧ n = 0
proof:
:=
  (Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp hmn).imp (fun hm => ⟨hm, n.coprime_zero_left.mp <| hm ▸ h⟩) fun hn =>
    let eq := hn ▸ h.symm
    ⟨m.coprime_zero_left.mp <| eq, hn⟩

name: Coprime.mul_add_mul_ne_mul
statement:
theorem Coprime.mul_add_mul_ne_mul {m n a b : ℕ} (cop : Coprime m n) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    a * m + b * n ≠ m * n
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ : n ∣ a :=
    cop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
      ((Nat.dvd_add_iff_left (Nat.dvd_mul_left n b)).mpr
        ((congr_arg _ h).mpr (Nat.dvd_mul_left n m)))
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ : m ∣ b :=
    cop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
      ((Nat.dvd_add_iff_right (Nat.dvd_mul_left m (n * x))).mpr
        ((congr_arg _ h).mpr (Nat.dvd_mul_right m n)))
  rw [mul_comm, mul_ne_zero_iff, ← one_le_iff_ne_zero] at ha hb
  refine mul_ne_zero hb.2 ha.2 (eq_zero_of_mul_eq_self_left (ne_of_gt (add_le_add ha.1 hb.1)) ?_)
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← h, Nat.add_mul, Nat.add_mul, mul_comm _ n, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm y]

name: gcd_mul_gcd_eq_iff_dvd_mul_of_coprime
statement:
theorem gcd_mul_gcd_eq_iff_dvd_mul_of_coprime (hcop : Coprime n m) :
    gcd x n * gcd x m = x ↔ x ∣ n * m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, (dvd_antisymm ?_ <| dvd_gcd_mul_gcd_iff_dvd_mul.mpr ·)⟩
  refine h ▸ Nat.mul_dvd_mul ?_ ?_ <;> exact x.gcd_dvd_right _
  refine (hcop.gcd_both x x).mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd ?_ ?_ <;> exact x.gcd_dvd_left _

name: div_mul_div
statement: lemma div_mul_div (hkm : m ∣ k) (hkn : n ∣ m) : (k / m) * (m / n) = k / n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n.eq_zero_or_pos with hn | hn
  · simp [hn]
  refine (Nat.div_eq_of_eq_mul_left hn ?_).symm
  rw [mul_assoc, Nat.div_mul_cancel hkn, Nat.div_mul_cancel hkm]

statement: lemma div_dvd_div_iff_right (hkm : k ∣ m) (hkn : k ∣ n) : m / k ∣ n / k ↔ m ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rcases k.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hk
  · simp_all
  · rw [← Nat.mul_dvd_mul_iff_left hk, Nat.mul_div_cancel' hkm, Nat.mul_div_cancel' hkn]

name: div_lcm_eq_div_gcd
statement: lemma div_lcm_eq_div_gcd (hkm : m ∣ k) (hkn : n ∣ k) : (k / m).lcm (k / n) = k / (m.gcd n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.lcm_eq_iff]
  refine ⟨div_dvd_div_left hkm (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n),
        div_dvd_div_left hkn (Nat.gcd_dvd_right m n), fun c hmc hnc ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases m.eq_zero_or_pos with hm | hm
  · simp_all
  rcases n.eq_zero_or_pos with hn | hn
  · simp_all
  rw [Nat.div_dvd_iff_dvd_mul hkm hm] at hmc
  rw [Nat.div_dvd_iff_dvd_mul hkn hn] at hnc
  simpa [Nat.div_dvd_iff_dvd_mul (Nat.dvd_trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m n) hkm)
    (gcd_pos_of_pos_left n hm), Nat.gcd_mul_right m c n] using (Nat.dvd_gcd hmc hnc)

name: eleven_dvd_of_palindrome
statement:
theorem eleven_dvd_of_palindrome (p : (digits 10 n).Palindrome) (h : Even (digits 10 n).length) :
    11 ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  let dig := (digits 10 n).map fun n : ℕ => (n : ℤ)
  replace h : Even dig.length := by rwa [List.length_map]
  refine eleven_dvd_iff.2 ⟨0, (?_ : dig.alternatingSum = 0)⟩
  have := dig.alternatingSum_reverse
  rw [(p.map _).reverse_eq, _root_.pow_succ', h.neg_one_pow, mul_one, neg_one_zsmul] at this
  exact eq_zero_of_neg_eq this.symm

name: ofDigits_eq_sum_mapIdx_aux
statement:
theorem ofDigits_eq_sum_mapIdx_aux (b : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) :
    (l.zipWith ((fun a i : ℕ => a * b ^ (i + 1))) (List.range l.length)).sum =
      b * (l.zipWith (fun a i => a * b ^ i) (List.range l.length)).sum
proof:
:= by
  suffices
    l.zipWith (fun a i : ℕ => a * b ^ (i + 1)) (List.range l.length) =
      l.zipWith (fun a i => b * (a * b ^ i)) (List.range l.length)
    by simp [this]
  congr; ext; ring

statement:
theorem ofDigits_eq_sum_mapIdx (b : ℕ) (L : List ℕ) :
    ofDigits b L = (L.mapIdx fun i a => a * b ^ i).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.mapIdx_eq_zipIdx_map, List.zipIdx_eq_zip_range', List.map_zip_eq_zipWith,
    ofDigits_eq_foldr, ← List.range_eq_range']
  induction L with
  | nil => simp
  | cons hd tl hl =>
    simpa [List.range_succ_eq_map, List.zipWith_map_right, ofDigits_eq_sum_mapIdx_aux] using!
      Or.inl hl

name: length_digits
statement:
theorem length_digits (b n : ℕ) (hb : 1 < b) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (b.digits n).length = b.log n + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with | _ n IH
  rw [digits_eq_cons_digits_div hb hn, List.length]
  by_cases h : n / b = 0
  · simp [h]
    aesop
  · have : n / b < n := div_lt_self (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn) hb
    rw [IH _ this h, log_div_base, tsub_add_cancel_of_le]
    refine Nat.succ_le_of_lt (log_pos hb ?_)
    contrapose! h
    exact div_eq_of_lt h

name: digits_length_le_iff
statement:
theorem digits_length_le_iff {b k : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (n : ℕ) :
    (b.digits n).length ≤ k ↔ n < b ^ k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : n = 0
  · have : 0 < b ^ k := by positivity
    simpa [h]
  rw [length_digits b n hb h, ← log_lt_iff_lt_pow hb h]
  exact add_one_le_iff

name: lt_digits_length_iff
statement:
theorem lt_digits_length_iff {b k : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (n : ℕ) :
    k < (b.digits n).length ↔ b ^ k ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  contrapose!
  exact digits_length_le_iff hb n

name: getLast_digit_ne_zero
statement:
theorem getLast_digit_ne_zero (b : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    (digits b m).getLast (digits_ne_nil_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases b with (_ | _ | b)
  · cases m
    · cases hm rfl
    · simp
  · simp
  revert hm
  induction m using Nat.strongRecOn with | ind n IH => ?_
  intro hn
  by_cases! hnb : n < b + 2
  · simpa only [digits_of_lt (b + 2) n hn hnb]
  · rw [digits_getLast n (le_add_left 2 b)]
    refine IH _ (Nat.div_lt_self hn.bot_lt (one_lt_succ_succ b)) ?_
    rw [← pos_iff_ne_zero]
    exact Nat.div_pos hnb (zero_lt_succ (succ b))

name: digits_append_digits
statement:
theorem digits_append_digits {b m n : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    digits b n ++ digits b m = digits b (n + b ^ (digits b n).length * m)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hb) with (rfl | hb)
  · simp
  rw [← ofDigits_digits_append_digits]
  refine (digits_ofDigits b hb _ (fun l hl => ?_) (fun h_append => ?_)).symm
  · rcases (List.mem_append.mp hl) with (h | h) <;> exact digits_lt_base hb h
  · by_cases h : digits b m = []
    · simp only [h, List.append_nil] at h_append ⊢
      exact getLast_digit_ne_zero b <| digits_ne_nil_iff_ne_zero.mp h_append
    · exact (List.getLast_append_of_right_ne_nil _ _ h) ▸
          (getLast_digit_ne_zero _ <| digits_ne_nil_iff_ne_zero.mp h)

name: digits_append_zeroes_append_digits
statement:
theorem digits_append_zeroes_append_digits {b k m n : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hm : 0 < m) :
    digits b n ++ List.replicate k 0 ++ digits b m =
    digits b (n + b ^ ((digits b n).length + k) * m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.append_assoc, ← digits_base_pow_mul hb hm]
  simp only [digits_append_digits (zero_lt_of_lt hb), digits_inj_iff, add_right_inj]
  ring

name: length_digits_le_length_digits_succ
statement:
theorem length_digits_le_length_digits_succ (b n : ℕ) :
    (digits b n).length ≤ (digits b (n + 1)).length
proof:
:= by
  rcases Decidable.eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn)
  · simp
  rcases le_or_gt b 1 with hb | hb
  · interval_cases b <;> simp +arith [digits_zero_succ', hn]
  simpa [length_digits, hb, hn] using log_mono_right (le_succ _)

name: le_length_digits_le
statement: theorem le_length_digits_le (b n m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m) : (digits b n).length ≤ (digits b m).length

name: pow_length_le_mul_ofDigits
statement:
theorem pow_length_le_mul_ofDigits {b : ℕ} {l : List ℕ} (hl : l ≠ []) (hl2 : l.getLast hl ≠ 0) :
    (b + 2) ^ l.length ≤ (b + 2) * ofDigits (b + 2) l
proof:
:= by
  rw [← List.dropLast_append_getLast hl]
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length, zero_add, List.length_dropLast, ofDigits_append,
    List.length_dropLast, ofDigits_singleton, add_comm (l.length - 1), pow_add, pow_one]
  apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
  refine le_trans ?_ (Nat.le_add_left _ _)
  have : 0 < l.getLast hl := by rwa [pos_iff_ne_zero]
  convert! Nat.mul_le_mul_left ((b + 2) ^ (l.length - 1)) this using 1
  rw [Nat.mul_one]

name: base_pow_length_digits_le'
statement:
theorem base_pow_length_digits_le' (b m : ℕ) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    (b + 2) ^ (digits (b + 2) m).length ≤ (b + 2) * m
proof:
:= by
  have : digits (b + 2) m ≠ [] := digits_ne_nil_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm
  convert! @pow_length_le_mul_ofDigits b (digits (b + 2) m) this (getLast_digit_ne_zero _ hm)
  rw [ofDigits_digits]

name: base_pow_length_digits_le
statement:
theorem base_pow_length_digits_le (b m : ℕ) (hb : 1 < b) :
    m ≠ 0 → b ^ (digits b m).length ≤ b * m
proof:
:= by
  rcases b with (_ | _ | b) <;> simp_all [base_pow_length_digits_le']

name: sub_one_mul_sum_div_pow_eq_sub_sum_digits
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | rfl | h : 1 < p ∨ 1 = p ∨ p < 1 := trichotomous 1 p
  · induction L with
    | nil => simp [ofDigits]
    | cons hd tl ih =>
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.sum_cons, self_div_pow_eq_ofDigits_drop _ _ h,
          digits_ofDigits p h (hd :: tl) h_lt (fun _ => h_ne_zero)]
      simp only [ofDigits]
      rw [sum_range_succ, Nat.cast_id]
      simp only [List.drop, List.drop_length]
      obtain rfl | h' := em <| tl = []
      · simp [ofDigits]
      · have w₁' := fun l hl ↦ h_lt l <| List.mem_cons_of_mem hd hl
        have w₂' := fun (h : tl ≠ []) ↦ (List.getLast_cons h) ▸ h_ne_zero
        have ih := ih (w₂' h') w₁'
        simp only [self_div_pow_eq_ofDigits_drop _ _ h, digits_ofDigits p h tl w₁' w₂',
          ← Nat.one_add] at ih
        have := sum_singleton (fun x ↦ ofDigits p <| tl.drop x) tl.length
        rw [← Ico_succ_singleton, List.drop_length, ofDigits] at this
        have h₁ : 1 ≤ tl.length := List.length_pos_iff.mpr h'
        rw [← sum_range_add_sum_Ico _ <| h₁, ← add_zero (∑ x ∈ Ico _ _, ofDigits p (tl.drop x)),
            ← this, sum_Ico_consecutive _ h₁ <| (le_add_right tl.length 1),
            ← sum_Ico_add _ 0 tl.length 1,
            Ico_zero_eq_range, mul_add, mul_add, ih, range_one, sum_singleton, List.drop, ofDigits,
            mul_zero, add_zero, ← Nat.add_sub_assoc <| sum_le_ofDigits _ <| Nat.le_of_lt h]
        nth_rw 2 [← one_mul <| ofDigits p tl]
        rw [← add_mul, Nat.sub_add_cancel (one_le_of_lt h), Nat.add_sub_add_left]
  · simp [ofDigits_one]
  · simp [lt_one_iff.mp h]
    cases L
    · rfl
    · simp [ofDigits]

name: sub_one_mul_sum_log_div_pow_eq_sub_sum_digits
statement:
theorem sub_one_mul_sum_log_div_pow_eq_sub_sum_digits {p : ℕ} (n : ℕ) :
    (p - 1) * ∑ i ∈ range (log p n).succ, n / p ^ i.succ = n - (p.digits n).sum
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | rfl | h : 1 < p ∨ 1 = p ∨ p < 1 := trichotomous 1 p
  · rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
    · simp
    · convert!
      sub_one_mul_sum_div_pow_eq_sub_sum_digits (p.digits n) (getLast_digit_ne_zero p hn) <|
        (fun l a ↦ digits_lt_base h a)
      · refine (length_digits p n h hn).symm
      all_goals exact (ofDigits_digits p n).symm
  · simp
  · simp [lt_one_iff.mp h]
    cases n
    all_goals simp

name: digits_two_eq_bits
statement: theorem digits_two_eq_bits (n : ℕ) : digits 2 n = n.bits.map fun b => cond b 1 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Bool.cond_eq_ite]
  induction n using Nat.binaryRecFromOne with
  | zero => simp
  | one => simp
  | bit b n h ih =>
    rw [bits_append_bit _ _ fun hn => absurd hn h]
    cases b
    · rw [digits_def' one_lt_two]
      · simpa [Nat.bit]
      · simpa [Nat.bit, pos_iff_ne_zero]
    · simpa [Nat.bit, add_comm, digits_add 2 one_lt_two 1 n, Nat.add_mul_div_left]

name: dvd_ofDigits_sub_ofDigits
statement:
theorem dvd_ofDigits_sub_ofDigits {α : Type*} [CommRing α] {a b k : α} (h : k ∣ a - b)
    (L : List ℕ) : k ∣ ofDigits a L - ofDigits b L
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => change k ∣ 0 - 0; simp
  | cons d L ih =>
    simp only [ofDigits, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
    exact dvd_mul_sub_mul h ih

name: ofDigits_modEq'
statement:
theorem ofDigits_modEq' (b b' : ℕ) (k : ℕ) (h : b ≡ b' [MOD k]) (L : List ℕ) :
    ofDigits b L ≡ ofDigits b' L [MOD k]
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons d L ih =>
    dsimp [ofDigits]
    dsimp [Nat.ModEq] at *
    conv_lhs => rw [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod, h, ih]
    conv_rhs => rw [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod]

name: ofDigits_modEq
statement: theorem ofDigits_modEq (b k : ℕ) (L : List ℕ) : ofDigits b L ≡ ofDigits (b % k) L [MOD k]
proof:
:=
  ofDigits_modEq' b (b % k) k (b.mod_modEq k).symm L

name: ofDigits_mod
statement: theorem ofDigits_mod (b k : ℕ) (L : List ℕ) : ofDigits b L % k = ofDigits (b % k) L % k

name: ofDigits_mod_eq_head
statement: theorem ofDigits_mod_eq_head! (b : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) : ofDigits b l % b = l.head! % b

name: head
statement: theorem head!_digits {b n : ℕ} (h : b ≠ 1) : (Nat.digits b n).head! = n % b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : 1 < b
  · rcases n with _ | n
    · simp
    · nth_rw 2 [← Nat.ofDigits_digits b (n + 1)]
      rw [Nat.ofDigits_mod_eq_head! _ _]
      exact (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Nat.digits_lt_base hb <| List.head!_mem_self <|
          Nat.digits_ne_nil_iff_ne_zero.mpr <| Nat.succ_ne_zero n)).symm
  · rcases n with _ | _ <;> simp_all [show b = 0 by lia]

name: ofDigits_zmodeq'
statement:
theorem ofDigits_zmodeq' (b b' : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (h : b ≡ b' [ZMOD k]) (L : List ℕ) :
    ofDigits b L ≡ ofDigits b' L [ZMOD k]
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons d L ih =>
    dsimp [ofDigits]
    dsimp [Int.ModEq] at *
    conv_lhs => rw [Int.add_emod, Int.mul_emod, h, ih]
    conv_rhs => rw [Int.add_emod, Int.mul_emod]

name: ofDigits_zmodeq
statement: theorem ofDigits_zmodeq (b : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (L : List ℕ) : ofDigits b L ≡ ofDigits (b % k) L [ZMOD k]

name: ofDigits_zmod
statement: theorem ofDigits_zmod (b : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (L : List ℕ) : ofDigits b L % k = ofDigits (b % k) L % k

name: modEq_digits_sum
statement: theorem modEq_digits_sum (b b' : ℕ) (h : b' % b = 1) (n : ℕ) : n ≡ (digits b' n).sum [MOD b]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ofDigits_one]
  conv =>
    congr
    · skip
    · rw [← ofDigits_digits b' n]
  convert! ofDigits_modEq b' b (digits b' n)
  exact h.symm

name: zmodeq_ofDigits_digits
statement:
theorem zmodeq_ofDigits_digits (b b' : ℕ) (c : ℤ) (h : b' ≡ c [ZMOD b]) (n : ℕ) :
    n ≡ ofDigits c (digits b' n) [ZMOD b]
proof:
:= by
  conv =>
    congr
    · skip
    · rw [← ofDigits_digits b' n]
  rw [coe_ofDigits]
  apply ofDigits_zmodeq' _ _ _ h

name: ofDigits_neg_one
statement:
theorem ofDigits_neg_one :
    ∀ L : List ℕ, ofDigits (-1 : ℤ) L = (L.map fun n : ℕ => (n : ℤ)).alternatingSum
  | [] => rfl
  | [n] => by simp [ofDigits, List.alternatingSum]

name: getD_digits
statement: theorem getD_digits (n i : ℕ) {b : ℕ} (h : 2 ≤ b) : (digits b n).getD i 0 = n / b ^ i % b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' h
  clear h
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
  induction n using Nat.caseStrongRecOn generalizing i with
  | zero => simp
  | ind n IH =>
    rcases i with _ | i
    · rw [← List.head?_eq_getElem?, ← default_eq_zero, ← List.head!_eq_head?_getD,
        head!_digits (by grind)]
      simp
    · simp [IH _ (le_of_lt_succ (div_lt_self' n b)), pow_succ', Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]

name: length_digitsAppend
statement:
theorem length_digitsAppend {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (l : ℕ) (hn : n < b ^ l) :
    (digitsAppend b l n).length = l
proof:
:= by
  rw [digitsAppend, length_append, length_replicate, Nat.add_sub_cancel']
  rwa [digits_length_le_iff hb]

name: lt_of_mem_digitsAppend
statement:
theorem lt_of_mem_digitsAppend {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (l i : ℕ)
    (hi : i ∈ digitsAppend b l n) : i < b
proof:
:= by
  rw [digitsAppend, mem_append, mem_replicate] at hi
  obtain hi | ⟨_, rfl⟩ := hi
  · exact digits_lt_base hb hi
  · linarith

name: mapsTo_ofDigits
statement:
theorem mapsTo_ofDigits {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (l : ℕ) :
    Set.MapsTo (ofDigits b) {L : List ℕ | L.length = l ∧ ∀ x ∈ L, x < b} {n | n < b ^ l}
proof:
:=
  fun _ h ↦ Set.mem_ofPred.mpr h.1 ▸ Nat.ofDigits_lt_base_pow_length hb h.2

name: mapsTo_digitsAppend
statement:
theorem mapsTo_digitsAppend {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (l : ℕ) :
    Set.MapsTo (digitsAppend b l) {n | n < b ^ l} {L : List ℕ | L.length = l ∧ ∀ x ∈ L, x < b}
proof:
:=
  fun _ h ↦ ⟨by rw [length_digitsAppend hb _ h], fun _ hi ↦ lt_of_mem_digitsAppend hb l _ hi⟩

name: injOn_ofDigits
statement:
theorem injOn_ofDigits {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (l : ℕ) :
    Set.InjOn (ofDigits b) {L : List ℕ | L.length = l ∧ ∀ x ∈ L, x < b}
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ _ h ↦ ofDigits_inj_of_len_eq hb (by simp_all) (by simp_all) (by simp_all) h

name: setInvOn_digitsAppend_ofDigits
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun L hL ↦ ?_, fun _ _ ↦ by rw [digitsAppend, ofDigits_append_replicate_zero,
    ofDigits_digits]⟩
  refine (injOn_ofDigits hb l) ⟨?_, ?_⟩ hL
    (by rw [digitsAppend, ofDigits_append_replicate_zero, ofDigits_digits])
  · rw [length_digitsAppend hb _ (mapsTo_ofDigits hb _ hL)]
  · exact fun x hx ↦ lt_of_mem_digitsAppend hb l x hx

name: bijOn_ofDigits
statement:
theorem bijOn_ofDigits {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (l : ℕ) :
    Set.BijOn (ofDigits b) {L : List ℕ | L.length = l ∧ ∀ x ∈ L, x < b} {n | n < b ^ l}
proof:
:=
  (setInvOn_digitsAppend_ofDigits hb l).bijOn (mapsTo_ofDigits hb l) (mapsTo_digitsAppend hb l)

name: bijOn_digitsAppend
statement:
theorem bijOn_digitsAppend {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (l : ℕ) :
    Set.BijOn (digitsAppend b l) {n | n < b ^ l} {L : List ℕ | L.length = l ∧ ∀ x ∈ L, x < b}

name: sum_digits_ofDigits_eq_sum
proof:
:= by
  nth_rewrite 2 [← (setInvOn_digitsAppend_ofDigits hb l).1 hL]
  rw [digitsAppend, List.sum_append_nat, List.sum_replicate, nsmul_zero, add_zero]

name: mem_fixedLengthDigits_iff
statement:
theorem mem_fixedLengthDigits_iff {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) {l : ℕ} {L : List ℕ} :
    L ∈ fixedLengthDigits hb l ↔ L.length = l ∧ ∀ x ∈ L, x < b

name: _root_.Nat.bijOn_ofDigits'
statement:
theorem _root_.Nat.bijOn_ofDigits' {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (l : ℕ) :
    Set.BijOn (ofDigits b) (fixedLengthDigits hb l) (Finset.range (b ^ l))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fixedLengthDigits, Set.coe_toFinset]
  convert! bijOn_ofDigits hb l
  ext; simp

name: _root_.Nat.bijOn_digitsAppend'
statement:
theorem _root_.Nat.bijOn_digitsAppend' {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (l : ℕ) :
    Set.BijOn (digitsAppend b l) (Finset.range (b ^ l)) (fixedLengthDigits hb l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fixedLengthDigits, Set.coe_toFinset]
  convert! bijOn_digitsAppend hb l
  ext; simp

name: fixedLengthDigits_zero
fixedLengthDigits_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fixedLengthDigits_one {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) :
    fixedLengthDigits hb 1 = Finset.image (fun x : ℕ ↦ [x]) (Finset.range b)

name: card_fixedLengthDigits
statement:
theorem card_fixedLengthDigits {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (l : ℕ) :
    Finset.card (fixedLengthDigits hb l) = b ^ l
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.BijOn.finsetCard_eq (ofDigits b) (bijOn_ofDigits' hb l), Finset.card_range]

name: ne_empty_of_mem_consFixedLengthDigits
statement:
theorem ne_empty_of_mem_consFixedLengthDigits {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) {l d : ℕ} {L : List ℕ}
    (hL : L ∈ consFixedLengthDigits hb l d) : L ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hL
  exact cons_ne_nil d _

name: consFixedLengthDigits_head
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hL
  rw [head_cons]

name: cons_mem_fixedLengthDigits_succ
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_fixedLengthDigits_iff hb).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using ((mem_fixedLengthDigits_iff hb).mp hL).1
  · intro x hx
    obtain rfl | hx := mem_cons.mp hx
    · exact hd
    · exact ((mem_fixedLengthDigits_iff hb).mp hL).2 _ hx

name: pairwiseDisjoint_consFixedLengthDigits
statement:
theorem pairwiseDisjoint_consFixedLengthDigits {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (l : ℕ) :
    Set.PairwiseDisjoint (Finset.range b : Set ℕ) (fun d ↦ consFixedLengthDigits hb l d)
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.pairwiseDisjoint_iff.mpr fun i _ j _ ⟨L, hL⟩ ↦ ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_inter] at hL
  exact (consFixedLengthDigits_head hb hL.1).symm.trans (consFixedLengthDigits_head hb hL.2)

name: fixedLengthDigits_succ_eq_disjiUnion
statement:
theorem fixedLengthDigits_succ_eq_disjiUnion {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (l : ℕ) :
    fixedLengthDigits hb (l + 1) = Finset.disjiUnion (Finset.range b)
      (consFixedLengthDigits hb l) (pairwiseDisjoint_consFixedLengthDigits hb l)
proof:
:= by
  ext L
  simp_rw [Finset.disjiUnion_eq_biUnion, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_range,
    consFixedLengthDigits, Finset.mem_image]
  refine ⟨fun hL ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hL₁ : L.length = l + 1 := ((mem_fixedLengthDigits_iff hb).mp hL).1
    have hL₂ : ∀ x ∈ L, x < b := ((mem_fixedLengthDigits_iff hb).mp hL).2
    have hL₃ : L ≠ [] := by simp [ne_nil_iff_length_pos, hL₁]
    refine ⟨L.head hL₃, hL₂ _ (L.head_mem hL₃), L.tail, ?_, cons_head_tail hL₃⟩
    refine (mem_fixedLengthDigits_iff hb).mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [length_tail, hL₁, Nat.add_sub_cancel_right]
    · exact fun x hx ↦ hL₂ _ <| mem_of_mem_tail hx
  · rintro ⟨d, hd₁, T, hT, rfl⟩
    exact cons_mem_fixedLengthDigits_succ hb l d hd₁ hT

name: sum_fixedLengthDigits_sum
statement:
theorem sum_fixedLengthDigits_sum {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (l : ℕ) :
    ∑ L ∈ fixedLengthDigits hb l, L.sum = l * b ^ (l - 1) * b.choose 2
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | zero => simp
  | succ l hr =>
      by_cases hl : l = 0
      · simp [hl, fixedLengthDigits_one, Finset.sum_range_id, choose_two_right]
      rw [fixedLengthDigits_succ_eq_disjiUnion, Finset.sum_disjiUnion]
      simp only [consFixedLengthDigits, cons.injEq, true_and, implies_true, Set.injOn_of_eq_iff_eq,
        Finset.sum_image, sum_cons]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      simp_rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.sum_nsmul, Finset.sum_range_id, hr,
        nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.card_range, add_tsub_cancel_right, cast_id, card_fixedLengthDigits,
        choose_two_right]
      rw [show b ^ l = b * b ^ (l - 1) by rw [← Nat.pow_succ', Nat.sub_one, Nat.succ_pred hl]]
      ring

name: Nat.sum_sum_digits_eq
statement:
theorem Nat.sum_sum_digits_eq {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (l : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (b ^ l), (b.digits x).sum = l * b ^ (l - 1) * b.choose 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← List.sum_fixedLengthDigits_sum hb]
  refine (Finset.sum_nbij (ofDigits b) (by exact (bijOn_ofDigits' hb l).1)
    (bijOn_ofDigits' hb l).2.1 (bijOn_ofDigits' hb l).2.2 fun L hL ↦ ?_).symm
  rw [sum_digits_ofDigits_eq_sum hb ((List.mem_fixedLengthDigits_iff hb).mp hL)]

name: digitsAux_zero

theorem digitsAux_zero (b : ℕ) (h : 2 ≤ b) : digitsAux b h 0 = []

name: digitsAux_def

    digitsAux b h n = (n % b) :: digitsAux b h (n / b)

name: digits_zero

theorem digits_zero (b : ℕ) : digits b 0 = []

name: digits_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem digits_one (n : ℕ) : digits 1 n = List.replicate n 1

name: digits_one_succ
statement: theorem digits_one_succ (n : ℕ) : digits 1 (n + 1) = 1 :: digits 1 n

name: digits_add_two_add_one
statement:
theorem digits_add_two_add_one (b n : ℕ) :
    digits (b + 2) (n + 1) = ((n + 1) % (b + 2)) :: digits (b + 2) ((n + 1) / (b + 2))

name: digits_of_two_le_of_pos
statement:
@[simp]
lemma digits_of_two_le_of_pos {b : ℕ} (hb : 2 ≤ b) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Nat.digits b n = n % b :: Nat.digits b (n / b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.eq_add_of_sub_eq hb rfl, Nat.eq_add_of_sub_eq hn rfl, Nat.digits_add_two_add_one]

name: digits_def'
statement:
theorem digits_def' :
    ∀ {b : ℕ} (_ : 1 < b) {n : ℕ} (_ : 0 < n), digits b n = (n % b) :: digits b (n / b)
  | 0, h => absurd h (by decide)
  | 1, h => absurd h (by decide)
  | b + 2, _ => digitsAux_def _ (by simp) _

@[simp]

name: digits_of_lt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem digits_of_lt (b x : ℕ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hxb : x < b) : digits b x = [x]
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hx with ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rcases Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' ((Nat.le_add_left 1 x).trans_lt hxb) with ⟨b, rfl⟩
  rw [digits_add_two_add_one, div_eq_of_lt hxb, digits_zero, mod_eq_of_lt hxb]

name: digits_add
statement:
theorem digits_add (b : ℕ) (h : 1 < b) (x y : ℕ) (hxb : x < b) (hxy : x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0) :
    digits b (x + b * y) = x :: digits b y
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' h with ⟨b, rfl : _ = _ + 2⟩
  cases y
  · simp [hxb, hxy.resolve_right (absurd rfl)]
  dsimp [digits]
  rw [digitsAux_def]
  · congr
    · simp [Nat.add_mod, mod_eq_of_lt hxb]
    · simp [add_mul_div_left, div_eq_of_lt hxb]
  · apply Nat.succ_pos

name: ofDigits_eq_foldr
statement:
theorem ofDigits_eq_foldr {α : Type*} [Semiring α] (b : α) (L : List ℕ) :
    ofDigits b L = List.foldr (fun x y => ↑x + b * y) 0 L
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons d L ih => dsimp [ofDigits]; rw [ih]

name: ofDigits_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofDigits_nil {b : ℕ} : ofDigits b [] = 0

name: ofDigits_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofDigits_singleton {b n : ℕ} : ofDigits b [n] = n

name: ofDigits_one_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofDigits_one_cons {α : Type*} [Semiring α] (h : ℕ) (L : List ℕ) :
    ofDigits (1 : α) (h :: L) = h + ofDigits 1 L

name: ofDigits_cons
statement:
theorem ofDigits_cons {b hd} {tl : List ℕ} :
    ofDigits b (hd :: tl) = hd + b * ofDigits b tl

name: ofDigits_append
statement:
theorem ofDigits_append {b : ℕ} {l1 l2 : List ℕ} :
    ofDigits b (l1 ++ l2) = ofDigits b l1 + b ^ l1.length * ofDigits b l2
proof:
:= by
  induction l1 with
  | nil => simp [ofDigits]
  | cons hd tl IH =>
    rw [ofDigits, List.cons_append, ofDigits, IH, List.length_cons, pow_succ']
    ring

name: ofDigits_append_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofDigits_append_zero {b : ℕ} (l : List ℕ) :
    ofDigits b (l ++ [0]) = ofDigits b l

name: ofDigits_replicate_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofDigits_replicate_zero {b k : ℕ} : ofDigits b (List.replicate k 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [List.replicate, ofDigits_cons, ih]

name: ofDigits_append_replicate_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofDigits_append_replicate_zero {b k : ℕ} (l : List ℕ) :
    ofDigits b (l ++ List.replicate k 0) = ofDigits b l

name: ofDigits_reverse_cons
statement:
theorem ofDigits_reverse_cons {b : ℕ} (l : List ℕ) (d : ℕ) :
    ofDigits b (d :: l).reverse = ofDigits b l.reverse + b ^ l.length * d

name: ofDigits_reverse_zero_cons
statement:
theorem ofDigits_reverse_zero_cons {b : ℕ} (l : List ℕ) :
    ofDigits b (0 :: l).reverse = ofDigits b l.reverse

name: coe_ofDigits
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem coe_ofDigits (α : Type*) [Semiring α] (b : ℕ) (L : List ℕ) :
    ((ofDigits b L : ℕ) : α) = ofDigits (b : α) L
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp [ofDigits]
  | cons d L ih => dsimp [ofDigits]; push_cast; rw [ih]

name: digits_zero_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem digits_zero_of_eq_zero {b : ℕ} (h : b ≠ 0) :
    ∀ {L : List ℕ} (_ : ofDigits b L = 0), ∀ l ∈ L, l = 0
  | _ :: _, h0, _, List.Mem.head .. => Nat.eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero_right h0
  | _ :: _, h0, _, List.Mem.tail _ hL =>
    digits_zero_of_eq_zero h (mul_right_injective₀ h (Nat.eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero_left h0)) _ hL

name: digits_ofDigits
statement:
theorem digits_ofDigits (b : ℕ) (h : 1 < b) (L : List ℕ) (w₁ : ∀ l ∈ L, l < b)
    (w₂ : ∀ h : L ≠ [], L.getLast h ≠ 0) : digits b (ofDigits b L) = L
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp
  | cons d L ih =>
    dsimp [ofDigits]
    replace w₂ := w₂ (by simp)
    rw [digits_add b h]
    · rw [ih]
      · intro l m
        apply w₁
        exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ m
      · intro h
        rw [List.getLast_cons h] at w₂
        convert! w₂
    · exact w₁ d List.mem_cons_self
    · by_cases h' : L = []
      · rcases h' with rfl
        left
        simpa using w₂
      · right
        contrapose w₂
        refine digits_zero_of_eq_zero h.ne_bot w₂ _ ?_
        rw [List.getLast_cons h']
        exact List.getLast_mem h'

name: ofDigits_digits
statement: theorem ofDigits_digits (b n : ℕ) : ofDigits b (digits b n) = n
proof:
:= by
  rcases b with - | b
  · rcases n with - | n
    · rfl
    · simp
  · rcases b with - | b
    · induction n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n ih =>
        rw [Nat.zero_add] at ih ⊢
        simp only [ih, add_comm 1, ofDigits_one_cons, Nat.cast_id, digits_one_succ]
    · induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with | ind n h => ?_
      cases n
      · rw [digits_zero]
        rfl
      · simp only [digits_add_two_add_one]
        dsimp [ofDigits]
        rw [h _ (Nat.div_lt_self' _ b)]
        rw [Nat.mod_add_div]

name: ofDigits_one
statement: theorem ofDigits_one (L : List ℕ) : ofDigits 1 L = L.sum
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ ih => simp [ofDigits, List.sum_cons, ih]

name: digits_eq_nil_iff_eq_zero
statement: theorem digits_eq_nil_iff_eq_zero {b n : ℕ} : digits b n = [] ↔ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : ofDigits b (digits b n) = ofDigits b [] := by rw [h]
    convert! this
    rw [ofDigits_digits]
  · rintro rfl
    simp

name: digits_ne_nil_iff_ne_zero
statement: theorem digits_ne_nil_iff_ne_zero {b n : ℕ} : digits b n ≠ [] ↔ n ≠ 0

name: digits_eq_cons_digits_div
statement:
theorem digits_eq_cons_digits_div {b n : ℕ} (h : 1 < b) (w : n ≠ 0) :
    digits b n = (n % b) :: digits b (n / b)

name: digits_getLast
statement:
theorem digits_getLast {b : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (h : 1 < b) (p q) :
    (digits b m).getLast p = (digits b (m / b)).getLast q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · simp [hm]
  simp only [digits_eq_cons_digits_div h hm]
  rw [List.getLast_cons]

name: digits.injective
statement: theorem digits.injective (b : ℕ) : Function.Injective b.digits

name: digits_inj_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem digits_inj_iff {b n m : ℕ} : b.digits n = b.digits m ↔ n = m

name: mul_ofDigits
statement:
theorem mul_ofDigits (n : ℕ) {b : ℕ} {l : List ℕ} :
    n * ofDigits b l = ofDigits b (l.map (n * ·))
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, ofDigits_cons, ofDigits_cons, ← ih]
    ring

name: ofDigits_inj_of_len_eq
proof:
:= by
  induction L1 generalizing L2 with
  | nil =>
    simp only [List.length_nil] at len
    exact (List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp len.symm).symm
  | cons D L ih => ?_
  obtain ⟨d, l, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_length_eq_add_one len.symm
  simp only [List.length_cons, add_left_inj] at len
  simp only [ofDigits_cons] at h
  have eqd : D = d := by
    have H : (D + b * ofDigits b L) % b = (d + b * ofDigits b l) % b := by rw [h]
    simpa [mod_eq_of_lt (w2 d List.mem_cons_self),
      mod_eq_of_lt (w1 D List.mem_cons_self)] using H
  simp only [eqd, add_right_inj, mul_left_cancel_iff_of_pos (zero_lt_of_lt hb)] at h
  have := ih len (fun a ha ↦ w1 a <| List.mem_cons_of_mem D ha)
    (fun a ha ↦ w2 a <| List.mem_cons_of_mem d ha) h
  rw [eqd, this]

name: ofDigits_add_ofDigits_eq_ofDigits_zipWith_of_length_eq
proof:
:= by
  induction l1 generalizing l2 with
  | nil => simp_all [eq_comm, List.length_eq_zero_iff, ofDigits]
  | cons hd₁ tl₁ ih₁ =>
    induction l2 generalizing tl₁ with
    | nil => simp_all
    | cons hd₂ tl₂ ih₂ =>
      simp_all only [List.length_cons, ofDigits_cons, add_left_inj,
        eq_comm, List.zipWith_cons_cons]
      rw [← ih₁ h.symm, mul_add]
      ac_rfl

name: digits_lt_base'
statement: theorem digits_lt_base' {b m : ℕ} : ∀ {d}, d ∈ digits (b + 2) m → d < b + 2
proof:
:= by
  induction m using Nat.strongRecOn with | ind n IH => ?_
  intro d hd
  rcases n with - | n
  · rw [digits_zero] at hd
    cases hd
  
  rw [digits_add_two_add_one] at hd
  cases hd
  · exact n.succ.mod_lt (by linarith)
  · apply IH ((n + 1) / (b + 2))
    · apply Nat.div_lt_self <;> lia
    · assumption

name: digits_lt_base
statement: theorem digits_lt_base {b m d : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hd : d ∈ digits b m) : d < b
proof:
:= by
  rcases b with (_ | _ | b) <;> simp_all [@digits_lt_base' _ m d]

name: ofDigits_lt_base_pow_length'
statement:
theorem ofDigits_lt_base_pow_length' {b : ℕ} {l : List ℕ} (hl : ∀ x ∈ l, x < b + 2) :
    ofDigits (b + 2) l < (b + 2) ^ l.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [ofDigits]
  | cons hd tl IH =>
    rw [ofDigits, List.length_cons, pow_succ]
    have : (ofDigits (b + 2) tl + 1) * (b + 2) ≤ (b + 2) ^ tl.length * (b + 2) :=
      mul_le_mul (IH fun x hx => hl _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)) (by rfl) (by simp only [zero_le])
        (Nat.zero_le _)
    suffices ↑hd < b + 2 by linarith
    exact hl hd List.mem_cons_self

name: ofDigits_lt_base_pow_length
statement:
theorem ofDigits_lt_base_pow_length {b : ℕ} {l : List ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hl : ∀ x ∈ l, x < b) :
    ofDigits b l < b ^ l.length
proof:
:= by
  rcases b with (_ | _ | b) <;> simp_all [ofDigits_lt_base_pow_length']

name: lt_base_pow_length_digits'
statement: theorem lt_base_pow_length_digits' {b m : ℕ} : m < (b + 2) ^ (digits (b + 2) m).length
proof:
:= by
  convert! @ofDigits_lt_base_pow_length' b (digits (b + 2) m) fun _ => digits_lt_base'
  rw [ofDigits_digits (b + 2) m]

name: lt_base_pow_length_digits
statement: theorem lt_base_pow_length_digits {b m : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) : m < b ^ (digits b m).length
proof:
:= by
  rcases b with (_ | _ | b) <;> simp_all [lt_base_pow_length_digits']

name: digits_base_mul
statement:
theorem digits_base_mul {b m : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hm : 0 < m) :
    b.digits (b * m) = 0 :: b.digits m
proof:
:= by
  rw [digits_def' hb (by positivity)]
  simp [mul_div_right m (by positivity)]

name: digits_base_pow_mul
statement:
theorem digits_base_pow_mul {b k m : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hm : 0 < m) :
    digits b (b ^ k * m) = List.replicate k 0 ++ digits b m
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ', mul_assoc, digits_base_mul hb (by positivity), ih hm, List.replicate_succ,
      List.cons_append]

name: ofDigits_digits_append_digits
statement:
theorem ofDigits_digits_append_digits {b m n : ℕ} :
    ofDigits b (digits b n ++ digits b m) = n + b ^ (digits b n).length * m

name: ofDigits_monotone
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem ofDigits_monotone {p q : ℕ} (L : List ℕ) (h : p ≤ q) : ofDigits p L ≤ ofDigits q L
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ hi =>
    simp only [ofDigits, cast_id, add_le_add_iff_left]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul h hi

name: sum_le_ofDigits
statement: theorem sum_le_ofDigits {p : ℕ} (L : List ℕ) (h : 1 ≤ p) : L.sum ≤ ofDigits p L

name: digit_sum_le
statement: theorem digit_sum_le (p n : ℕ) : List.sum (digits p n) ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact digits_zero _ ▸ Nat.le_refl (List.sum [])
  | succ n =>
    induction p with
    | zero => rw [digits_zero_succ, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, add_zero]
    | succ p =>
      nth_rw 2 [← ofDigits_digits p.succ (n + 1)]
      rw [← ofDigits_one <| digits p.succ n.succ]
      exact ofDigits_monotone (digits p.succ n.succ) <| Nat.succ_pos p

name: ofDigits_div_eq_ofDigits_tail
statement:
lemma ofDigits_div_eq_ofDigits_tail {p : ℕ} (hpos : 0 < p) (digits : List ℕ)
    (w₁ : ∀ l ∈ digits, l < p) : ofDigits p digits / p = ofDigits p digits.tail
proof:
:= by
  induction digits with
  | nil => simp [ofDigits]
  | cons hd tl =>
    refine Eq.trans (add_mul_div_left hd _ hpos) ?_
    rw [Nat.div_eq_of_lt <| w₁ _ List.mem_cons_self, zero_add, List.tail_cons]

name: ofDigits_div_pow_eq_ofDigits_drop
statement:
lemma ofDigits_div_pow_eq_ofDigits_drop
    {p : ℕ} (i : ℕ) (hpos : 0 < p) (digits : List ℕ) (w₁ : ∀ l ∈ digits, l < p) :
    ofDigits p digits / p ^ i = ofDigits p (digits.drop i)
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i hi =>
    rw [Nat.pow_succ, ← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, hi, ofDigits_div_eq_ofDigits_tail hpos
      (List.drop i digits) fun x hx ↦ w₁ x <| List.mem_of_mem_drop hx, ← List.drop_one,
      List.drop_drop, add_comm]

name: self_div_pow_eq_ofDigits_drop
statement:
lemma self_div_pow_eq_ofDigits_drop {p : ℕ} (i n : ℕ) (h : 2 ≤ p) :
    n / p ^ i = ofDigits p ((p.digits n).drop i)
proof:
:= by
  convert!
    ofDigits_div_pow_eq_ofDigits_drop i (zero_lt_of_lt h) (p.digits n)
      (fun l hl ↦ digits_lt_base h hl)
  exact (ofDigits_digits p n).symm

name: ofDigits_mod_pow_eq_ofDigits_take
statement:
lemma ofDigits_mod_pow_eq_ofDigits_take
    {p : ℕ} (i : ℕ) (hpos : 0 < p) (digits : List ℕ) (w₁ : ∀ l ∈ digits, l < p) :
    ofDigits p digits % p ^ i = ofDigits p (digits.take i)
proof:
:= by
  induction i generalizing digits with
  | zero => simp [mod_one]
  | succ i ih =>
    cases digits with
    | nil => simp
    | cons hd tl =>
      rw [List.take_succ_cons, ofDigits_cons, ofDigits_cons,
        ← ih _ fun x hx ↦ w₁ x <| List.mem_cons_of_mem hd hx, add_mod,
        mod_eq_of_lt <| lt_of_lt_of_le (w₁ hd List.mem_cons_self) (le_pow <| add_one_pos i),
        pow_succ', mul_mod_mul_left, mod_eq_of_lt]
      apply add_lt_of_lt_sub
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le (b := p)
      · exact w₁ hd List.mem_cons_self
      · rw [← Nat.mul_sub]
        exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ <| Nat.sub_pos_of_lt <| mod_lt _ <| pow_pos hpos i

name: self_mod_pow_eq_ofDigits_take
statement:
lemma self_mod_pow_eq_ofDigits_take {p : ℕ} (i n : ℕ) (h : 2 ≤ p) :
    n % p ^ i = ofDigits p ((p.digits n).take i)
proof:
:= by
  convert!
    ofDigits_mod_pow_eq_ofDigits_take i (zero_lt_of_lt h) (p.digits n)
      (fun l hl ↦ digits_lt_base h hl)
  exact (ofDigits_digits p n).symm

name: toDigitsCore_lens_eq_aux
statement:
lemma toDigitsCore_lens_eq_aux (b f : Nat) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (l1 l2 : List Char), l1.length = l2.length →
    (Nat.toDigitsCore b f n l1).length = (Nat.toDigitsCore b f n l2).length
proof:
:= by
  induction f with (simp only [Nat.toDigitsCore]; intro n l1 l2 hlen)
  | zero => assumption
  | succ f ih =>
    if hx : n / b = 0 then
      simp only [hx, ite_true, List.length, congrArg (fun l ↦ l + 1) hlen]
    else
      simp only [hx, ite_false]
      specialize ih (n / b) (Nat.digitChar (n % b) :: l1) (Nat.digitChar (n % b) :: l2)
      simp only [List.length, congrArg (fun l ↦ l + 1) hlen] at ih
      exact ih trivial

name: toDigitsCore_lens_eq
statement:
lemma toDigitsCore_lens_eq (b f : Nat) : ∀ (n : Nat) (c : Char) (tl : List Char),
    (Nat.toDigitsCore b f n (c :: tl)).length = (Nat.toDigitsCore b f n tl).length + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction f with (intro n c tl; simp only [Nat.toDigitsCore, List.length])
  | succ f ih =>
    grind

name: nat_repr_len_aux
statement: lemma nat_repr_len_aux (n b e : Nat) (h_b_pos : 0 < b) : n < b ^ e.succ → n / b < b ^ e
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Nat.pow_succ]
  exact (@Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul b n (b ^ e) h_b_pos).mpr

name: toDigitsCore_length
statement:
lemma toDigitsCore_length (b f n e : Nat) (h_e_pos : 0 < e) (hlt : n < b ^ e) :
    (Nat.toDigitsCore b f n []).length ≤ e
proof:
:= by
  induction f generalizing n e hlt h_e_pos with
  | zero => simp only [toDigitsCore, List.length, zero_le]
  | succ f ih =>
    simp only [toDigitsCore]
    cases e with
    | zero => exact False.elim (Nat.lt_irrefl 0 h_e_pos)
    | succ e =>
      cases e with
      | zero =>
        rw [zero_add, pow_one] at hlt
        simp [Nat.div_eq_of_lt hlt]
      | succ e =>
        specialize ih (n / b) _ (add_one_pos e) (Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul <| by rwa [← pow_add_one'])
        split_ifs
        · simp
        · simp only [toDigitsCore_lens_eq b f (n / b) (Nat.digitChar <| n % b),
            Nat.succ_le_succ_iff, ih]

name: toDigits_length
statement: lemma toDigits_length (b n e : Nat) : 0 < e → n < b ^ e → (Nat.toDigits b n).length ≤ e

name: repr_length
statement: lemma repr_length (n e : Nat) : 0 < e → n < 10 ^ e → (Nat.repr n).length ≤ e

theorem fib_zero : fib 0 = 0

theorem fib_one : fib 1 = 1

name: fib_add_one
statement:
lemma fib_add_one : ∀ {n}, n ≠ 0 → fib (n + 1) = fib (n - 1) + fib n
  | _n + 1, _ => fib_add_two

name: fib_le_fib_succ
statement: theorem fib_le_fib_succ {n : ℕ} : fib n ≤ fib (n + 1)

@[gcongr, mono]
theorem fib_mono : Monotone fib

name: fib_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma fib_eq_zero : ∀ {n}, fib n = 0 ↔ n = 0
| 0 => Iff.rfl
| 1 => Iff.rfl
| n + 2 => by simp [fib_add_two, fib_eq_zero]

name: fib_pos
statement: @[simp] lemma fib_pos {n : ℕ} : 0 < fib n ↔ 0 < n

name: fib_add_two_sub_fib_add_one
statement: theorem fib_add_two_sub_fib_add_one {n : ℕ} : fib (n + 2) - fib (n + 1) = fib n

name: fib_lt_fib_succ
statement: theorem fib_lt_fib_succ {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) : fib n < fib (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_add_of_le hn with ⟨n, rfl⟩
  rw [← tsub_pos_iff_lt, add_comm 2, add_right_comm, fib_add_two, add_tsub_cancel_right, fib_pos]
  exact succ_pos n

name: fib_add_two_strictMono
statement: theorem fib_add_two_strictMono : StrictMono fun n => fib (n + 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun n => ?_
  rw [add_right_comm]
  exact fib_lt_fib_succ (self_le_add_left _ _)

name: fib_strictMonoOn
statement:
lemma fib_strictMonoOn : StrictMonoOn fib (Set.Ici 2)
  | _m + 2, _, _n + 2, _, hmn => fib_add_two_strictMono <| lt_of_add_lt_add_right hmn

name: fib_lt_fib
statement:
lemma fib_lt_fib {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) : ∀ {n}, fib m < fib n ↔ m < n
  | 0 => by simp
  | 1 => by simp
  | n + 2 => fib_strictMonoOn.lt_iff_lt hm <| by simp

name: le_fib_self
statement: theorem le_fib_self {n : ℕ} (five_le_n : 5 ≤ n) : n ≤ fib n
proof:
:= by
  induction five_le_n with
  | refl => rfl 
  | @step n five_le_n IH => 
    rw [succ_le_iff]
    calc
      n ≤ fib n := IH
      _ < fib (n + 1) := fib_lt_fib_succ (le_trans (by decide) five_le_n)

name: le_fib_add_one
statement:
lemma le_fib_add_one : ∀ n, n ≤ fib n + 1
  | 0 => zero_le_one
  | 1 => one_le_two
  | 2 => le_rfl
  | 3 => le_rfl
  | 4 => le_rfl
  | _n + 5 => (le_fib_self le_add_self).trans <| le_succ _

/

name: fib_coprime_fib_succ
statement: theorem fib_coprime_fib_succ (n : ℕ) : Nat.Coprime (fib n) (fib (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => simp only [fib_add_two, coprime_add_self_right, Coprime, ih.symm]

name: fib_add
statement: theorem fib_add (m n : ℕ) : fib (m + n + 1) = fib m * fib n + fib (m + 1) * fib (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    specialize ih (m + 1)
    rw [add_assoc m 1 n, add_comm 1 n] at ih
    simp only [fib_add_two, ih]
    ring

name: fib_two_mul
statement: theorem fib_two_mul (n : ℕ) : fib (2 * n) = fib n * (2 * fib (n + 1) - fib n)
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · simp
  · rw [two_mul, ← add_assoc, fib_add, fib_add_two, two_mul]
    simp only [← add_assoc, add_tsub_cancel_right]
    ring

name: fib_two_mul_add_one
statement: theorem fib_two_mul_add_one (n : ℕ) : fib (2 * n + 1) = fib (n + 1) ^ 2 + fib n ^ 2

name: fib_two_mul_add_two
statement:
theorem fib_two_mul_add_two (n : ℕ) :
    fib (2 * n + 2) = fib (n + 1) * (2 * fib n + fib (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fib_add_two, fib_two_mul, fib_two_mul_add_one]
  have : fib n ≤ 2 * fib (n + 1) :=
    le_trans fib_le_fib_succ (mul_comm 2 _ ▸ Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ two_pos)
  zify [this]
  ring

name: fastFibAux_bit_false
statement:
theorem fastFibAux_bit_false (n : ℕ) :
    fastFibAux (bit false n) =
      let p
proof:
:= fastFibAux n
      (p.1 * (2 * p.2 - p.1), p.2 ^ 2 + p.1 ^ 2) := by
  rw [fastFibAux, binaryRec_eq]
  · rfl
  · simp

name: fastFibAux_bit_true
statement:
theorem fastFibAux_bit_true (n : ℕ) :
    fastFibAux (bit true n) =
      let p
proof:
:= fastFibAux n
      (p.2 ^ 2 + p.1 ^ 2, p.2 * (2 * p.1 + p.2)) := by
  rw [fastFibAux, binaryRec_eq]
  · rfl
  · simp

name: fastFibAux_eq
statement: theorem fastFibAux_eq (n : ℕ) : fastFibAux n = (fib n, fib (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.binaryRec ?_ ?_ n
  · simp [fastFibAux]
  · rintro (_ | _) n' ih <;>
      simp only [fastFibAux_bit_false, fastFibAux_bit_true, congr_arg Prod.fst ih,
        congr_arg Prod.snd ih, Prod.mk_inj] <;>
      simp [bit, fib_two_mul, fib_two_mul_add_one, fib_two_mul_add_two]

theorem fib_eq_fastFib : fib = fastFib

name: gcd_fib_add_self
statement: theorem gcd_fib_add_self (m n : ℕ) : gcd (fib m) (fib (n + m)) = gcd (fib m) (fib n)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | h
  · simp
  replace h := Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos h; rw [← h, succ_eq_add_one]
  calc
    gcd (fib m) (fib (n.pred + 1 + m)) =
        gcd (fib m) (fib n.pred * fib m + fib (n.pred + 1) * fib (m + 1)) := by
        rw [← fib_add n.pred _]
        ring_nf
    _ = gcd (fib m) (fib (n.pred + 1) * fib (m + 1)) := by
        rw [add_comm, gcd_add_mul_right_right (fib m) _ (fib n.pred)]
    _ = gcd (fib m) (fib (n.pred + 1)) :=
      Coprime.gcd_mul_right_cancel_right (fib (n.pred + 1)) (Coprime.symm (fib_coprime_fib_succ m))

name: gcd_fib_add_mul_self
statement:
theorem gcd_fib_add_mul_self (m n : ℕ) : ∀ k, gcd (fib m) (fib (n + k * m)) = gcd (fib m) (fib n)
  | 0 => by simp
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [← gcd_fib_add_mul_self m n k, add_mul, ← add_assoc, one_mul, gcd_fib_add_self _ _]

/

name: fib_gcd
statement: theorem fib_gcd (m n : ℕ) : fib (gcd m n) = gcd (fib m) (fib n)
proof:
:= by
  induction m, n using Nat.gcd.induction with
  | H0 => simp
  | H1 m n _ h' =>
    rw [← gcd_rec m n] at h'
    conv_rhs => rw [← mod_add_div' n m]
    rwa [gcd_fib_add_mul_self m (n % m) (n / m), gcd_comm (fib m) _]

name: fib_succ_eq_sum_choose
statement:
theorem fib_succ_eq_sum_choose :
    ∀ n : ℕ, fib (n + 1) = ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, choose p.1 p.2
proof:
:=
  twoStepInduction rfl rfl fun n h1 h2 => by
    rw [fib_add_two, h1, h2, Finset.Nat.antidiagonal_succ_succ', Finset.Nat.antidiagonal_succ']
    simp [choose_succ_succ, Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_left_comm]

name: fib_succ_eq_succ_sum
statement: theorem fib_succ_eq_succ_sum (n : ℕ) : fib (n + 1) = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, fib k) + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    calc
      fib (n + 2) = fib n + fib (n + 1) := fib_add_two
      _ = (fib n + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, fib k) + 1 := by rw [ih, add_assoc]
      _ = (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), fib k) + 1 := by simp [Finset.range_add_one]

name: IsZeckendorfRep_nil
statement:
@[simp]
lemma IsZeckendorfRep_nil : IsZeckendorfRep []

name: IsZeckendorfRep.sum_fib_lt
statement:
lemma IsZeckendorfRep.sum_fib_lt : ∀ {n l}, IsZeckendorfRep l → (∀ a ∈ (l ++ [0]).head?, a < n) →
    (l.map fib).sum < fib n
  | _, [], _, hn => fib_pos.2 <| hn _ rfl
  | n, a :: l, hl, hn => by
    simp only [IsZeckendorfRep, cons_append, isChain_iff_pairwise, pairwise_cons] at hl
    have : ∀ b, b ∈ head? (l ++ [0]) → b < a - 1
proof:
:=
      fun b hb ↦ lt_tsub_iff_right.2 <| hl.1 _ <| mem_of_mem_head? hb
    simp only [mem_append, mem_singleton, ← isChain_iff_pairwise, or_imp, forall_and, forall_eq,
      zero_add] at hl
    calc
      fib a + (map fib l).sum < fib a + fib (a - 1) := by gcongr; exact sum_fib_lt hl.2 this
      _ ≤ fib n := by
        rw [add_comm, ← fib_add_one (hl.1.2.trans_lt' zero_lt_two).ne']; exact fib_mono (hn _ rfl)

name: le_greatestFib

proof:

    fun h ↦ le_findGreatest (m.le_fib_add_one.trans <| by gcongr) h⟩

statement:
@[simp] lemma greatestFib_fib : ∀ {n}, n ≠ 1 → greatestFib (fib n) = n
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | _n + 2, _ => findGreatest_eq_iff.2
    ⟨le_fib_add_one _, fun _ ↦ le_rfl, fun _m hnm _ ↦ ((fib_lt_fib le_add_self).2 hnm).not_ge⟩

proof:

name: greatestFib_sub_fib_greatestFib_le_greatestFib
statement:
lemma greatestFib_sub_fib_greatestFib_le_greatestFib (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    greatestFib (n - fib (greatestFib n)) ≤ greatestFib n - 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.lt_succ_iff, greatestFib_lt, tsub_lt_iff_right n.fib_greatestFib_le, Nat.sub_succ,
    succ_pred, ← fib_add_one]
  · exact n.lt_fib_greatestFib_add_one
  · simpa
  · simpa [← succ_le_iff, tsub_eq_zero_iff_le] using hn.bot_lt

statement:

name: isZeckendorfRep_zeckendorf
statement:
lemma isZeckendorfRep_zeckendorf : ∀ n, (zeckendorf n).IsZeckendorfRep
  | 0 => by simp only [zeckendorf_zero, IsZeckendorfRep_nil]
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [zeckendorf_succ, IsZeckendorfRep, List.cons_append]
    refine (isZeckendorfRep_zeckendorf _).cons (fun a ha ↦ ?_)
    obtain h | h
proof:
:= eq_zero_or_pos (n + 1 - fib (greatestFib (n + 1)))
    · simp only [h, zeckendorf_zero, nil_append, head?_cons, Option.mem_some_iff] at ha
      subst ha
      exact le_greatestFib.2 le_add_self
    rw [zeckendorf_of_pos h, cons_append, head?_cons, Option.mem_some_iff] at ha
    subst a
    exact add_le_of_le_tsub_right_of_le (le_greatestFib.2 le_add_self)
      (greatestFib_sub_fib_greatestFib_le_greatestFib n.succ_ne_zero)

name: zeckendorf_sum_fib
statement:
lemma zeckendorf_sum_fib : ∀ {l}, IsZeckendorfRep l → zeckendorf (l.map fib).sum = l
  | [], _ => by simp only [map_nil, List.sum_nil, zeckendorf_zero]
  | a :: l, hl => by
    have hl'
proof:
:= hl
    simp only [IsZeckendorfRep, cons_append, isChain_iff_pairwise, pairwise_cons, mem_append,
      mem_singleton, or_imp, forall_and, forall_eq, zero_add] at hl
    rw [← isChain_iff_pairwise] at hl
    have ha : 0 < a := hl.1.2.trans_lt' zero_lt_two
    suffices h : greatestFib (fib a + sum (map fib l)) = a by
      simp only [map, List.sum_cons, add_pos_iff, fib_pos.2 ha, true_or, zeckendorf_of_pos, h,
      add_tsub_cancel_left, zeckendorf_sum_fib hl.2]
    simp only [add_comm, add_assoc, greatestFib, findGreatest_eq_iff, ne_eq, ha.ne',
      not_false_eq_true, le_add_iff_nonneg_left, _root_.zero_le, forall_true_left, not_le, true_and]
    refine ⟨le_add_of_le_right <| le_fib_add_one _, fun n hn _ ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [add_comm, ← List.sum_cons, ← map_cons]
    exact hl'.sum_fib_lt (by simpa)

statement: @[simp] lemma sum_zeckendorf_fib (n : ℕ) : (n.zeckendorf.map fib).sum = n

statement: theorem pow_minFac {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) : (n ^ k).minFac = n.minFac
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 1 with (rfl | hn)
  · simp
  have hnk : n ^ k ≠ 1 := fun hk' => hn ((pow_eq_one_iff_left hk).1 hk')
  apply (minFac_le_of_dvd (minFac_prime hn).two_le ((minFac_dvd n).pow hk)).antisymm
  apply
    minFac_le_of_dvd (minFac_prime hnk).two_le
      ((minFac_prime hnk).dvd_of_dvd_pow (minFac_dvd _))

name: prime_iff_prime_int
statement: theorem prime_iff_prime_int {p : ℕ} : p.Prime ↔ _root_.Prime (p : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hp =>
    ⟨Int.natCast_ne_zero_iff_pos.2 hp.pos, mt Int.isUnit_iff_natAbs_eq.1 hp.ne_one, fun a b h => by
      rw [← Int.dvd_natAbs, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, Int.natAbs_mul, hp.dvd_mul] at h
      rwa [← Int.dvd_natAbs, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, ← Int.dvd_natAbs, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast]⟩,
    fun hp =>
    Nat.prime_iff.2
      ⟨Int.natCast_ne_zero.1 hp.1,
        (mt Nat.isUnit_iff.1) fun h => by simp [h] at hp, fun a b => by
        simpa only [Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, (Int.natCast_mul _ _).symm] using hp.2.2 a b⟩⟩

name: Prime.pow_inj
statement:
lemma Prime.pow_inj {p q m n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime)
    (h : p ^ (m + 1) = q ^ (n + 1)) : p = q ∧ m = n
proof:
:= by
  have H := dvd_antisymm (Prime.dvd_of_dvd_pow hp <| h ▸ dvd_pow_self p (succ_ne_zero m))
    (Prime.dvd_of_dvd_pow hq <| h.symm ▸ dvd_pow_self q (succ_ne_zero n))
  exact ⟨H, succ_inj.mp <| Nat.pow_right_injective hq.two_le (H ▸ h)⟩

name: Prime.pow_inj'
statement:
lemma Prime.pow_inj'
    {p q m n : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hq : Nat.Prime q) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (h : p ^ m = q ^ n) : p = q ∧ m = n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero hm
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero hn
  simpa using hp.pow_inj hq h

statement:

name: dvd_of_forall_prime_mul_dvd
statement:
theorem dvd_of_forall_prime_mul_dvd {a b : ℕ}

proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 1
  · apply one_dvd
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_prime_and_dvd ha
  exact _root_.trans (dvd_mul_left a p) (hdvd p hp.1 hp.2)

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h 2 prime_two, fun p hp _ ↦ h p hp⟩, fun h p hp ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain rfl | hne := eq_or_ne p 2

proof:

proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  · intro h
    exact
      ⟨minFac (gcd m n), minFac_prime h, (minFac_dvd (gcd m n)).trans (gcd_dvd_left m n),
        (minFac_dvd (gcd m n)).trans (gcd_dvd_right m n)⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := h
    apply Nat.not_coprime_of_dvd_of_dvd (Prime.one_lt hp.1) hp.2.1 hp.2.2

proof:

  rw [← not_not (a := n.Coprime m), Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd]
  push Not
  exact fun p hp hn hm ↦
    ((le_of_dvd (by lia) hm).trans_lt <| h.trans_le <| minFac_le_of_dvd hp.two_le hn).false

proof:

  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => by rw [h.1, h.2, pow_one]⟩
  rw [← h] at hp
  rw [← h, hp.eq_one_of_pow, eq_self_iff_true, _root_.and_true, pow_one]

name: Prime.mul_eq_prime_sq_iff
statement:
theorem Prime.mul_eq_prime_sq_iff {x y p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hx : x ≠ 1) (hy : y ≠ 1) :
    x * y = p ^ 2 ↔ x = p ∧ y = p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => h₁.symm ▸ h₂.symm ▸ (sq _).symm⟩
  have pdvdxy : p ∣ x * y := by rw [h]; simp [sq]
  
  suffices ∀ x' y' : ℕ, x' ≠ 1 → y' ≠ 1 → x' * y' = p ^ 2 → p ∣ x' → x' = p ∧ y' = p by
    obtain hx | hy := hp.dvd_mul.1 pdvdxy <;>
      [skip; rw [And.comm]] <;>
      [skip; rw [mul_comm] at h pdvdxy] <;>
      apply this <;>
      assumption
  rintro x y hx hy h ⟨a, ha⟩
  have : a ∣ p := ⟨y, by rwa [ha, sq, mul_assoc, mul_right_inj' hp.ne_zero, eq_comm] at h⟩
  obtain rfl | hap := (Nat.dvd_prime hp).mp ‹a ∣ p›
  · rw [mul_one] at ha
    subst ha
    simp only [sq, mul_right_inj' hp.ne_zero] at h
    subst h
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · refine (hy ?_).elim
    subst hap
    subst ha
    rw [sq, Nat.mul_eq_left (Nat.mul_ne_zero hp.ne_zero hp.ne_zero)] at h
    exact h

statement:
theorem Prime.dvd_mul_of_dvd_ne {p1 p2 n : ℕ} (h_ne : p1 ≠ p2) (pp1 : Prime p1) (pp2 : Prime p2)
    (h1 : p1 ∣ n) (h2 : p2 ∣ n) : p1 * p2 ∣ n
proof:
:=
  Coprime.mul_dvd_of_dvd_of_dvd ((coprime_primes pp1 pp2).mpr h_ne) h1 h2

name: eq_prime_pow_of_dvd_least_prime_pow
statement:
theorem eq_prime_pow_of_dvd_least_prime_pow {a p k : ℕ} (pp : Prime p) (h₁ : ¬a ∣ p ^ k)
    (h₂ : a ∣ p ^ (k + 1)) : a = p ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, ⟨h, rfl⟩⟩ := (dvd_prime_pow pp).1 h₂
  congr
  exact le_antisymm h (not_le.1 ((not_congr (pow_dvd_pow_iff_le_right (Prime.one_lt pp))).1 h₁))

name: ne_one_iff_exists_prime_dvd
statement:
theorem ne_one_iff_exists_prime_dvd : ∀ {n}, n ≠ 1 ↔ ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ p ∣ n
  | 0 => by simpa using Exists.intro 2 Nat.prime_two
  | 1 => by simp [Nat.not_prime_one]
  | n + 2 => by
    let a
proof:
:= n + 2
    have ha : a ≠ 1 := Nat.succ_succ_ne_one n
    simp only [a, true_iff, Ne, not_false_iff, ha]
    exact ⟨a.minFac, Nat.minFac_prime ha, a.minFac_dvd⟩

name: succ_dvd_or_succ_dvd_of_succ_sum_dvd_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hpd : p ^ (k + l) * p ∣ m * n := by
      let hpmn' : p ^ (succ (k + l)) ∣ m * n := hpmn
      rwa [pow_succ'] at hpmn'
  have hpd2 : p ∣ m * n / p ^ (k + l) := dvd_div_of_mul_dvd hpd
  have hpd3 : p ∣ m * n / (p ^ k * p ^ l) := by simpa [pow_add] using hpd2
  have hpd4 : p ∣ m / p ^ k * (n / p ^ l) := by simpa [Nat.div_mul_div_comm hpm hpn] using hpd3
  have hpd5 : p ∣ m / p ^ k ∨ p ∣ n / p ^ l :=
    (Prime.dvd_mul p_prime).1 hpd4
  suffices p ^ k * p ∣ m ∨ p ^ l * p ∣ n by rwa [_root_.pow_succ, _root_.pow_succ]
  exact hpd5.elim (fun h : p ∣ m / p ^ k => Or.inl <| mul_dvd_of_dvd_div hpm h)
    fun h : p ∣ n / p ^ l => Or.inr <| mul_dvd_of_dvd_div hpn h

name: Prime.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd
statement:
theorem Prime.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd {p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ∣ p) :
    m = 1 ∨ m = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hm
  have := pp.isUnit_or_isUnit hn
  rw [Nat.isUnit_iff, Nat.isUnit_iff] at this
  apply Or.imp_right _ this
  rintro rfl
  rw [hn, mul_one]

name: prime_def
statement:
@[inherit_doc Nat.Prime]
theorem prime_def {p : ℕ} : Prime p ↔ 2 ≤ p ∧ ∀ m, m ∣ p → m = 1 ∨ m = p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ⟨h.two_le, h.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd⟩, fun h => ?_⟩
  have h1 := Nat.one_lt_two.trans_le h.1
  refine ⟨mt Nat.isUnit_iff.mp h1.ne', ?_⟩
  rintro a b rfl
  simp only [Nat.isUnit_iff]
  refine (h.2 a <| dvd_mul_right ..).imp_right fun hab ↦ ?_
  rw [← mul_right_inj' (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt h1), ← hab, ← hab, mul_one]

name: prime_def_lt
statement: theorem prime_def_lt {p : ℕ} : Prime p ↔ 2 ≤ p ∧ ∀ m < p, m ∣ p → m = 1
proof:
:=
  prime_def.trans <|
    and_congr_right fun p2 =>
      forall_congr' fun _ =>
        ⟨fun h l d => (h d).resolve_right (ne_of_lt l), fun h d =>
          (le_of_dvd (le_of_succ_le p2) d).lt_or_eq_dec.imp_left fun l => h l d⟩

name: prime_def_lt'
statement: theorem prime_def_lt' {p : ℕ} : Prime p ↔ 2 ≤ p ∧ ∀ m, 2 ≤ m → m < p → ¬m ∣ p
proof:
:=
  prime_def_lt.trans <|
    and_congr_right fun p2 =>
      forall_congr' fun m =>
        ⟨fun h m2 l d => not_lt_of_ge m2 ((h l d).symm ▸ by decide), fun h l d => by
          rcases m with (_ | _ | m)
          · omega
          · rfl
          · exact (h (le_add_left 2 m) l).elim d⟩

name: prime_def_le_sqrt
statement: theorem prime_def_le_sqrt {p : ℕ} : Prime p ↔ 2 ≤ p ∧ ∀ m, 2 ≤ m → m ≤ sqrt p → ¬m ∣ p
proof:
:=
  prime_def_lt'.trans <|
    and_congr_right fun p2 =>
      ⟨fun a m m2 l => a m m2 <| lt_of_le_of_lt l <| sqrt_lt_self p2, fun a m m2 l mdvd@⟨k, e⟩ => by
        rcases le_sqrt_of_eq_mul e with hm | hk
        · exact a m m2 hm mdvd
        · rw [mul_comm] at e
          exact a k (Nat.lt_of_mul_lt_mul_right (a := m) (by rwa [one_mul, ← e])) hk ⟨m, e⟩⟩

name: prime_iff_not_exists_mul_eq
statement:
theorem prime_iff_not_exists_mul_eq {p : ℕ} :
    p.Prime ↔ 2 ≤ p ∧ ¬ ∃ m n, m < p ∧ n < p ∧ m * n = p
proof:
:= by
  push Not
  simp_rw [prime_def_lt, dvd_def, exists_imp]
  refine and_congr_right fun hp ↦ forall_congr' fun m ↦ (forall_congr' fun h ↦ ?_).trans forall_comm
  simp_rw [Ne, forall_comm (β := _ = _), eq_comm, imp_false, not_lt]
  refine forall₂_congr fun n hp ↦ ⟨by simp_all, fun hpn ↦ ?_⟩
  have := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (hp ▸ show p ≠ 0 by lia)
  exact (Nat.mul_eq_right (by lia)).mp
    (hp.symm.trans (hpn.antisymm (hp ▸ Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by lia))))

name: prime_of_coprime
statement: theorem prime_of_coprime (n : ℕ) (h1 : 1 < n) (h : ∀ m < n, m ≠ 0 → n.Coprime m) : Prime n
proof:
:= by
  refine prime_def_lt.mpr ⟨h1, fun m mlt mdvd => ?_⟩
  have hm : m ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_dvd_iff] at mdvd
    exact mlt.ne' mdvd
  exact (h m mlt hm).symm.eq_one_of_dvd mdvd

theorem minFac_zero : minFac 0 = 2

name: minFac_eq
statement: theorem minFac_eq (n : ℕ) : minFac n = if 2 ∣ n then 2 else minFacAux n 3

name: minFacAux_has_prop
statement:
private theorem minFacAux_has_prop {n : ℕ} (n2 : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∀ k i, k = 2 * i + 3 → (∀ m, 2 ≤ m → m ∣ n → k ≤ m) → minFacProp n (minFacAux n k)
  | k => fun i e a => by
    rw [minFacAux]
    by_cases h : n < k * k
    · have pp : Prime n
proof:
:=
        prime_def_le_sqrt.2
          ⟨n2, fun m m2 l d => not_lt_of_ge l <| lt_of_lt_of_le (sqrt_lt.2 h) (a m m2 d)⟩
      simpa only [k, h] using
        ⟨n2, dvd_rfl, fun m m2 d => le_of_eq ((dvd_prime_two_le pp m2).1 d).symm⟩
    have k2 : 2 ≤ k := by
      subst e
      apply Nat.le_add_left
    simp only [k, h, ↓reduceIte]
    by_cases dk : k ∣ n <;> simp only [k, dk, ↓reduceIte]
    · exact ⟨k2, dk, a⟩
    · refine
        have := minFac_lemma n k h
        minFacAux_has_prop n2 (k + 2) (i + 1) (by simp [k, e, Nat.left_distrib, add_right_comm])
          fun m m2 d => ?_
      rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le (a m m2 d) with rfl | ml
      · contradiction
      apply (Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le ml).resolve_left
      intro me
      rw [← me, e] at d
      have d' : 2 * (i + 2) ∣ n := d
      have := a _ le_rfl (dvd_of_mul_right_dvd d')
      rw [e] at this
      exact absurd this (by contradiction)
  termination_by k => sqrt n + 2 - k

name: minFac_has_prop
statement: private theorem minFac_has_prop {n : ℕ} (n1 : n ≠ 1) : minFacProp n (minFac n)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases n0 : n = 0
  · simp [n0, minFacProp]
  have n2 : 2 ≤ n := by
    revert n0 n1
    rcases n with (_ | _ | _) <;> simp [succ_le_succ]
  simp only [minFac_eq]
  by_cases d2 : 2 ∣ n <;> simp only [d2, ↓reduceIte]
  · exact ⟨le_rfl, d2, fun k k2 _ => k2⟩
  · refine
      minFacAux_has_prop n2 3 0 rfl fun m m2 d => (Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le m2).resolve_left (mt ?_ d2)
    exact fun e => e.symm ▸ d

name: minFac_dvd
statement: theorem minFac_dvd (n : ℕ) : minFac n ∣ n
proof:
:=
  if n1 : n = 1 then by simp [n1] else (minFac_has_prop n1).2.1

name: minFac_prime
statement: theorem minFac_prime {n : ℕ} (n1 : n ≠ 1) : Prime (minFac n)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨f2, fd, a⟩ := minFac_has_prop n1
  prime_def_lt'.2 ⟨f2, fun m m2 l d => not_le_of_gt l (a m m2 (d.trans fd))⟩

name: minFac_prime_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minFac_prime_iff {n : ℕ} : Prime (minFac n) ↔ n ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, minFac_prime⟩
  rintro h rfl
  simp only [minFac_one, not_prime_one] at h

name: minFac_le_of_dvd
statement: theorem minFac_le_of_dvd {n : ℕ} : ∀ {m : ℕ}, 2 ≤ m → m ∣ n → minFac n ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  by_cases n1 : n = 1
  · exact fun m2 _ => n1.symm ▸ le_trans (by simp) m2
  · apply (minFac_has_prop n1).2.2

name: minFac_pos
statement: theorem minFac_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < minFac n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases n1 : n = 1
  · simp [n1]
  · exact (minFac_prime n1).pos

name: minFac_le
statement: theorem minFac_le {n : ℕ} (H : 0 < n) : minFac n ≤ n

name: le_minFac
statement: theorem le_minFac {m n : ℕ} : n = 1 ∨ m ≤ minFac n ↔ ∀ p, Prime p → p ∣ n → m ≤ p
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h p pp d =>
    h.elim (by rintro rfl; cases pp.not_dvd_one d) fun h =>
      le_trans h <| minFac_le_of_dvd pp.two_le d,
    fun H => or_iff_not_imp_left.2 fun n1 => H _ (minFac_prime n1) (minFac_dvd _)⟩

name: le_minFac'
statement: theorem le_minFac' {m n : ℕ} : n = 1 ∨ m ≤ minFac n ↔ ∀ p, 2 ≤ p → p ∣ n → m ≤ p
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h p (pp : 1 < p) d =>
    h.elim (by rintro rfl; cases not_le_of_gt pp (le_of_dvd (by decide) d)) fun h =>
      le_trans h <| minFac_le_of_dvd pp d,
    fun H => le_minFac.2 fun p pp d => H p pp.two_le d⟩

name: prime_def_minFac
statement: theorem prime_def_minFac {p : ℕ} : Prime p ↔ 2 ≤ p ∧ minFac p = p
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun pp =>
    ⟨pp.two_le,
      let ⟨f2, fd, _⟩ := minFac_has_prop <| ne_of_gt pp.one_lt
      ((dvd_prime pp).1 fd).resolve_left (ne_of_gt f2)⟩,
    fun ⟨p2, e⟩ => e ▸ minFac_prime (ne_of_gt p2)⟩

name: Prime.minFac_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Prime.minFac_eq {p : ℕ} (hp : Prime p) : minFac p = p

name: decidablePrime_csimp
statement:
@[csimp] theorem decidablePrime_csimp :
    @decidablePrime = @decidablePrime'

name: not_prime_iff_minFac_lt
statement: theorem not_prime_iff_minFac_lt {n : ℕ} (n2 : 2 ≤ n) : ¬Prime n ↔ minFac n < n
proof:
:=
  (not_congr <| prime_def_minFac.trans <| and_iff_right n2).trans <|
    (lt_iff_le_and_ne.trans <| and_iff_right <| minFac_le <| le_of_succ_le n2).symm

name: minFac_le_div
statement: theorem minFac_le_div {n : ℕ} (pos : 0 < n) (np : ¬Prime n) : minFac n ≤ n / minFac n
proof:
:=
  match minFac_dvd n with
  | ⟨0, h0⟩ => absurd pos <| by rw [h0, mul_zero]; decide
  | ⟨1, h1⟩ => by
    rw [mul_one] at h1
    rw [prime_def_minFac, not_and_or, ← h1, eq_self_iff_true, _root_.not_true, _root_.or_false,
      not_le] at np
    rw [le_antisymm (le_of_lt_succ np) (succ_le_of_lt pos), minFac_one, Nat.div_one]
  | ⟨x + 2, hx⟩ => by
    conv_rhs =>
      congr
      rw [hx]
    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (minFac_pos _)]
    exact minFac_le_of_dvd (le_add_left 2 x) ⟨minFac n, by rwa [mul_comm]⟩

name: minFac_sq_le_self
statement: theorem minFac_sq_le_self {n : ℕ} (w : 0 < n) (h : ¬Prime n) : minFac n ^ 2 ≤ n
proof:
:=
  have t : minFac n ≤ n / minFac n := minFac_le_div w h
  calc
    minFac n ^ 2 = minFac n * minFac n := sq (minFac n)
    _ ≤ n / minFac n * minFac n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (minFac n) t
    _ ≤ n := div_mul_le_self n (minFac n)

name: minFac_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minFac_eq_one_iff {n : ℕ} : minFac n = 1 ↔ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hn
    have := minFac_prime hn
    rw [h] at this
    exact not_prime_one this
  · rintro rfl
    simp [minFac, minFacAux]

name: minFac_eq_two_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem minFac_eq_two_iff (n : ℕ) : minFac n = 2 ↔ 2 ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← h]
    exact minFac_dvd n
  · intro h
    have ub := minFac_le_of_dvd (le_refl 2) h
    have lb := minFac_pos n
    refine ub.eq_or_lt.resolve_right fun h' => ?_
    suffices n.minFac = 1 by simp_all
    exact (le_antisymm (Nat.succ_le_of_lt lb) (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp h')).symm

name: factors_lemma
statement: theorem factors_lemma {k} : (k + 2) / minFac (k + 2) < k + 2
proof:
:=
  div_lt_self (Nat.zero_lt_succ _) (minFac_prime (by
      apply Nat.ne_of_gt
      apply Nat.succ_lt_succ
      apply Nat.zero_lt_succ)).one_lt

name: exists_prime_and_dvd
statement: theorem exists_prime_and_dvd {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 1) : ∃ p, Prime p ∧ p ∣ n

name: coprime_of_dvd
statement: theorem coprime_of_dvd {m n : ℕ} (H : ∀ k, Prime k → k ∣ m → ¬k ∣ n) : Coprime m n
proof:
:= by
  rw [coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one]
  by_contra g2
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpdvd⟩ := exists_prime_and_dvd g2
  apply H p hp <;> apply dvd_trans hpdvd
  · exact gcd_dvd_left _ _
  · exact gcd_dvd_right _ _

name: Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd
statement: theorem Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd {p n : ℕ} (pp : Prime p) : Coprime p n ↔ ¬p ∣ n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun co d => pp.not_dvd_one <| co.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (by simp [d]), fun nd =>
    coprime_of_dvd fun _ m2 mp => ((prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq m2 pp).1 mp).symm ▸ nd⟩

name: Prime.dvd_mul
statement: theorem Prime.dvd_mul {p m n : ℕ} (pp : Prime p) : p ∣ m * n ↔ p ∣ m ∨ p ∣ n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H => or_iff_not_imp_left.2 fun h => (pp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.2 h).dvd_of_dvd_mul_left H,
    Or.rec (fun h : p ∣ m => h.mul_right _) fun h : p ∣ n => h.mul_left _⟩

name: exists_infinite_primes
statement: theorem exists_infinite_primes (n : ℕ) : ∃ p, n ≤ p ∧ Prime p
proof:
:=
  let p := minFac (n ! + 1)
  have f1 : n ! + 1 ≠ 1 := ne_of_gt <| succ_lt_succ <| factorial_pos _
  have pp : Prime p := minFac_prime f1
  have np : n ≤ p :=
    le_of_not_ge fun h =>
      have h₁ : p ∣ n ! := dvd_factorial (minFac_pos _) h
      have h₂ : p ∣ 1 := (Nat.dvd_add_iff_right h₁).2 (minFac_dvd _)
      pp.not_dvd_one h₂
  ⟨p, np, pp⟩

name: not_bddAbove_setOfPred_prime
statement: theorem not_bddAbove_setOfPred_prime : ¬BddAbove { p | Prime p }
proof:
:= by
  rw [not_bddAbove_iff]
  intro n
  obtain ⟨p, hi, hp⟩ := exists_infinite_primes n.succ
  exact ⟨p, hp, hi⟩

name: Prime.dvd_factorial
statement:
theorem Prime.dvd_factorial : ∀ {n p : ℕ} (_ : Prime p), p ∣ n ! ↔ p ≤ n
  | 0, _, hp => iff_of_false hp.not_dvd_one (not_le_of_gt hp.pos)
  | n + 1, p, hp => by
    rw [factorial_succ, hp.dvd_mul, Prime.dvd_factorial hp]
    exact
      ⟨fun h => h.elim (le_of_dvd (succ_pos _)) le_succ_of_le, fun h =>
        (_root_.lt_or_eq_of_le h).elim (Or.inr ∘ le_of_lt_succ) fun h => Or.inl <| by rw [h]⟩

name: coprime_factorial_iff
statement:
theorem coprime_factorial_iff {m n : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 1) :
    m.Coprime n ! ↔ n < m.minFac
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_le, iff_not_comm, Nat.Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨m.minFac, minFac_prime hm, minFac_dvd m, Nat.dvd_factorial (minFac_pos m) h⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, hdvd, hdvd'⟩
    exact le_trans (minFac_le_of_dvd hp.two_le hdvd) (hp.dvd_factorial.mp hdvd')

name: Prime.coprime_factorial_of_lt
statement:
lemma Prime.coprime_factorial_of_lt {p n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hn : n < p) :
    p.Coprime n.factorial

name: Prime.coprime_descFactorial_of_lt_of_le
statement:
lemma Prime.coprime_descFactorial_of_lt_of_le {p n k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hn : n < p) (hk : k ≤ n) :
    p.Coprime (n.descFactorial k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.descFactorial_eq_div hk]
  refine (hp.coprime_factorial_of_lt hn).coprime_div_right ?_
  simp [Nat.factorial_dvd_factorial]

statement:
theorem induction_on_union (P : Finset α → Finset α → Prop) (symm : ∀ {a b}, P a b → P b a)
    (empty_right : ∀ {a}, P a ∅) (singletons : ∀ {a b}, P {a} {b})
    (union_of : ∀ {a b c}, P a c → P b c → P (a ∪ b) c) : ∀ a b, P a b
proof:
:= by
  intro a b
  refine Finset.induction_on b empty_right fun x s _xs hi => symm ?_
  rw [Finset.insert_eq]
  apply union_of _ (symm hi)
  refine Finset.induction_on a empty_right fun a t _ta hi => symm ?_
  rw [Finset.insert_eq]
  exact union_of singletons (symm hi)

proof:

  eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun i ↦ by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ht
    simp only [Prod.map, Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_product, and_imp, Prod.forall, Prod.le_def]

name: inf_sup
statement:
theorem inf_sup {κ : ι → Type*} (s : Finset ι) (t : ∀ i, Finset (κ i)) (f : ∀ i, κ i → α) :
    (s.inf fun i => (t i).sup (f i)) =
      (s.pi t).sup fun g => s.attach.inf fun i => f _ <| g _ i.2
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s hi ih => ?_
  rw [inf_insert, ih, attach_insert, sup_inf_sup]
  refine eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun c => ?_
  simp only [Finset.sup_le_iff, mem_product, mem_pi, and_imp, Prod.forall,
    inf_insert, inf_image]
  refine
    ⟨fun h g hg =>
      h (g i <| mem_insert_self _ _) (fun j hj => g j <| mem_insert_of_mem hj)
        (hg _ <| mem_insert_self _ _) fun j hj => hg _ <| mem_insert_of_mem hj,
      fun h a g ha hg => ?_⟩
  
  have aux : ∀ j : { x // x ∈ s }, ↑j ≠ i := fun j : s => ne_of_mem_of_not_mem j.2 hi
  
  have := h (fun j hj => if hji : j = i then cast (congr_arg κ hji.symm) a
      else g _ <| mem_of_mem_insert_of_ne hj hji) (fun j hj => ?_)
  · simpa only [cast_eq, dite_eq_left, Function.comp_def, Subtype.coe_mk, dite_eq_right,
      aux] using! this
  rw [mem_insert] at hj
  obtain (rfl | hj) := hj
  · simpa
  · simpa [ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hj hi] using! hg _ _

theorem _root_.BddAbove.range_finsetSup (hf : BddAbove (.range f)) :
    BddAbove (.range fun s : Finset β => s.sup f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩
  exact Finset.sup_le fun b _ => ha ⟨b, rfl⟩

name: sup_const_le

name: le_sup

name: isLUB_sup

lemma isLUB_sup : IsLUB (f '' s) (s.sup f)

name: isLUB_sup_id
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma isLUB_sup_id {s : Finset α} : IsLUB s (s.sup id)

name: le_sup_of_le
statement:
@[to_dual inf_le_of_le]
theorem le_sup_of_le {b : β} (hb : b ∈ s) (h : a ≤ f b) : a ≤ s.sup f

name: sup_union
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := grind _=_)]
theorem sup_union [DecidableEq β] : (s₁ ∪ s₂).sup f = s₁.sup f ⊔ s₂.sup f
proof:
:=
  eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun c => by simp [or_imp, forall_and]

name: sup_const
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup_const {s : Finset β} (h : s.Nonempty) (c : α) : (s.sup fun _ => c) = c

name: sup_bot
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem sup_bot (s : Finset β) : (s.sup fun _ => ⊥) = (⊥ : α)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hs := s.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · exact sup_empty
  · exact sup_const hs _

name: sup_ite
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup_ite (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    (s.sup fun i => ite (p i) (f i) (g i)) = (s.filter p).sup f ⊔ (s.filter fun i => ¬p i).sup g

name: sup_mono_fun
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := gcongr, grind ←)]
theorem sup_mono_fun {g : β → α} (h : ∀ b ∈ s, f b ≤ g b) : s.sup f ≤ s.sup g
proof:
:=
  Finset.sup_le fun b hb => le_trans (h b hb) (le_sup hb)

name: sup_mono
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := gcongr, grind ←)]
theorem sup_mono (h : s₁ ⊆ s₂) : s₁.sup f ≤ s₂.sup f

name: monotone_sup
statement: theorem monotone_sup (f : β → α) : Monotone fun s : Finset β => s.sup f

name: antitone_inf
statement:
theorem antitone_inf {α} [SemilatticeInf α] [OrderTop α] (f : β → α) :
  Antitone fun s : Finset β => s.inf f

name: sup_comm
statement:
@[to_dual]
protected theorem sup_comm (s : Finset β) (t : Finset γ) (f : β → γ → α) :
    (s.sup fun b => t.sup (f b)) = t.sup fun c => s.sup fun b => f b c
proof:
:=
  eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun a => by simpa using forall₂_comm

name: sup_attach
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem sup_attach (s : Finset β) (f : β → α) : (s.attach.sup fun x => f x) = s.sup f

name: sup_erase_bot
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem sup_erase_bot [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) : (s.erase ⊥).sup id = s.sup id
proof:
:= by
  refine (sup_mono (s.erase_subset _)).antisymm (Finset.sup_le_iff.2 fun a ha => ?_)
  obtain rfl | ha' := eq_or_ne a ⊥
  · exact bot_le
  · exact le_sup (mem_erase.2 ⟨ha', ha⟩)

name: sup_sdiff_right
statement:
theorem sup_sdiff_right {α β : Type*} [GeneralizedBooleanAlgebra α] (s : Finset β) (f : β → α)
    (a : α) : (s.sup fun b => f b \ a) = s.sup f \ a
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => rw [sup_empty, sup_empty, bot_sdiff]
  | cons _ _ _ h => rw [sup_cons, sup_cons, h, sup_sdiff]

name: apply_sup_eq_sup_comp
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem apply_sup_eq_sup_comp [SemilatticeSup γ] [OrderBot γ] {s : Finset β} {f : β → α} (g : α → γ)
    (g_sup : ∀ x y, g (x ⊔ y) = g x ⊔ g y) (bot : g ⊥ = ⊥) : g (s.sup f) = s.sup (g ∘ f)
proof:
:=
  Finset.cons_induction_on s bot fun c t hc ih => by
    rw [sup_cons, sup_cons, g_sup, ih, Function.comp_apply]

name: sup_toFinset
statement:
@[to_dual (rename := Pbot → Ptop, Psup → Pinf)
/
theorem sup_coe {P : α → Prop} {Pbot : P ⊥} {Psup : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, P x → P y → P (x ⊔ y)} (t : Finset β)
    (f : β → { x : α // P x }) :
    letI := Subtype.semilatticeSup Psup
    letI := Subtype.orderBot Pbot
    (t.sup f).val = t.sup fun x => ↑(f x) := by
  let := Subtype.semilatticeSup Psup
  let := Subtype.orderBot Pbot
  apply apply_sup_eq_sup_comp Subtype.val <;> intros <;> rfl

@[simp]
theorem sup_toFinset {α β} [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset α) (f : α → Multiset β) :
    (s.sup f).toFinset = s.sup fun x => (f x).toFinset

name: _root_.List.foldr_sup_eq_sup_toFinset
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem _root_.List.foldr_sup_eq_sup_toFinset [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) :
    l.foldr (· ⊔ ·) ⊥ = l.toFinset.sup id
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_fold_r, ← Multiset.fold_dedup_idem, sup_def, ← List.toFinset_coe, toFinset_val,
    Multiset.map_id]
  rfl

name: subset_range_sup_succ
statement: theorem subset_range_sup_succ (s : Finset ℕ) : s ⊆ range (s.sup id).succ
proof:
:= fun _ hn =>
  mem_range.2 <| Nat.lt_succ_of_le <| @le_sup _ _ _ _ _ id _ hn

name: sup_induction
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup_induction {p : α → Prop} (hb : p ⊥) (hp : ∀ a₁, p a₁ → ∀ a₂, p a₂ → p (a₁ ⊔ a₂))
    (hs : ∀ b ∈ s, p (f b)) : p (s.sup f)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => exact hb
  | cons _ _ _ ih =>
    simp only [sup_cons, forall_mem_cons] at hs ⊢
    exact hp _ hs.1 _ (ih hs.2)

name: sup_le_of_le_directed
statement:
@[to_dual le_inf_of_directed_le]
theorem sup_le_of_le_directed {α : Type*} [SemilatticeSup α] [OrderBot α] (s : Set α)
    (hs : s.Nonempty) (hdir : DirectedOn (· ≤ ·) s) (t : Finset α) :
    (∀ x ∈ t, ∃ y ∈ s, x ≤ y) → ∃ x ∈ s, t.sup id ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  classical
    induction t using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
      simpa only [forall_prop_of_true, and_true, forall_prop_of_false, bot_le, not_false_iff,
        sup_empty, forall_true_iff, notMem_empty]
    | insert a r _ ih =>
      intro h
      have incs : (r : Set α) ⊆ ↑(insert a r) := by
        rw [Finset.coe_subset]
        apply Finset.subset_insert
      
      obtain ⟨x, ⟨hxs, hsx_sup⟩⟩ := ih fun x hx => h x <| incs hx
      
      obtain ⟨y, hys, hay⟩ := h a (Finset.mem_insert_self a r)
      
      obtain ⟨z, hzs, ⟨hxz, hyz⟩⟩ := hdir x hxs y hys
      use z, hzs
      rw [sup_insert, id, sup_le_iff]
      exact ⟨le_trans hay hyz, le_trans hsx_sup hxz⟩

name: sup_mem
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup_mem (s : Set α) (w₁ : ⊥ ∈ s) (w₂ : ∀ᵉ (x ∈ s) (y ∈ s), x ⊔ y ∈ s)
    {ι : Type*} (t : Finset ι) (p : ι → α) (h : ∀ i ∈ t, p i ∈ s) : t.sup p ∈ s

name: sup_eq_bot_iff
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
protected theorem sup_eq_bot_iff (f : β → α) (S : Finset β) : S.sup f = ⊥ ↔ ∀ s ∈ S, f s = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  classical induction S using Finset.induction <;> simp [*]

name: sup_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma sup_eq_one [One α] [IsBotOneClass α] : s.sup f = 1 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 1

name: sup_disjSum
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
lemma sup_disjSum (s : Finset β) (t : Finset γ) (f : β ⊕ γ → α) :
    (s.disjSum t).sup f = (s.sup fun x ↦ f (.inl x)) ⊔ (t.sup fun x ↦ f (.inr x))

name: sup_eq_bot_of_isEmpty
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem sup_eq_bot_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty β] (f : β → α) (S : Finset β) : S.sup f = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sup_eq_bot_iff]
  exact fun x _ => False.elim <| IsEmpty.false x

name: le_sup_dite_pos
statement:
@[to_dual inf_dite_pos_le]
theorem le_sup_dite_pos (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    {f : (b : β) → p b → α} {g : (b : β) → ¬p b → α} {b : β} (h₀ : b ∈ s) (h₁ : p b) :
    f b h₁ ≤ s.sup fun i ↦ if h : p i then f i h else g i h

name: le_sup_dite_neg
statement:
@[to_dual inf_dite_neg_le]
theorem le_sup_dite_neg (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p]

name: sup_eq_iSup
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup_eq_iSup [CompleteLattice β] (s : Finset α) (f : α → β) : s.sup f = ⨆ a ∈ s, f a
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (Finset.sup_le (fun a ha => le_iSup_of_le a <| le_iSup (fun _ => f a) ha))
    (iSup_le fun _ => iSup_le fun ha => le_sup ha)

name: sup_id_eq_sSup
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup_id_eq_sSup [CompleteLattice α] (s : Finset α) : s.sup id = sSup s

statement: theorem sup_id_set_eq_sUnion (s : Finset (Set α)) : s.sup id = ⋃₀ ↑s

statement: theorem inf_id_set_eq_sInter (s : Finset (Set α)) : s.inf id = ⋂₀ ↑s

statement:
