name: inf_set_eq_iInter
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inf_set_eq_iInter (s : Finset α) (f : α → Set β) : s.inf f = ⋂ x ∈ s, f x

name: sup_eq_sSup_image
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup_eq_sSup_image [CompleteLattice β] (s : Finset α) (f : α → β) :
    s.sup f = sSup (f '' s)
proof:
:= by
  classical rw [← Finset.coe_image, ← sup_id_eq_sSup, sup_image, Function.id_comp]

name: exists_sup_ge
statement:
@[to_dual exists_inf_le]
theorem exists_sup_ge [SemilatticeSup β] [OrderBot β] [WellFoundedGT β] (f : α → β) :
    ∃ t : Finset α, ∀ a, f a ≤ t.sup f
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty α
  · exact ⟨⊥, isEmptyElim⟩
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨t, rfl⟩, ht⟩ := wellFounded_gt.has_min _ (Set.range_nonempty (sup · f))
  refine ⟨t, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
  classical
  have := ht (f a ⊔ t.sup f) ⟨insert a t, by simp⟩
  rwa [right_lt_sup, not_not] at this

name: exists_sup_eq_iSup
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem exists_sup_eq_iSup [CompleteLattice β] [WellFoundedGT β] (f : α → β) :
    ∃ t : Finset α, t.sup f = ⨆ a, f a
proof:
:=
  have ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_sup_ge f
  ⟨t, (Finset.sup_le fun _ _ ↦ le_iSup ..).antisymm <| iSup_le ht⟩

name: toDual_sup
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem toDual_sup [SemilatticeSup α] [OrderBot α] (s : Finset β) (f : β → α) :

name: ofDual_sup

theorem ofDual_sup [SemilatticeInf α] [OrderTop α] (s : Finset β) (f : β → αᵒᵈ) :

name: sup_inf_distrib_left
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup_inf_distrib_left (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α) (a : α) :
    a ⊓ s.sup f = s.sup fun i => a ⊓ f i
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp_rw [Finset.sup_empty, inf_bot_eq]
  | cons _ _ _ h => rw [sup_cons, sup_cons, inf_sup_left, h]

name: sup_inf_distrib_right
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup_inf_distrib_right (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α) (a : α) :
    s.sup f ⊓ a = s.sup fun i => f i ⊓ a

name: disjoint_sup_right
statement:
@[to_dual]
protected theorem disjoint_sup_right : Disjoint a (s.sup f) ↔ ∀ ⦃i⦄, i ∈ s → Disjoint a (f i)

name: disjoint_sup_left
statement:
@[to_dual]
protected theorem disjoint_sup_left : Disjoint (s.sup f) a ↔ ∀ ⦃i⦄, i ∈ s → Disjoint (f i) a

name: sup_sdiff_left
statement:
theorem sup_sdiff_left (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α) (a : α) :
    (s.sup fun b => a \ f b) = a \ s.inf f
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => rw [sup_empty, inf_empty, sdiff_top]
  | cons _ _ _ h => rw [sup_cons, inf_cons, h, sdiff_inf]

name: inf_sdiff_left
statement:
theorem inf_sdiff_left (hs : s.Nonempty) (f : ι → α) (a : α) :
    (s.inf fun b => a \ f b) = a \ s.sup f
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
  | singleton => rw [sup_singleton, inf_singleton]
  | cons _ _ _ _ ih => rw [sup_cons, inf_cons, ih, sdiff_sup]

name: inf_sdiff_right
statement:
theorem inf_sdiff_right (hs : s.Nonempty) (f : ι → α) (a : α) :
    (s.inf fun b => f b \ a) = s.inf f \ a
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
  | singleton => rw [inf_singleton, inf_singleton]
  | cons _ _ _ _ ih => rw [inf_cons, inf_cons, ih, inf_sdiff]

name: inf_himp_right
statement:
theorem inf_himp_right (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α) (a : α) :
    (s.inf fun b => f b ⇨ a) = s.sup f ⇨ a

name: sup_himp_right
statement:
theorem sup_himp_right (hs : s.Nonempty) (f : ι → α) (a : α) :
    (s.sup fun b => f b ⇨ a) = s.inf f ⇨ a

name: sup_himp_left
statement:
theorem sup_himp_left (hs : s.Nonempty) (f : ι → α) (a : α) :

name: compl_sup
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem compl_sup (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α) : (s.sup f)ᶜ = s.inf fun i => (f i)ᶜ

name: compl_inf
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem compl_inf (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α) : (s.inf f)ᶜ = s.sup fun i => (f i)ᶜ

name: apply_sup_eq_sup_comp_of_linearOrder
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem apply_sup_eq_sup_comp_of_linearOrder [SemilatticeSup β] [OrderBot β] (g : α → β)
    (mono_g : Monotone g) (bot : g ⊥ = ⊥) : g (s.sup f) = s.sup (g ∘ f)

name: le_sup_iff
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp) inf_le_iff]
protected theorem le_sup_iff (ha : ⊥ < a) : a ≤ s.sup f ↔ ∃ b ∈ s, a ≤ f b
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  · induction s using cons_induction with
    | empty => exact (absurd · (not_le_of_gt ha))
    | cons c t hc ih =>
      rw [sup_cons, le_sup_iff]
      exact fun
      | Or.inl h => ⟨c, mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl), h⟩
      | Or.inr h => let ⟨b, hb, hle⟩ := ih h; ⟨b, mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hb), hle⟩
  · exact fun ⟨b, hb, hle⟩ => le_trans hle (le_sup hb)

name: sup_eq_top_iff
statement:
@[to_dual]
protected theorem sup_eq_top_iff {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [BoundedOrder α] [Nontrivial α]
    {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α} : s.sup f = ⊤ ↔ ∃ b ∈ s, f b = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← top_le_iff]
  exact Finset.le_sup_iff bot_lt_top

name: Nonempty.sup_eq_top_iff
statement:
@[to_dual]
protected theorem Nonempty.sup_eq_top_iff {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] [BoundedOrder α]
    {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α} (hs : s.Nonempty) : s.sup f = ⊤ ↔ ∃ b ∈ s, f b = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial α
  · simpa [Subsingleton.elim _ (⊤ : α)]
  · exact Finset.sup_eq_top_iff

name: lt_sup_iff
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp) inf_lt_iff]
protected theorem lt_sup_iff : a < s.sup f ↔ ∃ b ∈ s, a < f b
proof:
:= by
  apply Iff.intro
  · induction s using cons_induction with
    | empty => exact (absurd · not_lt_bot)
    | cons c t hc ih =>
      rw [sup_cons, lt_sup_iff]
      exact fun
      | Or.inl h => ⟨c, mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl), h⟩
      | Or.inr h => let ⟨b, hb, hlt⟩ := ih h; ⟨b, mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hb), hlt⟩
  · exact fun ⟨b, hb, hlt⟩ => lt_of_lt_of_le hlt (le_sup hb)

name: sup_lt_iff
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp) lt_inf_iff]
protected theorem sup_lt_iff (ha : ⊥ < a) : s.sup f < a ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, f b < a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hs _ hb => lt_of_le_of_lt (le_sup hb) hs,
    Finset.cons_induction_on s (fun _ => ha) fun c t hc => by
      simpa only [sup_cons, sup_lt_iff, mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp] using And.imp_right⟩

name: sup_mem_of_nonempty
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup_mem_of_nonempty (hs : s.Nonempty) : s.sup f ∈ f '' s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction with
  | empty => simp only [Finset.not_nonempty_empty] at hs
  | insert a s _ h =>
    rw [Finset.sup_insert (b := a) (s := s) (f := f)]
    cases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with
    | inl hs => simp [hs]
    | inr hs =>
      simp only [Finset.coe_insert]
      rcases le_total (f a) (s.sup f) with (ha | ha)
      · rw [sup_eq_right.mpr ha]
        exact Set.image_mono (Set.subset_insert a s) (h hs)
      · rw [sup_eq_left.mpr ha]
        apply Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (Set.mem_insert a ↑s)

name: sup_of_mem
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup_of_mem {s : Finset β} (f : β → α) {b : β} (h : b ∈ s) :
    ∃ a : α, s.sup ((↑) ∘ f : β → WithBot α) = ↑a
proof:
:=
  (WithBot.le_iff_forall.1 (le_sup (α := WithBot α) h) (f b) rfl).imp fun _ ↦ And.left

name: coe_sup'
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem coe_sup' : ((s.sup' H f : α) : WithBot α) = s.sup ((↑) ∘ f)

name: sup'_cons
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem sup'_cons {b : β} {hb : b ∉ s} :
    (cons b s hb).sup' (cons_nonempty hb) f = f b ⊔ s.sup' H f

name: sup'_insert
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem sup'_insert [DecidableEq β] {b : β} :
    (insert b s).sup' (insert_nonempty _ _) f = f b ⊔ s.sup' H f

name: sup'_singleton
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem sup'_singleton {b : β} : ({b} : Finset β).sup' (singleton_nonempty _) f = f b

name: sup'_le_iff
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp) le_inf'_iff]
theorem sup'_le_iff {a : α} : s.sup' H f ≤ a ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, f b ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← @WithBot.coe_le_coe α, coe_sup', Finset.sup_le_iff]; rfl

name: le_sup'
statement:
@[to_dual inf'_le]
theorem le_sup' {b : β} (h : b ∈ s) : f b ≤ s.sup' ⟨b, h⟩ f

name: isLUB_sup'
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem isLUB_sup' {s : Finset α} (hs : s.Nonempty) : IsLUB s (sup' s hs id)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x h => id_eq x ▸ le_sup' id h, fun _ h => Finset.sup'_le hs id h⟩

name: le_sup'_of_le
statement:
@[to_dual inf'_le_of_le]
theorem le_sup'_of_le {a : α} {b : β} (hb : b ∈ s) (h : a ≤ f b) : a ≤ s.sup' ⟨b, hb⟩ f

name: sup'_eq_of_forall
statement:
@[to_dual]
lemma sup'_eq_of_forall {a : α} (h : ∀ b ∈ s, f b = a) : s.sup' H f = a

name: sup'_const
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem sup'_const (a : α) : s.sup' H (fun _ => a) = a
proof:
:=
  sup'_eq_of_forall H (fun _ ↦ a) fun _ ↦ congrFun rfl

name: sup'_union
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup'_union [DecidableEq β] {s₁ s₂ : Finset β} (h₁ : s₁.Nonempty) (h₂ : s₂.Nonempty)
    (f : β → α) :
    (s₁ ∪ s₂).sup' (h₁.mono subset_union_left) f = s₁.sup' h₁ f ⊔ s₂.sup' h₂ f
proof:
:=
  eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun a => by simp [or_imp, forall_and]

name: sup'_comm
statement:
@[to_dual]
protected theorem sup'_comm {t : Finset γ} (hs : s.Nonempty) (ht : t.Nonempty) (f : β → γ → α) :
    (s.sup' hs fun b => t.sup' ht (f b)) = t.sup' ht fun c => s.sup' hs fun b => f b c
proof:
:=
  eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun a => by simpa using forall₂_comm

name: sup'_induction
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup'_induction {p : α → Prop} (hp : ∀ a₁, p a₁ → ∀ a₂, p a₂ → p (a₁ ⊔ a₂))
    (hs : ∀ b ∈ s, p (f b)) : p (s.sup' H f)
proof:
:= by
  change @WithBot.recBotCoe α (fun _ => Prop) True p ↑(s.sup' H f)
  rw [coe_sup']
  refine sup_induction trivial (fun a₁ h₁ a₂ h₂ ↦ ?_) hs
  match a₁, a₂ with
  | ⊥, _ => rwa [bot_sup_eq]
  | (a₁ : α), ⊥ => rwa [sup_bot_eq]
  | (a₁ : α), (a₂ : α) => exact hp a₁ h₁ a₂ h₂

name: sup'_mem
sup'_congr
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := congr)]
theorem sup'_congr {t : Finset β} {f g : β → α} (h₁ : s = t) (h₂ : ∀ x ∈ s, f x = g x) :
    s.sup' H f = t.sup' (h₁ ▸ H) g
proof:
:= by
  subst s
  refine eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun c => ?_
  simp +contextual only [sup'_le_iff, h₂]

name: apply_sup'_eq_sup'_comp
_root_.map_finset_sup'
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem _root_.map_finset_sup' [SemilatticeSup β] [FunLike F α β] [SupHomClass F α β]
    (f : F) {s : Finset ι} (hs) (g : ι → α) :
    f (s.sup' hs g) = s.sup' hs (f ∘ g)

name: sup'_image
statement:
theorem sup'_image [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset γ} {f : γ → β} (hs : (s.image f).Nonempty)
    (g : β → α) :
    (s.image f).sup' hs g = s.sup' hs.of_image (g ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← WithBot.coe_eq_coe]; simp only [coe_sup', sup_image]; rfl

name: sup'_comp_eq_image
statement:
@[to_dual /
Also, this lemma assumes that `s` is nonempty instead of assuming that its image is nonempty. -/]
lemma sup'_comp_eq_image [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset γ} {f : γ → β} (hs : s.Nonempty) (g : β → α) :
    s.sup' hs (g ∘ f) = (s.image f).sup' (hs.image f) g

name: sup'_map
statement:
theorem sup'_map {s : Finset γ} {f : γ ↪ β} (g : β → α) (hs : (s.map f).Nonempty) :
    (s.map f).sup' hs g = s.sup' (map_nonempty.1 hs) (g ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← WithBot.coe_eq_coe, coe_sup', sup_map, coe_sup']
  rfl

name: sup'_comp_eq_map
statement:
@[to_dual /
Also, this lemma assumes that `s` is nonempty instead of assuming that its image is nonempty. -/]
lemma sup'_comp_eq_map {s : Finset γ} {f : γ ↪ β} (g : β → α) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    s.sup' hs (g ∘ f) = (s.map f).sup' (map_nonempty.2 hs) g

name: sup'_mono
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := gcongr)]
theorem sup'_mono {s₁ s₂ : Finset β} (h : s₁ ⊆ s₂) (h₁ : s₁.Nonempty) :
    s₁.sup' h₁ f ≤ s₂.sup' (h₁.mono h) f

name: sup'_mono_fun
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := gcongr)]
lemma sup'_mono_fun {hs : s.Nonempty} {f g : β → α} (h : ∀ b ∈ s, f b ≤ g b) :
    s.sup' hs f ≤ s.sup' hs g
proof: := sup'_le _ _ fun b hb ↦ (h b hb).trans (le_sup' _ hb)

name: sup'_eq_sup
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup'_eq_sup (H : s.Nonempty) (f : β → α) : s.sup' H f = s.sup f
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (sup'_le H f fun _ => le_sup) (Finset.sup_le fun _ => le_sup' f)

name: sup'_eq_one
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
lemma sup'_eq_one [One α] [IsBotOneClass α] (hs) : s.sup' hs f = 1 ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i = 1

name: coe_sup_of_nonempty
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem coe_sup_of_nonempty (h : s.Nonempty) (f : β → α) :
    (↑(s.sup f) : WithBot α) = s.sup ((↑) ∘ f)
proof: := by simp only [← sup'_eq_sup h, coe_sup' h]

name: sup_apply
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
protected theorem sup_apply {C : β → Type*} [∀ b : β, SemilatticeSup (C b)]
    [∀ b : β, OrderBot (C b)] (s : Finset α) (f : α → ∀ b : β, C b) (b : β) :
    s.sup f b = s.sup fun a => f a b
proof:
:=
  apply_sup_eq_sup_comp (fun x : ∀ b : β, C b => x b) (fun _ _ => rfl) rfl

name: sup'_apply
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
protected theorem sup'_apply {C : β → Type*} [∀ b : β, SemilatticeSup (C b)]
    {s : Finset α} (H : s.Nonempty) (f : α → ∀ b : β, C b) (b : β) :
    s.sup' H f b = s.sup' H fun a => f a b
proof:
:=
  apply_sup'_eq_sup'_comp H (fun x : ∀ b : β, C b => x b) fun _ _ => rfl

name: toDual_sup'
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem toDual_sup' [SemilatticeSup α] {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty) (f : ι → α) :
    toDual (s.sup' hs f) = s.inf' hs (toDual ∘ f)

name: ofDual_sup'
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp)]
theorem ofDual_sup' [SemilatticeInf α] {s : Finset ι} (hs : s.Nonempty) (f : ι → αᵒᵈ) :
    ofDual (s.sup' hs f) = s.inf' hs (ofDual ∘ f)

name: sup'_inf_distrib_left
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup'_inf_distrib_left (f : ι → α) (a : α) :
    a ⊓ s.sup' hs f = s.sup' hs fun i ↦ a ⊓ f i
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
  | singleton => simp
  | cons _ _ _ hs ih => simp_rw [sup'_cons hs, inf_sup_left, ih]

name: sup'_inf_distrib_right
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem sup'_inf_distrib_right (f : ι → α) (a : α) :
    s.sup' hs f ⊓ a = s.sup' hs fun i => f i ⊓ a

name: apply_sup_eq_sup_comp_of_nonempty
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem apply_sup_eq_sup_comp_of_nonempty [OrderBot α] [SemilatticeSup β] [OrderBot β]
    {g : α → β} (mono_g : Monotone g) (H : s.Nonempty) : g (s.sup f) = s.sup (g ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sup'_eq_sup H, ← Finset.sup'_eq_sup H]
  exact Finset.apply_sup'_eq_sup'_comp H g (fun x y ↦ Monotone.map_sup mono_g x y)

name: le_sup'_iff
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp) inf'_le_iff]
theorem le_sup'_iff : a ≤ s.sup' H f ↔ ∃ b ∈ s, a ≤ f b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← WithBot.coe_le_coe, coe_sup', Finset.le_sup_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe a)]
  exact exists_congr (fun _ => and_congr_right' WithBot.coe_le_coe)

name: lt_sup'_iff
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp) inf'_lt_iff]
theorem lt_sup'_iff : a < s.sup' H f ↔ ∃ b ∈ s, a < f b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← WithBot.coe_lt_coe, coe_sup', Finset.lt_sup_iff]
  exact exists_congr (fun _ => and_congr_right' WithBot.coe_lt_coe)

name: sup'_lt_iff
statement:
@[to_dual (attr := simp) lt_inf'_iff]
theorem sup'_lt_iff : s.sup' H f < a ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, f i < a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← WithBot.coe_lt_coe, coe_sup', Finset.sup_lt_iff (WithBot.bot_lt_coe a)]
  exact forall₂_congr (fun _ _ => WithBot.coe_lt_coe)

name: exists_mem_eq_sup'
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem exists_mem_eq_sup' (f : ι → α) : ∃ i, i ∈ s ∧ s.sup' H f = f i
proof:
:= by
  induction H using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
  | singleton c => exact ⟨c, mem_singleton_self c, rfl⟩
  | cons c s hcs hs ih =>
    rcases ih with ⟨b, hb, h'⟩
    rw [sup'_cons hs, h']
    cases le_total (f b) (f c) with
    | inl h => exact ⟨c, mem_cons.2 (Or.inl rfl), sup_eq_left.2 h⟩
    | inr h => exact ⟨b, mem_cons.2 (Or.inr hb), sup_eq_right.2 h⟩

name: exists_mem_eq_sup
statement:
@[to_dual]
theorem exists_mem_eq_sup [OrderBot α] (s : Finset ι) (h : s.Nonempty) (f : ι → α) :
    ∃ i, i ∈ s ∧ s.sup f = f i
proof:
:=
  sup'_eq_sup h f ▸ exists_mem_eq_sup' h f

name: map_finset_sup
statement:
theorem map_finset_sup [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset γ) (f : γ → Multiset β)
    (g : β → α) (hg : Function.Injective g) : map g (s.sup f) = s.sup (map g ∘ f)

name: count_finset_sup
statement:
theorem count_finset_sup [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset α) (f : α → Multiset β) (b : β) :
    count b (s.sup f) = s.sup fun a => count b (f a)
proof:
:= by
  let := Classical.decEq α
  refine s.induction ?_ ?_
  · exact count_zero _
  · intro i s _ ih
    rw [Finset.sup_insert, sup_eq_union, count_union, Finset.sup_insert, ih]

name: mem_sup
statement:
theorem mem_sup {α β} [DecidableEq β] {s : Finset α} {f : α → Multiset β} {x : β} :
    x ∈ s.sup f ↔ ∃ v ∈ s, x ∈ f v
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction <;> simp [*]

name: mem_sup'
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_sup' (hs) : a ∈ s.sup' hs f ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, a ∈ f i
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using Nonempty.cons_induction <;> simp [*]

name: mem_inf'
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_inf' (hs) : a ∈ s.inf' hs f ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, a ∈ f i
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using Nonempty.cons_induction <;> simp [*]

name: mem_sup
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_sup : a ∈ s.sup f ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, a ∈ f i
proof:
:= by
  induction s using cons_induction <;> simp [*]

name: sup_singleton_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_singleton_apply (s : Finset β) (f : β → α) :
    (s.sup fun b => {f b}) = s.image f
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rw [mem_sup, mem_image]
  simp only [mem_singleton, eq_comm]

name: sup_singleton_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_singleton_eq_self (s : Finset α) : s.sup singleton = s

name: map_eq
statement:
theorem map_eq {α β : TypeVec n} (g : α ⟹ β) (a : P.A) (f : P.B a ⟹ α) :
    @MvFunctor.map _ P.Obj _ _ _ g ⟨a, f⟩ = ⟨a, g ⊚ f⟩

name: id_map
statement:
theorem id_map {α : TypeVec n} : ∀ x : P α, TypeVec.id <$$> x = x
  | ⟨_, _⟩ => rfl

name: comp_map
statement:
theorem comp_map {α β γ : TypeVec n} (f : α ⟹ β) (g : β ⟹ γ) :
    ∀ x : P α, (g ⊚ f) <$$> x = g <$$> f <$$> x
  | ⟨_, _⟩ => rfl

instance : LawfulMvFunctor.{u} P.Obj where
  id_map

name: const.get_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem const.get_map (f : α ⟹ β) (x : const n A α) : const.get (f <$$> x) = const.get x

name: const.get_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem const.get_mk (x : A) : const.get (const.mk n x : const n A α) = x

name: const.mk_get
statement:
@[simp]
theorem const.mk_get (x : const n A α) : const.mk n (const.get x) = x
proof:
:= by
  cases x
  dsimp [const.get, const.mk]
  congr with (_⟨⟩)

name: comp.get_map
statement:
theorem comp.get_map (f : α ⟹ β) (x : comp P Q α) :
    comp.get (f <$$> x) = (fun i (x : Q i α) => f <$$> x) <$$> comp.get x

name: comp.get_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp.get_mk (x : P (fun i => Q i α)) : comp.get (comp.mk x) = x

name: comp.mk_get
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp.mk_get (x : comp P Q α) : comp.mk (comp.get x) = x

name: liftP_iff
statement:
theorem liftP_iff {α : TypeVec n} (p : ∀ ⦃i⦄, α i → Prop) (x : P α) :
    LiftP p x ↔ ∃ a f, x = ⟨a, f⟩ ∧ ∀ i j, p (f i j)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rcases h : y with ⟨a, f⟩
    refine ⟨a, fun i j => (f i j).val, ?_, fun i j => (f i j).property⟩
    rw [← hy, h, map_eq]
    rfl
  rintro ⟨a, f, xeq, pf⟩
  use ⟨a, fun i j => ⟨f i j, pf i j⟩⟩
  rw [xeq]; rfl

name: liftP_iff'
statement:
theorem liftP_iff' {α : TypeVec n} (p : ∀ ⦃i⦄, α i → Prop) (a : P.A) (f : P.B a ⟹ α) :
    @LiftP.{u} _ P.Obj _ α p ⟨a, f⟩ ↔ ∀ i x, p (f i x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [liftP_iff]; constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, _, ⟨⟩, _⟩
    assumption
  · intro
    repeat' first | constructor | assumption

name: liftR_iff
statement:
theorem liftR_iff {α : TypeVec n} (r : ∀ ⦃i⦄, α i → α i → Prop) (x y : P α) :
    LiftR @r x y ↔ ∃ a f₀ f₁, x = ⟨a, f₀⟩ ∧ y = ⟨a, f₁⟩ ∧ ∀ i j, r (f₀ i j) (f₁ i j)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, xeq, yeq⟩
    rcases h : u with ⟨a, f⟩
    use a, fun i j => (f i j).val.fst, fun i j => (f i j).val.snd
    constructor
    · rw [← xeq, h]
      rfl
    constructor
    · rw [← yeq, h]
      rfl
    intro i j
    exact (f i j).property
  rintro ⟨a, f₀, f₁, xeq, yeq, h⟩
  exact ⟨⟨a, fun i j => ⟨(f₀ i j, f₁ i j), h i j⟩⟩, xeq.symm, yeq.symm⟩

name: supp_eq
statement:
theorem supp_eq {α : TypeVec n} (a : P.A) (f : P.B a ⟹ α) (i) :
    @supp.{u} _ P.Obj _ α (⟨a, f⟩ : P α) i = f i '' univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp only [supp, image_univ, mem_range, mem_ofPred_eq]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · apply @h fun i x => ∃ y : P.B a i, f i y = x
    rw [liftP_iff']
    intros
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · simp only [liftP_iff']
    cases h
    subst x
    tauto

name: wPathDestLeft_wPathCasesOn
wPathDestRight_wPathCasesOn
wPathCasesOn_eta
statement:
theorem wPathCasesOn_eta {α : TypeVec n} {a : P.A} {f : P.last.B a → P.last.W}
    (h : P.WPath ⟨a, f⟩ ⟹ α) : P.wPathCasesOn (P.wPathDestLeft h) (P.wPathDestRight h) = h
proof:
:= by
  ext i x; cases x <;> rfl

name: comp_wPathCasesOn
proof:
:= by
  ext i x; cases x <;> rfl

name: wpRec_eq
statement:
theorem wpRec_eq {α : TypeVec n} {C : Sort*}
    (g : ∀ (a : P.A) (f : P.last.B a → P.last.W), P.WPath ⟨a, f⟩ ⟹ α → (P.last.B a → C) → C)
    (a : P.A) (f : P.last.B a → P.last.W) (f' : P.WPath ⟨a, f⟩ ⟹ α) :
    P.wpRec g ⟨a, f⟩ f' = g a f f' fun i => P.wpRec g (f i) (P.wPathDestRight f' i)

name: wRec_eq
statement:
theorem wRec_eq {α : TypeVec n} {C : Sort*}
    (g : ∀ a : P.A, P.drop.B a ⟹ α → (P.last.B a → P.W α) → (P.last.B a → C) → C) (a : P.A)
    (f' : P.drop.B a ⟹ α) (f : P.last.B a → P.W α) :
    P.wRec g (P.wMk a f' f) = g a f' f fun i => P.wRec g (f i)

name: wInd_wMk
wMk_eq
statement:
theorem wMk_eq {α : TypeVec n} (a : P.A) (f : P.last.B a → P.last.W) (g' : P.drop.B a ⟹ α)
    (g : ∀ j : P.last.B a, P.WPath (f j) ⟹ α) :
    (P.wMk a g' fun i => ⟨f i, g i⟩) = ⟨⟨a, f⟩, P.wPathCasesOn g' g⟩

name: w_map_wMk
statement:
theorem w_map_wMk {α β : TypeVec n} (g : α ⟹ β) (a : P.A) (f' : P.drop.B a ⟹ α)
    (f : P.last.B a → P.W α) : g <$$> P.wMk a f' f = P.wMk a (g ⊚ f') fun i => g <$$> f i
proof:
:= by
  change _ = P.wMk a (g ⊚ f') (MvFunctor.map g ∘ f)
  have : MvFunctor.map g ∘ f = fun i => ⟨(f i).fst, g ⊚ (f i).snd⟩ := by
    ext i : 1
    dsimp [Function.comp_def]
    cases f i
    rfl
  rw [this]
  have : f = fun i => ⟨(f i).fst, (f i).snd⟩ := by
    ext1 x
    cases f x
    rfl
  rw [this]
  dsimp
  rw [wMk_eq, wMk_eq]
  have h := MvPFunctor.map_eq P.wp g
  rw [h, comp_wPathCasesOn]

name: map_objAppend1
statement:
theorem map_objAppend1 {α γ : TypeVec n} (g : α ⟹ γ) (a : P.A) (f' : P.drop.B a ⟹ α)
    (f : P.last.B a → P.W α) :
    appendFun g (P.wMap g) <$$> P.objAppend1 a f' f =
      P.objAppend1 a (g ⊚ f') fun x => P.wMap g (f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [objAppend1, objAppend1, map_eq, appendFun, ← splitFun_comp]; rfl

name: wDest'_wMk
statement:
theorem wDest'_wMk {α : TypeVec n} (a : P.A) (f' : P.drop.B a ⟹ α) (f : P.last.B a → P.W α) :
    P.wDest' (P.wMk a f' f) = ⟨a, splitFun f' f⟩

name: wDest'_wMk'
statement: theorem wDest'_wMk' {α : TypeVec n} (x : P (α.append1 (P.W α))) : P.wDest' (P.wMk' x) = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, f⟩ := x; rw [wMk', wDest'_wMk, split_dropFun_lastFun]

name: M.dest'_eq_dest'
M.dest_eq_dest'
M.dest_corec'
statement:
theorem M.dest_corec' {α : TypeVec.{u} n} {β : Type v} (g₀ : β → P.A)
    (g₁ : ∀ b : β, P.drop.B (g₀ b) ⟹ α) (g₂ : ∀ b : β, P.last.B (g₀ b) → β) (x : β) :
    M.dest P (M.corec' P g₀ g₁ g₂ x) = ⟨g₀ x, splitFun (g₁ x) (M.corec' P g₀ g₁ g₂ ∘ g₂ x)⟩

name: M.dest_corec
statement:
theorem M.dest_corec {α : TypeVec n} {β : Type u} (g : β → P (α.append1 β)) (x : β) :
    M.dest P (M.corec P g x) = appendFun id (M.corec P g) <$$> g x
proof:
:= by
  trans
  · apply M.dest_corec'
  obtain ⟨a, f⟩ := g x; dsimp
  rw [MvPFunctor.map_eq]; congr
  conv_rhs => rw [← split_dropFun_lastFun f, appendFun_comp_splitFun]
  rfl

name: M.bisim_lemma
proof:
:= by
  generalize ef : @splitFun n _ (append1 α (M P α)) f' f₁' = ff at e₁
  let he₁' := PFunctor.M.dest a₁
  rcases e₁' : he₁' with ⟨a₁', g₁'⟩
  rw [M.dest_eq_dest' _ e₁'] at e₁
  cases e₁; exact ⟨_, e₁', splitFun_inj ef⟩

name: M.bisim
statement:
theorem M.bisim {α : TypeVec n} (R : P.M α → P.M α → Prop)
    (h :
      ∀ x y,
        R x y →
          ∃ a f f₁ f₂,
            M.dest P x = ⟨a, splitFun f f₁⟩ ∧
              M.dest P y = ⟨a, splitFun f f₂⟩ ∧ ∀ i, R (f₁ i) (f₂ i))
    (x y) (r : R x y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a₁, f₁⟩ := x
  obtain ⟨a₂, f₂⟩ := y
  dsimp [mp] at *
  have : a₁ = a₂ := by
    refine
      PFunctor.M.bisim (fun a₁ a₂ => ∃ x y, R x y ∧ x.1 = a₁ ∧ y.1 = a₂) ?_ _ _
        ⟨⟨a₁, f₁⟩, ⟨a₂, f₂⟩, r, rfl, rfl⟩
    rintro _ _ ⟨⟨a₁, f₁⟩, ⟨a₂, f₂⟩, r, rfl, rfl⟩
    rcases h _ _ r with ⟨a', f', f₁', f₂', e₁, e₂, h'⟩
    rcases M.bisim_lemma P e₁ with ⟨g₁', e₁', rfl, rfl⟩
    rcases M.bisim_lemma P e₂ with ⟨g₂', e₂', _, rfl⟩
    rw [e₁', e₂']
    exact ⟨_, _, _, rfl, rfl, fun b => ⟨_, _, h' b, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  subst this
  congr with (i p)
  induction p with (
    obtain ⟨a', f', f₁', f₂', e₁, e₂, h''⟩ := h _ _ r
    obtain ⟨g₁', e₁', rfl, rfl⟩ := M.bisim_lemma P e₁
    obtain ⟨g₂', e₂', e₃, rfl⟩ := M.bisim_lemma P e₂
    cases h'.symm.trans e₁'
    cases h'.symm.trans e₂')
  | root x a f h' i c =>
    exact congr_fun (congr_fun e₃ i) c
  | child x a f h' i c p IH =>
    exact IH _ _ (h'' _)

name: M.bisim
statement:
theorem M.bisim₀ {α : TypeVec n} (R : P.M α → P.M α → Prop) (h₀ : Equivalence R)
    (h : ∀ x y, R x y → (id ::: Quot.mk R) <$$> M.dest _ x = (id ::: Quot.mk R) <$$> M.dest _ y)
    (x y) (r : R x y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply M.bisim P R _ _ _ r
  clear r x y
  introv Hr
  specialize h _ _ Hr
  clear Hr
  revert h
  rcases M.dest P x with ⟨ax, fx⟩
  rcases M.dest P y with ⟨ay, fy⟩
  intro h
  rw [map_eq, map_eq] at h
  injection h with h₀ h₁
  subst ay
  simp only [heq_eq_eq] at h₁
  have Hdrop : dropFun fx = dropFun fy := by
    replace h₁ := congr_arg dropFun h₁
    simpa using! h₁
  exists ax, dropFun fx, lastFun fx, lastFun fy
  rw [split_dropFun_lastFun, Hdrop, split_dropFun_lastFun]
  simp only [true_and]
  intro i
  replace h₁ := congr_fun (congr_fun h₁ Fin2.fz) i
  simp only [TypeVec.comp, appendFun, splitFun] at h₁
  replace h₁ := Quot.eqvGen_exact h₁
  rw [h₀.eqvGen_iff] at h₁
  exact h₁

name: M.bisim'
statement:
theorem M.bisim' {α : TypeVec n} (R : P.M α → P.M α → Prop)
    (h : ∀ x y, R x y → (id ::: Quot.mk R) <$$> M.dest _ x = (id ::: Quot.mk R) <$$> M.dest _ y)
    (x y) (r : R x y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have := M.bisim₀ P (Relation.EqvGen R) ?_ ?_
  · solve_by_elim [Relation.EqvGen.rel]
  · apply Relation.EqvGen.is_equivalence
  · clear r x y
    introv Hr
    have : ∀ x y, R x y → Relation.EqvGen R x y := @Relation.EqvGen.rel _ R
    induction Hr
    · rw [← Quot.factor_mk_eq R (Relation.EqvGen R) this]
      rwa [appendFun_comp_id, ← MvFunctor.map_map, ← MvFunctor.map_map, h]
    all_goals simp_all

name: M.dest_map
statement:
theorem M.dest_map {α β : TypeVec n} (g : α ⟹ β) (x : P.M α) :
    M.dest P (g <$$> x) = (appendFun g fun x => g <$$> x) <$$> M.dest P x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, f⟩ := x
  rw [map_eq]
  conv =>
    rhs
    rw [M.dest, M.dest', map_eq, appendFun_comp_splitFun]
  rfl

name: M.map_dest
statement:
theorem M.map_dest {α β : TypeVec n} (g : (α ::: P.M α) ⟹ (β ::: P.M β)) (x : P.M α)
    (h : ∀ x : P.M α, lastFun g x = (dropFun g <$$> x : P.M β)) :
    g <$$> M.dest P x = M.dest P (dropFun g <$$> x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [M.dest_map]; congr
  apply eq_of_drop_last_eq (by simp)
  simp only [lastFun_appendFun]
  ext1; apply h

name: Obj.rec_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Obj.rec_mk {motive : P α → Sort*}
    {mk : ∀ a b, motive (.mk a b)} (a : P.A) (b : P.B a → α) :
    Obj.rec mk (.mk a b) = mk a b

name: Obj.fst_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem Obj.fst_mk (a : P.A) (f : P.B a → α) : Obj.fst (.mk a f) = a

name: Obj.snd_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem Obj.snd_mk (a : P.A) (f : P.B a → α) : Obj.snd (.mk a f) = f

name: Obj.eta
statement: @[simp] theorem Obj.eta (x : P α) : .mk x.fst x.snd = x

name: map_eq_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_eq_map {α β : Type v} (f : α → β) (x : P α) : f <$> x = P.map f x

name: map_eq
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem map_eq (f : α → β) (a : P.A) (g : P.B a → α) :
    P.map f (.mk a g) = .mk a (f ∘ g)

name: id_map
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem id_map (x : P α) : P.map id x = x

name: map_map
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem map_map (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (x : P α) :
    P.map g (P.map f x) = P.map (g ∘ f) x

name: W.dest_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem W.dest_mk (p : P (W P)) : W.dest (W.mk p) = p

name: W.mk_dest
statement:
@[simp]
theorem W.mk_dest (p : W P) : W.mk (W.dest p) = p

name: fst_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fst_map (x : P α) (f : α → β) : (P.map f x).1 = x.1

name: iget_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iget_map [DecidableEq P.A] [Inhabited α] [Inhabited β] (x : P α)
    (f : α → β) (i : P.Idx) (h : i.1 = x.1) : (P.map f x).iget i = f (x.iget i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Obj.iget, fst_map, *, dite_eq_left]
  cases x
  rfl

name: liftp_iff
statement:
theorem liftp_iff {α : Type u} (p : α → Prop) (x : P α) :
    Liftp p x ↔ ∃ a f, x = .mk a f ∧ ∀ i, p (f i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    cases y with | mk a f
    refine ⟨a, fun i => (f i).val, rfl, fun i => (f i).property⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, f, rfl, pf⟩
    exact ⟨.mk a fun i => ⟨f i, pf i⟩, rfl⟩

name: liftp_iff'
statement:
theorem liftp_iff' {α : Type u} (p : α → Prop) (a : P.A) (f : P.B a → α) :
    Liftp p (.mk a f : P α) ↔ ∀ i, p (f i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [liftp_iff]; constructor <;> intro h
  · rcases h with ⟨a', f', heq, h'⟩
    cases heq
    assumption
  · repeat' first | constructor | assumption

name: liftr_iff
statement:
theorem liftr_iff {α : Type u} (r : α → α → Prop) (x y : P α) :
    Liftr r x y ↔ ∃ a f₀ f₁, x = .mk a f₀ ∧ y = .mk a f₁ ∧ ∀ i, r (f₀ i) (f₁ i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl, rfl⟩
    cases u with | mk a f
    exact ⟨a, fun i => (f i).1.1, fun i => (f i).1.2, rfl, rfl, fun i => (f i).2⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, f₀, f₁, rfl, rfl, h⟩
    exact ⟨.mk a fun i => ⟨(f₀ i, f₁ i), h i⟩, rfl, rfl⟩

name: supp_eq
statement:
theorem supp_eq {α : Type u} (a : P.A) (f : P.B a → α) :
    supp (.mk a f : P α) = f '' univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp only [supp, image_univ, mem_range, mem_ofPred_eq]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · apply @h fun x => ∃ y : P.B a, f y = x
    rw [liftp_iff']
    intro
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · simp only [liftp_iff']
    cases h
    subst x
    tauto

name: cofixA_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cofixA_eq_zero : ∀ x y : CofixA F 0, x = y
  | CofixA.continue, CofixA.continue => rfl

variable {F}

/
approximation of the cofix of a pfunctor.
-/
def head' : ∀ {n}, CofixA F (succ n) → F.A
  | _, CofixA.intro i _ => i

/
def children' : ∀ {n} (x : CofixA F (succ n)), F.B (head' x) → CofixA F n
  | _, CofixA.intro _ f => f

name: approx_eta
statement: theorem approx_eta {n : ℕ} (x : CofixA F (n + 1)) : x = CofixA.intro (head' x) (children' x)

name: agree_trivial
statement:
@[simp]
theorem agree_trivial {x : CofixA F 0} {y : CofixA F 1} : Agree x y

name: agree_children
statement:
theorem agree_children {n : ℕ} (x : CofixA F (succ n)) (y : CofixA F (succ n + 1)) {i j}
    (h₀ : i ≍ j) (h₁ : Agree x y) : Agree (children' x i) (children' y j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain - | ⟨_, _, hagree⟩ := h₁; cases h₀
  apply hagree

name: truncate_eq_of_agree
statement:
theorem truncate_eq_of_agree {n : ℕ} (x : CofixA F n) (y : CofixA F (succ n)) (h : Agree x y) :
    truncate y = x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    cases x
    cases y
    rfl
  | succ n n_ih =>
    cases h with | intro f y h₁ =>
    simp only [truncate, Function.comp_def]
    congr with y
    exact n_ih _ _ (h₁ y)

name: P_corec
statement: theorem P_corec (i : X) (n : ℕ) : Agree (sCorec f i n) (sCorec f i (succ n))
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing i with
  | zero => constructor
  | succ n n_ih => exact .intro _ _ fun _ => n_ih _

name: head_succ'
statement:
theorem head_succ' (n m : ℕ) (x : ∀ n, CofixA F n) (Hconsistent : AllAgree x) :
    head' (x (succ n)) = head' (x (succ m))
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ n, head' (x (succ n)) = head' (x 1) by simp [this]
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => grind
  | succ n n_ih => grind +splitIndPred [Hconsistent (succ n), head']

name: M.default_consistent
statement:
theorem M.default_consistent [Inhabited F.A] : ∀ n, Agree (default : CofixA F n) default
  | 0 => Agree.continu _ _
  | succ n => Agree.intro _ _ fun _ => M.default_consistent n

instance MIntl.inhabited [Inhabited F.A] : Inhabited (MIntl F)

name: ext'
statement: theorem ext' (x y : M F) (H : ∀ i : ℕ, x.approx i = y.approx i) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  cases x
  cases y
  congr with n
  apply H

name: head_succ
statement: theorem head_succ (n m : ℕ) (x : M F) : head' (x.approx (succ n)) = head' (x.approx (succ m))

name: head_eq_head'
statement:
theorem head_eq_head' : ∀ (x : M F) (n : ℕ), head x = head' (x.approx <| n + 1)
  | ⟨_, h⟩, _ => head_succ' _ _ _ h

name: head'_eq_head
statement:
theorem head'_eq_head : ∀ (x : M F) (n : ℕ), head' (x.approx <| n + 1) = head x
  | ⟨_, h⟩, _ => head_succ' _ _ _ h

name: truncate_approx
statement: theorem truncate_approx (x : M F) (n : ℕ) : truncate (x.approx <| n + 1) = x.approx n

name: P_mk
statement:
protected theorem P_mk (x : F (M F)) : AllAgree (Approx.sMk x)
  | 0 => by constructor
  | succ n => by
    constructor
    intro i
    apply (x.snd i).consistent

end Approx

/
protected def mk (x : F (M F)) : M F where
  approx

name: dest_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem dest_mk (x : F (M F)) : dest (M.mk x) = x

name: mk_dest
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_dest (x : M F) : M.mk (dest x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply ext'
  intro n
  dsimp only [M.mk]
  induction n with | zero => apply @Subsingleton.elim _ CofixA.instSubsingleton | succ n ih
  unfold Approx.sMk dest head
  dsimp only [Obj.fst_mk, Obj.snd_mk]
  cases h : x.approx (n + 1) with | intro hd ch
  obtain rfl : hd = head' (x.approx 1) := by
    rw [← head_succ' n 0 x.approx x.consistent, h]
    rfl
  refine congrArg (CofixA.intro (head' (x.approx 1))) (funext fun a => ?_)
  unfold children
  dsimp only
  rw! [h]
  rfl

name: mk_inj
statement: theorem mk_inj {x y : F (M F)} (h : M.mk x = M.mk y) : x = y
proof: := by rw [← dest_mk x, h, dest_mk]

name: approx_mk
statement:
theorem approx_mk (a : F.A) (f : F.B a → M F) (i : ℕ) :
    (M.mk (.mk a f)).approx (succ i) = CofixA.intro a fun j => (f j).approx i

name: agree'_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem agree'_refl {n : ℕ} (x : M F) : Agree' n x x
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing x with | zero => ?_ | succ _ n_ih => ?_ <;>
  induction x using PFunctor.M.casesOn' <;> constructor <;> try rfl
  intro; apply n_ih

name: agree_iff_agree'
statement:
theorem agree_iff_agree' {n : ℕ} (x y : M F) :
    Agree (x.approx n) (y.approx <| n + 1) ↔ Agree' n x y
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · induction n generalizing x y with
    | zero => constructor
    | succ _ n_ih =>
      induction x using PFunctor.M.casesOn'
      induction y using PFunctor.M.casesOn'
      simp only [approx_mk] at h
      obtain - | ⟨_, _, hagree⟩ := h
      constructor <;> try rfl
      intro i
      apply n_ih
      apply hagree
  · induction n generalizing x y with
    | zero => constructor
    | succ _ n_ih =>
      obtain - | @⟨_, a, x', y'⟩ := h
      induction x using PFunctor.M.casesOn' with | _ x_a x_f
      induction y using PFunctor.M.casesOn' with | _ y_a y_f
      simp only [approx_mk]
      have h_a_1 := mk_inj ‹M.mk ⟨x_a, x_f⟩ = M.mk ⟨a, x'⟩›
      cases h_a_1
      replace h_a_2 := mk_inj ‹M.mk ⟨y_a, y_f⟩ = M.mk ⟨a, y'⟩›
      cases h_a_2
      constructor
      intro i
      apply n_ih
      simp [*]

name: cases_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cases_mk {r : M F → Sort*} (x : F (M F)) (f : ∀ x : F (M F), r (M.mk x)) :
    PFunctor.M.cases f (M.mk x) = f x

name: casesOn_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem casesOn_mk {r : M F → Sort*} (x : F (M F)) (f : ∀ x : F (M F), r (M.mk x)) :
    PFunctor.M.casesOn (M.mk x) f = f x

name: casesOn_mk'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem casesOn_mk' {r : M F → Sort*} {a} (x : F.B a → M F)
    (f : ∀ (a) (f : F.B a → M F), r (M.mk (.mk a f))) :
    PFunctor.M.casesOn' (M.mk (.mk a x)) f = f a x

name: isPath_cons
statement:
theorem isPath_cons {xs : Path F} {a a'} {f : F.B a → M F} {i : F.B a'} :
    IsPath (⟨a', i⟩ :: xs) (M.mk (.mk a f)) → a = a'
proof:
:= by
  generalize h : M.mk (.mk a f) = x
  rintro (_ | ⟨_, _, _, _, rfl, _⟩)
  cases mk_inj h
  rfl

name: isPath_cons'
statement:
theorem isPath_cons' {xs : Path F} {a} {f : F.B a → M F} {i : F.B a} :
    IsPath (⟨a, i⟩ :: xs) (M.mk (.mk a f)) → IsPath xs (f i)
proof:
:= by
  generalize h : M.mk (.mk a f) = x
  rintro (_ | ⟨_, _, _, _, rfl, hp⟩)
  cases mk_inj h
  exact hp

name: iselect_eq_default
statement:
theorem iselect_eq_default [DecidableEq F.A] [Inhabited (M F)] (ps : Path F) (x : M F)
    (h : ¬IsPath ps x) : iselect ps x = head default
proof:
:= by
  induction ps generalizing x with
  | nil =>
    exfalso
    apply h
    constructor
  | cons ps_hd ps_tail ps_ih =>
    obtain ⟨a, i⟩ := ps_hd
    induction x using PFunctor.M.casesOn' with | _ x_a x_f
    simp only [iselect, isubtree] at ps_ih ⊢
    by_cases h'' : a = x_a
    · subst x_a
      simp only [dite_eq_left, casesOn_mk']
      rw [ps_ih]
      intro h'
      apply h
      constructor <;> try rfl
      apply h'
    · simp [*]

name: head_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem head_mk (x : F (M F)) : head (M.mk x) = x.fst
proof:
:=
  Eq.symm <|
    calc
      x.1 = (dest (M.mk x)).1 := by rw [dest_mk]
      _ = head (M.mk x) := rfl

name: children_mk
statement:
theorem children_mk {a} (x : F.B a → M F) (i : F.B (head (M.mk (.mk a x)))) :
    children (M.mk (.mk a x)) i = x (cast (by simp) i)
proof: := by apply ext'; intro n; rfl

name: ichildren_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ichildren_mk [DecidableEq F.A] [Inhabited (M F)] (x : F (M F)) (i : F.Idx) :
    ichildren i (M.mk x) = x.iget i
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [ichildren, PFunctor.Obj.iget]
  congr with h

name: isubtree_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isubtree_cons [DecidableEq F.A] [Inhabited (M F)] (ps : Path F) {a} (f : F.B a → M F)
    {i : F.B a} : isubtree (⟨_, i⟩ :: ps) (M.mk (.mk a f)) = isubtree ps (f i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isubtree, dite_eq_left, isubtree, M.casesOn_mk']; rfl

name: iselect_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iselect_nil [DecidableEq F.A] [Inhabited (M F)] {a} (f : F.B a → M F) :
    iselect nil (M.mk (.mk a f)) = a

name: iselect_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iselect_cons [DecidableEq F.A] [Inhabited (M F)] (ps : Path F) {a} (f : F.B a → M F) {i} :
    iselect (⟨a, i⟩ :: ps) (M.mk (.mk a f)) = iselect ps (f i)

name: corec_def
statement: theorem corec_def {X} (f : X → F X) (x₀ : X) : M.corec f x₀ = M.mk (F.map (M.corec f) (f x₀))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [M.corec, M.mk]
  congr with n
  rcases n with - | n
  · dsimp only [sCorec, Approx.sMk]
  · dsimp only [sCorec, Approx.sMk]
    cases f x₀
    dsimp only [PFunctor.map]
    congr

name: ext_aux
statement:
theorem ext_aux [Inhabited (M F)] [DecidableEq F.A] {n : ℕ} (x y z : M F) (hx : Agree' n z x)
    (hy : Agree' n z y) (hrec : ∀ ps : Path F, n = ps.length → iselect ps x = iselect ps y) :
    x.approx (n + 1) = y.approx (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing x y z with
  | zero =>
    specialize hrec [] rfl
    induction x using PFunctor.M.casesOn'
    induction y using PFunctor.M.casesOn'
    simp only [iselect_nil] at hrec
    subst hrec
    simp only [approx_mk, heq_iff_eq, CofixA.intro.injEq,
      eq_iff_true_of_subsingleton, and_self]
  | succ n n_ih =>
    cases hx
    cases hy
    induction x using PFunctor.M.casesOn'
    induction y using PFunctor.M.casesOn'
    subst z
    iterate 3 (have := mk_inj ‹_›; cases this)
    rename_i n_ih a f₃ f₂ hAgree₂ _ _ h₂ _ _ f₁ h₁ hAgree₁ clr
    simp only [approx_mk]
    have := mk_inj h₁
    cases this; clear h₁
    have := mk_inj h₂
    cases this; clear h₂
    congr
    ext i
    apply n_ih
    · solve_by_elim
    · solve_by_elim
    introv h
    specialize hrec (⟨_, i⟩ :: ps) (congr_arg _ h)
    simp only [iselect_cons] at hrec
    exact hrec

name: ext
statement:
theorem ext [Inhabited (M F)] [DecidableEq F.A] (x y : M F)
    (H : ∀ ps : Path F, iselect ps x = iselect ps y) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply ext'; intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => subsingleton
  | succ i i_ih =>
    apply ext_aux x y x
    · rw [← agree_iff_agree']
      apply x.consistent
    · rw [← agree_iff_agree', i_ih]
      apply y.consistent
    introv H'
    dsimp only [iselect] at H
    cases H'
    apply H ps

name: nth_of_bisim
statement:
theorem nth_of_bisim [Inhabited (M F)] [DecidableEq F.A]
    (bisim : IsBisimulation R) (s₁ s₂) (ps : Path F) :
    (R s₁ s₂) →
      IsPath ps s₁ ∨ IsPath ps s₂ →
        iselect ps s₁ = iselect ps s₂ ∧
          ∃ (a : _) (f f' : F.B a → M F),
            isubtree ps s₁ = M.mk (.mk a f) ∧
              isubtree ps s₂ = M.mk (.mk a f') ∧ ∀ i : F.B a, f i ~ f' i
proof:
:= by
  intro h₀ hh
  induction s₁ using PFunctor.M.casesOn' with | _ a f
  induction s₂ using PFunctor.M.casesOn' with | _ a' f'
  obtain rfl : a = a' := bisim.head h₀
  induction ps generalizing a f f' with
  | nil =>
    exists rfl, a, f, f', rfl, rfl
    apply bisim.tail h₀
  | cons i ps ps_ih => ?_
  obtain ⟨a', i⟩ := i
  obtain rfl : a = a' := by rcases hh with hh | hh <;> cases isPath_cons hh <;> rfl
  dsimp only [iselect] at ps_ih ⊢
  have h₁ := bisim.tail h₀ i
  induction h : f i using PFunctor.M.casesOn' with | _ a₀ f₀
  induction h' : f' i using PFunctor.M.casesOn' with | _ a₁ f₁
  simp only [h, h', isubtree_cons] at ps_ih ⊢
  rw [h, h'] at h₁
  obtain rfl : a₀ = a₁ := bisim.head h₁
  apply ps_ih _ _ _ h₁
  rw [← h, ← h']
  apply Or.imp isPath_cons' isPath_cons' hh

name: eq_of_bisim
statement: theorem eq_of_bisim [Nonempty (M F)] (bisim : IsBisimulation R) : ∀ s₁ s₂, R s₁ s₂ → s₁ = s₂
proof:
:= by
  inhabit M F
  classical
  introv Hr; apply ext
  introv
  by_cases h : IsPath ps s₁ ∨ IsPath ps s₂
  · have H := nth_of_bisim R bisim _ _ ps Hr h
    exact H.left
  · rw [not_or] at h
    obtain ⟨h₀, h₁⟩ := h
    simp only [iselect_eq_default, *, not_false_iff]

name: dest_corec
statement: theorem dest_corec (g : α → P α) (x : α) : M.dest (M.corec g x) = P.map (M.corec g) (g x)

name: bisim
statement:
theorem bisim (R : M P → M P → Prop)
    (h : ∀ x y, R x y → ∃ a f f',
      M.dest x = (.mk a f) ∧ M.dest y = (.mk a f') ∧ ∀ i, R (f i) (f' i)) :
    ∀ x y, R x y → x = y
proof:
:= by
  introv h'
  have := Inhabited.mk x.head
  apply eq_of_bisim R _ _ _ h'; clear h' x y
  constructor <;> introv ih <;> rcases h _ _ ih with ⟨a'', g, g', h₀, h₁, h₂⟩ <;> clear h
  · replace h₀ := congr_arg Obj.fst h₀
    replace h₁ := congr_arg Obj.fst h₁
    simp only [dest_mk, Obj.fst_mk] at h₀ h₁
    rw [h₀, h₁]
  · simp only [dest_mk] at h₀ h₁
    cases h₀
    cases h₁
    apply h₂

name: bisim'
statement:
theorem bisim' {α : Type*} (Q : α → Prop) (u v : α → M P)
    (h : ∀ x, Q x → ∃ a f f',
          M.dest (u x) = (.mk a f)
          ∧ M.dest (v x) = (.mk a f')
          ∧ ∀ i, ∃ x', Q x' ∧ f i = u x' ∧ f' i = v x') :
    ∀ x, Q x → u x = v x
proof:
:= fun x Qx =>
  let R := fun w z : M P => ∃ x', Q x' ∧ w = u x' ∧ z = v x'
  @M.bisim P R
    (fun _ _ ⟨x', Qx', xeq, yeq⟩ =>
      let ⟨a, f, f', ux'eq, vx'eq, h'⟩ := h x' Qx'
      ⟨a, f, f', xeq.symm ▸ ux'eq, yeq.symm ▸ vx'eq, h'⟩)
    _ _ ⟨x, Qx, rfl, rfl⟩

name: bisim_equiv
statement:
theorem bisim_equiv (R : M P → M P → Prop)
    (h : ∀ x y, R x y → ∃ a f f',
      M.dest x = (.mk a f) ∧ M.dest y = (.mk a f') ∧ ∀ i, R (f i) (f' i)) :
    ∀ x y, R x y → x = y
proof:
:= fun x y Rxy =>
  let Q : M P × M P → Prop := fun p => R p.fst p.snd
  bisim' Q Prod.fst Prod.snd
    (fun p Qp =>
      let ⟨a, f, f', hx, hy, h'⟩ := h p.fst p.snd Qp
      ⟨a, f, f', hx, hy, fun i => ⟨⟨f i, f' i⟩, h' i, rfl, rfl⟩⟩)
    ⟨x, y⟩ Rxy

name: corec_unique
statement:
theorem corec_unique (g : α → P α) (f : α → M P) (hyp : ∀ x, M.dest (f x) = P.map f (g x)) :
    f = M.corec g
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  apply bisim' (fun _ => True) _ _ _ _ trivial
  clear x
  intro x _
  cases gxeq : g x with | mk a f'
  have h₀ : M.dest (f x) = .mk a (f ∘ f') := by rw [hyp, gxeq, PFunctor.map_eq]
  have h₁ : M.dest (M.corec g x) = .mk a (M.corec g ∘ f') := by
    rw [dest_corec, gxeq, PFunctor.map_eq]
  refine ⟨_, _, _, h₀, h₁, ?_⟩
  intro i
  exact ⟨f' i, trivial, rfl, rfl⟩

name: degLex_def
statement:
theorem degLex_def {r : α → α → Prop} {s : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} {a b : α →₀ ℕ} :
    Finsupp.DegLex r s a b ↔ Prod.Lex s (Finsupp.Lex r s) (a.degree, a) (b.degree, b)

name: wellFounded
statement:
theorem wellFounded
    {r : α → α → Prop} [Std.Trichotomous r] (hr : WellFounded (Function.swap r))
    {s : ℕ → ℕ → Prop} (hs : WellFounded s) (hs0 : ∀ ⦃n⦄, ¬ s n 0) :
    WellFounded (Finsupp.DegLex r s)
proof:
:= by
  have wft := WellFounded.prod_lex hs (Finsupp.Lex.wellFounded' hs0 hs hr)
  rw [← Set.wellFoundedOn_univ] at wft
  unfold Finsupp.DegLex
  rw [← Set.wellFoundedOn_range]
  exact Set.WellFoundedOn.mono wft (le_refl _) (fun _ _ ↦ trivial)

name: lt_def
statement:
theorem lt_def [LT α] {a b : DegLex (α →₀ ℕ)} :
    a < b ↔ (toLex ((ofDegLex a).degree, toLex (ofDegLex a))) <
        (toLex ((ofDegLex b).degree, toLex (ofDegLex b)))

name: lt_iff
statement:
theorem lt_iff [LT α] {a b : DegLex (α →₀ ℕ)} :
    a < b ↔ (ofDegLex a).degree < (ofDegLex b).degree ∨
    (((ofDegLex a).degree = (ofDegLex b).degree) ∧ toLex (ofDegLex a) < toLex (ofDegLex b))

name: le_iff
statement:
theorem le_iff {x y : DegLex (α →₀ ℕ)} :
    x ≤ y ↔ (ofDegLex x).degree < (ofDegLex y).degree ∨
      (ofDegLex x).degree = (ofDegLex y).degree ∧ toLex (ofDegLex x) ≤ toLex (ofDegLex y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [le_iff_eq_or_lt, lt_iff, EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq]
  by_cases h : x = y
  · simp [h]
  · by_cases k : (ofDegLex x).degree < (ofDegLex y).degree
    · simp [k]
    · simp only [h, k, false_or]

name: single_strictAnti
statement: theorem single_strictAnti : StrictAnti (fun (a : α) ↦ toDegLex (single a 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro _ _ h
  simp only [lt_iff, ofDegLex_toDegLex, degree_single, lt_self_iff_false, Lex.single_lt_iff, h,
    and_self, or_true]

theorem single_le_iff {a b : α} :

name: monotone_degree
statement:
theorem monotone_degree :
    Monotone (fun (x : DegLex (α →₀ ℕ)) ↦ (ofDegLex x).degree)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  rw [le_iff]
  rintro (h | h)
  · apply le_of_lt h
  · apply le_of_eq h.1

statement:
theorem degLex_le_iff {a b : σ →₀ ℕ} :

name: bubble_sort_induction'
statement:
theorem bubble_sort_induction' {n : ℕ} {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] {f : Fin n → α}
    {P : (Fin n → α) → Prop} (hf : P f)
    (h : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (i j : Fin n),
      i < j → (f ∘ σ) j < (f ∘ σ) i → P (f ∘ σ) → P (f ∘ σ ∘ Equiv.swap i j)) :
    P (f ∘ sort f)
proof:
:= by
  let := @Preorder.lift _ (Lex (Fin n → α)) _ fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) => toLex (f ∘ σ)
  refine
    @WellFounded.induction_bot' _ _ _ (IsWellFounded.wf : WellFounded (· < ·))
      (Equiv.refl _) (sort f) P (fun σ => f ∘ σ) (fun σ hσ hfσ => ?_) hf
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij₁, hij₂⟩ := antitone_pair_of_not_sorted' hσ
  exact ⟨σ * Equiv.swap i j, Pi.lex_desc hij₁.le hij₂, h σ i j hij₁ hij₂ hfσ⟩

name: bubble_sort_induction
statement:
theorem bubble_sort_induction {n : ℕ} {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] {f : Fin n → α}
    {P : (Fin n → α) → Prop} (hf : P f)
    (h : ∀ (g : Fin n → α) (i j : Fin n), i < j → g j < g i → P g → P (g ∘ Equiv.swap i j)) :
    P (f ∘ sort f)

statement:

theorem uncurry_apply_cons {n : ℕ} {α} {p : Fin n → Type u} {τ : Type u}

name: uncurry_apply_succ
statement:
@[simp low]
theorem uncurry_apply_succ {n : ℕ} {p : Fin (n + 1) → Type u} {τ : Type u}
    (f : Function.FromTypes p τ) (args : (i : Fin (n + 1)) → p i) :

statement:
@[simp]
theorem curry_apply_cons {n : ℕ} {α} {p : Fin n → Type u} {τ : Type u}
    (f : ((i : Fin (n + 1)) → (vecCons α p) i) → τ) (a : α) :
    curry f a = @curry _ p _ (f ∘' Fin.cons a :)

statement:

theorem curry_apply_succ {n : ℕ} {p : Fin (n + 1) → Type u} {τ : Type u}

name: curry_uncurry
statement:
@[simp]
theorem curry_uncurry (f : Function.FromTypes p τ) : curry (uncurry f) = f
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => exact funext (ih <| f ·)

name: uncurry_curry
statement:
@[simp]
theorem uncurry_curry (f : ((i : Fin n) → p i) → τ) :
    uncurry (curry f) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext args
  induction n with
  | zero => exact congrArg f (Subsingleton.allEq _ _)
  | succ n ih => exact Eq.trans (ih _ _) (congrArg f (Fin.cons_self_tail args))

name: seq_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem seq_eq : ∀ {m} (f : Fin m → α → β) (v : Fin m → α), seq f v = fun i => f i (v i)
  | 0, _, _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  | n + 1, f, v =>
    funext fun i => by
      simp_rw [seq, seq_eq]
      refine i.cases ?_ fun i => ?_
      · rfl
      · rw [Matrix.cons_val_succ]
        rfl

example {f₁ f₂ : α → β} (a₁ a₂ : α) : seq ![f₁, f₂] ![a₁, a₂] = ![f₁ a₁, f₂ a₂]

theorem forall_iff : ∀ {m} (P : (Fin m → α) → Prop), Forall P ↔ ∀ x, P x
  | 0, P => by
    simp only [Forall, Fin.forall_fin_zero_pi]
    rfl
  | .succ n, P => by simp only [Forall, forall_iff, Fin.forall_fin_succ_pi, Matrix.vecCons]

  | 0, _ => rfl
  | 1, a => (Fintype.prod_unique a).symm
  | n + 2, a => by rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc, prod, prod_eq]

example [CommMonoid α] (a : Fin 3 → α) : ∏ i, a i = a 0 * a 1 * a 2

name: take_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem take_apply (m : ℕ) (h : m ≤ n) (v : (i : Fin n) → α i) (i : Fin m) :
    (take m h v) i = v (castLE h i)

name: take_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem take_zero (v : (i : Fin n) → α i) : take 0 n.zero_le v = fun i ↦ elim0 i
proof:
:= by
  ext i; exact elim0 i

name: take_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem take_one {α : Fin (n + 1) → Sort*} (v : (i : Fin (n + 1)) → α i) :
    take 1 (Nat.le_add_left 1 n) v = (fun i => v (castLE (Nat.le_add_left 1 n) i))

statement:

theorem take_eq_init {α : Fin (n + 1) → Sort*} (v : (i : Fin (n + 1)) → α i) :
