name: take_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem take_eq_self (v : (i : Fin n) → α i) : take n (le_refl n) v = v

name: take_take
statement:
@[simp]
theorem take_take {m n' : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n') (h' : n' ≤ n) (v : (i : Fin n) → α i) :
    take m h (take n' h' v) = take m (Nat.le_trans h h') v

name: take_init
statement:
@[simp]
theorem take_init {α : Fin (n + 1) → Sort*} (m : ℕ) (h : m ≤ n) (v : (i : Fin (n + 1)) → α i) :
    take m h (init v) = take m (Nat.le_succ_of_le h) v

name: take_repeat
statement:
theorem take_repeat {α : Type*} {n' : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (h : m ≤ n) (a : Fin n' → α) :
    take (m * n') (Nat.mul_le_mul_right n' h) (Fin.repeat n a) = Fin.repeat m a
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [take, repeat_apply, modNat, val_castLE]

name: take_succ_eq_snoc
statement:
theorem take_succ_eq_snoc (m : ℕ) (h : m < n) (v : (i : Fin n) → α i) :
    take m.succ h v = snoc (take m h.le v) (v ⟨m, h⟩)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    have h' : i = 0 := by ext; simp
    subst h'
    simp [take, snoc, castLE]
  | succ m _ =>
    induction i using reverseInduction with
    | last => simp [take, snoc]; congr
    | cast i _ => simp

name: take_update_of_lt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem take_update_of_lt (m : ℕ) (h : m ≤ n) (v : (i : Fin n) → α i) (i : Fin m)
    (x : α (castLE h i)) : take m h (update v (castLE h i) x) = update (take m h v) i x
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  by_cases h' : j = i
  · rw [h']
    simp only [take, update_self]
  · have : castLE h j ≠ castLE h i := by simp [h']
    simp only [take, update_of_ne h', update_of_ne this]

name: take_update_of_ge
statement:
@[simp]
theorem take_update_of_ge (m : ℕ) (h : m ≤ n) (v : (i : Fin n) → α i) (i : Fin n) (hi : i ≥ m)
    (x : α i) : take m h (update v i x) = take m h v
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  have : castLE h j ≠ i := by
    refine ne_of_val_ne ?_
    simp only [val_castLE]
    exact Nat.ne_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le j.isLt hi)
  simp only [take, update_of_ne this]

name: take_addCases_left
statement:
theorem take_addCases_left {n' : ℕ} {motive : Fin (n + n') → Sort*} (m : ℕ) (h : m ≤ n)
    (u : (i : Fin n) → motive (castAdd n' i)) (v : (i : Fin n') → motive (natAdd n i)) :
      take m (Nat.le_add_right_of_le h) (addCases u v) = take m h u
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  have : i < n := Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt h
  simp only [take, addCases, this, val_castLE, ↓reduceDIte]
  congr

name: take_append_left
statement:
theorem take_append_left {n' : ℕ} {α : Sort*} (m : ℕ) (h : m ≤ n) (u : (i : Fin n) → α)
    (v : (i : Fin n') → α) : take m (Nat.le_add_right_of_le h) (append u v) = take m h u

name: take_addCases_right
statement:
theorem take_addCases_right {n' : ℕ} {motive : Fin (n + n') → Sort*} (m : ℕ) (h : m ≤ n')
    (u : (i : Fin n) → motive (castAdd n' i)) (v : (i : Fin n') → motive (natAdd n i)) :
      take (n + m) (Nat.add_le_add_left h n) (addCases u v) = addCases u (take m h v)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [take, addCases, val_castLE]
  by_cases h' : i < n
  · simp only [h', ↓reduceDIte]
    congr
  · simp only [h', ↓reduceDIte, subNat, castLE, Fin.cast, eqRec_eq_cast]

name: take_append_right
statement:
theorem take_append_right {n' : ℕ} {α : Sort*} (m : ℕ) (h : m ≤ n') (u : (i : Fin n) → α)
    (v : (i : Fin n') → α) : take (n + m) (Nat.add_le_add_left h n) (append u v)
        = append u (take m h v)

name: ofFn_take_eq_take_ofFn
statement:
theorem ofFn_take_eq_take_ofFn {α : Type*} {m : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) (v : Fin n → α) :
    List.ofFn (take m h v) = (List.ofFn v).take m
proof:
:=
  List.ext_get (by simp [h]) (fun n h1 h2 => by simp)

name: ofFn_take_get
statement:
theorem ofFn_take_get {α : Type*} {m : ℕ} (l : List α) (h : m ≤ l.length) :
    List.ofFn (take m h l.get) = l.take m
proof:
:=
  List.ext_get (by simp [h]) (fun n h1 h2 => by simp)

name: get_take_eq_take_get_comp_cast
statement:
theorem get_take_eq_take_get_comp_cast {α : Type*} {m : ℕ} (l : List α) (h : m ≤ l.length) :
    (l.take m).get = take m h l.get ∘ Fin.cast (List.length_take_of_le h)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [List.get_eq_getElem, List.getElem_take, comp_apply, take_apply, val_castLE, val_cast]

name: get_take_ofFn_eq_take_comp_cast
statement:
theorem get_take_ofFn_eq_take_comp_cast {α : Type*} {m : ℕ} (v : Fin n → α) (h : m ≤ n) :
    ((List.ofFn v).take m).get = take m h v ∘ Fin.cast (by simp [h])

name: mem_piFinset_iff_zero_tail
statement:
lemma mem_piFinset_iff_zero_tail :
    f ∈ Fintype.piFinset s ↔ f 0 ∈ s 0 ∧ tail f ∈ piFinset (tail s)

name: mem_piFinset_iff_last_init
statement:
lemma mem_piFinset_iff_last_init :
    f ∈ piFinset s ↔ f (last n) ∈ s (last n) ∧ init f ∈ piFinset (init s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fintype.mem_piFinset, forall_fin_succ', init, and_comm]

name: mem_piFinset_iff_pivot_removeNth
statement:
lemma mem_piFinset_iff_pivot_removeNth (p : Fin (n + 1)) :
    f ∈ piFinset s ↔ f p ∈ s p ∧ removeNth p f ∈ piFinset (removeNth p s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Fintype.mem_piFinset, forall_iff_succAbove p, removeNth]

name: cons_mem_piFinset_cons
statement:
lemma cons_mem_piFinset_cons {x_zero : α 0} {x_tail : (i : Fin n) → α i.succ}
    {s_zero : Finset (α 0)} {s_tail : (i : Fin n) → Finset (α i.succ)} :
    cons x_zero x_tail ∈ piFinset (cons s_zero s_tail) ↔
      x_zero ∈ s_zero ∧ x_tail ∈ piFinset s_tail

name: snoc_mem_piFinset_snoc
statement:
lemma snoc_mem_piFinset_snoc {x_last : α (last n)} {x_init : (i : Fin n) → α i.castSucc}
    {s_last : Finset (α (last n))} {s_init : (i : Fin n) → Finset (α i.castSucc)} :
    snoc x_init x_last ∈ piFinset (snoc s_init s_last) ↔
      x_last ∈ s_last ∧ x_init ∈ piFinset s_init

name: insertNth_mem_piFinset_insertNth
statement:
lemma insertNth_mem_piFinset_insertNth {x_pivot : α p} {x_remove : ∀ i, α (succAbove p i)}
    {s_pivot : Finset (α p)} {s_remove : ∀ i, Finset (α (succAbove p i))} :
    insertNth p x_pivot x_remove ∈ piFinset (insertNth p s_pivot s_remove) ↔
      x_pivot ∈ s_pivot ∧ x_remove ∈ piFinset s_remove

name: map_consEquiv_filter_piFinset
proof:
:= by
  unfold tail; ext; simp [Fin.forall_iff_succ, and_assoc]

name: map_snocEquiv_filter_piFinset
proof:
:= by
  unfold init; ext; simp [Fin.forall_iff_castSucc, and_assoc]

name: map_insertNthEquiv_filter_piFinset
proof:
:= by
  unfold removeNth; ext; simp [Fin.forall_iff_succAbove p, and_assoc]

name: filter_piFinset_eq_map_consEquiv
statement:
lemma filter_piFinset_eq_map_consEquiv (P : (∀ i, α (succ i)) → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    {r ∈ piFinset S | P (tail r)} =
      (S 0 ×ˢ {r ∈ piFinset (tail S) | P r}).map (consEquiv α).toEmbedding

name: filter_piFinset_eq_map_snocEquiv
statement:
lemma filter_piFinset_eq_map_snocEquiv (P : (∀ i, α (castSucc i)) → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    {r ∈ piFinset S | P (init r)} =
      (S (last _) ×ˢ {r ∈ piFinset (init S) | P r}).map (snocEquiv α).toEmbedding

name: filter_piFinset_eq_map_insertNthEquiv
statement:
lemma filter_piFinset_eq_map_insertNthEquiv (P : (∀ i, α (p.succAbove i)) → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] :
    {r ∈ piFinset S | P (p.removeNth r)} =
      (S p ×ˢ {r ∈ piFinset (p.removeNth  S) | P r}).map (p.insertNthEquiv α).toEmbedding

name: card_consEquiv_filter_piFinset
statement:
lemma card_consEquiv_filter_piFinset (P : (∀ i, α (succ i)) → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    {r ∈ piFinset S | P (tail r)}.card = (S 0).card * {r ∈ piFinset (tail S) | P r}.card

name: card_snocEquiv_filter_piFinset
statement:
lemma card_snocEquiv_filter_piFinset (P : (∀ i, α (castSucc i)) → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    {r ∈ piFinset S | P (init r)}.card =
      (S (last _)).card * {r ∈ piFinset (init S) | P r}.card

name: card_insertNthEquiv_filter_piFinset
statement:
lemma card_insertNthEquiv_filter_piFinset (P : (∀ i, α (p.succAbove i)) → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    {r ∈ piFinset S | P (p.removeNth r)}.card =
      (S p).card * {r ∈ piFinset (p.removeNth  S) | P r}.card

name: tuple0_le
statement: theorem tuple0_le {α : Fin 0 → Type*} [∀ i, Preorder (α i)] (f g : ∀ i, α i) : f ≤ g

name: tail_def
statement:
theorem tail_def {n : ℕ} {α : Fin (n + 1) → Sort*} {q : ∀ i, α i} :
    (tail fun k : Fin (n + 1) ↦ q k) = fun k : Fin n ↦ q k.succ

name: tail_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tail_cons : tail (cons x p) = p

name: cons_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cons_succ : cons x p i.succ = p i

name: cons_comp_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cons_comp_succ {α : Sort*} (x : α) (p : Fin n → α) :
    cons x p ∘ Fin.succ = p

name: cons_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cons_zero : cons x p 0 = x

name: cons_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cons_one {α : Fin (n + 2) → Sort*} (x : α 0) (p : ∀ i : Fin n.succ, α i.succ) :
    cons x p 1 = p 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cons_succ x p]; rfl

name: cons_last
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cons_last {α : Fin (n + 2) → Sort*} (x : α 0) (p : ∀ i : Fin n.succ, α i.succ) :
    cons x p (.last _) = p (.last _)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cons_succ x p]; rfl

name: cons_update
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cons_update : cons x (update p i y) = update (cons x p) i.succ y
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  cases j using Fin.cases <;> simp [Ne.symm, update_apply_of_injective _ (succ_injective _)]

name: cons_injective2
statement: theorem cons_injective2 : Function.Injective2 (@cons n α)
proof:
:= fun x₀ y₀ x y h ↦
  ⟨congr_fun h 0, funext fun i ↦ by simpa using congr_fun h (Fin.succ i)⟩

name: cons_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cons_inj {x₀ y₀ : α 0} {x y : ∀ i : Fin n, α i.succ} :
    cons x₀ x = cons y₀ y ↔ x₀ = y₀ ∧ x = y

name: cons_left_injective
statement: theorem cons_left_injective (x : ∀ i : Fin n, α i.succ) : Function.Injective fun x₀ ↦ cons x₀ x

name: cons_right_injective
statement: theorem cons_right_injective (x₀ : α 0) : Function.Injective (cons x₀)

name: update_cons_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem update_cons_zero : update (cons x p) 0 z = cons z p
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  cases j using Fin.cases <;> simp

name: cons_self_tail
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cons_self_tail : cons (q 0) (tail q) = q
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  cases j using Fin.cases <;> simp [tail]

name: cons_zero_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cons_zero_succ : (cons 0 Fin.succ : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1)) = id

name: consCases_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem consCases_cons {motive : (∀ i : Fin n.succ, α i) → Sort v}
    (cons : ∀ x₀ x, motive (Fin.cons x₀ x))
    (x₀ : α 0) (x : ∀ i : Fin n, α i.succ) : consCases cons (Fin.cons x₀ x) = cons x₀ x

name: cons_injective_of_injective
statement:
theorem cons_injective_of_injective {α} {x₀ : α} {x : Fin n → α} (hx₀ : x₀ ∉ Set.range x)
    (hx : Function.Injective x) : Function.Injective (cons x₀ x : Fin n.succ → α)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  cases i using Fin.cases <;> cases j using Fin.cases <;> aesop (add simp [hx.eq_iff])

name: cons_injective_iff
statement:
theorem cons_injective_iff {α} {x₀ : α} {x : Fin n → α} :
    Function.Injective (cons x₀ x : Fin n.succ → α) ↔ x₀ ∉ Set.range x ∧ Function.Injective x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun h ↦ cons_injective_of_injective h.1 h.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    replace h := @h i.succ 0
    simp [hi] at h
  · simpa [Function.comp] using! h.comp (Fin.succ_injective _)

name: exists_cons
statement:
theorem exists_cons {α : Fin (n + 1) → Type*} (q : ∀ i, α i) :
    ∃ (x₀ : α 0) (x : ∀ i : Fin n, α i.succ), q = cons x₀ x

name: forall_fin_zero_pi
statement:
@[simp]
theorem forall_fin_zero_pi {α : Fin 0 → Sort*} {P : (∀ i, α i) → Prop} :
    (∀ x, P x) ↔ P finZeroElim
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h _, fun h x ↦ Subsingleton.elim finZeroElim x ▸ h⟩

name: exists_fin_zero_pi
statement:
@[simp]
theorem exists_fin_zero_pi {α : Fin 0 → Sort*} {P : (∀ i, α i) → Prop} :
    (∃ x, P x) ↔ P finZeroElim
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨x, h⟩ ↦ Subsingleton.elim x finZeroElim ▸ h, fun h ↦ ⟨_, h⟩⟩

name: forall_fin_succ_pi
statement: theorem forall_fin_succ_pi {P : (∀ i, α i) → Prop} : (∀ x, P x) ↔ ∀ a v, P (Fin.cons a v)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h a v ↦ h (Fin.cons a v), consCases⟩

name: exists_fin_succ_pi
statement: theorem exists_fin_succ_pi {P : (∀ i, α i) → Prop} : (∃ x, P x) ↔ ∃ a v, P (Fin.cons a v)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨x, h⟩ ↦ ⟨x 0, tail x, (cons_self_tail x).symm ▸ h⟩, fun ⟨_, _, h⟩ ↦ ⟨_, h⟩⟩

name: tail_update_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tail_update_zero : tail (update q 0 z) = tail q

name: tail_update_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tail_update_succ : tail (update q i.succ y) = update (tail q) i y
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  by_cases h : j = i
  · rw [h]
    simp [tail]
  · simp [tail, (Fin.succ_injective n).ne h, h]

name: comp_cons
statement:
theorem comp_cons {α : Sort*} {β : Sort*} (g : α → β) (y : α) (q : Fin n → α) :
    g ∘ cons y q = cons (g y) (g ∘ q)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  by_cases h : j = 0
  · rw [h]
    rfl
  · let j' := pred j h
    have : j'.succ = j := succ_pred j h
    rw [← this, cons_succ, comp_apply, comp_apply, cons_succ]

name: comp_tail
statement:
theorem comp_tail {α : Sort*} {β : Sort*} (g : α → β) (q : Fin n.succ → α) :
    g ∘ tail q = tail (g ∘ q)

name: le_cons
statement:
theorem le_cons [∀ i, Preorder (α i)] {x : α 0} {q : ∀ i, α i} {p : ∀ i : Fin n, α i.succ} :
    q ≤ cons x p ↔ q 0 ≤ x ∧ tail q ≤ p
proof:
:=
  forall_fin_succ.trans <| and_congr Iff.rfl <| forall_congr' fun j ↦ by simp [tail]

name: cons_le
statement:
theorem cons_le [∀ i, Preorder (α i)] {x : α 0} {q : ∀ i, α i} {p : ∀ i : Fin n, α i.succ} :
    cons x p ≤ q ↔ x ≤ q 0 ∧ p ≤ tail q

name: cons_le_cons
statement:
theorem cons_le_cons [∀ i, Preorder (α i)] {x₀ y₀ : α 0} {x y : ∀ i : Fin n, α i.succ} :
    cons x₀ x ≤ cons y₀ y ↔ x₀ ≤ y₀ ∧ x ≤ y
proof:
:=
  forall_fin_succ.trans <| and_congr_right' <| by simp only [cons_succ, Pi.le_def]

name: range_fin_succ
statement:
theorem range_fin_succ {α} (f : Fin (n + 1) → α) :
    Set.range f = insert (f 0) (Set.range (Fin.tail f))

name: range_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem range_cons {α} {n : ℕ} (x : α) (b : Fin n → α) :
    Set.range (Fin.cons x b : Fin n.succ → α) = insert x (Set.range b)

name: append_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem append_left (u : Fin m → α) (v : Fin n → α) (i : Fin m) :
    append u v (Fin.castAdd n i) = u i

name: append_left'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem append_left' (u : Fin m → α) (v : Fin n → α) (i : Fin m) :
    append u v (Fin.castLE (by lia) i) = u i

name: append_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem append_right (u : Fin m → α) (v : Fin n → α) (i : Fin n) :
    append u v (natAdd m i) = v i

name: append_right_nil
statement:
theorem append_right_nil (u : Fin m → α) (v : Fin n → α) (hv : n = 0) :
    append u v = u ∘ Fin.cast (by rw [hv, Nat.add_zero])
proof:
:= by
  refine funext (Fin.addCases (fun l => ?_) fun r => ?_)
  · rw [append_left, Function.comp_apply]
    refine congr_arg u (Fin.ext ?_)
    simp
  · exact (Fin.cast hv r).elim0

name: append_elim0
statement:
@[simp]
theorem append_elim0 (u : Fin m → α) :
    append u Fin.elim0 = u ∘ Fin.cast (Nat.add_zero _)

name: append_left_nil
statement:
theorem append_left_nil (u : Fin m → α) (v : Fin n → α) (hu : m = 0) :
    append u v = v ∘ Fin.cast (by rw [hu, Nat.zero_add])
proof:
:= by
  refine funext (Fin.addCases (fun l => ?_) fun r => ?_)
  · exact (Fin.cast hu l).elim0
  · rw [append_right, Function.comp_apply]
    refine congr_arg v (Fin.ext ?_)
    simp [hu]

name: elim0_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem elim0_append (v : Fin n → α) :
    append Fin.elim0 v = v ∘ Fin.cast (Nat.zero_add _)

name: append_assoc
statement:
theorem append_assoc {p : ℕ} (a : Fin m → α) (b : Fin n → α) (c : Fin p → α) :
    append (append a b) c = append a (append b c) ∘ Fin.cast (Nat.add_assoc ..)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  rw [Function.comp_apply]
  refine Fin.addCases (fun l => ?_) (fun r => ?_) i
  · rw [append_left]
    refine Fin.addCases (fun ll => ?_) (fun lr => ?_) l
    · rw [append_left]
      simp [castAdd_castAdd]
    · rw [append_right]
      simp [castAdd_natAdd]
  · rw [append_right]
    simp [← natAdd_natAdd]

name: append_left_eq_cons
statement:
theorem append_left_eq_cons {n : ℕ} (x₀ : Fin 1 → α) (x : Fin n → α) :
    Fin.append x₀ x = Fin.cons (x₀ 0) x ∘ Fin.cast (Nat.add_comm ..)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ i <;> clear i
  · intro i
    rw [Subsingleton.elim i 0, Fin.append_left, Function.comp_apply, eq_comm]
    exact Fin.cons_zero _ _
  · intro i
    rw [Fin.append_right, Function.comp_apply, Fin.cast_natAdd, eq_comm, Fin.addNat_one]
    exact Fin.cons_succ _ _ _

name: cons_eq_append
statement:
theorem cons_eq_append (x : α) (xs : Fin n → α) :
    cons x xs = append (cons x Fin.elim0) xs ∘ Fin.cast (Nat.add_comm ..)

name: append_cast_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma append_cast_left {n m} (xs : Fin n → α) (ys : Fin m → α) (n' : ℕ)
    (h : n' = n) :
    Fin.append (xs ∘ Fin.cast h) ys = Fin.append xs ys ∘ (Fin.cast <| by rw [h])

name: append_cast_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma append_cast_right {n m} (xs : Fin n → α) (ys : Fin m → α) (m' : ℕ)
    (h : m' = m) :
    Fin.append xs (ys ∘ Fin.cast h) = Fin.append xs ys ∘ (Fin.cast <| by rw [h])

name: append_rev
statement:
lemma append_rev {m n} (xs : Fin m → α) (ys : Fin n → α) (i : Fin (m + n)) :
    append xs ys (rev i) = append (ys ∘ rev) (xs ∘ rev) (i.cast (Nat.add_comm ..))
proof:
:= by
  rcases rev_surjective i with ⟨i, rfl⟩
  rw [rev_rev]
  induction i using Fin.addCases
  · simp [rev_castAdd]
  · simp [cast_rev, rev_addNat]

name: append_comp_rev
statement:
lemma append_comp_rev {m n} (xs : Fin m → α) (ys : Fin n → α) :
    append xs ys ∘ rev = append (ys ∘ rev) (xs ∘ rev) ∘ Fin.cast (Nat.add_comm ..)

name: append_castAdd_natAdd
statement:
theorem append_castAdd_natAdd {f : Fin (m + n) → α} :
    append (fun i ↦ f (castAdd n i)) (fun i ↦ f (natAdd m i)) = f

name: addCases_castAdd_natAdd
statement:
theorem addCases_castAdd_natAdd {γ : Fin (m + n) → Sort*} (v : ∀ i, γ i) (i : Fin (m + n)) :
    addCases (fun i ↦ v (castAdd n i)) (fun j ↦ v (natAdd m j)) i = v i
proof:
:= by
  cases i using addCases <;> simp

name: append_comp_sumElim
statement:
theorem append_comp_sumElim {xs : Fin m → α} {ys : Fin n → α} :
    Fin.append xs ys ∘ Sum.elim (Fin.castAdd _) (Fin.natAdd _) = Sum.elim xs ys

name: append_injective_iff
statement:
theorem append_injective_iff {xs : Fin m → α} {ys : Fin n → α} :
    Function.Injective (Fin.append xs ys) ↔
      Function.Injective xs ∧ Function.Injective ys ∧ ∀ i j, xs i ≠ ys j
proof:
:= by
  
  
  let finSumFinEquiv : Fin m ⊕ Fin n ≃ Fin (m + n) :=
  { toFun := Sum.elim (Fin.castAdd n) (Fin.natAdd m)
    invFun i := @Fin.addCases m n (fun _ => Fin m ⊕ Fin n) Sum.inl Sum.inr i
    left_inv x := by rcases x with y | y <;> simp
    right_inv x := by refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) x <;> simp }
  rw [← Sum.elim_injective, ← append_comp_sumElim, ← finSumFinEquiv.injective_comp,
    Equiv.coe_fn_mk]

name: repeat_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem repeat_apply (a : Fin n → α) (i : Fin (m * n)) :
    Fin.repeat m a i = a i.modNat

name: repeat_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem repeat_zero (a : Fin n → α) :
    Fin.repeat 0 a = Fin.elim0 ∘ Fin.cast (Nat.zero_mul _)

name: repeat_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem repeat_one (a : Fin n → α) : Fin.repeat 1 a = a ∘ Fin.cast (Nat.one_mul _)
proof:
:= by
  generalize_proofs h
  apply funext
  rw [(Fin.rightInverse_cast h.symm).surjective.forall]
  intro i
  simp [modNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt i.is_lt]

name: repeat_succ
statement:
theorem repeat_succ (a : Fin n → α) (m : ℕ) :
    Fin.repeat m.succ a =
      append a (Fin.repeat m a) ∘ Fin.cast ((Nat.succ_mul _ _).trans (Nat.add_comm ..))
proof:
:= by
  generalize_proofs h
  apply funext
  rw [(Fin.rightInverse_cast h.symm).surjective.forall]
  refine Fin.addCases (fun l => ?_) fun r => ?_
  · simp [modNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt l.is_lt]
  · simp [modNat]

name: repeat_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem repeat_add (a : Fin n → α) (m₁ m₂ : ℕ) : Fin.repeat (m₁ + m₂) a =
    append (Fin.repeat m₁ a) (Fin.repeat m₂ a) ∘ Fin.cast (Nat.add_mul ..)
proof:
:= by
  generalize_proofs h
  apply funext
  rw [(Fin.rightInverse_cast h.symm).surjective.forall]
  refine Fin.addCases (fun l => ?_) fun r => ?_
  · simp [modNat]
  · simp [modNat, Nat.add_mod]

name: repeat_rev
statement:
theorem repeat_rev (a : Fin n → α) (k : Fin (m * n)) :
    Fin.repeat m a k.rev = Fin.repeat m (a ∘ Fin.rev) k

name: repeat_comp_rev
statement:
theorem repeat_comp_rev (a : Fin n → α) :
    Fin.repeat m a ∘ Fin.rev = Fin.repeat m (a ∘ Fin.rev)

name: init_def
statement:
theorem init_def {q : ∀ i, α i} :
    (init fun k : Fin (n + 1) ↦ q k) = fun k : Fin n ↦ q k.castSucc

name: init_snoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem init_snoc : init (snoc p x) = p
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [init, snoc, val_castSucc, is_lt, dite_true]
  convert! cast_eq rfl (p i)

name: snoc_castSucc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_castSucc : snoc p x i.castSucc = p i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [snoc, val_castSucc, is_lt, dite_true]
  convert! cast_eq rfl (p i)

name: snoc_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_apply_zero [NeZero n] : snoc p x 0 = p 0

name: snoc_comp_castSucc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_comp_castSucc {α : Sort*} {a : α} {f : Fin n → α} :
    (snoc f a : Fin (n + 1) → α) ∘ castSucc = f
proof:
:=
  funext fun i ↦ by rw [Function.comp_apply, snoc_castSucc]

name: snoc_last
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_last : snoc p x (last n) = x

name: snoc_zero
statement:
lemma snoc_zero {α : Sort*} (p : Fin 0 → α) (x : α) :
    Fin.snoc p x = fun _ ↦ x

name: snoc_comp_natAdd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_comp_natAdd {n m : ℕ} {α : Sort*} (f : Fin (m + n) → α) (a : α) :
    (snoc f a : Fin _ → α) ∘ (natAdd m : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (m + n + 1)) =
      snoc (f ∘ natAdd m) a
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun i ↦ ?_) i
  · simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [snoc_last, natAdd_last, snoc_last]
  · simp only [comp_apply, snoc_castSucc]
    rw [natAdd_castSucc, snoc_castSucc]

name: snoc_castAdd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_castAdd {α : Fin (n + m + 1) → Sort*} (f : ∀ i : Fin (n + m), α i.castSucc)
    (a : α (last (n + m))) (i : Fin n) : (snoc f a) (castAdd (m + 1) i) = f (castAdd m i)

name: snoc_comp_castAdd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_comp_castAdd {n m : ℕ} {α : Sort*} (f : Fin (n + m) → α) (a : α) :
    (snoc f a : Fin _ → α) ∘ castAdd (m + 1) = f ∘ castAdd m

name: snoc_update
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_update : snoc (update p i y) x = update (snoc p x) i.castSucc y
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  cases j using lastCases with
  | cast j => rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hne <;> simp [*]
  | last => simp [Ne.symm]

name: update_snoc_last
statement: theorem update_snoc_last : update (snoc p x) (last n) z = snoc p z
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  cases j using lastCases <;> simp

name: range_snoc
statement:
@[simp]
lemma range_snoc {α : Type*} (f : Fin n → α) (x : α) :
    Set.range (snoc f x) = insert x (Set.range f)

name: snoc_injective2
statement: theorem snoc_injective2 : Function.Injective2 (@snoc n α)
proof:
:= fun x y xₙ yₙ h ↦
  ⟨funext fun i ↦ by simpa using congr_fun h (castSucc i), by simpa using congr_fun h (last n)⟩

name: snoc_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_inj {x y : ∀ i : Fin n, α i.castSucc} {xₙ yₙ : α (last n)} :
    snoc x xₙ = snoc y yₙ ↔ x = y ∧ xₙ = yₙ

name: snoc_right_injective
statement:
theorem snoc_right_injective (x : ∀ i : Fin n, α i.castSucc) :
    Function.Injective (snoc x)

name: snoc_left_injective
statement: theorem snoc_left_injective (xₙ : α (last n)) : Function.Injective (snoc · xₙ)

name: snoc_init_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem snoc_init_self : snoc (init q) (q (last n)) = q
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  cases j using Fin.lastCases <;> simp [init]

name: init_update_last
statement:
@[simp]
theorem init_update_last : init (update q (last n) z) = init q

name: init_update_castSucc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem init_update_castSucc : init (update q i.castSucc y) = update (init q) i y
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  by_cases h : j = i
  · rw [h]
    simp [init]
  · simp [init, h, castSucc_inj]

name: tail_init_eq_init_tail
statement:
theorem tail_init_eq_init_tail {β : Sort*} (q : Fin (n + 2) → β) :
    tail (init q) = init (tail q)

name: cons_snoc_eq_snoc_cons
statement:
theorem cons_snoc_eq_snoc_cons {β : Sort*} (a : β) (q : Fin n → β) (b : β) :
    @cons n.succ (fun _ ↦ β) a (snoc q b) = snoc (cons a q) b
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  cases i using Fin.cases with
  | zero => simp
  | succ j =>
    cases j using Fin.lastCases with
    | last => simp
    | cast j =>
      rw [cons_succ]
      simp [← castSucc_succ]

name: comp_snoc
statement:
theorem comp_snoc {α : Sort*} {β : Sort*} (g : α → β) (q : Fin n → α) (y : α) :
    g ∘ snoc q y = snoc (g ∘ q) (g y)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  by_cases h : j.val < n
  · simp [h, snoc, castSucc_castLT]
  · rw [eq_last_of_not_lt h]
    simp

name: append_right_eq_snoc
statement:
theorem append_right_eq_snoc {α : Sort*} {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → α) (x₀ : Fin 1 → α) :
    Fin.append x x₀ = Fin.snoc x (x₀ 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ i <;> clear i
  · intro i
    rw [Fin.append_left]
    exact (@snoc_castSucc _ (fun _ => α) _ _ i).symm
  · intro i
    rw [Subsingleton.elim i 0, Fin.append_right]
    exact (@snoc_last _ (fun _ => α) _ _).symm

name: snoc_eq_append
statement:
theorem snoc_eq_append {α : Sort*} (xs : Fin n → α) (x : α) :
    snoc xs x = append xs (cons x Fin.elim0)

name: append_left_snoc
statement:
theorem append_left_snoc {n m} {α : Sort*} (xs : Fin n → α) (x : α) (ys : Fin m → α) :
    Fin.append (Fin.snoc xs x) ys =
      Fin.append xs (Fin.cons x ys) ∘ Fin.cast (Nat.succ_add_eq_add_succ ..)
proof:
:= by
  rw [snoc_eq_append, append_assoc, append_left_eq_cons, append_cast_right]; rfl

name: append_right_cons
statement:
theorem append_right_cons {n m} {α : Sort*} (xs : Fin n → α) (y : α) (ys : Fin m → α) :
    Fin.append xs (Fin.cons y ys) =
      Fin.append (Fin.snoc xs y) ys ∘ Fin.cast (Nat.succ_add_eq_add_succ ..).symm

name: append_cons
statement:
theorem append_cons {α : Sort*} (a : α) (as : Fin n → α) (bs : Fin m → α) :
    Fin.append (cons a as) bs
    = cons a (Fin.append as bs) ∘ (Fin.cast <| Nat.add_right_comm n 1 m)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rcases i with ⟨i, -⟩
  simp only [append, addCases, cons, castLT, comp_apply]
  rcases i with - | i
  · simp
  · split_ifs with h
    · have : i < n := Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h
      simp [addCases, this]
    · have : ¬i < n := Nat.not_le_of_gt <| Nat.le_of_lt_succ <| Nat.gt_of_not_le h
      simp [addCases, this]

name: append_snoc
statement:
theorem append_snoc {α : Sort*} (as : Fin n → α) (bs : Fin m → α) (b : α) :
    Fin.append as (snoc bs b) = snoc (Fin.append as bs) b
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rcases i with ⟨i, isLt⟩
  simp only [append, addCases, castLT, cast_mk, subNat_mk, natAdd_mk, cast, snoc.eq_1,
    eq_rec_constant, Nat.add_eq]
  split_ifs with lt_n lt_add sub_lt nlt_add lt_add <;> (try rfl)
  · have := Nat.lt_add_right m lt_n
    contradiction
  · obtain rfl := Nat.eq_of_le_of_lt_succ (Nat.not_lt.mp nlt_add) isLt
    simp [Nat.add_comm n m] at sub_lt
  · have := Nat.sub_lt_left_of_lt_add (Nat.not_lt.mp lt_n) lt_add
    contradiction

name: comp_init
statement:
theorem comp_init {α : Sort*} {β : Sort*} (g : α → β) (q : Fin n.succ → α) :
    g ∘ init q = init (g ∘ q)

name: snocCases_snoc
statement:
@[simp] lemma snocCases_snoc
    {motive : (∀ i : Fin (n + 1), α i) → Sort*} (snoc : ∀ x x₀, motive (Fin.snoc x x₀))
    (x : ∀ i : Fin n, (Fin.init α) i) (x₀ : α (Fin.last _)) :
    snocCases snoc (Fin.snoc x x₀) = snoc x x₀

name: snoc_injective_of_injective
proof:
:= fun i j h ↦ by
  induction i using lastCases with
  | cast i =>
    induction j using lastCases with
    | cast j =>
      simpa only [castSucc_inj, ← Injective.eq_iff hx, snoc_castSucc] using h
    | last =>
      simp only [snoc_castSucc, snoc_last] at h
      rw [← h] at hx₀
      apply hx₀.elim (Set.mem_range_self i)
  | last =>
    induction j using lastCases with
    | cast j =>
      simp only [snoc_castSucc, snoc_last] at h
      rw [h] at hx₀
      apply hx₀.elim (Set.mem_range_self j)
    | last => simp

name: snoc_injective_iff
statement:
theorem snoc_injective_iff {α} {x₀ : α} {x : Fin n → α} :
    Function.Injective (snoc x x₀ : Fin n.succ → α) ↔ Function.Injective x ∧ x₀ ∉ Set.range x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun h ↦ snoc_injective_of_injective h.1 h.2⟩
  · simpa [Function.comp] using h.comp (Fin.castSucc_injective _)
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    rw [← @snoc_last n (fun i ↦ α) x₀ x, ← @snoc_castSucc n (fun i ↦ α) x₀ x i,
      h.eq_iff] at hi
    exact ne_last_of_lt i.castSucc_lt_last hi

name: forall_iff_castSucc
statement:
lemma forall_iff_castSucc {P : Fin (n + 1) → Prop} :
    (∀ i, P i) ↔ P (last n) ∧ ∀ i : Fin n, P i.castSucc
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h _, fun _ ↦ h _⟩, fun h ↦ lastCases h.1 h.2⟩

name: forall_fin_add
statement:
theorem forall_fin_add {m n} (P : Fin (m + n) → Prop) :
    (∀ i, P i) ↔ (∀ i, P (castAdd _ i)) ∧ (∀ j, P (natAdd _ j))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨fun _ => h _, fun _ => h _⟩, fun ⟨hm, hn⟩ => Fin.addCases hm hn⟩

name: forall_fin_add_pi
statement:
theorem forall_fin_add_pi {γ : Fin (m + n) → Sort*} {P : (∀ i, γ i) → Prop} :
    (∀ v, P v) ↔
      (∀ (vₘ : ∀ i, γ (castAdd n i)) (vₙ : ∀ j, γ (natAdd m j)), P (addCases vₘ vₙ)) where
  mp hv vm vn
proof:
:= hv (addCases vm vn)
  mpr h v := by
    convert h (fun i => v (castAdd n i)) (fun j => v (natAdd m j))
    exact (addCases_castAdd_natAdd v _).symm

name: exists_iff_castSucc
statement:
lemma exists_iff_castSucc {P : Fin (n + 1) → Prop} :
    (∃ i, P i) ↔ P (last n) ∨ ∃ i : Fin n, P i.castSucc where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    cases i using lastCases with
    | last => exact .inl hi
    | cast _ => exact .inr ⟨_, hi⟩
  mpr := by rintro (h | ⟨i, hi⟩) <;> exact ⟨_, ‹_›⟩

name: forall_iff_succAbove
statement:
theorem forall_iff_succAbove {P : Fin (n + 1) → Prop} (p : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (∀ i, P i) ↔ P p ∧ ∀ i, P (p.succAbove i)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨h _, fun _ ↦ h _⟩, fun h ↦ succAboveCases p h.1 h.2⟩

name: exists_iff_succAbove
statement:
lemma exists_iff_succAbove {P : Fin (n + 1) → Prop} (p : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (∃ i, P i) ↔ P p ∨ ∃ i, P (p.succAbove i) where
  mp
proof:
:= by
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    induction i using p.succAboveCases
    · exact .inl hi
    · exact .inr ⟨_, hi⟩
  mpr := by rintro (h | ⟨i, hi⟩) <;> exact ⟨_, ‹_›⟩

name: eq_self_or_eq_succAbove
statement: theorem eq_self_or_eq_succAbove (p i : Fin (n + 1)) : i = p ∨ ∃ j, i = p.succAbove j
proof:
:=
  succAboveCases p (.inl rfl) (fun j => .inr ⟨j, rfl⟩) i

name: insertNth_apply_same
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insertNth_apply_same (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : α i) (p : ∀ j, α (i.succAbove j)) :
    insertNth i x p i = x

name: insertNth_apply_succAbove
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insertNth_apply_succAbove (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : α i) (p : ∀ j, α (i.succAbove j))
    (j : Fin n) : insertNth i x p (i.succAbove j) = p j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [insertNth, succAboveCases, dite_eq_right (succAbove_ne _ _),
    succAbove_lt_iff_castSucc_lt]
  split_ifs with hlt
  · generalize_proofs H₁ H₂; revert H₂
    generalize hk : castPred ((succAbove i) j) H₁ = k
    rw [castPred_succAbove _ _ hlt] at hk; cases hk
    intro; rfl
  · generalize_proofs H₀ H₁ H₂; revert H₂
    generalize hk : pred (succAbove i j) H₁ = k
    rw [pred_succAbove _ _ (Fin.not_lt.1 hlt)] at hk; cases hk
    intro; rfl

name: succAbove_cases_eq_insertNth
statement:
@[simp]
theorem succAbove_cases_eq_insertNth : @succAboveCases = @insertNth

name: removeNth_apply
statement:
lemma removeNth_apply (p : Fin (n + 1)) (f : ∀ i, α i) (i : Fin n) :
    p.removeNth f i = f (p.succAbove i)

name: cons_comp_succ_succAbove
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cons_comp_succ_succAbove (x : β) (p : Fin (n + 1) → β) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    cons x p ∘ i.succ.succAbove = cons x (i.removeNth p)

name: removeNth_fun_const
statement:
lemma removeNth_fun_const {α : Type*} {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) (a : α) :
    i.removeNth (fun _ ↦ a) = (fun _ ↦ a)

name: removeNth_insertNth
statement:
@[simp] lemma removeNth_insertNth (p : Fin (n + 1)) (a : α p) (f : ∀ i, α (succAbove p i)) :
    removeNth p (insertNth p a f) = f

name: removeNth_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma removeNth_zero (f : ∀ i, α i) : removeNth 0 f = tail f

name: removeNth_last
statement: @[simp] lemma removeNth_last {α : Type*} (f : Fin (n + 1) → α) : removeNth (last n) f = init f

name: insertNth_comp_succAbove
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insertNth_comp_succAbove (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : β) (p : Fin n → β) :
    insertNth i x p ∘ i.succAbove = p

name: insertNth_eq_iff
statement:
theorem insertNth_eq_iff {p : Fin (n + 1)} {a : α p} {f : ∀ i, α (p.succAbove i)} {g : ∀ j, α j} :
    insertNth p a f = g ↔ a = g p ∧ f = removeNth p g

name: eq_insertNth_iff
statement:
theorem eq_insertNth_iff {p : Fin (n + 1)} {a : α p} {f : ∀ i, α (p.succAbove i)} {g : ∀ j, α j} :
    g = insertNth p a f ↔ g p = a ∧ removeNth p g = f

name: insertNth_injective2
statement:
theorem insertNth_injective2 {p : Fin (n + 1)} :
    Function.Injective2 (@insertNth n α p)
proof:
:= fun xₚ yₚ x y h ↦
  ⟨by simpa using congr_fun h p, funext fun i ↦ by simpa using congr_fun h (succAbove p i)⟩

name: insertNth_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insertNth_inj {p : Fin (n + 1)} {x y : ∀ i, α (succAbove p i)} {xₚ yₚ : α p} :
    insertNth p xₚ x = insertNth p yₚ y ↔ xₚ = yₚ ∧ x = y

name: insertNth_left_injective
statement:
theorem insertNth_left_injective {p : Fin (n + 1)} (x : ∀ i, α (succAbove p i)) :
    Function.Injective (insertNth p · x)

name: insertNth_right_injective
statement:
theorem insertNth_right_injective {p : Fin (n + 1)} (x : α p) :
    Function.Injective (insertNth p x)

name: insertNth_apply_below
statement:
theorem insertNth_apply_below {i j : Fin (n + 1)} (h : j < i) (x : α i)
    (p : ∀ k, α (i.succAbove k)) :
    i.insertNth x p j = succAbove_castPred_of_lt _ _ h ▸ (p <| j.castPred _)
proof:
:= by
  rw [insertNth, succAboveCases, dite_eq_right (Fin.ne_of_lt h), dite_eq_left h]

name: insertNth_apply_above
statement:
theorem insertNth_apply_above {i j : Fin (n + 1)} (h : i < j) (x : α i)
    (p : ∀ k, α (i.succAbove k)) :
    i.insertNth x p j = succAbove_pred_of_lt _ _ h ▸ (p <| j.pred _)
proof:
:= by
  rw [insertNth, succAboveCases, dite_eq_right (Fin.ne_of_gt h), dite_eq_right (Fin.lt_asymm h)]

name: insertNth_zero
statement:
theorem insertNth_zero (x : α 0) (p : ∀ j : Fin n, α (succAbove 0 j)) :
    insertNth 0 x p =
      cons x fun j ↦ _root_.cast (congr_arg α (congr_fun succAbove_zero j)) (p j)
proof:
:= by
  refine insertNth_eq_iff.2 ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  ext j
  convert! (cons_succ x p j).symm

name: insertNth_zero'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insertNth_zero' (x : β) (p : Fin n → β) : @insertNth _ (fun _ ↦ β) 0 x p = cons x p

name: insertNth_last
statement:
theorem insertNth_last (x : α (last n)) (p : ∀ j : Fin n, α ((last n).succAbove j)) :
    insertNth (last n) x p =
      snoc (fun j ↦ _root_.cast (congr_arg α (succAbove_last_apply j)) (p j)) x
proof:
:= by
  refine insertNth_eq_iff.2 ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  ext j
  apply eq_of_heq
  trans snoc (fun j ↦ _root_.cast (congr_arg α (succAbove_last_apply j)) (p j)) x j.castSucc
  · rw [snoc_castSucc]
    exact (cast_heq _ _).symm
  · apply congr_arg_heq
    rw [succAbove_last]

name: insertNth_last'
insertNth_rev
statement:
lemma insertNth_rev {α : Sort*} (i : Fin (n + 1)) (a : α) (f : Fin n → α) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    insertNth (α := fun _ ↦ α) i a f (rev j) = insertNth (α := fun _ ↦ α) i.rev a (f ∘ rev) j
proof:
:= by
  induction j using Fin.succAboveCases
  · exact rev i
  · simp
  · simp [rev_succAbove]

name: insertNth_comp_rev
statement:
theorem insertNth_comp_rev {α} (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : α) (p : Fin n → α) :
    (Fin.insertNth i x p) ∘ Fin.rev = Fin.insertNth (Fin.rev i) x (p ∘ Fin.rev)

name: insertNth_succ_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insertNth_succ_cons {α} (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x a : α) (p : Fin n → α) :
    (insertNth i.succ x (cons a p) : Fin (n + 2) → α) = cons a (insertNth i x p)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  cases j using Fin.succAboveCases i.succ with
  | x => simp
  | p j =>
    simp only [insertNth_apply_succAbove]
    cases j using Fin.cases <;> simp

name: cons_rev
statement:
theorem cons_rev {α n} (a : α) (f : Fin n → α) (i : Fin <| n + 1) :
    cons (α := fun _ => α) a f i.rev = snoc (α := fun _ => α) (f ∘ Fin.rev : Fin _ → α) a i
proof:
:= by
  simpa using insertNth_rev 0 a f i

name: cons_comp_rev
statement:
theorem cons_comp_rev {α n} (a : α) (f : Fin n → α) :
    Fin.cons a f ∘ Fin.rev = Fin.snoc (f ∘ Fin.rev) a

name: snoc_rev
statement:
theorem snoc_rev {α n} (a : α) (f : Fin n → α) (i : Fin <| n + 1) :
    snoc (α := fun _ => α) f a i.rev = cons (α := fun _ => α) a (f ∘ Fin.rev : Fin _ → α) i
proof:
:= by
  simpa using insertNth_rev (last n) a f i

name: snoc_comp_rev
statement:
theorem snoc_comp_rev {α n} (a : α) (f : Fin n → α) :
    Fin.snoc f a ∘ Fin.rev = Fin.cons a (f ∘ Fin.rev)

name: insertNth_binop
statement:
theorem insertNth_binop (op : ∀ j, α j → α j → α j) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x y : α i)
    (p q : ∀ j, α (i.succAbove j)) :
    (i.insertNth (op i x y) fun j ↦ op _ (p j) (q j)) = fun j ↦
      op j (i.insertNth x p j) (i.insertNth y q j)

name: insertNth_le_iff
statement:
theorem insertNth_le_iff {i : Fin (n + 1)} {x : α i} {p : ∀ j, α (i.succAbove j)} {q : ∀ j, α j} :
    i.insertNth x p ≤ q ↔ x ≤ q i ∧ p ≤ fun j ↦ q (i.succAbove j)

name: le_insertNth_iff
statement:
theorem le_insertNth_iff {i : Fin (n + 1)} {x : α i} {p : ∀ j, α (i.succAbove j)} {q : ∀ j, α j} :
    q ≤ i.insertNth x p ↔ q i ≤ x ∧ (fun j ↦ q (i.succAbove j)) ≤ p

name: removeNth_update
statement:
@[simp] lemma removeNth_update (p : Fin (n + 1)) (x) (f : ∀ j, α j) :
    removeNth p (update f p x) = removeNth p f

name: removeNth_update_succAbove
statement:
@[simp]
lemma removeNth_update_succAbove (p : Fin (n + 1)) (i : Fin n) (x : α (p.succAbove i))
    (f : ∀ j, α j) :
    removeNth p (update f (p.succAbove i) x) = update (removeNth p f) i x
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hne <;> simp [removeNth, *]

name: insertNth_removeNth
statement:
@[simp] lemma insertNth_removeNth (p : Fin (n + 1)) (x) (f : ∀ j, α j) :
    insertNth p x (removeNth p f) = update f p x

name: insertNth_self_removeNth
statement:
lemma insertNth_self_removeNth (p : Fin (n + 1)) (f : ∀ j, α j) :
    insertNth p (f p) (removeNth p f) = f

name: range_insertNth
statement:
@[simp]
lemma range_insertNth {α : Type*} (p : Fin (n + 1)) (x : α) (f : Fin n → α) :
    Set.range (p.insertNth x f) = Set.insert x (Set.range f)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp [Fin.exists_iff_succAbove p, Set.insert, eq_comm]

name: update_insertNth
statement:
@[simp]
theorem update_insertNth (p : Fin (n + 1)) (x y : α p) (f : ∀ i, α (p.succAbove i)) :
    update (p.insertNth x f) p y = p.insertNth y f

name: insertNth_update
statement:
@[simp]
theorem insertNth_update (p : Fin (n + 1)) (x : α p) (i : Fin n) (y : α (p.succAbove i))
    (f : ∀ j, α (p.succAbove j)) :
    p.insertNth x (update f i y) = update (p.insertNth x f) (p.succAbove i) y

name: insertNthEquiv_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma insertNthEquiv_zero (α : Fin (n + 1) → Type*) : insertNthEquiv α 0 = consEquiv α

name: insertNthEquiv_last
statement:
@[simp] lemma insertNthEquiv_last (n : ℕ) (α : Type*) :
    insertNthEquiv (fun _ ↦ α) (last n) = snocEquiv (fun _ ↦ α)

name: removeNth_removeNth_heq_swap
statement:
theorem removeNth_removeNth_heq_swap {α : Fin (n + 2) → Sort*} (m : ∀ i, α i)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin (n + 2)) :
    i.removeNth (j.removeNth m) ≍
      (i.predAbove j).removeNth ((j.succAbove i).removeNth m)
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.hfunext rfl
  simp only [heq_iff_eq]
  rintro k _ rfl
  unfold removeNth
  apply congr_arg_heq
  rw [succAbove_succAbove_succAbove_predAbove]

name: removeNth_removeNth_eq_swap
statement:
theorem removeNth_removeNth_eq_swap {α : Sort*} (m : Fin (n + 2) → α)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin (n + 2)) :
    i.removeNth (j.removeNth m) = (i.predAbove j).removeNth ((j.succAbove i).removeNth m)

name: find_spec
statement: protected theorem find_spec (h : ∃ k, p k) : p (Fin.find p h)

name: find_min
statement:
@[grind →]
protected theorem find_min (h : ∃ k, p k) : ∀ {j : Fin n}, j < Fin.find p h → ¬ p j

name: find_le_of_pos
statement:
protected theorem find_le_of_pos (h : ∃ k, p k) {j : Fin n} :
    p j → Fin.find p h ≤ j

name: find_eq_iff
statement: theorem find_eq_iff {i : Fin n} (h : ∃ k, p k) : Fin.find p h = i ↔ p i ∧ ∀ j < i, ¬ p j
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun ⟨hm, hlt⟩ => have := Fin.find_le_of_pos h hm; ?_⟩ <;> grind

name: val_find
statement:
@[simp] theorem val_find (h : ∃ k, p k) :
    (Fin.find p h).val = Nat.find ((Fin.exists_iff.mp h))
proof:
:=
  ((Nat.find_eq_iff _).mpr ⟨⟨is_lt _, Fin.find_spec _⟩,
    fun _ hm ⟨_, hi⟩ => Fin.find_min h hm hi⟩).symm

name: find_nat_lt
statement:
theorem find_nat_lt {p : ℕ → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (h : ∃ k < n, p k) :
    Nat.find (p := p) (by grind) = Fin.find (n := n) (p ·) (Fin.exists_iff.mpr <| by grind)
proof:
:= by
  rw [val_find]
  have := h.choose_spec; exact Nat.find_congr (x := h.choose) (by grind) (by grind)

name: find_lt_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma find_lt_iff (h : ∃ k, p k) (i : Fin n) : Fin.find p h < i ↔ ∃ m < i, p m
proof:
:=
  ⟨by grind, fun ⟨_, hxi, hx⟩ => (Fin.find_le_of_pos h hx).trans_lt hxi⟩

name: find_le_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma find_le_iff (h : ∃ k, p k) (i : Fin n) : Fin.find p h ≤ i ↔ ∃ m ≤ i, p m
proof:
:=
  ⟨by grind, fun ⟨_, hxi, hx⟩ => (Fin.find_le_of_pos h hx).trans hxi⟩

name: lt_find_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma lt_find_iff (h : ∃ k, p k) (i : Fin n) : i < Fin.find p h ↔ ∀ m ≤ i, ¬p m
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← not_le, find_le_iff, not_exists, not_and]

name: le_find_iff
statement: @[simp] lemma le_find_iff (h : ∃ k, p k) (i : Fin n) : i ≤ Fin.find p h ↔ ∀ m < i, ¬p m
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← not_lt, find_lt_iff, not_exists, not_and]

name: find_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma find_eq_zero {p : Fin (n + 1) → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (h : ∃ k, p k) :
  Fin.find p h = 0 ↔ p 0

name: find_of_not_zero
statement:
lemma find_of_not_zero {p : Fin (n + 1) → Prop} [DecidablePred p]
    (h : ∃ i, p i) (h0 : ¬p 0) :
    Fin.find p h =
    (Fin.find (fun k => p k.succ) <| (exists_fin_succ.mp h).resolve_left h0).succ
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [find_eq_iff, forall_fin_succ, h0, not_false_eq_true,
    implies_true, true_and, succ_lt_succ_iff]
  exact ⟨Fin.find_spec (p := fun i => p i.succ) _, fun j => Fin.find_min _⟩

name: find_eq_dite
statement:
theorem find_eq_dite {p : Fin (n + 1) → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (h : ∃ i, p i) :
    Fin.find p h = if h0 : p 0 then 0 else
    (Fin.find (fun k => p k.succ) <| (exists_fin_succ.mp h).resolve_left h0).succ

name: find_mono_of_le
statement:
lemma find_mono_of_le (hi : q i) (hpq : ∀ j ≤ i, q j → p j) :
    Fin.find p ⟨i, hpq _ le_rfl hi⟩ ≤ Fin.find q ⟨i, hi⟩

name: find_mono
statement:
lemma find_mono (h : ∀ i, q i → p i) {hp : ∃ i, p i} {hq : ∃ i, q i} :
    Fin.find p hp ≤ Fin.find q hq
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, hq⟩ := hq; find_mono_of_le hq fun _ _ ↦ h _

name: find_congr
statement:
lemma find_congr (hi : p i) (hpq : ∀ j ≤ i, p j ↔ q j) :
    Fin.find p ⟨i, hi⟩ = Fin.find q ⟨i, hpq _ le_rfl |>.1 hi⟩
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (find_mono_of_le (hpq _ le_rfl |>.1 hi) fun _ h ↦ (hpq _ h).mpr)
    (find_mono_of_le hi fun _ h ↦ (hpq _ h).mp)

name: find_congr'
statement:
lemma find_congr' {hp : ∃ i, p i} {hq : ∃ i, q i} (hpq : ∀ {i}, p i ↔ q i) :
    Fin.find p hp = Fin.find q hq
proof:
:=
  let ⟨_, hp⟩ := hp; find_congr hp fun _ _ ↦ hpq

name: find_le
statement: lemma find_le (hi : p i) : Fin.find p ⟨i, hi⟩ ≤ i

name: find_pos
statement:
lemma find_pos {p : Fin (n + 1) → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (h : ∃ i, p i) :
    0 < Fin.find p h ↔ ¬p 0

name: find_of_find_le
statement:
lemma find_of_find_le {p : Fin (m + n) → Prop} [DecidablePred p]
    {hᵢ : ∃ i, p i} (hm : m ≤ Fin.find p hᵢ) :
    Fin.find p hᵢ = (Fin.find (fun j => p (j.natAdd m))
    ⟨(Fin.cast (Nat.add_comm _ _) (Fin.find p hᵢ)).subNat _ hm, by
      simp [Fin.find_spec]⟩).natAdd m
proof:
:= by
  have hⱼ : ∃ j : Fin n, p (j.natAdd m) :=
    ⟨(Fin.cast (Nat.add_comm _ _) (Fin.find p hᵢ)).subNat _ hm, by simp [Fin.find_spec]⟩
  refine (find_eq_iff _).2 ⟨Fin.find_spec hⱼ, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
  cases i using addCases with | left i => _ | right i => _
  · exact Fin.find_min hᵢ (Fin.lt_def.mpr <| (Fin.castAdd_lt _ _).trans_le hm)
  · rw [Fin.natAdd_lt_natAdd_iff] at hi
    exact Fin.find_min hⱼ hi

name: find
statement:
theorem find?_eq_dite {p : Fin n → Bool} :
    find? p = if h : ∃ i, p i then some (Fin.find (p ·) h) else none

name: find
statement:
theorem find?_decide_eq_dite :
    find? (p ·) = if h : ∃ i, p i then some (Fin.find p h) else none

name: get_find
statement:
theorem get_find?_eq_find_of_eq_true {p : Fin n → Bool} (h : p i) :
    (find? p).get (isSome_find?_of_eq_true h) = Fin.find (p ·) ⟨i, h⟩

name: find
statement:
theorem find?_decide_get_eq_find (h : ∃ i, p i) :
    (find? (p ·)).get (isSome_find?_of_eq_true (i := h.choose)
    (by simp only [h.choose_spec, decide_true])) = Fin.find p h

name: find_mem_find
statement:
theorem find_mem_find?_decide (h : ∃ i, p i) :
    Fin.find p h ∈ find? p

name: mem_find
statement:
theorem mem_find?_iff {p : Fin n → Bool} {i : Fin n} :
    i ∈ find? p ↔ p i ∧ ∀ j, j < i → ¬ p j

name: find
statement:
theorem find?_eq_some_find_of_exists {p : Fin n → Bool} (h : ∃ i, p i) :
    find? p = some (Fin.find (p ·) h)

name: find
statement:
theorem find?_eq_some_find_of_isSome {p : Fin n → Bool} (h : (find? p).isSome) :
    find? p = some (Fin.find (p ·) (exists_eq_true_of_isSome_find? h))

name: contractNth_apply_of_lt
statement:
theorem contractNth_apply_of_lt (j : Fin (n + 1)) (op : α → α → α) (g : Fin (n + 1) → α) (k : Fin n)
    (h : (k : ℕ) < j) : contractNth j op g k = g (Fin.castSucc k)

name: contractNth_apply_of_eq
statement:
theorem contractNth_apply_of_eq (j : Fin (n + 1)) (op : α → α → α) (g : Fin (n + 1) → α) (k : Fin n)
    (h : (k : ℕ) = j) : contractNth j op g k = op (g (Fin.castSucc k)) (g k.succ)
proof:
:= by
  have : ¬(k : ℕ) < j := not_lt.2 (le_of_eq h.symm)
  rw [contractNth, ite_eq_right this, ite_eq_left h]

name: contractNth_apply_of_gt
statement:
theorem contractNth_apply_of_gt (j : Fin (n + 1)) (op : α → α → α) (g : Fin (n + 1) → α) (k : Fin n)
    (h : (j : ℕ) < k) : contractNth j op g k = g k.succ
proof:
:= by
  rw [contractNth, ite_eq_right (not_lt_of_gt h), ite_eq_right (Ne.symm <| ne_of_lt h)]

name: contractNth_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem contractNth_apply_of_ne (j : Fin (n + 1)) (op : α → α → α) (g : Fin (n + 1) → α) (k : Fin n)
    (hjk : (j : ℕ) ≠ k) : contractNth j op g k = g (j.succAbove k)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy (k : ℕ) j with (h | h | h)
  · rwa [j.succAbove_of_castSucc_lt, contractNth_apply_of_lt]
    · rwa [Fin.lt_def]
  · exact False.elim (hjk h.symm)
  · rwa [j.succAbove_of_le_castSucc, contractNth_apply_of_gt]
    · exact Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.2 (le_of_lt h)

name: comp_contractNth
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rcases lt_trichotomy (x : ℕ) j with (h | h | h)
  · simp only [Function.comp_apply, contractNth_apply_of_lt, h]
  · simp only [Function.comp_apply, contractNth_apply_of_eq, h, hf]
  · simp only [Function.comp_apply, contractNth_apply_of_gt, h]

name: sigma_eq_of_eq_comp_cast
statement:
theorem sigma_eq_of_eq_comp_cast {α : Type*} :
    ∀ {a b : Σ ii, Fin ii → α} (h : a.fst = b.fst), a.snd = b.snd ∘ Fin.cast h → a = b
  | ⟨ai, a⟩, ⟨bi, b⟩, hi, h => by
    dsimp only at hi
    subst hi
    simpa using h

/

name: sigma_eq_iff_eq_comp_cast
statement:
theorem sigma_eq_iff_eq_comp_cast {α : Type*} {a b : Σ ii, Fin ii → α} :
    a = b ↔ ∃ h : a.fst = b.fst, a.snd = b.snd ∘ Fin.cast h
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h ▸ ⟨rfl, funext <| Fin.rec fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩, fun ⟨_, h'⟩ ↦
    sigma_eq_of_eq_comp_cast _ h'⟩

name: graph.card
statement:
@[simp]
theorem graph.card (f : Fin n → α) : (graph f).card = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [graph, Finset.card_image_of_injective]
  · exact Finset.card_fin _
  · intro _ _
    
    rw [Prod.ext_iff]
    simp

name: proj_equiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem proj_equiv₁' (f : Fin n → α) : graph.proj ∘ graphEquiv₁ f = f

name: graphEquiv
statement:
theorem graphEquiv₂_apply (f : Fin n → α) (i : Fin n) :

name: self_comp_sort
statement: theorem self_comp_sort (f : Fin n → α) : f ∘ sort f = graph.proj ∘ graphEquiv₂ f
proof:
:=
  show graph.proj ∘ (graphEquiv₁ f ∘ (graphEquiv₁ f).symm) ∘ (graphEquiv₂ f).toEquiv = _ by simp

name: monotone_proj
statement: theorem monotone_proj (f : Fin n → α) : Monotone (graph.proj : graph f → α)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨⟨x, i⟩, hx⟩ ⟨⟨y, j⟩, hy⟩ (_ | h)
  · exact le_of_lt ‹_›
  · simp [graph.proj]

name: monotone_sort
statement: theorem monotone_sort (f : Fin n → α) : Monotone (f ∘ sort f)

name: lt_card_le_iff_apply_le_of_monotone
statement:
theorem lt_card_le_iff_apply_le_of_monotone [DecidableLE α] (h_sorted : Monotone f) :
    j < #{i | f i ≤ a} ↔ f j ≤ a

name: lt_card_ge_iff_apply_ge_of_antitone
statement:
theorem lt_card_ge_iff_apply_ge_of_antitone [DecidableLE α] (h_sorted : Antitone f) :

name: lt_card_lt_iff_apply_lt_of_monotone
statement:
theorem lt_card_lt_iff_apply_lt_of_monotone [DecidableLT α] (h_sorted : Monotone f) :

theorem lt_card_gt_iff_apply_gt_of_antitone [DecidableLT α] (h_sorted : Antitone f) :

name: unique_monotone
statement:
theorem unique_monotone [PartialOrder α] {f : Fin n → α} {σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)}
    (hfσ : Monotone (f ∘ σ)) (hfτ : Monotone (f ∘ τ)) : f ∘ σ = f ∘ τ

name: unique_antitone
statement:
theorem unique_antitone [PartialOrder α] {f : Fin n → α} {σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)}
    (hfσ : Antitone (f ∘ σ)) (hfτ : Antitone (f ∘ τ)) : f ∘ σ = f ∘ τ

name: eq_sort_iff'
statement: theorem eq_sort_iff' : σ = sort f ↔ StrictMono (σ.trans <| graphEquiv₁ f)
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · rw [h, sort, Equiv.trans_assoc, Equiv.symm_trans_self]
    exact (graphEquiv₂ f).strictMono
  · have := Subsingleton.elim (graphEquiv₂ f) (h.orderIsoOfSurjective _ <| Equiv.surjective _)
    ext1 x
    exact (graphEquiv₁ f).eq_symm_apply.2 (DFunLike.congr_fun this x).symm

name: eq_sort_iff
statement:
theorem eq_sort_iff :
    σ = sort f ↔ Monotone (f ∘ σ) ∧ ∀ i j, i < j → f (σ i) = f (σ j) → σ i < σ j
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_sort_iff']
  refine ⟨fun h => ⟨(monotone_proj f).comp h.monotone, fun i j hij hfij => ?_⟩, fun h i j hij => ?_⟩
  · exact ((Prod.Lex.toLex_lt_toLex.1 <| h hij).resolve_left hfij.not_lt).2
  · obtain he | hl := (h.1 hij.le).eq_or_lt <;> apply Prod.Lex.toLex_lt_toLex.2
    exacts [Or.inr ⟨he, h.2 i j hij he⟩, Or.inl hl]

name: sort_eq_refl_iff_monotone
statement: theorem sort_eq_refl_iff_monotone : sort f = Equiv.refl _ ↔ Monotone f
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm, eq_sort_iff, Equiv.coe_refl, Function.comp_id]
  simp only [id, and_iff_left_iff_imp]
  exact fun _ _ _ hij _ => hij

name: comp_sort_eq_comp_iff_monotone
statement: theorem comp_sort_eq_comp_iff_monotone : f ∘ σ = f ∘ sort f ↔ Monotone (f ∘ σ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h.symm ▸ monotone_sort f, fun h => unique_monotone h (monotone_sort f)⟩

name: comp_perm_comp_sort_eq_comp_sort
statement: theorem comp_perm_comp_sort_eq_comp_sort : (f ∘ σ) ∘ sort (f ∘ σ) = f ∘ sort f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Function.comp_assoc, ← Equiv.Perm.coe_mul]
  exact unique_monotone (monotone_sort (f ∘ σ)) (monotone_sort f)

name: antitone_pair_of_not_sorted'
statement:
theorem antitone_pair_of_not_sorted' (h : f ∘ σ ≠ f ∘ sort f) :
    ∃ i j, i < j ∧ (f ∘ σ) j < (f ∘ σ) i
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! h
  exact comp_sort_eq_comp_iff_monotone.mpr (monotone_iff_forall_lt.mpr h)

name: antitone_pair_of_not_sorted
statement: theorem antitone_pair_of_not_sorted (h : f ≠ f ∘ sort f) : ∃ i j, i < j ∧ f j < f i

name: sort_perm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sort_perm (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    sort σ = σ⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply (eq_sort_iff.2 ⟨?_ , ?_⟩).symm
  · simpa using monotone_id
  · intro _ _ hij h
    exact (hij.ne (by simpa using h)).elim

name: Equiv.Perm.monotone_iff
statement:
theorem Equiv.Perm.monotone_iff {n : ℕ} (σ : Perm (Fin n)) :
    Monotone σ ↔ σ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Tuple.sort_eq_refl_iff_monotone, Tuple.sort_perm, ← inv_eq_one, one_def]

name: coe_tail
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_tail {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (n + 1) ↪ α) : ↑(tail x) = Fin.tail x

theorem coe_cons {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n ↪ α) {a : α} (ha : a ∉ range x) :

theorem tail_cons {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n ↪ α) {a : α} (ha : a ∉ range x) :

theorem coe_snoc {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n ↪ α) {a : α} (ha : a ∉ range x) :

name: embFinTwo_apply_zero

theorem embFinTwo_apply_zero {a b : α} (h : a ≠ b) :
    embFinTwo h 0 = a

name: antidiagonalTuple_zero_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem antidiagonalTuple_zero_zero : antidiagonalTuple 0 0 = [![]]

name: antidiagonalTuple_zero_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem antidiagonalTuple_zero_succ (n : ℕ) : antidiagonalTuple 0 (n + 1) = []

name: mem_antidiagonalTuple
statement:
theorem mem_antidiagonalTuple {n : ℕ} {k : ℕ} {x : Fin k → ℕ} :
    x ∈ antidiagonalTuple k n ↔ ∑ i, x i = n
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Fin.consInduction generalizing n with
  | elim0 =>
    cases n
    · decide
    · simp
  | cons x₀ x ih =>
    simp_rw [Fin.sum_cons, antidiagonalTuple, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map,
      List.Nat.mem_antidiagonal, Fin.cons_inj, exists_eq_right_right, ih,
      @eq_comm _ _ (Prod.snd _), and_comm (a := Prod.snd _ = _),
      ← Prod.mk_inj (a₁ := Prod.fst _), exists_eq_right]

name: nodup_antidiagonalTuple
statement: theorem nodup_antidiagonalTuple (k n : ℕ) : List.Nodup (antidiagonalTuple k n)
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing n with
  | zero => cases n <;> simp
  | succ k ih => ?_
  simp_rw [antidiagonalTuple, List.nodup_flatMap]
  constructor
  · intro i _
    exact (ih i.snd).map (Fin.cons_right_injective (α := fun _ => ℕ) i.fst)
  induction n with
  | zero => exact List.pairwise_singleton _ _
  | succ n n_ih =>
    rw [List.Nat.antidiagonal_succ]
    refine List.Pairwise.cons (fun a ha x hx₁ hx₂ => ?_) (n_ih.map _ fun a b h x hx₁ hx₂ => ?_)
    · rw [List.mem_map] at hx₁ hx₂ ha
      obtain ⟨⟨a, -, rfl⟩, ⟨x₁, -, rfl⟩, ⟨x₂, -, h⟩⟩ := ha, hx₁, hx₂
      rw [Fin.cons_inj] at h
      injection h.1
    · rw [List.mem_map] at hx₁ hx₂
      obtain ⟨⟨x₁, hx₁, rfl⟩, ⟨x₂, hx₂, h₁₂⟩⟩ := hx₁, hx₂
      dsimp at h₁₂
      rw [Fin.cons_inj, Nat.succ_inj] at h₁₂
      obtain ⟨h₁₂, rfl⟩ := h₁₂
      rw [Function.onFun, h₁₂] at h
      exact h (List.mem_map_of_mem hx₁) (List.mem_map_of_mem hx₂)

name: antidiagonalTuple_zero_right
statement:
theorem antidiagonalTuple_zero_right : ∀ k, antidiagonalTuple k 0 = [0]
  | 0 => (congr_arg fun x => [x]) <| Subsingleton.elim _ _
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [antidiagonalTuple, antidiagonal_zero, List.flatMap_singleton,
      antidiagonalTuple_zero_right k, List.map_singleton]
    exact congr_arg (fun x => [x]) Matrix.cons_zero_zero

@[simp]

name: antidiagonalTuple_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem antidiagonalTuple_one (n : ℕ) : antidiagonalTuple 1 n = [![n]]
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [antidiagonalTuple, antidiagonal, List.range_succ, List.map_append, List.map_singleton,
    Nat.sub_self, List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_singleton, List.flatMap_map]
  conv_rhs => rw [← List.nil_append [![n]]]
  congr 1
  simp_rw [List.flatMap_eq_nil_iff, List.mem_range, List.map_eq_nil_iff]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt hx
  rw [add_assoc, add_tsub_cancel_left, antidiagonalTuple_zero_succ]

name: antidiagonalTuple_two
statement:
theorem antidiagonalTuple_two (n : ℕ) :
    antidiagonalTuple 2 n = (antidiagonal n).map fun i => ![i.1, i.2]
proof:
:= by
  rw [antidiagonalTuple]
  simp_rw [antidiagonalTuple_one, List.map_singleton]
  rw [List.map_eq_flatMap]
  rfl

name: antidiagonalTuple_pairwise_pi_lex
statement:
theorem antidiagonalTuple_pairwise_pi_lex :
    ∀ k n, (antidiagonalTuple k n).Pairwise (Pi.Lex (· < ·) @fun _ => (· < ·))
  | 0, 0 => List.pairwise_singleton _ _
  | 0, _ + 1 => List.Pairwise.nil
  | k + 1, n => by
    simp_rw [antidiagonalTuple, List.pairwise_flatMap, List.pairwise_map, List.mem_map,
      forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
    simp only [mem_antidiagonal, Prod.forall]
    simp only [Fin.pi_lex_lt_cons_cons, true_and, lt_self_iff_false,
      false_or]
    refine ⟨fun _ _ _ => antidiagonalTuple_pairwise_pi_lex k _, ?_⟩
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      rw [antidiagonal_zero]
      exact List.pairwise_singleton _ _
    | succ n n_ih =>
      simp
      grind

end List.Nat

name: id_map
statement: protected theorem id_map {α : TypeVec n} (x : F α) : TypeVec.id <$$> x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← abs_repr x, ← abs_map]
  rfl

name: comp_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_map {α β γ : TypeVec n} (f : α ⟹ β) (g : β ⟹ γ) (x : F α) :
    (g ⊚ f) <$$> x = g <$$> f <$$> x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← abs_repr x, ← abs_map, ← abs_map, ← abs_map]
  rfl

name: liftP_iff
statement:
theorem liftP_iff {α : TypeVec n} (p : ∀ ⦃i⦄, α i → Prop) (x : F α) :
    LiftP p x ↔ ∃ a f, x = abs ⟨a, f⟩ ∧ ∀ i j, p (f i j)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    rcases h : repr y with ⟨a, f⟩
    use a, fun i j => (f i j).val
    constructor
    · rw [← hy, ← abs_repr y, h, ← abs_map]; rfl
    intro i j
    apply (f i j).property
  rintro ⟨a, f, h₀, h₁⟩
  use abs ⟨a, fun i j => ⟨f i j, h₁ i j⟩⟩
  rw [← abs_map, h₀]; rfl

name: liftR_iff
statement:
theorem liftR_iff {α : TypeVec n} (r : ∀ ⦃i⦄, α i → α i → Prop) (x y : F α) :
    LiftR r x y ↔ ∃ a f₀ f₁, x = abs ⟨a, f₀⟩ ∧ y = abs ⟨a, f₁⟩ ∧ ∀ i j, r (f₀ i j) (f₁ i j)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, xeq, yeq⟩
    rcases h : repr u with ⟨a, f⟩
    use a, fun i j => (f i j).val.fst, fun i j => (f i j).val.snd
    constructor
    · rw [← xeq, ← abs_repr u, h, ← abs_map]; rfl
    constructor
    · rw [← yeq, ← abs_repr u, h, ← abs_map]; rfl
    intro i j
    exact (f i j).property
  rintro ⟨a, f₀, f₁, xeq, yeq, h⟩
  use abs ⟨a, fun i j => ⟨(f₀ i j, f₁ i j), h i j⟩⟩
  constructor
  · rw [xeq, ← abs_map]; rfl
  rw [yeq, ← abs_map]; rfl

name: mem_supp
statement:
theorem mem_supp {α : TypeVec n} (x : F α) (i) (u : α i) :
    u ∈ supp x i ↔ ∀ a f, abs ⟨a, f⟩ = x → u ∈ f i '' univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [supp]; dsimp; constructor
  · intro h a f haf
    have : LiftP (fun i u => u ∈ f i '' univ) x := by
      rw [liftP_iff]
      refine ⟨a, f, haf.symm, ?_⟩
      intro i u
      exact mem_image_of_mem _ (mem_univ _)
    exact h this
  grind [liftP_iff]

name: supp_eq
statement:
theorem supp_eq {α : TypeVec n} {i} (x : F α) :
    supp x i = { u | ∀ a f, abs ⟨a, f⟩ = x → u ∈ f i '' univ }

name: has_good_supp_iff
statement:
theorem has_good_supp_iff {α : TypeVec n} (x : F α) :
    (∀ p, LiftP p x ↔ ∀ (i), ∀ u ∈ supp x i, p i u) ↔
      ∃ a f, abs ⟨a, f⟩ = x ∧ ∀ i a' f', abs ⟨a', f'⟩ = x → f i '' univ ⊆ f' i '' univ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : LiftP (fun i u => u ∈ supp x i) x := by rw [h]; introv; exact id
    rw [liftP_iff] at this
    rcases this with ⟨a, f, xeq, h'⟩
    refine ⟨a, f, xeq.symm, ?_⟩
    intro a' f' h''
    rintro hu u ⟨j, _h₂, hfi⟩
    have hh : u ∈ supp x a' := by rw [← hfi]; apply h'
    exact (mem_supp x _ u).mp hh _ _ hu
  rintro ⟨a, f, xeq, h⟩ p; rw [liftP_iff]; constructor
  · rintro ⟨a', f', xeq', h'⟩ i u usuppx
    rcases (mem_supp x _ u).mp (@usuppx) a' f' xeq'.symm with ⟨i, _, f'ieq⟩
    rw [← f'ieq]
    apply h'
  intro h'
  refine ⟨a, f, xeq.symm, ?_⟩; intro j y
  apply h'; rw [mem_supp]
  intro a' f' xeq'
  apply h _ a' f' xeq'
  apply mem_image_of_mem _ (mem_univ _)

name: supp_eq_of_isUniform
statement:
theorem supp_eq_of_isUniform (h : q.IsUniform) {α : TypeVec n} (a : q.P.A) (f : q.P.B a ⟹ α) :
    ∀ i, supp (abs ⟨a, f⟩) i = f i '' univ
proof:
:= by
  intro; ext u; rw [mem_supp]; constructor
  · intro h'
    apply h' _ _ rfl
  intro h' a' f' e
  rw [← h _ _ _ _ e.symm]; apply h'

name: liftP_iff_of_isUniform
statement:
theorem liftP_iff_of_isUniform (h : q.IsUniform) {α : TypeVec n} (x : F α) (p : ∀ i, α i → Prop) :
    LiftP p x ↔ ∀ (i), ∀ u ∈ supp x i, p i u
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftP_iff, ← abs_repr x]
  obtain ⟨a, f⟩ := repr x; constructor
  · rintro ⟨a', f', abseq, hf⟩ u
    rw [supp_eq_of_isUniform h, h _ _ _ _ abseq]
    rintro b ⟨i, _, hi⟩
    rw [← hi]
    apply hf
  intro h'
  refine ⟨a, f, rfl, fun _ i => h' _ _ ?_⟩
  rw [supp_eq_of_isUniform h]
  exact ⟨i, mem_univ i, rfl⟩

name: supp_map
statement:
theorem supp_map (h : q.IsUniform) {α β : TypeVec n} (g : α ⟹ β) (x : F α) (i) :
    supp (g <$$> x) i = g i '' supp x i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← abs_repr x]; obtain ⟨a, f⟩ := repr x; rw [← abs_map, MvPFunctor.map_eq]
  rw [supp_eq_of_isUniform h, supp_eq_of_isUniform h, ← image_comp]
  rfl

name: suppPreservation_iff_isUniform
statement: theorem suppPreservation_iff_isUniform : q.SuppPreservation ↔ q.IsUniform
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h α a a' f f' h' i
    rw [← MvPFunctor.supp_eq, ← MvPFunctor.supp_eq, ← h, h', h]
  · rintro h α ⟨a, f⟩
    ext
    rwa [supp_eq_of_isUniform, MvPFunctor.supp_eq]

name: suppPreservation_iff_liftpPreservation
statement: theorem suppPreservation_iff_liftpPreservation : q.SuppPreservation ↔ q.LiftPPreservation
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · rintro α p ⟨a, f⟩
    have h' := h
    rw [suppPreservation_iff_isUniform] at h'
    dsimp only [SuppPreservation, supp] at h
    simp only [liftP_iff_of_isUniform, supp_eq_of_isUniform, MvPFunctor.liftP_iff', h',
      image_univ, mem_range, exists_imp]
    constructor <;> intros <;> subst_vars <;> solve_by_elim
  · rintro α ⟨a, f⟩
    simp only [LiftPPreservation] at h
    ext
    simp only [supp, h, mem_ofPred_eq]

name: liftpPreservation_iff_uniform
statement: theorem liftpPreservation_iff_uniform : q.LiftPPreservation ↔ q.IsUniform

name: id_map
statement: theorem id_map {α : Type _} (x : F α) : id <$> x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← abs_repr x]
  obtain ⟨a, f⟩ := repr x
  rw [← abs_map]
  rfl

name: comp_map
statement:
theorem comp_map {α β γ : Type _} (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (x : F α) :
    (g ∘ f) <$> x = g <$> f <$> x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← abs_repr x]
  rw [← abs_map, ← abs_map, ← abs_map]
  rfl

name: lawfulFunctor
statement:
theorem lawfulFunctor
    (h : ∀ α β : Type u, @Functor.mapConst F _ α _ = Functor.map ∘ Function.const β) :
    LawfulFunctor F

name: liftp_iff
statement:
theorem liftp_iff {α : Type u} (p : α → Prop) (x : F α) :
    Liftp p x ↔ ∃ a f, x = abs (.mk a f) ∧ ∀ i, p (f i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    cases h : repr y with | mk a f
    refine ⟨a, fun i => (f i).val, ?_, fun i => (f i).property⟩
    rw [← hy, ← abs_repr y, h, ← abs_map]
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨a, f, h₀, h₁⟩
    refine ⟨abs (.mk a fun i => ⟨f i, h₁ i⟩), ?_⟩
    rw [← abs_map, h₀]
    rfl

name: liftp_iff'
statement:
theorem liftp_iff' {α : Type u} (p : α → Prop) (x : F α) :
    Liftp p x ↔ ∃ u : q.P α, abs u = x ∧ ∀ i, p (u.snd i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftp_iff]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨a, f, hx, hf⟩
    exact ⟨.mk a f, hx.symm, hf⟩
  · intro ⟨u, hx, hf⟩
    cases u with | mk a f
    exact ⟨a, f, hx.symm, hf⟩

name: liftr_iff
statement:
theorem liftr_iff {α : Type u} (r : α → α → Prop) (x y : F α) :
    Liftr r x y ↔ ∃ a f₀ f₁, x = abs (.mk a f₀) ∧ y = abs (.mk a f₁) ∧ ∀ i, r (f₀ i) (f₁ i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl, rfl⟩
    cases h : repr u with | mk a f
    refine ⟨a, fun i => (f i).1.1, fun i => (f i).1.2, ?_, ?_, fun i => (f i).2⟩
    · rw [← abs_repr u, h, ← abs_map]
      rfl
    · rw [← abs_repr u, h, ← abs_map]
      rfl
  · rintro ⟨a, f₀, f₁, rfl, rfl, h⟩
    refine ⟨abs (.mk a fun i => ⟨(f₀ i, f₁ i), h i⟩), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← abs_map]
      rfl
    · rw [← abs_map]
      rfl

name: recF_eq
statement:
theorem recF_eq {α : Type _} (g : F α → α) (x : q.P.W) :
    recF g x = g (abs (q.P.map (recF g) x.dest))

name: recF_eq'
statement:
theorem recF_eq' {α : Type _} (g : F α → α) (a : q.P.A) (f : q.P.B a → q.P.W) :
    recF g ⟨a, f⟩ = g (abs (q.P.map (recF g) (.mk a f)))

name: recF_eq_of_Wequiv
statement:
theorem recF_eq_of_Wequiv {α : Type u} (u : F α → α) (x y : q.P.W) :
    Wequiv x y → recF u x = recF u y
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction h with
  | ind a f f' _ ih => simp only [recF_eq', PFunctor.map_eq, Function.comp_def, ih]
  | abs a f a' f' h => simp only [recF_eq', abs_map, h]
  | trans x y z _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact Eq.trans ih₁ ih₂

name: Wequiv.abs'
statement: theorem Wequiv.abs' (x y : q.P.W) (h : QPF.abs x.dest = QPF.abs y.dest) : Wequiv x y
proof:
:= by
  cases x
  cases y
  apply Wequiv.abs
  apply h

name: Wequiv.refl
statement: theorem Wequiv.refl (x : q.P.W) : Wequiv x x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, f⟩ := x
  exact Wequiv.abs a f a f rfl

name: Wequiv.symm
statement: theorem Wequiv.symm (x y : q.P.W) : Wequiv x y → Wequiv y x
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction h with
  | ind a f f' _ ih => exact Wequiv.ind _ _ _ ih
  | abs a f a' f' h => exact Wequiv.abs _ _ _ _ h.symm
  | trans x y z _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact QPF.Wequiv.trans _ _ _ ih₂ ih₁

name: Wrepr_equiv
statement: theorem Wrepr_equiv (x : q.P.W) : Wequiv (Wrepr x) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with | _ a f ih
  apply Wequiv.trans (v := PFunctor.W.mk (q.P.map Wrepr (.mk a f)))
  · apply Wequiv.abs'
    have : Wrepr ⟨a, f⟩ = PFunctor.W.mk (repr (abs (q.P.map Wrepr (.mk a f)))) := rfl
    rw [this, PFunctor.W.dest_mk, abs_repr]
    rfl
  apply Wequiv.ind; exact ih

name: Fix.rec_eq
statement:
theorem Fix.rec_eq {α : Type _} (g : F α → α) (x : F (Fix F)) :
    Fix.rec g (Fix.mk x) = g (Fix.rec g <$> x)
proof:
:= by
  have : recF g ∘ fixToW = Fix.rec g := by
    ext ⟨x⟩
    apply recF_eq_of_Wequiv
    rw [fixToW]
    apply Wrepr_equiv
  conv =>
    lhs
    rw [Fix.rec, Fix.mk]
    dsimp
  cases h : repr x with | mk a f
  rw [PFunctor.map_eq, recF_eq, ← PFunctor.map_eq, PFunctor.W.dest_mk, PFunctor.map_map, abs_map,
    ← h, abs_repr, this]

name: Fix.ind_aux
statement:
theorem Fix.ind_aux (a : q.P.A) (f : q.P.B a → q.P.W) :
    Fix.mk (abs (.mk a fun x => ⟦f x⟧)) = ⟦⟨a, f⟩⟧
proof:
:= by
  have : Fix.mk (abs (.mk a fun x => ⟦f x⟧)) = ⟦Wrepr ⟨a, f⟩⟧ := by
    apply Quot.sound; apply Wequiv.abs'
    rw [PFunctor.W.dest_mk, abs_map, abs_repr, ← abs_map, PFunctor.map_eq]
    simp only [Wrepr, recF_eq, PFunctor.W.dest_mk, abs_repr, Function.comp]
    rfl
  rw [this]
  apply Quot.sound
  apply Wrepr_equiv

name: Fix.ind_rec
statement:
theorem Fix.ind_rec {α : Type u} (g₁ g₂ : Fix F → α)
    (h : ∀ x : F (Fix F), g₁ <$> x = g₂ <$> x → g₁ (Fix.mk x) = g₂ (Fix.mk x)) :
    ∀ x, g₁ x = g₂ x
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x⟩
  induction x with | _ a f ih
  change g₁ ⟦⟨a, f⟩⟧ = g₂ ⟦⟨a, f⟩⟧
  rw [← Fix.ind_aux a f]; apply h
  rw [← abs_map, ← abs_map, PFunctor.map_eq, PFunctor.map_eq]
  congr 2 with x
  apply ih

name: Fix.rec_unique
statement:
theorem Fix.rec_unique {α : Type u} (g : F α → α) (h : Fix F → α)
    (hyp : ∀ x, h (Fix.mk x) = g (h <$> x)) : Fix.rec g = h
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  apply Fix.ind_rec
  intro x hyp'
  rw [hyp, ← hyp', Fix.rec_eq]

name: Fix.mk_dest
statement: theorem Fix.mk_dest (x : Fix F) : Fix.mk (Fix.dest x) = x
proof:
:= by
  change (Fix.mk ∘ Fix.dest) x = id x
  apply Fix.ind_rec (mk ∘ dest) id
  intro x
  rw [Function.comp_apply, id_eq, Fix.dest, Fix.rec_eq, id_map, comp_map]
  intro h
  rw [h]

name: Fix.dest_mk
statement: theorem Fix.dest_mk (x : F (Fix F)) : Fix.dest (Fix.mk x) = x
proof:
:= by
  unfold Fix.dest; rw [Fix.rec_eq, ← Fix.dest, ← comp_map]
  conv =>
    rhs
    rw [← id_map x]
  congr with x
  apply Fix.mk_dest

name: Fix.ind
statement: theorem Fix.ind (p : Fix F → Prop) (h : ∀ x : F (Fix F), Liftp p x → p (Fix.mk x)) : ∀ x, p x
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x⟩
  induction x with | _ a f ih
  change p ⟦⟨a, f⟩⟧
  rw [← Fix.ind_aux a f]
  apply h
  rw [liftp_iff]
  refine ⟨_, _, rfl, ?_⟩
  convert! ih

name: corecF_eq
statement:
theorem corecF_eq {α : Type _} (g : α → F α) (x : α) :
    PFunctor.M.dest (corecF g x) = q.P.map (corecF g) (repr (g x))

name: Cofix.dest_corec
statement:
theorem Cofix.dest_corec {α : Type u} (g : α → F α) (x : α) :
    Cofix.dest (Cofix.corec g x) = Cofix.corec g <$> g x
proof:
:= by
  conv =>
    lhs
    rw [Cofix.dest, Cofix.corec]
  dsimp
  rw [corecF_eq, abs_map, abs_repr, ← comp_map]; rfl

name: Cofix.bisim_aux
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x⟩ ⟨y⟩ rxy
  apply Quot.sound
  let r' x y := r (Quot.mk _ x) (Quot.mk _ y)
  have : IsPrecongr r' := by
    intro a b r'ab
    have h₀ :
      Quot.mk r <$> Quot.mk Mcongr <$> abs (PFunctor.M.dest a) =
        Quot.mk r <$> Quot.mk Mcongr <$> abs (PFunctor.M.dest b) :=
      h _ _ r'ab
    have h₁ : ∀ u v : q.P.M, Mcongr u v → Quot.mk r' u = Quot.mk r' v := by
      intro u v cuv
      apply Quot.sound
      simp only [r']
      rw [Quot.sound cuv]
      apply h'
    let f : Quot r → Quot r' :=
      Quot.lift (Quot.lift (Quot.mk r') h₁) <| by
        rintro ⟨c⟩ ⟨d⟩ rcd
        exact Quot.sound rcd
    have : f ∘ Quot.mk r ∘ Quot.mk Mcongr = Quot.mk r' := rfl
    rw [← this, ← PFunctor.map_map _ _ f, ← PFunctor.map_map _ _ (Quot.mk r), abs_map, abs_map,
      abs_map, h₀]
    rw [← PFunctor.map_map _ _ f, ← PFunctor.map_map _ _ (Quot.mk r), abs_map, abs_map, abs_map]
  exact ⟨r', this, rxy⟩

name: Cofix.bisim_rel
statement:
theorem Cofix.bisim_rel (r : Cofix F → Cofix F → Prop)
    (h : ∀ x y, r x y → Quot.mk r <$> Cofix.dest x = Quot.mk r <$> Cofix.dest y) :
    ∀ x y, r x y → x = y
proof:
:= by
  let r' (x y) := x = y ∨ r x y
  intro x y rxy
  apply Cofix.bisim_aux r'
  · intro x
    left
    rfl
  · intro x y r'xy
    rcases r'xy with r'xy | r'xy
    · rw [r'xy]
    have : ∀ x y, r x y → r' x y := fun x y h => Or.inr h
    rw [← Quot.factor_mk_eq _ _ this]
    dsimp [r']
    rw [@comp_map _ q _ _ _ (Quot.mk r), @comp_map _ q _ _ _ (Quot.mk r)]
    rw [h _ _ r'xy]
  right; exact rxy

name: Cofix.bisim
statement:
theorem Cofix.bisim (r : Cofix F → Cofix F → Prop)
    (h : ∀ x y, r x y → Liftr r (Cofix.dest x) (Cofix.dest y)) : ∀ x y, r x y → x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply Cofix.bisim_rel
  intro x y rxy
  rcases (liftr_iff r _ _).mp (h x y rxy) with ⟨a, f₀, f₁, dxeq, dyeq, h'⟩
  rw [dxeq, dyeq, ← abs_map, ← abs_map, PFunctor.map_eq, PFunctor.map_eq]
  congr 2 with i
  apply Quot.sound
  apply h'

name: Cofix.bisim'
statement:
theorem Cofix.bisim' {α : Type*} (Q : α → Prop) (u v : α → Cofix F)
    (h : ∀ x, Q x → ∃ a f f', Cofix.dest (u x) = abs ⟨a, f⟩ ∧ Cofix.dest (v x) = abs (.mk a f') ∧
      ∀ i, ∃ x', Q x' ∧ f i = u x' ∧ f' i = v x') :
    ∀ x, Q x → u x = v x
proof:
:= fun x Qx =>
  let R := fun w z : Cofix F => ∃ x', Q x' ∧ w = u x' ∧ z = v x'
  Cofix.bisim R
    (fun x y ⟨x', Qx', xeq, yeq⟩ => by
      rcases h x' Qx' with ⟨a, f, f', ux'eq, vx'eq, h'⟩
      rw [liftr_iff]
      exact ⟨a, f, f', xeq.symm ▸ ux'eq, yeq.symm ▸ vx'eq, h'⟩)
    _ _ ⟨x, Qx, rfl, rfl⟩

name: mem_supp
statement:
theorem mem_supp {α : Type u} (x : F α) (u : α) :
    u ∈ supp x ↔ ∀ a f, abs (.mk a f) = x → u ∈ f '' univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [supp]; dsimp; constructor
  · intro h a f haf
    have : Liftp (fun u => u ∈ f '' univ) x := by
      rw [liftp_iff]
      exact ⟨a, f, haf.symm, fun i => mem_image_of_mem _ (mem_univ _)⟩
    exact h this
  intro h p; rw [liftp_iff]
  rintro ⟨a, f, xeq, h'⟩
  rcases h a f xeq.symm with ⟨i, _, hi⟩
  rw [← hi]; apply h'

name: supp_eq
statement:
theorem supp_eq {α : Type u} (x : F α) :
    supp x = { u | ∀ a f, abs (.mk a f) = x → u ∈ f '' univ }

name: has_good_supp_iff
statement:
theorem has_good_supp_iff {α : Type u} (x : F α) :
    (∀ p, Liftp p x ↔ ∀ u ∈ supp x, p u) ↔
      ∃ a f, abs (.mk a f) = x ∧ ∀ a' f', abs (.mk a' f') = x → f '' univ ⊆ f' '' univ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : Liftp (· ∈ supp x) x := by rw [h]; intro u; exact id
    rw [liftp_iff] at this
    rcases this with ⟨a, f, xeq, h'⟩
    refine ⟨a, f, xeq.symm, ?_⟩
    intro a' f' h''
    rintro u ⟨i, _, hfi⟩
    have : u ∈ supp x := by rw [← hfi]; apply h'
    exact (mem_supp x u).mp this _ _ h''
  rintro ⟨a, f, xeq, h⟩ p; rw [liftp_iff]; constructor
  · rintro ⟨a', f', xeq', h'⟩ u usuppx
    rcases (mem_supp x u).mp usuppx a' f' xeq'.symm with ⟨i, _, f'ieq⟩
    rw [← f'ieq]
    apply h'
  intro h'
  refine ⟨a, f, xeq.symm, ?_⟩; intro i
  apply h'; rw [mem_supp]
  intro a' f' xeq'
  apply h a' f' xeq'
  apply mem_image_of_mem _ (mem_univ _)

name: supp_eq_of_isUniform
statement:
theorem supp_eq_of_isUniform (h : q.IsUniform) {α : Type u} (a : q.P.A) (f : q.P.B a → α) :
    supp (abs (.mk a f)) = f '' univ
proof:
:= by
  ext u; rw [mem_supp]; constructor
  · intro h'
    apply h' _ _ rfl
  intro h' a' f' e
  rw [← h _ _ _ _ e.symm]; apply h'

name: liftp_iff_of_isUniform
statement:
theorem liftp_iff_of_isUniform (h : q.IsUniform) {α : Type u} (x : F α) (p : α → Prop) :
    Liftp p x ↔ ∀ u ∈ supp x, p u
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftp_iff, ← abs_repr x]
  cases repr x with | mk a f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a', f', abseq, hf⟩ u
    rw [supp_eq_of_isUniform h, h _ _ _ _ abseq]
    rintro ⟨i, _, hi⟩
    rw [← hi]
    apply hf
  · intro h'
    refine ⟨a, f, rfl, fun i => h' _ ?_⟩
    rw [supp_eq_of_isUniform h]
    exact ⟨i, mem_univ i, rfl⟩

name: supp_map
statement:
theorem supp_map (h : q.IsUniform) {α β : Type u} (g : α → β) (x : F α) :
    supp (g <$> x) = g '' supp x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← abs_repr x]
  cases repr x with | mk a f
  rw [← abs_map, PFunctor.map_eq]
  rw [supp_eq_of_isUniform h, supp_eq_of_isUniform h, image_comp]

name: suppPreservation_iff_uniform
statement: theorem suppPreservation_iff_uniform : q.SuppPreservation ↔ q.IsUniform
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h α a a' f f' h'
    rw [← PFunctor.supp_eq, ← PFunctor.supp_eq, ← h, h', h]
  · intro h α x
    cases x with | mk a f
    rwa [supp_eq_of_isUniform, PFunctor.supp_eq]

name: suppPreservation_iff_liftpPreservation
statement: theorem suppPreservation_iff_liftpPreservation : q.SuppPreservation ↔ q.LiftpPreservation
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · intro α p x
    cases x with | mk a f
    have h' := h
    rw [suppPreservation_iff_uniform] at h'
    dsimp only [SuppPreservation, supp] at h
    rw [liftp_iff_of_isUniform h', supp_eq_of_isUniform h', PFunctor.liftp_iff']
    simp
  · intro α x
    cases x with | mk a f
    simp only [LiftpPreservation] at h
    simp only [supp, h]

name: liftpPreservation_iff_uniform
statement: theorem liftpPreservation_iff_uniform : q.LiftpPreservation ↔ q.IsUniform

statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem mk_get (x : Comp F G α) : Comp.mk (Comp.get x) = x
